Author: StrayCat5Penang, Malaysia
Title: Staff can't 'reprimand' teh customers!
Review: So Straits Quay, including Healy Mac is totally non-smoking, as are all public areas n Malaysia. So, why is it that customers can sit outside & smoke - many sitting right by the no smoking signs? Blatantly breaking the law, but the staff don't/won't ask customers to stop smoking. & the smoke blows through, making a bad atmosphere for non-smpkers.So many customers don't wear masks when away from their table - just walk around, & through to the mall/toilets with no mask. Breaking SOPs. Not right at all.& kids who use the bar area as a play ground while mum/dad sit at tables with their phones for company. Totally unsafe - just need a kid to run into staff carrying hot food or glasses of drink to cause an accident - & I am sure the parents would blame the staff if the kids got injured! The worst - apart from kids running around - was just before Christmas 2021: a kid in there on a scooter. The boy was maybe 6 year sold, just scooting from the mall corridor to the bar, through the tables, & back to the mall (which is the area where food comes out of the kitchen).Malaysians don't like to 'lose face'/ tell people what to do, but for everyones health & safety, they really must start to do so. Management...... can do much better.Also, every time HM branch gets a fine for breaking SOPs, the food prices increase & they are not good value any more. Beer prices seem to increase by the week (we never pay the same for the same drinks) as the brewery keeps upping the prices. & of course the customers are expected to absorb the additional costs. There are far better places to go than HM Straits Quay.Show less

However, some creative table rearrangement by the staff, inspired by the festive spirit, saved the day. (The takeaway is that Healy Mac’s popularity as a venue for Christmas has grown hugely since 2019 – reservations definitely recommended!)The menu offered a traditional Christmas feast with a choice of three dishes for the starter and main courses and two for dessert. All were excellent but the roast turkey and stuffing, baked ham with roast and mashed potatoes, Brussel sprouts, buttered carrots and all the dressings, were not to be denied on Christmas Day! The service was, as always, exemplary, despite the full house, and Hasan, Faisal, Das and their colleagues (not to forget the wizards slaving away in the kitchen for our delight!) get a hearty round of applause! The wings are seasoned with a spicy seasoning and done just right, with the skin a bit crispy and the meat juicy which makes for a heavenly delight. The meaty pizza is so delicious with the crust just right.The prices are extremely reasonable compared to similar places in Straits Quay. Author: rudddassLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Terrible service
Review: As a family of 6 adults & four children we went for a meal early evening at the Pizza place next to Healy Mac's at the Straits Quay. It would seem the pizza restaurant and Healy Mac's is owned by one person. Upon arrival due to lack of attention from any staff we arranged the chairs and tables for our large group. The waiter Kamal attended to us after a 15 minute wait. We ordered a jug of beers which we were told provided 4 glasses but we only managed to get three from each jug. It was meant to be a better deal than ordering 3 separate glasses.One adult ordered their meal and instead of taking the order for everyone else went away.We managed to attract his attention and requested him to take order for the rest of the group of 10. He started taking the order but without a order slip or some other method of recording the order. When he showed hesitation and seemed unsure we asked him to note it down. He looked to then be writing the order on a servitte. The pizzas started to arrive but with some ingredients missing. We requested some olives and chillies that were missing. We received 6 of our pizzas and then having waited for some time enquired about a missing pizza and were told we had received our complete order. We kindly requested the missing pizza which we recieved after a 20 minute wait and after everyone else had finished their meal. On the whole the service was very poor and the meal as a whole represented poor value for money. We paid over 500RM for the meal.I would definitely not recommend this establishment.Show less

The 2 meat dishes were outstanding, with my girls (even the baby!) demanding for more. The portions were extremely generous, and we were stuffed to the brim. At the end of our meal I caught my 3yo scraping her plate to get the last grain of rice. When she thought I wasn't looking she picked up her plate and picked it clean! We went back twice more, ordering the small portions (they do small, medium or large) and sampling different dishes and loved them all. The young couple running the restaurant have fantastic energy and Liang has great customer service skills. It was good to see most tables were booked each time we went in and it was apparent that many people were regulars. Review: We visited here on valentines night and after hearing the reviews thought it might be full but we were lucky and managed to get a table.Another hidden gem in Penang, in a dodgy building with around ten tables.The food was excellent and as others have said the lady that runs it is very enthusiastic and happy.Value for money it is great, would recommend a visit. Show less

Author: andi_wilsonWhitehaven, United Kingdom
Title: Fantastic & Energetic!
Review: Wow what a fantastic place! The food is sensational but it’s the wonderful lady chef/owner who really stands out! She’s sooooo friendly and hyper! Totally love her! I recommend the sizzling noodles. The quality of beef locally can be a bit hit and miss but here it is exceptional. I dare you not to fall in love with Knife & Fork!!The sister restaurant is Tam San Guan Seafood across the road, also amazing. Show less

Author: clairefrancis22b
Title: Fabulous restaurant
Review: The best food EVER. Top floor of a "not very inviting" building, above KFC. The lady owner is so lovely and hard working. Her restaurant at the beach is open in the day and this is her evening restaurant. The best food we've had so far if you like to eat locally. Cost £28 for 4 people with a drink each. Well worth a visit. We will definitely return before we leave.One tip......use the lift. Show less

Author: 797tonyf
Title: Great food and great welcome,
Review: Great food and great welcome, also try the restaurant by the beach. Very reasonable prices. We really enjoyed.

Author: stor_pappa_stenslandOslo, Norway
Title: The kind of place you just have to go to
Review: Was in Penang for 4 days, and ended up going here twice. Very very cool place, in the third floor of a 'shabby, but charming' mall. The kind of place you just never forget. Food was very good, I ordered the sizzling noodles both times. You know when you crave something, and then you get it – but its just not exactly what you wanted, like it almost fulfilled your craving but not quite? Well, my experience here was the opposite of that! Exactly what you want a wok-noodle dish to taste like! The couple that runs the restaurant are so sweet as well.For the price, this is for sure one of the best food-experiences I have ever had. Created a trip-advisor account just to write this review… I hope to eat here again some day.Show less

Author: kajasve
Title: The best in Malaysia
Review: This was amazing!! The food is the best we tasted i Malaysia. I made a trip-advisor profile just because I wanted to say this. The lady that is working there is the cutest ever, we are going to miss her.

Author: 993andrews
Title: Fantastic gem of a restaurant
Review: Fantastic gem of a restaurant well worth the effort of getting up the two flights of stairs to get to!The menu is simple but everything on it is delicious. Run by a lovely couple who work tirelessly to ensure you are being served quickly and efficiently. The wife’s laugh is infectious!Show less

Author: TristanB591Rotterdam, The Netherlands
Title: Good food, nothing wrong with it
Review: If you're looking for a nice platter of chinese food, this is a go to place.Lady in charge runs around the place trying to answer everyone's requests.She does a great job, but one person is only one person.This means you have to wait a while for your bill.Mostly visited by Europeans and they're right to do so.Great little eatery.Do reserve a table, she only has about 6 of them or arrive on time (shortly after 6 o'clock).Owners do their absolute best to give you good food and service, this is hard to come by in Penang's tourist area's nowadays.Show less

Author: T4908WOjamest
Title: Decent food, limited menu
Review: Had dinner with my wife there last week. Food was nice but a tad on the salty side. Price was reasonable. Food and drinks menu somewhat limited.

Author: marqueekarenUnited Kingdom
Title: Excellent food and service.
Review: We visited this restaurant in November with family and friends. The food was excellent especially the sizzling prawns and sweet and sour pork. The owners Laing and Loon are so happy to see you even if they are really busy, and make time to ensure your food is to your liking. This is a gem of a restaurant so if you are in batu ferringhi it is well worth a visitShow less

Author: B2235WBsandrar
Title: Excellent Food
Review:
Visited 3 times during our stay,delicious food good wine at reasonable prices.well worth a visit
Top floor Eden Parade

Author: pigley70Singapore, Singapore
Title: Hidden gem!
Review: Ate here last night. It is in a shopping mall above KFC and overlooks McDonald's and adjacent gas station. About 40 seats with basic decor and the place filled up when we ate there about 7:30pm.FANTASTIC service, the couple who run it are doing an amazing job doing both the service and cooking - they earn their money!Limited menu done very well at a very reasonable price.Highly recommend. Would eat here again.Show less

Author: Sunara2015Penang Island, Malaysia
Title: A small neat place tucked away in on top of a sad looking Eden Parade
Review: We went for dinner to this place after reading rave reviews on Trip Advisor. Located on the second floor of Eden Parade, a building badly in need of a coat of paint, we found the place by literally walking around the floor once we got off the elevator. It is a small, charming place that looked clean and well kept. The hostess was friendly, spoke excellent English, and was very hospitable.We ordered just three dishes, sizzling prawns, a mixed vegetable dish, and what seemed like their signature dish, the black vinegar chicken. With steamed rice and green tea, we were all set for a quiet dinner for two. The first dish did not disappoint. The prawns were fresh, juicy and crunchy. We will recommend this to anyone. The veggie dish was just what you would find anywhere. We had no complaints. The chicken dish was a disappointment because the chicken was coated with too much of a thick sauce that made the crispy exterior soggy, And there was no real vinegar flavor either. Perhaps less sauce on the meat might have helped. Or maybe, serving the sauce on the side might be a better idea so guests can add the sauce according to their taste. Our overall impression was positive though we felt a little let down by the chicken dish that we had so looked forward to. In my experience, black vinegar chicken is not a dish commonly found in Chinese restaurants. This is a dish they can develop as their unique offering. We will give 5 stars for service, 4 stars for value and 3 stars for food on our first outing to this place. That would add up to an average of 4 stars overall. We will definitely go back and see if the vinegar chicken gets better.Show less

Author: gisiv2019
Title: Super super nice staff!
Review: Super super nice staff! And really good crispy chicken <3 was more than happy to find this place....

Author: ryde1980w
Title: Tasty
Review: Good food at a very fair price. Great they did the half portions. Very friendly staff who were attentive.

Author: erictantuanhwee
Title: HOME COOKED CHINESE FOOD SERVED WITH A SMILE
Review:
A small but delightful Malaysian Chinese restaurant serve delicious home cooked Chinese food in the heart of Batu Ferringhi   
An eater paradise 👍👍👍

Ferringhi.

Author: Jo2409Melbourne Aust
Title: Diamond in the Rough
Review: Reading reviews looking for a restaurant dinner when i came across Knife and Fork. We got there in a Grab MR7 from Bayview Beach Resort. So happy we made the effort. Liang and Loon provided us with a delicious dinner. We ordered 4 small plates so we could try different things. Sizzle prawns, curry chicken, honey caramalized pork and fried rice. Perfect and fullfilling. Liang you are such a busy hospitable waiter, cook. Highly recommendShow less

Author: Fiona MEdinburgh, United Kingdom
Title: Well worth finding your way to this little gem
Review: We have enjoyed Liang's cooking for some years at her lunchtime spot Tai Sam Guan Seafood (on the lane between the Golden Sands and the Lone Pine hotels, so were delighted to here that her Chinese offering was now an option at Knife and Fork (which had served Western food in the past). So we had to try it and we were not disappointed. The food was amazing - and the black vinegar chicken was tremendous, both crisp and soft, and very delicious. The food is reasonable and drinks pretty usual price for restaurants. It is on the second floor above KFC, and there is a lift or stairs (the elevator has never worked in all the years we have visited the building, unless we have just been unlucky).Show less

Author: TalaforniaDublin, Ireland
Title: Don't miss out!
Review: Must visit while in Batu Ferringhi. The hosts are incredibly nice despite being so busy! Food was exceptional, I can recommend the spring rolls and any of the meat dishes with gravy and veg. The white wine was also really good (and cold!). Great service and atmosphere. We had to go back. Thanks for a lovely experience (x2). (Check photo for location, it's up top there, don't be put off by the rustic route up, it's well worth it!)Show less

Author: 920michellecDa'an, Taipei
Title: Yum, Yum, and Yum (finally a great place to get pork)
Review: Loved the food at this restaurant we had the black vinegar chicken and the spicy pork. Both dishes were deep fried meat beautifully sauced (did not make the crispy batter soggy). The hospitality was like her brothers restaurant next door just delightful. My husband and I are not used to a lot of garlic so we were a bit sensitive to the overall taste but still adored the dishes.Show less

Author: DellickSingapore, Singapore
Title: Safe first night option
Review: Given the reviews we thought Knife and Fork would be a good first night option - which it was. It’s location on the third floor of the KFC Building (that’s not about chicken) is a bit unusual and the ambience isn’t much to write home about but the food was good and Liang bustles around both cooking and waiting. We ate a prawn curry and the black vinegar chicken both of which we enjoyed. Show less

Author: AnneBGoulburn
Title: Great service and meals
Review: We were a family of 8 and all the dishes we ordered were delicious. The menu is mostly home cooked Chinese but not like the 'local' in your town. Beer was really cold. The service was excellent and we’d recommend visiting this charming casual restaurant.

Author: darth-tataBirmingham, United Kingdom
Title: Superb!
Review: I felt compelled to review as the food and service were incredible! The restaurant itself is a little hidden away up a few flights of stairs but don’t be put off the food is worth it. We couldn’t have asked for better service and the food was freshly prepared for us. We all enjoyed everything that was served up to us and left with full tummies! The cost of the food was ridiculously cheap for what we received. Definitely worth a visit. We will be back.Show less

Author: sharmarkUK
Title: Hidden Gem
Review: Tired of trying the local cuisine and fancied something different, checked TripAdvisor for local restaurants & so glad I picked this little hidden gem!!This is run by husband and wife team, the food is freshly cooked, whilst the menu may seem small, Liang is more than happy to prepare a meal not on the menu.We were a family of 4 and the bill was extremely reasonable give the good quality and generous portion of food.The place was quite as we arrived but please don’t let this fool you, give Liang and Loon a try & you will be pleasantly surprised!!Thank you both for a wonderful meal, especially from the kids.Show less

Author: 240katiehChester, United Kingdom
Title: Totally felicious
Review: A little difficult to find but head to McDonald’s, look left and up, it’s on the top floor. Food and service was totally stunning. Ran by husband and wife who simply can not do enough for you. Totally understand why this is number 1. Quality food for such a good price. We left a huge tip as the food was worth far more than we were charged. Show less

Author: CityGuy1973Chelmsford, United Kingdom
Title: Classically simple, with excellent friendly service and flavours
Review: This was our first time here when visiting Penang and given the rave reviews on TA, we had to go.This place can be found in the second floor of a corner plaza; the TA map shows it the other side of the road but when you get to the location just look opposite and you’ll see the logo on the second floor. There is a lift service available but we opted for the stair/escalator given the lift didn’t look in great shape. On arrival the restaurant was simple in layout and decor but we didn’t come for that. The simplicity does not detract from the experience which was excellent from start to finish. The hostess was very bubbly and friendly, the menu straightforward offering Asian and western dishes, with drinks offered with ice and glasses.Everything here was super cheap with small dishes around 13 RM and large ones about 23RM. Soft drinks wee 3 RM so around 60 pence sterling for a can!We will definitely be coming back here; I cannot recommend this place enough. Show less

Author: KrystelVerkerkRotterdam, The Netherlands
Title: Best Lemon Chicken EVER!!!
Review: For a few years we have been having lunch in the little street besides the Golden Sands when we heard the owner has a restaurant close by during the evening. And so we went tot have dinner. It was such a cozy little restaurant with a nice atmosphere. And... last but not least, she and her husband serve superb food! The Lemon Chicken is not on the menu but if you ask, she will make it for you. The absolute best!!Show less

Author: HB500
Title: Great quality, value and service
Review: Our host and owner of the restaurant Liang ensures your dining experience is delightful. The decor is basic, but the food is fresh, tasty, great value, made to order and delivered with a smile. Children and adults well catered for by the menu. We also discovered Liang has a food stall in a lane alongside the Golden Sands and does fantastic lunches there ranging from 6RM to 15RM. We ate at the restaurant twice and the food stall 3 times. Highly recommend both venues. By the way, her brother Andrew has a restaurant Andrew's Kampung - also terrific.Show less

Author: DLKMac
Title: Delicious food, warm and friendly host
Review: Visited this restaurant based on Tripadvisor reviews and weren’t disappointed! The food was delicious, especially the sizzling prawns and black pepper pork. The owner was just lovely, very welcoming. A must-visit restaurant if you are staying in Batu Feringgi!

Author: davidsL2675DT
Title: Great food at good prices
Review: Staying at nearby Rasa Sayang resort, we visited this place due to good Trip Advisor ratings. Food was excellent and a really friendly host too.

Author: Thommo68Bournemouth, United Kingdom
Title: Great find!!
Review: After a boat trip for the day we wanted something local for dinner (which wasn’t in the hotel) & found this place on TripAdvisor. We got there at 7:30pm & there was only one other table occupied but by 8pm it was packed & buzzing!! Liang is a wonderful welcoming host! Nothing was too much trouble & they prepared a dish that wasn’t on the menu without any issue. She & Loon were amazing, doing everything between them ... cooking, serving & clearing up. Probably the best meal so far in Penang (& amazing value!!!) ... definitely worth a visit if you are in the area!!!Show less

Author: xsarahx101
Title: lovely little restaurant
Review: We visited this restaurant 2 times in our visit. It is a lovely little restaurant that makes you feel at home. It is only one couple behind the whole restaurant - waitressing and making the food, making it that little more special. The food is cooked freshly based on your order and is delicious! Show less

Author: BernieandMandyC
Title: Delicious
Review: So glad we found this hidden treasure ! Delicious food and wonderful service- not expensive and well worth a visit - thanks Liane 👍

Author: nooshandGoofy
Title: A little jem
Review:
We visited this little jem for a second time and we weren’t disappointed.
We were treated with the most friendly and welcoming smile
Food was honest and fast
A great little place and worth a visit 
Try it yourself

Author: Nick ZMelbourne, Australia
Title: Worth the effort
Review: It’s certainly a challenging place to a non local to find. Google maps had me looking on the beachside but it’s on the other side of the road. Look for the building with KFC, go up the escalators and walk to the opposite side of the building through Andrews. It’s worth the effort as everything is genuine from the service to the lovely food. If I get a chance I’ll be back.Show less

Author: ko883
Title: Unpretentious dinner
Review: The place and the food are unpretentiously simple and nice. Good place to have a sample of local Malaysia home cook style  food at down to earth price and settings.

Author: Mika KOulu, Finland
Title: Super tasty and so friendly service
Review: First I need to say that you will be regretting if you are not visiting this place!The restaurant is located in the Upper floors of the business building and getting there you need to use the stairs. But I promise you it is not for nothing, the Food is super tasty and the lady keeping the restaurant is the sweetest person you'll find. She is making you to feel comfortable and on top of that she is a master chef! She cooks the food by herself and you can follow her in action while sitting by the table.We ate few dishes and my favorite was clearly the honey caramelised chicken. So crunchy and so good!This place is a must visit at least one time or two during your vacation, do not miss the chance!Show less

Author: annarC2907QZ
Title: Great food
Review: We visited here earlier in May. We got lots of tasty food and people were friendly. Nice and cheap 👍🏻 I recommend! :)

Author: adandangBrisbane, Australia
Title: Fantastic night out!
Review: Great food and service from the owners at this hidden gem. We had the special chicken curry, fried rice, sizzling chicken and sizzling mixed seafood with noodles - all were amazing. Good value for money on both food and drinks. The washroom was very clean too! Great experience! Show less

Author: garrynsuef
Title: Best sizzles plate ever!
Review: Our friends have been eating food cooked by Liang and her family for 15 years! You’ll love it they said. And we sure did. Liang cooks the best sizzle plates in Batu Ferringhi, yummy curries and very tasty rice. Fresh ingredients, perfectly cooked prawns and a lovely vegetable plate with greens made this my favourite place to eat. The building is opposite Golden Sands hotel. Take the lift to the second floor and walk around to the other side. See the picture of the view of the mountains. Very nice. Liang loves to cook and will make you very welcome. We will be back! See you again Liang! Thanks for dinner!Show less

Author: jordyt117Arnhem, The Netherlands
Title: Good food for a small price
Review: I was a little bit fed up with the restaurants at my resort. So I decided to check some of the local restaurants in the neighborhood.On TripAdvisor I found Knife and Fork. The first time I tried to find the restaurant I failed to find it. I misread the location and I was not aware the restaurant was in some kind of shopping mall complex on the second floor.So the next day I tried again and found the place. I passed by Andrew Kampung which was quite full with customers. And when I reached Fork and Knife it was empty. But I didn’t cared.My mind was set to eat here.I was greeted by the lovely host/chef. I ordered several dishes, from shizzling beef and shrimps to honey something chicken and Chinese fried rice. And of course I had a tiger beer to complete my order.The food was really nice and for the price it felt if I was stealing the food. I only paid around 114 rm for lots of food with beer.I was looking forward for the next day to eat here again, but they told me they were not going to be open.I would recommend this restaurant whenever your are visiting Bukin Ferringhi.Show less

Author: RedTeddRossendale, United Kingdom
Title: Wonderful
Review: The restaurant is on the second floor of a shopping mall. It’s not ‘dodgy’ at all and there’s a fully functioning lift plus a restaurant next door.The food is top class irrespective of cost.We had the small portions but didn’t finish them.The sizzling chicken, garlic/ginger chicken,fried rice,fried noodles ,a large beer and glass of wine cost 78 ringgits,but don’t focus on price as the food was very good.The hostess was so friendly,even booked us a Grab taxi.Four star,not five,purely because of the outside view ( McDonalds !) but visit here,it’s great.Show less

Author: George SLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Open Agai New Menu
Review: Good to see this little resteraunt open againReasonable priced English type meals (probably the nearest you will get to the real thing) and a limited but decent number of Chinese dishes now..Run by the nicest young couple in Penang who also have the Hawker stall for a nice lunch situated on the route to the sea through the car park at the side of Golden Sands hotelBoth places reasonably priced and service with a smileShow less

Author: wifeandmumofthree
Title: Great food
Review: Fantastic food.  Would highly recommend. Great variety of food.  Resturant was clean and staff can’t do enough for you.  Will definitely be back.

Author: emilybuckby97
Title: Flavoursome food with extremely friendly owners
Review: We have been for 3 nights in a row for dinner and have not been disappointed. The food is delicious (favourite dishes being the sweet and sour chicken, Liang’s special curry chicken and sizzling beef) Would recommend to everyone!

Author: scooterfranFareham, United Kingdom
Title: Fabulous
Review: We visited here twice during our 6 nights in Batu Ferringi.The menu is small serving with western food or Asian.We opted for the Asian on both occasions.The first time the service was a bit slow as Liang and her husband do the cooking and front of house themselves with no help. However we didn’t mind as the food was so incredible when it came out that we were stunned at what they were doing on their own.The caramelised honey pork was amazing, so delicious, the sizzling beef so tender and flavoursome and the sweet and sour chicken melt in the mouth, we also had a small side of noodles and rice and left sated and ready for bed.The second time we had booked a table and the service was just lovely, this time we had the caramelised honey chicken and swapped the beef for sizzling prawns. Again the food was exquisite and by far the best meal we had in Malaysia.The drink menu is either beer, wine or soft drinks.Please visit you will not be disappointed.Show less

Author: Les B
Title: Excellent Food
Review: The food was very good with plenty of choices and the staff were very friendly and helpful on choice of food.

Author: 413clivebBrisbane Region, Australia
Title: Brilliant
Review: Mine Host Liang is a beautiful person full of life and enthusiasm which not only makes for a very pleasant evening but shows in the wonderful food she and her husband Loon prepare. This little restaurant is spotlessly clean, the food a delight, prawns that are so delicious and the sizzling dishes are fantastic and huge. A little hard to find but worth the effort. Show less

Author: Drivers22Poole, United Kingdom
Title: Unbelievable Nyonya Food! Plus more!
Review: Everything about this restaurant is wonderful. The owner operators Liang and Loon are just brilliant, friendly and are genuinely pleased to cook for you. Everything is cooked to order and they offer a varied menu. However the highlights are Liangs Curry (not to be missed) and great sizzling dishes with your choice of meat or fish. They also serve pork here which is s bonus as many places do not serve pork in Penang. We ate here three times on our recent visit and will definitely be back next time.Show less

Author: SharonSp66
Title: Sharon S
Review: Lovely little place run by Liang and Loon, great food and would highly recommend a visit. Serves Chinese food and also western food so theres something for everyone and so cheap

Author: trevor b
Title: Good value
Review: Re-opened and  has added Chinese dishes to the old western menu. Leane is an excellent host and together with her husband provide very good food at a very reasonable price. Suggest you book as often is full.

Author: SkippyDDLondon, United Kingdom
Title: So Good We Visited Twice in Two Days!
Review: What a find....a delightful restaurant run brilliantly well by Lianne and her husband only recently re-opened. Totally charming, nothing is too much trouble with delicious, fresh food. We loved the Black Vinegar Chicken and sizzling dishes but everything we tried was excellent. So good, we visited twice in two days. The restaurant is located on the second floor of the retail /office block near Andrew’s restaurant. Great food and a warm welcome runs in the family. Definitely worth a visit. Show less

Author: 211selinan
Title: Friendly neighborhood restaurant
Review: So happy this restaurant has reopened. The menu has expanded to include Chinese cuisine,  apart from their signature Western fare.  Try the Pork Wonderland, also the liver and onions.  Superb.  And the customer service is wonderful.

Author: worktopsteveWalton-On-Thames, United Kingdom
Title: November 2018 in Penang
Review: Visit Penang twice a year, this was the first time that we visited the Knife & Fork. It only used to serve Western Dishes but now has a Chinese Menu, the food is all freshly cooked, good quality, large portions and a great atmosphere. The Sweet & Sour Pork is the just the best. Well done Liang & Loon can not wait to see you again in May.Show less

Author: Julia W
Title: Great value, personal service
Review: Laing’s restaurant is fab value and very tasty food at incredible prices. Just ask her to decide for you and let her bring out a banquet. Anyone staying at the Shanghai La should put this on their agenda. A definite visit.

Author: KevinG2627
Title: Mr & Mrs G and family
Review: Our first time at knife and fork but can't rate the quality of food and service enough,  and highly recomemnd the black vinegar chicken,  sizzling prawns and caramelized hoeney chicken,  kids had Cumberland sausage and chips and we loved it

Author: miloaustraliaaustralia
Title: Cute as a button
Review: Laing’s restaurant is a lovely little restaurant opposite Golden Sands Hotel. Nothing is too much trouble for this gorgeous lady, she is a joy. The food is excellent and the view from this high up restaurant is great especially at sunset. Also visit her lunch time restaurant in the ally next to the Golden Sands Hotel absolutely amazing food and so cheap. We will certainly be back. Thank you Liang.Show less

Author: jurob2014
Title: Little gem of a restaurant
Review: Excellent little restaurant.   Good food great service.   Generous portions at good value.   Nothing is too much trouble, any dish was available in a vegetarian option,  you just have to ask.  Well worth a  visit or two.

Author: Linda572145Oxenford, Australia
Title: Great Food !!
Review: First visit to this recently opened restaurant & there will be many more.What a gem this is , the owner Liang is so friendly & accommodating.The food was excellent a choice of Chinese , Malay or Western.Very reasonably priced & delicious.Friendly casual atmosphere , very airy & pleasant setting..The restaurant is situated on the top floor above the CIMB Bank.facing the service/gas station.I will definitely return. Highly recommend a visit to this lovely gem of a restaurant.Show less

Author: BoewingboyPerth, Australia
Title: Hidden gem in batu ferenghi
Review: Liang's new restaurant for dinner is a great value alternative to dining to her lunch time restaurant which is located in the alley adjacent to golden sands. The location is in the second floor above the KFC near the petrol station on the same level as Andrew's kampung.Food caters to western and Asian palates at very reasonable prices. Highly recommend the black vinegar chicken a dish we have numerous times whenever we holiday in penang.Open every day except Tuesdays. Even great cooks need a holiday so order double on Monday nightsShow less

Author: if_i_should_fallLondon
Title: Hooray! Knife and Fork is open again!
Review: We were delighted to visit Penang again and find that the sweet couple from our favourite lunch spot (The Ok Cafe down the alley near Golden Sands Hotel) have reopened their evening location, Knife and Fork. The menu is now a mix of Western and Chinese food, with their popular sizzling dishes now available.We had some wonderfully cold beers and then ordered 'Pork Wonderland' which was good quality pork loin with bacon and pineapple in a yummy sauce, with chips and peas, and for my husband the sizzling pork, a black vinegar chicken (sounds weird but you must try it!) and some egg fried rice. Everything was delicious.Wish Liang and Loon every success, they deserve it.Show less

Author: avsidolforPenygroes, United Kingdom
Title: Evening meal
Review: Knife and fork has now reopened after a year closure. Someone recommended this restaurant.It's on the 2nd floor round the corner from her brothers restaurant Andrew Kampunk.I must say the food was beautiful and tasty . We opted for a medium size meal but it was huge and well worth the money.The sweet and sour chicken had a crispy thin coating even with the sauce on top.the chicken in caramelized honey was also lovely served with noodles and fried rice.The menu is small for now but has plans to add more starters but she would cook you anything for you that was not on the menu.Highly recommended pleasant service and we are going there again tonight as we really enjoyed it.Try it you won't be disappointed.Also there is a lift to go up.Show less

Author: Krissykris156Woodford, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent
Review: This is a gem!Food is excellent and owner Lianne is just a joy to behold.Homemade iced tea, pork wonderland with proper gravy and crunchy steamed vegetables...Perfect!Leek and vegetable soup to start, chocolate cake and ice cream for dessert... what's not to love in an open, airy and fresh restaurant.Have already booked again before the end of the holiday!Show less

Author: Joan MNelson, United Kingdom
Title: A real gem
Review: This is a small restaurant serving excellent western food. It is reached via the lift to the second floor in Eden Parade. The food is very good, the service is friendly and efficient and the prices are very reasonable. We have visited several times during our stay and look forward to coming back.Show less

Author: 623SteveD623
Title: Great food, fantastic service.
Review:
This is a great restaurant serving western food in Battu Ferringhi.
The food is of the highest quality, and the service from the restaurant owners is nothing short of outstanding. 
I recommend this restaurant very highly.

Author: PaulM018Southland
Title: Great food, wonderful atmosphere
Review: I'm glad not many people know about this gem. It's easy to find. Just get the lift at the Eden Parade building to the 2nd floor and then double back around the outside of the building and you will find Knife and Fork. Excellent and tasty food at good price, relaxed atmosphere, friendly service.Show less

Author: 211selinanBatu Ferringhi, Malaysia
Title: Quaint little place with good service and food
Review: This neighborhood restaurant serves a variety of western food. Our favorite is the Pork Wonderland. We also love their liver dish that is served on a generous helping of mashed potatoes. The set dinner is reasonably priced as well. Fantastic service from the couple who runs the place. Show less

Author: lizb617Glasgow, United Kingdom
Title: Best place to eat in Penang
Review: This restaurant is an amazing place to eat run by an amazing woman don't let the walk up the stairs to get to it put u of food is delicious & staff can't do enough to help u & make u feel welcome the owner also runs a day time restaurant close to the beach It's not in George Town but in the near by beach resort opposite the Shangri-La & 10 minutes from the Hard Rock Cafe which we also visited but the knife and forks food & staff where far superior The picture below is the owner & chef at both places & is truly a talented & wonderful person if ur visiting Penang u must treat ur self to a meal here & it truly is a treat with unbelievable prices a family of 4 eating starters , main course & having a couple of drinks for about £30 Show less

Author: jennylbMargaret River, Australia
Title: Hidden Gem
Review: Charming little restaurant owned by the delightful Lianne, the sister of Andrew who has the other restaurant Andrews Kampung just along the corridor.You know sometimes when you're on holidays in Asia and you overload on all the gorgeous spicy delights, sometimes you just yearn for something simple like a real pork bacon sandwich , liver bacon and onions or a chip buttie. , well guess what..... you will get that at the Knife and Fork. Nothing fancy, just great plain good old fashioned comfort tucker!! And even better it won't break the bank. In fact she is offering a 3 course meal of soup, any choice of main course ( and there is a good choice ) and dessert ( mostly ice cream) wait for it....... MYR 23. Yep you read that right MYR23. Thanks Lianne we had a lovely meal and will be back next time we are in Batu Feringghi.Show less

Author: CarolC5485
Title: Best Western Restaurant in Penang
Review: Liang & Loon are the perfect hosts for a great Western Meal!  They have created a beautiful restaurant and the food is the best!!  Will always return for a good meal and excellent service and very friendly people.

Author: kkazzproMelbourne, Australia
Title: desperate for some good home cooking..
Review: After weeks in Penang and desperate for some good home cooking this restaurant is a must to visit. The hosts are extremely welcoming and the restaurant is modern and very clean. Felt like I was sitting in a restaurant back home. The food is delicious and the menu has your favourite dishes like your mother makes. Very reasonably priced.Will definitely go back there.Show less

Author: Lynn G
Title: Great food, great value
Review: A must whenever we are in Batu Ferringhi Loon and Liang are the perfect hosts and the European food makes a very pleasant change from all the delights of the other local restaurants. There is a good range of food which is all freshly cooked. Husband loves the fish and chips! Also try lunch at Loon and Liang' s in the little lane that runs down to the beach, just to the left of Golden Sands. All the food is fantastic. Try the sizzling chicken, it's the absolute best in Penang!Show less

Author: webheathRedditch, United Kingdom
Title: A excellent and impressive taste of home (UK)
Review: If you want to break the rules and eat some western food while in Batu Ferringghi then you can't do better than eating here.Liang and Loon provide home cooked food of the finest order which is all prepared and cooked from scratch on site.Don't waste time trying to find better quality and value for money else where. Their menu is frequently expanding to cater for even greater western tastes with items such as, liver and onions, bangers and mash (both at weekends only), signature dishes such as Pork or Chicken Maryland, and even the humble "chip butty" can be cooked to order.It should also be noted that this is one of extremely few restaurants to serve pork in the area.Go and try.(Mr & Mrs Medium)Show less

Author: stanburyspain
Title: One year on and still as good
Review: Well done Li you have got even better , this lovely little place is packed every night, that's because the owners are so lovely and the food is excellent see you again next year Li

Author: webheathRedditch, United Kingdom
Title: Consistently exceptional
Review: Yet again, thoroughly enjoyed this exceptional value for money for a home cooked meal like Mother used to make. Never fails to exceed expectations with an extended menu this year. Will certainly visit again a number of times before returning to UK.If you want a little taste of English cuisine for a change, this is an absolute must visit.Mr MediumShow less

Author: Henk MVlaardingen, The Netherlands
Title: It's all in the family
Review: When "Knife and Fork Restaurant" has cast its magical spell with the enthusiastic and uncomplicated hospitality of the owner, the cheerful interior and, most important, the delicious Western food, it is no surprise to hear that the owner of "Knife and Fork" is the sister of Andrew, the owner of the famous "Andrew's Kampung" restaurant, on the same second floor of the "Eden Parade" building. Hospitality and top quality food is evidently "all in the family". Enter the Eden Parade building through the center hallway; take the elevator to the second floor and walk around the gallery. Knife and Fork restaurant is opposite the Petronas petrol station (whereas Andrew's overlooks the Golden Sands Hotel). The mainstay of the menu of "Knife and Fork" is Western food; I selected the grilled fish with matching delicious sauce and French fries and green peas. It was a complete feast. Well done and the 5 point rating is hugely deserved.Show less

Author: JeanetteR156
Title: Tasty Food in Pleasant Surrounding
Review: After 3 weeks of local food felt the need for some "home" food.  Chose the carrot and coriander soup which was delicious, followed by Cumberland sausages in an onion gravy. Could not fault the food or service and would definitely recommend this restaurant.

Author: Jodi R
Title: Awesome!
Review: Great western food at a decent price. The owners and cooks are very friendly. They are welcoming and make it a fun, pleasant experience. Highly recommended!!

Author: retiredGoa
Title: Leang and Loon well done
Review: Fantastic restaurant, great service and wonderful food.  A little hard to find but worth the search.  Opposite Golden Sands hotel  above KFC.  In Batu Ferringhi.

Author: JazAdams
Title: OK
Review: The starter was not that nice I had a salad. It looked nice but the taste was average. I got chicken and chips for main course the chips were nice but the chicken did not even taste like real chicken it tasted like Mc Donalds chicken burger...... The desert was nice though and the staff were polite and even gave us the chicken free.Show less

Author: Mike LGreater Melbourne, Australia
Title: A welcome change
Review: this restaurant is on the second floor of the Eden shopping centre. The first thing you are taken by is its presentation, immaculately clean ! The chefs and owners Liang and Loon also have the OK cafe during the day which is also excellent, and in the family is Andrews restaurant on the same level. The food is predominately Western and what I would describe in Australia as a very good counter tea, which quite fits the bill after a while. They are very talented chefs and so friendly and hospitable. The pricing is cheap, but the food is not.Show less

Author: Travelling_retireesPerth, Australia
Title: We had western food for a change In Penang
Review: We have lunch at Liang and Loons cafe which is in a lane between Lone Pine hotel and Golden Sands hotel. The cafe specialises in Malaysian and Chinese meals.On our first visit for lunch this trip Liang told us about their new restaurant on 2nd floor of 1 Eden parade which is opposite the service stationIn July we visited Knife and Fork and were greeted warmly by Liang. The restaurant is very clean and also has beautiful clean toilets. She took us through the menu and for Rm 19 we could have had a selection of soup, any main course with a selection of 2 side dishes, sweets and also a choice of tea or coffee.Not feeling especially hungry we chose pork wonderland with a selection of 2 side dishes . After a little while Loon served us our meal which consisted of 2 pieces of crumbed pork, mashed potatoes, mushy peas, pineapple, bacon and a tasty sauce. The meal tasted as good as it looked and there was plenty of it.Also the cold Tiger beers are reasonably priced.Show less

Author: LorrainepatriciatoddPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Very pleasant restaurant and food.
Review: We had dinner here on Monday evening 13 April. The food was fresh and nice and the owner also very pleasant. We had the fish n chips with mushy peas and tartare sauce and the Pork Wonderland which were both really good and as we live locally we will be back again. Nice ambience also. Would recommend you try it and it is also very reasonably priced.Show less

Author: davidpauline27Cleckheaton, United Kingdom
Title: A Great additional enterprise for Liang and Loon
Review: Visited twice in February and March 2015.Liang and Loon are the most welcoming and friendly couple you could wish to meet. The Western food was welcome change after eating mostly oriental food for a month, Pork real mash potato and processed peas were well prepared what more could you ask for. Other western meals are available from a limited menu which insures every meal is perfectly prepared. See you again in February 2016.Show less

Author: webheathRedditch, United Kingdom
Title: Fantastic Western food and incredible value for money - a must have experience!!!!!!!!
Review: Liang and Loon have definately got it right. If you want the taste of high quality western food while in Penang this is an opportunity and a delight which must not be missed. This family run restaurant buys, prepares and serves with the spirit of ensuring their customers thoroughly enjoy the experience in Knife and Fork. This is a high quality food, down to earth experience provided by the most sincere and willing to please people I have met anywhere in the world.Value for money is fantastic. (Mr medium)Show less

Author: sunlover191282
Title: What a find.
Review: The food is great .The staff are so helpful .Well worth a visit.A nice change to eat weston  food cooked  well.

Author: Tony186356Nottingham, United Kingdom
Title: Great Western Food
Review: Laing has found a real niche market by serving simple but excellent western food in the middle of Batu Ferringhi. The set meal consists of homemade soup, anything off the main menu and ice cream and cake to follow. The main meals consist of two kinds of fish either grilled or fried, chicken or pork. Her speciality is pork wonderland.All the food is fresh and comes with two of the following mashed potato, steamed vegetables, chips, salad or tomato rice.The restaurant is clean, bright and the decor colourful. Liang is one of the most bubbly characters you could wish to meet.We will there again in November when we return to Penang.Show less

Author: Jeff BPinjarra, Australia
Title: New kids on the block
Review: A new restaurant has opened in batu feringhi called the knife and fork restaurant its a western style food outlet.It is oposite the golden sands resort on the second floor alongside the kampung retaurantIt is run by liang and loon from the alley alongside golden sand very friendly couple i feel like i am preaching to the coverted but they are nice people and deserve a try.Show less

Author: ChalkybIver, United Kingdom
Title: Western food
Review: If you're looking for something from home give this place a try, the food is very good and all cooked fresh. We had the fish and chips with mushy peas and tartar sauce the fish was excellent very moist and the batter was nice and crisp. Will we go again? Of course we will!!Show less

Author: 2MaurenPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Best of the West
Review: Liang and Loon serve some of the best food in Batu Ferringhi. Food is simple and delightful. From the soup, the choice of mail course and the simple sweet is superb. Simply the best! Her brother (Andrew) runs the Kampung restaurant on the same floor. Another great place. We visit each place at least once a week!Show less

Author: AlwaysAClaretBurnley, United Kingdom
Title: A change from the norm ( and a good Gluten Free choice )
Review: If you want a change from the delicious local food offerings in Penang, then try a visit to this reasonably newly opened restaurant. The welcome is always enthusiastic and the food varied and extremely tasty, although mainly Western. Liang makes delicious soups with varied ingredients and the main courses come with a variety of sauces ( even the "boring" sauce is extremely tasty ! ). Being intolerant to Gluten is sometimes difficult abroad but because Liang researches and makes most things herself she is extremely knowledgeable about the ingredients.Always a pleasure to visit ( also try her brother Andrew's place just around the corner )Show less

Author: JeanetteR156Royston, United Kingdom
Title: New restaurant serving Western food
Review: This is a new restaurant which serves western style food. Liang and Loon, the proprietors, are well known for their delicious food at "The Poker Cafe" (now the OK cafe) and have set up this new restaurant for evenings. The food is of a high standard and their fish, chips and mushy peas are to be recommended. The set meals are fantastic value and there is a good variety of food to choose from. Well worth a visit for those days when you crave good home cooked familiar food.Show less

Author: GEORGE1953Aberdeen, United Kingdom
Title: First visit
Review: This was our first visit here.it is on the same level as Andrews Kampung. it is Andrews sister who owns it, The food is actually western kind of food. which can sometimes be fine if you want something instead of Asian food for a change, she opened it as there is a lot of long term westerners living in Penang. well worth a visit prices very reasonable. also very good hostsShow less

Author: OldiesAbroadPlymouth, United Kingdom
Title: A Welcome Change
Review: We have visited this establishment 3 times now after a recommendation from a friend. We were not disappointed the proprietor was both jolly and generally please to see us. The service can be a bit slow at busy times but is made up by the quality of the food.. For a set menu ie. soup, main, sweet and coffee at RM19 is good value for money. Tonight was Valentines night and was decorated very tastefully with red coloured everywhere.Show less

Author: Paul5jFleetwood, United Kingdom
Title: Must try restaurant
Review: Excellent food again from Liang and Loon. Just like their day time restaurant tan sam guan (aka the poker cafe) the food and service is excellent. The food is more of a western style food but is worth a try.Everything here is already at a high standard and will only get better.Definitely worth a visitShow less

Author: stanburyspainBenejuzar, Spain
Title: Great if you fancy a break from rice and noodles
Review: The owner Li Han is lovely, for 19.00 RM you get a three course meal western food, lovely home made soup choice of mains from the menu dessert and either tea or coffee, for people who are missing food from home this is the place for you, the fish and chips comes highly recommended and all served up by the lovely Li Han who is a lovely bubbly girl who makes everyone feel so welcomeShow less

Author: smokee2014George Town, Malaysia
Title: True Western Food
Review: We visited this new restaurant on its opening night in December 2014 for the first time but have been at least once a week since. Being Ex Pats from the UK we were a little sceptical about the authenticity of the food to be served, we were extremely impressed with both the quality of food and the service we recieved. The patrons Liang & Loon were welcoming and take pride in their food, homemade soups and desserts with traditional dishes such as fish & chips with mushy peas unrivalled on the island. Looking for a taste of home then this restaurant must be on your list to visit.Show less

Author: 44basHornchurch, United Kingdom
Title: Western Food only, expertly cooked
Review: Liang & Loon opened this restaurant about 6 weeks ago. They cook amazing soups every day. It's the best fish & chips I've had anywhere in Batu Ferringhi during my stay. Liang googles her recipes so that she can cook Western food for us. She's an amazing cook, and not only that, a very bubbly,happy girl, whose always surprised & excited that we turn up to try her English food as we call it. It's also one of,if not the cheapest restaurant of this standard around. Do try it - you won't be disappointed.Show less

Author: jackw53London, United Kingdom
Title: A Western Delight
Review: A newly opened restaurant whose menu is predominantly aimed at the Western taste. Don't be put off by the quaint use of English in describing the various dishes. My wife and I started with Pepper Chicken and a Prawn Salad, followed by Chicken Maryland and Fish and Chips. All the dishes were excellent and the service from Liang and Loon was both attentive and cheerful - they really know the meaning of the word "service".The ambience is basic but pleasing with the walls decorated with paper butterflies and pride of place given over to a "Gainsborough" portrait. Value is nothing short of outstanding our bill came to 58 ringgits including drinks and there is a set menu option at a remarkable 19 Ringgits. Accessing the venue for first timers is a bit of a challenge - we took the lift to the 2 nd floor, walked towards the rear of the building, turned right onto the veranda and kept walking - this brings you to the front of the building where K&F is located. Definitely worth the effort.Show less

Author: Gunner47BeaconsfieldGreat Kingshill, United Kingdom
Title: New restarant
Review: This a new restaurant run by Liang and Loon who also run what was the poker cafe at the side of the Golden Sands. Not the same cuisine however, they are now branching out into Western Cuisine. You can have a la carte or the set menu which is a 3 course plus drink for 19 ringits. We ate there last night and the food is really good. It is in Eden Parade on the second floor at the front. The mall it's in is not great but the restaurant itself is spotlessly clean and nicely decorated. The owners are lovely people. Would highly recommend if you are craving western food after having your fill of Asian cuisine.Show less

Author: Y262RYkelvinl
Title: super good food and services from two frenchies
Review: their food has been good since my first visit in 2018. what i find nice and can recommend are:sides/starters : french onion soup, croque madame, escargotmains: creamy pasta, ribeye, salmon dumplingdesserts: floating island (egg white specialty), creme bruleenot really sure how they are written in french for the mains but the staffs will know!Show less

Author: Yamatoii
Title: Food feedback for 2 Frenchies
Review: Service was excellent. Greeted with a bright smile. Regular check backs done by Iqram and training staff. Dishes served well in sequence. Good recommendation on dessert. Really appreciated the complementary drinks by the lady boss. Service from start to end was done with grattitude from staff. Food was super duper scrumptious and mouth watering. Steak was served just as asked by me. Medium rare. Overall a very satisfying experience. Thank you 2 frenchies.Show less

Author: DavidF9994Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: A great hidden European gem in the heart of old Penang.
Review: We wanted a nice bistro experience and were given amazing service by Ikram and his colleagues. We both had a lovely Salad to start with a burger and a Cassoulet for main. Both were superb. Desserts were perfect and the wine paring was well matched and priced. Very happy.Show less

Author: JCTraveller78
Title: An Authentic French Cuisine with Genuine, Friendly Service
Review: A perfect staple for my friends and I who were looking for authentic French cuisine in Penang. The chef brings his family recipes, with skilful love of cooking to each dish he creates. A truly little tease for every palate! We had classic dishes escargots,, moules frites (my favourite), mushroom & truffle ravioli, and flavourful tomahawk steaks served with truffle mashed potato and salad. Service was attentive, staff members were friendly. We came back again the next day bringing more friends along for a Sunday brunch.Show less

Author: 585rolfb
Title: Consistently good
Review: Constantly good food. Attentive and friendly staff. Kronenbourg beer on tap. Make reservation specifically at weekends.

Author: KerrineYing
Title: Birthday celebration
Review: Super friendly service they had, chocolate cake is superb! Seafood pasta is good. Quiche is a little “salt-bae”. Overall quite satisfy ☺️

Author: siew_chyun
Title: Dinner
Review: Tonight is fully booked but they managed to get us a table for two. Thanks for the service team. Ikram is very nice and friendly. Great service! Will come back again-Nick.

Author: Michteh03
Title: Great food and service
Review: Excellent service, love the food and ambience here. They even made me a good cocktail on my birthday. I will definitely come back here.

Author: M9621TWjanel
Title: Good food great service & ambiance
Review: Ikram gives the best service and makes an amazing cocktail! Very pleased with my visit to celebrate my friend’s birthday

Author: Kris_thenomad07
Title: Helpful Staff, cool ambience.
Review:
The staff are well groomed and helpful, the place is clean, neat and befitting for a good dinner.
The food was great, especially the duck confit.

Author: KarenS3604
Title: Family Dinner
Review: Authentic French cuisine. Food taste delicious with normal portion. However price is on the high side.

Author: Paradise17544624035
Title: Go to French dinner
Review: Legitimately the best french restaurant around Penang. Doesn’t matter what I get I end up liking it. My family and I have been eating here for a few years now. They make variety of classic french cooking and probably the best french food I’ve had.

Author: fishynyan
Title: Chill environment, delicious foods & very friendly
Review: Love the chill environment🍷 The foods are really delicious and they're soooo friendly! Love them 🥰🥰🥰 I love the Sangria🍷

Author: Baba YBukit Mertajam, Malaysia
Title: First visit
Review: Very enjoying during first visit, actually also long time never enjoy western or french cuisine since work, best recommend will be the duck leg, you come to taste then will know, staff is friendly and just ask for recommendation, but first, its all depend on how much is your budget, worth to try^^Show less

Author: N_LC789Penang Island, Malaysia
Title: Food and Service
Review: Two frenchaise will never fails ! The food and the hospitality of the staff is excellent, well trained ! Especially one of the staff name Ikram. Amaazing food! The whole experience from start to finish is great server, is always so friendly and kind. The food can’t get better and the prices are fair for the portion size. Always a great spot to get great food.Show less

Author: Megan C
Title: Food and service
Review: The food was nice especially the escargots and the chili shrimps. the service is excellent will visit next time.

Author: Aditi PSingapore, null, Singapore
Title: Tasty breakfast and friendly staff!
Review: Visited with family for breakfast. We ordered a sharing platter, butter and sugar crepes, nutella crepes and a bacon brioche and everyone was very happy with their meals. The waiter and waitress were very friendly and attentive and made it a pleasant experience for us. Would love to visit again for dinner sometime!Show less

Title: Awesome
Review: The food was great and the workers were very friendly, which makes the ambience great. Would recommend bug functions as the portions are big.

Author: Compass44451587070Penang Island, Malaysia
Title: Two Frenchies never fails!
Review: Two Frenchies never fails! Have been frequently dining here with big groups which has great ambience and excellent service. Waiters and waitresses are very well trained in serving guests and can often give good food recommendations. Was recommended the chef’s special – duck apricot which has a great combination of French and surprisingly Mediterranean taste with dates and olives. I would rate Two Frenchies as one of the top French dining place in Penang!Show less

Author: jacklimcss
Title: Retreat
Review: Nice environment, friendly waiters and food is superb! The workers made my experience even better. Would come again!

Author: roseanna172Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Amazing authentic french food
Review: Myself and my husband had this place recommended to us and we were not disappointed. The food, ambience and friendly staff made our experience so memorable. We both ordered the pork & lentil soup from the specials menu and for mains I ordered the Confit de Canard and my husband ordered the Moules frites, both were so flavoursome and tasty - definitely worth the a revisit. Our dessert was a Valrhona Chocolate Cake served with berry coulis and whipped cream and mine was a Tarte de Pommes apple Classic French apple tart served with whipped cream accompanied by a fine bottle of maine de Haut Gleon Rose. We had an Absolutely perfect evening, the staff were so attentive and so friendly Diana the manager was so lovely too. I would highly recommend you visit this “Gem” of a place as you’ll not be disappointed.Show less

Author: mudcowGeorge Town, Malaysia
Title: It's our local favourite so we keep going back! Very good with allergies.
Review: We have been many times and never had a bad meal. The lunch menu is our favourite. 3 courses for about 25RM served efficiently in the manner of a Parisian bistro. My wife always has the bœuf bourguignon. Every. Single. Time.A wonderful warm welcome every time that we visit. The profiteroles or apple tart are both wonderful for pudding but it can be hard to fit them in if you've already had a starter and main course.French onion soup or pate are the recommended starters. Their private dining is something really special. We felt utterly spoilt.Show less

Author: Christina HLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Amazing authentic French food!
Review: We ordered delivery during lockdown of moules frites, vegetarian platter, apple pie and Leffes Blonde beers - it was like I had stumbled into a memory of a French holiday! Amazing service, incredible food and range, authentic European cuisine. Thank you! We will definitely order again.Show less

Author: Diver99999
Title: Our weekly highlight
Review:
Since 3 years we joined 2 Frenchies almost every week. Perfect service, very nice and special food.
Every time a great experience

Author: docdevan1
Title: Teatime and Weekend Breakfast Menu at a quaint French Cafe & Bistro
Review: Visited the ‘Two Frenchies Cafe & Bistro’ with three friends for breakfast today. A quaint french restaurant housed in a pre-war building in Penang took me back to the happy alleyway cafes in France. I can’t thank Two Frenchies enough for at least taking my palette back to happier times which I yearn for as we live through these uncertain COVD-19 pandemic times. Name: Two Frenchies Cafe & BistroAddress: 36, Bishop Street, 10200, Penang.Tel No: 04-2612000 / 016-5553934Opening hours: Tues - Fri : 1100 - 2130 hoursSat & Sun : 0900 - 2130 hoursMon - ClosedWe ordered from the ‘Teatime and Weekend Breakfast Menu’ with coffee and hot chocolate.A. GALETTES(1)La Complete(A French classic: pork ham chunks, gruyere and fried egg) - RM 24(2)Penang RendangRich chicken rendang, fried egg, cherry tomatoes and coriander - RM 24(3)Not Quite VegetarianRatatouille, onion confit, sundried tomatoes and almonds - RM 23B. CREPES(4)Nutella Nutella - RM 17C. BRIOCHE TOASTIES (5) Mayo, mustard and cheese filled brioche bread, Provencal Lamb Stew and french fries - RM 21French and Malaysian food are probably at two ends of the flavour spectrum, but i must commend the most definite nod to Malaysia via the Penang Rendang galletes...a subtle but delicious fusion. A delectable start to my Sunday. Super yummy.What more can you ask for than a happy tummy and a head full of memories of better times. I can’t wait to get to “Two Frenchies” again to savour their extensive lunch and dinner menus. My recommendation - head to Two Frenchies quick since none of us are holidaying in Europe anytime soon!!Show less

Author: Ron6978Penang Island, Malaysia
Title: Night out with girlfriend
Review: Loved this place. Staff super attentive. We booked and they took the trouble to remember our names. Food was amazing. Recommend the snails. Sauce so yummy Wine reasonably priced. Ambiance was great. Always asking if we want more bread. Forced down 3 courses because it was all so good. Will definitely return. Loved it. Thankyou Show less

Author: my_dgrt
Title: Onion Soup is the Best
Review: The onion soup is impressive and the best in Penang, the service is top of the range too. They explained every dish very details.

Author: PaperStoneScissorsPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Excellent
Review: Our previous visit had been a few years ago and it had not been particularly enjoyable. However so many people had started raving about it that we thought we should give it a second chance. We were not disappointed and will be going back again soon. The duck breast was enormous but they kindly wrapped it so I could take it home.Show less

Author: aussiedevilleMelbourne, Australia
Title: Slowly Having a Soft Spot for Two Frenchies
Review: Back here for a second time while in Penang. Loved it as much as the first time. We had the rib-eye steak and burger. We shared a soup. A few drinks throughout the meal. Service was great. We were taken care off and felt pampered. Very cozy. This is surely becoming our go-to spot whenever we are in town. Show less

Author: misslilithjr
Title: I have been to this place
Review:
I have been to this place twice so far & the consistency of their food is remarkable. 
The food is delicious, & the service is just so amazing. 

Definitely will recommended to my family and friends!

Author: BenYorkieKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: First Class
Review: We went along for lunch - 9 of us. And we all came away having enjoyed the whole experience at the Two Frenchies.The interior is a typical heritage long narrow Chinee shophouse - and very nicely decorated inside, very light and airy; it creates a great atmosphere.Very helpful staff and we had a visit from the chef himself so we felt somewhat privileged.Good menu and plenty of choices - we had a missed bag of dishes since not everyone wanted a big lunch but there were no disappointments with the food. French onion soup, d confit, lamb, caramelised onion tart - all fine.A first class dining experience - and at very reasonable prices.Show less

Author: Makan_Tidor
Title: You won’t be disappointed
Review: Dining here is the best choice i made during my recent trip. The owner and the staffs are so passionate about their work & hospitality, extraordinarily friendly and helpful. Ask then for special of the month, surely won’t let you down. Thumbs up and keep up the good food and service.Show less

Author: sINDHuVee
Title: Excellent cuisine, ambience and service!
Review: Tried this restaurant with a friend a few weeks ago.. A truly gastronomic experience at a fair price.. Service was beyond good ( thank you Mr Ikram!) .. Loved how the music picked up towards to later part of the evening.. Would absolutely come again! SindhuShow less

Author: Vidhya CPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Excellent!
Review: Went for dinner with the family and once again, few days later with friends. Had a wonderful experience both times. Food is very tasteful, my daughter is strictly vegetarian with plenty allergies - the staff and chef are extremely accommodating and made sure she enjoyed everything - appetizer to dessert!! Extremely friendly and helpful staff, special mention of Ikram - very friendly and enterprising! Thank you!Show less

Author: PaxTGMidhurst
Title: Relaxed atmosphere and friendly welcome
Review: We arrived for an early lunch on Sunday and were warmly welcomed by all the restaurant staff. We ordered the rib eye steak which was first class. The vegetarian platter had a great choice of cheeses. Cannot fault the service which was attentive and efficient. By the time we left, the tables were starting to fill up and I can understand why this restaurant is a popular choice. We hope to return and would recommend the Two Frenchies.Show less

Author: Amyang08
Title: Nice food..great service
Review: The food is above our expectations for the price we paid. Great place with great service. Absolutely loved it.

Author: JozenK
Title: Birthday celebration !
Review: Great environment ! Had my lunch but I chose this pet friendly cafe for my sis celebration .. friendly staff Ikram recommended comfort food to us , nice place to chill.. birthday surprise well arranged by the staffs with birthday song , had a great time ! Highly recommendedShow less

Author: TANCK111
Title: Mr
Review: The ambience is nice. The food and dessert are special and awesome. Strongly recommended for the onion soup , roasted chicken and duck (confit de Canard).

Author: charlsv2014
Title: Nice place
Review: Nice food, amazing environment, sweet jazz music and great service, for a good price, highly recommended

Author: GeorgesCalbery
Title: Very very nice French restaurant in the heart of George Town
Review: This restaurant is very nice. Very clean. Top service with friendly staffs. And the good remind me of home!! Really enjoyable. And... even not French, I would say that their burger is the best in town!

Author: CyndyJoanPenang, Malaysia
Title: Perfect Ending
Review: I recently visited Two Frenchies for dessert. I cannot resist their apple tart and after dinner with friends stopped in to enjoy their amazing dessert and a glass of wine. This was my fourth visit since they opened following MCO lockdown, 3 visits for dinner with friends and last visit was for dessert with friends, I have tried all the desserts on the menu and can recommend them all. Thank you for great service and caring even if I only had a dessert.Show less

Author: MFSCFSBayan Lepas, Malaysia
Title: Dinner with Friends
Review: Recently visited Two Frenchies with 11 friends for dinner. This was the first time visit for my friends and their first experience at a French restaurant. They were overwhelmed by the wonderful choices on the menu and ordered many dishes to share. I enjoyed being part of this. I am sure we all will be returning very soon. Great evening, amazing food and incredible service. Thank you 2FShow less

Author: 77SteveS
Title: Relaxed excellence
Review: We so much enjoyed 2 generations celebrating Father's Day lunch here. Third time to visit and had our best meal yet. 5 star on the chocolate cake on the bottom of the dessert menu! Attentive service., enjoyable setting, very tasty food.

Author: Ling20162016Penang Island, Malaysia
Title: Lovely place for gathering/private function
Review: We were invited for lunch on a Sunday w/ a group of friends. It has been quite a while since our last visit to this restaurant though we actually like this place much.I started w/ an onion soup- one of my favorites here. The 2 Frenchies Sharing Platter, the Sirloin Steak as well as the ravioli ( cooked to a perfect al dente) were all nice. We enjoyed ourselves w/ the pairing of a good glass of wine too.Will definitely visit soon either for a brunch or a dinner!Show less

Author: HurseMakati, Philippines
Title: Covid 19 - whatever it takes!
Review: As a regular now to the 2 Frenchies, I was delighted to hear that, during the current crisis these guys have relented & decided to offer a delivery service. I understand that this is a conscious effort to help the community at this time and to service their loyal customers. I tried and ordered my favorite dish, the 5 hr Lamb and was shocked that it was so good!!! Well done guys you deserve a medal!!!!!!Show less

Author: Philippe DHuy, Belgium
Title: A great lunch in the ideal environment
Review: First of all we were travelling to Penang with our dog and needed a dog friendly restaurant (not easy in Malaysia at all). Second my wife had not tried "Cassoulet" yet . 5 years ago we had a restaurant in the city that reached at the time the top ranking of the eating places in the island "Chez Nous" Belgian restaurantand wanted to try the try this relatively new restaurant serving authentic French food (rare also in the country). We were warmly welcome including our pet. I was a little worry as there no no sign of French presence in the restaurant and in the cuisine. I guess the owner are now only present part-time. We ordered "Cassoulet Toulousain" and "canard a l'orange with gratin dauphinois" and were very happy with our choice, the portion and the service. Very nice meal.Show less

Author: CyndyJoanPenang, Malaysia
Title: Happy Birthday
Review: I held my birthday party at Two Frenchies on 15 Feb and had the best birthday party. Annette took great care of everything and Ikram was amazing with the techie things. The food was wonderful and just what I asked for. I received lots of feedback from guest who had not been to Two Frenchies before saying they would be going to return for dinner or lunch. A huge thank you to the staff at Two Frenchies for making this birthday so special. I love you all and will return again and again. Big HugsShow less

Author: SinagQuezon City, Philippines
Title: Finally, a very good french bistro on our shores
Review: Delicious. Yes, we drove all the way to Penang not just for local culture, history and cuisine but also for the best of French comfort food - in advance of Le French Festival in Malaysia.We were happy to have our Sunday breakfast of pancakes and omelette and receive excellent service from the Two Frenchies staff. We loved the decor that reminded us of the french culture. Le Petit Beurre. Apéro. After breakfast, we went to Penang Hill and we were meant to drive back to KL soon after. However the thought of the Two Frenchies menu which had cassoulet, confit du canard, les escargots, steak frites etc. was just too hard to disregard. We made a detour and two hours later from our first visit, we were ordering our lunch! It’s been two weeks since our visit but now I’m looking for another weekend trip to Penang - just to visit the Two Frenchies :0).Parking is tricky so I recommend walking to this place instead.Show less

Author: Mimibah
Title: Nice Food Great Service
Review: Delicious food, especially the platter. When eating the food you'd know that the food was prepared by chef who cooked whole heartedly. All the waiters/waitress were happy people & you'd tell that they are happy working there, like a family. One of the owners i.e. Diana, she's very friendly, courteous & good in recommending the restaurant's specialty. Will definitely dine in this restaurant again in futureShow less

Author: lindainaus
Title: Try this restaurant it won’t disappoint
Review: Outstanding service, food was really good and the restaurant was spotless. Will definitely come again.

Author: retiredattySpokane, Washington
Title: Fabulous surprise
Review: This is a charming restaurant, with a warm, friendly atmosphere. The service was excellent and the food was good and it was fun. My husband's French Onion soup was so good, that we had to go back the next day so I could have my own bowl. We did not require reservations (as we eat dinner quite early) and we did not have to "dress" for dinner - in a French restaurant. How often does that happen? Take advantage while you can and we hope you have as much fun as we did at this bistro.Show less

Author: NadiaPon
Title: Very good! Highly recommend!
Review: We stopped for dinner in this restaurant, it was sooo tasty truly French food! Nice atmosphere and friendly staff. Absolutely recommend this place if you are looking for a good place with delicious food and great service.

Author: 524nailk
Title: Perfect French atmosphere
Review: The atmosphere of the place is excellent: French music, helpful staff, interior decoration, meals. We really enjoyed.

Author: Smita714Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: A little French GEM..
Review: Great food and fabulous service.. friendly staff who made our dinner quite enjoyable.. we ordered beef and duck, both were tender and very good. Loved the raspberry Pannacotta as well..A good meal overall and a definite must if you want a break from local food. Show less

Author: jerryreserveLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Allez Les Bleus!
Review: Penang is renowned for its variety of great food; Malay, Chinese, Indian and European. Two Frenchies is an authentic French Bistro run by two Frenchies (both of whom I had the pleasure to meet); the food is excellent, the wine selection is small but good and not too expensive (given that this is Asia) but most of all, the staff are superb - cheerful, helpfull and well organised - all overseen by the manager dynamic Diana. It's the perfect place to unwind over a couple of cocktails after a hard day by the pool...so good I went there (too) often!Show less

Author: Kenneth YPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Genuine French bistro in the heart of Georgetown
Review: Being die-hard Francophiles, my wife and I were excited to try out this restaurant. We were looking forward to eating our favourites - French onion soup, snails and, of course, creme brulee. We also tried the beef bourguignon and the seafood pasta. Our verdict? The food was good but it was just short of being great. The onion soup was a little bland and we were a disappointed the snails were served without shells - canned? Fortunately the wait staff was well trained and very attentive.Show less

Author: boontheam
Title: Dinner
Review:
French onion soup superb.
Rib eye ribs as good as anywhere else.
Staff friendly and courteous.
Prices acceptable.

Author: ClaudiaN2547
Title: The most authentic French
Review: The most authentic French food you can find on Penang Island!Tried escargot for the first time here and it was simply delicious. I was recommended here by a French friend who loves this place very much. This cafe is frequented by mostly foreigners and is not growing more popular with the locals as well. Delicious food and top quality desserts. I would recommend the valrhona chocolate cake and chocolate mousse! Show less

Author: andrewLsh1987
Title: Great little French bistro, excellent cooking
Review: We had beef bourginion and a bacon beefburger. Both were excellent. Choice of beverages were good. Tables near the entrance were a little close to each other. But overall i plan subsequent visit.

Author: claudio2018
Title: Meeting with friends
Review: The food quality very good staff really professional and friendly and the environment perfect many thanks Diana and Cedric congratulations and well done

Author: guyw945Cologne, Germany
