👍🏻👏

Author: jims12345Hong Kong, China
Title: must go Laksa specialist
Review: We stay in a nice boutique hotel Jawi Peranakan Mansion this time and there’s a nice Laksa store nearby, we tried their traditional Adam Laksa from variety selection, Nasi Kerabu with dried curry chicken and Mango Roll, when the dishes being put onto our table, they’re as beautiful as shown on the menu. The Laksa taste much better than I tried from nearby night market and hygiene concern is much more rest assured, highly recommend. The Nasi Kerabu don’t have much special favour but the natural col is beautiful and curry is taste good. And the owner is a young lady Christine is super nice, she gives us many tips of nice food in George Town Definitely will visit again next time!這次我們住在一家不錯的精品酒店Jawi Peranakan Mansion，附近有一家漂亮的Laksa餐廳，我在不同口味的Laksa選了傳統的Adam Laksa，Nasi Kerabu配乾咖哩雞和芒果卷，當菜餚放在我們的桌子上時，他們'如同菜單上顯示的一樣美麗。 Laksa的味道比我在附近的夜市嘗試的要好得多，衛生問題更加放心，強烈推薦。 Nasi Kerabu沒有太多特別的味道但天然顏色很漂亮但咖哩味道很好。主人是一位年輕的女士Christine人非常友善又熱情，給了我們很多George Town美食的推薦，再來檳城絕對會再訪Laksa Licious！Show less

Author: TimRutgers
Title: Outstanding Laksa
Review: Of all the great food we tried in Georgetown, the Laksa of Laksalicious really stands out. A must stop for foodies. Owner speaks English very well, and can explain everything on the menu and give advice on what to choose. Pleasent airconditioned setting.

Author: 207oriolsAveiro, Portugal
Title: Recommended 100%
Review: We tried two different types of Laksa and we loved both! It was the first time for us and right now it is our favorite Malaysian dish. Moreover, the attention was really good, they explained us the differences between dishes and how to eat like locals do.Recommended 100%Show less

Author: HarryR976
Title: Loved the food!
Review: Food was delicious, it came out very quickly! Very good prices! Just above street prices! Will definitely come again!

Author: lina_kiwiAuckland, New Zealand
Title: Excellent food - great service!
Review: We had lunch here and the food was delicious! The service is excellent - the lady explained everything to us and gave us great recommendations! I definitely became a big fan of laksa. So super yummy. And very very clean. Definitely a must when in Penang.Show less

Author: Jennifer MSingapore, Singapore
Title: Excellent place to try laksa!
Review: I was only in Penang for a couple of days and wanted to make sure I got to try some good authentic Assam laksa. Found this place online and decided to try, and was glad I did. The lady who was serving (the boss?) was so friendly and took time to explain the menu to every customer who came in. The Assam laksa was delicious, and I loved the prawn crackers that came with it! Also the gula melaka coffee is a must try!Show less

Author: Dr_Albert_Chan
Title: Extremely Highly Recommended!
Review: I started things off with the crispy sweet potato roll and the crispy cempedak roll. Both were served at the correct temperature, i.e. steaming hot! They were light and fluffy and absolutely delicious!The assam laksa was definitely one of the best I'd tasted in Penang. I also sampled the laksa lemak, and it was incredibly good...the yummiest in Penang in my opinion, and I'd tasted many versions of laksa lemak throughout the island over the years.The beef rendang (accompanied by blue rice, a hard boiled egg and some salad) was spicy, rich and flavoursome - exactly how I like it!Two desserts were ordered: cendol and sago gula melaka.The cendol at Laksalicious comfortably beat the Penang Road Famous Teochew Cendol at Lebuh Keng Kwee (what a great shame for the hundreds of people who queue at the stall there each day!) and vies keenly with that at Jonker 88 in Melaka for the title of best cendol in the world! I've been reliably informed that the gula melaka in the cendol at Jonker 88 has added sugar to enhance its sweetness, whereas the gula melaka in the cendol at Laksalicious is completely unsullied. Having tasted both versions, I'd say that the Laksalicious version wins by a nose!Sago gula melaka is one of my favourite desserts in all the world...and it's very rare that I don't order it when it appears on a menu. My mum makes a pretty good sago gula melaka, and I've been fortunate to have also tasted a fair few delightful versions at cafes and restaurants throughout the world over the years. However, I'd say that the sago gula melaka at Laksalicious was easily the best I'd ever tasted anywhere in the world! The texture and 'springiness' of the sago were perfect, the coconut milk was commendably fresh, the gula melaka was undeniably authentic, and the presentation was visually stunning! As far as I'm concerned, the king of sago gula melaka lives at Laksalicious...and long may that continue!The customer service by Christine Ooi (the owner) and her team was excellent - friendly, knowledgeable and courteous. The place had an attractive decor and was super clean. I would strongly encourage all Penangites and tourists to visit Laksalicious - you won't regret it!Show less

Author: Marta MCheltenham, United Kingdom
Title: Friendly restaurant
Review: Visited this restaurant today and tried laksa and the blue dessert ( can’t remember name, sago gula maybe) both were very nice, nothing like my everyday food. The lady came and explain the menu to us which was very helpful. She was very welcoming and considerate which was nice change after street food vendors who are constantly in a hurryShow less

Author: ChrisBob123
Title: Superb
Review:
Only been in Georgetown for a day and have eaten here twice already. Working my way through the menu! 

Food ver tasty and not expensive.

Author: Wheldon N
Title: Highly recommend
Review: Very authentic and delicate Laksa. Although the restaurant was virtually empty (probably the wrong time of day) you could tell that it was a very popular place. We loved the desserts too!

Author: xueer228Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Average
Review: My second time here. The Assam laksa was good. I find it better than the famous Ayer Itam. Desserts were good. However the curry noodle not worth mentioning. The first time when I was there, the shop was quite empty. The lady boss was very friendly. That was the reason I brought my hubby’s whole family there two weekend ago.Latest experience, the shop was almost full house. My 4yo daughter was surprisingly happy the other day when she entered the shop. She was laughing and making sound (not screaming I assure you. Probably the sound from adult talking is even louder) then was asked by the lady boss to not to make noise. Of course my daughter went silent immediately and continued to be silent until we left. I have a very awkward feeling about this whole scenario. Probably my first time having such unpleasant experience. Normally my daughter will have no issue even at very high end fine dining restaurant etc. Show less

Author: 347ruit
Title: Delicious like the Restaurant Name
Review:
Very friendly staff.
Took their time to explain the menu with detail and explained what was spicy or not. ( always helpful!).
Food was delicious! We went for some starters and mains and also the tradicional coffee.
5 stars!

Author: Bordow86Bangkok, Thailand
Title: Laksawesomess
Review: So let me tell you the story of the best place, I visited in Penang.I arrived for lunch ordered a Assam laksa local soup and a coffeelicious(coffee)I was amazed by the taste of both.Coffee is really nice sweet and strong at the same time. Soup was so fresh and light I could eat another 3 easily, the taste was perfect and unexpected.The inside atmosphere is nice, clean and fresh.Regarding the services, I guess it was the manager which welcome me so nicely, she gave me some super advice, she is available, she came to check if everything was all right, always smiley. I would come back again just for her kindness and attitude. Please come here and you won’t regret it. This place should be the first in Penang TripAdvisor. As for the food and the service. Show less

Author: Jeremy T
Title: Delicious Food
Review: Just finished eating here and the food was delicious! I ordered the mango roll and traditional Laksa. This place definitely lives up to its high rating.

Author: robertavalyte
Title: Superb
Review: The best laksa we tasted in Penang, great cosy environment and friendly service! Everything was explained to us patiently in English. Their spring rolls and laksa prawn crackers are to die for!

Author: JenP1137
Title: Great laksa
Review:
The food was great and the staff were very friendly and took time to talk through the menu.

We found the price really reasonable.

Author: SaharaFelizPenang Island, Malaysia

Author: 412philippehHong Kong, China

Author: YilingL70
Title: Best local delight

Author: Jason P

Review: THe laksa was excellent but what I liked most was Christen, the owner!  She was friendly, helpful and took the time to explain the menu items.  Very clean and nice atmosphere as well.

Author: HarrisW47

Review: So I’m walking around from the hotel with my wife... Review: If you're looking for the perfect laksa this is the place, very cool and clean with friendly staff and good sides to go with the main event. We both had the vegetarian laksa and the flavours were excellent. Highly recommend!

Author: Simiboi_Ken
Title: Something different
Review: I'm laksa lover (extreme hot and spicy)The ambience is nice and boss is friendly too! If you are person who willing to try something different, take it on! Author: Adudesf
Title: Savory & sweet delights
Review: Wow, cuisine here is a foody's heaven!We tried both types of laksa, Assam & Lemak -- both are savory & spicy, but favorite is Assam by far. We also enjoyed their blue sago desert with coconut & palm sugar. Their palm sugar is what really stands out -- thick & smoky, very difficult to find these days. Also, enjoyed talking with the manager about ingredients.Highly recommend trying for lunch or dinner!! We will be back :)Show less

Author: PKB_1990
Title: Absolutely loved it!
Review: Delicious vegetarian nyonya laksa lemak. We called earlier to check there was a vegetarian option and they were helpful enough to reserve some for us. Sago gula melaka was one of the best desserts I've had, till date

Show less

Author: gosiak888

Author: amaliechristineb

Review: The Laksa was very good, and the restaurant was a cool place. We had A3 and we’re both very happy with our meal.

Author: Anne-Marie TWatford, United Kingdom

The decor inside the restaurant is interesting and there were plug sockets so I was able to charge my phone.Show less

Author: BnF-GillisMississauga, Canada

Author: sarahrJ29CNBang Kruai, Thailand

Author: balloonrPortland, Oregon
Title: So Good!
Review: I was in Penang for business and local colleagues brought us here for lunch. They recommended several dishes from the menu and we trusted what they said was good. I was very impressed. The owner was there and also made recommendations and was very attentive to us and to others in the restaurant. It was weekend and not really busy which made it easier to converse with the owner. Hands down my favorite was the coconut milk asam laksa. It was creamy flavorful with fresh vegetables and addicting! The group shared a number of dishes and all were very good. We universally enjoyed our meal from Vietnamese coffee to the desert which was blue! The place is small but great things come in small packages!! Highly recommend searching them out. Also small location in Queensbay mall which had some of the same food and also was very good.Show less

Author: MaddyNie
Title: Delish veggie laksa
Review: Very nice little place- clean and modern. Had veggie Laksa which I didn’t see on the menu but asked for after reading reviews here. Really loved it!

Author: Anthony P

Assam Laksa was delish & I went to fruit heaven after biting into that Cempedak Roll (that’s Jackfruit for the non-Malay speakers :P). Author: SJ1490

Author: almqanni
Title: Good vegetarian laksa
Review: I loved their vegetarian laksa. Blue rice was exciting and the desert very pretty. I warmly recommend vegetarian laksa, so tasty and full of flavours!

Author: GeorgetownPenang
Title: Delicious Laksa in Comfort
Review:

If unsure try the mix laksa

Author: EvaA3370
Title: A.M.A.Z.I.N.G
Review: We came here on our last night in Penang, we were sad we were only able to go once! To drink we had a cold lemon tea and a cold coffeelicious - both so good and refreshing! To eat we shared a bowl of Assam Laksa and a bowl of Laksa Lassam (made with coconut milk) we had them both with thick noodles - I can’t describe how good they both were! So delicious!! We had to get a second bowl of the Laksa Lassam it was so good! The Assam Laksa was spicier but perfect for me, the Lassam was milder and creamier. Both (+ the extra one!) dishes were full of fresh ingredients made with the expert knowledge. And such a cheap price for the quality you are having. The cafe itself has a lovely atmosphere, nice and cool temperature, and a really friendly and helpful manager. Great place to escape the hustle and bustle of street food. I would recommend to everyone and can’t wait to go back when I’m next in the country! Thank you Laksalicious team for our best meal of 3 months of travelling! Show less

Author: Rian T
Title: Very good food
Review: Really nice Laksa! Definitely some of the best in Georgetown. The service is also great. Highly recommended.

Author: 102glync

Review: Ate here twice ,first time laksa very goodSecond time rendang - amazing , genuine slowly cooked flakey chuck steak, fantastic flavour.Simple clean place, very friendly helpful owner , excellent value.Full of indians ,malays ,chinese and westerners so proof that all food is good, not just catering for certain tastes.Highly recommended Show less

Author: ChantelleM341Johannesburg, South Africa

Everything was beautifully presented. The laksa was flavorful & delicious. Clean & air conditioned restaurant. Really friendly staff! Thank you Christine!Show less

Author: shansummer22015Singapore, Singapore
Title: Yummylicious ! Authentic Penang food, desserts, drinks !
Review: A very cosy and clean cafe with air-cond. You almost can get all authentic Penang food, desserts, drinks here. The Penang Assam Laksa tastes yummylicious with prawn cracker! Cempedak rolls are mind-blowingly good, crispy and fresh with cempedak filling! Dreamy Butterfly Pea Nyonya Sago Gula Melaka is a must try item, very nice and good, not too sweet indeed. There are many nice food, desserts, drinks on the menu which I yet try, definitely will be back to Laksalicious when I’m in Penang again! The lady boss is friendly and thanks to recommend us the signature dishes here. Show less

Author: ReettaM28
Title: Very nice
Review: Very nice and clean restaurant, good service in english and delicious food! The owner was very helpful.

Author: Jeff_KostyBangkok, Thailand
Title: Assam Laksa from old-school, no-shortcuts fish stock.
Review: I've been to Penang many many times. I live in Thailand and I go to Penang when I need a new visa. Shockingly, embarrassingly, I had never tried assam laksa. it's an iconic Penang dish. This time, I drew a line in the sand. I was not going to eat *anywhere* I'd eaten before. Short version: It worked out extremely well, and Laksalicious was a highlight. The family of a friend of mine has a laksa restaurant in Singapore, but Singapore laksa is a very different dish. I was torn between the assam laksa and more familiar coconut laksa. This led to a long talk with the very friendly owner about how her fish stock is made, and the shortcuts some laksa makers take with their stock. I cook myself, and I'm a bit of a purist when it comes to stock (if you use buillon cubes you belong in prison as far as I'm concerned). The old-school process she described made total sense to me, and assam laksa seemed the best way to appreciate the stock. TOTALLY. the sardine stock was a rock-solid foundation for the laksa. as an added bonus, sardine stock's a SUPERFOOD 'bone broth'. Trendy BS aside, it's super nutritious when made right. And this? it's right. As affable and charming as the owner is, I'm all about the food. I'll be back to Laksalicious. For the food. Good conversation is just a bonus.Show less

Author: mythzmoiselleJakarta, Indonesia
Title: SUPER DELISH!
Review: To be honest I never tried Laksa before, even if I did, I forgot the taste. When I came to Penang, people always recommend me to have Laksa. So I browsed on the internet where can I get the best laksa in town. And I am so surprised that Laksalicious is one of the list, because I passed by the shop almost everyday! (My hotel located nearby) but never dare to stop by. When I found out on Trip Advisor that its one of the best Laksa, I instantly go there and yes its true! I had Assam Laksa with Prawn Crackers and Cempedak Spring Roll. Both taste was da bomb! Its just so good I can't let myself drinking after my meal is finished. I would love to come back again! For sure!Show less

Author: AonnyHappyTraveller
Title: Recommended! Nice laksa.
Review: I found this restaurant online and follow people review. Worth to try.. I try laksa. It is nice. 😍☺️😘🙂

Author: toni s
Title: Yum!
Review:
The vegetable laksa was delicious - lots of sweet and sour flavours
Nice, clean and air conditioned! Owner was helpful

Author: Kaitotan92
Title: One of the best laksa in Penang
Review:
Both laksa and banana roll were very good. Ambience is nice and friendly boss.
Good location. 

Highly recommended!!

Author: blammers01
Title: Great food!
Review: This was easily one of the best meals I had during my vacation. Many times places don't make you feel welcome when traveling. That was not he case here. The owner was very kind and food was great.

Author: crv1993Newcastle, United Kingdom
Title: Delicious food, helpful staff
Review: As soon as we arrived we were welcomed in by the owner, who then took the time to talk us through the menu explaining each dish, giving recommendations and showing us pictures of what the food looked like. She is clearly very passionate about her cafe. The cafe is lovely and clean, and the food was delicious and reasonably priced. I ate the Assam laksa with spring rolls- it is quite spicy! Show less

Author: cameron h
Title: Laksalicious So Delicious
Review: Jackfruit spring rolls was a nice surprise as well as the plum coffee 🤤. The assam laksa was amazing. Would definitely recommend to anyone in the area. The hostess was incredibly hospitable as well; offering suggestions the whole time.

Author: ongjasmine
Title: Good Laksa & Great Side Dishes
Review:
I had the asam laksa and it's really close to the ones at the road stalls. The environment is great     As well. 

I particularly love the chempedak spring roll and the egg rolls that goes so well with the laksa. 

Two thumbs up! Please come.

Author: LizIzRiz
Title: Very tasty!
Review: We had the Assam laksa, Laksa Lemak and Kapitan Chicken. It was all superb! Service was good, ambiance was nice and the owners were lovely. Highly recommend Laksalicious!!

Author: Henrygoh71Singapore, Singapore
Title: Best Assam Laksa in Penang
Review: We went to a few "famous" penang laksa stall before coming to this restaurant. What separate Laksalicious fm the others are the food are served are piping HOT! the others served their laksa Luke warm. One stall even served their laksa cold!!Our kids love the chendol and fried Cempedak(Jack fruit).And best of all you will be sitting in a aircondition restaurant to savoir on these delicious penang delicacies!Show less

Author: Daniel V
Title: wonderful Malaysian food
Review: Located on Hutton Lane, one of the more interesting locations in Georgetown. Both the ayam laksa and laksa lemak are excellent. I was told these laksas came in second in the 2017 Georgetown Festival Macam Macam 2-day food and entertainment event. Some may find them somewhat pricey, compared to street food and lower end rumah makan.Show less

Author: LinusNg
Title: nyonya and assam laksa in an airconditioned restaurant
Review: I have had the assam laksa before, however, it was my first taste of nyonya laksa. It was a cross between a curry and assam laksa. Pretty tasty and convenient lunch stop if you are staying on Jalan Hutton.

Author: strannikny
Title: Delicious indeed
Review: Laksa, both original and mixed, are outstanding. Great Vietnamese coffee too. And very friendly service. Restaurant is air-conditioned and has nice tranquility to it.

Author: gnjamesSwindon, United Kingdom
Title: Laksa Cherry Popping
Review: Went here the other night simply because it was one of the closest place to our hotel and weren't up for venturing too far. Never had Laksa before, so followed the reviews on here and also had the recommendations and guidance of the lovely owner. She guided us through the menu and was a great help. My wife had the Assam Laksa and I had the Mixed Laksa (half Assam Laksa and half Laksa Lemak - a milder coconut milk based broth). Stuck with the thick noodles and prawn crackers. Also had some spring rolls on the side. All of it was tasty and served speedily and with a smile. Enjoyed my first taste of Laksa. Check it out.Show less

Author: Zisa U
Title: Yummy and nice staff
Review: Came here because I read there were vegetarian options. Waitress was lovely and explained everything I wanted to know about the food ingredients. Loved the vegetarian laksa and the spring rolls. She explained some dessert options and I liked the Bubur cha cha :)

Author: 727yingc
Title: Good laksa
Review: The second time we have tried Assam laksa in Georgetown and it was pretty good. I really like the prawn cracker, it adds an extra layer of flavour to the laksa.

Author: karlou83
Title: Very good food
Review: The main dish proposed "Assam Laksa" was very yummy, you can dip in your spring roll to maximize the yumminess. The owner is really looking to help you in your choice. Its good place if you want a good internet connection and escape Penang's heat.

Author: googlenogSingapore, Singapore
Title: Delightful!
Review: We ordered the Assam Laksa, a bowl each, with the prawn cracker. Best Assam Laksa I've ever had. Not too spicy, a rich and sumptuous broth with the right balance of spice, sourness of the assam and the salty flavour of the fish! And the prawn cracker, dipped in this heavenly broth is an absolute delight. I recommend ordering extra! The other dishes we had - the chempedak spring roll, the turnip-filled crystal-skinned steamed dumplings (I call these dumplings though they are much larger) while lovely, paled in comparison to the signature dish. And I'd definitely recommend forgoing the deserts- clearly not the forte of this small establishment. Though many of the taxi drivers helpfully recommended that we go to the stall at Ayer Itam, close to the famous Chinese temple, Kek Lok Si, we could not bear the muggy hot Penang weather and chose to eat comfortably at the air-conditioned Laksalicious. We were really happy with our decision. Service was marvellous with the owner herself sweetly attending to our various questions and requests. A must-try if you want a satisfying bowl of Assam Laksa!Show less

Author: GorillaFootAlbacete, Spain
Title: Loved it!
Review: We really enjoyed our laksas here, the owner was super friendly and especially went out of her way to provide a vegetarian option. The mixed laksa was divine and we finished with some interesting desserts.All in all a great experience which Id like to repeat if I had enough time.Show less

Author: zareffm
Title: Nice food!
Review: The food are nice esp the laksa & dessert, owner is so friendly! The cempedak roll is awesome! Will be back here again!

Author: koshpatPenang, Malaysia
Title: Try this!
Review: I'm a huge fan of santan / coconut milk and for those who love the coconut fragrant in your food, this is the place to enjoy a bowl of satisfying laksa. This is not the conventional laksa like our local Malay style laksa or Chinese air itam style laksa. It is something out of the norm but very delicious!The name Laksalicious is a perfect fit for its Laksa.This place is slightly crowded but it's worth your patience. People come in and take away 10-15 packets of laksa.. no kidding..Show less

Author: paullR534ZA
Title: Best Assam laksa
Review: One of best Assam laksa and lemak laksa is great too. A little pricey but good portion, clean and aircond. No complaints. Just compliments.

Author: Tat_Tatchai
Title: Good Laksa place with AirCon
Review: Good laksa place with a variety of laksa to choose from. The lady owner is very nice and can recommend you what to order. I especially like the laksa with coconut milk ( think it's Laksa Lemak). The durian spring roll is also very nice.

Author: 264eddielMelbourne, Australia
Title: A hidden gem brings the best out of this beautiful joint
Review: My Penang friends from Melbourne where I also lived when I told them I like to try the traditional Penang Assam laksa brought me here.This place is cool ..... never once I had a beautiful hot bowl of Assam laksa in an air conditioning place. Christine Ooi, also owner of the place took pride n joy in recommending her menu to my Friend, kerrie. I was giving her orders .. just order what you think is best here. We also ordered some other delicious Soon kueh, had awesome iced Vietnamese n hot Vietnamese coffee. Was beautiful !If only I didn't have two plates of fried Kway Teow before coming here. I would have had two beautiful bowls of Assam laksa.Secret weapon - their one piece of cracker to go with the Assam laksa was awesome. Seriously, very very good. Christine, I will be back whenever I return to the pearl of the orient. Show less

Author: RoderickSIaSingapore, Singapore
Title: Air-COn! place with decent laksa
Review: Well, this is one of the place with air-con and serves decent laksa. Not the best or the fantastic ones in Penang, but if you want to beat the heat and some of you guys dun like laksa, there's other food here as well, (not much but there is)We tried the Assam laksa (3/5)Blue rice with sesame oil chicken (3/5)Pohpia - spring roll (to go with laksa gravy) (4/5)Prawn cracker (to go with laksa gravy as well) (4/5)My friend tried the nyonya laksa and it's not very up to standard. (2/5)Lady Boss (i believe) is friendly though. Food came not very hot. (i wonder why) but warm enough. Recommended place to drop by for food if you're nearbyShow less

Author: May M
Title: Delicious like names
Review:
Very good food I eat in Penang 
Very nice service mind
Very fast internet and fresh air
I love this place

Author: victoriabain
Title: Great environment for hot spicy laksa!
Review: Really good! Great environment to have laksa because majority of laksa sold in Penang is at an outdoor environment, so its not that pleasurable to eat! This place is really nice because its air condition so we don't feel the heat when having spicy laksa!

Author: Carmen C
Title: Disappointed
Review: I love nyonya foods however  foods here is below average, kind of disappointed. We ordered nyonya laksa lemak , kapitan Chicken with blue rice , chai kueh, Chicken pie ( taste like frozen food ) ....

Author: Emy A
Title: Very Recommended😋😋😋
Review: I just had the best laksa of my life. Not only laksa, all the food in the menu were delicious. Will come again if going to Penang😘

Author: mario_bavariaIpoh, Malaysia
Title: A different Laksa experience in Penang
Review: First, I love all Laksas, but the Singapore Laksa is my favourite. Before coming to this place, I had a callsical Penang (Asam) Laksa, so I was in mood for a Laksa Lemak or Laksa Siam, the one with coconut milk. It is a really beautiful restaurant with aircon, nice music and wifi, so don´t expect street stall prices. But prices are very reasonable, my Laksa Lemak with a prawn cracker (highy recommended, goes perfekt in the Laksa) was around RM 10, the Asam Laksa and the Mix Laksa are a little bit cheaper.Not too strong fish taste, so this Laksa is perfekt if you prefer a lighter fish taste. Noodles are tasty, nothing to complain. On my next visit to Penang i will definitely come back to taste their other Laksas. Closed on Wednesdays.Show less

Author: Hansheung
Title: Nice food, good environment
Review: Worth going! Food is good, nice environment. A nice place to try out Penang Laksa. It has a variety of famous Penang food. You dont need to scout around Penang, you can find most of the famous food here.

Author: Sue808Yokohama, Japan
Title: Delivious
Review: This is a family run little restaurant. We had the Assam laksa and nyonya laksa. Both were surprisingly good. The Assam laksa was among the best we tasted on this trip. The fact that you get to enjoy the bowl of laksa in a clean and air conditioned place is definately a plus as well! Assam laksa comes with a prawn cracker perfect for dipping in the gravy. Show less

Author: R9245AWrobl
Title: Delicious vegetarian Laksa
Review: Went for lunch at laksalicious and arrived to a menu that didn't include a vegetarian laksa. Not to worry though, the friendly waiter (owner I think) explained that if we could wait 20 minutes they could prepare a vegetarian nonya style laksa. The wait was worth it - one of the most flavoursome laksas that I have ever had. We also had freshly made spring rolls and a yam and sticky rice roll that was also delicious. We highly recommend laksalicious for both veg and non veg laksa enthusiasts when visiting Penang.Show less

Author: stromulusSouth Gippsland, Australia
Title: Penang New Wave cuisine at its best
Review: Laksalicious makes the best Beef Rendang I have ever had, including my own. The Laksas are innovative, fresh and superior. The desserts are also very yummy The whole place is a pleasure to visit and above all clean. I love the signature blue rice made from a pea flower. There is a new wave of food in Penang, Laksalicious is at the forefront.Show less

Author: ChuneKeat
Title: Good laksa place in Aircon setting
Review: Nice good laksa in Aircon setting. We had the Assam laksa and lemak laksa which were both awesome. It was very friendly service in clean service !!

Author: Ly  L
Title: Good laksa
Review: Try the laksa here! It is really good and a good portion. The owner is so nice, she even gave us tips on what to eat where jn the rest of Georgetown. :)

Author: 603kennyl
Title: Leisure
Review: When visit Penang. Give it a try. This place is nice and food is great. Although not in popular location but definitely worth the trip. Owner and staff are friendly

Author: marianneongllGeorge Town, Malaysia
Title: Whets your appetite
Review: We tried the sour laksa, the lemak laksa , the mixed laksa and the creamy pie. The laksa was yummy but the pie was just so so. The grass jelly drink and bubur cha cha was not up to my taste. We have tasted better. Pricing is mid range. Finding a parking space is a minus factor. Service is good.Show less

Author: Lau DIpoh, Malaysia
Title: Best laksa discovery for 2015
Review: Reviewing only four months after my last visit but still better late than never. My friends and i have eaten here twice and we can truly say that this is one place for 'laksa fine dining' if there is such a thing!The nyonya kuihs and pies were good too but for us it was the nyonya and assam laksa mixed soup that bowled us over! Show less

Author: AustraliaPinballMelbourne, Australia
Title: Very good laksa in a modern aircon setting
Review: You can go for the full-on-local Experience, where you sit on a plastic stool, out in the gutter, and hope the fan blows air over you occasionally. Or you can come here, and sit on comfortable chairs at a non-wobbly table, in ac comfort. The place is also immaculately clean.The Assam laksa was very good, but I felt it could have had a bit more sour/fishy taste. It was a little bland for my tastes.Show less

Author: MurniraM
Title: Great place to try laksa
Review: For those from KL who like the taste more Asam and less sweet laksa asam this is the place. Tried the Ipoh style dipping crackers into the laksa gravy and the Penang style dipping popiahs into the gravy. Great taste and ambiance.

Author: Wyendi HSingapore, Singapore
Title: Suitable for everyone's tastebuds
Review: I have tried local Penang laksa before. In comparison, Laksalicious lacked the punch in the asam taste which, in my opinion, was the essence of the broth. Nevertheless, it was tasty and I cleaned up the entire bowl of laksa. People who do not like the asam/sour flavor in the local penang laksa would like this lighter broth. Remember to choose the thick noodles - the authentic way of having Penang laksa.Show less

Author: StrawberryGal1983
Title: good laksa
Review: if you are looking for a decent laksa , this is a place. The laksa is simply delicious with generous portion. Choices of asam laksa and nyonya laksa ( nyonya laksa only available on weekends)

Author: TiriniusVernon, Canada
Title: Tasty Asam Laksa.
Review: A newer, very clean welcoming eaterie on Hutton Lane. This air conditioned modern restaurant serves up good Laksa! They won an award in 2015. Very friendly owner and staff. Try both the original Laksa as well as the coconut milk version. We had the thick noodles but thin noodles are available if you prefer. Worth a visit when you are in Penang.Show less

Author: seeseepgPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Good Fare
Review: Laksa is above average, do come on weekends (Fri till Sun) as their " Laksa Lemak" (Coconut Milk Laksa) is the one to savour.Snacks & cakes are quite good, too.Nice decor, friendly atmosphere, as with most Penang new mushrooming joints opening up left & right.Hope this can sustain in the future ....Show less

Author: Willmatt65
Title: Trying
Review:
Nice little cosy place. Good service with mouth watering food. Especially their sushi, wow. 🤤🤤🤤🤤
Definitely will come again.

Author: RicardoBowieEdinburgh, United Kingdom
Title: Super Sushi
Review: Sushi Kitchen sits on the 3rd floor of the Gurney Mall. A slick, highly polished outfit with a strong sense 9f purpose.Non GMO, and healthy options being key to this vegan inspired brand.Ate there with my wife and we both loved our meal. Had a sushi platter for 2 and other dishes too. My meal was accompanied by a nutmeg drink and my wife with a lime.Really good, healthy and balanced food.Thanks Show less

Author: imrickyisaac
Title: Execellent Sushi
Review: We stumble this while riding a bicycle..We thought we just going to have a light meal..but.since the food.is so.good we keep on ordering the food..Must TRy..especially if you are the vegetarian person

Author: H2436MXnickg
Title: Best Sushi(vegan or not)
Review: Three of ate here for lunch and dinner and only one of us was vegan. We all loved the food. Amazing soups, sushi and desert. I wish I could eat here all the time. Great staff and atmosphere.

Author: 388clarah
Title: Fantastic sushi!
Review: Fantastic vegan sushi! We are not vegans, but did not miss the fish. It was beautiful served and very fresh.

Author: CF1886South Wales, United Kingdom
Title: Recommended!
Review: Stopped off for lunch and ordered the edamame rice and opted for brown rice. It was presented really nicely but I forgot to take a photo until I’d already started eating (this happens regularly!). It cost RM14 and was really filling; it was my favourite rice dish since arriving in Malaysia. I was also given two complimentary portions of sushi which was really good. I’d like to have tried some cake but I was too full from lunch so hopefully will be back to try the cake.Show less

Author: abfwilliams
Title: Best sushi ever!
Review:
We had such a lovely lunch here. We had the family sushi plate, and we finished every mouthful. The most amazing combos! And such lovely people too. 

Thanks again!

Author: yhLOH9831
Title: Best sushi we ever had!
Review: We are so lucky found this hidden gem in Penang. We come back everyday during our 4days trip. The best sushi we ever had. All the food are prepared with fresh ingredients. Staffs are lovely and helpful. It’s a place that worth for a visit if you are travel to Penang.Show less

Author: greenhornet35
Title: Exceptional concept great execution
Review: Great food.  Veggie sushi and other japanese food. Watch out:Juices and tea a bit to sweet. To  recommend highly if uou are on a more alternative edgy track

Author: TheWanderingGurlSingapore, Singapore
Title: Healthy & Yummy
Review: Really yummy selection of vegan sushi and noodle dishes. I really recommend the Spicy Udon noodles which is made from local spices grown in Penang.It is a very cosy restaurant which serves as an ideal respite from the unforgiving Penang heat. A must-visit for vegans and vegetarians!Show less

Author: charlottediv91
Title: Best Vegan sushi ever
Review: It's the first time my husband eat vegan food, normally he eat lot of meat, and with the help of this restaurant, now he loves vegan food. Thanks Sincerely, the quality of the product, and the service were perfect! And the menu propose also a lot of choice.A culinary travel whit full surprises.The personal was very positive and happy.If you need, they can give you good advices for your travel in PenangThanks you so much!!! Show less

Author: Michael1052Armidale, Australia
Title: Pleasant dinner
Review: As is typical for Japanese restaurants, everything is done exquisitely. No matter what you order it will be delicious. The atmosphere is equally pleasant, as is the service friendly and attentive. The food comes quickly. In all, this is a fine vegan restaurant.The only thing which I found surprising was that they had no tempeh available nor tofu on the menu, which is odd. Thus the fried rice was basically delicious rice with only scant vegetables. Without tempeh or tofu, it makes each meal somewhat similar, despite being prepared very well.I should add that the prices were quite reasonable.Show less

Author: perseuskualalumpur
Title: Ok Vegan
Review: After reading the many positive reviews, I was looking forward to something  exciting  here. Very slow and expensive for a vegan restaurant. Good for a meatless night but no rush to go back.

Author: 842edhOxford, United Kingdom
Title: Four thumbs-up from a part-time vegan + a carnivore
Review: Small place but not very busy ?due to it being the low season. Service was faultless. Menu completely plant-based despite sign outside saying “vegetarian”. Ordered a couple of large plates of sushi + some hot noodles each. Both noodle bowls were umami-licious. Sushi was varied and delicious. My girlfriend who is a carnist says that “she liked it”. The meal was cheap considering the quality + compared to other places we are but obviously the concept of what is cheap is relative. Show less

Author: Georgia9000000000000
Title: Food is expensive & not substantial
Review: Food is expensive & portion is rather small (doesnt fill you up at all). Service is poor - the waiter will show you attitude if you have special request.

Author: aydrianacSan Francisco, California
Title: Awesome vegan sushi with impeccable ethics!
Review: Come here if you love sushi but you don't love how fish are treated to get on our plates! :)Using fine ingredients that they list out, you know you're in good hands here. I recommend all of the sushi rolls but especially the 7 spice! The flavors are mouth watering! The Wakame salad was super fresh and spiced perfectly! I had to get it everytime! Do try the global warming rolls- they don't specify but they come out crispy and are so delicious!I also had the fried udon and I forget what it was called but something like red chilly udon -- that one was amazing! I'd come back again and again if in the area! 5 stars! Show less

Author: DennisB25
Title: Tasteful sushi
Review: We were looking for a nice place to eat sushi in Georgetown when we found Sushi Kitchen on Tripadvisor. A small and quiet restaurant with nice servings and good sushi. Very nice staff as well. Very much recommended.

Author: sinaleo
Title: Best Sushi 😍
Review: We went there a second time because we loved it so much. The Sushi, udonnoodles and the misosoup was so delicious! It was all vegan and so fresh and tasty! We wish we could go there a million more times. The prices were really good too! We loved loved loved this place. Show less

Author: 137Maple1962Penang Island, Malaysia
Title: One Corner Cafe Char Kuey Teow
Review: This stall is my favourite as the lady cooking this dish has been at it for a loong time, and the “wok hey” from her wok is inimitable.She gives a generous dollop of prawns as well and for 5.50 ringgit, I would it is worth every cent.Her husband, the server is also a very endearing chap and I highly recommend this as a place to go to for good Penang Char Kuey Teow.Show less

Author: KristenDariaSingapore
Title: Detailed care
Review: It is clear that detailed care goes into every minute detail- from serving the guests to the preparation of each dish. Enjoyed the experience so much, we returned!I was doing the ketogenic diet & made major modifications to most dishes. Yet despite the substituted ingredients, each dish whipped up tasted marvellous!Show less

Author: pickleinwimbledon
Title: Good vegan food
Review: Good, wholesome vegan Japanese food. Maki and hand rolls were very good. Noodle dish a little bland for my taste. Nice atmosphere and good service. Option of sitting on the floor or at tables. Freshly cooked/ prepared to order.

Author: Antonio V
Title: Sushi for ever
Review:
Minimal location execelent food 
If u like to try a particular mix vegetarian or vegan this is the best

Author: VicSbr
Title: Excellent
Review: Lovely little restaurant. We decided us for the 4 course menu and enjoyed every bite of it. It was healthy, tasty and nice served. I fell in love with the "Organic Rainy Day" and the amazing vegan sushi. We totaly recommend this restaurant.

Author: oge2328
Title: Tasty Japanese Vegetarian Food!
Review: Give vegans more variety and choice. Food is beautifully prepared and tasty! Highly recommended. Small and cozy restaurant.

Author: Noknata
Title: All about sushi and ramen.
Review: The chilling restaurant in Georgetown by malaysian chineses teenager. All about sushi and ramen so delicious but no various.

Author: Travelasia2018
Title: Absolutely delicious!
Review: Surprisingly good. Everything is made with love and attention to detail and very high quality fresh ingredients. Staff super friendly and helpful. Will definitely be back. Highly recommend!

Author: VickyDimiBrussels, Belgium
Title: The best vegan sushi
Review: We found this small and cozy Japanese restaurant via trip advisor and it is for sure worth a stop over. We didn't know it was vegan and for us it was a very good experience. Staff is very friendly and helpful and the food is good quality for a small price.Show less

Author: THFOO
Title: Ok for vegetarians
Review: Good place for vegetarians to enjoy and taste Japanese food. May try the carbonara and the sushi set.

Author: munyuanlim1991
Title: Serves more than just Sushi
Review: if u think this is just another ordinary vegan restaurant then you are wrong. they serve delicious and healthy vegetarian food!

Author: marktobias
Title: Lovely
Review: I love this place. There's so much to choose from and everything is full of flavour. Such a cozy place to eat too, nice atmosphere and nice surroundings. Friendly staff,good prices. I'll be coming back next time I'm in Georgetown

Author: demalayboiPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Delish Vegan Sushi!
Review: They served all vegan only japanese cuisine, but surprisingly taste so good. Menus are limited; you can choose some type of dishes from udon, porridge, fried rice, noodles to sushi menu except that there was no meat, fish, pork whatsoever. On average a single dish mostly cost less than RM10, except for sushi; can go to RM16 per dish.During my visit, I ordered the global warming maki (I lol a bit when I saw the name but I really recommend it), happy bachelor maki set & miso udon. Very satisfied with every dish I had, service was also good. But to note that seatings are limited.I never been to a vegan restaurant before but this place really did change my perception on vegan food.Thumbs up Show less

Author: GrahamChen
Title: For vegan friends gathering
Review: nice environment and food for gathering with vegan . you will enjoy the food even you are not vegan. especially the sushi is really nice

Author: mariafdagironFrankfurt, Germany
Title: Average and extremely slow!
Review: The sushis here are just average! The creativity of vegan sushi’s is very low since it is the same ingredients for all the sushis. This place is also in desperately need of an extra server! It gets full very easily (because of its tiny space) so the service is extremely slow! They took 1hour and 30minutes to deliver 4 types of sushi! (We ordered more stuffs but they forgot!) Also extremely expensive for the average sushi flavor. Was worth the try but we would not come back. Show less

Author: SGaind
Title: Delicious Food
Review:
Love their ambiance .. especially the wall. 
The place was clean as expected. 
We just love the sushi collection of theirs..  Rainbow shushi is a must one ...

Author: Ginny9899
Title: Delicious
Review:
Delicious spaghetti & Sushi, healthy & yummy. Must try
All Cook with vegetable and fruits, non msg food.

Author: livga
Title: Delicious!
Review: Very delicious sushi and rice with edamame. The staff was friendly, but we had to wait rather long to order and until the food was served. But as it was delicious, i would still recommend it :)

Author: soumayab565Paris, France
Title: Friendly staff and tasty food!
Review: This restaurant offers healthy and veggie meals including ramens, sushis, and bentos. Sushis are different from the ones we know in Europe as it’s made without any fish, but I was positively surprised!! I took one ramen soup and a set of sushis and it tasted really good. Staff is very friendly and always smiley. Show less

Author: MichelleShellDBristol, United Kingdom
Title: Delicious!
Review: This is the most delicious vegan sushi i have ever eaten! The food is well presented. The staff are very helpful and friendly, its obvious that they take great pride in their work and their enzyme water.Yes the food takes a little while to be served but thats because its all freshly made to order and its a popular place. Its worth the wait and excellent value for money.Show less

Author: riccardoa745
Title: Sushi spot on finally after one hour waiting.
Review: Great dishes, a lot of different choices in the menu but the from the time we sat down to the first dish served was past almost one hour. It was worth it but from who is on the 1st place in trip advisor Penang everything have to work a little bit better if after there is a 10% of service on top to pay. Overall happy and a place "must to try".Show less

Author: Xiao Wei T
Title: Great ambience, great food and great staff as well
Review: Great ambience and the staff was so helpful and polite. The food very delicious and fresh, the taste was amazing especially the mango sushi. Love it so much. The price was affordable.

Author: NadineH2008
Title: Amazing Place!
Review: we tried almost everything, its delicious! especially the sushi. staffs very friendly. the waiting time is quite long but they inform you in the beginning; theres a sign on the table. so take your time and enjoy the delicious food!

Author: backpackmegMargate, United Kingdom
Title: Yummy food.
Review: We enjoyed the food very much, there is lots of choice and as vegans we love finding places like these. The food was very tasty and healthy. Everything was reasonably priced which was good. There was also deals for lunch. The restaurant itself was very dark and not very lights this is not a problem but we just prefer an open light space especially in the day time. For that reason we are giving a four rather than a five as the rating is about everything. It's nice to have a different cuisine and if you enjoy Japanese food we recommend this place.Show less

Author: tomhA3408FD
Title: Amazing vegan sushi & friendly helpful staff
Review: Beautiful food, friendly staff and a gorgeous little restaurant, tastefully decorated. We shared one main (the happy spicy noodles) and the large sushi platter between two and the amount of food was perfect. Would go back anytime!

Author: MoonByrneManchester, United Kingdom
Title: Amazing food and lovely atmosphere.
Review: We had a really nice meal here at Sushi Kitchen. The menu is fantastic as it tells you every ingredient that goes into each dish so you can pick one you know you will love. We had fried rice with soy bean floss which was absolutely delicious! No idea what the floss was but it tasted amazing! We also had an udon Red Sea soup which was really tasty. To finish off we shared some global warming maki sushi and it was outstanding! I am not usually a sushi fan but this was incredible and I highly recommend you try it! Apart from the food being some of the best we have ever eaten the atmosphere was chilled, the staff were lovely and the service was great. I would highly recommend this delightful restaurant to everyone!Show less

Author: platybo
Title: Wonderful Vegan Sushi rolls
Review: We were a bit apprehensive since we vegetarians/vegans like to rate like-minded restaurants highly just for serving ethical food, not necessarily for how good the food tastes. We were pleasantly surprised in every single way. From the outside this place looks like a closed little home but inside it's cosy and pleasant. The food was great! I highly recommend the 'Hapiness Family' set which allows you to try a variety of sushi rolls. They have refill green tea and water and were very reasonably priced. My favorite was the global warming Maki :) Show less

Author: brionys447
Title: A must try!!
Review: we found it by accident while visiting the clan jetty. Had seen it on happy cow a few days before and just happened upon it that day! The price really depends on what you want, but everything is very reasonable. You can eat cheap and healthy (and delicious) japanese food here. The menu tells you everything that goes in each dish, which is good for fussy eaters. Extremely friendly staff (maybe the 2 women are the owners?) even offered us an umbrella when we were leaving in the rain. We had udon noodle/miso soup wich came with tempura enoki mushrooms,and also ordered a wakame salad. Refills on your green tea aswel books if you want to chill out for a bit. We never got around to trying sushi as the portions are perfect.Show less

Author: MynameisrickKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: A Must TRY
Review: A Restaurant You Should go if You In penang...A Vegetarian Restaurant with Japanese cuisine..We tried the vegan Udon and The sushi ..it was tasty for me..I never thought that Vegetarian sushi would be taste so delicious..It stated there they make their own.mayonaise...The negative part Their operation hour show 6pm- 10pm..BUT we have to.wait 15 to 20minutes to wait because the staff still not there..We only see One White lady (mat salleh)and we taught shes the customer..Apparently shes the one who serve us :) ..It would be better if Staff who came late apologize to the waiting customer..Instead looking at us with no Smiley face....We have to.wait because you are LATE...And its not 5 minutes late...And Some more 10%service included..What a service charge i did pay with Sour Face Dude .Luckyly The White lady handle the situation well..I would gave 5 star but Sour face 4 star :)Show less

Author: 821sebCaldaro sulla Strada del Vino, Italy
Title: Best vegan Udon noodle soup and sushi ever!
Review: Highly to be recommended!!!We are the first time vegan sushi and Udon noodle soup and the taste was delicious. I never thought that vegan sushi can taste like this.Also very friendly staff. Nice small restaurant. Great price value. Could not believe the low price.Try it and love it.Show less

Author: rainbow753Singapore
Title: Good food worth the wait!
Review: Tried a few days of local food. Read so many reviews on Gurney Drive, Northern Beach and New Lane. The comments were ready extreme.Finally sushi kitchen caught my attention with many very consistent positive feedback. About 10 min walk from the hotel I stayed. Small and cozy place. Perhaps aircon can be better. Service is not fast as they already mentioned why it is so on the menu.No regrets! Food was good. Worth the wait. I tried the mango sushi which was not on the menu. The spaghetti was good. We tried the dessert and coffee! They were good! Will definitely recommend to friends. Or visit the next time when I am in Penang! Show less

Author: simply4m3Singapore, Singapore
Title: Just a treat for Vegan, Vegetarians or anybody ready for a healthy meal
Review: I am coming to this place every time I am in Penang and been here countless times but never thought of commending until now, since I think that this place is without a doubt my favorite eatery in Penang. Not just the food and service is great but once you enter this place its like the time is standing still....and all you do is enjoy a great plate of food prepared with care and love! just amazing in times like this! Must try: Global warming, tom yum noodle soup!!! just yummmmyShow less

Author: GregnkiaPerth, Australia
Title: Beautiful experience
Review: Visitited sushi kitchen yesterday on a whim. Neither my wife and I are not vegetarians or vegans. But enjoy Japanese cuisine, sushi and appreciate honest, healthy food cooked well and that is exactly what this was. Green tea, fresh ingredients and tasty food.A beautiful service with impeccable, high quality well presented honest food that would give nobu a run for his money!Show less

Author: Ambassador15105
Title: Superb
Review: One of the best places to eat in Penang. We ate at both the branches, George Town and Gurney plaza. We loved the fresh ingredients and the quality of food. It’s not only healthy but yummy. If I get this kind of vegetarian sushi I would never crave the other kind. Highly recommend even if you are not a vegan or vegetarian. Show less

Author: SingaporeBagelSingapore, Singapore
Title: The best vegan restaurant anywhere!
Review: We are a family of vegetarian/vegans and this is hands down the best Vegan Japanese restaurant we’ve been!No MSG and all natural or organic products used at the little, simple and cozy restaurant.Yummy and clean tasting dishes tried include happy spicy noodles, Golden miso udon and all sushi rolls were excellent!Definitely recommended for vegan/vegetarians and also anyone interested in a good Japanese meal.We will be back.Show less

Author: Stine L
Title: Amazing
Review: Amazing food on the 3rd floor at Gurney Plaza. The sushi was incredible and we ended up eating there several times

Author: jetlaggedmum
Title: Amazing food
Review: Fresh tasty ingredients made into amazing dishes. Great for people who want a bit of a change in what they are eating or for those of us actively seeking out vegan food!

Author: zoeywoey2007
Title: My favourite vegetarian restaurant
Review:
Worth trying it, they sell vegetarian food that does not make you have the "vegetarian" feel. No "artificial-meat", they use all natural food.

My all-time favorite is their Cinderella porridge and Rainbow sushi.  

Be patient as they have no enough staff this branch.

Author: Adrian PLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: This is a vegetarian Resturant
Review: I thought wow Sushi so we decide to come for sushi, looking at the photos it looked amazing .my mouth was watering with the thought of salmon and squid. Unfortunately we were meet with a sad mistake no salmon or squid. The staff were amazing offered alternatives but the young man we were with wanted non vegetarian . Next time I want to try cause wow the food looked great. Perhaps it should have been made clear this is a vegetarian restaurant!Show less

Author: CortunefookieMelbourne, Australia
Title: Amazing vegan Japanese food
Review: I ate here a few times on a recent trip, trying different types of sushi each time. It was amazing. I didn't see any "fake meat" style products on the menu, instead it is all happily vegetable based. The service is friendly and very helpful, and while it isn't cheap for Penang it is INSANE that such good quality and innovative food costs so little. We generally had plate after plate after plate of some of the best sushi I have ever had and the total was about 80 RM each time. Would visit George Town just to go back.Show less

Author: sharadbhat13Singapore, Singapore
Title: Best Japanese restaurant I've ever been to, anywhere!
Review: The title is true, and I've been to quite a lot of Japanese restaurants, even non vegetarian ones! We had the happiness couple sushi set and happy spicy noodle soup. They were both amazing and healthy. The staff were really amazing and i loved the homely and comfortable interiors. We also had the Japanese green tea, which was soothing. It was also very very reasonably priced. The wall has wonderful messages left by travellers from around the world. If it was in my home town, i would visit every week. It even made me think about moving to penang!!Show less

Author: ritub214Geylang, Singapore
Title: Paradise for vegans, recommended for non vegetarians too!
Review: Tasty food, beautiful environment and lovely people. Sushi Kitchen is a must visit in Penang! The food is delicious and the whole experience of dining here leaves you feeling happy! I went there with a friend who has tried non-veg Japanese food and he loved it too.Special recommendation: Happy spicy noodle soup Show less

Author: Sammy BNottingham, United Kingdom
Title: Amazing Sushi :)!
Review: We really enjoyed the food here! The service was brilliant and food tasted amazing and was presented so well. Being vegan, I usually steer clear of sushi as there is not a great choice, so it was perfect to be able to choose anything off the menu! My boyfriend, who is not vegan, said it was some of the best sushi he has ever had! Show less

Author: francescpbKo Phi Phi Don, Thailand
Title: One of my Top3 worlwide
Review: Yesterday I went to Sushi Kitchen Georgetown Branch while waiting for the process of my visa to go to Thailand.It was my 3rd time there in the last two years.Again absolutely amazing.I'm not vegan but this is by far the best high quality restaurant in the city.I ordered fried noodle with sesame oil, mushrooms, carrots, seeds, etc. Again superbI topped this with an edamame as appetizer and one crunchy maki.For drink hot green tea.The taste and the environment was a festival for my senses. I also had the opportunity to have a chat with Ms Guang Yeoh, one of the owners. She explained me that they grow all the vegetables which they use so all them are collected when properly mature. She also showed me that the restaurant if free of chemicals. The cleaning is done with natural enzims which again they prepare on their own.The price is also incredibly friendly, moreover when you check the extreme excellence of their recipes and cuisine.If you come to Georgetown in Penang, to have lunch or dinner in the Sushi Kitchen is a must. Otherwise you will miss one of the top wonders of the city.Show less

Author: Marc P
Title: Fantastic Jap Vegan Resto
Review: Japanese style vegan restaurant. Interesting cooking philosophy. They use enzyme to soak all vegetables and filter water for all cooking and drinking.Very affordable prices for the quality and the innovative offer. Perhaps a bit limited in my opinion .Highly recommend for vegans and non-vegans!Show less

Author: ApocalypseYana
Title: Vegan everything!
Review: Sushi Kitchen is a vegans dream. We had two delicious noodles soups and a plate of sushi and all were incredibly tasty!

Author: DaffilsTravels
Title: Excellent vegan sushi
Review: Love how peaceful and quaint the restaurant is. There is a quiet zen-ness about this place that makes you want to put away your electronic devices and enjoy your meal mindfully. The vegan sushi is a must-try, and I'll definitely be back for more.Relatively affordable: 6 maki for 10 ringgit. Show less

Author: alexandrabW2702DFMount Maunganui, New Zealand
Title: Incredible place to eat & love 💛
Review: The most amazing experience at sushi kitchen! Not only is all the food vegan, it's prepared, created & served with love. We aren't vegan, ended up eating here 4 times whilst in Georgetown. Staff are incredible! They invited us to make vegan dumplings as a special occasion & taught us how, then we cooked and ate them together. Was incredible! I would recommend the spicy happy noodles, the energy miso with brown rice & the Red Sea udon noodle soup. Was amazing! Along with their global warming sushi. Couldn't rate this place highly enough. Thanks for an amazing experience ☺️⚡️☺️keep killing it sushi kitchen! Show less

Author: Fabio S
Title: Orrible
Review: In italiano: Fa schifo tutto.. È un sushi vegano. Niente pesce!In English: The food is not bad for vegan... the local is very orrible and terrible as the service... the waitress isnt professional... he said me the wifi didn't work but the truth was he wouldnt gave me... unpleasant experience!Show less

Author: milouvm
Title: LOVED IT!
Review:
Omg this vegan sushi is THE best! Even my carnivore bf LOVED it :D
Also Many other choices like nasi, Bami,all vegan!

Author: LisaFreeBirdCafeChiang Mai, Thailand
Title: Vegan Sushi!
Review: Oh my goodness! My friends all told me to go here and I didn't make it in my last visit and then came on a Tues when they were closed (my fault, they are always closed on Tues). I finally made it today and it was sooo good! I got the platter for two but easily ate that and a veggie hand wrap. Their vegan mayo is delicious and it looks like they do a lot of in house fermenting which is cool. I will be back for an Udon Noodle or Porridge which also looks wholesome and delicious. It doesn't seem to be a location close to many other things except a big mall but I easily took an Uber here from my guesthouse. I will try another location next time as they have 4 spots. The service was really great and it seemed like a lot of locals and business lunches happening which is always a good sign. Enjoy! Oh, they also showed me their enzymes that they make for cleaning with, it's awesome that they don't use any chemicals in their place at all :) Show less

Author: carolineaB9919NY
Title: Best (and first) vegan sushi!
Review: This is a hidden gem! Amazing food and atmosphere located in a rather empty area - however don't be fooled, for you won't be disappointed, this is truly incredible.

Author: Sharifa D
Title: Absolutely fantastic!
Review: We went to this lovely, vegan, restaurant. We didn't knew it was vegan until we arrived but since we only eat fish sometimes, this was a blast! We celebrated my birthday over here and will recommend this place to everyone! Even if you eat meat, you must try it. Show less

Author: pattrag2015Chaweng, Thailand
Title: Best Japanese food in Penang
Review: So nice food and very yummy. Outside look like it close if we have no TripAdvisor we will never know this place. Thank you TripAdvisor and thank you of Sushi Kitchen for good food . If I back to Penang I will not miss this place. And I won't you miss this too :).Show less

Author: MAChanoiHanoi
Title: Sushi Saved My Life!
Review: Sushi Kitchen that is. Seriously. And I didn't have sushi -- I had a huge fabulous bowl of noodles, because, really, this is a noddle bar. An ORGANIC noodle bar! And it was only my second day in George Town and I had gone in search of something near Chew Jetty and had not found it and it was SO hot and I didn't have my usual bottle of water with me and I thought really I am about to pass out -- when I passed this little hole in the wall with a Japanese fabric banner out but which looked closed. And thank goodness I tried the door! Open! Not closed, just a bit dark... and COOL! In both senses of that word, as in I was saved from the heat and in a peaceful, clean, magical space full of friendly faces at a long table (none of them speaking English) and the English-speaking woman waiting tables was kind and patient and the soup was heavenly. I could not believe my good luck! Even if you are not vegetarian or about to have heat stroke, I urge you to go here for lunch.Show less

Author: izzyk000
Title: Vegan food
Review: A really cozy vegan restaurant. The food we ordered were all well presented and taste yummy. Good for group gatherings.

Author: Kiki L
Title: All vegan sushi!
Review: I ate here almost every day. Loved the food, the staff, the ambience and of course the fact that EVERYTHING on the menu is vegan.

Author: harnamrLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Amazing vegan food!
Review: Stumbled upon this place looking for good vegetarian options... so glad we did. Food was delicious and the restaurant was really cute and cosy. We ordered the Happiness couple plate which was SO tasty... the sushi is wonderfully presented and tasted even better. I also ordered some fried rice which is one of their specials... was so good that we are planning to go back whilst on the trip! If your about I really recommend supporting this place xxxx Show less

Author: seeseepg
Title: Neither here nor there
Review:
Its a vegan food joint, mind ya. No meat for carnivores like me.
Tastewise, it's just a-ok, not great but not bad, either.
Price is ..... for meatless fare, it ain't cheap.
Do i wanna return here? Probably not.

Author: SEEMINO1
Title: Dinner ... Veg
Review: Good food. Idea for vegan. My kids love the food. Love the Happy Spicy Noodle. Reasonable price. Very tasty sushi.

Author: Pizzapup101
Title: Delicious food, great service!
Review: We visited this little restaurant for lunch during our stay in Georgetown. It was nice to discover it in a quiet street, a little off the beaten track. We were so happy to find really tasty vegetarian food as we've found this a little hard to come by in Malaysia. The sushi was fresh and innovative. The warm dishes (noodles and soups) were also delicious. All very reasonably priced and with top notch service. We loved it so much we went back for lunch the next day! We'd recommend the crispy gken floss sushi rolls. Show less

Author: Anna-Lena G
Title: Delicious Food
Review: I highly recommend this Restaurant. It tastes so awesome and the Atmosphere ist also pretty nice. We tried different Sushi and a sweet potato soup. Everything was great and affordable.

Author: Christin717Penang Island, Malaysia
Title: BEST SUSHIi ever in town
Review: I'm not a vegan person but this place is really awesome ! Staff is very friendly and great recommendation. The place is build with Japanese tatami style which on sit on the wooden floor. t=They have table chairs as well. But i would prefer tatami style to experience Japanese culture.Cozy environment with dim light. Relaxation music.Air-conditioned. The food is SOOOO DELICIOUS that I ever taste. So surprised me with their meatless meal ! I can feel my body is very comfort by the food. NOT feeling heavy aft having the meal here. Very easy to digest the food energy. Just simply comfortable.I can said that it was a self-reward meal for me on the day.Thank you Sushi Kitchen !Show less

Author: Alex PSaint Petersburg, Saint Petersburg City, Russia
Title: The most delicious place in Penang
Review: I stayed in Penang for about 4 weeks and tried Sushi Kitchen only at last week. Thanks to my friend for recommendation. And after that I ate there every day! Greatest soups ever! If you spicy-lover, get Happy Spicy Noodle and if you're not — take Sapporo Noodle Soup or Sweet Potato Noodle. That would be a perfect start. Then you can continue with sushi and other meals, but I really loved this place for their noodle soups. Prices are very reasonable, starting just 6 RM per meal. The place is vegan, but not only vegan people will love it — don't pay attention to this if you're not vegan. Highly recommend to visit in George Town!Show less

Author: vganyogi
Title: Excellent vegan sushi
Review: Favorite place that I wont miss everytime I visit Penang. Healthy yet yummy cuisine with organic ingredients. You should try their porridge, spicy noodle (la la mien), and the sushi set. You wont regret.

Author: Theresa6315
Title: Good vegetarian sushi place
Review: Was suprised to find that it is a vegetarian sushi restaurant.We had a few dishes to try and found everything very nice and tasty.Great find for vegetarian

Author: Erica JAtlanta, Georgia
Title: Excellent lunch!
Review: Popped in here for a lye lunch as it is right around the corner from our hotel. Super quaint and clearly a gay friendly establishment. Vegan sushi, yum.Menu has several hot noodle and rice dishes, sides, and creative rolls. For a filling delicious lunch for 4, we spent $15 USD.Show less

Author: LjungskogChuo, Japan
Title: Disappointing sushi experience
Review: Due to the overwhelmingly positive reviews and my curiosity, my wife and I went here this weekend to try something new - "Vegan Sushi". I was looking forward to an "..explosion of spices and different tastes", but we had no such experience. The 5 different sorts of Maki Rolls we tried, tasted allmost the same and was far away great. If you have vegan or vegetarian preferences, it might be a decent alternative to real sushi, but for sushi lovers, sushi kitchen is not the best choice.Show less

Author: Maria R
Title: Amazing (all vegan) food!!
Review: My favorite place to eat in Penang definetely! The Enoki Porridge is so delicious, as well as the sushi and Golden miso udon. And it is all vegan food!The staff are the nicest people and the atmosphere of the place is quiet and chill. I can't recommend enough!Show less

Author: lcpriest1
Title: Delicious!
Review: The sushi was delicious! I would also highly recommend the happy spicy noodles. The staff are very friendly too.

Author: Nikita S
Title: Simply amazing!
Review: I was here with a friend and we just kinda stumbled upon it. This is definitely the best sushi I've ever had, it's an explosion of spices and different tastes! And after I'm done eating I realize that this is a vegan place. Definitely worth a visit and I would recommend you to order the happiness bachelor plate to get the most out of the experience. Service is also fast and nice plus it's a very relaxing atmosphere. Show less

Author: rodneykchan
Title: Sushi
Review: Good food, but you have to not like meat. The noodles were great and service was good. The door is a little hard to find and the taxi driver didn't know where it was. You might have to use good map to show the taxi driver. Show less

Author: Rhiannon S
Title: Unexpected Vegan
Review: I had read a review on this restaurant saying how delicious the food was and on arrival, we realised that it was a vegan restaurant - to our surprise! But wow, food was amazing! I went with my parents and husband (all meat eaters) and we loved it. Had numerous sushi options (my favourite the mango sushi), two types of fried rices and an udon dish. We gave it 4 stars as The venue itself is quite small with an average atmosphere and our waitress was okay, but the food is definitely worth it. Yummy Vegan Food!!Show less

Author: virginieb958
Title: Vegan organic japanese made with love
Review:
New at Plaza gurney, 3rd floor, with outside cool terrace with fountain, fan and lounge music. Food is just delicious! 
Can be customized, brown rice, high organic food quality, fresh, it s heaven!

Author: 277veraaKoh Tao, Thailand
Title: Amazing plant-base sushi - pieces of art, super friendly staff
Review: The most amazing sushi we ever had! Because it was so delicious we came back the next day for lunch and take away for our travel onward. Every sushi is a true piece of art. We loved the Crispy sushis, the "Happy Bachelor" plate and the sushi called "Global Warming".Might be a bit hard to find, but absolutely worth to walk a small bit out of the busy area. Check the wall, especially next to the sticker in the middle ;-)Show less

Author: jackassygood
Title: Best vegan sushi outside of Japan. ..well maybe not
Review: Just walking and looking at murals when I fell upon a Japanese sushi restaurant in hot penang.  Good decor and very Japanese.   But the important thing was the food itself which was good.  It was a nice surprise.

Author: P N
Title: Extremely tasty vegan food
Review: The flavours are immense! Great unassuming ambience and very cute restaurant. The staff are very pleasant and everything is cooked fresh.

Author: Adventure679752
Title: Loved it!
Review: I absolutely enjoyed the experience. Thanks to the staff and the chefs. The environment was kinda hippie which is fun! Yet, the food and the presentation felt respectful and clean which you cannot always get with veggie places in Penang. Thumbs up for this place!

Author: 162liannek
Title: Loved it!
Review: We heard a lot of really good stuff about this place and we have to admit that all of it is true! Great sushi and really lovely people! Loved the mango sushi as dessert and so nice that everything is vegan. Should be more places like this all around the world!Show less

Author: myoape
Title: Vegan at its finest
Review: A lovely place with a chill atmosphere,  free refills on tea. We tried both fried upon and several of the sushi,  which were all really good. The ingredients were fresh and crispy.

Author: F179DOthomasm
Title: Super sushi
Review: Small cozy place. Very japanese style. Food excellent. No meat - just vega. But superb sushi. Very competitive pricelevel. I will visit again

Author: travelbug2859Penang Island, Malaysia
Title: Simplicity at its best!
Review: You would think it's another Japanese cafe cum restaurant that serves the normal sushi range but surprisingly it's a bit different from others.Went to the outlet in Lebuh Acheh.Place is back to basic , some seatings on tatami Using basically vegetarian as well as organic ingredients, it's an ideal place for vegans.We tried a few of their sushi range, small in portion but tasteful and unique and good presentation.The soup udon was also good, be it soy based and particularly one with a combination of pumpkin/lemon grass soup based. So unique!A worthwhile visit!!Show less

Author: luiscC5401MZPortsmouth, United Kingdom
Title: Simply incredible food
Review: We came here to eat as it was close by and had decent reviews. We did not expect such an incredible little restaurant.Everything here is vegan and made with care, love and exceptional skill. I'm not a vegan but after eating here I'm thinking it wouldn't be a bad idea.The honey nutmeg juice is delicious and the sushi they do is crazy. I was under the impression sushi meant fish, but some how they've created these amazing bundles of vegan joy. That's not saying they don't do other dishes. Their fried rice is super tasty as is the sweet potato noodles. The variation of amazing food to eat will keep you coming back (in 4 days we ate here 4 times).I take my hat off to you. When we're back in Penang, expect us clearing your plates once again! P.S. The waiter who was there every time we went in was super helpful and friendly as well, making us feel comfortable and welcome every time we visited!Thank you! Show less

Author: 757mandyr
Title: BEST!
Review: You will really forget you're actually in a vegetarian restaurant. All the food serve is really good especially the smtg spicy noodle. Sushi kitchen is near Armenian street heritage hotel. About 5-10 mins walking distance. Recommend to book table before going because they only have limited space. Eventhough their service is slow, I would really go back to Penang just for the sushi! :DShow less

Author: CM2020
Title: Love the sushi
Review:
You'll forget the food is vegan. We couldn't resist a second visit. The sushi and soups taste fantastic and are priced fairly. The staff are very polite and friendly. 
Sushi kitchen is a great choice for vegetarian/vegans/anybody. Definitely recommended.

Author: LovelySR
Title: Great food. Hard to find the restaurant though.
Review:
Wonderful food served here but the shop itself is hard to find.... The map doesnt bring to the exact location of the shop.
Service was slow due to lack of staff and there is limited seats available. Worth the wait though for my vegetarian food.

Author: Mareli007Ko Samui, Thailand
Title: Extraordinary culinary experience
Review: I'm not a vegetarian although have cut down a lot on meat and fish in the past years. Sushi Kitchen was the most surprising experience. Sushi with no fish? Udon noodle soup with miso base or crunchy seaweed in this March heat of Penang? Well we were converted two nights in a row with a new experience for the palate. Delicious Japanese food at its utmost healthy and so tasty. The manager/waiter was so helpful too and recommended with complete confidence the dishes we should try and he was spot on. We left with full tummies yet not feeling heavy and sleepy but rather elated and wishing we could have this at home.We started with a classic wakame salad, sushi rolls (they're all good if the two we had are anything to go by), the black God soup and an Udon crunchy seaweed soup, next night the spicy udon noodle soup. We practically licked our bowls clean !Lastly the wall of patrons who have dined over the years leaving messages on the walls is also very entertaining to read... Can t recommend it enough. Show less

Author: lichtleeSingapore
Title: SOOO DELICIOUS
Review: I love the sushi very much! The seaweed was made crispy and it tasted soooo good!!! MUST TRY! MUST TRY! The udon was served hot, it's really delicious when you wanna feel your stomach up with hot soup. Rich taste with a mixture of tofu. I craved for more when I went back to the hotelShow less

Author: cindyhayashi
Title: AWESOME
Review: No MSG, pure handmade and organic! I don't know how to describe this place but it's a very down to earth vegan restaurant i've ever eat so far!

Author: scottdacurtyErfurt, Germany
Title: Best restaurant in Georgetown
Review: We had to come back the next day after we've eaten there for the first time. It's a cozy restaurant with all vegan food. The prices are fairly cheap which was a pleasant surprise. The food was amazing, the only minus is that they didn't have vegan gyoza but that's just personal preference. The global warming sushi extremely good but the seaweed rice was also very good. Show less

Author: melanieh305
Title: Awesome vegan Sushi
Review: I absolutely love this place. Food is great, price is good, would go there every day if I could. I had the spicy noodles and the global warming sushi and both were delicious.

Author: SniddiejSeoul, South Korea
Title: As a non vegan: i changed my opinion
Review: as my friend is getting closer to vegan than vegetarian we looked for vegaterian places. And we found this. this was one of the meals we kept on going on about during our holiday and we will never forget this place. great food and lovely staff and good environment. this restaurant made my opinion about vegan positive and reccoment in for everyone! from a meat lover who normally doesn't like sushiShow less

Author: wshaprMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Organic Vegetarian Japanese food
Review: This restaurant is introduced by a friend. We took some time to find this restaurant even though with the help of Penang friend. Initially, we thought it was closed as the wooden and traditional door was not opened. It is located nearby the art street. There is some unique food such as mango sushi, green bean fried rice etc that you won't be able to find it whether in Vegetarian restaurant or normal Japanese restaurant. Show less

Author: Tobias L
Title: One man show
Review: This dude rocks the show. One man performance and his crew in your living room? Sushi Kitchen is your new home! Its delicious, different and home style!
