Luckely the menu also provides a range of different price levels and so we are there quite often. Thanks Sushi Kitchen Vegan paradise...Show less

Author: Joshua BMelbourne, Australia
Title: Amazing
Review: I don't usually eat vegetarian food, let alone vegan food. But this place was absolutely deliciousThere's a good selection, the food is all fresh and the taste is just amazing. We ended up going back here 3 times because the food is so goodJapanese is my favorite type of food, and this is one of the best Japanese restaurants I've ever been toShow less

Author: Dochema
Title: Awesome vegetarian sushi!
Review: Loved it...the food, the ambience, the service!! It's totally vegetarian, no msg, no meat, no garlic and onions. But the food is tasty!

Author: SangkerM
Title: Must visit for veg lovers
Review: One of the best veg restaurant in Penang. Japanese style veg foods with cozy environment will make u to forget ur busy life for awhile. Staffs also very friendly.

Author: rayslab2001
Title: Best Jap vegetarian I have eaten
Review: Love all the food there from noodle, maki, hand roll to all their sushi.. The restaurant size is small but the staff is friendly and helpful.  Love the spicy noodle very much....never get enough of it and the hand roll.....tasty!

Author: KateAzarovaLviv, Ukraine
Title: Best vegan place so far
Review: In total KL the best place to be vegetarian! So many places with amazing veggies and tofy. But Sushi Kitchen definately best place for vegan sushi. We tried 2 different kind of sushi and spirulina soup. All is very good. Prices are reasonable. Also i king a fan of this kind of interior design simple and art in the same time. Very chill and comfortable atmosphere. Would love to come back there one day P.s. You also can by handmade vegan bodywash and maybe some others things on reception :)Show less

Author: M RNantes, Pays de la Loire, France
Title: Vegetarian ? Yummy first !!!
Review: Vegetarian, you said Vegetarian ? HahahaWhen we went there, we didn't notice it is a veggie place, as we are not vegetarian.We were a bit surprised not to see fish in the sushi or other dishes, but it was so yummy that it didn't really matter.It was a good surprise, and a delicious lunch ! Miam !!Show less

Author: SMYDY
Title: Japanese vegetarian cuisine
Review: This is one of my favorite vegetarian restaurant, they serve variety of Japanese cuisine with their joy and beautiful hearts. If you are a sushi or udon noodles lover, then don't miss this wonderful place while your visit to Penang.

Author: Climber426155
Title: Best veggie food in Georgetown
Review: Hands down the best veggie/vegan restaurant in Georgetown, if not Malaysia. I love this place so much, I've been 3 times in the 10 days I've spent in Georgetown and my meat eating boyfriend was just as eager to go back as I was. All the food is prepared fresh, and is delicious and healthy. The guy who works here is very sweet and friendly and also told me about a vegan cake shop they own in Penang. I haven't tried it yet but I hope to soon. If you like Japanese food, this is a MUST EAT, if you are vegan or not. Show less

Author: TripMember06152015
Title: Good vegan's restaurant
Review: Been there couple of time before.Tucked away in the corner of heritage area of PENANG, difficult to find as the shop's deco external as well internally is not remarkable.Took time to prepare the food that you order but I bet they have the determination to serve you the best. Claimed no preservatives, wash and clean food ingredients with enzymes etc.I ordered some sushi & noodles.Quality is above average.Mangoes shushi are the best.Show less

Author: Jepa PHelsinki, Finland
Title: One of best meals I ever had
Review: I highly recommend Sushi Kitchen to anyone wondering what a completely vegan japanese restaurant could offer. We tasted makis and they were so good we ended up ordering sets after sets... :) The ambience is also nice and warm, and waiter was very friendly. Everything we tasted was SO good that words fail. They even played old jazz, and when Satchmo sang "Heaven, I'm in heaven..." and I had a mouthful of Global Warming sushi, well, I felt that heaven really must be like this.Show less

Author: lmeinkingBuffalo, New York
Title: Excellent vegan food!
Review: Went to this place with my husband after reading the reviews here and it was an amazing experience. The food is indeed very good, we tried at least eight different sushi dishes, all extremely good. Try their special one, called global warming. It's fried and excellent. There was just one cook so the food took some time but it is definitely worth the wait. Our miso soups were also delicious. The nice guy who took our orders suggested we should try their homemade nutmeg juice, which is made of nutmeg syrup. Very good! If you don't want too sweet, make sure you tell them. Show less

Author: Peter H
Title: Delicious vegan Japanese food
Review: Very small and friendly restaurant we discovered accidentally and too late to try many things, but the sushi sets made us wish we had. Subtle and tasty which showed a talented chef. Their wall is covered with testimonials, many from non-vegans.  Give them a try!

Author: U5571MLjenniferlPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Good place for vegetarian meal
Review: Managed to try out this restaurant after friends went there and recommended it. u may missed the restaurant if u are not really aware of it passing through Gat Lebuh Acheh as the door are closed and it is decorated with lots of plants outside. Small cozy place to enjoy your meal, quiet, clean and simple. Food are prepared with much passion by seeing how they present their meals and food portion is reasonable for the price. Workers are friendly. the only setback for me is there are a lot of things not available in the menu.. :( hope they could improve on that :)Show less

Author: Renke B
Title: Best Sushi Ever!
Review: Eat here once and you'll keep going back :) Great selection and wonderful staff... Try the 'Golden Age' sushi!!

Author: luz_del_abismoPai, Thailand
Title: Serene space with delish vegan japanese food
Review: This is my absolute favorite restaurant & place to chill in penang. It combines all my preferences... Japanese organic vegan food, a serene space with great service by passionate people who live their beliefs.It serves sushi, inside-out rolls, inari, wakame, miso soup, rice dishes, & creative cuisine including sweet potato noodles & other gluten free delights. Also serves porridge, fried udon dishes & tasty, refreshing beverages like homey nutmeg juice. My favorite is 'mango sushi' which they only offer when mangoes are perfectly sweet in season.The portions are a good size & price is very reasonable. A great place to take friends & share meals. The atmosphere is calm with low lighting, chilled lounge music & soft air-con (not too cold). There is raised floor seating on pillows & a bench / bar for those who prefer to be off the ground.The people who work there are incredibly lovely, polite & helpful. Ask them what they recommend - you won't be dissapointed.Open Tues to Fri 11.30am - 9.30pm (last order 9pm)Sat & Sun 11.30am -2.30pm, then 6pm -10pm (lo 9.30)Closed on Mondays.The door is always closed over, so just go straight in, it keeps the inside quiet & cool.www.facebook.com/sushikitchentooShow less

Author: wa_LiewKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Vegetarian choice
Review: A good place for vegetarian, there are a lot of choices beside sushi, the noodle and fried rice is good, in fact, if u r not sure what to order the staff would be helpful enough to help by recommend the food to u! The atmosphere here is fair, may be there should improve on it...cos it looks a little disorganised! Overall is ok!Show less

Author: AnnerCheeKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Not worthy, feeling cheated!
Review: Not worthy, they recognized us the famous sushi with different tastes which have 8 pcs per plate, is too expensive! It was just 8 small pcs with a normal tasted and cost us RM18.80, which is RM2 something per small piece! (Please look at the photo!) The restaurant stated open from morning to night, but when we reach there the door was close, and we have to call them for open the door! Wired! The restaurant is not so clean, and a bit of smell when we enter it.Show less

Author: iolona6Levico Terme, Italy
Title: Best vegan sushi I've ever had!
Review: I can't recommend this place enough. It is a bit hidden, but as soon as you find it you find paradise!The staff is super welcoming and caring, their principles are great and the sushi is just soooo good! They would also make the best vegan sauces. Fish eaters would be surprised if they only went there. There is also a branch somewhere in Penang, which has great reviews. This one is right in the city centre and much easier to reach if you are a tourist. Prices are average, but really worth for the quality.Show less

Author: mudcow
Title: Over rated
Review: The food was reasonable, the service slow and the toilet was absolutely disgusting even by local standards.  Given the abundance of excellent venues locally we probably won't return.

Author: LeeceNLondonKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Great cocktails, burgers, music and just feels like coming home!
Review: I first tripped over the lovely Junk almost exactly a year ago, fell in love with the general welcoming vibe, tunes, food, cocktails...plus made a firm friend in top man, Prakash. So I knew it would be first on my list when I finally broke out of KL CMCO this Christmas. COVID has had an unfortunate effect on most of us, not least Junk, which has had to move (just a little bit!) round the corner, so if 401 Chulia Street is still showing as it is as I type this, do make sure you venture just a tiny bit further to 1, Jalan Pintal Tali. It's well worth it, I promise. For food - burgers are it. I don't eat meat (so the Grilled Vegetable or The Great White both more than float my boat) but if you do, you're in burger heaven! And cocktails? Well.. I fondly remember the Bloody Mary sorting me right out just before the Langkawi ferry last year, but tonight I started with a classic Moscow Mule and then superstar bar guru, Prakash suggested I go off piste with his own creation - the Ginger Mojito. And proper lush it was too! To be clear, it's not on the menu, but I'm sure if you ask him nicely, and say hi from me, he'll do you one! Can't rate Junk highly enough!Show less

Author: HMLDN
Title: Great spot for cocktails and vibes
Review: Great spot for cocktails and good vibes! Excellent music guaranteed!!! Amazing staff (shout out to Prakash!) and a great overall aesthetic.

Author: RobinandLexi
Title: Great Coctails.
Review: I really enjoyed the cocktails I bought from Junk earlier this evening.  The barman happily filled mine and my wife’s reusable cups.  The bar was full of retro and antique collectibles and appeared to be well worth closer inspection.

Author: 390vittoriaf
Title: Amazing experience
Review:
Place, food and staff are absolutely adorable and authentic.
The hamburgers are super tasty and juicy and the fries just perfect (I go nuts for sweet potatoes!!!). The price was also very good. If I lived in Georgetown, I think I would eat there everyday.

Author: Simon B
Title: Best bar in penang
Review: I went to visit this very unique bar on chulia Street in penang, the atmosphere was amazing with great music fantastic drinks and delicious food I am addicted to this place, thanks for the memories

Author: Palin2010Huddersfield, United Kingdom
Title: Funky bar.
Review: Was strolling past this place and heard the great tunes coming out of it - soul, reggae and funk. The owner is a really friendly guy with a great taste in music. Decided to have a meal and the food was great too! All reasonably priced and a really good vibe. We'll be back!!!Show less

Author: Betül I
Title: Friendship
Review: Really good place. But much more important think is the friendship and beatiful  heart   of all guys . Thank you so much  my friends. You are really great. ❤

Author: JCT1962
Title: Good spot for people watching
Review: Bar offers a good spot for people watching if you grab a table outside. The bar has a good atmosphere and   a range of  music as well as the normal drinks offer of beer and cocktails. Popular with backpackers as is much of Lebuh Chulia.

Author: Dnaray
Title: Excellent Cocktails
Review: Eclectic space slightly off Love Lane with cool music and friendly staff. The best cocktails we had in Penang.

Author: rachael168Singapore, Singapore
Title: Worth it
Review: Totally kitsch, great music, huge measures and made to feel really welcome. Randomly stumbled across Junk and so glad we did. Bartender was great, excellent gin and tonic - 2 of them and we had our gin buzz on! Love that tat all over the walls, please go for one. It’s worth it!Show less

Author: LovelyDinosaur
Title: Funky bar late night
Review: Great value beer. Funky 80s and 90s tunes. Super friendly staff. Perfect for post dinner drinks! Beer served in cooler sleeves to keep your drinks cool on the Malaysian evening heat :)

Author: RossR908Thames, New Zealand
Title: Don't bother
Review: Kitchen is closed booze only therefore no longer a cafe. Walked here based on reviews only to find the aboveShow less

Author: Annika WKissimmee, Florida
Title: Best place in penang
Review: The most creative vibes cozy atmosphere caring and lovely staff. The only place I chill in penang. My happy place. Love you junk cafe. No where else like this and the cocktails he makes are the best in the world. The music is the best. Everything the best of the best. Must go here :)Show less

Author: Sharvesh678
Title: Great place to hang out. Look out for party days.
Review:
Nice place for food and drinks. 
Unique n nice. 
Food worth the price.
Friendly bar ppl.
Happening daily esp on party days

Author: SandytoesboundSan Pedro, Belize
Title: Fun & Funky 5 Star
Review: This place is so much fun! Prakash mixed up some outstanding cocktails, and Neyvin grilled up one of the Best Burgers I've ever had! (My mouth is watering just thinking about it!) The place is full of "junk" to intrigue and entertain, the music rocks, wifi is fast, and conversation is the best. Go check it out, you won't regret it, and say Hi to the Guys for me!Show less

Author: Discover15624314152
Title: Best burgers
Review: My bf and I had both the pork burgers on the menu and it was delicious. The patty was juicy and we loved it. Must try restaurant

Author: PatrickF581
Title: Great burger, interesting 'junk'
Review: We both had the beef burgers, were great. Cocktails were great as well. Place is cluttered, but really interesting. Service friendly. Only seating is small and low (I'm almost 2 meters tall).

Author: 294renataf
Title: Best burger ever
Review: We were in Georgetown and we really wanted to eat some good western food. So we went to this place. The place is so nice, the staff really friendly and in the beginning I wasn’t expecting so much, for me only a normal burguer it would be good. But when the burguer came I was really surprised! It was amazing! I totally recommend this place.Show less

Author: Swill2204
Title: Steve
Review:
Best place for a burger in the who off Penang, and the staff are the friendliest people you will meet!! 
Make sure you check this place out

Author: Joulesmcl
Title: Amazing atmosphere
Review:
Amazing drinks and atmosphere!!! Loved every min of my visit! Came back for a return visit with new friends and they loved it too! 

Ras was incredible!!!

Author: WesmineKang
Title: Super Yummy Burgers!
Review: Awesome selection of cocktails available and the burgers are definitely to die-for! Juicy pork patty & belly are scrumptious and the service was top notch! Staffs and owner, Sam, both are very friendly! High recommended!

Author: noraschlumpf
Title: Awesome place to relax and enjoy
Review: It's a really unique and cute place, perfectly located in Georgetown, like a little green oasis to escape for a while and to have a beer or food. Staff is really friendly. If you are looking for a special place to enjoy Georgetown, it's perfect for you!! Would highly recommend!!Show less

Author: mtnhiguyAspen, Colorado
Title: Just go there!
Review: In an area scattered with bars catering to hipsters, this one stands out. When you walk in you are taken to another space and time. An eclectic collection of stuff adorns the walls. The music is soothing and groovy and rightly suits the atmosphere. Belly up to the bar and order a premium liquor or cold one at reasonable prices. I had the cheeseburger which accompanied with sweet potato fries made my western palate happy.Show less

Author: Mark DPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Strange name--- but an amazing experience!
Review: Originally this shoppe was home to many "very interesting collectables"... until it became a "coffee shoppe"--- and then further extended itself to be a "Quirky" bar (open until late... and the Margaritas are super ) and Cafe... While their burgers and homemade "french fries" are really good--- so is the Greek favourite Tzatziki [cucumber salad]... While sitting in the cafe... the ambience/surroundings border of the "stupendous". The cafe bar has been ranked in the top 1% of the 1,000 restaurants located in Georgetown (by travellers like you and I). In addition, the restaurant has been awarded- by TripAdvisor- with its "Certificate of Excellence". A visit will be rewarded with great memories-- and a desire to return!!I hope that this Review has been helpful.Show less

Author: BenjaminLeeABCLang Suan, Thailand
Title: Find A Happy Place!
Review: Burger crave was very sufficiently dealt with here. Really class act for the price. Music and ambience of venue unique and cool. When i was there it was a flow of rare groove broken beats and soul... really nice background vibe to chill, work, socialize eat. Coming back to Junk Cafe with my girlfriend when return to penang, fo sho!Show less

Author: AneeLee
Title: Best Burger in Town!
Review:
If you’re looking for delicious burgers at Penang, Malaysia, then please do visit this cafe! They served really tasty burgers! 

I tried the burgers and well it was so delicious! Will definitely visit Junk Cafe the next trip!

Hand down to Junk Cafe 🙌

Author: Inspire463225
Title: MOST AMAZING MARGARITAS n UNIQUE COCKTAILS BY RAS IN PENANG
Review:
Best little cafe and bar with reggae music and live didgeridoo on Sundays.
A must visit in Penang Island! 💖

Author: worldtravellerbackPhuket, Thailand
Title: Amazing as before!
Review: Visited this place in 2017 and went back this time, just as before great burger, patties, amazing staffs, excellent service and music. They used to have 2 boys singing and playing guitar. One was Jon if I’m not mistaken and the other one was a tall guy. Not sure if they have them still, but those boys blessed us with a very good music the last trip. Nevertheless, perfect place, perfect burger with perfect company, always welcomes with a big smile. Show less

Author: MidlandsArttravelShenton Park, Australia
Title: Best bar in the area by far
Review: Don’t be put of by the exterior it is decorated in accordance with the title..with Junk...but the staff are very friendly and get to know you in a couple of visits. The cocktails are genuine good quality and cheap for what they are ..not so called house pour spirits being served up by the happy hour joints on Love Lane. We only had a couple of light bites but they were lovely.Can’t recommend it highly enoughShow less

Author: DazFPeterborough, United Kingdom
Title: Funky place!
Review: Dug this one out from trip advisor! A quirky funky cool place that used to be an old antique shop. A real hippy/collectic vibe here. Great for a beer or two to chill from the heat, as we called in at a lunch time. Has a burger with sweet potato fries, simply yum!! Great value and would have no problem in recommending a visit. All four of us enjoyed our different burgers, but only one could finish their plate. Good value and friendly atmosphere.Show less

Author: sorenk556
Title: Cool little spot!
Review: We were 4 friends visiting Junk Cafe in a Tuesday night. It wasn’t busy, but had a handful of customers.We ordered a couple of rounds of Caipiroska’s. They were excellent.There was a wide wine selection which could be ordered by glass or bottle.The decor was detailed, warm and cozy.Friendly and relaxed management and crew. Will visit again next time I’m in Georgetown fore sure.Show less

Author: Christofer_Sweden
Title: Good burger, great atmosphere
Review: We really liked both the burgers and the home made fries. The atmosphere in the evening was nice with a laidback soundtrack to go with the food and a smooth Black Label whisky afterwards. Probably a great place to chill later at night.

Author: JayteevV
Title: Great vibe, lovely lounge music, nice food
Review: Perfect place to hang out and chill with great lounge music, drink a beer and have a fantastic burger!

Author: CFEIIIAustin, Texas
Title: Interesting cafe
Review: I was told that this was once an antique shop before it became a cafe/bar. I can believe it. lots of stuff on the walls, some people may find it junky, I found it interesting. The people were nice, the music was a mixture, and the mojitos are excellent!Show less

Author: DenHaagTravellerKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Superb place to hang out
Review: I’ve been here a few times now and I’ve always had a good time. The staff and customers are super friendly and always make you feel welcome. It’s modelled on a Budapest style ruin pub, but with a little more class. If you like that style you will love this place. There isn’t much to drink in the way of quality beer but the cocktails were great and reasonably priced. I’d probably go as far as saying that this is the best bar in the Georgetown area right now. I can’t think of a more quirky and friendly location than this. They just need to get some better beers and this place would be complete!Show less

Author: MichaelColley92Australia
Title: Amazing food and good atmosphere
Review: Visited here one of the days we were in Georgetown and we were not disappointed!I went for the old reliable Cheeseburger after being away for 2 months and wanting something that tasted like home.When the burger arrived it was exactly what i wanted and to top it off the drinks are really cheap here too.The beef burger literally fell apart in my mouth it was that fresh and tender.I would definitely recommend this place and it has to go down as one of the best burgers I have ever had.MichaelShow less

Author: weichern91Penang Island, Malaysia
Title: A place to remember
Review: The cafe do keep up with its words , of calling it self "junk"but if you look closely there is a history in every junk in there environment is nicethe food is mouth watering price wise i say its worth it for the quality and environment they provideShow less

Author: BigBuzzy
Title: Awesome spot
Review: A really cool place. The staff are friendly and attentive, the burgers are on the pricey side but my god they are good!! A must visit in George town.

Author: Aria V
Title: Nice looking place, dry chicken
Review: I read great reviews about Junk Cafe, so I wanted to try it out. I am glad I went, as the actual cafe is really quirky, and it has a good vibe. I ordered the chicken salad, and it wasn't the best price, but it wasn't breaking the bank. The dressing was good, a bit oily. And the chicken was so dry, I needed water in between each bite. I personally won't go again, but I guess it was worth a try.Show less

Author: shendrickson33El Dorado Hills, California
Title: Great place for a burger and drink.
Review: I have had the junk burger and a fish burger, sweet potato and normal fries as well as a few cocktails. Everything has been excellent. The best burger and fries I’ve had in Penang. Delicious mojitos. The three of us all rate it five stars. Fun atmosphere.Show less

Author: Emily MManchester, United Kingdom
Title: Good for lunch, great burgers
Review: Went here as we were staying just across the road at Yeng Keng hotel and this cute bar had caught our eye. Was quiet at late lunchtime. We both ordered beef burgers which were absolutely delicious, big juicy and meaty. The fries were also good. They had an array of cocktails but we went with their homemade passionfruit lemonade which was good, However I think they would benefit from some juices on the menu as well. We would definitely go here again as the burgers were great.Show less

Author: fortyttttttyppppppGeorge Town, Malaysia
Title: A cool bar
Review: Been dropping in here every time I go penang It’s just up from the 7/11 at the beginning of love lane The bar not big The food is ok for western The drinks at a honest price !!The staff are friendly an will give you advice about penang where to go day or night time One guy name of JAY is cool an good for tips about penang If it’s your first time in Penang this is a ideal bar to relax or partyShow less

Author: jfoitvfs
Title: Excellent burgers, vegetarian options
Review: Nice cosy cafe with nice ambience. The Junk need burger is excellent and the grilled veg burger is a very good option for vegetarians. A place to recommend.

Author: GloriaSomeHobart, Australia
Title: Great music, excellent food, friendly staff
Review: We are probably not quite the clientele that Junk Cafe are hoping to attract, as 60something grey haired tourists! However we loved the place and we had a great time watching the friendly bar staff do their thing, listening to the great music (they even played some of ours!) and enjoying the excellent food, we had spring rolls which were the best we had on the whole trip and fries with aioli which were also delicious. Drinks were very good value I would highly recommend this quirky but excellent cafe/barShow less

Author: totmon
Title: Cozy place!
Review:
Very interesting cafe where you just can chillax and get some  good food too! 
If you are coming to Penang and wanna have nice time while you having a pit stop this is the place

Author: zoeb813London, United Kingdom
Title: Cool spot to visit
Review: Great vibes (very cool place to grab something to eat or just drinks), friendly staff and cool music. My boyfriend and I had the cheeseburger and chips - one with sweet potato fries and the other with normal fries. Both excellent. Accompanied by a glass of House red which was also very reasonably priced. Hope to be back during our stay in Penang! Show less

Author: Calico95
Title: Burgers to die for!
Review: We stopped for dinner here and it wasn't busy at all. I had the junk burger which was a beef burger with sautéed onions and mushrooms. I don't know what they did but it was honestly the best burger I have ever had! Fries were proper English chips and were delicious! Place has an amazing vibe to it with a really comfy couch in the back room. We stayed for a few hours and they didn't rush is at all. Service was really lovely. Definitely worth a visit! Show less

Author: George A
Title: Amazing.
Review:
I got the burger with sautéed mushrooms in, it was amazing. I’ve had my fair share of burgers and this was up there. Hands down best burger I’ve had in south east Asia! 

Cool and quirky decor too! Loved it.

Author: Ilina B
Title: Good location
Review: Interesting decor, plenty artefacts, good location. We went there for drinks and just to relax and observe the world goes by. Good service, average prices. Visit if in the area

Author: JCT1962
Title: Good bar
Review: Stopped off here last night for drinks on way back to our hotel. Bar has a nice vibe and drinks are a good price. More evidence that lebuh chulia appears to be the place to got for drinks and food in Georgetown now.

Author: Steven B
Title: Just Ok
Review: I ordered the Full of Junk burger (25 RM) and added bacon (4 RM). The burger quality and overall flavor was just ok. Nothing really special about it but also not the worst I've had while traveling overseas. The French fries had a different flavor to them which I didn't care for and it was the same story with their brand of ketchup. Would I pay for the meal again? No. I'm sure there are better options here.Show less

Author: OnlyplacesilikeLondon, United Kingdom
Title: An eclectic discovery
Review: What a lot of fun we had as we stepped out of the pouring September rain that humid Sunday night in George Town. It was like stumbling into someone’s home to dry off and being welcomed with an espresso martini. Chilled and laid back, it most definitely wasn’t what I had expected to find in Penang ... and which made it all the more appealing really. Show less

Author: Susee1980
Title: Burger!
Review: I had the Tzatziki burger which was really really good!!!The only let down was the chips were fried in something weird...can't out my finger on what oil, and the ketchup and mayonnaise also tasted odd.The waitress and staff were really lovely, good tiger beer, and good ambience.Show less

Author: joph263Zeist, The Netherlands
Title: Alternative bar with western food
Review: We went here on a (very, VERY) rainy afternoon, to drink a beer and eat something easy. This was a lovely place for it. It had a reaggae-ish vibe and there a wide variety of stuff (some might say junk, I’d say peculiar collection) displayed, to honor the bars name. We very much recommend this place if you’re looking for some western food or just a nice bar you won’t see everyday.Show less

Author: Theakk
Title: Bad beer
Review: Ordered two carlsberg beers, they were most likely watered out. Tasted really bad. The music was too loud to have a conversation. The bathroom was really gross.

Author: lisajbickLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Best bar in Georgetown
Review: We visited this bar every night we stayed in Georgetown. Filled with eclectic 'junk' over every wall, shelf and surface - this is a bar with brilliant character.Each time you look around you spot something new.The staff truly made this place for us and kept us coming back each night, thank you for making us so welcome! Sometimes live music too which is always fun. Didn't actually get round to eating there but drinks were lovely! Defo a Georgetown must! Show less

Author: GMOPA
Title: Great burgers!
Review:
Visited on late afternoon during three days vacation in Penang.
The beef burger I ordered was really tasty! Great place just for a beer also

Author: Danny C
Title: Sensational burger
Review: Super impressed with this place. Saw the sign stating penang best burger a few times decided to finally give in. I was extremely impressed the sign lived up to its expectations. Really cool cafe great vibe and excellent music. The burgers are sensational so delicious handmade well seasoned can't go.wrong with the sweet potatoe fries. It's that Gordon happy going every week there. Massive thumbs up from me.Show less

Author: Pauly1975London, United Kingdom
Title: An eclectic, quirky bar!
Review: I really enjoyed visiting this bar! It's filled with an eclectic mix of curios of all kinds from 1970s advertisements to old lamps and everything in between.The staff are very friendly and there is s wide range of drinks on offer including Tiger beer at 10 MYR, which is a fine price! I really recommend this bar as a place to cool down after exploring the wonderful Georgetown.Show less

Author: Allison CSingapore, Singapore
Title: Chilled
Review: Some friends and I came here after eating at Y Not (next door) for a quick after dinner drink. The venue is as the title suggests - it looks like a junk store - but in a good way. The various random items dotted everywhere, from shelves to the walls to the ceiling are a definite talking point.The staff were friendly and equally laid-back and they knew how to make a great cocktail. Definitely worth a visit.Show less

Author: 600shanedUbud, Indonesia
Title: Awesome burger and salad
Review: I've tried a few burger joints in Penang and this is the best. The meat patty had heaps of flavour, the buns were very fresh and the hand cut fries were perfect. I created my own double cheeseburger with bacon which they were happy to make for me. And to top it off my girlfriend had a salad which was the best she has had in Penang. I would highly recommend and definitely come back. Show less

Author: Kim B
Title: Delicious burgers!
Review: Just go here! The burgers are fresh, delicious and we were quite full after our meal. The menu is not that big, but what we got was great. A bit more expensive than a hawker stall, but nice for a change from all the rice ;)Show less

Author: TrippinMonkeySydney, Australia
Title: Burger and Beer
Review: Stopped in here for a break from walking the streets of George Town after reading the reviews. It was quiet because it was mid afternoon but they happily accommodated us and we ordered beer and burgers. The food was great, the place has an interesting eclectic vibe to it and the music was great for a chilled afternoon.Show less

Author: TimmygobblesExeter, United Kingdom
Title: The ol' switcheroo!
Review: This is a great bar, but unfortunately the staff ripped us off by charging for the good gin we asked for, and giving us the cheap stuff. We were sitting outside, and I guess they thought we wouldn't notice. Make sure you watch them pour your spirits. Show less

Author: tomwP859VQ
Title: Excellent vibe, wine by the glass
Review: This is a very atmospheric little bar, great reggae music and idiosyncratic design. Great selection of drinks (we didn't eat here but will do next time) and you can have a good glass of wine (try the Malbec) for a very reasonable price.

Author: AykutU30
Title: Great burgers
Review: I came to this place while doing a visa run. Great ambiance at night with dimmed lights, lots of stuff on the walls, good music and great burgers. Try it if you have time. Shame it is not a bit bigger

Author: Flav1984Dundalk, Ireland
Title: Renaldo & Jon steal the show!
Review: Happened upon this little gem simple because of the excellent music we heard whist walking home one night. Intended to stay for one drink, but ended up there for a few hours. Excellent decor, fantastic music by the two young lads, the hand cut fried and sauce were amazing and the beer and staff really cool. Would totally recommended calling in if you are in George Town.Show less

Author: 691georgeh
Title: I just want a burger
Review: Ordered burger and fries (baby q) . 5 mins later was told they don't have any bacon or BBQ sauce. I said don't worry about it that's half of the burger ingredients. The burger was still made and offered to me?Was still keen so ordered a different burger - beef one that usually came with bacon but asked to exchange the bacon for extra cheese or grilled zucchini instead. She said not ok. Kept trying to offer me the old burger (sitting there for 10mins at this point). Made me feel really awkward. Don't think I'll be back. Side note : my friend really enjoyed his lamb burger and the ambience of the place was really cool. Show less

Author: lmblue
Title: Quirky bar with affordable pints
Review: Happened upon this gem on a visa run from Thailand, really quirky style, friendly staff and owner and a good burger (we got a bit excited about having pints in a proper bar and misjudged the closing time of street vendors!)

Author: victoria8304
Title: Best social place in Penang
Review: Eating, drinking, socialising, listening to music - this I the place to be 😍. Can not reccomemd this place enough!

Author: 318lindsaya
Title: Unique hangout
Review: This place is pretty cool. Bar staff are friendly and burgers are good. Unique decor and just an interesting place to be. Swing by and check it out, you won't be disappointed.

Author: Clare H
Title: Best burgers ever
Review: This place is awesome. Something interesting everywhere you look. Staff are lovely and friendly. As a veggie I sometimes find it hard to find good grub, their veggie burger (kinda more like a sandwich) is delicious, best one I've ever had. My boyfriend had a meat one and was equally as enamoured. Great place! Show less

Author: Robert N
Title: Favorite place in g-town!
Review:
You will not find better food or staff !!!! Love love love this place! If you don't like the food or atmosphere here there is something wrong with you lol

Bob

Author: FirmfriendsLondon
Title: Great place
Review:
Just love this place in the heart of heritage George Town. A fun happy place great drinks , great atmosphere  and a good price.
We didn't eat but food looked good.
A great place to visit .

Author: tarvins
Title: Atmosphere
Review: Awesome atmosphere to just hang out, friendly staff, awesome music, comfortable...a must visit place if you're in penang

Author: 248lesliem
Title: Leslie Oorschot
Review: This was an experiance I would do over ad over again. A wonderful bar with an amazing atmosphere and a crasy eclectic collection of memerobilia. The cocktails were delicious and cheap and the simple menu, yummy. The owner is an absolute joy and very friendly and a mind of information. A must visit when in Georgetown Penang.Show less

Author: Bella S
Title: Bob Marley & Cocktails
Review: Very hip and trendy, with a lot of interesting Art Deco. Cheap, yet excellent, range of cocktails. Well worth a visit.

Author: HxKmlLucerne, Switzerland
Title: love it
Review: Junk is a really cool place with amazing decor. Walking around you can see collectables and oddities from around the world. if you're into interesting and curious art and oddities this is the place for you. never tried the famous burger but amazing green apple juice and very cool staff.Show less

Author: GaryhellyerPortsmouth, United Kingdom
Title: A drunk junk review
Review: What a place. Junk is a very quirky little bar situated right near our hotel, Yeng Keng. As soon as you approach the bar you realise it will be different to the norm. It is a little dark inside but it adds to the atmosphere. The cocktail prices are cheap and well worth the money. They are not weak and I highly recommend the Long Island ice tea. We also had food. This consisted of cheese burgers and the signature 'full of junk' burger. They came with a choice of either sweet potato fries or normal fries. Both were very delicious and the burgers were succulent and tasty. Highly recommend a visit if you're in the area!! Show less

Author: theworldlywilliams
Title: Great burgers 🍔!!!
Review: Not much to say except the burgers are fantastic and the atmosphere is calm and casual. If ever in George Town and looking for American food this is the place. Grab a burger and beer and you won't be disappointed.

Author: Londontraveller1964XLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Great feel to it and good cocktails
Review: Dropped in for a great Long Island Ice Tea and thoroughly enjoyed the experience. S whacky place although i thorougly enjoyed sitting out in the frontbwatching the world go by. Im sure that its hots up in the evening but as a midfle aged travelling couple this was a good start to the evening.A bit expensive but worth it.Show less

Author: MuddyPoopdeck
Title: Meal and Drinks
Review: Great burgers in a relaxed and friendly atmosphere. Chilled music and the staff are attentive and genuine.

Author: PineappleViking
Title: Amazing atmosphere
Review: A real gem in George Town,  the decor is unique and amazing and the service is top notch. Kitty is a very hospitable host, definitely recommend it.

Author: Hotel-Motel91
Title: Cool decor, excellent coffee!
Review: The surroundings and decor are real cool! Full of 'junk' as the name suggests...the coffee was great, the best coffee I found in George Town! :-)

Author: milham82
Title: Great burger
Review:
Good burgers, really tasty burgers, washed down with the coldest lager I have had in Penang, served in a frosted glass which is always a good touch. 

Let down slightly by the fries otherwise would have been a 5. Gladly go back.

Author: annie_ladybird
Title: ok burger, weird staff
Review: the burger i had here was ok, wasn't expecting much and it delivered. there was a woman who appeared to be staff mucking around a lot, doing shots and talking about drugs loudly, whilst smoking at the bar. wasn't my cup of tea.

Author: johnl2017
Title: Best burgers in town
Review: Junk cafe is a place you must visit when you're in Penang. Very good customer service. Awesome burgers and cocktails. It's a nice place to hang out with friends family and for couples as well. The cafe is filled with nice art work and antique stuff which you will enjoy looking at while you're there. Show less

Author: kitty5515George Town, Malaysia
Title: ABSOLUTELY THE BEST BURGERS IN PENANG
Review: It's a whimsical wonderland of antiques, vintage items, and just cool junk in general I ended up going there every week! The burgers are so authentic and delicious. But they do have one burger called the chicken blood cream which is not "classic", but it's to die for. Creamy Parmesan and semi dried tomato sauce is a great accompaniment with the awesome sweet potato fries! It's definitely a must have! Show less

Author: Yas S
Title: Amazing burgers and decor
Review: Chilled out environmemt, delicious burgers with the option of hand cut french fries, sweet potato fries or salad.

Author: matt19880
Title: Homemade burgers
Review: Good place to come for a burger. They don't sell any other food. The burgers were really good as were the fries. They have a small selection of drinks that were served at room temperature.

Author: Sherry SMumbai, India
Title: Cute little place.... great food
Review: Just down one of the roads in George Town, walking distance from Lebuh Farquhar is this cute little cafe. It may not seem like much but once you go through their menu they mean business. Burgers and drinks was to the T. Friendly staff and hospitable. Didnt get a chance to go there again. Definitely a place to visit.Show less

Author: anne_sophie_feenstra
Title: Nice burgers, friendly staff
Review: Good (cheese)burgers and cocktails, nice place to visit. Maybe a bit expensive compared to other restaurants in the area, portions are not too big. Nice food though!

Author: Sjors v
Title: Nice little place down the street
Review:
Nice bar, it's like a museum inside! 
Ordered a cocktail and a beer. It's reasonable priced. Very helpful bartender.

Author: David MLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Incredible burgers, cool setting
Review: The burgers here are one of the best I've ever had. Really. Go for the junk burger you won't regret it. The decor of the restaurant has a really cool arty vibe. It's hard to make disconnected items look good, but they've done it. One of the best eats in Penang - well doneShow less

Author: msblow
Title: Most interesting...even our 7 yo said this cafe was "So cool"!
Review: Wonderful little curiosity shop serving gourmet burgers and beers! Look out for the sign that says " Penang's worst tattoo shop upstairs"!

Author: MichelleHarris81
Title: A Hidden Gem
Review: A small rustic junky cafe in the heart of Chulia Street. We loved the interiors, filled with junks but tastefully presented. The dim lighting with their reggae/dub background adds the feel to the place. U are definitely no where near Georgetown.... Coffee was 1st class and met an experienced barista, Neyvin......The team were very accomodating. Burgers were simply excellent!A must go place in Penang.....Show less

Author: Evan GDubai, United Arab Emirates
Title: Excellent little place
Review: Popped in for a couple of well priced drinks. Friendly, attentive staff. There are a few tables outside and a few options inside. They seem to have live music / DJ on some nights. Overall an excellent option along Chulia street. I will go back to try their burgers during the day.Show less

Author: 824brianyDallas, Texas
Title: Best burger in SE Asia
Review: This funky cafe has the best burger I've had in Southeast Asia. As an American traveling through Asia the past couple of months, you start craving burgers but often are disappointed when you get one. Well not at Junk Cafe...the lamb burger and Junk burger truly hit the spot. Thanks for bringing a little bit of home abroad!Show less

Author: manspinsSingapore, Singapore
Title: Chilled out bar, great cocktails
Review: This is a very chilled out bar with friendly bartenders who make great cocktails. We returned to this place a couple of times during our stay in Georgetown because of its cool vibe. Can sit inside or outside, both are enjoyable. We didnt have any food as we only had gone there for drinksShow less

Author: Sandy M
Title: Small but comfortable
Review: Small cafe on Chulia , nice atmosphere and close to our hotel so convenient for us. Not a lot of seating but was quiet when we were there.

Author: mississabCavite Province, Philippines
Title: The reviews are true - best burger in Penang!
Review: Going here was the best decision we made after cycling around Georgetown. Best burger with that juicy patty, tasty cheese, and sweet potato fries. Highly recommend you to try this place if you're around Georgetown. Value for money, you won't regret trying their Full of Junk Burger. The best! The place comes with wifi, too!!!Show less

Author: wgy_wgy
Title: Good burger and good daiquiri
Review:
Had a good burger which was made of a crispy bun, pesto grilled vegetables and feta cheese good flavour and the french fries are made from real potatoes. 

The Daiquiri was flavourful and well balanced.

Atmosphere is good, but interior is for a younger audience.

Author: Fabiola C
Title: super cool
Review: Grungy atmosphere, nice cocktails and the best burger I had in such long time. The guys are friendly and the music is great. Very cool place.

Author: Lau J
Title: Great ambience and food
Review: A must got when you're in Penang. Warm and cozy atmosphere from their unique atmosphere is what makes it great. Also, the food is fantastic. I recommend the Chicken Blood Cream. Owners and staff are also really friendly.

Author: roamin_d
Title: Best burger, period.
Review: I've visited this burger shop a number of times, sometimes dining in and sometimes taking out and I can say (with extensive burger-consumption experience on 3 continents) that THIS is how a burger should be made.

Author: treasure_ir3landKent, United Kingdom
Title: Great place with so much character!
Review: We stopped in here on a crazy hot day in George town to grab a drink to cool down. I am so glad we did, we had some tasty cold drinks and enjoyed the great atmosphere in the cafe. The decor gives the place so much character, definitely stop by for a visit when in George Town. We would recommend!Show less

Author: D5117HBmarks
Title: Met up with family
Review: A fantastically  fun place with a mix of  locals and foreigners. The drinks are reasonably priced in the atmosphere is fantastically fun

Author: MrsTMLJ
Title: Interesting place
Review: My family of 5 loved the burgers here. Only come here if you want burgers, though. Not the best of the best burgers in Asia, but quite close. Before you enter you wonder if you are in the right place with the great reviews. After sitting down and having a drink and a great burger with the friendly service you will be reassured.Show less

Author: flavoursomejourneyPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: One of the real best burger and chips in penang
Review: Homemade beef patties seasoning with rosemary, melted cheese, caramelised onions and sauté mushroom are such a great combination of natural flavour without a need in adding any sauces for their beef burger. Their homemade chuck of fries are so deliciously sweet and taste so unprocessed. A must go place!Show less

Author: Jodi RTanjung Bungah, Malaysia
Title: Burgers? Amazing! Smoking inside? Unpleasant.
Review: Having lived in Penang for over 4 years, i can say hat these are the best burgers I have had here. I'm an American and the local "burgers" just don't do it for me. Also, Junk Cafe had amazing fries. The drinks were a tad pricey, but it's worth going for the burger and fries set. This place would have been rated excellent. However, any place that allows smoking indoors these days is not excellent in my book. It's unpleasant to smell while eating. Second hand smoke is dangerous and I would not bring my son to this place for that reason alone.Would I go again? Yes! But it's a very small place with very little seating, so it's ideal for a group of 2-4 people.Show less

Author: Abdelrahman A
Title: Astonishing Place
Review: One of the best restaurants in George Town, wonderful atmosphere with an amazing food. The prices are reasonable and the music is good.

Author: TracyY291
Title: not bad, worth a try
Review: it may look small, same as how their burger looks like, but it is actually not that small. at least for us it is very filling.parmesan sauce of the chicken sandwich is a lot. the taste is good but it is a little too salty, maybe because I eat it without the bread.Show less

Author: Charlie S
Title: Wow!
Review: This place is amazing just all the stuff around the room was really cool. I could stay for ages just looking at all the old "junk" hanging around. Even the bathroom was interesting. We order coffee and juice the coffee was delicious and so was the juice 10/10 would come againShow less

Author: Slachebuches
Title: The best quality/price ratio
Review: The best ever burgers for that price I ever had. Nice atmosphere. Good service.  Must visit place to have a short bite during you historical trip at George town

Author: 484mikaelar
Title: Great for burgers and beer!
Review: Stumbled upon this place one night while looking for a chill place for drinks and snacks-- this did not disappoint! The burger was juicy, flavorful, and fresh, and the decor/music selection made for a fantastic vibe. Definitely recommended!

Author: Yousef K
Title: Been in Penang George Town and i saw a curious shop
Review: So I came here because its close to my hotel. It looks a bit old school. But don't let this fool you. Its down right genuis in its assertive menu with few products but premuim quality. The Chef has a lot of experience and caters for the indivual. The burgers are delicccc. And at a fair price . Show less

Author: denisf171
Title: Good Junk, great food and service.
Review: A small quirky little Cafe /restaurant with interesting junk scattered throughout the place and quality food with reasonable prices. Very casual and friendly staff. Sit out the front and watch the world go by.

Author: Chin Leong SLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: Wonderful bar
Review: Stop over this bar because of raining, at first I was having two glass of beer outside and awaiting the rain to stop but the music turn me on so I decided to go in and order further a glass of whisky and try the bloody cream burger and it was ready good!!!! The interior design was dreamy however there are some funny smell from the sofa where I sit and found too many cigarette bud inside the toilet bowl. If the management would consider turn it into a lodging place upstairs sure I would stay there for a day or two. Show less

Author: Cranky C
Title: Cheapest, biggest and best straight coffee I found
Review: If you just want a caffeine fix, you can get a decent, large "Americano" for 7rm. 11 for a cap. Also oneof those places in Georgetown where the staff are nice. They need to break out the mosquito coils for the lounge area though.

Author: michaelpI4183QZWendover, United Kingdom
Title: Amazing food, amazing place!
Review: Popped in looking for a quick bite and could not be happier with the choice I made!We both had the chicken burger which was cooked perfectly, the sauce was incredible and chips spot on!Couldn't have asked for more, great food, great service, great setup!Show less

Author: L6741EUchristianb
Title: Amazing burgers.
Review: Went there twice with my girlfriend and kids. The burgers are really really good, and the double fried fries nice and crispy as well. The café is cozy and fun and the staff are friendly and attentive.

Author: May C
Title: Nice burger!
Review: We had the burger with their fries. The burger is juicy and homemade by the chef. Must try burger in town!

Author: alexandmaggieCranbrook, United Kingdom
Title: Good food good price
Review: The junk cafe is really quaint with as the name suggests lots of junk to look at. We ate burgers which were excellent and had very reasonably priced gin and tonics. Good place if you need a change from rice and noodles. Sadly they do allow smoking in the cafe.Show less

Author: pkm68Ko Lanta, Thailand
Title: Really good !
Review: What a quaint little place. Lovely staff, super burgers, cold beers, interesting surroundings. We were in Penang for approximately 2 weeks and went there 4 times. It's a limited menu , but for me it seemed like it meant every meal was mastered and as long as you are a meat lover ..It's easier to make a decision !!!Show less

Author: Pat L
Title: Great burger
Review: We had been eating some great Malaysian and Thai food for our whole trip but fancied something more western style for one night. The service was excellent and the burger and chips were amazing!

Author: 841madelineh
Title: Delicious burgers!
Review:
Fresh, homemade burgers prepared with a love for food. Really tasty and reasonably priced! 
A must to go in Georgetown!!!

Author: AWildRaticateUlsan, South Korea
Title: One of the best burgers I've ever had.
Review: This is a really cool little cafe with lots of interesting stuff hanging all around. We went in one evening for a quick drink and found them to be very good and reasonably priced. The burgers looked amazing, but we'd just eaten, so we came back the next day and were very impressed by them. The staff is very friendly and the cook really knows what he's doing. If you want a big, juicy burger and a stiff cocktail, this is the place to go in Georgetown.Show less

Author: allfunandgamesAuckland
Title: Great Burgers!
Review: After living in Thailand for a while I have been craving a decent burger and Junk Cafe satisfied that craving, and then some!The friendly staff will cook the meat as you like (i.e. medium), all burgers are served with fries and cost around 19R The tzatziki burger was delicious, while the mushroom burger had 4 different types of mushroom. Also do a decent coffee and have beer available.Great place to chill out and would recommend to anyone who wants a good burger in George Town.Show less

Author: 873madelainebBrisbane
Title: Good burger and great chips
Review: We stopped here early evening to grab a bite. Only customers there with all the weird and wonderful 'junk'.... Ordered a beef burger with mushrooms - it did not disappoint - great burger. Also loved their fries/chips - home made and soft and crunchy. It was a quick stop - it probably would have more atmosphere at night. Great service. Thanks!Show less

Author: 239lenpBendigo, Australia
Title: Quirky, gimmicky, & wonderful...
Review: Sat at the rear in period seating amongst heaps of, well, junk!! As in antiques...It added to the atmos, & the beer & coffee was very nice...We went the chicken burger...it had garlic buns, with a side of fries & was very good in both value & taste. Been back a couple of times now.Jason & Shan will look after you :-) Show less

Author: FanHupPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: No Chef, No Burgers.
Review: Arrived a little before 12 noon. At five to, saw the "Open" sign and attempted to walk in. Stopped and told the premises were not open yet. Umm, maybe flip your sign to "Closed" or amend your business hours. The rather surly youth then added that the chef was out and there were no burgers available. What time would he be back? In about half an hour.Plenty of "tak apa" in this shop.Show less

Author: CaCarolin
Title: Must visits,
Review: You must go here! Great burgers and crab rolls - all hand made and delicious. A real quirky feel inside with loads of "junk" being displayed. The two brother who run it are very friendly and pleasant too.

Author: RMMLLJBHamburg, Germany
Title: Cozy little place!
Review: We decided to sit down due to the cozy looking interior of the bar. Think of a relaxed hipster, oldish vibe. It is rather small and not as commercial as other bars in the street and therefore also not so crowded. A nice place for a relaxed beer! Would definitely recommend this place, even if it is just for a break from the highly commercial touristy bars you find everywhere in George Town.Show less

Author: Normalcat
Title: Brilliant burgers
Review: they have a very limited menu here, but what they do is amazing. They are some of the best burgers we've had and drinks were good too.

Author: Baronclog
Title: Really tasty freshly cooked burger style food,
Review: It' s only a small place, a bit expensive by local standards but still good value for money. Really great chips/ fries, some of the best I've ever had. The staff  are cheerful and enthusiastic and the crab sandwich when available is a stunner.

Author: Rebecca ASydney, Australia
Title: Delicious and gluten free friendly.
Review: This was a favourite for us on our recent trip. Chef was happy to modify the menu so that our son could have a GF, egg free meal. For GF people - the burgers are 100% meat. You'd be hard pressed to find burger this good in Sydney. Friendly staff, quick service and delicious food!Show less

Author: Aurora B
Title: Homemade and grilled to order
Review: This is a cozy and fun place for whomever needs a break from the heat with a refreshing freshly made juice or a delicious and filling homemade burger. Their menu is small, with only burgers, but they are well made and taste wonderful.You should definitely drop by if you are in the neighborhood :)Show less

Author: Georgia1104
Title: Awesome, fresh and delicious burgers!
Review: The burgers were homemade and even the chips were as well. Fresh and so tasty, made right in front of you! Definitely worth a try.

Author: LazyRoseAlberta, Canada
Title: Cool, Funky Cafe
Review: This place was almost right next to Chulia Mansion (where we were staying) so we walked by it a few times when it was closed but wanted to check it out. I think we actually ended up eating a couple dinners there because we really liked the burgers. But I went there almost every day because I had a bit of an annoying cold (I think I picked it up in KL) and they had a really tasty honey lemon tea that you could order hot or cold; I must have drank two of those a day to help with my cold. We had a couple coffees there also, they make a great cappuccino. The staff were really friendly there and remembered us after a couple visits. We sat outside most of the time, but it's worth going into the the restaurant to look around and check out all the "junk", it's a really cool spot. If you sit at the outside table, the BBQ is out there too, so you can pretty much watch them cook your food. Definitely worth checking out, even if you just go for a drink.Show less

Author: Kohor
Title: Nice small café
Review:
A nice small café in Chulia street, own by 2 very friendly persons.
A nice decoration, a good café and some exellent burger make this place to be visited

Author: Alvin O
Title: This how burger should be made!
Review: Excellent burger, friendly owner that makes consistent burger every time. The decor is way beyond your imagination..like a time travelling machine. Awesome place to visit and chill.

Author: Flora W
Title: Best burgers in town
Review: Stumbled upon Junk unintentionally and what a great find! We had a lovely warm welcome and the decor is fantastic!Things only got better. A small menu, which I love, they do burgers/sandwiches, and they do them fantastically! If you like a huge choice this may not be for you.I ordered their signature Full of Junk burger and my friend the Tzatziki burger, they were fantastic! We both asked for our burgers medium and they were perfect. Lovely toasted bun and top quality fillings. This was all washed down with very reasonable priced tiger beer! If you have a burger crazing in Georgetown this is a must or if you just want interesting surroundings whilst sipping a coffee, Junk is a must!Show less

Author: xanefm
Title: best kept secret on Chulia St
Review: Amazing decor, excellent location, DELICIOUS FOOD, and friendly staff! You can't go wrong with this little cafe :)

Author: Patrice-xoKeele, England, United Kingdom
Title: BIG MISTAKE TO NOT COME HERE
Review: We came to this cafe on a whim and tried the blood cream chicken sandwich and ended up having it three times in 2 days. It's the most delicious sandwich we've ever eaten and the sauce is the best we've ever tasted. So so delicious. Not going to lie we will probably come back to Penang just for this sandwich, were from the uk! Go here, you won't regret it!!!! xxShow less

Author: warutch
Title: Worth a visit!
Review:
We found this shop in tripadvisor and it's definitely worth a visit.
The shop decorations are awesome. We had full of junks burger. Honey lemon is not very sour like we would want but if you have time please visit

Author: jegaaya
Title: More than a Junk
Review: As antique lovers we decided to give a try to this cafe ideally located along Lebuh Chulia. We tried their chicken sandwhich and signature crab roll... It's was simply delicious.

Author: rorykilaleaLondon
Title: You have to see this to believe it!!!
Review: A series of rooms with odd bric a brac that you had never studied in detail. An old dodgem car hanging from the ceiling-a sculpture made of trombones-two wonky pianos....glass bottles of every shape...this is a wonderful place of originality and makes you happy...I re examined the reel to reel tape recorders I used when I was young-I looked at the ancient 8mm projector...and I then realised why the dildo was included on the trombone sculpture- the musical instruments represented a man...! (Duh)Oh.. the coffee is the one of the best in George Town and the place is justly famous for its hamburgers...Great staff tooShow less

Author: Chris BBoston, Massachusetts
Title: Can't think of a better Burger
Review: I ate twice at Junk last month, I had the best hamburger that I've had since I can remember. I especially liked the hamburger with mushrooms, but the one with sun-dried tomatoes was no slouch. Australian beef, cooked in front of you on the grill and served piping hot. Makes me hungry now to write about it (I'm back in the USA now and last week I ate at an our expensive local "gourmet" restaurant which now serves what I consider the second best burger in my experience).Liked the folks at Junk too: Shin (spelling?) and Jason. (Jason was especially pleased when I complimented their burger. He said my opinion was especially important since I'm an American and we are raised on hamburgers.) Very attractive young woman, Michelle, is there sometimes too.It's on the busy main street - Chulia Street - but watching the tourists go by is always better than visiting the Zoo.Show less

Author: bigw0rldsmallwalletCalgary, Canada
Title: NOT CLOSED!!!
Review: Not sure what the other reviews are saying, maybe was previously closed for renovations?Open now, right next to the hotel "Chulia Mansion"Visited Feb 18 2015- fantastic food. Had both the Junk Burger and Crab Roll. Really top quality food in a city full of top quality food. Service was good too, food was cooked right infront of us.Sat outside. Strongly recommend this place. Also, super cool decor inside!Show less

Author: kimgan210
Title: Chic Hideout
Review: Never expected to find an awesome place in the hustle bustle of Chulia St. The setup was done well with attentive service. Coffee was good but food wise has nothing much to offer. Will return for the junks / antiques only.

Author: bellalou123
Title: Brilliant!
Review: Stumbled on this cafe whilst in George Town ! What a treat. Amazing coffee , friendly staff , great food , good prices , relaxed atmosphere. Couldn't ask for more. Highly recommend !

Author: YiningOoiPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Coffee junkies serve the best coffee in Penang!
Review: Coffee junkie triumph all other cafes in Penang with its uniquely cosy ambiance. A coffee bar set inside an antique shop surrounding with funky art and vintage interior adds life and individuality to the café. Justin, the superb barista is the expert behind the craft coffee. The piccolo latte I had upon every visit, was bold and balanced punchy of acidity with silky smooth steam milk. It has great creamy mouthfeel. Perfect for an afternoon pick-me-up! No doubt, definitely the best latte I ever had in Penang! Love the satisfaction of sitting back enjoying my favorite cup of coffee at junkie, it has instantly becomes the weekly coffee session spot for my friends and I ever since the first visit. No exaggeration.. A must-go cafe for all coffee lovers! #caffeineismybloodShow less

Author: zezeannKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Coffee lovers' hideout
Review: Definitely the best coffee in town. There is this Donna, the barista who is super friendly and make me and my friends some great coffee. The reason I like this humble cafe is that its decoration is made out of lots of antiques bringing out the feel of an old time and it is no ordinary cafe. Besides that, they only serve coffee which is nice cause they really major in coffee-making. Hope they will serve tidbits that suit a cup of good coffee soon in the future. Oh yeah, its kinda hard to find this cafe like I said they are the hidden gem so here's pic of their cafe. Cheers ! :)Show less

Author: AmmarKhalifaGeorge Town, Malaysia
Title: Reason To Love Penang
Review: With Great coffee, even better company, and a truly incredible display of DIY art made of junk collected through the years, it is almost impossible not to love this place. Try to sneak in after closing hours and you might run into jamming musicians drinking the night away and providing what might very well be your most cherished Penang memories. They could start serving some food at some point, but I am not sure if they are planning to do so in the near future.Show less

Author: Kai W
Title: Awesome
Review: One of the best coffees in Penang with a chilled and artistic ambience. The owner and people working here are very friendly and down-to-earth, plus the service is tip top. You will feel so comfortable in this small setup that you won't move for hours!

Author: Jarrod R
Title: Best Coffee on the Island
Review: By far the best coffee on the island. Ignore the places on Armenian Streets. Head to this place straight for good coffee and amazing ambience. The barista is super friendly

Author: jorisamericaZurich, Switzerland
Title: Coffe Junk. The Place to be.
Review: On the busy streets of Penang, Junk is a Oasis in it self.With nice Musik in the background, it is a great Place to meet People in a relaxing and peacfull atmosphere. Full of antique-things and a exelent tasting Coffe, im suprised, each time i go there. Really Cool Place !Show less

Author: MCHLondon_10London, United Kingdom
Title: I love Junk
Review: By far the best coffee around Georgetown, not to mention extremely interesting and friendly hosts. Where else can you sit upon a lifeguard chair suspended in the air watching over Chulia Street whilst sipping a cappuccino and listening to a small group of musicians experiment with an array of unique instruments? If you've been travelling around Asia missing the piano they've got one in the back and they want you to play it. Without a doubt the coolest hangout in Georgetown.Show less

Author: Patrick084London
Title: Best Coffee in Penang! Amazing decor!!
Review: I'm from London and travels masses and have drink coffee everywhere! The coffee at Junk is superb. The best in Penang - and I've tried many place over the last 4 years! The atmosphere is amazing too. Unique decor. Real style and up to European or Singapore standards. Great music too. A good place to chill in the evenings too with beer and wine and a cocktail. Opposite the Sky Hotel on Chulia Street just up from Love Lane/the 7 Eleven towards Penang. Do check it out. Lead the crowd!Show less

Author: 226james
Title: The best coffee in town
Review:
I think their coffee is the best in penang Georgetown.and they cafe is kinda old school style and is full of junks.. 
They don't serve food here, only coffees and alcohols,and you can bring your own food to have the their coffees.

Author: CBSportySingapore, Singapore
Title: Outstanding on every front: Cuisine, Service, Decor
Review: My husband and I, traveling to Penang for the first time, were recommended Kebaya by a friend living in Penang this past weekend. This restaurant far exceeded our expectations.The warm greeting we received upon entering by Dinesh (who periodically checked on us throughout the evening), the delicious drinks (both mocktails & cocktails) served up by Gungu and the outstanding service (and menu advice) provided by June, made for an absolutely perfect evening... and this is before mentioning the food. Living in Singapore, our food standards are fairly high, and I can say this was the best dinner we've had in over a year. The prawn dish (which I almost didn't order) was the shining star of the evening (thank you June, for convincing me to try!), and I would say a must for all who visit. None of the 6 dishes & 3 desserts we ordered fell short, all were fantastic, but I am still dreaming of the prawns. This restaurant is an absolute must for all traveling to Penang. It is housed in a lovely row of shophouses that are actually a hotel. The area is charming, the shophouses are beautiful, and the restaurant is very memorable in atmosphere, decor, service and food. If we had had a chance to eat there a 2nd time in our long weekend, we certainly would have. If we return to Penang, it is sure to be a first stop.Show less

Author: 129fredericb
Title: An absolute must in Penang, a jewel of a restaurant...
Review: Great ancient Chinese restaurant in Georgetown. It absolutely looks stunning and the food is fantastic. Prices are reasonable, even for the wines. Service is efficient and very friendly

Author: 756jiaz
Title: Superb customer service and excellent menu! Worth a try or even re-visit!
Review: Overall very satisfied with the customer service especially Mr Syahrul who served very professionally & helpful. Other than that, the menu are superb and yummy even when it’s takeaway. (Comes with tiffin).You should definitely try this restaurant, they serve good Nyonnya food and all of my friends & siblings love it.Show less

Author: ari73Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: This place is a gem in Penang
Review: Thank you for the great hospitality and service rendered to our family during our first lunch at the Kebaya Dining Room. The food, service and ambiance were top-notch. We will certainly be back. Am glad we were able to have a spot yesterday for the special occasion.We were fortunate to be able to try all the dishes, and we love all the dishes.Shoutout to Syahrul, Wendy and the rest of the crew! You are the best.Show less

Author: Makan_Tidor
Title: 2nd visit and still full of surprises
Review: Came back after a year and they still surprised us with sumptuous nyonya fusion food. Sticky plum duck leg, hong bak lamb shank & tamarind glazed beef are must-try.

Author: 794guentherkGeorge Town, Malaysia
Title: Fine Dining even in MCO
Review: we have visited Kebaya , Seven Terracces two times for dine in, before MCO and after being vaccinated. In the time between we had four orders for take-away set menu. Take-away in metal tiffin, not cheap plastic containers was a complete eye opener. Dine in, staff very friedly, even rembers whether vegetarian or meat choice on last take away. Delicious Nyonya food, servings very generous. Always a treat to dine there. we will come again.Show less

Author: henrysusanti
Title: Tasty Nyonya Food
Review: Flavour of Nyonya Food, tasty in all dishes. Portion of meal package delivery is just nice. Cute tiffin brought the food stacks: grill snapper with chilli jam, lemon grass chicken, prawn masak lemak, kerabu Kacang botol and Pandan Creme caramel. Love it all! Very recommended!

Author: fedor1685George Town, Malaysia
Title: Exquisite restaurant
Review: We finally got around to visiting Kebaya restaurant in Penang and it was worth it. The food was delicious and the service impeccable. We opted for the 3 course meals. The appetizers and "greens" were okay but not spectacular. I had the feeling my popiah had been around for awhile. I had the prawn curry for a main course and it was delicious. So was the chocolate brownie and infused banana ice cream for dessert. My husband's beef main course was also delicious and enough for three people. His appetizer and greens were also just okay. All in all, we loved the ambiance and the food and will be going back.Show less

Author: El3an00r
Title: Packaged well
Review: The restaurant food is Eastern flavour and spices with Western influence. The food was really lovely and packaged well. Cooking and portion of rice was perfect. Only thing, they could charge more for food!

Author: PER JShanghai, China
Title: Lovely vegan menu
Review: In Penang, we are blessed with many vegan eateries, yet few premium option restaurants for special occations. Last night, we had an extra ordinary vegan menu at Kebaya in Georgetown. Sophisticated and delicious.Show less

Author: PER JShanghai, China
Title: We had ordered the special
Review: We had ordered the special menu (2-3 pers) for Valentine’s Day to arrive in a beautiful and environmentally tiffin. Instead the food arrived in enough plastic to fill an ocean. The rice was excellent but the rest of the rm 150 menu was bland and uninspiring. No, not our cup of tea.Show less

Author: Bevan vPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Covid19 Lock down Takeaway Experience
Review: I am normally not a fan of takeaway food from a fine dining restaurant, as half the experience is the atmosphere, service, plating and ambience of the place, which cannot be replicated at home. However, with the Covid19 lock down and inability to dine in, takeaway was the only option. Our 3 course meal was delivered, still warm, in a three tiffen cannister along with all the extras. They took the initiative to provide an explanation on how to serve and enjoy your meal at home. As I am allergic to seafood, they made allowances in the selection to cater for my needs. So one starter was unique to our order.Every course was an explosion of flavours, with a wonderful combination of sweet, fresh, spicy (but not excessively hot) tastes and aromas. We had to take a break before tackling the dessert, as the portions where more than ample, so some time was needed to digest the first two courses.I am not going to break down each meal as they were all amazing and you need to experience them yourself. So while locked down, don't despair you can still enjoy a beautifully cooked meal from this fine restaurant. We did have the pleasure of having one of their tasting menus a while back while touring Seven Terraces, which had set our expectations at a very high level and are thrilled to say we were not disappointed. We can't wait for the restrictions to be lifted so we can return to enjoy another meal at the restaurant itself. Well done to the Chefs and staff for preparing such a wonderful experience in such difficult times.Show less

Author: Lewt123Petaling Jaya, Wilayah Persekutuan, Malaysia
Title: Amazing nyonya food with a twist, great service and ambience.
Review: The 3 course dinner in Kebaya is amazing. My husband and I are here for our honeymoon getaway and am really glad we chose this place vs other fine dining places. The starter otak2 is special with the crispy puffs and the sauce is so good! For our main course, seabass was grilled to perfection and lamb was extremely soft and tender. We really enjoyed the vege masak lemak too, gravy was great. For desserts, we really enjoyed the pengat panna cotta, and the tang yuen. Loved the ambience and service too. The waiters are very helpful and friendly. They even served us complimentary dessert because we're on our honeymoon. Will come back again. Dont expect a traditional meal and be pleasantly surprised!Show less

Author: henrysusantiTanjung Tokong, Malaysia
Title: Nyonya cuisine with the style
Review: It’s located inside Seven Terrace hotel building. Available on set lunch and dinner. Nice ambience, fine dining (casual dress code) with Chinese and colonial style, grand antiques stuff. Wine and drinks are available, bar with colonial style. Friendly and helpful staffs, ask recommendation from menu and the explanation from waiters or Sahrul, the Manager. Tasty awesome food, especially Hong Bak Lamb, Fish, Prawn but all food we ordered are tasty too. Very recommended!Show less

Author: shearersx4Canberra
Title: The Ultimate Penang Experience
Review: For the past four years Kebaya is where we have taken every special guest visiting Penang and where our family has celebrated every special occasion - birthdays, anniversaries, exam results, etc. More recently we have also enjoyed several superb lunches too. Kebaya was our first destination as soon as lock down restrictions were eased.Dining at Kebaya is magical and the luxury and decadence are effortlessly entwined in every aspect of the experience. The professionalism of the staff, the quality and presentation of the extraordinary food, the style and sophistication of the beautifully restored Seven Terraces - it all feels genuine and flawless. The lychee martini is not to be missed and is the perfect way to start the evening. We have loved every dish on every menu over the past four years and the sophisticated flavours and elevated interpretation of traditional Nyonya dishes never fails to impress.The lunch menu in particular, offers exceptional value and there is always something fascinating to feast your eyes on too - the The Chinoiserie Exhibition is superb and the antique shop gallery is worth a visit. Dining at Kebaya is an experience not to be missed for Penang residents and visitors alike.Show less

Author: jessye3000Sioux Falls, South Dakota
Title: Last Dinner Out Before Lockdown
Review: We were in Malaysia when it went into lockdown because of the coronavirus, so we figured we might as well spend our last dinner out at a beautiful place. And this place is beautiful. There was live music which was just gorgeous and the decor was outstanding. The Peranakan food here is definitely more expensive than elsewhere, but for a nice night out it is worth it. The set menu was packed with delicious food. My fav was the otak otak starter. I still think about it haha.Show less

Author: koayteowNewcastle upon Tyne, United Kingdom
Title: Fine Dining Nonya Style
Review: Located in an exquisitely restored set of Georgetown Townhouses this is fine dining Penang style - unmissable. A number of different influences blended with Nonya style cooking. Higher end prices for Penang - Outstanding value for the food and ambience. The menu is just the right size - and the staff will guide you through the choices. Try a cocktail.Show less

Author: dunyaschotman
Title: Fantastic restaurant!
Review:
Fantastic restaurant! 
The service here is incredible and the food is great! I was with 2 others so we shared some dishes and everything was so good! Try the duck for your main dish!

Author: snufkeiHong Kong, China
Title: Enjoyable dining experience in Penang
Review: We went there as a group of 4 during our trip in Penang. The service, environment and atmosphere are brilliant! The waiters are very accommodating and take initiatives to provide recommendation.
