A perfect place for celebration with live music and great vibes - there's another group celebrating birthday and there are a little surprise by the restaurant.We love every dish from appetizer to dessert - not too much surprise for us as Nyonya cuisine is very much like Chinese cuisine, but food is in high quality so it's a pleasant experience. Price is relatively high in Penang where you easily grab a dinner for just USD2-3, but definitely worth to try to search for somewhere in time.Show less

Author: Angie965Auckland Central, New Zealand
Title: Beautiful Meal in Exquisite Surroundings
Review: My husband and I have just enjoyed the most beautiful meal at Kebaya. Right from the outset we were made to feel so welcome & the location itself is like a film set from the 1920’s. The restaurant is part of the Seven Terraces Boutique Hotel. The food is nyonya fusión & the flavours are so adeptly combined, that you savour every mouthful.The wine list & drinks menu is extensive, and the staff are utterly charming. When we left this evening we noticed an elderly man playing what the lovely front of house staff member told us was the guzheng. It was quite mesmeric, you felt as if you had gone back in time. It really was a fitting end to a perfect evening.Highly recomended, don’t miss out on a special experience.Show less

Author: Londonerpeakdistrict
Title: Definitely recommend Kebaya
Review:
A fellow guest at our hotel told us about this place, we have been travelling for three weeks and this has been our best dining experience 
I doubt whether we will get better
Excellent service and delicious food and so reasonably priced

Author: DaisyC153Hong Kong, China
Title: Peranakan dining to perfection in a too die for setup
Review: This is a must visit, prices are slightly on the higher end of the spectrum for Penang standard but still affordable given the exquisite quality and service. The dining room sit in a restored heritage building cum boutique stay named the Seven Terrace. All the china and porcelains are just to die for! You need to call to book in advance as they only serve dinner sets, this gives a different side of the Penang culture other than the wide array of street food. Must visit Show less

Author: Happiness05765781898
Title: Great service, great food
Review: Visited with my mother and wife, very very nice evening with very good local food with a European twist. Very nice place all together and good service.

Author: Davidlye70Singapore, Singapore
Title: Waited 20 minutes for table while first seating guests chatted idly
Review: I dread eating standard Chinese New Year reunion food so we ended up with Peranakan for reunion where it was less crowded and food was not production line.It would have been perfect if I did not have to wait 20 minutes for my table while the guests from the first seating sat around chatting and the restaurant staff did not encourage them politely to leave, until I broached it.Show less

Author: TheMohawkSingapore
Title: Outstanding vegetarian dinner in beautiful Peranakan house
Review:
One of the best vegetarian meals that I have had. Stunning texture and tastes.

Lovely range of wines too, unusual for Malaysia.

Great service too with a smile.

Beautiful peranakan house/hotel.

Faultless.

Author: hayend89Warminster, United Kingdom
Title: Fabulous evening!
Review: Beautiful surroundings should be celebrated with a good cocktail and the Georgetown Cooler at the bar hit the spot, and was a great start to a supberb culinary experience. Book a table at Kebaya, put on your smart frock and enjoy the excellent service, ambiance and of course food. It is rare that I read a menu and would like to choose most items on it, but this is one of them. You choose a starter, main, veg and desert for a set price and my husband and I shared our dishes - a fusion of tastes complimented by some excellent wjne. We visited on recommendation from friends who come frequently, and all I can say is GO!Show less

Author: JohnsnelgroveHong Kong, China
Title: Disappointing evening in a restaurant with great food
Review: An anomaly. Our third visit to a really good restaurant ruined by the staff. Disinterested unengaged it turned a good evening into a very disappointing one. It is a shame as the ambience is good, we had our regular table. When I asked to see the manager I was told he was having his dinner. Fortunately, his assistant came to see us. Need to sack the staff and train a team that will complement their good foodShow less

Author: Trivinator
Title: Great food with local influence.
Review: Wonderful food and great service.  The waiters are ready with dining suggestions.  The food is really nice.

Author: VDesRosiers
Title: Frankly disapointing
Review: This restaurant is a rip off! Same food on the street is ten times better and cheaper. It looks impressive and probably is for tourists who are not foodies or who cannot tell the difference between a good Chinese cuisine and a tourist proof one... We were very much looking forward to it but we were very disappointed. Everything is a facade. You pay for accessing the history of the ace, nothing more. Foodies: don't waste your money on this restaurant!Show less

Author: jorinas576Singapore, Singapore
Title: Second time here and food
Review: Second time here and food was still as delicious as ever. My parents enjoyed the food and even more so the impeccable service from the staff, especially Dinesh who was very friendly and gave good recommendations on what to order. He also remembered all 12 of our orders without writing down anything! Ninie was also very warm and invited us to stay at the Seven Terraces hotel next time we came to Penang. Standout dishes were the prawns and barramundi! Would come back again and again. Show less

Author: goshkaDingle, Ireland
Title: Excellent
Review: My wife and I dined here last week and had a most enjoyable experience. This is by far the best restaurant we ate in while in Penang. The food, service, setting,decor, were all excellent. A little more expensive than many of the other restaurants in Penang, but you get what you pay for, and I would consider it very good value for money. The menu is a 4 course set menu, but with plenty of choice, good portions, and nicely paced. Will definitely return,Show less

Author: 590ngq
Title: Unique flavors of Penang’s Peranankan Food
Review: Stepping in the Kebaya Dining Room is as if walking back in to the Peranakan Houses during the colonial times. Coming from Singapore, my friend and I are familiar with how the usual Peranankan food taste. The uniqueness of Kebaya’s food comes from the use of the spices and local fruits- in the instance of the lor ark, it comes with the taste of cinammon, star anise, cloves and nutmeg. The grilled snapper was well marinated and nicely grilled. For appetizers, we had miang kham of salmon roe which I thought was a creative mix of typical Peranakan ingredients with the unusual ones such as the salmon roe! And the Joo Hoo Char roll which came with a twist, as described in their menu :) A pity it was a little small (cos it was an appetiser). I enjoyed the Georgetown Cooler that had nutmeg juice infused:) Service was good and attentive. I would definitely come back here again. Oh don’t forget to make a reservation. The place is cosy but also means that there are limited seats! Show less

Author: skyhightravellers
Title: Wonderful experience
Review: A beautiful setting in a heritage hotel. Staff were friendly and attentive. Amazing menu. Food was so well presented and tasted delicious. Had a great evening. A truly wonderful experience.

Author: PatsyY
Title: Good
Review: It sits in a heritage house, nice design and decoration.  Food and service is nice, lamb is very tender, prawn is fresh.  I would give 5 if food can be in a more nicer presentation.

Author: Maubis
Title: Truely Asian taste
Review: Right in the centre a beautifull restorred building. Very classic heritage styleful restaurant. The wonderfull Asian fusion dishes are being served by a great staff. Just go there and experience it.

Author: marybymcdonnellWarrenton, Virginia
Title: Superb food in charming old world ambience
Review: Transports you back to a slower time when relaxing with good food and responsive, unobtrusive service was more the norm. Kebaya serves very authentic Penang cuisine meticulously prepared. A great place for a group in a private room or for all adult families or a romantic couples night out. Quiet ambience and elegant lighting and furnishings show off the well maintained structures of this old Chinese courtyard house beautifully.Show less

Author: HotKhongPenangPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: As good as ever...
Review: I visited Kebaya Restaurant again after about a couple of years, and find that the ambiance is pleasant, the food just as good, and the service just as welcoming and efficient as it's been before. It's definitely a nice place to get away for a couple's only dinner.Show less

Author: jennytH6286CG
Title: Tasty food coupled with wonderful ambience and service
Review: Winning three course menu with standout service from all staff. Thoroughly enjoyable and highly recommended. Very reasonable price for the experience.

Author: Wayne M
Title: Something different
Review: We enjoyed the good quality food on offer in a relaxed atmosphere. The menu options are linked to local cuisine and are enjoyable.

Author: deepsapphyr
Title: Great nonya restaurant with wonderful setting
Review: Great nonya restaurant with traditional dishes by chefs who trained in Europe. It consists of a 4 course tasting menu with several choices in each course. Beautiful setting and very good food.  Their oolong tea was superb! At $40 per menu a steal.

Author: Jonky1Chiang Mai, Thailand
Title: Exquisite
Review: I’d give this one very high marks. Beautiful china and ambiance, spongy comfy chairs. It’s a set menu only, $30., there’s no a la carte dishes available. Difficult to make a selection the entire menu looked perfect, I had the beef cheeks and crab apple vegetables with the salmon row as an appetizer. The beef cheeks/ fall apart delicious, and the crab/ apple salad unique tastes and excellent. Wine by the glass $10. I was there at 6:30 pm, about 30-40% full, no reservation. 15 min grab ride $2.00. The area is rustic colonial old architecture, bring camera. Very highly recommend! Show less

Author: vl4781Newcastle upon Tyne, United Kingdom
Title: Amazing food, experience and ambience
Review: I visited Penang, saw this restaurant in my guidebook and it says $$$$ as well as needing to book way in advance, did not think I have much of a chance. However, as I traveled alone I tried my luck and as it would have it they have 1 tablet for the first sitting. There are 2 sittings per evening so I went to the earlier one but that was fine as I did not want to hang around much longer.It is located in quite a central area of the old town of Penang. It is a restaurant but also a hotel. I really like how they have sympathetically preserved the decor and building itself but the same time brings in some modern amenities such as air conditioning. The staff was all very friendly, helpful and courteous. The theme of the restaurant is a bit of East meets West where the food is east but with a western twist to it. I had a Otak Otak to start which red snapper in crispy pastry which is the slightly western part. It was baked to ordered as the pastry was very flakey. My "Greens" course was the Thai Softshell Crab Salad. I ordered the Chinese New Year Special the Babi Assam Koffman and the Prosperity Wafers. I don't know if the "Koffman" part is to do with Pierre Koffmann as he is well known for his trotters. All the food was really delicious and well balanced between flavour and spices. The other aspect that reminded me of home in the far east is you can have a further serving of rice as part of the meal. In the U.K. restaurants charges you for rice which I do not understand, would they charge extra for having pasta with your bolognese?Towards the latter half of my meal, a musician started playing the guzheng now that is atmosphere!Just to highlight the really good standard of the waiting staff, I actually got a bit of food stuck between my teeth when eating the trotter. I was trying to discreetly remove it when a server saw me he brought some food pick over straight away. I thought that shows how much they are aware of what their customers are doing. Overall, really enjoyed the food, great place to eat and definitely worth at least one trip. Whilst I know the guidebook says it would rank this place as $$$$ but perhaps from the U.K. and U.S. standard this probably is not "expensive" but definitely more expensive than usual places to eat which is about a fifth or a quarter what they charge. But could I get the same quality food the way they have presented to me with someone playing the guzheng for what they charged me in the U.K..... NO.Show less

Author: 152katier938Sydney, Australia
Title: Celebratory Dinner
Review: Attended with friends on our last night in Penang. This restaurant came highly recommend by friends back home in Australia. The four course meal was absolutely delicious and we couldn’t fault a single thing. The service was impeccable, a large and affordable through to expensive drinks menu. Comfortable seating and a fantastic ambience. Would wholeheartedly recommend. Show less

Author: travels_ahoyLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Lovely anniversary meal
Review: Went to Kebaya for dinner to celebrate our anniversary whilst staying at the hotel (Seven Terraces) and had a fabulous time. It's not cheap compared to a lot of other more 'local' restaurants, but the food was great - we had a 3-4 course meal and cocktails and it came to £70 so great value by British standards, just not Malaysian!Highlight for me was the desserts, and even my husband (who usually doesn't have a sweet tooth) said his pandan creme brulee was amazing. To top it off, the staff also presented us with a card and a free extra dessert which was a lovely touch.Show less

Author: katherinewG5809WUSydney, Australia
Title: Lovely Nyonya dinner
Review: Kebaya is the fine dining restaurant at the Seven Terraces boutique hotel (which is fabulous). The dinner is four courses with a choice from about 8 dishes for each course at about $45AUD. The service was wonderful, June our waitress gave us a tour afterwards and we were so impressed we had to go back and spend a night there! Thanks June! The food was lovely and the laid-back ambience of the restored old shophouse terrace made for a very relaxed evening.Show less

Author: Kimhan2911Teluk Intan, Malaysia
Title: Just an average restaurant. 7/10
Review: Thought it is a great restaurant but just an average after all. Nice atmosphere with live music. The first thing comes to me is the obvious stained glass of Pandan Jasmine Tea which should be seen by everyone yet it served to me. In my thought, the cleanliness of this restaurant is not what I expected as it should be. I'd ordered Grilled Chicken Kapitan which is not grilled at all. It looks like the boiled type. The chicken even has an unpleasant odor from the inside bone part which can tell the chicken freshness.Show less

Author: robynd802Brisbane, Australia
Title: Amazing food, great service.
Review: Elegant surrounds and attentive staff made our dining experience memorable. The food was so good. We were a party of three and each ordered different items for each course and the dishes were presented as share plates so we tried so many tasty flavors. Staff explained the meals well and the food was served at just the right pace. The bar is also worth some time for pre dinner drinks with interesting cocktails and a good wine selection. Book in advance. So popular, but still so attentive.Show less

Author: perthite79
Title: Nice dinner menu.
Review: Lovely setting and meal.As we had been staying at the hotel Seven Terraces we had dinner here one of the nightsThe four course set menu was lovely. Plenty of choices for each course so not limited like many other set menus. Soft shell crab was our favourite. Show less

Author: FrazersNorthumberland, UK
Title: The most delicious meal of our tour!
Review: Beautifully furnished mansion house offering sublime food with perfect service. Must be booked in advance. Superb menu of local delights including my bizarre green creme caramel! Totally recommend.Show less

Author: BalisandClovelly, Australia
Title: Sumptuous and delicious
Review: We were a party of five, all familiar with Peranakan food, all adventurous eaters - and all delighted. We started with GREAT margaritas, and were carefully advised by the attentive staff on how best to order. Three starters, one of each for each person. The Miang of salmon roe was outstanding, the crispy prawns delicious, and the otak otak a nice spin on the traditional presentation. We then ordered one each of the main course dishes, to share, and side orders of salads and vegetables. Again huge success, the standouts being the 49-hour lamb shanks, the duck confit with Asian flavours and the pork belly with hoisin sauce. All a huge success, in a graceful and elegant space. A memorable evening!Show less

Author: Charlotte T
Title: Superb set dinner menu
Review: We went here for dinner on our last night in George Town. Superb food on the set dinner menu and just the right amount of it. I would absolutely recommend ordering the sous vide lamb...But it's all delicious.

Author: dchongsterSingapore, Singapore
Title: Peranakan with a twist
Review: Heard much about Kebaya ahead of our trip to Penang. Watching an episode of Jason Can't Cook featuring the restaurant, sealed it for me and we made a reservation for dinner. A 4-course meal may not sound like much, but as the portions are really meant to be shared, it turns out that it is really quite a lot of food for our party of two. The food was really good. I was really there for the Kapitan Chicken and it did not disappoint! The tang yuen served in a coconut broth was interesting and a good end to the meal.And then, there is the ambiance ... what can I say, simply gorgeous. Oh and by the way, service was excellent too!Show less

Author: tonyhJ9770AY
Title: Celebration of significant milestone birthday
Review: Exceeded expectations; ambiance, service & food all 5 out of 5. Cost was not not excessive, overall evening was a trip highlight for many guests who travelled from overseas. Cannot recommend highly enough!!

Author: keroppi_jb
Title: Wonderful restaurant serving nice Nyoya cuisine
Review: 餐廳位於Seven Terraces酒店裡，氣氛很好，裝潢很漂亮，服務員也很親切，對應也很迅速。食物味道很好，無論前菜、主菜、甜品都很出色，也很有特色，非常喜歡它們的咖喱蝦和魚，甜品的Pana Cotta也令我很驚艷，讓第一次吃娘惹菜的我對娘惹菜另眼相看。

Author: StephenTheHungry
Title: Lovely
Review: Succulent duck and lovely flavours all around. Gentle live piano music serenaded us and all around a super dinner

Author: 697racheleLondon, United Kingdom
Title: One of our best meals of the trip!
Review: We were staying at Seven Terraces and saw how busy this place was so had to visit! A delicious 4 course menu with as much rice as you can eat, all washed down with a lovely bottle of wine! We couldn’t fault it - the flavours, service, value for money - it’s one of our best meals yet! Show less

Author: 221camrPerth, Australia
Title: Take your stretchy pants
Review: My partner and I visited Kebaya on the recommendation of a friend, and were definitely not disappointed. The staff were pleasant and friendly, and food... well, I can't say enough about the food. Uh-maze-zing. We had a booking for 6(pm), got there early, after checking out some street art through the heat of the afternoon, so we enjoyed a little cold shandy (read beer and nutmeg juice) at the bar prior to service. What a stunningly restored building. The team here has created a perfect ambience and setting to enjoy almost perfection coming from the kitchen. Definately wear your elastic waisted pants for this, you may need them. Would definitely recommend and we'll likely visit again.Show less

Author: SGClaudiaSingapore, Singapore
Title: 60th birthday
Review: We booked Kebaya through Syah. He helped me plan the menu for my husband’s 60th birthday. From start to finish the dishes were exquisite. The fusion combination was Delectable. For example the chef combined otak otak in a crispy puff pastry. Organic Roast pork was combined with hoisin balsamic reduction sauce. Prawn Geng in a turmeric coconut sauce. The combination was powerful. Totally out of the world. Dr Jason was the pianist who entertained with his brilliant pieces. You could even give him your choice of songs. He so patiently played all seven songs that we chose that evening! Thank you, Syah, for turning this celebration into such warm memory for us and our friends... Show less

Author: Spicydumpling7
Title: Wonderful service and food
Review: We were really excited to dine at Kebaya Dining Room and our expectations were exceeded!! Beautiful ambience and even w the smaller menu selection we couldn’t decide what to eat, they all sounded so delicious. Service was exceptional, all the servers and hosts were friendly, attentive and wholehearted. We didn’t manage to catch the names of the staff but Dinesh in particular was so helpful & stood out! Delicious food thoughtfully prepared only slightly overshadowed by the wonderful service. Really excited to return in the future!Show less

Author: sanju72015
Title: Food is much better now compared to 2017
Review:
Dinner at Kebaya Restaurant
Penang

Two years ago we had dinner here and the only dish that was really good was the otah puff.

So I was indeed surprised that the food was mostly good tonight. 😋

Sigh! Can’t add more than 10 photos.

Author: EllaOscarSingapore, Singapore
Title: Nyonya experience
Review: Book ahead to secure your table. A wonderful experience in terms of the ambience, the food and the excellent service. The servings are generous and the waiters will help to guide your choices. We considered this to be a highlight of our time in George Town.Show less

Author: janicecG8636ZQKowloon, China
Title: Beautiful vintage restaurant with delicious food
Review: Great taste of Nyonya cuisine of Malaysia , great service . Only the 4 course set meal is served , no A La Carte , but surprised to find out that they hv fries and nuggets for my children. a beautiful place for dinner , one of the best restaurant in Penang.Show less

Author: 47bjcdMelbourne, Australia
Title: Dinner
Review: Opulent setting for a fine dining experience. Well composed, excellent food. Slightly western influenced in my view. Very good, smallish wine selection. Attentive staff. Prices reasonable but on the high side for Penang. Pork belly very good. Crème brûlée my highlight!Show less

Author: BrightonKarenBrighton
Title: Delicious meal
Review: Beautiful building and wonderful food. We visited with our daughter and they were very welcoming, and despite offering a set menu only, they will cook a kid friendly option for young children when dining with parents. Set menu was delicious - relatively expensive compared to a lot of food in Georgetown but worth it, and more of a fine dining option. Staff were also excellent and our waiter even gave us a mini tour of the hotel (which looks amazing).Show less

Author: Artistry105Singapore, Singapore
Title: A truly Penang peranakan experience
Review: I went here with my friends, as it was highly recommended by my other friends.When we entered, the decor was what impressed us first - it was amazingly beautiful and incorporates what the peranakan culture is in Penang.As we came as a group, we ordered the set menu which allowed us to try everything as we are sharing everything. I remembered that the food was amazing, the tastes were rich but not too spicy. I recommend to try the set menu if you are traveling in a group - this allows you to try everything.There is a hotel in the back of the restaurant which also looks amazing. The kind staff allowed us to take pictures there and I am pretty sure I would like to try the hotel in the future.Please do try this restaurant - I think its a place to start to understand what peranakan Penang food is like.Show less

Author: hovnav
Title: Liked the decor
Review: There is something pleasantly old fashioned about this restaurant. Love the wood and the curtains in the restaurant and the live music. The food was all delicious and the service was good. Did not feel in any way overpriced.

Author: leejinw
Title: Worth a visit!
Review: Lovely ambience, and we enjoyed the music played by the pianist there. Food quality was superb and it's worth the price (RM128++ per pax)

Author: Aquilabangkok
Title: Historical Place with very good meal
Review: We went to this place by my friend recommendation. On the first night we went to have a drink at the bar first. I have to say the place and decor is looks stunning. So we decided to make a booking for dinner on the next day. The problem we have is we don’t eat pork and our daughter is Vegan so we inform staff about this matter, staff wouldn’t hesitate at all and she replied promptly to accommodate our special dietary. On the day we come for dinner Service, food and ambience really nice our food menu was fantastic. I would recommend anyone who stay in George Town to try if you have budget for set menu. We paid 128 RM++ person if I’m not wrong. We will go back again if we in George Town.Show less

Author: sugeoffNoosaville, Australia
Title: Amazing restaurant
Review: The restaurant is amazing and the history and the ambiance make this a worthwhile visit,The service was impeccable and the food quality is superb, the evening was perfect from the time we arrived to the time we left,wehave recommended to friends and will be back next time in PenangShow less

Author: gt556
Title: Beautiful food in relaxed surroundings.
Review: We searched for a restaurant to enjoy a highlight meal before we left on our holiday and selected Kebaya. So glad we did. From the moment we walked in and were welcomed,we were impressed by the decor and exemplary service.Delicious food done so well. A young Sri Lankan man was delightful in looking after us & talking with.Take a moment to view the quirky art work in the courtyard outside, so worthwhile>Show less

Author: afernando3445
Title: Excellent Food
Review: Amazing environment and atmosphere, Extraordinary food, Excellent Service. Thanks to the Hostess June for having us and Thanks to the waiter Deva and Dhinesh for attending us throughout the night. Surely will be back.

Author: Ted GMelbourne, Australia
Title: Great Experience
Review: Kebaya is a wonderful restaurant. It is housed is an amazing building at Seven Terraces, which has been beautifully restored. Even though is says a set menu, there are 4 or 5 choices for each of the four courses. The food is delicious, great Nonya style cooking. The staff are excellent and for the quality, it is great value for money. Our only disappointment was dining on the last night of our visit, otherwise we would have been back.Highly recommended. Show less

Author: Sue C
Title: Elegant, stylish dining
Review: Bookings essential for this restaurant. Two evening sittings with a fixed menu, although there is some choice within each course. Able to accomodate a seafood allergy easily. Thrilling setting, piano accompaniment throughout, alcohol served. A special place with superb food and excellent service.

Author: derekchiangSingapore, Singapore
Title: Disappointing experience :(
Review: Bad experience overall - we found hair in our thai soft shell crab salad and requested for a new plate. When speaking to Shirley, the restaurant leader that evening, about our unfortunate incident (especially coming from a restaurant of this status), she wasn't apologetic at all. I was mindful and paying attention how she was trying to do her service recovery - there was not a word of "sorry" or "i apologise". It felt that the restaurant was not wrong to serve dishes with hair at all. To give her some credit, she did try to do some service recovery by offering arabica coffee which she said was something new on the menu (seriously?! And who drinks coffee at night?). My friend and I do not drink coffee and declined her kind offer for coffee, but there wasn't an alternative for us sadly, which i thought was bad customer service. There was no also follow up or byes after we paid. A pity our evening was affected by this unfortunate incident and hope that they can improved.Show less

Author: janpal
Title: Nothing but 5 stars for everything.
Review: This was an amazing experience. All our courses were wonderful and extremely reasonable in price.  The service was top-notch. Friendly and right on target. Go. You won't regret it. The surroundings are very elegant. A real stand out in our travels.

Author: carolynandpeter2016Perth, Australia
Title: Fantastic
Review: A wonderful experience. The beautifully restored building is amazing - chandeliers, velvet curtains, gorgeous furnishings - and the staff are extremely attentive. The quality of the food was outstanding over all the courses. We thoroughly enjoyed the pianist and the ambiance as a whole and recommend this restaurant highly.Show less

Author: AmyLimWang
Title: Amazing dinner!
Review: Very nice place with a wonderful atmosphere, great food and drinks. A bit overpriced but very high standard of quality. High recommend

Author: GongzhuelaNew York City, New York
Title: Memorable dinner in lovely Georgetown
Review: Had a fantastic dinner at Kebaya. We came for the 6pm session, which was perfect because it wasn’t crowded. Food was delicious!! The restaurant is in an upscale renovated mansion, so make sure to walk around and take pictures. Decor of the restaurant brought us back to old Shanghai in the 1920s. Ask for Dinesh to be your waiter to make your experience personal - he’s warm and very attentive. Show less

Author: Cabana1973Dubai, United Arab Emirates
Title: Family Dinner
Review: We were staying at the Seven Terraces so we thought we had to try and it didn't disappoint. My family and I all chose a different dish and we shared from one an others plates. The crispy pork dish we had was fabulous and some great vegetable dishes as well. If you're in town and looking for a good restaurant I would go here!Show less

Author: 49karenlSudbury, United Kingdom
Title: OUTSTANDING EVENING
Review: I booked out table at least one month prior to arrival in Georgetown as I had heard so many positive things about Kebaya.I am so glad I did - the evening was superb. From arrival asyou walk into the beautiful dining room and are greeted by theirlovely hostess to every other member of staff who are clearly exceptionally well trained and are a pleasure to encounter.The menu is a set menu, but no problem for us as the choices were very well thought out and complimentary and gave one agood flavour of Nonya food. The food was excellent, every dish and course really delicious.The most pleasing thing to us about Kebaya was there were nopretentions as one so often encounters in 'The restaurant to eat in' venues, just happy professional staff who took real pride in presenting outstanding food and creating a lovely atmosphere at a very reasonable cost to their many patrons. Highly recommended.Show less

Author: Xin10000Singapore, Singapore
Title: Mixed feeling, for a MYR128 meal in Penang, one would like to expect more.
Review: We read reviews and wanted to try this peranakan fine dining restaurant. A lot of other reviews talked about the food, so I wanted to say something else. After all everyone has their own preference of taste.However the service could have been improved.1. We came with a small suitcase, 25 minutes before our 6pm reservation. We were told by the waiter that we could wait at the bar area with the suitcase. Nobody showed us to the seats or told us where exactly we could leave the suitcase. So we found seats ourselves, but there was a lady (maybe in charge?) came and told us we SHOULD leave the suitcase at the reception... conflict of opinions from staff and confused guest. It was not a big issue at all so no problem. We followed her instruction and waited at the bar.2. The same lady apparently was not good with names? Only 4 parties arrived at that time. We were checked for reservation name, 4 times within 15 minutes.3. Menu, just two pages, could have been seriously improved. Would the restaurant like to consider the idea of making it a nicely printed booklet, including picture of the dish, more info/story behind each of them if any, or stories for the historical building, the hotel, georgetown or even peranankan cuisine/culture? We were the second table placing order therefore our food came quite fast, but we noticed some other guests who came later indeed waited for LONG time. Maybe it is a good idea to provide some reading? 4. Related to #3. Maybe some snacks (peanuts, crackers, etc) while waiting? Of course if those seems too much, the restaurant could charge a bit more, to cover the printing of (take-home) booklet/menu/story, some welcome tea and snacks. Btw we didn't get the drink menu so I thought the drink menu previously we saw at the bar were only for the bar...5. You might also consider the idea of having a postcard as souvenir. It could be the hotel building, the interior of the restaurant, or the dishes.6. Some waiters/waitress seemed quite new. They walked around the tables in a very causal way (not like the waiters in E&O for example). They talked among themselves while pouring water to you glass. When you said thank you no (or inaudible?) response from them...some plus points:- we liked the kebaya and sarong that lady(in #1, #2) wore, but she was the only one wearing those.- we liked the pianist, but for the 6pm seating, he came only around 7pm? Food is OK for us, not really fancy or very impressive but quite OK, as I mentioned taste is a very individual thing. However "fine dinning" is never only about the food itself. For this price (seriously with MYR10 you could easily get a serve of fancy noodle) and what we got, I'd rather patron some peranakan restaurants back in Singapore more, like national kitchen, true blue, house of peranakan, blue ginger etc. None of them advertise themselves explicitly as fine dining anyway, nor anyone is really more expensive than this restaurant.Show less

Author: benny_yong_myTiong Bahru, Singapore
Title: Excellent service, good food, great atmosphere
Review: Thanks to Syah and Steven for constantly accommodating my many queries and last minute requests for additional diners.Recommended menu was enjoyed by the guests, particularly the desserts.Great atmosphere w the pianist playing.Minor hiccup when they served beef which we had earlier exchanged w the lor ark, but the kitchen came through and did speedy service recovery, thus letting us have our correct order very quickly.Show less

Author: Ch BMontpellier, France
Title: Exquisite dining
Review: We went there the two of us, after reviewing the reviews on Tripadvisor we decided to go there. A reservatie is a must. The ambiance is very very nice. 7 townhouses were converter into this restauran, in a very nice colonial style. The menu is a bit Chinese/Thai fusion style. There are photo's of the menu in the photo-bit, so you can see what to expect. We are not very fond of deserts, therefore we copuld trade of 2 desert for 2 additional starters. The staff is experienced and does speak good English. All in all, a MUST visit when in Penang.Show less

Author: WorldTraveler639Montreal, Canada
Title: Average - We Expected More
Review: Given all of the rave reviews of Kebaya, we were expecting more. The portions are big so you're definitely getting value for your money, and the decor is very pretty, but the food itself is just fine. Nothing wrong with it, but the meal was simply not memorable. Also, they specify a dress code but when we were there we saw one group in shorts and T-shirts, not to mention another table took out their own alcohol from their bag and started drinking it -- how is that ok? If you're going to bill yourself as one of the nicest restaurants in Georgetown, you should follow your own rules. So strange. Would not return.Show less

Author: ungbh33
Title: Well Done!!!
Review: The environment, hospitality plus awesome food.. definitely a memorable evening with my wife.The set dinner was well crafted fusion dishes lovingly presented by the Chef and delivered by courteous service staff. The character and atmosphere of the place was fantastic.

Author: OenbbSingapore, Singapore
Title: Friendly staff, but the food is not t as authentic as I would like it to be
Review: Beautifully decorated restaurant inside the hotel, very well kept peranakan house and it is a pleasant to dine there. However, I would not say that the food is the most authentic. For those who have not had much experience with Nonya food might think that the food is good but to me, I think that something is missing. They cater more for tourists, not for the real peranakan food lover. No doubt the service was excellent but the price also is at its top.Show less

Author: normad88Singapore, Singapore
Title: Great ambience, good food, at top end prices
Review: We were recommended Kebaya by a hotel staff. As stepped in, we were immediately impressed by the 'rich' Peranakan ambience of the dining large dining room. However, one tell from looking at the guests that this is a place targeted at tourists and that gave me a sense to lower my expectations of the food. Frankly, I do not recall anything I ate though they were good enough for my taste buds. Dinner is fixed price per pax with options for each course. It is clearly not a place that locals would be attracted to unless perhaps they were celebrating birthdays. The Birthday song was sang five times that night :) Go for the experience but check out the price first.Show less

Author: LindsayMannMelbourne, Australia
Title: Excellent dining experience
Review: This restaurant was recommended to my wife and I and it lived up to our high expectations. The setting is magnificently restored 19th century shophouses. The staff were excellent - particularly Syahrul, June and Deva. The menu is not long but offers ample choice. There is a limited wine list but again sufficient variety. We enjoyed all the dishes we chose (with advice from the staff). We particularly liked the Otak Otak entree, the Prawn Geng main and the Pandan Creme Brûlée. The coffee was also excellent as was the Bottle of Margaret River SSB that we drank. The staff were very attentive throughout our meal. Overall an excellent dining experience.Show less

Author: Bernice D
Title: A fantastic place we always visit when in George Town  food and service fantastic
Review: Exquisite food perfection and service the same  we love dining here  when ever visiting Penang and have never been disappointed sets your taste buds an an exquisite journey  thsnk you for our latest wonderful experience

Author: 321joesSingapore, Singapore
Title: Beautiful decor, wonderful staff and almost perfect food
Review: I actually wanted to give 4.5 stars but unfortunately could not and it felt harsh to rate the place as a 4. The building is stunning, the decoration is exquisite and the staff are so very helpful and delighted to guide you through the menu. The live music which is not at all in your face adds to the atmosphere. It’s just a shame that one of our starters was not parity with the excellence of the rest of the food and the service. We gave some feedback on the sub par starter and the staff saw fit to inform the Chef and they brought a complementary glass of wine for the trouble.You should definitely book in advance to visit this restaurant. It’s a real treat but probably best for 4-6 people as you will get to try more dishes without bursting your belly. Show less

Author: jenniferclaire2014Penang Island, Malaysia
Title: Always a treat - a glamorous evening in a stunning dining room, delightful food and very good service.
Review: We've eaten at Kebaya many times and consistently it has delivered. From the rather glamorous bar area for a pre-dinner drink to the fragrant, beautifully-presented food and the knowledgeable, friendly service it is a restaurant hard to beat. We always enjoy our evenings there as do our various overseas visitors and to be 'cocooned in a spot of luxury and spoiled' Kebaya-style is a must during a visit to George Town.Show less

Author: wflal1991Bendigo, Australia
Title: Great meal again
Review: 2nd visit to Penang and also to Kebaya Dining Room for a great meal. The selection of food was again great however for our 6pm service, they have 6pm and 8pm, we were seated promplty and ordered from tbe menu by 6pm. We chose different selections and sparkling water. Our entree and mains were served very quickly with as much rice as you wanted and by 630pm both of us slowed down as we would of been out by 7pm for a 2hr sitting. We then asked for a drink and some time before dessert which the staff did happily. We were even given a photo book to look through of the hotel from its inception. Great images it took 2yrs to complete. Dessert delivered a good 15 minutes after we asked for a break which was great and allowed us to enjoy it more. Overall great food, staff were nice but seemed to hover a little, and the kitchen staff could be heard from our table. Not a big issue but we could hear them also when we 1st visited as well.Overall .. yes we would be back as the food is great. Staff friendly but just needs to be better paced bw courses.Show less

Author: detman2434Melbourne, Australia
Title: Great room, excellent service and good food.
Review: Return visit Seven Terraces, staying for six nights and ate at the restaurant twice. Set menu but chose badly...didn't order a wet dish opting for the sous vide pork which was a mistake, it being the only really technically flawed dish we had. The restaurant is emphasizing a fusion menu with modern technique but the pork that resulted was bland and the accompanying balsamic sauce simply out of place.... the whole thing a pale imitation of classic Chinese Char Sieu pork Knew better the second time around. Had a finely balanced meal, though spice and heat levels compromised to , l assume, not offend the Western palate. Keep making the point that there is no need for restaurants to dumb down their food. First because a majority of the customers appear to be Asian and second you can design a menu that has a balance of spicy/hot versus mild and staff can direct accordingly. The object lesson here is Bangkok's Nahm and Peter Thompson whose uncompromising , intrinsically much hotter and spicier Thai food was such a success. Chef Thompson apparently had a part in the recent menu revamp at Kebaya but unfortunately it doesn't show.Stick to doing the local cuisines brilliantly and with maximum integrity and this could be a world class, destination venue.Wine list is small and, as is usual in Asia, expensive. Limited and boring selection of beers. Nahm used to have the same issue until enough customers complained and they fixed it.Gorgeous room, excellent service in a great hotel.Show less

Author: PeterD8Newcastle, Australia
Title: Great Food, Great Location
Review: We have eaten here previously a few years back and found it good without being outstanding. We decided to try again and this time the experience was outstanding.The setting is very attractive with enough of a nod to the past to be nostalgic.Service is attentive without being pushy. The timing of the food delivery was just right.Not sure if it was what we ordered this time, but all of the dishes were superb. The standout was the slow cooked Tamarind Beef which is simply one of the best things I've eaten. It is however not a restaurant suited to young children. All in all an outstanding ding experience.Show less

Author: ko883Penang Island, Malaysia
Title: One of the best Nyonya Restaurants
Review: Housed in nicely renovated pre-war heritage terrace houses, the ambience of the place was unbelievably Nyonya style.The food were presented beautifully with some fusion style and tasted deliciously, especially the Hong Bak Braised Lamb. The lamb was braised for 48 hours with local ingredients and went down excellently with the fragrance rice. The curry prawns were fresh and nicely cooked in the curry which is tasted more like Thai green curry though. The Tang Yuan desert and gula Melaka creme brûlée were good and unique.Service was attentively excellent, one of us brought a small pint of single malt whisky to enhance tasting experience and the corkage charge was kindly waived by restaurant. Very satisfying meal and good for many returns.Show less

Author: Joslynlin84
Title: Great Place & Good Ambience.
Review: Wonderful historical restaurant, This place has ambience and decoration.It is fusion nyonya and local food. We were encouraged to each choose dishes and share so that we could experience more flavors.The restaurant is beautiful, part of a really interesting and beautiful hotel.

Author: philin134
Title: Restaurant in a colloquil building
Review: The Baba Nyonya food was superb, which is my favorite. I love the wide selections there. The ambiance was cozy with lots of space and furnished with curtains from ceiling to floor.

Author: DanielGarciaFraile
Title: No kids friendly
Review: They explained that the fixed menu is not suitable for children and they don’t do ‘a la carte’ so we were invited to change the restaurant! I never saw this in my extended experience in Asia. Very annoying and lack of respect.Show less

Author: dalaw1
Title: Peranakan food in traditional setting
Review: The restaurant serves IndoChinese and Peranakan food in a local traditional setting. The food quality was amazing. If one wishes to try the local cuisine, there is the place to go.

Author: Tina CMelbourne, Australia
Title: Fine Dining in Peranakan Elegance
Review: A superb experience indeed dining at Kebaya restaurant, with delicious perennial Peranakan favourites served up with a modern twist! All plated on Peranakan style crockery that adds to the authenticity of the experience. Hats off to the chef!Arrive earlier to partake in pre dinner drinks at the bar while you absorb the ambience of yesteryear Straits Malaya.The long dining room is beautifully decorated with exquisite original Peranakan pieces, which superbly enhance the dining experience.Well worth a visit to complete your visit to Penang with a special insight into Peranakan lifestyle and food!Show less

Author: TJooSingapore, Singapore
Title: For tourist, this is good. For local, stay away.
Review: If you are travelling, this is a good start to explore nyonya cuisine (kinda expensive though). Its nyonya and western cuisine fusion exposes peranakan culture to the world with its rich spices and traditional sauces, but not too spicy and the seasoning is quite moderate.But if you are a local, dont bother to go there!! Your mum probably cooks it better.If you are local, don't bother to order the pandan brule. It tastes exactly like 'kaya', the expensive and classy version. But if you are a traveller, still can give it a try. Owh ya. The ambience is perfect. I like its garden. Show less

Author: oge2328
Title: Very good Nyonya food in an authentic Baba and Nyonya setting!
Review: If you haven't tried authentic Nyonya food, you can get very good nyonya cuisine in a rich Nyonya ambience.  Can be a bit pricey though.

Author: whoisthisSan Francisco, California
Title: Delicious food, wonderful experience
Review: We were fortunate to secure a same day reservation. Upon arrival, we were greeted warmly and our waiter took the time to explain menu and patiently answered our questions on some of the menu items. Our food arrived promptly and the pacing was just right (we ate on the early side around 6:30pm and the restaurant was about half full at the time). The staff was like ninjas, appearing suddenly to clear empty plates and glasses. The food was amazing. It’s such a unique fusion of several Asian cultures. We were able to discern Chinese, Thai, Vietnamese, and Malay influences. We also like the menu setup, with the fixed price, ability to choose from each category, and family style servings. Overall it’s a delicious and unique meal in a wonderful old world setting. We would definitely come back. Show less

Author: barbarajilloCheltenham, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent food , great atmosphere
Review: This restaurant simplifies matters by dividing the menu into sections from which you chose one dish and if you want extra there is an additional charge , rice accompanies the main course. I ate here twice because I liked it so much the first time . The decor is elegant the servers bring an element of theatre to their presentation and on both occasions a thoroughly good time ensued . It tends to be fairly busy so a make a reservation to avoid disappointment.Show less

Author: thuyvi85Dingolfing, Germany
Title: Overrated
Review: Food: Average. Definitely not fine dining. Rice was too dry. I would not call this a 4 course meal either because you can’t class a side dish as a separate course. Service: we waited an hour for our main course when the seating session was only two hours long! One woman who looked like she was the owner or manager of the place ignored us the whole time although she seemed to be uber friendly to everyone else. Even when we greeted her she just ignored us. Ambience: very nice Cost: too expensive for what you got considering how cheap Penang is Overall quite disappointing. I give it a 2.5/5Show less

Author: BigTone72Melbourne, Australia
Title: Beautiful & tasty meal, excellent service
Review: 4 of us thought we should try Kabaya for dinner. Whilst pricey for Penang it was well worth it. We did the RM128 4 course dinner. Excellent starters for all to try & share. Duck, beef, prawn & lamb for mains which were succulent & tasty. Various Asian infused veges and beautiful range of dessert. The chocolate fondue was to die for. Excellent service in an old grand dinning room. Very classy and well worth it. Highly recommended.Show less

Author: canadian_visit0rVancouver, Canada
Title: Expensive for a set meal
Review: The atmosphere and feel of the restaurant feels as if you are walking into history. There is a live performance and the staff are attentive. It is expensive for a set course and not all the dishes were to my liking. Having grown up with Nyonya food, the fusion of old and new is not always a hit. Unsure about the salad combination but love the prawn curry (4 pieces!) and grilled fish. My lime drink was so tart I could not finish it. I would say try it once if you have not experienced Nyonya food. There are other places that can offer so much better and at a fraction of the price.Show less

Author: Chancarrie
Title: Lovely experience
Review: This is restaurant is good located. In the Seven Terraces Hotel,Style decor and service with a lovely ambience. Our meal was delicious. The friend staff shared with us the history of Kebaya .The four course set price dinner was very good .

Author: EDNG333Western Australia, Australia
Title: good deco good food good service
Review: total 4 of us ( 2 couples ) both ladies are birthday celebrations dinner, when we walk in the restaurant, the building, setting made us feel walk into a grand residence of Malaysian. the host was so nice to show our table.We pick up the four courses meals.we have a wonderful night with the lovely food.i will go back to the restaurant again.Show less

Author: Wang ITrento, Italy
Title: If you want to try the real Nyonya food, this is the place
Review: This is really a cute place, but with great attention of details for the Nyonya traditions.The food is just beyond description, with such a correct price for all set dinner, we tried from the appetizer till the dessert, just one word only "extraordinary!" the place is really nice, with nice piano bar after the 8pm, and every table has its distance and you can just enjoy your meal without any disturbs. the service was great and fast, the food is just so delicious and you can finish all the dishes without problem. The nyonya cuisine is so delicate, and we really fall in love after this dinner.all the staffs are so nice, and also we made a simply tour inside the seven terraces boutique hotel, such a nice boutique hotel, so many arts and nice corners to feel inside the peranankan traditions.the curry prawn, and the pork are really delicious!! also for our girl, she had a simple dish for kids. and she was so happy, and enjoyed her meal also.nice experiences, and we will come back when we back to Penang again. :)Show less

Author: GaryF600Welwyn Garden City, United Kingdom
Title: Last night in Georgetown
Review: Fantastic food and decor. We had a problem with our reservation, but Shirley sorted it out quickly and found us a table. It was a perfect meal with wonderful flavours for a special occasion. All of the waiting staff were very efficient and friendly. I highly recommend Kebaya for the ambiance and delicious food. Michelin quality in my opinion.Show less

Author: Fudgecat0250
Title: Excellent restaurant
Review: Delicious food and amazing staff, preceded by superb cocktails in a beautiful restaurant and colonial-style bar.

Author: Drivers22Poole, United Kingdom
Title: Wonderful food in a spectacular environment
Review: Third time I have eaten at this restaurant. The food is consistently good but the thing that makes this place special is the space that has been created by converting old derelict shop houses in to a comfortable restaurant that reflects the Penang of the1950's.The cost is expensive by Penang standards but it is worth every ringgit!Show less

Author: Grace S
Title: After work trip
Review: I am a big fan of nonya food, but was rather disappointed with the food. Firstly, the lady who served me is just too raw & seems to be so in her own world.. secondly as compared to candlenuts in sg and other peranakan dishes, it was just okay. I must admit that the ambience is good. For example, the crab salad have used over ripped papaya,the chicken is okay but the spices overwhelmes.Is not that the food is bad but is just simply overatedShow less

Author: DanoutjeSingapore, Singapore
Title: Perfection
Review: It starts with a wonderful lady welcoming you in a beautiful kebaya. Come a little early to enjoy a drink at the bar and enjoy the beautiful lobby and its furniture. I chose the vegetarian menu. It comes in a stunning laquer box with a choice of 6 dishes + rice. Absolutely delicious with a special mention to a vegetable curry that was the best ever. Could have just drank that sauce. The service was absolutely impeccable, attentive and caring. As I said, perfection.Show less

Author: TrustTheGreek
Title: Great place to dine in :)
Review: Wonderful historical restaurant serving very tasty food.i liked also the manhattan cocktail prior being seated. Definitely worth a visit if you are in Penang

Author: The_TravellerSg
Title: Quality food at good prices
Review:
Comes as a set menu where you choose from one starters, one main, one green and one dessert.

Good quality peranakan fusion food with a twist and definitely worth the price you paid for

Author: Benoit MParis, France
Title: Very nice Chinese restaurant
Review: In a "vintage" mansion , Kebaya offers a beautiful experience of Chinese specialities. To be noted that there is no menu , only a fixed one . However well arranged and abundant.Choice of wine though restricted is enough to enjoy !Show less

Author: skdcitravellerLondon, United Kingdom
Title: A wow fusion dining experience!
Review: We went on a recommendation and it certainly lived up to expectations!We chose the four course set menu and could have gone for any of the options at each course; starter, main, vegetable and dessert. We will let you choose your options from the menu which is available on line.All we can say is that the tastes, textures, presentation & service is wonderful. All too often you have tasted the same herbs, spices or flavourings but not here I can honestly say that not only had I not heard of many of the ingredients but not tasted the complimentary additions.Overall a great and I don’t use that word often in reviews, dining experience. The decor and ambience was wonderful as was the service. We love the story of the restoration of the seven terraces which all adds to the overall sensation of dining at Kebaya.If you are staying at the Eastern & Oriental as we were it is a gentle 10 minute stroll.Very highly recommended and at very reasonable prices.Show less

Author: TimCMossFlamstead, United Kingdom
Title: Outstanding snapper
Review: We enjoyed crisp and fresh starters which arrived promptly and had a nice combination of vegetables and protein. The standout was the main course grilled snapper fillet with a very tasty spicy sauce. The fillet was cut across a large fish and was perfectly cooked and not dominated by the sauce. The Prawn Gueng main with coconut milk and lemon grass was a generous bowl of large prawns in a delicate spicy sauce - really good. The “greens” course come with the mains and we’re different fresh and very tasty. Dessert was also very acceptable. The drinks are on the expensive side for Penang, but the food is good value for the quality of ingredients and cooking as well as the spectacular setting. Overall a great experience with friendly and professional service.Show less

Author: Aporo
Title: Recommended
Review: Worth going for the décor alone. Food is really good and very well presented.  Staff great.  More expensive than local eateries but still excellent value for money.  Try one of Podi's cocktails in the bar beforehand.

Author: Victoria P
Title: Good food in a nice setting
Review: Ate here with my partner during our trip to Penang. The restaurant itself is lovely and the staff were attentive and friendly. The food was very nice and priced reasonably. I would happily recommend this restaurant.

Author: Jemma MPerth, Australia
Title: Mothers birthday
Review: Wonderful, warm greeting both for pre drinks un bar area and restaurant. Beautifully chilled champagne to perfection and food simply delicious. Lovely waiters and pianist played happy birthday for my mum and lovely little surprise cake. Will definitely be back. Lovely special occasion you made it so special thank youShow less

Author: JoJoManly
Title: Fantastic food, welcoming to children
Review: The food was amazing and the children were made to feel very welcome. The restaurant is beautiful, part of a really interesting and beautiful hotel.

Author: emilioeats
Title: Great food & ambience, despite unhelpful and disingenuous server.
Review: We arrived promptly for our 8pm dinner reservation at Kebaya Dining Room, located within Seven Terraces Hotel--the courtyard of this hotel (adjacent to the dining room) occupies the terraces of seven colonial-style shophouses. Upon entering, we noticed the heritage-forward interior and ambience, which we thoroughly enjoyed throughout our whole evening there. Whilst searching around for the maître d', another party of guests entered and also waited to be seated. A middle-aged lady with short hair finally appeared to greet the guests that came after us and we notified her that we also had a reservation for the 8pm seating. Her attitude towards our letting her know we were also ready to be seated was cold and dismissive. She eventually ushered our party and the next to our respective tables and handed us the menus. When we asked her on the menu items and prix fixe structure, she was ill-tempered when we asked for further clarification and recommendations on how the 6 of us could best order the dishes for each course. Due to her obvious irritated state, we asked her to help us choose our courses so that we could try the greatest variety in each category, noting that we were interested in the pork dishes.To our surprise, when the dishes came, no pork dishes appeared, and for the 6 main courses (for each person) we were obliged to order (out of 5 main courses available), she omitted the pork dish, and without consulting us beforehand, doubled the portions for the vegetable tempura and prawn curry (that was combined into one small pot with just an additional helping of prawns). The other four dishes (which she could just as much have doubled) seemed more worth our while and preferable as the options included a leg of lamb, beef steak, chicken curry and (the missing) pork. As the menu is prix fixe for each diner, we didn't feel like having two portions of vegetable tempura gave us our money's worth.The Nyonya cuisine we experienced at Kebaya tasted good, but was overshadowed by the waitress's poor service and misleading suggestions. We felt that she could have been more hospitable and less sly in helping us order our meal.Show less

Author: Penangellen55George Town, Malaysia
Title: A perfect evening
Review: Everything I have read about this restaurant says it is excellent, and it was all true. The restaurant is beautiful, the service is excellent, and the food is innovative, delicious, and perfectly prepared and presented. As an added bonus, the prices were quite reasonable for such a lovely experience. This will now be our number one special occasion destination. Show less

Author: Nicholas GKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: You Ain't Been to Penang if You Have Not Dined Here
Review: Strong opinion? Well, the place is beautiful and food is absolute yum. It is Nyonya food. Service on par with the food quality. If you got the money stay there too (7Terrace). Nyonya food it is but not your average nyonya food. Strongly suggested you RSVP if you do not wish to be disappointed.BTW this place is fine dining without the high price. Truly deserving of Tripadvisor award.Show less

Author: SteveArundelWorthing, United Kingdom
Title: Wow what a gem
Review: Booked this restaurant based on other peoples reviews on here. Certainly not dissapointed. Has it down as being expensive but 4 course meal for £25 per head is great value considering what you get. Best of East meets West with sous vide cooking and great mixtures of the old and the new. We had 72 hour cooked beef and 48 hour cooked pork. Lovely flavours. Also dont miss the courtyard behind like something from an old movie. Show less

Author: Peter SPerth, Australia
Title: Return visit
Review: First visited this place in December 2011 and went back again for my birthday in mid January 2019.Another place in Penang that dose not disappoint - we had the 4 course set menu and struggled to get through the very tasty dishes. Nice little birthday touch also from the staff.Show less

Author: GordonHartPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Terrific Food Experience
Review: We had friends staying with us from the UK for 3 weeks, and they took us to Kebaya for dinner as a thank you. We have lived in Penang for over 3 years and tried many restaurants, but can't believe how we have missed coming here. It is tucked away in Seven Terraces in Georgetown and we have never noticed it before. As an eating experience it is unique in Penang. It is a full 5-Star dining experience and we will definitely be going again. It is the kind of place you don't go to every week, it is one that should be kept for that Special Occasion.It is a semi-fixed menu. You get to choose from a few dishes for each of the 4 courses.It is hard to choose as they all sound and look terrific. It definitely did not disappoint. Full of flavour and generous in size. Only issue we had, which wasn't really an issue, is that the starters come in threes, which is a bit awkward for a party of four. But we managed as we are good friends.Can't comment on cost as we were being treated and were not shown the bill. But I would imagine it is not cheap as it is excellent quality. Overall a great experience in a beautiful setting with very professional staff.Highly recommendedShow less

Author: pakabayAdelaide, Australia
Title: Can;\'t wait to return
Review: We spent 4 nights at the Seven Terraces Hotel and had dinner at Kebaya on our last night.There are two sittings and a semi-set menu, but don't worry, the choices are amazing and I'm sure everyone would be happy with it.This was the last night of a much bigger 5 week holiday, so it was a memorable evening in more ways than one.We started with drinks in the bar, we had discovered earlier in our stay that they make some pretty impressive cocktails, so that got us off to a great start.The service in the bar and restaurant, like everywhere in the hotel, was excellent. Friendly, thoughtful and professional.Our meals were simply wonderful. George Town is blessed with excellent food, from jetty-side hawker stalls to the Kebaya dining room.The room itself is like the rest of the Seven Terraces hotel, done to perfection. Modern facilities blended into traditional furniture, fittings lights and more. It is truly elegant.It's not a surprise that Kebaya just made it into the Trip Advisor list of the top 20 restaurant in Asia.We will be lucky enough to visit Penang again, off a cruise ship early next month, and we have already booked a table for dinner at Kebaya!Show less

Author: VegasToEssexEssex, United Kingdom
Title: Gorgeous Dining Room, Nice Meal Overall
Review: My husband and I stayed at the Seven Terraces so we decided to stay at the hotel and eat at Kebaya one evening. The restaurant is absolutely stunning from head to toe. There are two seatings at the restaurant. For some reason, our meal felt a little rushed and mechanical - like there was more focus on serving the set meal then creating a special dining experience. The staff were friendly but somewhat slow in serving drinks and water for the table.The set menu was reasonably priced. Standout dishes were the pork and the tempura vegetables. The beef was just ok. I’m glad we tried it, but I’m not sure I’d go back if we ever visited George Town again.Show less

Author: putu_piringSingapore, Singapore
Title: Evening to remember
Review: Our party of 7 booked the 6pm seating dinner at Kebaya. Coming before dark allowed us to see the metal sculpture in the courtyard and view it from both sides. If you go, do this and be surprised by perspective.In sum:1. Good meal with two outstanding dishes - soft-shelled crab and the panna cota dessert;2. Pleasant surroundings; and3. Excellent service from Chin Yao who was enthusiastic, knowledgeable about the food offered and made good recommendations.It was a memorable evening.Show less

Author: claudesuppiah
Title: A lot of hype
Review: A restaurant that was extremely busy, the setting and the decor were extremely good.The food however was really mediocre.... You can can get 10 times the flavour eating at any other other restaurant.Show less

Author: ScottM130Sydney, Australia
Title: First class
Review: Had the set menu (4 dishes) which was magnificent. We stuck to the Malaysian dishes and I suspect this is the best Malaysian restaurant on the island. Added bonus was the live music from a guzeng player and an excellent selection of wine and great atmosphere.Show less

Author: jamesflorraine
Title: 5 times now
Review:
We have now visited Kebaya 5 times, it is still amazing, great service great staff, and superb food.
The ambiance is great the decor is good, just a stunning place with sensational food.

Author: limjunhao
Title: Service was good!
Review: I had the dinner course with my partner and it was one of the best! The good was great, atmosphere was amazing and the staffs service were at it’s best. Not forgotting the manager, Mr. Syahrul who took a lot of effort arranging things for me through emails. Will definitely visit back!Show less

Author: chirojonesBath, United Kingdom
Title: Lovely eatery in the centre of old Georgetown
Review: The Kabaya is situated in a truly beautiful restored old colonial style building right in the centre of Georgetown: easily the best restaurant with the Indigo @the Blue Mansion in Georgetown. The staff were faultless, they just made you feel at home and so helpful. The food was delicious with a Malaysian slant, and very reasonably priced. The drinks were also cheap in Malaysian terms. Yes, this place is an absolute must for top quality food at a very sensible price.Show less

Author: Purbasari SDepok, Indonesia
Title: Splendid dinner to end our vacation in Penang
Review: We are family of 4 enjoyed dinner in Kebaya restaurant very much. Communication by email was fast repond and clear. Food was excellent. Waiter has good knowledge on wine pairing. Ambience is magnificent. We enjoyed the 4 courses dinner although a bit too much but they let us pack it up for to go. Overall impressive restaurant and food and service.Show less

Author: travellingurolfellowMelbourne, Australia
Title: Beautiful space and food
Review: Celebrated New Year Eve 2018 here with a large group of family.We were able to book online one month in advance and placing a deposit.The dining room is as the photos suggest, tastefully furnished with tiles, teal and curtains. The adjoining courtyard of the hotel is a beautiful clean space that children can burn off some energy in.The plates are beautiful antique Chinese porcelain.There are vegetarian options across the whole menu. Children were able to have chicken breast schnitzel and fries.The food is a fusion of western and Indo-Chinese cooking. Most of the meats are slow cooked and fall off the bone. The dishes are shared and the price per person expensive for Malaysia but for similar food in Melbourne, very reasonable.Show less

Author: Rachel Y
Title: Beautiful setting, good service, delicious food
Review: I'm Peranakan - you'll be hard pressed to find any Peranakan who finds food cooked by anyone other than their mother/grandmother "good enough". Well, I won't say this was better than my mother's food. But it comes pretty damn close. Food was delicious - all except the vegetable tempura which was nothing special. Probably a good dish to order if you have kids though. Everything else was great. Meat dishes were all good quality and tender. Would recommend.Show less

Author: SW612
Title: Delicious food in a beautiful setting
Review: Great atmosphere and delicious food served in a beautifully restored building. The restaurant was busy and the staff were very efficient and everything tasted amazing and was presented beautifully. Definitely worth a visit.

Author: BuddingSommelier61George Town, Malaysia
Title: Superb meal!
Review: Wow this is a seriously good restaurant! From the minute you walk in the service is top notch very professional. The concept of the sharing -one cost menu makes ordering easy and fair. All dishes were excellent the Soft Shell Crab salad was one of the best. Drinks were reasonably priced.Show less

Author: Flyn1170Singapore
Title: Best Peranakans Restaurant
Review: This has probably to be the best Peranakan restaurant in both Penang and Melaka. It not only has such delicious dishes, it is also refined. The service was excellent as was the dishes. It was a set meal in which one could select the starter, protein, vegetables and dessert. Everything is good on the menu!!Show less

Author: Nellly
Title: Delicious food in traditional building
Review: Delicious and beautifully serviced food in a traditional building. Very beautiful decoration. Relaxed atmosphere.

Author: JingpeiSingapore, Singapore
Title: Hidden Gem
Review: recommended by a friend, we made a booking to come try the place at dinner. the food are local fare but with a pleasant surprise. tasty food, retro colonial style settings in a shophouse courtyard, this definitely enhances the dining experience. the waitress are attentive and one don't have to wait long to get any of their attention. food are set menu affair, just have to pick and choose from each category, to be honest, every dish tastes good. one is really spoilt for choice, will definitely be back again when in Penang.Show less

Author: XT94Glasgow, United Kingdom
Title: Do not miss out on this gem!
Review: As a group of five it is often hard to please everyone but Kebaya had no problem in impressing us all. From the warm welcome, to the beautiful decor we knew it would be a lovely evening. The staff are friendly and happy to offer advice on the dishes. The range of food is perfect and the taste is to die for! The idea of sharing food we love and all the dishes were delicious. There are really no negatives to this place and would return 100%! Worth every penny.Show less

Author: summerainbowinter
Title: Worth every penny!
Review: Love this place! Authentic Nyonya food! Great ambience. Great food. Great dessert. Service staff very friendly. Worth the value. Must try in Penang!

Author: Mark DPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Top Rated, the food says it all!!
Review: This "heritage restaurant, in an "upscale" Heritage themed hotel is a sheer delight!! It is a top rated restaurant in Penang [where the competition is very active], and has attracted TripAdvisor's "Traveller's Choice" designation. The Peranakan [the name of early, historical Penang residents] based menu has been honed by professionals as well as "knowledgeable foodies"! The ambience of this wonderful restaurant reflects the UNESCO designated Heritage Area-- of which it is a part. The dishes are mostly "grouped"-- as part of a multi course meal [as one finds in great restaurants in "Foodie Havens" in France]. The attention to detail [as is also evident in the Hotel] is also reflected in the "helpful professionalism" of the staff. An eventful gastronomic evening will definitely reside on one's memory as well as one's taste buds!!I hope that this Review has been helpful!Show less

Author: 830albansPrinces Risborough, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent meal in a wonderful setting
Review: We had the set menu - starters, protein, greens and dessert. Really tasty and unusual dishes. 4 of us each ordered different dishes and shared which meant we got to try most of the options. A beautiful room and very good service. Highly recommended, though note that while the meal is not that expensive, wine doesn't come cheap at £35 per bottle for the cheapest. Despite that well worth it - make sure you book n advance as it is very popular.Show less

Author: 779justineg
Title: Winderful
Review: Last minute reservation and not disappointed. Wonderful 4 course meal. Amazing service and staff and gorgeous interior. And so well priced. All in all and great evening in Georgetown. Will definitely be back!!

Author: JudithTan
Title: Any Bibik worth her salt would love to eat here
Review: Great ambiance and the food, though presented in a modern way, is still as sedap!! You should try and book a room with the Seven Terraces to stay and experience the Nyonya hospitality as well.

Author: KimberJet
Title: Nostalgic Dinning Experience
Review: Food was awesome. Ambience was nostalgic. Service was superb. Basically they serve peranakan food with a twist, in a splendid way! Good for couples, or unique family gathering. Interior and decor of the restaurant is also amazing... filled with years of collectible items.

Author: Kate TGreater Hobart, Australia
Title: Fine dining in Penang
Review: Were recommended we try to have a meal here and I’m so pleased we were able to get a booking.Staff were lovely and helpful and the food was to die for. The soft shell crab salad, the duck and the chocolate desert were a highlight.Would thoroughly recommend you give this place a try But make sure you book.Show less

Author: DHGreen
Title: Very nice setting
Review:
Fixed course meal with 3 appetizers and 10 mains.  2 desserts.  

Very nice meal.  This type of cuisine is an amazing fusion of Indian, Thai and Chinese.

This is a very nice place to eat.

Author: Worldwide12345
Title: Wonderful birthday celebration
Review: A lovely devoted building, service was friendly and attentive. There good variety choice of spread to choose from, the crackling pork was wonderful. What made it even more special was the birthday sing song entelled for me, which I didn’t expect and a free desert.Thank you will be back in future when in around penangShow less

Author: JennusyQuezon City, Philippines
Title: A Must When in Penang
Review: Excellent modern Nonya Cuisine served in an elegantly designed dining room of the Seven Terraces Hotel along Stewart Lane. Not to be missed when in Penang. A four-course meal comes with generous portions of an appetizer, vegetables, main and dessert. Each dish is enough to serve 2-3 people (in my opinion). I suggest to order different dishes and share, so you get to sample more dishes.Show less

Author: Sushi118Melbourne, Australia
Title: Not recommended.
Review: Me and my wife had the course dinner a Kebaya restaurant. We were looking forward to the experience because of high reviews. The restaurant and hotel were indeed beautiful to look at. However when the appetizers arrived all illusions were shuttered. The presentation was poor, taste blunt and boring. This continued for rest of the dinner. However the worst part is proteins and greens came cold. They couldn’t even get the basics right. I don’t know what kind of deprived people could recommend this poorly managed food joint. Show less

Author: bhatku101Singapore, Singapore
Title: Excellent vegetarian food!
Review: We were booked for dinner at the Kebaya. I was wondering if they would have any suitable vegetarian options. However, it turned out to be one of the best meals I have ever had. Our server, very helpfully got me a different menu and I had a set of starters (ask for ketchup and chilli sauce) and a beautiful box with a lovely variety of tasty vegetarian food. The veg. curry reminded me of Nahm, Bangkok. The chocolate dessert was ok and the coconut pannacota was a bit firm but tasty. The accompanying passion fruit sauce made it delicious!Show less

Author: Lisa CKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Beautiful experience
Review: 4 of us dressed in Kebaya for dinner and wearing kebaya in a peranakan restaurant really brings out the ambience. Their courtyard has beautiful setting for photography. We ordered wine to go with the set dinner. I would recommend the mains such as duck confit, prawns and chicken kapitan. For appertizer, I would recommend pai tee and dessert, tang yuan. The servers were attentive. Having read the previous comments about Shirley, we were disappointed that she never once approached our table. Nonetheless we had a great experience. Btw, if you are dressed in kebaya, you’ll get 20% discount.There’s parking in front of the restaurant.Restaurant is not suitable for childrenShow less

Author: WNFdiary
Title: Peranakan cuisine on high end dining level!
Review: This lovely restaurant is a true eye candy. No matter where we looked it was always a sight worth observing. Inside or outside the restaurant, and on a plate. The dishes were even better to taste, as the high ingredients used in the dish leave the signature. We loved each dish and the culinary dinner ended with superb dessert. The detailed review of each dish is available on my blog WNFdiary, where you can found more about Peranakan origins and heritage.Show less

Author: 384kittycHong Kong, China
Title: An enjoyable dinning experience!
Review: We have just 3 days in Penang for a short weekend and there are quite a few fine dinning places we want to try. We chose this one in George Town caused it’s in a heritage building and the high ranking as well as the ambience here... It is absolutely the right choice from the selection of the dishes on the tasting menu, the wine, decoration, the music and the service all made it an super enjoyable dinning experience! And the bill is absolutely reasonable...high PE value! MUST TRY in Penang!Show less

Author: Trip821159
Title: good experience
