Review: I had a good experience here. The beautiful interior, great service, good food and friendly staff. Love here ~~~

Author: GSPhPerth and Kinross, United Kingdom
Title: Best meal I have had in years!
Review: We were staying at the Seven Terraces and usually dislike easting in Hotel Restaurants rather than sooting out to see what a city has to offer... however, we were strongly urged by lots of friends to eat here one night during our stay. Thankfully, we did! Just delicious. Wonderful range of dishes, cooked to perfection, perfect portion sizes and fantastic staff. The Barman was a proper old-school trained one and the choice of cocktails were just right and perfectly mixed. There was a pianist on that night, which normally I really dislike - but he was brilliant! He was extremely talented and played a good range of classical, gentle pieces with a wonderfully light touch.I had prawn quenelles to start, Kapitan Chicken with a side of Vegetable Tempura and finally a blissful melting chocolate pudding with passionfruit coulis. all for 128RM (not cheap by Penang's standards BUT an absolute bargain for food this good!) The restaurant itself is tastefully and authentically decorated, with lovely Chinese panelling throughout and gorgeous blue and white furnishings that echo the ceramics on display. So very good, we went back the next evening to try 4 different dishes and they were just as wonderful, so this restaurant is now firmly one of my favourites!Show less

Author: Christopher Joh... H
Title: A food highlight in a city full of them!
Review: Perfect service, delicious fusion food, intriguing ambience- a must visit in Penang. The prawn curry in particular is something I'll remember forever, and the cocktails are fresh and imaginative.

Author: Onnanohito184Hong Kong, China
Title: Delicious food
Review: We stayed at the hotel and had dinner in Kebaya twice. They have a fixed menu that doesn’t seem to change so you will try almost everything over two dinners for two people.The starters are outstanding, any one of them. For mains, beef and snapper are the most delicious of all. The beef is melting in your mouth, and the fish is fresh and full of flavour, the sauce - wonderful.For desserts- although I am not a fan personally of any sweets, I did try the pandan creme brûlée. Amazing!So as far as food quality is concerned - definitely recommend this restaurant.The service was not consistent though. The first evening everything was perfect. The second time the waitress seemed to be nervous and in a rush: served me a spoon of rice and ran away, while I did not have any food to go with the rice. Then we waited for a long time for the desserts to arrive.Show less

Author: 77helenng
Title: Good food
Review: Service and ambience was good. As well as the dishes. Especially the Tamarind beef. Very tender and flavorful. Not over priced either.

Author: Mister7StarMelbourne, Australia
Title: Didn't live up to the hype
Review: When you hear that a restaurant is the best in Penang for fine dining, upscale Nonya Cuisine, your expectations are raised somewhat. And I think you almost always get disappointed. And unfortunately, this was the case. Firstly, I didn't appreciate the surly welcome from Shirley (the hostess) who wanted to make sure that I knew the price and format of the set menu before I sat down. (Don't know if it was because I was dining alone that this warranted special attention).The dining room is quite tastefully decorated with lovely ceramics, Chinese furniture, colonial inspired textiles in a traditional Georgetown house. The staff apart from the hostess were all warm and friendly. And the menu had a good selection of dishes though I don't why there were Thai dishes on the menu but anyway...The food was good but it wasn't great. The stand out dish for me was the Otak Otak which was delicious. I had never eaten this dish before and it was wonderful. The flaky pastry, beautifully cooked fish, coconut spiced curry - the perfect Malaysian fish pie. Normally, it's made with banana leaf so I thought it was clever spin.If you aren't familiar with Nonya Cuisine and appreciate fine dining then I think that Kebaya is a good introduction. My bill for set menu (4 courses), glass of wine and mineral water was about 200MYR I think.Show less

Author: gauravsethi78Dubai, United Arab Emirates
Title: The best We have had
Review: The hostess, waiters, staff and service are so good that yo should go back just for that. The ambience, decor and furnishings are authentic and awesome, they are a draw by themselves. Finally if you want good food and drink at good prices, this is the place. Everything to like.Show less

Author: Sidbal03Munich, Germany
Title: Great Eveneing
Review: We had a really great Food celabration in that reataurant. Of course you have to spend more money for your dinner compared to other resataurants, but it is worth to spend it. The Food is excellent and you must try one of the Cocktails. If you are interested in high Quality Food in a magnificant ambiance you have to go there. Show less

Author: CanucktravelinlatinWhistler, Canada
Title: A treat!
Review: After beating through the rugged paths of Borneo and living mainly on street food, I decided to treat myself to a little luxury. The gentlemen at Kebaya graciously accepted me last minute without a reservation. It was a high end meal, great wine and good value. Sure, more expensive than your average meal in Malaysia, but this restaurant is lovely and the food is outstanding. Wonderful attention to detail even with the charming plates and silver spoons, what a nice experience! The waiter remembered I mentioned liking spicy, and kindly brought me extras of the beautiful chilli condiments. Enjoyed the salmon roe starter, prawn curry, tempura veggies and the Bright Green Pandan Creme Brulee was amazing! Very good service, lovely restaurant!Show less

Author: S3686GBandytSingapore, Singapore
Title: Price is ok food more like peranakan fussion
Review: Price is reasonable for the place maybe because it is penang. Not much upscale place like them but overal experience is nice waiter and waitress need to be polish more interm of their services as they seem not to excite it about their menu. But cleanliness and ambience is good so . I will come back again for sure.Show less

Author: kylez_182Bentleigh, Australia
Title: The best food in malaysia!
Review: This was by far the best meal i had during my Malaysia trip. Yes it's on the expensive side for Malaysia but well worth it and i wouldn't get half as much tasty food and drinks for the same price in Melbourne. It's a standard 4 course meal for about RM130pp and there is a good range of dishes to choose from. The pork buns were to die for. Drinks are extra but reasonably priced for fine dining. You won't regret spending a bit extra for this meal. Show less

Author: Thai E
Title: Interesting Dining Experience
Review: Nice ambience if one is in to Nyonya/Peranakan culture. The restaurant is part of a lodging. in Stewart Lane Penang.. It is non-halal, so not a place to take your Muslim friends to.  Opens daily from 600 to 1000pm.

Author: 671aniruddhag
Title: Fantastic fine dining experience!
Review: Lots and lots of fantastic food! The portions are huge - be warned! - the staff is very friendly, helpful and the food is fantastic. Great ambience too, and also of the attached hotel at the back...

Author: carolynp225London, United Kingdom
Title: Beautiful setting, great food and great value
Review: This restaurant does not fail to please. The Peranakan dining room is prettiness personified, the service is attentive and the food sensational. My only complaint would be please don’t give us so much - the four course menu for one is enough for 4 people and it really doesn’t need to be, it is just a little off-putting as a result. Good things come in smaller packages. Show less

Author: Suddenly_Supine
Title: Just Ok
Review: Nice setting in a convenient conservation shophouse as part of a boutique hotel. The restaurant is popular and crowded, we arrived early for a drink at the bar before dinner but there was no place to sit and the whole service felt a bit rushed. If you’ve never had Peranakan cuisine before it’s an OK choice because of the setting but just based on food, there are better Peranakan restaurants around. we found the food too strong in flavours I.e each dish was either overly sweet, overly salty etc and lacked balance of flavours. Overall not bad but I the place feels more about the setting than the food. Show less

Author: vickyinmalawiPerth, Australia
Title: Beautiful food in beautiful setting
Review: If you go to George Town you must eat in Kebaya. Yes, it is expensive by Malaysian standards, but not for Western tourists.The dining room is tuning, the food is exceptional and the service outstanding.We have been to George Town twice with different sets of visitors and both times everyone has been very impressed with the whole experience.Be sure to book ahead as the restaurant is full most nights.Show less

Author: Alessandro MLugano, Switzerland
Title: Simply amazing
Review: Everything was great, starting from the welcoming all the way to the dessert.The food was delicious and the menu is various enough to cover every taste from starters to desserts. Service was very professional but friendly and warm at the same time.The price is high compare to the average of the Island (country?) but quite cheap from a European point of view, especially considering the overall experience. For two people we had 2 complete menus, 2 glass of wine, 1 bottle of water for a total of 90$ ish.We had a great time and we're looking forward to visit the restaurant again.Show less

Author: whitneycnyHong Kong
Title: Good fusion food!
Review: The food is delicious. You can feel the sincerity of making good. From the starter to dessert, all the courses are unique. You will definitely love to try out all of them. Make sure to book before you go, contact them ASAP. They full of people all the time.Show less

Author: VirginiaBrighton
Title: Very tasty, great surrounds
Review: Great food, pleasant service, prices were reasonable all things considered.  3-course menu was a good format, wine reasonable also.

Author: LucianoPerth
Title: Wonderful service. Great food!
Review: My wife and I enjoyed a superb dinner at Kebaya. The 4 course set menu is not huge but the choices are excellent. Would highly recommend Kebaya for a wonderful dining experience. Lovely décor, attentive wait staff and great food. What more could you want?

Author: choobengg2017Singapore, Singapore
Title: Nouvelle Peranakan in an elegant setting. Setting a new standard in Georgetown!
Review: Being guests at the Seven Terraces we looked forward to our dinner at the Kebaya restaurant which occupies six of the so called seven terraced shophouse units, facing Stewart Road. If you have a chance to see what a derelict pile this property looked like before , you will have to credit Georgetown hotel impresario Chris Ong for making this one of the most elegant dining rooms in South East Asia. A blend of 19th century Peranakan aesthetics (think gold leaf and carved Victorian and Chinese furniture) with eclectic modern touches. Sort of the late David Tang’s clutch of China Clubs in Hongkong and Singapore. Respecting the interior architecture of the buildings. Moving to the food. They offer a four course set menu at a competitive pricing versus fine dining establishments in Singapore and Bangkok. We tried the week’s special of duck curry as the main and the durian sticky rice dessert. Before you think that these are familiar favourites and dismiss them. Note that Chris had engaged the creative minds of the team behind Nahm in Bangkok. We were pleasantly surprised with the end result. The duck was tender and well marinated with the nutty curry gravy that lingered in your mouth. The pie tee could be more stuffed with the vegetables though. It appears there are some familiar favourites that appeal to the diners such as the otak(which is really a puff pastry) and the organic roast pork which I newly discovered goes very well with Italian Balsamic! Book early to avoid disappointment! Show less

Author: SunMoonShineOxfordshire, United Kingdom
Title: Stunning interiors and building. Food quality can be elevated
Review: Top marks for an excellent restoration. The interior decoration is excellent and the service staff from the hotel side to the restaurant are well trained and polite. Definitely a place to have a celebration meal and the bar looks very inviting. What needs tweaking is the food taste which was acceptable but when one is in Penang where Nonya/straits style food reigns supreme,Kebaya should raise their bar higher. Show less

Author: benedettaferraccioliPordenone, Italy
Title: Beautiful restaurant & creative cuisine
Review: Probably the best dinner we had in Malaysia so far. They have a 4 courses fixed menu (appetiser, protein, veggies and dessert). The food is absolutely great and I highly recommend it to those who love experiencing new tastes and flavours! The main courses are tasty and delicious. We loved their desserts also! The restaurant is in the same complex of Seven Terraces Hotel, which has been recently renovated and converted in one of the most beautiful boutique hotels in the city. Show less

Author: Bernice DBrisbane
Title: fantastic evening great food and great price
Review: We were at this amazing restaurant a year ago, so when we visited Penang we went again twice, taking friends with us. It is a four course meal with choices for each section, and roughly in A$40.00 per person was an absolute bargain. The place itself is beautifully created, the food is absolutely delightful so fresh with slightest tastes of herbs and spices. Service is fantastic but beware wine is quite expensive, we paid almost as much for the wine as we did for the meal! Great great place, and we intend to go there next year when we will be in Penang again I am already looking forward to it. Thank you Kebaya for looking after us so well and for serving such delicious food.Show less

Author: MandarinBlairgowrieBlairgowrie
Title: Superb Penang Cuisine
Review: Apart from the wonderful décor this restaurant serves excellent local dishes. We would recommend the multi course set menu that is served at 6pm or 8pm. Ample portions of delicious local dishes, you have a choice within in the categories of Starters/Main etc, which is stylishly presented. A comfortable bar area for a pre dinner drink and subtle live piano music.Ceiling fans and low key aircon keeps the room a comfortable temperature.The staff were friendly and attentive making for a wonderful evening.Show less

Author: MetalTigerPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Wonderful lunch with flavours that exploded in the mouth
Review: I arranged an event with lunch at the Kebaya Hotel which is part of the boutique Hotel 7 Terraces owned by Chris Ong. The set meal was a delicious experience and all the courses are on the normal menu so available to all. POPIAH - which are delicate think wrappers, in which you make your own selection from what's on offer: Fresh blue swimmer Crab, Omelette julienne, crispy Garlic and dried Sole with stir fried Jicama and Shiitake Mushrooms. Then the Main Course was NASI KERABU - A Turmeric rice salad with herbs, Japanese mackerel, salted Egg omelette served with Lemongrass jam, sambal Belachan & fish crackers accompanied with Mango kerabu salad. For Dessert we were given Creme Brulee with a difference! it was spiked with Pandan essence and served with a petite brandy snap. As I said in my title the flavours exploded in the mouth. Just beautiful surroundings with marvellous attentive professional staff. A breath of fresh air! Top of my 5 star choices in Penang. Highly recommended.Show less

Author: SonnymaoBrea, California
Title: Superb Prenakan Cuisine in Penang!
Review: The restaurant is inside the restored - and gorgeous Seven Terraces Hotel. It seems non-descript as we entered through the small road adjacent to it, but once we entered its doors into its spacious foyer, we literally gasped at how beautiful its interior is! It has white mosaic tile floors, intricately carved wooden antique furniture and pots of fuchsia and white orchids abound. I made reservations so we were seated promptly by a very gracious hostess. Kebaya offers a distinctive taste of Peranakan cuisine that is anchored in the past with its ingredients, but updated with the way it was prepared with French cooking techniques. Service was impeccable and attentive, the wait staff anticipating our needs perfectly. Kebaya has elevated Prenakan food to something sublime and yet comforting. I am surprised Kebaya does not have a Michelin Star!Show less

Author: maninstride
Title: Nyonya Cuisine with a Fusion twist
Review: One of the best nyonya cuisine I have experienced in Penang. Wait staff are well trained and offered attentive services without intrusion. A four course set menu offered adequate choices for both regular and vegetarian diners. Memorable dishes included Prawn Geng and the Gula Melaka mousse. About RM 124 per person is reasonable. Overall is a great memorable dining experience and highly recommended. Show less

Author: Gregman79
Title: Best Peranakan restaurant in Penang
Review: Kebaya is among the best Peranakan restaurant i have ever tried. The place is absolutely gorgeous, the staff is very professional and the food is great! A must go in Penang!

Author: Narinder S
Title: Great Ambiance and Good nyonya cuisine imalgamated to its finest !
Review: With super ambiance from every corner of the premis to dining with excellent food, of the finest nyonya baba cuisine in penang, kebaya will take you to a journey like no other.

Author: GloriaSomeHobart, Australia
Title: Consistently high quality restaurant experience
Review: This was our second visit to Kebaya and we were very happy to find the food, drinks and whole experience just as good as our first visit 7 years ago. The 4 course set menu represents excellent value and the opportunity to share the selections means you could taste the whole menu if you come with a larger party. As a couple we tried 8 different dishes this time and they were all superb, particularly crab and papaya salad and the gula Melaka mousse. The setting is beautiful we were glad we enjoyed our last evening meal on our Penang holiday here at Kebaya.Show less

Author: jan1ce_cshKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Awesome food! Must try.
Review: Love love love the food & ambience here and officially one of my favourite place to dine with family and friends. They only serve set meals which come with an appetiser, a meat, a vege & a dessert of choice served with rice. A good variety to choose from and although it costs RM128++ per person, I still think it is worth paying for because 1) the food is awesome - rich and a delight to your senses 2) generous portion. So if there are 2 of you and you order 2 sets, you can actually share around. For kids, they have western kiddy meal for them. But what we did was just to order extra portion of rice. The style of cooking reminds me of my grandma. Service is great too.Photos attached.Show less

Author: Janet IBristol, United Kingdom
Title: A treat!
Review: This is undoubtedly the best food I have had in SE Asia. It is a fine dining restaurant, and the price is worth it! We dined at Kebaya almost every evening we stayed in Georgetown. I sampled the vegetarian options which were unique and most flavoursome.Show less

Author: TheHeritageSeekerSingapore
Title: A feast for the senses
Review: This is a fine dining restaurant to impress your partner/spouse or foreign friends. The night we were there, there were 3 birthday parties. Peranakan furniture can be gaudy and overwhelming but the owner had done up the place very tastefully. I love their blue & white tableware used for food. Soothing piano music was played in the background.The menu is a 4-course set per person and the serving is quite substantial, even for someone with a big appetite. The food taste is good and aromatic though not all is 100% Peranakan, eg the fish curry was beautifully done but probably sweeter than expected to suit Western taste buds; the salad is more Thai/Vietnamese. Although I can take the heat in the dressing (I was forewarned by the staff), it would be too spicy for most. I am a dessert person so I wished they offered 2-3 different mini bites instead of choosing just 1 type of dessert.The staff serving us was attentive and helpful, without being intrusive.Overall, I find the price is reasonable for a fine dining experience.PS: If you are not a guest of their hotel, do take a peek at the courtyard which is on the way to the rest rooms.Show less

Author: jonascnSingapore, Singapore
Title: Expensive but worth it
Review: The restaurant is located in a old Peranakan shophouse. The lady is friendly. She will recommend some dishes depending on the number of pax. The food is expensive but worth it. My favourite was the roasted pork and coconut based desert. The ambiance is great too with colonial based design and connecting hotel. Highly recommended for the best Peranakan fusion food in Penang. Best to go with friends as you can order more variety of food.Show less

Author: JandJAdelaideAdelaide, Australia
Title: Wonderful restaurant in a fabulous building
Review: We had a superb meal at Kebaya on our last night in Penang. The buildings have been brilliantly restored possibly beyond their former glory. It was a fascinating mix of European and Chinese decor very reminiscent of the Peranakan Museum we had visited a few days earlier. After an excellent cocktail at the cosy bar we enjoyed a wonderful meal. It was well cooked with excellent ingredients. Yes this is not as cheap as some places in Penang but it was great value for money. You would pay far more for this quality of food and venue elsewhere. We will certainly go back next time we are in Penang. Show less

Author: 791jonSingapore, Singapore
Title: More for westerners
Review: It’s a beautiful restaurant set in amazing restored building. The service was good. For the food, it will be a good introduction of peranakan for westerners. But for locals & tourists from Asia that are used to strong spices and Asian flavors, may be tad ordinary. Show less

Author: 109simonwBangkok, Thailand
Title: Restaurant in Boutique Hotel
Review: This was our first time in Kebaya for dinner whilst on a weekend break in Penang and it was a surprisingly good choice.Penang is not overflowing with good restaurants and often the street food options are better - but Kebaya with its four course menu is above the norm.For mains we had the tamarind beef and prawn curry which were both superb. Desserts of pandan creme brûlée and chocolate fondant with passion fruit were equally good.Definitely a go to place in George Town in a beautiful indo-Chinese setting.Show less

Author: FellowTraveler280686
Title: Wonderful
Review: We visited for our wedding anniversary. The food is very good, the decor and atmosphere is amazing. The stand out is the staff with the passion they have for the business. I have never experienced anything like it anywhere else.

Author: narni4Perth, Australia
Title: FIVE STARS.
Review: The décor,service,staff knowledge of the menu and attention to guests is amazing.Then came the Food !!! We came to Kebaya 4 years ago to celebrate our 50th Anniversary and our first decision this year was to book again.This year was even better. We were unanimous that we had the BEST MEAL we had ever eaten.The cost was even better Four people Four courses each,one bottle of French wine pre-dinner cocktails for $Aust 286.00.total.A must go-to but book ahead.Show less

Author: savourynotsweetGeneva, Switzerland
Title: beautiful surroundings, a great experience with a few flaws
Review: The decor and atmosphere here are definitely worth 5*. In terms of the food, the beef was really, really good, but some of the other dishes were just standard. The desserts were disappointing - for me they just tasted of sugar, sugar and more sugar. Cocktails were very tasty but didn't have any kind of a kick.Service was attentive and drinks orders were taken straight away but I was a little annoyed that when we asked for water, the lady confirmed if we wanted a bottle without explaining options. Its a fine dining restaurant and I wasn't sure what the Penang equivalent of tap water was so I just agreed. They then brought out the most expensive bottle - Evian, which I would never ask for as branded water is just a rip off IMO. They then kept filling up our glasses every 5 minutes, probably so we would order another one. They are obviously out to make money this way so if you don't want to pay 16 MYR plus tax just say the water carafe is fine.Overall, the price is a bit high because as many reviewers mention there is an abundance of tasty food in Penang. Definitely worth going once for a special occasion.Show less

Author: 805marv
Title: Yummy
Review: Yummy.... The food is great and the building is nice. I particularly like the pandan cream brulee.. Only thing is the price is on the high side.

Author: champagnes2016Hong Kong, China
Title: Good dinner
Review: Service was good, food quality was good. The cocktails were well made. Price on the high side for the cost of the ingredients and one can eat similar dishes elsewhere at a fraction of the cost. However, if you consider the entire dinner experience, it is definitely classy and very comfortable. Show less

Author: tamminhAnn Arbor, Michigan
Title: Delicious Fusion Food and Excellent Service
Review: We had reservation for 8 pm, the second of the 2 sittings nightly. At 7 pm, however, we asked if we could start our dinner. To our pleasant surprise, the staff cheerfully accommodated us (apparently because some parties had failed to show up for their 6 pm reservation.) In fact, everyone of the waitstaff was cheerful and attentive. Special mention for the excellent service should be given to Dinesh who was extremely helpful and informative.We found all of our choices (2 appetizers, 2 proteins, 2 greens, and 2 desserts) were perfectly delicious, each with its own flavors. The "Banh Xeo" (note the correct Vietnamese spelling) took the name of the Vietnamese dish, yet was a creative improvement by the lack of greasiness from the fried shell. We had trouble ranking the 8 dishes but in the end, my husband chose the Shrimp Curry as his #1 and I, the Wing Beans salad.Show less

Author: teejayem
Title: Great dining experince
Review: A wonderful venue for a fancy night out with friends. A set menu designed for sharing, the only disappointing thing we tried was the pork belly which was over cooked. All other dishes were excellent. The venue itself was exquisite, straight out of another time.

Author: chongbroodSingapore
Title: Deliciously elegant - food and setting
Review: Peranakan fusion food, uniquely presented in interesting ways. The food didn't just look good, it tasted good too. While the set was priced a little on the high side, it was well worth the money. The servings were generous. We came in a group and so were able to order a little of everything. A lovely memorable meal in a beautiful setting in one of Penang's most elegant hotels. Highly recommended for a splurge. Show less

Author: Yen X
Title: Awesome Nonya Food
Review: Held my Birthday Dinner of 11 pax here at the Kebaya Dining Room. The service is impeccable and we were treated with very attentive to details. From the serving of water to the discussion of the menu, recommendations to ask the staff as they know which palate different nationalities have. All the food we had was bursting with flavour and very robust. For my birthday pictures, thank you for the staff to patiently take pictures for my whole group of friends and family at the courtyard. Highly recommend! Show less

Author: LaohuPenang
Title: Traditional food in splendid setting
Review: Traditional Peranakan food is served in a restored traditional house, served by cheerful and helpful staff. There is a set menu each evening with a fair choice of starters, main dishes and deserts.

Author: SemperteFallantSolihull, United Kingdom
Title: Super restaurant with delicious food
Review: This was our first taste of the local Peranakan cuisine and it was a great experience. There is an all-in price for a four course meal (basically, a Starter, Main Course, a Veggie dish and a Dessert) with half-a-dozen choices for each, and our first difficulty was trying to decide which of the delicious-sounding dishes to try. Anyway, the ones that we chose were fabulous and had we not been leaving the next day we would have gone back to try some of the others. Maybe a bit pricey for Malaysia (especially when you add in a bottle of wine), but the plush décor, excellent food, tranquil live Chinese guzheng music playing in the background and friendly service made it eminently worthwhile.Show less

Author: Troy BPerth, Australia
Title: Amazing food. Ambiance not quite there
Review: Went here for our final evening meal in Penang as it was highly recommended.We arrived and was seated smack bang in the middle of a samsung group that were from a convention. Very very noisy and we asked to be moved.However an hour later they were finished and gone.That when the restaurant really lived up to the hype. The food was absolutely faultless. Very fusion type cuisine with a twist. The otak otak was one of the best starters i have ever tasted. The onde onde rice balls amazing finish to the night.Well Done.Show less

Author: MelvachiaSingapore, Singapore
Title: Touristy and unconventional Peranakan Cuisine
Review: Beautiful and traditional Peranakan decor in the restaurant. Service can be more attentive. Cuisine is very fusion and if you're looking for traditional eats, this is not the place for you. Every other table are tourists and you will not find any locals here. Food is average but presented very well. I would say the desserts are the highlights of the entire mealShow less

Author: wflal1991Bendigo, Australia
Title: What an amazing experience!
Review: It was an amazing dining experience in George Town.The staff made you feel very special and were extremely attentive without being intrusive.We arrived a little early so were welcomed to have pre-dinner drinks in the bar which was beautifully furnished in the heritage building.Show less

Author: Palag
Title: Must be the best in Penang!
Review: A wonderful dining experience a must for any traveller to Penang and by international standards very affordable !

Author: Lankylee
Title: Starbucks
Review: This place has a great reputation.  Decor and staff very good. Wine list small but adequate.... nothing that will get a vino excited.  Food is good that has a Starbucks quality.  Entirely good but there is little of excellence to recall.

Author: greganglands
Title: Kebaya #amazing
Review: Outstanding dining experience, great food & service, beautiful heritage building. Would recommend to all.

Author: ChriselloyBeaumont Hills, Australia
Title: Beautiful building and loved all the China
Review: Kebaya was nice fine dining restaurant and the food was good although for my taste not truly authentic Peranakan. It was a set menu which I found disappointing. U had to choose entree, main veggies and desert and they had two specials but had run out of the Durian soufflé which was disappointing. The staff and Manager were very attentive. When we complained about the dessert running out the Manager was excellent and handled it well. Not sure I’d rush back again but it was an experience I enjoyed. Show less

Author: cloudyh2018
Title: The best meal in Penang
Review: Excellent service, well-designed place, great ambience, superb food, and most importantly the whole experience is value for money. The is the best meal I have ever had in my whole Penang trip!

Author: FellowTraveler761351
Title: Perfect Dinner
Review:
World class food and drinks. 
Already discussing next year's holiday we will be back to Kebaya.
Nice food, nice service.

Author: siauwweihanSingapore, Singapore
Title: Bitter birthday
Review: Tonight, when we arrived at the restaurant, we felt really unwelcomed. We stood at the front desk for a few minutes (many staff were not busy when arrived), and no one acknowledged our presence untill we spoke up. And to our horror our reservation was not in the list, but we were finally seated. What transpired had already spoiled the mood some what. During the meal, I kept wondering if my request to surprise my friend will be done. To be honest, I already half expected it not happened. To be fair, the food was good. However, as one of the more expensive restaurant in Penang, the level of service should be of certain standard. Unfortunately, it lacked quite a bit. What was meant to be a memorable birthday came with some bitterness. We left with full stomachs nonetheless. Show less

Author: DalesRangerLeeds, United Kingdom
Title: Great food - service v snappy.
Review: We had a set menu that was excellent in every respect. We underestimated the portion sizes and should have shown some restraint early on. The chef/s deserve loads of credit in combining some very traditional dishes and ingredients in some innovative and tastey ways.Service was very attentive - which will suit those who like their service snappy - but we prefer a less formal approach. But this was a minor issue and did not detract from a lovely evening. Wine prices by Malaysia standards were OK and the choice was the best we have found in Penang- so far.Show less

Author: Joerg MBingen am Rhein, Germany
Title: Delecious Peranakan Food
Review: We had a very good dinner with delicious Peranakan Food in a beautiful setting. The restaurant offers a small number of standard menus and has a good wine selection to choose from. The staff is always attentive and very friendly...always enthusiastic to help taking pictures. The high quality food is nicely decorated on traditional plates and bowls. Only downside are the prices which for Malaysia are very high. We paid for standard menu for 3 people including one bottle of red wine (from the lower price segment of the wine list) the equivalent of 135 €.Show less

Author: MyReview22Berkshire, UK
Title: Lovely!
Review: Really enjoyed our meal here. Managed to get a booking relatively last minute and I think we were lucky. Beautiful surroundings & slick service. Food beautifully presented & tastes to die for. The only reason I haven't put 5 stars on, is I think it was a little over priced for Penang. 2 adults, one bottle of wine £110.Show less

Author: grays693Glasgow, United Kingdom
Title: Best Restaurant in Penang
Review: There’s a lot of excellent eating establishments in Penang so to label a restaurant as the best it has to be pretty special. Kebaya is that good. You can eat more cheaply but I think this restaurant is worth every penny. A fixed menu with 4 courses the choice of dishes is varied but every choice is excellent quality, taste and imaginative cooking. The service is refined but friendly and engaging and the restaurant itself is very nice as part of a quality boutique hotel. We were lucky enough to visit twice on our 8 day stay in Georgetown, after the first visit we just had to return. Already discussing next year’s holiday we will be back to Georgetown and Kebaya is definitely due another visit. Show less

Author: haharockd
Title: Terrible service
Review: We called in advance to book a table for the six of us and requested only 4 sets as there were children among us who could not finish the full set. However, we were met with blatant rejection and they said that no sharing was allowed. This is absurd as they expect everyone, including children, to finish all the food. Inflexible for such a highly rated restaurant.Show less

Author: minikittenBristol, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent anniversary meal
Review: We are staying at the hotel and booked online before our visit. Such a beautiful dining room, lovely decor and atmosphere with live piano music. The food was delicious and the flavours were sublime. To start we had pork Bahn Mee style mini buns and prawn top hats, both were lovely but the buns stood out for me as the flavour in the pork was fantastic. We followed with the snapper and tamarind beef. Both were wonderful. Soft and delicious and beautifully presented. The beef was decorated with nasturtiums and the portions surprisingly large. Our waiter gave me a local chutney to accompany my fish too which was lovely, and added an extra dimension to the dish. The deserts were excellent, pineapple panna Cotta was absolutely sublime, perfect tartness and sweet balance. The deconstructed local pandan dish was also very good. It’s nice to try something different as I don’t often have dessert in Asian restaurants so the flavours were really interesting for me to try. A beautiful Coconut ice cream, cubes of green jelly, banana chips, puffed rice and flavoured potato balls. It was delicious and so beautifully presented. Initially I thought we would struggle to eat it all but the deserts were very light. Great value, 500 rm for two with a bottle of wine and a drink at the bar beforehand. Show less

Author: ShaashaaParnallSingapore
Title: Amazing spread.
Review: Delicious peranakan food. A must try when in Penang. 4 course meal for £20? Uh, why the hell not.Great service. Very attentive and helpful.Fantastic ambience. Highly recommended for groups of 4 rather than couples because then, you'll get to try most of the dishes. Show less

Author: KiiraAndMikkoVantaa, Finland
Title: Beautiful place, beautiful food, beautiful service
Review: Always when you come to a top rated restaurant, you have so high expectation that it´s a challenge to meet them. Even better than we expected. Kebaya did not have any problem with this. The four course dinner was perfect. Maybe the best food ever. We strongly recommend: don´t miss this unique place. Chris Ong designs his heritage hotels and restaurants with taste and the staff in all three places we visited is highly motivated and professional.Show less

Author: rouyingr
Title: Fantastic food, did not disappoint
Review: Service was good, attentive but not overwhelming. Food did not disappoint. Might be expensive in penang terms, but definitely worth the try. The beef was the outstanding dish of the night. Be warn: Food portion is pretty huge, so be ready to fill your tummy!

Author: FChapmanSan Francisco, California
Title: Best in class .... but don’t take my word for it !
Review: Went to Kebaya for a family reunion dinner with a number of very traditional Penang foodies who were initially skeptical of the restaurant’s fusion approach to traditional dishes. The great thing about large family dinners is that you get to try a little bit of everything.... and by the end of dinner, the local foodies were raving about the flavors and creative approach. Enjoy it all!!Show less

Author: mousefindsoutLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Baba Nyona Delicacies served in style
Review: I really enjoyed our visit to this restaurant and would gladly have made a second visit despite the wealth of opportunities to eat in Penang. They specialise in the Nyona fusion food of Malay and Chinese dishes. All delicious and service flawless. the surroundings are elegant Peranakan in style so that it makes for a feast for eye and mouth. Not to be missed. Booking essential.Show less

Author: 68maurasLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Exceptional meal
Review: This was one of the highlights of our trip. Expensive for Penang but when compared to western restaurants of the same standard and service, this place outshines any high-end eatery. We loved the snapper main and chilli crab salad. The chocolate fondant is quite special too. Lovely atmosphere with pianist playing in the background. Staff are very friendly and Steven chatted to us at the bar and gave us great trips for the rest of our travels. A must do in Penang!Show less

Author: macneillfamily
Title: Beautiful dining room with well prepared and tasty food
Review: If you are n Georgetown for a few nights this restaurant within the 7 terraces hotel is a must visit attraction, old colonial architecture, impeccable service and lovely vibe.

Author: snworb
Title: Fine Dining
Review: This restaurant located within the Seven Terraces is absolutely fantastic. We dined twice during our five days and thoroughly enjoyed the upscale cuisine served in a classic dining area. The service was excellent from the well informed staff.

Author: terje_rsvollo
Title: Thank you!
Review: This was the best food in Penang so fare! Well presented and taste rich. Good service and friendly staff in a nice atmosfare with life soft music. Not expensive.

Author: iamkokinoseattle
Title: If you only go to one restaurant in Penang, come here
Review: A beautiful restaurant restored from 7 houses now connected together, Kebaya is also a hotel across the courtyard. We came early for a drink at the bar, admired the decor and were already so deliriously happy we forgot that we came here for the food. The tasting menu was a delight as were all of our servers. Everyone there made us felt welcome, warm and comfortable - it was as if we returned to dine at an old friend's home. Show less

Author: mrs fm l
Title: Restaurant serving fusion Peranakan food
Review: Great food, expensive by Penang standards but it's a good place to unwind and enjoy the flavourful dishes. My favorite: beef stewed in peanut turmeric sauce. Least fave: desserts all in all - good food, great servicedownside - uber and taxis are not familiar with the location. SighShow less

Author: Dean SManila, Philippines
Title: Stylish setting, interesting set menu with varied combinations
Review: Had lunar New Year meal here and pleased with the elegant setting, prompt and attentive service, and reasonable choices for a set menu. Did not feel hurried and quiet enough that conversation was possible. Price is fairly high for Penang, but for special occasions worth it. The piano in the background was a nice touch.Show less

Author: R0peTechAuckland, New Zealand
Title: New Years Banquet
Review: We went to Kebaya and had their Chinese New Years set menu. The greens were crisp and interesting, the Snapper was cooked to perfection and well presented. To top it all off the service was very good. I recommend Kebaya if you are after a fancy dinner out. Show less

Author: wpislanderBophut, Thailand
Title: Well worth a visit!
Review: Was curious about Kebaya after reading all the rave reviews on TripAdvisor, and especially since it’s rated No. 1 in Georgetown. And I have to say, it truly deserves all the great reviews.They serve a 4-course meal with a choice of two seatings at 6pm or at 8pm. Their 4-course dinner of “To begin”, “Protein”, “Green” and “Sweet” has a wide variety of dishes to choose from. Just go to their website if you want to view their menu.I chose the Pork Man Tou, Lor Ark (duck confit), Wing Bean Kerabu, and Pandan Creme Brûlée. All were good, but what really were big Wows for me were the duck and the pandan creme brûlée. The duck was so tender and the flavours from the spices were incredible! I was a little sceptical about ordering the pandan creme brûlée initially but all that melted away as soon as I tasted it. Absolutely delicious!! Perfect texture as any good creme brulee should be except with a pandan twist to it. A definite must-try!Service was highly attentive without being intrusive.The restaurant is tastefully decorated with a nice cosy old world charm.Highly recommend Kebaya if you would like a change from the street fare that Penang has to offer. At RM120+ for this 4-course meal, it really is not expensive especially with the quality you get, and their portion for each course is huge! There is no way you will walk away from this place not feeling totally stuffed!Show less

Author: jan59Essexessex
Title: Fine dining experience
Review: We were fortunate enough to have chosen Seven Terraces as our base in Georgetown, so Kebaya was an obvious choice for one evening. They offer a 4 course menu - starter, main, veg & dessert. My duck main was tender like Peking duck, outstanding. Thoroughly recommend Show less

Author: Blue_Man_AlejandroSingapore, Singapore
Title: Had the best time at Kebaya
Review: Kebaya is ranked the #1 Restaurant in Penang. Naturally, I’m asking myself how much can I trust this rating. After reading several reviews, we decided to give Kebaya a go. I’ve always believed in experiencing something before critiquing it.Dinner night didn’t start off on the right footing as it was pouring and things just weren’t going well for us. Got to Kebaya an hour earlier than our reservation time and We were lucky, as we always are when together, to get a table and at a quieter spot. The Restaurant Manager, Steven who is a very nice man and looked after us well that night. The interior of Kebaya is impeccably decorated. The restaurant is housed within a hotel and you wouldn’t believe that this place was previously an abandoned row of shops and almost entirely ruined. The staff showed us a book with pictures of what the place looked like pre-Kebaya. Suffice to say, What you see now is a far cry from what it used to be. Ask for the book if you wish to have a look. Kebaya works on a set menu so you pick four dishes from the fixed menu - a starter, a protein, a vegetable and a dessert. The stand out for me was the Miang Karm, which is a clever version of the Thai appetizer but with salmon roe. I’ve always loved this appetizer but never had it with salmon roe ever. We had the slow cooked beef and curry prawns for mains which were both delectable. The accompanying vegetables were rather ordinary but I suppose a must with every meal. Hopefully they would be able to jazz these up a bit more. The glutinous rice ball dessert was pretty good but the colour of the balls totally caught me off guard lol! I’m not so much of a mouse person but LGF liked it. We had an amazing night at Kebaya; fun-filled and with lots of laughter afterwards. The environment is relaxed and Service is really fast as you would expect with a fixed menu. The waiters are helpful and yet tactful; realising that we preferred to be left alone so did not disturbed us much and let us enjoy our own company. As with us, I realised that most people patronise Kebaya on special occasions. This was evident by the two groups celebrating birthdays. However, if you have yet to visit Kebaya, I highly recommend that you make plans soon to do so. Will definitely be back the next time we’re in Penang.Photos courtesy of LGF!Show less

Author: ScubaDy
Title: Pleasant surprise
Review: Very good nyonya fusion dinner place. On the pricey $$$$ side but on the whole the food was superb. The appetizers, mains, and desserts were fantastic. The greens didn't deliver as well.

Author: KevinLim
Title: Thoroughly enjoyable
Review:
Kebaya Dining Room is widely regarded as Penang's best restaurant and a recent visit didn't disappoint.
For us, the highlights included the sous vide beef cooked in a gula melaka (palm sugar) glaze and the pulled pork in Chinese buns. Service was also great.

Author: Irlantilainen
Title: Excellent
Review:
A fixed dinner menu of traditional cuisine served nightly at 18h00 and 22h00, reservations required.

First class service, delicious food.

Affiliated with the equally good Muntri Grove hotel.

Author: Nigel WOdense, Denmark
Title: Delectable food and great atmosphere
Review: Wow. We ate here on our first night of staying at the 7 Terraces. It was such a success that my partner requested a return visit for his birthday dinner 3 nights later. Great food. Lovely live piano music. Attentive service. Interesting décor. Booking essential - people are in the know.Show less

Author: deecooley88Brisbane, Australia
Title: Simply Delicious
Review: We were so blessed to be able to enjoy a wonderful meal in Kebaya. We had not realised we should book in advance but fortunately for us there was a cancellation for the first sitting. We were in house guests and having seen the restaurant we were excited to be dining there . Our four course degustation meal was beautifully presented and the flavours danced on our palates. Attentive service a beautiful meal served in Heritage surrounds left us with only one last thing to do a toast between us to a wonderful experience. Thank you Kebaya .Show less

Author: truongkvChantilly, Virginia
Title: Elegant Restaurant, Great Food
Review: We reserved a table ahead of time since this restaurant was always crowded and seating was limited. We were not disappointed! The restaurant interior looked great with nice decors, good atmosphere, and spacious. We ordered the Kebaya set dinner for 3 people which included appetizers (minced prawn wrapped on sugar cane, salmon roes on pennyworth leaf, crispy char rolls), entries (stewed lamb, Duck Confit, and Tamarind Beef), and greens (Wing Bean Karabu which was crunchy and fantastic, Sautéed Greens, Sautéed French Beans). Of course the set also came with desserts (crème brulee, pana cotta, and palm sugar sponge cake). Every was delicious. The service was prompt and attentive. At the end, the manager also came over and gave us some new local authentic sauce to try. Very impressed with the staff, food, and service.Show less

Author: SummerWang25Singapore, Singapore
Title: Had a wonderful dinner @ Kebaya
Review: Like to commend Kebaya’s Team to make my Husband’s birthday a memorable one with a surprise dessert and an exquisite birthday card. It was really unexpected and kudos to the team and pianist who sang and played him a birthday song. Thank you so much for the good service and not forgetting the wonderful dinner we had. Special mention on the 2 dishes:Otak Otak - was awed by the modern twist to a traditional Otak. Snapper meat was very fresh and tastyNew Zealand Lamb - very flavourful tender meat Recommend to anyone who is looking for a good dining experienceShow less

Author: Bunagaya1
Title: Beautiful dishes, beautiful surroundings
Review: We had an excellent time at Kebaya with our family (and baby). Service was friendly and fast (when staff didn't know something they quickly checked). The food was to die for (particularly the lamb and prawn curry). Highly recommend!

Author: Jennifer LSouth Africa
Title: Very good, but busy and more pricey
Review: We enjoyed a birthday dinner at this Penang institution, and thought all the food was delicious. The setting is also nice, although the dining room is very busy, and the service - especially when it came time to get the bill - could have been better. Show less

Author: Wongluk
Title: Excellent meal
Review: This is restaurant for 7 terraces hotel. In heritage building at end of a quiet street. Beautiful setting. Service friendly and efficient. The food is delicious. Need to make a booking. Well worth a visit. Will come again

Author: ShowtimeSach
Title: An unbelievable find, worthy of any city and critic
Review: What a find!The menu is a far cry from anything I've seen across the world. The taste does not disappoint.It hit the 'wow' factor with every dish. The Kebaya tamarind beef is one of the most flavoursome and succulent dishes I've had in years. The duck (signature dish) is sweet and delicate in comparison but still a solid 8/10! The setting is an old hotel. It is beautifully decorated giving a vintage Chinese feel. You are given plenty of space with the tables a good distance apart. The service was efficient and friendly. Then comes the bill. It is ridiculously cheap by international standards. The meal is just under 130RM (c£24).This is a must if you love food. An absolute must.Show less

Author: leo_ooo
Title: Questionable service made for a mediocre experience
Review: Pork belly and duck were delicious dishes, nice atmosphere, good Chinese fusion with a local influence. The service was a little questionable and definitely diminished otherwise interesting and memorable experience.

Author: jamesflorraineBrisbane, Australia
Review: We visited Kabaya with friends, this is our 4th Visit, simply stunning.From arrival to leaving everything was superb.The manager Robert was on hand, and runs a great Hotel/Restaurant, the waiting staff are great, the food was sensational.Presentation is great, a simply stunning restaurant, I’m sure we will return agai , the restaurant is great value, not overpriced at all, great placeShow less

Author: 419charlotteb
Title: Worth it!
Review: This is the best food we have had in Malaysia. The sharing plates work well and the service is fantastic. Highly recommend the red snapper for entree course and the duck for main. Well worth a visit if you’re in Penang. Make sure you make a booking. Show less

Author: Camilla vBrisbane, Australia
Title: The best in Penang for a reason
Review: We booked for our last dinner in Penang and wished we'd been there before.The 4 course fixed menu (should be renamed price-fixed menu, like the French) is more than enough. You choose one entree, one main, one side dish and one dessert for RM120. After booking on the website I received an email within 24 hours confirming the booking (there are 2 sittings - 6pm and 8pm) as well as the menu arrangements and pricing. It was pretty clear and courteous. The serves are more than sufficient and beyond delicious. Hubby and I had the chinese buns and prawns for entree, snapper and beef for main, snap peas and greens for side, and then 2 of the special desserts. Amazing flavours - beef just melted, and the snapper was soft and moist. We also had a bottle of wine and 2 signature cocktails for RM502 - well worth the money.The staff were attentive and discreet at the same time - there when needed and no hovering. The building is old and luxurious (it's part of luxury hotel) with beautiful Chinese furnishings and the most beautiful plates. We read the reviews on Trip Advisor and were perplexed about some of the comments about families being catered for. When we were there for a 6pm sitting there was a family of 8 with 3 children under 10, and one in a high chair. Family was more than made welcome. Do not pass over the opportunity to experience this place. Show less

Author: Philip I
Title: Great food at such good prices
Review: This is the restaurant in Seven Terrace hotel  Best to book as it gets busy.  great menu, well cooked and served but best value for such quality i saw in Malaysia.

Author: marystewart24
Title: Great cuisine
Review: The menu is varied with a great deal of choices and the food is delicious and some of the best we had in Penang

Author: BruceandtuzAustralia
Title: Fantastic food and great location
Review: Easy to find and I would say that it was the best food we had in Georgetown. It’s expensive for Penang but compared to home it’s a cheap meal with exceptional quality of food and service. I would definitely recommend this restaurant and would return without hesitation. Great for a special night out.Show less

Author: scubafun1234
Title: Great atmosphere, ok dinner
Review: Had business dinner here with some colleagues, atmosphere is really nice, the attached hotel is beautiful, the food choices were plentiful, and the food in general was good, it just was not outstanding, nothing that would make me come back

Author: VanessaPatel
Title: Peranakan cuisine at its best
Review: the vegetarian menu was very good, but limited after eating there once. The kept putting shrimps in our veg tempura, but were very apologetic for their mistake

Author: TheHungryStudent
Title: Perfect
Review: Fantastic service from beginning to end, large portion sizes, interesting and delicious food and and the best value fine dining I've encountered. We're so glad we found this place!

Author: PatsynFamilySingapore, Singapore
Title: Fine dining
Review: This is at Seven Terraces hotel. The food, although is for single portion is enough to share. We like the Beef, it was good, tender, flavourful. Wing bean was crisp and not overcooked.The ambience is like a stylish private home dining space. Love the pillow that support your back while you sit. Would like to have more food option though. Prices a bit on the high side. I think it was RM$120 per pax, for a starter, main course, veggy, and dessert.Show less

Author: Heather0664Perth, Australia
Title: A Penang fine dining experience
Review: Visited here on recommendation from a friend in KL, as well as the Trip Advisor reviews. Lovely decor and ambience, with attentive service from staff. Really happy with our menu choices, especially the beef main course. The pandan brulee dessert was also special. I would like to give 4.5 stars, as it was one of our better meals whilst staying in Penang.Show less

Author: EdinaFR
Title: Best meal in Georgetown
Review: We arrived without reservation but were promptly seated. The menu has a lot of interesting choices and each dish we had was a winner! Definitely recommended!

Author: unclelumpyHingham, United Kingdom
Title: Bad service, they broke the 15 minute rule.
Review: We chose this restaurant based upon the TripAdvisor reviews. It looks lovely and there was a nice ambience with a pianist plinking away in the background.However, fifteen minutes after being shown to our seats we had still not been asked what we wanted to drink, let alone had anyone talk to us about the menu. The last straw was when they started to clear and set tables rather than take out order. So we walked out.When the manager realised he apologised and tried to get us to stay but I’m sorry, if your staff don’t prioritise a customer whose actually there then they don’t deserve their custom.It’s a real shame as the food looked really good but life’s too short to put up with badly trained staff.Show less

Author: nigelm317Hong Kong, China
Title: Can it be???
Review: Can this be one of the best restaurants that I have ever eaten at? Indeed it can and it is!! I travel monthly on business or vacation and have eaten all over the world but Kebaya is now at the top of my list!! The restaurant is full of character, the staff delightful, the food delicious and interesting with a few " twists " to the norm. I'll be looking to stay in the hotel on my next visit. Kebaya is seriously not to be missed!!Show less

Author: U9431MHsusandCanberra, Australia
Title: Fantastic food - lovely restaurant
Review: This restaurant was a great find. The menu (attached) was original and delicious. There were 7 of us friends at a table and the courses were all designed to share.Each dish was delicious, everyone was claiming that each one was better than the last one.The dessert was a creme brûlée which was green! But it was lovely. The staff were very attentive without being invasive. The decor was superb and the pianist was concert standard. I highly recommend this restaurant Show less

Author: NgKS9368
Title: Dinner
Review:
So called fine dining for Nyonya food.
Expensive & the food is so so only.
Worst thing is they set a time frame for your dinner.  But one thing for sure is great environment. Can give it a try.
...................

Author: Sim FClayton, Australia
Title: Nyonya culinary experience ; new twist
Review: What can I say about the Kebaya Restaurant?The ambience is perfect as you are immediately transported to an era rich in Nyonya traditions from the tiled floors, gold leaf screen partitions to the marbled top tables. That sets the mood for a culinary experience. We enjoyed the entrees immensely; the otak otak wrapped in light crispy pastry (instead of the traditional banana leaf) coupled with an exquisite sauce. The new take on Pai tee with fresh ( instead of cooked) vegetables was really good. However, we were not impressed with the main of red snapper. The spice sauce draped over the fish was a bit flat. The highlight was the dessert; the pandan creme brûlée was to die for. I could have gone for seconds or more! In one word: Yum!!Show less

Author: cityofbeautySingapore, Singapore
Title: Delicious food, Excellent service!
Review: We visited Kebaya after reading the good reviews in Trip Advisor and were not disappointed. They charged RM120++ for 4 course dining excluding drinks. You should order different dishes to get more variety. A place you should including in your dining list. Advance reservation is a must!Show less

Author: JoannaSBenHouston, Texas
Title: Wow!!!!
Review: Best meal I’ve had while traveling through Asia. They only have two seatings (6pm and 8pm - from what I remember) and boy am I glad we ate there the first night we arrived in Georgetown, because no other restaurant compared since. Food is absolutely delicious and the staff is so nice, goes above and beyond. I can say that each and every dish was so tasty. I still think about this meal and wish I lived near by so I could pop in when I had a craving. Show less

Author: Raoul N
Title: Great food, dessert is fantastic
Review:
Partner and I visited Penang for 3 days and made this one of our destinations.

We thoroughly enjoyed the atmosphere and the service was impeccable. Is a must go if coming to Penang. The Otak Otak entree was the highlight of the night. 

Would recommend.

Author: SunshineSunshineSingapore, Singapore
Title: Dinner
Review: 4 course set menu at RM120++ with a corkage charge of RM25 - RM50. Food was good but not all dishes are authentic peranakan food as some of the dishes were infact Thai food. Lovely ambience with a pianist playing whilst we were having dinner. It could have been better if tables were more spaced out. Shirley the lady in charge was professional in arranging the food for the 8 of us. Bryan the server was efficient and friendly but the rest wasnt as attentive as they should be as the dining hall was relatively small.Show less

Author: AznitaN1
Title: Good
Review:
- good food : taste was good 
- good atmosphere : love the deco of the whole place
- suitable for vegetarians

Author: pedrolaperdrix
Title: Worth it
Review:
After a week of foodstall markets we easily booked at this restaurant,
welcoming and friendly staff took time to explain us how the menu was designed,
it was tasty, good, generous and well led,
Thanks Shirley and her team for this diner,
Pierre

Author: 891maxr
Title: It's a beautiful dining experience, but I think you can find better food
Review: I liked it, but based on the outstanding reviews, I was a little disappointed. It's a fixed price menu (although they told me that hotel guests may choose a la carte). o I had otak otak as an appetizer. Very good -- an Ao For the protein dish I had the snapper, which was good, but not outstanding -- a C+o For greens I had nyonya tempura -- good and interesting. B+o Desert was tang yuen -- very good, an AThe restaurant itself is beautiful.The service was fine, but I had to seek out the waiter for my check. (I *hate* hate having to wait to pay.)Show less

Author: Pia D
Title: Good food in a beautiful decor
Review: Very good food. I'm not a big fan of chinese food becaise its mostly too greasy, this was absolutely different. Everything was very refined. I would advise to all order a different dish, the portions are big so you can share. In total with 1 glass of wine and a bottle of sparkling water we paid around 400RM. Service was very friendly.Show less

Author: MWBollomKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Beautiful period decor; wonderful food
Review: Even if you don't go here to eat, stop into the bar for a drink--the restored decor is worth going to see and the bar is well stocked.If there is a table available (it's a small place with only two servings per night (6PM and 8PM) stay for dinner. The four-course dinner is inventive (signature touches on Peranikan Chinese favorites) and delicious.Show less

Author: Eddie TSingapore, Singapore
Title: Authentically Wonderful & Tasty Peranakan Food (Vegetarian Friendly)
Review: Very authentic peranakan food. Nice restaurant environment. Great service. Great desserts! Must try are the Pandan Creme Brulee & Chocolate Fondue. The menu is based on a set meal with choice of various starters, mains & deserts. Best go w 4 or more ppl so that you can share & taste the various mains with your fellow foodie friends. Show less

Author: Geoff BMelbourne
Title: Fine dining in fine setting
Review: I can recommend this restaurant if you want to splurge, by Malaysian standards, on a quality meal with faultless service in a 'grand' dining-room. The dining-room, recently restored, provides a lovely setting.My partner and I visited for my birthday celebration and, with a couple of minor reservations, we were not disappointed.The menu is a set menu with several choices for each of starters, mains, sides and desserts. All of the dishes that we ordered were presented beautifully. The highlights for us were the starters (red snapper parcels, minced chicken/prawn in leaves) and the desserts (pana forte, chocolate fondant). The mains were not up to the same quality. The wine list is not extensive, with only a few wines available by the glass, but all bases are covered.Our waiter, Dinesh, was attentive, knowledgeable and friendly. He was a good 'un! To cap the meal, I was presented with a small cake and candle and then serenaded with a round of 'happy birthday' by a quartet of waiters, including Dinesh, AJ and Ray.A wonderful evening.One word of warning. When we arrived we were advised that we were part of the first sitting, something not mentioned when we booked. We dislike that approach, one of putting a time limit on dining out. It turned out to be inconsequential; the restaurant was not fully booked and we left at our choosing.Show less

Author: CortunefookieMelbourne, Australia
Title: Great food, lovely setting.
Review: Kabaya is set in a beautiful old building and is very elegantly decorated. Our hotel suggested it and booked it for us, so we didn't realise quite how nice it was and turned up pretty underdressed. The staff were still nothing but friendly and welcoming. There is a four course menu, where you select a starter, protein, greens, and dessert. There are dishes marked that can be prepared as vegetarian. The food was great! Really interesting Malay fusion dishes, with an emphasis on fresh, high quality ingredients. By Penang standards it is expensive, but it is still an absolute bargain for what you get. Highly recommended.Show less

Author: 412brittanyg
Title: Authentic Penang
Review: We had a wonderful 4 course meal, we decided to order things we weren’t familiar with and we weren’t disappointed. The Miang Kham of Salmon Roe is a must for the appetiser, but make sure you eat the whole thing in one bite. For main we had the grilled snapper which was delicious!! And for dessert we had the Pandan creme brûlée and the Tang Yuen (glutinous rice balls) which was my favourite dish out of them all!!! A definite must while visiting Penang!Show less

Author: tropicalg645
Title: Wonderful selection of food 🍲
Review:
What an experience it was. Really authentic Malaysian food 🍲 experience. 

Staff service has nothing to complain at all. Elegantly decorated and it's so nice. 

I would advice to make a reservation before you visit. 

A must see visit place in Penang.

Author: Nick LSydney, Australia
Title: Great food and service!!
Review: Went here for the 6pm seating and was blown away!! 4 course set meal was amazing, as was the service! Beautiful dining room, with plenty of space between tables, great pianist setting the scene for an overall night to remember. Beef dish and lamb dish were both particularly good, but everything was really. A must if in George Town!Show less

Author: Paul_R_8208
Title: Wonderful fusion of Malay and Chinese flavors in a classic atmosphere
Review: Excellent unique cocktails at the historic bar followed by an amazing meal. The ambiance was nice. The appetizers and main dishes were all very flavorful and tasty. We enjoyed everything. Great desserts too!

Author: Sarah Jane MHong Kong, China
Title: Wonderful food
Review: This was our treat night away from the amazing street food!It is a four course set meal and we had a bottle of wine with it. The hotel itself (Seven Terraces) is beautiful as is the restaurant/bar we sat in. Also it is pretty much in the heart of old Georgetown heritage site.I would recommend booking as we were lucky to get a table. There are two seatings (6pm and 8pm) so you have time to really savour the experience. There are about 4 choices of every course and I would recommend choosing different things as your friends to sample as much of the menu as possible! We loved the otak otak starter immensely - the curry dipping sauce was incredible. For the main courses we had the crispy pork, melt in your mouth beef and a variety of very tasty vegetables. The desserts were very yummy - we had the pandan creme brulee and the more local dessert (i forget the name!) of glutinous rice balls in coconut milk.Show less

Author: shumcheung
Title: One of the best meal I’ve ever had in my life!
Review: No joke! I really meant every word I said! The 4-course set dinner was absolutely perfect. Meat was so tender and juicy, vegetables are so fresh and perfectly flavoured. The restaurant is so elegantly decorated. No Complaints whatsoever!!!

Author: GourmandVKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Excellent local food in beautiful setting
Review: Every dish that we had here for dinner were super delicious, especially the beef, lamb, 4 angle bean kerabu, prawns and all the desserts! The blend of spices in each dish were superb and top notch! The decor and ambience is beautiful and service was very attentive. Note: if you are hosting a dinner for private dining, there is a noise restriction, which was a little ridiculous ("guest upstairs complained" at 10pm). Highly recommended to dine here! Vegetarian options also available upon request.Show less

Author: emsijayne87Sheffield, United Kingdom
Title: Good dessert
Review: Went to kebaya last night and had really high expectations after reading the reviews, unfortunately it didn't really live up to them. It's a lovely restaurant and the food is good but a few things let it down, first of all we were talked out of getting two of the same side dishes as they said it would be good to have something different, we wish we had gone with our initial choice as the veg tempura was lovely and the other salad thing wasn't really to our taste. Second, our main courses were given to the table next to us by mistake and we had to wait longer for one of our mains to come which meant the rest of our food was getting cold on a stand near us. No one apologized for this and it was just brushed over. The atmosphere is also lacking a little. The desserts almost made up for this though as they were delicious, my partner had the chocolate fondant and he loved it, but my pandan creme brulee was amazing, I just wish it was bigger! Cocktails are pretty tasty too. Overall it was a nice meal out but Im not sure it deserves to be number one in George Town, I've had better dining experiences elsewhere.Show less

Author: lelmazBath, United Kingdom
Title: Lovely authentic fine-dining experience
Review: I don't even know where to begin. Walking in, this restaurant brought me to the Peranakan Chinese era. Neither posh nor shabby, this restaurant was inviting from the beginning. Once the food came out, our tiresome excursion of the day was soon forgotten. Dish after dish, nobody spoke a word as we were all on a mutual acceptance of the divinity of the food. I would love to recommend my favourite dishes but I can't as all of them were splendid. I would definitely be coming back here again and again! Show less

Author: MrThingsMelbourne, Australia
Title: Good ( But maybe a bit try hard-ish )
Review: My family took me here for Fathers' Day and whilst the food was excellent, my experience was spoiled by our seating location. We were seated at the first table inside the entry door, which was unfortunately also directly opposite the courtyard door leading to the toilets. This created a chilly breeze every time someone either entered the restaurant or went to the toilet. I asked to be moved to another table within minutes of being seated and all they did was turn off the A/C units. This was the general theme for the whole night. I'd request something and we'd get a completely different outcome. Also this table location is located next to their reception / waiter station and we just ended up hearing their 'walkie-talkie' all night. ( very distracting ). As for the service, I was getting the impression that they were trying too hard to be a little more upmarket than they were. So yes...... great food, just select your seating carefully and maybe go with a local so then can translate any of your requests.Show less

Author: Boyd T
Title: Worthwhile
Review: Excellent value for money and an overall lovely experience. Staff were accommodating to my 7 month old which was appreciated.  Worthwhile if you are in Georgetown and looking for a special dining experience with ambiance.

Author: Zdravkovets
Title: Good Ambience Good Food
Review: A very tastefully done restaurant with proper service. Great place for a social and business dinner. This is not the ordinary tasty, cheap and good 'eat-and-run' place. The food is excellent. The Curried Prawns is the best.

Author: Otilio_bocadiglioBilbao, Spain
Title: The way tastings should be
Review: It was wonderful to enjoy such a restaurant in one of the gastronomic capitals of south east Asia. Even if the bar is significantly high in the city, this restaurant really stands out from the rest. Besides this, the menu modality (1 choice in each of the 3 categories per person in a close menu) allows to taste most of the traditional dishes!! Must be a mandatory stop for any "bon-vivant"!!Show less

Author: BrettnJulie
Title: The Best
Review:
Pricey compared to other restaurants but once you taste the food you certainly pay for quality. The 4 course meal was fabulous, from the entrée to finally desert all plates were fantastic.
Service was great.... thanks for a great evening

Author: Khem CBangkok, Thailand
Title: A Fine Dinning Peranakan Food
Review: Peranakan cuisine mixes between local Malay and Strait Chinese settlement. it is good to give a try, especially if you have a special occasion. The cuisine comes by 4-5 courses which can be shared. Sharing food is the normal practice in Asia. Setting in the nice decorating Peranakan house and be part of beautiful boutique hotel, Seven Terraces, dinning here is not just only for food but it is an experience. Cocktails from nearby bar, Baba Bar is sufficient for cooling your hot day and imagine to be in British Colonial time. Wine list here is amazingly good. Affordable but do not expect to get those expensive bluff wines here. Somehow I feel that they already selected the nice wines to pair with food here.Kindly reserve in advance because the seating is limited.Show less

Author: Wendy KKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: The best fine dining Peranakan food we have had in Malaysia.
Review: This is a must-do - the food is definitely five star. You could see the delight on the faces of the diners - and the sighs when they tasted something delicious. I'd go as far as saying that this is one of the best restaurants we have eaten in.The restaurant itself is beautifully decorated in the peranakan style and it is a joy to be in it - the tasting menu was incredibly well balanced and everything was cooked to perfection.One piece of advice... if you see the Pandan Creme Brulee on the dessert list - order it! I'm not usually a fan of pandan as I think it can overpower but this was incredible. It's converted me ... and got me looking up recipes to see if I can try making it at home. The people next to us saw us exclaiming about it and ordered it themselves and agreed immediately it was the best thing ever. We often come up to Penang and this will always be on our list. Can't recommend it highly enough.Show less

Author: Sascha KGermany
Title: Give it a try...
Review: The 4 course set menu is recommendable, even though I would't call a side dish a course, but nevertheless good food even though on the pricey side compared to what you can get on the street of Georgetown. But hey, life is too short for bad wine... Show less

Author: MOBrien1907Port Douglas, Australia
Title: Most amazing atmosphere, food and service
Review: We first dined at Kabaya last year on our first trip to Penang. It was amazing then, and even better second, and third time around.We stayed at the Seven Terraces Hotel, where Kabaya is located, and dined there on two of our three nights there.Decorated in the Peranakan style the restaurant is extremely grand. After fantastic cocktails at the bar we were treated to a delicious meal of slow cooked beef-cheek and porkbelly on the first night and slow cooked lamb-shank and duck on the second. Wines are reasonably priced, and a number are by the glass. Outstanding!!!The staff are lovely and very attentive.This is an experience not to be missed!Show less

Author: Kim BMilford, Massachusetts
Title: Understand why the top rating in Georgetown!!!!!
Review: Our local business hosts took us here for our last evening in Penang. Wow! The food was delicious and glad that we were able to try several appetizers along with the entrees. The desserts were so yummy and beautifully presented....happy they were a small size as there is so much food during the three course meal.The room is beautifully decorated along with the hotel public areas behind the restaurant. There was also someone playing piano during our visit, which was a nice touch.Show less

Author: FionaB2006Melbourne, Australia
Title: Divine Nyonga Dining in Georgetown
Review: We had the most delightful dining experience at Kebaya. We were referred by a friend on Facebook who noticed we were in Georgetown and suggested this venue. I'm so glad he did as my partner and I had the most exquisite evening. Our waiter Ray, made sure we were well looked after and regaled us with the story behind the Indian Ganesh festival that was taking place that evening.We shared duck, fish with turmeric sauce, tempura veggies and braised Asian vegetables wth a panacotta and fascinating blue dessert. The decor is Peranakan, or Chinese Straits influenced strongly by the homelands of the Chinese migrants but with influence from the Malays that they inter-married with. A really genteel and divine setting. We could easily have been sitting there 100 years ago eating the same food with same ambience, same silverware and divine blue ceramic crockery. And did I tell you the food was out of this world? Well it was.Show less

Author: HKEuropeantravelerHong Kong, China
Title: Very nice restaurant even with kids
Review: The food was excellent, the portions were perfect.We came with 2 daughters of 3 years old and 5 months old. Staff was nice and efficient. Food was served at the right pace. We didn't order anything for our daughter and she just shared our food (they had no complain at all and gave her rice).The venue is nice and well decorated. Some explanation about the building would have been nice.I recommend.Show less

Author: 330daphnelHong Kong, China
Title: Try once....
Review: Food was good but service could be improved. Email confirmation suggested us to go early n sit at bar for drinks n will be seated when table ready. When we walked in got the coldest reception ever. After staying in another boutique hotel where staff were like family yet professional, warm and friendly the staff at Seven Terraces and Kebaya were cold. Things improved slightly after we were seated at table. Service improved and staff attitude improved. Food was served promptly. Food was good but not the best we had in George town.
