We preferred another place we went. Food taste is catered more for foreigners. Place deco was interesting.Show less

Author: Ben HHong Kong, China
Title: Yummy.com!!!
Review: A perfect balance of flavors, decor, service and history all in one place. My suggestion is that go with a few people and select different items from the set menu. You will not go wrong. The duck was juicy yet flavor packed. The sauces from all the dishes were great and taste best when mixed with stream plain rice.Don't eat too much rice, it took up space for dessert. Do make the time to talk to the staff, they are lovely. Show less

Author: Chloe D
Title: Fine dining, done right!
Review: This place is amazing from the moment you walk in the door. The staff great you with warm smiles. The food oh my, every dish was perfected I cannot fault this place. Thank you!!!

Author: iainmcleodMid Calder, United Kingdom
Title: What a treat
Review: We stumbled across this when having a wander so didn't realise it was linked to the swish hotel. You enter from a back street and it was a revelation. As a family of 5 this became a big treat. Elegant lay out 4 course ( tho vegetable choice is 1 of 4) for 120myr a head. Access to courtyard when you go to toilet. We love cheap tasty streetfood but this was sophisticated fusion food that went down a storm. WowShow less

Author: LissC0011
Title: Beautiful food and setting
Review: The food was amazing the the ambience of the piano playing in the back ground was a fantastic touch. Stunning. Would highly recommend!!

Author: Von1955
Title: So good
Review: Elegant setting for a superb meal.  The historical building sets the scene for great service and fantastic food.

Author: Ritakoo
Title: An enjoyable evening with friends.
Review: Been to Kebaya a couple of times. Food and service are consistently good. Always enjoyed the ambiance too.

Author: yolandaz565Lake Villa, Illinois
Title: Months later I still think of it ....
Review: I still think of the elegant treatment, piano playing, beautiful serving dishes, imported Australian wine, ambiance of the grounds and the amazing flavors of the food. Timing, process, etiquette and food was done greater than expected. We asked the manager to order our meal and gave dietary expectations (1/2 of meal not to be seafood) and everything was more delicious then I could have imagined. This would be my teams number one spot when we return. Show less

Author: John C
Title: Fusion food of the highest quality
Review: One of the best meals we have had. An exciting and very interesting blend of flavours. The red snapper in particular was spectacular. Reasonably priced as long as you stay away from wine. Tea goes really well with the dishes.

Author: simone6789Melbourne, Australia
Title: Stunning restaurant, refined Nyonya cuisine
Review: Highly recommend this stunning restaurant, especially if you've never had traditional Nyonya cuisine before. Admittedly the dishes are a bit less spicy than usual Nyonya standards, but everything was still delicious. I've been a few times over the last couple of years, and have each time ordered the set menu. It's a bit pricey for local standards, but it's worth it.Show less

Author: craigjacqueline
Title: The best Chinese fusion
Review:
We had a fabulous meal , the food was delicious very well presented and the service was outstanding.
We will highly recommended the place.
Booking is request.
Excellence prices for a fine dining experience.

Author: thamfeliciaSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good quality of foog
Review: Very good quality of food. They only offer 4 course set dinner menu at RM120 per pax for walk in customer. Al-la Cart available for in-house guest and small kids. The portion of food is reasonably big. We order the snapper and duck confit and they were fantastic. I also like their tang yuan and pie tee. Do make reservation as it's quite packShow less

Author: Victoria Vlahov L
Title: Amazing
Review: An amazing range of food.  Could not fault this restaurant.  Would go back without hesitation.  Wine selection was great.  A little treasure hidden in the back streets of George Town

Author: 808tknSingapore, Singapore
Title: Indeed A Great Restaurant ...
Review: Call a day earlier to make dinner reservation and she explained in details about the 2 seating per table arrangement. At the restaurant the staff were excellent in explaining the menu ..... the food were just magical and also quite a big serving too. Taste really good, nice presentation ... honestly not to expensive .Will come back Show less

Author: highman14Nottingham
Title: Beautiful surrondings
Review: A haven of calm and sophistication on a very hot evening.Attentive staff and interesting menu , although we were not keen on choosing all courses including sweet altogether. The starter & sweet were gorgeous but the main courses lacked the same attention..... Particularly the prawn curry and lamb shoulder.Overall a nice evening , we felt thoroughly spoilt .Show less

Author: GaryC4449Bangkok, Thailand
Title: Double standard
Review: Heard this is the best peranakan or nyonya cuisine in penang. Invited by friend to try this out, initial feel this is a good restaurent as it nicely setup in a heritage building. However, start to feel different once the ordering process compare to the next table (visitor from others country) start n become worst right at the end of our 4 course meal as we are ask to leave the place although we are still chatting n about to order another bottle of wine. We though spend too much time in dining but the fact it was just around 2hrs, we also look around the next table n surprise to see they still can enjoy good time after the meal.In summary: good setup, good food quality, poor service and over price.Show less

Author: KPinHKHong Kong, China
Title: Wonderful meal. Plenty of food and beautiful location.
Review: The meal at Kebaya was outstanding. There are two seating a night and a set menu, with options to choose from 4 courses. The dining room is gorgeous down to the plating. Because there are 2 settings, people are eating en masse, so the service is not the same as in a restaurant with staggered reservations. I don't mean that it's bad, it's just a different set up. That said, the staff was extremely friendly, and came around to check in, and offer more rice - for example. You will not leave on an empty stomach and I don't think you can go wrong with any of the options on the menu. Highly recommended. I would definitely go back if I'm in Penang again.Show less

Author: Hailsk2411
Title: Fabulous food and service
Review: This was a delightful restaurant! Firstly I emailed to make a reservation. And had a response the same evening for the next day! When I arrived I advised I had a nut allergy a they advised what I could and couldn't order off the menu. The staff were brilliant and very kind! The food was tasty and the lamb feel off the bone! I would definitely eat here again when I'm next in Penang! Show less

Author: 243robertagMelbourne, Australia
Title: Excellent food and service
Review: For us it's always going to be a special place because that's the restaurant where we got engaged. The food was great and the service as well. They have an amazing menu for vegetarians and vegans! The staff members are so kind and I'd like to thank them again for making everything perfect :) We will come back on our next visit to Penang! Show less

Author: angely_angelSingapore, Singapore
Title: Best meal in Penang
Review: Though slightly expensive, it's worth every cent! Food served was of high quality and left us in awe! Ambience was great especially for a night with your soulmate. We went there with kids and went to the courtyard for a walk but kept being hushed by one of the staffs. Constantly reminding us to keep our volume down as the guests are resting. If I'm a guest at the hotel I would totally appreciate that I get my peace and quiet, however, after a while it's just too stressful to keep hushing our kids in the courtyard, so we left after swallowing our desserts. Couldnt take the time to enjoy it I guess. It would be nice if the staffs helped to entertain the kids with some pre-packed activities or some sort rather than keep hushing at them to be quiet. Not a must, but would be nice.Anyway, that doesnt affect my view on how good the food were. The food's really great!Show less

Author: 841sw
Title: Kebaya Restaurant, Seven Terraces
Review:
Highly recommended. Would definitely go again.
Food: Excellent
Atmosphere: Excellent
Service: Excellent
Price: Not cheap, but not unreasonable.

Author: KAYmarie16Bangkok, Thailand
Title: Spot on
Review: Amazing first night in George Town spent here. The set menu deal is an absolute bargain and we experienced great Malaysian French Asian fusion food. The setting and ambience is lovely and well worth you checking this beautiful restaurant out - make a reservation, it's worth it.Show less

Author: LinusNgNewton, Australia
Title: Fusion peranakan dinner in a stunning setting
Review: Enjoyed a delish dinner at Kebaya. Stunningly beautiful peranakan highlights throughout. Food was a lovely fusion of local delicacies with some inspiration drawn from the wider south east asia region including ban xeo and miang kham. Loved the pie tee for entree, chicken kapitan for mains and the kerabu for vegetables.Show less

Author: sueanne MCanberra, Australia
Title: Exquisite meal in elegant surrounds.
Review: Located within the Seven Terraces on Lorong Stewart, Kebaya is a Chinese fine dining restaurant featuring a four course menu for $120 RM. PP. The restaurant has an excellent wine list to accompany the traditional Chinese cuisine. The dining room is elegantly decorated with ancient plates, and a pianist provided background music and ambiance. The service was friendly and the staff knowledgeable about the food and menu. HIGHLY RECOMMENDED.Show less

Author: eatmyhatLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Food awesome - small tweaks needed.
Review: We were also guests at the hotel within which the restaurant sits. So the feedback here is within that context. And, also, as the number 1 place to eat/drink in George Town: you gotta be able to take the good with the bad, right!We booked easily for the 8pm sitting and came to the bar at 7.30pm for a cocktail.The drinks menu is A4 paper landscape printed both sides and curling and stained. Get some decent menus printed that match the status of the place. Make them look pretty and classy, not tatty!Similarly, the specials menu (curly piece of paper, paper clipped into the main menu) lets the place down.The staff are very friendly and food AWESOME!But...let me be clear...someone needs to be more firmly in charge. All the waiting staff seemed to be rushing around doing everything, like a busy cafe.One waiter to three tables max. Quiet presence, predicting the clients' needs would be much better and calmer. We spoke to no less than six waiting staff. That is unnecessary.All that said, ambience and food lovely. But I think it probably needs a shake up. Change the menu. Give the place a shake. It feels like it may have become a little complacent with its position.We would eat here again.Show less

Author: 5771jasonyc
Title: Great dinner outing with friends
Review: We fell in love with the place as soon as we walked in to the courtyard. Awesome place, great ambience. Love the decor.

Author: Sue_kkhSingapore, Singapore
Title: Excellent Peranakan food in antique setting
Review: We had the pleasure of having dinner at Kebaya during our trip to Penang. Food was remarkably tasty. When one hears of Peranakan food with a modern twist, one might think.. i would rather have the authentic food. But be pleasantly surprised. 4 course dinner consisting of starter, greens and main course followed by dessert. Great service and waiters highly trained. 7 terraces manager Robert came by to have a chat. Friendly chap. Show less

Author: SeacroftKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Kool Kebaya
Review: This is a return visit to a very cook establishment. We went a year ago for my birthday and returned last week as we were so impressed with our first tasting. Again the set menu selection was excellent although I do agree with my wife that the food does need to be spiced up or else it is in danger of becoming a little too bland. Still the Thai soft shell crab salad was excellent as was the grilled snapper. Really loved the Nonya tempura vegetables. And as the restaurant in the beautiful China house offers a completely separate vegetarian menu it met all our needs for a vegetarian guest. NOW the big disappointment was the really long wait for the dessert. I am talking about 45 minutes plus. We had to ask the waiting staff and manageress at least three times about the whereabouts of our desserts. IT was obviously the chocolate fondant ( which was superb when it finally arrived) that was causing the problem. No offer of a discount just some complementary coffee - poor service recovery we all thought. And left a bit of a sour taste at the end of what could have been a superb evening.Show less

Author: Christopher SPerth, Australia
Title: Secret Seduction !
Review: From the moment we entered the restaurant ..... without a booking,,,,,, we were treated like family. The exceptional level of serivce by Brian, Sheila, AJ and the team was personalised to a level that made the evening 'special' (as was the cuisine) without feeling in any way obtrusive. 'The whole package presented by the Kebaya is a credit to all involved.As we later found out, the Kebaya was a reflection of the 7 Terraces Hotel, where the eye for style, finesse and commitment to detail by the owner Christopher Ong and his team would be hard to surpass in this ever frenetic world of 'expediency'.Both establishments are to be highly recommended ...... havens for the discerning !Show less

Author: RB_Bob_44
Title: Great chinese fusion food.
Review: The Kebaya is located in the Seven Terraces Hotel, where we stayed. I'm not a big foodie, but the food was great and the service was low key but flawless.

Author: Nordeukmelbourne
Title: Tantalising flavours: ezquisite diversity
Review: We were taken to this restaurant by local friends who wanted us to sample Peranakan food. What a feast we were served. From the set menu we each chose different entrees, vegetables, main course and desert.All were beautifully presented and laid out for us to share. The unique flavours, unusual blends and complex dishes made for a most memorable meal.Although this was an early sitting, we were not hurried along by the pleasant staff. Our only concern was that there was too much to eat and we reluctantly had to forego some of the delicious dishes.I suggest you also take the time to look at the downstairs area of the meticulously restored Seven Terraces Hotel in which the restaurant is located.It is hard to find parking nearby.Show less

Author: vishnu350
Title: The flavours were just awesome.
Review: Never tasted anything this good, seriously. Maybe it is the fresh ingredients, I don't know. Went for vegetarian sets with a couple of friends. Their desserts were special, they were basically traditional desserts with an Asian touch. Will definitely be coming back.

Author: Craig PSouth Australia, Australia
Title: Elegant and enjoyable the best dining experience we have had in years
Review: Outstanding from the moment we walked in the door , we were greeted and seated with friendly efficiency .The menu was described and instructions were given on how to maximise the variety and therefore enjoyment of the tastes being offered .The structure ,heritage architecture, furniture and overall style of the restaurant all combine to create a beautiful environment in which you can enjoy superb dishes .Four of us dined together sampling a total of fourteen different dishes , all of which were enjoyable and generally excellent .Presentation was outstanding service was prompt and very friendly .Portions were very generous and I smiled as I happily paid the bill .overall an exceptional night of great food and attentive friendly service , cannot pick fault with Kebaya and cannot wait to return .Thank you and well doneShow less

Author: LawrenceSeng
Title: A wonderful work of cuisine fusion
Review:
A beautifully decorated restaurant that serves top notch Peranakan & western cuisine; 

Clearly the results of the chef's hard labor, the fusion cuisine never disappoints in my every visit.

Author: Kieran11Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Superb food in a wonderful environment
Review: Food - awesome Service - excellent Ambience - very good This Restuarant delivers in all aspects - exquisite food accompanied by excellent service - the wonderful flavours created are indeed up there with the finest cuisine in Malaysia - would hesitate to recommend this place. Bring your appetiteShow less

Author: Michael KPeterborough, United Kingdom
Title: Elegant dining in George Town
Review: After a week of street food Kebaya restaurant was a welcome change. The dining room of the Seven Terraces is cool in every sense of the word. Elegant decor with gorgeous antiques, beautiful table settings, and professional, well trained staff . The wine list is good and reasonably priced for Penang, especially in a restaurant of this quality. Our guide book told us to expect a set dinner but in fact you choose a set number of courses from a varied menu at an inclusive set price. Quality of the dishes was excellent and service was attentive without being intrusive. Spicyness of the food was restrained and if you are looking for firey flavours this is not the place but then there are plenty other options in Penang to get your taste buds singed.For a refined meal of high quality in an elegant setting this is probably the best option in George Town.Show less

Author: robertfrancisl
Title: Upmarket restaurant a little disappointing
Review: We were recommended to eat at this upmarket restaurant. The food is good and plentiful. The staff were very attentive at first but a little lacking in attention towards the end of our meal. Paying the bill was a little confronting and rushed.

Author: rhiannon83
Title: Gorgeous, classy, delicious!
Review: Amazing, fresh, beautiful food, for a very reasonable cost considering the quality. Definitely a must-dine in Georgetown!

Author: AlphablackNewcastle, UK
Title: Good food in lovely surroundings
Review: The food was good, no doubt about that, but fell short of superb. The starters came quickly and the staff were very helpful and attentive, explaining each dish and how to eat it (which dip/sauce etc). The mains were fairly tasty, but just didn't astonish - perhaps we had too high an expectation. We had a re snapper (large portion) which was cooked to perfection but bland, and a pork sous-vide, which was tiny but more flavoursome. Hot tip 2: book, especially at weekends!Hot tip 2: you can bring your own wine for a small (RM30) corkage fee.Show less

Author: gmunroSydney, Australia
Title: Recommended but still surprised
Review: We were recommended by friends who raved about Kebaya but even despite their comments we were very pleasantly surprised.The greeting & seating process was warm and very professional.Dinesh, our waiter, explained the process of the meal and responded eloquently when asked about his preferences. We agreed on the 2 entres but when we selected the daily special, red duck curry, he changed his main recommendations to compliment our selection. The ordering process was easy & informative thanks to Dinesh.The meal itself was a surprise and very enjoyable.The service we received was comprehensive but not intrusive. At one stage we had four waiters attending to out needs, very professionally.The restaurant is simply decorated in the tradtional peranekan style with some beautiful antique. There was a pianist who played beautifully but did not intrude on the table conversation.Enjoyed ourselves so much we are going back next week!Show less

Author: cornell5
Title: Not quite perfect
Review:
This is an upmarket fine dining restaurant. Beautifully restored.
Initial service on arrival was welcoming and professional. The food was interesting and tasty, but not outstanding. The table was cluttered once all the dishes were served. The service once the mains were served was ordinary.

Author: JoDellaSpadaZurich, Switzerland
Title: Stylish dining, high quality food, friendly atmosphere.
Review: The Kebaya offers four courses for 120 MYR per person. You choose a starter, a protein course, greens and a desert. As we were in six we ordered all different kinds of dishes and were absolutely happy with the quality and the combination of flavours. There are excellent wines, but the Malbec we ordered was just a bit too warm in temperature. With the desert we had a good Chinese tea. What impressed us was the interior design of the Kabaya. It's fairly traditional. The piano player and the sound of the milling of the coffee machine makes you feel like in ancient times. We can highly recommend this place and hope we'll have the chance to get there again when we'll be in GeorgeTown next. Show less

Author: shouldisayitLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Amazing classy setting with amazing food
Review: We dined as a family of four (with two children under 7) for two consecutive nights. The restaurant is part of the Seven Terraces Hotel - a heritage building that has been restored to it sumptuous former glory. A truly amazing setting that spans the width of seven terraced houses. The staff were friendly and attentive. A pianist plays tirelessly throughout the evening. Excellent service at a very reasonable price for what you get. A classy venue. The restaurant offers a set menu for you to choose from. For two adults we had to select: 2 starters, 2 protein (main course), 2 vegetable (sides), and two desserts. We saw a lone diner presumably ordering for 1 from the set menu. The food is best described as being Asian fusion. The outstanding mains for me were: crab salad which was spicy and delicious; and the roast organic pork which came in big mini steak chunks with the most amazing crackling. We stuck with the same desserts for both visits: the pandan cream brûlée was rich with the right amount of caramelised sugar on top; the mochi filled with local sugar in coconut milk was light and perfect. Truly delicious food. At one end of the restaurant is the bar. We only had soft drinks but it looked as though the bar could produce some quality cocktails. Would definitely return to Kebaya if we come back to Georgetown.Show less

Author: Bernice DBrisbane
Title: a magical evening of culinary delight
Review: The E & O HOTEL where we were staying recommended Kebaya Restaurant situated at Lorong Stewart in World Heritage George Town Penang and we are so pleased they did, although a warning here: Having developed an excellent reputation that even with two sittings each evening, 6p.m. and 8p.m. if you don't book well in advance you will be lucky to get a table. From the moment you enter the beautiful designed interior with its white mosaic tile floors, intricate carved antique furnishings and vases filled with glorious displays of white Orchids and blue fuchsias, the friendly and helpful head waitress waiting to greet you, you know you are in for a treat. And we were not disappointed. The decor is beautiful without being overly so, the staff are fantastic and the food..... is absolutely divine. A beautiful and perfect mix of Indo-Chinese infused with French seasonal cooking flavours. It isn't a cheap by Penang Standards where the Malaysian Ringgit is about a third of the Australian dollar and where everything (apart from French Champagne) is very cheap, for instance we never paid any more than the equivalent of two to four Australian dollars for a taxi! They serve a three course fixed menu with many options and we paid 120 Ringgits Malaysian each - the equivalent of about Au.$40 each. Its the same price whether you decide on one, two or three courses. And of course this doesn't include a glass of wine or two.We liked the look of everything on the menu and with so much to choose from let our waiter decide for us. She didn't disappoint. Everything was mouth watering and perfect . If not sure what you should try let the waiter give you an idea or two, it will be worth it. It would be an awful mistake if when next in Penang we don't visit the kebaya Restaurant. In fact it will be one of the first restaurants we will book well in advance .Show less

Author: 318lindsaya
Title: Pretty good
Review: Service and pianist were fantastic. King Prawn curry 9/10. Stay away from the snapper puffy things in the entree, was the only thing that let the meal down. Will be back to roll the dice on another entree soon.

Author: Lauren RHamilton, United Kingdom
Title: Delicious
Review: A beautifully decorated restaurant with friendly staff, lovely atmosphere and excellent food. Each of the courses we had were all delicious, two of us ate here and we ordered something different for each course so that we could try more things. The real stand out of the show was the Red Snapper Curry, was one of the best things we have ate in our life, and that is not a joke. I wish I could get it here. The Pandan creme brulee was also a real highlight. We went to the 8pm serving and were not rushed in the slightest. Each meal was a good portion size too, so you could enjoy all of them without feeling too full.Show less

Author: Boadicea-1954
Title: Delicious Nyonya food
Review: Gorgeous surroundings and well trained staff added to the pleasure of an enjoyable dinner. Reservations are essential to ensure a table.

Author: MaksmumMelbourne, Australia
Title: Wonderful meal and service
Review: This was a wonderful experience. The food is great with enough choices to make it hard to decide. Everything we had was fabulous with a variety of spices and combinations which were interesting and delicious. The service was great with one waiter even bringing us an uncooked vegetable so we could see what it looked like before the kitchen had prepared it. The cost is expensive for Penang but perfectly reasonable for what you get. Portion sizes were geared so that you could get through all the courses without feeling ill. Environment was also delightful. Great restaurant.Show less

Author: ozallanSydney, Australia
Title: Great Local Cuisine
Review: We had a private room in the "library" for a pre-wedding dinner. The food was a variety of local dishes which were all very delicious. Nice decor but the service could have been a bit better. Overall though well worth a visit to taste great Malay food.Show less

Author: AngelMom69
Title: Beautiful Restaurant
Review: Love the ambience. Delicious mains. The only thing that my friend and I were not too keen on was the starters. I guess our palate are not used to peranakan fusion food. Some dishes are just meant to be kept authentic.

Author: David HGeelong
Title: What a dining experince
Review: Tucked away within the remark you restored seven terraces, this little gem is a must to try whilst discovering the food delights of GeorgetownRemarkable ambience, tantalising food, over all a true Malaysian experience Indulge yourself with many of the dishes from the comprehensive menu, try them all you will be going back for more This place has two sittings ... 6-00 pm and 8.00 pm. I'd recommend the eight so your not rushedShow less

Author: PalmytaffParaparaumu, New Zealand
Title: Impressive food, atmosphere and setting
Review: Good selection of foods within the set menu, an incredible location and attentive staff make this a true foody experience. Expensive by Malay standards but very reasonable given the quality of the food and experience by western standards. Highly recommend. (Beer is reasonably priced, wine list is short and expensive, but this is Malaysia - what did you expect??)Show less

Author: Pyecombe
Title: Fine dining albeit at a price too match: a place for special occasions
Review:
If you want a real dining experience with beautifully prepared and impeccably served food then Kebaya is the venue.
It was by some distance the most expensive meal we had in Penang but it was worth it.

Author: Norma H
Title: A must!
Review: Hands down this is my favorite restaurant in George Town.  Every time I come I eat there. Love the vegetable tempura and the prawn curry. Do come. Beautiful restaurant.  Attentive service.  Amazing food.

Author: B2006HCmarkwMelbourne, Australia
Title: Lovely atmosphere, disappointing food
Review: It was probably always going to be hard for a place in the food capital of Malaysia to live up to the hype of being the most original and good. Sure, the ambiance is excellent; however, the wine list is poor for a fine dining establishment. The entrees were good-ish and desert very good (especially the pandam brulee), but the mains were seriously uninspired (a chinese duck dish you could get better on the street and a roast pork dish in search of something .... ). Nothing dreadful , but take away the atmosphere of the building and it is not really worth the money for the food.Show less

Author: JolenelfcSingapore, Singapore
Title: Lovely Peranakan cuisine in a heritage building
Review: A Friend highly recommended the restaurant just as I was leaving for Penang for a short break. Seeing we had no firm plans, decided to try it on our first night in Penang. The restaurant is part of the Seven Terraces, a heritage hotel group of 7 properties. The decor is distinctly Peranakan but the cuisine is surprising modern. The menu is a 4 course meal at RM120+ person. We are to select one item from appetisers, main course, green and desserts. As there were 4 of us, we each chose something different from each of the category and so ended up with a wide selection covering almost the whole menu. It was absolutely delicious! We love the Miang Kham of Salmon Roe for the appetiser. It's a betel nut leaf on which were placed with toasted coconut, shrimps, lime, cashew and salmon roe. Put the whole thing into your mouth and chew - it's a burst of flavour that is so surprisingly pleasing!The other dishes in the main and greens were delicious too. All with a modern twist. Love the Tang Yuen - which I didn't choose but was recommended by the service staff. It's glutinous rice ball served with a warm coconut broth with slices of fresh coconut flesh - heavenly.Although at RM120+, it is rather costly, but the quality of the food and the beauty of the restaurant made it a worthy holiday treat!Show less

Author: BabyBijouBangkok, Thailand
Title: Lovely food, lovely setting, incompetent service
Review: Delicious, creative, accessible food. Service leaves much to be desired... Friendly but not aligned with the quality of food. They tried to charge us for two glasses of champagne totaling 100 USD, so be sure to check your bull. Recommend: pork bun appetizer, duck and beef mains, crème brûlée and panna cotta desserts. Show less

Author: LoungerLondonDorking, United Kingdom
Title: Beautiful Room Superb Food
Review: So glad we ate here on one of our 2 nights in Penang. Set Menu consists of appetiser, main course, greens and dessert for approx £25 each which is expensive for this part of the world, but the food was unbelievably good. Lots of choice for each of the courses and they recommend that you get different courses so you can share - great idea as everything was so delicious. Wonderful service from our two Sri Lankan waiters (lots of chat about cricket!), perfect ambience and surroundings to die for. Shared a bottle of the house red which was lovely. Hard to find but you must must find it if you fancy a luxury meal with fresh produce and subtle flavourings in wonderful surroundings.Show less

Author: grahamc847
Title: Great food and ambience
Review:
We had a delightful meal last night.
Sheila and Denish were very helpful.
Sheila gave us a tour of the hotel's facilities which was much appreciated. 
Hope to one day stay in the one of 14 suites.
Karen and Graham 
Melbourne

Author: 585rolfbGrand Rapids, Michigan
Title: Quality Nyonya dinner in historical environment
Review: Enjoyed a great dinner with very tasty and nicely presented dishes. All dishes were of exceptional quality not yet experienced at another restaurant in Penang. The interior design of the dinning room and the use of classic china ware (blue & whites and Nyonya design) creates a memorable atmosphere of local culture. The staff is very friendly and may offer you a quick look at the adjacent courtyard and the hotel lobby.Show less

Author: Mojopin66Melbourne, Australia
Title: A good introduction to nyonya food
Review: This is a lovely space to try some nyonya cuisine. Note that the menu is a 4 course dinner, which I felt was very good value for money coming from Australia. The service was attentive and the ambience of the restaurant was lovely. It is part of the Seven Terraces hotel. At one point we were even given a free tour of the hotel, which is very boutique and chic. The food itself was delicious and fresh – if there are two of you, get different things so that you can try more variety. Show less

Author: J0hnnyG13Brisbane, Australia
Title: Superb
Review: We'd heard good things from any of our friends who'd visited before, so it had to be on the list for our first visit to Penang. And it was sensational. Great wine list, simply laid out. Good range of food. We loved all our starters and mains. Stand outs included the chicken starter in little taco shells and the pork and beef mains. A passionfruit panna cotta was the taste sensation of the desserts, all lovely. Wonderful to share such food with friends in a beautiful building with gorgeous decor and super service, a big shout out to Sheila! Show less

Author: Drivers22Poole, United Kingdom
Title: Lovely building and atmosphere.
Review: We enjoyed most of our food and found it to be exceptional. The tastes were great and the presentation amazing. The only dish that we were disappointed with was the beef with tamarind which was almost inedible due to the texture of the sauce. The wine was also very good. The service again was friendly, attentive and helpful. You must have a good look around the hotel when you are there, as the building is amazing, especially when you see what state it was in before the renovation! This is an expensive restaurant for Penang but definitely worth a visit. The menu is a fixed price menu but with a reasonable selection of courses.Show less

Author: cclyeGeorge Town, Malaysia
Title: Good and creative nyonya food
Review: I have read many nice reviews on this place. My parents and brother had been here some time ago; they loved the food in the first visit. We all enjoyed the food this time too.Let me start with the ambience - very nice restored Georgetown pre-war houses. A nice air well separate the dining room from the hotel/ residences. Good place for photography.We tried 3 starters: pork mantou, Kebaya man xeo, and otak-otak. All were yummy finger food. For mains, we ordered selection of 10 dishes among them grilled chicken kapitan, hong bak lamb, organic roast pork, grilled snapper, prawn geng, loh ark, and another 4 greens to go with steamed rice. For desserts, we tried all 5 dishes - good but not out of this world.Service was attentive and prompt. Not sure how some of the other reviewers experienced such poor service here.Show less

Author: Lloyd HUnited Kingdom
Title: Beautiful Setting and Lovely Food
Review: We treated ourselves to dinner here for our anniversary and weren't disappointed. The setting is stunning and the the atmosphere one of elegant dining. The food was inventive and refined to match the beautiful surroundings, and served in surprisingly generous portions. I see other diners have had problems with the service, but this simply was not our experience. Service was attentive but relaxed and food arrived well-paced. Staff were quick to top up iced water, and offer additional rice with our main courses. We felt the wine offering didn't really justify the high prices, but I guess this is normal for Malaysia. We were very happy to drink beer and tea which went perfectly with the food and both were fairly priced. It's certainly true that by local standards this is not a cheap dining option, but by international standards it is very good value for the level of cooking and the overall elegant atmosphere. On other nights we loved the frenetic atmosphere and delicious food of the hawker stalls for a fraction of the price, but if you want the treat of a more refined dining experience I would highly recommend Kabaya.Show less

Author: Merinda_angel
Title: Excellent services ❤️Delicious food ❤️ Elegance place
Review: Been in penang many times, and just want to try if any good restaurant that i never been. And found this restaurant with good rating in tripadvisor, and from the picture was so nice too. Then we give a try and found it superb, we love the food , the place itself, so unique, classic and elegance. The staff was very friendly, all of them. After first visit then last nite we come again with our dear friends. We all love the food. As we are 6 , then we have chance to try other food that we dont order before. As all of sharing. Surely will come back again if we come to penang. One of the Best restaurant in penang ❤️ Keep up the good work Show less

Author: SurreyRoamerSurrey
Title: overrated
Review: Service on the evening we went was shockingly bad. There seemed to be nobody in charge; despite repeated requests to find out what had happened to our food, our starters arrived after 45 minutes and had to be sent back as they were cold. As the courses started to arrive, it was clear that there was more confusion about the cooking than fusion. The limited wine list was curious in its choices and outrageous in its prices. There are lots of good places to eat in George Town; don’t waste your time and money here because they don’t know what they are doing.Show less

Author: Worldtreader1Cancun, Mexico
Title: I Don't Get It
Review: I hope they just had a bad day when we went ! The food was mediocre, the problem was the service. SLOW, and I mean slow, we waited about 10 minutes for our drinks order, OK fine. The main course was about a 45 minute wait, not exaggerating, totally unacceptable.The staff were huddling together like Keystone Kops, confused and doing nothing.There were not many tables filled as we arrived early, no excuse there.Best we had in Georgetown was Mews Cafe, excellent.Show less

Author: LongDrivesWashington DC, District of Columbia
Title: Fusion Cuisine in an Elegant Space
Review: We enjoyed Kebaya the other night. The food is inspired by Peranakan cuisine, but this is not a culinary museum and the chef draws from local tradition and very high quality ingredients, both local and imported, to create a fine dining experience. We appreciated the choices on offer and in particular loved the red snapper and duck dishes. The staff was very attentive. The setting is grand -- beautiful antiques and serving ware. The goal is to create a particular mood, through both cuisine and setting, and Kebaya was successful at this. Look, if you want to bring your toddler, if market stalls are your price point, or if you want to order a la carte, this is not your place. If you want a great meal in an elegant setting, please make a reservation for one of the two settings and enjoy.Show less

Author: John DLondon, United Kingdom
Title: I don't see what all the fuss is about
Review: I think Kebaya is a confused concept. It tries to be fine dining but I think could be considerably improved if a more flexible approach were adopted. I was not keen on having to order a set menu and would have much preferred an a la carte approach, particularly because the portion sizes were enormous and simply not appropriate for a restaurant operating a "fine dining" concept. On the other hand, the food I tried was reasonable, but certainly not spectacular given the price point.Perhaps rethink the menu and offer an a la carte option?Show less

Author: Sayhellotoworld
Title: Beautiful Place
Review: Great decor & service. The foods are somewhat between malaysian and chinese cuisines but they tasted good. Recommend the padang creme bulee.

Author: Capta1n57
Title: Happy Birthday
Review: My Wifes Birthday. We had tried to get in here before but was fully booked. We now know why. Beautiful building,adjoning Seven Terraces Hotel,Superb food,and we thought,great value too. A Must visit in Georgetown

Author: meyha
Title: Great!
Review: Been for business meeting, love the place very old yet fantastic.  Manage to look around and some wine. Perfect night for me.

Author: RoyF31Newark-on-Trent, United Kingdom
Title: Definitely number one
Review: Have experienced the delights of dining in Kabaya it is not at all surprising that it is voted number I on Tripadvisor.The place oozes character and charm with a wonderful ambience.The food is delicious and the staff delightful, friendly helpful but not intrusive.it is a set menu with plenty of choice and generous portions if your in George Town don't miss it would be my recommendation.Show less

Author: bibimoony
Title: Ghod
Review: It had a four set meal.chose two from each set.but......the toilet was to dark already.the food is excellent immmmprreeessiveeee!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

Author: Tripper1Malaysia
Title: Great Peranakan food with a modern twist
Review: Make sure you order dishes to share - the flavours are complex but wonderful.  The stewed beef in tamarind is delicious and soft; the curry kapitan was favoursome with just enough kick.  The service is attentive but not overwhelming.

Author: Patricia T
Title: A restaurant you should not miss
Review: We arrived 10 minutes earlier than our reservation time and were greeted nicely by the staff. Service was superb and food very delicious. Will definitely return next time in Penang.

Author: BillyT0313
Title: good place with good food and good services
Review: this is a over 80 years building. I love that very much. You will feel that you are back to 1930's for a dinner. Nonya food is very good with attentive staff Shirley cocktails is very suitable for food too. I have a great night with my friend and enjoy this night very much! that's why this is #1 here!Show less

Author: McCRichards
Title: peaceful and fabulous
Review: Excellent modern nonya food. We were encouraged to share all dishes and left the table fit to burst! The desserts were especially fantastic. The setting is elegant and relaxed, and wine by the glass available. Great flavours and beautiful surroundings. Good value for money.

Author: 829yannik
Title: Exquisite nyonya restaurant
Review: Excited to go here as it's number one asian fine dining restaurant in georgetown according to tripadvisor and absolutely worth the price with the food they offer and the ambience.They only offer set menu no ala carte. We choose pork man tou and kebaya ban xeo for starter and then hong bak lamb and grilled snapper for main course (the snapper tastes real nice till we finished the sauce) and for the greens we choose cher chai and wing bean kerabu (the highlight is wing bean kerabu some kind of salad with sweet sour spicy sauce and pomegranate suppa likey) and the best thing is their dessert gula melaka mousse and pandan creme brulee (pandan creme brulee taste really nice as it melt inside your mouth hmmmm) still can't move on hahaha.....So if you still think of what to eat in penang you can consider this place.Show less

Author: MMB1954Shanghai, China
Title: Excellent
Review: Wonderful restaurant with excellent food and attentive staff. We had a great evening where we shared many different platters in a beautiful location. The menu is simple and a fixed price with not a huge choice but all the dishes were delicious. The Kebaya ban xeo was amazing as was the Pork Man Too and the crispy Joe Hoo Char roll. Main courses were the organic roast pork, soft shell crab, Kebaya Tamarind beef and the prawn Feng curry....all fabulous accompanied by crispy Nonya tempura of vegetables. Deserts we shared a panacotta, chocolate fondant and the pandas crime brûlée. Been coming to Penang for many years and it has been difficult to find restaurants offering such a high level of interesting cuisine. It is located in the 7 Terraces hotel (which in itself is beautifully decorated) so gets busy and would recommend booking. Definitely worth a visit! Show less

Author: foodiegoestravelSingapore, Singapore
Title: Fine Dining with great service and ambiance
Review: Kebaya Restaurant is one of the most popular peranakan restaurants in Penang. We tried the four-course set meal and had the unique tea pairing experience. Appetizer I personally think Otak-Otak is a must to order, it's done with a western twist (it is a pleasant surprise). The 72-hour cooked beef was really delicious too. It's tender and flavorful. End the dinner with Pandan creme brulee that melts in your mouth and the French dessert infused with local Pandan leaf did have a very magical chemistry.Show less

Author: birgitreist
Title: Excellent dinner
Review:
Kebaya was one of the best dining experiences we have in a long time! The food was excellent and really special! 72 hours slow cooked beef - SO good! 
Not to mention: fantastic value for money!

Author: MelS377Werribee, Australia
Title: Nice but overpriced
Review: We went to this resturant with high hopes but came out feeling cheated. Do not understand how this can be rated #1 in Penang considering the amazing food Penang has to offer. The food is very nice however not worth the 125RM price tag.The drinks are extremely overpriced, 25RM for sparkling water.All up for 2 we paid 500RM also including 4 drinks between us.Don't mind paying that amount of money for a nice meal and a great experience, however we came out still hungry and underwhelmed with service provided by the staff. We were not asked once how our meals were and we were pushed into ordering our food in a hurry. The beef and red snapper were lovely but the starters and desserts were tiny.Most certainly will not go back, would not reccomend to my family and friends unless they felt like being over charged for some nice food.Show less

Author: Virginia R
Title: Over hyped and not very good
Review: I was disappointed with this fixed menu restaurant. The choices were not great as many of the dishes were in batter. They were not flexible at all as we wanted some time between the courses and were promised this if we ordered everything at the same time which we didn't want to do. Sure enough everything came out almost immediately. The surroundings are beautiful but I have had better food from my local take away and certainly hotter in temperature. The hawker stands are brilliant in Penang and it is hard to compete with such fresh and wonderfully spiced dishes. I recommend the Redgarden.Show less

Author: Brooke M
Title: Best meal in Penang
Review: Of all the meals I had in Penang, this was the best. Every dish I tried was delicious. The decor was beautiful with a sophisticated atmosphere. The service left nothing to be desired.

Author: MarkWong007Sydney, Australia
Title: Fine dining, Penang good quality food
Review: I liked this place from the moment I saw from tripadvisor and so I went to book. Staff are very nice and helpful. Space is gorgeous, food is delightful to eat and very generous. Wine is no too expensive. I have already recommended our friends to go there. Perfect night. They only served 4 course set menu for RM120+ tax and we can order 2 completely different dishes which we did so we tried 8 dishes in total. Great for us! The bill was about RM380.- including tax which is very reasonable for what we got and I felt even lucky that I have eat this meal. Everything is delicious, for main we had snapper and duck and for green we had wing beans and green beans. Desserts are probably weaker compare to the savoury dishes but they were still pretty good. Staff are attentive and friendly.Show less

Author: JeslineD
Title: Very Good Food.
Review: If you are looking for Nyonya Food with a twist, this is the place to go. Great food with very skillful chef. It is a must try if you are in Penang.

Author: mav68Singapore, Singapore
Title: Top Price also comes with good Quality and Service
Review: The restaurant is pretty huge taking the facade of the pre-war shop houses. The name is Kebaya, which is a traditional clothing of Nyonyas. The interior is nicely decorated and adorned by chandeliers exude an elegance feel.There is a courtyard at the back of restaurant which it separates the restaurant and suites. It is a boutique hotel located near to all historical sites in Penang. The food is certainly above average but comes with a hefty price tag if you are local. If you are a foreigner with strong currency exchange rate it is still ok. The price is MYR 120+ per person excluding drinks. I would strongly suggest to visit this restaurant if you are a party of 4 or above so you can really sample most of the popular dishes. With that kind of price you would expect impeccable service which they are really up to. The ambience truly comes with the price as well.I will recommend this place to foreigners not so much for local as it scores high on 1/Ambience 2/Food ( a little fusion so be prepared) 3/ Authenticity 4/ ServiceA good place to splurge!Show less

Author: suexplorestheworldZurich, Switzerland
Title: Modern Malay kitchen
Review: As the Seven Terraces hotel the Kebaya restaurant features a beautiful heritage interior design. The waiters were very friendly and professional. Also the menu offers a very good choice of modern Malaysian dishes with cross Asian influence (starter, main course and dessert for RM 125). The food was nice but as a food specialist I think, it is not as outstanding as the critics say. And the day after, I suffered from diarrhea due to bad fish or crab (NB: I never had troubles when eating street food...). This should definitively not happen at a restaurant of this kind. The piano player was also second choice.To sum up: Nice setting and good food but overrated in my view.Show less

Author: manalive53715Saba
Title: Hard to find, perhaps?
Review: My wife and I tried for hours to find this place, to no avail one night. It would have helped if the Title here included Seven Terraces Hotel! I am not sure how many locals and cabbies we asked. One person finally did put us on the right path, but then we were in a lone dark street (looked like an alley) and turned back - looked pretty dicey. Turns out if we went another half block and turned right, we might have found it. Also, the sign for Kebaya is really tiny and only on the door. We know that because we were determined to find it, and did so the next day (in the light, took pics). Of course it was closed then. Ah well. So I can't really rate the food, but HEY, put up some signs!Show less

Author: Madeline O
Title: Enjoyable
Review: We had a wonderful evening the 3 of us. Everything was presented beautifully. The staff were excellent, catered to our every need. The food was even better. The restaurant is beautifully decorated with a piano playing soft music

Author: msiewm
Title: Lovely setting and great food
Review: Would definitely recommend others to eat here! The setting has the traditional Peranakan feel. The dishes are all superb and have a slight modern twist to them!

Author: LexieKnight
Title: A taste sensation!
Review: You must dine here whilst in Penang. The food is outstanding. The Beef Rendung is prepared 48 hours in advance and is to die for! A three course meal will leave you fully satiated and in need of a walk back to your hotel. Well worth the money!Show less

Author: StewartRobertHong Kong, China
Title: Excellent restaurant
Review: The hotel restaurant at Seven Terraces (a stunning heritage hotel) is really well worth a visit. A big grand dining room with an elegant bar area at one end, beautifully decorated with antiquities and fresh flowers. Shirley runs the front of house and she welcomed us with style and grace. We had the Chinese New Year set dinner which started with popiah for two, delicious roll your own pancakes. The prawn curry was amazing. Prices are high-ish, but worth it for a great meal in a lovely setting Show less

Author: Craig G
Title: Beautiful food and environment
Review: Absolutely delicious experience, food, service, wine all wonderful, if possible you should dine here.

Author: ChinRichalds
Title: Birthday treat
Review: I booked a table online several weeks before we left the UK. I mentioned it was a birthday meal and the staff brought us a cake after we had eaten desert and sang happy birthday which was nice. We had a set menu and the food was delicious. Starter, main, veg side dish and desert. The crab salad was fantastic! We tried all of the side dishes, they were tasty other than the tempura veg which was quite bland and didn't add anything to the meal. Staff were friendly and helpful. I would recommend but book in advance to avoid disappointment! Show less

Author: peng1946San Francisco, California
Title: Overrated
Review: Expensive and not true peranakan flavours. Very disappointed. We loved Penang food but not this one. Can get better peranakan food in another restaurant.Show less

Author: Lheng RPhilippines
Title: Great dinner!
Review: Yesterday we called at 6:30pm and got lucky to get a 7:30pm confirmation for dinner for 5 persons. We heard the place is busy because the food is very very good! and oh boy, it did not disappoint!We ordered 3 kinds of appetizer to share. which by the way are all awesome esp the Salmon Roe!!! Then I had a Prawn Geng for my main course, with Sambal goreng for greens. All were delicious, I thought I will not order dessert as I am already full and satisfied. But no, its our first time here so no diet for me ha ha...I had their Gula Melaka mousse and it is just perfect! highly recommended!Show less

Author: VT2369toronto
Title: Food is not as good as before
Review: We only went there with our oversea guests. The price was on the high side for Penang, but the food quality was not as good as before. My husband ordered a lamb shoulder, it used to be a generous portion, but now, you could finished it in 4 bits. Not acceptable for MYR120+ per person.Show less

Author: 681margaretg
Title: Fabulous food
Review: This is a must when in Penang the food is fabulous and the service exceptional we have been 3 times now and not been disappointed traditional Malay food with a twist

Author: leanndreasonjaKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good place with amazing waiters
Review: I went there for Christmas with my family and the waiters gave a first impression as we walked in the door assisting us with whatever we needed. Since my grandma was on a wheelchair, they were really helpful in getting our table and ensuring our comfort. Biggest thank you goes to Bryan and Durga for their endless help and hospitality! Cheers.Show less

Author: Samwllee
Title: Delicious!
Review: This restaurant was lovely! The food was delicious and it was a nice change to the local Malaysian foods which are delicious but often not in fancy establishments. The building was beautiful! We even flicked through a book with all their photos. We ate there a while ago but the pork belly was delicious! It was one of the few places we managed to find pork. I remember that there were also some really yummy Vegetarian dishes.A couple at another table informed the waitresses that we had been married in the past few days so we were given a really tasty dessert which is only eaten by the newly weds.A great evening!Show less

Author: BricodustSouth West France
Title: Fine dining Nyonya style
Review: An excellent fine dining restaurant.The selection og Nyonya dishes was very, very good.Take the set 4 course meal for 122RM ++, choose different dishes and share to appreciate the range of cooking.Wine is not cheap, so stick with water or a beer.The service was excelent, unobtrusive but timely and efficient, very friendly staff.We have been twice so it must be good.You need to book particularly at weekendsEnjoyShow less

Author: chriscS1444NQCaulfield, Australia
Title: Great fine dining
Review: We had a great meal at Kebaya. The meals were generous in size and generally very good. We found the entrie dishes looked fantastic yet the favours were only good yet not exceptional. I had the lamb for my main course which was great. It is definitely worth a visit.Show less

Author: JoeyMumblesLincoln, United Kingdom
Title: When in Penang....😋😋
Review: Fantastic place located in beautiful old building with an air of colonial opulence.Concise menu and v good value for money considering quality of food provided.High end setting with a 30's feel with piano in the background and good but not intrusive service. Just had beer and gin as wine is(throughout Malaysia) marked up that you aren't getting value for money.Had Snapper and Chicken for mains and no complaints from ether of us. Good quality fish/poultry presented well and cooked in local style which unleashed a cascade of flavours. Think this place is a must if eating out in Penang.Show less

Author: mustardbjSydney, Australia
Title: Nice experience
Review: After mainly eating from street carts (which we thoroughly enjoyed) my partner and I thought we would splash out and have an elegant dinner on our last night. We arrived half hour early to have drinks in the bar area which was nice to do. Loved the lime and lychee signature cocktail! They also provide the menu and discuss it with you so you can think about food you will choose. Dinner was at 8pm setting (can also choose 6pm) The sides were really nice -one was stir fried vegetables with lovely garlic flavour and as lovers of spicy food the highlight for us was the wing bean salad. We had prawn curry which was very mild but tasty with huge prawns. Also had lamb as was recommended by other diners. It was quite a large shank for lamb and in a peppery gravy - in hindsight maybe not the best for Australians to choose as it makes you realise how fantastic our Lamb is (even though it said it was from NZ). I was glad we didn't have another creamy curry dish though as that would have been too much. As a dessert lover I really enjoyed the two desserts we had (last two on the menu). One was a velvety melt in the mouth almost honeycomb flavoured mouse with thin sponge in middle - so nice! Other was gelatinous balls in warm coconut milk broth. Serving sizes generous - we were very full by the end!There were lots of staff and restaurant was not full. Staff attentive to the point it feels a little rushed but that might just be us as we usually take our time over nice dinners and pick at the food over our conversation. I suppose you only have a two hour window as they close around 10pm I think (at least that is what they seemed to be aiming for). The thing I found odd for the size of the restaurant is there is only one small uni-sex toilet and at one point there were three people waiting to use it.Go for the experience not just the food and if you like long dinners go early to have drinks at the bar.Show less

Author: Denise TKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Awesome food - Kebaya is the place for Nyonya food!
Review: Every single guests for my wedding was being WOW-ed by the foods and cocktail! It was so good that I think they just set the bar higher for Nyonya Foods. Every dish are being made perfectly and go through a very strict quality control before it's allowed to be served out from the kitchen.Be sure to make a booking WAY in advance! It is always fully booked.Show less

Author: andje580Oamaru, New Zealand
Title: No words to describe just go
Review: Great introduction to Peranakan dining in a beautiful setting. The more of you to dine the more food there is to share . The staff were very attentive and helpful with the menu. The pricing is excellent when you think of this style of dining in a western country alternative. The pork buns are a must as is the pandan Burlee . Wonderful evening ...thank you kebayaShow less

Author: Steven L
Title: Plentiful food
Review: This fine-dining restaurant recommended a 4-course meal per person that comprised of an entrée, a meat dish, a vegetable dish, and a dessert. The entrées came out together, and ALL of the meat and vegetables dishes came out together subsequently. The main dishes were to share and we honestly felt that there was too much food: 2-3 courses would comfortably serve 4 people. As a result, much of the food turned cold as we battled to consume most of the content. Ratings: entrées 4/5, mains 3/5, desserts 2/5.There was also live piano music which was pleasant, and the setting was lovely! Show less

Author: AdelePhSydney, Australia
Title: Unforgettable Christmas Eve dinner!
Review: We stayed at Seven Terraces just before Christmas. I was looking for a lovely place for our family for our Christmas Eve dinner and Kebaya was highly recommended by my brother. I made a reservation with the restaurant as soon as I've booked our stay at the hotel. We arrived early for our 8pm reservation. We went earlier as we wanted to enjoy a few drinks at Baba Bar before our dinner. The cocktails were great! The bar staff was excellent. We were also served some sweet potato chips while we enjoyed our drinks. They also showed us the restaurant menu and we were given the option to order our selections ahead of being seated and we decided to do just that. We were welcomed to our table 10 minutes before 8pm. The table they have selected for us was perfect and for us it was the best located table. It was right in the middle of the restaurant, close to the pianist but far away from the majority of the bigger tables and seating. We thought it was perfect! So thank you! As we had already placed our selections, shortly after we were seated, out came our entrees. It was perfectly timed. We enjoyed all our entrees and eagerly waited for our mains. Our mains did not disappoint! It was excellent. The sides dishes were good as well. Truthfully I barely had much rice as the portion was generous and every single dish tasted very good. I simply didn't want too much rice. I'm not a big fan of dessert in general let alone Asian desserts but the dessert at the Kebaya was great. I especially loved the Pandan Creme Brûlée. It was excellent! We loved the food at this restaurant. It's very sophisticated and refined. The service was excellent. The pianist was good. The cocktails was amazing, I especially enjoyed their Gallefort Special. We thought the price for the food was good and very fair for what they served. I throughly enjoyed our dinner at the Kebaya. I'm glad we dined at the Kebaya for our Christmas Eve family dinner. It was the most perfect way to celebrate.Show less

Author: VDV11London, United Kingdom
Title: Great Food and Location
Review: This is a very nice restaurant located in a superb city for foodies.The food we ate was lovely, with the Duck and Lamb dishes both exceptional. The ambience is fantastic - the historic location is complimented with a grand piano player.The experience was slightly let down by the service - our table was not ready until after our arrival time and when we were shown to it we were essentially abandoned and had to ask for menus ourselves. From thereon in it was fine but perhaps not befitting of somewhere striving to be the best. Additionally, the food is in no way worth the large price multiple vs other simpler places serving delicious food, and the red wine we had was really poor. However by UK standards the bill clocked in at a still reasonable amount.All in all, would have no issue recommending this placeShow less

Author: MarkandBrendaK
Title: Great fine dining!
Review: Very beautiful restaurant, nice bar with pianist. We had the set menu for 2 for dinner and the food was excellent. The service was flawless and the ambiance was lovely!

Author: Kate MLeeds, United Kingdom
Title: Amazing food
Review: Went for dinner and the food, service and atmosphere were all great. The food was amazing for a set menu there was a lot of variety and each dish was shared between my boyfriend and I, they were delicious. The staff were attentive and helpful. Will definitely be going back during our stay in Georgetown. Show less

Author: WanderLustDavao
Title: Food for the cultured
Review: Kebaya Restaurant is a must see to complete your Penang experience for its modern Nyonya cuisine. It boasts of French cooking technique combined with local produce, equals a unique menu with its own character.

Author: AustraliaBeachbelleSydney, Australia
Title: Best night of the holiday!
Review: What a fabulous building, beautifully restored with very authentic decor. The food was spectacular. There were a few of us so we had virtually everything on the menu and it was all amazing. We had such a great night and even byo'd. Would recommend to everyone. It is a "special" night - they even had someone playing a grand piano which was not at all intrusive. 5 stars definitely.Show less

Author: SingaporePiggy71singapore
Title: Fantastic celebration for family gathering
Review: Our family members and close relatives were very impressed by the library room decorations and the food served. I had 3 tables in a private room with sitting sofas cum dinning tables set up atmosphere. All my guests including my family members had thoroughly enjoyed the evening session with good food and good attentive services from the service crew team. I want to take this opportunity to say a big Thank You to Mr Syahrul who had been so accommodating to my every request even on that day to add an extra person. He had been so helpful in answering my questions via email and what's app. Without him, I don't know how these special occasions (my parents golden anniversary and my dad's 80th birthday) could work out well without his help.Thank you so much for everything :)Show less

Author: ROTOVEGASNew Zealand
Title: Fantastic enjoyable evening!
Review: The decor here sets a lovely ambiance.We came for the 6 pm seating and it wasnt very full.With great anticipation the food arrived!It was delicious!The portions were just the right size. In fact i could have ordered extra! From the starters to the dessert all dishes were fantastic!The price is very reasonable for a lovely dinner out.Show less

Author: delicacious
Title: Beautiful place, interesting food
Review: The restaurant is set in a beautiful hotel, and the decorations made the dining alot more interesting. The food servings were generous, and the food was above average. I really enjoyed the desserts and the beef main course.

Author: Tat_TatchaiBangkok, Thailand
Title: The best meal in Penang
Review: Tue best meal in Penang. Period. It's located in Seven Terraces hotel and serves fusion Peranakan cuisine. But don't let the world fusion bores you. It's fusion in a great way. Everything is well balanced and really really delicious. The service is top-notch and you can feel that all details are being paid attention to, name it the tableware, the interior, the taste....everything. Plus the price is not expensive at all comparing to what you get. Definitely 5 stars. Don't ever ever miss this place!!!Show less

Author: RunnerSofWashington DC, District of Columbia
Title: #1 Rated Restaurant for a Reason
Review: A meal at Kebaya is filled with excellence. The restaurant provides a pleasant ambience with a live pianist. Everything is family style and delicious. We had a great experience hear and would highly recommend it for a memorable experience. Good for a date night or group outing. The food is amazing - try some of everything! Would come again. Expensive but it's high quality.Show less

Author: 759alastairwDominican Republic
Title: Wonderful meal
Review: Perfect setting with lovely dining room , attentive cocktail waiters let them make their Sri Lankan special.The food was plentiful and of the highest class beautiful flavours this restaurant definitely deserves to be number 1 in Penang. We thought it very reasonably priced for the excellence on offerShow less

Author: Frandy S
Title: Nice malaysian peranakan fusion dining
Review: A very nice ambience start from you enter until you finish your food. Nice food presentation. Good for dinner. We order alot of food and able to finish it. The spices is delicate pampering your tastebud. Very recommended dining place

Author: ritchieorlando
Title: Nice place nice food but a bit expensive
Review: Fusion malay cuisine. Good old fashioned restarurant with delicious food but at higher price. Wont go there again, just for one time experience

Author: ivanp4023
Title: delectable grandeur!
Review: you simply must eat here! the food, the service and the interior all blend together to create a unique and unforgettable experience... a sensual feast!

Author: Anaza LWestern Australia, Australia
Title: A dining experience to remember
Review: Following on from my review of 7 Terraces we now move on to the hotels restaurant Kebaya Dining Room.We elected to celebrate my husbands birthday here as we had the pleasure of experiencing this restaurant on our last visit to Penang.We found the food to be of exceptional standard once again,matched by the professional and attentive staff who also made the experience one to remember right down to going to the effort of decanting our delightful wine.If you are wanting to find a pallet of flavours that will stimulate your taste buds, then treat yourself to the culinary delights of this restaurant. If you have as we did a group of people, Shar the restaurant manager was extremely helpful in assisting us with our meal selections for the evening. We chose to begin with an array of 3 entrees followed by a selection of 5 mains, 4 vegetables and fragrant rices which was shared amongst our guests 'family style'. To complete our dining experience desserts were the ' icing on the cake'. All our guests voted this meal experience one to remember.Show less

Author: loobyBucksbucks
Title: Very good value
Review: The restaurant offers a four course menu which includes stater, main , veg dish and dessert. The food is cooked to a very high standard and you get plenty of it. Staff all very friendly and helpful. Worth a visit at any time but especially if you have a celebration.Show less

Author: SteveskiptonNorth Yorkshire, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent seeing and food
Review: Whilst you should not be expecting Michelin star food, non the less the food is excellent. At MR 120 for the 3 course meal you are not paying MS rates. The setting is lovely and the staff very attentive and knowledge. The menu is a fixed price for 3 courses chosen from an inserting and varied selection, mostly on an Asian theme. The prawn curry was amazing. Certainly worf a visit for a special meal whilst in GeorgetownShow less

Author: BuffyLongBrooklyn, New York
Title: Absolutely Delicious!
Review: Visited Kebaya on recommendation of a friend who had dined their 2 years ago. We were not disappointed. Would highly recommend the beef and lamb! All food is presented beautifully and reasonably priced! Would definitely go again when I return to Penang! Only point of improvement would be the wait time for food, but honestly, it's so delicious that it's worth the wait! Show less

Author: michaelfU5445HLMuscat, Oman
Title: A Great Dining Experience
Review: I did enjoy this meal. The three course set offering has someting for everyone. Ingredients and quality of service are of a high standard; the meals are super tasty. The dining room itself has great character. We shared the Lamb Sahnk and the beef dish - both first rate mains. Small complaint - the wine list was average and lacked imagination. Show less

Author: wongkristenpNew York City, New York
Title: A disappointed experience from NY foodies
Review: We picked Kebaya solely because it was rated number 1 on Tripadvisor. Now in hind sight, I wished I had read through more of the three star reviews because the experience I had tonight was not one that would persuade me to dine again at this restaurant. We were a group of 5, three adults and two young children. Our reservation was for 6p and we arrived a couple of minutes prior to 6. The restaurant was nicely decorated, a bit bland and stuffy. After an awkward minute or two of standing in the restaurant without being greeted by anyone, I had to walk further into the restaurant to ask if they were open. That's when we met, Brian Loh, presumably a manager at the restaurant. Mr Loh, not only did not apologize for our wait, he carried this grimace on his face as if he really did not want to be there. After seating us, he went over how the menu works rather quickly and impatiently. As a matter of fact, I see him checking himself out more at the mirror than on his patrons. We ordered a round of cocktails as a before dinner drink. One of the two signature cocktails (first one listed on the menu) was relatively good while the other one tasted like something a dive bar would serve if not for the cocktail glass and the fruit condiments. There was a limited choice of vodka on their menu and the Stoli dirty martini had ice cubes in the martini glass. We finished our meal with two shots of Macallan 18 which was very good. Pour was rather small but for $20 USD for a shot, it was relatively inexpensive. The food was tasty but nothing exceptional and mind blowing. Presentation was non existent. The two wait staff that serviced us was relatively good. They were friendly, bused the dishes at appropriate times, and was attentive in asking if one of the kids wanted more white rice during our meal. However, we were not asked if we wanted another drink after our first drink was finished and also no one checked in on us to see how we were doing during our meal. Being New Yorkers and foodies, we were quite disappointed by our experience. I realize Michelin rated restaurants are not yet in Malaysia, however given the price tag and the way Kebaya tries to carry itself, I feel I should expect a somewhat Michelin star restaurant experience from Kebaya. I suppose it is unfair to compare the service level to a restaurant like Le Bernadin in New York, but if Kebaya is trying to be the Le Bernadin of Penang, then let me tell you, you guys have a really long way to go. We had a much more memorable experience at Opium KL in Kuala Lumpur then at Kebaya. The cocktail menu, the taste of the food, the ambience, the presentation and the service all out ranked Kebaya. Perhaps, if the owner of Kebaya is reading this candid review, you should consider hiring the restaurant manager at Opium to give you a few pointers. In summary, the experience was nothing to rave about. If your mission was to offer an exceptional dining experience, then you have failed miserably. A 5 MYR bowl of fish noodle soup I had this afternoon at a hawker stand wow'ed me more than what I've experienced tonight. That's some food for thought for you from a New York foodie!Show less

Author: WM_Loves_To_TravelTokyo, Japan
Title: Delightful Fusion Nyonya Restaurant
Review: Delicious fusion peranakan food whilst maintaining key traditional ingredients. The desserts (Pana Cotta and Tang Yuen) were unforgettable!The staff at Kebaya are commendable and attentive. They also showed us around Seven Terraces and Mr. Robert shared the photo album of "before" and "after" that made us appreciate the whole settings even more. Thumbs up and we will definitely come back soonShow less

Author: kinheng
Title: An evening back in time...
Review:
Great peranakan ambience.  Dining was an exceptional experience.  Food presentation was awesome and creative and was delicious.
The antique furniture and furnishings gave it an old world charm that reminded me of the days gone by.  So nostalgic !

Author: cynthiay677London, United Kingdom
Title: Delicious Nyonya cuisine.
Review: Delicious food served in a lovely setting, the service was great, really attentive! I went there without a reservation and the staff were helpful in finding me a table. They only serve from a set menu, but there's plenty of choice in it. It's priced at RM120 per person for a 4 course meal, which is a pricey for what you'd be used to in Penang, but it's very worth every penny. I'd be more than happy to go back again the next day! Show less

Author: christrewin404Melbourne, Australia
Title: Dinner
Review: Booked the 6 PM dinner session for 10 (2 children). Staff were very friendly and informative. Is a set menu per person as 4 course share plate. Staff recommended to order only 8 sets due to children appetite and there was plenty of food. Highly recommend even if local. Booking is essential. Show less

Author: gubgub21a
Title: First class
Review: We had a sensational meal at Kebaya. The food was delicious and the chef is obviously talented with a wonderful palate. Also many thank to Aruna a first class waiter and guide.

Author: Tishpc
Title: Mrs Church
Review: What a fantastic restaurant couldn't fault anything 10 out of 10 very reasonable staff very friendly

Author: Benrose74Singapore, Singapore
Title: Best in Penang
Review: Came here with my 12 year old son. We love the food in Penang generally, but this place was beyond everything else. We loved it so much that we came back 2 nights in a row, just so we could get through a bit more of the menu! Everything was delicious, but the minced prawn fries skewers to start, the beef, prawn curry and blackened fish, the vege tempura, pandan crime brûlée and rice balls in coconut milk (forgotten the name!) stood out. All in a beautiful setting in 7 old shophouses. Currently one of my favourite restaurants - anywhere.Show less

Author: THEBONDIGIRLLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent dining at Kebaya in the Seven Terraces Hotel
Review: The sumptuous and peaceful surrounds of the old world Seven Terraces Hotel has a beautiful and tastefully decorated (with a porcelain and furniture collection) dining room, Kebaya.The 4 course set menu is mouthwatering and the service second to none in this peaceful, atmospheric hidden treasure which is reasonably priced.With my special dietary requirements the waiters went out of their way to assist and serve me as well as the barman working his magic on cocktails.I only had time for a brief visit so a taxi was ordered, ready and waiting to drive me to the airport from the hotel.I would recommend booking Kebaya but I was able to walk in without a booking and the lovely lady on reception was not only helpful but it was obvious she clearly adored her job.I highly recommend Kebaya. Show less

Author: GourmandBCSingapore, Singapore
Title: Delightful discovery in charming old Penang
Review: Been reading and seeing on TV Peranakan cuisine in Penang. So instead of boring it in the grand old dame - Rasa Sayang's dining offers or slumming it at the famous but sticky and hot Hawker scene, I decided to try Trip Adviser's highly recommended Kebaya - nested in a v stylishly made over Seven Terraces boutique hotel in Lorong Stewart. Google map was superbly reliable and even though a bit of a drive from Batu Ferringhi it was easy enough to find. Yummy food. Fusion-ised but done extremely well. We are a family of 4 hungry wolves - kids too and we ordered 4 - 4 course menus - in other words - we tried a huge part of the menu. Wing bean kerabu salad was yummy. Chao Tom appetiser delicious, the Kebaya tamarind beef (sous vide to perfection), Pandan Creme brûlée were all highlights. The organic roast pork - well what can I say for a family of porkers - was the first dish to disappear. Probably least impressive was the crispy Nyonya tempura. I loved the ambience - done slightly OTT but beautiful and v romantic - so a great place to bring and impress a date.
