Must have missed that in some of the other reviews, as we wouldn't have eaten such a big lunch if we knew!Anyway, the food was lovely and really tasty and the service was fantastic! We're not usually ones for dessert, but as it was part of the price we opted for some gelatinous balls in coconut rice soup! We would never normally try something like this, but it was lovely and so we were glad we did!The menu is reasonably priced for the amount of food, it's equivalent to about £20 pp based on the current exchange rate. Wine was also reasonably priced.The building itself is well worth a look around: it has a rich history and has been lovingly restored. If we return to Georgetown we would look to stay here as the standard looked very good.This venue warrants its place at the top of the list of restaurants in Georgetown in our opinion, we had a lovely evening and would definitely recommend it an essential visit while staying in Georgetown. Take a look at their sister venue too: Mews Cafe where we also enjoyed some excellent food.Show less

Author: familytravellers2011Melbourne, Australia
Title: Absolutely delicious
Review: During our stay at the Rasa Sayang this restaurant was recommended to us by another guest. We are so glad we listened to her. It was a bit difficult to get a reservation but we were flexible with our dates and managed to get in. The restaurant is in the Seven Terraces Hotel in Georgetown which is truly magnificent. The restaurant itself is just amazing to see. Beautiful features and antiques. We were greeted by the hostess Jackie who was delightful and friendly. She gives so much attention to the customers and is excellent at her job. As has been said before, it is a set four course menu with plenty of choices. My husband and I were with our teenage daughter so we were able to taste much of what was on the menu. WE had the prawns, the chicken and the squid entrees. For mains we had the beef, the pork and the soft shell crabs with the tempura vegetables, the stir fried greens and the beans and baby corn in a peanut sauce for vegetables. We finished off with the passion fruit pannacotta, the crème brulee and the chocolate fondant with the most delicious passion fruit filling. Everything was truly delectable and all for around $42AUD a person. Try finding a meal like that for anywhere near that price in Melbourne. Impossible. The only remote negative I can make is that there was too much food and it was a shame we just couldn't eat it all!!A very enjoyable experience!Show less

Author: Grace L
Title: Fantastic ambience
Review: The ambience is fantastic inside the restaurant. The heritage site truly brings you back in time with some modern twists. The piano playing was an added bonus as the pianist played recognisable classical music which we throughly enjoyed . The food was Malaysian/Chinese/general South East Asian fusion. I can't say the food was amazing but it was nice and the portions were generous. The best was the durian creme brûlée which was the special of the evening. I have never had durian creme brûlée before and I was concerned that it would taste revolting, but it was the best dish of the evening and I wish I could order another portion if my stomach had space.Show less

Author: Zilpah5
Title: Fabulous Restaurant my favourite in South East Asia
Review: We went to Kebaya for my husband's birthday. The restaurant was beautiful and the food was excellent. I particularly enjoyed the prawn curry and the pandan creme brûlée. The service was excellent and the piano playing was lovely.

Author: clyn88
Title: A memorable experience
Review: Come here to experience the authentic Nyonya dishes. Excellent service by the staff, friendly and attentive. Overall a great experience.

Author: SingaporeExpaddydublin
Title: Good food, beautiful restaurant
Review: The setting of Kebaya in the Seven Terraces Hotel is excellent. The hotel is located in a great area of George Town. As for the meal, the food was very good, the menu was small but with a good selection. We really enjoyed the meal but felt the service was a bit rushed and each course was served quickly after the other. This would not stop us from returning though.Show less

Author: DOC1967Edinburgh, United Kingdom
Title: Not overhyped in the least
Review: We dined here one evening in June and can say that in terms of quality of food , wine , service , ambiance , price and not least efficiency and friendliness of staff this restaurant fully justified its position as No 1 on TA . Worth a visit for an amazing experience , you will not be disappointed .Show less

Author: Happytraveller974
Title: A little pricey, but worth every penny
Review:
This isn't a cheap night out, but my goodness the food is sensational!! 

The beautiful surroundings and live music are a plus, but I would eat on the side of the road to sample that slow cooked beef again!! Amazing!

Author: dirkusalbertusSao Paulo, SP
Title: Simply amazing, a 5 star plus experience in a stylish mansion
Review: A restaurant close to perfection. When you are having your appetiser in the bar listening to Tosca's "E lucevan le stelle" on life piano you know this is going to be a great experience.The place is gorgeous, service impecable and discrete and the food simply amazing. We went for the 4 set menu with gorgeous fusion food and an additional salmon roe appetiser which is beyond description. And the price ? With appetisers, a bottle of champagne and this 3 star Michelin worth food brought us to 150 Euro. A fraction of what you would be paying in Europe or in China.Show less

Author: reins76Scone, Australia
Title: Delicious
Review: Nice setting. Amazing snapper fillet in sauce mmmmm. Nice beetle leaf and salmon roe starter, great spicy salad. Desserts we chose were not as good as the mains but you can't get it perfect. Service was excellent. Price was expensive for Penang but cheap for equivalent experience elsewhere in the world.Show less

Author: Wayne B
Title: Upmarket
Review: Impeccable entrees. Only place was downhill from there. Yet the mains were very tasty the duck and pork were a touch dry. The deserts were average+. Ambiance was Magic. Service was excellent. If I could afford it I would be back there again.

Author: 662jacqueliney
Title: Great experience with Nonya food
Review: We heard so much things about Kebaya and we decided to try it out one day when we booked a night stay at Seven Terraces in Penang. The 4-course meal is a good concept, not too big servings but still enough for sharing. The tamarind beef was very good and flavorful. And I especially liked the wing bean salad. The signature cocktails are refreshing and very unique. I would certainly come back again !Show less

Author: 231visitorPenang, Malaysia
Title: Great meal in lovely setting
Review: My wife and I went last night to Kebaya with another couple. The restaurant itself is beautiful, the service was excellent, the food in terms of quantity and quality was superb. We followed the suggestions from the waiter and shared our choices. We could not finish all the main and veg. If you want a treat, go there !Show less

Author: bcheongShanghai, China
Title: 2nd time round
Review: My 2nd time here and this time with friends. The novelty factor wore off and I focused more on the taste of the food rather than the ambience. For dinner, it's 120 ringgit per person for 4 courses. You can add additional courses with more ringgit . As it as a large group of 10 of us, we ordered 3 starters of 2 portions each to share. The salmon roe starter tasted the best, and the otak puff was good and unusualWe each ordered a main, but also shared each other's dishes. The duck was a giant portion and was ok. The beef was much smaller and tender. The prawn curry had good gravy to go with the steamed riceThe 4 vegetable dishes were also shared, and they were so-soDessert was also interesting fusion. The durian and pandan Creme brûlée were good, and the gula Melaka was a stand-outOverall good service as wellShow less

Author: Matt S
Title: Not exactly what people say about it
Review: Rather classic scenario of overrated extravagance coupled with the usual mix of enjoying something via price tag. The atmosphere is more appetizing than the food served. Chef has no doubt forgotten the most important idea in cooking, that is, is the food delicious? It's not bad by any means but is it exceptional? No. Definitely not.Show less

Author: ateelleman
Title: Great food
Review: We enjoyed our lunch here pretty much. Food was fantastic and delicious. The atmosphere was relaxing and comfortable and staffs were very welcoming and smiling.

Author: joseq654Witney, United Kingdom
Title: Birthday treat! Wow
Review: My wife surprised me for my birthday and booked this restaurant for my birthday.Wow, what an amazing place! It's expensive but the experience was worth every ringgit!The staff are excellent, the building has lots of history and the food... congratulations to the owners of this amazing venue.If I ever go back to Penang, I will return.Show less

Author: MumtoScruffyYorkshire, United Kingdom
Title: Fantastic
Review: A holiday in Penang would not be the same without a visit to this fabulous restaurant and on our visit last week it again lived upto our wonderful previous dining experiences.The food for us is simply outstanding and we can honestly say that we have enjoyed all of the differing choices we have made. Whilst I appreciate that everyone has their own opinion and palate, I would like to comment on a recent reviewer who stated that the food was too sweet. I certainly do not enjoy sweet food and I too had the soft shell crab and found the flavouring to be well balanced and not overly sweet.There is a very good choice of wine and by Malaysian prices, it is not overpriced and is stored and served very well.Service is always very good and we like the fact that Marcus the manager keeps in the background and quietly observes what is going on. There is no need for him to be flamboyant and interfere with the serving staff, they know their job and do it very well. The ambiance here is relaxed and sophisticated buts certainly not stuffy or pompous.The surroundings are simply wonderful and the beautiful piano playing by Moses made for an overall brilliant night.On leaving the restaurant we discovered that the hotel umbrella we had left near to the door had been taken by someone else who was staying at the same hotel as us. We were a bit concerned that the hotel might charge us for this so Marcus kindly phoned the hotel to establish if a charge would be made. He also asked us to take one of the restaurants umberellas which was a thoughtful and kind thing to do. To summarise, this is a restaurant serving superb food by lovely staff and in beautiful surroundings at a reasonable cost.Sincere thanks to everyone and we look forward to visiting again on our return in December.Jumpa Lagi from Kevin and Margaret Wilkinson (guests at The E&O)Show less

Author: zhangjiesmomBeijing, China
Title: Beautiful surroundings
Review: First, I'll start by saying that Kebaya is a beautiful restaurant and I was really looking forward to dining there. My first course I ordered Ng Kham of Salmon Roe. This appetizer was delicious but a little sweet. The coconut flavors overpowered the other shrimp and roe flavors which I found disappointing. My main course was the Thai soft shell crab salad : fried soft shel crab, mango, green apples, pomegranate in a chill lime dressing. The soft shell crab was delicious but the salad was brimming with sugar. I couldn't eat it. I ordered the Sambal Goreng veggie dish which was french beans and baby corn. This was by far the best - slightly crisp and the sweetness of the vegetables came through. For dessert I had the Pandam creme brûlée. This too was excellent - crispy dark caramel and underneath was a creamy Pandam custard. I didn't think it was too expensive for what I got, I was disappointed in the amount of sugar they used. I would go back again since I think it is unfair to base a review on one dinner and in order to get a feel for a restaurant usually many trips are required. I would however, ask them about sugar content in the dishes I order. I do like sweets and dishes that run on the sweet side, but I found that the crab salad had probably 4 tsp of sugar in that one serving alone.Show less

Author: 252ravinb
Title: Amazing dining room
Review:
The food overall was quite good and very tasty. The dining room is probably the best I have seen in Penang. 
The only let down was the beef dish was tough.

Author: Steven MMelbourne, Australia
Title: Great food and experience
Review: This was such a lovely experience on our last night in George Town. The restaurant is a great space and tastefully decorated with local antiquities. And on the night we were there, a pianist was playing which was a nice touch.The service is excellent, although don't expect Euro or Australian fine dining standards, but it is great for Malaysia. The food is also top class, tasted great and was beautifully presented. It may not stick to traditional recipes of some dishes but that was what we liked about it.The only complaint is that its a set price for four courses and one of our party doesn't eat dessert. The staff were not willing to switch for an additional entree or side dish, and only offered a free cup of coffee. They would have done well to offer the change of dish even if it cost a few dollars extra.Show less

Author: Traceylee0404
Title: Great food, lovely surrounds
Review: Delicious Nonya/fusion cuisine, excellent service and beautiful surrounds. We were a group of four, and all enjoyed this venue and the range of dishes presented. A very memorable night out in Penang, highly recommended.

Author: 2RightyPerth, Australia
Title: Must Visit - Excellent
Review: The decor of bold tiles, dark furniture, candles, and gold inlaid chinese timber work, along with Jackie the hostess really set the stage for a meal to remember, and it was. Service brilliant,and thanks to Denash for finding the lamb shank that was originally not available. The Snapper grilled in banana leaf moist and excellently spiced. The mini Bau with Pork Belly with pickled vegetable was so clever, could have eaten 3 serves. Finally the Lamb Shank was the best I have ever eaten, served in a grey coloured coconut flavoured gravy I initially thought "oh, oh", but how wrong I was. It is a must have. Do yourself a favour and put this restaurant on your must visit list.Show less

Author: FatboyRedSingapore, Singapore
Title: Very pretty restaurant but not for purists
Review: We tried making a reservation for Kebaya on the day itself but it was full. We popped by without a reservation at about 9pm and thankfully they managed to set a table for us.The restaurant’s ambience is fantastic and the whole place is very nicely furnished. However, as the management pointed out, Kebaya is a fusion restaurant or at least one that offers a “new approach” to peranakan food. Some hits and misses:The standout dish of the night was the betel leaf wrap with salmon roe (appetizer). The addition of the salmon roe added unami and moisture to the wrap. The wing bean salad was also very good, with the addition of pomegranates and pomelo.The duck, however, was too sweet. The roast organic pork belly was mediocre. We waited a long time for dessert even though we did not order the chocolate cake. In summary, eat at Kebaya for its ambience and do not expect a robust, traditional peranakan meal.Show less

Author: Blackers79London, United Kingdom
Title: Exquisite dinner and surrounds
Review: A visit to the delightful Kebaya was a lovely contrast to the many informal, cheap and cheerful hawker food meals we had in Georgetown. The dining space is lovely and we were warmly welcomed by our kebaya-clad hostess. The food was excellent - it was great to experience Malay cuisine in a more formal dining environment (but in no way stuffy). The desserts were probably my favourite - I've never had onde onde in soup before! My partner's passionfruit panna cotta was also delicious.Make sure you book - it is a popular place.Show less

Author: namhalbeijing
Title: Awesome restaurant and Hotel
Review: This is one of the best restaurants we have experienced in Penang or indeed Asia. Kembaya has a wonderful grace and style in a traditional but contemporary environment.Jackie, the restaurant Manager is a total professional with a great personality. I had the best Lychee Martini I have had in any bar in the world….and the food…glorious!!! subtle tastes of Penang, Asia and western fare beautifully presented and cooked to perfection. They also offer wonderful contemporarty Asian styled accommodation for couples and families. Just go there, you won't be disappointed.Show less

Author: PamInPng
Title: Delicous food!
Review: Nice atmosphere, great bar attendant and good quality food. We took visitors to sample good local cuisine and it was delicious. We enjoyed the live piano player as well!

Author: ScrumBumJakartaKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Mindnumbingly Good
Review: It had been a long day and I was in a huff... peeved at my spouse, friends who had accompanied us on our break from KL and life in general. we arrived down a dingy lane (it was raining and dark) to eat at the "best restaurant in Penang" and I was sceptical...wow... not only were my spirits lifted by the bar staff (excellent Saharan dry martinis.. I like it that way... wave the vermouth at the glass and its enough) but by the attentive staff, the intriguing menu and the decor.The food did not let me down and all I can say is that the portions are perfect size, even for a rugby player, the quality was superb and the wine... very reasonably priced for Asia (a French Sancerre for $60). The bill was very reasonable and we all left suitably replete (stuffed in other words) and I was as happy as a happy thing on happy gas and a full belly.BOOK AHEADShow less

Author: porkkkchopSingapore, Singapore
Title: good!
Review: We strongly feel that you must share when you come here, and come only in groups. This will allow you to order different dishes and try more dishes at one seating!Essentially, dinner is a four course meal- a starter, a main course, a vegetable dish and finally dessert. There is free flow of rice to go with the main course and veg dish.Five of us shared three sets, and loved all the dishes we selected except for (the only disappointing dish here) the tempura vegetables. Had an excellent experience here! There was a live piano performance...good ambience and very well mannered service staff. Will recommend friends who visit penang to try Kebaya!Show less

Author: tobyandcarol3St. Andrews, United Kingdom
Title: Unbeatable
Review: We loved Kebaya. My daughter and son-in-law live and work in Penang, and our visit to this wonderful restaurant was the 'treat'! We could not have hoped for better. The food was superb - I ate lamb in a coconut sauce for my main course and my mouth is watering at the thought of it even now. Everything was perfectly cooked and beautifully presented, the service was first rate, efficient and unobtrusive. and the setting elegant, tasteful and comfortable. It was also, by British standards, very reasonable. It would be simply impossible to have such an exceptional meal, with wine and coffee, in such a delightful setting, for £45 a head - which is what it cost. Our visit to Kebaya was a highlight of a wonderful trip. Next time we go to Penang, and there will be a next time, I want to stay in the 7 Terraces Hotel, to which Kebaya is attached. Something else to look forward to! Thank you to all concerned!Show less

Author: Viphil MLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Charming experience
Review: An excellent restaurant: ambiance, cuisine, service. We were a dinner party of six including two small children. Tables are widely spaced and suitably sized, so you are not hemmed in by your own guests or those of other tables, and can enjoy conversation without bothering other tables or being bothered ny them. Marble table tops keep the surface cool, a consideration in a hot and humid climate, although of course there is aircon. Period furniture (lovely Asian cabinetry) and china add to the elegant decor. Service was timely and friendly with proper advice on suitable choices. Although the food is a choice of 4-course menus (no a la carte) for which some reviewers have downgraded the restaurant, it was excellent on the evening we were there with an extensive choice and a perfect introduction to the Peranakan cuisine of the area. While the overall price is not cheap for Penang, one has to take into account the other factors mentioned above and also bearing in mind that in Singapore, the other noteworthy centre for Peranakan cuisine, the same meal in an equivalent high end restaurant would be 3 to 4 times as much.Show less

Author: Mike CShenzhen, China
Title: Surprising
Review: We walked along Stewart Lane into Little India and Chinatown on our first evening in Georgetown looking for a restaurant which was not Chinese or Indian, so this was a little silly maybe. However, I live in China and we have good Indian restaurants too. We noted the restaurant and after giving up went back to it.The food turned out to be exactly what we'd been looking for - a Malaysian take on various good dishes. The surroundings were very comfortable and interesting and the service was excellent. You choose your courses from a restricted menu which changes daily, which I think is a really good system.Show less

Author: Wobbly_auSydney, Australia
Title: Wow, what food, and great value.
Review: A superb four course meal, in a beautiful setting with great staff. What more could you ask for? Expensive by Malaysian standards but very reasonable if you are a tourist, I'd strongly recommend you try at leat one dinner here if you are staying in Penang.Show less

Author: Amanda WUnited Kingdom
Title: Amazing Peranakan haute cuisine!
Review: We had an incredible meal in Kebaya while staying at the Seven Terraces hotel - it was a real highlight of our trip and we'd have eaten there again had we been staying longer. The menu is laid out so that you choose a starter, main course, vegetable side dish and desert per person for a fixed price of MYR110 - which we thought was very reasonable for the quality of food provided. We also found the wines to be reasonably priced for good quality. We enjoy Peranaken food anyway and this was very superior - the duck dish was probably the best I've ever had and the lamb and everything else we chose were also great. Service was good - we could see who was in charge and all the staff knew what they were doing and looked happy doing it. All in all a memorable evening.Show less

Author: canarywaltz2016London, United Kingdom
Title: Very memorable meal
Review: Took my whole family here during a recent Chinese New Year trip having been meaning to visit for ages. After having sampled their nyonya kuih, I really wanted to try their dinner offerings. They don't offer an ala carte meal-only a set meal at RM110++ per person-it's steep by local standards but well worth every ringgit. As there were the six of us, we got to sample quite a lot of the menu-really loved the Lor Arck (braised duck), the curry and the delightful desserts-the pandan creme brulee, tang yuan and passion fruit panacotta were to die for...Our entire family left happy and satisfied and look forward to returning soon..Show less

Author: piero1749Genova, Italia
Title: Till now the best in town
Review: I went with my wife and some fiend. The place is very nice and quite elegant. The service excelent, very excelent and professional full of suggestions and detail about the dishes. Were share almost all the main course plates, all were delicius , beef, duck, red snapper. A must in the City! Show less

Author: 513kianlFrimley Green, United Kingdom
Title: Modern Nyonya Cuisine
Review: To approach the food at Kebaya as your typical Peranakan (Nyonya) cuisine would be a mistake as you will leave disappointed. However what the food here shows is a willingness to embrace modern progression. Whilst still keeping the typical flavours which is much loved in Nyonya cooking, the chef here infuses it with modern european technique. Take for example their version of roast belly pork which is first cooked sous vide before being finished off - the result is a melt in your mouth texture of the pork belly along with the obligatory crackling. It is hard to fathom such a texture could be achieved by traditional means of roasting in a hot oven. Other stars include their deconstructed version of 'otak-otak' - the classical version calls for fish which is minced into a paste and then steamed in a banana leave. Here the fish is stuffed in a crispy puff pastry and served with a sauce made with all the herbs and spices used to flavour the fish. If you closed your eyes, the flavours are inevitably that of the named dish. On a few rare occasions, the modern techniques are less successful. A dish of Loh Ark (braised duck) uses confit duck. However, here, the traditional method of braising serves to infuse the duck with delightful heady aromas of the spiced liquor which was missing here.Service here was excellent and dishes arrived at a steady pace.Kebaya is a definite must-go if you are in Penang and is a great way to introduce tourists to the delights of Peranakan cuisine.Show less

Author: greenchipMelbourne, Australia
Title: So good - we went twice
Review: A really beautiful, smart, sophisticated restaurant in an amazing restored terrace. Great selection of food choices in their 4-course meal (we had so much trouble choosing, we decided to come back the following night!!).A chance to dress up if you want and enjoy the fine surroundings, excellent service and great food. All at a fraction of what we'd happily pay back home!!Show less

Author: jamesmb155
Title: Recommended
Review:
This restaurant came highly recommended so we made sure of a reservation. We thoroughly enjoyed the ambience and quality of the restoration. The service was excellent.
The food was good but we were expecting better

Author: pituitaryglennSingapore, Singapore
Title: Elegant, Modern Peranakan food
Review: Kebaya is basically Peranakan food, elevated by modern Western techniques, a touch of foreign influences and a gorgeous dining environment. Many items on the menu are cooked sous vide and some others are confits. This is fine-dining, Penang style.It is a 3-course set menu at RM 110 per person - the most expensive meal we had in Penang BY FAR. Those familiar with Peranakan food will probably wince at the price, but the experience, in my opinion, is worth it. For starters, we ordered otak otak which came in filo pastries with a spicy turmeric sauce on the side. We also ordered the ban xeo, a taco-like shell filled with stuff. The otak otak pastry was dry, a little hard to cut through and tasted like it had been prepared much earlier in the day and reheated. Without the sauce, it was uninspired. The ban xeo was not bad, but nothing to write home about.The next course was the main. You get to choose 1 protein and 1 green to pair with white rice. I ordered the lor ark (duck confit) and the spicy wingbean salad which I paired with a glass of rose . The duck was absolutely sublime. Quite possibly the best duck dish I have ever had. Slight crisp on the outside and perfectly cooked on the inside. The sauce was sticky, sweet and savoury, made with plums and mandarins, and lovely with the rice. The wingbean salad brought the acid and spice - a great complement to the duck. It seemed to contain fish sauce and some green mangoes, which made sense when I read later that the sous chef is Thai. The rose pairing was a winner (and I find this to be true with Peranakan food in general). It worked perfectly with the spice and acid of the salad and was a great counterpoint to the sweetness of the duck.My wife ordered the organic roast pork (sio bak) - about 8 slivers of pork (measly next to the generous portion of duck) - and the tempura veges. The pork was very tasty, especially with the sauce, but very little crackle on the skin. The tempura batter was a little too salty and perhaps a little out of place on the menu.Finally, the desserts. As I write this, I'm having a hard time remembering the desserts. Oh ya, a chocolate fondant cake and a gula melaka mousse. Chocolate fondant was so-so, the mousse was quite interesting. Strong molasses flavours and some coconut milk (i think). Yet it was effortlessly light and quite enjoyable.A quick word about the ambiance and service. The restaurant is located within the stunning Seven Terraces boutique hotel, and the dining room is exquisite. They even had a pianist on a baby grand (if memory serves). And while I misguidedly brought our 1y/o along, it isn't a place for a cranky infant/toddler. The silver-haired 'head-mistress', while cordial and extremely attentive, is quite serious about keeping the aura of swank undisturbed.Show less

Author: SustainableJohnMilton Keynes, United Kingdom
Title: A real find
Review: We dis not know George Town but the reviews of this place were good and it looked good , so we decided to give it a try. What a piece of luck. The food was outstanding, service excellent, manager a delight, setting beautiful, a concert level pianist playing (discretely) and all this and it was good value too. We instantly booked for the next night and everything was just as superb. A real find.Show less

Author: rcllawHong Kong, China
Title: Do share your dishes and come early to admire the building itself
Review: With so many good reviews before , there is really no need for me to add any more words about the meal itself. But perhpas the suggestion for people to share their dishes. So it you have more than 4 people , do try to order different dishes from the menu and you will be able to sample all the signature dishes . Mind you , some of the dishes are spicy( hot) and you need to ask the waiter to convey to the kitchen to modify the taste slightly for you if that is not your favourite thing. Also , if you are coming here for dinner , do come early before the sun come down to admire the renovated old building that house this restaurant ( the boutique hotel therein). The courtyard inside is really elegant and your camera will be put to good use.Show less

Author: Robert HPanay Island, Philippines
Title: Dining at Kebaya is suggested for any visitor to George Town
Review: The dining environment is so exquisitely beautiful, it's a challenge for the food to match it. The dishes we had were beautifully presented, competent and enjoyable, but not exceptional. Still the entire experience was so enjoyable that we advise anyone visiting Penang to have at least one meal at Kebaya.Show less

Author: UKcriticLancashire, England
Title: Lives up to Number 1 rating
Review: Beautiful restaurant with first class service and wonderful food. One of those rare places that you suspect that everything on the menu is top rate so you can choose anything at all and be very well satisfied. We chose from the 4 course menu and loved every part of it.Expensive by Malaysian standard but still great value for what you get. If you get the chance, go.Show less

Author: 1201NN
Title: Absolutely perfect! The "pearl" of the Pearl of the Orient!
Review: From the moment you step inside, you know it's going to be special even before you see the menu. Jackie the major domo greets you warmly and professionally watches over the intimate setting while a concert worthy pianist plays in the background. A prix fixe menu of exquisitely inspired and prepared items to pleaseeveryone's taste. Flawless service. You won't be disappointed.Show less

Author: Charlie BEdinburgh, United Kingdom
Title: Top Penang Restaurant - Popular so make a Reservation
Review: During our stay at the Seven Terraces hotel we had dinner each evening at Kebaya. We were there during Chinese New Year and the dishes on offer reflected this....a fusion between Chinese and Malay. Whilst the menu was a little limited each of the dishes on offer were truly excellent. The were a choice of two appetisers/starters then you selected a main course and a "green" course and finally a choice of desserts. In the case of the latter we would highly recommend the creme brûlée and the panna cotta - just delightful!!The service both in the bar and in the restaurant were second to none. This is a "must" for any visitor to Penang - evidenced by the fact that it was always busy and many were local!Show less

Author: sweetaftonSingapore, Singapore
Title: Ideal place to entertain foreign visitors
Review: A very popular venue, part of the Seven Terraces hotel. A pianist was playing in the bar area. The cuisine is local Peranakan or Straits Nyonya, presented in non traditional ways. The 4-course menu is prefixed, divided into appetisers, mains, greens, and desserts. The diner has to select an item from each group. We shared plates to have a taste of everything ordered.Portions were quite generous and we were really satiated by the end of the meal.Service was friendly, informative, and efficient. The pace was leisurely. Corkage was MYR 30/- a bottle.Because the restaurant is located in a heritage area, the street outside is narrow. Parking is definitely a problem. Highly recommended. Reservations a must. Come by cab. Nearest carpark a good 10-15 mins walk.Show less

Author: EricT007Osaka, Japan
Title: Beautiful heritage place but not authentic Peranakan
Review: The setting of Kebaya is in a very beautifully restored Peranakan dining room with 5 meter high ceiling surrounded by antique Peranakan plates and bowls and the whole ambience is one of the highlights of dining here. The food is sort of Peranakan with a modern twist. For a true Penangite like my mother who is adept at cooking and tasting Peranakan food it may not be to their liking. The food probably will cater for those Penangites who had left Penang many years ago and made their money overseas and is back for a visit. The house smoked salmon Yee Sang was one of the best modern interpretation of this traditional dish during Chinese New Year. However the roll it yourself Poh Piah was disappointing as the filling was dry and tasteless. For the mains, the chicken curry Kapitan had succulent chicken pieces in thick curry sauce but the prawn Gaeng in thick tumeric coconut curry was too rich with coconut milk but not enough spices making it rich but bland. The grilled snapper had no grilled taste at all and tasted like steamed instead of grilled.The desserts were very good! The panna cotta with passion fruit was a great combination and the pandan creme brûlée was superb! The Tang Yuen using Ondeh Ondeh simmered in coconut milk with thin slices of fresh coconut flesh was also a mark of genius! In summary go there for for the ambience and the dessert to avoid disappointment as there are many other better Peranakan restaurants in PenangShow less

Author: Taylor4-13
Title: Beautiful setting. Great meals
Review: We had three meals in this restaurant during our stay at Seven Terraces.  My husband and I are vegetarian and they went out of their way to adapt existing options for us.  Excellent meals in a beautiful setting

Author: BendyBonesManchester, United Kingdom
Title: Wonderful dining experience!
Review: Had an amazing and memorable evening here with my husband. We had pre dinner cocktails whilst perusing the menu. The staff were so attentive and professional. The manager welcomed us and showed us pictures of how the building had been renovated - definitely with lots of thought and attention to detail. The decor, lighting, ambience, food, service and pianist all made for a wonderful evening. I felt truly special and thoroughly spoilt...thanks to Kebaya's excellent team. Would highly recommend a visit as it's definitely worth the extra expense. Show less

Author: breascleteMona Vale, Australia
Title: Best we have been in s.e Asia
Review: This place is truly a well oiled machine. Service, food and ambience all come together in one fantastic package, from pre dinner cocktails thru to 4 course dinner thus was a first class dining experience. There was also a pretty decent pianist playing in the background during whole evening. The main course snapper and tamarind beef were excellent , the lamb was ok. If we thought the meal was good then the desserts were out of this world. Like the seven terraces hotel we are staying in this whole experience can only be produced with exceptional management and that is evidently present with every minor detail. I can't think of one better dining experience I've had in recent memory anywhere !Show less

Author: ileftmyheartnseattleDavis, California
Title: The best restaurant in George Town
Review: I've been to Kebaya twice. Once with another couple and the second time for Valentine's day with my husband. On both occasions I had delicious food, excellent service, and beautiful ambiance. In my opinion this is the finest restaurant in George Town. I also enjoy starting in the bar area, which is very cozy and inviting, and being seated once the first course is ready. The staff are extremely polite and attentive and the management is professional and hospitable. An example, during my last visit I was drinking wine, but two is my limit and I was wanting a glass of water. The thought had just entered my mind and I saw our waiter bringing over two glasses of ice water. Now that's service!Show less

Author: Allison DMorpeth, United Kingdom
Title: Fine dining in a beautiful setting
Review: Kebaya is a little gem where you can enjoy delicious food in a gorgeous setting. The restaurant forms part of the Seven Terraces hotel and the whole building has been lovingly restored to create an intimate and elegant ambience. Service is exemplary and the dishes compliment each other very well. It's clear that the menu has been prepared with care and attention to detail. I'd describe the flavours as modern Peranakan with a french twist. Do visit if you're able.Show less

Author: Darien G
Title: Kabaya
Review: The food was fresh, beautifully cooked and tasted delicious.the ambience of the restaruant is lovely and the service was friendly, staff have been well trained. Would highly recommend this restaruant to anyone wanting beautiful food and a quiet place for thT special occasion dinner.

Author: Dannielle E
Title: Food was excellent
Review: A fantastic restaurant in Georgetown housed in an old colonial building. The flavours were fantastic, I would describe it as fusion food but delicious and beautifully presented. I can't recommend this restaurant highly enough!

Author: PracticalCritic
Title: Venue with good ambience
Review: Kebaya is a beautifully refurbished restaurant and has a wonderful ambience. It provided a special atmosphere for our get-together of friends. The service and staff were friendly, attentive and helpful. However the Peranakan food was disappointing, on the night we were there, the food was no match for the best of Penang Peranakan food. Thus my average score despite the great decor and surroundings. The food in a restaurant must be the most important part of a dining experience, and while not bad, the food was certainly not the best Peranakan I have tasted. And the price was high.We still had a good time as the staff were attentive and the place is really quite beautiful.Show less

Author: Leconcombre2014Luxembourg City, Luxembourg
Title: Very good asian-fusion dinner with attentive staff
Review: Long time I wanted to have dinner at the number 1 restaurant in Penang. For all sorts of reasons, I had never manage to make it. For this trip tothe Island I made sure to full-fil my desire. I was welcome by the staff and was given the interesting menu. As starter I selected the selected very tasty shrimps with sugarcane. My main dish, the Australian beef was delicious. The only disappointing part was the "green".The beans/baby corn in peanuts sauce were not special. the cook made up with an fantastic dessert based on fresh coconut flesh and milk. For the entire dinner the staff members were attentive and professional. A great evening at Kebaya, finally.Show less

Author: KentManKentKent
Title: Outstanding
Review: Do go to Kebaya. You will not regret it. The whole experience is outstanding - the beautifully restored room, decorated and furnished with great style - the excellent four course menu (our waiter helpfully explained how it worked, pointed out the two spicy dishes and suggested we each choose something different and share them, which we did) - the beautifully cooked and presented delicious food - the excellent cocktails - and most of all the outstanding service from the superb staff.Not cheap by local standards, but exceptional value and truly memorable. No wonder it is No. 1 on Tripadvisor.Show less

Author: Chepeow
Title: Fine Dinning
Review: One of my favorite restaurant in town. Proud to say that I have eat through the whole menu. I especially love the desserts here. Atmosphere is great. Helpful and efficient staffs. Never fails to impress my friends or guests to dine in Kebaya. Highly recommended.

Author: ReedRoverManchester, United Kingdom
Title: Treat yourself!!
Review: The building is beautiful and the ambiance of the dining room is perfect. Mosaic tiled floors, wood panelled walls and the sounds of the piano gently playing in the background provides the perfect backdrop to indulge in fantastic food.It's nice to eat off quality crockery and utilise nice cutlery which perfectly complements the dining experience. I don't have to pick out individual dishes or complement the excellent waiting staff because previous posts have already done that but I will reiterate that a visit to this restaurant is well worth the effort and the extra expense.Show less

Author: Tom YGlendale, Ohio
Title: Eat at the stalls, save money. Then eat here.
Review: We had the most spectacular meal here. I had a red snapper with a Penang type sauce my wife had beef. One course was better than the next. The facility itself is beyond words. The most beautiful. We didn't have a reservation and the restaurant was full so they let us sit at the huge dining table. We felt like a queen and king! After dinner the host toured us around and showed us the hotel and explained all the work that was done. It's beautiful and the food delicious. Show less

Author: Daphne YBury St. Edmunds, United Kingdom
Title: Fine dining, lovely setting
Review: this was the best restaurant we found in Georgetown. A modern take on traditional Straits dishes, well cooked and served impeccably. Not the place to choose if you want a budget meal, but definitely the place if you want to eat well in elegant surroundings. Great breakfasts too.Show less

Author: sansanvmHong Kong, China
Title: Bad experience in the restaurant
Review: I am first time visit Penang, we specially choose this restaurant as we found the internet comment, it is historic place. When we arrived the staff is very nice and we finally decided to dine in this restaurant, since the time still early, around 6 : 00 pm, the restaurant is only us and have told the waiter we can start dinner at around 6:30 and then snapping outside, however, when we walking around and shooting at the courtyard, suddenly a nervous GM stop us snapping, he said the other side is the hotel lobby , it is a really embarrassed us as they did not inform us in advance or no sign / notice, the hotel lobby is not allow to photo taking. In fact, all the camera are without flash on, we are traveller , snapping around is normal , how come suddenly have a guy come out and stop us ???For the food, this restaurant only serve set dinner and no a la carte menu, it is too full for us. For travellers from western country, I believe it is good but for Asian it is just so so fusion food... It is true that the environment is good and clean.Show less

Author: S_BeatoongMelbourne, Australia
Title: Nice meal in a beautiful setting
Review: The hotel (Seven Terraces) that the restaurant is located in is absolutely stunning and the dining room was tastefully decorated with beautiful crockery. The service was good and we were given some recommendations for their 4 course menu. The menu was supposedly nonya but there were a lot of options that reminded me of Vietnamese food. We got the spring rolls (yummy and crunchy), otak otak which was served in a pie form (tasty), tamarind beef (quite dry), pork belly (some pieces had great crunch but overall very tasty), super crunchy tempura veges, four bean salad, pandan creme brûlée (better dessert) and the mousse. Everything was generally well cooked and yummy but we didn't think it was anything super innovative. It is definitely pricier than most restaurants in Penang but you get to sit in beautiful chairs, and eat off gorgeous plates and bowls while a pianist plays in the background.Show less

Author: Alexparis183Roussillon, France
Title: Quite perfect
Review: This beautiful restaurant nestled in the Seven Terraces hotel looks like a perfect colonial haven. It feels like a lounge, a club, a bar... And a restaurant of course.Cocktail didn't really impress us. But the 4 dishes set, to choose from a promising menu of interesting fusion dishes, did. I could recognize some Vietnamese favorites, with a twist, Chinese, Malay... Every single dish I tasted, in my plate and in my husband's plate :-) was delicious.The meal was one of our best in Malaysia!Show less

Author: PeterFiftyLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Rightfully No. 1 in Penang!
Review: We discovered Kebaya two months after they opened in November 2012 and have been recommending to friends visiting Penang ever since, so we are pleased that the restaurant has gone from strength to strength and built up such a good reputation amongst it's competitors.For our second visit, in January 2015, we actually felt the overall dining experience was even better than the first, which was difficult to improve upon. The setting, in one of Penang's historic buildings, is stunning and the delicious food complemented by the ambiance of a bygone era and a very talented pianist. The food at Kebaya really speaks for itself and we will certainly be back and continue to recommend to others too.Having dined at most of the other 'fine dining' restaurants in Penang we feel that Kabaya really does stand out from the crowd and has a winning formula in great service, unpretentious food which is packed with flavour and is good value for money too (re-reading my Jan 2013 review the set menu has only gone up by 10RM in two years).Show less

Author: dordognemarkBeaumont-du-Perigord, France
Title: Our best meal in Penang
Review: This was our second visit as we loved our first a couple of years ago, this time we were even more impressed.This restaurant has it just right, it has created an elegant colonial style without being 'stuffy' or ''pretentious', the staff are very welcoming and offer excellent service. In particular Kerwin who looked after us very well.The pianist who provides and ambient background music is super talented, a lovely blend of modern and classical choices provide the perfect balance.The food is simply amazing. The menu is just 110MYR plus plus, which is great value for the wonderful dishes they serve. Portion size is generous, and without exception, every dish was perfectly cooked and presented. A recommend the Confit Duck main, delicious. We will return and definely continue to recommend.Show less

Author: NICK RCheltenham, United Kingdom
Title: A great choice for a special meal
Review: We had an excellent meal at Kabaya.We had, for starters, fish pie and pork buns followed by the beef and duck and the choc fondant and panna cotta and sides of tempura veg and wing bean salad.All the dishes were very tasty, used good quality ingredients and were well presented. The beef was melt in the mouth and the wing bean salad really excellent.Portion size is very generous.Service v good and ambiance relaxing.Our most expensive meal by a very long way whilst in Penang but worth it!Show less

Author: 747HolsxUnited Kingdom
Title: Amazing food
Review: Four of us had dinner here in early January. The building has been beautifully renovated. The service was efficient but we were a little 'rushed' and the waiter was a bit curt when explaining some dishes. The food was fantastic. We all shared four starters and then each chose a different meal and no one was disappointed with their choice. The flavours of the nyonya dishes were delicious. We would highly recommend this restaurant Show less

Author: LondonTravelbirdLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Lovely restaurant, good and inventive food
Review: A very beautiful restaurant with a lovely dining room. Very good low key service. Very good food. A treat to have the fine dining experience in Penang. Many of the very good restaurants here are not places to take lots of time to leisurely eat lunch or dinner, they are more functional. Here you can relax and take your time.Show less

Author: JasmineLaila
Title: Amazing feast at Kebaya
Review: Easily one of the best fusion food in Penang despite the price. Although we can only order the set meals but the quality of food, posh environment and impeccable services more than justify.

Author: LostWanderlusterPalm Harbor, Florida
Title: Wonderful meal, get
Review: For Georgetown, we think this is a must visit restaurant for quality, service, food, and atmosphere. Kebaya is one of only two restaurants we visited twice during our stay. They offer a four course dinner option for RM 110 (about $33 U.S.) and we had a bottle of Shiraz one dinner and a Shiraz/Cab the second dinner --- RM 120 and RM 135 (approx. $35 - $45 U.S.). The food is just unexpectedly tasty and high quality. Our five star ratings are for the Georgetown area but this would rate 4+ stars most anywhere in the world. What a value!!! Jackie (the hostess and just about everything else) is a treasure. Also, if you are planning a visit to Penang/Georgetown, Malaysia, do yourself a favor and check out the Seven Terraces Hotel. Kebaya is associated with this hotel and they are both quality operations. Very very nice.Yes, Kebaya gets my very selective YMMMMMM rating. HA.Grilled SnapperDuck ConfitChocolate FondantShow less

Author: CraigLaronta
Title: Memorable
Review: An excellent course dinner at Seven Terraces' renowned restaurant. Immaculate service and great dining experience more than justify the relatively high price tag associated with the dinner. Great painist complemented the dinner as well.

Author: sharonsO6579SU
Title: A wonderful Oasis
Review: We ate here with dear friends at the end of December, the decor was charming, the tables well spaced, service great and food exceptional. We ate at some wonderful restaurants while in Penang but this clearly was the best.

Author: perkybLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Lovely for a special occasion
Review: I took my husband to Kebaya for his birthday recently. I am vegetarian and he very definitely isn't so I was struggling to find somewhere special in George Town. I emailed the restaurant to see if they could do a veggie option for me and they responded immediately and were charming and accommodating. We booked a late table which worked well for us so we could have a cocktail at the bar first. The setting is stunning and the service was great - Marcus in particular really looked after us. My husband had lots to choose from on the set menu and I know he enjoyed his meal, but I was in raptures over mine! I had no idea what to expect but was delighted with my salad starter - lots of crunchy fresh salad veg with a gorgeous tamarind/lemongrass/palmsugar marmalade. And then the main course arrived. I was presented with a beautiful giant lacquered box and when they lifted the lid there were six different veggie dishes inside, and each one was superb. A highlight was the okra, mint and pomegranate salad. A passionfruit panna cotta completed the meal. I don't often get to enjoy such a feast at a non-veg restaurant. A lovely place for a special occasion.Show less

Author: Macon F
Title: Number 1 Restaurant in Penang
Review:
Amazing food and service and is excellent for a special occasion.  
Piano played by Andrew
Expensive but worth it!

Author: Peter A
Title: A special place
Review: It's located in the Seven Terraces Hotel which is a beautifully refurbished terrace of shop houses in the heart of Georgetown. The setting is gorgeous and the food is wonderfully presented on lovely porcelain.

Author: gazza6London, United Kingdom
Title: Superb dinner in a delightful setting.
Review: We went to this restaurant one evening last week and enjoyed it so much we returned a couple of days later. The restaurant is part of the seven terraces hotel which has been very tastefully restored from several derelict buildings in the heart of Georgetown. The restaurant was fully booked on the first night but they said if we could leave it until 8:30pm they could accommodate us.We arrived at 8.30 and were greeted by the hostess Jackie and shown to our table. The menu was quite exquisite and the food was brought to us in a timely manner. There was a pianist playing in the background which added a certain air to the dining room. The restaurant was well staffed and all the staff were welcoming and friendly without being intrusive.Unfortunately they had run out of one of our choices, the duck. The food was delicious, well prepared and delightfully presented. The taste was superb. We had a thoroughly enjoyable dinner and returned on our last night to have another blow out meal.The second occasion they had the duck which I must admit was the best cooked duck I have ever had in any restaurant. The ingredients are top notch and the subtle spices were just right.I would highly recommend this restaurant if you want to have a brilliant meal in a very comfortable environment. The menu was varied and the standard was exquisite. The staff and atmosphere was delightful and a credit to the management.Show less

Author: Nathasha K
Title: Mouth watering
Review: Unbelievably good! This is a must try for anyone who fancy Nyonya/Peranakan food in its authenticity, heritage feel and intimate service. Simply amazing and unforgettable. Pricey but what can you expect from a top notch diner?

Author: CeiloTelford, United Kingdom
Title: Exceeded our expectations
Review: Staying in Penang we wanted to try Kebaya as we had seen reviews back in the UK.We arrived having had a Nyonya meal the evening before thinking we knew what type of food we would get, but we couldn't have been more pleasantly surprised!From the greeting we received from Jackie to the attention we got from the bar staff and the fabulous cocktails and Negroni's - equal only to those taken in Italy itself.We were given our menus and Jackie explained to choose a starter, main, side dish and dessert and left us to choose in peace - we were able to wander around the building in between choosing our food - what a fabulous restoration project! The before and after comparisons were stunning, I'm no expert but the panelling, decorations and layout looked like an authentic shophouse type building.Anyway, back to the food! There were four of us and so we were able to sample four different dishes - Ban Xeo, chicken, vegetables and tofu in crispy wafers - Pai Tee, crisp "top hats" of prawn, vegetables and sweet chilli - Chao Tom, delicious prawn paste on sugar cane skewers and Joo Hoo Char Rolls, Pork, squid and veg in lattice rice paper - all bursting with flavour and texture and absolutely delicious and innovatively presented.For mains we went for soft shell Crab salad with mango, apple and pomegranate, organic roast Pork belly with hoisin and balsamic, 72 hour cooked tamarind Beef and an absolutely gorgeous Prawn Geng, all served with endless steamed rice - the beef and pork were meltingly tender and the prawn curry creamy and gently spiced whilst the salad perfectly balanced sweet and sour.We tried tempura vegetables dusted with belachan, Wing bean salad, sambal goreng, chargrilled and added to coconut cream and Cher Chai sautéed greens.The waiting staff were fabulous, professional but very friendly and endlessly patient with my brothers bad jokes and teasing!When we were fit to burst our desserts came after a small gap to allow us to breathe, two had Chocolate fondant but even this had a twist and seemed to be combined in the centre with passion fruit coulis, this cut through the chocolate richness superbly, one Pineapple cake special was declared the best dessert that my brother has ever eaten and the Tang Yeun which was chosen because we thought we should try it was to die for! Young coconut and toasted coconut dumplings afloat in warm coconut milk sweetened with palm sugar.A blissful meal that over delivered massively, it's an absolute must if you are visiting Penang, we will definitely book a room for a few days in the hotel when next in Malaysia.Well done on the restoration of this old traditional building, beautifully and tastefully done and well done on the fabulous restaurant, food and staff!Show less

Author: Hilde P
Title: Great restaurant!
Review:
I just had one of the best meals ever!
The decor and service - great. Then a brilliant live pianist, called Jason Shua, playing Puccini, Chopin ...,  if you come to Georgetown Penang and apreciate quality, don't miss an evening at Kebaya,

Author: AmandaMayas
Title: Charming
Review: One of the best meals I have tried in Penang amid the tastefully designed and decorated restaurant in Seven Terraces.  Fantastic food plus immaculate service,  this is a memorable dining experience not to be missed

Author: Giogina R
Title: Simply the best
Review: Rivaling the best Peranakan dishes from historical town of Malacca, this is one of the best cuisines I have tasted anywhere. There is no comparison on its feel and service too. Highly recommended.

Author: Steve GRedhill, United Kingdom
Title: Great meal
Review: I visited with a friend on Saturday 12th Jan for dinner. We found it to be a great experience from start to finish. Lovely food, staff. The piano also helped with the atmosphere. I cannot explain why but I also liked the crockery. It looked brand new. I would recommend this restaurant to anyone who fancies a decent meal in comfy surroundings. I would certainly go back to try other dishes on the menu.Show less

Author: JonathanDBryantSydney, Australia
Title: Stunning
Review: We recently enjoyed dinner at Kerbaya. Housed in a superbly refurbished series of shop houses, this restaurant should absolutely not be missed if you are in Georgetown and enjoy good food. The décor is absolutely stunning. The service was exceptional and the food completely delicious. Highly recommended Peranakan cuisine in an uber glamorous environment!Show less

Author: Smith294265Singapore, Singapore
Title: Fantastic Experience
Review: We really enjoyed this place. We had the full menu with each of us ordering something different. Everyone was satisfied with our food. Beautifully presented. The dining room is lovely and the hotel looks fantastic. I will stay at the Seven Terraces the next time I visit Penang.Show less

Author: Rod E
Title: Something a little special in Penang
Review: Great location, great accommodation and great food and the service was second to none. People so friendly and efficient. We came early evening as we heard it was very popular. Good move as we got great seats at the restaurant and had a good night

Author: schmidtmgSwitzerland
Title: perfect New Year's dinner
Review: we went to Kebaya for our New Year's dinner, and it was a thoroughly enjoyable and tasty experience. The setting in the beautifully restored Seven Terraces Hotel, the beautifully prepared and carefully cooked Peranakan dishes - we chose the New Year's menu - the wines, all lived up to the expectations we had from previous reviews. Too bad other evenings were also fully booked, otherwise we would have come back.Show less

Author: Foodie0505
Title: Best Restaurant in Penang
Review: Great Thai food at good prices, in lovely surroundings. Was a high point in our vacation over Christmas and the New year.

Author: BVOS99New Zealand
Title: Faultless Combination
Review: Kebaya is the stand out stylish restaurant in Penang set within an exquisitely restored heritage hotel. The theme throughout is Straits Chinese. Start with a Georgetown cooler cocktail which combines elements of Penang’s history: Nutmeg juice, limes, Bombay Sapphire gin, longan, grenadine and soda. 4 courses for RM110 included Tamarind Beef – Aussie beef glazed with tamarind and gula melaka and cooked for 72 hours, followed by a fabulous dessert of passionfruit and coconut panacotta. This dinner was delicate and perfect.NB: Popular with wedding parties who often stay in the adjacent Seven Terraces boutique hotel so make sure you book well in advance to avoid disappointment.Show less

Author: BillN674Carseldine, Australia
Title: Ahhh. Yumm
Review: We had the absolute pleasure of staying at seven terraces early October and dined here during our stay. Everything about this place is pretty perfect we think. The restaurant staff felt like family and the food and wine the night we dined was fantastic!!! It was so good we forgot to take our usual foodie photos to post with this review. The lamb shanks were to die for and we still talk about our wonderful experiences here including going to dinner with no shoes after a long hot day.Show less

Author: hvdmeebergAmsterdam, The Netherlands
Title: Perfect Fusion
Review: Kebaya is one of the best examples of malay/european fusion in Penang. A lovely chinese mansion atmosphere. Great food we really liked the tamarind beef and soft shell crab salad. Passionfruit pannacotta is also great but still cannot beat the best Italian version ever tasted in Bra (It).Show less

Author: davidetalMelbourne, Australia
Title: Seriously good ....food, service, ambience...everything.
Review: We didnt book but, perhaps because we were there at 6.30pm, they found us a table...and v glad they did.First, let me mention the piano player. Skilful, appropriate repertoire, not intrusive...much appreciated.Service was impeccable: quick, attentive,discreet.Food was of the standard you would expect of a high end restaurant: quality ingredients skillfully prepared and well plated. No knock out dishes....apart, that is, from the insanely superb pork belly; five stars with gravy on top.Do it. Treat yourselves!On our way out we walked through the hotel...wow wow wow.Show less

Author: brownbag68Geelong
Title: Well worth the hype - a dining experience
Review: My wife and I went here on our 21st wedding anniversary and we had a wonderful night. The service was outstanding and every bite of the food was delicious. We chose the duck and the chicken kopitam, and both were full of flavour and we savoured every bite. Had some wonderful desserts that reminded us of home (Austrlaia) but that included some wonderful local tastes (gula melaka, pandan). A thoroughly enjoyable experience. Expensive for Malaysia, but not really too much when you consider the quality. Every meal in Malaysia is about 1/3 what you pay in Australia. This cost $100 but would have cost well over $200 in Melbourne, as it was a dining experience.Show less

Author: Sandra19Sydney, Australia
Title: An oasis - amazing dining and service experience!
Review: After initial disappointment at not being able to secure accommodation at Seven Terraces due to a big wedding celebration, we booked for dinner and were blown away by everything. The hotel and restaurant are simply beautiful, a haven in gritty Georgetown, both stylish and refined. The food was amazing, the best Asian meal we've ever had with helpful, pleasant service and despite the portions not appearing enormous, we were incredibly full before dessert arrived. Notwithstanding the excellent ambience and food, we topped off the experience with a tour of the hotel, beautifully appointed with amazing attention to detail. Thank you for a wonderful evening 10/10 on all rankings.Show less

Author: NatanYoyo
Title: A good choice
Review: we found this restaurant from a staff at our hotel nearby. The atmosphere was good. Food was lovely and nice taste but they do not have any promotion for a special occasion. Hope that would be applied. And the location was good, easy to find.

Author: Girlie T
Title: Hole in your pocket
Review: Food's good but rather expensive.  There are many peranakan restaurants in Penang and this is by far the most costly.  Ambience is fantastic if that's what you want but if it's food you're interested in, try somewhere else.

Author: RainbowladSingapore, Singapore
Title: Interesting fusion (but not fantastic)!
Review: Kebaya Restaurant offers interesting fusion and Peranakan flavours! We ordered the Otak Otak and the Kebaya Ban Xeo for appetisers, followed by prawn geng & grilled snapper as our Mains. For greens, we ordered the wing bean kerabu and nonya tempura. Desserts were gula melaka mousse and tang yuen. Other than the Otak Otak and the Ban Xeo, we were not wowed by the prawn geng (too much thick coconut which mars the taste of the lemongrass and the tumeric curry). My spouse and I enjoyed the wing bean kerabu & the Otak Otak.I was excited by my order of the gula melaka mousse and was looking to indulge. But it turned out to be a disappointment. Maybe the gula melaka was lacking, hence the mousse lacks the oomph! Would I come back for dinner on the next visit to Penang? Maybe not!Show less

Author: Kuniko DHenrico, Virginia
Title: Nonya style cooking
Review: The restaurant was within a boutique hotel called Seven Terraces. The dining room was beautiful and the staff were very attentive. There was a pianist playing classical pieces that I enjoyed very much. The food was delicious. Everything was so full of flavor. When in Malaysia, one must try the Nonya style cooking, I was told. I am glad I did!Show less

Author: LadesClimpingCallington, United Kingdom
Title: Good food in a great setting
Review: We were recommended this restaurant and turned up without a reservation. The staff were really accommadating and found us a table. The set menu had a good selection of choices and the food itself was absolutely superb. We really enjoyed this place. It is a little expensive but well worth splashing out for!!Show less

Author: MatthijsK_13Amsterdam, The Netherlands
Title: just one perfect evening
Review: i followed most of the very hospitable staff recommendations... so had the red snapper starter, followed by the prawn curry with cumin delicious (i am from the netherlands..we have cheese with cumin) accompanied with the spicy but not too spicy salad, dessert also delicious.staff especially the guy from Sri Lanka and the fabulous Lady are great. they showed me around their property... next time I would love to stay there or in Sri Lanka as he suggested...Show less

Author: peter_mm_10Norwich, United Kingdom
Title: The best food, service and setting
Review: We went to Kebaya for my birthday and was not disappointed. We booked a table a few days earlier. We turned up early as we thought it would be nice to have a cocktail before dinner and enjoy the ambience. The staff were fantastic, helping us with our menu and wine choices. The restaurant is set in the Seven Terraces hotel. The food quality and quantity were perfect. It has to be one of the best evenings we have had. Absolutely faultless in every way. This is a must visit for everyone who likes good food and service. Cost worked out at approx MR 250 per person so if you can afford that, then you must go. Show less

Author: OlgaS481The Hague, The Netherlands
Title: Refined nyonya in elegant place
Review: We loved everything in Kebaya - tasty food (went for digustation menu), elegant decorations, friendly stuff, live music, even autentic cutlery. if you have a minute after making the order, scroll thru the Seven Terrase premises - it's silent dignity. It was three of us, so we ordered three fully different set of digustation menus - food was full of rich flaviours and very abandont. Easily enought for 5, not just 3 person, be ready for that. What we were missing is to have some more raw veggies to compliment "heavier" curries and rendangs. I agree with the ealier comments, that it was the best dining experience in Penang, keep for special moment/day/partner.Show less

Author: RS946
Title: Loved it!
Review: Great food, atmosphere and service. The menu is set at 100myr/pp and includes choices for four courses.  A true dining experience!

Author: VivianCyfEast Coast, Singapore
Title: Best Peranakan Crusine!
Review: We had our dinner here last Thursday, kebaya gave us an unforgettable dining experience. The food is superb delicious especially the snapper, the roasted pork and the appetite recommended by the staff. Food is good, staff service is good, unique penang architecture and a very good music along the dining, a restaurant you should not miss if you visit penang and highly recommended.Show less

Author: 248nickfHuntingdon, United Kingdom
Title: Simply Amazing
Review: I took my girlfriend here for her birthday during a short trip to Penang. We were both amazed with the food. The menu option was very good, both of us choosing different starters, mains, sides and deserts and then sharing them all. The restaurant itself is simply beautiful, with lovely live piano music playing in the background. All the dishes were delicious but the chicken kapitan was simply out of this world, and had we been there longer I would've returned again simply for this dish. Food of this standard in London I would expect to pay £100+ per head with wine. Here we had cocktails, wine and 4 courses and paid less than £100 in total. Put simply, this is the best place I've ever eaten, and would put a return trip to Malaysia at the top of my list purely because of this place. Show less

Author: TJFlinwardNottingham, United Kingdom
Title: Eating Elegance
Review: Everything we ate was fantastic. If we lived in Malaysia I would want to go every night - as it was we dined twice at Kebaya (we were staying at Seven Terraces), and loved everything we tried. Particular highlights were the fluffy pork buns, and the pudding of beautiful blue dumplings in a warm coconut milk broth with slivers of fresh coconut. Wonderful!Not only does Kebaya offer incredible food, but a skillful pianist plays throughout the evening which adds to the atmosphere of the beautiful setting. I was particularly delighted when on arrival I heard the strains of the minute waltz across the courtyard!Special mention must also go to the bar which in itself is very beautiful, and serves up some superb cocktails.Show less

Author: CestMoi33singapore
Title: Mixed feeling
Review: The ambiance was a great experience for a Peranakan restaurant. It feels refined and elegant. On the night we dined in there were a few dishes that were not available which was a let down for me. I was a bit surprised too to find vietnamese / japanese/western influence in the menu. The duck was pretty good but the grilled chicken tasted too sweet. There is no samba belachan either. Desert was good but nothing spectacular. Overall, the food could be a little bit more authentic even if they are positioned as fusion category. Service is excellent and the staffs always made sure that you have everything that you need.Show less

Author: Janine G
Title: Amazing Nyona style food with French twist
Review: Without doubt, one of the best restaurant meals we've ever had.  Superb in every way.  The blue rice balls for dessert were amazing, but then every meal at Kebaya is!

Author: LPItaliaMonza, Italy
Title: Great food in a lovely setting!
Review: Our dinner at Kebaya was very memorable and a highlight of our trip to Penang. The 4 course set meal was delicious and we can particularly recommend the entree with salmon roe, the duck main and the passion fruit panna cotta. The setting is very atmospheric and the pianist further added to the charm. Highly recommended and we wish we had the chance to go again!!Show less

Author: Kazzaneil
Title: Delicious
Review: A lovely restaurant with a reasonably priced set menu that has a lovely selection of food to choose from.  We ate here twice and enjoyed it on both occasions, highly recommend.

Author: Margaret GNew Zealand
Title: Perfect in every way
Review: My colleague and I chose Kebaya after reading reviews from Trip Advisor and we were impressed from the moment we stepped in the door. The restaurant is in a beautifully restored set of old buildings and every little detail seems to contribute to the ambiance. The service was outstanding and attentive but not intrusive. There was a set price, four course menu with fabulous and interesting choices for each course. We were advised by the wait staff to order different dishes from each other and share. We did this and got the feeling that there are no disappointing choices on the menu! We sat near another couple who told us they never eat anywhere else in Penang- the food is that good. I don't think I have ever eaten better!We did not visit the bar but it appeared to be another lovely part of the building.I will definitely go back next time I visit Penang. I recommend Kebaya very highly.Show less

Author: JeliyaBamako
Title: Wonderful, made our stay
Review: There are places you remember for a long time, and I am sure that Kebaya will be one of them, as indeed will Georgetown. We ate here as a family, and it was probably the highlight of our two-week holiday in Malaysia. We did a trawl of Georgetown restaurants and then went walkabout in the morning around the wonderful heritage part of the city. When we eventually came to the restaurant (part of a fabulous hotel) we were invited in and shown around. It is a beautiful setting and we immediately decided that we should eat there. The menu was presented to us, and we were even allowed to select our table. When we came back to eat, we opted for the four-course multi-choice menu, which as I recall was priced at RM 100 (€25, $30). This is more expensive than typical Malaysian food, but is excellent value by international pricing. For each course, we each ordered a different dish for the table and shared. The food was excellent and wonderfully varied in flavour and texture. I won't try to describe the dishes, but will just say that it was a meal to remember. The decor and ambience were wonderful. The service was a lovely combination of professional and informal. For me, Kebaya gets the full five stars.Show less

Author: hokkienlang1Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Dinner with a Past
Review: The decor of the place is amazing. Ambience is just nice.Service staffs are very proffesional & attentive. The Lady in the Sarong Kebaya lends an air of authencity to the place.Kudos to the friendly restaurant manager Marcus on introducing the place to us.Though it's not exactly Nyonya but that's the Peranakan spirit anyway where differences are absorb to create something new and interesting.Makes me happy that our heritage is being revived and appreciated in this modern times.Show less

Author: griffin139Dubai, United Arab Emirates
Title: Just Delightful
Review: Stayed with friends in Georgetown and had read about the restaurant at the Seven Terraces.Booked and went on a stormy wet night which just added to the effect. The setting is beautiful, like a dream, a wonderfully renovated block of old terraced houses.The restaurant has an amazing ambiance complete with a piano player and a great old wooden bar at one end of the room. The staff were very welcoming and the 4 course meal was simply delightful. Each course has an amazing selection of asian/chinese dishes all so well presented. If each of you picks a different dish then you can try them all. One of those rare evenings were everything feels perfect and you wish the wine bottle would last for ever. If only this restaurant was local and not 3000 miles away. We were taken around the hotel at the end of the evening and it looks just as good as everybody says, now just need to find an excuse to return.Show less

Author: bweib
Title: Excellent service compensates for the 'fushionised' Nyonya food
Review: Five of us walked in and were impressed with the immaculate decoration of the place. The service level was very attentive and friendly throughout the entire meal.As soon as we saw the set menu, we suspected the food has been 'westernised'. We were proven right when the food was served. Almost every item on the menu has been 'fushionised', making it less 'full of spice' (what Nyonya food is meant to be) and very much catered for foreigners. In summary , unlikely to return here for authentic Nyonya food but would probably still pay a premium for a drink amidst immaculately decorated Nyonya house.Show less

Author: Van Khiem VHo Chi Minh City, Vietnam
Title: Just perfect!
Review: Wow, that was nice. And difficult to choice from the menu (but that is a good thing ;)) and there was even some Vietnamese food on the menu :)The food is stunning, the service very helpful and friendly.The decoration in the restaurant is amazing.I like very much as well the different plateware during dinner. Lovely.Highly recommended.Tip: do make a reservation!Show less

Author: JashahaHong kong
Title: Loved everything here
Review: It was a very nice dining experience at Kebaya.The setting of this restaurant was impressive. Food was amazing. Service was exceptional.Food is mostly southeast asian/Chinese fusion. The flavours were so rich and special. We have been to lots of similar style restaurants before outside of Penang but we found this place exceptionally good!Show less

Author: mcsee77Melbourne, Australia
Title: Just exceptional
Review: Had the four course set menu here one night whilst staying at the adjoining Seven Terraces and were completely blown away. The food is amazing with generous portions designed to be shared in a serene, welcoming environment replete with pianist and cocktails to die for from Baba bar. We were especially impressed by how hassle-free it was to switch dishes to delicious vegetarian options. Dont just wait for a special occasion to book this fabulous restaurant, make any day special by dining here whilst in Georgetown! Show less

Author: SaracjbLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Wonderful food, service and ambience
Review: We ate at Kebaya while staying in Georgetown and thought it was the best restaurant in Penang. The food was imaginative and delicious, the service charming and attentive and the decor and ambience is gorgeous. An excellent wine list makes this a must visit restaurant. The betel leaf starter was to die for. Show less

Author: judejudeSydney, Australia
Title: Sensational food and great service.
Review: The restaurant is based in a wonderful boutique hotel consisting of a row of heritage terrace houses.There is a wonderful atmosphere and ambience and the best part is the food is exceptionally good.There is a choice of courses, which is difficult as they are all good choices.I'm looking forward to our next trip to Penang to get back to this restaurant.Show less

Author: G9127IIjameshLymington, United Kingdom
Title: WOW!!!
Review: We travelled around Malaysia for Honeymoon, and out of all the places we visited this was some, if not the best food we had. The restaurant is beautiful, and the atmosphere was great. The service was brilliant. (The Pianist was also amazing!) We had the set menu, and we got the waiter to choose our courses for us. Best decision we ever made, as everything he suggested was delicious!
