Just get a water filter , your workers and customers could enjoy it for life time . Or just one cup of plain water as a welcome drinks . Small little thing could give a deep impression to a person . This is just my own opinion , no offense . I just hope that KOTA could be better . Suggestion to customer: don't choose the table near the corner of the restaurant . That area is not covers by aircon . Show less

Author: Conal T
Title: Best part of Fort Cornwallis
Review: This stylish and modern café is situated inside Fort Cornwallis with a bookshopnext door. Great food and drinks;  the cendol smoothie was literally one of the best drinks I've ever had.

Author: Kevin C
Title: A hidden gem
Review: Being in Penang for more than 20 years, I am ashamed to miss such a wonderful place within a fort. The food was great, service was fast and staff was polite. A definitely must try location.

Author: dorbettsBoston, Massachusetts
Title: Nice ambiance with intricately flavored local food
Review: Set amidst Fort Cornwallis, Kota offers local delicacies of nyonya, laksa and gula-melaka laised cream brulee in a nice 60s modernist setting. Portions are haute-cuisine small, but the flavors are wonderfully executed. Service is the usual disappointment because foreign staff aren't given sufficient training. What it needs is maintenance to avoid continuous deterioration.Show less

Author: hilde2688Western Australia, Australia
Title: Fort Cornwallis Inside Food..
Review: In CNY, i have book a tour for Freestyle 8 Hours Tour, In this Kota restaurant , is a tourist sport to look for Fort and have a lunch at Kota. Friendly Staff try to explain for Rempah Meaning. Really look like When Francis Light Meets Rempah, The food is Fusion . Delicious , but only 1 thing not so good, a bit hot on it. i think it is because afternoon time. Show less

Author: larag978Amsterdam, The Netherlands
Title: Just had coffe but it was good!
Review: We have been here twice. Just for coffee. The staff is very nice and the coffee very good. The make slow coffee, so sit down and relax.. don’t rush.We did not eat here but the food the put on the tables next to us looks lovely.Show less

Author: baldwincKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Great 'local' dining experience
Review: Such a nice hidden gem inside Fort Conwallis. Was sceptical at first when I saw the price and the limited food items, but the food quality did not disappoint. Only wish the whole nice effort from the ambience to the food would be more complete if they play the right pipe in music and hire staff that has better command in English.Show less

Author: cynthialam312
Title: AWESOME !!!!
Review: Laksa here so nice!!! First, the presentation really cute, then when I sips the laksa soup,,,, OMG!!!! It's like flying to heaveeeennnnnn... with all the scenery at kota, I felt really relaxed and I looking forward to try other menu.

Author: _L4854VU
Title: Nice nyonya food
Review: This is my 1st time come to this nyonya restaurant in Penang, the nyonya food is very delicious and the ambience is very nice.

Author: JuEanHeng
Title: My kind of Sundate -- Francis
Review: Well, I felt so cool to dine in a fort. Kota is the first restaurant which is business in a fort. The ambience of the surrounding is harmony and they serve fusion cuisine. I'm in love with their cream brûlée.

Author: Jess L
Title: Special food representing of nyonya cuisine!
Review: Have a great lunch with my friend! Laksa nice and spicy ! Highly recommend for those who like to eat spicy food :)

Author: YongCheeT
Title: Creative & delicious
Review: Very pleasant. Loved the creative interpretation of laksa, nyonya & hokkien. Highly recommended cream buree !! It apply our local flavor into a classical french dessert, and super delicious.

Author: ivantan94Penang, Malaysia
Title: Very calm environment with good food embience
Review: Have been viewing all those that comment on trip advisor.the food presentation attracts me at my first sight.so planned to visit here on my girlfriends birthday.the food has a very unique taste and well prepared. The chicken tandoori Briyani was my favorite and also the creme brûlée its the best one ever I have tasted before.the staffs were very helpful to celebrate her birthday.u know it was a surprise birthday.the staffs gave us more idea on how to make it even better.we had a very pleasant dinner.and the service was great.thanks so much for being very helpful to me.highly satisfied and highly recommended.Show less

Author: Brandon LGeorge Town, Malaysia
Title: "When Francis meet me then only meet Rempah"
Review: Last yesterday I was having beriyani and asian breakfast together wif my wife.. Both was really really really nice n make me full untill cant walk .. Nice enviroment and they have a friendly staff .. Overall was Excellent ! Superb ! Daa best in Penang ! Show less

Author: siangt2016
Title: Lunch date with Francis
Review: Good environment, great service provided by the crew. Im in love with their creme brûlée, they present in three different flavor which is pandan, gula melaka and the glutinous rice stuffed in the creme brulee. And thumbs up for their main course " Nyonya " is really good taste, should have a try. :)Show less

Author: Minicboo90
Title: Unique Restaurants, Exciting!
Review: Visited this restaurant with my friends from Singapore, it's a very unique restaurant that actually located at Fort Cornwallis George Town Penang(Their says they are actually first restaurant that operated inside a big fort in Malaysia), Okay let's talk about the food, they actually serve Malaysian Fusion Cuisine,foods are surprising me, can you imagine how the dish 'hokkien' look and taste like? Yes should try this! The flavor and the taste are really nice & outstanding. For me the variety of the menu is alright because this is not a cafe style dining place, but it's a Unique Restaurant, they have proper setting on table and everything looks tidy like fine dining, but the price still consider as the same range with those Cafe in Penang. We enjoy dining at this cozy and relax place. Highly recommended.Show less

Author: Nadia A
Title: Overpriced, almost like a scam
Review: This "Fancy, High-End" restaurant is located inside the historic Fort Cornwallis.  They have very small and limited menu with a few choices for "set meal". We ordered a set meal which cost RM40 ++ , comes with appetizer, main course and dessert. We were rudely shocked when the appetizer was served: it was a bowl of regular Papadoms sprinkled with parsley leaves (the bowl was fancy). That's it. FYI, papadoms are served for free in Indian restaurants!!The papadoms were supposed to be served with "Pulut Udang" but according the the waiter, they were out out Pulut Udang so they added extra papadoms for us. LOLWAT We also tried the other dishes, Curry Puff, Briyani Rice , Hokkien MeeTo be fair, the chefs tried very hard to make the dishes "look fusion" but the taste? Disappointing. IMO, just cross the street to the restaurants/stalls over at Beach Street or the Esplanade Foodcourt for cheaper & delicious local food and if you want Fancy Fusion food, head over to "Kebaya" on Stewart Lane.Show less

Author: Jeffrey Ng T
Title: Very Unique Restaurant. Highly Recommended!!
Review:
A very unique restaurant in town, especially the food presentation and concept are exactly rendered Malaysian's culture. 
Waiter are very friendly, the food are delicious and the price was reasonable.

Author: rockie03Bristol, United Kingdom
Title: poor menu .. small , pricy too
Review: went here as was told about it , but when i got there there were only 2 tables inside at 1pm, the problem is you have to pay RM20 to get into the attraction to eat here, and the menu was very small and quite pricy .. so i dint eat here , didn't fancy the menu Show less

Author: Nuzrul H
Title: Highly recommended
Review: Such a very good place to have a fine dinner with family members,friends or loved ones...highly recommended to everyone...really love the foods presentation and the taste of the foods...fabulous service by the service crew...will visit again...

Author: TsyyyLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Good food presentation and in historical site
Review: Need to pay entrance fee, but later can be claim back from the food. It is in a historical site, there is cannon which leave there back then while war time. It is like a park now, besides it near seaside. And hence can roam around in that area. The food presentation is good. Is like fine dining presentation. The food Taste just alright. I like the creme bruree and satay. The birani and the hokkien nee don't really taste good. The water is charged and expensive. Show less

Author: Vincent K
Title: My first time
Review: The enviroment heritage and nice. Food taste delicious , suitable bring friend , family and customer for enjoy the food and enviroment.

Author: Jack_teh
Title: Best restaurant in town
Review: Good quality service, good quality food. Must try when visit Penang Island. I will visit again. Recommended !

Author: Mercelin
Title: Excellent Dinner having at here
Review: Their Service quite good, the food is too excellent for me , what i enter before feeling is they will be like normal cafe style , but , really amazing , they do food full creativity .

Author: jazzlahPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Fusion food that could surprise anyone~
Review: When i first visit, I found their menu is limited and with very ordinary name. I order Hokkien from menu and i was expect Hokkien Mee that could find any place in Penang. Surprisingly, Hokkien serve in Kota is not the Hokkien Mee that i try before, it's an idea from Hokkien Mee with some prawn bisque taste but the noodle is angle hair instead of normal yellow noodle. It's something that impress me and my wife. We found their Satay is unsual and delicious too. I definitely will come back to try for others....Show less

Author: AnwarAnis76
Title: Authentic local cuisine
Review:
Great food. Good service. Char Koey Teow highly recommend. 

The location maybe a little out of place, but don’t let that deter you.

Author: RussellHouse65Melbourne, Australia
Title: Looks Can Be Deceiving
Review: As the title says looks can be deceiving.Don't let the fact its hard to find, the plastic table & chairs or even the unique plastic bottle lighting (I love the lights).The food was so full of flavour extremely tasty, plenty of it and was on our table in a flash.The service was also exemplarmary.We stayed down here road a few hundred metres at the Shangri La.As my wife had a broken ankle and was on crutches, the Hotel rang the restaurant to check if they had an elevator, as she struggles going up and down stairs. Andrew's father yes the owners dad, came and picked us up and dropped us off after out meal.Just amazing service and great food which all contributed to a fantastic nightShow less

Author: russellh559
Title: Looks Are Deceiving
Review: As the title says, looks are deceiving. Don't let the seating and unique bottle lighting put you off this place as the food and service were amazing.Andrew's can be hard to find, but it's well worth it.Food was full of flavour plenty of it and was on our table in a flash.The service was also exemplarmary. We stayed only a few hundred metres down the road at the Shangri La.As my wife had a broken ankle and was on crutches, The Shangri la rang the restaurant to check if there was an elevator (couldnt get up stairs) and the owners, yes the owners father came to picked us up and then dropped us off after our meal, just amazing service.Highly recommended. Show less

Author: Yvette FBuckingham, United Kingdom
Title: Dont miss this restaurant
Review: Stayed in the area for 5 nights and ate here twice. I had chosen it because of previous reviews, and im glad i had seen them or i would probably given this place a miss. Its located just down the road from shangri la and is located in a pretty run down shopping area on the upper floor but dont let this put you off as the food is really worth going for. Andrew is very welcoming and friendly and had a great menu. We loved the spring rolls, the crispy duck and the fried rice was so tasty, we would happily eat it on its own. We also tried the deep fried ice cream which was great. The flavours that he produces in his dishes are sublime and if we had tried here on the first night, would probably not eaten anywhere else. The meal with drinks came to under £20. Worth every penny. This review was from nov 19 but i found i hadnt posted it and wanted people to know how good it wasShow less

Author: jieyip2017Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Friendly, affordable and delicious local food.
Review: Very friendly service, our family went there around 7pm without reservation, they accommodated us as the place was fully reserved for 8pm. Do call up to make a reservation during peak travel season. The food were very delicious, love the green curry and clay pot tou fu! They have plenty of Asian food choices, a few western food option, vegetarian friendly and they serve beer.Show less

Author: TribalVancoverTian'e County, China
Title: A Nice place for a quiet dinner
Review: I came here after reading the "terrible" review just to give a try for the food, since I'm a local penang.The food was ok, I'll rate 4 stars out of 5. I'm suprise a small restaurant's menu have almost 50+ choice of food for you to choose.Price wise is reasonable, one sizzling black pepper beef set cost RM15 come with a rice and egg, and actually the portion is quite big for an adult. I'm suprise some other stated over price, You expect wayu beef steak with this price tag??Location wise, you will miss this place if you didn't pay enough attention to the signboard, even some resident here don't know this place despite staying here for years. However it is a worthy place for dine in.Show less

Author: oscar_ubillus
Title: New year 2021 trip to Penang
Review:
The food was delicious, all Thai dishes were really good. The service also really good and the price was not expensive.

I definetely come back to this restaurant next time in Penang.

Author: dyganonKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Best Nyonya Food in Malaysia
Review: Lots of the nyonya food in Melaka and Kuala Lumpur seem to be very sweet and mild spicy. Not Andrew kampung. Here you can get Malaysia Nyonya food with Thailand hot and spicy. The amount of chilli in Devil curry beef is mind blowing. I am very near getting hiccups. Good quality cuts of beef. No chewvy fat and tendon.I think the chef is half Thai. She watched youtube in Thai after done cooking.It is a bit of fresh air of Malaysia Nyonya Cuisine. Tamarind Chicken was amazing. I could just have rice with gravy. Very thick sauce.Great place for lunch. Overlook the hotel. Not so great in the evenings with the noise of the crows and birds nearby.Daytime is much quiet.Show less

Author: drnavin83London, United Kingdom
Title: Simple, homely with great food
Review: This place give you the warmth of being 'at home' the minute you walk in. It has the simplest of decors, but is very nice.Very honest people, we ordered a few dishes, and the guy that took our order told us to order one size smaller as the portions are big. I honestly cannot recall the last time an owner of an establishment who suggested that.And the food was generously portioned, from the dishes to the coffee and even the dessert. As for the taste, it was nothing short of expectation. We enjoyed our dinner here and we would definitely return! Highly recommended!Show less

Author: Florence TKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Wonderful lunch
Review: Had lunch at this lovely restaurant with my family (3 kids, aged 1-6). Everything on the menu looked fantastic, but we finally settled on lemon chicken (this was a super crowd pleaser), squid, fried rice and home made tofu and vegetables. The food was prepare really quickly and smelt delicious. My girls enjoyed every single dish and told us that they wanted to come again. This is definitely worth another visit. Everything is was perfect - well cooked value for money food, excellent service and very family friendly. At the end of the meal my husband declared "we can never go back to eating hotel food again". Show less

Author: Laurent D
Title: Excellent diner will delicious meals!
Review: Very nice restaurant with delicious dishes. Dynamic and friendly team. Not too expensive. Lots of tourists because famous place. Be careful when looking for the restaurant: it is in an upstairs building!

Author: Doccraignewlands
Title: The spring rolls, sizzling
Review: The spring rolls, sizzling prawns and devil prawns were delicious. The staff were very friendly and efficient. I would definitely recommend. Very good value.

Author: suziecraigb
Title: Duck and the Malay curry!
Review: Food was great with great service! Great to watch the family dynamic in running restaraunt! Ate here a couple of times! Great both times!

Author: ostGlasgowglasgow
Title: Highly recommend
Review: A must if you are in Penang! Food was wonderful! Don't be put off by the building this is an amazing restaurant. We were in Penang for 4 days and ate here twice. The black vinegar chicken was superb as were all the other dishes we had! Show less

Author: JCT1962Newcastle, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent Local Food
Review: Many reviews focus on the fun and chaotic atmosphere of this place, which is I have to say great fun, but that is to do a disservice to the food which we found once again to be very good. We had starters of Satay and Samosas followed by Malaysian Chicken Curry and Masala Chicken accompanied by Fried Rice all of which were tasty and spicy. The food also offers superb value for money.Show less

Author: sb00th4Sheffield, United Kingdom
Title: Family Diner
Review: We visited based on the reviews on trip advisor and were not disappointed.The building itself is not the most inviting but dont be put off as the food and service are excellent. I had the prawn sizzler on Andrew's recommendation and it was by far the best I had while in Batu Ferringhi. The rest of the food was also very tasty and of a good standard at reasonable prices. I would definitely return to Andrew's next time we visit Penang.Show less

Author: harvey3705
Title: 2nd year/visit
Review: Came here last year so decided to go again. loads of people return. stairs to climb, nice welcome, good food, good service, always busy. good price.

Author: Angela MWest Sussex, United Kingdom
Title: Terrific food!
Review: Well worth the clamber up the three flights of concrete stairs to get to Andrew's. Definitely the best food in the area, which is why you mostly need to book. Andrew and his staff are all very helpful and attentive. We tried some of his signature dishes - the calamari in particular were absolutely fabulous. Don't miss this restaurant if you're spending any time in Batgu Ferringhi!Show less

Author: John LDevon England
Title: Who cant love Andrew?
Review: We visited various restaurants/street food sites whilst in Batu, all were good, but on the last night, where to go? Had to be Andrew's. There was a slightly larger choice than some of the other restaurants but having tried enjoyed all sorts of dishes all over town this was the place I liked the most. Andrew is like a whirling dervish,organizing, greeting and giving hugs and kisses to old friends who are leaving but still finds time to run a very organized restaurant. Definitely my number 1.Show less

Author: Explore613998
Title: As expected from the reviews AMAZING!
Review: Top place - top service. Andrew is the sweetest man ever. We could not say more about it that hasn't already been said. Visit there and you will be saying the same. All perfect here.

Author: KarenBrock
Title: Always good value
Review:
Quickly prepared tasty food.
Reasonably priced.
Andrew always the ever present host.
May need to book if going at peak times and need to pre-order if wanting duck.
Deep fried ice cream not to be missed!

Author: Bellj382019
Title: Nice not great
Review: Nice food but not special, food is tasty and I recommend the Malaysian beef curry, went back two days later and the quality wasn’t consistent. The staff were lovely,

Author: Louise L
Title: Eccellent
Review: 4 if us visited and i must say the food was excellent the staff were very tentative and could not do enough for us

Author: Anne W
Title: Hot tasty and yummy
Review: went for a take away and Andrewe is just such a good host, we chatted while it was prepared, food hot and very tasty indeed, woud recommend

Author: CJBARRDarlington, United Kingdom
Title: Best meal we had in Penang
Review: we stumbled upon this place while looking for a different restaurant, the location is terrible situated on the second floor of a run down building but don’t let that put you off.Michael the owner was brilliant, his front of house skills deserve a better location.We had a Malaysian curry, Thai fishcakes and a beef dish with a couple of beers.By far the best meal we had in Penang, very cheap for what we had around £20.Well worth a visit.Show less

Author: GEORGE1953
Title: Place you have to visit
Review: Andrews is a nice little place good atmosphere great food and service reasonably priced food.it is family run business with Andrew aunties helping out

Author: stevecZ1386GD
Title: Excellent food, excellent customer
Review:
Excellent food, excellent customer service 
Thoroughly recommend 
10 minute work from the Holiday Inn Resort where we were staying!!

Author: andi_wilsonWhitehaven, United Kingdom
Title: Fabulous!
Review: Luckily we found Andrew’s on TA, otherwise would never have thought to look on the second floor of this ramshackle shopping centre!We didn’t book but managed to get a table and had a sensational meal. My husband had the Devil’s beef, too hot for me but certainly got him sweating! I had honey plum chicken which was sweet & tasty. We also shared the 1/2 duck which was fat & succulent. Altogether with three large beers, rice & noodles we paid about £25. Well worth it! We’ll be back I’m sure!Show less

Author: Jeaniechew
Title: Great Place, atmosphere and Friendly people!
Review: Decent place with great food and atmosphere! Food was delicious and the people there are friendly. Definitely recommend for people to visit this place in penang! Will visit again on the next trip:) thank you

Author: 181milesc
Title: A MAZ ING!!!! Just had the
Review: A MAZ ING!!!! Just had the most amazing meal, Satay, Malay Beef Curry and Sweet and Sour Prawns. Loved every mouthful and booked to return in 2 days! Thank you Andrew and staff, superb

Author: pawprintoSingapore, Singapore
Title: As always with a popular place
Review: As always with a popular place you wonder if it’s just the hype. After a meal there I definitely understood why it was so popular. Food is good, service is prompt. The never ending stream of customers is evidence of the good food. Can’t go wrong here. Show less

Author: Rustyslass
Title: Best crispy duck!
Review: Don’t be put off by the abandoned looking shopping centre - whilst the place may look a little run down and basic it was quite possibly the best crispy duck we ever ate and an amazing Kapitam Chicken Curry - will definitely visit again

Author: DomirwinHong Kong, China
Title: Thank-you Trip Advisor
Review: This place is hidden away on the second floor of a half filled shopping center. It is worth looking for it. When we eventually found it we noticed it is next door to another highly 4*+ TA rated local restaurant. It’s not fancy. But the food is good and excellent value. It was fairly full and we were lucky to get a table. Clearly some customers were regulars. Charming service from everyone. Crispy duck was the kind you get in the UK (ie shredded roast duck with rIceflour pancakes, spring onions and cucumber, plum sauce and hoi sin sauce) but better, with the duck moist and not cremated. Having said that I wouldn’t have this dish again because the other dishes (which I hadn’t generally had before) were fantastic: “butter” prawns which were freshly cooked and delicious and Malaysia chicken curry which was spicy (this was supposed to be “medium” but it was at the top of my spice tolerance) and yummy. We also had spicy local water spinach which was good. My recommendation would be to go for something new here. They know what they are doing.Show less

Author: GraemeShanghaiShanghai
Title: Great local food
Review: If you're in Penang Andrew's is well worth a visit for authentic Malaysian food. We sat on the airy balcony and dinned on Spring Rolls, a local rice dish, vegetables and Chicken washed down with a bottle of Australian Sauvignon Blanc - a great dinning experience.Show less

Author: blakejam
Title: Great food great service
Review: Were lucky to get last table when we walked in, though it quietened down later. Nice air on the balcony, with sun setting over the hills. Andrew is a great host. Food was delicious, with vegetarian curry available. Spicy.

Author: 914shawPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: A hidden flavour extravaganza,
Review: A hidden flavour extravaganza, on the second floor above KFC. We were craving some good quality Penang food, and Andrew did not disappoint! Tasty kangkung blachan, rich spicy chicken curry, spring rolls that mum used to make, all washed down with some refreshing iced lime tea. Were definitely coming back!!! Show less

Author: TonyC104Bedford, United Kingdom
Title: Good local food and at excellent price
Review: If you are in the area you have to give this a go. Local food well cooked at a very good price. It is quite a small place on the 2nd floor of a tower block near the street market and the Shangri-La hotels. The service is good with Andrew extremely friendly and helpful. I would recommend you book as it got busy both times we went. I just emailed the owner via the Trip Advisor app.The Malaysian Chicken curry is superbHighly recommendShow less

Author: ElinlindvallVaxjo, Sweden
Title: Very nice staff and good food!
Review: Very nice staff and good food! Its located on the third floor, and you can see a big sign on the side of the building so you know your in the right place.It doesnt take too long, and its very cheap! A small portion is more than enough and costs about Rm15. Just make sure to order rice and noodles for your dish. :)A tip is to ask the staff which dishes are spicy and not. Even the medium spicy dishes are spiiiicy, at least for me and probably many more europeans whom are not so used to spicy food. The staff are more than happy to help! :)Show less

Author: Sham L
Title: Little Gem
Review: The food is great and the service is quick and friendly. These guys are good host. This place gets full in the evenings. Be there early.

Author: kianwee82Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Delicious!
Review: Stumble upon this place on day 1 after googling where to eat. Ordered their devil's curry. My wife and I enjoyed it as we love spicy food. Only downer is you have to walk 3 floors up to get to the restaurant and the lift is under maintenance when we were there.Show less

Author: Sunara2015Penang Island, Malaysia
Title: Expect a warm welcome and good food
Review: Andrew's kampung is located on the second floor of a dilapidated building known locally as Eden Parade but with no signage anywhere on the building indicating this. It is located opposite to the Golden Sands Resort Hotel and the Lone Pine Resort.There is an elevator hidden to the left when you take the main entrance to the building and it saves walking up two floors. Many visitors either miss this elevator or do not know of its existence and so work up an appetite puffing up two flights of steps to the second floor. Signages to Andrew's Kampung are well marked. What meets your eye is a simple outfit with plastic chairs and round tables-simple and unpretentious. Don't let the lack of ambiance fool you. Don't let the absence of locals fool you either. Penangites are not in the restaurant because they have not heard of it and not because the food is below par. It makes sense to make a reservation, although this would not cross your mind when you see the place. It is always crowded with foreigners and walk-ins are entertained only when places become available. So reservations avoid the cost of waiting.Andrew and his crew are pleasant and ready to please. No discrimination based on skin color or citizenship! I have been here with friends, foreign and local, for about five times now. Apart from one occasion when the dishes served did not match our orders, we have never been disappointed. As with all restaurants, your experience will depend on what you order. Andrew is honest enough to tell you what's great and what's not so great on the menu and I appreciate his honesty. The starred items are good bets but here's my personal combination. Start with strips of squid, fried in batter served with a local sauce. Then go for the Devil Prawn curry. Andrew will warn you that it is spicy but go for it anyway. If the curry is too spicy, just fish out the large, fresh and very crunchy prawns that are already skinned ("naked prawns" as Andrew describes it). Along with steamed rice, this alone will make a delicious meal. For veggies, order kailan with garlic sauce and claypot tofu. The latter comes with veggies. The Nyonya fish (fillet) is great as well. We finished off with his famous fried ice-cream. One portion can serve two or four people, depending on how much sweet you like after your meal. The ice cream helps to cool off tongues on fire if you took too much of the prawn curry! All in all, this place provides good food in a welcoming environment. Certainly recommended.Show less

Author: Joanna  M
Title: Dinner
Review: Hidden yummy. Good food, Good drinks . We were there with friends. Everybody found something delicious

Author: 773greeng
Title: Basic high end Chinese family style food at a decent price
Review: Price is decent. Food is okay. Ambience is gorgeous. But I can't say is a four star thing and a must eat place in Penang. Simply because Penang/Malaysia has so much to offer in terms of food and experience.If you want to try Chinese family style without paying the overpriced cost in a pretty sit in air-conditioning silk tablecloth setting restaurant while wearing slippers and beach shorts, then this is a good alternative. That being said, it is still Chinese serving style (order 2-4 dishes shared among friends and family with rice ordered separately)which meant that it won't be cheap either compared to hawker or ala carte.Show less

Author: Mandy BPolmont, Scotland, United Kingdom
Title: Disappointed
Review: We went after reading reviews and it’s full of brits and Aussies. Was difficult to find as up on second floor and pretty grotty once inside. My meal was like a pile of oily mush but friend enjoyed theirs. Shows you not to trust reviews. Waste of money and very disappointing.Show less

Author: Babs3hunt
Title: Best place to eat !
Review:
Andrews Kampong - just great, food great, service great, Andrew just great, very caring and looks after you personally. Wine list - well its great!
Highly recommended for everyone its really great ! Get your photo on the wall !

Author: ElksabHelsingborg, Sweden
Title: Lunch place
Review: It’s a really great and good lunch place. Good selection on nice food. The stuff speaks Chinese, English really super good. The food is good tests and nice spicy. The famous desert you need to testing, ok it is super sweet special is-cream.... Just enjoy the great time to enjoy your food. Show less

Author: skyhightravellers
Title: Fantastic restaurant
Review: This is a fantastic restaurant in humble surroundings. Staff are welcoming and so friendly. The food is amazing. Very reasonably priced. Highly recommend.

Author: YvettetravelLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Best in town
Review: We are back 3 years later and Andrew still reigns supreme over his restaurant, greeting his customers and shouting order to the kitchen in his unique fabulous way. The food is superb and you should not leave Batu Ferringhi without having tried Andrew’s delicious Kapitan curry or Malaysian curry or crispy duck !! I can’t get enough and I wish I could take some of his amazing food back home with meShow less

Author: 652berniemAdelaide, Australia
Title: We made it back
Review: After initially visiting Andrews Kampung 2 years ago, we decided to take friends there last week. Man oh man. Nothing has changed. Food is amongst the best around. Our friends couldn’t believe the quality and flavours - scared to come back to Australia and have Asian food again. We enjoyed our visit so much on the Tuesday Night, we went back again on the Friday Night. Sweet and Sour Prawns are superb. Malaysian Chicken Curry and Thai Green Curry both hits. And the wife said it was the best Lemon Chicken she has ever had. You have to try the food - and the staff are incredibly friendly and nice. Thanks again, Andrew and Team. Show less

Author: matzxr
Title: Came here on a recommendation
Review:
YOU MUST EAT HERE !!!!
Location looks strange (for us Westerners)
but once you’re here your made very welcome, all staff are very polite and Andrew is a delight.
Food is OUTSTANDING.
I had Sizzling Beef, my wife had Malaysian Beef Curry, mouth-watering.

Author: E2481QTdavebBournemouth, United Kingdom
Title: What an unexpected delight.
Review: On the recommendation of guests in our hotel we went and found Andrews restaurant this evening. Without the advice we would never have found or entertained this restaurant. Hidden up 2 flights of unassuming stairs we discovered this brilliant little restaurant. My partner felt a little unwell today so I was sent to bring a takeaway back to our hotel. The food was absolutely gorgeous and came to 50 ringgit just £10 for the two of us. Black pepper beef. Chinese style rice, samosas and spring rolls. All delicious and they even supplied takeout cutlery as they new we were in a hotel. It’s Quirky and not normally the sort of restaurant I would consider. It would have been my loss and we are going back for a sit down meal before the end of our holiday. I love finding a gem like this. See you soon Andrew and compliments to the chef. DaveShow less

Author: 920michellecDa'an, Taipei
Title: 5 star food better than the local 5 star hotels.
Review: My 10 year old girl, husband and I stumbled on this restaurant. What a great find! The food was exceptional, quick and incredibly reasonably priced. The decor is reminiscent of many street food type outdoor dining restaurants however look up at what you think are the disco light balls and you’ll see they’re actually recycled water bottles. We had the duck, kampung rice,, lemon chicken and sizzling beef - every dish was delicious and worthy of any of the top Asian Melbourne restaurants (without the 5 star price). The hospitality of its staff and especially Andrew makes you feel like you’re a lifelong friend that’s come to visit. If ever in Penang again I would eat here every second night (as his sister’s restaurant next door has amazing food too)Show less

Author: AnneBGoulburnGoulburn, Australia
Title: Great find in an unexpected location
Review: We were a family of 8 staying across the road. The owner Andrew made us very welcome and explained some of the dishes. It was hard to pick a favourite because they were all delicious, including spring rolls, Malay Curry, sizzling beef, and the deep fried ice cream. There will be a return visit.Show less

Author: Tim OMelbourne, Australia
Title: Probably the best food we have tasted
Review: Attended as a group of 9 and were easily settled. The owner - Andrew was very friendly and helpful in food choices. The food was very nice and very large portions. Considering Sharon’s some dishes. 2 courses and a few drinks cost about 45 ringgit per head. We were all very pleased with what we are and the service. Show less

Author: Happy-loversEngland
Title: Well worth a visit.
Review: Came because of great reviews & so pleased we did. A variety of people from locals, regulars & new faces all made to feel welcome. Good choice of drinks & varied main dishes in 2 sizes. I’m a veggi & found several things to eat. All arrived in good time considering how busy they were with every table taken. Andrew was constantly round to see everyone & was on hand to take orders. Heard him advise for a gluten free table by us. All the staff spoke English & didn’t stop. We had samosas, rice, noodles, large honey chicken & mixed vegetables with 2 beers at a total cost of £16. Will be going again before we go home. Highly recommend Show less

Author: GrumpybrotherHong Kong, China
Title: Delicious meal in an unconventional location
Review: We had a great dinner here and as others have said Andrew and his family are supreme hosts.The Poh Pia (Spring Rolls) were excellent and obviously freshly made. We also had the beef Malay curry and the butter prawns as well as the river spinach all combined with rice. Everything was delicious and for those with modest appetites a small bowl of curry is sufficient for two people.The restaurant is in an unconventional location in that it is in a shopping centre, but not one of the glitzy gleaming ones. There are numerous signs on the building showing where it is.Do not expect silver service, but good home cooked food in a friendly environment. Would certainly recommend, but be prepared for surroundings which are some way away from a western norm for a restaurant. Also very reasonably priced.Show less

Author: anthonyb508
Title: Late night dinnet
Review:
Enjoyed a lovely meal here whilst holidaying.
Would recommend the curries and the cold beer. Andrew is a great host and looks after all your needs.

Author: Andrew B
Title: Hospitality plus with food
Review: Andrews Kampung is entertainment with great food, host Andrew makes everyone feel welcome, staff are great, place is cooled with fans and offers second floor open air dining. Had sizzling beef, chicken veg stir fry and the best deep fried ice cream going around!

Author: Dinesh_AlphaqueKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Worth more than one visit
Review: A cozy and casual place just across from the Golden Sands Resort. It's on the second floor but you can spot the signage from the main road.Decent variety of Malaysian good with a slight Chinese flavor to it. Not too pricey for the touristy belt either. We loved the Szechuan chicken and the Kai Lan. Definitely worth a return visit to try the devil curry.Show less

Author: Cherrybaby_11Walsall, United Kingdom
Title: Well, what a find
Review: Fab,fab,Fab. From our initial greeter to the minute we walked out we were treated very special. The place itself in on the second floor of a shopping development. There is a lift available. The food was wonderful and arrived within 10 mins of us ordering. Can’t wait to go backShow less

Author: Stephen B
Title: Great food and great service
Review: This is what TA is all about. We would never have found this little gem without the app. Don’t be put off when trying to find your way to the second floor. The food and service are both great, highly recommend

Author: johnhZ1322GD
Title: Dinner
Review: Known Andrew for years. The food keeps getting better. He is a great host and a big reason to keep coming back to Penang.

Author: 746tamsinh
Title: Excellent food - Duck -Wow!
Review: Don’t be put off by location or decor - the food here is amazing! The owner is welcoming and fun. It’s always busy - get there early if you want the duck - it’s so popular they may run out!

Author: Evo58Warragul, Australia
Title: Hidden Gem on the third floor!
Review: We tore ourselves away from the admittedly good Long Beach Hawker stalls to try somewhere different on our last night; wished we’d done so earlier! All the top TA reviews reflect how good this place is, great personal service and advice from Andrew and with that in mind as good value as Hawkers. Home made spring rolls, Crispy duck pancakes, Malaysian beef curry and deep fried Ice Cream are all suggested dishes and that’s just what we ate; delicious!A family-friendly restaurant that had a very Caucasian clientele the night we went although there were some locals too.Would have definitely returned!Show less

Author: Joe0145
Title: Very good
Review:
The restraunt is not on ground level but this should not stop anyone eating there
The food is fresh and delicious 
Service is quick and staff are really friendly
Prices are very reasonable

Author: PerthWAJohn
Title: Excellent quality food with friendly staff
Review:
Had dinner here with our group of friends. A bit hard to find for the first time, however upstairs and a lift available.
Food was fresh cooked and great example of local cuisine. 
Would recommend to anyone.

Author: xsarahx101
Title: wonderful - went 4 nights out of 9!
Review: it is a superb place!! Andrew and all the waitresses are lovely and make you feel so comfortable. The setting is amazing - i love the photos on the wall of all the customers, creates a homely atmosphere. The crispy duck is a MUST! it is incredible!! The devils curry is also great, very good if you like spice. Not to mention the sweet and sour chicken was the best i’ve had EVER!Show less

Author: IngoP591
Title: Nice place
Review:
Intended to go to next door restaurant Knife & Fork but was empty. Decided to eat dinner at Andrew’s Kampung which was a good choice. 
Andrew is really nice guy and all staff are very friendly. 
Food and cost is well matching.

Author: kajsacat
Title: a diamond in the rough
Review: it was amazing. service was quick and decor was very original. it is very crowded so reserve in advance. it is on third floor but there is elevator.

Author: dorlaUK
Title: Great food,
Review: ndrew's on our last night in Penang and wern't disappointed in our food - Crispy Duck for our starter and we had to order Sizzling Beef again along with Devil Curry Beef (had to try it) along with Kapitan Curry Chicken with extra Chilli. No room for dessert :(Andrew and his staff (felt like family) are exceptional - it is a restaurant in a place you don't expect, the food is well cooked and tasty.A hidden gem - would I recommend Andrew's - a stunning yes and should I ever have the pleasure of returning to Penang you know where to find me ;)Show less

Author: crazymegan1212
Title: Omg..what a find..
Review: Thanks to TA and the word kampung...we ventured out to Andrew's. Really delicious, super friendly and kids loved it the choices too. We had devil's curry..spicy but heavenly..will go again. Thanks Andrew.

Author: Jennie D
Title: Andrew never lets us down!
Review: A short walk from Shangri-La Rasa Sayang,  is the wonderful Andrew’s Kampung.  Great service, generous serves of great, tasty food keeps us coming back.  Batu Ferringhi would not be the same without a visit to Andrew’s.

Author: Barry TBrisbane, Australia
Title: Excellent, Beautiful food, Great Friendly Service
Review: Went for dinner on a recommendation and we loved it. Situated just prior to the night markets in Batu Ferringhi on the 2nd floor of a corner building which also houses the KFC on the ground floor. We had two differing prawn dishes, pineapple fried rice and the fried ice-cream. Food was delightful and plentiful, even on the small serves. Prices reasonable, staff lovely and Andrew is a lovely friendly host. Highly recommended.Show less

Author: marcusnl2018
Title: Very good Chinese food
Review: We enjoyed a great meal in this clean Chinese restaurant. The price may be not as low as in a hawker centre, but is still value for money. Very friendly and nice service.

Author: 91michelw
Title: Fresh and tasty asian food
Review:
One of the best restaurants for asian food in Penang we've been so far. Fresh ingredients, kind staff and great atmosphere. We recommend it! 

Advise: Try their special duck...

Author: Veslevamp
Title: Hopitable
Review: We were received in the most hospitable way, and felt very welcome. Also, the food was gorgeous - both times we were there.

Author: 47bjcdMelbourne, Australia
Title: Sample lunch
Review: Quaint location upstairs in a humble building yields beautifully crafted Malaysian cuisine. We only had a small range of tasters: spring rolls, nyonya fish, Kampung fried rice and Malaysian chicken curry. All superb. Lovers of Malaysian food I think will appreciate the superior flavour nuances that make this restaurant a cut above. Show less

Author: klY9115IDSaar, Bahrain
Title: Delicious!
Review: Went as a family of four at 6:40. Thankfully managed to get a table before a large group would arrive at 8. Ordered crispy squid, kapitan prawn curry, chicken satay and pineapple fried rice along with soft drinks, one beer and two scoops of ice cream (c. 120 myr) . Great food and larger portions than we had anticipated. The staff were super friendly. Location was easy enough to find. Go to the second floor via the lift or stairs once you see the little shopping complex with Kfc. Show less

Author: Chand_StriderTashkent, Uzbekistan
Title: Lovely food - Thank you Andrew and his staff's
Review: The restaurant is located on the 2nd floor, there is a lift's to go up. Do make prior table booking before you go! The food is well worth it! Andrew is a very friendly, humble and excellent host, who clearly loves his work. It reflects on the dishes he serves. We would definately go there again when we are back in Penang!Show less

Author: khanhlinh1204
Title: Ms
Review: The place looks fantastic but a bit small cuz our group contains alot of ppl.The waiters and manager are super friendly and nice especially the Chinese manager that served us. He was still really happy even though the kids were noisy a lot abt the lemonade, asked for less sugar but then need more sugar or stuffs. The food are tasty and wonderful, both kids and adults could easily eat the food. I highly recommend the roasted duck w pancake n pinapple fried rice.Show less

Author: adandangBrisbane, Australia
Title: Great food and service
Review: The food was excellent and medium portions were what we’d describe as very large! You will not leave here feeling hungry! We started our meal with a 1/4 crispy duck shared between four of us that was honestly the best we ever tasted. This was followed by sizzling beef and Malaysian beef curry, Two house special fish dishes and fried rice plus bok Choy. In retrospect we were a little over ambitious in the portion sizes and struggled to finish it all but gave it a damn good go. Andrew is an excellent host and we were well looked after. Great value for money too. Show less

Author: YengK5
Title: Friendly restaurant with good food
Review: The building is a bit run down..... but what awaits is truly worth the visit.... extremely friendly owner and most importantly, with very nice food, highly recommended for best dining experience.

Author: annarC2907QZ
Title: Good food :)
Review: We got this place as recommendation and we’re so glad we went! Food was really tasty and good price. Their spring rolls were the best! Satay chicken wasn’t my favourite

Author: Anthony_NgOfSg
Title: Home like cooking, and feeling like home
Review: This is a place with great food, and great service! Loved their crispy duck, claypot vegetables and etc... Andrew, his aunt and his team of staff make us feel like home here. Thank you for making our 5days stay so homely. We will be back...

Author: JCookCheltenhamBlackpool, United Kingdom
Title: Amazing food and service
Review: Came here on recommendation of friends from UK who come to Penang every year. It really is a hidden gem. From the moment we arrived, Andrew was attentive and friendly and offered advice on dishes to order. We had the chicken satay to start which was lovely. We had beef Devil curry which is spicy hot but as we love spicy food it was amazing. Also had the Malaysian chicken curry which was also beautiful. The flavours were amazing and there was loads of food. Would definitely recommend Andrews to anyone looking authentic Malaysian/Penang food. Can’t wait to come back. Thank you Andrew and staff. John & Tony Show less

Author: TwoGoodFriendsPerth, Australia
Title: Hidden gem
Review: We climbed the many stairs to this restaurant, opposite Golden Sands, only to find there was a lift. Cheap and cheerful with great, tasty food. They also do half portions which was great for us. Fine dining it is not, but good food at cheap prices it is.Show less

Author: kfwrigleyLiverpool, United Kingdom
Title: Another great dining experience.
Review: We have been to Andrews lots and lots of times over the years and the standard of food and service never drops below excellent.Andrew is as genial as ever and all his staff make sure you have a great time there.The food is always so tasty and the Pineapple Chilli Chicken was delicious.We will be returning again before we leave for home.Show less

Author: kimmyblidgemanchester
Title: Repeat visit
Review: Came back to Andrews as visited 2 yrs ago food was good as always but feel he has slightly out priced himself. First off noticed how much more the prices were and Tiger beer charging a lot more than other eateries. Prob wouldn’t go. Ack again to eat here although Andrew flamboyant as always. Show less

Author: L6639RGmarcop
Title: Dinner
Review: This place is a must great service great food great prices, very clean good portions yes we were very happy eating here.

Author: Joanna O
Title: Excellent!
Review: Food is super tasty and at a good price. We ordered fried chilli squid and cashew nut chicken. The owner and staff is extremely friendly and carrying about the customers, it makes you feel as if you were served in their home! Not to forget about delicious fried ice cream! Best place to eat in Batu Ferringhi!Show less

Author: Ajemoon
Title: Delicious Chinese food
Review: The resturant is hard to find, but it was definitely worth it. After we found the place we had all our meals there and I am still missing the taste. Please give it a try, you will NOT be disappointed. And last but not least the owner Andrew and co are very hospitable and friendly.Show less

Author: 0Jools0Langkawi, Malaysia
Title: Lovely food and friendly owner
Review: No wonder this place is so busy! The food is delicious and Andrew is so friendly and welcoming and works hard to make sure everyone gets great service and quality food. We thoroughly enjoyed our evening. All I can say is don't be put off by the grubby entrance to the restaurant, this place is definitely well worth finding. Show less

Author: CurvermacSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good food, reasonable prices
Review: Good local food reasonably priced. They open for lunch and all afternoon where nearly everybody else in Batu Ferringhi only opens after 6:00pm.The building in which it's located is a little ropey. It's on the second floor above KFC. This means the third level as level one is the ground floor. The lift may or may not be working but the escalator seems to have retired in old age.The restaurant is not air-conditioned but tolerable with fans blasting awayShow less

Author: neelypeelyManchester, United Kingdom
Title: Great restaurant.
Review: We visited here with a large group of family and friends. My friend had booked. As he was a local he knew what to order. The different curries were fantastic. Some of the group were vegetarian and they catered well for them too. All in all we really enjoyed eating here and it’s worth a visit. Show less

Author: scooterfranFareham, United Kingdom
Title: The hype is true
Review: We visited here on our first night on Penang. We thought we make struggle to find it but a large banner handing from the building directed us to where we needed to be.The restaurant was busy but Andrew managed to squeeze us in.The food came quickly despite the business of the restaurant. My Szechuan chicken was superb really hot and spicy. My husbands chicken was also good. We booked to return and when we did the food was equally good.Great ambience, good service and fab food.Show less

Author: travelswithMCHong Kong, China
Title: Best meal of our trip!
Review: My teen was not feeling well when we arrived in Penang, so it took until our fourth night to get to Andrew's Kampung. My only regret is that we were only able to go once! The service was outstanding, the food absolutely delicious. I'm already looking forward to our next trip to Penang so we can go again!Show less

Author: 17jacquieSydney, Australia
Title: Andrews is a must!
Review: If you are staying anywhere near Batu Ferringhi you must go to Andrews Kampung. Don’t be put off by the location in a poor looking building or the 3 flights of stairs to get there...it is all worth it.From the moment you enter you are greeted by Andrew and his staff. Their warmth and hospitality are charming. The menu is tricky as it is difficult to decide what you won’t eat! There is a mix of Malaysian and Asian food on the menu and I think I spotted some western dishes too. I would suggest that would be to accommodate the many tourists staying at the resorts in the area.Musts to try are: Kapitan prawns (Nyonya), Devil Chicken Curry (Portuguese influence), Kampung Fried rice and the Malaysian Fish - superb! I nearly forgot the Char Koay Toaw - not greasy at all and the best I have tried in Malaysia. The satay however was not the best I have had, but there are so many dishes to try, so why bother with one you can get elsewhere. Most dishes come in half sizes so you can try more! In our six day stay in Batu Ferringhi we dined twice and would happily have gone back again. Another recommendation is the fried ice cream - different to what I have had before as the coating was not a batter but a sweet bread. A delicious reminder of childhood dining experiences at the local Chinese restaurant.The service is great and chef Andrew floats around making sure all are happy with their meals. Very fast service too. A Blaine’s table is good to view the bust streets below.Highly recommended.Show less

Author: Westy99
Title: small but fun
Review: can be a bit hard to find but fast service with a smile with great food and service , cheap as chips .

Author: jamiecunn
Title: Lovely meal
Review:
Had an amazing meal even though they were almost full placed us on a table until another became available.
Lovely food at a good price definitely recommend.

Author: jeanrobertsforgetmenPortsmouth, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent food, great atmosphere
Review: Once you have eaten here there is no need to look elsewhere. Food is fresh, tasty and well cooked. The slant can be Indian, Chinese or Malaysian. Staff are very friendly and attentive, helping you to understand what to order. We are vegetarian and there was plenty of choice. The restaurant is on the second floor...we never found the lift but there is one.Highly recommended  Show less

Author: PJM2437
Title: Great food
Review:
Great food in a non descript place.
The spring rolls and duck are absolutely amazing. 
The best part .... extremely good value for money. 
One of my favourite places in the world

Author: AnnieQuas
Title: Very good food
Review: Had excellent meals here, no complaints at all. Best to book as very busy, especially at popular times. The restaurant is not large. The staff are very efficient, and Andrew is  jovial and helpful with food allergies, particularly gluten free. Walking distance to most hotels.

Author: andrew_balasingamSubang Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Friendly Setup & Great Food
Review: We were surprised with the turnout of this restaurant. It’s located up in a shop lot. Looks can be deceiving. As soon as we got up, we were greeted by the friendly host called Andrew! The setup is comfy with good breeze. They have a variety of food from Malaysian, Thai, Chinese, etc. You can’t go wrong with any of the selection. We had the Thai Green Curry, Sambal Fish, Claypot Tafu and Foo Yong Egg. Yummy indeed! Show less

Author: jbsunshineacres
Title: Disappointed
Review: Unfortunately our meals did not live upto our expectations from the recommendations we had. The four of us all had different meals, and all agreed, we had had better in other nearby restaurants and the local food court.

Author: 434jacoblHanoi, Vietnam
Title: Wonderful surprise
Review: We were meandering through the night marker as they set up their stalls and decided we needed to get some food with our friends and 3 young children in our group. We saw the reviews for Andrew's and decided to give it a try. We were NOT disappointed in anything except the fact that we didn't know about the elevator until we left! The service was well above what we experienced anywhere else in Batu Feringgi, very friendly and accommodating with our semi-picky children. The owner advised us patiently about what would work for the kids and what sauces could come on the side. We ordered half portions of most items because we wanted to be able to try many. We had the lemon chicken (kids loved it and so did we), honey plum chicken (got sauce on the side, which as parents we were disappointed with as it would have been so good on the chicken, the sacrifices we make...), devil curry beef (amazing), spicy squid (not that spicy), sizzling beef (wish we had a full portion), samosas (lighter than expected and served with a delicious chili sauce), homemade spring rolls (very tasty), and Kampung fried rice (so good!). We were very happy and the total was about 50 usd with drinks. This place has been around for 20 years for a reason and I can see it being around for even longer. The view from the balcony is pleasant but is blocked by a big resort. But honestly you'll be focused on the food anyway. If we hadn't found this place on our last evening in Batu Feringgi, we would have gone back!Show less

Author: Brian ISydney, Australia
Title: Eating at Andrews
Review: We were told about Andrew's by many people and we discovered him about 3 years ago. His menu is quite diverse and meets most peoples requirements. The crispy duck and marmite chicken (do not be put off by this the marmite has been made into his own sauce) we like a lot, but the rest of the menu is good.Andrew is quite a character always on the move and makes everyone welcome.Show less

Author: Rex TSuffolk, United Kingdom
Title: Good place to eat
Review: Went there with friends who go there a lot. Andrew is very friendly and his staff are good, the food is very good with a varied selection as mentioned before the restaurant is in an odd place but who cares if the service etc is good. Will definitely go back next trip.Show less

Author: roslienPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Home Cooked food
Review: Andrew's kampung restaurant is in Batu Ferringgi, Penang. It's run by Andrew and he's such a friendly person. I have tried some of the food and the price is reasonable and the food is very good. If you want it more spicy then you have to inform Andrew. I work around here so what we do is we call him before hand and give him our order and it's ready when we get there and enjoy the food. You can order a meal and it come with a drink too. It's a small and lovely place. Good food, very reasonable price away from all the buzz.Show less

Author: Les B
Title: Good Food
Review: The food was very good with a good choice of food on there menu.The staff were very friendly and helpful giving you advice on there dishes.

Author: dselvanWarrington, United Kingdom
Title: Good food
Review: Rang and booked a hotel and it is walking distance from Shangri-La.We had a table overlooking the road but it was outside on the balcony area.The service was good and the food was good although prices were higher than in Georgetown.Had a starter to share and 2 main course and they were very good and I asked for spicy and it was hot and nice!!Had their famous dessert and it was massive and we shared it.We walked out with very full stomachs and happy!!!Show less

Author: JBCharles
Title: excellent dinner
Review: Andrews father will pick the less able up by car so its makes it more accessible and even takes you back to the hotel at no cost. excellent service.

Author: letsgosydneySydney, Australia
Title: Couldn't fault it
Review: Andrew is the most wonderful host and treats every single guest as a long lost friend. He is very helpful in choosing dishes and also accommodated our requests with no problems. We were only there 3 nights and ate at Andrews restaurants 2 nights in a row. Make sure you book though as it is always busy. The menu is varied and there is something for everyone, I wish I was there now. Thanks Andrews and your wonderful All Female staff.Show less

Author: Stephan B
Title: What a treat! Must visit restaurant! Price low, quality outstanding!
Review: On our way to tonight’s restaurant! Through the back fence, up dodgy escalators, which clearly have not been working for ages, further up another staircase. And then, there it is, Andrew’s Kampung! A true Malaysian retreat! They really made us feel welcome. The people, the smell, AND THEN THE FOOD! Absolutely amazing! Just could not get enough! Love this place!Show less

Author: shrill
Title: Average at best
Review: Can’t understand the rave reviews this place gets. We thought it very average food in not particularly pleasant surroundings and with exception of Andrew himself, the service was unfriendly.

Author: iain754Dumfries and Galloway, United Kingdom
Title: A must in Penang
Review: This restaurant is straight across from the Golden Sands and is on the 3rd floor which can be accessed either by lift or stairs. The food and service are excellent and great value for money. There are a lot of ex-pats and regulars go here so booking is adviseable and Andrew is a great host.Show less

Author: Q3603DVanthonycWigan, United Kingdom
Title: Odd location. Great restaurant
Review: Located on the 3rd floor of a apartment block, which had seen better days. However the restaurant is really good with a great range of local foods at really good prices. The wine was also good and reasonably priced. Great food and lovely friendly staff. Well worth the visit. Show less

Author: 717jillianwMahe Island, Seychelles
Title: Good value for money
Review: This is the type of place you would never find if you weren’t looking for it after being recommended or reading reviews here. Small place with the usual plastic chairs and plastic plates and fans that blow the hot air around but you find this all over this area. That said, we really enjoyed our evening here the food was good and plentiful and reasonably priced. We had Satay chicken and spring rolls to start followed by Penang chicken curry and sweet and sour chicken with mixed veg and rice. Staff very welcoming and friendly.Show less

Author: David W
Title: Jolly ex-pat hangout
Review: Very cheery welcome and extremely good food, on the second floor of a mall overlooking the main  drag. Seafood a great draw. No Coconut, however.

Author: craigb130Durham, United Kingdom
Title: Lovely Chinese food, exceeded prices
Review: All we wanted was excellent cheap Chinese food, this is just what we got.Andrews is up 2 levels-on the top of a building with shops and other restaurants, (lift provided if req)The service was outstanding, the food quantity & quality was better than all of our Chinese restaurants back at home in County Durham area, expect the Pavilion near Stanley.We had starters, mains and 3 drinks total bill was RM110, or £20 quid, my belly was bulging we found the whole experience relaxing and completely comfortable.Show less

Author: DavidGpangPangbourne, United Kingdom
Title: Great meal and service
Review: Had a lovely meal here. Didn't book but Andrew 'fitted us in' and although we were near the entrance and a little away from the main restaurant we weren't forgotten - service was excellent. Very efficient service, Andrew is extremely talented at what he does. The restaurant seemed like a club, with the mainly British clientele seeming to know each other and many of them obviously repeat customers. I have no hesitation in recommending this restaurant.Show less

Author: GBHKWORLD
Title: Just ok
Review:
Food is ok, just ok.

Not a great sign when a place serving local food has no locals going to it.

Better and cheaper local food at the hawkers markets.

Author: MartinL198Hove, United Kingdom
Title: Birthday Dinner
Review: Went with my wife and our teenage daughters for her birthday. (You need to book ). Whilst most of the customers were English (if that’s an issue for you). The food was fantastic. Chilli beef, marmite chicken. Sweet and sour fish and the satay chicken were our favourites. Andrew and his team were lovely, very friendly and made you feel very welcome. Don’t let the walk up two flights of stairs put you off, its well worth a visit. Show less

Author: Ladykf1962
Title: Wonderful food
Review: unexpectedly delightful place above a multi storey carpark with a very entertaining host serving great food at great prices.  the only place we found with the prawn peeled

Author: ko883Penang Island, Malaysia
Title: Nice food in Batu Ferringhi
Review: This is a localised version of Chinese food, sort of fusion of food of different Chinese dialects.Andrew is very helpful and service is good. The closest competition is Golden River nearby but Andrew’s environment or ambience is better as its situated in a proper building in Eden Parade Batu Ferringhi . Show less

Author: CarolineGPang
Title: good food, good value and great service
Review: We ate here after reading about it on Trip advisor.Yes there are lots of elderly British people here, but that certainly didn't put us off. The owner is efficient at taking food orders and welcoming people. Decent portions and lovely cold beers

Author: JenS57Almelo, The Netherlands
Title: as good as they say!
Review: Great food and very service, very tastefull! Although the restaurant does not sit in a beautifull building and its interior is not fancy either, the malaysian food we had was ver good and really freshly prepared. The warning about some of the (very, very) spicy dishes were really helpfull in making a choice from the (not really extensive, lunch?) menu.Show less

Author: Louise BPeterborough, United Kingdom
Title: One of the best restaurants in Batu Ferringhi!!
Review: If you are staying in, or near Batu Ferringhi then you absolutely have to go to Andrew's Kampung. We were told about this restaurant the first time we came in 2016, and it's the first restaurant that we wanted to eat at when we arrived this time. We ended up coming four times during our two week holiday. We've tried loads of different dishes here, but I think our favourite's are the 'quack quack', sizzling prawns and lemon chicken. All of which are absolutely delicious!To avoid disappointment. Either book a table, or get to the restaurant by no later than 6.30pm.Show less

Author: Jeff_KostyBangkok, Thailand
Title: Very good, best food I had in Batu Ferringhi
Review: You may want to book a reservation. This place tends to be packed, everyone knows about it. Once you get in, service is great, and super friendly. Now on to the important part: the food. The food is quite good. I didn't eat everywhere in Batu Ferringhi but it was hands down the best of anywhere I ate there. The Malay food is generally not as spicy as Thai food, but the Malay shrimp curry I had was not spicy at all, even by Malay standards. Next time I'm in Batu Ferringhi I'll likely order the same dish, but I'll ask them to make it to Malay taste. The highlight was the spring rolls. Giant deep fried spring rolls. They know how to deep fry here, they were nice and crispy, and not at all greasy. The crispy (deep fried) squid was also excellent. If you are in Batu Ferringhi it's totally worth the hassle of getting a table to eat here.Show less

Author: 1966cbuk44Farnham, United Kingdom
Title: Lovely local Malaysian food
Review: Either arrive early or make RESERVATION !We arrived at 6 the place was empty but we were squeezed in between the reserved signs and told we would need to be out by 7.30 ( which was fine) . Food was great and the best we have had locally . Starters samosas , satay , spring roll - tiger beer ( of course ) followed by sizzling prawns ( u have to have some thing sizzling as it was spectacular !) accompanied by bright green Thai curry and Malaysian beef curry . All efficiently served . As first in we watched all the hopefuls arrive with reservations - if you were not known personally lots of discussion generally ensued on emails and phone calls that had been exchanged - essentially double check you have a reservation ! Also they close on a Tuesday - definitely would go back Show less

Author: Adam SPrinces Risborough, United Kingdom
Title: Andrew Steals The Show!
Review: Don't be fooled by the exterior as you approach this 2nd floor hidden gem of a restaurant because once inside you are in for a culinary treat!Andrew, the host of this family business greets you like a long lost friend and his camp like excitable and animated persona cannot help but make you smile as he flounces between tables entertaining his guests.We had the sizzling beef which arrives at your table in a cloud of steam providing much amusement to the regular customers as it engulfs the table. We also had crispy wantons, Kampung chicken curry, Chinese fried rice, and a local spinach like vegetable cooked in garlic butter.For dessert we had the famous deep fried ice cream..all tasted amazing.Andrew is on hand to explain portion sizes and how spicy things are.A recent reviewer (cyc326 on 13th Feb) posted that it was a nice friendly Chinese with lots of white people (I'm sorry us white people have to eat too!);yes there were alot of Westerners here, and I do advise reserving a table beforehand as it does get busy, but I think it shows what a great dining experience it is, and the quality of food when you have regular customers coming back for more.Keep up the great work Andrew, you're obviously doing something right to be the top restaurant in Batu Ferringhi and we will definitely return.Show less

Author: E7174Birmingham, United Kingdom
Title: Super friendly, great food
Review: This is on 3rd floor of the Eden Shopping arcade. The arcade is a bit scruffy, but don’t let that put you off this great place. There’s a lift if you need it.Food is Chinese/Malay, loads of choice. Crispy duck is fantastic as was everything else we had (squid, fish).Leave space for the deep fried ice cream - you won’t regret it.Look out for the chandeliers made from plastic bottles... brilliant.Great food, great service. Show less

Author: hsheila85
Title: taste of heaven
Review: the service is excellent with friendly staff. foods are delicious..feels like home cook meal..if you are here do not forget to order the deep fried cappuccino ice cream..it is to die for!!!

Author: Mynameischarlotte
Title: Taste of Heaven with Excellent service! - Most recommended place in Batu feringghi!!!
Review: Everything we tried was so yummy ! With friendly staffs and excellent service! The desert we had - deep fried ice-cream - every bite taste like heaven!!!! Definitely gonna come back again! 👍🏼👍🏼👍🏼👍🏼👍🏼

Author: RedsamjCaldicot, United Kingdom
Title: Delicious food and very friendly service
Review: Don’t be put off by the entrance stairway. once up the stairs it’s fine especially compared to other places in this resort. The restaurant was recommended by a number of people also staying at the Shrangri-La. The food was absolutely excellent best we have eaten here and very reasonable. Great service and the wine was pretty good by local standards Show less

Author: zoeknight81Fleet, United Kingdom
Title: Yummy Food
Review: On our first evening in Batu Ferringhi we had an evening meal here. A few steps to climb in what appears as a run down shopping centre building leads you to this fantastic local restaurant. Everything we ate tasted amazing! Washed down with a glass of very nice glass of white wine. Very friendly people. Would definitely recommend Show less

Author: Samantha S
Title: TERRIFIC
Review: Go here the food is amazing and Andrew is terrific.  We had fried fish which was fantastic, missed out on the duck but apparently that's the best thing on the menu so make sure you order that as well.

Author: BernieM15Gloucester, United Kingdom
Title: Enjoyable food
Review: This restaurant was recommended to us by a couple of tourists at our hotel. There's a lift but if you take the 3 flights of stairs it looks a bit rough and unwelcoming. Don't be put off. Lots of Brits appear to eat here and the food is excellent. Ask for help from the staff when deciding what to choose. I had Malaysian Chicken Curry which was hot and delicious.Show less

Author: marisammutPhuket, Thailand
Title: Best place in Batu - Andrew you and your staff are doing a fantastic job!
Review: Warm, genuinely happy smiles greet you as you walk in. Very nice white wine (by the glass if you wish). Wide selection of good food which you don’t have to wait ages for. Delicious food at a good price, so good we’ve booked a table for tomorrow! Make this your first dining experience in Batu Ferringhi and you won’t regret it Show less

Author: Crunchy_Fr0gWorthing, United Kingdom
Title: Great food
Review: One of the best restaurants we ate in during our one week stay. The approach is somewhat daunting up some pretty tatty stairways, but the food and drink is well priced and tastey and it arrived pretty fast too. There were customers waiting for tables, a sure sign of a popular restaurant.Show less

Author: GiulioA318
Title: Kids made us go back teice
Review:
The food was good and well priced
It’s gets busy so booking may be a good idea
We went once based on reviews but then my daughter insisted we return because she liked the food

Author: jimtD8398YU
Title: Great food
Review: We came here for dinner one night. It is up a few flights of steps but is well signed so easy to find. The usual outside dining area was full and they led us to a back room which was simple but it had air con which was a nice relief. Drinks were good - the lime tea was nice, and the milo too. Dinner wise, we had the fried whole fish which was delicious - just keep in mind it is a whole fish so you have to have someone who can pick the flesh off the bones!! The squid was very more-ish. And the sizzling prawns were very tasty too. And the bill total for 3 ppl was RM150. Highly recommended and I can certainly see why it’s the number one restaurant in Batu Ferringhi. The service was great - friendly and attentive and welcoming. Show less

Author: 94pera
Title: Great food and atmosphere!
Review: Great value and atmosphere! A little hard to find, but one of the best places to eat in Batu Ferringhi. Went there twice with my family during our stay. Friendly staff and great food!

Author: JayashreeR53
Title: Delicious food
Review:
Excellent food and service- but if you are looking for ambience this is not the place. 
We ordered Chinese fried rice, fried noodles, sizzling chicken and Malaysian chicken curry - each one was delicious.

Author: LYMoon30Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Price was expensive, small portion, foods tasted ordinary.
Review: Ordered fried noodles, price stated for half portion and one portion. That lady boss told us one portion was meant for two person. So we ordered one portion, ended up so disappointing, the portion was enough for one person. The price was expensive. At night we walked to another restaurant (Golden River) nearby, same fried noodles, price was cheaper and bigger portion.Lady boss wasn't friendly maybe we didnt order much foods. Highly not recommended.Show less

Author: RafagonzNew Zealand
Title: Amazing food..amazing people!
Review: What a place. The food was amazing! The crispy duck, sweet and sour prawns, spring rolls and the deep-fried ice cream were delicious. The devil prawns were beautifully hot, just like they should be. The service was amazing and they event went the extra mile. It was raining extremely hard, and Andrew was very helped us get back to our hotel safe and dry. Thanks Andrew!Show less

Author: stew2676
Title: Great restaurant
Review: Just had dinner at Andrews staff very friendly and the food is good, cooked to order and very reasonably priced, the deep fried ice cream is definitely worth trying will be back before we leave

Author: GojavasBengaluru, India
Title: Good food and a quiet atmosphere
Review: As mentioned by the other reviewers, we went on a weekday night for dinner and I was the only one to order food since my wife had already eaten. We ordered sizzling prawns, Kapitan curry chicken and two bowls of rice with a coke for my daughter. I also ordered a mineral water but never opened it since it was not required as my daughter was unable to finish her coke. So Andrew was kind enough to take back the mineral water and did not charge the same.The bill came upto RM 62 for all the above...so not very cheap food but reasonable given the area is a tourist location. I was impressed with the food and if you are looking for some good Malay/chinese cuisine in the Batu Ferringhi area, this place does not disappoint. I think he also accepts cards as I saw a "visa" sticker on the cash counter but we paid by cash. There is also parking available near the CIMB bank ATM as this place is situated in a shopping complex. Note that you will need to walk 2 floors up as we did not find an elevator nearby.Show less

Author: LucyxvBolton
Title: Tastiest food I've had in Malaysia
Review: Been in Malaysia a week, been to Kuala Lumpur and George town. All were great and I had tasted some pretty good dishes. But then we had duck and Malaysian curry at Andrews...wow. I'm not an expert on Malaysian cuisine but it was the tastiest food I've tasted in a long while! All were perfectly cooked and delicious. The staff were so lovely and yea, the place itself is basic but the food speaks for itself.If you are looking for tasty food...please go here!Show less

Author: RaymondY398Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good food, but not necessarily great
Review: As a local, I had no false expectations that this would be a Michelin-star restaurant. This place serves decent local Chinese food, period. The mostly white clientele and reviewers appear to have overrated the restaurant, in my own opinion. Andrew was interactive for sure, perhaps this was the main selling point of the restaurant. On well, whatever that works, works! (to get the high ratings, that is)Show less

Author: 981betya
Title: Nice staff members
Review:
Date: 17/12/2018
Location: Ferringhi Beach area

Type: Local chinese food
Clean: Yes
Service: Yes
Friendly Staff: Yes
Food Quality: Average
Value for money: No
Scale of 0-10: 5.5/10

Total spent: MYR$62.70 (2pax)

Really average food. Seriously overhyped.

Author: worktopsteve
Title: Latest trip to Penang
Review:
Great to be back in Penang and to eat at Andrews again, had 3 great meals there, service , food and atmosphere all excellent, especially the crispy aromatic duck. Well done  to Andrew and all the girls who work so hard.
See you in May.

Author: BuddingSommelier61George Town, Malaysia
Title: Good food
Review: We were a bit apprehensive about going here due to the description about the ambience. We found it fine except for the Mosque right next door chanting for over an hour which made it hard to here onself. The meal was good and service great no complaints.Show less

Author: Paul B
Title: A lovely restaurant
Review: We visited Penang for the first time spending 8 days there. We read about Andrew’s Kampung and wanted to try it. It’s not the easiest place to find but what a lovely place. Andrew welcomes you and you choose where to sit. The menu is not huge but that’s a good thing. The food was excellent in particular my green curry the second time we went there. As we left Andrew took a photo for his photo board.Show less

Author: YVR_Big_ERichmond, Canada
Title: Simplely Delicious!!
