Review: Friendly service, excellent food and very reasonable prices. As many other reviewers had mentioned, the setup of this place is very simple but it was clean and comfortable. There is an elevator that will take you up to the restaurant from besides the KFC building entrance if you don't feel like climbing up 4 flights of steps, but you might as well do that so you can feel less guilty for ordering more than you normally would as their dishes were all so tempting!Make sure to save room for the deep fried ice cream; it was best described as ice cream in Asian-style french toast - it was gangster!! Do yourself a favor; skip the hotel/resort food one night and give this place a go!!Show less

Author: Lbayorkie
Title: Great little restaurant
Review: This restaurant stands head and shoulders above the charmless and basic hawker type canteens along the main strip. Excellent food, great prices and a very friendly host and owner, Andrew. This place has character and I would firmly recommend it.

Author: Julia W
Title: On everyone’s to do list
Review: Basic setting, plastic chairs and cutlery but food and staff fabulous at silly prices. Make sure you visit. If you stay in Shanghai La make sure you visit. Don’t be put off by the location.

Author: jpf862Zoetermeer, The Netherlands
Title: Unexpectedly good
Review: I was looking for a quick diner at night (around 21:00), and did not want to walk too far from my hotel. I could have went for the hawker stall, but some recommended this restaurant.It looks a bit shabby at first. I also got a table at the balcony, which didn't really offer any nice view at all. The food on the other hand, was very good. I ordered wontons and grilled fish nyonya style... I was not disappointed. Friendly staff, and affordable prices. I would go here again if I had the chance.Show less

Author: KevinG2627
Title: Meal
Review: Our first vist to penang and was recommended a meal at andrews  and it was loverly one I've the best Chinese meals we have ever had and will go back before we go home

Author: andreasL4524NO
Title: Amazing
Review: Best hidden gem we found .  It was recommended and Although basic setting food was exceptional. Get the duck best I have ever tasted and we travelled the world

Author: Norma KMiddlesbrough, United Kingdom
Title: Nice food but surroundings a bit off putting.
Review: We have dined here several times and have not been disappointed. Always very welcoming and popular with the brits. The duck starter is delicious and the wine is nice while reasonably priced. You often have to book during busy periods but so far we have not been turned away. Would like to see it move to ground level where people can see it.Show less

Author: hourgmornKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Tourist Spot. Foods okay though.
Review: Came all the way up to Batu Ferringhi to try Andrews Kampung as it caught my attention with its great reviews. The food is just okay for Penang standards, nothing special. As a local I'd say you could get way better and more authentic food in Georgetown. The only reason why this place has great reviews is because it's in a tourist spot and are getting mostly reviews from tourists while locals don't use TripAdvisor so often which makes ratings unreliable (especially in Batu Ferringhi). Show less

Author: jamiexxCambridge, United Kingdom
Title: Amazing food and staff
Review: Well, what a lovely place. So much so, we ate here twice in the week we stayed. and the food is just lovely.Food was reasonably priced (for the British anyway) and the flavours were just amazing. It was a little tricky to find and I did wonder where we were going but it's well worth making the effort.We had some amazing fish and spices. If you don't know what something is on the menu, don't be British, just ask! They are so friendly it really does make you want to go back again.Don't expect a fine dining restaurant, it's not. However, I gave it a 5 star rating because of the food taste, quality, overall price and of course, the staff.Closed on Tuesdays (As of Sep 2018)Show less

Author: JOMCD81Geelong, Australia
Title: Excellent food, friendly service.
Review: We ended up eating here twice during our week stay in Penang. The service was friendly and welcoming of our two slightly excitable children!! The local curries were delicious, as was the satay sticks...the highlight was the deep fried Ice cream which we all loved!! Very good value for money and our bills were no more than 70-80 RM excluding alcohol. Highly recommend this place, great if your staying opposite at the golden sands resort. Show less

Author: Alison01924Leeds, United Kingdom
Title: Lovely food and a friendly host
Review: My sister and me ate here during a storm so we're blown about a bit on this roof top restaurant but the food more than made up for it. The food was hot, spicy and full of flavour and and about £25 for 2 courses and 2 drinks each it was great value too.Show less

Author: ljotravellerBuckinghamshire, United Kingdom
Title: A must do
Review: Just as other reviewers have stated - Andrew’s is a must. Food was great and reasonably priced - we went several times during our holiday. It’s located directly across the road from the Golden Sands. As one viewer stated, the stairs aren’t great but there is also a lift if you would prefer to use this. It’s very busy though so you must ring and book beforehand. Show less

Author: Fiona MEdinburgh, United Kingdom
Title: So good - and handy if staying in Shanghai La hotels
Review: Do not be put off entering the building which always feels a bit uninhabited. The easiest approach is up the stairs opposite the Golden Sands by the CIMB bank. This food is great and it does feel as though you are in Andrew’s home. Pick several half portions and share. You can always order more if you underestimate your hunger or particularly like a certain dish. Show less

Author: TonyP992
Title: Great Dinner
Review: had the duck, as always and the special steamed whole fish with spices. Andrew looks after the guests with true gusto. A must place for dinner when up at Batu ferringhi.

Author: kasperstaerkSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good local food
Review: Visited based on the great Tripadvisor reviews and to try something local. 2 adults and 1 kid and had plenty of food and a few drinks. Bill came to just shy of 150myr so not super cheap but would say good value. Very enthusiastic owner - Andrew - was there and service etc. perfect. Food was delivered VERY prompt! The deep fried ice-cream,calamari and Malaysian Chicken Curry the best of the 6-7 (half portion) dishes we had. Show less

Author: Iain THorsham
Title: Great food, a must on any visit
Review: Located on the top floor you can take the stairs or a lift. The service was prompt and friendly with Andrew overseeing everything and you can hear him directing the whole place. The menu offered something for everyone. The wine was good and roughly the same price as you would pay in the local mini market. We had starters, a beer, a bottle of wine and mains for around MYR188. The Malay chicken curry was delicious the same can be said for the sizzling beef. Remember its cash only, no card.Great host, great food and highly recommended.Show less

Author: NicMorgsSpearwood, Australia
Title: Best local restaurant. Must try!
Review: If it wasn’t for all the great reviews we probably wouldn’t have given this place a try. It’s hidden upstairs in a random building is a real local gem. The service is always great, especially from Andrew. The food comes out super quick and is all really delicious. We enjoyed the food so much we came back multiple times during our trip. Some of our favorite dishes were the fried wontons, honey plum chicken, sizzling beef and the fried ice cream. The place is only small so would recommend booking, especially for larger groups. Would definitely come back here and recommend to anyone. Show less

Author: traveller2044
Title: Yummy!!!
Review:
We arrived at the restaurant starving. The service was so quick and the food was really very very very tasty, price decent and the staff lovely. Top marks for this one!

P.s. We were so busy eating the food we only took two pictures!

Author: KingoMidlandsNorthampton, United Kingdom
Title: No frills however food and service was 5 star
Review: Visited because of positive reviews and wasn’t disappointed. Staff very helpful with advising what to order particularly when one doesn’t want spicy food. Food was fresh and tasty, definitely recommend the spring rolls to start with, much better than what we get back in the UK. Mains were perfect and not too spicy, the staff even pointed out the chili’s in the rice which my husband had managed to source and ate. So hubby had no room for pudding apparently but because of the deep fried ice cream being mentioned in some of the posts he thought it would be rude not to try which he did very well so well he refused to share. Would I recommended this restaurant to others, definitely yes, do give it a try. Don’t be put off by the downstairs access as per other reviews, once you arrive at the restaurant you completely feel at home. Show less

Author: GRDorkingsGreenville, South Carolina
Title: Great fresh food served with no frills
Review: You need to walk the stairs unless you know there is an elevator round the back. It’s pretty much open on 2 sides so not much difference between inside and outside.Service was great and friendly, food is simple and tasty and fast. I would go back and try a lot more dishes Show less

Author: Ian JYorkshire, United Kingdom
Title: Wonerful Food !
Review: If you want posh surroundings in an elegant setting then this will not be the place for you. It is a very simple cafe.The welcome is warm and friendly and they take care in helping you decide want to order. The food is freshly prepared and arrived piping hot and delicious. If you have room for desert then the fried ice cream is a must. It was closed on our final day in Batu Ferringi otherwise we would have visited it again.Show less

Author: emma S
Title: tasty and affordable
Review: we mostly had our meals here. kids finished clean the sweet and sour chicken, and curry chicken. the fried rice was average. the host of the restaurant was very friendly too.

Author: Nick MAdelaide
Title: Number one - for a reason
Review: Searched and found this due to it's high rating - and we were not disappointed, food was the best I have had for some time, service great and met & chatted to Andrew. Duck & the fried ice cream were the favourites. Don't miss this if you are in the area.Show less

Author: sigma8Tynemouth, United Kingdom
Title: Great Restaurant
Review: We have visited Andrew’s twice during our visit. The food is amazing and the owners and staff are very friendly and helpful. The first time we sat out on the balcony but last night it was raining and the balcony was closed. The main room was full but they quickly set up a table in another room. You can choose whether to have a half portion or full portion. The half was fine for me but my husband was happier with the full size meal. They serve deep fried ice cream for dessert which we had never tried before. We were going to order one each but were advised to share because of the size of it. It was delicious!! Show less

Author: johnpS9750TT
Title: Penang local food
Review: On the "good" end of Batu Ferringhi Beach near to the night markets....the local curries are excellent here and the service friendly.

Author: RoweysBristol, United Kingdom
Title: Wonderful food
Review: What a great find! We we a group of 8 with kids and had a fantastic meal here. From some amazing crispy duck to Malaysian curry, wow. Everything was so moreish. The hospitality was great with some very friendly staff. Set in a building on a high floor, ignore the surroundings, once you get to Andrews you won’t be disappointed. Yum.Show less

Author: Pjf10Coventry, United Kingdom
Title: Fantastic Place To Eat
Review: We ate here towards the end of our holiday having read a number of positive reviews. It’s in what can only be described as an office come residential come retail block, but don’t let that put you off at all. It was busy which is always a good sign, but our reserved table was ready set up for us. The service feels like you are being served by family members and the food was fantastic. The kids (and adults) would highly recommend the fried ice cream to finish which was excellent.Show less

Author: RosFKFalkirk, United Kingdom
Title: First night find
Review: My husband had read about Andrew’s and when we found out it was literally right across the road from our hotel we decided to look no further for an early dinner. It was amazing! I know others have commented on the price being higher than the street food but this is our first night so we haven’t been elsewhere yet, and for two soft drinks, a starter, two mains, a rice to share and deep fried ice cream it was £15!! (80 ringet including the tip!) The food was very nice, obviously fresh, well cooked and the service was warm and friendly. We had the pineapple fried rice, chicken Kapitan curry, garlic fish and the aforementioned deep fried ice cream (only get one portion between two!!) and it was sent from heaven. It isn’t anything fancy to look at, it’s up a number of very inauspicious stairs (although we found out there is also a lift) and it’s plastic BBQ chairs to sit on, but we would definitely recommend Andrew’s and will probably return during our stay. Show less

Author: ew00076Surrey, United Kingdom
Title: Fantastic staff and food
Review: We were recommended this restaurant by a local and were pleasantly surprised. The staff were amazingly friendly and flamboyant. We had several super tasty dishes with the best service. The setting is lovely too. Set up several stories up with lots of photos and memorabilia around the place. Show less

Author: Mike_DennehyTauranga, New Zealand
Title: Lives up to the hype, well worth a visit
Review: We were recommended to visit by English friends from a few years earlier, and despite making the trip all the way from George Town we weren't disappointed.Andrew is a lovely man and a great host, everything on the menu looks fantastic and we really had to work hard to narrow it down so we could order.Everything we ate was delicious and tasty, and while it costs more than the street food it should too - you're getting freshly cooked food and table service, with a nice view of the strip.Definitely recommend, and will return.Show less

Author: chrisgC5364HJ
Title: Amazing food and hospitality!
Review: It was our best dinner so far while travelling. All dishes were great, service was top class and the bill was very reasonable. Highly recommend!

Author: Ramesh M
Title: Great food
Review: Amazing food. We stayed near the restaurant and visited twice. Great  service, great food and reasonable price. The kids absolutely loved the food as well. The staff are so accommodating. If you visit Batu Ferringhi, it's must to go and eat at Andrew's Kampung.

Author: pistonbroke28Liverpool, United Kingdom
Title: Wow wow wow
Review: We went tonight on the recommendation of Trip Advisor. To only was it very friendly but the food was amazing. One brilliant idea is the half portion option on main meals. Great idea. We had the duck for starters and 3x curries. Amazing flavours. Best ever. Located in shopping mall opposite the mosque on 2nd floor. There is a lift near KFC which will take you to the 2nd floor. Take the time to visit. Excellent quality food and cheap as chips. Authentic and brilliant. Thank you. See you again soon xxxShow less

Author: David W
Title: Great Food, Lovely Service
Review: Had a family meal for 11 here yesterday. Despite, just turning up unannounced we were seated quickly with no fuss. Prompt and very friendly service and excellent Malay food. The best Satay we have had in Penang! All the dishes were excellent though. The Devil's curry is very hot!Do not let the modest surroundings fool you, this place is a gem.Thank you for a very pleasant evening.Show less

Author: bhadbritneeAdelaide, Australia
Title: Best food in Batu ferringhi
Review: My partner and I have been in Penang for a week. We have eaten twice at this restaurant and could not recommend it more highly. Andrew is bubbly and friendly as are his staff. The marmite chicken is the best in the history of mankind. If you are visiting Penang, do yourself a flavour and eat here.Show less

Author: Quest42n8George Town, Malaysia
Title: Very Nice Food and Selection
Review: Very Nice selection on food.In Batu Ferringhi, one can buy from Hawker stalls or the food markets and find good food for under 20 Ringett or $4 US at this point in time. There is a wide variety of choices.Having said that, Andrew's is about double this price but the selection, quantity and quality is much better. I think more worthwhile for those special nights when you with to have a nicer meal.I had the Crispy Duck. This was a leg and thigh which was taken apart tableside. Served like Peking Duck with pancakes (the most I have been given), sliced cucumber and duck sauce. It was very good. I love Peking Duck and have had it around the world. For the price, this was fantastic (39 R) and really could feed 1 people.I also had the Crispy Squid, (small portion for 12 R) which was fresh, tender and delicious. The portion was of good size. Again, with the duck this could easily feed 2 peopleThe drinks were a little expensive for Batu Ferringhi (about double) at 5.90 R but not too bad. This considering that this amounted to $1.50 US.The service was very good and they left me alone enough to eat in peace while checking in to see that everything was good and to let me order something else.The owner was attentive and happy.This restaurant is closed on Tuesdays.All in all a very nice change of pace from the food markets and stalls.To get to the third floor restaurant you have a choice of stairs or a lift. It is right on the corner across from the Golden Sands and has big sign on the side of the building.DABShow less

Author: Adam1630Leeds, United Kingdom
Title: Great food, but looks like a transport cade
Review: The food is cheap and flavourful, the staff are helpful and friendly, however it’s not the sort of place you would visit unless you had the assurances of a good trip adviser rating. The restaurant is on the top floor of a concrete block and nothing has been spent on decor.I enjoyed the food, but wouldn’t go back as I think they need to improve the setting.Show less

Author: Lilibeth M
Title: Good lunch
Review: Went for lunch, place is empty, we had duck with pancakes which was very satisfying. Sweet and sour prawns are ok, seems the prawns was cooked in the morning and just got reheated with the sauce. Over all it’s satisfying.

Author: Simon H
Title: Great food, lovely staff and our favourite option in the area
Review: We made a few visits on our recent holiday because the food was so nice, good value and the staff unfailingly welcoming and attentive. We never had to wait for service on arrival and recommendations spot on, without upsell.Special dish mentions go out to the spring roles, Kapitan curry, Malaysian curry, sizzling prawns and delicious fish.Show less

Author: sham1274London UK
Title: Lovely homely meal
Review: We visited after positive reviews on TA. Glad we did - food great and Andrew is charismatic and attentives. Staff lovely and welcoming to all family and young children. Although the set up is basic they will do their best to make you comfortable with fans and shutters if the sun is too hot.Samosas, crispy duck, kapitan prawn, Kang kong and bee hun all lovely and fresh. Deep fried ice cream memorable!’Better experience then food court and prices not far off. Visited twice during our 5 day stay.Show less

Author: joanp927Crawcrook, United Kingdom
Title: Fantastic food
Review: I cannot thank Andrew enough for his hospitality . The food is fantastic. He is a great host, as well as his staff. He will cook anything you want. I have to say the deep fried ice cream is divine. Look forward to my fourth visit in November 2018.Show less

Author: Barbara C
Title: A must to visit
Review:
Had Malaysian prawn curry twice, if we had found it earlier, we would have had it more.
Staff were lovely and helpful and Andrew, a lovely guy.

Author: GlendaSNSydney, Australia
Title: VERY PLEASANT EXPERIENCE
Review: We took the local bus 101 & it was easy to find this restaurant. Started with Chicken Satay sticks which I would not order again, Beef Kapitan which was so tender, steamed rice ,mixed veggies, Chicken curry which was very good & a couple of beers. Very relaxed environment, the staff are very entertaining & didn't break the bank.Show less

Author: nellipuzhaBangalore
Title: Decent food, a tad pricy
Review: Building is a dive. But, the trek is worth it. The place is nice, clean and homely. Service is good. Then the entire area is a tourist trap when it comes to restaurants. This place is for the times you dont want to eat street food or go to a fancy restaurant, but want tasty food. But, the prices are a bit steep.Show less

Author: StuartfromBisleyBisley, United Kingdom
Title: Top food, good value.
Review: Yes, it's up two flights of stairs, but exercise is a good thing on holiday!Very welcoming, nice chilled tiger straight away.Andrew is a charming and helpful host, a lot of customers seemed to be regulars having 'same as yesterday'Best Tom Yum soup, fresh spices was the explanation...Followed by crispy duck with pancakes, like home (UK) but pancakes much thicker and triangular. Still delicious, especially with the extra homemade chilli sauce.Will be returning before I go home!Show less

Author: Keysi999Hong Kong, China
Title: Great meal out
Review: Agree with all the reviews, this place is tiny, seems family run and is a plastic table kind of place... I mean that in a good nice and local way, not a put down.Food was fantastic, we went for a mix of starters, Crispy Duck was great, spring rolls and garlic bread.For mains we went for 1/2 dishes and shared, the Devils Chicken and Marmite Chicken were the highlights, with sizzling beef an absolute winner with the kids.Add rice, noodles, 2 adults, 2 x 12 year olds, lots of cold beers, nice glass or 2 of white for the Mrs, cokes extra for the kids, and not forgetting the vanilla and rainbow deep fried ice cream, all really good.Price, it came to a very reasonable 330RM, so we gave them a nice tip.Thank you Andrew and team for a lovely evening Show less

Author: Woodychester1Birkenhead, United Kingdom
Title: Friendly service and good food
Review: Arrived late into resort and arrived at this semi open air restaurant on third floor of large multi use block!In spite of closing time they were happy to serve us, food choice good for local food, costs very reasonable and food good, service exceptionally friendly ( if a little camp). Certainly worth considering although many may visit the hawker stalls along the main drag.Show less

Author: P5372MFjamesg
Title: Great food at a good price
Review: Just adding to the already positive stuff on here really. Good food and you will be happy with the bill and friendly service.

Author: cardiffcwtchCardiff, United Kingdom
Title: Fabulous, authentic and wonderfully loud!
Review: We’ve visited Penang many times but in all the years have never found Andrew’s Kampung; it’s a real treat.The staff are friendly without being gushing, the surroundings are basic but clean and quirky and the choice is wide enough to please everyone.It’s exceptionally reasonable. Our family of four ordered a basket of samosas, the best spring rolls I’ve ever eaten and a platter of garlic bread (for our spice averse 8 year old) as starters. This was followed by devil chicken curry, nonya fish, Malay chicken curry - all with kampung or steamed rice and fish and chips with a broccoli side for my son. It was all delicious: freshly cooked, bursting with flavour and massive in portion size. I don’t know how the children had room for it but they finished with either a deep fried ice cream or a milo ice. Two large bottles of water, many cokes and sprites and four large tiger beers (blushes) brought the bill up to an unbelievably reasonable RM 250. It would be possible to spend much less but it was a warm night and the Tiger Beer was beautifully cold.No surprises that we’ll be going back! Show less

Author: jamestpendletomLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Superb local food with local service and character
Review: I visited Andrews with family (2 adults, 1 teen, 2 children aged 8 and 10) on a Friday evening after having booked a table. When we arrived we were seated promptly in an area with ceiling and floor fans. There is an inside area as, well which can be requested , also is sometimes used for parties.We used the stairs, which is a bit of a trek up to the second floor in the heat. You can also use the lift which is around the corner near the KFC.Andrew met us with a great big smile and quickly laid out the menu for us suggesting items that we could order. We ordered some starters and drinks and followed up with a main of the Malay Chicken Curry, Thai Chicken Curry and Beef in Pepper sauce which was served on a banana leaf.The food was amazing, the children enjoyed the Malay curry so much that it was gone within the 15mins! I found the Thai curry extremely good with the perfect level of spices. the Beef was good as well.Andrew and other staff came by often to see how we were and talk to us about the food and ingredients, which was very nice and added to the experience.We enjoyed the food and experience so much, that we booked immediately to return again the following evening.So in summary, great food, great service, amazing local dishes, would definitely visit again if I return to Batu Ferringhi.Show less

Author: bucketlisttravellersSydney, Australia
Title: Get the rainbow fried ice cream!
Review: This restaurant is on the top floor of the building opposite McDonalds. It seems to be targeted to the tourist market and there are pictures on the wall of their many customers. There is seating indoors or on the undercover balcony area. It gets a nice breeze up there and we enjoyed looking out at the view of the town below.The prices are cheap by western standards, but expensive by Malaysian standards. Most dishes were around 20-30 ringgit. We had the Nyonya fish, Kapitan chicken, 2 serves rice and Rainbow fried ice cream. The bill came to 53.50 ringgit. Everything was delicious and we particularly enjoyed the rainbow ice cream. This is a great place to come for a relaxing meal with a great atmosphere.Show less

Author: abilouSomerset, United Kingdom
Title: Amazing food and very friendly people
Review: We went to Andrews Kampung last night and we will definitely be returning before we return home as the food was delicious and the staff couldn’t do enough for us! You do need to book though as the place is very popular and was really busy when we arrived at 8 o’clock. If you would like the Peking duck you need to preorder it too as it is very popular and sells out early. (We were lucky as they had saved us some.)Show less

Author: izwanhShah Alam, Malaysia
Title: Tasty food
Review: Went here for early lunch, I don't think they were officially open at the time but the lady there is nice enough to take my order.. Tried their nasi goreng kampung and asam pedas fish? Actually I forgot the actual name of the dish, but both was good and generous portion size.. Price wise is right in the middle between not too expensive, not cheap either.. I don't think this place is halal certified as it serves liquor but they don't serve porkShow less

Author: KevinR_12Melton Mowbray, United Kingdom
Title: Just great food and local service.
Review: Easy to find ...a blue sign overhangs the balcony. It’s up stairs but there is a lift.I was feed up paying hotel prices. This place is great value - 4 adults 200 RM incl. drinks.It surroundings aren’t salubrious, no AC, but fans, it’s was fine. Table, glassware, and toilets were clean.Food tasted “Awesome” as my late teenage son described it. Hope to go back again before we leave.Show less

Author: alidahs
Title: DELICIOUS
Review: Andrew is the nicest person, and the  food was amazing + cheap! The crispy duck with pancakes was so sooo delicious!!

Author: ClemnJoRockingham, Australia
Title: Tasty Authentic Food
Review: We had lunch on the day of our departure from Penang and were disappointed that we didn't find this place earlier in our trip. The food is authentic and the curries were to die for. When we return to Penang, we will be regular visitors to Andrew's Kampung.Show less

Author: wheels95Melbourne, Australia
Title: Great local food
Review: We were a party of two couples and loved Andrews so much we went three nights in a row. Great value and really delicious food. Extensive menu and excellent house special dishes. No glamorous decor but friendly staff and its all about the food. Highly recommend.Show less

Author: Alexandra S
Title: Best food in Batu Ferringhi!
Review: We ordered the roasted duck and the black pepper fish. The portions were very big and they were absolutely delicious!

Author: Junjie_JaySingapore, Singapore
Title: Dinner Takeaway
Review: WE decided to dine in at the hotel one night because we were so tired to go out. I read the reviews here on TA for Andrew's Kampung and decided to give it a try. Everything i ordered was yummy, a non spicy curry (kapitan chucken curry i believe), vegetables and fried rice were all really nice and good value, would probably try to dine in next time since Andrew was so friendly too.Show less

Author: debbieboase
Title: Weekly fix
Review: Every year when in Penang we go to Andrews Kampung for the tastiest Malay/ Chinese food!! And he never disappoints

Author: Allan K
Title: Good food
Review: We had the special all you can eat menu ,trying several different starters and main course  all the food was of excellent quality and taste ,Andrew is always on hand to recommend different dishes to try ,

Author: barbaraf1962
Title: Disappointed
Review: Really didn’t live up to reviews. We went on back of previous reviews. We were really disappointed and wouldn’t return.

Author: moe48212Sterling Heights, Michigan
Title: Fried ice cream
Review: Have to try the fried ice cream, specially the vanilla one. Vanilla was my favorite. They also have curry called devil chicken, all i have say it's awsome. I loved everything on the menu that I was able to try. Great place if your foodie person.Show less

Author: kfwrigleyLiverpool, United Kingdom
Title: Andrews Kampung never disappoints.
Review: As frequent patrons of Andrews we have never noticed any drop in the quality of his food or Andrews enthusiasm with his guests.Our latest meal there was the Crispy Duck followed by Pineapple Chicken, both were excellent dishes served quickly and arrived very hot.Special mention to all of Andrews staff who always look after us so well.We will be returning there later this week.Show less

Author: LeowY31Singapore, Singapore
Title: Great food, but pricey
Review: Service was great, Andrew himself served our table. Food was quick to arrive. Food was excellent. We tried the Kampung Fried Rice 10/10 (We ordered 4 portions, there are 7 of us). The black pepper pork ribs are ok, nyonya fish wasn't fantastic. The fried ice cream (4 portions, each of different flavour) was good, especially the coffee flavoured one. (i would give the strawberry a miss) and the balachan kang kong was 10/10 as well. For those who like spicy food, the balachan fried rice might be something you would like to try too. We didn't get to try their signature duck as it was out of stock.Show less

Author: Emily L
Title: Ok
Review: Friendly & quick service however the food itself was average- not too flavoursome. Small portions particularly for price. Slightly disappointed considering rave reviews.

Author: Jeyjey05Rawang, Malaysia, Asia
Title: Hidden gem in batu feringghi
Review: What else can I say. Went there based on the review in trip advisor. First and foremost.. Restaurant is on 4th floor just opposite petrol station. We were greeted by the friendly host. He recommended some of the good food there as it was our first time. One of the recommended dish was the kapitan chicken curry and the spring roll. Pictures are as below. It was really tasty and I would recommend anyone to try it. Overall the food was fantastic. Price was average. Worth every ringgit paid. Will definitely come back again. Show less

Author: akorea
Title: Excellent food!!!
Review: A non-pretentious place, home style restaurant in Batu Ferringhi. Delicious food: Malaysian curry chicken and Capitan  beef curry and fried noodles!!! Service was friendly and price is great for such a nice meal. Highly recommended if your are around this area.

Author: jesseaurKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Fantastic food, super friendly owner
Review: The humble food here was so good that we returned everyday. For those who likes spicy, the devil's curry is for you. Chilli padi comes out strong. Thai green curry, nyonya fish and vege was good. super friendly owner who kept the kitchen open for our takeaway 15 min before closing time and did it with a smile too!Show less

Author: bobcop_12
Title: good tasty food
Review: Good food cooked piping hot. Bit of a climb to get to it.Then found there was  a lift on the way down. Not too cheap and beer was dear

Author: georgig2016
Title: Tasty !
Review:
Great place to eat local food ! The host is fantastic and really helpful and attending.
The meals we had were delicious! The duck pancakes are a must!

Author: stevehan92Peterborough, United Kingdom
Title: GREAT FOOD AND SERVICE & GOOD VALUE
Review: Highly recommend this restaurant. Lots of choice of food and all freshly cooked. Someone recommended to start with pancake rolls and they are fab ( shared one between two of us ) The food is delicious and excellent value. Well worth a try. Andrew is the life and soul of the restaurant.Show less

Author: Christine THartley, United Kingdom
Title: Amazing Food
Review: Discovered this restaurant on our last trip to Penang and returned again this year. Food is absolutely and definitely the duck is the best anywhere we have ever eaten. Great range of dishes and haven't been disappointed in anything we have tried. We were introduced to the deep fried ice cream which was something I had never been tempted to try before - amazing and would recommend everyone tries this at least once. The restaurant does get busy so if you want a guaranteed table you may be better off book. Fantastic food, staff and atmosphere and excellent value for money. Apart from the duck try the Kapitan chicken curry - full of flavour and not too spicy or hot. Andrew himself is a great character and genuinely cares about his guests enjoying their food. Don't visit this area without going to this restaurant Show less

Author: Richard TBurnley, United Kingdom
Title: Authentic local cuisine
Review: This is a great place to sample excellent local Chinese style food in a really authentic atmosphere. Food and service is excellent and it is good value.Don't expect a fancy air conditioned dining room - more like an outside veranda, but a truly great experience.Show less

Author: Amsmmm9
Title: Great restaurant
Review: Can see why this is the number one restaurant in Batu Ferringi on trip advisor.  Don't let its location put you off especially the climb up the stairs - it's well worth it!  Lovely food , cheap price and excellent service from very friendly staff.

Author: Ratty180
Title: Great food
Review: Visited 3 times on a recent holiday and the food was great each time, liked the fact that half portions are offered so got to try more dishes. Andrew is a excellent owner service and presentation was great.

Author: Charlotte WKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Excellent food, very friendly and great value
Review: Would not hesitate to recommend, had an absolutely lovely meal here, we massively over-ordered as the portion sizes were very generous and everything was delicious.As other reviews say, don’t let the building put you off, persevere and get to the 2nd floor and you’ll find it.Can especially recommend the crispy duck which was so good, and enough for 2 people. Thank you, we will be back!Show less

Author: Andyyy6
Title: Good overall
Review: This is certainly tailored to the expat - overall food was good and service quick and friendly. I did have higher expectations after reading the reviews so was disappointed the food didn’t have a more local choice.  There’s certainly more local restaurants in George Town.

Author: SteveandDDPort Macquarie, Australia
Title: Nice, nice, nice
Review: After reading TA reviews we decided to give it a go, and we are glad we did. It is a very pleasant place on the second floor of a building on the left just before the night markets, and there is a lift tucked away in the middle of the ground floor - as we discovered after dinner and after climbing 8 sets of stairs to the second floor.We loved the local fried squid and both our curries (one Devils chicken, the other Malaysian beef) were delicious and the servings were ample. Service was excellent as were the smiles all round. Of course, the prices are reflected in the fact that it's a restaurant, but for one large Tiger beer, squid, two curries with steamed rice, MYR82 (AUD27) is pretty good. Show less

Author: butchNottsUknotts uk
Title: Friendly and simple
Review: We heard about this place and glad we visited. The staff are delightful. With lots of smiles and greetings. The food was so tasty and full of flavour....sadly we forgot to go back!!Which is a shame as intended on making a couple of trips there.Show less

Author: Dream624129
Title: Amazing
Review: The restaurant is up on the 2nd floor of a war torn building block, by don't let that put you off . The prices are very very reasonable and the food is such good quality and fresh it is without doubt the best restaurant in Batu Ferrenghi. The red devil curry and pepper beef is amazing. The owner Andrew is very camp but speaks perfect English. The restaurant also does half portions so you can try various dishes. Please note that the restaurant closes on a Tuesday.Show less

Author: Lance GMelbourne, Australia
Title: Fussy eaters appeased
Review: Great food. Great service. Managed to find lots of new dishes our two very unadventurous children found to their surprise they liked! On first visit had the duck (superb) and Kapitan chicken curry. This time the sizzling beef (highly recommend), pineapple chilli chicken (nice mild chilli hit) , chicken satay and pineapple rice. All very good dishes. Very friendly and casual place. Cheers.Show less

Author: Sebastian F
Title: Mixed feelings
Review: In my opinion is not the best food in Penang. Very spicy? Definitely, yes! Good but not number one in our hearts.

Author: Y9367TZpeteraNorrkoping, Sweden
Title: Best in Batu
Review: Welcoming, nice, local malaysian food in the middle price range ~20RM/plate. Been eating here four times now and tried over ten different dishes from the menu, all good and tasty. It's on the second floor, take the stairs to the right of the Bank office or the creepy elevators inside the center of the buildingShow less

Author: FionaH545
Title: Lovely food
Review: Absolutely worth a visit. Lovely food, friendly attentive service.  Ice cold beer in uced glasses.  Food was really delicious. We had to order a second crispy duck  the kids loved it so much.

Author: TrueamBerkshire, United Kingdom
Title: The best.........
Review: We went to Andrews twice while staying in Batu Ferringhi, both times were very good, don't be put off by the building its in. Andrew was very welcoming its superb value, we actually paid more for our bottle of wine than we did for our food!!Show less

Author: Shirley LSingapore, Singapore
Title: Andrew's Kampung
Review: This restaurant is situated opposite the Golden Sands Resort Shangri-la. It offers delicious food at reasonable prices. So if you are tired of the expensive hotel type of food, visit this place. Andrew is very hospitable and would recommend the various dishes that suits you. Their crispy duck is yummilicious. A must try if you are there. Their steam fish and kampung fried rice are lemak! You should also try their fried ice cream. No air con though. But it is cooling. Had lunch and dinner there on several occasions. Show less

Author: MynameisrickKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good taste..
Review: We when there because of the good review...The food was good..Especially the Indonesian Fish...The dessert also good..Ice cream.goreng...for.the price a bit pricey for me..But i understand its a tourist and popular area...Make.sure you use elevator near KFC..because we didnt know bout that..we have to climb up 3rd story stair case :) Show less

Author: thomasrossmr
Title: Good for both local and western food
Review: Andrew runs an excellent restaurant near the major hotels. It is very popular with hotel guests and offers a good range of cuisine both local and western. It is reasonably priced.

Author: NeilFarnham
Title: As good as people say
Review:
We'd read the reviews, we'd had personal recommendations, so we had to visit Andrew and try it for ourselves.

It didn't disappoint.

Quality food at great prices served in a warm and welcoming restaurant environment with a good view of the market and nightlife.

Author: Rake61London, United Kingdom
Title: First class, second floor
Review: This is a great little place, once you've found it. Hidden away on the second floor of a small plaza on the main road, it is perfect for a relaxing evening of tasty food and friendly service. We had some of the house specials including morning glory and black pepper beef and some delicious meaty spring rolls. The portions are generous so if you want a selection of dishes, order half portions.Show less

Author: Elliot_BusbyUK
Title: Cheap & cheerful
Review: We visited Andrews twice during our holiday. The first time was very good however the second was just average maybe a different chef? The first time the food was tasty prawns & a beef dish with rice. The second time different main dishes but the same rice & noodles and the food was swimming in oil , stopped us returning! Show less

Author: CalebS628KL
Title: Good Penang Hainanese Food
Review: Firstly, the place itself does not appeal very well to tourists especially it being in a quite oldish looking building. Nevertheless, once you are at the restaurant you will probably be focusing on what you would be ordering. They have an extensive menu, comprising of both local/hainanese and western food. I am a big fan of Hainanese food and I found it to be fairly authentic although not all dishes made an impression to me. The beef kapitan was fantastic (better than the chicken kapitan), spring rolls were good and they had pretty decent Hainanese fried noodles too. The service was great, and the owners themselves were very friendly. Definitely a place a to visit if you are at Batu Ferringhi.Show less

Author: TravelOver55British Columbia, Canada
Title: WE will pass...
Review: Don’t know what the fuss is all about..... all white tourists.Food was anything but authentic, and the staff were anything but friendly. They just appeared to scream at one another. Curry dish didn’t taste very ‘homemade’..Sorry, I would much prefer to go to Long Beach where the chefs actually ask if you enjoyed the meal after you finish.We had eaten at The Living Room a few days prior, and it was very authentic, and a caring owner/Cook.Show less

Author: FionaPerthWAperth
Title: Nice traditional food
Review: This place is on the 3rd floor of a small centre roughly opposite the Golden Sands Hotel. There are quite a few stairs to get up there but if you look in the centre of of the building there is a lift. It is a very simple open air restaurant run by Andrew in the kitchen an older lady serving. We had Malaysian prawn curry and Chicken Kapitan with a side of bok choy. Everything was freshly made and tasted very good. It is open at lunchtime when sometimes it's hard to find places. Give it a try.Show less

Author: JSIM78
Title: Top restaurant in this area
Review: Not a place for local but the food is really not bad. Great customer service! Highly recommended if you are in this area.

Author: Y1294MUjameslTrinity Beach, Australia
Title: A Must for Anyone Visting Batu Ferringhi
Review: I read the reviews and insisted on going here on the first afternoon on the first day of our 2 week holiday in Batu Ferringhi, For an afternoon snack we ordered Hainanese Spring Rolls, Chicken Satays and a couple of cold beers. This was just to sample the food quality. Andrew served us and stopped us from over ordering. He was right - servings were generous, so tasty and very high quality. Sometimes our eyes are bigger than our tummies!! Anyway, we booked for dinner for the same night and came back for the crispy skin duck and Masala Chicken. WOW. Yes the duck was great. We came back for dinner 3 times - once was on the eve of Chinese New Year. A previous reviewer said they did not see many Chinese guests. Well, I found the mix between Chinese and other guests to be 50:50. Who can argue with good food and a fun family owned restaurant atmosphere. Décor is nothing flash but who goes out to eat the table and chair? Booking is recommended. This speaks for itself.Show less

Author: 152romaing
Title: A Must in Batu Ferringhi
Review: I highly recommend every travellers staying in the hotels around to have dinner to Andrew's restaurant. Outdoor seating, excellent local food, friendly family atomosphere. Reservation is recommended.

Author: Alan EReading, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent Food
Review: Visited Andrews recently on more than one occasion whilst staying nearby.I also had read the reviews and was not disappointed. The staff are very friendly, keen to help and the food was excellent. I am extremely fussy, the food is well priced, piping hot and the wine was served chilled.It's well worth a visit!Show less

Author: PeterFiftyLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Tasty as ever
Review: When dining at Andrew's you have to take it for what it is and enjoy the experience - and judging by the high volume of happy return guests (ourselves included) it's always a good one. The food is very tasty, freshly prepared and a lovely experience. It's a guilty pleasure for the guests (us included) staying across the road in the lovely five-star hotel confines and the rough & ready street-food approach a nice change from haut cuisine and fine dining.I take exception to the rather patronising review from Melissa from Australia; suggesting the restaurant is full of Europeans not use to eating this kind of food and, therefore, thinking it's great - well, Melissa, we are European and regularly eat and prepare Asian food and, for the price paid, what we have enjoyed at Andrew's down the years is always great. We have also paid 10 times the price of Andews to eat at The China Doll in Sydney for a similar style & taste of food. Furthermore, on Tuesday evening when we dined there were as many Aussies enjoying the tucker as us European folk! Go with the view that you are paying the price of a fast-food meal at home and enjoy some of the great flavours of Malaysia from wok to plate in 5 mins. This time we had samosa and salt n pepper chicken to start; followed by Malaysian curry and sizzling beef with fried rice - all tasted great and will go again next week before we head back to Europe.Show less

Author: MelissaY728Narrabeen, Australia
Title: Don't waste your time
Review: OMG - I've read so many reviews of this restaurant where people rave about the food so I went myself to check it out. In 3 words - IT WAS AWFUL. No taste, bland food and only down the road is the hawker stands that sell amazing food at a cheaper price.I don't understand how people say this restaurant is amazing but it was full on Europeans that don't normally eat this type of food.I would never go back and wouldn't recommend this restaurant to anyone.Show less

Author: Franny C
Title: Meal at Andrew's
Review: Went on 9th Feb 2018 with my friend we didn't book we were welcomed by very friendly staff found us table food was cooked to perfection I had sweet and sour chicken with steamed rice Restaurant very clean toilets were in immaculate condition...I would highly recommend this Restaurant. Franny from Liverpool Show less

Author: 20mitesht
Title: Amszing
Review: Best restaurant in Batu Ferringhi. Cheap prices, friendly staff and quality food. Highly recommend the Malaysian chicken curry.

Author: Stephen CLondon, United Kingdom
Title: This is how to run a Resturant
Review: Staying in rasa wing nearby Tucked away in unusual spot in most unlikely building , don’t let that put you off.Great food served by charming staff led by charming host Andrew.Food delicious, great atmosphere and cheapBest meal in Batu ferringhi by far .Going back tomorrow!Show less

Author: billyK49Perth, Australia
Title: mr kavanagh
Review: Went to this place because of some good reviews. First thing I noticed was that all the patrons were caucasian. Iordered the spring rolls, followed by the duck.The spring rolls were big in size but short on taste.The duck was shredded at my table by a waitress.It was totally overlooked, dry and tasteless. Now I know why there were no locals eating. The place was noisy and untidy. Give it a missShow less

Author: jenny1tyrrell
Title: Holiday
Review: I have visited Andrews kampung for many years excellent food and value for money lovely idea to serve half portions gets very busy so advisable to book Andrew is a star as are all his staff lovely gesture of a rose on Valentine’s Day

Author: RufusZachBath, United Kingdom
Title: Best place for dinner in Batu Ferringhi
Review: Located in a small mall on the second floor across the road from the Shangri La Golden Sands resort. We were staying as the other Shangri La and came here to eat a few times.Staff are delightful. Food is Chinese Malay. All freshly cooked, comes out piping hot as it is done. Generous portions. Tasty food, good quality. Would highly recommend.They were often full when we went, so advise reserving.Show less

Author: Ilovemyjollies
Title: Fabulous
Review:
You may want to book ahead as it was very busy when we arrived.  

The food was lovely, the service equally so and very friendly. 

Great value for money and wouldn't hesitate to recommend.

Author: 307simonecBelair, Australia
Title: Taste Sensation with a view
Review: When you watch the chef shows on tv and they comment on how you can taste each individual herb, spice, ingredient in a dish and it isn’t just all mixed up together - this is it. You had the taste of the overall dishes - curries etc but could taste all the flavours. Food, service, views and price are all great. Other reviews talk about it worth climbing the stairs but did discover there is a lift.Show less

Author: 121thompsonm
Title: Awesome food
Review:
After climbing a few flights of stairs to work up appetite was pleased that the service was first class and food was bloody amazing well done andrew and team 

Not sure what others are on about with there negative comments  awesome guys

Author: Colin_JSRivenhall, United Kingdom
Title: If you like good Chinese cuisine, at a sensible price, this restaurant is a must !!
Review: We ate dinner twice at Andrew's Kampung during our 5 night stay in Batu Ferringhi. Don't be put off by the rather decrepit building in which it is situated, the restaurant is fine.We only found out about the restaurant by accident, when talking to a UK ex-pat who had lived in Batu Ferringhi for some years. It's a must do, it's 100% essential to book for evening dinner to avoid disappointment. Lots of folk without reservations were being turned away when we were there. We just popped up during the day to make a reservation, easier than phoning.The menu is extensive, and the food when it arrives will not disappoint, its outstanding. Prices are sensible too.The atmosphere is busy but very friendly. Service is swift, friendly and with a smile. Our only surprise was having to ask for chop sticks, cutlery otherwise seems to be limited to a fork and spoon.I have no hesitation in recommending this restaurant.Show less

Author: ChrisLeicester
Title: Great service and atmosphere
Review: Have visited many times over the last 5 years and it never disappoints on food and service as far a value for money is concerned.

Author: dghayfieldBanff, United Kingdom
Title: Outstanding
Review: This was our second visit to this restaurant and as per our first visit the food was exceptional. Between the starters and mains we were spoilt with flavour packed dishes, some spicy some not but overall it was a fantastic meal and would highly reccommend. Tip-booking advisable as it gets very popular.Show less

Author: Reg_FlyerBirmingham, United Kingdom
Title: Highly recommended!
Review: We had seen the tripadvisor reviews and decided to drop in on Andrew's. Andrew managed to squeeze us in despite the restaurant being pretty packed out. We started with the crispy duck and then moved onto a selection of half portions to share between us. The food portions were generous and the flavours were lovely. All in all it was a super meal and we booked ourselves in for our final night before returning. The second meal was equally successful. We decided to have a lighter meal so I could try the deep fried ice-cream recommended in several trip advisor reviews. This dish consists of a really big scoop of ice-cream sandwiched between two slices of bread and then cooked. The bread then takes on the flavour of the crispy bits of a nicely cooked bread and butter pudding. It was lovely but I was glad I had a lighter meal before hand. All the staff were very switched on and attentive, but Andrew was definitely the star of the show. As other reviewers have mentioned - do not be put off by the setting as the restaurant is on the second floor of a rather run down retail block. The decor wasn't as off putting as some of the other reviewers hinted at. The atmosphere, the food and of course Andrew made it a really nice dining experience.Show less

Author: 275lizzmHat Yai, Thailand
Title: Really delicious food
Review: This place was pretty packed when we went! Very popular and you may need to book. Andrew himself was extremely helpful, and the staff speak English and Chinese too. Pineapple rice was amazing, as was Malaysia chicken curry, ginger beef and bak Choy. Good prices for excellent food. Show less

Author: Rod_NBTBMKnaresborough, United Kingdom
Title: Delicious Chinese Cuisine!
Review: We've visited Penang twice in the past 5 weeks and Andrews Kampung has been our top choice for dining each time. We've enjoyed 3 delicious dinners and excellent customer service on each occassion. Having lived many years in Hong Kong and Shanghai, I'm quite picky when it comes to the quality of Chinese food, but this place is authentic and a top choice. You won't be disappointed.Show less

Author: K630GFalext
Title: Great food, great service.
Review: Bit of a weird location but the food was superb, tasty and fresh. Andrew is very lively and nice and all the staff were great.

Author: pip207St Ives, United Kingdom
Title: Great food great fun night.
Review: Opposite the Mc Donald sign and garage a large building the restaurant is on the second floor use the lift, you would be wise booking in advance it gets very busy, we took pot luck and ended up in the air con waiting room so called it was fine nice and cool, it was a very hot night outside. We started with onion rings six saty chicken with peanut sauce fab, main course we had crispy chicken and beef in black bean sauce with pineapple rice and fried ice cream , Diet Coke and Tiger beer delicious every course all this for less than £20.Show less

Author: 801cm
Title: The Best in Penang
Review: Excellent food and service! Everything we ordered was tasty and delicious. Attentive service. A must when in Penang. We went on a Sunday night and it was packed so reservation is recommended.

Author: brianbakerphoto
Title: Over Hyped!!
Review:
On the ratings of Trip Advisor visited this restaurant.Have to be honest it wasn't our number one.
Food was fine and very reasonably priced

Author: James G
Title: Best value in Batu Ferringhi
Review: Well established restaurant on the second level accessed by private lift open air atmosphere with western style Chinese food always good never had a bad meal there, very popular with tourists and locals alike the owner Andrew is a one off.

Author: MAKANRANGERSKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Friendly Andrew
Review: Read many good reviews about this place and came to tryout.Nice ambience and it gets full for dinner. Many would have reserved tables earlier.Ordered kampung fried rice, fried noodles, curry beef, mixed veggie soup, stir fried fish slices with veggies and 2 lime juices, all for Rm81.Food is alright, good thing it's not loaded with MSG. Service is good.Have a good walk upstairs for warm-up before dinner is a good idea.Show less

Author: Karen0167Adelaide, Australia
Title: Outstanding Malaysian food- must visit
Review: We were recommend to visit Andrews by a staff member at our hotel- best Malaysian he said and boy was he right!!Everything we had was just delicious with the duck and the special house rice absolute standouts. We will go back to Batu Ferringhi just to eat at Andrews!Show less

Author: Levis S
Title: Good place to eat
Review: Hidden place, but worth a visit. Good food and service. Always a lot of people but they tray their best to find a place for you. Best is to make a reservation first.

Author: rosiesweet
Title: Fabulous food
Review: One can visit this restaurant time and time again, food is exceptional. Andrew is an absolute star, with very hard working extremely friendly staff. An absolute must to visit

Author: 492fionas
Title: The best eating place we visited in the town. Reasonably priced, excellent Malaysian food.
Review: If going to this area we thoroughly recommend this restaurant. Outstanding food, staff and reasonably priced. Very friendly.

Author: petera772
Title: Dinner and a Show
Review: When you eat here you really get dinner and a show. Watching Andrew run the place is great entertainment and you get a very good meal at a reasonable price. Although he seems to manage to accommodate everyone making a reservation is useful.

Author: AlisonS2544
Title: A must visit!!
Review:
Absolutely the best local Malaysian food around ... delicious!! Andrew is so friendly and attentive and the restaurant staff too. Great quirky decor and lighting 😀
Go there!!!!

Author: JCT1962Newcastle, United Kingdom
Title: Good local fare
Review: Having read the reviews and it having visited on previous trips to Bath Ferrnghi we decided to give it a go and were not disappointed. We had satay to start served with a good peanut sauce followed by two local chicken curries which were tasty and quite spicy. We accompanied this witb half portions of pineapple rice and kampung fried rice which was more than enough for two of us. The atmosphere is excellent if a little chaotic with staff continously shouting instructions to each other Andrew buzzing round like a worker bee. Would recommend giving it a go next time you are here.Show less

Author: Htm999England,UK
Title: Penang does Fawlty Towers Michelin style
Review: Had a delicious meal here which was made all the more enjoyable by the welcoming, down to earth staff. The hilarious banter between them was flowing , and so was the fantastic food, good sizedportions and good value. Highly recommended for a fun night out. Top tip there is a lift within the precinct if you don’t fancy the stairs ! Show less

Author: myworld52
Title: authentic and fun
Review: the restaurant was recommended by several people. we were not disappointed. great welcome from Andrew who despite looking busy and harassed was totally in control. the food was mainly Malay/Chines fusion without being too spicy consumed in a busy and fun place. recommended.

Author: Sidda1
Title: Best in Batu Ferringhi
Review: Excellent, friendly staff and the food is fantastic. Value for money is second to none and you need to go here for the duck alone!

Author: Jackie B
Title: Oh Andrew
Review: Our first night at Batu F. we landed here. Tried the malaysian curries- supposedly mild, I'd hate to try hot. The food here was very  good although very spicy hot. Lovely staff. 30 ringit per dish average

Author: fenyvesip2015
Title: Great food and service
Review:
Had dinner here when a bid storm rolled through, Staff were great . And made sure we were ok . Food was fantastic especially the fried ice cream, definitely recommended
More like Andrew Ka Yums!

Author: Southy1964Kingston-upon-Hull, United Kingdom
Title: Great choice and can’t go wrong
Review: This is the top of the list for reviews in the area so many people automatically give it a try. It is a great place, the food is good and the pricing reasonable for the area. We ate here twice and were not disappointed. It is one of many good quality places in the area and I would say give it a go! We tried most of the dishes including the duck and all were very nice, except the satay which we thought was better in every other place that we had tried. Show less

Author: Jim-Grogga
Title: Winner winner kampung dinner!
Review: Always a great experience eating at Andrew’s. Fresh food and service with a smile. The roast duck and spring rolls are superb. Well priced meal.

Author: Oakmead1Bury St. Edmunds, United Kingdom
Title: Wowzer
Review: We visited here twice over our fortnight holiday.They had run out of the famous crispy duck the 1st time so I What’s App’d Andrew for the 2nd visit.The best sizzling beef and fried ice cream were the best we had in Batu Ferringhi and then the crispy duck is just superb.We rated 5 of the 6 places we ate during the fortnight as very good but we decided this was numero uno.The great food along with the unquestionable attentiveness of Andrew make it a thoroughly enjoyable place to eatShow less

Author: Kaspars LRiga, Latvia
Title: What an excellent find!!!!!
Review: This is the BEST place to eat in Penang!!! Can choose between half and full portions, but try to order more half portions to try the variety as much as you can! Indonesian Fish was the best dish during our trip. English spoken!!! Cannot wait to be back!Show less

Author: Traceycowderoy01
Title: Nice fresh food
Review: We stayed at the Sarang rasa just over the road.. so this is handy and comes recommended. Food hot, fresh and cheap... not posh but great food with no frills...Would recommend

Author: Netti27Melbourne, Australia
Title: Yummy food, served quickly with a smile!!!!
Review: Trip Advisor and other tourists we met in Penang, recommended this excellent restaurant. A short walk, a few stairs and you can have an icey cold beer and eat yummy Crispy Skin Duck, Beef Rendang, Nasi Goreng and I finished with the best Fried Ice Cream ever!! A booking was necessary (Christmas/New Year period), we ate here twice and Andrew greeted us with a smile and excellent service and there no waiting for that cold beer or the food.Show less

Author: 848millieh
Title: Number 1 in Penang
Review: Can not fault this place at all, incredible food for a very cheap price. The owner and wait staff were lovely, would definitely come back here.

Author: tarita2017
Title: Family dinner
Review:
Visited this restaurant twice whilst on holidays in Penang. 
Fun place to eat, real locals serving and preparing meals. Best restaurant in Batu Faringi. Authentic Malaysian food. 
Book to avoid disappointment as it's full every night

Author: C7964ROkarend
Title: Great food
Review: Food was delicious. We ordere black and pepper fish, sweet and sour fish, sweet and sour chicken, Kampan prawns (like a mild curry), and squid. Great food and reasonably priced. Service was a bit slow but restaurant was busy and we arrived fairly late.

Author: jamesflorraineBrisbane, Australia
Title: Very Good
Review: We have visited this restaurant on previous occasi0ns. The food is good but not fine dining.The service is very good and very affordable, the Crispy Duck is a house special, and a must have, try and order this before you visit, Andrew is always on hand in this family business great job will return.Show less

Author: Jsycpl
Title: Fantastic restaurant.
Review: Absolutely fantastic restaurant ! Lovely, friendly staff, very relaxed atmosphere. The food is all freshly prepared and great value for money. If you like spicy food go for the “Devil” options on the menu. Highly recommended.

Author: jrvd2015London, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent food, service and reasonable prices
Review: I asked the hotel staff to recommend a place that both they and locals go to for food rather than the ‘tourist hotspots’ in the area. This place was on the top of the list for more than one member of staff, and it certainly delivered! Food was delicious and the service was excellent from all staff. In fact the food and experience was so good we went back 2 days later! MAKE SURE YOU BOOK A TABLE!Show less

Author: stevendH7037EZ
Title: Always great
Review:
Always great 
Food is good and well priced.
Menu is the same and has not changed.
Portions seem to be smaller.
Still good value when you compare it to Australia.

Author: _davidwalker963
Title: Great Place
Review: A nice friendly restaurant with good food at a reasonable price.  Its elevated so you get a nice breeze to escape the heat while your eating.  The food is traditional and cooked well. Its well worth a visit.

Author: hamiltrj
Title: excellant!
Review:
went twice during our week in penang. both times we went with staff advice on the food. beer is cheap
really good much getter than the night market options

Author: johnny5iceSimi Valley, California
Title: Super friendly service and delicious food
Review: Arrived earlier and the place was pretty full. We were able to get a table by agreeing to eat in 50 min before another reservation party showed up. This worked out great for us given we have young children. So we ordered quickly and the food came out in 10 minutes. Every dish was good. Loved the option of half portions to allow you to try more dishes. Gets 4 stars only because of the ambiance isn’t that great. Anyone staying at the Golden Sands resort should try it one time. Show less

Author: GordonHartPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Great Local Food
Review: Andrew's is a great find. The food is terrific, service is quick considering the dishes are cooked freshly. Don't know how he cooks his duck but it is the best I have ever tasted. Another good point is you can order half portions. So you can order two small dishes instead of one large so you get to try more of the excellent dishes he has on his menu.Andrew is great fun as well, he has time to talk to everybody, will tell you if you have ordered too much and gives good advice on his menuIt is very popular so it is a good idea to book, or you might have to wait for a table.Show less

Author: missusleong
Title: Left wanting more of the duck!!
Review: Had dinner here and was packed on a Monday night. We had the duck and it was amazing. The other dishes were good as well. Service was quick and staff were warm and friendly. Just like dining in someone’s home. Will come back again!

Author: CindyepMelbourne, Australia
Title: A lovely restaurant
Review: After reading all the Trip Advisor reviews we thought we should check out Andrew's Kampung. It is one flight up in an non descript building. Andrew greets you on a arrival and is full of personality. The food was delicious. Would definitely recommend to others. Food is dearer then Hawker Market but the setting is also a little nicer and better presented. Our fussy children loved the plum chicken and pineapple rice. You may need to book as the restaurant is popular.Show less

Author: colinlee0711Singapore, Singapore
Title: Great food!
Review: Very delicious food at reasonable prices!Personal and affable staff and owners. Chef (see pic) comes out to interact with customers to get feedback. Very accommodating to requests for food prepared to our liking. A favorite place for meals among the guests staying in the hotels opposite. Noticed many of their repeated elderly customers had became friends with the owners. Show less

Author: MiaSurinKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Tasty but price on the high side
Review: Whilst the food is tasty and service is great, the prices are a little on the high side (more expensive than some restaurant of the same status based in KL) considering it is not an air-conditioned restaurant. Recommended chicken chop, black pepper fish and fried ice creamShow less

Author: camseanTownsville, Australia
Title: Great Food Despite the Setting
Review: As many reviewers have said, this restaurant has a less than salubrious location in a rundown block up, up a few flights of dingy stairs. However the food makes up for it.We ordered five or six dishes and all of them were tasty and well cooked. The service was also friendly and fast.Show less

Author: blood-bankerbelfast n. ireland
Title: Excellent. Highly recommended
Review: The best restaurant we visited in Batu Ferringhi. Warmly welcomed and brought a beautiful bottle of Chilean Carmenere! When ordering the meal Andrew said we could have our starters and then decide on our main course. What a sensible idea! Duck pancakes lovely. When deciding our mains we noticed that there were half portions available, again what a super idea. We had two different but lovely curries. A pleasure to meet Andrew and his team.Show less

Author: lordofthepieslondonLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Shows the limitations of where to eat in Batu Ferrnghi
Review: The fact that this is number 1 shows what a poor choice there is of decent places to eat at in Batu Ferringhi. Certainly the owner is delightful, he even gave us a lift back to our hotel, but to get there you have to run the gauntlet of people trying to sell you a massage as the restaurant is on the 2nd floor of an unprepossessing building, when you get there prepare for a surprise, plastic chairs and plastic plates, the food is perfectly acceptable but nothing special. Another good reason not to come back to Penang.Show less

Author: KennethC661Singapore, Singapore
Title: Unpretentious and Great value for money Malaysian food with an atmosphere
Review: Andrew purposely runs his family restaurant in an unpretentious manner to pass the savings on to his guests. This means Great value and high quality Malaysian and ASEAN signature dishes. We loved it and look forward to the next time and to becoming one of the many regulars :)Show less

Author: Ex-Slb-and-HappySt Leonards-on-Sea, United Kingdom
Title: Great Food and Wonderful Atmosphere despite it’s location
Review: The Food is great, many local and Asian dishes.I loved the fact that you can order half size dishes and have an assortment of flavours.We tried the sizzling chicken, Marmite Chicken and lemon chicken, all were fantastic.Great Bok Choy and fried rice and Noodles too.So depsite the fact that its on the third level of what looks like a shopping precinct overlooking the main road, this only adds to the atmosphere. Do not get put off by this.The waiter was a great help, suggesting dishes but not letting us over order, very friendly and making the visit more enjoyable.Total cost for two of us with drinks was under 90MYR. A bargain and I will be returning in a couple of days. Note they are closed Tuesdays.Show less

Author: Sharon J
Title: Great food.
Review: What can I say - Andrew never dissapoints. Food, service and price excellent.  Can only recommend if you're in Batu Ferringhi.

Author: KarenO493
Title: Great food
Review:
We went here one night and the food was amazing.
Andrew was the perfect host and was charming. 
I would recommend the samosas.

Author: wackijac1Patterson Lakes, Australia
Title: Some great flavours but mixed portion sizes
Review: The spring rolls were very large and extremely tasty. Mains arrived immediately after we finished spring rolls, a little disappoininting given it was late afternoon and only one other couple in the restaurant, so it was t like they needed the table or were about to close.The devil curry was th spiciest dish we have had all trip but the beef was a little chewy. The marmite chicken packed a punch. The real disappointment was the steamed rice. It was ridiculously tiny, about half the size of a usual single serve and double the price of most places. Never seen a serve of rice so small.Show less

Author: GaryH458Wokingham, United Kingdom
Title: Local Food at its best
Review: Well. We had read about this place on TA as we were staying in the area. We (3) then chanced upon it whilst visiting the night market. Yes it’s on the 3rd floor of a dodgy shopping unit and yes there are some scanky stairs to go up and yes the place is a bit jumbled up and yes it’s got plastic tables and chairs.If you go to a restaurant for service and deliciousness then you have come to the right place. The food was brilliant. Marmite chicken was the star out of 9 courses we tried. The spring rolls were amazing as was the. Squid, black pepper beef, pineapple rice and so on. Even the juices are amazing - huge glasses of freshly squeezed done to order. Service was quick and personal - AK is a joy to behold as he runs the front of house with gusto and made us laugh several times.And the price... one hundred ringo’s. All in. Unbelievable. Do not miss this place.Show less

Author: BobY646Brisbane, Australia
Title: Hidden Gem
Review: A little difficult to find as it is on the second floor accessible by elevator. The eating area is partly open and small but offers a good view and the tables are clean. The food is excellent and the service is good. Well worth a visit for local cuisine. Chandeliers are remarkable.Show less

Author: CarolTMartinEdithvale, Australia
Title: Fabulous
Review: After reading the reviews of this restaurant we went along for dinner and it’s fabulous. Across the road from the Golden sands hotel, easy walk and Andrew the owner was so obliging, his staff were lovely, meals were quick and delicious. 5 Stars even with the plastic chairs and cushions. Show less

Author: andrew_0494London, United Kingdom
Title: Lovely food staff and price !
Review: Very impressed with Andrews kampung. Greeted by the friendliest waiter who was extremely helpful with the menu and the whole service for the night! (I think he was the Andrew Kampung). We had many dishes in the half portion size all of them as tasty as each other and with 2 people more dishes in smaller size means you get to try more without getting too full up. Very impressed with this restaurant and it was extremely reasonably priced. Show less

Author: Mon888key
Title: Very tasty
Review: Food is lovely and service is good.  Andrew is a very bubbly host. Try the spring rolls. Not the easiest place to find - 2nd floor of Eden Parade - there is a lift to the left of the main escalator FYI.

Author: dadamdThames Ditton, United Kingdom
Title: Unbelievable!
Review: Feeling frustrated at the reviews on here saying that the food is average. In my opinion, the tastiest food I’ve eaten in Penang. Maybe people are used to eating sugary, junk Chinese or Asian food but here you can actually TASTE what you order. Black pepper beef with a real peppery kick, sizzling prawns with bean sprouts are a must. If you are ordering prawns Andrew will likely recommend this.. sweet and sour fish was fantastic after I was initially sceptical. Love the location, love the staff and love, love, love the food! The table behind us ordered what we had based on the smell... says it all! Cannot recommend enough. Make sure you order 3 - 4 half portions between 2 people so you can maximise what you try, you will not regret it! We’re going back next week! Show less

Author: chansaikeongKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Average Only
Review: I have been to Batu Ferringhi many times but yet to have a chance to try this restaurant. Due to many recommendations from Tripadvisor, I am eagerly to dine here. Finally, I made it on 20 October 2017 for having our dinner here. Below are my comments/experiences that divided into three themes namely restaurant location and environment, staff service and food quality and price. The restaurant is located in the 2nd floor of Eden Parade. If you still having no idea where is it, basically it is just opposite of Golden Sands Resort. It is a small eatery shop with unique decoration. Restaurant environment is cozy and clean. Staff services were good and fast. The owner, Andrew, was nice and friendly. Food serving time also fast which we waited for about 10 minutes only. Before discussing the food quality and price, let me list down what I had order for our dinner (for 2 adults and 3 children): char kuey teow, Chinese style fried rice, chicken satay, spring rolls, crispy squid and 3 drinks. All dishes except squid were a bit salty. As a Malaysian, I would rate the food quality as ordinary. We paid about RM75 for this dinner which I am considering a bit pricey.Show less

Author: AndrewnMegs
Title: Best meal in Batu Ferringhi
Review: We were delighted with the food at Andrew's, it's deserving of its #1 rating on TA. We had several meals here and could not fault the food or the service. Don't be put off by the location up the dinghy stairs.

Author: AMJ5Longparish, United Kingdom
Title: Doesn’t match up to the hype on TA
Review: Andrew is clearly the life and soul here. Running around all evening chasing up his staff with a pleasant smile. The food is OK and good value, but not exactly outstanding. The restaurant itself is on the 3rd floor of a shopping precinct with nothing special to shout about, and requires going up a pretty creepy staircase to access. Setting is concrete pillars, very stark and almost canteen like. Was expecting more from somewhere rated so highly on TA - we found better in the area with much nicer ambience.Show less

Author: Forfarloons63Forfar, United Kingdom
Title: Great Restaurant
Review: Loved this restaurant. Andrew himself is great fun and we had a good chat with him after the meal. Super food. Hubby always had the onion ring starter as he says they are the best he has ever had. Great food and cooked to your liking -" if you want spicy we do spicy"! Walked up 2 flights of stairs to get there the first time, didn't realise there was a lift until Andrew pointed it out. Alcohol beer or wine only. We found the meals great value for the price.Show less

Author: 412brittanyg
Title: Not sure what all the rave is abiut
Review: We recently had dinner at Andrews after it being recommended to us by people and reading reviews on trip advisor. Have to say it didn’t match up with the reviews left.... we ordered the crispy duck with pancakes as the waitress said it was their specialty, the duck was very dry and the pancakes seemed to be tortilla wraps instead of the traditional pancakes usually served with Peking duck. The rest of the dishes were okay but nothing spectacular. Show less

Author: Cherylleo
Title: Great food and very affordable!
Review: We went last weekend, and had a great meal there. The food and wine together were all very affordable. The duck, fried rice, butter prawns and squid were great! Wasn't something to shout about, but definitely a decent, value for money meal :-)

Author: tomkate
Title: Great restaurant
Review: Delicious and excellent place to eat at.  Very busy, friendly, excellent food and has a great ambience.  It was worth the effort to get here to eat.
