Author: SurinderrehalColnbrook, United Kingdom
Title: One of best meals in Batu Ferringhi
Review: Went here on last night on recommendation. Wish we had gone earlier.Andrew a great host will alter menu to your taste - our food was great. Venue has a good view - garden furniture but a big favourite amongst the locals which speaks volumes. You may have to ask someone where it is and how to get there. In the same building as Danish Briyani HouseShow less

Author: Lewis HHaverhill, United Kingdom
Title: Amazing food!
Review: We heard about this place from trip advisor and was actually talking to a couple from the uk on our way to the restaurant who said it was amazing and they were not wrong! Amazing food at amazing prices and what a lovely guy! Food tastes amazing, service was brilliant and we will definitely be going back before our trip has ended. Show less

Author: dghayfieldBanff, United Kingdom
Title: OMG
Review: Oh my god. What an amazing food experience , probably the best evening meal in our two trips to Penang. Seriously tasty food with a gentle kick of spice all well presented with excellent service. We booked but a few walk ins appeared who were lucky to get a table. Simply amazing food of the highest standard. Show less

Author: damienrobertanthonyhAbu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates
Title: Delicious food without a big price tag
Review: At there twice in two days with family. Lots of dishes to try. Crispy duck and squid were big hits with us. Also tried the curry and fried rice which were great. Enjoyed the fried ice cream as well. No frills here but delicious, fresh, inexpensive food. Really recommend!Show less

Author: Alex_jane93
Title: Fantastic
Review: Delicious food, cheap prices and a fantastic host. We went twice during our short trip because it was so good! You must try here when in Batu Ferringhi.

Author: catupoverMelbourne, Australia
Title: Delicious food and a hospitable host.
Review: We had a great variety of food here and the host was really helpful coming over to offer suggestions and explain the menu. You would probably miss it unless you knew what to look for as it's on the second level. Plenty of people had clearly found it though! Would thoroughly recommend this one. Show less

Author: Fi-W-Scotland
Title: Great food and friendly atmosphere
Review: Had a lovely meal and were made very welcome at Andrews.  Great selection of Chinese food with mains available in two sizes (full size around $20 (£4). Everything we ate was super tasty and we LOVED the deep fried ice cream.

Author: Michael WCardiff, United Kingdom
Title: Lovely food & hosts
Review: I would recommend this restaurant. The food and service was excellent, and the hosts very welcoming. To avoid disappointment, I would recommend booking a table, if you are eating in the evening. We have visited Batu for a couple of years, and always go back to eat here.Show less

Author: LoftusroadW12Doha, Qatar
Title: Very good!
Review: Followed the TA reviews, and we ate really well here. The host is a very friendly character and genuinely nice person; who is happy to go through the menu and give some recommendations.Service was prompt and also friendly, and the food we ordered was very good. The steamed fish (teo chow I think) being particularly flavourful. A prawn dish was a bit fo a let-down, mainly due to too few prawns. But the other dishes we ordered were very good.If ambience is crucial to you, then you might find the setting (in a shopping mall) not to your liking. But the food and service are good, and you'll eat well here.Show less

Author: tommouknewLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Amazing host and amazing food
Review: So what's with all the this is simple etc. Out of all our meals so far, this place does what it says but better. An amazing host Andrew is and guess what all the dishes come out at once rather than just one by one. Recommended are the spring rolls and the devil curry. Hats off great quick meal for us with no messing.Show less

Author: 639BarbaraM
Title: Great food
Review: Lovely person nothing too much trouble will try to accommodate for everyone’s taste food very good went there twice looking forward to going back

Author: wbick5Nelson, New Zealand
Title: Excellent food
Review: This restaurant was across the road from our hotel, I spotted it on Tripadvisor, we had the Crispy Duck, Squid, sates and greens, we were told to hold of with noddles- a good decision. The Crispy Duck would have been adequate on it own- the best tasting meaty duck I have had in along time serve Peking Duck style. reasonable price, helpful friendly staff.Show less

Author: ahky12
Title: A must visit!!! 😀
Review: One not to miss, excellent food, you cannot miss the duck, very friendly staff, quick service, we would highly recommend and would visit again. Great value.

Author: tiggeroneLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Amazing Find
Review: We were told about Andrews Kampung 2 years ago when we stayed at the Golden Sands. This is more or less opposite but across the road and up some steps. The food is cook fresh and is first class. Service is great the flavours are first class. Would highly recommend going here for a meal, price again very good.Show less

Author: DdkentCanberra, Australia
Title: Deserves the high rating
Review: We sought out Andrew's Kampung after reading reviews on Trip Advisor, and we were not disappointed. We ordered Pepper Prawns, Malaysian Curry chicken, Kampung fried rice and Crispy fried squid. The food was some of the best we had in our visit to Malaysia; tasty and spicy, with fresh ingredients. It was a bargain at the price charged.A very enjoyable meal, and we would highly recommend this restaurant.Show less

Author: LoreleiYorkshireLeeds, United Kingdom
Title: Super tasty food with a fabulous host!
Review: Stumbled on this restaurant by complete chance one evening. It is on the top floor of a shopping center and everywhere seemed quite deserted when we visited, however Andrews Kampung was very busy and we soon found out why.Andrew himself was a very charming host and advised us on certain dishes on the menu. The food itself was DELICIOUS we had the ho sin duck and pancakes and shared some fried ice cream (you must try it!).Having visited Penang many times, we will be certain to come here again! Great value too, no complaints!Show less

Author: Helen175Bendigo, Australia
Title: The place to eat!
Review: This little restaurant is a delight both for the excellent food and the friendliness of Andrew and his staff. Food is delicious, service good and a great atmosphere. The restaurant is on the second floor. You can use stairs or the lift. The restaurant opens out onto the balcony where you can catch the balmy evening breezes while you eat.Show less

Author: 765cazcAnsiao, Portugal
Title: Love it! Love it! Love it!
Review: From the moment we arrived we were made to feel very welcome. We went on our first day here and as we were tired and not too hungry we had crispy duck and then deep friend ice cream. The crispy duck was the best I have had outside Hong Kong/china and the ice cream was to die for! The second time we went we had the duck, sizzling prawns, Thai green curry and of course the icecream. We are planning to eat there again before we leave as we love it! Andrew is amazing it is worth going here just to meet him!Show less

Author: major_riotBristol, United Kingdom
Title: Little Gem of Penang
Review: Warm and Friendly staff who go out of there way to ensure you are looked after. Penang is all about the food and Andrew's Kampung is one of its best ambassadors . My wife loves spicy food and went for the Devilled King Prawns and she was not disappointed. I had the Malaysian curry and was awesome. We also had the special fried rice which had some chillies in it and fried anchovies; which I was a bit dubious about but it really worked. All washed down with some King Tiger beers excellent. We will definitely be back.Show less

Author: Linde L
Title: Amazing!
Review: Just perfect. The food is so good, the staff is so nice! You should really try the deep fried ice cream as desert! Delicious!

Author: karren p
Title: Absolutely fabulous
Review: If you are looking for a great place to eat, fabulous atmosphere and entertaining staff this is the place for you. We visited on a few occasions Andrews kampung during our trip to Penang and we highly recommend this place for dinner. We really enjoyed the duck, satay and oh my goodness the fried icecream is amazing. Thanks Andrew, we look forward to seeing you on our next trip to Penang ☺️Show less

Author: 239signek
Title: Love it!
Review: Very good food and service 😄 it's really a hidden treasure here in penang. The people working here is amazing and kind, really taking care of their guests!

Author: malcolm FEurope
Title: Understandably popular
Review: Easy to find if you look at the signs high on the west side of a block which is sited 150m east of the main road !!! There are good views over the 'locale', a pleasant breeze from the balcony, service is efficient and Andrew is delightful ! Prices are (by western standards) very modest and the food above average for this type of restaurant (don't however expect the Malay equivalent of haute cuisine). If you are in BF its the best value place to eatShow less

Author: EdCook24
Title: Authentic with amusing, energetic staff
Review: Had a great meal at Andrew's Kampung, fantastic food with generous portions.  The staff are very amusing and obviously make it their mission to ensure everyone has a good time.

Author: JinWeiS
Title: Overrated
Review: Service was excellent, but that's about it. Every single dish is overrated and slightly overpriced. The lightning was decent, but the atmosphere was bad compared to the lightning.

Author: hannajomeansMalaysia
Title: Great service and food
Review: Andrew and his staff make you feel incredibly welcome and took the time to discuss dishes with us, explaining things we had questions about. The food was good. I give a 4 instead of 5, as I'd prefer the cashew chicken to have more than 5cashews thrown on as garnish. With that said, I will definitely go back. It's going to be a local favorite for sure. Show less

Author: N4703CArichardcSandhurst, United Kingdom
Title: Perfection!
Review: Visited here with my family this evening. I'm thankful that we chose to eat there today whilst we still have 6 days of our holiday left....why? Because it means we can go again.....twice at least!Andrew is the perfect host- polite, helpful and knowledgable. The food.....quite simply to die for!Not the best of surroundings maybe.....but this is Penang! Fed my whole family of four including a second helping of one of the dishes,sprites for the kids a 3 large bottles of Tiger for my wife and I to share all for the princely sum of £41The best crytics are my young kids who are very food fussy - they wolfed it down (the second portion mentioned above was for them!!). I must also add, one of my daughters has a severe nut allergy (an issue in Malaysia!!) but Andrew was very happy to help and advise the dishes that would be ok for her. I would urge you to visit - you will not be disappointed. Show less

Author: Sara69Surrey, England
Title: Amazing!
Review: What a brilliant find!Firstly, Andrew and everyone else who works at this restaurant are amazing. Truly lovely people!The food is beautiful and such good value. We loved the atmosphere and was always made to feel totally welcome.By far our favourite restaurant during our holiday!Show less

Author: Caitlin241Chester, United Kingdom
Title: Best food in Penang
Review: A perfect spot for authentic Malaysian food outside of your hotel. Broad menu with vegetarian options so likely to find something for everyone. Service is fast and excellent, I highly recommend the Thai green curry and deep fried ice cream! Ignore the shady looking flights of stairs up to it, amazing value for money.Show less

Author: gilly482017
Title: A night out
Review: Good local food and service. If you want a meal outside your hotel this is it. Would go again if we return to Penang.

Author: Jon_SuzyParkside, Australia
Title: Best Food in Batu Ferrungi
Review: I recently visited Penang and stayed at The Golden Sands Hotel, having been to this area before I wanted to go back and eat at Andrews Kampung.So if you are new to the area in can be a little hard to find but well with it.Directions.Opposite McDonalds facing the side street is the Eden Ferrungi building at the front there is a KFC go in the entrance to the main building keeping KFC on your right to the left there is an elevator and signage to take u to the second floor to the restaurant.The food is simply amazing a mix of Chinese,Malaysia, Thai and a few Indian dishes.I love the Devilled Chicken is quite spicy and I also love the Fish done Cantonese style.I don't know anyone who finds there way here to be disappointed I know many people that when on holiday come night after night and try different things.Andrew offers main course for around MR 20 AUD $7 Fried Rice etc is just a fraction of the main course price.There is a great selection of Beers and Wines they have some nice wine but any foreign wine is expensive, one glass of wine can more than your food bill, simply because of the import tax.You get a great view from the balcony overlooking the Bay and the activities in the night market.A guaranteed food and dining experience.JohnShow less

Author: 803AliP
Title: Great service and view!
Review: So friendly and welcoming. Amazing local dishes, satays for the kids and great spring rolls.  Penang curry was well spiced, local fried rice was delicious. Highlight was salt and pepper squid, best we found! All topped off with deep fried ice cream!

Author: 877tranhHo Chi Minh City, Vietnam
Title: The best in town, Superb,
Review: I came here with my mom and my kid of 4 and we all love the food, its taste and service from Andrew. I can say my mom is not easy eating, but she was so pleased with Andrew's place. The 1/2 portion offer also helped to try different dishes. Strongly recommend and definitely love to go back to AK times to times if back to Batu Ferringhi.Show less

Author: Allan KCarlisle, United Kingdom
Title: Friendly service good food
Review: Been to this restaurant several times over the years on our visit to Penang,Andrew and staff give excellent service ,and the food is also excellent,we always have the all you can eat buffet as we dine with friends so we order several different dishes so we can share, Show less

Author: b0rne0b0undPerth, Australia
Title: Great service
Review: We decided to eat here after hearing so many great reviews... also it was right over the road from the hotel where we were staying. We were tripped up on our first attempt as it is closed on Tuesdays. When we did manage to get in, it seemed as though we were lucky to get a table as it was packed. The service was excellent - Andrew even suggested he do us half serves so we could try more dishes. It seems really popular with tourists. I thought the food was pretty disappointing though - don't bother with the satay or the malaysian chicken curry. The attentive service made up for it, but we didn't bother coming again as there was better food to be had elsewhere.Show less

Author: Angelo442014
Title: Fantastic food and service
Review: Andrew and his aunties looked after as very well.  The food was of good quality and tasty.  Service was quick.

Author: 6784_dog
Title: Popular for good reason but pricey comparatively
Review: Seeing all the great reviews, we thought we better have dinner there. Tip 1 - reserve during peak times, we went for an early dinner and struggled to get a table (it's popular)The menu is wide and we had the satay, beef rendang and the kids also ordered some garlic bread - lovely and attentive service and the food was very good as well.The only downside is that the prices are very much tourist pricing with dishes between 2x -3x what would be charged in a local place.That said, it's still good value compared to most western restaurants, with good service and a family friendly menu.Show less

Author: sujatav2015Hong Kong
Title: Friendly, reasonable prices & nice atmosphere
Review: The service was warm and very friendly.We visited at lunch time. The food was good: the Nonya fish stood out for us, but everything was nice. What I liked best was the setting -- the restaurant is tiny but has this balcony running around two sides. We were seated near the corner with two fans keeping us cool, and nice views along Batu Feringghi Road. The decor is not fancy at all but interesting -- our 5-year old got inspiration for his perennial "upcycling" projects from the chandeliers made out of used plastic bottles and the roses made of old magazine pages.Show less

Author: Debs01462Bedford, United Kingdom
Title: Fun evening
Review: After reading reviews on trip advisor we tried this restaurant and as others have said ignore the location and entrance! We were greeted by Andrew on both occasions and he is a very personable, fun character and so are all the lovely staff that work with him. We have been twice now and everything we have had has been delicious and available in 1/2 or full sized portions which is great if you like a selection of dishes. Good value, great fun and always busy!Show less

Author: Eric G
Title: Good but not memorable
Review: Tried the chicken satay (which came fried), the crispy squid bites with chili sauce and the beef curry with jasmine rice. Inexpensive but not especially memorable. Outdoor seating, and there is a nice breeze along the railing.

Author: Danielle FSydney, Australia
Title: Seriously amazing food
Review: The food here is incredible. Everything we ordered was delicious. My friend who lived in Malaysia for 6 years said they were the best butter prawns she's ever had! We also had fried rice, sizzling beef, lemon chicken and fried noodles. All were amazing and some of the best food we've eaten in Malaysia. The service and friendliness of staff was great too. It's a bit pricey compared to other restaurants but absolutely worth it. Don't let the wall of photos of white people put you off! It is incredible food and definitely worth a visit. Show less

Author: JanegradwellPreston, United Kingdom
Title: Great food, great value, great staff. Loved it here!
Review: Don't be put off by the 'rough and ready' appearance from the outside, or the inside for that matter. This was by far the best dining ecperience of our 6 day trip. If I could, I'd go back again tomorrow but it's closed on Tuesday's. We were greeted by Andrew who is outgoing, charming and very charismatic, all his staff are friendly too. The food was absolutely delicious. and the service was amazingly prompt. I loved the ambiance; think street food but with five stars. Excellent value. You must eat here, it's fabulous!Show less

Author: jilpet
Title: Beautiful dinner
Review: Taxied from Hard Rock Hotel to Andrew's for RM10. Greeted by Andrew himself and seated shortly after. A huge menu to select from but we chose Homemade Spring Rolls for starters followed by Deep-fried Spicy Squid, Sizzling Beef, Shischuen Chicken, Bok Choy, Fried Noodles (vermicelli) and rice - all half portions. Including a large Tiger beer and a glass of wine, the bill was RM99. Service was excellent, staff were friendly and Andrew constantly checked that all was well. Intend to get back there in the next four days to try other dishes before we leave.Show less

Author: Jan M
Title: Great value
Review: Great restaurant, upstairs across from Golden Sands.  Always busy, tourists & locals. Excellent Asian food at a good,price

Author: Michael L
Title: VERY FRIENDLY, EXCELLENT FOOD
Review: Do not be put off by the access?...situation, stairs, aspect etc. This is a real find. Great OPPORTUNITY TO experiment with the half portions. NOT TO BE MISSED

Author: Janet JUlladulla, Australia
Title: Wonderful!
Review: We enjoyed our meal at Andrew's Kampung very much. It is situated in a shopping mall (top floor) with a lift (that we discovered after the walk up the stairs). The staff are lovely especially Andrew who spent time talking to us and made the evening even more enjoyable. The food is delicious especially the duck pancakes!. We hope to enjoy it all again some day!Show less

Author: Terry TBracknell, United Kingdom
Title: Got to go there
Review: What a super place to eat the food is to die for, try anything on the menu and you will not be disappointed. The staff are all so friendly and helpful it gets very busy so get there early or you may have to wait for a table well worth it though. We only found this place towards the end of our holiday but we still ate there 3 times and plan to go back next year.Show less

Author: TheHobo7
Title: Amazing food and service
Review:
Some of the best food i've had, amazing service. Absolutely loved it, can't wait to go back. 

Chicken curry was incredible. Andrew was a great host. 

Prices are so cheap for such great food.

Author: dels123Midsomer Norton, United Kingdom
Title: Amazing food!
Review: Restaurant located on the 2nd floor of a block of flats , follow the signs but so glad we came here food was lovely me and my friend were spoilt for choice so order 2 half portions of dishes each and had a little mix and match and they were all great! Bet sweet and sour chicken i have had so far! Realisable priced :) Show less

Author: amybX1871HFMelbourne, Australia
Title: A - MAZING!!!!
Review: Admittedly wasn't easy to find at first... but if youlook up to the second floor of the building on the junction opposite the Golden Sands Hotel you will find it. There is a lift around the corner by KFC if you don't fancy the stairs!! Andrew and his staff are warm, welcoming, very friendly and very efficient. The food is honestly on another level (the duck particularly I loved) but the sizzle plates too were pretty special and even the mixed veggies were lovely. When the bill came we couldn't believe such great food, in a lovely little setting (we sat on the balcony able to watch the world go by) was so so reasonable!!! Honestly Andrews really is worth a visit, we will be going back there before our holiday finishes 100%!!! A little hidden gem.Show less

Author: robertfrancislFaulconbridge
Title: Great value family owned restuarant
Review: This is our second visit to this value for money family owned restaurant. Great food and plenty of it. Chilli crab is fantastic but you will have to ring before hand so they can get it at the fish market. Very pleasant and happy staff who are eager to talk. The wall is covered in photos of many happy and smiling people who have obviously enjoyed their meal at this simple eatery.Show less

Author: Never_om
Title: Pleasantly surprised.
Review:
Ignore the decoration and state of the building on the way up- once your seated and ordered your food, you will be surprised by the quality and value of the food.
Very tasty food, run by a great character who entertains you throughput the evening.

Author: terimakasih50
Title: Great restaurant
Review:
Food fantastic especially the squid.
Book or get thereEARLY!!!!!
There is an elevator nearby....stairs are a killer
Very good value for money

Author: TandL-BristolBristol, United Kingdom
Title: Great value for money
Review: My family and I had dinner once at Andrews Kampung whilst on holiday in Penang. We all loved the food, which was very reasonably priced. Service was good and whilst it wasn’t the most glamorous of surroundings, I’d definitely recommend this place and we’d go back if we were in Batu Ferrenghi again.Show less

Author: DrLincoln
Title: Great deep fried ice cream!
Review: Nice chill out place! Interesting decor all from recycled material. Local homestyle cooking is pretty good. Highlight was the deep fried ice cream - one of the best i have ever had!

Author: peteb561
Title: Don't let location put you off
Review: What a find. Restaurants in the area are struggling because they are reducing quality and upping price. Andrews is good on all counts Value for money excellent quality of food outstanding I'm sure location stops some people from visiting. If this is you you are missing something Duck good Infact all dishes were very good fresh with good flavours. Takes credit cards ( and doesn't try any Ringitt Pound silly games which is going on around in other restaurants ) A pleasure to eat there and Andrew is paranoid about the whole experience Don't miss it Show less

Author: Hogl89
Title: Yummy
Review:
We would never have found this restaurant if it wasn't for TripAdvisor. It is placed on 2 or 3 floor, so unless you know you just don't drop by. 
The menu is not huge, but the food is tasty.

Author: 826trishcSydney, Australia
Title: Good service
Review: Andrews kampung was a little hard to find there's a lift so you don't have to climb up three storeys & worth it the food was good & the service was great. Very attentive & friendly staff & they were happy to answer any questions about the food including dietary restrictions without any problems. Good value for money. Show less

Author: sampaul2017Cambridge, United Kingdom
Title: Fabulous
Review: Doesn't look the nicest of places from the outside, but it certainly is well worth a visit.Andrew is super friendly, and very honest in advising you about the half portions, which is plenty if you've had a starter. My husband didn't like spring rolls, that is until he tasted Andrew's, they are so tasty. We went back a second time, so we could have more, and the fried ice cream is a must, sorry we didn't discover it on the first visit.Andrew had taken his staff away for a few days , otherwise we'd of gone a couple more times.Fab food, great host and terrific value.Five stars *****Show less

Author: Q6074FEdavidfShenzhen, China
Title: Worth the trip out here
Review: We live in China and eat a lot of Chinese food already, so we had been reluctant to eat much Chinese food in Malaysia, but decided to make an exception here and throw in a few Chinese dishes along with other dishes...and we didn't regret it! Ordered Kang Kong, Satay, Tom Yum Soup, Nyona Fish, Malaysian Beef Curry, Char Koay Teow, and Kampung Fried Rice, for two people, so all half servings of course. Everything was delicious but the real standouts were the Beef Curry and the Tom Yum Soup (Malay and Thai, respectively). Flavors were bursting out of those dishes, heat level was excellent, just really well executed. Fried Ice Cream for dessert was perfect... exactly what was needed Obviously the environment isn't the Ritz, but it is what it is, and that's not going to even come close to knocking this place off of the 5 star level it deserves. Show less

Author: Glennyfer
Title: Fab
Review: Brilliant service and exceptional food. We chose duck and pancake, spring rolls , chicken satay, lemon chicken, beef with spicy Thai flavour , sweet and sour chicken and fried rice. Can honestly say perfection and great value

Author: Trevor MStourbridge, United Kingdom
Title: Good food, great host.
Review: Used this restaurant on several occasions and found the food to be reasonably priced and very good.Service was be excellent and Andrew, the host, was fun.I particularly enjoyed the house speciality of Nyonya Fish along with the Kampung Special fried rice. Half portions of most dishes were available so one is able to mix and match from the menu. Show less

Author: kfwrigleyLiverpool, United Kingdom
Title: Exceptional food again.
Review: We have visited Andrews Kampung dozens of times and it never disappoints.Andrew and all of his staff make you feel so welcome, the food as always is delicious and we must have tried all the dishes there and everyone seems better than the last.Looking forward to our next visit there again later on this week.Show less

Author: blidge
Title: Friendly and nice food
Review: Andrew's is a lovely little place and service with a smile so no wonder I went there. On the 2nd floor as you travel up to the night market from the shangri-la on the left. You'll see the banar up above. Fast cheap food with a warm greeting. You must go. Show less

Author: SineadB123
Title: Amazing !
Review: Best meal in Malaysia, 🇲🇾. The crispy duck pancakes, lemon chicken and fried ice cream 10/10. C an not wait to go back tomorrow for more!

Author: P8123OUcarolines
Title: Lovely time at Andrew's Kampung, Batu Ferringhi
Review: Great food, lovely people.   Andrew actually stopped us from over ordering and in such a lovely way.  He is a great host and his staff are awesome.

Author: Tina D
Title: Last nites visit
Review:
A hidden gem .fantastic food,lovely people reasonable price .Egg fried rice fab no peas/ pieces of ham .. you must eat here ! Close on Tuesday xx
Andrew and team lovely .

Author: Rachelle R
Title: A great night out
Review: Excellent dinner but remember to go upstairs where the lift is not the stairs. They are located on the side front side not the main road side.

Author: Jia H
Title: Out of expectations
Review: I am a Malaysian. I live in Penang and I've been there to taste the food too.But actually you can get crispy duck at particular place in Penang.You can actually ask local residents too.I'm sure they are willing to help too.Besides that, I think its not worth to spend your money there.You can get the food with the same name but more delicious food at a lower price.I think the portion is small too.Show less

Author: nick m
Title: Great place to eat and drink!
Review:
Very good meal. 
My partner is vegetarian and was well catered for! 
Sizzling beef was delicious.

Well worth a visit

Author: kimmyblidge
Title: Good food great hospitality
Review: Went here upon recommendation on TA. Didn't disappoint, food was flavoursome and service with a smile. Priced very well. Would not hesitate to come back again.

Author: paul HGold Coast, Australia
Title: A Local Gem
Review: We went here after talking to the staff at the resort we were staying at.Did not disappoint. Great food at a very reasonable price. Excellent service and staff. Andrew makes you feel so welcome. Make sure you try the fried ice cream it is very tasty.Show less

Author: 997XavierB
Title: You need to go
Review:
When you ender..you immediately feel that you are more than a customer...you feel more like a guest. 
The staff is extremely welcoming...the food is great and it is not expensive.

We had the duck...it was perfect

Their deep fried ice cream is a must

Author: Axi13Nashik, India
Title: Good Food & Awesome Fried Ice Cream
Review: The high point of our visit was definitely the owner. Cheerful, happy and always present, he brought great energy to the place. The location is average and don't expect a fancy air conditioned restaurant. Overall, the food was good. I especially appreciate their efforts in customising food to suit our children and vegetarian taste preferences. I tried the butter prawns, fried rice, chicken satay and noodles too. All the dishes were good.The best part of the meal was definitely the fried ice cream. It is truly unique and tasty. We tried the cappuccino & chocolate flavour, but the best was the mix of 4 flavours in one flavour. I would recommend visiting this place at least once if you are in the vicinity. Show less

Author: marionandmike
Title: slightly quirky, great place
Review: Andrews is on the second floor, so not too obvious at first, but usually very busy. The owner is terrific, great fun. Staff very attentive. Food is Chinese, great prices and great quality. Not a posh restaurant, but a really good night out

Author: gemmacV1003KZLeamington Spa, United Kingdom
Title: Amazing food, Amazing people
Review: Found the restaurant through trip advisor so thought I would add to the reviews.The restaurant is on second flood (there is a lift) of a shopping centre opposite Golden Sands hotel. Easy to spot from ground :)When we arrived...having taken the stairs...we were greeted by a very friendly enthusiastic Andrew. All the staff here are very happy to help and we got recommendations from Andrew about the curry's (the Malaysian curry which I decided on was nicely spicy).The spring rolls were amazing as was all the food. Overall very glad we ventured up the stairs.... (remember about the lift).Thanks Show less

Author: the-g-rant-travelNoosaville, Australia
Title: Magnificent Maitre'D & Great Dishes
Review: Local duck (substantial serve) and squid, a great choice. Worth the climb to experience some authentic local food, prepared with pride. Service is beyond expectations, although it's quiet now, Andrew and crew are attentive and courteous. Whatever you order, take Andrews advice, he's a great character and knows his dishes!This place is a ray of hope and enlightenment on this strip, well above the ordinary if you are looking for real Chinese and not the "mixed" offerings all too common around here. Not fancy but clean and honest.Easy to see why Andrew's has been in business here for so long with such quality food at reasonable prices.Show less

Author: AlastairN_11Melbourne, Australia
Title: Entertaining and good local restaurant
Review: If you like a down to earth local restaurant with good food, an entertaining owner/chef and a delightful family feel, this is the place for you . There are no frills but staff are warm and friendly. Wine selection is red or white. Prices are very reasonable and there is a great choice. You can sit outside on the balcony, which we preferred or inside as you wish. It is a short walk from the main hotels such as the Shangri- La Rasa Sayang in a pretty cruddy building but do not be put off. We had the duck and Kang Kong the first night, chicken marmite, squid and a vegetable dish the second and all were goodShow less

Author: Putz80Sydney, Australia
Title: Definitely eat here. Leave space for the fried ice cream!
Review: We decided to try Andrew's Kampung after reading all the great reviews on trip advisor. The restaurant was not far from our hotel and was definitely well worth a visit. Andrew is a great host and helps you through the menu. We had the spring rolls which were huge and delicious! We then tried the specials including lemon chicken, marmite chicken and sizzling beef. We really enjoyed everything that we ordered. The meals aren't huge so you can order a few things which we really liked. The beers were cheap and our whole meal come to approx $30 Aus which was incredibly good value. There was a large group of expats dinning while we were there who are obviously regulars. We could definitely understand why. Did I mention the deep fried ice cream?? Wow, I have never had anything like it before. Three types of ice cream between fried bread with caramel sauce! I would like to go back to Penang just for Andrews fried ice cream! We'd definitely recommend having a meal here. Some of the reviews said the venue was bad. Id just say it's 'authentic' but don't let that put you off. Show less

Author: Mark DPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: A "Funky" Family owned restaurant on the second floor.
Review: ANDREW is a "genuine character" who always makes his guests feel most welcome. He and his family really want to make you feel glad that you are giving them a chance to startle and delight their guests. The diverse food offerings are great, as is the level of service-- and one can order as much as one's appetite will allow.Show less

Author: Wolf_Pack_SGNHo Chi Minh City, Vietnam
Title: Rather delightful!
Review: I grew up in a chinese restaurant in Australia and Andrew's Kampung takes me back to my childhood. The food here was absolutely delicious! Regretfully, the food was not overly photogenic but every mouthful was certainly glorious. My favourite thing about the menu (and really it's rather ingenious) is that for most of the meals, they offer a 1/2 portion. What this meant was that the two of dining could order more dishes (at 1/2 portions) and have more of a variety for dinner! The waitstaff ask if you would like your meals brought out in one go if you've ordered appetisers which we opted for and once the food arrived carrying its aroma to our table, I was in Chinese food heaven. The KaiLan was cooked to absolute perfection. I love meat and can't do without it but could literally sit and eat a while large plate of the Kai Lan (also known as Gai Lan) on its own. Then came the fried ice cream. My word. It was an interesting version from the ones I used to roll in my childhood, but in terms of flavour, it certainly did its job to take me back. There's no airconditioning (which is the only bad thing I can say about this place) but definitely worth a visit for the food. I really enjoyed our meal at Andrew's Kampung and will certainly be returning the next time I find myself in Penang. Show less

Author: Ray dMelbourne, Australia
Title: Don be put off by looks
Review: In my opinion this is one of the best Asian restaurants I and my wife have been to. Yes the surroundings are not 5 star and you could easily be put off as there are better looking restaurants on the strip. However you will not get a selection of fresher food than here.Andrew the owner is a personality in his own right and one of the few that advises you not to over order.Our first visit saw us order the duck and believe me it was possible the best we have ever had and certainly could not have eaten another thing after it as Andrew had advised.We returned again and ordered the lemon chicken, rice and vegetables and all of these were to die for. Also good inexpensive wines.Loved the plastic bottle lights and the view out over the balcony.If your in Batu Ferringhi you would do yourself a disservice by not eating here.Show less

Author: Caroline PLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Very Popular
Review: Everyone from our hotel across the road seemed to radiate towards this restaurant in the evenings! Fortunately, we were taken there by fellow guests at our hotel as I don't think we'd have found it otherwise, as it's not that easy to find! However, when we arrived it was pretty full, so people obviously made a point of finding it, probably because of its excellent reputation.The food was very good indeed & very good value for money, as were the beers - i.e. not extortionately over-priced like in the hotels. There were no frills about this restaurant - plastic tables & chairs & minimal decoration - but the food more than made up for that.Show less

Author: oedipus98Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Surprise, surprise, surprise
Review: Located in a dinghy building, we climbed up the stairs as we cannot find any lifts. 2nd floor means it is located on the 3rd floor of the building as there is a ground floor, first floor and then second floor. Clear direction on the location of the restaurant. Services is friendly and the food varies from local and western. I like the fact that they have half portion and one portion selection. For lunch, it is a limited choice of menu. Found the lift which is located inside the building right at the corner. Closed on tuesday but other than that open daily from 11am to 10pm. We loved the fried rice and even my fussy mother commended that the food is quite nice even though we did a take away which can reduced the taste dramatically. Will go back there and recommend to others.Show less

Author: Elaine J
Title: Make sure you look up so you don't miss this
Review: Glad we searched trip advisor or we definitely would have missed this. Not the most romantic of settings but the hike up the stairs is worth it when you finally get your meal. Great idea to do half portions so you can try lots of things. Deep fried ice cream is delicious Show less

Author: JasonNathanLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Tasty and friendly
Review: We ate here twice during our visit. On both occasions, service was friendly and speedy.Food was almost universally excellent - Chinese and local dishes executed perfectly with a depth of flavours missing from other restaurants of its price range.Seating was basic-ish on the balcony of a sad shopping mall, but the owners had made some efforts to cheer it up.Lastly, all food was available in 1/2 portions which meant browsing the menu was interesting. Prices - came to 90 Ringit for 2 adults and a child to really fill up with no alcohol.Show less

Author: TheYumL
Title: Andrew's Kampung
Review: The food here is absolutely delicious! So much so that we went back twice in two days. The prices are very reasonable too. The only reason I rate it 3 instead of 4 is that I'm sure they use MSG in the recipes. Both my husband and I had headaches and very dry mouths after eating here both times.Show less

Author: mrkieronSt Helens, United Kingdom
Title: Try Andrew's first
Review: I felt like I was having the experience I wanted. Proper Asian and Malay dishes, cooked the way I wanted to try them. The local ingredients fused together. Great really great. There was a nod to the British love of Chinese cuisine as well. Crispy duck! Just like we get it at home. Pancakes the lot. The stars of the show without a doubt are the fish curry dishes. Andrew was very interesting and informative and gave us the help we need with some of the dishes. Perched up on the second floor of an old mall it's not easy to see from ground level especially if you aren't told it's up there! There's no air con so you won't need your full metal jacket. The place has the South East Asia feel about it. The balmy night, the noise of the traffic and people below. You feel like your in a movie. But which one ? Show less

Author: gemsfromnzChristchurch, New Zealand
Title: Cheap & Delicious!
Review: If you want a delicious feed but you don't want to pay through the nose you must try Andrew's Kampung for lunch or dinner! We thoroughly enjoyed ourselves and the food. Especially the marmite chicken and deep fried icecream. The service was exceptional and the restaurant has a great atmosphere. Show less

Author: AlexL84Southampton, United Kingdom
Title: Quirky
Review: We visited this restaurant on the strength of reviews on Trip Advisor. I can add nothing that's not already been said .Warm welcome and service from Andrew and team.Excellent food for comparatively small cost.We did say how did we end up in a rundown retail block for an evening out, but I think the quirkiness adds to the experience.Give It a go ,you won't be disappointedShow less

Author: Niamh BDublin, Ireland
Title: Amazing in every way
Review: Don't be turned off by the staircase because once you get to the top the experience is fabulous. Andrew is there on hand to guide you through your meal. We didn't order enough food and ordered more and we should have went with his suggestions the first time. The sizzling chicken and chicken satay is to die for. We asked for no chilly and there was no problem at all. We'll be back again! Show less

Author: Collin BSydney, Australia
Title: Quite good
Review: This restaurant is on the 2nd floor of a big complex. It was across the road from our hotel. I would definitely say that the quality of the food was really very good. They had half serves, which meant that although we were only two people, we could try a few different dishes. The food itself was very good so I would recommend going here. Andrew is super camp in a fun old style way (think Julian and Sandy), put on a good show, and he was very attentive to his straight customers. Go there for the food. Good value for money.Show less

Author: C2668EDjenniferrWilmslow, United Kingdom
Title: Hard to find but good food and Andrew is great 'front of house'
Review: They are very attentive and accommodating. It looks clean and the food is very tasty and the red wine quite drinkable surprisingly. I have never seen someone take orders from tables of 10 and 12 so quickly and efficiently as he anticipates fairly successfully what everyone wants to eat and drink. On the other hand he will spend time talking to you to determine your likes and dislikes and suggest dishes too. It feels much cleaner and safer than eating in many of the other local Malaysian restaurants nearby even through you have to walk through a grotty shopping mall to get to it.Show less

Author: Bodinlondon
Title: Wonderful - wish we had found it earlier!
Review: As other reviewers have said you won't stumble across this restaurant but it isn't that hard to find and it was definitely worth going to! Once we found it we visited for our last 3 nights in Penang. I went with my parents, my husband and super fussy 6 year old. I am vegan but the rest of them aren't. The first night it was so busy we ended up in the air con room which was pleasant enough but not as nice as the main area. Andrew's dad took our order the first night and there was a bit of confusion about the noodles and I ended up with egg on my noodles. Andrew sorted it out straight away and really understood what vegan means. The second and third nights I just asked him for something vegan and I had an amazing curry one night and sizzling veg the second night. My parents/husband tried the sweet and sour fish, lemon chicken, squid, salt and pepper chicken, crispy duck and it was all delicious. We had the 1/2 portions which were plenty for us and we often ordered and extra dish to try. The first night we ordered chicken chop for the super fussy 6 year old but the following night andrew suggested chicken nuggets (not on the menu) but very much appreciated! The fresh juices were really nice too. Service was great and I definitely wish we had found it earlier. Show less

Author: clive36london
Title: Fantastic food but it is Andrew and his staff that make it great!
Review: Spent 12 days in Batu Ferringhi and eat 4 times at Andrew's, together with most of the guests of the Shangri La Rasa Sayang over the road. One of the best Chinese meals we have ever had. Shredded duck is a must and his Marmite Chicken is to die for! As is the Malaysian Beef Curry (mmm spicy!). However, it is Andrew's warm welcome and effusive personality together with his wonderful staff that makes this place a joy to go to! We were having difficulty confirming our flight going to Singapore, and when Andrew heard of it, he got out his i pad and did his best to confirm it online for us, eventually calling the airline. This, incidentally, was in a packed restaurant! So thank you Andrew for an unforgettable experience!Show less

Author: UK_SPLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Great local food and service
Review: Small place in an odd location was a bit difficult to find but lovely. All staff were lovely and Andrew himself is so attentive to all patrons. Simple local food, worth checking out! Atmosphere and restaurant itself is average but Andrew and the food make this place. Also, just to mention the dishes were altered to be child size for our young two kids, this was really nice avoids food waste.Show less

Author: 901BobRhondda Cynon Taf, United Kingdom
Title: More than deserves its no1.
Review: The food was the best in batu ferringhi, you could get half or full portions.Andrew was a great host, looked after all his customers, food was the tastiest and it was a pleasure to eat there twice in the 8 days i spent on holiday.Try get a tasty meal for just over 1 british pound for half portion or just over 2 british pounds for full portion anywhere else. Beautiful food and deserves his no1 rating. Do visit here at least once if youre in batu ferringhi.Show less

Author: 523jennys
Title: Does not deserve its rating
Review: This place does not deserve its number 1 rating. Food was pretty average and overpriced for what you got.

Author: GinnyLovesFood
Title: Simple deco great food
Review: Nice dining experience here with Andrew, the nyonya fish was delicious as well as the black pepper beef. Saw tourists dining in as well as expats. Despite the fact that it's located on the 2nd floor, the good food doesn't deter the crowd

Author: Drivers22Poole, United Kingdom
Title: Andrew makes this place a must to visit.
Review: This is a must visit restaurant when in Batu Ferringhi. The food is spot on chinese cuisine with many local dishes done very well. Andrew is the owner and manager and makes this place tick. He is such a big personality and makes each visit special.Show less

Author: Jeanne2222
Title: Fav black pepper beef!
Review: Went to the Andrew's after finding out from TA. Been recommended to try out their black pepper beef when i asked for a beef dish. VOILA! The beef was so tender in the inside and juicy with the gravy. Though initially I didnt expected much from Andrew's after seeing the foreigner cooking in the kitchen through the open window, but after tasting it I would definitely recommend the black pepper beef. Also, for the beef lovers, don't forget to try out beef at Beach Cafe too, as I had one of the most delicious beef meals there too. Good job to the Andrew's and Beach Cafe. Perfect everytime!Show less

Author: Mickeysnoopy
Title: Quick and tasty.
Review: Food was good especially the spring rolls which were well filled and not too crispy. The best I have tasted.

Author: Eyes08London, United Kingdom
Title: Delicious Food at a great price
Review: We dinned at Andrews a few times and on each occasion we tried different food which was totally amazing. It's a family run business and the service is first class. Just tell them the kind of food you like and they will recommend something for you. The food is at great prices and Andrew is such a very bubbly character.Show less

Author: BeePeeCeeNorthampton, United Kingdom
Title: Tasty
Review: Group of four went purely on the strength of TripAdvisor reviews. Push on through the smell of urine on the stairs and it will be worth it. Good variety of local food and the highlight was sizzling beef. Tip - if you go for a whole fish dish, opt for steamed. Fried is a bit underwhelming. Show less

Author: Dave W
Title: Food is excellent
Review: Do go!  the food is excellent . The prices are very good. Andrew advises you on portion sizes so you don't over spend. Satay lovely , duck  even better . Will definitely go back

Author: wiggy1011Guildford, United Kingdom
Title: Fantastic place to eat
Review: We came to Andrews with out booking and he made us very welcome and sorted a table out for us. You can get half portions ( these are ample enough for one). the food was fantastic and very cheap.Andrew is very attentive to all his guests and is constantly on the go.I would highly recommend you visit this place if your staying in Batu Ferringhi.Show less

Author: joanp927
Title: Number 1
Review: Andrews is a fantastic place to eat, this year he has condensed the menu however, food and service still excellent. Looking forward to returning next year. Thank you for getting me  Cider.

Author: BullishBear169
Title: A celebration to remember
Review: Had a family birthday celebration of size more than 10. Restaurant was very accommodating to set aside the necessary tables for us, given the size. Food was pretty nice. You can read a lot from other TA contributions so i shall not comment more. Decor is nothing to shout about. Was a bit challeging in placing our orders for the huge group as the portions are made for individuals. We ended up having to re-order again and again. Nothing to complain just challenging. Staff was very friendly and we do not have to wait too long for our food. Appears to be a restaurant frequented by tourists only as we do not see any locals there (other than the staff). The bill came up to more than Rm 500. Perhaps we ordered too much or we were too hungry. It was our first meal in Penang Ferringhi. Thereafter, we had several other meals at different parts of Penang and nothing came close to the same amount again.Overall, it was a nice experience in Andrew's Kampung. Yes, i will be back again if the group is much smaller and I happen to be in Ferringhi area. Enjoy ya!Show less

Author: Catherinelimlh
Title: Uniquely Kampung
Review: Excellent non pretentious friendly down to earth service. Pleasant kampung atmosphere. Andrew recommended steamed fish & crabs as the catch were so fresh! Also had kampung free range chicken & their signature dishes: fried calamari & fried ice-cream! Thanks for a wonderfully kampung dining experience!

Author: Mark DPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: This "non buffet, buffet" is absolutely great!!!!
Review: The concept of this family owned and operated restaurant is that you can have whatever you want-- & as much as you want.... BUT a. each dish is ordered and freshly prepared and b. served to your table! This is the very best of a buffet as well as a full service restaurant!Show less

Author: David GNewcastle upon Tyne, United Kingdom
Title: What they said!
Review: I'm just repeating what's been said before, but this is great place to eat, nay, a MUST place to eat. The half portions are a great idea, my wife generally doesn't like spicy food, but loved 2 out of 3 of the dishes we tried. Superb quality, superb service, worth going just to witness Andrews banter with the customers!Show less

Author: DEBBIE P
Title: Amazing service and food
Review: We went early and we're lucky to get a table. So glad we did, Andrew is the best host, friendly and fun. The food was delicious, option of half size portions allow you to try more dishes, everything we had was stunning. So far the best food in Batu Ferringhi so understand why it's number 1. Leave room for the deep fried ice cream if you can, it's yummy! The atmosphere is lively but not loud with everyone obviously happy to be enjoying such good food. Loved the lamp shades made from recycled bottles and wall of photos. A great team of friendly ladies serve the food while Andrew ensures everyone it greeted and looked after. Highly recommend.Show less

Author: linandmikeg
Title: An enjoyable evening.
Review: We were recommended Andrew's by a number of people so gave it a try. It is not an extensive menu but the food is very well prepared and a good quality. Andrew himself is quite a character and a very good host.

Author: Watts599
Title: Average Food
Review: Variety of menu is not bad. But taste of food in not in expectation. Anyway it's still a nice place to dine in.

Author: tmglovetravel
Title: best "local food" of the trip
Review: very friendly restaurant run by Andrew and his family, lovely relaxed atmosphere, food very good would recommend this restaurant to anybody. good idea to book as gets very busy. has good wine available and can also bring your own!

Author: mini_breaks_10Dublin
Title: Gorgeous food
Review: We were staying the the Shangrai-La Rasa across the road from Andrews and all of the guests kept saying that we had to visit! We arrived and had a table on the outside. The menu has a huge amount of choice and the food was delicious!! It was so good that we went back the next night!Show less

Author: A380ManchesterUKManchester UK
Title: Excellent food and atmosphere
Review: Best booking or you may struggle to get in. Very conveniently situated near the Rasa Saya where we were staying and directly opposite the Golden Sands hotel. We visited solely on TA recommendations, as being No 1 in Batu restaurant listings.Unlikely that you will accidentally walk past this place and see it, as the restaurant is on the 2nd floor of a block of shops/restaurants. Very clearly signposted if you look up though.Depending on how you enter, the way in may at first be a little off putting. Our way was via a solid concrete stairwell, past a laundry and down a outside balcony!As many reviews state the restaurant is quite small and there is nothing fancy about the tables, chairs and table settings. The food and Andrews personality wins this place over. Its not expensive, but there are much cheaper places it must be said within walking distance. As with most restaurants in Batu (and probably Penang), all close on one day a week. Tuesday being Andrews day.Crispy duck/pancakes can be recommended. Also try his deep fried ice cream special. Got a table without a booking on our first visit (last one) although a few more did become available later. Booked for our second visit. Worth noting that Andrew's does take credit cards - something that given food prices most of the smaller restaurants do not.Clearly a lot of regulars go here, from the banter overheard. Interesting light fittings made from plastic bottles!.Deserves its high ranking for food, atmosphere and Andrew himself. .Show less

Author: Y7819TAsarahm
Title: Great service from the man himself
Review: Slightly pricier than some of the cheaper places in Battu Ferringu but excellent service from Andrew and his team. Mainly Chinese food on the menu which was all very tasty. Malaysian options also available. We did have to ask where it was but we're glad we did and would definitely return. Show less

Author: VMEZ
Title: Great food and excellent service!!
Review: The food was excellent, highly reccommend and if the guy that we assumed was Andrew was actually Andrew then what a great bloke he was, if everyone was like him what a better world we would live in, the staff couldn't do enough for you.

Author: rachelbournerMickleton, United Kingdom
Title: What a feast!
Review: After being recommended to eat here by our taxi driver today, we chanced our luck and went without booking, they were full up but we were seated in the air-con room out the back. Unusual surroundings but Andrew was a wonderful host and the food was incredible. Can highly recommend the spring rolls, chicken satay and crispy squid. Lovely meal. Show less

Author: Jason KCambridge, United Kingdom
Title: Can see why it's number 1!
Review: After seeing that this place is number 1 on TripAdvisor and only 50m from our hotel, thought it would be rude not to see what the fuss was about. The location/building itself is not fantastic on the eye, and I had to persuade my wife half way up the stairs that this place is very good. Andrew, as most reviews comment is friendly, flamboyant and with great customer service. The food was exceptional. We shared the duck starter and there would have been enough for 3 of us let alone 2. Both our mains were lovely complimented with half portion of rice and noodles which was more than enough for us both. All in all, a fantastic meal with drinks for about £20! Show less

Author: trodd
Title: If you can't find it - keep looking!
Review:
The parade this restaurant is located in doesn't look great. The escalators weren't working but we just followed some other people! The place was packed but they squeezed us in.

Excellent service and food.

This place deserves to be well known.

Author: Mark ABarnt Green, United Kingdom
Title: Great service, great food and great value for money
Review: Andrews Kampong is situated on the second floor of an insalubrious shopping centre but the food and service more than make up for the setting. Andrew, the flamboyant owner is an absolute delight and he goes out of his way to make sure all your needs are met. The food is sublime and the option of ordering half portions allows you to make the most of the varied menu. The sizzling beef is a must and the marmite chicken definitely worth a try. We ordered more than two could eat and spent around £30 which included four large beers - great VFM!This place gets busy and we had a 30 minute wait for a table on our first visit. Lesson learnt and we booked ahead for two more visits during our 11 night stay. There is a lift to the second floor if you use the entrance by KFC.Show less

Author: lambornecourtChester, United Kingdom
Title: Great food, make sure you book
Review: We stayed at the Shangr-la Rasa Sayang and the manager Nick told us about Andrew's, we had also read some reviews on trip advisor. Great, authentic food, really reasonably priced, make sure you booked! We didn't the first time and we still able to get a table but we saw lots of people being turned away due to there being no space.Duck for start which was gorgeous and then we had 2 full portions of different currys, really good. Can see why they offer half portions so you can try more dishes.Really reasonably priced and staff were friendly and attentive.Show less

Author: NicholasMing
Title: Nice Place.
Review: I went there with my girlfriend. We have tried out their foods, tasty. Definitely will be back. The boss also friendly.

Author: Sue P
Title: Very enjoyable visit
Review: Have been to food stalls for 2 nights so decided to check out Andrews. Managed to get a table but booking is advisable. Staff very friendly and helpful, food good although definitely geared to westerners. Would recommend to anyone visiting area for first time but think on whole we prefer the hustle and bustles of stalls and it is cheaper.Show less

Author: HLS12872
Title: Great food at reasonable price
Review: Had a great meal here last night. Fantastic local dishes. The deep fried ice cream is a must try! Highly recommend.

Author: glynisbriddonRotherham, United Kingdom
Title: Authentic local food away from the street traffic
Review: We ate here twice and found the food very tasty. Many mains on the menu come in full or half portions which is a great way to try different dishes and also handy if you fill up on his crispy duck to start! (not to be missed). Andrew works so hard to keep an eye on all the tables and is the perfect host, stopping for a chat especially with his many repeat customers. Just look up opposite the Golden Sands hotel and you will see his sign on a small apartment block. No traffic noise here and a nice breeze. Recommend booking but if you do have to wait he has an air conditioned waiting room.Show less

Author: AussieBecsMelbourne
Title: Nice views and some good food
Review: We visited Andrew's Kampung on our last day in Penang and I was looking forward to getting here, having read the reviews. We were staying at the Hard Rock Hotel, so it was a little bit of a walk for the kids, but eventually got here.I liked the location - nice views and it kinda felt....homey. I liked seeing the satays being made in the corner.The food was good, nice service and good pricing...not sure if its any better than the Living Room Cafe, but still nice.Recommended.Show less

Author: dordognemarkBeaumont-du-Perigord, France
Title: Always enjoyable, deserved number 1
Review: There are many lengthy reviews extolling the virtues of Andrews Kampung, and deservedly so, excellent food freshly prepared, and smiling service. Ok, so the setting is a bit odd and you sit on plastic chairs, but for the pennies that you pay for superb quality food, what more do you actually need? Love it, and will come back again and again Show less

Author: B6389YEianhBrighton and Hove, United Kingdom
Title: Quirky
Review: Don't be put off by the location on the 2nd floor of the complex and it's in on the main road , or the stairs. When you arrive up at the restaurant you get a warm welcome and Andrew is quite a lovely character. Food was great and decent value , you should give this a try during your visit. Show less

Author: jackw53London, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent or Poor?
Review: Okay this is the Million Dollar Question "Is the new Andrews better than the Old"? Having known Andrew for many years and his present establishment almost since it began I have to be honest and say NO - it is NOT better it is MUCH better! Still retaining the Kampong feel Andrew has updated his tables and interior decoration so the place looks much better and he has brought back into use the interior dining room for those who feel sitting in the balcony area is not for them or it is too hot. However people don't just come here for the décor - they come because the host and his staff are so welcoming as well as the menu which caters for all tastes. I think in my time I have not had a bad dish and recently as the photographs show our selection of chicken, prawns, spring rolls and samosas were not only delicious but also did not cost the earth. I think the mark of a good local eatery is somewhere the local go to and Andrews is just that. Yes access can be a little daunting for those visiting for the first time but not only is there a lift there is also an underground car park which if you are wheel chair bound could be used to access the lift and the floor where the restaurant is located - just ask and I am sure the locals who frequent the foyer of the building will be only too pleased to direct you.Show less

Author: CaseyHantsDublin, Ireland
Title: Don't be put off by the stairs
Review: We read the reviews and thought we'd give it a go, we climbed the stairs and almost turned round but when you actually get to Andrews it's a really nice environment, the food is good, Andrew really works hard to make sure your ok as do the rest of his team and we enjoyed our visit a lot.Show less

Author: Alemap2005Truro, United Kingdom
Title: Well worth a visit
Review: Don't be put off by the fact this place is on the second floor of a rather run down shopping centre. When we visited the place was full. The meal was excellent and Andrew was the perfect host. Make sure you pay a visit you will not be dissapointed.Show less

Author: EuroTraveller52London, United Kingdom
Title: Great not too spicy sauces, friendly service, clean
Review: We really enjoyed the food on Andrew's wind-blown terrace, despite a too gentle-tasting tilapia in his Nonya Fish. Frankly I could have licked the platters clean of the sophisticated sauces in a beef Curry Kapitan and a Nonya Fish. We were of divided opinion on the Spring Rolls, and the Crispy Fried Squid was, as usual, pretty tasteless. Pleased I phoned before and we went early (18:00) because by the time we left at 19:30 it was totally packed. And because it is hard to find (up the lift of the building housing Kentucky Fried Chicken to the 2nd floor). Show less

Author: casey l
Title: Dinner
Review: after we ordered what Andrew suggested all westerners were start coming in, most with reservation. BTW, there isn't sign of "all you can eat," I guess it is no longer offered. Please correct.This place has certainly better food, ambience, less expensive than where we went yesterday in well known western end place.For price, it should $$, instead of $.Show less

Author: BrettM2066
Title: Underwhelmed,over priced
Review: As a budget traveller I reward myself with a "nice"meal each week. The reviews are fantastic-but for me reality quite different. I had to wait for a table,when seated(on plastic chairs!) Ordered from the menu-prawns and wine. My glass arrived 1/4 full! I ran a bar previously,it wasn't a standard pour(@rm20!)My prawns arrived-nearly smallest I've ever seen(steroids definate needed) @rm40! Both wine and serve size definate on the small side. When finished I fancied icecream that I had noticed on the menu,my table was cleared and no mention of dessert. As McDonald's is across the carpark decided that was a better option rm3.50 yummmm, no plastic chairs- get with it!! Very disappointedShow less

Author: DJN55United Kingdom
Title: David Neale
Review: Went to Andrews last night with my wife and daughter, the food as usual was very good served hot and with a smile.Drinks like the food are reasonably priced and ice cold.Andrew likes to be the star of the show and minces for table to table and is very attentive.Beware of the DEVIL Curries they are very very HOT !!!EnjoyDNShow less

Author: charliethecriticCrimond, United Kingdom
Title: Nice meal
Review: We tried this restaurant due to its place on TA. The food was good but is in my opinion just a step above the night market traders at Long Beach with the costs slightly higher. We found the place thanks to a review on TA as it is very difficult to spot as it is on a high level, accessed by a flight of stairs. When you find them it is well signposted from there. We were lucky to get a table quickly but were near the kitchen and a lot of shouting was taking place. Andrew served us and kept us right with the menu and we opted for half portions of the chicken and beef Malaysian curry. The portion size was perfect for us with fried rice. The food was good, the beef was excellent and we have booked to return. Cost was 60rg which included a large beer.Show less

Author: PeterFiftyLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Enjoy it for what it is and you will have a great time.
Review: We have been visiting Penang for a number of years and last evening was our 10th visit to Andrew's Kampung.It's always interesting to read the negative reviews on Trip Advisor first and, in doing so, I hope that this review is balanced and informative as is the purpose of them. Kampung's is a simple restaurant that offers a wide variety of Malay and SE Asia dishes cooked to order. It is No 1 on Trip Advisor for Batu Ferringhi as it has a very loyal following, is inexpensive, has a good reputation.....it's also a bit of a naughty pleasure for the majority of it's patrons staying in the four and five star hotels across the road! Located on the 3rd floor of a rather outdated shopping centre (there is a lift in the middle if you follow the signs), don't go expecting fine linens and silverware, this is in essence hawkers food but with the convenience of (albeit plastic) tables, chairs and plates (but stainless steel cutlery).The food is cooked to order and, in all of our visits, has been packed with flavour. Yes, you sometimes have to wait a while, but have a beer or wine and a chat with the owner and before you know it you will be enjoying your food. One previous review said it is expensive, I think he/she must be on a different planet! Last night we enjoyed two starters, two mains, rice, noddles, Tiger beers and water and the total bill came to 50 Ringitt pp (just over 10.50 Euros) - that would not even buy you a meal at MacDonalds. If you don't mind a bit of heat (as you are essentially sitting outside but with overhead fans), are happy to wait a little time for your dishes (we waited no more than 15 mins from ordering) and can rough it a bit, you will enjoy your time here immensely. If by contrast this sets the dining scene from hell for you, best to find somewhere else.Show less

Author: GEORGE1953Aberdeen, United Kingdom
Title: Great host and great food
Review: As previous visitors over the years, this is one place we always visit. nothing fancy about it and surroundings but the food is brilliant and not expensive. Andrew his self is just brilliant and makes you so welcome, also his staff are very nice.His Malaysian curry is lovely.also his sizzling beef is to die for.About 3 years ago he took a picture of us and to our surprise we saw it on his wall this year.Show less

Author: SkpevansNottingham, United Kingdom
Title: Andrews Kampung food heaven
Review: Andrews front of house is special , but it wouldn't work without the food - again the food excels - salt and pepper chicken and sizzling prawns to die for .The mix of sweet and sour and the char from the griddle prawns so difficult to put into words - you have to taste for yourselves - keep up the good work and see you soon Andrew on our anniversary on the 8th FebShow less

Author: Marc H
Title: Andrews, Andrews....So good we ate there thrice!
Review: If you want somewhere that looks nice and inviting from the outside, then this isn't for you. If you want a high dining silver service experience, then this isn't for you. If you want somewhere that serves great food at a great price with a welcoming atmosphere, then this is definitely for you.Andrew, his aunty, in fact all the staff are welcoming and genuinely friendly. If you're lucky Andrew will take a photograph of you and you will end up on his 'wall of fame' (my description). Like any good restaurant, their menu is not extensive, but just enough to give you a tantalizing choice and I would advise you to talk to Andrew or his staff about whats on the menu. Our particular favourite was Marmite chicken, which Andrew recomended.All the main dishes come in either half or full portions. We tended to go for half portions so we could try lots of different things on the menu. As for desserts, you can't do better than the deep fried ice cream. If I had one criticism it would be......actually who am I kidding, There is nothing to criticise. Our family loved eating there and when we visit Penang again, Andrews will be number one on our list of restaurants to eat in.Show less

Author: Natalie S
Title: Lovely, quick food
Review:
Excellent food, good service.
Really enjoyed having lunch here whilst staying in a hotel across the road.

Author: John H
Title: i have known andrew for years
Review: Andrew has had various buildings all over batu ferringhi from one end to the other and had to move on due to other people buying the sites.. where ever he has been his food has always been good and served in a very nice way. i have been many times with lots of people and again we have always enjoyed it. not been to this new place yet, if i go back next year i will go and see him.Show less

Author: annavO5277GFHeydon, United Kingdom
Title: Fantastic find
Review: We were recommended and were not disappointed Andrew himself is a great character and the food fantastic value and really well cookedA bit of a climb but there is a lift at the back if you can't manage the stairs We had his special local Penang dishes and they were streaks ahead of other really expensive places nearbyWould go again and again Show less

Author: LeParayre
Title: Delicious and friendly
Review: Didn't book but put us in a reserved table. Quick very welcoming service and Andrew is a blast. Wonderful local dishes. Had ones that were asterisked as house specialty. Not disappointed. Left full and satisfied and booked a return.

Author: AlexisShanghaiShanghai
Title: Great food and service
Review: A great little place. Plain and simple decor that fits with the authentic, tasty food at very affordable prices. A good selection of food and flavours. You'll need to book to get an outside table (reasonable view of the sunset). Service with a smile. Visited by people from everywhere and from all walks of life. Show less

Author: T7311IXlisamAdelaide, Australia
Title: We must have been unlucky!!!
Review: After reading reviews on here this was on our list of must visit places. On our third night in Batu Ferringhi we grabbed a table here for dinner for 3. We could not be seated outside as we hadn't booked but we were just happy to get a table and were looking forward to some amazing food!Andrew came in and we said hi and tried to chat a little, we knew it was a busy night but were not expecting to be fobbed off and ignored. He was trying to sort something with the aircon and thought he would answer our hello and general greeting when he was done....no, he just walked off.We gave our drinks order which came quickly and ordered our food. We sat and watched other six tables in the room fill up while we ate our first course. The spring rolls were ok as was the satay. We then sat and watched everyone else get their food orders in, their food arrive, some even got to eat their food and leave while we sat there waiting.It seems we were not alone as the table next to us managed to eat their entire meal before their drink order arrived even though they repeatedly asked for it.Our main food eventually turned up just as we were about to leave, with no apologies for it taking so long. One meal was wrong so we called back the lady who had taken our ordered and explained it wasn't what we had ordered - she took away the food with no apology and we were left waiting again for food to arrive. We had ordered a couple of different dishes to try so we ate what we had, while waiting for the correct food to arrive and then realised we still had another dish missing.Eventually the corrected meal arrived and was put down on the table and she just walked away without a word. The sizzling chicken I ordered was still nowhere to be seen so we pretty much gave up on even getting it, the fried rice we had been served was completely inedible and gluggy. Just as we were finishing up the food we had (and could eat) my sizzling chicken arrived which just tasted like chicken in bad gravy. Hardly any flavour at all and most also got left.We were extremely disappointed with our food, the night before in long beach had been much tastier and a fraction of the cost! It had taken nearly an hour for any food to arrive and the whole time we just got to listen to people screaming out to each other from the front and the kitchen which isn't the lively ambiance we had read about.It was complete chaos trying to find out how we could pay as all we wanted to do by now was leave. This took over 20 minutes just to pay!All I can think is we must have headed to Andrews on an off night but one thing is for sure - when we return to penang in December we won't be heading back here. A few people at the hotel we stayed at commented that he had expanded since their last visit and they thought it had gone down a little - maybe a victim of their own success and should have kept that smaller, more personal space with good customer service? Felt more like a loud, brash fast food joint than somewhere you could relax and enjoy your food.Would not recommend, sorryShow less

Author: KatyJ956London
Title: Excellent local restaurant
Review: Reviewed as the number 1 restaurant in Batu Ferringhi...I can see why! Andrews Kampung could be missed if you don't know where to look for it. Don't be put off by the location, a run down building with a mixture of businesses and housing.A small restaurant with no more than 15 tables, Andrews Kampung is a hidden gem.We ordered chicken satay, spring rolls, Malaysian chicken curry, sweet and sour chicken and steamed rice. The food all arrived fairly quickly and it was piping hot. Delicious, authentic, Malaysian cuisine. The Malaysian curry was HOT...apparently this was a medium heat for a Malaysian curry, they said we should have orders the Kapitan curry as it is not as spicy! Dessert was deep fried ice cream, a selection of ice cream flavours to choose from, we went with cappuccino and vanilla...wow! One serving is enough for 2 people to share. The staff were really welcoming and friendly. For excellent local cuisine and to eat knowing you are supporting a local business, Andrews Kampung should be high on your list of places to eat. Show less

Author: PercyHair
Title: Very basic.... but a brilliant restaurant!
Review: Great find.... you may be scared when you start walking up the broken escalators. But the food is great and the service is super friendly. You will have fun for sure.

Author: Denise D
Title: Legend!!
Review: Andrew is brilliant!! Really funny and entertaining. The food is delicious and very reasonably priced.

Author: Jim-Grogga
Title: Andrew is a champion
Review: Don't be discouraged by the exterior and effort required to get to the second floor. Service and food is worth the effort.  Andrew is a great host and the food was delicious. BYO option. We will be back! Thank you to Andrew and his team.

Author: johnlim74
Title: Superb Food and Service!!
Review: There are varieties of dishes with local Penang taste of nyonya cook. Owner was very friendly and price were reasonable. A place must go when visit Batu Feringghi.

Author: David MMelbourne, Australia
Title: Great find - you should try!
Review: Across the road from the Golden Sands and up 2 flights of stairs you will find a very popular and fabulous place to eat for very cheap prices. The same food in Australia would cost quadruple the amount, but for the quality and delicacy of flavours I'd be happy to still to pay at Aussie prices! Despite the large number of (often repeat) customers, the host, Andrew, takes his time with you to ensure your selections are explained and to your liking. He'll even check for allergies issues (as was the case for my crustacean allergy) and suggest appropriate dishes.
