The service is prompt and the food has finely balanced and complex flavours, using clearly fresh ingredients. Highly recommended if you don't mind the rustic decor and two flights of stairs!Show less

Author: Kay G
Title: Delightful Experience
Review: Our family enjoyed a sampling of dishes from the menu and enjoyed each and every thing we tried. The deep fried ice cream was excellent. We had to wait for a table - but once we were seated service was incredibly quick.

Author: Andrew MSingapore
Title: Wonderful food, ridiculously cheap, great host
Review: Entry to Andrew's Kampung seems more than a little dodgy, with a climb up two flights of stairs in a somewhat run down building. Believe me, the journey is worth it. Three of us ate here two nights in a row, and both nights, the food was as wonderfully flavoursome as the host, Andrew, was engaging. Andrew knows his food well, even to the point that he could advise us on dishes containing traces of prawns (one of us has an allergy). The local dishes are definitely the ones to try - Nyonya Fish, Malaysian Curry Chicken and Sizzling Beef. The dishes were bursting with flavour, and the ingredients were clearly moist and fresh.For all of this, three dishes and rice, with bottled water cost 66 MYR (about AUD$7 per head). Eating here two consecutive nights also proved the point that the good food the first night was not out of the ordinary.The restaurant is quirky in its decor,, and the 2nd floor gives good views. Sit near towards the outside if you want the view and a lovely breeze. Find it directly opposite Golden Sands Resort.Try it - you'll enjoy the food and the host.Show less

Author: Valerie Y
Title: Dinner
Review: Extremely busy the night we went.Had to wait a long time to be served and needed to remind the staff several times in order to get what we had ordered.We were seated indoors, this room is very primitive with egg carton shells as wall decoration and no door on bathroom which cuts your appetite when eating. They were so dirty that our daughter went back to our hotel to use the bathroom.Food was okay but we expected much more considering the TA ratings and reviews.Show less

Author: Lynn LWhitley, United Kingdom
Title: Such fun and excellent food
Review: This was in a building so steps to climb to 3rd floor . As this is popular would suggest you book and ask for a table indoors . The whole experience was fun and the food was excellent , with a good menu . Enjoy ! Show less

Author: yayyay1951
Title: Thank you Tripadviser
Review: We would never have known about this excellent restaurant had it not been for the reviews on Trip adviser. Excellent food, served by Andrew in a pleasant setting - good prices too.

Author: 623SteveD623Adelaide, Australia
Title: Great food. Great value.
Review: Andrew's Kampung Restaurant is without any doubt one of my favorite restaurants in Battu Ferringhi. The food is outstanding, service matches the standard of the food and the friendliness of the staff is sensational, The range of dishes always leads to a dilemma of making a choice. Whatever I chose was better than I expected, and the value for money is suprisingly good. I highly recommend this restaurant to anyone visiting Battu Ferringhi. Show less

Author: travelmood008
Title: Great food & entertainment
Review:
We had dinner in Andrew's last night - the food was excellent and Andrew was a very entertaining host - the restaurant was very busy so you need to book.
A no nonsense wine list red or white on offer.

Author: david jFalkirk, United Kingdom
Title: Hidden Gem
Review: Please do not be put off by the location of this restaurant the service and food is fantastic. It is situated directly across from The Golden Sands Resort Shangri La,where we are staying. If it hadn't been for the Trip Advisor reviews we would have probably not even noticed it !!We were dining with friend of ours from Penang who had never heard of the restaurant either. We had Crispy Duck,Spring Rolls,Malaysian Curry,Sizzling Beef and Lemon Chicken and it was all fantastic. My friend has told us he is going to bring his family back there soon so a local thumbs up also Andrew himself appears a very charismatic individual and a bit odd but funny at the same time and can't do enough for you. PSMake sure you book in advance as a number of guests were turned away last night as it was so busy. Show less

Author: 680carlosaGeneva, Switzerland
Title: Extraordinary...
Review: Quite possible the best food we had in Penang... and we visited several of the top 10 rated restaurants in the Island... the food was amazing but way the restaurant is managed, they really make you feel at home. We had lunch and came back for dinner. Truly a gem to visit.Show less

Author: Tom1873Scotland
Title: Very nice
Review: After reading some of the reviews we were not sure what to expect ?? Once we found Andrews which is just across the road from the Shangri-la Golden Sands we thought well this is different for us !!! We went for the spring rolls followed by the sweet and sour chicken which was a treat !!! Andrew himself is a colourful character who doesn't stop. We actually went back again as we really enjoyed it !!Show less

Author: Catjlyn
Title: Brilliant entertainment
Review:
The food at Andrews is on par with a lot of restaurants in the area however with the added entertainment from Andrew it makes the meal very enjoyable
You must book in advance to avoid disappointment this is a very popular restaurant

Author: balihi65Perth, Australia
Title: Great Food
Review: We ate here on our last night. The food and service was great and I liked the fact that you could get a half serve of dishes. The fried ice cream was to die for.You should really have a meal here it was cheap and the food excellent.Show less

Author: boyle2015
Title: Fab place
Review: Food & service really great. Try the Malayasian beef curry. The best !!!! Good service. Very popular place to eat in Penang.

Author: Nanyangview
Title: Great Place for a causal meal
Review: Good place for a causal meal. Nice food, Excellent service and friendly staff.Good value. We ordered Indonesian fish and spring rolls, etc. All were very good.

Author: no2plumbing
Title: Superb food
Review: Best Chinese/Asian food ever .crispy duck is to die for . Food is the best we had in long time .good for family's.

Author: Y9126DBkimr
Title: Excellent food and service
Review: Fantastic and great value meal with a very welcoming host. Environment was basic but friendly. Andrew personally attended to us and provided a great eating experience.  Thoroughly recommend a visit to this establishment.

Author: ceftriaxonAalborg, Denmark
Title: Nice little place
Review: Went here because of tripadvisor reviews and it's surprisingly good. Had the Nyonya fish (great), plum chicken (sweet and good for kids) and the devils curry. Andrew warned us about it - very spicy - but we tried it anyway. We should have listened. Nice taste but very spicy. Service is good. Show less

Author: Piotr K
Title: I'll be back
Review:
Great food, great service. Greetings to the Owner. Recommendation: curry, duck, fish.
Ask for fried bananas, not in the menu

Author: Wayne SPerth, Australia
Title: Enjoyable visit
Review: When we were in Georgetown a local girl suggested visiting this place when we moved over to Batu Ferringhi. Walked in without a reservation and they made us welcome and found us a nice table. Food and service were both great. We enjoyed our meals and would recommend a visit.Show less

Author: claragarrood
Title: best restaurant in penang - andrew is a absolute star
Review: only a short walk from our hotel the Shangri-la Rasa Sayang, the building looks a little sketchy and the restaurant isn't a white tablecloth kind of place but the atmosphere is so cheerful due to Andrew's always positive and amusing attitude. the food is so cheap and delicious - definitely try the lemon chicken. we ate there so many times on our stay that there's a picture of us up on his wall! try your hardest to have a meal here, it's a hundred percent worth it!Show less

Author: datin_tan
Title: A place for foreigner
Review:
The food is nice, but the food portion is much smaller then most restaurants. Price is higher (approx 10-20%) if compare to others.

A typical restaurant for foreigner.

Author: sushsf2016Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good food but lacks ambience
Review: Food is good especially the green curry. However prices are on the higher side n more suitable for western tourist .A long way to drive if you are staying in Georgetown , more suited for those in Batu Ferringi. Can be noisy especially when there are families with young kids. Also please put on insect repellent to prevent mosquitoes bites. But service is fast n good .Show less

Author: Johary M
Title: A must dining!
Review:
Walking up the stairs was so not 5 star, restaurant itself, looks so normal. But the food was awesome, we loved the spring rolls, kampung fried rice as well as the sambal belacan and butter prawn. 
Really good food and would definitely come again.

Author: AustraliaBeachbelleSydney, Australia
Title: Great food and Andrew was very entertaining!
Review: A bit dubious about going here as it is upstairs in an uninspiring building but had met some people who said it was fantastic so we gave it a go! And we were right to do so. Lots of fantastic dishes - such choice and everything was delicious. Andrew works the room like no-one else! Wine was very good value too which is important in Malaysia!Show less

Author: paoloescobar2019
Title: Excellent Chinese good
Review: Andrew is a great host and the food is really excellent and great value for money. Must try the deep fried ice cream. 😋

Author: Jane831
Title: Delicious
Review: Went here after recommendation and it didn't disappoint! Bit difficult to find but worth it. Approach not very appealing but bear with it. Food amazing and service spot on great value for money

Author: James GMaybole, United Kingdom
Title: THE BEST VALUE IN BATU-FERRINGI
Review: This is a very popular restaurant not only with tourists but locals also, Andrew who runs and owns the restaurant is the star of the place, ALL the food is top notch and you will be spoiled for choice, my favourite is chicken Kampung for starters followed by his famous lemon chicken, bet you make a booking when you are there for another eveningShow less

Author: fudge456Congleton, United Kingdom
Title: Fab food and so friendly
Review: Food was well plentiful tasty prompt and serviced with a smile had the home made huge spring rolls to start very chunky and hot. Next we had small portion of sweet and sour chickenMalaysia beef curry meat tender and fried rice to finish had a very light battered banana fritter icecream and cream what a fab meal really wonderful staff will be backShow less

Author: E3904GUlindacFeltham, United Kingdom
Title: EXCELLENT RESTAURANT
Review: Andrew's was recommended by friends so we went Saturday night and the food was brilliant. I had the Malaysian Chicken Curry which was spicy but very tasty and my partner had Sizzling Chicken and we shared a Kampung Rice. Portions were good and Andrew was very friendly and helped us chose. Quite a few tables were reserved so he is always busy. Can highly recommend this as prices only slightly higher than the Hawker Stalls. Show less

Author: Saim7Preston, United Kingdom
Title: Good Food
Review: Good food and Quick service which is exactly what we wanted for lunch. Could use a bit of renovating though as its quite old plastic. Price was a slightly higher than we expected for a cafe. Andrew was not present when we went so missed his service as mentioned in the other reviews.Show less

Author: naiyanghappyNai Yang, Thailand
Title: don't think about it just GO
Review: This restaurant just gets better and better. I have followed Andrew from one situe to the other and before l left Penang some five years ago he had just moved to where he is now. It is a bit difficult to find its not fine dining by any means but the place ooozes character the same as Andrew does. Having decided on a long weekend from Thailand, my first stop was Andrews the food is even better than l remembered it. Go for the all you can eat buffet menu. Spring rolls are home made and out of this world as is the chicken salt and pepper and dim sum as starters. There are other choices for the starters. Main course, the sizzling beef a must, lemon fish, chicken ginger everything is cooked fresh to order. He has also started to serve a very nice Australian white wine...so splash out and enjoy a bottle with the meal. This place is a must.Show less

Author: Jayne' R
Title: Yummy
Review: Excellent food and service. We came as a group of 10 and called 30 minutes ahead to reserve a seat. Reasonable prices for the food.

Author: Sally BSpalding, United Kingdom
Title: Great food and Great company
Review: The food here was lovely, the host Andrew so friendly and welcoming. Where possible you need to book. Duck was excellent, we visited a couple of times and were not dissappointed. Do not forget to try the delicous deep fried Ice Cream! Look around at the basic decor etc and see how imaginative Andrew is. He, his sister and brother could not make you feel more welcome.Show less

Author: Jenny958Bromley, United Kingdom
Title: Fantastic Food Great Atmosphere
Review: Andrews is always busy. We were advised to book. Glad we did. The food was amazing. We went a couple of times. I have never had spring rolls that tasted so yummy. They were awesome. Andrew is a larger than life character who makes the whole experience so enjoyableShow less

Author: 713shirleyl
Title: Nice food and good service
Review: Nice food with reasonable price and good service. As the restaurant is relatively small as run by family it is advisable to make your reservation earlier.

Author: angelor960
Title: Excellent
Review:
The food is so good that it makes up for the fact that it was a bit basic in terms of seating and general furnishings.

Go and visit its superb in terms of quality of food, quality of service and value for money!

Author: Jan Willem t
Title: Excellent lunch and dinner restaurant
Review: We arrived early evening around 19.00 hrs., later there is always the risk that this restaurant is fully occupied by locals and tourists, the place is very popular and deserves its popularity by the delivered Chinese food quality and friendly service.

Author: D5311FFgrahambBiggin Hill, United Kingdom
Title: Amazing
Review: Recommended by our driver from Shangri la hotel. Andrew the owner is a extremely congenial host greets you cordially as does all the staff but enough of the big words. Food is superb, great value for money and as a lot of people have said have the half meals so you can try more of the menu. Will be back again before we leave next week. Show less

Author: michael eSherborne, United Kingdom
Title: An amazing food experience
Review: Well what can we say about this fantastic restaurant , well we ate here a few times over our stay in Batu Ferringhi and wish we could have fitted in another visit before our departure . It is better if you can to try and reserve a table as it's very popular . Andrew is the star of the show , he is a very sincere character and full of life . He will guide you through his menu , and he also does two sizes of meal just in case you wish to try his menu . Whilst I was there he talked me into having a dish Marmite Chicken ! It was full of flavour and very tasty . I will miss this place , but if I'm back in Batu Ferringhi then definitely it will be my first choice . Thank you to all the wonderful staff , and of course Andrew . You are all amazing . Food price average , but food quality superb ... Very Tasty ...You will find Andrews dead opposite the Golden Sands in a tower block on the 3rd floor . Tip if you walk around the building in the middle is a lift that takes you straight up to the third floor ...Show less

Author: Fredster1991
Title: Best Guy and Food in Town❤️
Review:
The Food was amazing and you feel,that Andrew really like his job. He gave us a very nice recommendation (Marmite chicken) and we loved it. 

Go there and taste the greatest food in the town(spring rolls,marmite chicken and a tiger with iced Glases)😍

Author: Phillip LPerth, Australia
Title: Andrew is the star of this establishment apart from the food
Review: Can see why thgis restaurant is ranked number 1 as it was a very enjoyable experience Unfortunately we left it to the last night to dine here The food was excellent & reasonably priced & of course as I said the dining experience was made more enjoyable by Andrew's service & quirky behaviourShow less

Author: Deb B
Title: Andrews kampung
Review: A bit different, food was good and we enjoyed eating it, surroundings a bit pop up cafe using plastic chairs and tables, but Andrews personality made all the difference and we will go back before we leave.

Author: tashiritesh
Title: Best food in Penang for price!
Review: Ordered the crispy chilli squid, amazing Malaysian curry, and claypot tofu. Everything was very tasty and excellent host and service.

Author: Happyholidayer7Bristol, United Kingdom
Title: Glad we were introduced to this
Review: We were taken here by local friends. So glad we were. This was the best meal we had during our stay. Food was fabulous, particularly the marmite chicken and pepper beef. Delicious. We would never have known to try it were we not taken here by friends. Would have returned again if we had time and a good reason to return to Penang. A must!Show less

Author: 199eminb
Title: Impeccable
Review:
Jaw has officially dropped. 

Wow! Amazing food, amazing service. 

This has been the best experience. 

Thanks

Author: mack8882016
Title: Best Food
Review: A visit to Andrews Kampung is definitely a worthwhile experience. The food is excellent and the wine very reasonably priced. Not a big restaurant but Andrew is a very good host and will make you feel most welcome. Would recommend to anyone staying in Penang

Author: boultons9
Title: Fantastic
Review:
Food as always fantastic been many times in the last few years standard always very high,Andrew and his family and staff are gems.

The quality of the food and the prices are amazing,see you again 2017

Author: CarolC5485Melbourne, Australia
Title: Best Restaurant in Penang!
Review: After regularly visiting Penang for over 20 years, Andrew's Kampung is one of the very few local restaurants left! The food is amazing and the most friendly staff - you must try the Peking Duck!!! Will always be at the top of our list!! Great work Andrew - keep up the good work!Show less

Author: soonamiScarborough, Australia
Title: Unusual location but absolutely fabulous food and service
Review: We went as a group of 9 adults. First of all, don't let the entrance put you off. 3 flights of stairs (avoid the lift!). The service was fast and friendly. Andrew was lovely, enthusiastic and genuinely cared about our experience. The food was good, tasty, basic malayasian/chinese cuisine. We decided on the half serves and that was plenty - everyone left with full bellies. Alcohol was also well priced. Definitely recommend this restaurant.Show less

Author: ebonytia
Title: Delicious food!
Review: Definitely worth a visit if you are staying in Bari Feringhi. The staff are very friendly and helpful giving recommendations of popular dishes. We had the crispy duck with pancakes which was amazing!

Author: craigieboy2015
Title: good food
Review: nice middle of the road food which wont kill your pocket.Andrew reminded us of chef one even though he doesn't cook.you can have a good laugh with Andrew he is  good fun.

Author: Turn176
Title: Fast efficient service, but
Review: The host, Andrew is entertaining but the ambiance and standard of cuisine doesn't make it a place for a second visit.

Author: Duncan_R_EllisLee-on-the-Solent, United Kingdom
Title: Entertaining host, okay food
Review: Andrews is located on the second floor of the tower block that also houses the CIMB bank.Andrew himself is an entertaining and slightly flamboyant host. Popular with tourists (probably due to high rating on trip advisor) but few locals that we saw. The food was reasonably priced for the area and was okay, but I think the reviews present an optimistic perspective and it didn't reach the standards we were hoping for. Not that it was bad, it was fine but just fine.Show less

Author: Dean E
Title: Best spring rolls in Malaysia!
Review: We were very impressed with the food, and certianly suggest to everyone to order a serve of the spring rolls. Possibly order two! Service was also very good. Great value for money.

Author: 682saray
Title: Friendly Andrew
Review: As usually Andrew is giving a good service to everyone. He's so friendly and always ensure all guest were having good food n service provided. The taste of food was always excellent no doubt. Keep up good work!

Author: FamilyAdventure2011Sydney, Australia
Title: Well priced and good food!
Review: We went with another couple and really enjoyed the adult time. The service was excellent, attentive and helpful as we had a gluten free couple with us. Andrew was extremely helpful and welcoming. Food was good I wouldn't say great, but still worth the walk. Food was chinese influenced but nice. Batu Ferringhi has lots of restaurants, very hard to pick No1 as they are all similar style of Asian dishes. Show less

Author: StevelincolnLincoln
Title: Highly Recommend
Review: Andrew your host is polite, professional and funny! The ambience of the restaurant is quirky and clean and well presented. The menu is varied and Andrew will go out of his way to meet your dining needs and experience to ensure your evening is a good one! Prices are very competitive for the local area. We have dined at Andrews many times and would highly recommend it to anyone eating in the Batu Ferringhi area. Show less

Author: Kiran_THSKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Super delicious food
Review: If you want to have food made with love - this is the place to go. We went here twice for lunch - enjoyed both the meals. It is on the second floor and a small clean restaurant. Aunty there makes amazing food. Prices are reasonable and they do have half portions so you can enjoy a variety of dishes. Kampung fried rice, char kuay teow and pineapple fried rice are yum. The sizzling chicken is yum too. There is enough variety for vegetarians too.Show less

Author: Susan HMarple, United Kingdom
Title: So good we had to go back for more
Review: Please do not walk past the building and dismiss Andrews Kampung it is on the second floor and the building is old and looks uncared for. When you arrive at Andrews you are greeted with a big smile from Andrew and he is the perfect host though out your meal. We started with the amazing spring rolls and to follow we shared the Malaysian Chicken curry which was fabulous and the sizzling beef the beef was so tender it melted in your mouth it was accompanied with fried rice. We shared a dessert of deep fried ice cream which was lovely and light. We also had a bottle of wine and a bottle of water all for under £30 what a bargain. So next time you are in Penang look up Andrews you won't be disappointed Show less

Author: buxton-blade
Title: Theres better food around
Review:
Dont like giving negative feedback but this was a very average Chinese meal in an area full of wonderful food. 
It was ok but there is much better places around

Andrew was a great host though

Author: Nicholas AThetford, United Kingdom
Title: An amazing place to eat
Review: We went to Andrews following recommendations from friends. All I can say is it is everything that our friends and other reviewers say that it is. It fully deserves its 'number 1' rating for the area. Andrew is a larger than life figure, somehow managing to give all his guests his full attention and remembering complex orders without writing anything down. As other reviewers have said, do not be put off by the location (2nd floor in a shopping mall) or by appearances (plastic chairs and tables). The food and service are both 100% and the prices are extremely competitive. Andrew is very helpful, explains dishes that you may not be familiar with and recommending other dishes that will compliment your choices. Half size portions are available so you can try several different things. Do not miss the crispy duck or the fried squid - if you eat nothing else, try these. It was so good we booked again for the following night before we even finished. We will definitely be returning for more. Show less

Author: d4v1dv00
Title: Found this place via TripAdvisor
Review: Delicious food and friendly services. Reasonable price expected in tourism area. Excellent service and creative interior design. The only challenge to get to the restaurant is have to climb stairs for 3 floors.

Author: fazadinr
Title: Restaurant review (1st visit)
Review: Headed here with my family based on the ranking and review here on TA. The restaurant itself is fairly small and wasn't too busy, doubt you'd need to make a reservation but it's always good to call beforehand to be sure. Do note that it is located on the top floor (above CIMB) and you have to climb multiple flights of stairs to get there. The waiter was very friendly and helpful in suggesting dishes. We had the following dishes:Sizzling beef - 2/5 below average taste. The beef wasn't very good and the sauce wasn't memorable either.Broccoli - AcceptableFried squid - 4/5 one of the better fried squids I've had in a while.Butter prawn - 3.5-5 the prawn was good but the batter could do with more sugar IMO. Overall, by Malaysian standards, I'd say this restaurant is above average depending on what you order. I'd definitely try this restaurant again in the future and sample the rest of the menu.Show less

Author: AgathaChristie2012Singapore, Singapore
Title: Reliable and Clean
Review: As a Malaysian food lover, I was sad when I was diagnosed w celiac disease since that meant no more Chinese food Etc (soy sauce, msg, etc) Andrew however understands Gluten Free (at least for the most part) so I can eat Thai Chilly Prawns and fried rice without getting sick! The price may be slightly higher than some stalls nearby but we can rely on cleanliness at Andrew's plus a very friendly host who speaks Australian English!!Show less

Author: 185matthewrMelbourne, Australia
Title: Simply brilliant
Review: An unassuming location on the second floor of a small shopping however you are welcomed enthusiastically by Andrew and then treated to arguably the best Malaysian cuisine in the local area. The house specials all have a little asterisk on the menu, stick with these and you can't go wrong. The table next to us had people who were eating there for the 5th night in a row because they felt they would just be disappointed if they went elsewhere. Show less

Author: p_mcrae317Newcastle, United Kingdom
Title: Good
Review: Had a meal here the first night we arrived.it was good and staff are good,but nothing outstanding.owner is a jolly man and very friendly.not to good if your not good on your feet as its on second floor.prices are medium as there are cheaper places to eat.Show less

Author: Jewels680
Title: Good but not great
Review:
The host and staff very helpful in choosing the meal.Andrew is quite a character.
Duck starter ok rolls a little too crispy.
Main course was really good but not great.will return though during visit

Author: debbietinkerLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Outstanding
Review: A hidden gem (building looks like a multi storey car park opposite the golden sands hotel,on the second floor above the bank,access via the lift by the kfc ) A choice of all you can eat or I recommend choose off the main menu,it looks limited but requests are always catered for.sizziling dishes and the pineapple rice are to die for.and unlike some nearby restaurants they also serve alcohol ,great value from Andrews family run business,it's our 6th and sadly last visit tonight.Show less

Author: Paula_CWH
Title: Yummy food, friendly owner
Review: We had amazing experience at this casual restaurant. food is lovely, great service and loads of Chinese and Malaysian choices. Not easy to find as it is located on the second floor above the bank, look for a banner AnDrews Kampung. If you don't like spicy food I would advise to say No Spicy rather than Mild.Fried ice creams are great dessert.Show less

Author: Sharon L
Title: Great character
Review: Andrew's was fabulous. Great range on the menu, very friendly service from Andrew and his team. Food was delicious and reasonably priced. I'd certainly go back again.

Author: BlytheFamily2011
Title: Fab
Review:
Fab, Andrew's is an experience! 
Good food, great prices, you get served by him and HIS mum in person, whilst you feel like you are sat in a multi storey car park at 30'C.

No poorly tummies give it a go!

Author: Nolita230Hong Kong, China
Title: good simple food
Review: When you travel and eat Western food, it's hard to get vegetables in your diet - that's where Chinese food is great because you can have your veggies, protein and rice/noodles. Service was really friendly, it wasn't very crowded when we went for lunch and dinner, food was good at ok prices, good for families. Just want you want for a simple Chinese meal.Show less

Author: 130vichAdelaide, Australia
Title: Hidden treasure
Review: We dined at Andrews Kampung on 3 occasions and we had excellent service and fantastic food every time. The choice of food was very good , from Asian to western , all cooked very well and served by a most hospitable staff.Recommend booking as it is very popular and Andrew has no objection to you taking your own wine. It is a bit hard to find , it is located on the second floor of Eden Parade , take the lift to second floor and follow the sign. You will not be disappointed. You can also order half serves of most dishes so you can try a lot of different meals for a very reasonable price.Show less

Author: MMPET STruro, United Kingdom
Title: Great food, great host
Review: This place is definitely worth a visit, if not two if you have the time. Location is a little bizarre on the 3rd floor of tower block above KFC & CIMB bank. Escalators weren't working and the walk up all seems quite desolate but don't let any of this put you off. Andrew is a welcoming, characterful and jovial host who will make you feel most welcome.Decor is basic with egg boxes on the walls, lampshades made from plastic bottles and furniture basic but is all somehow very quaint.Food is superb and very reasonably priced. The home made spring rolls were excellent.A unique and quirky place but definitely recommended.Show less

Author: TRR99
Title: Fantastic food, reasonably priced
Review: My husband and I went there for our wedding anniversary dinner and we were not disappointed. Food was fantastic and the staff helpful, friendly and were keen to ensure we had a good time. Good wine too which is unusual for Batu Ferringhi. We have already booked to go again and would not hesitate to recommend.Show less

Author: Rani JLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Fabulous food & service
Review: Very well priced for local food , the duck was fab . Also if your not sure what to order help was always at hand to offer advice . The food was well cooked and very tasty . Again don't be put out by the outside & how it looks this was good wholesome food. The icecream as desert was the best I have ever tasted .Show less

Author: David B
Title: Always great food
Review:
Just been to Andrews again and the food was excellent, working our way through the menu, just had devils beef and crispy squid and onion, both tops,  till the next time
Cheers to Andrew and the staff

Author: Frances C
Title: Delicious food, great atmosphere
Review: Find this place in the middle of the high rise where Kentucky is- 2nd floor and signposted. It's open air, really good atmosphere. I asked if they did vegetarian food and they checked what I would eat- no meat, no fish. Very accommodating and checked with me again when the meal arrived. Really delicious and very well priced.Show less

Author: mmegsy
Title: Sensational
Review: You know those type of places that stay with you long after you've left ?This is one of them !!! Andrews is not fine dining , it's honest fresh delicious home style cookingHAVE THE BUTTER PRAWNS THIS IS AN ORDER !!!! You will be left wondering why your on a high.THANKYOU Andrew ,You also are half the reason we ate here 3 timesDuring our stay !!!! You gotta be good to get these ratings Show less

Author: Muffin68
Title: AMAZING AMAZING AMAZING ANDREW
Review: Loved it - wish we were still there eating the crispy squid and many other delights.  Well done Andrew.

Author: Muffinfamilytravel
Title: LOVED LOVED LOVED ANDREWS AND EVERY MORSEL OF FOOD
Review: Simple restaurant - don't let that fool you - the food was absolutely magnificent - wish our family of five were there right now.  One night, our group totalled 13 of us and they were very accommodating.   Yummmmmmmmmm

Author: 728suef
Title: Go, food and hospitality excellent!
Review: You will never just wonder past this place, but hunt it out, excellent food and good prices! My son was no feeling very well on this evening and the staff really looked after him too.  Well worth a visit!

Author: rzinger
Title: Kyle tested Kyle approved
Review: This fantastic hidden gem was tested by top food critic Kyle Mitchell... And he approved - the restaurant passed with tons of room to spare... Must try the pineapple chicken!

Author: Michelle DBrisbane, Australia
Title: Always welcome and delicious
Review: Greeted warmly, as always by Andrew and the team at Kampung, I was happy to be revisiting. It appears they've moved away from their 'all you can eat' buffet concept to offering dishes of small, medium and large for almost everything on their reasonably extensive menu. This suits me perfectly, particularly when dining with my brother who shares my love of small, eclectic portions. We chose small portions of everything we ordered with the idea that if we wanted more then we'd simply order more. Andrew's Kampung is ever reliable. Great food at extraordinary value. They do not have a Halal certificate only because they serve alcohol. But it is completely pork free, which is perfect for me. But for those of you who think without pork all is lost, you're in for an enormous surprise.The food is just great. Of the 10 dishes sampled over the two visits, not one was less than very, very good. And the iced tea is perfectly sweet, and charged with fresh lime making for a thirst-quenching digestive that's admirably suited to the food. Or you can get a Tiger Beer or glass/bottle of wine if you prefer.It doesn't really matter what we chose to eat. You pick what you like the sound of. You pick anything. You won't be disappointed.Show less

Author: Roger B
Title: Heaven on a plate
Review:
Fantastic nonya food and very cheap with really cold beer😀
Andrew really looked after us recommending what to eat. It's just a shame that we didn't find him sooner!!!

Author: billhR6361EX
Title: Hidden gem in Penang
Review: This delightful restaurant immersed us in Malaysian culture. We were welcomed with friendly smiles, with staff who ensured we had a lovely meal. The food was excellent - the best we've had so far jn Malaysia. The highlight of our meal was the Indonesian fish, which we would highly reccomend. If you're visiting Penang i would strongly advise stopping by this restaurant for a Malaysian meal you won't forget. Show less

Author: welshman279North Wales
Title: Delightful
Review: You will see plenty of reviews here about the now famous Andrew. We found he lived up to the best of those reviews. Great food ( marmite chicken is just one great dish) and with Andrew running the show, great service. We did eat here on his night off, it wasn't as smoothly run, however the food was just as good.Remember to book! He will try and fit you in if he can, but Friday's and Saturdays he is usually booked up.Show less

Author: ladolcevita73
Title: Authentic home-cooked at reasonable prices
Review: What can we say - Andrew himself is so entertaining that we didn't mind that the portions were not huge although they were certainly authentic and home-cooked style.  We have a thoroughly enjoyable dinner there.

Author: MoolidayMelbourne, Australia
Title: Restaurant for tourists only
Review: It's not easy to find the restaurant since it's located in an old building but we were surprised to have found so many tourists in this restaurant. Compared to the famous local Penang dishes, this restaurant is catering food for tourists' taste but not to the local. I wouldn't categorize it as authentic Penang food but It's okay (not bad) for Malaysian/ Asian food hence I rated it as average only. Penang is famous for it's local food, I would still go to George Town for real authentic Penang food.Show less

Author: Jen S
Title: An entertaining dining experience
Review: Trip Advisor really need congratulated for making this owners business an ongoing success. Had it not been for the reviews, I believe this place would be significantly quieter than it is, and due to its location, we would never have went in. The patrons, almost without exception, are Australians or Europeans.ANdrews is on the second floor of an older style shopping centre. It is quite small and gets very busy in the evenings between 7-8pm as you would expect.Andrew is a flamboyant host who is extremely welcoming to guests, but may not be quite so kind to kitchen staff.Food is pretty cheap and tasty. Our children ate more here than anywhere else because after trying the first plate and enjoying it... They were happy to try everything else we ordered even although it wasn't foods they would usually eat.Really liked that most of the dishes could be ordered as a half portions so you can order lots of tasting plates. 1/2 serves of curry dishes were about 8mr or under $3 per plate.As mentioned, the restaurant obviously caters for westerners tastes and locals don't rate it as a place to eat (our hotel staff were really surprised we thought it was so good). Prawns are about the most expensive dish at 39mr with most mains about 15mr or $5. Would recommend everyone try an egg fried rice dish with your meal which I thought was delicious.Show less

Author: BabsioSydney, Australia
Title: Ok food, great service
Review: Went to this place based on trip advisor reviews. The food was ok/good. Nothing special and certainly not bad. I just would favour other places. The service was efficient and friendly.The ambiance of the location is lost with the loudspeaker from the Mosc (at the Golden Sands) across the road, but don't let that deter you from having meal here. Accomodating for young children.Show less

Author: worktopsteveWalton-On-Thames, United Kingdom
Title: Recent visit
Review: After reading reviews for Andrews and Trip advisor we visited with 4 other guests from our hotel. The food is excellent and great value for money. Andrew is a character and is always willing to stop and chat with you even when he is really busy. The crispy peking duck and the sizzling prawns are the best I have eaten. On a very rainy night Andrew even drove us back to our hotel in his own car, this is over and above what you would expect from a local restaurant. We are looking forward to seeing Andrew and auntie again in November.Show less

Author: Elizabeth_Melb
Title: Absolutely Delicious
Review: Great food and Andrew and the team are very accommodating!! A must try when in Penang.... Be sure to ask about his sisters restaurant for lunch too....

Author: woohartyBrisbane, Australia
Title: Big expectations
Review: After reading all the rave reviews about Andrews, we tried it out on our recent trip to Penang. Overall the experience and food was average. They brought the wrong dish to us and I didn't see or we were not offered an all you can eat menu. Would I return, no, we had better meals at other restaurants.Show less

Author: Passport83083
Title: Fantastic Food
Review: Don't be put off by the plastic chairs and basic decor, the staff are friendly and the food is amazing. Highlights were the lemon chicken and sizzling beef. Best fried ice cream I've had!

Author: stevecA8481TLAshwood, Australia
Title: Fantastic
Review: Andrew and the team are fantastic. Fast, quick service, and icy cold beer on a hot day. We went once to try it out and have returned each day to work through the menu. We haven't been disappointed at all. Good for the whole family (we have two boys aged 8 and 10) who have loved the honey plum chicken, prawns, and duck pancakes. The curries are tasty and not overly hot, unless you want it fired up more. Cannot recommend it more highly. Great food, good service, fantastic host in Andrew. Have recommended the restaurant already to many people we have met at the hotel. Show less

Author: simongJ4800AN
Title: Brilliant
Review: Visited 3 times in a week. Atmosphere is fantastic. Andrew is a lovely character who can't do enough for you. Food is lovely and a decent price. If it wasn't for the fact there are other places to visit I would quite happily eat there all the time.Don't expect high class decor, but if you like good food, good atmosphere and good value then it's a must visit! Show less

Author: Panheady
Title: Good but not outstanding
Review: Enjoyed the crispy lemon chicken and it is great you can get half serves. Spring rolls were so so, wouldn't order them again. Deep fried ice cream was very tasty.

Author: Peter1709Perth, Australia
Title: Great chinese food
Review: Visited twice during our stay.We ordered the "eat all you can" option which is all freshly cooked for you. RM39.90 and a small tiger beer was RM10.You can work through the menu from start to finish and order as much as you like as long as you don't waste food which is to be expected.The food is served quickly and tastes superb.Andrew is very friendly as are all members of this family restaurant.On the 2 occasions we dined the weather was awful, the rain poured down but rather than try and hire a taxi Andrew kindly drove us back to our Hotel on both nights.You can't fault the service.Show less

Author: 127anneh
Title: Great night
Review: Upstairs restaurant but there is a lift.  Great food and attentive service.  Lemon chicken was excellent.  We dined there twice in the five days we spent in the area and enjoyed our experience both times.  It is licensed and not expensive

Author: rjf1002014
Title: A little Restaurant packing a big punch
Review: This is an unassuming restaurant easily missed as its on the 2nd floor of Eden Parade, but it was recommended to us and we were delighted. There were plenty of local people in the restaurant which for me is always a very good sign, and once we sat down it was no surprise. The food and service were excellent on both occasions we visited, I love Malaysian Curry and this was the best I had. A big thank you to Andrew and his team.Show less

Author: jackw53London, United Kingdom
Title: Consistently Good
Review: What can one say that has not already been said about this establishment? We have been returning here year after year and always find Andrew and his staff welcoming and happy to suggest dishes if you need their advice. The meals are well prepared and served and I can recommend any of the curries as well as the sizzling prawns. Well done.Show less

Author: 900maddiebWhitehorse, Canada
Title: Best restaurant in Malaysia! Food heaven!
Review: The food is amazing and the service is amazing as well. The food comes out very fast and and is sooo good! Easily the best restaurant to eat Malaysian food at in Malaysia. Don't get turned away by the location! The restaurant had tons of tourists in it and the atmosphere is amazing. Highly recommend going!Show less

Author: Kerensa2014Singapore, Singapore
Title: Unpretentious little joint with tasty bites
Review: Located at the corner of the second floor shophouse, this eatery may not look inviting enough for tourists. However , if you are looking for authentic, local food, this humble place is highly recommended . I tried the spicy deep fried local squid & onions and it's a surprising yummy version of little calamari and onion rings ! It's not somewhere to linger, but a great place for a quick lunch or dinner. The price is very reasonable and service staff are cheerful and friendly Show less

Author: gary2507Kuta, Indonesia
Title: Great food location sucks
Review: The food you get here is of a very high standard, taste and good value. You get great service from Andrew and the rest of the crew. All this fades into nothing when you look around at where you are sitting, 2nd floor of a shopping centre and not a very nice one at that. You would be OK eating here at lunch time whilst shopping but for an evening meal its a little ordinary. This restaurant needs relocating to a better spot, If this was somewhere else you would gladly eat here every day.Show less

Author: AzOthmanBern, Switzerland
Title: "Very friendly service matched by superb, delicious, awesome food."
Review: When we walked in at Andrew's, it wasn't packed yet. The service is very friendly and efficient. Wow! The restaurant sits on the 2nd floor over looking busy Batu Ferringhi. We ordered chicken satay, kankung belacan, mixed vegetable, butter prawns, fried squid and sea bass with thai sauce. Oh my GOD was it delicious! My favorite was the butter prawns and the sea bass. Did i say already it was delicious? Ok once again it was superb, awesome and delicious food. Actually shouldn't write this review. To many will come and they all wanna taste Andrew's Kampung. Not good, not good! ;-)Show less

Author: 285ruthw
Title: Awesome!
Review: Wow the food is truly amazing! We had the lemon chicken, satay chicken, devil chicken and fried rice. All were delicious and the hospitality most major restaurants could learn a think of too about! Thank you x we will definitely be back for more :)

Author: carolyn618Sydney, Australia
Title: Best food and best host!!!!
Review: Ate here two nights in a four night stay in Penang. Loved it!!! The all you can eat option is a great price and food is so delicious. As for Andrew, what a legend!!! He makes the night fun and has the biggest smile for you. We let Andrew plan our dishes, he would bring them out for us to try and wow, so tasty. His Aunty and other staff are very friendly also. So glad we were recommended to go here. Will be telling everyone about this place!!!Show less

Author: Wagirl2012Perth, Australia
Title: Home style Chinese
Review: We went to visit for a dinner. What a lovely dinner of spring rolls, crispy duck and sweet and sour prawns.It was delicious fresh food with a great outlook.Andrew was a wonderful host, dinner with two beers and a lemon tea was $112.30 RM.Lovely to visit for the food and happy atmosphere, a must do at Batu Fearingini!Show less

Author: kkazzproMelbourne, Australia
Title: A must when in Penang
Review: The type of restaurant you can go to and no matter what you order you know you won't be disappointed. Good authentic food at very reasonable prices. Make sure you try the deep fried ice cream, only a few ringgit and so indulgent. Andrew truly makes you feel so welcome that you will keep going back there just to see his smiling face.Show less

Author: Allan K
Title: Good night
Review: Been here several times and always have the buffet meal all you can eat just order the dish,s you like and enjoy the owner Andrew his very helpful and will advise you on all the dish,s that they provide

Author: ChuneKeatSingapore, Singapore
Title: Lovely family place with overall good food
Review: Great service, the auntie prepared some lovely off menu Mee sua for my sick daughter which she found lovely. The food for adults were also wholesome family cooked food. The place is a little hard to find.. Easiest is to go to the kfc and take the lift up(follow signs) .. Setting is simple but if looking for good home cooked style cooking this one is hard to beatShow less

Author: HishamZarinaAnwar
Title: COME HERE FOR GGOD FOOD
Review: I wrote this review after 5th visit to this place, they are consistent in quality and taste, the Aunty was very friendly. Good place to have a meal at Batu Ferringhi.

Author: JulianaChuaslSingapore, Singapore
Title: Home Cooked food!
Review: Wonderful ice coffee - the best i have ever tasted and home cooked Malaysian cuisine such as Char Kuay Teow. Certainly did not expect this from a non-descript, unassuming eatery on the 3rd floor of an equally non-descript building - opposite Golden Sand's Resort along Batu Ferringhi. One would have to look up to see Andrew's.Show less

Author: paulhQ1919SLLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Tasty and friendly
Review: Not sure how or why, but my wife and I ended up staying in Batu Ferringhi for New Years. Our hotel's heyday, like the resort itself, had long since past. To escape in the evening was difficult, so this restaurant and the Long Beach food court were real finds. The host is very welcoming and very friendly. We felt relaxed and lingered after our meal had finished, watching the street scene below. The food isn't bad either!Show less

Author: AaronY394
Title: Worth visit
Review: Like home cooking foods..very nice place..friendly owner too..love the place,owner very helpful too ..to let us know some good place to visit nearby..tumb up..~~

Author: TallTravels29San Jose, California
Title: Brilliant little discovery
Review: We were staying at a resort nearby and only went here because a colleague recommended it. It's a hole in the wall on the second floor of a commercial building so not the type of place you would generally discover, but what a discovery it was. The beer mugs arrive chilled and icy, the black pepper beef and sizzling prawns were fantastic and we literally had the best fried rice of our LIFE there. Seriously, I have no idea what they put into it but is so flavoursome you want to jump onto the table and do a little dance. They were also very accommodating of vegetarians in our group and recommended some off the menu dishes. It was a fabulous meal and can't recommend this little place highly enough. Show less

Author: TimvenutaMildura, Australia
Title: Amazing Food
Review: The reviews are all true!!!This restaurant is not flash nor pretty to look at but......its amazing chef and staff truly make up for it. The home made springs rolls were amazing, followed by a rice dish, noodles, sizzling beef and sweet chicken all faultless! Delicious from beginning to end. My best meal while staying in Batu Ferringhi.A definite must try, worth the walk up the steps.Two thumbs up to Andrews KampungShow less

Author: Fedz1980Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Great Food but run down restaurant
Review: We decided to dine here for dinner after reading the reviews on tripadvisor. After taking the lift up to the 2nd floor and walking around to the restaurant we were met with a beautiful breeze which was so nice seeing it was so hot and humid. Once we were seated we all just looked at each other and said i hope the food is better than the decor. Its a little run down restaurant with lots of plastic bottles for chandeliers and rolled up newspaper for decoration on the walls plus a wall full of photos of im assuming people who have dined at the restaurant. Each table had different plastic table clothes and lots of mixed up glasses and cutlery. Im all for upcycling but the place really did look dirty. Now that i have got that out of the way the food is a different story. The food was delicious. We ordered the green thai chicken curry (best i've ever had), chicken cashew nut, black pepper beef, fried noodles, chinese fried rice and for dessert fried ice cream. We enjoyed everything and the vanilla fried ice cream was so delicious. The ladies there are lovely.Show less

Author: Madjestic
Title: Batu Ferringhi
Review: Great atmosphere, great food and great prices. Would recommend if you are going to Batu Ferringhi. The staff were helpful and friendly.

Author: ChocosugaLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Quick Dinner
Review: Had heard about this place for a while. So decided to sample their cuisine. The team were warm and welcoming.We ordered 5 various things. It was done in a fairly quick time. I noticed that our daughters came out first. Which was a nice touch as children could be quite titchy when out. Food was presented well drinks were cold. The waiters who dealt with us spoke English very well.Place is modestly decorated I quite like their quirky menu's and their lamp shades made out of plastic bottles. Very ingenious. This is not a swanky place. I would refer as rustic. Food was tasty but I was not wowed. I've had much tastier in Penang.What I loved about it was its unpretentious nature and the team.Seeing it was our 1st time. I'd have liked some guidance or recommendation from our waitress, but that did not happen. However she did guide when i asked whether dishes were spicy etc.Restaurant is clean so was the toilet. They had overhead fans and a standing one. We were not hot.It's a little gem hidden in a storey block. An interesting find to add to our black book. Prices are very reasonable too. I definitely recommend it.We would go there again maybe our palette was slightly different today:)Show less

Author: GabouxWhangarei, New Zealand
Title: Perfect little no frill restaurant
Review: We never would have found this place just strolling arround...we read about this marvellous restaurant in the tripadvisor, gave it a try and returned every night of our stay in Batu Ferringhi to try out different dishes of the menu card. Actually that never happend before as we like to try out different eating places... but the food and price are so perfect it wasn't a question.The restaurant is located on the 2nd floor in the same komplex you find Danish Byrani restaurant. On the other side of the mainroad where Golden Sands Hotel is located. Andrew, his aunt and all the staff are extremely welcoming and friendly. Not business fake friendly but genuine. We tried pepper chicken (boneless), sizzling beef (tender), homemade spring rolls, vegetable noodles, pinapple rice, lemon chicken, chili chicken, tofu soup, green curry chicken.... All very very tasty. Not one did disappoint. My favorite was the lemon chicken. The best I have ever tasted. Crisp and so lemony. A must to go eating there if you are in Batu Ferringhi if you ask me. Show less

Author: JWP23Bromley, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent little find
Review: Don't expect luxury furniture and airconditioning, what you can expect is a very warm welcome from the owner Andrew, excellent food and superb service. We ate at this restaurant several times because of the quality of the food and the flavours. Some reveiws say that he shouts a lot, he doesn't his voice is raised sometimes when he is telling the kitchen the orders to get over the noise from the restaurant and the street outside. So if you want an excellent meal with good service, atmosphere and excellent value for money then gice this place a go you will be pleasently surprised.Show less

Author: Neil PHigh Wycombe, United Kingdom
Title: Really enjoyable experience
Review: We ate at Andrews on a couple of occasions during our stay in batu Ferringhi. The restaurant is unpretentious but Andrew and is Auntie are great hosts and the food is authentic a great tasting. The was a group there with a little girl who was having trouble staying awake so Andrew pushed some chairs together and along with several cushions made a instant bed for her. So sweet.Show less

Author: SussexTravelBugsHawarden, United Kingdom
Title: Delicious food, casual atmosphere, excellent friendly service
Review: Ditch the decidedly average hotel food across the road and eat here every night! The food was really tasty, with the very spicy Devils Chicken, creamy Malaysian curry and black pepper beef the highlights for us. Service was excellent and friendly, and the prices very reasonable. Would thoroughly recommend. Show less

Author: standardfamily474Canberra, Australia
Title: great place, very friendly but a little overhyped
Review: A great little restaurant overlooking Batu Ferringhi with a nice breeze, friendly staff and good food at the right price. We had dinner here on a Thursday night at 8pm having walked in to book earlier same day after reading reviews. On the topic of reviews; there are a few gushing reviews about, and while it is very good, I have difficulty with the rating at #1 in Batu Ferringhi and #2 of 1200 restaurants in Penang but admittedly have only been here once and tried a small sample of the menu, maybe Im missing something (perhaps should have tried the duck??). I do worry it might soon suffer a little from the hype and unrealistic expectations. The staff are exceptional and Andrew is a very friendly character and seems a savvy operator. They create a comfortable feel while being very efficient so the service is excellent and between them, they are likely responsible for the strong following. The menu has a good variety of Malay and Singaporean / Chinese dishes. We had Salt & Pepper chicken & crispy wontons for starters - both very nice; some of the best wontons we’ve had in a while (recommend). Mains were chicken curry (OK) and black pepper fish (good). Salt & pepper chicken (OK). The Fried rice had a nice charcoal-smoke flavour. Drinks are very cold and beers came at lightning speed with a frozen glass - nice! Price was RM 110 including drinks; very fair. The location is easy to find; at the main intersection in Batu Ferringhi / centre of the night markets you will see the traffic lights, petrol station etc. Looking from the beach side of the road, its the building on the left above CIMBANK and Danish Biryani House. The restaurant is on the second floor, left corner as you see it. Stairs are in the middle of the building facing the beach (Filthy). Overall, enjoyed it and feel good about our choice to go and if you manage your expectations I’m willing to bet you will also. There is also a reliable laundry service directly below on 1st floor who charge about RM 7 per kg and will deliver to your hotel next day for an extra RM3.Show less

Author: PeterriggersStaffordshire, United Kingdom
Title: Make sure you go
Review: We went to Andrew's Kamung restaurant on the recommendation of Trip Advisor and we were so pleased we did, in fact we went there twice!As the previous posts have explained, ignore the walk and stairwell you must follow because you will be greeted with a huge smile and welcome.Andrews hospitality is the main factor for our return visit as well as his menu containing good tasty Malaysian and Asian food. Don't expect a 4* restaurant, it's not, but for a good evening meal which pushes your boundaries you will be pleasantly surprised.LGBT friendly.Show less

Author: hobsfinosouth east
Title: Believe the Reviews Go There on Your First Night
Review: We had read that this restaurant was the best in the area and not to be put off by the approach. Unfortunately we didn't listen to the reviews and ate in the hotel we were staying in until the last night when we went to Andrew's Kampung. We were very upset to discover how fabulous it was and that we would not be able to visit again. The food is fantastic, it's not fine dining, but it is the tastiest food we had in our entire visit to Malaysia. Andrew is delightful and could not be more welcoming. The setting is strange in that it is in a block of flats above some shops and looks like they took a flat and took out two external walls so although you are sitting inside it is open to the outside. It doesn't have air conditioning but it doesn't need it as the ever present breeze blows gently through the restaurant. My daughter ordered the Tom Yam Soup and Andrew did warn her it was hot but she said she'd had it before and then proceeded to bite on a birds eye chilli which caused her considerable eye watering and we did what we thought was right and ordered milk to help take away the heat however, Andrew seeing her discomfort said she needed to have water as hot as she could stand. Which although sceptical we did and she said it hurt momentarily which she put the hot water in her mouth but it took away the chilli pain immediately. Andrew knows his stuff. We all had a lovely meal and enjoyable experience.Show less

Author: denise b
Title: Good local away from the traffic
Review: nice to eat away from the busy street. Clean café style and the staff were helpful in advising best local dishes.

Author: thundercat114Sheffield, United Kingdom
Title: Very Welcoming
Review: We overheard someone suggesting Andrews and seeing how it was our first night in Penang after arriving from Cambodia we thought we would give it a try. Like all the other reviewers have stated dont be put off by the building itself. Andrews is signposted you can take the lift or the stairs to the second floor.You can have a set menu where you can pick from different dishes or go a la carte. My wife had the set menu spring rolls and chicken with cashew nuts with ice cream to follow. I didnt fancy the spring rolls and had satay sticks the waitress said she would charge just a little extra than set menu instead of the full price.The staff are really attentive and the food is excellent. We both had a drink and the bill came to under £13. We definitely will go back as we want to try the crispy duck! Show less

Author: ahmedmA5167HMMecca, Saudi Arabia
Title: Best malay food
Review: The food was tasty and very good. If you want to try malay food so let them recomend you food. Very friendly staff that want every thing to go perfect for their business. We also tried fried ice cream that was hot ouside and ice inside was very good experince Show less

Author: 988tracyb
Title: Spring rolls not to be missed
Review: Great food at Andrew's Kampung....the spring rolls really are fabulous. Service was good and the location just a little quirky....definitely worth a visit

Author: E9454YVmarkbGuernsey, United Kingdom
Title: Andrew is a legend
Review: The food is of very good quality for a very affordable price (especially compared to surrounding restaurants). The restaurant is with in a commercial building but please don't let this put you off because when you get inside you quickly feel at home. Andrew himself is a lovely host with a smile and a sense of humour. A personal favourite was the marmite chicken. Go give Andrew and his lovely staff a visit. It's well worth it.Show less

Author: Stephen B
Title: one of the best little restaurants around
Review: would not miss going to Andrew's when in Batu Ferringhi, he always makes you feel so welcome and will always find some  where  for you to sit.

Author: Carousel7
Title: Decent food
Review:
We had Chinese food for dinner, at affordable prices. Andrew was very friendly. I could see why the British expatriates or tourists enjoyed his hospitality.

Food was decent.

Author: Guide266694Ascot, Australia
Title: Excellent food and an excellent host
Review: Visited Andrew's Kampung firstly through the other excellent reviews on TripAdvisor but also on recommendation from the Concierge at our hotel who visits often with his large family. We were not disappointed from the moment we arrived. Andrew is a fabulous host and he made sure we were well taken care of. Our 4.5 year old daughter loved the spring rolls as did we, I had the green chicken curry which was excellent and my wife had the sweet and sour fish. My wife commented that she had the same dish on a trip to KL in January and thought that was excellent and this was even better, high praise I can tell you! All in all and excellent meal and an excellent host, will definitely go back on our next visit. Show less

Author: john mPortsmouth, United Kingdom
Title: good food
Review: we where recommended to eat there as its situated on the 2 floor its easy to miss to restaurant is very basic plastic tables chairs and plates but its easy to overlook this as the food was excellent and the staff so friendly just a nice place to eat.Show less

Author: Julie HPerth, Australia
Title: Thank you so much to Andrew...generous man!
Review: Well, we discovered Andrew's place, after a hot dusk search. Unfortunately, my teenage daughter fainted and convulsed about 2 minutes after stepping into Andrew's Kampung. All the staff and restaurant go-ers were very helpful (in a fairly stressful time). Despite not dining here, Andrew insisted on driving us back to our hotel - Park Royal. It smelled absolutely devine, but my daughter felt too embarrassed to go back there...venue is nothing special, but the food smells and service were out of this world. Go there after dark as it is 2nd story, so sun can still be punishing until it goes down.Show less

Author: tallthinblokeMaylands, Australia
Title: Great Service, Great food
Review: We went here after a recommendation from some people at our hotel, they ended joining us and as Penang veterans (+20yrs visits) we thought they'd know what was what. Andrews isn't flash, plastic chairs and tables and not easy to find on the upper level of the complex. However the food and service were superb, Andrew and his family in the restaurant were friendly and a joy to be with. The scallops baked with cheese, Marmite chicken, prawns, chicken curry, local fish and sambal prawns with various side dishes were excellent, very fresh seafood and great tasting. The beer and glasses were cold. Then to top it off it starting hammering rain, so Andrew very kindly drove us back to Shangri- La resort.All in all a great experience with great food and an awesome host, thank you Andrew we will return.Show less

Author: SteffiandSofiaMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Good food in a not so good place
Review: It's a good surprise to find this small restaurant inside a rundown building. Don't expect a cozy restaurant when you come here. Order the duck dish . If you have been to Bali , you'll be reminded about the famous fried duck from bali .Another success factor could be the male waiter / server . He is kind and friendly and speaks good EnglishShow less

Author: TanimannAdelaide, Australia
Title: Delicious food
Review: My husband and I were very happy that we took the stairs up to Andrews Kampung. It was worth it. The food was simply delicious and extremely well priced. We had char koi tow (fried rice noodles), black pepper beef and chilli prawns. The beef was the stand out dish - perhaps because it used the islands own pepper - simply fantastic. definitely worth a visit.Show less

Author: 324edgarkMelbourne, Australia
Title: Pleasant evening
Review: We had dinner here one night with family and had a pleasant evening. It was a little bit more local than we had expected (open air restaurant) but that did not detract at all. The staff were friendly and attentive. The food was reasonably priced and we enjoyed all the meals we had. This is a good place to visit if you are staying in Batu Ferringhi. Show less

Author: david d
Title: Relaxed, good food
Review: Food is only bettered by cheerful service. Come in from the front not the side street (good signage from front, nothing on the side of the building)

Author: WirazzinSydney, Australia
Title: Excellent Food
Review: Visited this restaurant a number of times for lunch and dinner. Great food. Andrew is a very "out there" host. When quiet service is excellent but when busy the staff are a bit overwhelmed and you do have to wait a while.The end product however is always lovely food.Basically across the road from the Golden Sands Resort - a bit tricky to find but on the 2nd floor. Escalators didn't work when we were there and lift door opened and closed real quick - added to the experience !!Worth a visit!Show less

Author: wooltonLiverpoolLiverpool, United Kingdom
Title: LOVELY AND FRIENDLY
Review: Good choice on our visits and always very busy, freshly cooked food and nice choice of drinks. Staff very good and always obliging. Andrew is a character. Situated up to flights of stairs but well worth the effort, situated in the centre of Batu at the traffic lights., Show less

Author: Pat0409Perth
Title: Great local food
Review: You must try this place, it is on the 2nd floor in a building opposite Golden Sands Hotel, just get the lift up. Food is amazing, and cheap. Let Andrew tell you what to order, he is so friendly and so much fun, he makes you feel very special. The food is local food, with lots of flavour, and very fresh. Not fine dining by any means, but good wholesome food in a café style setting.Show less

Author: Gss1973
Title: Very friendly
Review: Very nice people. Food was good but for locals nothing great! I was surprised how highly rated it was on trip advisor! The squid was nice and the prawns were decent

Author: Anthony B
Title: Highly recommended
Review: Andrew is a great host and his menu is fresh and varied. Dish of the night was the crispy duck pancakes, but everything was excellent. They also have a surprisingly good Chilean sav Blanc for only $20.

Author: bek lWorthing, United Kingdom
Title: Fantastic
Review: Don't be put off by the surroundings - the restaurant is on thesecond floor of a concrete shopping centre but there is a lift!Andrew is a wonderful host and the food is amazing - do savea little space for his deep fried icecream. As the restaurant is very close to the two Shrangri-La hotels you will usually find lots of faces you know! Think it is advisable to book although wewere lucky on the two nights we visited.Show less

Author: Duncan CGloucester, United Kingdom
Title: Good food and a friendly service
Review: First time here started with a friendly welcome. When ordering our meal we were kindly advised to only have half portions of rice and noodles to go with the mains. This turned out to be a wise choice as it would have been too much ... Saved some money too. The food was very good , I can personally recommend the chilli prawns. It was a warm eating and we sat on the balcony with the benefit of a near your fan. The service was friendly from start to finish.Show less

Author: Brit8Hong Kong, China
Title: Very tasty
Review: Andrew provided great service. Food came out quickly and was very tasty. It's just opposite the Golden Sands hotel. If you are staying at the Shangri-La Rasa, you can get a buggie which drops you off at the Golden Sands (a hotel linked with it) and then you just cross the road. A minute or two only in the buggie. After dinner, you can get a buggie from Golden Sands back to the RasaShow less

Author: pershore123
Title: Great atmosphere and food
Review: Do not be put off by the building this is a great place run by Andrew and family . Beautiful food and packed well worth the experience .

Author: philstreet2Leeds, United Kingdom
Title: Great Value Place to Ea Malaysia foodt. Great Host
Review: Andrews was recommended by lots of other Rasa Hotel guests as a place to eat. The food was fresh and tasty. Andrew is a great character and is very popular with his regular customers. You will need to book on most nights. The restaurant is on an open 2nd floor terrace, you might get damp on a rainy night.Show less

Author: John NCambridge, United Kingdom
Title: One of the best
Review: There is a wide choice of places to eat in Batu Ferringhi ranging from the superb and very pricey Ferringhi Grill at the Shangri-La to the simple and great value for money eateries in the Hawker Market and along the street.Andrew's Kampung falls very nicely between the two - very good food, a great welcome, relaxed and among pleasant surroundings, offering good value for money. With a Chinese bias and Thai and Malaysian influences, the cuisine of the area is well represented at Andrew's.Don't be put off by the hike up the slightly scruffy stairway to reach the restaurant - it's well worth going.Show less

Author: 305samb
Title: Lovely homely food
Review: Lush food in a local setting - try the black pepper beef - my favourite dish there although all the food was great.  Restaurant was full by 8 so book or head there early.

Author: Cindy Y
Title: Friendly owner and cooks from their hearts
Review: Have been visiting this restaurant every year during our cheng beng trips for past 10 years. Never fails to stop and have a really hearty and delicious meal from this family run restaurant!

Author: Mathilde A
Title: Very nice
Review: Had dinner with my daughter. Very Nice food and good service. However come early or remember to book :). Its a popular place

Author: webheathRedditch, United Kingdom
Title: Fantastic value all round.
Review: 8th consecutive year of eating at Andrew's while on holiday and yet to be disappointed. Tremendous value for money throughout a very extensive menu. Andrew and his staff always provide superb service with enthusiastic and honest advice if required. A must visit but suggest booking in advance to avoid disappointment. Mr Medium. Show less

Author: Epatrickbarber
Title: Dinner at Andrew's Kampung
Review:
Good relaxed atmosphere, excellent service and food.
Great speciality dishes including Andrew
's own spring rolls and spicy squid. Tom Yum soup also excellent.
We went 3 times in a space of 10 days!
Only downside is the price of wine!

Author: jacksU1396EP
Title: Great food and people
Review:
Nice food , reasonable price for portion offered and friendly owner.
Authentic taste, variety selection and good service.
Would strongly recommend although place a little bit cramp but still manageable.
Located at 2nd floor opposite golden sand resort.

Author: pugpie
Title: A Must visit
Review: After reading on trip adviser and speaking to people at our hotels, Andrews was always the first place mentioned, we ate here a couple of times, always receiving a warm welcome, from Andrew and his staff, the food was delicious, a must try is Andrews Marmite Chicken, its place we look forward to whenever we visit PenangShow less

Author: Amelia LSomerset, United Kingdom
Title: Lovely food, great place to eat.
Review: We were recommended to try this place and were so happy with the food and service, we returned 3 more times!! It's definitely in my opinion the best restaurant in the area. The menu is really great, the crispy fried squid with onions being an absolute favourite which we ordered every time!! Andrew will tell you anything you need to know about any of the dishes and is a great host- friendly, welcoming, generally very nice person. the waitresses are also excellent and friendly, by the time we came for the 3rd time, , we didn't need to ask for the wine and a separate Sprite -it just arrived with an ice bucket. Great part of our holiday!! Show less

Author: customer873
Title: Great food
Review: We ate at Andrews tonight and it was the best food so far on our holiday, I would strongly recommend this place  for quality food at a very reasonable price.

Author: misstravelbug-ukUK
Title: Great menu choice, lively surroundings
Review: We went based on all the great reviews, it is very close to the Shangri-la Rasa Sayang. We didn't try other restaurants in the area so can't really compare but there was a good selection of menu offerings and price was reasonable. Ability to choose half portions was good too. Looks like a favourite of nearby hotels (lots of tourists here). The food was good though not particularly memorable. We didn't feel the need to go back though noted there seemed to be nearby patrons who were regulars.Show less

Author: Nursetraveller91London, United Kingdom
Title: Amazing buffet
Review: Second time going having returned to Penang. Such a warm welcome and the buffet menu has such a huge choice of protein with different sauces you won't know where to start. Started as fresh and it's all cooked to order. What you want is what you get. No need to watch your waistline here. Andrew is so kind. Show less

Author: Alyson W
Title: Loud evening
Review: Food O.K. but after climbing 2 floors found high temperature and humidity hard to handle.Also mine-host somewhat vocal.Long Beach cafe across road,food hall with abundant choice and noisy but buzzy.Fans keep temperature more bearable and at ground level.

Author: stevetanyaTexasDenver, Colorado
Title: Great Food, Great Service, Reasonable Prices
Review: I have written over 200 reviews on Trip Advisor and believe in the power of feedback. I hope you find my review helpful.We found Andrew's on Trip Advisor. This is NOT a high-end restaurant but a good choice for tourists wanting local flavors without breaking the bank.Andrew, the owner, is very high energy and willing to explain everything to you in detail. He is over-the-top in friendliness and will ensure you are satisfied.They even got one of our orders wrong and he quickly sand efficiently removed the plate and had the correct plate to us in minutes.We had for an appetizer scallops with baked cheese. Good.Also my wife ordered deep fried squid with garlic. She loved it. I didn't care for it. Too much batter.For mains we ordered the sizzling chicken. It was awesome. We also ordered the anchovy fried rice. They served the pineapple fried rice by mistake which was awesome. The anchovy fried rice was ok but not great. We also ordered broccoli as a side and it was scrumptious.I would go back again and again. Show less

Author: kj51ordCardiff, United Kingdom
Title: Great food, Great time!
Review: When you see that a place is toward the top of the tree on trip advisor, there is, I guess, a temptation to think that it must offer 5 star surroundings and fine dining.If you are looking for fine dining, Andrews is not going to deliver, but make no mistake, the food is excellent! There are high standards striven for in this restaurant too - watching Andrew trying to get his staff to realise that iced water should be served with the same finesse as a bottle white wine must rate as some of the best entertainment that I encountered last month!All the staff are willing to please, service is snappy and attentive. Andrew himself always has a word for all of his customers. I visited twice and didn't come away disappointed either time. The food is honest and well prepared; it's generally cheap too. Book because it's nearly always full, but. Don't be. Too surprised if you've got to. Wait for the table to. Become free. It's that sort of place. Go with the flow and you'll love it!Show less

Author: Gavin MMelbourne, Australia
Title: Great place to have fun
Review: This place is first class. Food great , cheap and the atmosphere fantastic.Andrew was a great host and staff helpful. You better book.Yes it looks average from the road but it is a must if you are looking for a good laugh. Never got to meet The Chef, Andrews hard working brother.Keep up the great work.Show less

Author: raygo2Cardiff, United Kingdom
Title: Welcome & service excellent but food ordinary
Review: Andrew seems a genuinely warm and friendly host who gave a sincere welcome and found time for all his customers. The setting is unusual but we liked it as taking-over the adjacent balcony areas gives plenty of seating with a good airflow due to the 2nd floor position. The food was perfectly adequate but we thought not quite to the standard of some of the other, similarly priced budget restaurants listed positively on Tripadvisor. We would still visit again however as we enjoyed our visit to Andrew's. Show less

Author: MikeyVonnyOkehampton, United Kingdom
Title: Fabulous experience
Review: As has been mentioned in previous reviews don't be put off by the location as the food is spectacular and very inexpensive All the staff are excellent and work there socks off to make sure you have a great time Best to book though as its full of returning customersShow less

Author: jackw53London, United Kingdom
