Title: A for Andrew A* For Food and Service
Review: My wife and I are no strangers to Andrew's having first visited back in 2014 and again in 2015. Here we are in 2016 and the place is still our number 1 in Batu Ferringhi. What is clear in 2016 is just how popular this establishment is with both local and tourists alike. I will refrain from mentioning the location as this has been covered in previous reviews. However I can't not mention the tasty food, great service and "mine host". I have to admit to us being Andrew Groupies. Andrew makes a good establishment outstanding and his eye for detail, his sound advice ( not only on the menu items) set him apart from other local hosts. Eating at Andrew's for us is like eating with the family.Show less

Author: TheTimeBandits
Title: Great recommendations
Review:
Number one rating, and you can see why.
Excellent service, great food at reasonable prices.
Make sure you make a reservation as regular customers return again and again,  although Andrew seems to find space for everyone.

Author: DazFPeterborough, United Kingdom
Title: Wow, a gem to find!
Review: Recommended by fellow guests at the Golden Sands, we gave Andrews a try. Sceptical upon our arrival, plastic plates, sitting along a balcony corridor and inventive décor!! But the food, oh my word, simply the best Chinese food in Ferringhi area. And Andrew himself is such an enthusiastic friendly efficient host. I could almost guarantee you will go more than once to eat there. Just wish we'd found it earlier in our stay!!Show less

Author: 922warrendSingapore, Singapore
Title: Very friendly and very tasty food
Review: Wall to wall western tourists of a certain age greeted us. Like a tower block cruise ship. Word of mouth seemed to be the thing. The service was really excellent. Everyone was having fun and the food was really good. Fried Won ton starter and Malay Chicken Curry really good. It's a strange old location but persevere up the tower block steps to the 2nd floor and you will be glad you did. Show less

Author: moonirkLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Believe the hype!
Review: Read the reviews and had to go because of the ranking. We're not disappointed! The food is incredible and the service - including Andrew himself - is great. Love the fact they offer half portions of a lot of the dishes so we could try so many different items.Not the greatest decor and don't be put off by the access to the restaurant and you may have a short wait if you don't book in advance - but all worth it!Would definitely return!Show less

Author: RoyF31Newark-on-Trent, United Kingdom
Title: Good value
Review: The restaurant was very busy as it was Chinese New Year but we had booked a table and the service was excellent, Andrew is entertaining (it is almost a cabaret act) but he is a very efficient host and the staff were friendly and helpful.We were a little disappointed with the food my wife had garlic fish and ginger but could not taste the ginger. I had chilli beef but had to hunt for the chilli, both dishes were tasty but not what was expected. It is very popular with old ex pats and the spicing may reflect their taste. It was good value and worth a visit other dishes maybe less bland.Show less

Author: Diptendra p
Title: Just good food
Review: Just go for the tasty food an the added presence of the effervescent propertier forget about the ambience food is worth the visit...very good and cheap

Author: webheathRedditch, United Kingdom
Title: Never fails to satisfy.
Review: Andrew and staff never fail to provide exceptional food at superb prices. An extremely warm welcome is offered at all times irrespective of how intense his business is at the time. Always busy which is a good indicator with advance booking advised.Superb food at tremendously pleasantly suprising prices with consistent quality. Well done to all and having now visited for 8 consecutive years, will continue to be a frequent visitor when in Penang.Mr MediumShow less

Author: tatours
Title: Be entertained by Andrew
Review: ordinary setting with good food but the host andrew is a knockout it's a little hard to find  prices are ok

Author: Keith RGreater London, United Kingdom
Title: Great food, Great atmosphere - and lovely evening
Review: We had made a list of restaurants to visit, whilst on holiday, but found Andrew's difficult to find, although it is signposted- its on the second floor (take the lift)- its above the Bank.Great food, nice airy tables on the balconies- so great when the weather is hot. Food excellent- and service even better. Andrew took the time to answer all our questions on the numerous dishes he has on the menu- ie what they were.Particularly good was the Duck with pancakes & plum sauceWould certainly recommend this. Service excellent.Show less

Author: FilWiLinkoping, Sweden
Title: Good food, friendly service
Review: If you're into Indian food that's well spiced then you'll want to come to Andrew's Kampung (kampung, BTW, is the Malay word for "village").There is a limited selection of curries but they're well done and well served. The staff is friendly without being obnoxious. The downsides are the price, as you can get similar food cheaper in Batu Ferringhi, and the location, which is run down (the building, not the restaurant) and tends to be windy at night with tablecloths flapping about.Also, it's very popular so you'd better book a table if you want to be sure to get a spot.Show less

Author: SkpevansNottingham, United Kingdom
Title: Kampung experience
Review: It's always interesting reading other reviews , one thing is for sure there are always different experiences - Andrew's food is still excellent and we have waited another year to savour his pandam and sizzling dishes At front of house Andrew is at best and his staff are always pleasant and attentiveThere was a comment about the quality of the wine but this was no issue for us and his Wolf Bass Shiraz went down The walk or lift up to the resturant is perhaps not as aesthic as you would want but this is a small price to pay for a good night outShow less

Author: 920yenas
Title: Ok food
Review: After reading so many good reviews on this restaurant, my expectation was high. Food is ok but not great, taste is acceptable. Still ok if you want to try local food around this area

Author: Simone C
Title: Great food with amazing price
Review: We ate dinner set menus and they were great! There was plenty to eat and the waiters very diligent and always ready to satisfy any request. Excellent ratio quality/price! Will definitely return.

Author: martinprice1Chichester, United Kingdom
Title: Great tasting food
Review: This place at the time of writing this review was top rated on trip advisor so we thought we would give it a try. It's on the second floor of a large ugly looking building but we ventured up (using the lift cause it's baking hot) and met with a friendly welcome. The food was really tasty and a meal with drinks cost around the 100RM mark. So about £16 for the two of us! Great value and if you don't mind plastic chairs, which give it a certain charm then give it a go. Probably the tastiest food we had! Show less

Author: marcushenry14leeds
Title: Awful, Am I missing something here?
Review: Visited about a week ago after being recommended and reading trip advisor reviews. We were prepared for the entrance to the restaurant to be dirty as we had read that the lift experience was not great. However, I did not expect the restaurant to follow suit in terms of grubbiness. To make sure that the waiting staff kept in keeping with the restaurant and surroundings, they were also grubby and looked like they had just got out of bed!. Heard that the portions were large so decided against ordering starters. Ordered the sweet and sour jumbo prawns. Disappointed to receive a plate of only 6 prawns and they were certainly not jumbo!. I have seen bigger prawns in a Morrison's prawn cocktail. Noodles and rice are my favourite foods so you can imagine my annoyance when Andrew presented us with a half portion of each despite ordering normal portions. Remember that we had not ordered starters and had requested normal portions of rice and noodles. He took it upon himself to change our order without asking!!. He said we could order more if we wanted but why would I order more AFTER i had finished our main dishes?. To be fair, my wife's fish dish was very tasty and the beer was cold and cheap!. The wine was awful though. What amazes me is that the restaurant is obviously always busy. I fail to see why when anyone who eats here must surely eat better Chinese food at home. Yes, it's cheap but the food everywhere locally is cheap. Personally, I would avoid at all cost!!Show less

Author: Daniel ABangkok, Thailand
Title: Very recommendable restaurant at Batu Ferringhi
Review: This restaurant entirely lived up to expectations and the food we chose was delicious. It's a slightly scruffy unpretentious place yet a delight to eat there. The chilli jumbo prawns were excellent and we ordered their red wine which was fine. The owner and staff are delightful and I can well see why this is so popular while nearby restaurants are almost empty. It is also extremely good value.Show less

Author: Andrew MWelwyn, United Kingdom
Title: Many good things but does not deserve such a high position on TA
Review: I like to start with the good news. Andrew is a wonderful and enthusiastic host. If you are staying in one of the nearby hotels the value for money is awesome! (the wine's not so good, though still cheap by Malay standards, and beer is much recommended). The location is very easy and up on the open second floor a most pleasant breeze served as natural air conditioning. The menu is long and comprehensive, but not very informative - and a special deal table d'hote for MR20 is a special, deal indeed. Furthermore "half portions" are offered at an amazing price - and for us, they were the perfect size. So what about the food? A mistake to have garlic bread only because it is western and you don't come here for that. The samosas, out other starter were very unexciting. Expecting the Sichuan chicken to be to be the spiciest Andrew said no, the "devil chicken" was the best in those terms. And it was, delicious. But my wife's cashew nut chicken was very bland. Different rices - Kampung rice (house speciality) went well with the spicy chicken. The lemon tea was disappointing and did not seem to have seen much lemon.Show less

Author: Arthur MNottingham, United Kingdom
Title: The must visit place in Batu Ferringhi (if you can get a table).
Review: Andrew’s is a great place to eat.Firstly, the food is delicious. We had sizzling jumbo prawns. You got 6 medium size prawns for RM39. Plenty for one, but you need another dish if you are going to share. The taste was excellent.I then add devilled chicken, which was really hot and spicy, but properly cooked. Not that raw taste of spice you get in a bad restaurant where the food is undercooked, but really tasty and well blended. A half portion was around RM9 and was plenty for me with my half of the sizzling prawns.We finished off with the coffee icecream, which was really tasty. Not at all the usual plastic taste you get in many restaurants.As to the service, Andrew is totally hands on bustling around the tables making sure everyone is well served and is happy. He’s a fun character, but obviously also totally on top of everything going on in his restaurant. His staff were also good and very attentive, checking we were happy with the meal and taking orders efficiently and quickly.It was obvious that for many of the people eating at the restaurant, this was their second or third visit.The location is not wonderful, being on the second floor of a small shopping complex. There is a lift. Andrew has taken over one corner of the block and made it his own, with tables on the balcony and in the restaurant and fun decor. Note. It is closed on Tuesday and you need to get there early, or telephone to reserve a table. We got there about 7.15 and managed to get in before a reserved party at 8.30. Andrew said the night before he had turned 4 groups away as his small kitchen could just not cope with any more.Andrew deserves all the success in the world for his excellent restaurant which is why this is my first 5* of this holiday.Show less

Author: Henk MVlaardingen, The Netherlands
Title: On my Penang restaurant short list
Review: Yes, Andrew's Kampung, tucked away unobtrusively on the second floor of the "Eden Parade" building in Batu Ferringhi, opposite the Golden Sands Hotel, is, in my opinion, one of the best restaurants in Penang. The informal atmosphere, created by Andrew, the restaurant owner, with his unlimited hospitality, combined with a choice of delicious, freshly prepared Asian food, makes Andrew's Kampung what it is: Not to be passed up by serious food lovers. There are three ordering modes: Firstly there is the menu, you can order from freely, secondly a fixed price three course menu is offered with a limited selection of main courses and if that is not enough, an "all you can eat" order is offered for a fixed price. Thereby, prices are reasonable, even to be called modest. One new feature is that half-portions of a main course can be ordered. This is not only convenient for the guest with the limited appetite, but it is possible to order two half-portions for main course, enabling you to get two great dishes to taste. Before you hurry to Andrew's: The restaurant is closed on Tuesdays.Show less

Author: JasLevJohannesburg, South Africa
Title: Cheap and cheerful
Review: As South Africans, we travel on a very weak currency. So eateries with good service and great food at low prices are sought-after gems. This quirky restaurant manages to pull off a buzz and prestige even that belies its quite down-at-heel status. And that is due exclusively to two things: the focus on great flavours and the charming host, Andrew. We had a set menu which was super-reasonable and really tasty.The building it is in is central, but grubby; the decor is (artistically) rolled up magazines and faded lanterns; the scullery is in full view; the tables and chairs are all plastic...but none of it seems to detract somehow...Show less

Author: einnie
Title: Best value for the money in Batu Ferringhi
Review:
We had dinner here twice during a weeks vacation.
All four of us loved the food and the friendly service. Our last dinner was crispy duck made on order from the day before. Just perfect!

Author: Hin316Bishops Stortford, United Kingdom
Title: Great food, great prices and excellent service
Review: Don't be put off by the location, Andrews was the highlight of our trip. The welcome is friendly, the service is excellent and the food is exquisite! I particularly recommend the delightful Kapitan beef! we ended up eating there four nights out of seven. recommend booking as only a small number of tables. Show less

Author: potsUkWilmslow, United Kingdom
Title: Great food in tatty surroundings
Review: Loved the food, loved the prices, loved mine host, Andrew is a scream and the perfect host. Well worth a visit if in the vicinity. Please do not be put off by the locality and scruffy surroundings. The restaurant is on the second floor of a poorly maintained shopping mall across the road from the Golden Sands HotelShow less

Author: Mostly M
Title: Delicious and cheap
Review: We stopped by for late lunch about 3pm. Many choices on the menu but Andy (yes, I'm allowed to call him that) recommended the lunch special. I had dry chilli chicken and my wife sweet and sour chicken. Fresh and delicious and very reasonably priced at about 9 ringgit each. This includes rice and a drink of fresh iced tea or ice cream for dessert. We both loved our meals. Then again, we're just a couple of bogans.Show less

Author: Matthew W
Title: Best food for its money?
Review: Great food, great service and for a great price. I ordered the "reverse buffet" option here and just got drowned in piles of amazing food, but everything given was delicious, always something new to try here and all food quality is better than U would expect at any fine dine of the same food, but still down to a great price :)Show less

Author: MMAH10
Title: Simple and Local
Review: Nice simple local & Nonya dishes. Friendly service and clean place. Very relax place. recommend their crispy duck.

Author: aimzl87Melbourne, Australia
Title: Delicious and authentic food for a great price
Review: We only found Andrew's Kampung on our last night which was so disappointing as it was amazing and we could have eaten here every night. The set menu was about 20 ringgit each (approx $7AUD) and the food was fresh and tasty. We shared a chicken masala curry and a Malaysian beef curry and we couldn't fault either of them, they were stunning! Probably the best curries we've had on our trip to Malaysia. We also ordered some wontons and some nasi kampung (it was our last night so we needed a final fix) and they were delicious. With a beer and wine the night cost us about $25AUD. Would highly recommend stopping here if in BF, you won't regret it! Show less

Author: Catieoz
Title: Cheap option
Review: Reviews were raving about this place so thought we would go. We didn't know there was a lift ( side entrance near KFC) so went up 4 flights of stairs. If you are looking for a tidy clean looking restaurant then this is not the place. The front counter looked like it hadn't been cleaned in years and there was junk around the various shelves. Service was OK by waitress but certainly improved when Andrew turned up about half hour into our meal. The 19RM set menu was an excellent choice . The food was nice but Ferrenghi Garden is much better qualityShow less

Author: Lin B
Title: Worth a visit
Review: Visited because of reviews and as was local to our hotel, The Golden Sands Resort.Was busy when we arrived but were found a table quickly. Nice breeze as on the 2nd floor. We chose from set price menu, 3 courses just over £3.00. Good sized tasty food....the spring rolls were huge and delicious.Andrew is defiantly a character and there seemed to be many regular visitors who he greeted warmly.Good atmosphere and good food.Show less

Author: markbH558NFPerth, Australia
Title: Great Local Food
Review: We were lucky to be recommended Andrew's Kampung by the hotel staff before realising it was so highly rated on Trip Advisor.Great food and service by Andrew who took great pride in looking after us. We like good local food and Andrew's Kampung certainly fit the bill. There is a 39RM all you can eat special, however I would recommend going a la carte both my wife and I thought the quality/taste of the a la carte dishes was better. Was filled mainly with tourists which is not a problem when the food is good which it is, high turner over of food means what you are eating is usually fresh.Would happily recommend Andrew's Kampung.Show less

Author: BryonySmerdonLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Dinner with Penang's most fabulous host
Review: Living up to its title as a 'kampung' (meaning village in Malaysian) Andrew's self-titled restaurant serves wholesome and delicious food in a fun and bustling atmosphere. Portions are generous, well priced and do not lack in flavour. Andrew was a gracious and entertaining host, making us feel more than welcome in his kitchen. On my first visit I ordered they clay-pot bean curd (a vegetarian dish) and Andrew was sure to ask me if I was happy to have my meal cooked with egg and oyster sauce. Served with a smile, it was delicious. I will definitely be going back every time I'm in Penang!Show less

Author: snapytom
Title: Anytime
Review: Andrew's is hard to find but worth looking for. His food is first class and cheap and Andrew is a lovely person. We are looking forward to our next visit, which is soon.

Author: Amarjeet BUnited Kingdom
Title: Good food with excellent service!
Review: I really enjoyed my visit. The entrance way was a bit intimidating, going up some poorly lit and not particularly clean stairs. However when you reach Andrew's restaurant all our fear vanished as we greeting by the friendly Andrew. We enjoyed our reasonably priced meal, one of the better offerings in the area, I would recommend the restaurant to those who are tiring of their hotels selection.Show less

Author: stevendH7037EZ
Title: Dont miss out do it.
Review: Party of 10,and Andrew really turned it on. His humour, style and the way he presents his food is outstanding.Food was superb and the beers ice cold. Perfect for Penang.A must do in Penang don't worry about the décor just sit down and eat and you wont be disappointed.Very well priced $16AUD per head for quality food,I will return.Show less

Author: DavisDreamer
Title: Must come and eat here!
Review: Brilliant! We enjoyed the atmosphere from the moment we walked in, Andrew is a very entertaining person. Food was excellent and we will definitely go back every time we visit Penang.

Author: 863rachellfMudgeeraba, Australia
Title: Number 1 for a reason
Review: Found this on Trip Advisor and well worth the rating. They squeezed 2 of us in without a booking, probably recommend that next time and great service. The owner Andrew is quite entertaining and lovely to many rerurned customers. The food is great and reasonably priced too. The duck pancakes were really good and filling too, the curry beef, honey plum chicken were amazing aswell. Would definitely recommend and we will go back. Loved the plastic bottle chandeliers :)Show less

Author: astyli
Title: Really good food
Review: Great service and authentic Chinese food. Tucked away on the 2nd floor but go and check it out. We were the only ones there at first but others found it too. We have eaten at places that we have read reviews

Author: ColBerger
Title: Definitely Worth No. 1 Rating
Review: Andrew is the most wonderful host. So friendly and accommodating. His family assist and work at the restaurant and made us feel at home. The food was great and good value for money too. Great fish, spring rolls, duck with pancakes are a must. Go and enjoy this hidden gem Show less

Author: iancU8632AGDublin, Ireland
Title: So So food and rushed service
Review: I went here on the basis of the TripAdvisor rating. The food quality was average and the service was rushed. I asked the proprietor (Andrew) to suggest his 4 best main courses. Sizzling Jumbo Prawns - 5 medium sized prawns for RN39.Thai Beef curry, Malaysian Chicken Curry and Sweet & Sour pork. All were reasonably tasty but the portions were small (Not the small size - the regular size) and just dropped on dinner plates - No presentation.We've been in the area for the last 4 days and eaten out for every meal.. It was not bad but based on our experience in other restaurants nearby - it was below averageShow less

Author: LaurenceMacraeDoha, Qatar
Title: Great value for money
Review: This is a great place to go and eat , the staff are all really nice and the food is excellent. I shared sizzling chicken & lemon chicken , with fried rice and noodles with my wife and daughter and it was superb! It was very busy but we were served very quickly , would highly recommend a visit. Show less

Author: sionghoe
Title: Nice food
Review: Nice Chinese food and halal too. The fried sweet potato leaves was very nice and staff was very friendly too. The restaurant is very windy when we ate there during lunch.

Author: DamianW1247
Title: Good food
Review: Very enjoyable.  Will go back again. Food was tasty. Service was a little frantic but not a problem. Very reasonably priced and family friendly.

Author: TraceyPedersenMelbourne, Australia
Title: Food To Die For!
Review: I've been to Andrew's Kampung several times now and every time is great. The food is excellent and Andrew is truly a lovely man. He's always cheery with a ready smile for everyone. The all-you-can-eat menu is extensive and every dish is lovely. Be prepared to wait a little as there are many people ordering lots of different dishes. It also pays to make a reservation as this place gets busier every time we come. Also appears to be open for lunch now. Can't wait to go back!Show less

Author: H3llsb3llsCambs
Title: Good food
Review: Not the best location or surroundings but the food is very good. We hadn't made a reservation so were asked to sit in an air conditioned room whilst a table became free but we actually ended up eating there which was quite nice as it was cool. No frills but good quality food. The spring roll starters are big and the quality of the meat in the main dishes was very good. Set menu for just under 20 RM. Great value. Show less

Author: SarahG534
Title: Amazing Chinese food
Review:
Price of the food here is great and the service is the best. 

All of the dishes we had were beautiful and we left nothing on our plates.

Author: KimP557
Title: Authentic Asian setting
Review: Read the reviews this afternoon Visited this evening was-not disappointed Authentic Asian , plastic tables chairs plates , nothing fancy But Andrew and his staff so friendly and wow the food was fantastic , hot,plentiful and very tasty loved all the fresh vegetables and the Thai fried snapper was lovely And so very cheap , eat with the locals you won't be disappointed Show less

Author: David C
Title: Great food
Review: We enjoyed our meal here. The duck was very good. All the dishes are freshly cooked . Will eat here again.

Author: KL C
Title: First visit
Review: The waitress recommendations for food was quite OK. But not up to my expectation as the rating in TripAdvisor was quite high. Maybe we have not order the right food.We sit outside of the restaurant and you can fell the breeze of the wind.The location is good, just walking distance from Golden Sand Hotel. The restaurant is located at 2nd floor and you need to walk up because no lift.The staff services was good and friendly. We may come back again.Show less

Author: KL_Chong2014Rawang, Malaysia
Title: Evening dinner, first visit
Review: The waitress recommendations for food was quite OK. But not up to my expectation as the rating in TripAdvisor was high.The location is good, just walking distance from Golden Sand Hotel. But You need to walk up to 2nd floor cause no lift.We sit outside and the environment is good, you can feel the breeze of wind.May come back again for next round to try others.Show less

Author: Sheree T
Title: Never judge a book by its cover
Review: This little gem is hidden. You will need to vlimb a few flights of stairs to get here. But its definately worth it we had a lunch special for 2 people AUD $7 included a beautiful iced lime tea. Cant wait to go back 😄

Author: 747HolsxUnited Kingdom
Title: Just as good as we remembered
Review: We visited Andrew's again on our visit this year and receive very warm welcome and an excellent meal. We both had the all you can eat menu but didn't over order. Crispy squid, wontun, fish cake & spring rolls all excellent. We followed up with lemon chicken, teriyaki chicken & Thai chilli beef + egg fried rice all very tasty & freshly cooked. We had ice cream to finish & e glasses of wine all for approx £20 - you can't go wrong by visiting here for aa meal. At the end Andrew dropped us back to our hotel for no extra cost. He is a really lovely man who deserves to be successful. Show less

Author: Linda O
Title: Ok !!
Review: Maybe it was my choice of food, but I found it a bit bland and boring which was a shame, however, It is lovely to see Andrew trying so hard to make the business a success. He is so friendly and make us really welcome.

Author: Luyksgestelkid
Title: Very good food and excellent service. Worth persevering to find it.
Review: Not the most salubrious location (with lifts & escalator not working) but the struggle up the back stairs was rewarded by an excellent freshly cooked meal at a very reasonable price. The view over towards the sea was very pleasant too.

Author: joanp927
Title: Magical place to eat
Review: The service is faultless, the food is fantastic and the price is so good. Eat here once and you WILL return!  We have been 3 times and this is trip advisor number 1 for good reason. What lush food

Author: Kris_thenomad07Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Spacious, vintage themed Cafe, good food
Review: The cafe did lived up to the expectations from the reviews. The interior has a vintage charm with posters and arts from the yesteryears. The food was good to great though the choices were bit limited. They wouldn’t accept cards for payments and no sign outside, luckily I had some cash - hence lower rating.Show less

Author: ItsSashabdullah
Title: The Best Breakfast/ Brunch EVER
Review:
Been coming for more than 2 years now, the service is always nice and the food quality never cease to amaze!

Highly recommended!

Author: Olex_KL
Title: Overrated
Review: This is probably the worst food I’ve ever had in Penang. I don’t understand how this place get so high rating . Absolutely not worth it.

Author: NgKS9368George Town, Malaysia
Title: Lunch
Review: First time been there & love their atmosphere. You can see their collections on old stuff and still in good condition. Strongly recommend to order their tomato soup (one of the best tomato soup in town) and variety of choices on main dishes - western, Chinese, etc. Definitely will go back again especially for the tomato soup.Show less

Author: nigel g
Title: excellent breakfast venue
Review:
Had breakfast here a number of times over the past year and always found  the  food and service 100 per cent
Highly recommend this little corner venue

Author: Harrison-F-Carter
Title: Nice place - good food
Review: Nice place for breakfast - small and friendly with a nice selection of options for breakfast. Recommended.

Author: Tasha WKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Great Western Breakfast, some with a Malaysian twist
Review: The bread they use for toast here is very lush and it's nice you get such a big slice with your breakfast! I had the omelette with sambal - it was so savoury. I also had the banana and berry pancake but be warned it comes with ice cream.The staff are friendly and quick with service. I would recommend making a stop here for breakfast if you can!Show less

Author: nolw474
Title: Best place and best food !
Review:
Best place and best food ! 
The place is quiet and the staff is really friendly!
Nice deco and very clean place
Don’t hesitate !

Author: SimoIT69
Title: A very good place to stay, to eat and to drink!
Review: Clean, confortable and cosy small restautant and bar. Very good food and drink. Friendly, helpful and thoughtful staff!

Author: UnicornPoopoo
Title: Chilli Scramble Eggs
Review:
Had the Chilli Scramble Eggs and they were great (just abit oily for me). 
Great portion too. 
Would go back again to try more dishes. :)

Author: DomirwinHong Kong, China
Title: Excellent Coffee - Cool Ambience
Review: Just had coffee and a ginger tea but this was so good (and so prepared with love and care) that we went back a second time. It’s a cool place with a bohemian type atmosphere and is great as a literal “pit stop” when exploring old Georgetown. Frequented by expats, tourists and local families. Recommended.Show less

Author: BillH3079
Title: Homey place and great food
Review: Nice good, fast service and really delicious western breakfast brunch food. Adequate selection of food and interior decor is really charming although a little small. Price wise is pretty decent as well.

Author: Dave H
Title: Good Breakfast
Review: Thanks you for the good breakfast and the good service. The waitress is very kind and the place had An great ambiance.

Author: Dom B
Title: Definitely recommend
Review: Really nice place, came for breakfast had a lovely pancake and coffee served by really friendly staff.

Author: dharumiy
Title: Well served!
Review: Really tasty Tuna and Cheese Sandwich for breakfast! It comes with a small portion of salad and fries! Also the orange juice is so fresh!

Author: soniamajumder
Title: Breakfast
Review: Really good breakfast and great polite customer service! Street art decor, cozy atmosphere and couches! Definitely recommend this for a reasonable priced breakfast.

Author: NataliaK6151
Title: Best place for breakfast
Review: I was staying in Georgetown for two weeks and this was my fav place to have my breakfast. Super friendly staff and the most delicious omelettes and pancakes you’ve ever tried!

Author: CanmoreFunkyDudeCanmore, Canada
Title: Great Breakfast Cafe
Review: Located on Lorong Chulia, which runs parallel to Love Lane, just up from the night hawker market. A fairly eclectic little place, with an interesting “flea market” decor. The menu offers a bit of everything you would expect in a cafe, but I was there for breakfast, as the offering at my hotel was very short of satisfying. I ordered the chili scrambled eggs, which were excellent, and came on a plate loaded with exquisitely grilled cherry tomatoes, a generous serving of grilled back bacon, toast, and a hash brown patty that had been wok grilled, not deep fried, and could have passed for home made, if it wasn’t for the tell tale shape. I was very impressed. The service was excellent too. MYR 15, including tax and tip.Show less

Author: Packidge
Title: An excellent place for breakfast
Review: If I'm in town in the morning this is my goto place for coffee and breakfast. There is a good selection of choices and the decor is very typical of such cofee houses in Penang

Author: KimmyM354
Title: Very Good Service
Review: Came here twice for breakfast , Had their western breakfast & chicken curry, their pancake with banana is also really nice ,  service was friendly & good. Food was fresh & good coffee. Definitely worth a try !!

Author: sharonjenko
Title: Excellent breakfast
Review: After a stressful morning at the Thai visa office, the excellent breakfasts cheered us up, coffee was great and I recommend the chilli scrambled eggs.

Author: Richards1250Peterborough, United Kingdom
Title: Breakfastic
Review: Came here for breakfast one morning and was delightfully surprised how wonderful the experience was. Ordered the omelette was truly tasty. The thing that stood out then most was the wonderful service, the gentleman who brought our food over was very proud of his homemade tomato sauce, he was right to be it was very good! To top it off was the fruit they brought over at the end, knowing we were tourists probably wanted us to try the local fruit. Was a really nice touch, would highly recommend.Show less

Author: Frode R
Title: Nice place serving good breakfast
Review: Cozy place serving good breakfast and good coffee. Placed in a quiet street. I had western style breakfast with eggs, bacon and some bread.

Author: Rallycat99
Title: PitStop
Review: I would Highly recommend Pit Stop. Clean atmosphere & delicious food! Definitely try the Vinegar pork.

Author: Ilgnim
Title: Decent breakfast
Review: Service was good and the waiter had a great eye for detail, saw three of us ordering only one breakfast set and he prepared three small plates and cutlery sets without us asking. Very attentive to customers as well.

Author: Berlin347
Title: Coffee made me feel welcome
Review:
The nice message which they left on my coffee made me smile :-)

I don't have anything to add but TripAdvisor requires me to write more...

Author: terencem76
Title: Delicious breakfast in a relaxed environment
Review:
This cafe has been around for quite some time.
Good food (recommend sandwiches, pesto pasta)
Good service
Good environment
Reasonable price for portion.

Author: itsjamielee
Title: Great brunch with lovely details
Review: The brunch was delicious and the cafe latte was served with lovely art. We ordered the big breakfast and three little pigs omelette. Afterwards we were served with free little mango-cheesecake cones as dessert. Recommended plan a for a relaxing and delicious breakfast/ brunch close to the street art area.Show less

Author: Chelsea M
Title: Chili scrambled eggs!
Review: Fantastic breakfast in a really nice environment. I had the old school breakfast with proper bacon, good hash brown and chili scrambled eggs which were delicious. Highly recommended!

Author: Manuhar JIndia
Title: Little Gem!!!
Review: A small little restaurant in the corner of a alley, blink the eye and you miss it. Went there after reading some amazing reviews and the place was above expectation. Sitting in quite street and having their lovely tomato soup feel so relaxed.Staff working here are just superb and so charming people. Highly recommended to visit for a relaxing timeShow less

Author: Patricia H
Title: Cute find
Review: Good food, fast service. However some napkins would have been appreciated. Other than that, tasty food and great location :)

Author: mrsmalkey
Title: Amazing breakfast
Review: This lovely cafe with friendly, capable staff & a great menu delivered a spectacular breakfast to every member of our family.  So good we enjoyed an encore the next day & received this same delicious food & great service. Highly recommend a visit

Author: 492benoitb
Title: Great breakfast & coffee in Penang
Review: Felt so good to have a nice breakfast & coffee since we left haha...Great food and nice restaurant inside...Staff very nice and competent. Would come back for sure !!

Author: CheeWah_ChanPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: One of the best black vinegar pork trotters in Penang
Review: Pit Stop no. 12 - an ideal place for breakfast, brunch and lunch, serves one of the best black vinegar pork trotters in Penang. Also recommending their breakfast set such as Mushy Mushy with omelette stuffed with mushroom, served with hashed brown with garden salad as side dishes. Western, pasta, rice and noodle sets are also available in the premise.Show less

Author: Freedom253951
Title: Great breakfast/coffee
Review: We stayed in Georgetown for 5 nights, and we came here 3 times for breakfast. The chili scrambled eggs were my favorite, and the prices were very reasonable. The service was top notch, highly recommend!

Author: lourdesdassp
Title: Mothers day
Review: Had oriental Chicken and black pepper Chops .Weĺl done and tender.The service is very good and the prices are reasonable .

Author: 632joant
Title: Breakfast
Review: Taking a break from Hawker food. Good Western breakfast especially scrambled eggs with chili (Chilli crab aftertaste). Tuna sandwich was decent. Coffee was good. The retro ambience was excellent. Worth another visit!

Author: _Z6822HA
Title: Perfect place for pitstop))
Review: Lovely place for breakfast or coffee break. Good choice of food. Breakfast is varied. Just one advice for owner. Add more desserts, then your guests will enjoy coffee even more. I can recommended!! Price is normal as for Penang

Author: 727yingc
Title: Nice chillout place
Review:
Came here to escape from the heat and to sit somewhere to use wi-fi.

It's a nice place, the drinks are good (strawberry and lime crush is tasty!). The staff are friendly and attentive.

Author: CatLowHSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good service
Review: Went there during late afternoon with a Friend. Ordered a salad and a drink - there was a mixed up of my drink to my friends' - the waitress replaced our drinks without being asked. Not to forget the food is fantastic as well. Atmosphere is quaint and overall, a nice lazy afternoon spent.Show less

Author: CarolineG1083London, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent breakfast and nice place to chill out
Review: We came to the cafe for breakfast as we had a craving for a more Western style meal after a few months of noodles and rice! The food was delicious - we had bacon, eggs, toast and hash brown and you get a deal on tea and coffee with breakfast. The staff are very friendly. After breakfast we stayed for a while to relax and do some work on the laptop (there is wifi and plug points). We were not rushed at all. A bit later also had a strawberry and lime juice which I highly recommend!Show less

Author: 932stmLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Great Lunch
Review: I had a lovely bowl of Udon for lunch, the staff are friendly & service was promt. The decor & seating is in keeping with that part of town & comfortable making it a perfect place to refuel & escape from the heat of the mid-day sun for an hour or so.Show less

Author: Roznat2013Bangkok, Thailand
Title: Best breakfast we had during our stay!
Review: I waited 5 days to write this as we wanted to try a few other places but can honestly say this was the best place for breakfast. They do a great selection and are happy to take a special order. From pancakes to bagels to real bacon and lovely sour dough toast this place is great and only wish we hadn't bothered trying others. We popped back in for coffee and cake and that was just as cool and the lunches we saw being served looked amazing. One of the best wifi connections and happy to let you charge your phones etc., whereas some places ask you not to so be warned.Great place and will be back again, highly recommended.Show less

Author: JS_Li_0319Singapore
Title: Worth a visit, nice chill out hangout
Review: Randomly found this cafe online, and decide to give it a try since its recommended. The time and money are well spent over here. Located at the junction along Lorong Chulia and Lonrong Pasar.Its a fusion style cafe with a mixture of western, italian and chinese. The vinegar pig's trotter and chicken chop are delicious and affordable. But the choco pancake is a dismay, its dry and abit hard. Coffee is nice as well.Show less

Author: Chloe L
Title: chilled out cafe - good for breakfast
Review: nice little cafe - does nice breakfasts (around 12ringitt) not quite as good as breakfast in UK but nice enough!!

Author: Londontraveller1964XLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Tasty all day breakfast and superb lemon,lime ice crush
Review: Stopped here as two sweaty 50 year olds whilst walking around GT. Very quick service gives you a free cup of water and on our first visit we ordered a lemon and lime ice crush and a strawberry and lime ice crish.They are 10 MYR each but seriously worth it. A lovely place to sit outside but also reat comfortable aircon inside.Went a few days later for late breakfast and had a great mushy omlette and milk shake. Cant fault the place .Quick service and top quality food and drink.Show less

Author: 210charlinem
Title: Worth a visit
Review:
Super nice and helpful staff. High standards in comparison to what we have experienced in service in Penang.
Food was good, had the mushy mushy omelette and a fresh Apple juice ( you gotta try it, so good!)

Author: Deirdre M
Title: Good Cafe with a Solid Western Breakfast
Review: I came here for breakfast and some coffee. The breakfast I ordered included eggs, bacon, a hash brown and toast. The meal was good enough that I came back again! Their coffee is also good, and I lingered and read my book both times I came here. The staff is really lovely, as well!Show less

Author: sleepyd88
Title: Luncj
Review:
We needed a quick pit stop to keep us going for the afternoon

Staff are very friendly and the food is good but not exceptional. 

Prices are very reasonable. 

We had local curry kapitan and green curry. 

It won't disappoint.

Author: traveller7301
Title: Cozy, quiet & relaxing
Review:
I don't need to say much other than to check it out. One of the best coffee & cafe joints in Penang. 
Reasonable priced. 
Take it from me when I say one of the best. I am a coffee snob!

Author: Ed B
Title: Quality little cafe!
Review: Lovely setting and decor with super friendly staff. Not huge selection of food but food itself very nice! I can recommend the bacon and cheese sandwich (13 rm). Worth the visit

Author: AthieDev
Title: “Great ambience and food!”
Review:
Tasty food. Friendly staffs. Nice place.

P/s:- should improve the salad presentation and the strawberry milkshake.☺

Author: AaronChng88
Title: Cosy cafe friendly staffs!
Review:
Set in a corner unit along Chulia and Pasar street.

Open from 9am daily. 

Welcomed by a smiley staff. Yes, they do have baby chairs and its air-conditioned. 

Good spread of European and local delights.

Unable to comment on food as we only had breakfast.

Author: Stev609
Title: Good service, decent food & coffee
Review: The end of a long day when dropped in less than an hour before the kitchen closed. Was greeted promptly & overall good service shown. All day breakfast (had pigs in the blanket) & coffee ordered was decent.

Author: Fabio U
Title: Good place for a snack
Review: Excellent restaurant to have a meal or a tea .The place seems clean, with a nice atmosphere, good service and good menu. There are not so many table do you keep your intimidate.

Author: Jack M
Title: Decent cafe amongst hundreds of hipster cafes in Penang.
Review: We went here for lunch and was completely satisfied. We had juices (strawberry & lime and a fresh apple juice, both of which were really nice). Between us we had a tuna & cheese sandwich which was decent (can't really go wrong) and the kapitan chicken curry with deep fried dough (I can't remember the name). This was really tasty and full of flavour. The atmosphere is good and the staff are friendly and helpful. Show less

Author: JazzyJeff_16168Poole, United Kingdom
Title: So glad I found this place.
Review: Unbelievable food and at reasonable if not cheap price. The main guy that serves you is so polite and friendly. This place really is worth a visit the food is just delicious and makes a lovely change from all the street food and Indian food in George town.Show less

Author: juliana74Singapore, Singapore
Title: A delightful find
Review: Chanced upon this place while strolling along Lebuh Chulia and turned into Lorong Chulia to look at a restored house. Has a vintage charm, tucked in a corner. Had an iced lemon tea so can't vouch for the coffee. The menu had breakfast items. Nice little spot to take a break from the heat!Show less

Author: Alexander6011Tauranga, New Zealand
Title: A cute cafe run by a great team
Review: This morning I was able to get into this cafe. My first visit was postponed because the cafe was packed and no one seemed in a hurry to go anywhere else. Pit Stop no. 12 is a cute place. It's not big. There are four of five tables, some comfortable chairs and a few tables outside. I was lucky enough to get one of the comfy seats. The guys are friendly and attentive. This is the only cafe where they've provided water and keep topping it up. The Lavazza coffee was a treat, so much so that I had a second cup. The bacon and cheese omelet made for a great light, second breakfast. On my 'go back here' list.Show less

Author: AnnaL10249
Title: Delicious food
Review:
Good taste of food & best service..
Like this place, relax..
All the staff are very friendly..
Cappuccino & alio olio pasta my favorite ..
Must drop by to try up..

Author: Mika C
Title: Mediocre food but good ambience
Review: Food is quite mediocre with typical English type of breakfast. But staff were quite professional and the overall ambience is pleasant.

Author: 912shrutim
Title: Amazing
Review: Had breakfast here. Excellent service, good prices and delicious food. The tomato soup was the best I've had :) will definitely come back here again

Author: hkaidolavenPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: A hidden gem for affordable good english breakfast
Review: Serves great hot coffees, with special cartoonised coffee arts. Service is fast. Great value for the portion served. I always remember the first time I discovered this shop while driving passing by and decided to give it a shot. Later it becomes top 5 in my revisit list of penang cafes :)Show less

Author: ElvyFoodTravel
Title: Great food and great service
Review: I went to this cafe for so many times and their food quality & drinks are always really good. Great service and environment too. Worth a visit for tourists.

Author: 598marcusp
Title: Worth a visit
Review: Reasonable prices, great menu that highlights the recommendations. We had the pork stew and it was delicious. The lemon & lime crush was also a good pick. Free wifi is provided while you wait for your food. Enjoy!

Author: GLS76Penang Island, Malaysia
Title: Good Breakfast
Review: Went there with family for breakfast. We ordered the omelette with mushroom and cheese, the scrambled eggs and pancake with nutella and cashew nuts. Overall breakfast was good. Ambiance is nice and quiet. Service was good too. We also packed the vinegar pork trotter and mum loved it!Show less

Author: 554johannag
Title: Great service and coffee
Review: Went there today for breakfast which was really good. Also food and drinks arrived fast (not a given in Malaysia). Coffee was just great! Service really attentive and sweet. They even wrote "Happy Valentines Day" on my coffee. Would definitely recommend going there!

Author: HP8_11
Title: Pretty Good and cool in the heat
Review: Very nice  place with cool air in the historic centre. We stopped for lunch, which was good particularly the kapitan chicken.

Author: TropicalPenquin
Title: Good outdoor seats, nice coffee and free wifi
Review: We loved the outdoor seats and always sat outdoor, the indoor seats look comfy. The coffee served here is good to also ginger lemongrass tea. We did not try their food but from our observation, all dishes look very inviting and yummy.

Author: 755lucky22London, United Kingdom
Title: A little gem
Review: I came across the Pit Stop no. 12 by accident, and decided to pop in for a coffee. What a lovely little café, with friendly staff, interesting décor and good coffee.My coffee took a while to arrive, which was not a problem as I appreciated finding shade from the sun, and when it did there was a cute little note on top that made me laugh. Reading other reviews, I wish I had gone back for some lunch.Show less

Author: nellielim
Title: Cozy cafe
Review: Stumbled upon this cozy cafe while exploring street art around the Heritage site. Serves a good breakfast but expensive by Penang standards seeing as the portions were quite small.  Anyway food was good and the pancakes delicious. Friendly owner and staff.

Author: Lucy B
Title: Great pancakes!
Review: Came here for breakfast and had delicious pancakes. Wasn't too badly priced and came decorated very nicely! Vanilla milkshake was also amazing.

Author: Kris5552014Newberg, Oregon
Title: To be aware of...
Review: This is a cute little place in Georgetown with friendly service. We have eaten there twice. The portions are small, so sharing a breakfast was not adequate for my husband and myself, who always share meals. Today, we ordered the black vinegar pork. It was a small portion and was 90% pork fat. The 10% meat was tasty, as was the sauce, but not worth paying for food we could not eat.Show less

Author: LC2129
Title: Great decor and fantastic service
Review: Really cute quirky cafe with amazing decor! The service is the best we have had in Malaysia and the food was brilliant at a reasonable price. There is a great choice of both Western and Asian food and a huge choice of drinks.

Author: iPhantom96
Title: One of the best
Review: Cozy environment, good food and friendly staff. Had wide variety of food rather than just typical pasta like most café does. Price is ok. Love to chill in the cozy environment the most.

Title: Yum
Review:
Really good choice of food western and local. Amazing pancakes must try....licked the plates clean!
Venue very clean very friendly staff, free wifi!!!!

Author: Wouter89Eindhoven, The Netherlands
Title: Great food, great service!
Review: Very nice cafe serving great (Western) food! The sandwhich is great value for money, including some very tasty potato wedges. And the service is very friendly: when it is quiet and you are open for it, they make some nice conversation (their English is great!). The open kitchen is also nice!Show less

Author: ivylie546
Title: Beautiful interior and palate design.
Review: The environment inside the cafe was enjoyable and the food is okay. But the cakes was delicious and not overwhelming

Author: kellypippin
Title: Great for a break on a hot day
Review: We found this cafe on our travels and loved it! Great food and funky interior. Wait staff were friendly and helpful.

Author: agnieszka s
Title: Lovely
Review: Great place for breakfast and lunch. And the coffee is one of the best i had in Asia!!!! Plus the staff is super friendly and always smiling.

Author: YYLem-Sit
Title: Great Breakfast place
Review:
The service was good and food was delicious.
Place a little dated but we liked it...
Fresh juice costs around Rm10 per glass.
BF starts around RM10 for mushroom cheese omelette with a slice of bread!
Good latte and coffee !

Author: StrayCat5Penang, Malaysia
Title: Nice little find!
Review: Stopped by for lunch after a personal recommendation. Husband has chicken (off the bone) kapitan curry & I had spaghetti carbonara. He had capuccine, I had latte. RM47 for all, including taxes. (approx £8.40).All well presented, well cooked, good portion size (maybe even too large!!). Messages & pictures drawn on coffees. Non smoking inside, smoking tables outside. Waiters were polite, attentive (but not overly so). Menu - all day breakfast options, pastas, local dishes & more. Would return to try something different. Closes early evening so not suitable for late dinners.Show less

Author: Paige-Tiffany BLondon, Canada
Title: Delicious breakfast! Highly recommended!
Review: My fiancé and I ate here 3 times while we stayed in Georgetown and each time it was delicious, the food was reasonably priced, and the staff were friendly. Excellent breakfast with chicken sausage option ( my fiancé doesn't eat pork). Coffee was good, service was quick, and the café has a nice atmosphere. We also ate a late lunch here (chicken sandwiches with salad and potato wedges) which did not disappoint. Sometimes you just need some food from home while you're traveling :)Show less

Author: ReviewsByDan
Title: Great little spot for a break and a snack
Review: Sightseeing on a hot day through George Town merits a nice little break from the sun, and this place was perfect. Small, quiet, comfortable, air conditioned, with great coffee and food! Staff was exceptionally friendly, wifi was great, and the food quite affordable! It provided a nice little break from the street food, with the omelettes, scrambled egg sandwich, and espressos being on my 'usuals' list for the few days I was there. Keep up the great work!!Show less

Author: aworldtourist
Title: Great Service & Food
Review: The service is extraordinary! The service is really attentive and friendly. We had breakfast and curry.  Bother were really good. More over you get free water and WiFi! Highly Recommended!

Author: Cazablanca57Penrith, United Kingdom
Title: Secluded & Quiet
Review: Tucked away on a little back street just off the busy & hectic Chulia St, a little surprise awaits you. A good UK style breakfast, with discret but attentive service. The coffee, Lavazza came quickly to the table & was hot not lukewarm complete with Donald Duck etched on the top of the capachino. Iced water with lemon was quietly topped up while we ate, the staff did not hover over or around while we ate.Show less

Author: MarkoC_12
Title: Must go !!
Review: If you look for nice, cosy place to eat fantastic breakfast in GeorgeTown than here. Very delicious and serve with style.

Author: rugiez
Title: Great place to relax
Review: First off, another reviewer wrote "Will deserve a 5 star if the coffee is as good as the food!" It is. They use Lavazza, and they know how to prepare it. This may well be the best coffee in town.In addition to the coffee, they of course make excellent food. This is a small place with a relaxed and comfy interior. A great place to relax inside or outside and have a leisurely (and plentiful!) meal. I've now been there four times (always for breakfast), and I've been very satisfied every time.The staff is friendly and helpful. The place is just a few feet off the beaten "Chulia" track, with relatively few Western tourists. This gives it a more "local" and less crowded feel. Very enjoyable!Show less

Author: A T
Title: Great cafe
Review: This cute little cafe is down a quiet alley in the centre of Georgetown so nice to get away from the hustle and bustle. Excellent if you fancy a western breakfast/lunch. Very clean, modern and a great place to catch up with friends for a coffee. Small outdoor area and air-conditioning inside.Perfect espresso coffee!Show less

Author: Christine FPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: A friendly, cosy cafe
Review: From the reviews I read of this cafe, it seems they serve a good and hearty breakfast. But I was there with a friend for lunch and we both had pasta. It came in a generous portion, well cooked al dente and with a nice creamy Carbonara sauce (for me). Service was efficient and friendly and the interior design tasteful with a relaxed and casual feel. Unpretentious, ideally situated a stone throw away from the bustling Chulia Street and very reasonably priced, this is an excellent address which I don't hesitate to recommend.Show less

Author: Sebastian L
Title: Good meals
Review: We had an enjoyable lunch at this restaurant with authentic heritage feel. Attentive service and prompt service while we sampled the Lavazza coffee.

Author: MY L
Title: Brunchy with friends
Review: Having brunch here with orders of big breakfast, mushy mushy,  three little pigs, orange juice and black coffee. Free flow of plain water. Nice and friendly service. We are allowed to bring our cake for birthday celebration.

Author: JasmineLaila
Title: Enjoyable
Review: Had a nice lunch recently. Very good meal and excellent drinks. Not a typical commercial cafe but with good service.

Author: chuaskh
Title: Nice Food
Review: Was surprised to find the food in this cafe very tasty and of high quality rivalling those from restaurant. The overall feel is good too. Will deserve a 5 star if the coffee is as good as the food!

Author: Giogina R
Title: Nice cafe
Review: Good food and service are assured when I had my pitstop here. Not bad coffee and heritage feel too. Good choice

Author: reireiliou
Title: great cafe
Review: friendly staff! Nice atmosphere, good place to take a rest.

Author: Cheeyong73
Title: Delicious!
Review: This restaurant serves good fusion food, especially the big breakfast. Good portion and well presented, the food is fresh and welcoming service. The coffee however is above average.

Author: Shanesng88Singapore, Singapore
Title: Peaceful Cafe with Great Tasty Food
Review: So Good I came back TWICE with my girlfriend. I recently traveled in Dec 2014 and popped by for breakfast one day after reading raving reviews.I was not disappointed, you can't really go wrong with all-day breakfast choices. I had the Big Breakfast and She had Mushy Mushy (Omelette with Mushrooms and Cheese). The eggs were rightly done and soft and tasty enough while the hashbrowns were warm and crispy.One hidden gem would be the Pork with Vinegar which appeals to us Asians! The sourness was just right and meat was succulent. I came back again just to eat this.We were treated with warm and patient service with a smile and some nice greetings and a simple chat.You definitely have to pop by if you are around the area, just at the intersection along Lorong Chulia and Lorong Pasar. (Especially when it's raining Haha!)Show less

Author: AmandaMayas
Title: Good food
Review: Stopped by for a tea break and ended up ordered pancakes cappuccino milk shake instead! No regrets as they are tasty and appetising. May come back and check out other items in the menu when stop by Georgetown.

Author: Nathasha K
Title: Nice cafe
Review: A fulfilling meal is assured at Pitstop #12. Variety is good and service is very welcoming. Coffee is ok and you won't leave the cafe disappointed or hungry.

Author: CraigLaronta
Title: Hidden gem
Review: A small but cozy cafe hidden behind chulia street at Georgetown. Food is amazing and lots of options. Will go back again as the service is friendly and make you feel at home. coffee is however above average.

Author: ShereenTan
Title: friendly service😊
Review: Nice Food, Coffee! They are not only selling the Food, they are also selling awesome service. 😊 If I have to rate them from 1 to 10, I'll give them a 11

Author: SabbaticalnessBoca Raton, Florida
Title: Great Breakfast Cafe
Review: When you're going to eat Chinese, Malay, and Indian hawker food all day and night, sometimes it's good to start the day with a nice Western breakfast.. at least that's what my wife insists on. We went here two consecutive mornings and the breakfast is delicious, sunny side eggs, chicken sausage, toast, and hash browns. Coffee is great, and so is the freshly squeezed orange juice. Nice atmosphere inside, chic coffee house. Definitely recommended.Show less

Author: nObOdY007
Title: Great Coffee; Great Place
Review: I Love This Place Because Of The Lavazza Coffee. Staffs Are Attentive And Foods Are Yummy. Location is Great. Easy To Go and Have Many Selective Menus

Author: BrycoolButterworth, Malaysia
Title: Another cool hidden laneway cafe in town
Review: Seen this lil hidden cafe when I parked my car around there to explore hawkers foods at Chulia Street. Came in days ago in the morning to have brekkie, it stunned me with the homely interior and a few cosy outdoor tables reminding me of Fitzroy Melbourne. I picked the outdoor seat instead since the weather was not so warm in the morning. The Big Breakfast I ordered was superb... Smoked salmons, with a slice of poppy seed toast, eggs, salads and bacon! And I was attracted by the coffee bean they use to be honest, nice aroma as expected, nice some polish on the latte art though! Overall it was a great experience, from food, coffee to the service and ambience! It became my second hideaway instantly, strongly recommended!Show less

Author: Fredgirl_Penang
Title: Nice breakfast
Review: Always looking for a nice western breakfast place, and found it in Pit Stop. Good service, good food, nice atmosphere

Author: SSChua28George Town, Malaysia
Title: Lunch Break
Review: Now, this is really one cool place to be at. I have been meaning to try but did not have the time until now. So, since I happen to be around this area, I thought this is the time. I walked in and wow! it was a pretty crowd niffy little joint. My first impression of this place is that it is surprisingly spacious. It did not look it from the outside as there was only a little door leading to the cafe. Once you're inside, it tells a different story. Also, because this cafe is situated within the Georgetown heritage area, it means the place inside is also distinctly heritage in looks and feel, Very nicely done with little touches here and there. The building itself is a very "long" colony house and that means that there are actually plenty of spaces. Now, for the food. The spread is actually quite substantial but owner is pretty smart in that it is offered in fixed selections, eg if it is western then the number of variations is within the western selections and so on. Price -wise, I deem it to be reasonable for this kind of set-up. We ordered spaghetti Bolognese Beef, Tomato Soup with toast, spicy Olio Pasta with Bacon and for drinks we had Iced Lemon Tea and Cold Chocolate. All these came up to RM51.00. The food was served pretty quickly and efficiently. It was really tasty too. I will definitely drop by to try more of their menus.Show less

Author: Sebastian R
Title: Worth while pit stop
Review: Free cold water. Service is great. The strawberry and lime juice is the best I've had. The cappuccino milk shake makes me want to order another one right away!

Author: Atillia_Malaysia
Title: Lovely!!!!!
Review: Been here 3rd time ady, never make something dissapointed or anything bad. I can recommended for all of you to make a step here n taste how lovely n delicioua the food n beverages. Service excellent. I wonder why no service charge in their xcellent service. Thats why make me so proud of this cafe n wanna go everyday. ThxShow less

Author: Chris BHuddersfield, United Kingdom
Title: Very good service
Review: read reviews on this place on here so thought why not give it a try.the staff were friendly and made you welcome.the food is really nice especially the pancakes one off the best places we have eaten in Penang.The menu isn't the biggest but that makes it easier to chose what you and the price off the food is really good.I will be going back here to eat again Show less

Author: Mark ONorth Shields, United Kingdom
Title: Great stop for delicious food.
Review: The food here is delicious. As a group (5 of us) we each ordered a different dish meaning that we could all try different foods. The sandwiches were surprisingly good. They were tasty and big so you get a descent meal out of them. The Thai curry was spicy and very tasty. It comes with boiled rice that is covered in egg, a nice touch which added extra flavour. By far my favourite dish was the pork with black vinegar source. It was incredibly tasty. I would highly recommend it. The staff were very friendly and helpful. There were also a lot of people in so it had a really good atmosphere. A must stop place for food. Show less

Author: Christeene818Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Nice place to hide away and recharge...
Review: We only had coffee and cake here but noted that it caters very well for large groups. They have a number of tables that seat can seat 6-8 people. They are also very child friendly as a family had just finished their meal and were thanking the owner for going to so much trouble to accommodate their three young boys. We sat on a comfy couch and had a cappuccino, some hot flavored milk and a petite blueberry cheesecake - was just enough for us to cool down and recharge before hitting the streets again. Staff were especially good even though we were only having coffee and cake we were well looked after as the cafe was quite full at the time with at least three large groups. If getting a bit over sightseeing have a break here.Show less

Author: CeaserBoy
Title: Coffee and Breakfast
Review: Great little cafe for breakfast and for some real strong coffee. Superb location in the city. Staffs were friendly and prices were pocket friendly.

Author: jackdrum6St. Petersburg, Russia
Title: Great cafe in the heart of Georgetown
Review: This was a cute café located nearby serving great food and drinks. I had a Chinese braised lamb dish with five spice seasoning (melt in the mouth delicious), and my partner had a Chicken Curry laksa which she too enjoyed. I think both were around $12RM each, which is really cheap! They do great drinks too including proper coffee and juices. Free wifi, friendly staff… I can’t fault this place, it was an excellent local café while we were staying in Georgetown.Show less

Author: 885maddiehSydney, Australia
Title: Great Little Cafe!
Review: This place is so lovely, it's got a great decor and atmosphere. The customer service was great and the food delicious. We stopped by for breakfast and both had an omelette and they were delicious. The coffee was also great! It actually tasted like coffee. I would definitely recommend stopping by if you're around.Show less

Author: SemHolmes
Title: Love this place !
Review: Beside hard to find a parking space, everything else is good. I love the cafe design and the environment. The boss is very friendly and experienced guy. They have good food and good coffee. I will go there more often whenever I got time.

Author: Lauraemiliethomsen
Title: Good place for coffee and breakie
Review: A place with an cozy atmosphere. The staff is freindly and helpful, and the food is delicious. And last - finally a STRONG coffee that actually tastes like coffee! Will definately recommend this place if you're in the area.

Author: teohtkIpoh, Malaysia
Title: A place I called home.
Review: Use to live in this place when I was young helping my parents run the coffee shop. Drop by for a visit and is surprised by its changes. Love the ambience and it braised vinegar pork with rice. Fantastic!! A must try if you love Chinese food. Staff are friendly and helpful. Highly recommend if you are in this area of the city.Show less

Author: theblessedlady
Title: Little Cosy Cafe
Review: Love their sandwiches, creative and sincere meal. Tried their macha latte which serves rich green tea flavour! Would always drop by to have meal alone or with friends...great place to hang.

Author: leanne_pearcperth
Title: Great little cafe
Review: We stumbled across this cafe, in fact we almost did not see it and from the outside you can not see how lively the interior is!Sunday morning and everyone was having breakfast bringing about a great atmosphere in the middle of Georgetown There is seating outside under full shade and a fan or inside in air conditioning.The coffee was excellent. Strong and hot, even with coffee art. The cafe is about a five minute walk from Yeng Keng HotelShow less

Author: FarahAzureenA1
Title: Friendly and Good Local Food
Review: Very friendly owner , and my fav is their coffee and lemak laksa ! So unique for me first time tasted lemak laksa and it was good

Author: Harrison-F-Carter
Title: A good one...
Review: This was a well-recommended place - and deservedly so - lovely menu and lovely food. Glad to have visited.

Author: chipbumleyHadleigh, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent Laksa
Review: Decided to try this place after finding it on here. Really enjoyed it. Simple menu, which was quite nice as I probably wouldn't have chosen the Laksa if there was a vast menu. It was amazing. My wife, my 8 year old and I all loved it. Would be going back tomorrow if there weren't soanyt places to eat in Penang ! Show less

Author: Harriet TKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Lemak laksa is the best!!! Recommended!!!
Review: Lemak laksa was inventing by Evan Cheah, a young muscular guy who has a passion for cooking the laksa. It was super yummy and tasty! It wasn't too creamy nor salty, and the taste was just right! Recommended LEMAK LAKSA! Tell you a secret; I ate two bowls of lemak laksa! Show less

Author: WaywardSoul999Hong Kong, China
Title: Recommended!!
Review: I came after reading some reviews. As same laksa is their signature main dish and taste delicious. Not too salty, not too sour and not too spicy too, suits tourist taste buds. Simple heritage design cafe and thumbs up for the friendly owners. I will definitely recommend this place to all. Show less

Author: robjar
Title: Cheap local food
Review: What’s not to like? Cheap local food with good quick service. Only a couple of items on the menu but classic dish was great. Had nice chat with the assistant.

Author: nathanh271
Title: Excellent
Review: Excellent laksa made with fresh mackerel, lovely white coffee, very fast and friendly service from the owner, would definitely recommend

Author: Smijie
Title: Great quick stop
Review:
Refreshing white nutmeg juice and light, delicious laksa.. tastes like the sauce contains orange zest.

Would recommend if you're passing by

Author: 66kirstyl
Title: Lovely food and owners
Review: Very nice owners who are super friendly and make you feel welcome as soon as you walk through the door. Delicious food and fresh juices which are very cheap too! Definitely worth a visit

Author: Miroslav_Markov
Title: Local dishes
Review: Small bistro with two delicious dishes and fresh juices. Friendly owner and staff. Lazy cats and ambience. Near to famous graffiti on wall.

Author: MariaF2936
Title: Amazing Signature Assam Laksa
Review: If you come to Penang, don’t miss this wee place. The service is so nice and their Signature dish is absolutely tasteful!

Author: jamessP2299AN
Title: Great food, friendly staff
Review: Go inside and pick a table, the staff are very welcoming and provide amazing tasty food. It’s great value and good atmosphere. The place blends into the street but it’s worth it to seek it out!

Author: Peter J
Title: Good find!
Review: Simple, local, amazing food. Cooked fresh and great value for money. Recommend the laksa highly! Will definitely return.

Author: Frankiejjj92
Title: Perfect food & super friendly
Review:
They have 2 dishes on the menu.
It tasted really good and only 6rm each.
The owner is very friendly.
Feels like home.

Author: PimVugts
Title: Very friendly and tasty
Review: We walked through the city to take a look at the street art and saw this restaurant had a high rating on trip advisor. It is located at the beginning of our trip so we decided to have lunch here. We were welcomed by a very friendly man (I think the owner) who showed us a table and took our order. The menu contained only one dish: laksa, and several drinks or smoothies. So not a lot of choice but the laksa was defenitly worth it. Very tasty and a bit spicy, maybe too spicy if you don't like it but I'm sure that can be less if you say it beforehand. Overall very good food, friendly service, and a great location, so I definitely recommend this place! Show less

Author: cricticri801
Title: A must try!
Review:
We had there the fishballs and the famous laksa: tasty and nicely spicy! We felt more than welcome by the owners, so nice!
Have a stop there, it’s worth it!

Author: RavP26
Title: Assam Laksa to die for
Review: The Assam Laksa can only be described as a mouth party. Amazing flavours. The mackerel isn't fishy at all. All the flavours cascade into one delicious mouthful. With silky soft noodles.

Author: whisker11Singapore, Singapore
Title: Yummy!
Review: We walked in and were served immediately by the friendly owners. The menu is not extensive but we ordered their specialties of Penang Laksa, fishballs, as well as fried belachan chicken wings. The Laksa was delicious although I would prefer a more full-bodied broth. The fishballs were enjoyably tasty and swimming in a more robust and delicious assam sauce. The belachan chicken wings were the best I have ever tasted. Crispy, aromatic and juicy on the inside, I had to stop myself from ordering more. I would definitely return just for those chicken wings again.Show less

Author: saikitng
Title: Not for anyone from Malaysia
Review: Only for foreigners who don’t know how Char Koay Teow and Assam Laksa should taste like. Their version is far from the real deal. Show less

Author: shopagaga
Title: Breakfast
Review: Assam laksa was very good ! Only assam laksa and curry fishball dishes & a selection of drinks are available for breakfast. The cafe opens at 10am.

Author: dickychrismaf
Title: Excellent service on small restaurant
Review: We visited this restaurant after walked around street art area. We ordered fried rice, koay teow, and milk tea. Very good taste, good price, and excellent service from the waitress/owner.

Author: Worldismyoyster1070
Title: Excellent customer service and yummy food.
Review: I had the Assam laksa and nutmeg juice--great place to try both.  It is near Armenia street so easy to access and get away from the chaos on Armenia street.  Staff were very hospitable.  Highly recommend it.

Author: TravelkopiPrinceSingapore, Singapore
Title: Great Assam Laksa at very economical price
Review: As a foreigner who prefer less fishy smell version of Assam laksa, this is definitely for me. The taste is good with minced fish soaked into the laksa sauce. Very TOP quality rice noodles as they are so soft and chewy! Good price. Could have earned 5 stars if not that they only serve laksa and nothing else that day. Would have been better if there are other side dishes to go with.Show less

Author: Rachel S
Title: The best Penang Laksa
Review: We were both excited to try Penang Laksa and had this place recommended to us. I can’t imagine it getting much better than here, the flavours were amazing, the fish was really meaty and tasty. This is a really good place if you want to try local cusine that is simple, delicious and cheap!Show less

Author: asiaheavens
Title: Crazy amaing laksa!
Review:
Honestly this restaurant has The best asam laksa in malaysia 
I loves the white coffee as well 
Location in art street dont forget to take a walk after eating

Author: Mark DPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: A Terrific "local" Restaurant!
Review: This centrally located [in the UNESCO World Heritage Area] small, homey restaurant, serves many "local favourites", prepared better than most other restaurants!! It has been ranked [by travellers like us] #2 out about 1,000 restaurants. It has also been awarded TripAdvisor's "Certificate of Excellence". Among the excellent "local dishes" are "Asam Laksa", as well as [my favourite"] Char Koay Teow. The "Durian coffee" is both unusual and unforgetable!! The service is both friendly and prompt [and one can ask questions] and the freshly prepared dishes are hot! It is well worth a visit [which will probably result in a "return visit, or two"]...I hope that this Review has been helpful.Show less

Author: vietha3110
Title: Must try Laksa!!!
Review: Dont forget to visit My Own Cafe, they serve best Laksa in Penang. It’s so delicious. The owner and his son are nice.

Author: Jian Ru Jenny J
Title: Tasty
Review: Never had this kind of laksa before, but surprisingly addictive!! The sour and spicy soup base is really good for the humid weather here. I wish I can pack this to go home!

Author: d-eilatan
Title: Delicious!
Review: We ordered the Asam Laksa and Char Kway Teow. Food was delicious, service was quick and staff were very friendly! Food was reasonably priced. Would recommend to anyone looking to try some authentic Malaysian food.

Author: siskapsari
Title: Delicious asam laksa and fish ball
Review: I ate here with my families, the asam laksa  was so delicious, the fish ball was so fresh, the char kwetiao also good.

Author: thuyvi85Dingolfing, Germany
Title: Delicious
Review: Love these sort of places that are simple and just serve delicious food. They only have a few dishes but it seems like they do them very well. We had the Assam Laksa and the sambal fried rice. Both were sooo tasty! Service was friendly and fast. Great value for money!Show less

Author: Maggie O
Title: My Own Cafe
Review: Enjoyed great food and drinks with friends at My Own Café. Lots of dishes were served and nice. Customer service was friendly. Reasonably priced.

Author: theanos2019
Title: Great place
Review: Lovely little cafe, we had the Assam Laksa dish which was delicious, very cheap as well. Lovely staff too, with the visit!

Author: ShortermtravelgoalsDublin, Ireland
Title: Yum yum
Review: Visited after reading the positive reviews on TripAdvisor, they weren't lying. The food was delicious. I had the assam laksa, it was lovely and fresh. The flavours shone through. Also had a real fruit juice, which hit the spot too. Highly recommend a visit, the owner was thoroughly charming and gave a few food tips for later on that afternoon.Show less

Author: KristenDariaSingapore
Title: No-carb modification
Review: I appreciate that my no-carb modification for the assam laksa was not just taken, but made in such a way that the modified dish was made delectable to the taste buds too.A second visit was futile, as they had sold out for the day. Go early to be guaranteed of (a) serving/s.Show less

Author: Gregor K
Title: Authentic and family friendly
Review: Based on reviews you just have no option but to visit this nice, small place - they even got a famous graffiti in the restaurant.Enjoy the famous local fish broth asam laksa or the char kway teow noodles, I had two. For children order fried rice (tell the waiter to skip spicy ingredients) and you can have an authentic and cheap meal for everybody.Show less

Author: stevensI9354AY
Title: Amazing!!! Must visit
