Review: The food, the staff, the design are all top notch. Do yourself a favor and make this place a must visit. Since they have a small menu that is well priced you can try most of the items there and still be able to continue a food tour the rest of the day.Show less

Author: Trek57847180180Singapore, Singapore
Title: Nice Ambience with Good Food
Review: The Laksa and Fruit Rojak was to rave for... it was tasteful and their service is warmth and friendly. The owners welcome their guest like family and will always ask how was your food and will share the tourist spot areas in Penang. Definitely will come back again to have the nice home cook Laksa.Show less

Author: irinnelaksmanaBandar Lampung, Indonesia
Title: Must visit, best asam laksa!
Review: We came here by accident last month as we were strolling along Armenian street. We had the best asam laksa, char kwetiau and fried belacan chicken wings! We loved it so much that we decided to come back today and tried more dishes such as the muah chee anf fried rice! Service is excellent too, staff members are friendly.Show less

Author: Bozgu64Guam, Mariana Islands
Title: Wow wow Assam Laksa
Review: Smallish cafe packing a big punch. They have limited menu and the main feature is the Assam Laksa which is done with exactly the right spice and sourness quite well cooked noodles too! We also had the Char Kuay Teow! Both dishes quite delicious. We heard the food was simple yet delicious and it lived up to its billing! Wow wow!Show less

Author: ParagliderBaselBasel, Switzerland
Title: Size doesn't matter!
Review: This is a little place with just a few tables in an old heritage building on the same street as one of Penang's big tourist attractions Khoo Kongsi. Located in bustling Georgetown we came across My Own Cafe in some of the guide books and decided to give it a try. And we were happy we did.We were welcomed warmly and taken through the menu which has a limited number of items. While my daughter and I tried the Asam laksa, my wife tried the Char Kway Teow. They were delicious. The fruit juices were awesome in the mid-day heat as well.Proof of the fact that you don't need to have a sprawling location or an endless menu. If you provide good food at a reasonable price, people will keep coming. Size simply doesn't matter.Show less

Author: twiggsandtravelsMississauga, Canada
Title: Cheap lunch with ceiling fans!
Review: We visited twice during our stay, largely because the food tasted good, was reasonably priced, and we could enjoy ""street food" with the added comfort of a ceiling fan! The staff were very friendly and accommodating of my vegan requirements. I had the delicious Char Keoy Teow and my boyfriend had the laksa and a spicy rice. The juices were fairly pricey but very fresh and delicious. Great place to rest your aching feet after a morning of exploring Georgetown. Show less

Author: ew00076Surrey, United Kingdom
Title: Lovely laksa and such a bargain
Review: We wanted to try a proper laksa and found this place via google reviews. It is a very small restaurant, and features some of the recommended street art inside. The menu is very small, but all very tasty. The laksa was super tasty and so so cheap. They also have different juices freshly made, and again are all very cheap. Would definitely recommendShow less

Author: BWF2012Chinatown, Singapore
Title: Simply Outstanding!
Review: Excellent food, very fair prices and great service. The laksa was very good, and our fried rice well made and flavourful. We also had noodles which which spicy and full of flavour. As an unexpected bonus, the “Bro!nanas” (deep fried bananas, but better) were amazingly good. They also had some very good street art inside. Friendly, without feeling too touristy, excellent food and good service. Highly recommended!Show less

Author: refreshingmin
Title: Recommended food in George Town!
Review: Really scrumptious laksa! highly recommended because we ate two large bowls each, only downside was that the portion was too small but quality for money! Fishball has nice texture. The soup sauce complements the fishball well. Will be back for more in the future! Value for money! Thanks for the friendly serviceShow less

Author: doreenlgl73
Title: Great experience
Review:
So far the best Assam Laksa and Rojak. TripAdvisor Certificate of Excellance Year 2017 & 2018.
Good service, friend hosts and relaxing environment.
Bought the rojak paste home too 😍

Author: eddyfeddy
Title: The best laksa
Review: Always eat here with my friend many kind of food here delicious service tip top owner also friendly i suggest to all visitor need to visit this place my own cafe

Author: AzRatArizona
Title: Perfect
Review: We stopped in on our own Street Art quest while visiting Georgetown, as one of the pieces is in the cafe interior. We decided to have a coffee - a excellent 'white' btw. I saw the food coming out of the kitchen and had to give it a try. Excellent laksa and amazing fried chicken finished with a rojak treat. The vibe was really great - friendly, family, busy but no pressure to eat and leave. Their FB motto 'good food doesn't have to be expensive', is proven strategy here. The menu is not extensive but they are doing everything perfectly. Right near the busy Armenian street tourist area and definitely worth a stop. This is a small cafe so don't expect a swanky restaurant. Highly recommend.Show less

Author: Stihov
Title: The best soup & Laksa
Review: I am happy I stumbled into this place, since it became my best food experience in George town, Peneng. The place looked like a nice place to sit down, and they had three different food wagons. I decided to try the Laksa, and with a surprise it had all my favorite elements of a perfect soup. The healthy, delicious flavours of all the herbs, the well balanced soup, the fish that is prepared from fresh fish from the market (and it doesn’t taste too strong, like in some of the other Laksa I tried in Penang). Also the staff here is super friendly and talkative. I highly recommend to go here if you are in Penang.The banana from “bro!nana” stand is also worth to mention. I normally don’t eat dessert and especially not after lunch/dinner, but this was just amazing anyway! I had the Crispy cheese, banana with honey cornflake. How the flavours complimented each other was astonishing. I still wonder what kind of cheese was used, because it worked perfectly. Thank you so much for making so delicious food. You will see me next time I am in Penang for sure.Show less

Author: Allan2212
Title: Hidden gem for laksa and rojak
Review: First thought just to try the Rojak but we ended up with 3 bowl of laksa and a big bowl of Rojak. The laksa was balanced between, spicy, sourly and thickness. Should give a try when you pass by here.

Author: Miguel A
Title: Perfect Asam Laksa
Review: Good quality food ar a simple venue with brilliant attentive staff. Not much to choose from on the menu, but what they do, they do great. Tried Asam Laksa and Fishballs for RM5 each.

Author: danszotjJakarta, Indonesia
Title: Delicious food!
Review: We decided to visit this restaurant because of TripAdvisor good rating. We ordered Chicken wings, Assam Laksa and Char Kway Teow. The Char Kway Teow is so good, the wok-hey, balance of the taste of saltiness, spicy, savoury/umami, sweetness. I would even say the taste is even better than other more famous Char Kway Teow food stall!!My wife like the Assam Laksa so much, she drained the soup (it is a rare occasion :)). it is comparable to the famous Ayer Itam Assam Laksa and the Chicken wings also taste very good. The best thing is that usually these 3 foods are not sold in one place, so we have to go to separate food stall/restaurant. But now, we found one that do, will definitely go back to My Own Cafe.Show less

Author: ahalvdanBaton Rouge, Louisiana
Title: Street drop in. Amazing Laksa
Review: TripAdvisor proves right again. After disappointing Laksa at the Chulia Night Market, I had a craving for a real, delicious and complex bowl in the morning. As I was walking around perusing street art and GT, I stumbled across this cafe. I’m happy to say this Laksa delivered in spades. It was slightly different but just as good as Penang Road Famous. You could taste the time that went into it from the complexity of the broth to the deboned fresh mackerel. The mother and son team working were charming and attentive and happy to talk food and laksa with me. I would highly recommend giving this place a try!Show less

Author: Midtownie
Title: Chicken wings and noodles
Review: I was a bit too scared to try the laksa as I don't like fish. However, we had the chicken wings which came out hot and crunchy and were a good price. We also ordered the char koay teow and enjoyed it.

Author: susiki
Title: Yummm!!!
Review: Walked by and remembered I saw the good reviews, since it was lunchtime I stepped in. Was greeted very friendly by the owners. The Assam Laksa was delicious, I enjoyed every single bite of it! Absolutely recommended!

Author: skylimsk_0729
Title: Nice
Review: The taste of asam laksa is nice and syok. The fried chicken is the taste that I love. Chay kuey Teow is the cheap and nice.

Author: chrissI6403OJ
Title: Lunch
Review: Stopped for a lunchtime drink and a light meal. Had two beers and char kuey teow. Latter was good but should have included cockles. Simple, good service, cheap.

Author: benkH8751OU
Title: Lunch for £1
Review: I got the Assam laksa when we came here and I thought it was delicious, unfortunately that was the only thing available as the chef had to leave early as they were sick. What we had was very good and ridiculously well priced!

Author: RyanTravs84
Title: Lovely Laksa and great hosts
Review: A simple but fantastic little family restaurant. The food is made with love and served with a smile. I will probably go for another meal there before the end of my trip.

Author: Maria Cristina R
Title: Best laksa!!
Review: Amazing service. Super friendly and delicious laksa. Also tried their carrot juice which had no sugar and tasted great. Make sure you come here. Super affordable.

Author: ramonakenHamilton Island, Australia
Title: Surprising
Review: My girlfriend and I were walking around wondering where we were going to eat.Suddenly we saw this place, there wasn’t any guest inside but it was raining and we were hungry so we decided to come in.Thanks god we did it! Best meal in the town so far! The fried rice was good but the Char kuey teow is a must!! Well balanced, super tasty, perfect spiciness and enough portion to satisfy you.The owner is really friendly and funny, definitely recommend this place to whoever come to Pennang. Show less

Author: maninstride
Title: Cozy little family restaurant
Review: Came here for lunch. Surprisingly found a little gem hidden in a tourist area. Menu items are limited to a total of five. We have their house speciality Laksa and their Char kway teow and was surprisingly very good as compared to the other well written street hawkers in the area . Prices are extremely reasonable and we will definitely go back for a light snack from time to time. Recommended. Show less

Author: Los_Bubus
Title: Must try!
Review: The place only has 5 dishes but the most popular one is the fish broth sup its only 5MR and its amazing kind of spicy in a good way! The staff is super nice and attentive.

Author: magthegagSingapore, Singapore
Title: Delicious local food in a touristy area
Review: I was sceptical. You don’t order local food in a touristy area (in this case, the street art area) and expect it to be good. However, the dishes we ordered, together with some fruit juices were delicious. The penang assam laksa had enough spicy kick and was flavourful! The wings were good too. I later went to a street filled with hawkers and ordered the same few dishes, expecting better. However, My Own Cafe’s version was better. Order the penang laksa in small (RM5) or large (RM6). Scratch that - just order the large lah!Show less

Author: Cutetaiki
Title: Penang Asam Laksa
Review:
The soup sourness' really good. I tried the small portion and i might will come again tomorrow.
The owner is nice and kind.
You can see one of the street art inside.

Author: JimmyinChinaHong Kong, China
Title: Very Good !
Review: Our local friend brought us here to try the famous Assam laksa which indeed earned its name, not too sour nor spicy, it was just right. The char koay teow was equally good but the portion seems a little small. The fried chicken wings were cooked to perfection, not oily at all with super crispy skin and very meaty. All washed down with a few beers in the heat which was perfect. Everyone in our group was satisfied. Very interesting heritage building which brought sweet reminiscence of our childhood. Many thanks to the super friendly host and his friendly son! I really wanted to take the cart with the laksa home!Show less

Author: U8373EGanam
Title: Best laksa
Review: It’s the place you don’t want to miss if you are in Penang, the food exceeded my expectations. The place looks cosy and the staff are friendly. Good prices as well. All together a very pleasant experience.

Author: Beej86London, United Kingdom
Title: Great tasting food and lovely peoplw
Review: We were looking for a place to try the Assam Laksa. Having been here the food did not disappoint. We ate their siganture Laksa and their Char Koay Teow. Both of them were great. The Char Koay Teow reminded us of a pad thai noodle dish but a lot more authentic and flavoursome. A cheap eat too. The guys running the place are very sweet and friendly. Keep up the hard work and the hype is totally worth it. Show less

Author: JonathanY989
Title: Penang Laksa
Review: A Very authentic and traditional style of cooking Penang Laksa. It's Assam Laksa was not too thick or too blend, giving it a taste that I have never experienced before. I personally am not a fan of Laksa, but I have to say I really enjoyed this.The char kuay teow however, I personally found it pretty ordinary compared to other char kuay teows I've tried. Love it's fragrant durian coffee! Show less

Author: ChinMinT2
Title: Delicious laksa and char kew tiao
Review: Hygienic restaurant serving delicious laksa, char kway teow, balacan fried chicken and fresh made fruit juices. Friendly owner and good location, Definitely good option for lunch in penang.

Author: lalatwinklebellSingapore, Singapore
Title: Try The Laksa & Char Koay Teow
Review: 3rd visit to this cafe & 2nd trip to Penang.. The place is really clean compared to the more popular roadside stalls in Penang that don't look hygenice. The place is non air conditioned but really cooling from the super hot and sunny weather of Penang. The laksa and char koay teow is really worth trying and I found them better than a lot of other food places here that I'd tried so far.Show less

Author: Ilina BMelbourne, Australia
Title: Assam Laksa
Review: Can i give 6 stars for this one? Yes the menu is small, but the food is full with flavours. Yes the cafe is also small, but the owners are lovely and warm people cooking cooking super tasty traditional food. A must while you are in Penang. P.s Super cheap alsoShow less

Author: sporestriker
Title: Delicious Assam Laksa!
Review:
Everyone seems to ordering their specialty which is the Assam Laksa so ordered two large bowls for the both of us with a side of fish balls in laksa gravy. Both dishes didn’t disappoint us at all.. they were simply delicious! 

Simple and tasty..highly recommended!

Author: akoreaHanoi, Vietnam
Title: Very local and seafood based shop
Review: The menu consists of around 4 dishes. All of them featuring seafood, be aware. Fish-broth laksa is the specialty. In our taste, is was just ok. Fried noodles with prawns were also ok, with a chili oil aftertaste. Price was affordable. Service was provided by very friendly owner.Show less

Author: allyaheather
Title: Incredible laksa
Review: The laksa is amazing, and they even made a vegetarian version of char koay teow for my friend! Very conveniently located, not expensive, and delicious-- all things I love in a restaurant!

Author: Auraajaree
Title: A lovely family run cafe
Review: The restuarant is centrally located near major attractions eg khoo kongsri, street arts and 3D museum. It is just next to Yap temple. The food is simple but delicious. Char kuay toey and fried rice with samba sauce there were very nice. Would recommend to take a big bowl of laksa. It is only 1 RM difference. The wall of the restuarant which is one of the major street art objects is actually the picture of the owner who makes laksa. Although Laksa is the signature dish, I personally like char kuay toey and fried rice with salted fish more.The owner’s son was friendly and took a photo for us. There were also free brochures for tourists which contain discount coupon for 3D museum.The price is also very reasonable. Recommend to have lunch there if you visit street art. P.S. The restuarant closes at 5 pm so it is suitable only for lunch.Show less

Author: HappyHeart2012Bradford, United Kingdom
Title: Best Laksa in Penang
Review: Found this restaurant by mistake but the small bowl of laksa we had for lunch was superb! Jay Rayner should come here and try it out! A simple menu but unexpectedly delicious food! In the heart of the World Heritage Area, simple and basic décor but great food.Show less

Author: Eve VUnited Kingdom
Title: Simply but perfect
Review: We came for lunch, quite early so I wasn't sure if I wanted a big or small bowl of laksa. Chose a small bowl. The REGRET! I wish I have chosen a big bowl , laksa was just delicious, perfectly spiced ! A MUST TRY. Cafe is small, so don't expect a 10 page menu. It's a lovely family run cafe, where speciality is laksa and that's what they serve. Lovely, friendly owners. Made me feel welcome, and I wish I could go back to Penang just for bowl of laksa.Show less

Author: Lauren G
Title: Best Assam laksa
Review: We ate here twice as the assam laksa and char koay teow were delicious! Friendly service and good fresh carrot juice too.

Author: Jerraplane
Title: Just so tasty & cheap!
Review: Penang Assam laksa so tasty, well balanced sour tamarind and cheap for a bowl of noodles! Must have the nutmeg juice too. Helpful & cute young boss!

Author: 888travelKaron, Thailand
Title: Only 4 dishes on the menu!
Review: Ok, so everyone goes here for the laksa - which was very nice, but apart from that, there were only 3 other dishes on offer (char kway teow, and something with rice). So don’t make a special trip if you’re after more to eat than just a bowl of laksa!It was nice but this place probably doesn’t deserve a top 10 rating on the basis of one dish alone. Show less

Author: MynameisrickKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Thumbs UP
Review: I my self ordered to.meal just for me..To try out their asam.laksa and charkuey teow..my wife has nasi goreng she said suit her taste..My Char kuey teow very good..taste the wok.hey...I like it ..its just compare to.bee hwa..I personally prefer bee hwa..its just asam.laksa..taste good..my personal opinion iy would be tatse better if the chef increase the sourness...chicken.wing Belacan very juicy..Belacan taste not realy taste it..i would be better if the chef enhance the taste of belacan.The service Excellent..Tip top...ThumbsupShow less

Author: jwtraveller4
Title: Disappointed
Review: Got here just after 4pm it wasn't overly busy. I waited 45 minitues in 33 degree heat for my char koay teow should of just walked out others would have. Everyone around me was served. It wasn't until I gave the waiter a death stare that he went to chef! It was then cooked and brought to me at 5pm they shut at 5. I felt rushed to eat. Food itself was OK very oily I've had better at Gurney Drive. There are much better places in Penang, I won't be returning. Show less

Author: cnirving
Title: Top grub
Review: Excellent Malaysian food at a brilliant price. Friendly service and nice atmosphere - highly recommended

Author: Dan MCupertino, California
Title: This is the number 2 Tripadvisor restaurant in Penang?
Review: The service was satisfactory, and the location is good. But I'd just barely call this a restaurant. It seemed that they served Laksa and fresh juices, period. It was my first Laksa so I don't have much to compare it to, but it didn't look like the photos and it was too spicy for my taste.There is something wacky going on with Trip Advisor Restaurant ratings. After going to My Own Cafe, Trip Advisor's number 2, for lunch we went to another restaurant rated down around 250 for dinner, and found it to be head and shoulders, fork and spoon, better.Show less

Author: rajit80Jakarta, Indonesia
Title: Value meal
Review: This restaurant is very close to Khoo kongsi. So you can plan your lunch here when you are visiting Khoo kongsi. We had our lunch twice in this restaurant. Very busy. And both the days we had to wait for sometime to get a seat. Food is very cheap and limited number of options. Laksa, fish ball, fried rice and chicken fries. That’s it. Of course they have quite number of drinks options. Only down side of this restaurant, there is no air conditioning unit. Otherwise I would have rated 5 star. However, still this is one of the top value restaurants.Show less

Author: bundaoli
Title: yummy kway teow!
Review: the small cafe is located just around the armenian street, very handy! you will also find few beautiful souvenir shops and come back to sit down for cup of coffee haha. very lucky to find this place. the host was very friendly and handful.serves specially kway teow and laksa and they are superbs! i had apple juice which was very fresh. price is great so i hope they keep the quality of the food. would be great if there are a bit more in the menu though. will definitely come back! Show less

Author: Paul F
Title: Lunch
Review: Very good atmosphere and good food. We had Assam Laksa and Char Choy Teow. Wonderful. Would recommend food. No so sure about toilet!😯. Lovely staff. Very friendly.

Author: belgianlonghornShanghai, China
Title: Quality over quantity
Review: You are likely to be greeted with the delightful energy of Mr. Cheah as you enter. When you look at the menu, you may be surprised to see 6 food items available. Don’t let this fool you. The limited menu means that each item has been perfected, not just by the chef, but also by customer feedback. With tasty food and the delightful service, this is sure to be a highlight of your trip to George Town.Show less

Author: 66jesusfAustin, Texas
Title: Bet value café in all of Georgetown
Review: We came in here sweaty and tired after a long morning of exploring the town and jetties. Even though a Korean “studio” was supposed to film a “movie” and made us get up from our table, the owner Mr. Cheah immediately stepped in, gave us a shared table with a wonderful couple and got right down to showing us the menu. There’s about five food choices and all are incredible. The laksa is a must, with a beautiful blend of flavours brought together by a tangy pineapple addition that works as a bridge between sweet, sour, and spicy. We got the fried chicken and it was also delicious. A nice iced white coffee to cool us down and wash down the food was a perfect ending to a perfect meal. Value cannot be overstated! The prices are way too affordable, I almost don’t want to go anywhere else. Great service, awesome taste, and incredible value... what more could you want?Show less

Author: tudora380
Title: Great experience of local food in George Town.
Review: The staff was very friendly and kind, the food came very fast, even though they were very crowded. They have a very short menu, but they know the recipes very well.

Author: fimaf2018
Title: Good food!
Review: I like the ambience of the restaurant. They have their owner’s graffiti. The laksa, kway teaw and black coffee is very nice and recommended. In overall is good food and restaurant!

Author: Caline D
Title: Amazing Belacan Fried Chicken!
Review: Stumble upon that cafe as we were looking for the artwork on the wall and they were shutting down but let us take a quick picture anyway.We returned on another day to try their food and the laksa is yummy! However what blew our mind was the Belacan fried chicken! Delicious and not oily at all! As we are back home in Australia now, I dream of eating that fried chicken again! It is a family owned business and the son (young guy at counter) is really friendly. They take pride in their food and it is really heartwarming to eat there. Show less

Author: Ozdoglovers
Title: Outstanding
Review: This is my second visit to Malaysia and Penang. The food and service here was first class without the hefty prices. The setting is amazing.

Author: ivalice89lKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Cozy cafe
Review: It is located at Lebuh Cannon, opposite a Chinese temple. Grab or uber can’t locate the place directly. It is a simple cafe, with few menu selection: Asam laksa, fried rice, char kuey teow, chicken wings and it is pork free. No fancy music, not air-conditioning but it’s comfortable enough for a lunch break after a hot sun walking at Armenian street. My friends and I think the Asam laksa and char kuey teow are moderate but the chicken wings are extremely good. We went back again on the next day to eat the chicken wings (high recommended). The service is good, friendly staffs, able to speak English. Price is moderate, still moderate. One person about RM10-15. Show less

Author: bat-and
Title: Rapid service and good lunch
Review: I tried the ASAM laksa and the fried rice and both were flavorful. The location is very small and i think it should be improved a little bit. Despite this, I loved the service, both young and old men were very friendly!

Author: mp749505
Title: Great Assam Laksa and service
Review: My husband and I visited here for the famed Assam Laksa which was delicious. Staff were super friendly and helpful.

Author: Alex S
Title: Brilliant cafe
Review: Lovely place. Staff were so friendly and really welcomed us in. A small menu which is great because it meant they are VERY good at all they do. Great juices, fresh with no sugar! Lovely place

Author: mehnooooosh
Title: The rest room was owful
Review: The toilet wasnt clean it doesnt have toilet papers but the atmosphere was good evry one was kind and had a smile Show less

Author: alisA3153II
Title: Friendly
Review: We went for a beer. The first thing we noticed was the smile on staff faces. The toilet was dirty though. Good for a short beer rest

Author: camillaaustralia
Title: Delicious  Laksa
Review: Wish we had found this earlier in our visit instead of our last day. The laksa was so tasty! And the service very friendly. We also had the char kway teow which was also great.

Author: 578izmiri
Title: Nice food and nice people.
Review: With only three (!) dishes in their menu the owners managed to establish a good well known business which leaves positive emotions and good feeling. Thank you!

Author: 798anderskBronshoej, Denmark
Title: Best way to start A New Year.
Review: First of Jan. we were looking for a good post-new years eve breakfast. We found this place by random and loved it. The service was friendly, and a cozy atmosphere. But the food... the food was wonderful. Our 11. years old son had to order an extra round of fried rice, because it was the best food ever. Show less

Author: Mauro G
Title: Best food in George Town
Review: Very limited choice, but what Tey have is really great. Cannot leave George Town without eating here. Be careful, close at 6pm! Very friendly and nice people

Author: 165hanspetersDusseldorf, Germany
Title: Best Laksa
Review: We enjoyed the Laksa two times here. It was absolutely delicious. It is served in the Chinese Style. I tried The Malaysian Style (it tastes more fishi) in other places, I definitely like the Chinese Style more. The stuff is friendly and fast. Everything is damn cheap: Laksa 6 RM, Coke/Sprite 2,8 RM, fresh Juice 5,9 RM. Go there when you are here! It is such a nice street as well. Show less

Author: Kieran B
Title: Very tasty Laksa
Review: The Laksa here was very tasty and was pretty cheap. Its a small quaint café in the centre of Georgetown. It is walking distance to all of the famous street art

Author: Megumi_09
Title: Reasonable price for excellent food and service
Review: I had lunch here after sightseeing, I had no idea it's a popular restaurant, just walked in because I was too hungry. Lucky me! They keep the price reasonable even though it's located in a prime spot for tourists. There wasn't many choices on the menu so I just chose laksa which the owner recommended. I absolutely loved it! It was also fortunate that the restaurant wasn't too busy when I was there. When I asked one of the staff how to get here and there in George Town, he took his time to advise me in details, which place I should go to and how to get there efficiently in order to catch my bus back to Kuala Lumpur. If I have the chance to visit George Town again, I will certainly come to My Own Cafe for meals.Show less

Author: KwaiYinLSingapore, Singapore
Title: A great place to chill and eat
Review: The menu was quite limited but we were glad that the food tasted good.Four of us ordered several items to share: Laksa, Char Koay Teow, fried chicken and the two types of fried rice (salted fish & sambal). Nevertheless, we added one more bowl of laksa after the first one. It simply tasted good... generous serving of the ingredients and the soup was really yummy :) I liked the chicken which was fried with the paste. It's so fragrant and tasty when served piping hot! For the rice, however, there was not much difference between the two. It seemed to me a family business. Quite like the ambience here. Great eating place.Show less

Author: PetrikS14
Title: Excellent lunch!
Review: Laksa was quite spicy and really good. Fresh juices were great refreshers. The service was friendly and enthustiastic!

Author: anjaH444
Title: laksa!
Review: the staff are gorgeous, the price is right and the laksa is perfect! It was quite busy when we went here and we were lucky to get a chair outside, very popular with the local people, which is always a good sign.

Author: loergaard
Title: Great Laksa
Review: Very nice and helpful service. Great Laksa not to spicy for european taste. Beautiful painting inside.

Author: F6656CPandrewa
Title: Over-rated
Review: This place is very overly-rated for us. Assam Laksa wasn't good and quite a few stuffs in the menu are not available. Coffee just average.

Author: CraftBeerDeanDoncaster, United Kingdom
Title: Nice coffee and friendly service
Review: Nice coffee and friendly service. I didn't try the food but it looked good. It was popular with locals and tourists alike. The iced coffee was only 4 Rm and was pretty good. There is no wifi. The place looks great with lots of wood. There are also ceiling fans to keep cool.Show less

Author: PatrickT1340
Title: Incidental lunch place
Review: Excellent service and outstanding foods. Worth to drop by for authentic Penang laksa. Char kuey teow taste very good with generous numbers of prawns.

Author: axlim09United Kingdom
Title: Hidden gem
Review: I wasnt expecting best assam laksa. Honestly, we were finding any restaurant to dine in and rest then continue our journey. This is a Hidden Gem, and I liked the assam laksa here as compared to the famous one at air itam. The customer service is quick and friendly. They made us feel welcome. Its in a colourful and pretty decoration. BEST. Show less

Author: 685susanhSingapore, Singapore
Title: Best Assam Laksa
Review: I tried many Assam laksa from different stalls including the one at air itam while I was in Penang. I must say that this cafe serves the best! Super spicy and super sour with lots of ingredients! They don't serve any other dishes except for Assam laksa and they do it very well. If you like Assam laksa, you must try and decide for yourself if this is the best.Show less

Author: justmarigold
Title: Amazing value
Review: Exceedingly friendly service with amazingly good Laksa at a cheap price. Drinks were an amazing value too.

Author: 743oles
Title: The nicest café in town
Review: Cosy café serwing great Assam Laksa and a good place to try the awsome Nutmeg juice. Very friendly laidback owners ... and the prices are reasonable even though the café is placed next to Armenien street.

Author: KPinHKHong Kong, China
Title: Friendly Owners - Good Laksa
Review: This is a nice little stop for some asam laksa. I'm not even sure if they actually serve anything else. But do one thing, and do it well, that's what I always say. I actually don't always say that, but in this case it works. The owner and his son(?) were extremely friendly and it was a good bowl of soup - no frills. Worth a stop!Show less

Author: gyuhoqqDaegu, South Korea
Title: Laksa!! 락사 전문점!!
Review: 락사는 페낭에서만 맛볼수 있는 특이한 음식이죠. 다른사람들 리뷰를 보면 마치 참치김치찌게와 비슷하다하는데 정말 그말이 딱 맞아요. 하지만 민트가 들어가서 야채를 씹다보면 갑자기 민트향이 훅 올라옵니다. (저는 민트를 좋아해서 맛있게 먹었습니다.) 면발은 탱글탱글 한게 정말 식감이 좋았습니다.사장님이 너무 친절하고 늘 웃는 모습이어서 저절로 기분이 좋아지는 식당이었습니다.페낭 간다면 꼭 락사를 드셔보세요!! 강추!Laksa is unique in Penang. The taste is similar to Korean food Kimchi stew. The main menu has only one Laksa. They sell several kinds of drinks. The boss is very friendly and always smiling to make you feel good.Show less

Author: 727yingc
Title: Tasty laksa
Review: This place only does laksa and it's good. There's a lot of flavours going on in this bowl of laksa and I really like the touch of pineapple in there.

Author: whitevelJakarta, Indonesia
Title: Lovely cafe with delecious laksa
Review: I found this cafe when I was lookong for Khoo Kongsi. It was around 9AM I suppose.I ordered the small laksa. It might not be the most delicious laksa in Penang (subject to each preference), but it's definitely very good.The restaurant decor was lovely as it has an old chinese feel and the owner was also very nice and helpful.Show less

Author: funkykiddoLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Delicious Laksa and Uncle (Owner) Was So Friendly Too!! :)
Review: It was so worth it coming here. The laksa is unbeatable and so delicious. My mouth is watering as I am writing this. Haha :)The restaurant is lovely and it has so much character - very old feel and Uncle was super friendly and helpful. I will come back!! No doubt about that!PS: You must try the Iced Durian Coffee. Amazing!!Show less

Author: Sayhellotoworld
Title: Friendly staff & yummy laksa
Review: I came here, based on various trip advisor reviews, for a laksa & coffee. I was warmly welcome by a young, energetic, handsome & myscular boy who has first tried to identify if we could speak any common language (cantonese & english finally) and then explain their food & drinks to me. I soon realised that he is panacea to the restaurant as he has made and served the laksa & durian coffee to us and both deserved my praise.Recommended! (If you are foreign to asia, do have a look at this heritage cafe!)Show less

Author: James M
Title: Perfect Little Stop Off
Review:
My Own Cafe was the perfect little stop off on a day wandering around George Town. 

The Asam Laksa is a fish based noodle soup dish that was amazing!! Fresh juices made to order and very friendly service.

Author: burchabroadBirmingham, United Kingdom
Title: Asam Laksa to die for
Review: My friend and I stopped off at My Own Cafe for a very refreshing juice (orange, apple and carrot) by complete chance in order to escape the mid-afternoon sun whilst exploring the George Town street art.The place specialises in 2 things: fresh juices (although a selection of other beverages are available) and Asam Laksa, a spicy and sour fish and noodle based dish. We had already eaten lunch on the first visit, so just had a juice.Ended up going back the following day to try their Asam Laksa (in no small part due to the high ratings on TripAdvisor). This place thoroughly deserves the praise it receives. The laksa was just spicy enough and exploding with flavour. Absolutely delicious. Highly recommend checking out the laksa here.Service was also really friendly. All in all, it was a delight to eat at My Own Cafe.Show less

Author: 399sarahy
Title: Delicious laksa
Review: We had a delicious lunch of Assam Laksa and a durian iced coffee - both of them a must try! Staff were friendly and made the experience more lovely. Would definitely recommend and visit again.

Author: NurulS1342
Title: Best Asam Laksa
Review:
I've been recommended by this aunt who i also don't know her.. Then she recommend to me to try this Asam Laksa.. 

The owners are very friendly! Pls go and try the dishes and you wont be regret!

Author: Jessica BSingapore, Singapore
Title: Friendly service
Review: Stopped here for a quick lunch as we'd read on TA that it was THE place to eat Penang laksa. The laksa is very good, but it's basically the only thing on the menu and the kids didn't want to eat it... Not a problem for the helpful, friendly staff, who simply offered to get some fried rice for the kids instead (from one of the neighbouring cafés or hawker stalls I think - I don't know because the nice young man went and ordered it and it was brought to our table!) Try the durian coffee, even if you don't normally like durian - I don't, but the coffee was very nice!Show less

Author: Aryaziz7
Title: Great cafe!
Review: Superb food! Reasonable price! Friendly cafe owner! Hats off! Im a gym freak who take care of my diet. After reading the reviews, i could not resists it but to try. Worth it! Try the durian coffee, superbly taste.

Author: DavidH15359
Title: Laksa (only dish) and ice durian coffee. Yum.
Review: You come here solely for the Assam laksa, and I'd say it's quite an impressive offering for 6R. Coupled with a nice durian ice coffee, the entire meal becomes a real treat. A highlight of my day. Just outside the Cafe there is a vendor selling dessert: coconut ice-cream with jellies, corn, all served in a half coconut with flesh helpfully loosened for scraping out. Delicious. Show less

Author: gemjem13Bathurst, Australia
Title: Delicious
Review: My husband and I decided to try this place out as they had good reviews. Their menu is limited to laksa but that's why we went there as it is obviously their specialty. It was delicious. The customer service was also great and we felt very welcome.Show less

Author: LugrabrMelbourne, Australia
Title: Good laksa, and that's all
Review: They said my kids could have noodles from cafe next door and my husband and myself could have Laksa. Then we sit and ended up cafe next door was closed.My husband had a Laksa (good but not great) and my kids had eggs with bread. I think they should let us know, before bringing the Laksa, that the other cafe was closed. We could try to find another place to all of us have a proper meal. Despite that, staff is friendly and apple juice (fresh squeezed) was great.Show less

Author: megac2014Jakarta, Indonesia
Title: They only serve Laksa, and that only thing is enough!
Review: Their laksa is very good, not too spicy-according to the owner I believe who served us when we were there- has been adjusted to the tourists taste, you should try!The place is quite small, but the ambience is great, because I like the feel of being in an old house just like what my parents have in my hometown. You will definetely experience the feeling of being a chinese in 60's if you are a western and have no experience about it before.Show less

Author: lefrenchie_cm
Title: Really good laksa
Review:
Really good laksa in a cosy ambiance.
Great staff. 
Located in a beautiful area, you will do amazing pictures your belly full.100% recommended.

Author: 678lizBirmingham
Title: Great Penang coffee
Review: I ducked in here to avoid the rain, and ordered a Penang white coffee. It was kind of like a latte, but sweeter and creamier - really good! Cafe was clean and the staff very friendly. If I have the opportunity, I will go back to try the laksa. Show less

Author: Danielle LMontreal, Canada
Title: Great place for Laksa, juice or coffee
Review: IN this busy area of George Town it's not always easy to find place with affordable and good white coffee or juice, this is the place! If you don't want to take a taxi out of GeorgeTown for Laksa, it also offers wonderful Laksa soup in a very cosy reception area. I would highly recommend this place to stop, eat and rest your feet.Show less

Author: fabians424Cologne, Germany
Title: Best Laksa in Town
Review: Rich, sour and flavourful broth with wheat/rice noodles. We tried several Laksa Places, following our host's recommendations and this was the best one. We have been there several times - try to be there between 1.00 and 3.00 p.m. as the laksa gets thicker and even better simmering for hours. On a busy day, going there at 4.00 p.m. can be too late and they already run out of this dish. The owners family is very friendly and provide you with a good service. Remember, that Assam Laksa on Penang is different from the Laksa in the rest of Malaysia - the fish broth is not cooked with coconut milk (Curry Mee is this dish called in Penang). Show less

Author: DanielleS3518
Title: Awesome Laksa! Friendly service!
Review: This was our first food stop when we arrived in Georgetown and it didn't disappoint. The cafe is small so has a nice atmosphere and the staff are super friendly. The menu is pretty much only Laksa and drinks... but that was exactly what we were after and it was so tasty! You can watch the chef make your food, and the juice was fresh and refreshing. There is also a seperate coconut icecream stall outside and that is worth a try too.Definitely visit this place for some good, cheap Laksa in Georgetown.Show less

Author: malzySydney, Australia
Title: Limited Food & not the best taste
Review: Read about this cafe in Tripadvisor so we were in the area and called in for lunch. Only one thing on the menu and that is Assam Laksa with a choice of small or big bowl. Big bowl is not big in case you are hungry and thought a big bowl would satisfy you. We ordered two laksa and a fruit juice blend. Juice had been watered down (probably with melted ice) and the laksa was disappointing. Penang is renowned for its Assam Laksa but this one with large rice noodles is not really the best. It's ok but the bowl we had was not too appetising being swamped with tamarind taste and not much fish. It's certainly a trendy alternate place to hang out with interesting decor, but really quite small. Better food elsewhere. Show less

Author: Russell E
Title: No service
Review: Tried this place because of good reviews. Nobody around when I arrived. Looked for a menu?? Sat and waited - no one around. A table of people were leaving as I sat. Waited. Young guy came and cleared the table of those who just left, nodded at me. Waited.Still no service. So I left.Show less

Author: doraemongerSingapore, Singapore
Title: Awesome!
Review: Not really a fan of assam laksa as I'm quite afraid of the smell.. Decided to try it after seeing great review on it.. I fell right in love with it. It's so fragrant and flavourful.. Have it together with the nutmeg juice, it's a match in heaven!Show less

Author: LeonieN80
Title: Fantastic local laska!
Review: They have one dish on the menu and they do it so well - a version of laksa unique to Penang. The owners were really friendly and gave us loads of advice for other great places to eat local food. Our time in Penang was improved massively by the amazing places we ate at thanks to them!Show less

Author: Adel ling x
Title: The Taste of Penang on Our Monday Blues
Review: Very Good the Asam Laksa and coconut ice cream. The environment is very pleasing and very comfortable. The old building decoration give the feeling of nostalgia and the owner is friendly.

Author: SamuelOng
Title: BEST LAKSA
Review: Best laksa in this area I have try so far, with a coconut ice cream it is ur dream place to eat. MUST TRY

Author: hwang123
Title: Famous Asam Laksa in the busy street
Review: I order the famous Asam Laksa and nutmeg juice. Since there is no air-conditioning, I choose the outdoor setting and watch tourists walk by. The food quality is very good and price is reasonable.

Author: Melinda S
Title: Well worth a visit....
Review:
Does not look much from the outside, but well worth a visit.
The owner was very helpful and even wrote down other food to try- much appreciated.

Author: _L2722LP
Title: 槟城-George Town 【My Own Cafe】
Review:
槟城-George Town
【My Own Cafe】
果然是有名次的餐厅
Asam Laksa 超好吃 吃进嘴里那酸辣甜的味道 就激发了味蕾 胃也被打开了 面条的口感也超棒的！
白咖啡也一极棒！！
老板 老板娘人也超亲切
感觉超棒的 😁😁😁

Author: Mahe_FInterlaken, Switzerland
Title: You shouldn't miss it!
Review: What an amazing place :) only one plate to taste here but that also means very good quality! Enjoyed my laksa with a freshly fruit juice. The staff are super friendly (speak well English) and know how to make your lunch/dinner comfortable. On top of that, you have a beautiful street art on the wall, if this is not perfect to represent Penang! :DLaksa = MYR 6 for big portionShow less

Author: Go530688
Title: Yummy!
Review: I don't normally eat laksas but it was pretty much the only dish that this cafe sells so I tried one and it did not disappoint! The soup base was extremely flavorful and noodles the perfect texture and bounciness. We also ordered a mixed orange and apple juice (freshly squeezed) and it was refreshing. Definitely worth a visit if in Penang!Show less

Author: bw018Gorzow Wielkopolski, Poland
Title: Good place to chill out.
Review: My Own Cafe is a relaxed place where you can eat a very good Laksa (two portion sizes available) or grab a cold or hot drink. All very reasonably priced and the people who run the place are very friendly. Go there if you are in the area. Show less

Author: DanishaT4
Title: Superb laksa and super friendly family
Review: Had a really good lunch in this place.. The laksa was superb made by the uncle himself. The son himself makes fresh juices and the mom is a superb entertainer. Friendly family with really good hospitality. Would definitely visit this place again. 👍👍👍

Author: Sng W
Title: Stay for the assam laksa
Review: I came here at the recommendation from a staff at a nearby restaurant. The owners are very cheerful and friendly, and instantly made me felt welcome. The restaurant can get rather warm as there is no air-conditioning.This place only serves one dish - assam laksa, but when it is this good, you don't need anything else. This is one of the best assam laksa I ever had.The laksa is flavorful; tangy, slightly spicy with a hint of sweetness. The noodles are smooth and springy. If the spiciness gets to you, there is a coconut ice-cream stall conveniently located within the restaurant's front porch.Many people came here to take a photo of the street art painted on a wall in the restaurant. It's a pity that they didn't stay for the laksa as the dish is good enough to be an attraction. Come here for the street art, stay for the assam laksa.Show less

Author: siyoung91
Title: Tasty laksa and super cheap!
Review:
Really tasty bowl of laksa, and couldn't believe how cheap it was given the generous serving. Nutmeg drink also really refreshing.

Only negative is that it could do with more air conditioning - it can get quite sweaty in there!

Author: gillyl492Hong Kong, China
Title: One of must-go places
Review: I have tried various types of Laksa in Asia and I found this is the best. The Asam Laksa made here have a lot of chopped fish, vegetables, red onions, pineapple etc. The soup is hot and sour and taste perfect. Noodles are bouncy too. Besides, the owner is very friendly. Show less

Author: chocolattefudgesingapore
Title: Generous amount of Mackerel!
Review: Situated opposite Khoo Kongsi, the cafe was easy to find and offered only one main dish- Assam Laksa (RM 4.50 Small/ RM6 Large). The interior was comfortable and cosy, with an interesting wall painting which was great for photo opportunities. Their signature dish was was tangy and came in a hearty portion (we shared a large bowl), with the broth on the spicier side (as compared to Joo Hooi Cafe's version). Ingredients were added generously to the bowl of springy rice noodles- the liberal amount of mackerel was very tasty. Recommended as a pitstop to start any heritage trail in Penang:)Show less

Author: tmebay
Title: Very friendly and great Laksa
Review: Went there yesterday, after they were closed on Wednesday, and were not disappointed by the previous race reviews. The Laksa truly is amazing and the hosts are very friendly and courteous.

Author: Peter D
Title: Excellent Assam Laksa and Friendly Host
Review: I came here today to try my first assam laksa it was one of the nicest dishes I have had while travelling Malaysia. With the food and the friendly manner of the hosts the atmosphere in this little cafe was excellent.

Author: aarond956
Title: Asam laksa
Review: This place is a must if you want to try authentic Asam laksa! The fish is super fresh and they have delicious juices! Jump in an uber and get here iff you love authentic Malaysian cuisine

Author: meitonglauKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good Service
Review: Best asam laksa we have ever had. Family business, the boss & son were very friendly & helpful in assisting us to find the parking on the small alley next door. Asam laksa is the only food they served in the restaurant. The portion is extremely small. The small size could be finished with 2 slurps; large size could be finished within 5 slurps. Show less

Author: mvdzwet
Title: Tasty family affair
Review:
Lovely Penang Asam Laksa, fabulous fresh juice, nice people. 
We were passing by wondering what to eat and run into this great charming family room. Try yourself!

Author: Dallooccio-BlooSydney, Australia
Title: great local experience
Review: i had a small bowl of the Assam Laksa...it was really tasty and authentic and the little old man who makes it is really sweet too., the coconut ice-cream stall out the front is really good. a great place for a nice authentic and super cheap lunch.Show less

Author: Ameera O
Title: Tasty Asam Laksa
Review: Me and my bf was craving for asam laksa in penang. Searched on TripAdvisor and brought us here. We did not regret it. I had 2 large bowl for myself. With combination of all the ingredients that need to be in it. The level of spiciness just right. Is a must to try! Show less

Author: alank2726Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Great food, friendly service and reasonable price!
Review: Great authentic laksa (a.k.a Assam Laksa). The owner, Mr. Cheah is very friendly and helpful. He even told us about the other nearby attractions.Shop deco is simple and there is even a wall painting (listed in the map as well).A must visit if you're at this area.Show less

Author: wrchy
Title: Quiet yet roomy - will not be disappointed with Asam Laksa!
Review:
Great Asam laksa, service and hospitality! Deco is simple yet meaningful; representing true Penang heritage, culture and love for food. 

Highly recommended!

Author: calvin2424Boston, Massachusetts
Title: Popular place
Review: Went here for lunch cuz it has good reviews. Ordered Laksa soup - A balance of sweet, sour, salty and spicy elements, popular accompaniments include Vietnamese mint and fried Asian shallots. LUO HAN GUO fruit drink.Coconut shaved ice cream with peanut, sweet corns. Recommended the coconut shaved ice cream and Laksa soup.Show less

Author: Sam S
Title: Great laksa and coconut icecream
Review: We had the assam laksa, as well as a local soy drink and durian coffee (not for the fainthearted!), and then grabbed a coconut icecream on the way out - all were really good, though the laksa could have been spicier. Very friendly service, interesting interior, a cool and quiet pocket in the hustlebustle.Show less

Author: Della KSingapore, Singapore
Title: Delicious assam laksa
Review: My friends and I chanced upon this small cafe on our hunt for assam laksa, and wow we were not disapppointed. We tried a small bowl each at first, and the bowl was filled with ingredients, the noodles were springy with a nice texture, and the gravy was just the right amount of sourness and spiciness! We finished the whole bowl and drank up all the gravy. We decided to eat it again on our last day im Penang, and this time we ordered a large bowl. Once again it was so good we finished every single drop. You can end off with the coconut ice cream for dessert, which is also very good and refreshing, comes served in coconut husk, with the flesh peeled out. You even get a cup of coconut juice to go with it. They also have a foot and body massage service upstairs, which my friends and I also tried. The masseurs are good and makes you feel relaxed to continue your day in Penang. Oh and if you're hunting for Georgetown's wall art, there's one inside this cafe. Overall, a place that deserves a visit! Show less

Author: matthewtI182YG
Title: Lovely cold beers
Review: Very friendly team looked after is on blistering hot day , cool fans and cold beers helps us refresh ! Beer were 8 ringets and nice selection of food

Author: cliffong
Title: Food and Drink are average
Review:
The environment quite nice, afternoon will feel quite hot. 
The only food in this Cafe is Laksa. The Laksa is too sweet. Feel dissappointed

Author: dyganonKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Assam laksa with a kick
Review: Loving the penang Laksa here. Served with refined ingredient such as white fish and proper finely sliced pineapple and cucumber. Much better than the one served in air putih. Everything is chucky with bloody fish. Also loving the nutmeg drinks. Shame the ice stall renting a spot in the restaurant only serve ice ball. Could have selling ABC or cendol, ang ku kuih, dodol or any traditional deserts. A customer come for childhood food would want childhood drinks or desert come with it.Show less

Author: Gladys_YenSingapore, Singapore
Title: Cozy and warm cafe
Review: We 'accidently' found this café while trying to complete the street art puzzle of Georgetown. This is a good place to chill after walking under the hot sun with their refreshing juices. The owners are friendly and helpful to guide us with direction too. Hope to try their Laksa in the next visit too.Show less

Author: htoninbolton
Title: Food very nice
Review: Great place if you want noodles get a very big bowl full the western menu very good the beef stew lovely just like mum use to make

Author: KeepMemoriesSingapore, Singapore
Title: Friendly owners
Review: The mural on the wall is actually the owner father. Very friendly owners who didn't expect visitors to patronise, welcome drop in to take photos. We decided To take a break and tried the laksa. It was really good tasty and not over powering. Love it!We also tried the fried fish. Simply outstanding. Show less

Author: manonm536
Title: Delicious laksa
Review: When you visit Koh Kongsi you should stop here for a refreshing juice or for a freshly made laksa asam. The guy running this place is very warm and welcoming and enthousiastic to explain and teach you about the ingrediënts and other things in Malaysia.

Author: DulceSun
Title: Delicious Asam Laksa
Review: For an anti-spicy tourist like me, My Own Cafe's Asam Laksa was so good that I had the courage to finish a the whole bowl. And it is perfect with cold white coffee. Warm, people, nice clean little place. Made my Penang experience memorable.

Author: nellielim
Title: Original Penang laksa
Review: Locxated in Cannon Street, this is a family run coffee shop/cafe which specialises  in Penang laksa. The taste is original and it is topped with prawn paste. Nice art work at the front of the shop. A must try.

Author: MrinalP30
Title: Amazing Laksa
Review: The laksa is very good! Restaurant offers only one dish..Laksa! Different from Singapore Laksa..but very tasty. Service was excellent. My kids were with us, they couldn't eat laksa as it was spicy, they arranged burgers for them from a nearby vegetarian restaurant. Must try when in Penang!Show less

Author: Ines C
Title: Authentic
Review:
My boyfriend loved the laksa - and he hates anything with a fishy smell, so that says a lot.
Service was good and friendly.

Author: laresislandPhilippines
Title: Safe haven from the rain
Review: Just as the rain started to pour down, we pulled up My Own Cafe. We parked our bikes and ran for cover. It was about 11:30 and we were the first customers. Since we knew we were going to have to wait out the weather, we ordered 2 big sized bowls (6 RM each). It was absolutely fantastic. This is a thick soup, so even a small bowl is filling. The soup base is fantastic, and the noodles still gummy. It was still raining so we also ordered iced coffee while waiting it out. Great place to stop by.Show less

Author: Geoffg1952Garstang, United Kingdom
Title: A Little Fishy
Review: I found this little cafe on my walkabout's in Georgetown whilst looking for local "Street Art" When I visited the place was full with every seat/table occupied, shows how popular the place is. The owner was most apologetic and asked if I would like to wait or come back later. I went the day after to be greeted warmly by the owner & his son who helps him run the cafe. I looked at the extensive menu which consisted of Penang Asam Laksa small portion or Penang Asam Laksa large portion, yes this is a Asam Laksa only place. The Asam Laksa (fish noodle soup) is hot / spicy & certainly opens your taste buds & at I think 5 to 6 RM a go well worth it, so good that I went back several more times. The artwork on the main wall inside is of the owner himself.Show less

Author: joepv979
Title: Nice cafe
Review: Very nice cafe with good food. The laksa tastes very delicious and the fresh fruit juice was nice and cold. Owner is very friendly.

Author: sunnyboy9Singapore, Singapore
Title: Convenient Pit Stop in Georgetown
Review: We were there in Armenian street to look at the famous wall murals and found the walking too hot just after lunch. Seeing this was highly rated by Tripadvisor, we went in hoping to get refreshed perhaps with coconut ice cream we saw so much around that street, perhaps some snacks, cold drinks and beers. If we didn't come for the Laksa, there really was limited selection. They didn't have the beer either. The saving grace was that the staff didn't mind us bringing others food in and we ordered fresh juices to be sure.Show less

Author: 171steevec
Title: Good but only one dish - Laksa
Review: Friendly service, good dish at a cheap price but only Laksa offered. It's a mono-product restaurant. They tolerate that you bring food from the opposite restaurant if not all of your friends want to have a laksa.

Author: epicwanderingsPortland, Oregon
Title: Good laksa
Review: I ordered a bowl of laksa at My Own Cafe several months ago and had a chat with the owner's son, who prepared the laksa for me. I prefer mine on the less sweet side so next time will leave out the sugary shrimp paste that comes on top of the soup spoon. If you prefer yours salty and spicy, I would do the same. Either way, this is a good bowl of laksa and the interior is lovely! It's also in a great location.Show less

Author: V L
Title: So-so
Review: We went there based on high score at TripAdvisor.  They offer one single dish - Assam Laksa.  Honestly, I couldn't find it too impressive.  But the price is really cheap.

Author: yuunanaseHong Kong, China
Title: Good Laksa!
Review: Small shop located in the middle of Georgetown. This cafe is an excellent choice if you want to taste local Laksa (very different to singaporian Laksa) , and uses a large amount of shrimp paste with rich flavours and not spicy at all. Though, the portions are very small, so you can also try the ice-cream. Show less

Author: ShaunandSam2014London, United Kingdom
Title: Assam Laksa
Review: Well run family business. The dish; excellent, a superb blend of flavours. Not experienced enough with this style of food to express an opinion as to how true to the dish this meal was, but would highly recommend as a 'must try'. For anyone who has an aversion to "spicy food" - avoid, all of the rest of us, a big yes!Show less

Author: BradJill THong Kong, China
Title: My Own Cafe - They serve one dish (Penang Asam Laksa) and its really good!
Review: We stopped at My Own Cafe on Lebuh Cannon during a recent visit to George Town and really enjoyed the Penang Asam Laksa and iced durian coffee serve here. This is a great eatery that specialises in one dish and they seem to really get it right! The signature Penang Asam Laksa is served in either a small or large bowl (RM4.5, RM6) and it is quite tasty. Their version includes a nice dose of prawn paste, bit of mackerel and thick noodles. Overall, we found it cheap and quite delicious and well worth trying if you want to sample local food and cuisine while sightseeing in Penang (rating 4.25 of 5). During our visit, we tried the iced durian coffee (RM4) that was quite good as well. This was a milk (white) coffee with a strong, prominent durian flavour! It might sound strange but give it a try, you might like it. We found the strong flavour was quite nice after the laksa. Indoor seating area is casual and comfortable. There is a mural on the wall that brings in tourists for picture taking, this is sort of neat. They have a small table outside near the laksa station where they prepare bowls to be served to customers. In the end, we really like small eateries that serve single specialty dishes that they know they'll get right. My Own Cafe serves Penang Asam Laksa and it is very good. We would happily return for more bowls from My Own Cafe during future trips to Penang.Show less

Author: 834leahjCampbell River, Canada
Title: Asam Laksa
Review: I found this place after visiting Khoo Kongsi this afternoon. The staff are friendly and helpful and the boss even said hello. The restaurant serves primarily asam laksa a spicy noodle soup with a tamarind base and thick rice noodles. I had the small portion for 4.50 ringgit and it was very good and I would recommend it to anyone looking to sample this soup.Show less

Author: mimosa_miniSingapore, Singapore
Title: Best Assam laksa!
Review: Must try this mouth drooling Assam Laksa in Penang! being so specialised in their menu, they simply had to be the best! Noodles has got that tangy chewy texture, the broth cooked just nice, sour and spicy with pieces of mackerel in the broth.. I don't usually take spicy food but this is just right and it is sure to stimulate your taste buds. Go for the big bowl that costs RM$6. I had two children with me and they have a separate menu that orders Burger or simple dim sum from opposite restaurants. I ordered a Burger set at RM$8 for my kids aged below 6. Enjoy! Show less

Author: carolinetan
Title: Best Laksa Ever
Review: Our rickshaw driver brought us here and we decided to give it a try. The noodle melts in your mouth and the broth was light and fresh. Will definetely come back to this restaurant if we ever visit Penang again.

Author: jerzy000Melbourne, Australia
Title: Divine assam laksa
Review: You will truly miss out on the best assam laksa you will ever taste if you do not visit this fantastic little café during your stay in George Town. It is run by Evans and his father and the laksa is the only item on the menu (apart from fresh drinks and some very tasty desserts).The laksa is just the right combination of sweet and sour and spice that will get your taste buds just wanting more. We visited on a Thursday whilst in George Town and just had to return from Batu Ferringhi the following Tuesday to get one last taste before heading home. The café is a cosy little place very nicely decorated inside and you are made very welcomed by Evans and his father who obviously take great pride in their divine creation. Pity this restaurant isn't in Melbourne, Australia.Show less

Author: Elizabeth H
Title: Great Laksa
Review: Happened upon this little restaurant in Georgetown.   The laksa will not disappoint and the staff were really friendly. Great value. Highly recommended.

Author: adleong
Title: Tasty laksa and friendly efficient service
Review:
I would show you a pic of my laksa but all I have to show now is an empty bowl. Burp. 

Pleasant place for respite from the sun. To chill out. Place seems like a nice family business. I recommend them.

Author: Rick U
Title: Canadian Thumbs Up!
Review: This was probably in the top 3 places we ate while in Malashya.. The food and service were top notch, and the owners took the time to ensure you were satisfied.

Author: Exploring wBerlin, Germany
Title: Laksa was yum!
Review: Went for the world famous laksa and was well impressed. Not a massive fish fan usually so at first i was sceptical but its such a great dish. Had the white iced coffee and it hit the spot. Super friendly owner and a super cool building. Great to stop by when its too hot outside Show less

Author: Scott TPittsburgh, Pennsylvania
Title: What an Experience
Review: I just returned home from an extensive trip throughout Asia and wanted to let everyone know of my great meal at My Own Café. Being American I had never tried Laksa and wanted to say it was wonderful. You couldn't have asked for better food and service that I received during my short visit there. I recommend to all to stop by and try the famous Laksa. While there please say hello to the family and assure them that this Crazy American will be back for more.Show less

Author: CraigSJPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Worth a visit
Review: If you're in George Town, Penang, chances are the food is one of the reasons. It would be wrong to leave town without having tried Laksa, and this seems like one of the best places to experience its essential Penang style. My Own Cafe just has one dish on the menu--Asam Laksa--available in small and large sizes, both at a price that's on par with street-hawker stalls. It's a pretty interesting dish....basically a spicy fish noodle soup, but with a sour citrus edge to the broth. It might be confusing to western palettes. I tried it a few years ago at a different restaurant and didn't know what to think, but I had it here and loved it! During my visit, the waiter was really friendly and helpful. Definitely recommended!Show less

Author: NatalieReport
Title: Tasty! Must try!
Review:
Good local soup and sooo smiling friendly staff!
And they make fresh juice like my mom :)
Thank you, guys for our lunch today, It was really delicious!

Author: Azrael84
Title: The place to try Laksa
Review: Tried the famous Asam Laksa and really enjoyed it. The durian coffee was however, erm...let's just say a little too exotic for our taste buds! The waiter was very friendly too, which was nice.

Author: Lara MMelbourne, Australia
Title: Great value for money on the tourist trail
Review: We popped into this cafe when we were exploring George towns street art. The place does a nice laksa and great penang coffee at a reasonable price. The decor is quite interesting, a mural on the wall and lots of old fashioned artefacts which I imagine are from the war. Great service too! Worth a bite if you're in the area.Show less

Author: AlxcamPhnom Penh
Title: The Laksa was Awesome!
Review: They had a big sign out the front for the Asam Laksa, which I heard was good. It was early and the place was quiet, but Evans was very friendly. I opted for a small bowl, but really wish I'd had a large! It really was an awesome taste! Well worth a try, I wish I had had time to go back again on that trip.Show less

Author: OoBenjaminoO
Title: Just Yumm...!!!
Review: Been traveling thru Asia quite some time now, and as a professional Chef I love my food.By Far the best Assam Laksa i had in my life... The Balance of sweet and sour, just fantastic. The fresh Ingredients. Staff is also happy chatting about the area and them self.Loving it ! and 4RM is a really fair price Cya Soon Guys for round 2BenShow less

Author: CraigLaronta
Title: Something different
Review: Sampled the famous Asam Laksa and a cup of durian coffee, and boy they are delicious in a certain way although the after taste was pretty strong. Still an interesting alternative to conventional cafe food.

Author: Victoria ZMexico City, Mexico
Title: Interesting food for adventurous
Review: First time trying the famous local delicacy and found it slightly soury for my tastebud. Like the retro feel and good service, but somehow I went overly adventurous and sampled the durian coffee which my local friend highly recommended, and perhaps it was way too much for me.Show less

Author: Dehan H
Title: Great food
Review: Great laksa, owner and cute cafe  :) best laksa I've ever had in my life! With fish bits  and drinks .... yummy!!!!!!!

Author: 684raymondkHong Kong, China
Title: Excellent Laksa, very nice host
Review: We came while finding a wall painting. The staff warmly welcomed us to come in and take photos and introduced the origin of the paintings. he didn't ask ja to order any food or berverges but I decided to try the laksa here because it was the only item other than drinks and it wasn't disappointing but indeed the beat laksa I have tried in my Malaysia trip. I had a wondeful experienece for the host's hospitality and the tasty laksa. Show less

Author: Giogina R
Title: Unique local food
Review: Visited this cafe to check out the famous laksa. Not bad and pretty tasty than other typical local food. May revisit to try out others.

Author: Sebastian L
Title: Unique taste for the adventurous
Review: Tried the popular Asam Laksa which was heavily promoted by the staff and we were pretty satisfied with the unique taste. The other specialty durian ice cream and coffee are way too adventurous for us and the taste stucked in our minds for days.

Author: wmybrenda
Title: laksa & service are excellent
Review: it's so warm that the person of the wall painting is the father of the cafe owner,the size of the laksa not large but excellent traditional taste which almost lost in malay.

Author: Benedict C
Title: Unexpectedly Best Penang Laksa Around
Review: was looking for the street art paintings and realised it was inside this shop. Nice folks welcomed us to take photos without pushing us to order their food... but we decided to return their genuine welcoming gesture and ordered 1 bowl of laksa to share... we endeded up ordering 3 more bowls... all Large ones... go figure ...btw take a look at their wall... see if u can spot someone familar...Show less

Author: Sin-Kwan
Title: great place for a bowl of authentic homemade asam laksa
Review: It's a great place for a bowl of authentic homemade asam lakas, the quality is so good that you will definitely want to go back!

Author: GaoMei-SGSingapore, Singapore
Title: Thumbs up for Assam Laksa and Ice Durian Coffee
Review: Was on the art trail when I came upon the café at around 3pm. Remember reading it by some Penang blogger, indicating there is an art piece on the wall within the café and their laksa is good. Their menu also have durian coffee which I haven't come across in other cafes' menu. So decided to give it a try. Both owners, father and son, welcomed me to take photos. I had a good chat with Evans, the son, on the story behind the café.The café is decorated with lots of old toys and articles, many I had seen when I was a kid, hence gives a familiar and cosy feeling. There is a sofa at a corner which seems comfortable for a group of 6-8.Coming to ice durian coffee, it's great!! The mixture of durian and coffee taste was just nice. Evans shared some tips on how to prepare a cup of nice ice coffee.The laksa was sold out for the day so I went back another day to try it. It is good and sour enough, suits my taste. I am glad I went back for their laksa.Show less

Author: 310dz
Title: RM 5 Laksa - Brilliant
Review: Stopped in for my first Laksa and man I'm glad I had it here. Price was right and service was awesome. In total my wife and I spent RM 7 for this and two mineral waters. I'd come back if I wasn't leaving Penang today.Oh and it's right in the heart of Georgetown. Recommend a Laksa here.. Not sure about there other dishes but.. :)Show less

Author: peachiepaganPortishead, United Kingdom
Title: Must try the Penang Laksa
Review: I came across this place on the street art route and as there's one inside I decided to have a drink. Instead I ended up ordering their speciality Laksa which was absolutely fantastic and best I've tasted in Malaysia ! Very friendly family orientated cafe and can have either a small or large portion. Small is sufficient mind I did eat every last bit it was that good and so cheap too ! Show less

Author: Sagan W
Title: Nice Cafe with friendly owner
Review: This is a small cafe with a limited menu serving a variety of fresh juices and a regional fish and noodle soup dish. The soup was excellent! The juices were also refreshing on a hot day

Author: LuongCongTu
Title: Amazing Asam Laksa
Review: Go there and try the Asam Laksa. It is freakin amazing! I have Laksa from three different places around George Town and My Own Cafe has the best tasting one.

Author: Micia1506Singapore
Title: A must try
Review: Chanced upon this cute place filled with Heritage, the first Assam Laksa I have in Penang and nothing has measured up ever since. Very well spiced and nicely presented. The Durian Coffee was also very nice. Both accompanied with the very friendly people there was a great start before the walk along Armenian street. I look forward to trying the Char Kway Teow on my next trip.Show less

Author: esther l
Title: Good service n nice penang asam laksa
Review: My kids enjoyed the American breakfast and my husband  and I had a ball 🍲 of  good taste traditional penang asam laksa

Author: davlim
Title: Yammy roasted duck
Review: Luckily I found this kimpo famous roasted Duck new location... The new location is located at gurney drive(Persiaran Gurney) Coco island cafe. Very nice and comfortable cafe.. Pls call 0182284698 for order or make order thru FOOD PANDA

Author: Harrison-F-Carter
Title: Really enjoyed...
Review: Visited three times during our stay, just for a snack, and got the BBQ pork each time. Really lovely.

Author: Jennifer L
Title: Lives up to the reputation
Review: Excellent barbecue pork and crispy duck. Both were good but next time we would get just the bbq pork--it was so good. We love fatty pork though. Friendly and helpful staff. Good price.

Author: Rosie J
Title: Best duck
Review: We had crispy duck and it was the best I had in Malaysia it’s a must try. You will find them in the red garden food centre only a few doors up from the blue mansion.

Author: 363rajaramk
Title: Nice and Juicy
Review:
I tried this chicken rice after seeing the trip advisor logo. I must agree with the review and feedback given.

The roasted chicken is really nice. And the price is quite moderate.

Author: bigwik
Title: Very nice restaurant
Review: Great Roasted Chicken and duck. Restaurant is located within the Red Garden. English speaking informative staff, delicious fresh food

Author: stevemG9926LY
Title: Awesome
Review: Crispy roast duck was the choice and I wasn’t disappointed at all. Not only was it crispy skin but the meat was tender and tasty.

Author: Graham_and_Susan414
Title: Worth A Visit
Review: Thank you to Connie at this place, it is good tasty food and reasonably priced a must visit if you are at the Red garden Food Paradise food court.

Author: slickandshazzNelson Bay, Australia
Title: Oh for duck's sake!
Review: Honestly, the absolute best roasted duck ( did I mention crispy skin?) we have tried in wonderful Penang. Blew us away, the flavour superb as was the quality of the meat. Should we go Vegan after this ? I think not...Thanks folks for a great experience Show less

Author: skyhightravellers
Title: Delicious duck.
Review: Fabulous duck, really tasty. Great atmosphere in the food hall. Very reasonably priced. Definitely recommend.

Author: Virginia231975
Title: Excellent crispy duck
Review: The best crispy duck I ever ever ate. It is exquisite. It is not that cheap but it is duck and it is above all excellent and worth to pay the price something like 20 rm. The roasted duck with wan tan mee is oki, cheaper but better take the crispy duck served with some soup asideRed garden is popular for locals and above all tourists. The place is very noisy but you can use a table a bit away from the bla bla of other people. Plastic chairs and tables. Basic. In the evening there is sometimes artists coming to demonstrate what you can do, so you pay indirectly also that forThe food choice is excellent, which dish can’t you find here in that food court of Red garden?With roasted duck I was not full, so I also ordered dumplings at another stall and then it was ok . With the crispy duck it is enough wihout rice you are not frustrated. The portion of the dumplings was ok for the price. The portion of the crispy duck is ok.Service of Kimpo roasted duck is very good. They even come to check if it is good. Bangladeshi people don’t serve anymore drinks at red garden apparently. Now there are malaysian waiters and so better service There are only 9 different juices mentioned on the wall and they don’t understand nothing to what you want, so I let it go and I didn’t order anything. The other times I went the server was a friendly non Bangladeshi woman so the service was ok and she could understand immediately what I wanted. You can find cheaper drinks elsewhere besides. The value for money is ok, it is bit expensive because it is duck and inside red garden, the portions could be a bit bigger for roasted duck but the crispy duck is very good. I’m looking forward to going back there for the 7th time since 2019. i discovered the place in 2017Show less

Author: Theadventuresofus
Title: A TASTE SENSATION
Review: This eatery is located in the RedGarden Asian Fusion Eatery in Penang, Malaysia. The hostess/chef extraordinary is not only friendly and welcoming but takes such a pride in her culinary offerings. We had three servings from this amazing woman who makes crispy in all three of duck, pork and chicken a taste sensation that just wants you to come back for more! We highly recommend this food and give it percent for value, flavour, service and hospitality!Show less

Author: Bill666999
Title: Don’t Duck on this One
Review: Duck and meat superb well worth visit prices are very reasonable. Host extremely nice and helpful. Best meat we have had so far in Penang.

Author: NorcaLCNew Orleans, Louisiana
Title: Dinner next to Blue Mansion!
Review: We had just arrived in Penang and didn’t have time to research a dinner place so we decided to check out this place. Wow, the crispy duck and BBQ pork is a must-try! It’s 5–star spot with a very friendly cook whom we had the pleasure to chat with. Show less

Author: debbiespeers
Title: The Best
Review: Living in Singapore, we have been to many Hawker Centres and tasted their wonderful array of food but this beats all that we have had. Amazing Duck, as must to try and that Roast Pork, we are coming back tomorrow night for a whole plate. Thank you fantasticShow less

Author: PimVugts
Title: Super cheap
Review: The hawker is located in a big covered center with other stalls. Luckily we had a roof over our head, since it was pouring down the whole evening.As already described by others, the crispy duck was phenomenal. Yet, you should also definitely try the BBQ chicken and pork!And to top it off, it only costs you 30 RM to get both, win win :) Show less

Author: 687andyl
Title: Absolutely amazing!
Review: The crispy duck is one of the best I've had, and the pork wasn't far behind! The crispy pork dumplings are also definitely worth a try! All cooked by an extremely friendly man who is always smiling and talking to his customers. A must visit!
