Author: Chupp
Title: Best DUCK EVER!!!
Review:
This duck is the best I have ever eaten by so far.

Located in the Food Court,  you order, tell them your table number and wait.... 

Ente gut - alles gut!

Author: TheEagerDinerStockholm, Sweden
Title: Yes Yes Yes!!!
Review: It's famous for a reason, and that's because it's simply delicious. I tried the crispy duck which is what the waitress suggested as she told me this is what they are famous for and I have to say, as far as I can remember it's THE BEST DUCK I HAVE TRIED. Crispy on the outside and so soft in the middle!!! If you don't fancy rice, just get a whole plate of duck, it's amazing, hence the reasoning for a 5 star rating,Show less

Author: figgs289
Title: Best crispy roast pork in town
Review: Been coming here every year since 2014. Unbeatable roast pork in a food court with all the ambience you would expect in Penang

Author: CraftBeerDeanDoncaster, United Kingdom
Title: Nice chicken
Review: I ordered the quarter chicken for Rm 11 and gave them my table number and sat down. one of the wandering drinks waiters came round and asked me if I wanted anything to drink. I ordered a large Guinness for Rm 20 (4 Euros). The price seems to be going up every year. My chicken arrived and was pretty good. Quite juicy. RecommendedShow less

Author: ScottM130
Title: Great value
Review: Had the roast duck and pork ... my preference the duck ... but both excellent. The atmosphere at the hawker site is cute ... and it would be fun to eat when the entertainment begins.

Author: Peter S
Title: Great food
Review: I have been in George Town for 3 weeks and this is simply the best place in town to eat. The duck and brown sauce is excellent and bbq pork was great too. The chef was great and spent a few minutes to chat, his English is good. It may be hard to find in George Town but worth th effort. So refreshing after weeks of chicken and fish. This place is excellent. Worth the effort to find.Show less

Author: Marg22
Title: The reviews say it all
Review: We visited last evening and really enjoyed sharing a plate each of crispy pork and crispy duck. Delicious food for a reasonable price. The whole hawkers market was really worth the visit. Will go again before we leave.

Author: Tony P
Title: As advertised...
Review:
Go to Kimpo Famous Roasted for the Crispy Pork & Crispy Duck. You won't be
disappointed. It came exactly as advertised. Scrumptious and delicious.
Only day they're closed is Wednesday, open every other day from 6 pm to midnight.

Author: Leonathan2013Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Popular Roasted Pork & Duck
Review: I have read positive reviews of this food stall & ordered the wan ton noodles with roasted pork (siew yoke) for dinner at the red garden hawker center. Since his assistant was busy , the owner who had a friendly disposition personally brought over the noodles to our table. The noodles with the crispy pork was truly delicious. I was unable to try the famous roasted duck as I was full after tasting the various other hawker fare . Visitors to Penang must not miss out this food stall .Show less

Author: petmeff70
Title: Crispy pork
Review:
I found this place on trip advisor.
Short walk from Chulia Mansion Hotel.
It is inside Red Garden food paradise.
Pork was as promised delicious and crispy.
Thanks Kimpo.

Author: marianaesthers
Title: Amazing!
Review: I went to Kimpo Famous Roasted with my mother and we ordered the crispy & BBQ pork and the roasted duck, and let me tell you a secret: to use the word “delicious” to describe the meals is an UNDERSTATEMENT. It’s absolutely revolutionary! On another level of culinary excellence! Everyone has to try this when they visit Georgetown, Penang.Show less

Author: 647freyapJakarta, Indonesia
Title: Best crispy pork ever!!!
Review: Just went here for a dinner with my family around 7PM. The chef which I assumed the owner is very friendly and recommend us with the dishes. I ordered 1 crispy pork, 1 bbq pork and some vegetables with rice. Both of the porks are all great, but the crispy pork is just amazing! They are very tender and have the perfect balance of meat and fat, and so the skin is just so crispy! I wish I tried the noodle coz it seems delicious. Will come back here again if I go to penang and try the noodle..It's located inside the Red Garden Restaurant, just go to the right side when you come in from the back entrance (if you come in from the front entrance where there's parking lot, you'll find Kimpo on the left side at the back).Show less

Author: juanalfrescoIndia
Title: Amazing
Review: It’s not often i write a review but this is one of the best joints i’ve ever eaten at. It’s also not often i eat two meals, but this is legit asian food at a VERY reasonable price. I had a Beautifully cooked duck wonton soup followed by a similar dish but with pork. Words almost are not enough - go and try Kimpo Famous Roasted for yourself and i gurantee you will not be dissapointed. Show less

Author: Josh K
Title: Porking good!
Review:
Crispling and yum. Chef breaks English good. Cheap cheap. 10.50 dorra malay 
Chili source need hot but tast good

Author: LorenP247
Title: Must try!
Review: Crispy, delicious and really inexpensive! I would have ordered but we also ordered few other dishes so we had more than enough food for 2 adults and 1 kid. :)

Author: oneflightabroad
Title: Very bad service
Review: We have to wait for 45 to 60 minutes. Everybody around us get there food and they came like 30 minutes later! When we ask why she said we have to wait! We walked away! Very very bad service! Never again

Author: SvendsenL
Title: Great food, really cheap
Review: Really good food, nice people serving. It's so cheap and even though the servings seem small, it will make you full. And if not, you can just add some dim sum or spring rolls from another stall

Author: Basile B
Title: Good food, small quantity
Review: We try duck and pork.The food was good, but nothing special.People are super friendly, even if they forgot to give our food !We have to ask again to get it, but it was not a problem.We have a good experience at this place, with this particular environement (music, noisy, crowded...). We recommend you to try this place at least once, to discover the area !Show less

Author: Paweł Z
Title: Very good duck!
Review: We had a great meal, 1/4 of crispy duck and a pork BBQ. Both dishes were very good, but duck was better. On the down side is the fact that there are many pieces of duck on a plate that you don't eat in Europe.

Author: O7996TRkarenmParis, France
Title: Good and cheap!
Review: Nice food at this food court.I’m not a big fan of Asian food in general but I enjoyed the crispy pork. My boyfriend had the soup and the crispy duck with noddles. It was good and we only paid 22MYR!Really nice area where everybody can order what ever he prefers Show less

Author: JuanitaW657Melbourne, Australia
Title: Best Crispy Duck and Crispy Pork
Review: We read reviews on TripAdvisor and decided to go as it was 100 metres from our accomodation. Being a family of 6 we ordered a whole duck (60 ringits) and 3 plates of crispy pork(10 ringits each) and a vegetable dish. The duck was so yummy and tender- it melted in your mouth-cooked to perfection. We’ve eaten along of crispy duck in Footscray, Melbourne, Australia and this was up here with the best! The pork was a generous amount, so soft with lovely crispy skin, but not fatty. We all thoroughly enjoyed our meal. We also loved the Red Garden setting, as you order at the hawker and then sit down- you pay for your food when they bring it over. Love the service! There are drinks waiters who take your order- beer and fresh juices, and deliver it to you. Its very very affordable- just need cash only.We went back the next night again especially for the Crispy duck and pork- but it was closed! Hoping it’s opened tonight!!Show less

Author: 913johnsmith
Title: Duck not as amazing as I read about
Review:
Duck not as amazing as I read about
Nied atmosphere at this market and lots of other choices for starters, main courses and deserts
Live music quite loud

Author: Jorge6880
Title: The best choice on "Red Garden"
Review:
Among the options on the food court "Red Garden" this is by far the bet option. 1/4 duck 15r.
Best duck in the country.

Author: 143mickbMoraira, Spain
Title: Best crispy duck in town (and for 35 years)
Review: Just had an interesting evening at the Red Garden food hall where we watched some questionable but entertaining live acts.Whilst being dazzled by the vast array of food available I plumped for the roast pork from "Kimpo". It was sublime. So much so that I went back and had a portion of the "Kimpo" crispy duck.I have had crispy roast duck many times before, but this was on a different level. It took me back 35 years to my college days in Liverpool when we used to visit Chinatown and I first encountered the famed duck. Somehow after those initial tastings, it never quite tasted the same; but tonight what I had was every bit as good as I remembered.Well done Mr Kimpo. I salute you.Show less

Author: HenryC1064
Title: BEST DUCK EVER
Review: Amazing. Food we ate the 1/4 crispy duck served with wantan mee which you can have either in a soup or dry in is wantons in a noodle soup!19 ringitsAbsolutely. Delicious! Best crispy duck ive ever had so moist and cripsy :)Loved it so much. We even ordered an extra side of crispy duckHighly recommend if you fancy some duckLovely owner as well, he will make sure he mentions his duck is famous and I can see why! Show less

Author: RusutsuPulau Sipadan, Malaysia
Title: Crispy duck and wonton noodles
Review: I ordered 1/2 a duck and wonton noodles. They were the only food I could remember from the range we ordered at Red Garden, so that speaks volumes of its quality. I thought it was the best value street food we had for the entire trip.Show less

Author: 397mirenb
Title: Delicious crispy duck and pork
Review: Just had dinner there, they are in the red garden hawker. The duck was DELICIOUS, as well as the pork.

Author: Sharona1990Birmingham, United Kingdom
Title: Best duck ever!
Review: I had the 1/4 crispy duck with Wonton noodle soup for 19 RM and my partner had 1/4 crispy duck with rice set for 20 RM, we both thought it was amazing! Although agreed that my noodle soup was tastier than the rice. The duck is the best we've ever had! So crispy and juicy! Just be careful with the bones. Show less

Author: greenham01San Jose, California
Title: I agree!
Review: Had a hankering for duck during my recent stay and the stall at Carnarvon St for some reason was never open. Tried several times over several days....but that's another story.Tripadvisor recommended this place but given it is at the touristy Red Garden food court, I had low expectations. I am glad to report I was wrong.I tried their dry roasted duck (pei par duck) and it was good - wasn't fatty, the skin was crispy, and the meat tender and not gamey as some ducks could be. Nice. The menu can be a bit confusing with a gamut of combinations, best just go up to them and tell them what you want and have them recommend you. I had their rice with 1/2 duck, but next time, think I will try their egg noodles instead - that looked good too!Show less

Author: zoew425Wolverhampton, United Kingdom
Title: AMAZING
Review: Had the duck set for 20R. Outstanding value for money could barely finish it shall be returning tomorrow evening! The dumplings are also amazing. Lovely guy who runs it with excellent customer service skills! It's located inside the food quarter of red garden. Highly recommended 5*** Show less

Author: reginapicaullyBandung, Indonesia
Title: Best and cheap duck I ever had
Review: My dad was on diet and he only eat meat. I suggested him to eat here since our hotel was just few steps away. And we ate here every night in Penang. Now he's craving for this duck. The uncle is very friendly and the duck is very delicious. And of course the price is cheap!Show less

Author: amandar633
Title: Is it supposed to be served cold?
Review: I had the pork plate with rice and it was cheap so that was a plus. But the crispy pork is served cold. I'm not usually a picky eater but I just ate the crispy bits on the end and left the rest

Author: AaronKin
Title: Good Wanton Noodles and Roast Duck
Review: overall really good roast duck, friendly bosses especially the lady boss. Food was good, and cheap eat. Come try!

Author: safwanlim
Title: Execellent choices chicken or duck
Review: A simple meal you could not resists either mixed with chicken or duck or both with rice. A bowl of won ton soup you could enjoy.  All one could choose differently from the menu...yummy delicious.

Author: Sosuma
Title: Nice duck
Review: 20RM for crispy duck set. Duck was tasty and the portion size was good. Friendly owners and worth a try.

Author: edwE9454FT
Title: Awesome Roast Duck
Review: If you want some great roast duck, this is the place!  Owner is very friendly and his food is very tasty!  Yummm

Author: Brettski73Adelaide, Australia
Title: Fantastic duck
Review: Inside the red garden food court. We ate from 3 different establishments and the duck dish by kimpo was best by far, lovely crisp skin and very tender meat. If you like your duck, definitely give this place a go. I just ordered a 1/4 duck, came with cucumber and hoisin sauce, it was also the best serving size we received. Show less

Author: ken2oNew York City, New York
Title: Must try!
Review: My hotel is right next to the Red Garden hawker food center. Duck is one of my favorite choice of meats. Kim Po knows how to make a phenomenally crispy duck at a price that's easy on the wallet. Duck this delicious could easily go for 3x the price in the west. If you pass Red Garden, definitely order a fish from Kim Po. Your taste buds will receive a pleasant shock. Show less

Author: Chris B
Title: Delicious, clean and economical
Review:
We have had 1/4 duck a couple of times........delicious

Inside the Red Garden food court

15 ringitt (A$5) per 1/4 duck
10 ringitt per 1/4 chicken

This Dude is proud of what he does and it shows

Author: Ramin07London, United Kingdom
Title: Amazing delicious treats
Review: We just had lunch at Kimpo's and the food was amazing, very local and incredibly fresh.The service was also incredible and they take great pride in what they do. It's very clear they love what they do and you can tell in the taste. We had crispy duck, crispy pork and delicious little pork wantons. We cannot recommend this place highly enough! Go down and visit the guys for some delicious little treats, is definitely worth your while. Show less

Author: paulcosta5
Title: The best roast duck
Review: We visited this restaurant in The Red Garden and had a dish of their roast duck. We have had many similar roast duck but this was as good as it gets. If you are in the area do not miss out.

Author: 505liamc
Title: Really nice cheap food
Review: Ok, so this place is actually in the Red Garden food square. The food was really good and cheap (I had the roast duck). The owner (and chef) was also lovely and came out to ask where I was from and what I thought of the food. Really nice unassuming place.Show less

Author: Andrew K
Title: Amazing Duck
Review: This place certainly lives up to its expetations of serving wonderfully crisy moist duck and the pork is a real winner also,definately be coming back

Author: John O
Title: Superb crispy roasted duck
Review: We had 1/4 roast duck and a plate of noodles with choi sam.  Delicious. Great friendly service, and only RM18.

Author: markwH5584AMDee Why, Australia
Title: A good meal for the price
Review: We went to the Red Garden food market on a recommendation, Kimpo was closed that night but one of the drinks waiters spoke rally highly of Kimpo so we decided to return a couple of days later to try it.I have to say that the crispy duck and pork plate that we tried was a good dish of food, not amazing, but the meat was moist, whilst the duck had bones they were very easy to pick out and the pork wasn't too fatty. It was also a generous portion.There are plenty of other places to try in the Red Garden area but I would return and try some of the other dishes on the menu. I think it was reasonably priced, living on a small island of the coast of Thailand I'm used to paying more for my food.Show less

Author: ReviewsByDan
Title: What's All The Fuss About?
Review: Found their stall at Red Garden and decided to see what all the fuss was about. Ordered a mixed plate of duck and pork. Pork was excellent, but nothing really set it apart from any other decent roaster. Duck was crispy alright, being over cooked and a rather hard chew. Not the cheapest either compared to the other options surrounding it.Show less

Author: Katie-ElizabethMBristol, United Kingdom
Title: Just brilliant
Review: Are here last night, the red garden area is brilliant, love music and lots of atmosphere. We shared the 1/4 crispy duck and it was amazing, the duck had bones but plenty of meat came with rice and a sweet plum sauce. The owners were helpful and friendly and approached us after to ask how the food was and engaged in conversation with us, we really enjoyed our visit and will return before we leave.Show less

Author: priscyntia
Title: Very good
Review: I ordered both crispy duck and crispy pork. They were both very good and the portion was generous! The service was good too

Author: GeoffD395
Title: super pork
Review:
We had to visit the food court twice just so we could try this pork
crispy skin, quite cheap and very very yummy

Author: Bill NDublin, Ireland
Title: Very accommodating and true dedication
Review: I have been a little worried about what food to order from hawker stalls, however the owner I'm assuming was very accommodating in reassuring me about what I was ordering i.e no heads or other unwanted parts on the duck we ordered. Absolutely delicious, tender crispy duck. A true gentleman who was serving us. Very much appreciated being so far from home! Show less

Author: Güliz EIstanbul, Turkey
Title: Go for it
Review: Kimpo is one of many local eateries at the Red Garden which is teaming with life in the evening in George Town. We looked at all the various options at the Red Garden, having spent two weeks eating locally in different parts of Malaysia. Kimpo turned out to be an excellent choice. His crispy duck (prepared a la Malaysia, different from Peking) and pork were very good, vegetables tasty and service was excellent.Show less

Author: PapersuxsTampa, Florida
Title: The pig won
Review: Had both the duck and the pork, it was the pork that won me over. It had the right amount of fat, crispness and was more flavorable. The duck was dry with a slight aftertaste. Also the duck was chopped in small pieces that you had to be careful to not swallowing a bone.Show less

Author: philli1Hagley, United Kingdom
Title: Came for the duck, but it was the pig that won!
Review: Came here for the duck. However we weren't overimpressed. It wasn't bad, it's just that we had high expectations after all the rave reviewsHowever, the crispy pork was very good and was a surprise.We were still hungry so went elsewhere in the food court.Show less

Author: Battlinglime
Title: Great Mexican food
Review: Visited the restaurant for lunch. Mr Ranjit who attended to us was friendly and recommended the restaurant finest food. Of course they were delicious. Will come back again for other dishes they have to offer.

Author: Stuart294265Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Excellent Quality Mexican - drinks a little expensive
Review: The food is excellent quality here and we tried many of the smaller plates to eat over 2 evenings. The drinks are a little expensive (bottles of beer) but I would say the cocktails are worth the price as have good amount of alcohol and mixed very well - try a BullDog !Show less

Author: henrysusanti
Title: Best Mexican Food and Resto in Penang
Review: Good food of dine in or delivery. Authentic flavour of tacos, nachos, sopa, enchilada, fajita and all. Tried most food from menu and love it all. Always back for more. Resto itself is small, nice decor and good mural. Very recommended!

Author: DaveThompson16Ampang, Malaysia
Title: Ok everything if you’re craving Tex-Mex
Review: We were attracted by the cool decor!Started with nachos with additional guacamole. Very nice. For our main courses, my wife had chicken fajitas (very good but no cheese, and the salsa was dry) and I had a Holyritos, which was tasty and filling. A plate of churros with chocolate sauce to finish. We shared a pitcher of frozen margaritas, which were a little too sweet for my taste, but still ok. Service was very friendly and responsive - no complaints there. All told it came to RM198. Decent food and decent value. Probably wouldn’t search it out again, but ok for a one-off.Show less

Author: Muneswaran
Title: Good enviroment and good service
Review: Good is great and they will guide u on each menu items to be ordered.The service is great where the waiters are very friendly.

Author: resureihosto
Title: Delicious Mexican Cuisine Foods. Splendid Environment
Review: We usually have hangout with friends in this unknown cultural restaurant. The environment brings some Mexican pattern and some Spanish music rhymes. Although the cooks are not Mexicans, they did cook some awesome foods. We're Asian and do enjoy these kind of Mexican vibes.

Author: aidahrhdc
Title: Catch-up dinner
Review: Went to have dinner with bestie.  Had great time coupled with great food, loved the tacos, the churros is a must try 😍, the ambience was superb, ig worthy venue...very vibrant and colour full decor.  Friendly staff and fast service

Author: lelatobeng
Title: Great time great place
Review: Went for dinner with my bestie, great food, great service, great atmosphere. The staff were very helpful and friendly, fast service and the place is super comfy. It was our first time there but they made us feel like regulars 👍🏼👍🏼👍🏼👍🏼👍🏼

Author: IverrencePenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Little Mexican Secret Penang
Review: Went there with my wife as she was craving some Mexican food (She’s an American, kinda explains it). It wasn’t hard to find parking spots given Penang standard, well, the shop did follow the SOP pretty well and all in all it was a pleasant experience, the price for margarita was splendid, and the food was scrumptious. The staffs were quite attentive and did not get frazzled even though there were quite a number of customers during our second visit.If you’re craving tex-mex, well, search it up and give it a shot.Show less

Author: ditchnapper
Title: Atmosphere with service
Review: Nice small place. If weather permits, can sit outside in area which is not on the street, unlike most other places in this zone.  Great tacos and margaritas.  Very good service

Author: MrNeillM
Title: Great food & atmosphere!
Review: Very nice with excellent food Mexican restaurant.   I'm told same owner as the larger restaurant two lots away "the Loft".    Indoor and outdoor seats.  Very quaint to sit outside after dark (and the weather cools off).

Author: JCGUILLOU
Title: Disappointing
Review:
Supposed to be the best in penang.
Salsa no coriander... margarita tastes like a very sweet premix.. staff was mostly not interested.... food was ok. Below par. This is covid time so perhaps that explains.

Author: aby2099Bukit Mertajam, Malaysia
Title: Love the food, ambience, music- just everything!
Review: Lovely ambience, super friendly and warm staffs, food was so so good.. the guacamole is just so perfectly made. Enjoyed the churros, too! Quesadillas were yummy! I had a lovely monitor, hubs had a coconut margarita. So good on a hot afternoon. Will definitely go back again and again and again! The staffs were so friendly towards my toddler and even helped heat up his food which we brought, and provided utensils for him. I would go back again and again to this place, just to try everything else on the menu!Show less

Author: Yen Shan T
Title: Really lovely ambience and happy hour
Review: The atmosphere was really nice, despite covid measures. Good dance music. Margaritas and Daiquiris cost 12 during happy hour and were pretty good. The beef burrito was delicious. Came twice during our 5 day stay in Penang.

Author: theannachew
Title: When you read this, turn around, don't step in.
Review: When you read this, you'll know why I won't recommend this place. I ordered the CHEF'S SPECIAL, the Al Pastor. The soft taco came uncooked and broken up. I told the waiter, he said the guy who made it was just there for 3 days.I asked to take it off the bill and management said it is already keyed in, too bad. That's what service is like here. Skip the place. Obviously not keen about locals. Nothing tastes authentic anyway. Holy regretsShow less

Author: meershanthini
Title: Overrated !
Review: Despite having multiple Mexican cuisine choices, all the dishes tastes similar and bland. Only Pizza is acceptable. Guacamole is tasteless and watered down. Wasted my RM12 for it.

Author: 95MichaelG95Leeds
Title: Best Mexican in Malaysia
Review: We absolutely love this place and come back every time we visit Penang. The food is amazing - the best tacos we’ve had in Malaysia and the guacamole is to die for! The staff are super friendly and go above and beyond to ensure you are happy, and the cocktails are really reasonable and delicious! A must visit!Show less

Author: Becky-san2014Ogawa-machi, Japan
Title: Amazingly good for halfway around the globe!
Review: Yearning for good Mexican food, we went to Holy Guacamole with hope in our hearts and it paid off! This eatery has a very wide menu of really tasty dishes and lovely ice-blended daiquiris & 'ritas. The decor is terrific, too. Great service and wait staff as well, especially Nadim, who treated us like old friends, not first-time customers. The only thing missing was the refried beans and rice that you get Stateside, but otherwise it was super-good. We'll definitely be heading back soon, with friends.Show less

Author: Harrison-F-Carter
Title: Lovely food
Review: Really enjoyed our visit here - friendly staff and a nice place to sit on Love Lane and watch the goings on. Food is really good.

Author: RajGill1
Title: Mexicana in lovelane
Review: Bored of kueh teows and the nasi kandars, try this mexicana guacomole for a change. good food, tasty and good portions. service not bad

Author: AlexandreNiquet1978
Title: Cool and fun place for a drink
Review:
Honest mexican food serving by a really cool staff. Great ambiance and party vibe. Cocktails are fine.
Cheers guys!

Author: henrysusanti
Title: Good Mexican food in Georgetown
Review: We enjoy the food even on delivery during this pandemic time. Fast delivery and quality. Taco el pastor, taco pulled beef barbacoa, Hongos quesadilla, Sopa de tomates and Enchiladas. All good!

Author: charlottebO8969TA
Title: Great Mexican food and lively surroundings!
Review: If you appreciate Mexican food, festive cocktails, attentive and nice waiters, relaxed atmosphere and live music - then this is the place for you! During our recent stay in Georgetown, we ended up visiting this place three times. You can choose just to have a cocktail and/or a cool beer, perhaps with a portion of their lovely tortilla chips with guacamole - or you can choose to enjoy a full dinner. One evening we had the sizzling chicken that had to be wrapped in small delicious wraps.Absolutely recommendable and we would definitely visit again, if we were to go back to Georgetown.Show less

Author: Dawnkaur1995
Title: VeRy NiCeee big sha very nice
Review: VeRy NiCeee big sha very nice hehe food very nice hehe. Very nice music hehe. Big sha very kind. Polite and cool. Very hip and swag hehe

Author: TreyM34Chicago, Illinois
Title: The beer per glass is from
Review: The beer per glass is from a can? How would any one know? Is that how they do it in Penang. The salsa was sketchy and skimpy from the appetizer but when u order another it’s proper size. Staff let a solo person sit at a table for four but would not let me and my GF sit at same size table, after the dinner rush. Just all around shady stuff. They lost the plot Show less

Author: RosseliRikke
Title: A must visit taco place!!
Review: We spent 10 days in Penang, and visited this restaurant 5 times! BEST GUACAMOLE in town. Everything taste amazing! we even had a birthday celebration with 40 people, and they did an absolutely amazing job!

Author: Sanna R
Title: Good food and nice service.
Review: We liked the place and our waiter big sha. Looking forward to come back to see the live music. Also nice decoration

Author: jandX5943FG
Title: Food amazing, service also
Review: Food amazing, service also really nice, we did not need to wait. In the evening is live music and also classic music (latin) makes your mood super relaxed.

Author: 643lauritsg
Title: Amazing food, and amazing
Review: Amazing food, and amazing athmosphere. The food was so delicious especially the mexico city pizza, and the service was top class as well. Big thanks to Ranjit, who definetely made our night!

Author: ChristineC5215
Title: Nice and perfect drinking session
Review: Big sha is a super nice guy. Friendly and provide good services. Good in holy is delicious.. Perfect..

Author: independent9919
Title: It’s good Mexican food.
Review: It’s good Mexican food in town.This time i’ve been with family and still good as before.I think only one in this area can find Mexican food so it’s good choice to go there for people who want Mexican food when traveling in Penang.

Author: j0420
Title: Top notch
Review: The foods are bomb, with very reasonable price. We love the ambience and the vibes there. The live band was also great. Went there for my boyfriend’s birthday & got a tequila shot on-house! Service are great. Thanks to Shad the server!

Author: Mactan2013
Title: A real gem
Review: This place was a real gem of a place, a good discovery in my opinion. Quaint lively place with a mixture of locals and backpackers. I’m told it gets livelier as the day goes by.

Author: juliusnitsche
Title: Best place in Penang
Review:
We came here several times during our time in Penang and I have to say its been the highlight of the trip. 
Great food and amazing drinks. Special shout-out to Big Sha, who took great care of us everytime!
We'll come again next time!

Author: Maxies88
Title: The best ever
Review: Amazing restaurant. I recommend the holy bulldog. Big Sha our server is very caring and gave us the best service ever.

Author: tommylake123
Title: Tip top Mexican vibes with live music!

Author: sambissettMelbourne, Australia
Title: Terrible Mexican Food
Review: I was skeptical about Mexican food in Malaysia, but this place had such good reviews, I decided to give it a go. I'm generally not very critical, but the whole experience was very disappointing. The restaurant is decorated with overly-stereotypical "Mexican" decor, and the waiters are neither attentive or very friendly.I ordered a margarita, which came out frozen, even though I just asked for a normal one. They replaced it with a normal margarita, which was the most disgusting margarita I've ever had. It tasted like 95% tequila with a squeeze of lime. I would have ended up on the floor if I had drunk the whole thing.The menu is not really Mexican, but more Tex-Mex, with burritos, jalapeño popper etc. Our Quesadillas were cold and quite bland. The burrito was full of fresh ingredients, but very bland and was not served with any salsa.While it was nice to have a change from Malaysian food all the time, this was a very disappointing dinner. Only come here if you want bland, fast-food-like Tex Mex food.Show less

Author: Tom GPenang
Title: World-Class Mexican food with friendly service and a great setting
Review: I am from Texas - a place where there's great Mexican food in every part of town. I've also lived in Penang for years and understand the difficulty in finding high quality international food here. Was hesitant to got to Holy Guacamole when I first heard about it as I've had some spectacularly bad Mexican food in Malaysia. What I experienced was a place that would succeed not only in Penang but anywhere in my hometown of Austin. The food is better than some of my favorite places at home - have been here many times and tried almost everything on the menu and haven't been disappointed yet.On top of high quality and fairly authentic recipes, the service is wayyy better than most places in Penang. Restaurant service quality is not a priority for most in Penang but this place has service I'd appreciate at my favorite place back home. Everyone is friendly and accommodating and actually checks in to see what you need (only place in Penang I can say this for). While the food and service win me over, it's also a very funky place with fun deco. And the nightly entertainment is good. It's a tight/crowded area at night but worth the hassle. For lunch and early dinner it's a super-relaxing place.Some of my local friends moan about the higher prices relative to local places but for the quality and serving sizes (not to mention the services and atmosphere), it's great value.Show less

Author: dandddurangoDenver, Colorado
Title: Such a Disappointment!
Review: We ate at this restaurant last week. We have known about it for awhile and were anxious to try it, but what a disappointment.Although the menu does have typical Mexican items, that was about all that was typically Mexican. First we ordered chips and salsa. The chips were actually pretty good, but the salsa had a strange taste—like there was some kind of Indian or Middle East spice in it. I ordered a beef taco. It arrived on a crisp, flat tortilla—this was a tostada, not a taco. A taco is folded in half and the contents placed inside. But I would have been okay with that except that the beef was cooked and/or marinated again in Indian or Middle East spices. These kind of spices NEVER belong in Mexican food. Having come from an area where Mexican food is very abundant, I have never in my life tasted Mexican food that tasted like that beef did. There was also some cheese on the taco/tostada; I don’t remember if there was lettuce and tomato—if there was, it was a small amount.I realize this is Penang and not Arizona or New Mexico, but with regard to the reviewers indicating that this place served decent Mexican food, apparently they have not eatten truly good Mexican food. At least use Mexican spices and not Indian or Middle Eastern spices in the preparation of the food! We thought the prices were quite high given the size and quality of the food portion. So beware—do not go here expecting traditional Mexican food—expect food with an Indian or Middle Eastern flavor. We will not be back.Show less

Love lane and the surrounding area are full of people having a great time. At the Chinese temple opposite, acrobats we’re practising their Lion dance routine which was great to watch. Sitting just inside away from passing traffic but looking out gave the feeling of being outside, and was a great position for both the live music and people watching as all nationalities strolled by. Two great evenings here in a row :-)Show less

Author: Cevdenb
Title: The fajitas with chicken are amazing
Review:
Gluten free options are really good. I had a chicken fajita with a mango margarita. I am definitely going back for them. They have a nice atmosphere as well. 
L O V E D  I T !

Author: Jacqueline5259
Title: Awesome place to hangout
Review: Great food and good ambience! We were here twice in a week and the services are great, one of the staff Iqbal was very attentive! It's really enjoyable to have our meals & drinks here!

Author: 4896lol
Title: Great Service!!
Review: Was served by Iqbal, kept the drinks flowing 😄 The foods here are also enticing, namely the tacos, fries with sriracha mayo and the nachos!

Author: n0tmadn0madAmsterdam, The Netherlands
Title: Not organized - food ok
Review: Went for a quick bite with my friend. The service staff seemed to not be briefed too well about Mexican cuisine. They had no staff clothing either so it was hard to tell who is working there.We ordered 4 things. Three items came quickly and were okay - not awesome. The 4th item never arrived and after waiting we asked about it and they told it was coming soon. After 15 mins more waiting we just ordered bill, paid and left. No one apologized about the missinh course.Overall the place was a bit torn apart and needed TLC. Not sure if i'd come back.Show less

Author: 746tamsinh
Title: Amazing Mexican & great atmosphere
Review: Well positioned in Love lane and has a great given - live entertainment is great but the best thing is the very fresh Mexican food. Best Mexican food we have ever had!

Author: SadieKS
Title: Great food and atmosphere
Review:
Lively place and comfortable. Lots of. Food options on the menu. The quessadilla was good.
Only disappointment was they didn't have churros nor jalapeño poppers.

Author: FrancescoRonz
Title: Pleasant dinner in lively Love Lane, Georgetown
Review:
Cool Mexican restaurant/pub in hectic Love Lane at the heart of the historic center of Georgetown. Food was great, coupled with a nice atmosphere and live music after 9ish pm. Recommended !
Only “minus”: service could be improved.

Author: discodivaboogieJersey, United Kingdom
Title: Nice food and they do vegan!
Review: I was really pleased to find a Mexican in Penang! This busy little restaurant is tucked away down a little lane. The food is good, and they have vegan options!! The service is like everywhere in malaysia - your food doesn’t come all at the same time. If you want to just turn up here make sure you come early or pre book because it’s always really busy.Show less

Author: sharminia
Title: Nice place, enjoyed the band
Review: Love the deco, staff were attentive and quick to respond. We especially enjoyed the margaritas, quesadilla(must try) and nachos. A nice place to unwind. We enjoyed the 2 piece band too who played every song we requested :-)

Author: Tayls78
Title: Great food, drinks and atmosphere
Review: I love this place. There are lots of choices for food, including vegetarian options. The price is reasonable and there’s happy hour on drinks until 10pm. There’s always a good atmosphere, with live music every night. If you’re looking for a fun place to start...More

Author: b1239876b
Title: Burrito is great
Review: Burrito very tasty and filling. Not so cheap, but you get what you pay for.. a burrito filled with yummy goodness and a great combination of ingredients.

Author: 91michelw
Title: Craving for something different?
Review: If you are looking for a different type of food than asian then you should try out this one. They serve excellent mexican meals and drinks, the staff is very kind and the atmosphere with the live music is great. We truly recommend this restaurant!

Author: chauthorn
Title: Need a break from the SE Asian cuisine? Go mexican
Review:
We ordered nachos for starters, enchiladas and quesadillas with a salad. Really great food, and friendly staff.

We sat indoors, and liked the decor & music.

Author: Ashirley2
Title: Great food, great service, great location!
Review:
Really loved this Mexican restaurant.  After a year in Malaysia this is the first Malaysian restaurant we have found with really good Mexican food!   

On weekends they have live music and the ambiance is lively and fun.   Definitely make a reservation then as the place...More

Author: RobPhil3
Title: Wow
Review: We decided to eat in Holy Guacamole on our first night in Penang after reading some reviews, and the reviews weren’t wrong, we came back again two nights later! Fajitas, enchiladas, quesadillas, we tried as much as we could during two visits and all of...More

Author: Patsy1962
Title: Love love love this place
Review: Our last night in Penang so we decided to hit the entertainment street. The food was super here and the atmosphere was terrific. I had the jalapeño poppers which was delicious and we had tacos, and nachos with our group. The solo singer was very...More

Author: Bbobogo
Title: delicious
Review: Enough of Asian food.  Then go to Holy Guacamole in Love Lane.  Mexican food with homemade Guacomole!  And good prices for the food.

Author: salma s
Title: Omg food heaven
Review: This place is the first restaurant we went to in penang straight after we landed and OMG it was delicious, my kids between 4-15 all enjoyed it. Definitely a must try, best start to the holiday

Author: stevesudjatmiko
Title: A very worthwhile place for mexican restaurant
Review: We had enough char kwe tiauw and nasi lemak or nasi kandar in penang. So what's next? my daughter suggested that we visit this restaurant. And we were really happy with the outer decoration of this restaurant, very Coco-like decoration and away from Chilli restaurant....More

Author: the_travel_directionBenowa, Australia
Title: Simply the best!
Review: Love this place on love lane. Have been here several times now and always friendly staff, awesome food, well priced drinks and an amazing atmosphere day or night.The acoustic music at night is always pleasant but be sure to get there early for a good seat.Can’t speak about the staff highly enough especially the lovely lady and manager guy (didn’t even get there names but are in photos) who has been an absolute delight over the past couple of visits.The frozen margaritas are a definite hit! Show less

Author: Kapitan007
Title: Great Mexican
Review: Nice ambience, good service and even better food. Just had the nachos and tacos, both excellent as were the dips. Recommends.

Author: HanglooseBro94Zurich, Switzerland
Title: only in the evening for drinks
Review: We only want to try local food when we are travelling so we didn't try the food here, because we can have that also at home. However the cocktails were amazing. We tried a few different ones. And every cocktail was really good. Best time to go there is when day have a live musician. It can get really crowded though. Not like the other places around, which try to talk you into their pub. Show less

Title: Amazing food!
Review:
Too good and relax restaurant.
Our 5 and 7 years kids are enjoying the nachos and relax atmosphere.

Giving a big 10!

Author: 358mohammede
Title: My first visit
Review: Very very nice place n music ..nachos is really good highly recommended..will definitelu visit again

Author: pedromY5456FZ
Title: Awesome food
Review: Five star food. Best nachos i've ever had, also amazing burrito and quesadillas. Highly recommend!!!

Author: emilygb18
Title: We keep going back!
Review: Whether it's just popping in for a quick drink, a snack or a full meal, we've been to Holy Guacamole a lot in our last couple of weeks in Penang! The staff are friendly, the food is excellent and the atmosphere/vibe is lively and fun. A must if you are in the area!Show less

Author: izzabizz
Title: Amazing food and great vibe!
Review: The food here was amazing! The margaritas during happy hour were only 11RM and they were delicious. There was such a good vibe always and the staff were super friendly.

Author: meganp94xBristol, United Kingdom
Title: Fantastic Mexican!!
Review: Stumbled across this place whilst walking down Love Lane for the first time! Myself and my boyfriend had to stop for lunch because the atmosphere was great and the restaurant looked pretty cool! I am so glad we stopped here! Had a pulled beef taco for lunch with a classic passion fruit daiquiri! Both were extremely good!! Cocktail was also ‘happy hour’ 11RM - happy hour was all day until 10pm!! Lunch was so good that we ended going back for dinner the next night! Both having the fajitas - which were again, really good! The atmosphere on the evening was buzzing - so many people dining there and was nice to have a live band playing also! Would 100% recommend this restaurant.Show less

Author: UllandGort
Title: Go here!!
Review: Amazing food and drinks! Around 10pm there is good live music. Very friendly staff. Definitely worth a visit:)

Title: The best for ever
Review:
This is the best food I have been tried in mleysia ..
You have to try it 😁
Aqasadia 
Tacco 
Fahitta 
All are ammaizing

Author: RamblinRed67
Title: Arriba!
Review: Great food, drinks, live (classic covers) music and vibe. Not a Mexican hat or local customer to be seen though in this touristy but fun part of town.

Author: Richard  Dcruz W
Title: Casual
Review:
Good service 
Excellent staff - Honey Singh, Tej Singh always with smile
Wonderfully courtesy. Recommended , food is nice
Fried Chicken wing very tasty

Author: 999kateb
Title: Kate
Review: Initially thought this would not be a suitable spot to eat .. lots of loud music ..  but after a corona or two ...  your opinion will change ! Good Craic as we say in Ireland !!

Author: Elena P
Title: Good fun!
Review: Had a really good night here! Great cocktails! Service was really friendly Z and Nadeem were really friendly and chatty! Really recommmend! Enjoy!

Author: Marcia TBradford, United Kingdom
Title: Great food and drinks
Review: Had a great night at holy guacamole. I ordered the burrito and it was a really nice change from Malaysian food. Amazing burrito!! Really nice staff really looked after you, and brought drinks when you asked and didn’t take long for the food to come out. Great service. The staff Zicky and Nadim were Great! Thanks guys ☺️Show less

Author: ClaireC4190
Title: Great cocktails!
Review: Fantastic cocktails and music! Particularly great service from Iman; friendly and very helpful. We <3 Iman. We came just for dinner but ended up staying most the night :) Loved this place!

Author: Leigh MKingston, Canada
Title: SO MUCH FUN!!!
Review: Came here to celebrate a birthday while travelling abroad. The staff were so much fun and provided such wonderful service! Very attentive and so friendly. Big thank you to Zeke for making our night! Food was delicious and the happy hour drinks were both fabulous and cheap! Would especially recommend the passion fruit margarita!Show less

Author: Lloydness
Title: Delicious and cheap
Review: Delicious mexican feast! Honey was a great addition, always greeting us with a lil smile. We went multple times, wish we had one at home.

Author: Riona C
Title: Great prices and service
Review: Wide variety to choose from at great prices. Hani the waiter was warm and welcoming and gave us great service every time- always there with a smile!! Food was great and drinks were cheap and delicious

Author: koksanjet
Title: Great place
Review: Amazing tacos and good drinks + great vibes.  Recommend the 5 layer dip and tacos. Will come again. Yes.

Author: YentlD6
Title: REALLY GOOD
Review: We had some drinks at that place. The Atmosphere is really nice. It's a good place to spend some hours. Also our waitress was fun and kind (Zee). So at the end it was a super fun evening. Thank you!!

Author: roisinb451
Title: Fabulous
Review: This was such a good restaurant. We went there as a group of 6 and they quickly seated us. The food was delicious and well priced and the happy hour cocktails were great! Our server iman was great and very friendly.

Author: S1561HCamyw
Title: Delicious Food!
Review: The food and cocktails were amazing unbelievably good value. Iman and his staff were very welcoming and we would recommend this to anyone. A definite must visit!

Author: gastroroubadour
Title: A must visit for excellent food and drinks!
Review: The best Mexican food I’ve had to date. Skip the Fridays and Chillis if you’re looking for great Nachos and the likes! Lovely tacos and quesadillas. Very friendly and attentive staff. Lively and vibrant atmosphere. The sangria is absolutely fab!

Author: Matthew HBelfast, United Kingdom
Title: Mexican marvel in Penang
Review: If you’re visiting Penang then you need to go here. We stumbled upon this little gem by accident, on the tourist friendly love lane. It has a relaxed, yet vibrant atmosphere. It is sociable, sharing large tables with other patrons. Staff are incredibly pleasant, friendly, accommodating and fun! The food is glorious! And the drinks are well priced and delicious. The live music is perfect - loud enough that you can hear and enjoy, but not so loud that you can’t have a conversation. This well located spot is a must visit. We actually returned for a second night despite only spending 3 nights in Penang! Can recommend highly enough!Show less

Author: Jhave5
Title: Friendly atmosphere and good food
Review: This is the best mexican food I've had while traveling. The beef quesadilla was delicious and full of the right flavors. The staff was really friendly and they had plenty of waiters so it was easy to get served and the food came fast. The passionfruit daqueri also hit the spot. Thanks for the great food!Show less

Author: D9762WW
Title: Me gusta
Review: Tasty, authentic mexican food, friendly staff and cheap happy hour cocktails that pack a punch. What more do you need?

Author: MMAH10
Title: Good Oldly Mexican
Review:
Great ambiance, foods and service. Cosy F&B place located in the heritage narrow street well known as Love Lane.
Crowded with local and tourist. Car parking no issue as just next door. Recommend to try their Mexico City Pizza, Quesadillas and others.

Author: CaseeeLSManjimup, Australia
Title: awesome quick easy food, cheap, sweet spot
Review: found this spot after looking at reviews for best food in penang, easy to get a grab to love lane and holy guacamole is just next to a car park and a couple of other restaurants. first stand out - awesome spot. right on the road, serious penang dining. secondly, no sleazy guy at the front poking the menu in your face like next door. they don't need to heckle at all, people will just fill the restaurant on it's own. we got margaritas, lovely and cold. we shared nachos, firstly big serve, delicious sides of beans, tomatoes, guacamole and sour cream. I had chicken enchiladas which were huge and soooooo yum. I get funny about chicken but it was flavoursome shredded chicken with loads of cheese and tomatoes. partner had chicken burrito, huge serving very nice. Bill came to 98 ringit, in Aus about $35. cheap as. we didn't need to share the nachos could have just had a main each but the menu was so good we wanted to try everything!!! food and drinks came out really quickly, atmosphere is just awesome on the road. music. would recommend anyone to come here for some good filling easy food, and some malaysian dining. happy people filling up the place. if you walk up love lane and go out onto the road there are heaps of hawker stalls and shops a real cool spot. cheersShow less

Author: ThilankaA
Title: Good food and atmosphere
Review: Went to this place with a bunch of friends for drinks. Pretty colorful and cool atmosphere with wall paintings and music. Since we went on the Valentine’s Day the band was playing some good music. Nice for hanging out with friends.

Author: trinitiii333Groves, Texas
Title: FInally, MEXICAN FOOD!
Review: I am on holiday with my family and parents. We are from Texas btw so Mexican food is our favorite food. We went to Holy Guacamole and I immediately fell in love.First I love all the Sugar Skulls decoratiing the inside. So fun and festive. The Cheese Quesadillas for my kids were perfect. My mom ordered nachos and a plate of chips came with a layer of melted cheese on top. Beans, guac and pico was brought out in individual bowls so that was different. My husband and I shared the Fajita Camarones. They were huge and served with corn tortillas. Excellent choice. Not to forget, we started the dinner off with chips and salsa. (hard to come by in Malaysia) So for me, it was a great experience. Being from Texas and not eating any Mexican food in Kuala Lumpar for the last 10 months has been painful. Was it the best Mexican food ever? Of course not.... But look around, this is Malaysia lah.Show less

Author: sahib N
Title: amzing food....
Review:
the quesadillas are amazing, the salsa taste so much fantasticccc
eating here makes me travel to mexico instantly

Author: 95cherrypCornwall, United Kingdom
Title: Good food, great vibe, average service!
Review: We went to this restaurant on our last night in George Town and were not disappointed. The food was amazing and great portion sizes. We had the nachos, chicken quesadillas and fries to share then both desserts on the menu. Whilst pricier than other places, we definitely deemed it worth it. The only downsides were that we were seated in the road (they kept adding tables and chairs as they got busier and cars moved) and had to wait ages to be served whilst they juggled their tables around. Once we moved indoors the service was better, but we still waited for ages to have our order taken and our dessert order. In between staff were attentive and overall it can be expected due to the business of the location. It would be a five star review if it was just a little bit more organised and we weren’t originally waiting for so long!Show less

Author: Robert PPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Pretty Good Mexican Food for Asia
Review: Had lunch here. Tacos Al Pastor was a Taco (singular) Al Pastor, but it was good and tasted just like the ones you get in Mexico. Also had the Guacamole Grande dip and chips side, which was an avocado you-smash-em up real thing and was quite good. Chips were deep fried authentic; not the 'out-of-a bag' garbage you generally get. Atmosphere and furnishings reminded me of a Mazatlan beach bar - but fits the area (Chula Street) and has a quirky charm.The menu is a bit short on Mexican food choices and one in our group tried the 'non-Mexican' selections. Staff was very friendly and attentive. Prices were average, but a local would consider them on the high side. My wife thought the place was a little dirty, but I didn't notice. I'd go back (so would she!)Show less

Author: Jennifer E
Title: Holly yummy
Review: We have been travelling Asia since December so I was super happy to get a authentic Mexican taste! It’s was very good and even my kids enjoy their food until the last bite! The staff is also worth mentioning they are very nice and helpful.

Author: mojay1George Town, Malaysia
Title: Atmosphere very vibey
Review: Came here with some friends.food id rate at 7/10 price about 7/10,drinks price for top shelf 6/10 atmosphere 9/10....that’s as accurate as I can be.I give it an average because the costs are high for the quality and quantity for the food and very high for cocktails with foreign brands rather than local brands.its way too costly to enjoy a great night.foreign staff are excellent and always aim to please.The owners are greedy for profits but create the vibe good enough to have people spend.Show less

Author: granier_fructis
Title: BEST MEXICAN FOOD AROUND!!!!
Review: If you are looking for friendly service,delicious food and a comfortable environment this is the place! Ask for Eej, he is so welcoming and accommodating! The food was out of this world! Especially the tacos!

Author: MickB0910
Title: Awesome bar, awesome food, awesome staff
Review: Went here for 3 nights in a row for super cheap, delicious margaritas! The food was tremendous as well. After our hikes in the Cameron Islands we even came back for 1 day to celebrate cinco de Mayo! The staff immediately recognised us and brought us our preferred margaritas in no time! They are super friendly. When we left, they showed us a place to go dancing with another group we met in this place! A must go if you are in Georgetown!!Show less

Author: 3Kart6George Town, Malaysia
Title: Great food
Review: The food was very good and was brought in decent time, there is a lot of crowd. You may have to wait for a table or a while for your food but it is worth it. The prices are quite good and the ambience is nice considering it serves alcohol.Show less

Author: dustink929
Title: Satisfy your craving in Penang’s best Mexican food!
Review: Wonderful Mexican food with a great atmosphere.  Nadim and the staff are top notch!  The Holy Bulldog is one of many amazing drinks!  I hope you enjoy it as much as I did!

Author: jacquivella3
Title: 5star Hospitality
Review: Came to Holy Guacamole as a solo traveller, was greeted by Milano and was treated like a VIP all night, customer service is off the charts! Even treated me with free nachos! Great atmosphere with live music and fun vibe

Author: missfridamaleneDrammen, Norway
Title: Best restaurant for Mexican
Review: My friends and I were staying in Penang for about two weeks and we spent a lot of dinners here at holy guacamole - and we still talk about how good the food is! There was a lot of good dishes and the guacamole was really great. Friendly and helping staff!Show less

Author: Kira T
Title: Had such a GOOD time!!!
Review: Spent my birthday at Holy Guacamole and had an incredible time! Everyone was so friendly and made my day feel so special! Milen was so sweet and made sure everything was delicious and that we had a wonderful night!

Author: KatharinaW737
Title: Great vegan burrito!
Review: Lovely mexican restaurant in the center of Georgetown. I had the vegan burrito and it was fantastic. Also Milano and his team is very friendly.

Author: dickenswwHong Kong, China
Title: Very eye catching decoration
Review: I was only attracted by the dia de los muertos wall painting at first before finding out it was rated no.2. But seriously why would you try Mexican food in Penang while there is none cultural crossing between these two country ever haha. We went late night for a drink and some midnight snacks. The waiter was trying hard to sell us a 60 ringgit drink with a corona upside down in a margarita glass but aren't no falling into that tourist trap, guess alcohol tax is quite heavy in the Muslim dominated malay community anyway, none of the drink I have experienced in Penang was strong enough when compare to those I had in HK. Waiter was much less passionate to serve us after fail to sell us the 60 ringgit drink. We ordered a coconut Margarita (which was made by adding Malibu surprisingly), a taco and a mixed meat burrito. We spent around 70 ringgit for the food and drink and It is a nice deal if you fancy Mexican food.Show less

Author: DDonoghue88Kempston, United Kingdom
Title: Something different
Review: Came here for lunch, mainly to get out of the heat and the outside of the building was quirky and music enticing.Wasn't expecting much but wow! The food was delicious! We devoured our dishes! The guacamole was one of the best we have tried.Friendly staff, nice to have something different from Asian food. Price wise, much higher than other places we've been to nearby (street food/hawkers) but worth it.Show less

Author: robincranen
Title: Very good!!
Review: Very good food i had chicken quesadillas. The staff is very friendly and helpfull. Specially Milon!!

Author: angelamow
Title: Nice beer, fantastic margarita  and good service
Review: The service was great and the spiced pumpkin taco was very tasty. Lots of margarita choices. Service is wonderful. If you want a place to have a drink and take s break. This is a very good choice.

Author: Roseofaolain
Title: Great place for a solo traveler
Review: Was recommended to come here by a friend. Such a nice place. Great atmosphere, great margaritas and fastasic tacos. Highly recommended the beef! Nilon was super friendly and welcoming, such a good laugh. Keeps calling himself the black Irish 😂. Definitely recommend!

Author: RedHeadFamHoi An, Vietnam
Title: Love Lane with lovely people
Review: Being a Texan born and raised I like to think that I know a thing or 2 about TexMex, so this review may be a little long winded, I apologize in advance.If you want the short version, we loved the food and the staff was warm and inviting. If you would like the long version then keep reading....To be totally honest when we found Holy Guacamole our expectations were pretty low but wow! we were very pleasantly surprised to see that they did a really good job of bringing that taste from around the world. Now, don't expect it to be authentic with an old Mexican woman hand making tortillas (like my mom used to do) in the back but it is really good nonetheless and the attitudes and friendliness of the people working there made the experience that much more awesome. The menu is filled with TexMex favorites, tacos, burritos, fajitas, guacamole, and chips & salsa, all of it done really well. Also, drinks! They offered the typical soft drinks and beer, but we are a traveling family so the part we loved were the fresh juices! We've been in Penang for a month and half and this place provides us a comforting meal when we are missing home.Now, we've been to more restaurants than I care to say and we've had our share of friendly owners, waitstaff, and hosts but Holy Guacamole goes over the top to welcome any and everyone. At night the whole Love Lane scene transforms from quiet restaurants and coffee shops to THE place to be for nightlife. While there are plenty of bars and restaurants this area still kept the family friendly vibe and families with small children can be seen out and about. They do their part to add to the festive atmosphere by adding tables in the street allowing people passing by to smile and nod while getting a glimpse of your food and you get to just how diverse this place is. People from all over the world congregate here and that is a beautiful thing!We have been twice and have tried most of the menu, there is definitely a third trip upcoming and maybe a forth???Show less

Author: mandyh685
Title: Amazing and relaxing place with awesome food
Review: Super nice food and affordable drink. Amazing service and super helpful staff. You must look for a guy call Milon he is very funny and entertaining and excellent service. Awesome experience with my bestie!

Author: Anna M
Title: Great Mexican food
Review: If you are craving for Mexican food, this is the place to go. A little high on price but definitely worth it.

Author: Leehut93
Title: Refreshing margeritas and friendly staff
Review: Refreshing cocktails and margeritas with super service!! They also serve Guinness which is a rare find in SE Asia. Our server Milon is a rockstar!!!

Author: Danny M
Title: Great cocktails and great fun
Review: Delicious cocktails and even better service. Would definitely recommend holy guacamole to anybody :)

Author: suzi103Cardiff, United Kingdom
Title: Tasty food but overpriced and unwelcoming staff.
Review: First impressions were good. The place was very busy but we were able to get a seat inside. The waiter who initially served us looked really annoyed. No smile, and came across unfriendly. We ordered frozen margaritas which were a little too much on the sour side but OK. We both ordered fajitas. There were tasty but I felt like they were a little overpriced for the portion. One waiter towards the end of our meal approached us with a smile and appeared to 'care' about what we thought of the meal. Unfortunately this approach does not appear to be case for the majority of staff. It was not the worse service we've ever had, but we've experienced great service in penang, and been charged half the price for delicious food, so we left a little dissappointed. 2 cocktails, 1 small water and 2 fajitas came to 94RM. I would not return.Show less

Author: madzfoodieNewcastle, Australia
Title: Awesome vibe... amazing food and drinks!
Review: Love love love this place! The staff here are exceptional. I have visited more than once in the past few weeks and both times the staff were extremely friendly, efficient and continuously checked on us throughout the night to see if we needed anything else and to make sure we were satisfied. Very authentic Mexican food in an awesome atmosphere. I felt like I was in Mexico with the live music, artwork on the walls etc. The enchiladas are to die for... especially with all that melted cheese on top! Make sure you try their bulldog cocktail, they are delicious and a perfect way to cool down and get a bit of a buzz! Highly recommend to anyone that visits Georgetown. You will not be disappointed!Show less

Author: MaddyV2
Title: Great bar
Review: Friendly service with a fun drinks selection on Love Lane. Shared a pitcher between 2, great value!!

Author: Mihaela ZZagreb, Croatia
Title: Nachos Problemos and that big ball of fresh guacamole....
Review: I kept coming back to Holy Guacamole every few days during my stay. The food was amazing, fresh and tasty, even non-Mexican meals, like pizza and burger, were satisfying. There was a good variety of vegetarian meals, tasty and healthy. The same goes to the amazing cocktails. The staff was the main factor that made a difference, welcoming and polite, always managed to find a table that fits our needs.Show less

Author: DrAmuz
Title: Excellent Nachos!
Review: Nachos and the variety of dips were very delicious. The music was great, service was fast. I truly enjoyed my night.

Author: dvwlf
Title: Great Drinks, Great People
Review: Drinks are great,Beer as well,food was really good. Definetly worth going. Kind of a hotspot to go to. Enjoy your evening!

Author: 257flemmingsSingapore, Singapore
Title: Love Lane delicious Mexican
Review: Arrived into George Town midday and needed a cold beer in the 35 degree heat. We walk for hours or it seemed that way before google directed us to Love Lane and Holy Guacamole.I was more thirsty than hungry but ended up consuming hops of home made corn chips and fresh guacamole. All very good and adding friendly service, cold beer and a frozen margarita I can only give this place my best recommendation Show less

Just one word: unforgettable!

Author: AdrianRaj
