Review: Awesome atmosphere and super tasty food:) we had the chicken fajitas and the enchiladas. Friendly staff and definitely a place to visit if you want a change of flavors from the curries.

Author: Sheppo1989
Title: Brilliant Restaurant
Review: Great restaurant will a fabulous atmosphere and food. Milon is an awesome host and really made the visit enjoyable. Would 100% recommend and will be visiting again!

Author: KristenDariaSingapore
Title: Good food
Review: Good food, close to the original Mexican version;most of the food items are to be raved about, the rest are not great but ok.Generous when it came to asking for add-ons. Kitchen staff were great, wait staff were passable;service quality & consistency needs to be looked into to improve the dining experience.Show less

Author: Victoriathetexan
Title: Tasty nachos and friendly staff
Review: The nachos were the best I've had outside the US, which is saying a lot :) Milon and the other staff are also friendly and make you feel welcome the moment you enter. Thank you!

Author: Food_enthausiast
Title: Interesting place to be
Review: Went there for the first time. We ordered nachos, lagsana, beef burrito and their spicy fried chicken. Their nachos was delicious and flavourful. The lagsana and beef burrito were good. The beef was juicy and tender. Their food truly reflects their provinances as a Mexican food culture. However, their spicy fried chicken was quite a disappointment. It tastes very sweet instead of spicy. I actually enjoyed their interior design and atmosphere.The staffs were quite friendly too. Might go back here one day. Show less

Author: Duck077
Title: Second time here on our visit to Penang. Milon is lovely and recommends great dishes! Thank you to the whole team.
Review: Great fresh food! Thank you to milon who recommends the best food! We love the nachos and chicken wings!

Author: peiwen c
Title: Superd
Review: Awesome food awesome service awesone liveband highly recommended especially Milon, recommended us nice food n drinks.

Author: trinamoore74Ashburton, New Zealand
Title: Awesome Place!!
Review: A great place on Lovers Lane for Dinner, great atmosphere, super attentive staff, beautiful Mexican food and a great selection of tequilas and Margaritas!! wish we found this before our last night as we would have been back. Love the decor too, it was super super busy but service was great!Show less

Author: Jeff_KostyBangkok, Thailand
Title: OK for backpackers and fratboys
Review: Love Lane is backpacker party central. If you like backpacker party drinking/eating establishments, then you'll probably love it. If not, not. The service was prompt and friendly. Drinks were relatively cheap. Those were the best things about this place for me. I was in the mood for Mexican food. Not a lot of options that I know of in Penang. So, in spite of not being the sort of person looking for backpacker party joints, I gave it a try.The food was OK but not very Mexican. I had tacos. The fillings were good, but the tortillas weren't. What do I mean by "fratboy"? The signature cocktail is a margarita-ish vat with an upside down beer attached. as you drink the margarita the beer empties into the glass, turning it into a beer cocktail, then a beer. If the most important thing about a cocktail is volume, this is the one for you.Show less

Author: 1966cbuk44Farnham, United Kingdom
Title: Loved it
Review: We went last night after rushing around to see a few sites / pulled up outside about 8.45pm - restaurant half full. Meet and shown to a great table - lots of fun attentive staff - happy hour drinks upto 10pm. Excellent Mexican food - we all had some thing different - all great - even bought a t-shirt ! Loved it Show less

Author: hourgmorn
Title: Decent food, tiny portions
Review: Food is 4/5, quite good but the portions could be much more better since the food is on the pricier side. The place is always packed especially by tourists so come earlier.

Author: cclyeGeorge Town, Malaysia
Title: First truly Mexican restaurant and bar in Penang?
Review: I have always loved having chicken quesadillas. In the past, I tried them in Chili’s and TGIF but theirs are not that good.We had nachos, chicken-, mushroom- quesadillas, chicken burritos and chicken wings. We also ordered a pitcher of lime margarita to share.The food, drink and atmosphere were all great. Fact.But what nearly spoilt the meal for us was some supervisor or captain insisted that we cannot have 2 low tables which can sit 8 pax) for 5 of us. He even suggested one of us sitting in the narrow end between 2 tables: I seriously doubt any customer would have been comfortable sitting there.I asked for the low tables because I didn’t want my old folks (late 70s) climbing onto the high stool. We offered to have another couple share one end of the table.All pleas to deaf ears. Maybe the serving crew felt that this Asian family with 3 oldies cannot consume too much alcohol so the bill will not be big enough for combining two tables of 4 for them. Very unhappy to be treated that poorly after we called up to make a reservation.After that ugly start, a serving crew Jojo tried his best to give us good service.Show less

Author: HugoRace
Title: Comfortable and Delicious
Review: We ate here based on a recommendation from family who live in Penang. The food was very tasty - I had the beef burrito wrap (very generous serve) and my wife two tacos, one chicken the other beef. Hot jalapeño sauce was available to help spice up if you needed it - I did. We ordered fresh pineapple juices and the waiter asked if we wanted added sugar - this was appreciated as often in other eateries the question isn't asked and the sugar automatically added. Service was friendly and decor good. Cost wast modest as well. Would highly recommend.Show less

Author: 555abigailtKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Dinner with the family
Review: We found this place on foursquare and it had great review, we all had fajitas - delicious and one person had the sweet potato taco - the serving size was very small for the taco but the fajitas were a good size. The service was great and we were seated immediately.Show less

Author: Hurrell4
Title: Good.
Review: It was nice, a little expensive and the portion was slightly small. Good atmosphere, waiters tried to 'up sell' a little too much for me, overall enjoyed my meal.

Author: MorneVA
Title: Absolute gem!
Review: Amazing customer service, such friendly staff that make you feel welcome, the food is outstanding and the drinks are top quality, they also have drinks specials that are really great value, a must visit if you are planning to visit Penang in Malaysia!

Author: REDSTONE S
Title: Just walking past
Review:
Strolling down Love la, soaking up the atmosphere and we came across this Mexican bar.
Food excellent,  drinks reasonably priced and a great atmosphere.
We're here for a few days, so this place will definately be re-visited👍👍👍

Author: J8811XWmikem
Title: Texas boy loves it
Review: Great price for what you get, very tasty and  great happy hour prices for beer.  Cool artwork and nice people, had the beef burrito and a holy taco beef as close to Mexico you can get to in Penang..will be back next visit...cheers ya'll

Author: 586bryand
Title: Holy Guac!
Review: Diffentilty the  best Mexican I've  had in Asian, and better than most places in America. Good portions size and proper ingredients for the order. Staff welcoming and happy to inform you about the menu. If your in Penang you must try this place.

Author: David D
Title: Unexpectedly good
Review: We’re not great fans of Mexican food, but this place deserves the high ranking on TripAdvisor! Friendly, welcoming and great quality.

Author: henrysusanti
Title: My Fave Mexican cafe In town
Review: Located at the hustle bustle of Georgetown, Penang. Busy cafe, always full but there is always seat outside. Staff is efficient and helpful. Good food and drinks. Love the cafe mural inside. Soup, Burrito, nachos etc, all good. Love the margarita there too

Author: leliahoehn
Title: Good food, good prices, good service
Review:
The food is really good, not pricey and big portions. They are playing good Music and sometimes life music. 
Happy people and a good atmosphere. 

Definitely come back !! :)

Author: nigel r
Title: Great lunch and beer
Review: Just went to the restaurant today for lunch the Mexican food was really good and the bartenders really helpfull

Author: fibi2015Newcastle upon Tyne, United Kingdom
Title: Absolutely Superb !
Review: One of the best Mexican meals I have had in years and on Penang Island of all places !!Great vibe, great service and food so good you won't believe it. Very modest prices with happy hour beers and cocktails for £2. Understand it's only been open a year but what a thriving, successful business you have on your hands, built on quality food at affordable prices in the hip atmosphere.Brilliant.Show less

Author: AmandraAndrew
Title: Awesome Food & Awesome Service
Review: All the things we ordered - nachos, chicken wings and fajitas were all delicious and flavourful. Loved their signature drink 'Holy Bulldog' mix of Corona and margarita. Super good. Peak hours 8 pm onwards. Totally going back.

Author: lisakV257YCMorphett Vale, Australia
Title: Best Mexican food in Penang
Review: Absolute great service & the best Mexican food in Penang . Super fresh & an awesome verity of dishes on offer. The service was fantastic, all the staff were super friendly . Would highly recommend Holy Guacamole in love lane , Penang. Also there cocktails are delicious as their food . Show less

Author: NoorRahemtulla
Title: Holy Guacamole
Review: I had a great experience dining at Holy Guacamole during my visit in Penang. This quant Georgetown restaurant is located on the bustling Love Lane and boasts amazing service with even better food. I would highly recommend it to anyone in the area craving authentic Mexican food.Show less

Author: Kyrafrazeltt
Title: Our favourite place!
Review: We are from the UK and were looking for a restaurant that didn’t serve noodles and rice... we found this place and we have been 3 yikes within 1 week!!! There were 2 birthdays and each time the restaurant have made it extra special! Food is AMAZING!!!!! Can’t wait to come back again lol. P.s drinks are very strongShow less

Author: Desinggi
Title: Worth the visit!
Review:
Fajita & quality drinks accompanied with live Mexican music... Really an awesome place to chill out. Certainly not one of those typical 'bars' out there in penang that blasts loud Chinese songs destroying your mood.

Definitely going again.

Author: C8875BOjasonrEchuca, Australia
Title: Worth the visit
Review: Highly recommend experiencing Holy Guacamole after 7.30pm when Love Lane starts coming to life (just need to make sure you can get a table). It was relatively quiet when we got there at 6.30pm but by 7.30pm the place was full and it had a real party atmosphere. The margaritas were refreshing (and cheap) and the food was good, but it can depend on what you get. The enchiladas and burritos were tasty but the tacos were a bit lacking. Definitely worth the experience, especially in the evening.Show less

Author: Jillybairn
Title: Great bar
Review:
Had the margarita slushy and beer cocktail.  v nice.  Great band.
Corn on cob with slightly spicy mayo and a crispy taco great flavours

Author: johnnye201
Title: Disappointing
Review: I'm very surprised to see so many good reviews of this place. The guacamole was decent (although nothing to write home about), but two kinds of tacos that we had, including 'chef's special', were really bad: they were very greasy, and the meat was dry and seemed quite old. There were too few ingredients compared to a Mexican taco. Having been to Mexico we know what a taco should be like and these were nowhere near. We ended up with upset stomachs on the following day. The only good thing was the Argentinian band that played that night, but that has nothing to do with the food. Show less

Author: George C
Title: Mexican food in a lively location
Review: The food at Holy Guacamole was authentic Mexican with delicious food and great margaritas!  Service was thorough and quick.  The Yemeni gentleman who served us was extremely helpful, professional and kind!

Author: rockerriert
Title: Good stuff
Review: Great atmosphere, band was very entertaining and nice and friendly staff. (we didn't eat so can't judge the food)

Author: tjcabo
Title: A taste of Mexico in Malaysia!
Review: Great food, service and atmosphere.  Being from Mexico, this brought a little bit of home to us while traveling.  Tacos, enchiladas, guacamole and margaritas!  It was a wonderful evening and would highly recommend a visit for a taste of something different.

Author: O5768NTthomasb
Title: Burrito
Review: Nice place to eat, had the burritos a chicken one and beef, they were big so had to take half away with us, really tasty, and the staff were really nice and helpful! Will come again for the food and live music

Author: Dunja D
Title: Love this place
Review: So good food and nice staff. The prices are little expensive but the food is great. We came back two times because it is a great vibe

Author: Kate_elizabeth_30
Title: The place to be
Review: I just love this place. The vibe, the happy hour drinks, the staff and the live music is the best. The food is good although my friend wasn’t impressed with jalapeños poppers but still the cocktails are spot on!

Author: DavidJTurley16Birmingham, United Kingdom
Title: Great Restaurant!
Review: My girlfriend had found this online and wanted to try it out while we were visiting Penang. The food was great in there and when it turns into a bar, the atmosphere is great. This place is well worth the visit; for the food or for the night vibe! Show less

Author: Andrew C
Title: excellent dining experience
Review: wonderful dining experience, good food and drinks ,staff are very friendly and good live band provided.

Author: fionap02Bangkok, Thailand
Title: Good for drinks and nightlife, not great for food
Review: Holy Guacamole has a great ambiance, live music is spot on, not too loud so you are still able to chat and good quality singers. They have a happy hour from 12 - 10pm, drinks are good and cheap. Personally, I didn’t enjoy the vegetarian food as it is all mushroom based (very chewy) and was bland, no spice for a Mexican restaurant! The meat options may be better but I can’t comment. I would recommend enjoying the Malaysian food Penang has to offer then heading to Holy Guacamole for the evening. Show less

Author: gianinabellaJakarta, Indonesia
Title: Great Vibe
Review: I stayed here for NYE and it was really fun. They have this band and they play a really great music until the New Year. The crowd & the vibe is amazing! The food is also great, love their quesadillas so much and love the frozen margarita too, great for the humid Penang weather. Despite the crowded vibe, all the staffs is really helpful & fastShow less

Author: Happycookies
Title: Lousy Mexican food; good for drinks only
Review:
1. Portions are small and Flavours lacking
2. You are better off eating Chijlis at paragon. The fajitas are guaranteed way better. 
3. Service is also very average for the price you pay

Author: GypsyLeo
Title: Good Mexican Food in Malaysia
Review: Have eaten here several times and highly recommend if you are in the mood for Mexican food. in Penang. Fresh ingredients prepared well. Love their burritos and house sangria.

Author: deveryv
Title: Cool atmosphere
Review: Great food, great service, good drinks, we really enjoyed ourselves and will return. This might be the only place to find a clean toilet in Malaysia! Thanks guys.

Author: samunyberg
Title: 5 out of 5
Review: Great place. Staff is very friendly, music's good and the food is delicious. Overall mood is very positive and friendly. Highly recommended!

Author: bartachai
Title: Good food
Review: Very good but small quantity and a bit expensive, we had first waiter not really helpful but the other waiter was very patient to explain everything and  give advice.

Author: FoodiesloverMelbourne, Australia
Title: Amazing
Review: Coming from Langkawi where we started our holidays, we were very disappointed with the food standards there. But we were very pleased when we found Holy Guacamole. The food was so yummy, the service was outstanding and we enjoyed the night with great live music. Highly recommend. The quality is as good as in Melbourne. Oh also their toilets are super clean.Show less

Author: 662joel
Title: Great food
Review: Great place for food and drinks staff are very helpful and attentive clean and delicious  drinks are great too

Author: polinachiner
Title: Simply amazing
Review: I love everything in this bar, from wonderful design to serving dishes. Tasty, good cocktails and nice happy hours. Prices are ok for Malaysia. Good music and lovely staff. Thank you!

Author: NikkiloolahKochi (Cochin), India
Title: So pleasantly surprised we had to keep going back!
Review: Passed by this busy, lively restaurant and made an impromptu stop to have dinner. We are so glad we did and ended up coming back 3 times in as many days, for lunch or dinner. The staff are very friendly and attentive to your needs, the food is freshly made and extremely tasty. The happy hour cocktails at 10RM (AU$3.30) were good value and there was plenty of drinks, alcoholic and non alcoholic to choose from. Great atmosphere and the staff welcomed us back each time. Reasonably priced and well worth a visit.Show less

Author: KavetiaD
Title: Excellent Eatery.
Review: Went there with several family members. The food and drinks were beyond delicious and the staff were friendly and fantastic. A great place to try, it has something for everyone, and the price is reasonable.

Author: CFEIIIAustin, Texas
Title: brings back great memories of Mexico
Review: Holy Guacamole is close to my hostel and was recommended by the hostel staff. I don't usually mix cuisines and cultures, but it was rainy and they are close, had live music which was pretty good...I ended up having fish tacos and guacamole here (twice). some of the best guacamole I have had since leaving Mexico and the fish tacos brought back memories of street food along the Baja! This place is the real deal. Lots of Ria de los Muertos skeletons and Mexican art!Show less

Author: MichaelColley92
Title: Nice food and good vibe
Review:
Went here a couple of times when we passed through Georgetown and the food was absolutely brilliant with good drinks and happy hour which made the prices really good.

Would definitely recommend the Chicken(Pollo) Quesadillas which are just delightful.

Michael

Author: SahnesaschyKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Authentic Mexican Restaurant
Review: We came here with our family and our 1 yo son. great vibe, awesome food. we arrived at 6pm and stayed till 9pm. the later it gets the less it is suitable for families, but great hang out for people to have fun.Will definitely come back for the foodShow less

Author: JGTidswell
Title: Love this place
Review: We had the best time at Holy Guacamole. It was by far our favourite place in George Town, if only we had another night to go back! The staff were so friendly, the drinks were amazing and the live music created a great vibe. People could dance or just enjoy the music. Definitely recommend Show less

Author: Curious16207886483
Title: Mrs
Review:
Very good, great service.  Enchiladas were very good!  Pretty close to authentic Tex Mex, and for Penang that’s saying a lot!!  
Would recommend!

Author: Travelicious_KKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Regret coming here
Review: We decided to have some bites and drinks here because the place was swarming with people and it seemed to have a very good vibe. After waiting for about 5 minutes for a table, we were ushered in. The guy who greeted us didn’t really care if we wanted to be there or not. He seemed to be in a rush the entire time. It was as tough some other people could replace us because “everyone seemed to wanna be there”. All their staff seemed to running around like headless chicken with no smiles on their faces, except one guy who was really nice and even had a conversation with us. The food was disappointing. I love Mexican food, but what we had here was sorely lacking in everything. The cocktails appear to be cheap and it really reflects in the quality of the drink they put in front of you. And finally, the toilets. They’re really dirty and disgusting! Suffice to say I wanted to get as far away as possible from this place after visiting the loo. Show less

Author: T1576KAamanda
Title: Very happy birthday celebrations here
Review: Had a fantastic birthday dinner here. The food is fantastic and descent prize. The cocktails were good and they had a good happy hour. Would absolutely come backS The live music is good and they sang happy birthday for my partner. Also got a free happy birthday tequila shot. Show less

Author: davidgZ397SC
Title: Best Mexican food in Asia!
Review: Great food and really nice staff. I had the beef burrito and it was delicious. The beef was marinated to perfection with a very nice flavor. Chips and guacamole are a must and the margaritas are awesome. Show less

Author: Mohammad S
Title: Simply Amazing
Review: We had a good time here. The food, drinks and service was absolutely amazing. We visited here 3 times in our 5 days stay. High recommendedShow less

Author: sneha0202Hyderabad, India
Title: The late night bar
Review: This mexican bar is open till late and serves delicious nachos. we landed here pretty late and they were sweet enough to serve us some fresh hot nachos.Show less

Author: lsarandes
Title: Outstanding Tex-Mex!
Review: After months in Asia I was ready for something different. Holy Guacamole did not disappoint. They have outstanding Tex-Mex! Highly Recommended! Show less

Author: bhatku101Singapore, Singapore
Title: Nice ambience, ok food
Review: We went to have dinner at Holy Guacamole after observing that the place seemed full all the time. Also there did not seem to be many Mexican food options around. We found the food to be lively and crowded. The food however was average. Really nothing special.Show less

Author: 271sundeepj
Title: Food was very average, staff were friendly
Review:
We went here as a group of 6 for lunch. The food was very basic and bland, basically it had very little Mexican flavour. But it was at least cooked well.

Staff were friendly in general.

Author: BarryM845Da Nang, Vietnam
Title: Loved it
Review: I’ve eaten Mexican all over the world including Mexico and LA and London. I’ve eaten in some really upmarket restaurants and this one measures up really well. Very reasonably priced with cheap drinks too. Show less

Author: traveller2044
Title: Amazing night
Review: Super fun night at Holy Guacamole in George Town. The staff was very nice and brought food and drinks very fast. The prices were reasonable and the best part was the live bands all night (our favourite was called I think Key Project), we couldn't stop dancing and singing.I am not giving it 5 stars (although it probably deserves it) because the food could have been a little more authentic Mexican-tasting but it was not bad at all! Definitely recommend anyone passing by there to have a drink at Holy Guacamole. Show less

Author: paulchoongPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Great music ... food is ok
Review: Local visiting this place for our regular weekend drinks and music. Food is average, could be improved tastewise. Nice colorful interior so it's great for photos. The weekend band is pretty good.Show less

Author: AzRatArizona
Title: Love Lane Tex-Mex
Review: Who would believe this. Actual decent Mexican food in Penang. We have been traveling in SE Asia for months, decided to try something different and sit down. I realize this is very ‘tourist’ but don’t care. We live in the Sonoran Desert (across the border from MEX in Arizona) and have 40 years experience eating real mex and Tex mex. The flavors at Holy were authentic styled towards Tex. Excellent pico de gallo and carne quesadilla. They have all the correct fresh ingredients in Asia and it’s just a matter of someone putting it together. Truly amazed at the quality of the tortilla 8000 miles from its origins. All things considered Holy got it right based on our sample. Normally we would shy away from non native foods when traveling and eat local. This was, as stated, a nice change. The atmosphere on a Friday night was not really our thing and we almost departed before ordering when we were led inside the crowded, noisy bar space and jammed into a long bench table. Fortunately the server caught our displeasure and he got another server who setup a street side table, so we stayed. I realize that this is a current ‘hip’ spot and crowded, maybe in my youth I could tolerate drunk people screaming to each other over loud music, but prefer the quieter clean well lighted place now. Go for the mex food it was really good and something different in George Town and Holy Guacamole is serving it up. We are visiting for several weeks, staying 5 minuets away, and will probably return.Show less

Author: Christopher V
Title: Egh - Tourist Trap
Review: This is the place tourists go who don't want to try actual Malaysian food (street food or inside a restaurant). Only went here because was not feeling well and was hoping Western food would help. The food wasn't bad, it just wasn't good.

Author: NunoV455
Title: Found it Great !
Review: Holy Guacamole is Bar in the Love Lane, where by walking throughout the street I got an eye catch by the coolest decoration and environment. Once walking in, everything is amazingly on the right spot and nice. The drinks and food are very good The service and staff are friendly and helpful. Show less

Author: SietaaRotterdam, The Netherlands
Title: Great place for drinking a cocktail and listen to the live music!
Review: Holy Guacamole is a nice restaurant/bar in the middle of Love Lane. We did not eat here, I can only say that the cocktails (Mojito) were really good!Nice place to sit, relax and listen to the live music. The staff exists of some enthusiast and nice men from different countries. Special thanks to Roman!Show less

Author: Joep BAmsterdam, The Netherlands
Title: Nice vibe, good Mexican food
Review: Situated on Love lane this small backpackers hangout serves good Mexican dishes with nice cold beers (happy hour till 10 pm). Show less

Author: CourtneyF1121Bangkok, Thailand
Title: 5 Star Mexican experience
Review: Thank you for a truly fantastic lunch today. Not only was the food delicious but the staff were also happy to make our experience the best we’ve had in Penang. Show less

Author: 247stens
Title: Lovely food!
Review: Holy Guacamole is a perfect place to go to when you’re not in the mood for typical Malaysian food. We had nachos and burritos and they were all delicious! The staff is a little bit pushing to order but you can also see that as good service. It’s not very cheap for the local standards but definitely worth the price!Show less

Author: ShopaholicMamaSingapore, Singapore
Title: Holy Moly! This must be the best Mexican restaurant in the region
Review: Stumbled into the restaurant, drawn by the bright colored La Muerte Wall murals. There is really no specialty for this restaurant. Everything tastes so good! Must visit when you are in George Town. Show less

Author: Mark8888Singapore, Singapore
Title: Awesome live music
Review: Heard the music and wandered by about 10pm on a Monday night and stayed until 1am. Great vibe, extremely talented singers (Queen, Bryan Adams, Bon Jovi, Oasis, Abba and even Britney!) and well priced drinks. Great night outShow less

Author: justine-2017777
Title: Excellent a place to discover
Review:
This is a place to go when you are in Penang and do not want to eat street food !! The food is really good and the drinks also with happy hours. Bands are coming it is very cool.  
I highly recommand this place!!

Author: tezzacl
Title: Good vibes, cocktails and bites
Review: A really friendly and fun place - always a great atmosphere in the evening, a heady dose of cocktails, Mexican food and often live music. 👌

Author: IvyB235
Title: Great burrito
Review:
And very friendly and nice staff! The burrito was Peng! Would definitely go there again missed Mexican food already!
Recommend this place

Author: BBQ_And_Craft_BeersThailand
Title: Viva La Mexico!
Review: Great place nestled down the small road of Love Lane. Also they have the green sauce on the table, which is pretty cool too. Service was excellent, the staff were very attentive and were eager to please. Keep up the good work!Show less

Author: petmeff70
Title: Great place
Review: I read about this place on Trip Advisor.We then found it by accident our 1st day whilst wandering the streets of Penang.We stopped in for lunch.They had happy hour on the cocktails so of course we had x2 margaritas. And an iced milo for a 7 year old X1 traditional lime and x1 slushy mango, both delicious.Just had a few quick snacks.Jalapeño poppers, spicy wings and guacamole and corn chips.All delicious.Cost in total 76 MYR.I loved the walls and all the decorations.A lovely vibrant place and great service.Thanks Petrina Australia Show less

Author: 34claudinevLaunceston, Australia
Title: A Little Slice of Mexico in Penang
Review: We stumbled across this place just down the street from our hotel. Funnily enough, we have a Holy Guacamole back home in Launceston, Tasmania. We had a great seat at a tall table on the sidewalk, perfect for people watching as there is plenty of action in Love Lane. Beer was cold, juice was fresh, staff were awesome, food was tasty and well priced. Highly recommended.Show less

Author: gooseontour
Title: Oh So Holy Chicken Quesadillas 🙏🏼
Review: Wow o wow those chicken quesadillas! Came here on our first night in George Town and then visited again 3/4 nights we were there!!! Reasonable prices and all day happy hour.Recommended 100% the quesadillas (22MYR) and the daiquiris (only 10 MYR). Don’t have the enchiladas - very dry.Lovely staff and restaurant always busy, great atmosphere, thank you Holy Guacamole. Show less

Author: johnrajiv
Title: Extra Gin
Review: Pretty nice and colorful place. Went slightly late and didn't get to try their food. Their cocktails are cheap and comes with generous amounts of Gin. Nice staffs too.

Author: 0isaacaHong Kong, China
Title: Good food, but disorganized
Review: I stopped by on a Sunday evening to get a burrito, but the place was packed so I decided to get it to go. The staff is friendly enough, but I was moved twice after being asked to sit down, and was offered a menu three more times. Great burrito though.Show less

Author: TheRealReinis
Title: Great!
Review: Food, service, happy hour, atmosphere, everything was just perfect. Thanks! A place to return, for sure!

Author: B dSaint-Nom-la-Breteche, France
Title: Loved this place
Review: Service was a mess but we didn’t careWell, the title says it all. All staff members are very nice, the location is great, the atmosphere is great, the food is good, the margaritas are perfect. All of this in a middle of a happy mess (my tacos finally came after my wife has finished her main course, and 3 people asked me what I ordered, we were given the check after having ordered deserts, etc.). The energy and friendliness of the place and the people makes it all.Show less

Author: Shazanne66Braunston, United Kingdom
Title: Love it!
Review: Had a great experience here. Went with my Mum and my daughter. The food was lovely and there was a lot of it. We had the nachos, prawn fajitas, vegan burritos and fries. It was delicious and beautifully presented. It was happy hour so our Margaritas were only 10 Myr! I highly recommend the mango margarita!Staff were great and looked after us very well. Highly recommend!Show less

Author: ChrisJ4947
Title: Best in George Town 🇲🇾🇲🇽
Review: We visited every day of our 4 day trip for lunches, dinners or drinks. Fab decoration and staff. Live bands in the evenings make a great atmosphere!

Author: Richards1250Peterborough, United Kingdom
Title: Sour experience
Review: The food here is very tasty especially if you like Mexican food, the atmosphere is also very good. It’s just such a shame the staff let it down. The first night we came it was quite full and the gentlemen running the place said he would get us a table then disappeared for a while so we gave up. Came back for a second time and sadly the experience wasn’t the best. Food came separately which is fine and then I asked for sour cream, waited a while as my food went cold grabbed a second person and asked him, still waited. It got up to ten minutes and I was quite frustrated so I got up and asked the bar they said they would bring it. A while later i finally received the sour cream, the man rather aggressively said I had to pay for it. That’s fine, just let me have some!!! No apologises just wants money, I don’t mind paying at all it’s just the wait and the attitude. For someone who is passionate about sour cream I would avoid in the future. Show less

Author: IswaryaS16
Title: Awesome place and great atmosphere
Review: The food was good and it was a lively atmosphere. The price was reasonable.We would surely go back there again.

Author: rominawalianStockholm, Sweden
Title: Wonderful food! Horrible staff.
Review: We were 4 friends who are new to penang and saw this resturant on the recommended site on tripadvisor. When we arrived it was very crowded and a good vibe. The waiter told us that we had to wait a little to get a table. No problem. However when a table was available, a few lads behind us had a guy who just went and sat there even though we were instructed to sit there. An argument broke out, the lads said that they were regulars and that they had their seat there. We were told to wait even though we were there first. Then we got told to sit at the very end on the resturant/street beside the trash with a table which was about as high as a side table for a sofa and broken chairs. We told the waiter that this was not acceptable. We got another table after a bit of an argument. We ordered food (which was delicious! Therefore the 3-rating) however even before we finished the staff came and gave us the check. We told them we werent finished and we wanted to order more drinks. After 10 minutes another staff member came and said ”you asked for the check.” So we paid and just left. We felt really unwelcome. Show less

Author: mrwoelf
Title: Nice mexican food
Review: Perfect place for a good lunch! Really nice mexican food! The quessidilla chicken was verry good! Try it!

Author: seaniegibbs
Title: YUMMY!
Review: Probably some of the best Mexican food we’ve come across in Asia. As Mexican food isn’t easy to find. We are huge Mexican food lovers and it’s one thing we miss a ton while traveling! This place is a bit expensive but so worth the price! Show less

Author: ZoeLafortuneMontreal, Canada
Title: Nice evening
Review: The ambiance is very good. The two-people band was simply great. The food was on point and the service is friendly and effective. You can pay by card which is kinda rare on Love Lane. There are other choices than mexican on the menu if you don't feel like eating mexican but you are still looking for a good place to eat.Show less

Author: MigueVillanuevaStuttgart, Germany
Title: Fun place with good food
Review: Fun place to have some Coronas and eat excellent Mexican food. I was there just to watch the Mexico football game and I was surprised of the food quality, the drinks were very good and the live band afterwards was excellent. It was a highlight in Penang.Show less

Author: HaloM21Phuket Town, Thailand
Title: Inviting!
Review: I found myself at this lovely restaurant almost every night during my month's stay in Penang. The staff made me feel so at home. I loved the food and atmosphere. Not only is the service top-notch but the live music is too! I will definitely be going there again.Show less

Author: jchowjsSingapore, Singapore
Title: Possibly Penang's Top Mexican Joint
Review: Really chill Mexican bar in Penang's central district. Didn't know this place popped up a few months back and was really nice to see the laid back atmosphere with tables by the roadside when I visited during World Cup season. Service was reasonably fast and good, with attentive servers who were very helpful and accommodating. Of course, the food speaks for itself - just look at the pictures I've posted in the review. All their Mexican dishes are good. If there's anything to avoid, don't go for the burgers; everything else on the menu is definitely worth ordering. There are a few other Mexican joints I've tried in Penang such as Tex Mex, A-Mex and Grumpiez but this place beats them all out with the freshness of their ingredients and the taste of the meats. Show less

Author: David H
Title: Great Burrito
Review: I have a lot of trepidation when trying Mexican restaurants in places far removed from the old country but gave it a go.  Darn fine Carne burrito, could pass muster in Texas or California easy.

Author: Cassie S
Title: Perfection!
Review: I love Mexican food and I certainly wasn’t disappointed! Warm and friendly welcome by attentive and lovely staff, food and drinks came out quickly and were delicious. Good atmosphere, would definitely recommend!

Author: 274fionap
Title: Nice place to have a break with Asian food !
Review: Nice people, Roman and his crew, good time and tasty food. Good cocktails to try. Nice and refreshing time.

Author: STELLA08AucklandAuckland Central, New Zealand
Title: Endedup here by default
Review: We walked for miles looking for somewhere to have chicken satays with peanut sauce for our last meal here. Couldn't find anywhere & we were staying in Chulia St so we collapsed into this Mexican restaurant - too hot to walk any further. And they had chicken satays with peanut sauce on the menu !! It was early evening so not too loud & crowded for old people like us, and the satays that we shared were delicious. I think we would've definitely gone back again if it hadn't been the end of our holiday.Show less

Author: Jan K
Title: Searching for good food!
Review: High quality food, super friendly people in service... there was a little live band and we enjoyed. The restaurant was Nice and authentic,  also clean toilets.... .

Author: palin12324
Title: Friendly bar with great live music
Review:
Came here looking for a chilled late drink on Love Lane and it did not disappoint! Really friendly staff, reasonably priced beer for Penang and a fantastic live band! Great way to spend my final night in 
Georgetown

Author: andrewaX6654JC
Title: Awesome tacos!
Review: Came in for some tacos and they were amazing!! Coming from Texas we love our tacos! So, having a little taste of home was a great break! Big shout out to Tej and Roman for being great hosts!!

Author: richy66673
Title: Great change from the normal
Review: I had the corn chips and sauce called totopos. Then had the quesadillas which is a tortilla wraps. Superb change food. This restaurant has a great vibe. Nice decoration good music. Very clean and reasonable prices. The staff are genuinely helpful and nice people. 1 of best meals ive had in penang. Show less

Author: kellywatson21
Title: Amazing!
Review: South African’s out in Penang on business and was recommended this place by a friend. Not sorry we came here. Food is amazing, service is great and the staff so friendly. Definitely worth visiting. And the live entertainment! Wow!

Author: Katy Rose GBristol, United Kingdom
Title: Some of the best mexican food I’ve ever had !
Review: Me & my friend we’re welcomed by very friendly staff, the restaurant itself was decorated with bright colours & paintings on wall & looked very inviting. We both ordered fajitas, which was probably one of the nicest I’ve ever had! So flavoursome, authentic and portion size was very good too, price is reasonable as well. Will defiantly be visiting again. The cocktails looked really good too!Show less

Author: MarianaL2399
Title: Delicioso!!!
Review: Really good food! Super fun and friendly environment! Good place to eat, have a couple of drinks, listen to good music and relax..

Author: rzinger
Title: Amazing Mexican food!
Review: This place is awesome. Literally all the Mexican dishes on the menu are great, you can’t really go wrong! The elote corn is a great starter. There is usually live music and is a super fun atmosphere!

Author: Tina BKiel, Germany
Title: Good food, small dishes
Review: I am glad I tried Holy Guacamole because the food was very good. However, I left more money than I had intended because the plates were very small. Prepare to order several dishes if you are really hungry. Apart from that the place is nicely decorated and the service was friendly and quick. Show less

Author: Y6668XHcharliewEdinburgh, United Kingdom
Title: Music was loud, I SAID THE MUSIC WAS LOUD!!
Review: The music was loud, loud. However this may have been a special night and we did dine rather late. The food was OK, the burrito lacked salsa and the quesadillas were too sweet..Maybe a good place for a drink (bar), but to eat (restaurant) get there early. Still the staff were very friendly and the food was reasonably priced ✌️Show less

Author: NadineH2008
Title: best place in town!
Review: very good food, especially the nachos! amazing drinks & very lovely staff, so friendly and caring! & they had a live singer.. the atmosphere was just perfect! thank you so so much for this great night! YOU ARE AMAZING! :-)

Author: roblaw84
Title: Margarittas!
Review: 10 riggit margarittas al day long, what more could you a want. Didnt eat there but he drinks where cld and cheap compared to most places.

Author: Aimz-n-edzTauranga, New Zealand
Title: Don’t miss
Review: Great value great food and great service do not miss! After wanting a break from laksa we throughly enjoyed our meal and holy guacamole what a neat spot!Show less

Author: 276johnnyc
Title: Great Mexican
Review: We’ve been here multiple times now and it’s by far the best Mexican in Penang. It’s great to have something other than the usual Chinese, Indian or Malay food. The staff are friendly and helpful.Show less

Author: _judithellidgePenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Very good
Review: Food was very nice if bland, but: hot sauces available. Staff lovely. I am the pickiest person in the world and will go back.I did not like the music but it was very low.Buzzing wth local Chinese and backpackers. And me! The long time resident Uk granny! I did not feel uncomfortable at all.Show less

Author: VikPawManama, Bahrain
Title: Great atmosphere
Review: Great food and happy hour from mid afternoon til midnight.Much quieter than at the night time, can enjoy a peaceful drink and bite to eat.Recommend the tacos, and quesadilla.Margaritas and Tiger beer Show less

Author: MoonByrneManchester, United Kingdom
Title: Tasty tasty Mexican!
Review: Really good food and not too bad price wise either!The nachos were really tasty but they served the beans, salsa and sour cream on the side. We would have preferred them all mixed in really. But they tasted so good we didn’t mind all that much. The pumpkin tacos and the mushroom tacos were really good too! Best Mexican we have had in a while! Show less

Author: asilam88Chonburi Province, Thailand
Title: Delicious Guacamole!
Review: We found this restaurant just wandering around and decided to enter. The Restaurant is decorated so you actually feel like your in mexico! The magaritas were good and the nachos as well! Wish the tacos were a bit bigger tho. The staff was very helpful recommending dishes and taking photos for us.Show less

Author: PuebalanBatu Ferringhi, Malaysia
Title: Farewell
Review: Good staff, good food, fantastic entertainment and nice envoirement. All in one, Relaxing place. Don't miss out when you in penang.Show less

Author: 695ollybHaslemere, United Kingdom
Title: Good food that’s reasonably priced
Review: Portion sizes aren’t massive and the prices aren’t super cheap but the food was really good. We had the Carne burrito and the Mexico City pizza. Would recommend both of them. The Happy hour deal they have is reasonable too although there are cheaper bars right next door with better happy hour deals. Show less

Author: wendyk621Seattle, Washington
Title: Eating Mexican Food in Malaysia Not A Bad Idea
Review: Lots of good Asian food of every variety in Georgetown, Malaysia. Now there is decent Mexican food too. Great homemade tortilla chips with salsa, strong Margeritas, and my husband said his tacos were tasty. Comfortable atmosphere, reasonable prices, a great option.Show less

Author: Vegard VOslo, Norway
Title: Love the place - some simple improvements
Review: Good Mexican food in Penang.Love the atmosphere and packed place.The tacos were very good, however some of them were a bit dry..... But an easy fix by adding guacamole, sour cream or a hot sauce.Love the guts for trying, however the Satay taco doesn't work.Good nachos and condiments.I'll have a Corona with that....PS: Play more Mexican or Spanish music ;)Show less

Author: emilye890
Title: Amazing Mexican Restaurant!
Review: If you're looking for some good mexican food and drinks in Georgetown, look no further! Happy hour beer, margaritas and daiquiris for 10RM. Food is also very reasonable for Georgetown. What truly makes it is the atmosphere and the incredible and friendly staff! They even have live music some nights!Show less

Author: 504kell_
Title: Excellent Mexican food on Penang
Review: This is for sure the best Mexican food we have had here in Malaysia in the three years we have been here.Can highly recommend this if you are looking for some Mexi food.Prices are average Penang and food value for money!Show less

Author: CrizMCebu Island, Philippines
Title: Beef tasted different
Review: I'm from California and after having Asian food for too long I was craving something from back home. I wasn't expecting too much so I just ordered a carne asada burrito. I just couldn't enjoy it. The beef tasted funny like it was a different kind of meat. I know most Malaysians don't eat beef, but didn't expect that taste. I should have gone with chicken. I also didnt care for the Margarita. It may have been the Margarita mix they used. I can't say I agree with the other posts that it's the real deal, but I appreciate their efforts. Restaurant is beautifully decorated.Show less

Author: marie180286
Title: Great food great atmosphere
Review: The setting of the place is amazingly beautiful with delicious food and with of course who can forget the margarita..excellent !will definitely be back for more !

Author: travell715
Title: Sooooo delicious
Review:
This restaurant is just great. We loved everything from the drinks over the staff to the amazing food.
Every dish we had was just perfect and so much made an decorated with love.
Holy Guacamole is definitely a MUST! if you come to Penang

Author: laurahS8516WUCardiff, United Kingdom
Title: Quesadillas made in heaven
Review: We absolutely loved our meal here! The place itself is really colourful and we loved the decor with all the sugar skulls decorating the walls. The cocktails were delicious and refreshing and happy hour is from 12pm-10pm, you can’t go wrong with a margarita for 10 MYR! We ordered the carne burrito and quesadilla with nachos, the stand out dish was definitely the quesadilla, it was heavenly! The best I’ve ever eaten and would 100% recommend it. Spent a little more money than planned here but was worth it!Show less

Author: CycleSeanPenang, Malaysia
Title: Tasty Lunch
Review: I’m very glad we stopped here for lunch - the decor is fun, the staff friendly, and the food is full of authentic flavor. The menu is extensive enough offering most of the usual offerings. The tortilla chips and salsa were fresh and made in-house and the tacos were small but tasty. The burrito we ordered was huge, so I suggest you enquire about portion sizes with the waiter before placing your order. While this restaurant nearly earned a full 5 stars from me, the very weak Margaritas were unfortunately disappointing. But we’ll be back - but I’ll probably order a soda next time. Show less

Author: Edmundo1727
Title: Nice Cosy Place to hangout
Review: A real nice place to hangout with friends. Music is good. Anwar and Botak plays a nice selection of songs. Music is not too loud until you can't talk. Food is yummy as well. Serves good selection of mexican food. Owner/outlet manager is down to earth and is flexible on customizing our orders. You don't see that often anymore. Nice and unique deco as well...Makes you feel like you are in the COCO cartoon. Keep up the good job guys!!!Show less

Author: H7167ORtimf
Title: Fun!
Review: Holy guacamole was a fun experience at night!! Good love music and nice people made it a great vibe.  We also went during the day and it was delicious. Great food!!

Author: 591gwendad
Title: Brilliant foid and atmosphere
Review: Can't recommend this enough. Food was great. Mango mojitos awesome. We went back twice in 10 days. Atmosphere was relaxed and Mexican food great and pizzas few days later tasty

Author: Lewis H
Title: Amazing food
Review: Amazing food! Went for nachos and a burrito. Everything tasted perfect! Is a bit on the expensive side but you won't walk away disappointed.

Author: amyo530
Title: Great food and atmosphere!
Review: Can’t wait to go back again! Food was delicious, perfect for sharing or bigger plates available! Cocktails were super tasty, staff are really good fun and helpful! Live music every night and great vibes! 10/10Show less

Author: frekhetsjekShwenyaung, Myanmar
Title: Best Mexican food in Asia
Review: If you love Mexican food then this is the place to be! As a starter we had nacho's with some guacamole. For the rest you can choose between Fajita's, burrito, taco and quesedilla's. They also serve some western food. They had great live music, a spot where you can hangout all night!Show less

Author: Janinev437
Title: Seriously Holy!
Review: This is a great place. The Staff is wonderful. Very attentive. Have a live band too. Music throughout the day is fabulous. The food taste great. and then the Happy Day cocktails.... AMAZING! Cocktails are like slushies. Clearly not shy with the alcohol part. Would really recommend the place to visit!Show less

Author: kevindl1971
Title: Awesome
Review: Awesome small restaurant and bar. Can highly recommend the Margaritas and Daiquiris well priced and fantastic slushy taste

Author: NathanL123Penang, Malaysia
Title: Great Mexican food option for Malaysia
Review: We were there with a group of 4 adults and 4 kids from 3 to 9 years old. Everyone enjoyed the food. There were good options including healthy and interesting veggie options, and it came mostly well presented. We even arrived for an early lunch, and they opened early for us.Show less

Author: perrysimpsonmolSouthampton, United Kingdom
Title: Hidden little gem!
Review: We found this little restaurant after a full day of touristy stuff!We got there at happy hour which meant the beer and cocktails were cheaper, result!The food was amazing and the staff were super chilled and lovely! Which is why we came back again the next night to eat!!There are also some very good live music bands that play there who are a lot of fun.Would highly recommend if you’re in Georgetown!!Show less

Author: huntforgoodtimes
Title: Everything is fab
Review: Fantastic staff, perfect food & funky setting. They even have live music and happy hour beers & cocktails. Doesn't get better than that.

Author: grs1973Newport, United Kingdom
Title: Buzzing
Review: What a find amongst the bars and restaurants on Love Lane, really busy and accomodating. Really friendly staff making everyone feel welcome. The food was authentic and tasty, really good value. The decor is what really stands out. Cant recommend this place highly enough. A must visit in Georgetown.Show less

Author: Riduan123
Title: Great Vibe here!
Review: We had Mexican chips with guacamole and couple of drinks. We only stayed longer because of the live music as they were very engaging and entertaining. Will definitely come back here soon!

Author: Tour431798
Title: So good
Review: We went here just before closing time and had nachos. Simply the best and most well done environment i have seen in this city. There was live music, usually thats waaaay too loud, but this was at a level were you still can talk with each other. And the food were just brilliant. Would definetly come back hereShow less

Author: AzurianWorthing, United Kingdom
Title: Buzzing little restaurant.
Review: We'd been in Penang for a week and wanted a change from Curries and Chinese food and this place hit the spot. We both had a burger- they tasted pretty good, not burnt to a peice of shoe leather like a lot of others we've eaten. The restaurant hasn't been open for very long but it's extremely popular already,and we had to wait to get a table- it was worth it though! Credit cards are accepted.Show less

Author: 354haleybSantorini, Greece
Title: SO DELICIOUS
Review: Honestly the best place I ate while in Penang. The food is so delicious and they have a wide selection. I recommend the nachos with guacamole The margaritas are frozen and delicious and reasonably priced! Strawberry was our favorite. Our waitress was so friendly! Love this place. Show less

Author: titchpitch
Title: Good :)
Review: Good food and a fair price. burrito could have been larger. Drinks fairly priced and good happy hour. Just opened so worth a visit.

Author: Taco L
Title: Amazing place
Review: This place is amazing! The food is really good, but their different varieties of margaritas are really delicious!! A good place to eat, or just to have a drink! The staff is really friendly and great atmosphere! When I’m back in Penang, I definitely will come back to this place!Show less

Author: clarebJ2451LZGeelong, Australia
Title: Very cool new restaurant! Must try!!
Review: We visited Holy Guacamole on the 4th day it was open. It was packed which is a great sign.We were greeted by very friendly staff and seated.We ordered drinks.Delicious Strawberry Daiquiri. Juices were a little on the small side.The food was great. Flavour packed and very fresh! The interior is very cool and made us feel like we were in he heart of Mexico!The staff are very friendly and attentive.The only tiny thing bringing this place down is the size of the meals.A little on the small side. Also, a little extra salsa with the corn chips as the ratio wasn’t quite right.All in all- were giving it 5 stars This place will do VERY well in Penang and we wish you all the very best!!! Show less

Author: lordt137
Title: New Bar on the Block
Review: The taste of south America with an Asian flavor .great food ..atmosphere.. & and music. ..dont hesitate. ..just come here

Author: trulanium
Title: new and vibrant
Review: The whole concept of this place makes u feel like u are in mexico... the food is delicious and drinks are inexpensive... they have live band n dj at certain nights... a place to visit when u are in penang!

Author: yvettedavey2022Penang Island, Malaysia
Title: Indigo one of my top three restaurants in Penang
Review: Indigo has a great reputation in Georgetown, Penang. The atmosphere, the menu, meal presentation and the staff. I can not fault it! It’s a must when visiting Georgetown, Penang.Show less
Restaurant: Indigo Restaurant at The Blue Mansion

Author: IenaS6
Title: Delicacy wrapped in history
Review: The beautiful and historical building welcomes visitors in a very friendly and welcoming manner. Lunch seems to be in the 1500s BC. Surrounded by walls and paintings that tell the story of his life. The food is also very tasty and appetizing with the five star resto service. You have to come to feel it for yourself.Show less
Restaurant: Indigo Restaurant at The Blue Mansion

Author: janicekhor68
Title: Great fine dining experience
Review: Excellent quality of food, great atmosphere and service too :) Many thanks to Daniel for the thoughtful arrangement 😉 Highly recommend the gnocchi and soft shell crab salad - the vinaigrette dressing was simply amazing 🥗👍
Restaurant: Indigo Restaurant at The Blue Mansion

Author: DrPhilipPradeep
Title: Must visit atleast once
Review: Beautifully decorated restaurant. Delicious food. Fine dining at its best. Value for money. Very hospitable staff. Must visit at least once.Show less
Restaurant: Indigo Restaurant at The Blue Mansion

Author: G8250OAcathyc
Title: Delicious lunch in beautiful historical surroundings
Review: A stunning dining room and a warm welcome. Best ever seafood pasta followed by an excellent chocolate ganache. Great value for the ser lunch. We will be back Show less
Restaurant: Indigo Restaurant at The Blue Mansion

Author: Aishah K
Title: Great dinner with family
Review: As a special treat to celebrate the birthdays of our daughters (different birthdates but fairly close to each other) we went to Indigo. The meal was lovely although we would have liked our water glasses refilled more frequently. We are not a family that enjoys loud protestations of birthday wishes so it was lovely to enjoy each other's company and being able to hear our own conversations. We ordered different things and they were almost all great. My husband didn't enjoy one of the accompaniments to his meal but the rest of us found no fault. The prices are a little steep so not able to afford very frequent visits but for a special treat definitely a go-to place for our family.Show less
Restaurant: Indigo Restaurant at The Blue Mansion

Author: submersiondPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: New Years Eve
Review: Fantastic night the food and service where fantastic. The one thing I think would be a nice addition would be a wine pairing. The food was fantastic with several courses. But because of that you go from fish to meat and back meaning you really need different wines with each course. Which in Malaysia is outrageously expensive due to government taxes. So a by the glass offering with each course would be a lovely way of adding to what is already an exceptionally good meal. Show less
Restaurant: Indigo Restaurant at The Blue Mansion

Author: mel-mitchell1712
Title: Amazing vegetarian set menu - 4-5 courses
Review: Amazing food and impeccable attention to detail. We had pre-booked a vegetarian set menu a few days before, and not only were they able to come up with a delicious 4-5 course set but they were willing to work with us to avoid certain foods that we could not eat. The food was the best I’ve ever had and so plentiful. The ambience and setting was also impeccable. Hands down the best dinner I’ve ever had. Also excellent service- really cannot give any complaints at all. Show less
Restaurant: Indigo Restaurant at The Blue Mansion

Author: ming TPenang, Malaysia
Title: Overall it is good
Review: The food is delicious and the environment is nice. The SOPs was strictly taken during this covid period and the service was good. Overall it is good and recommended. Definitely will come back again.Show less
Restaurant: Indigo Restaurant at The Blue Mansion

Author: Volker S
Title: One of the best restaurant in Penang
Review: Nice restaurant in a historic building. Excellent service and very tasty food. You can order a la cart or take one of the set menu. Also nice Cocktails and wine are available.
Restaurant: Indigo Restaurant at The Blue Mansion

Author: MillaChangAmpang, Malaysia
Title: A wonderful evening
Review: Very nice atmosphere, and the waiters are very enthusiastic.The meals are generally good, with large portions, suitable for sharing. It's a pity that there are not many types of coffee, and the mushroom pasta is sweeter, just not our favorite taste..In any case, it is still a restaurant worth visiting for a pleasant evening.Show less
Restaurant: Indigo Restaurant at The Blue Mansion

Author: hockstan25
Title: Overall
Review: Indigo restaurant @ The Blue Mansion- Good food, excellent service and nice ambience for diners from all walks of Life.
Restaurant: Indigo Restaurant at The Blue Mansion

Author: EricY598
Title: A Fine place to dine!
Review: Great food, amazing ambience and excellent service. A must visit when one is in Penang or go often if you're based in Penang.
Restaurant: Indigo Restaurant at The Blue Mansion

Author: Frequenttravel888
Title: Best dining experience in Penang!
Review: It's one of the best fine dining experiences we've had, internationally. Wait staff was extremely attentive. The place was completely spotless and above and beyond adherence to govt. standard SOP for Covid.
Restaurant: Indigo Restaurant at The Blue Mansion

Author: Robert J
Title: Wonderful Anniversary Dinner
Review: My wife and I live in Penang and recently celebrated our 40th wedding anniversary by having dinner at the Blue Mansion. We had excellent service, the atmosphere was very nice and unique, and the food was very excellent and reasonably priced.Show less
Restaurant: Indigo Restaurant at The Blue Mansion

Author: Tleena
Title: Fine Fusion Dining
Review: The food is excellent. They are able to combine local ingredient to create a western meal in a fine dining settling. Service is excellent and they practice social distancing without compromising comfort. Worth Visiting. Hope they will create more variety in their menu.
Restaurant: Indigo Restaurant at The Blue Mansion

Author: TheYumL
Title: Beautiful Restaurant
Review: This restaurant is in such a pretty location. The food menu is creative and very tasty. Every dish is a piece of art.Show less
Restaurant: Indigo Restaurant at The Blue Mansion

Author: EnzoTheTravellerPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Best asian fusion dinner in Penang!
Review: One of the best Asian restaurants in Penang with the best service. The presence of Alwee made the dinner a memorable one with his exceptional professionalism in his service and attitude. The food quality is simply excellent and impeccable.Show less
Restaurant: Indigo Restaurant at The Blue Mansion

Author: PipitanBangkok, Thailand
Title: perfect service,tasty
Review: Nice building,tasty menu,service perfect!! I went to Lunch time,I "d like to visit dinner time next time.Show less
Restaurant: Indigo Restaurant at The Blue Mansion

Author: wongbhGeorge Town, Malaysia
Title: Dining at Indigo
Review: Nice ambience. well spaced tables.Pleasant prompt serviceLimited but adequate menu- Presentation v good. Show less
Restaurant: Indigo Restaurant at The Blue Mansion

Author: alvinchong71
Title: Great ambience and food variety
Review: Great service and food quality.  Worth consider indulging and giving yourselves a treat while in Penang.
Restaurant: Indigo Restaurant at The Blue Mansion

Author: puchkaBengaluru, India
Title: A must place to visit
Review: Located on the first floor of the Blue Mansion, this restaurant is popular for Asian and Western cuisine. The offer for the day was a set menu of one starter, one main course, one dessert and coffee or tea. The food was well prepared and well presented. We ordered separately to taste a variety of dishes on offer. The pear salad with greens and croutons, cheese, and a vanigraitte dressing was fresh and delicious. The crabs were unbelievably cooked to perfection. For main course we chose grilled snapper with seafood and chicken rolled in bacon, both incredibly good. Dessert was creme bulle with a dollop of chocolate ice cream. The theme is of course blue. A must place to eat when in Penang.Show less
Restaurant: Indigo Restaurant at The Blue Mansion

Author: Papa9090Singapore, Singapore
Title: Really Good Food!!
Review: You wouldn't go wrong having a meal here especially the 3 course lunch set menu at MR65/Pax!! Liked both the starters of Asparagus soup n the Caught Prawns, I don't really fancy the Cold Laksa. As we were sharing we ordered 3 different main courses, a big dish of Seafood Stew - fantastic flavour [our favourite], Chicken Breast n the Panfried Red Snapper, both were just as good but 3 of us felt that the Snapper was a bit overcooked. Author: agaig_partdeuxchester
Title: HIGH PRAISE - INDEED.
Review: I have travelled around most of the world and dined in some of the best restaurants and hotels but Indigo Restaurant at the Blue Mansion was one of the most wonderful experiences of a lifetime. The moment you approach the hotel you just know you are entering a doorway to the past. So many artifacts outside to remind the visitor that this was once a great house of a very great and influential man. We had a little time to take some photos by the two antique trishaws which are parked on the verandah, as you look around you can see that this is an oasis set in the middle of a very busy city, the mansion is set within the boundaries of Penang's local Government buildings, many are colonial and a reminder of Britain's legacy to this part of the world. Once you enter the building you step back into 19th Century Penang, beautiful Victorian chandeliers, carved wooden seats. Between two antique carved doorways you can sit and gaze in awe at this great entrance to what is now a hotel with spectacular doors, stained glass windows and wooden shutters that are all still in use, from a magnificent antique carved settee which is inlaid with mother of pearl. Through the doors and up the stairs to the right we found the entrance to Indigo and were yet again propelled back through time to the colonial days of Cheong Fatt Tze a businessman and politician who was also a powerful Nanyang industrialist and a first-class Mandarin in the Manchu government; he was made Consul-General in Singapore and economic advisor to the Empress Dowager. The dining room is calm and beautifully decked with crisp tableclothes, air conditioning tricks you into believing that it is not really 30 degrees on the verandah. The staff in the restaurant are wonderful; you are treated as the only person in the restaurant and given their full attention. We had a special lunch menu which consisted of a very tasty soup for myself and my husband, my son tried the asparagus and mushroom salad with rocket, tofu and sesame miso dressing. Perfect. Main course was a very unusual but tasty steak pie for my husband, Duck for myself and Prawns and Clams with pasta and tomato sauce which was beautiful and now I wished I had had the same as my son, however, the duck was nothing less than perfection and I have never eaten parnips, pureed so well before. Excellent. Dessert just had to be the chocolate mouse encased in a rich chocolate ganache and served with cream and a drizzel of fruit coulis. Our meal ended with coffee and tea, we enjoyed our coffee so much we asked for another cup. The whole lunch was only 65 Ringets or approx. £13.00 UK and was thoroughly enjoyed by us all. We then went on a tour of the Mansion which brought the whole place to life and once we had learned the history of the now hotel and the man who had built the Blue Mansion as his office, home and base for his enterprizes it was also the home of his 7th and much loved wife we understood the world this man had lived in and could see why this building was so wonderful especially as the house had been built under the influence of Feng Shui, this is why there was so much peace felt in the building. After the tour we then retired for a couple of drinks in the very comfortable and colonial bar, what a wonderful way to spend the day, we had gone there for my son's 35th birthday and he thoroughly enjoyed the whole experience also. Thank you so much to all the staff at the Blue Mansion for making our time with you so memorable. I hope that one day we shall be back to sample your welcome and the splendour of the Blue Mansion yet again. This visit was wonderful and will be forever in my memory.Show less
Restaurant: Indigo Restaurant at The Blue Mansion
