Review: Lodged in comfortable surroundings on the first floor, the three course lunch at Indigo is not overly expensive and very good value compared to a set lunch in France. Our smoked chicken salad starter was OK but not fine dining while though our steak was absolutely perfectly done. Unfortunately, the steak lacked accompaniments which we would normally expect such as a side of potato of some sort or a vegetable which isn't garnish (and doesn't taste of vinegar).We were slightly puzzled as to why we had to ask for iced water when we arrived; and later, why we had to wait for salt and pepper for our salads which had no dressing.Both lunch desserts were very passable, but certainly not in the "fine dining" category.The main advantage of the portion sizes is that you don't leave feeling as if you need to lie down! The overall standard of food far exceeds a set lunch in most parts of France, so if you're prepared to ask for water and salt & pepper when you arrive, if don't expect 'fine dining' for 65RM, then I'm sure you won't be disappointed. If you're not booked on the tour, I suggest you make an advance reservation for the restaurant on-line (very easy), and then take a screen shot with you just in case...Show less
Restaurant: Indigo Restaurant at The Blue Mansion

Author: caleighle3
Title: Great
Review: We had a very good time there, great food, great ambience and great service. We enjoyed every minute and good value for money. We will definitely visit the restaurant again should we have the chance to visit Penang.
Restaurant: Indigo Restaurant at The Blue Mansion

Author: rouyingr
Title: Excellent set lunch
Review: The service was top-notch, place is nicely decorated. The set lunch priced at 65+ (no service charge) was definitely bang for the buck. Portions are not huge, but definitely filling. Food did not disappoint -- from appetisers to dessert, all was nicely done.Show less
Restaurant: Indigo Restaurant at The Blue Mansion

Author: Wendy YGreater Sydney, Australia
Title: Wonderful dinner in gorgeous surroundings
Review: Earlier this month my husband and I were staying in George Town for a few days. We spotted the Cheong Fatt Tze Mansion on one of our walks. It was extremely close to our accommodation so we decided to book dinner in its signature Indigo Restaurant. We were not disappointed. If you want to experience fine dining at reasonable prices, then this is the place for you. The staff were extremely attentive and helpful with both food and wine selections. The menu has both Malaysian and Western dishes. The mansion itself was built in 1904 and has been wonderfully restored, receiving a UNESCO Asia Pacific Heritage Award for authentic restoration in 2000. There are also guided tours of the mansion throughout the day. Both the restaurant and mansion should be on your 'to do' list when you are in the city.Show less
Restaurant: Indigo Restaurant at The Blue Mansion

Author: Cloud9YYZ
Title: Excellent Value for Money
Review: Great set lunch menu. Top notched food and service with a very reasonable price tag.  Will visit again.
Restaurant: Indigo Restaurant at The Blue Mansion

Author: ThomasBoHanoi, Vietnam
Title: Great food in magnificent setting
Review: In Georgetown, it can't get much better than at the Indigo restaurant in the legendary Blue Mansion, once owned by a famous Penang based Chinese mandarin. The Mansion itself is incredibly beautiful, and the lunch we had was one of the very best in Penang: Aspargus soup, Risotto with more than a twist and banana pancakes. So good that we made a new booking on the spot. Show less
Restaurant: Indigo Restaurant at The Blue Mansion

Author: Thomas Bo P
Title: Fabolous food in a beautiful setting.
Review: Having lunch at the Indigo restaurant at the   legendary Cheong Fatt Tze Mansion was a unique experience. Super delicious food in the amazingly beautiful ancient Chinese mansion. Don’t miss this place, when in Penang!
Restaurant: Indigo Restaurant at The Blue Mansion

Author: NgKS9368
Title: Birthday Dinner
Review:
Indigo Restaurant @ The Blue Mansion
Building is well maintained & beautiful, worth to visit. Waitress give a good service & food also good. Can give it a try.
Restaurant: Indigo Restaurant at The Blue Mansion

Author: archi71penguin
Title: Great Ambience, Great Food
Review: Drunken chicken salad was scrumptious, so as the pumpkin risotto! The 3 meal course ended with tiramisu was a perfect choice.
Restaurant: Indigo Restaurant at The Blue Mansion

Author: LarryKLBangkok, Thailand
Title: Beautiful setting; food needs work
Review: For Penang standards we went for a late dinner, arriving just after 8:30pm.Arriving at this magically lit building in the evening and then going upstairs, walking into the dining room is certainly a very special experience. We both felt that the the renovation of the interior was very well executed, respecting the old, and introducing smidgens of the new.The food itself unfortunately was not up to expectation. Our prawn starter was the best, although a rather small portion. The main was duck breast with a tomato based sauce which just didn't work at all. The chocolate dessert was rock hard and lacked the depth of good chocolate flavours.And the Maître D' was excellent I must say; very courteous, very knowledgable, and continuously made his round of the tables to check and serve everyone that could possible be meeting anything. Well done!Show less
Restaurant: Indigo Restaurant at The Blue Mansion

Author: Terence MGreater Perth, Australia
Title: Delightful meal
Review: Dined there on our 48th Wedding Anniversary and had such a lovely time, had a simple meal but it was just topping up a lovely day for us. Did not require parking as walkedfrom the Eastern and Oriental Hotel so cannot tell you about parking.Show less
Restaurant: Indigo Restaurant at The Blue Mansion

Author: JSLINAZFreeland, Washington
Title: Amazing!!! You must go there.
Review: We had exceptional, delightful and sincere service at this drop dead gorgeous restaurant. Food, wine and decor were amazing too. Don’t miss this dining and cultural experience. Maitre d is a real professional. Show less
Restaurant: Indigo Restaurant at The Blue Mansion

Author: 欧 雷
Title: Exclusive, Food Delicious, Excellent Service!
Review: i come for the business trip! all of us and my friend are very happy with the service! the food! and the environment! their team are very friendly and i will come back to this place again.
Restaurant: Indigo Restaurant at The Blue Mansion

Author: syfcinhkHong Kong, China
Title: Wonderful meal in an elegant setting
Review: I took my dad here whilst on a long weekend together to Georgetown and thought it would be a lovely treat after sampling all the delicious streetfood. We had visited the mansion a couple of days prior, but hadn’t seen inside the mansion. The staff were attentive and professional, and the food was wonderful and beautifully presented. It was great value for money compared to Hong Kong where I live as well! My only gripe was that it was quite noisy - other diners’ voices echoed across the high ceilings so maybe they need more artwork on the walls to buffer the noise, and make it seem less stark. But otherwise a lovely experience overall. Show less
Restaurant: Indigo Restaurant at The Blue Mansion

Author: LadyA_9228Canton of Geneva, Switzerland
Title: Friendly staff, but disappointing dinner, did not meet our expectations
Review: Our experience: The warm bread bun served was nice and crispy. However, starting with the appetizers, the otak-otak appetizer dish, which was very nicely presented, tasted rather strange and very far from real genuine otak-otak. The asparagus appetizer was served with a cold soft egg. As for the main dishes, the aromatic chicken dish was served almost cold, and we requested a replacement. The staff was very understanding and helpful, but sadly, the replacement was just a little warm. Again, taste somewhat not harmonious. The sea bass dish was served warm, but not hot, and looked rather poorly with a few gherkins and a few slices of radish. While the staff is kind and helpful, the food needs much improvement. Too far into fusion will spoil the original flavor of simple local dishes, and pre-warming the plates and serving all foods at the right temperature is a must for any good restaurant. It can be done. Good luck!I enjoyed the glass of German Riesling.Show less
Restaurant: Indigo Restaurant at The Blue Mansion

Author: John DLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Delicious food, very serene and tranquil in a unique setting
Review: We had lunch at Indigo Restaurant. They have an impressive dining room and there were only 4 other guests. Lunch is a set menu with around 3 choices for each course. The cost of around 70 MYR is very reasonable for such a restaurant (although I do not know how much they charge for dinner). The service was prompt and discreet. The food was well fresh, well presented and tasty. We also had the opportunity to look around The Blue Mansion afterwards. If you are considering visiting to see the Mansion, why not book lunch instead of a tour?Show less
Restaurant: Indigo Restaurant at The Blue Mansion

Author: Mei Lin OPenang, Malaysia
Title: Beautiful Mansion with Warm Hospitality
Review: We had a dinner for 40 colleagues at The Indigo and it was a great success. The food was good ( the vegetarian set menu was as good as the non- vegetarian menu), the tables were beautifully decorated and the staff were discretely attentive.Show less
Restaurant: Indigo Restaurant at The Blue Mansion

Author: Karen PKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Perfect lunch
Review: I visited with a group of 10 friends on Saturday afternoon as a pre-wedding surprise. We were impressed with every aspect of our experience. The building is beautiful, the service was wonderful and the dishes we had were enjoyed by all. We were generously treated to a bottle of champagne from the manager which topped off a fantastic meal. I will certainly return on future trips to Penang. Show less
Restaurant: Indigo Restaurant at The Blue Mansion

Author: JPDH52Canberra, Australia
Title: Perfectly captures modern Penang
Review: It was, given the superb ambience, excellent service and exceptionally fine food at Indigo, a surprisingly quiet evening when we dined there. All the staff - from our arrival, throughout dinner to helping us secure a taxi when leaving - were particularly friendly, attentive, responsive and helpful. While we don’t normally pursue food styles that can be described as ‘fusion’, Indigo provided us with dishes which combined clever and subtle Asian flavour elements with very attractive western presentation. While a fairly large serve for a starter, the grilled squid stood out in excellent company which included a delicious scallop starter and duck breast as a main course. The Asian interpretation of tiramisu for desert was also extremely good. Dinner was very successfully accompanied by an elegant French rose. Indigo’s setting, in the famous Blue Mansion seemed to perfectly capture all of the heritage qualities of Penang as well as its thriving, modern and elegant style. We will be returning to Indigo when we next visit Penang. Show less
Restaurant: Indigo Restaurant at The Blue Mansion

Author: 399RichardPPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Highly Recommended
Review: We visited for dinner, and left very,very happy with all aspects of our experience. Located in the beautifully restored Cheong Fatt Tze mansion (also known as the Blue Mansion), the ambience in Indigo is probably unique in Penang and manages to be elegant without being 'stuffy'.This also applies to the service, which was professional and well informed throughout, with wait staff always available when required. The food was similarly professionally presented, with a fusion style leaning towards Asian flavours - a warm Squid Salad starter was reminiscent of Thai salads but without the sometimes overwhelming chilli heat. A Lamb Shank Rendang main course was just perfect, correctly slow cooked and on the dry side as Rendang sould be, but also beautifully creamy.The Seared Scallop starter was similarly very good, served with a sweet corn based sauce. The wine list is extensive, with house wine and other bottles starting at about RM96, ranging all the way up to about RM480 for a Chateauneuf du Pape, with a very good selection of both reds and whites across the price range. A glass of house Sauv Blanc (which was very pleasant), is priced at RM22 - very good value in a restaurant of this quality.Overall this was an excellent experience which we would highly recommend.Show less
Restaurant: Indigo Restaurant at The Blue Mansion

Author: Mandy P
Title: lovely food and service
Review: lovely dining room and excellent value. Great attentive wait staff. Great attention to meal presentation.
Restaurant: Indigo Restaurant at The Blue Mansion

Author: msiewmPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Beautiful setting, amazing food
Review: Their truffled corn soup with lobster is a must try for seafood lovers! The ice-cream that came with their chocolate fondant was just divine!For most people, four courses would be an overkill. I was already feeling satisfied/not hungry after the second course and stuffed by the end of the third course. I would suggest sticking to three courses unless you are a big eater.Expensive for Penang, but worth the money.Show less
Restaurant: Indigo Restaurant at The Blue Mansion

Author: ChrisbolivHong Kong, China
Title: Disappointing
Review: Although the ambience is nice, only HALF the items on a VERY limited menu were available. Table cloth was stained and the chair was wobbly.Show less
Restaurant: Indigo Restaurant at The Blue Mansion

Author: chrisnguyen320
Title: Love everything about this historical and cultural site!
Review: This is a truly unique place packed with lots of stories and cultural heritage. The rooms are comfortable and has everything one needs to feel at home, the attention to detail is also unparalleled. The staff was warm and welcoming. My highlight was the free tour this property offered. Show less
Restaurant: Indigo Restaurant at The Blue Mansion

Author: lovemykidsallthetimeKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Wow! Great for vegetarians & pescatarians. Really nice food with a subtle Asian twist!
Review: More traditional than typical fusion food, but there is a definite & yet subtle Asian twist! My cod (fish of the day) came with a really delicious purée with subtle hints of crab, almost like a mild version of the Singaporean chilli crab sauce. My daughter's silky pumpkin spaghetti was amazing! So nice to have a place where pescatarians and vegetarians dine as well as the others!Show less
Restaurant: Indigo Restaurant at The Blue Mansion

Author: bagpuss24
Title: Amazing food in an amazing restaurant
Review: Excellently prepared food of very high quality in an amazing restaurant. Very good service the food was delicious and at a very good price indeed. I'm looking forward to returning.
Restaurant: Indigo Restaurant at The Blue Mansion

Author: sherylnsyShah Alam, Malaysia
Title: Beautiful concept, delicious food!
Review: We had a special dinner prepared for my boyfriend and I by Chef Weng! The soup was so tasteful, it had codfish and prawns in it. The salmon steak was cooked perfectly and the dessert was absolutely stunning. Do try the Mango sorbet!! All the portions were just nice and the environment was romantic enough for us! Show less
Restaurant: Indigo Restaurant at The Blue Mansion

Author: LawrenceSengGeorge Town, Malaysia
Title: Wonderful experience but not quite so
Review: Dined during Christmas eve; the chef is clearly talented and skilled in his craft, however service by the serving crew not so; one of our party member was served his beef 20-25 minutes after everyone else's main have been served, which is clearly a blunder either by the kitchen or service crew. Perhaps it was due to the lack of service crew or the busy night of Christmas eve, but one ought to be prepared for one of the busiest night of the year;Show less
Restaurant: Indigo Restaurant at The Blue Mansion

Author: howsy2017
Title: A good recommendation  for fine dining
Review: Great services from the waitress, nice environment to walk around the antique building, they serve quality food and easy to get car parking spots.
Restaurant: Indigo Restaurant at The Blue Mansion

Author: Barbara DJohor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Three ladies in Penang
Review: Excellent food in a beautiful setting. We particularly enjoyed the duck and found the service to be professional and not intrusive. We were delighted that arrangements were made for us to eat downstairs one evening as my elderly mother was unable to face the stairs: most accommodating. Hope to return one day. Show less
Restaurant: Indigo Restaurant at The Blue Mansion

Author: magy1261
Title: Awesome Birthday Dinner!
Review: GM of the blue mansion Mr. Daniel was awesome.. he recommended the best.. n true enough the food was yummy... delicious ! Thank you !
Restaurant: Indigo Restaurant at The Blue Mansion

Author: Susan H
Title: Birthday lunch
Review: Excellent fresh food. Professional and welcoming staff. Restaurant part of Blue Mansions, decor and ambience enhances the food. Terrific value.
Restaurant: Indigo Restaurant at The Blue Mansion

Author: hatthi84
Title: Excellent!Impressive!
Review: Excellent! We truly impressed with the food (it was great and very delicious). Outstanding dinner arrangement. Very professional service.Our group had very good experience dining at such beautiful place Indigo Restaurant at The Blue Mansion. Highly recommended you to visit!
Restaurant: Indigo Restaurant at The Blue Mansion

Author: vanjahellborgFrankfurt, Germany
Title: Falling in love!
Review: I discovered and fell in love with the Blue Mansion in 1983 - a dusty forgotten building just like sleeping beauty, which through caring restauration can indeed live up to its name. Not only can one sleep well here, but since recently also dine very well. To make your visit to Penang and/or Georgetown complete would be to get to know tycoon Cheong Fatt Tze and reviving the magic of a long gone era!Show less
Restaurant: Indigo Restaurant at The Blue Mansion

Author: DTgeorgetown
Title: Fine Dining
Review: Ample parking space. Good service and good food. The company of other guest was pleasing as they dress their best.
Restaurant: Indigo Restaurant at The Blue Mansion

Author: RetiringnotShy
Title: Perfection
Review: Delicious French fusion food, presented to please the eye. Attentive and friendly service in the most beautiful space. We had dinner here and then lunch. Both superb and the fixed price lunch menu must be the best value in Georgetown.
Restaurant: Indigo Restaurant at The Blue Mansion

Author: Kees DAmsterdam, The Netherlands
Title: A great place with great food
Review: Penang is known for its food and beautifull old buildings this is all coming together in the blue mansion , great food , excellent service in a great environment. With service we mean the whole line , serving the food the talk at the table anout the mansion and we talk about the whole staff , Thank you All we Will come back , Lara & Kees Show less
Restaurant: Indigo Restaurant at The Blue Mansion

Author: Sabrina W
Title: A JEWEL !!
Review: While back in Penang for a visit, my Cousins took me to The Blue Mansion, and we had lunch there. The Restoration of this Old Home was very Impressive. We then had lunch at Indigo Restaurant. Food was Excellent; Service was Impeccable; Setting was Very Pleasant. I HIGHLY RECOMMEND this restaurant for a Very Pleasant, Unhurried Meal. 2 days later, on my last day, I took my Uncle and Aunt back there, and we had a really good visit and meal again. HIGHLY RECOMMEND this JEWEL RESTAURANT !!Show less
Restaurant: Indigo Restaurant at The Blue Mansion

Author: TheJetsetterDiaries
Title: Must try when in Penang!
Review: The atmosphere is amazing and the food is so delicious. Must try: truffle corn soup, crispy duck leg, coconut pineapple cake. Top it off with some great coffee or a drink on the terrace.
Restaurant: Indigo Restaurant at The Blue Mansion

Author: CassG0hPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Good food with Great Service!
Review: We had a corporate appreciation lunch at Indigo restaurant just now. Daniel, the manager provided excellence customer service and I'm impressed with the food and the interior design. Food came in the right amount, taste good too. Daniel is so generous by having the house guide to give us a quick explanation about Cheong Fatt Tze Mansion history for free. What could I ask for more?Show less
Restaurant: Indigo Restaurant at The Blue Mansion

Author: travelhappy2010
Title: Gorgeous lunch is a great setting
Review: Went for lunch & had the set menu for the amazing price of MYR 65.......great food & service is the beautiful blue mansion
Restaurant: Indigo Restaurant at The Blue Mansion

Author: joshua_narendran
Title: Excellent experience
Review: Had a very good experience lunching there. Food was great especially the beef dish. Service was very professional too.
Restaurant: Indigo Restaurant at The Blue Mansion

Author: carlos222222Singapore, Singapore
Title: Ambience and great food
Review: We just walked in for lunch while we were trying to see the Blue Mansion. The bed possible experience. Beautiful high ceiling atmospheric dining room with beautiful modern touches. Very nice, discreet and attentive service. And the food, I would call it contemporary western with twists from the local cuisine and ingredients. Fabulous!!!. Great value and well worth visitingShow less
Restaurant: Indigo Restaurant at The Blue Mansion

Author: Amy F
Title: Delicious Food, Beautiful Setting
Review: We stopped here for lunch when going through Georgetown and then food was delicious and so well presented. I highly recommend it!
Restaurant: Indigo Restaurant at The Blue Mansion

Author: doris l
Title: Most Beautiful Mansion on Hakka Millionaire Row
Review: "Best restaurant to impress a date or new client."Indigo is impeccable with attention service and delicious meals curated by Chef Weng.I have been to Indigo twice. First outing was set lunch date with my girlfriends. A few weeks later I returned for a Chinese New Year reunion Yee Sang dinner. On both occasions the food was perfectly seasoned and delicious.For lunch, I had the crispy skin salmon with beautiful potato croquettes. I enjoyed the addictive potato croquettes and wished I could order a basket of these as a starter. For dinner, my main dish was seared duck. It was served crispy skin with pink succulent meat. Perfectly cooked, and not gamey at all. I ate this slowly with the buttery delicate foie gras to enjoy the texture. Each dish is so well executed that I remember the taste even weeks later.For desserts, Chef Weng has a way of creating impact by turning his final presentation into a conversation piece.The Green Tea ice cream with a hint of bitter is a dream come true for Matcha fans. The dessert has different interesting textures and is not sweet. The thin crepe looks like snow skin moon cake, soft, tender filled with red beans.An absolute delight! I can't wait to try the new menu!Show less
Restaurant: Indigo Restaurant at The Blue Mansion

Author: sherreenl1
Title: Exceeded all expectations
Review: In the street food paradise that is Penang, Indigo at the Cheong Fatt Tze Blue Mansion is a bit of an outlier - but a very, very good one. We booked in for a late lunch and decided to try the 5-course tasting menu. Each course was cooked and plated to perfection - from the 'balik smoked salmon' appetiser, pan seared red snapper, lamb loin to the chocolate gateau with cherries - it was hard to pick a favourite! We rolled out of the beautiful first floor restaurant and back to our rooms very satisfied. Service was on point without being overbearing - a big plus point for me. I couldn't recommend this spot any more to mansion guests, Penangites and tourists alike. Where fine dining in Penang is concerned, I feel Chef Weng sets the bar high in Penang - Indigo is perfect for that date nigh or special occassion.Show less
Restaurant: Indigo Restaurant at The Blue Mansion

Author: SlsiawGeorge Town, Malaysia
Title: Excellent service with gorgeous ambience
Review: Indigo restaurant was a perfect setting for Chinese New Year dinner. We were there with some friends for dinner over CNY and was pleasantly surprised with a lovely 4 course dinner in a most charming yet elegant setting. Portion of Yee sang was a bit small unlike the usual yee sang that we were a custom to tossing as it was served on individual dish for each person. Braised sea cucumber was lovely as was the chicken dish and dessert. Service was very attentive. We had a wonderful time there as it was nice to have Chinese New Year dinner slightly fusion, interesting visually and not rushed as one would be in most Chinese restaurant.Show less
Restaurant: Indigo Restaurant at The Blue Mansion

Author: marokins
Title: Checks all the boxes: Great food, service and ambience
Review: My husband and I were staying over at The Blue Mansion so we decided to have one of our dinners here at Indigo - located at the second floor and apparently recently renovated. The restaurant is furnished beautifully and in keeping with the rest of the mansion.We ordered the Kimchi Clam Soup, Black Angus, Chicken Roulade, and for dessert, the Chocolate Gateau. Everything was wonderful -- the flavors and portions were done perfectly. The menu is quite slim: for dinner, there were only six or so Mains on offer -- but I got the impression that it's a well curated menu featuring only what the chef / resto can do well / best. The staff was also very attentive and efficient.All in all a great experience. Definitely among the best in fine dining in Penang. Show less
Restaurant: Indigo Restaurant at The Blue Mansion

Author: Amanda CHong Kong, China
Title: Excellent service!
Review: We went to this place with our grandma who's over 80 years old during Chinese New Year for dinner. When I made the reservation, I overlooked that it's on the first floor of the building (and no elevator).It was impossible for grandma to walk up the stairs and at first we thought maybe we could just order some food from downstairs and eat there. Daniel, who was the manager there, was so wonderful to offer to let his staffs to carry grandma upstairs (with grandma sitting comfortably in a chair). There were 34 flights of the stairs, so not easy at all! Before each trip, Daniel would explain to grandma what they were gonna do and I think that's very sweet of him.Thank you so much Daniel and his wonderful team! This is the kind of customer service that I haven't seen in a long while.Show less
Restaurant: Indigo Restaurant at The Blue Mansion

Author: ellycmc7Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Ambience and yummy food
Review: We love the setting. It was cozy and well thought out. The food selection for dinner was a bit too little but good in variety. We had the steak, pasta, risotto and fish. All were so good. There is also set lunch available. Will be back.Show less
Restaurant: Indigo Restaurant at The Blue Mansion

Author: SawE23
Title: Fabulous Food In A Nice Ambience
Review: The newly refurbished restaurant is nicely decorated and adorned by hanging lanterns exude an elegance feel. I had dinner last week and the food by the skillful chef is simply fabulous and service is impeccable. It is a must try if you are stay in Penang. Do visit Indigo at the Blue Mansion, one of grandest Mansion in the World, accorded by Lonely Planet.Show less
Restaurant: Indigo Restaurant at The Blue Mansion

Author: Sxnflower_Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Mouth watering food in an absolutely gorgeous setting
Review: The indigo restaurant at the Blue Mansion offers a variety of different cuisines cooked to absolute perfection. The Blue Mansion itself is a picturesque treasure chest of historical beauty, boasting beautiful fine dining as well as an insight into Chinese heritage. The restaurant is a spacious room, clad with beautiful art and features a cost terrace to accommodate the option for outdoor eating. The staff are all incredibly friendly and welcoming, quick to satisfy any requests you may have. The atmosphere of the restaurant is one of romance, from entering the restaurant, you are made to feel truly comfortable with everything you need to enjoy the company you are dining with.The food is some of the best I have had in my years of travelling. The wagyu beef instantly melts in your mouth, being my particular favorite of the three course meal. The presentation is artistic at best, leaving a feeling of resentment for eating something that is so visually beautiful. There is a great variety on the menu, each dish offering a different spin on a particular cuisine. The portion sizes are of decent size, allowing you to taste every course before becoming too filled. Overall if you are in Penang, I believe the Indigo restaurant is a must try and will leave you feeling saddened that you are too full to try every dish on the menu.Show less
Restaurant: Indigo Restaurant at The Blue Mansion

Author: AlphablackNewcastle, UK
Title: Superb setting, average food
Review: I'd love to rate this more highly, as the Blue Mansion and the Indigo dining room in particular are spectacular and superb. You can have a drink on the balcony, and dine in splendid surroundings. The staff are lovely and the service is good. However, I can't, because the food was not up the the same standard really. The squid and prawn salad was tasty (we both had it), but the choice was slightly limited otherwise for such fine dining place. The main of duck breast was OK, but not accompanied by much, a very small serving of pureed mash and the greens were bland. My chicken was fine, but same comments for the bok choi. The rice was tasty but no sauce, so again dry. To end on a good note, the wine selection is very reasonable and of good quality.Come on Indigo, you can do better and deliver the goods in this foodie city heaven!Show less
Restaurant: Indigo Restaurant at The Blue Mansion

Author: Asiadvisor001
Title: contemporary asian
Review: Penang is known for its street food... if you look for more sophisticated cuisine, Indigo is a great choice... and the Chef is happy to cook outside the menu.
Restaurant: Indigo Restaurant at The Blue Mansion

Author: AllenTanPGHong Kong, China
Title: The Perfect Venue...
Review: From the moment you step through the traditional Chinese arched gateway, over the granite threshold, into the grand main hallway, around the gold leaf screen doors into the courtyard, up the beautifully crafted timber staircase into the main dining room on the first floor, the experience offered by Indigo is at once sublime and full of surprises. It is, simply, the perfect venue whether you are planning a quiet evening for two or, as we were, a banquet for twelve. The Captain / Maitre d is extremely attentive and very professional and you can tell that she is slowly whipping the staff into shape one serving at a time. The food is, in two words, sublime & creative, combining elements of traditional Eastern influences with modern western techniques. The result, delicious. The recent renovations to the main dining hall on the first floor are tasteful and bold without being overbearing and kitsch. Truly, The Perfect Venue. Show less
Restaurant: Indigo Restaurant at The Blue Mansion

Author: ksarmanYangon (Rangoon), Myanmar
Title: first dinner in Penang
Review: after my first afternoon in Georgetown i cam back to my Cheoung Fatt Ze s room!i was delighted to discover the Indigo Restaurant in housei was so Hungrythe food was really good even if the gnocchi was little bit too saltythe russian urchin was superband the Valrohna crepe good but not enough cookedthe dinner room is beautiful as the house, i feel so peaceful and the restaurant team is really professional and nicei did not discover many places in penang but the Indigo ll be my place in case of emergency !!!!there is a nice balcony for take aperitif or tea!Show less
Restaurant: Indigo Restaurant at The Blue Mansion

Author: shutter51Sydney, N.S.W.
Title: Beautiful setting and wonderful food
Review: Staying at Cheong Fatt Tze Mansion I decided to eat at their restaurant. There is a balcony overlooking the front of the hotel where diners can have a pre-dinner drink. The room is a fabulous combination of maintenance of the traditional features with wonderful modern touches. The amazing light fittings are a fine example of this. I had the scallops which were a fabulous entree, the lamb cutlets which were cooked exactly to medium rare as requested and jasmine tea pudding for dessert. While the cab Merlot was fine it was disappointing there were only two wines by the glass, Probably because there are only 18 rooms but I would have loved a glass of bubbly.Show less
Restaurant: Indigo Restaurant at The Blue Mansion

Author: Roman KHong Kong
Title: Best dinner during our trip!
Review: Don't miss this gorgeous venue, offering good food and excellent service! Can highly recommend the rack of lamb and lobster pasta, both a nice change from the traditional local fare, which is also very nice, but always good to have a change after a few days. Show less
Restaurant: Indigo Restaurant at The Blue Mansion

Author: GypsyMalayBBatu Ferringhi, Malaysia
Title: heritage decor, but we also would want proper food...
Review: do not go if you are really hungry ....We ordered few dishes, they look awesome - pretty decorated and unsual items and the taste is overal really okay, but looking at price/quality and considering this is Penang..... is is sad.The quality was fine, except for the beef, service however very friendly is very unexperienced, and it is not their first week of opening..... We ordered two the same beef dishes, one of the more expensive items on the menu. Author: Ellsy BPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Could have been a 4 star rating or more, but......
Review: Lagenda means legend in English. A tribute to a well loved Malaysian legendary artiste, P Ramlee. His movies are classics, his deep voice melts a thousand dames and his songs are all-time favourites. This cafe? When I first discovered this cafe a few years back, at Campbell Street, I said I must introduce it to my family and friends. The Malay food was tantalising, awesome. The man who served us was polite and courteous. Still remember it like yesterday. So, naturally I was excited when I chance on it recently when I was at Chulia Street. The new cafe is on a street perpendicular to Chulia Street, oppostie Mugshot Cafe. However, my 2nd visit was rather a letdown. The western offering was so -so, understandably to cater to tourists or children who cant take rich spicy foods. The banana split that my kiddo ordered has some surprises. They added cutlets of watermelon to it! Sorry, banana, ice cream, watermelon and something else ( can't remember) just didnt go well with us. I ordered what they are good at - Malay dishes and I was not disappointed there. Interesting presentation. The main dish came together with an array of Malay 'appetisers", served on a congkak and chinese altar tea cups! Very interesting! The cafe has a pleasant ambience and setting to it. Sadly, what's missing is a sweet welcoming hospitality and smiles! The people who work there look uptight, not willing to smile even when we were courteous towards them. Ratings just tumble because of that. It is very competitive out there. Without the hospitality, the friendliness and smiles, I wonder what's up their sleeves to keep patrons coming back. Will I return? Nope. Nope. Which is sad, cos I really like the nostalgic feel of P Ramlee and his old, charming songs.Show less

Author: Adrian_on_TAPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Traditional Malay cooking at Lagenda Café in the heart of George Town
Review: True to its name, Lagenda Café offers a host of legendary Malay cuisines as well as some Oriental and Western-fusion dishes. I usually go straight for the main course and skip the appetisers as the main dishes are hearty and I like to keep some room for the yummy desserts. The local favourites are surely top on my recommended list. Here are three fulfilling chicken dishes I would relish – ayam percik madu tiga, belalang chicken rendang and ayam penyet Nusantara. Three brilliant ways of cooking chicken, each with its own distinct flavours. Ayam percik madu tiga is my daughter's favourite dish at this café. The smoky flavour of the aromatic grilled chicken marinated with savoury peanut sauce has won her heart over. This dish is served with turmeric rice, jelatah (pickled vegetables), kerabu tauge (bean sprouts salad) and crackers. The belalangs chicken rendang is also very good. The thick fragrant curry owing to the generous use of coconut milk hugely complements the tender chicken and ulam (fresh greens such as winged beans) that accompanied this dish. On the congkak board of goodies you have something green, something spicy, something sour and something crispy – all enjoyed with a serving of warm blue rice. If you enjoy crispy fried chicken, go for the ayam penyet Nusantara. Chicken marinated with herbs and spices is deep-fried and served with blue-coloured rice, clear soup spiced with jintan (anise) and fried shallots, crackers and a lovely congkak board of ulam.The prawn lemak with pineapple is a rice set complete with a congkak-board of condiments (such as winged beans, pickled cucumber, kerabu omelette and sambal). Rice dyed blue with butterfly-pea flowers is wrapped in banana leaf to keep it moist and warm. Beautifully presented, the star of this dish, prawns are cooked in a typical Malay masak lemak fashion of coconut milk and turmeric. The creamy curry is sweetened with ripened pineapples, adding more depth to the flavours.As for desserts, panna cotta seri muka is a must-try item. The pandan-flavored custard is served with a drizzle of strawberry sauce. Please remind the waiter to serve the sauce on the side or to drizzle less if you prefer the level of sweetness to be reduced. Meanwhile on the side of this dessert are two scoops of blood-red glutinous rice. The sago do re mi (named after P. Ramlee's popular classic, Laksamana Do Re Mi) – three scoops of coloured sago pearls smothered with rich coconut cream and topped with fragrant palm sugar syrup – is a delicious treat. The banana bakar – grilled bananas topped with freshly grated coconut, brown sugar and a scoop of vanilla ice cream – is my favourite dessert. The combination of flavours and texture are so simple yet brilliant. Relish this to complete a satisfying meal here.Lagenda Café pays homage to Malaysia’s iconic musician P. Ramlee. You would notice some of the menu items are named after his famous works. The warm, cosy interior with an eclectic mix of furniture and paintings makes this a simply affordable café and a wonderful place to enjoy a meal or even drinks. The friendly staffs have always made my visit pleasant and memorable. If you are touring George Town and would like to take a break and escape the tropical heat, Lagenda Café is an ideal choice. The café offers an extensive beverage list complete with fresh juices to mocktails and refreshing local delights. As you sip your drinks, take joy in P. Ramlee's melodious tunes that would effortlessly soothe your mind and soul.Show less

Author: kirkp613Singapore, Singapore
Title: Delightful
Review: I went with a friend for a casual dinner. We had a chicken rendang and stingray, the food was tasty and presented very nicely. We couldn't resist trying some desserts, including a sago dessert (new to me) which to my surprise was absolutely delicious. Would recommend.Show less

Author: myra_sany
Title: Hidden gem
Review: Went there for dinner with some friends.I was impressed with the decoration.The The place is cozy and sophisticated ,with all the decoration. The food was truly excellent with authentic flavors, yet innovative, and beautifully presented.Love to visit again during my Penang trip

Author: ChicoY81
Title: Really nice food
Review: We were with 3 adults and and 2 young kids. Ordered several dishes: Gado Gado, fish & chips, nasi sate etc. All dishes were really good in their own taste, would recommend it to other people.

Author: farmerchris2018George Town, Malaysia
Title: Mr
Review: Excellent food, tasty and delicious and tastefully presented! Wonderful friendly and attentive staff, smiles all around! We were recommended to go there by Michael the owner of Sam’s Batik House in George Town but we couldn’t find it last night so we were delighted to find it tonight! Lovely; thank you!!Show less

Author: Nor Shakinar H
Title: Excellence food & Service
Review: We been here 2years ago during a new opening of this cafe which turned up to be a very good decision the food was fantastic during our recent visit we stumble to the cafe and eat our favourite beef rendang and grilled fish they never failed to blown us away with the taste and attention to details from the taste and presentation. The service is top notch. We are glad that we return. Lagenda will always be our favourite cafe in Penang. kudos to the team. Show less

Author: Ali9111
Title: Fine but nothing special
Review: My wife and I had two different chicken dishes, here’s was fine and it tasted good, but my chicken wasn’t cooked properly and even when I told the waiter she made sure a new one was made for me, but the new one wasn’t cooked either. So I chose to eat the rice with the small salads(which were very nice). So the chicken wasn’t good enough for me. Starter was chicken satay which was nice but not as good as in Kuala Lumpur. But one thing is sure, the waiters were very nice and helpful for us, and the waitress made sure that we had lemon water in all times. :) Show less

Author: Mohd Khairul An... M
Title: Dinner Date
Review: I love the cosy and romantic ambiance set up. I have made earlier reservation on my plan dinner. Thanks to all the staff for accomodating with my request. Excellent

Author: FadinaR1
Title: GREAT PLACE
Review: The food was amazing, and we enjoyed perfect wait service from Robert. Portion sizes is big and price are very reasonable and value for money and what we get. We especially love the gado gado. So uniquely present and authentic

Author: Flyer797001
Title: Recommended
Review: Thank you so much for taking such wonderful care of our staff during our visit to the Penang. You and your staff were so very accommodating. The food at your cafe was always delicious!

Author: denadae3
Title: Must try 👍🏻
Review: Had dinner here while on the island visiting family and friends. The servers are just wonderful. The food is authentic. A must try Cafe when you in Penang!

Author: nitimita
Title: An option for a special meal
Review: Expensive but beautiful decorated food and drink. Can be a place for special meal. They have enough choices for you to try fusion, local foods and mocktel. Friendly staff, nice music but lound. The internet is lagging. Pretty comfortable seats.

Author: DianeJ1396Penang Island, Malaysia
Title: Marvelous .........
Review: Lagenda was a great surprise experience for my cousins from Australia. The quoted they have never tasted such fantastic food so fusion and remarkable. When ever my cousins and friends come down from anyway around the world Lagenda will be the first place to bring them to experience the traditional food of Malaysia. I love the dishes names. They always come up with such unique names.Two thumbs up .. Their staff there all are very friendly especially Robert and the other Philippine girl. Both of them are very attentive. Robert always makes my booking. He is very helpful. Note when u order their dishes like the ones where they have condiments it comes in a congkak its really cool and something different.Show less

Author: jacqqqNCL / KUL
Title: Agree - Twas Underwhelming
Review: We wanted something, ummm, “trendier” than the street food we indulged in for our last nite in Penang. Actually, we set our sight (and palette) on a real decent nyonya place. Regretfully, it was a Monday and almost Our shortlisted nyonya restaurants were closed for the day. That pushed us to readjust our plans.Relying on the ever trusted TripAdvisor, we settled on Lagenda.Nice enough setting. Love the decor.Sad to say though that the food was pretty forgettable. In fact, I can’t remember for the like of me what we ordered. Ahhhhhh .... Wait .... Found the receipt ! Ikan bakar and ayam penyet. If this is your maiden trip to Penang and you’re on your first day, Lagenda is a good intro to the delights in Penang. Truth is there is better food to be had elsewhere.Show less

Author: Ladini JChicago, Illinois
Title: Underwhelmed dinner experience
Review: I was excited to see that this was a top 10 restaurant on trip advisor for Penang but I was skeptical because there were only 200 reviews and Penang is such a foodie haven. Anyway, the place was clean and cool in temperature. Staff was friendly when they actually came to the table (we were often left alone for long stints). The food was beautifully plated but tasted meh. The chicken carbonara was good but dripping in heavy cream. The Ayam Percik Madi Tiga was lackluster... had no flavor. Overall I think if you skipped this place you’d be fine. Show less

Author: TimskuUtrecht, The Netherlands
Title: Good food!
Review: I really recommend this place. The establishment looked very nice and clean from the inside. The staff was also really friendly. Most importantly the food tasted good and was beautifully prepared. The only downside was that it took really long to prepare our food. But overall a really nice experience!Also, dont order the gado gado as a side dish for two persons, it is way to big for that haha. Show less

Author: BKK111bangkok
Title: i hope you're not slipping
Review: Visiting Lagenda has become something we do on every trip to Penang and we have always loved it. However on this trip our food was not hot. Given that we both ordered chicken dishes which if not fresh and hot enough can pose health risks, we informed the staff. We received an apology and they said they'd let the kitchen know. I also let the owners know through Facebook but didn't receive any response which makes me think they're not taking this seriously. Whether or not we return is something we'll decide on when we go to Penang next time but i think it's worth informing people to be aware of this issueShow less

Author: jamestpendletomLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Great food in a cool and trendy restaurant
Review: Visited Lagenda cafe on a Wednesday afternoon at about 5.30pm with family (3 adults , 2 children). On entry we found the restaurant very nicely decorated and air conditioned. It was great just to sit in the cool and trendy atmosphere of the cafe. We ordered variety of smoothies and fresh juices which arrived promptly and were very refreshing. We continued by ordering some of the fusion starters and local specialities as main. The food came quickly and was good sized portions. The taste was excellent and also looked great.The only let down of the cafe was the toilet, which was not as clean as I would have expected.In summary, great food, great service, great atmosphere in a cool and relaxed environment. Show less

Author: 184brookem
Title: Legenda Cafè
Review: Our food was very nice and the service was friendly and quick. I would recommend this family friendly cafe and restaurant to everyone.

Author: ZoeM1896
Title: Good food & good service
Review: Nasi goreng and Chicken rendang dishes were both very good. Good service which was also quite fast. Would recommend it.

Author: U058542New York City, New York
Title: Complaint
Review: Food very tasty, but it was my last day in Malaysia and I was living on my Mastercard, very low on cash. Sign on the front door and next to cash register said clearly that Mastercard/Visa were accepted. Only when I came to pay the bill was I told “there is a 50 Ringgit” minimum, and I was a “solo” diner. Lagenda Cafe should know that setting a minimum transaction amount on a Visa or Mastercard is strictly ILLEGAL outside the US, where a $10 minimum transaction has been legal, but only since 2010. It’s a reportable offense. I JUST barely had enough cash to pay my bill but I left very unhappily. If you want to continue this illegal practice, post a sign, ok?Show less

Author: 253neham
Title: good food, moderately priced
Review: We visited the place for lunch and ordered chicken satay, I had prawn lemak pineapple and my husband had Ayam percik madu tiga. both the dishes are served congkak platters which basically has crackers and some sambal, and pickled onion and tomatoes. We loved absolutely everything we ate and would highly recommend the cafe. The staff was polite and served well.Show less

Author: greggh438Manchester, United Kingdom
Title: Amazing food!
Review: Went here as it was rated number 3 on here out of all the restaurants in Penang and it really did not disappoint! Beautiful food. I opted for pasta which came with loads of delicious Asian spices (think pasta with an Asian twist) and my friend had one of the vegetarian curries! Absolutely incredible. So good that we went back 2 nights laterShow less

Author: MarcWain
Title: Absoloutly Fabulous
Review: What a find - on our last night a little street cafe that serves the most incredible food. The service was impeccable and incredibly great value.

Author: holidayman6868gold coast, australia
Title: Awesome food and great service could not ask for more
Review: This was a perfect visit to Malay restaurant. The reviews said good things but there were a few doubts about the food choices. These doubts were quashed as soon as I looked at the menu. We got in before the rush time without a booking. We were greeted and seated promptly. We ordered our non alcoholic drinks which came out pretty quickly they were incredibly delicious. Then we ordered as many Malay dishes as we could. The meals arrived very fast they were beautiful to look at and great portion sizes. The food was so delicious some of the best food we had in Penang which is hard to believe as all food in Penang is amazing. My family had an awesome night full of fun laughs and great food. Show less

Author: ridzuanfakiri
Title: Lunch date for my wife birthday
Review: Good food,good service,great space. Call and make reservation. Ask help from Lagenda Cafe team to prepare some decoration for my wife birthday celebration. The team prepare a sweet deco,with fresh flowers and balloons with fare charge. Will come again.

Author: Adair_and_ThandoNew York City, New York
Title: A fine dining experience without burning a hole in your pocket
Review: We cannot praise this place enough: the service was impeccable, the decor chic and eccentric, and the food... YUMMY! We loved the side dishes that came with our entree, they were a great bonus surprise!It’s good for getting Malaysian food and is easily accessible to people who may not be familiar with the dishes.Show less

Author: akorea
Title: Good food in a nice place
Review: Food was good and tasty. Nasi goreng and rendang chicken. Banana dessert as well. Very well located in downtown. Service was friendly. Price was ok, not super cheap thou. Food timing could be improved.

Author: sarahrJ29CNBang Kruai, Thailand
Title: These guys are doing it right!
Review: Great food, fast service, friendly staff, fast wifi, air con, and a decent music playlist.I came here for a late-afternoon snack. The menu was comprehensive, with a general Malay influence.Portions were generous, certainly filling enough without ruining my dinner appetite.The mocktails were calling to me but I couldn't decide, and the lovely waitress helped me pick what turned out to be a delicious option.Thanks guys, I certainly left happy :)Show less

Author: SsuTianC
Title: Some amazing, one-of-a-kind dishes!
Review: The specialty Pineapple Prawn Lemak dish is one of the best things I've ever tasted, while the Grilled Seabass and Grilled Salmon were so fresh and tasty alongside buttered vegetables. Fresh fruit juices quite delightful. The staff were also polite, friendly and helpful. Love the décor. Highly recommended especially on the mentioned dishes.Show less

Author: demalayboiPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: A good restaurant to represent local foods
Review: The restaurant served a variety menus of local foods & some western. Highly recommended to tourist or foreigners who would like to experince local foods. They served plenty of rice dish menus (which is our local specialty), including appetizer and desserts etc.The menu I ordered during my visit here are the Nasi Goreng Bujang Lapok (fried rice) & Banana Bakar; I would say the taste are on spot.The pricing can be consider average; not cheap or too expensive. The meal cost me RM40++ including drinks.Overall, I’m satisfied with their service and food that they offer. I will come back here again for more.Show less

Author: Steve W
Title: Something different
Review: This lives up to its billing. Small restaurant serving interesting Malaysian fusion dishes.Appetisers are quite generous with the stuffed tofu a real treat. One between two might be enough for some.The range and imagination of the mains is substantial. Choose anything would be my advice. Good selection of juices and mocktails. No alcohol served.One of our best Malaysian meals.Show less

Author: Mahendra FColombo, Sri Lanka
Title: Didn't serve us saying kitchen was closed
Review: We walked all the way here as their opening times on Trip Advisor and Google Maps said 11 pm. We got there around 10:20 pm and they refused to serve us saying the kitchen was already closed. Suggest amending their opening times to 10:30 to avoid confusion.Show less

Author: barryg973Bophut, Thailand
Title: Very Good food and good prices
Review: Visited while on a stopover in chulia only 2 mins walk from here. Had the chocken chop with mushroom sauce. Chicken was cooked well and sauce was very tasty and creamy. This plus fresh orange juice was around 30 ringit which i think is good valueShow less

Author: stef_nsy
Title: For the food, for the environment, for the passion
Review: Food is ok, you can feel their respect and passion on the food they served from the presentation of the food. Nice environment. The price is not low, but is matching with the food and environment. Overall it is an enjoyable dinner.

Author: 800joewKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Great place
Review: This is the second time I have visited the cafe over the last few months and again, it did not fail. Great friendly staff witha fantastic drinks menu and snacks. Really recommend going here if you want to take the weight off your feet and get a good drinkShow less

Author: Suzie L
Title: Lovely cafe: friendly service and tasty appetizers
Review: We ended up stopping here to escape a late afternoon rain shower and I’m really glad we did. The booths/tables were comfy, the appetizers delicious (veggie friendly which is always a plus) and the staff were very welcoming and friendly. Cracking stuff.

Author: 771ashleighHebden Bridge, United Kingdom
Title: Lovely atmosphere and brilliant food
Review: My partner and I visited Lagenda Cafe on our last night in Georgetown and were not disappointed - the food was brilliant, with a mix of local and fusion food, and the atmosphere was friendly and comfortable, with brilliant service. We tried the chicken satay and the fried tofu to start with, and the Nasi Goreng and the chicken massaman with spaghetti (a fusion dish) for main course, and would highly recommend all of the dishes. The total bill, along with a non alcoholic drink each, came to 96 ringgit. I’d recommend trying the nutmeg juice if you haven’t already! Show less

Author: RogerfculpinPortishead, United Kingdom
Title: Great place to eat in central Georgetown
Review: We ate here on our first night in Georgetown as it was close to our hotel. We had not looked at reviews or ratings. What a great find and culinary introduction to Malaysian food.We had fritters fried and satay chicken to start. Then salmon fillet and chicken rending. All were just delicious and portions were generous. Service was excellent and the ambience good too. The lack of alcohol was no problem at all. The bill came to 86 myr which we felt was good value for money. We will eat here again before we leave.Show less

Author: MilijanaZEdegem, Belgium
Title: Nice and cosy restaurant
Review: We came here as we saw that this restaurant was number one on TripAdvisor. Both the food and service were really good. The food was served in a very nice and colourful way. We had absolutely no remarks on the quality and serving of the food.Reason why we rate it 4 stars is that, probably, you can find the same quality of food in other places in Penang for the same or even lower price. Show less

Author: MOREL DBrighton,UK
Title: Absolutely the place to eat in George Town!
Review: There's a very good reason why the Lagenda Cafe has a certificate of Excellence. It's more than the name sounds and serves excellent meals through the day into the evening. The authentic Malaysian food is served imaginatively and you can't fault the portions.Keep in mind that the restaurant does not serve alcohol, but that no hardship and more than made up by the excellent food and serviceShow less

Author: PaulaP456
Title: Great food
Review: Really amazing traditional Malay food. Very affordable. Clean. Friendly staff. Overall a wonderful experience

Author: 275lizzm
Title: Excellent food, fast of Malaysia
Review: Really great fusion food. Staff were friendly and helpful. Delicious smoothies and the banana Baker was especially delicious.

Author: 621juditt
Title: The best cold drinks
Review: They have a good kitchen, very kind staff, good prices, nice desig and some good tables also on the street under the arcade. I liked so much to seat there with a good cold drink!

Author: Howard BToronto, Canada
Title: Surpise
Review: I have not seen reviews or recommendations for Lagenda anywhere so I approached with trepidation. In fact I was blown away by the quality of the food and the service. The menu seems different from most in Georgetown and is more of a Malaysian fusion but the results are well worth trying.Show less

Author: 800joew
Title: Great food
Review: Booked into Lagenda house and decided to eat at the café for my first meal in Georgetown. It was fantastic! I ordered the nasi gorang and a ice blended latte. Both were really tasty and I will eat here again.

Author: AzOthmanBern, Switzerland
Title: "A Legend"
Review: We went to Lagenda Cafe at least 10 times already and it never failed us! The food always super delicious. Wait staff always very friendly and excellent in taking the orders.The ambiance is calm with nice music from the past and welcoming. Went there with very critical food lovers (my aunties) and also Chef's. They were all impress with the food and service. Lagenda Cafe my favorite diner for Malaysian/ Indonesian cuisine.Show less

Author: mndyky
Title: Family get together dinner
Review: Great food and service were awesome 👏🏻 The only minus point is the location, difficult to find parking space.

Author: 102glync
Title: Great presentation good food n drink
Review: Great presentation good food ok pricing.Had chicken rendang not as good as laksalicious but nice meal and environment

Author: Nomad_AAADubai, United Arab Emirates
Title: Fantastic meal
Review: I had the beef randang for dinner here in January 2018. It was a superb meal and wish I had more time and days to come back and try other meals as well. The restaurant ambience was nice and the place was clean. The staff were also quite friendly too. Would eat here again for sure.Show less

Author: LiJames77Sanya, China
Title: Different class
Review: We've had lots of different dining experiences since arriving in George Town but this one was utterly different class. The restaurant itself is absolutely beautiful, with carefully chosen artwork, a wall mural and galleried dining above, candles on the tables - it is all done to promote an intimate setting which seems rare around these parts.The food and drink is lovingly prepared, that much is obvious, our chosen dishes of the local broth with chicken/prawn (the long name escapes me) and beef rendang were spicy in a balanced and pleasant way while the mocktails were works of art. The grilled banana dessert was out of this world.Basically, this is the ideal restaurant for your 'final night of your vacation'. Then you'll wish you'd come here every night!Show less

Author: gloriap252
Title: Malay food in a romantic setting
Review: The restaurant is offering a wide choice of Malaysian and western food, with good presentation and nice taste. Location is central, in a animated and popular street.

Author: ruperrobertoaRupit, Spain
Title: Probably one of the best in town
Review: I went with my girfriend to dinner last night and we choosed the same dish. A tumeric soup with coconut milk, tofu, tempe, beans and vegetables. Probably the best vegetarian dish we tasted in a while. The local was very clean and the waiters were so kind. Show less

Author: Joanne M
Title: Fabulous
Review: Had a great lunch here, would totally recommend.  Beautiful tasty food, very polite friendly staff loved it

Author: judee t
Title: 5 stars
Review:
Went there upon recommendation from a friend back home and reviews from Tripadvisor. It truly lives up to its theme,the legend of malay actor P.Ramlee. 
Tasty food. Nice presentation. Good,relaxed ambience. Polite staff. Worth the money.

Author: BKK111bangkok
Title: superb
Review: we couldn't wait to come back to Lagenda after our first great visit a few months ago. The food is fantastic. Presentation is a work of art, obviously prepared by someone who loves their job! Portion sizes are large and prices are excellent value for what you get. We particularly enjoyed the gado gado. I can't complete a review without mentioning the lovely staff, polite, friendly and attentive. There's nothing negative to say about Lagenda.... don't miss this restaurantShow less

Author: Judith MBolton, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent service and food
Review: We were newly in Georgetown, tired and looking for an evening meal. We were about to give up looking for somewhere that looked appealing when we found Lagenda. We were warmly welcomed, made comfortable and beautifully served with super food. We returned 2 nights later and it was just as good. We highly recommend you try it. And tty the nutmeg juice too. Delicious!Show less

Author: thetraveler2829
Title: Tasty dishes and excellent service
Review:
We were there for lunch. We had the satay and rice set. Simply amazing!
Service was attentive and quick.
Will come back again.

Author: Aidi H
Title: P Ramlie themed is the best!!
Review: The food was nice, plus the looks of the restaurant is beautiful!! We just knew it is an hotel up stairs so we take a look and it is gorgeous!!

Author: IllianaAziz
Title: Special as their name..
Review: Thisis our 2nd visit here, i noticed some changes in their menu, more variety. Their food quality great as usual. Love their smooth silky Tauhu Sumbat which crispy outside. Unique food presentation, Nasi Goreng Bujang served in dulang, while nasi with grilled fish wrapped in banana leaves and ulams were served in Congkak (traditional Malay games). Show less

Author: 236IanCUnited Kingdom
Title: Inexplicably quiet...
Review: Having read the reviews and walked past during the day, we decided upon the restaurant in advance and arrived around 20:15 on a Sunday eve. It turned out we were the only people there except for the staff, which was baffling as the food was superb. Not cheap compared to some local places, but still as cheap as chips compared to the UK and well worth the money. Delicious... Show less

Author: lpy912
Title: Malay cuisine with a twist
Review: I ordered the ikan bakar which is cooked to perfection.The most interesting part of the dining experience is that they will serve side dishes using Congkak which is a traditional Malay game.

Author: Bella_P8621
Title: Yummy food
Review: Sumptuous food.. love the food presentation...A nice place to hang out too.. hotel can be found right behind the cafe.. highly recommended!

Author: beepique
Title: Two tumbs up!!
Review: Great ambiance, great atmosphere, delicious food, great service, but the price is above the average. So if you're looking for cheap food go to another place. But if you want to have a delicate lunch come to this place. They have many variant menu from western, Asia, fusion, dessert. Try their satay and their salmon, so fresh and yummie. I love how they decorate the table with batik cover.Show less

Author: MuhamadLudfi
Title: A Halal Cafe after a hundred non halal surrounding it.
Review:
Have a lot of Menu. Coning herevin the early morning. The workers is not Malaysian. But the quality of food is a Malaysian standard. Good.
Polite and profesional. I am having breakfast with Banana Bakar.
I like it...

Author: BKK111bangkok
Title: Very impressed
Review: We were invited to dinner here. When we arrived at 7pm it was quiet but before long the restaurant was busy so I'd recommend reserving in advance. It's easy to see why, the food was excellent and the presentation was clearly a big focus here. It looked and tasted amazing. If I have one slight...and it is slight...the staff could have been a bit more attentive. As regular visitors to Penang Lagenda is definitely on our list for return visitsShow less

Author: PathfinderBritt
Title: Perfect
Review: The food is delicious! They had traditional food for a good price. It's one of the best restaurants we visited in Malaysia.

Author: murnie916Penang
Title: Exquisite place and food!
Review: I come a many times especially if i want to be with my family and this is a great place for all of us to relax and it is one of my favourite lepak place.Every meal and drink come with all the detailed make it so unique and i enjoy it so far.Show less

Author: Shabaka13
Title: Very strong spices
Review: Nice homy place. Food was just right for us. Way too strong that we could not go beyond a first taste. If you are sure you love the type of food they offer, go for it. Otherwise i would say skip.

Author: sujudh2016
Title: Yummy!
Review: This cafe is so uniqe ... beautiful old building with awesome interior! The best thing is the foods, it's truly Indonesian cuisine ... so tasty!

Author: honeylampard86Shah Alam, Malaysia
Title: Delicious food with lovely ambiance!
Review: Cafe Lagenda is housed within one of the old shops along Campbell Street. It has an interesting menu that features traditional Malay-Indonesian cuisine or Western-Fusion dishes with a touch of Oriental. Delicious food and lovely ambiance. Recommend the Prawn Lemak Pineapple with congkak side dishes is super duper yummy!Show less

Author: DFH-Manager
Title: Nice atmosphere and good food
Review:
Went there twice due to a good offer and pleasant staff.
Food was presented very nicely and taste was good.
However, the drinks were not as expected and could improve.

Author: pippyboomboom
Title: Delicious meal
Review:
Would highly recommend, we were impressed  by this fusion restaurant.  Friendly staff and very tasty meals.
It seems like a hot spot as it was full, but we were lucky to get the last table!

Author: kolooi
Title: Good local dishes
Review: We loved the local dishes, the fusion dishes were bold, but the chicken chop should not have been served with the gravy poured all over the dish.

Author: PhekSanOGeorge Town, Malaysia
Title: Delicious food and good music
Review: Had dinner on 31st Dec with dishes like Ayam Percik and Mee Kuah. Dessert was grilled banana with ice cream...simply heaven!Was so impressed by the dessert that we came back today for tea and had pengat and sago "do-re-mi" ....all which tasted great and didn't disappoint us. Coupled with soothing music and good service...we will certainly be back for more of everything. Extremely relaxing with good company.Show less

Author: alicessg
Title: Lunch
Review: A place which serves good food. Like the way they present the food. A nice place to eat and relax during lunch

Author: DerekFGuadalajara
Title: Expected better for our lunch
Review:
We had high expectations of Lagenda after reading other reviews; however, we were underwhelmed.
Small portions and blander dishes than expected ,left us savoring only the mint tea.
Friendly service was not enough to leave a good memory.

Author: thepaulhereKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Another cafe/restaurant in town area
Review: Visited this restaurant during noon was abit hot. The overall experience was nothing ordinary. Ordered the western food, but almost similar with those "western food cafes" in Penang. Probably wont come for 2nd time due to the food and the service charge on top of the food caused the foods to be pricey.Show less

Author: teh s
Title: Fabulous lunch
Review: We took Uber from office to this cafe. It was a breeze. Friendly staff! But our food took awhile to arrive. We were starving by then. Then the food came and we finally understood why it took so long to prepare. They were simply amazing! We had their recommended signature dishes and yes! Must try their mocktail drinks. Everything is nicely balance. The spiciness, the herbs and the sweetness - balanced very well! It made our day!!Show less

Author: unnatural2uKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Loved it
Review: Got to know this place off the net and boom we hit the right place. Arrived from a long drive from KL to Penang and we're welcomed with great food! Everything is good. For you with family, its a good choice because the menu is fusion and something for everyone especially the kids.Show less

Author: 545shanerPort Macquarie, Australia
Title: Followed the Trip Advisor Reviews!
Review: We followed reviewers recommendations and had a lovely family meal at Lagenda. The food is kind of local x western fusion which was a winner with our kids and very tasty for adults. Friendly staff, funky music and cool relaxed decor made for a nice break out of the heat. Worth a visit for something a little less traditional if you need a break from the Hawker stalls. Show less

Author: GetFoxy_com
Title: Still in my top 10
Review: Consistent and great. One of my favorites in Penang. Staff is A+.  Try the beef lasagna or the rendang or the massaman spaghetti.  Yum

Author: WeeyahnehVail, Arizona
Title: Delightful and delicious!
Review: Sometimes you run across a restaurant that does it just right. Lagenda offers that compatible blend of ambience, food presentation and quality that puts a smile on my face. I tried the Ikan Bankar Pancha Delima ... grilled seabass with blue rice. Delicious. Loved the sweet and spicy accompaniments. Very savory lemon grass soup as well. Yummy glutinous coconut rice ball in palm syrup and coconut milk for desert. The photos will speak for the cuisine! Show less

Author: justinhewettHo Chi Minh City, Vietnam
Title: Not bad, but not great...
Review: This may be faux paux to say, but sometimes Tripadvisor is not the best way to locate the best restaurants... I am writing this review right now as I sit in an Arabic restaurant that I would much rather have eaten at, that would have cost a fraction of the price...The meal we had was fine, but nothing special, especially the fact that this was our one nice meal to splurge on while we were in town. If you are looking for authentic Malaysian cuisine then just walk around and open your eyes. Using Tripadvisor here is like using Tinder in Thailand... Totally unnecessary.The cost of the meal was less important than the fact that I feel as if we squandered an opportunity for something authentic.Lastly, even though the price is "$", in Malaysian terms it is closer to a "$$$". The total bill for (2) dishes and (1) Coke was 68 MYR.Show less

Author: MichelleHarris81
Title: Excellent Food
Review: Amongst all the cafes we visited in Georgetown, Lagenda is serious about Malaysian food with a twist. The food is delicious and smartly presented. Do check out their congkak utilised for sauces, ulam and sambal. Worth the price and an ambience celebrating the late P.Ramlee.Service is top notch and deserves a five full star. Show less

Author: Kelly WAdelaide, Australia
Title: Excellent
Review: Went here for dinner. They didn't have that many vegetarian options but the waiter advised they could make a vegetarian yellow curry, which I took him up on and was so glad I did as it was absolutely delicious. My boyfriend had the salmon and he also advised this was very good. The staff were super nice and the fresh juices were also very tasty. I highly recommend this cafe!Show less

Author: NikT140
Title: It's really good
Review: Yep, the other reviews are correct - the food is really good, the staff are nice and the atmosphere is cool. Definitely worth a visit.

Author: Kev M
Title: Tasty food and great drinks!
Review: We had a lovely meal at this restaurant. Both the Chicken Rendang and the Beef Rendang were delicious, well-presented and inexpensive for the quantity and quality of food. Nice atmosphere with good music. Good choice of freshly made drinks; all of which looked delicious. We ordered the sour passionfruit ice-tea! A great place to come for a relaxing and well-priced meal. Show less

Author: GetFoxy_com
Title: Favorite in Penang
Review: Perfect mix of delicious food and reasonable prices.  Service is excellent and decor is stylish.  Awesome place you should not miss

Author: fedupi
Title: Not so vegetarian
Review:
Few choices of vegetarian dishes. 
However the staff working there is very good and friendly. Good impression. Salad they made was very good, thank you. Easy to find.

Author: 101010Jen
Title: Delicious
Review: Great food, very fresh and tasty. We had the Gado Gado which was lovely and a big portion.  Nice decor and atmosphere too.

Author: 410jorisbMiami Beach, Florida
Title: Food OK, service very slow
Review: We had dinner here while a large group was also having dinner. Unfortunately this led to extremely long waiting times for the drinks, the appetizer, the main course and the second round of drinks. There was at least 30 minutes between the main course of my wife and my main course. The food is ok, but not 5 stars good. I can image that in a regular evening this place would earn 3-4 stars. The manager came to apologize when she brought the check and gave us a discount, which almost made us feel guilty for feeling pissed of.Note: this restaurant does not serve alcoholic beverages.Show less

Author: 211selinanBatu Ferringhi, Malaysia
Title: Fantastic Malay Cuisine
Review: I enjoyed every minute at this restaurant which is housed below a boutique hotel in a pre-war shop house on Campbell Street. Decked with framed photos of the late artists, P Ramlee and Salome in its walls and batik table runners. A fantastic menu with food presentation that blows your mind away. Try this if you are in the neighborhood. Try the platter that gives you a variety of typical malay snacks. This is set to be a legend, like it's namesake. Show less

Author: EvaP1270
Title: A P Ramlee style Cafe
Review: Very nice deco and food serves up a very unique way. Everyone would enjoy eating there. I would recommend the cafe to all my local and foreign friends.

Author: domfrase
Title: Great food, great service.
Review: We went here for a late night dinner.  The atmosphere is relaxed and cozy, with saxophone music in the background.  We had Chicken Satay and Beef Rendang (RM12+24) and both were great.  Definitely kept to the high standards expected in Georgetown.

Author: marlyd2013
Title: Fantastic food!
Review: Great food! Good quality and pure food. Nice atmosphere too. Try the grilled seabass and the lime soursop juice. Nice local specialties on menu.

Author: OoiH53
Title: Malaysian cuisine with a different touch.
Review: Brought my KL friends there for lunch...excellent choice. They simply loved the food and place. Went there a second time with my colleagues for dinner...again the food was great and this time we tried their desserts...yummy! Drinks were great too. Good food and cozy environment not to mention their excellent service. Thanks to all the staff there. Definitely going back again.Show less

Author: jerryw166
Title: Great Malaysian food
Review: Came for lunch. We shared the chicken wings and had the beef and chicken redang. All dishes where excellent. Thus place 7s a keeper. We will be back.

Author: m_1ssaPerth, Australia
Title: To die for
Review: It's the perfect Modern twist to the authentic Malaysian cuisine. One of the best meals I've eaten my entire KL and Penang trip. Highly recommend the Sea Bass meal, was sooooo delicious and cooked to perfection. For dessert, Pandan Brûlée..one of the best desserts I've ever tasted in my life!!!Show less

Author: JacekBKK
Title: Nice, family run Restaurant
Review: Good food, great, friendly service. Great place to try something different ... though no alcohol. Excellent fruit juice

Author: koshpatPenang, Malaysia
Title: Good food, friendly crew
Review: Penang has so many, too many, restaurants to be tried even for locals. Thus, merely good food is no longer good enough. Some people go for quality food, I prefer quality food and service. This place has it all. This Muslim friendly restaurant serves authentic delicious Malay food. What I have tried and loved: 1) Ayam Rendang 2) Satay3) Ikan Bakar4) Grilled banana with ice creamRemember to take a picture with the P.Ramlee mural in the restaurant. For the information of foreigners, P. Ramlee is the icon of Malay entertainment in the 60s and 70s.Parking may be a problem so try to reach before 7pm. Roadside parking.Location can be found in Waze. Happy Dining.Show less

Author: Iratdog
Title: Safe Haven
Review: Rarely do you see such consensus. I must agree. This little spot does what it should. Does it courteously. Nice room. Clean. Comfortable. Great coffee! It's actually a Hotel Lobby. Nice.

Author: Stephie1711Malaysia
Title: Little gem!
Review: My friend and I stumbled upon this cafe while going for a walk. The cafe has a unique design and good environment. The staff are friendly and helpful. Food is great, I had the murtabak sandwich- very delicious. Love this place, will definitely be back when I'm in Penang !Show less

Author: junithaPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Dinner
Review: The food is served up in generous portions, which causes a pleasant raise of the eyebrows as the prices for the portions served are very reasonable. Drinks served are punchy and refreshing. Table service by warm and friendly staff makes the experience of having a meal at Café Lagenda even more pleasurableShow less

Author: anastasia_doula_thai
Title: Right place to start your perfect day!))
Review:
Exeptional! Coffee, sweets, amazing music, hospitable owners, good wi-fi, very nice design.
If you like to start your day in George town - come here!
Alone, with family and friends!
Lovely-lovely-lovely!

Author: iisechewMalaysia
Title: The power of embracing heritage.. authentic food
Review: Jawi House Cafe GalleryServing perhaps the best Lamb Biryani in town, this Halal Restaurant definitely goes in the must-visit list for Penang's food. Helmed by Chef & Owner Nuril, he takes real pride in his Jawi Peranakan Heritage. The pre-war building in which Jawi House located is beautifully decorated with pictures of family and Jawi Peranakan ladies who were the frontier of their unique heritage. In some ways similar to the Baba Nyonya, the Jawi Peranakan have strong Malay heritage with strait settler origins (Pakistan, India, Acheh, Etc).Let's dive in to the cuisine.
