We had the Levant Platter; with its hummus, babaganoush and the Pita Bread, it was delicious. Rich and perfectly seasoned, Michelle who normally does not relish raw salads finished the greens entirely. The Lamb Biryani was incredible. The meat was extremely tender, with spices that completed the whole experience. Accompanied with the Dhaal, it was most palatable. I would come here again for the authentic Jawi Peranakan experience. It has a class of its own, and it truly is art. This is the power of embracing heritage.Show less

Author: xeroxian58Shah Alam, Malaysia
Title: Good Food, Good Mood
Review: Went here during MCO 3.0 for a business trip. This place was not really rave on google engines, and reviews were so so. However, glad that me & my partner went for it. We ordered chef’s recommendation prawn briyani 4/5 & armenian salad 3.5/5. The food was good blended well with the ambience of the restaurant. Definitely worth the try!Show less

Author: eerza
Title: A nice and cozy spot to dine in
Review: Modest pricing on the menu considering its prime location along Amernian Street. Food is full of flavour and staff are attentive/friendly. Suggest not to drive there if you can help it as parking will be difficult.

Author: Casta C
Title: Best Food during our Stay in Georgetown
Review: Authentic Jawi Peranakan food in historical setting. Went there for lunch, fast and attentive service. Wonderful sauces. Big portions and very good selection of teas. Highly recommended.

Author: 885tjs
Title: Excellent Jawi Peranakan Cuisine
Review: Jawi Peranakan cuisine at its best! Absolutely love everything about this place. The cosy ambience, beautiful wooden dining furniture and a historic display of photos through time gives it a nostalgic feel. My husband and I ordered a kerabu mangga, mutton briyani, colonial lemon tart for lunch, all washed down with a mighty refreshing glass of nutmeg juice. Divine fusion of flavours and textures, a true gastronomic journey with every mouthful. It was definitely one of our best lunches in Penang - great service, reasonably priced too!Show less

Author: DaudRayPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Penang’s best sauces and flavor—and that’s saying A LOT!
Review: We came here after Halab’s management dishonorably refused to honor our table booking number. Best decision we could have made. Penang is the food capital of Asia (i.e. of most of the inhabited world), and Jawi House Cafe is perched at the very summit of authentic Penang deliciousness. The sauces (everything in Penang is in the sauces!) are the best we’ve ever experienced. The dahl curry masalah (typically good, but not awesome at restaurants) is stunning. The beef rendang (good almost everywhere) is the best example we’ve ever tasted. And the biryani rice and peanut rice dishes are delicious with the sauces. The kerabu manggo was an excellent and refreshing starter. The nutmeg and lime drinks were just right. And the sago pudding was a great way to top it all off. The waiters and chefs were especially friendly despite having a full house. They answered our questions about the recipies. At one point one of them even called the owner to confirm that the dahl masalah we’d eaten was the same one described on a certain page in her recent recipie book The Penang Feast. Tonight the management at Halab was unhospitable; the management at Jawi House Cafe made up for it with warm hospitality and top notch delicious dishes.Show less

Author: Climber651403
Title: Delicious
Review: Highly recommended! I love all the dishes that I ordered. The cucur Udang and kerabu is must try appetiser

Author: jessye3000Sioux Falls, South Dakota
Title: Delicious !
Review: This restaurant was well worth the evening, the Jawi Peranakan food was really delicious. We loved the nutmeg juice here, and the desserts were also great. We went here once for dinner and once for an afternoon snack. Totally recommend it. I regret not buying one of the cool cookbooks they sold in the back ! Show less

Author: ekeat79George Town, Malaysia
Title: A nice and quiet place for Peranakan cuisine
Review: This restaurant is located within the George Town Heritage Zone, therefore parking spaces are rather limited here. That, however, does not mean that one should not be coming to dine here at all... rather, if you do choose to come to this area for your lunch/dinner, then restaurant this would be a huge recommendation. It specialises in traditional Peranakan cuisine, with a mixture of Arabic, Northern Indian, Pakistani, asd well as Malay dishes. In addition, with a nice setup here (accompanied by some slow music), this place does provide a great ambience for a lovely dining session among friends or for business discussions. The only downside (if I were to find one) is probably the generally small portions for each dish.Show less

Author: Rick WSevenoaks, United Kingdom
Title: Small intimate restaurant
Review: We walked to this restaurant on the advice of our hotel concierge - and it fitted the bill perfectly. Great friendly service, excellent food, reasonable prices and a lovely ambience. We paid £3.50 for a plate of hummus and bread and just £3.50 each for our main courses of chicken (for me) and mixed vegetables (for my wife). Our bill for two people came to just £15! This was authentic Penang cuisine - but real quality.Show less

Author: iammarsSingapore, Singapore
Title: Nice atmosphere. Tasty food.
Review: Enjoyed a nice vegetarian lunch. Everything was good except for one small problem. Our waiter, who also seemed to be the manager, gave me the wrong information and I ordered something I didn't like. I'm sure it was an honest mistake but one that can be crucial in the restaurant game.Show less

Author: StingRay1985Liverpool, United Kingdom
Title: Cosy restaurant with lovely food
Review: This is a small restaurant tucked away in George Town. The staff as very friendly and the food is excellent quality. We ordered a huge selection of food between 4 of us. They advised this might be too much food, they were right, however every dish was delicious. Excellent value for money and highly recomended.Show less

Author: lmchoo
Title: Excellent Peranakan fare!
Review: Excellent Peranakan fare, delicious to its every bite. Authentic, the bryani rice, and unique blue pea rice are must try! The beef rendang is da bomb! Super yummy! Ask the chef to tell you the history of the house, origins. He will! :)

Author: ZhenyaSeverenchuk
Title: Awesome food and pleasant service
Review: The food here tastes great, everything is clean and neat. Food portions are huge, so I’d recommend ordering one dish for each member of your group to start :)  the staff is pleasant and friendly.

Author: lucy_theBandung, Indonesia
Title: Good food and nice ambience
Review: After spending a hot day walking around art street , we decide to stop by in Jawi house cafe gallery for lunch . Its a nice homey restaurant . I choose something light for our lunch . Kerabu mangga as a salad dan roti surai . I like the kerabu mangga because the taste was balance , not to sour and strong . I like the ginger flower chop . Also beef brisket sandwich was juicy and tender . Everything was perfectShow less

Author: rakesh ACary, North Carolina
Title: A pleasant surprise!
Review: In Penang for two nights. Unbeknown to us , our travel agent plopped us into this resort — Park Royal which is 30 mins. drive to all the best restaurants in Georgetown. Our place is a foodie “desert” Googled and chanced upon Jawi House. 30 mins. later we found ourselves in this lovely restaurant that was almost someone’s living room. Gracious understated service. Ordered a nutmeg and Arab rose water drink — soothing for parched throats Ordered the laksa, shrimp biryani and fresh snapper in a spicy sambal. Every dish was delicately spiced ( especially the biryani ) and delicious. Wanted try more dishes ( even requested half portions of dishes so we could order a greater variety of the interesting dishes on the menu — no such luck! ) Recommend this place unreservedly— made up for the lousy location of our resort!!  Some advice— if you are a foodie — stay closer to Georgetown — that’s where the action is!Show less

Author: Eathereplease
Title: We had an excellent dinner
Review: We had an excellent dinner here! Really enjoyed everything we ordered. Nice, clean restaurant and good service. Can’t complain.

Author: AdrianMB
Title: High class food, reasonably priced
Review: We have eaten their 3 times in the last 8 days. Portions are good size, food is great. Staff are excellent and multi-lingual. It is Malaysian muslim food and drink, so no alcohol, etc, but a great show of Penang food.

Author: n0tmadn0madAmsterdam, The Netherlands
Title: I love Jawi food!
Review: I didn't know anything about Jawi food until I visited this small family ran place on Armenian Street.The first impression is like stepping into someone's home for a dinner. The decoration includes old artifacts and family pictures on walls. The menu was simple and easy to understand. The service was great and OMG the food.. its like similar to Malay food but 100 times more flavor. The laksa was balanced, sambal spicy and rendang with full of taste. I had an extra order of lemuni rice which really worked with rendang.Definitely a place to not miss when in Penang!Show less

Author: TrustTheGreek
Title: Great Dinning Experience!Recommend :)
Review: I have visited the restaurant before few weeks ago and i have tasted the delicious cuisine that they serve. Traditional Malaysian food at its best. Definitely recommend.

Author: 665keitht
Title: Great service splendid food
Review:
Kind and beautiful service
Food was delicious, tasty and nicely plated
Environment was nice and cool.

Unfortunately restroom is upstairs. Slightly inconvenient.

We paid 160RM for 4, with 1 dessert and non alcoholic drinks. We were very full!

Author: JadamrosPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Cosy restaurant
Review: This is a cosy restaurant serving Jawi Peranakan food, a mix of Malay, Arab, Punjabi, Indian and Persian culture. Very intimate and welcoming, service was also attentive and pleasant. Located on Armenian Street which is the touristy area but the restaurant is not obvious unless you look for it. Set inside one of the pre-war shophouses it has been tastefully furnished. We did not try much of the food on the menu, but the blueish Nasi Lemuni was interesting, the Arabian Sherbet drink was refreshing and the Lemon Tart was scrumptious.Show less

Author: saluamanonoKauai, Hawaii
Title: Excellent food in Georgetown
Review: Walked past on several occasions and noticed it was often crowded to decided to give it a go. Great decision. Its a cute, small restaurant and gallery on Armenian Street. Easy to find. Focus is on traditional Malay food. Wide range of options. We had a green mango salad (similar to thai som tam), prawn biriyani that came with a side of curry, raita, papadam and chutney and a fish curry. All were very tasty. Servings were large. This was plenty for two. Total cost was less than $20US. Great value, great service, friendly staff. Highly recommended. They do not serve alcohol but have a wide range of juices, soft drinks, teas, etc.Show less

Author: shazzerinthesun
Title: Great place to experience local cuisine
Review: Terrific pleasure to eat here and enjoy local food in a beautiful shophouse.  The service is always excellent, and the food delivery is spot on.  In a great neighbourhood worth exploring after you have had a meal!

Author: philipkhor
Title: Will come again - good food & ambience
Review: Amazing service, nice ambience and lovely food. Felt the spices tingling in my tongue. Will recommend it to friends who want a nice quiet place for Malay food. Keep it up, Cheers~

Author: adcl0421
Title: Madly in love with this restaurant
Review: We were just strolling around and just hopped into this restaurant and it turned out to be one of the best on TripAdvisor. You gotta try their Jawi Briyani, scrumptious. Good service. Will come back again!

Author: inviaggiodal64Singapore, Singapore
Title: A real pleasure to eat here again
Review: When I visit Penang, I always make sure to come and eat again at this great restaurant. Every time, it is a real pleasure to savour my favourite:the "cucur udang" (baby prawn fritters), but also the levant platter, the briyani and lemuni rice. My friends also loved the meat dishes and especially "jawi bamieh" and the beef briyani. But really, try everything because everything is good here. Service is warm and attentive. And they are always enthusiastic if you ask about their great fusion Jawi Peranakan cuisine.Show less

Author: anna r
Title: Bloody brilliant
Review: Best food. Top quality produce, exquisitely prepared. We paid about £45 (225 RM) for a meal for 4. Expensive for our kind of trip, but worth every single penny. Made for a really lovely evening.

Author: jodyd726
Title: Delicious Food
Review: This place serves food with amazing flavours , very unassuming shop front , staff are helpful and have lovely friendly manner, we enjoyed so much we had dessert YUM !

Author: aandlkchKuching, Malaysia
Title: Delicious food at Jawi
Review: This is always our favourite restaurant in George Town. The owner and staff are welcoming and the service is good. As usual we enjoyef the food here - tasty and interesting Jawi Peranakan dishes - family recipes, not just dished up for tourists. Also recommend the lemon tart - so delicious!Jawi will be on our list again next time we are in Penang.Show less

Author: CharlesChenQJPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: A nice and calming setting but food A let down.
Review: After reading so many great reviews posted on.Trip Advisor, my wife and decided to check Jawi House out.We so looked forward to enjoying the food that so many foreigners had raved about.Alas, we were soooo disappointed when our orders finally arrived.1. The Roti Surai (yellow netted crepe, aka Roti Jala in Malaysia) was clumpy and the curry chicken comprised of a small piece of stringy white meat strands.2. The cucur udang (aka prawn fritters) was served lukewarm when it arrived. If they had been freshly cooked and served out of the deep frying pan, each fritter out to be burning hot. Moreover, we tasted mainly deep fried flour pastry with no sight of any prawns.3. Bryanni lamb,touted as out of This world was a big let down!! The basmati rice was not cooked completely and it was hard and dry. The rice buried a big chunk of mutton that was too lean and dry. No effort made in enhancing the dish with some proper presentationAll the above food were not piping hot when served.The redeeming points about this place is the calm and relaxed atmosphere.And the service staff members were cheerful, helpful and had good guest relations skills.The chef at Jawi House ought to try all the above dishes prepared by the many street vendors in Penang because they honestly do a much better job.We now have to take raving reviews of local Asian food, written by foreign tourists with a pinch of salt. I believe they honestly do not know what the real Mccoy taste like.Show less

Author: j0ycelint
Title: Delicious and good service
Review:
Delicious food, excellent service and nice ambience.

The briyani and chicken curry is a must try.

Place is well air conditioned and has wifi. Will definitely visit if I am back at Penang.

Author: BacinacSanta Clara, California
Title: Super place for local food.
Review: If you are thinking about this place-do it. A bit of an Indian -Malaysian fusion but I was told it was representative of a type of local cuisine. It was really good. Ordered a variety of dishes. They are pretty small so order a bit extra to make sure you try everything. Not expensive by US standards. No alcohol on the menu but maybe due to Ramadan. Only drawback is bathroom on second floor. Tiny and very utilitarian. Great staff. Wonderful neighborhood (Armenian street) for exploring before and after the meal. Show less

Author: 556bharrisSydney, Australia
Title: An excellent restaurant.
Review: Two starter, two mains, two drinks, R124. If that is beyond your budget in Georgetown, read no further. However, if you are happy to pay around $Aus40 for a lovely meal in very pleasant surroundings, Jawi House is highly recommended. We stopped in for afternoon tea with Gula Malacca and a tasty slice of pineapple and coconut tart. The dining room had the feel of a family dining room with dark wooded furniture, and a local extended family of about ten people were enjoying their lunch together as though it was their family own home. We came back for dinner and thoroughly enjoyed the experience. Imaginative drinks - Penang nutmeg,, also Afghan sherbert. A refreshing and uplifting Kerabu Managa salad of green mango strips, coriander, dried shrimps and peanuts with a light sweet and sour dressing. Jawi Bamieh: boneless lamb in a rich sauce of tomatoes and herbs, with either Indian bread or one of a range of creative rice dishes. Very interesting and tasty food. The staff were friendly and clearly very committed to Jawi House, and we would certainly return there on another visit to Georgetown.Show less

Author: Travelkingaisa
Title: Worderful place
Review: Great food and nice service. I like the lamb briyani and the penang nutmeg. The staff is so friendly i will come back again for sure.

Author: basicdavid
Title: "Avoid and go somewhere else."
Review: I visited this place with my family. The waitress was a bit pushy about ordering drinks. (Seriously, we will order drinks if we want. We won't if we don't. Because it's us who are paying. Simple as that.) The noodle dish that I ordered was not tasty at all. Hard a hard time trying to finish it (but couldn't). My family ordered barayani. It was so-so. You can get a better barayani with much (much) cheaper price in Penang.The decor is average. Don't understand what the hype is all about. Our main disappointment was how average the taste was for the expensive price we paid. Just avoid and go somewhere else with better taste and cheaper price. Show less

Author: sscb_2017Sydney, Australia
Title: Turned away
Review: We had been recommended to go here, but unfortunately when we arrived, right on opening at 11am (when the place was empty) we were turned away. Originally my husband and 4 year old daughter were told there was a table available but then when they saw me and our 10month old baby, they turned us away and said they only had a table of 2. There were literally 2 other people in the restaurant so this was extremely offensive. Clearly they have a problem with babies, which is terrible. Show less

Author: IronMuZz
Title: Top place to eat
Review:
Great place to eat , great meals , good service.
i had the prawn Biryani and also ordered the nutmeg juice.

Author: Mark DPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: A Wonderful addition to this "UNESCO designated "Heritage area"!!
Review: This restaurant has wonderful ambience from at least three sources-- the heritage location, the restaurant.... and the remarkable and diverse, "Heritage Inspired" Malay Cuisine!! The area around the restaurant has been Internationally recognised for its "Heritage features", and the restaurant honours this TOTALLY-- both in the menu, the quality of the food and the professionalism and helpfulness of its staff! TripAdvisor has recognised this restaurant by awarding it with the "Certificate of Excellence". While some diners react to this type of cuisine in "different ways" -- in major part because it is different [BUT delicious]. It is definitely worthy of a visit--- especially if one is also exploring this Heritage area!I hope that this Review has been helpful.Show less

Author: amarkoulSingapore, Singapore
Title: Fell short of expectations!
Review: I've been here for three times every time I'm in Penang but this is definitely the last. If you're in tune with local tastes, the standards here are falling. We ordered beef masala & chicken curry - both of which were really tasteless, lacking salt & spices. Appetisers were good though.Show less

Author: domidius
Title: unique Peranakan food...
Review:
Jawi, or Malay Peranak food is quite rare to find, as most people are unaware of its' existence...

the food is unique, it showcases the unique Jawi heritage, the influences on the Malay cuisine in Penang...

Author: NoseasonPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Nice Set up fir Tourist
Review: Restaurant situated along Armenian street where there are many heritage shophouses refurbished. The cafe served authentic Jawi peranakan Malay food. The food servings is fullfiling with decent presentation. We had the Laksa glass noodle in fish sauce with coconut milk. This is a local delicacy but different from the typical Penang Laksa. The beriyani rice was also light and fragrant. Served with tender lamb, chicken or beef. The furniture set up is marble top table and wooden chair and the wooden staircase that reflects a mix of malay and chinese culture. Photos of the people who lived in this area are nicely decorated on the wall.To dine at this cafe gives you a feel of what the old Penang was like. Nice clean restaurant and good food and service.Show less

Author: Sherpa431699
Title: Great food and authentic atmosphere
Review: Food was outstanding.  Service was excellent. Music was well selected and low enough to be able to have a conversation.  One of the best places so far on this visit to Penang

Author: Sabina SVienna, Austria
Title: So delicious
Review: We found the restaurant by chance, we didn't read any reviews before, so didn't really know what to expect.We walked in and the interior was nice and so atractive and the manager was very polite and proffesional that we immediately felt good.We ordered several different things (I think five different dishes) and everything was so delicious and so full of taste.Price was very reasonable, service was great, everything was just perfect. We left satisfied and happy, because finaly we had an excellent dinner in Georgetown.Next evening we went to Jawi house again. We tried five more different dishes and two desserts. Again everything was so tasty. Next day we left Georgetown, but if we wouldn't, we would go there again. There are still lots of things on the menu, which should be tasted.This restaurant really does justice to Georgetown and its reputation for best food, what we can not say for any other restaurant, which we went in here. Thanks god we found Jawi house, otherwise we wouldn't believe Georgetown is a food Mecca as its being advertised. Show less

Author: ATKokMacau, China
Title: Good food with good service and nice staffs
Review: I love the rice, both jawi and the blue flower flavoured. The grilled shrimps are really tasty and the lamb braised very soft and delicious. The curry is savoury.When I m not sure about the sago pudding’s sweetnesses, the staffs just proposed to make the sago pudding serving separated with the black sugar syrup and coconut milk. So I can mix it myself. I think he is so helpful.The price of food is reasonable.The building of this restaurant (and gallery) is a historical house. And it’s beautiful.The location is just very closed to the main street arts area.Show less

Author: vivnairMacau, China
Title: Nothing to write home about
Review: Went here for dinner tonight, nothing out of the ordinary. We didn’t leave with a sense that this was either authentic or a creative take on Malaysian cuisine. In fact it made the cuisine look like a poor copy of Indian and middle eastern foods. The Baba Ganoush was bitter, the biriyani’s only made you long for the real thing. Malaysia has a vibrant food culture. Jawi House is a poor ambassador for it.Show less

Author: BujangTravelz
Title: Good Service Good Food
Review: Went for lunch with Chinese friends and the staff were helpful enough to explain some of the dishes and also highlighted which dishes are spicy as one of my friends couldn't take spicy food. Food was delicious and amount just nice.

Author: fionap02Bangkok, Thailand
Title: Great food, great service
Review: We tried a few times to get to Jawi House but they were closed for refurbishment. It was worth the wait, we went for a lunch and were not disappointed. As our party consisted of 2 vegans and 1 gluten free travellers the staff were happy to answer questions and the food was excellent. For vegetarians they do a set with 3 local dishes, loads of vegetables, which was great and the curry dish was delicious. Price was very reasonable. Show less

Author: gianinabella
Title: Authentic Melayu House
Review: I found the rice has unpleasant smells, but maybe it's just the spices? However, loving the interior & the hospitality, but all the food was just okay.

Author: tinpencilToronto, Canada
Title: Would Have Been 5 Star...
Review: This would have been a 5 star rating, but unfortunately their signature dishes - Beef Rendang and Beef Masala fell just short on the moisture scale and just a touch bland for me. The Herbal Lemon Rice was superb and the Penang Nutmeg Juice was divine.Do again? For the Ambiance - Yes For food - read my other Penang reviews (hint...Sri)Show less

Author: Syarifshahab
Title: Cool
Review: The cafe has an ethnic touch. Come here only to eat the dessert. The price is a bit above average but worth to try.

Author: MuhamadLudfi
Title: Birthday Celebration
Review: Beetroot soup and Malayan Salad is wonderfull as a starter. Staff help us to surprise our Birthday Princess with a Red Velvet Galilei. Prawn Biryani is very tasty. Lentil rice make a cheerful memories to our BD princess. Of course Lemuni rice is a unique dish to try.Sagoo Gula Melaka and Bubur Cha cha good as it should be.And we finished our enjoyful Birthday celebration with a tea. Ginger, Lemongrass and Mint tea. Its come with a cute teapot.Ginger and Lemongrass is too strong. I think it should be more light taste as a finishing refreshment . The Mint tea the is a good tea. Of course we share this tea together rather than to finished ourvown tea. Hope chef owner can consider a light and fresh taste of herbal tea. Tq. Everything is good. A light tea tea taste will make this review perfect.Show less

Author: Alvin V
Title: charming small restaurant in old George Town
Review: Authentic Penang cuisine! this cafe serves both traditional drinks and local food. Located near the art street scene in old George Town, this charming restaurant is in a traditional row house and the architecture is authentic. Try their nutmeg drink and specialty rice dishes.

Author: Pin Seah KPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Original taste which brought back memories of yesterdays when grandmas used to cook using only original ingrediens
Review: Great place to dine and admiring beautiful settings and surrounding. Even the plates and bowls are like work of art. It's definitely excellent Peranakan dishes. Only managed to dine in there after the third attempt as it was previously fully booked under private events. So do call them in advance to avoid disappointment.Show less

Author: roli2201
Title: Very good!
Review: We had a very good meal, friendly, red velvet cake is good. Very good food for a small price! You should try this restaurant.

Author: Karen-HappuchPenang, Malaysia
Title: Excellent Peranakan Food
Review: Came with a group of 20+ friends for my second visit here. The ground floor area was all occupied by us. Its strenths are its’ excellent-tasting food - which also has great presentation; another strength is its cosy ambience. On the downside is that the interiors are a bit cramped. Nice place to bring non- Penangite friends for some Peranakan cuisine. Show less

Author: PKHY38
Title: Malay Peranakan
Review: A return visit since our last trip in December 2017 to Penang, Malaysia. It didn’t disappoint...reasonably priced delicious traditional Malay Peranakan food served in cosy homelike surroundings. Our dinner bill for 5 adults was Malaysian Ringgit 152 (approximately US$38!)

Author: inviaggiodal64
Title: Great place, good food, excellent service
Review: We loved this place. The food is authentic and there is a good choice of vegetarian and not too spice food. Service is attentive and warm. It was a real pleasure to talk to the chef/owner and learn about local ingredients.

Author: MunirchM
Title: Fascinating and Rich in flavour
Review: Located at Penang most famous heritage street. From outside looks very much simple and normal restaurant. The choices of menu are limited but definitely are the best collections can be made available.Few special dishes like briyani and lemuni rice are those top on the list. Exceptional ambience and setup. Show less

Author: paulinesophiec
Title: Amazing!
Review:
This place was fantastic! The food was amazing, the juices ever so fresh and the service very friendly and attentive. 
The waiter laughed at my brother’s stipud jokes so bonus points for that!
Warning! The portions are huge so we all waddled our of there!

Author: GadiShaiSingapore, Singapore
Title: Would be nice to taste food if only....
Review: I have written a number of reviews on various websites for both accommodation and food, but never negative reviews as I am generally averse to the idea. However on this trip to Penang in which I have found the people and establishments to be accommodating and genuinely warm in general, Jawi House Cafe has become a ambassador of the other end of the spectrum. Rude service from wait staff the second you enter the door. Our group, 4 grandparents, 2 parents and 2 well mannered young girls arrived to enjoy a pleasant meal out and instead were rejected service. Why you may ask? Not enough tables? Improperly dressed? Neither of the above. Instead, the staff simply decided that short of saying that they would not accept children they concocted a story that the table they had already offered us to sit at was suddenly spontaneously booked by another customer on the phone while we were waiting to be seated at said table. This is clearly not a family friendly establishment and instead thinks too highly of itself. I will certainly be recommending Jawi House Cafe and Gallery to my friends, relatives and students as somewhere to avoid should they wish to maintain the impression that Penang is a welcoming place. Show less

Author: javdac6070Fife
Title: Highly recommend
Review: We were recommended to come here by our guest house and we were so glad we did! We had Malay salad & pancake with potato and chicken curry both of which were lovely. For our mains we had the beef randang which is a Malay speciality and it was delicious. Had home made ginger beers & ginger and mint teas to drink. The bill was 132rm, very good value for money. Show less

Author: Hanim71
Title: Well worth the money spent
Review:
Portions are great! Taste wise is duly expected since it is No.1 restaurant (halal) in Penang.
Must try lime tart and the trio of almond, pineapple and coconut tart!
Do not miss this!

Author: ferlool
Title: Malaysian food in its best
Review: If you want to try local food go here. The beef rendang is superb! And the staff very friendly as well.

Author: Janet I
Title: Fantastic food
Review: This is a hidden little gem which offers delicious local dishes. The service is excellent, and the food is fantastic, the quality is similar to the one offered at Kebaya.

Author: 880cindywChichester, United Kingdom
Title: Super traditional restaurant
Review: We enjoyed a great dinner at this traditional Malay restaurant. The very helpful owner advised us to have the lacy pancakes to start with chicken curry gravy which were outstanding. We followed with beef rendang and fish curry with their limoni rice also memorable. Fresh mint tea to finish. Brilliant value, great service even to calling us an uber cab to save us money! Thank you.Show less

Author: Rachel Y
Title: Great staff, comfortable & classy atmosphere, food to die for
Review: As a solo traveller I could not order too many dishes so I opted for their curry chicken and kacang rice. Was blown away! The rice was so flavourful and the chilli (sambal?) that came with it accompanied the dish so well. The chicken was well-cooked and came off the bone easily + the sauce was so yummy I finished off almost all of it. Highly recommended! Seems to be a place that the locals visit too -- NOT a tourist trap. I spent 21 ringgit!Show less

Author: 194FaridehKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: A gourmet place, not to be missed!
Review: OH MY GOD! This place is a gem of a place! Even though it is quite small, however it is managed with the greatest attention to Gourmet delights and food conoisseurs who really wish and aspire to eat a delicious lunch ir dinner. We were walking with my husbsnd, strolling lazily, when we saw that cute little restaurant. Mostly European customers, who know where to find gourmet food. We ordered its sprcialty, consisting of herb rice with chicken curry. We also ordered some salad and another kind of briyani shaped rice. The soup, the main dishes, were tremendously delicious. It was sooo good that we ordered another portion of the herb rice. When it was finished, we really missed the beloved herb rice. When I asked about it from our waiter, he said it is a specialty of penand malay food. Not chinese, but 100% malay. The cheescake was a delight for the palate.To be truthful, the portion were moderate, going to small. It was not generous. But what the heck, the taste won over everything else.And... The prices were quite high.This I should point out. But then again, where can you eat such delicious herb rice?We are impatiantly waiting to go back to penang to eat, once agsin in that restaurant. A definitely A+ restaurant. Not to be missed. Show less

Author: StueyJWoodford, United Kingdom
Title: Great Food
Review: We spoke with out guide generally about the difficulty of finding a Malay restaurant with good vegetarian options. He introduced us to the restaurant. The restaurant was full and buzzy. We enjoyed the non-alcoholic drinks. The hummus was to die for. My wife had the vegetarian option comprised of different dishes, beautifully presented and certainly not bland which were delicious. I had the beef rendang which was delicious. Service was efficient and professional. The restaurant was relaxed and to our minds was not overly expensive. It's situated in a characterful building and I would recommend this restaurant. Show less

Author: 771ashleighHebden Bridge, United Kingdom
Title: A little gem in Georgetown - wonderful food and service!
Review: My partner and I visited Jawi House Cafe & Gallery for dinner last night and were absolutely spoilt for choice. From the outside the restaurant looks tiny and would be easy to miss, but the dishes on the menu sounded as wonderful as they looked and smelled, and we eventually settled on the Jawi Biryani with beef, the Creamy Rose Chicken and the Eggs with Sambal as a side dish. I’d absolutely recommend all of these dishes, the quality of the food was brilliant and all for the price of 68 ringgit (including a soft drink each). The staff were incredibly helpful and friendly, and even offered to help us with directions when we had left the restaurant and were stood out on the roadside consulting Google maps. All in all, a lovely little find that is absolutely worth a visit. Show less

Author: SRaj75Horsham, United Kingdom
Title: Beautifully cooked food
Review: When chicken not only tastes nice but also falls off the bone, then effortlessly works it's way down, it is good food. Jawi House makes lovely food. We had a Malay chicken curry, Dal and rice. The taste and flavours here have been worked out well. The cost was highly affordable and thee setting pleasant. It appears booking is worthwhile, though we did not... Great food. I would happily book and re-book again here... Show less

Author: Kathjbell
Title: Great Local Lunch
Review: This was recommended by a local and it was very good. Food was lovely and service was great. Highly recommend if you are looking for lunch in Georgetown while looking at the street art. The mango salad was amazing.

Author: Lorraine P
Title: Great food and great value
Review:
Our hotel recommended this restaurant and it didn’t disappoint . The lemuni rice dish was amazing for both colour and flavour . My friend had the lamb and she was delighted .
A special mention for the service too which was exemplary

Author: GudGollyMsMollySydney, Australia
Title: Delightful haven with awesome x-cultural cuisine
Review: Dropped in for a quick bite on the recommendations of our close friends as well as our tour guide from the previous days &weren’t disappointed. 4 lovely fruit drinks, cucur udang & the mixed platter of salad/hummus/babaganouj - more than we could eat for just on MYR100. Staff are friendly & efficient; we’d definitely go back as would dearly love to try things like their Rendang.Show less

Author: leecK9330OU
Title: Heritage Restautant
Review: It's a heritage decorated restaurant. Good atmosphere & foods. Of course price is at high edge but really delicious

Author: clareguCullercoats, United Kingdom
Title: Very good food
Review: We have been here 3 times now and the food has been very good every time. It's traditional Malay food done well. The rendang is better that the biryani that latter which was too sweet for me. The Arabian sherbert was slightly odd to my taste, malty tasting. My mum in law loved the humous and the traditional rices are delicious.Show less

Author: yangturkMalaysia
Title: Unique cuisine to match rich culture
Review: Jawi is an Arab word to refer to Malays and Muslims who migrated to South East Asia in early 19th century and Jawi Peranakan were Arabs that married local Malays whereas Baba Nyonya Peranakan were Chinese migrants that married local Malay women. With such a rich and proud heritage, their food is unique and an eclectic mix of cultures influenced by spices and local ingredients. Restaurant is located in an area popular with tourists. Nicely decorated to reflect the tradition, would have been nice to promote more local Malay artists. We had 3 dishes for lunch - Roti Surai which is like Roti Jala(Baba version), Jawi laksa which is “lemak” coconut based but noodles a bit too soft, and Cucur Udang which is like a prawn fritter, a generous pot of fragrant Masala tea. All awesome, very complex flavours and refined standards. You can tell they cook with passion and pride. Cannot wait to go back and try the Nasi Bryani, Jawi Bamieh lamb stew and Lemuni rice. Prices above average by local standards but still affordable and reasonable.Highly recommended for the adventurous tourist foodie looking for a different experience.Show less

Author: tudora380
Title: Good food, but a bit too expensive.
Review: The food was good, but the portions were a bit too small and weren't right for the price. The staff is very friendly.

Author: 151theresedCremorne, Australia
Title: Lovely dinner in a lovely restaurant
Review: We visited this restaurant and enjoyed a mainly vegetarian meal and experienced exquisitely prepared food, unique flavoursand friendly service. Great care was taken in development of original recipes and preparation of food. The platter of dips with bread, hummus, baba ganoush and salad sounds standard but was really delicious with more delicate flavour than usual. The prawn & vegetable in pancake batter was nice but the accompanying deep fried tofu was fantastically fresh and beautifully cooked. These entrees were followed by the house rice specialty (don’t remember the name) and the 3 vegetable curries (this is one dish). They were all really lovely - vegetable & lentil, jackfruit in coconut milk curry and finally spinach. A word of warning here for vegetarians. Questioning the staff revealed the vegetable & lentil curry contained “meat powder”!Tropical fruit and sago for dessert all accompanied by the two house favourite drinks of nutmeg juice and sherbet. This restaurant is not licensed for alcohol and they do not want customers to bring alcohol. I am tempted to give Jawi House 5 stars but for the use of meat powder in the vegetable curry. Show less

Author: LusyKororL
Title: I eat here refularly
Review:
I eat here regularly. All the staff are lovely and the food is great. Good atmosphere and decoration to. Clean and good value for money. 
Surprisingly cheap given how fancy the place looks.

Author: Lilibud88
Title: Very Good Choice!
Review:
Excellent service, food, ambience!
Love the almond, pineapple tart, the lemongrass tea! Service very good too!  Please make bookings ahead as the restaurant is small!

Author: Howard B
Title: Disappointing
Review: The food was just okay. Even the recommended dishes by other travelers failed to be as good or as interesting as many other restaurants in Georgetown. I found the food rather bland.

Author: idazaiwai
Title: yummy
Review: taste of chicken briyani, lemuni rice and beef rendang👍🏼👍🏼👍🏼 so delicious ✌🏼need to come again next time🆒

Author: IEatLOVEPrayKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Must Try - Loved it!
Review: An accidental find which turned out to be the of the best meals I have had in Penang. It wasn't the typical nyonya - peranakan fare Penang is famed for, but everything we ordered was prepared like a truly home-cooked meal. We had two variations of rice dishes which were both delicious. The Roti Jala (Laced Pancakes) were served with a delicious curry and the Mango Salad was so good that we had a reorder. We also had a laksa just to try and it had a refined coconut flavour like a cross between a phuket and penang laksa! And the egg sambal, to die for. I wished I had a bigger tummy or a bigger group of people to share more dishes!! Pleasant serving staff who helped us to order and didn't try to upsell. A must visit - must eat venue! Show less

Author: Rian T
Title: High quality food
Review: Really good - we got the three vegetarian dishes, a rice dish and a juice. Very high quality food in a lovely setting.

Author: fahmenhamraJeddah, Saudi Arabia
Title: tasty food, calm place
Review: The Chicken Briyani was tasty. So much rice with papadam and some nutmeg side dish and Dalca. Nutmeg Juice was so refreshing. The Grilled Chicken Sandwich was to die for. With something crispy the put in ans the chicken so tender, the salad was soooo good. Show less

Author: 123vikashpLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Fresh and Tasty
Review: This was a great little restaurant in a small cul de sac. Their fresh juices are a great refresher for the hot days. And their biryani was fragrant, well spiced and the meat melted in your mouth. Service was quick and friendly. And the restaurant is located close to quite a few sites that are recommended.Show less

Author: TravelDreamsPortland, OR
Title: I had one amazing meal there, and one so-so
Review: My first night at Jawi I had a great lamb dish with okra served with Benggalli toast. So tasty. Then the Red Velvet galette blew my mind. The second day I had some shrimp/ veggie fritters which I think were boring, the tofu and cucumber served with it were too bland to go with them, and a Arabic pink drink was also lacking flavor. So, go! It has great potential, but research what to order. Show less

Author: 460MartinC460Adelaide, Australia
Title: Disappointing
Review: This place is very disappointing, I had hummus to start, I can make much better myself. Biryani was tasteless. And chicken was dry. Gallery also underwhelming. Tomorrow we hope is better for food. Show less

Author: drk65Adelaide, Australia
Title: Below par
Review: Very average food and service. Flavorless food. Over cooked and pre-prepared. Staff not interested. Not licensed. Not even for beer. Over priced and pretentious. Plenty of other places to spend your money better in Georgetown Show less

Author: oldwheatVictoria, Canada
Title: the place for traditional 'blue' rice and other delights
Review: If you visit the 'Wonderfood' museum in Penang you will learn about various heritage and traditional dishes including 'blue rice' Nasi Kerabu. I was able to taste this rice at Jawi House. This was a highlight for my food focused visit to Penang.I enjoyed the food so much at dinner I went back for lunch the next day. After lunch, Assistant manager Danial Tahir showed my friends and I the plants used in the traditional cooking. This most appreciated opportunity helped us link plant to plate. This restaurant has excellent service, lovely atmosphere, delicious food and good prices.Show less

Author: kathryn9003
Title: A gem
Review: Stumbled across this little gem. Food is incredible and there is so much of it! Service was great- can’t fault this for value for money!

Author: No_BS_svp
Title: Don't understand the hype
Review: We expected something special based on the TA reviews. We were really disappointed. Hummus was mediocre. Lamb was tough as shoe leather. Fish of the day was mystery fish drowned in a glutinous spicy sauce. Tables too close together. No alcohol served. Won't return. Ever. Avoid. Show less

Author: Avni PPenang, Malaysia
Title: completely OVER-rated!!!!
Review: ate here some time back and I recall I had no qualms with the food. but last year when i returned after two years, i realised the food was tasteless. they name their dishes after some local asian cuisines but there is no flavour in the gravy. maybe it's meant for people who can't tolerate spices or they are simply not consistent with their cooking. never going there again. don't trust reviews on trip advisor!Show less

Author: Lusy KPenang, Malaysia
Title: i love this place so much i'm a regular
Review: we have a group of people that come here every week to catch up and eat the good food.The staff are really lovely, well trained, and friendly.The food is consistently good (we have been going there for 3 years) and there is enough variety on the menu to keep everyone happy (even my fussy niece and nephew).Started by a local guy who just wanted to share his passion for his culture.Love this place, and cannot recommend it enough.Show less

Author: Nagpal
Title: Good food
Review: The food is good and they have baby chairs for the young ones. Service is excellent and their lamb biryani is so good. Would definitely recommend this place.

Author: luming7
Title: Yummy dinner!
Review: Had a delightful dinner here with friends. All the dishes we got were good! And the dessert was really yummy - we had the lemon tart (my fave), cheesecake and almond / coconut / pineapple tart to share :)

Author: 165charlotten
Title: Great food
Review:
Chicken Biryani was lovvvely 😍
Came with popadom and chutney and fresh raita on cucumber and carrot. 100% would eat again

Author: EdmundsanSingapore, Singapore
Title: Flavourful food & great service
Review: We've never had Jawi Peranakan food before and were pleasantly surprised & left so stuffed & satiated. Our most memorable dishes are: The Bamieh (lamb stew) is awesome with its lamb so tender & delicious broth. And the Lamuni rice is interesting as the lamuni flower gives it an refreshing aroma & this rice goes well with fish curry. Briyani is great too. The foods are not at all spicy for our asian tastebuds. For desserts, the lemon tart is amazing coz of its tart sweetness & brulee drizzle, while the red velvet gallette is not bad.Show less

Author: clarebJ2451LZGeelong, Australia
Title: Super tasty!!!
Review: We ate dinner here and we were so pleased with the food and the service.We ordered the salad/dip platter for starter. Plenty for 2 adults and 2 children.The dips were delicious and the salad had a very nice dressing.We ordered more pita as one piece each wasn’t enough for the amount of dip we had.For mains: Beef Rendang - very tasty. Lamb Masala - stand out dish!!Dalca (vegetarian/Dahl) dish - tasty, but not very generous in either vegetables or the Dahl. Needed a little more I feel. It was majority of liquid sauce.We also ordered:Lentil rice - stand out! Tomato rice - tasty.Plain white rice (for daughter...)The papadums were delicious- be sure to order some of those.Portions aren’t very big, so for a family or a few adults- you will need to order a few dishes.Food is great and high quality produce.The flavour they pack into the curries is amazing!!If you like lamb- you can’t go past the lamb Masala. Be careful of the bones though!!! (Husband almost lost a tooth!)The teas are also very good. I had ginger. Very strong. I could only have one cup. And husband had the Masala which he loved!Also the pineapple tart was very good.Staff are happy and friendly.Restaurant is very quiet. I’m not sure how you’d go with a rowdy bunch or very small toddlers/babies...perhaps it was just the night when we were there? We will be back!!!Show less

Author: 401christophhErfurt, Germany
Title: Satisfaction
Review: We went to have dinner on New Year’s Eve after reading the positive ratings on TA and it was really a delight. Try the lamb with biryani rice or assorted vegetables. The cheesecake was yummie as well!Show less

Author: Mai Phương A
Title: It's the best restaurant in Penang
Review: The space is very warm, the staff are so nice. The dishes are so delicious and not so expensive. If you stay at Georgetown, this is the best place for dining.

Author: Oriol C
Title: Very Poor
Review: We came here for new years eve. The food wasnt as expected and the service very average. Totally overrated.. Show less

Author: reettak2014
Title: Really good food
Review: Went for lunch and had hummus, the three sauce dish and jawi laksa. Sooo good! Especially the laksa, man, so delicious! Better than assam laksa imo. Super nice staff as well. Show less

Author: 578izmiriMoscow, Russia
Title: Spoiled place
Review: I think these guys are spoiled by this ranking. When visited the place 5 minutes ago with a coconut in my hands(was drinking its marvelous juice) i was told that it wasn’t allowed to come with “your own drinks”. I found it to be absolutely normal and was ready to get rid of it. But when i asked them to take it from me and dispose off it i was asked ... to leave the restaurant and find the recycle bin outside myself. When i told the manager that i didn’t see the bin at the entrance he said that it wasn’t his problem. Needlessly to say that me and my wife left the place immediately. So thank you Jawi House for poisoning my mood for the rest of the day. Show less

Author: Brian MMelbourne, Australia
Title: Wonderful Penang food
Review: Very very happy we went here for dinner. Themed old style Penang in a restored house and matched to a familiar menu but with some uniqueness too, like Lumeni rice. Flavors were really good and so was the quality of food. Portion size was a little strange as a couple of entrees were larger than our main. This meant too much food. Service was very good and the restaurant is smaller size so book. Show less

Author: michaelhH5372IGLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Lunchtime Chill
Review: It was nice to get off the hot and busy streets and into the cool, quiet and calm efficiency of this cosy eatery. The mango salad and hummus starters were excellent and biryani prawn, chicken and veg dishes were delicious. The toilet facilities were basic but clean. I would highly recommend but you would do well to book ahead as it doesn’t take much for this small charm to be busy and it is likely to be too hot to wait for any length of time.Show less

Author: rebeccakX3650KE
Title: Delicious feast and lots of yummy flavours!
Review: We ordered the rice with vegetable curry, the chicken curry, beef curry with rice and the hummus. It was allllll delicious! Couldn’t have asked for a better taste of little bits of everything. A great delight!

Author: M_2027
Title: Great vegetarian options
Review: I suggest this place for lunch. Many small dishes to order for variety. The starters, mains and desserts are all tasty! Must visit.

Author: shavaunne
Title: Superb!
Review: This is a must to visit if you want authentic quality food. Had the best mango salad! Well presented and authentic.

Author: dylanc220
Title: Clean and cosy, food is fantastic!
Review: Such a lovely place. Food is very good and healthy. And the price is relatively cheap for such quality!

Author: Farzad T
Title: A-must-try fusion
Review: The perfect Jawi Peranakan fusion experience (Malay-Middle Eastern). The Jawi lamb dish was spot on in satisfying my lamb cravings

Author: Zhaffi
Title: Great for authentic Jawi food
Review: Food was wonderfully great. Great and polite service staff. Attentive to all request and orders. Overall the briyani with beef was so smooth to eat. I am very particular about my beef and they have prove me wrong. The beef was superb nice!!!

Author: Abdullah N
Title: Best Place & Best Meals
Review: Best place to eat, very relaxing. I really enjoy with this place - frequent visit at least once a month. Ginger Tea & Red Velvet the most recommended.

Author: GerryC766
Title: Dinner
Review: Gluten free options given.  Teenager loved chicken curry.  Kids loved lemon tart.  Restaurant was full, glad we came early.  Will come again

Author: stockmktgeniusOrange County, CA
Title: Right near tourist sites!
Review: Really enjoyed the food, the service, everything. Not expensive, not a tourist trap. Near Lek Lok Si and lots of street art. If you go, try seeing if the table’s open in the second room, where they sell books and food. There was a special light that shined on it that made it look magical.Show less

Author: EllenNoronha
Title: Great place!!!
Review: Was a surprise! The food is very good, original Malay and very taste. Even for me that I'm not a spicy person, the staff could direct to the best choice (I had a lamb) and the flower rice is so good. The lemon tart was very good also! Good choice in Georgetown, good environment and service! Show less

Author: gospidinmilojkoBangkok, Thailand
Title: Would love to eat their food daily..
Review: If you wish excellent food we would recommend you Jawi House. The menu is not big but is gold worth. We prefer restaurants with less dishes as this way they will be excellent in all they offer.Don’t forget their dessert, lemon tartin Can wait until next visit Show less

Author: evs1305
Title: Lovely Lunch
Review: We stopped here for lunch after seeing reviews and it didn’t disappoint. I had the fish laksa and my boyfriend had the lamb stew. Both were lovely, but I’d definitely recommend the lamb. It was excellent food for the price (between 18 and 24 MYR).

Author: unclelumpyHingham, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent food and service
Review: Our lovely hotel recommended this place and we were most impressed. It’s a lovely local restaurant serving local food and the service is great too.They don’t serve alcohol so we had some locally brewed ginger beer which was the most gingery ginger beer we’ve ever tasted. We had the beef rendang and a chicken dish which was to die for. A must for anyone who likes the local food.Show less

Author: H1275WLmarkb
Title: Welcoming in an authentic setting
Review: Our work group enjoyed lovely local food set in a welcoming heritage style restaurant - great food st wonderful value

Author: Claireylou79London, United Kingdom
Title: Great food good prices!
Review: We visited here for dinner and shared the beef masala byriani, chicken curry (described as an add on) and extra papadoms! So glad we shared no way we couldn’t have eaten a byriani each! The food was great, service friendly. Note to diners that they don’t serve alcohol but don’t let this put you off as it is well worth a visit. Show less

Author: Jonathan JSan Francisco, California
Title: Nice experience with gluten free options
Review: A nice, clean restaurant with tasty food and efficient and pleasant staff. Understood my requests for no gluten and ended up with a tasty meal and lovely flan/creme caramel for dessert. The atmosphere could be a tad bit nicer if they turned down the lights a bit and added some nice music but overall a good dining experience with good food.Show less

Author: Felipe_BanSao Paulo, SP
Title: Amazing food!
Review: I had an amazing lamb with vegetables!! It wasREALLY good! The place is great, the staff polite and the music soft and nice. The only 2 things are that 1) since it’s a Muslim estatura the they don’t serve alcohol; 2) I’ve asked for a coffee at the end and they don’t have sweetener I would definitely come back!Show less

Author: JHND
Title: Wonderful.  Delicious food, great service
Review:
This is a wonderful restaurant.  It's peranakan with flair and creativity, the traditional ingredients and recipes with a difference. 

Lovely location too, interesting art work and great service.  We had a lovely evening there

Author: NpPeguero
Title: Abundant deliciousness
Review: Another good address in Penang is this jazzy music background restaurant. Very clean and elegant. The food is just so tasty ! You cannot avoid the Roti Surai at a starter (just order it while you are choosing you food).

Author: diubirdSingapore, Singapore
Title: Not your typical Peranakan restaurant
Review: My buddy recommended this restaurant to me and I assumed that it was the typical Peranakan restaurant serving dishes such as babi pongteh, ayam buah keluak, but I was wrong.Jawi House is an Arabic Peranakan restaurant which results in a different mix of dishes.The environment is extremely cosy and we would have loved to stay there for a longer period of time.Servings are not huge and its a little more pricey compared to the normal fare, but it was worth every cent.Show less

Author: IllianaAziz
Title: Delicious and superb!
Review: Cozy and unique restaurant! I love their food. Should try their laksa lemak, highly recommended! Nasi tomato and bubur chacha also not bad. Quiet place and relax. And most important is clean, including their toilet!

Author: Chantalle88
Title: Lovely restaurant
Review: What a lovely meal we had here! All dishes we ordered were really fragrant and looked amazing. It is a bit more expensive than other places in town, but it is definitely worth it as the food and service are good!

Author: ClaireM383
Title: Gorgeous little restaurant, great food!
Review: This restaurant has a really welcoming atmosphere. It is nicely decorated and I love the coloured windows at the front. The food arrived quickly and it was delicious. A good price too.

Author: Jnagaoka
Title: AMAZING
Review: What a gem- we LOVED visiting Jawi House! Do yourself a favor and get the Red Velvet Cake!!! :) The history and owner is incredible- do spend time with him if you have a chance!

Author: Ivek090
Title: Delicious!
Review: Beautiful restaurant with great service, nice atmosphere and delicious food. It's not the cheapest, but certainly worth the visit. I'd love to come back!

Author: 874harryh
Title: Very recommendable!
Review: Very tasty food, good prices and nice atmosphere. We came here twice because the food was simply delicious!

Author: AdlynAzizi
Title: Awesome but
Review: Remember to reserve a place beforehand because the tables are quite limited! Other than that, the food is AMAZING. Im a Malaysian, living in Selangor and their malaysian food is one of the best Ive tasted. Fun to see that the place is packed with tourists The ambience is perfect for dates and also families. 10/10 would recommend the Red Velvet Galette. Show less

Author: 81Jay
Title: Lunch time visit
Review: Fine dining. Beautiful serene surroundings. Ate delicious Malay food recommended by wait staff. Definitely worth a visit. Child friendly I think.

Author: SsuTianC
Title: Roti Surai and Malayan Seasonal Salad!
Review: Tasted a few stuff at this restaurant, but there was consensus among all the people I took to eat there that the Roti Surai (which is like Roti Jala) is the most delicious. Recently also tasted the Malayan Seasonal Salad and it was excellent too (with avocado tasting better than the ones I bought outside myself - maybe due to the pomegranate juice on it with papaya slices among the greens). May need to call ahead to ask whether stuff like the Roti Surai is available and book table because sometimes might be fully booked. Love the décor and staff is quite polite and service quite good too.Show less

Author: SingaporelonegrangerSingapore, Singapore
Title: Must return!
Review: Our hotel recommended it for our first dinner in Georgetown and we liked it so much we returned a second time.The food was highly spiced but the flavours were not overpowering and hot, reflecting the chef's skillful hand. Whilst we tried to order different dishes the second time, we repeated the order for the mango salad and herbal lemuni rice as we loved them so much.The biryani rice is also excellent and the prawn version deserves special mention. Every dish we ordered in any case, was wonderfully executed. Set in the heritage Georgetown, the ambience was fabulous. The best part was the great value for money.This is going to be my "must-go" when I return to Penang.Show less

Author: Andrea LGreater Sydney, Australia
Title: Always a wonderful meal!
Review: We can't visit Penang without visiting Jawi for at least a couple of meals and we are never disappointed. In fact we take all our guests there knowing they will love it just as much as we do. The food, Nuril and his charming staff all make it a special visit. Oh and don't forget to order their sublime lemon tart for dessert or just pop in and have a slice with a very good cup of coffee.Show less

Author: Davidlye70Singapore, Singapore
Title: Delicious Muslim Peranakan food
Review: It is right smack in the middle of UNESCO Armenian Street.Seating is limited.We had Bryani rice with prawns and chicken masala, both delicious.The nasi dagang with tuna curry was delicious too.Desserts wise, the red velvet galettes with cream were nice. I liked the almond, pineapple and coconut tart too; it does not have much pineapple.Show less

Author: tobyf80
Title: Must visit in Penang!
Review: Went for dinner. Had the laksa and lamb balmieh. Both were delicious, best dinner we've had on our six week trip. Lemon tart and red velvet galette were delightful, as was the wonderful service. Go early or book ahead, it gets busy. I  I'm

Author: aondra9c
Title: Delicious
Review: The best place in Penang!! Everything was perfect. Food, atmosphere, staff... I would like to eat there everyday!

Author: LinusNgNewton, Australia
Title: Excellent Lemuni rice and rendang
Review: We stopped by for lunch and was delighted with the food. we had Lemuni rice with rendang and Lemuni rice with curry chicken. Although both were outstanding, the amazingly tender rendang was my favourite. I also enjoyed the unusual but pleasant tasting Arabian Sherbet. Service was prompt and courteous. Highly recommended.Show less

Author: adliizhamaShah Alam, Malaysia
Title: A nice Malay restaurant
Review: Location is right smack in the middle of Georgetown. Parking is a problem if you are driving. Food are good. There are a lot of local dishes like Nasi Lemuni which I tried and was quite delicious, nasi beriani, nasi dagang, nasi tomato and other local favourites.Worth a try.Show less

Author: NGarrityKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Outstanding food, service and value
Review: I'm a relative novice at South East Asian food and perhaps am easily pleased, but I went with my Singaporean partner and two Malaysian friends who were as impressed as I was with the Peranakan food with more of a Malay twist, than the Chinese emphasis we are more used to.We had a selection of wonderful dishes which we were guided to by the excellent waiter.Lovely ambience and easy on the wallet.Cast iron recommendation!Show less

Author: Jeremy G
Title: Delicious food and amazing service
Review:
The restaurant provides amazing indian malay food. We had a bryiani and beef rendang, both were delicious. 
The waiting staff were passionate and  knowledgeable. 

The restaurant feels like you are eating in someone's home. Highly recommended.

Author: Macarena2730South Miami, Florida
Title: Hidden Gem!
Review: We stumbled onto this gem and we were so lucky! The staff was very friendly, service was great and the food was delicious. Their specialty is the Lemuni Rice and it was delish. The Prawn Briyani was also excellent. The decor was very nice to visit second floor or to use the bathrooms one must remove their shoes. Show less

Author: demalayboiPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: A Good Fusion of Malay and Indian Food
Review: I went to the place for lunch, never been there before, a first timer. Parking spot is very difficult to find nearby or in front of the restaurant, so if you wish to come here by car, I recommend you to park near Masjid Kapitan area and it will just take like 2-3 minutes walk from the mosque. The sevice is good; a waiter is already ready to open the door when you enter the restaurant. I ordered Jawi biryani lamb for main course, orange juice and yogurt cheese cake for dessert. The food was served like 15 minutes after ordering. Overall it was a good meal. The biryani really hit on the spot, the lamb was soft and tender, served together with a bowl of dhal/dalca curry that has a bit of sour and creamy flavor; not spicy at all. The cheese cake however can be consider just ok (as in the picture).The restaurant served a good blend of food from malay and a bit indian culture. So if you're looking and taste of local food, here is the place to be.Its already stated in the front door that they served halal food; so no pork or alcoholic products.Show less

Author: Janice MManchester, United Kingdom
Title: Great food, great service
Review: We turned up on a rainy Saturday night without a booking. They were really busy, but found us a table upstairs (which isn't really part of the restaurant). Despite being the only people upstairs the service was great & the food was really tasty & great value.Show less

Author: henrysusantiTanjung Tokong, Malaysia
Title: Unique culinary of Malaysia
Review: Located at heritage house of Georgetown, and within tourists spots area. Unique decor and food. The mix food between Nyonyah food, Indian and its unique Jawi speciality. We try almost all food in menu, good taste and we enjoy our lunch. My fave is serabai, mango salad, tomato rice with rendang, bubur chacha and sago pearl pudding. Friendly and helpful staff. Recommended for tourists or expat who like to explore Malaysia traditional culinary and heritageShow less

Author: aandlkchKuching, Malaysia
Title: Still just as good at Jawi House
Review: We always go to Jawi House when in Penang and the staff remember us immediately. It is always a pleasure to see Nuril the owner again.We went for dinner on 2 evenings during this visit, and the food was as good as ever, and likewise the service.It is best to book as this is a very popular restaurant, deservedly so.Show less

Author: FahmeedFR
Title: Classy, cozy little place
Review: Its a beautiful place with lots of art here and there. very close to the armenian street attractions so thats another plus. The staff are also very polite. Food is not bad, but nothing to write home about either.

Author: anisemayoJenjarom, Malaysia
Title: Delicious and affordable
Review: We had too much of nasi kandar for our trip so we decided to try something else. After visiting the street art, khoo kongsi temple, we go further up n reached this restaurant. We didn't do any reservation so we actually have no place to sit when we reached. Luckily the staff able to squeeze us a spot. Since it was out first time there, i read all the reviews here, while asking the waitress on wat to eat. We ordered laksa, lemuni rice and i forgot another dish. All of it was so delicious!!All total of rm69 only! Recommended for those who want to taste something different in penang!Show less

Author: 240jeanmarct
Title: Best restaurant in town
Review: If you are looking for a great meal, come to Jawi house on Armenian st. it is a Middle East Muslims / Malay influentes food. Great dishes, very nice staff. Best quality / Price place. Local Flavours at its best. !! Go there and you won't be disappointed. Try many dishes as we did from mango salad to bryani beef. Show less

Author: arthil_11Manila, Philippines
Title: best in georgetown
Review: During my stay in Georgetown, I was focused on the street food but decided to vary my dining by trying a few restaurants, picking from recommendations in Tripadvisor and my Rough Guide. Of the ones I tred, by far the best was Jawi House Cafe. In the first place, both the location on Armenian St, for me one of the best areas in old Georgetown, and the cosy but elegant atmosphere of the cafe were conducive to an appreciative mood. The food, different from both street food and other Malaysian restaurants I have tried, was a wonderful new experience for me. The lemuni rice with chicken curry was superb and the lemon tart was perhaps the best I've tasted. Best was the very friendly service by the smiling girls attending to me, who even gave me an impromptu explanation of the varieties of peranakan cuisine (seeing "peranakan" in the restaurant's signage, I had assumed it meant nyonya). If I find myself back in Georgetown, a revisit is definitely in the cards.Show less

Author: angkolaindradewahJakarta, Indonesia
Title: Authentic cozy restaurant
Review: Came to this restaurant after see the review in TripAdvisor. I ordered laksa, but it taste not as I expected for a laksa. I tried many version of laksa, but I can not recalled ever having like here. But if you food adventurer, you might try this. When I eat, it seems many herbs came to your tongue and dancing in your mouth. Combination of unknown herbs make the taste is very unique. I give 3 star for Laksa, as it came not as I expected, and if possible 5 for the place.Show less

Author: Alex_yong98
Title: Antique environment and good food
Review: The environment of the shop is classic and antique... Waitress is patient and professional when recommending food to us. Foods were delicious. Definitely will come back again.

Author: T00ts10Cranbrook, United Kingdom
Title: Good recommendation
Review: Recommended by our hotel. Good evening stroll along Armeniam Street and spotted some street art. Jawi House is a tradition Paransakan Muslim restaurant in an origianal house. Like eating in someone's house. Food was excellent and tried their signature Herbal Lemuni rice with Beef Masala and Lentil rice with vegetable curries. Both recommended. Very friendly staff. Interesting range of cookbooks and prints in the backroomShow less

Author: AlexL84Southampton, United Kingdom
Title: Delightful
Review: On a visit to George Town we selected Jawi House from the reviews and its location to the Street Art.It is a quaint restaurant which is well furnished and very clean.The Waitress was so polite and well mannered.My wife started with the Hummus and Bread followed by The Prawn Biryani and a Creme Caramel for desert.I ordered Roti Surai to start and Lamb Biriyani for mains.Every element of the order was delightful.With a drink each the total was MR 111.Outstanding value.Show less

Author: Nicole Y
Title: Close your eyes to taste the signature dish
Review:
The Lemuni Rice, mildly fragrance with lemuni leaves and blue telang flowers. 
Like the interior deco, traditional... old enough yet clean

Author: popcin22
Title: Just OK
Review: As much as I wanted to like the food based on the reviews, unfortunately it was just average. The staff was lovely however      as was the setting. The chicken curry was better than the lamb dish, which was essentially boiled lamb in a broth.

Author: Haluk-Gulsun
Title: Good food, cosy atmosphere
Review: When you do not feel like having any more street food, Jawi House would be the best option. Good food, nice people, feels like eating with the family. Hummus is a must, also nice meals as well as delicious deserts..

Author: Sandemahuman
Title: Very Nice!
Review: Why eat anywhere else when you can enjoy the ambience and wonderfully prepared food at Jawi House Cafe? Even the side salads that came with the quiche and sandwiches were excellent. And the yoghurt cheese cake made a great finish to the meal.

Author: JoziAudreyJohannesburg
Title: Delicious!
Review: My husband and I were divided over the best bits of the meal - he loved the babaganoush, I thought the hummus was to die for. I refused to share my Bamieh lamb stew, but he had eyes for nothing but his beef rendang. So all in all, no complaints here! I was really surprised that it was almost empty - this restaurant is a treat.Show less

Author: LinLing03
Title: Great hole in the wall
Review: Good food and great service. The chicken curry is bone-in chicken. The chef is very friendly and extremely humble.

Author: dylahshukranSingapore
Title: Good food with great ambience
Review: We truly enjoyed our lunch. Great ambience! Having done a lot of walking in tt area, hunting for the street art, we deserved that yummy plates of rice. My family of 6 ordered different types of 'nasi' - nasi tomato, nasi lamuni, nasi kerabu, etc. Good food - simply syiok. And the Sago Gula Melaka was superb!Show less

Author: donaldf673
Title: Good Halal restaurant with added art gallery upstairs
Review: We ate a banquet here - it was very tasty with a wide-ranging buffet available. It doesn't serve alcohol but does serve some unusual and very sweet non-alcoholic drinks!

Author: Shirley SChichester, United Kingdom
Title: What a disappointment after rave reviews here!
Review: The other 4 tables looked as if they we occupied by TripAdvisor readers! All of us there under false pretences! Having said that the starter- a trio of hummus and aubergine etc.was v.good. Be advised they do not serve alcohol! No complaints about the service.I chose the lamb stew which was 3 small pieces of mutton swimming in a rich tomato flavoured gravy served with 3 large slices of 'doorstop' white buttered toast! Hubby had the beef rengang and lemony rice- very small portion of beef but he thought it was OK. There is no atmosphere and the whole place seems very amateurish.We paid 100 ringgits and left.Show less

Author: Susangermany
Title: Excellent....
Review:
taste of different dishes like mutton, beef and chicken. The salad is fresh and delicious. After lunch we all had a good taste in our mouth!!
Light and delicious lunch! We come back!
Service is fast and reasonable prices!

Author: kapuchin
Title: ho hum home cooking
Review: Nothing particularly special to recommend about the food though service was good. Expensive for what was offered.

Author: rathin2017
Title: The Duchess Travel Wing at The Jawi House
Review: 21of the Duchess Traveller had a sumptuous lunch here.fabulous authentic food.we loved it.thank u so much Chef Nuril and Dato Dr Wazir Kareem.we will definitely come back .thank u

Author: tbayu0826
Title: A little oasis after exploring the town
Review: Found this restaurant after exploring Armenian street. The interior was very cosy. Ordered nasi biryani with ayam rose, laksa, and prawn biryani. The taste was good. The service were attentive and friendly.  The price for meal were reasonable. Very satisfied with this restaurant.

Author: fandy1983
Title: Lovely restaurant.
Review:
Good services from the staff. Nice food especially the laksa and bamieh.
Too bad the lemuni rice is sold out

Author: alongsjMalaysia
Title: A Hidden Gem
Review: The cafe is small and quaint and absolutely cosy. The food is scrumptious. I can only recommend everything because what we ordered was delicious and filling. Do yourself a favour and go eat here. Upstairs is an art gallery, showcasing some beautiful art pieces (some are for sale).Show less

Author: FoodtalkSinSin
Title: A Night In Gathering As In Salvaging This Jawi House's Unique Cafe
Review: Friendly service, with good local and English speaking host in attendance. Quite a cosy ambience in atmosphere for a gathering of new & old acquaintances for a night's fellowship as in salvaging the uniqueness of this Jawi House Cafe's offering of its unique cuisine cooking as in presentation. The dishes in offer are quite 'challenging' for the 'taste buds' of the 'adventurers as in explorers', but, are quite in liking and loved for by most of the locals, to say the least. These so said authentic unique Dishes of the Jawi come in many forms recommended by the host upon requests.Show less

Author: peternC8393KV
Title: Heaven on a Plate
Review: All I can say is do yourself a favour and try the food. Anything said here is pointless. Go there and let the food do the talking.

Author: 759alastairwDominican Republic
Title: Gem of a restaurant
Review: Came here for lunch after an excellent walking tour the restaurant has a beautiful spotless interior. The food was fragrant flavoursome and authentic Malay Cuisine do not be put off by the picture menuThe restaurant was recommended by our guide who had given us the best guided walking tour of an city I have visited and her recommendation was spot onShow less

Author: Emma D
Title: Fresh and crispy
Review: Food was so good went back twice. We ordered. Hummus, babaganosh, mango salad, malay salad, trio of vege dish and lentil rice. Our friends ordered pumpkin soup and chilli sambal fish. Everything was well made and presented well. Environment was clean. Was only 150Rm for 5 of us including drinks. Great value for equality food. We didn't like a the prawn fritters even though it was probably made correctly it wasn't too our liking.Show less

Author: Kinabalu-LouNome, Alaska
Title: Artful
Review: Our meal this evening was nothing short of wonderful. The food was prepared in a most artful manner, with a finesse you will seldom if ever find at an outdoor Malay food stall. The ingredients are blended in a well balanced manner and everything is fresh. The salads were as delicious as any we've had in Asia, and the other dishes were equally amazing. And the staff was spot on with their recommendations and very helpful. We will probably return tomorrow for lunch!Show less

Author: BrianQuaglia
Title: Great food and enjoyed the visit
Review:
Stopped in fir dinner after business meeting and had a great dinner 

Food was good and had excellent service

Food: good
Portions: not large
Quality: excellent
Cleanliness: good
Service: excellent
Atmosphere: great, modern, good for picture taking 

HIGHLY RECOMMEND FOR A GREAT MEAL!!

Author: Laksh85Singapore, Singapore
Title: For Briyani lovers
Review: After reading rave reviews about this restaurant, we decided to check it out as I'm an ardent fan of briyanis. There are many variants to Briyani like the Moghulai, Lucknowi, Afghani, Nasi Kebuli and many more. Jawi house serves one of such variants. We ordered chicken Briyani, prawn Briyani, sherbet, lemon grass drink, Malay cake for dessert. The chicken Briyani came with generous portion of braised meat garnished with fried onions and cashew nuts, papadom, sweet pickle/achar and dalcha by the side. The prawn Briyani came well cooked prawns and hard-boiled eggs. The Briyani was bursting with flavours, the fried onions and cashew nuts gave crunchy texture to the food. The chicken was well cooked and tender while the dalcha (lentil based curry) had the usual veggies but with the tinge of coconut milk added an unique touch to it.The drinks were buck the trend type and dessert was tasty too. The service was attentive and the food was reasonably priced Overall, it's a must try place for all Briyani lovers. Show less

Author: LinnaTeng
Title: Great Jawi Food
Review:
Must try the Red Velvet cream Cheese Dessert. Is great.

The Nasi Bryiyani are nice.

Just abit hard to find parking space.

Author: Nurhuda N
Title: Jawi Laksa
Review: I came all the way to taste Jawi Laksa after I saw the making of it on Ainsley Eats The Street on Discovery Travel; cooked by the chef himself. It is appetizing to see, what more the taste is delicious.
