This is my second visit, the first in June to view the artworks, and this second time to try the Jawi Peranakan cuisine.My meal was very simple : a drink of Penang Nutmeg and Lime (RM8) while waiting for the entrée, Balmieh - lamb stewed in tomatoes and herbs, served with okras, and Benggali bread (a very popular local version of crusty bread)(RM15); dessert was Rooibos tea infused with vanilla essence and a complimentary piece of cake with orange zest (RM10). The meal cost me RM33. It was an appetising experience of Jawi Peranakan cuisine. The rooibos tea was heavenly. I had the opportunity to chat with both the owner and the young chef, who happily allowed me a sampling of another entrée I was curious about - Herbal Lemuni rice w chicken curry, cucumber, egg, and sambal. The rice was unusual, flavoured with a local flower, the bunga telang or blue pea.Hopefully the menu will expand soon and I will definitely try out more of this cuisine.The café owner is also an anthropologist and if one is lucky to meet her she may educate one on the Jawi Peranakan culinary traditions. Or else one can buy a coffee table book with both the sociology of the foods and the recipes. I bought a book, signed and autographed by the owner and the young chef. Since it is a café, the menu also offers hot and cold drinks, snacks and salads, sandwiches, and cakes, good for walk in tourists exploring the area.Business hours are 10am to 7pm daily, closed on Sundays. No dinners unless prearranged.Parking was a hassle. The first time I was there, I went by taxi, actually to view other art galleries in the same street. This time I had to park a block away. Walking tourists will have no such problem.Show less

Author: yukeshwarandPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Got to try their Steamed Fish Fillet!
Review: Ordered their Steamed Fish topped with their special sauce, cilantro and a handful of ginger. Paired with a side of white rice, it was a nudge towards perfection! Love the mild Asian flavours and the ginger slices offered a balanced kick to the dish. Big portion too! Show less

Author: jessye3000
Title: A pleasant place for a light meal
Review: A pleasant place for a light meal in Little India. Plus, the building has cool history as an old Chinese medicine shop. I had a nice mushroom soup. Lots of healthy options.

Author: L2485IMianp
Title: just when you thought there wasn't a decent bar/bistro in Little India
Review: Well this is it: chilled beer and great snacks in a heritage location. A great place to get your bearings when you have just arrived or to get out of the mad dog heat of the day.

Author: Heli PHelsinki, Finland
Title: Old world charm
Review: The white corner building in the center of Little India used to house a medical company, the paraphernalia of old activity has been kept for athmosphere. I come here for lunch in their open space restaurant downstairs from the boutique hotel. The tilapia was cooked excellently with ginger, I ordered some steamed vegetables as extra.Show less

Author: desoztopperKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: nice place, hipsters should not come to ruin it
Review: nice comfortable place, good western and local food, not that cheap, but not overly expensive, nice place to lounge around and read some left behind books, check out the shop next door, more of a back packer friendly atmosphere then a pretentious fake hipster atmosphere, so you are nor subject to people posing with their tatoos and piercings and hardos and beards and so on....hopefully it stays that wayShow less

Author: sangeetk2015
Title: A sugar craving!
Review: I've not had the food here but I had the brownie and it was amaamazing!!the best part it was really cheap and a great size. the decor is great! a must visit!

Author: marwat111
Title: Great, trendy café and restaurant near Little India - perfect coffee
Review: We were desperate for a sitdown and a coffee and found Bistro Tang by chance. The welcome was warm and we ordered coffee and a homemade brownies. Both coffee and cake were wonderful  - definitely recommend

Author: PSurret
Title: Hipster café
Review: We stopped by chance on this cool hipster café. Loved it, the retro furniture, great café and amazing brownie. Very nice welcome and service too. Nice break from walking in the heat.

Author: Eathereplease
Title: Great Laska
Review: It was our first time trying Laska and we really enjoyed it. Reasonable prices and nice clean atmosphere. The server was very friendly.

Author: 111kennyc
Title: Good environment and nice food
Review: Highly recommend for local delicious menu. The laksa very special and delicious. It like curry laksa mix with Asam laksa.

Author: CaseeeLSManjimup, Australia
Title: Awesome awesome awesome!!!
Review: Came here after reading reviews on TripAdvisor. Can’t seem to find the place on a map for some reason, so catch a Grab to wonderfood or something near little India and walk. Firstly, there was no one in the restaurant when we arrived at around 6.30pm. At tentative staff, good menu of different meals like western, Asian, Indian. Something for everyone I found. We ordered the pulled beef salad, the lamb curry wrap, an iced tea and an iced coffee. Man I did not think the food would be SOOOOOO good!!! Meal sizes were awesome, came out so quickly, the salad was super fresh and had yum stuff on it like vinegerette, tomatoes, olives. Lamb curry wrap - jingies. Soooooo good. Warm, soft, tasty, I could have had two honestly. Served with a side salad, delicious. The iced tea was great it was literally ice cold black tea so refreshing in the heat. Partner had iced coffee, was beautiful and bitter and cold. Can’t get good coffee in Malaysia we’ve found but this was so yum. And the price all up - 55ringit. Cheap!! Will recommend anyone to come here for sure. Don’t be put off by hardly any people in there, they’re probably getting street food (which is awesome) but this place is great too and a nice change, a good place to sit and rest your feet. Thanks so much for having us. Show less

Author: LuuuumSydney, Australia
Title: Amazing laksa *_*
Review: I had an amazing time in that restaurant The laksa is absolutely delicious, and I had the desert with meringue and passion: everything was just really, like really good.By far the best restaurant I’ve been so far around If you like gin, try some of theirs as they are also delicious Show less

Author: dickenswwHong Kong, China
Title: One of the best Laksa i had in Penang
Review: My girl friend and I come with high expectation and we are not disappointed with the food. Ranked #16 restaurant in Penang in TripAdvisor but personally I will say its one of my favorite. I ordered Bistro Tang Laksa and it comes thick and full of fish puree, with a hand full of mint, onion, cilantro and other greens. It was a laksa you won't forget.One thing to pick on was the waitress don't quite know difference between "brew coffee" and "instant coffee". I reconfirmed by asking is the white coffee brewed since I paid for an overpriced white instant coffee in Lovelane, I even told her the story and she answered their white coffee is brewed. And you guessed it, it finally comes with another cup of instant coffee.Show less

Author: Heli PHelsinki, Finland
Title: Excellent fish lunch
Review: The furniture is custom made resembling 1950's vintage creating a homely atmosphere mixed with old equipment of the Chinese pharmaceutical company which owned the premises of the restaurant and boutique hotel. Lately it has been hard to find fish on the menu so I was delighted by the steamed Tilapia served with ginger, the best food this far on Penang. The front of the room opens straight to the busy streets of Little India, the ceiling fans create a nice temperature level. Service was very friendly and attentive, prices reasonable.Show less

Author: wouter0011
Title: Great ambiance
Review: Discovered this place the first day I visited George Town. Since then I visited three days in a row for some delicious drinks and the great ambiance.

Author: martinhelmantel
Title: Cozy place for a drink
Review: Strolling downtown Georgetown we found this place by coincidence. Cozy place to have a drink and a bite. Some different types of beer and wine on the menu. Some local food as well.

Author: lachlanj1Ipswich, Australia
Title: great food ... something for all tastes
Review: My wife and I recently stayed at Ren i Tang for about 8 nights, so we had a number of meals that included lunches and dinners. I cannot recall any food that was not fresh and very tasty. That they serve a variety of food was a saving grace, as my wife is not fond of spicy foods and I'll try anything. The laksa and curries were up there with some of the best that I tasted on our 28 day trip and my wife swore by the pulled beef salad.The location of the bistro is great ... on a busy corner in Little India ... yet, once you are inside it becomes a refuge from the (enjoyable) chaos of the busy street.In sync with what you come to expect from Ren i Tang, the service is always friendly and the food arrives quite quickly.Show less

Author: s0us0uradaKastoria, Greece
Title: A Oasi in the center
Review: Amazing place,nice decoration very vintage!The girl that serve us was very kind and professional.We had 8 plates all different all of them was very good!We was very lucky that we have found this place.Upstairs there are also rooms for rent.It is in a very nice zone in George Town.Show less

Author: alsuk84Croydon, United Kingdom
Title: Great find!
Review: Great find in the hustle and bustle of Little India. Staff friendly and attentive, loved the old colonial feel of the building. Had a lamb curry and chicken satay, both which had fantastic flavours, and all at reasonable prices. Definitely one to try if you are in the area. Show less

Author: stuffmatters
Title: Relaxed lunch spot.
Review: Bistro Tang in the heart of Little India is a relaxed spot to enjoy a beer and lunch. It’s comfortable, has a fun vibe and a menu comprising both local favourites and western comfort food.

Author: Meryem MParis, France
Title: Historical atmosphere and delicious food
Review: We stopped for launch and for some fresh air after a long wander in the heat of George Town. We had a delicious local meal with some refreshing beverages. The place still holds the furniture of the ancient Chinese medicine store that it was. It creates a special historical atmosphere. Show less

Author: vivadramPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Gorgeous food
Review: They have such a charming set up. We love the food and every time we bring guests here, they fall in love too. We have yet to stay at the hotel but the bistro itself is wonderful. They have quality Asian cuisine that is big on taste and a creative selection of drinks. The weather outside may be scorching or pouring but the atmosphere is just magical and perfect for wanting to wilt away the afternoon and enjoy each others company, create, absorb or just be.Show less

Author: Davidlye70Singapore, Singapore
Title: Food, coffee and history
Review: In an authentically restored Chinese medicine hall from the 19th century, this bistro is below a 3-star bed and breakfast inn. There is no air-conditioning but plenty of ceiling and standing fans in the bistro.There are a small museum of the Chinese medicine hall and a cosy garden between the bistro/inn and the kitchen. Its menu offers both local and Western. The herbal soup either mushroom or chicken with flour vermicelli or rice was good, so was the nyonya curry chicken served with rice. Portions on the small side. If you have space for dessert the brownie was delicious and tasted freshly made.Staff was very friendly and helpful.Worth another visit.Show less

Author: lindy1993
Title: Delicious!
Review: A true “hidden” gem in Little India. The food is beyond delicious (we tried the Lhaksa, Nyonya chicken, bruschetta and brownie). Staff members are extremely kind, the service is fast and the restaurant is very clean and beautifully decorated. You will not regret going here!

Author: Los_Bubus
Title: Great for a midday break
Review: Excellent ambient and cozy place. Good selection of refreshing teas. Great and fast service. Totally recommended.

Author: I1498AUandreaa
Title: A bit dissapointing
Review:
This restaurant is located in Little India and it's a very cute spot.

The service was ok and we didn't have to wait long for our food, but nothing was to tasty. We tried some dips, chicken noodles and salmon rosti.

The wifi wasn't working.

Author: BSmith25
Title: Delicious food
Review:
We had lunch here on arriving to George Town and it was absolutely delicious - the laksa was particularly good!
Really friendly service and a great drinks selection including a gin and tonic menu.

Author: lizbogar130
Title: A great experience in Georgetown, Malaysia
Review: This was a very unique restaurant with wonderful food!  I had smoked salmon served over hash brown potatoes.  It was wonderful!  My friend and family members had various dishes, all of which were very good!

Author: JohnandBridgetTauranga, New Zealand
Title: Average
Review: Went on a quiet evening so only 1 other table occupied by a guy the waitress seemed to know quite well..We had a lamb curry which was more like a stew and bland and yee me with chicken which had nice flavours..drinks were also nice..unfortunately everything was let down by the service..the waitress was more concerned about making eyes at the guy at another table that we didn’t get any service..we never got offered desert so just left and went elsewhere...Show less

Author: Mary_Basset
Title: Nice little bar
Review:
We had nice deserts & gin (they have a gin menu for those who like me, enjoy a nice G&T) 
I would recommend it, nice place.

Author: Beeteeyork
Title: Worth a visit
Review:
Stopped off for a drink and a light snack. Good menu, tasty chicken satay. Calamansi freeze a delight. 
Doesn’t look much from outside but great for a drink or a light meal. Free water and WiFi.

Author: Trine K
Title: Love this place!
Review: I had the veggie wrap and mango smoothie everyday while visiting penang. Fantastic food! And the girls working there were so nice. Love this place!

Author: Arnoud d
Title: Great indian fusion food!
Review: We had dinner twice with our young kids sitting at a low table on pillows in the back of the restaurant. Relaxing calme atmosphere, games and toys available to entertain your kids. A real holiday feeling. Food is also great!!!

Author: lawc22
Title: restaurant with a heritage vibes
Review:
The laksa served was good.. full of flavors and near-to the local laksa lemak.
Service is good and the cafe settings in the middle of busy little india makes all the vibes and characters.

Author: David_from_Bristol
Title: Wonderful Laksa
Review: A lovely relaxed place to while away an hour. I had a Laksa which was tasty and full of goodness and a tiger beer that was, well, a tiger beer. The Calamansi Freeze looked refreshing though.

Author: TxabibiPulau Tioman, Malaysia
Title: Great food
Review: Even if the bistro was over crowded due to Chinese New Year, the crew was very friendly, and managed to serve us properly, with a smiling face.They do not have a lot of beer, just a Tiger and a Franziskaner, but the selection of Gin is very nice.Regarding food, herbal soup mushrooms, herbal soup chicken, tomato soup, satay chicken and lamb curry were delicious. All dishes were served within the same time , were very tasty, spicy but not too hot for the curry... a real enjoyment for your taste buds !!!Show less

Author: Laura179Madrid, Spain
Title: Cozy accommodation and very yummy food!
Review: We stayed with my family for 4 days and rent out 3 bedrooms. Hotel is walking distance for all the main things to visit.Rooms cozy, confortable, quiet and the staff very helpful and friendly. Love the breakfasts, lemonades and food! I will recommend to my friends in KL.Show less

Author: tudora380
Title: They had soup
Review: The eastern cuisine is pretty ok, although a bit expensive. Don't order anything European, as they have no idea how to cook it. Our schnitzel was undercooked, even the second time. The local cuisine menu items have quite small portions.

Author: puneet_mishraKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Hmmm.....
Review: It was rated pretty highly and we walked in , quite disappointing , I guess that we asked in at 3 pm was also partly responsible for this. The decor is quite nicely restored and you have various options for seating. I am sure there are things that please a lot of patrons but the Nyonya curry was pretty sad and did not feel that it was fresh, the wraps were quite oily and full of eggplant All in all a bit disappointing late lunchShow less

Author: Steven B
Title: Quality Meal
Review: I order a fresh lemonade (9 RM) and the baked potato wedges (13 RM) as an appetizer. To my surprise, the lemonade came from a carton, and tasted as such, so there was nothing "fresh" about it. The potato wedges were quite tasty with a good flavor of lemon and black pepper. I then ordered the fish and chips (24 RM). The portion size was great and the quality was spot on. Good crispy breading and well cooked fries. Would I eat here again? Yes, definitely. The staff were friendly and the environment was relaxing. Well worth stopping by for a meal.Show less

Author: LiJames77Sanya, China
Title: Pleasant lunch
Review: This restaurant has an airy and welcoming ambience, situated as it is, within an old colonial commercial building, you can somehow tell that the food will be good just by setting foot inside. Their fish and chips was well done, the chips nothing special but the fish flavourful, well cooked and battered, as only an Englishman can judge! My wife's laksa was unfortunately not to her taste, but to my mind it was aromatic and looked colourful and well prepared.Show less

Author: Bryan HPortland, Oregon
Title: Did the trick ...
Review: After a hassle of a day, we wanted a dinner that was relaxing, no-stress and tasty. The Bistro Tang was the perfect answer! Reasonable prices added to the dinner. We had a sweet potato/pumpkin soup that was subtle and out of this world. The Fish and Chips were bountiful for the price, and the food arrived in a timely manner in spite of the warning from the servers that it would take "20 minutes" for the fish and chips. I would urge them to get another veggie option on the menu that contained tempeh, nuts or tofu. My vegetarian wrap was tasty, but I wanted a bit more protein for dinner. The service was informal and friendly ... and the decor interesting and soothing -- especially given that the chaos of George Turn churned just a few yards away.Make the journey and check them out!Show less

Author: RobinAnn44
Title: Relaxing & tranquil
Review: Enjoyed the relaxed atmosphere so much one night with a friend that I went back alone the next night. The food was super, and the service was very nice too!

Author: 517imrank
Title: Chilled out place
Review:
Went there with my boys and they had bangers and mash which was all great 
Staff were really friendly and the venue is so relaxed felt like in Barbados

Author: DewOnTheRoadSacramento, California
Title: Nice little bistro in Little India
Review: The dining area is kept comfortable with fans, but no AC. The menu consists of some local fare as well as western dishes. The laksa was good, chicken snitzel was fair, and chicken curry was average. A small selection of beer and wine by the glass (1 red and 1 white) are available. Service is good.Show less

Author: Amanda C
Title: The Laksa is delicious!
Review: I went to Bistro Tang specifically to try their laksa, based on reading past reviews. I was not disappointed! The soup is perfectly spiced and beautifully presented. My friend had the pumpkin soup which she enjoyed, and the vegetable wrap which was okay but had too much oil in it.Show less

Author: IsabellangeMoute
Title: Great lunch .. nice and welcoming restaurant
Review: Tasty food. We had the lamb which was very good .. not a lot of meat on the sauce though ...so for the price they should consider make the portions bigger.  Wehad a very nice dessert with meringue and passion fruit. We recommend.

Author: renee6764Singapore, Singapore
Title: quaint
Review: we stayed at the ren i tang and dropped by bistro tang for an afternoon coffee before heading upstairs to our room. we had a lovely latte and honey lemon tea, sat on the comfy cushions at the back of the room and chilled. lovely staff and music played in the background.Show less

Author: S1827RFmanuelb
Title: Very good
Review: Good beer and good main dishes. Very good environment and a very nice and fast service. I will return.

Author: Nancy BFranklin, North Carolina
Title: We went back!
Review: My friends had been there last year, and they wanted to show us this great restaurant. And we went back twice on this trip-so you know it has to be good. We were there for both lunch and dinner. They offer a large variety on their menu. The food was great and the people were very friendly.Show less

Author: donnie1965Bridestowe, United Kingdom
Title: Our favourite place to eat in Georgetown.
Review: Not my first review for this great eating establishment and if I wrote a review for each visit I'd be on trip advisor every day during our many Georgetown visits. It's great; it's fantastic.The food is well prepared and tastes delicious.The staff are friendly and always aim to please.My favourite is still the tomato soup and a plate of French fries!!!But I can confidently state the rest of the menu is very very good food.The ambience is great; the decor perfect and as a final compliment, the Wi-Fi is very fast, which is a nice change to the usual slowish speed found in many places.It'll be a while before we can return, but everyone at BT, Sabine and Donnie will be back one day.Show less

Author: drdamien
Title: Great little gem
Review: Had a few dishes and all of them were great! Friendly staff great deco and awesome food. Highly recommended and we will definately be back

Author: LoungerLondon
Title: Warm Welcome Good Food
Review: Just needed somewhere close to hotel on our first night and walked into here. Warm welcome, good service, nice wine and delicious food. Very cheap and great value. If you are passing here it's worth a quick meal.

Author: Adammor
Title: Lovely little find
Review: Just stumbled across this wonderful little cafe. Well worth a visit if you are in the area. Cold beer, cakes and friendly staff. I will be back

Author: Mauricemerguez
Title: Cute coffee shop
Review: Good fruit shake, cute place, nice staff, we've spent some time in this place and even came back a couple of times.

Author: rafharoldTangalle, Sri Lanka
Title: A trendy & relaxed place.
Review: We visited Bistro Tang twice. A beautiful resorted house with antic items and a modern trendy touch. The staff is very friendly and helpful ( they even organized a taxi for us ). The menu is quiet large with a mix of European and Asian food for reasonable prices. The food we had was delicious. The day after we came for a drink and it was nice to come back during day time. Sitting in the front part, having a beer and a cigaret and looking to the traffic and people outside on the street.If you are looking for a nice place with good food ... Bistro Tang is the place to go.Show less

Author: rybkaanka
Title: A laksa to die for
Review: Adding to a chorus of already great reviews. Delicious high quality fusion food at a decent price. Excellent music too. A laksa to die for but very sumptuous so if you go for laksa don't take anything else. Definitely recommended

Author: Fjodolf1
Title: Was actually looking for indian food
Review: This place got good reviews as an indian place on Trip Adv. Not much indian on the menu. More malay take on indian and western food. Got some slow cooked chicken/lamb which was very good. Pleasant staff. Good coffee!

Author: vien d
Title: Super cute staff and delicious food
Review: We've stayed in George town for 5 days and we've had dinner in this restaurant 3 times!!! The staff is super cute and caring. Delicious food and gorgeous atmosphere. A gem of George town

Author: caleva-travels
Title: Delicious Satay
Review: Very good chicken satay, we went back for a second time for satay! Nice spot to sit and watch people!

Author: JensC725
Title: Great food, good vibe!
Review: I had dinner in this nice restaurant, in which both Western and Oriental food are served! Satay and curry can be recommended. Bistro has a good traveller vibe and is situated in a vivid street in Little India!

Author: Sincy TKuala Lumpur, Wilayah Persekutuan, Malaysia
Title: Impromptu Dinner visit
Review: This play caught my attention as there serve fusion food besides typical cafe menu. I came to try their signature Bistro Tang Laksa. Overall taste is good and is different from Penang Asam laksa. It taste like nyonya laksa. But the soup or gravy was too little and I have to request for additional soup which have additional charges.. cost around Rm5 (as mention by the waitress) Anyway, quite a cool place to chill during chilling weather as open concept with hanging ceiling fan (no air-con).Cool decoration with antique and recycle furnitures... Show less

Author: Shakti_WLPokhara, Nepal
Title: East meets West place
Review: While I was eating the most traditional Yin Oi Tang Herbal Mushroom Soup with Rice, the one next to me was eating Fish and Chips, and both of us, one as a Chinese and another one as an English said the food were both very good. Indeed, a very interesting place where east meets west.On top, this is a very beautiful building, renovating from the 124 years old Yin Oi Tang Chinese Medical Hall, they tried to upcycle as many materials as they can, so you can see in this place the elements of old chinese shophouses as well as the contemporary cafe style. Don't miss the little museum inside the hall. And don't miss their homemade ice-cream as well, it is really yummy!Show less

Author: DariHeu
Title: lovely food and nice atmosphere
Review: the plates were very delicious and i would totally go to this Bistro again! if your very hungry, you better not go for the wrap, it's rather small. my plate had a good size tho. the staff was nice too

Author: Johannes03
Title: tasty, nice ambience
Review: good food, nice smoothies. Average to high prcie level. The choice is quite limited but the nice interior and friendly staff easily make of for this. Books to read and games to play are laying on th eshelves for guests to ue during the visit.

Author: junjunvanVancouver, Canada
Title: Hidden Gem in George Town
Review: Needed a resting place from toasting hot afternoon & we walked into this time capsule. Tastefully restored from original Chinese Medicine Wholesaler Shop to a Cafe/Boutique Hostel/Museum. Very impressed and credit to this new owner for preserving original structure and sparing a corner to display authentic artifacts. Highly recommend for afternoon tea or morning coffee! And chicken satay is super juicy and yummy!Show less

Author: Jan Willem tNijmegen, The Netherlands
Title: A pleasant tea stop
Review: We feared to dry out after a long walk through the world heritage center of Georgetown so we decided to drink a tea in this bistro. A nicely decorated tea room and very friendly waitress 5/5. The furniture is attractively and comfortable, the place is clean and cosy 5/5.We ordered ice tea. 5/5. There are many dishes on the menu but we came just to drink something. The bistro is inviting and once in the region again we will come back for sure and try some food.Show less

Author: ElMarrana
Title: Beautiful place, great food
Review: Bistro Tang is a beautiful decorated place, nice vibe. They offer a menu with original dishes, western as well as eastern choices. Very nice people. Recommendation!

Author: prudeePerth, Australia
Title: So good, been here twice in 2 days!
Review: No faults at all. The mushroom soup with noodles was tasty and a filling main. The passion fruit meringue comprised a sticky, sweet meringue base which perfectly offset the tart caramelised passion fruit - yummo! My wife enjoyed the satay very much Friendly service from 2 young ladies and a great atmosphere. Perfect place to sit and watch the comings and goings in Little India. Best of all they serve decent Asian food AND they serve beer and wine. They're closed tomorrow (Tuesday) but we'll be back to try their rated curry and, as is the most important accompaniment, cold beer. Can't wait.Show less

Author: Adel ling x
Title: The hidden Bistro Tang
Review: Must come here to try and you will know how good it is because the Laksa with coconut milk for those who like foods with coconut milk. All other snacks are good too eg. wedges and indian appetizers. The bistro somehow mix up chinese amd indian, which is unique for me.Show less

Author: Hannah RLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Cozy place, nice food and great staff
Review: I stopped here first for a cold drink to get out of the heat and then came back later for lunch.I had a vegetarian wrap, which was very tasty but the portion size was very small for the price and very oily. However it was nice and the watermelon juice was deliciously refreshing.Good place for a spot of lunch. Very lovely staff too! Show less

Author: Jessica RMacon, Mississippi
Title: Peaceful Nook
Review: I absolutely love this place! It's quaint, has amazing staff and delicious food at a reasonable price. It's a breath of fresh air after the noise and chaos of Little India or the blazing Penang sun. Stop by and get their refreshing calamansi freeze or try their herbal chicken soup if you want something homey. This is a top spot I take all my out of town guests. Never disappoints!Show less

Author: Arupendra DKolkata (Calcutta), India
Title: Great Laksa
Review: Bistro Tang is the cafe extension of hotel Ren i Tang. The feel is is really informal and you can have a beer or a cup of tea watching idly people walk by.We had ordered for a Laksa , which is a local Malaya dish and the cooks did a really great job of creating out a riot of flavor and taste. Their unconventional coconut and palm sugar ice cream was hot a favorite with my family.Show less

Author: Julesperton
Title: Stunning food and location!
Review: Excellent service, fresh and innovative food, charming staff and ice cold beer! What a treat in the heart of Georgetown!

Author: snakes116Frankfurt, Germany
Title: Not so impressed
Review: We popped in on a saturday evening after seeing the recommendations on Trip Advisor. Our starter the potato wedges, picture included was in the small side for a starter.The food was not as we expected and more fusion than authentic. Which is fair enough, neither of the dishes were to our taste. It could appeal to more adventurous diners. The atmosphere was non existent. It was too empty, the music was nice. Not too bold or over bearing. The decor etc was nice. A lot of time and effort I guess into putting it together. Maybe for a coffee or lunch but not dinner.Show less

Author: AstridG34
Title: delicious food in great atmosphere
Review: Very cosy place, beautifully old restored building, interesting tiny Chinese pharmacy museum in same building. Good menu, some Asia dishes as well as western, so something for everyone. Most delicious creme brulee and brownie for desert.

Author: Shirley SSouth East England
Title: Lovely staff, nice atmosphere, good menu and amazing smoothies
Review: Came across this place by chance, but pleased we did as it's lovely. Best smoothies in town (obviously not the cheapest), full of flavour, rather than ice like many smoothies in town! We just had a drink and a snack, but we recommend it. Excellent service by friendly, helpful staff.Show less

Author: Lina1806Berlin, Germany
Title: YOU HAVE TO GO THERE!!
Review: We found the little bistro on trip-advisor and we're more than happy! The stuff is so lovely. But most convincing was the delicious food. One of the waitress recommended me a lemon honey drink that was so nice and refreshing! As a golden finish we ate PERFECT creme brûlée, such a dream! You've to try it! We love Bistro Tang and will definitely give them another visit tomorrow! Show less

Author: Karen H
Title: Friendly
Review:
Tasty food in a comfy and relaxed atmosphere. Staff are very welcoming and friendly. Right in the heart of Georgetown.
Good value for money.

Author: jtn143
Title: Great food
Review: We stayed in the hotel connected to the bistro and ate here twice. Great atmosphere and great food, with a good selection of local and Western dishes.

Author: gregorioz191Melbourne, Australia
Title: Very Fitzroy-ish
Review: We were looking for a meal and found this place on TripAdvisor.The building and its story truly fascinating. The interiors, using the old furniture, the internal courtyard are very picturesque.I will say the food didn't wow us much but good quality and good service."Good" is probably what we would rate it.Show less

Author: Kim H
Title: Great food and atmosphere
Review: We went to Tang Bistro for a late lunch. Enjoyed the food and the atmosphere and the service was nice and friendly. I'd recommend going there in the late afternoon/ early evening to also enjoy the atmosphere of little india on your way, which literally starts just outside Bistro Tangs door. You should try the Laksa here!Show less

Author: 493BethSTampa, Florida
Title: Delightful
Review: Went to Penang for the day during a cruise and planned to eat somewhere else based on TA reviews. Turned out the other place was closed so we walked about and stumbled upon Bistro Tang in Little India. Wow, fantastic. The food is great and the service even better. Wanting to get a taste of the local flavors, we settled upon the staff's recommendation and were more than pleasantly surprised. Great atmosphere too. Highly recommend.Show less

Author: Marijne12000San Juan del Sur, Nicaragua
Title: Really good!!
Review: Cosy place, friendly staff and great food! Beef and chicken wrap were delicious and you can buy a bottle of wine for around 65ringit!! We went there the dat before yesterday and are going again tonight! If it's good... It's good! :) !!!!!!! One IMPORTANT remark! The adress on tripadvisor is wrong! It is in penang strees in india town! Not in jalan penang (this is the other side of town) Show less

Author: PannirselvamB
Title: Relaxing
Review: Been here twice after hot day shopping in little india never regretted. Good staff and extremely friendly service.Like the passion fruit soda and watermelon blast.Highly recommend it.

Author: ammi189Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good food and service
Review: Stayed for a night at their attached hotel with hubby and 2kids (12y and 7y). The kids enjoyed the food (pasta and chicken chop were their favorites). I usually am not a fan of Chinese herbal soup but since I was a bit under the weather, decided to try it. It was the tastiest herbal soup I ever had. Kudos to the Chef.Service was good and friendly. Relaxed and cosy atmosphere.Show less

Author: sandyh14
Title: Lovely staff, great food
Review: The food was lovely and the iced Latte superb on a hot day! I was allowed to use their wi-fi free of charge while I dined. It was fast and the connection good. The staff were very helpful and attentive.

Author: nellielimKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Heritage building
Review: A bistro located in a heritage building in Little India. Serves great local cuisine and international fare. Their assam laksa is good. Beers are really cold and great after a day of exploring in the heat. Price on the high side for Penang standard. Service friendly and warm.Show less

Author: yvonneinoz
Title: A must try
Review: Trendy cafe/bar  in the heart of Little India, very pleasant good food and coffee, open for lunch and dinner

Author: zoejgan
Title: Delicious & Delightful
Review: A little cosy restaurant, loved the old-school interiors. Must try the Bistro Tang Laksa and the Nyonya Chicken Curry, delicious!

Author: PatrickN654
Title: Super dining possibilities!
Review: We went 3 times (!) for diner to this restaurant. Super friendly staff and very tasteful and healthy food. The laksa soup, the merinque desert, etc. Reasonable prices and located in a beautiful (restored) house in Little India.

Author: MarkReynolds
Title: Beautiful space
Review: Beautiful, relaxing open space with great food and drinks. Service was brilliant and the staff were happy to stop and give recommendations.

Author: 182victorialWalkerville, Australia
Title: Cheap eats
Review: We found this restaurant amid the veritable forest of eateries in Georgetown & knew immediately that we'd got it right. A lovely atmosphere, friendly service & a quiet spot for dinner. Cheap beer & absolutely beautiful food (local laksa is a definite must have). We would go back even just for the cold beer. Show less

Author: Mceroni
Title: Great chill out place
Review: My favourites are the tasty pulled-lamb wrap, salmon rosti, and waffle with fried chicken - the fried chicken is juicy and waffle is done just right. Coffee is good too and I enjoy having one while sitting back on a comfy chair facing the street for a bit. The bistro music is good too. All in all good food, location, and ambience. Show less

Author: ileftmyheartnseattleDavis, California
Title: Best Cafe' Mocha in George Town
Review: I love this restaurant for hanging out and people watching. It has a cozy and friendly vibe that keeps me coming back. The menu is diverse so if someone in your party wants to eat fish and chips and someone else herbal chicken soup, you are in luck. Everything is freshly made in-house and it comes through in the food. The service is impeccable which really adds to the experience. Don't miss the garden courtyard in the back, it's a tranquil refuge in the city.Show less

Author: anthony hPlymouth, United Kingdom
Title: Great food and ambiance.
Review: Just sit and watch the world go by with a beer and a snack or even a light meal. The food is excellent, the Fish and Chips were delicious and the best I've had for years. Everything is freshly prepared and piping hot when it arrives. Plenty of choice although don't expect "fine dining", it's a Bistro not a Michelin Restaurant! As a Bistro, it performs it's job perfectly.Show less

Author: JusT76Singapore, Singapore
Title: Yummy and Fantastic
Review: On the countless positive reviews by fellow reviewers over here at Tripadvisor, I and my wife decided to try out this eatery (especially when we were hotel guests here as well --- you can refer to my review on the hotel “Ren I Tang” separately). We had their “family recipe” laksa, herbal chicken as well as drinks of Calamnsi Freeze and Watermelon Blast. Both of us were not disappointed at all!! A special mention is their special assam laksa, which tastes very different from the rest of the assam laksa we had at other places in Penang, Melaka and Singapore. You must try it!! Service is prompt with the owner Karen and her staff very friendly and efficient. If you are into food trail exploration, a stay in Penang would surely be incomplete without a visit to this cozy little eatery.Show less

Author: fanfandango
Title: Great coffee
Review: Lovely vintage coffee shop, great coffee and juice, free wifi, great place to catch your breath and check out the passing people.

Author: Giogina R
Title: Gem in Little India
Review: A good find in Little India where one will not expect to have coffee in a heritage styled cafe. Overall food and drinks are commendable, plus attentive service to complement.

Author: CraigLaronta
Title: Coffee break
Review: Stop by Tang bistro for a coffee after having lunch at restaurant nearby Little India. Good heritage ambience and coffee is ok. Seems like they serve Many local food and will come back to try next round.

Author: W_vannoort
Title: Top
Review: Good food, good service, great entourage. Both the western and eastern dishes were very tasty and well prepared, staff was very helpful.

Author: Piccolo22
Title: Yum!
Review: Ate here on two evenings having the laksa soup, calamansi freeze and homemade ice cream. Absolutely delicious, nice setting and friendly staff.

Author: ClaraWongKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Never Overrated, Just Nice
Review: After a disastrous dinner somewhere opposite Tangs, we decided to try here the next day. Took us by surprise. It's a nicely restored building and the food was superb. Four of us tried their Laksa and simply out of the world. The coffee was excellent as well. Loved their motive and decor smacked in the hustle bustle of Little India. Keep it up Tangs....Show less

Author: 316kazf
Title: Great Laksa
Review: The Laksa was great and highly recommend. Had a watermelon and lychee mixed soft drink which was great also! Very nice BGM in the restaurant and loved the atmosphere of the interior of the cafe.

Author: Trisa T
Title: Relaxing place.
Review: The place is comfortable and very relaxing. Grab a beer and lounging at the corner near the window is perfect to enjoy the afternoon. If you're hungry, try their Asam Laksa, it's delicious.

Author: Anabel FParis, France
Title: Lovely place, absolutely worth it !
Review: We walkes past just strolling around and decides to have a coffee. Fresh juices mix choicewas enticing so we tried (make sure you check out their watermelon-lychee and mint juice)! The coffee was very good and the cosy atmosphere with all sorts of old items scattered in the walls and decoration, as well as the very nice waitresses made us come back for lunch the next day. Food was very good, we were not dissapointed ! Definitely worth a stop.Show less

Author: Alessandro4478
Title: Very nice
Review: Food very Good, Service good nice and Clean location. What else is necessary ??? Highly recommended for a pause from Asian food

Author: Smita S
Title: Good food, great ambience
Review: Had the laksa, salmon rosti, brownie with ice cream. All delicious. I love the space, relaxed, well designed, calm. Friendly staff.

Author: Kanerva
Title: Looking good!
Review: We just happened to walk by and ended up walking right in. This place has a great look and very good service. Loved the furniture. Just had beer ans snacks. Free WiFi.

Author: chrissymzh
Title: A little overrated
Review: The cafe looks really nice and the atmosphere is good to, but the food was just okay. From the reviews I read I expected it to be much better

Author: LorneK
Title: First the Chicken soup then chocolate brownies!!!
Review: YUM - the Chicken soup with a wide variety of Chinese herbs was both delicious and nourishing.  The chocolate brownies - don't go past the chocolate brownies!!

Author: Fiona FChalong, Thailand
Title: What a great place
Review: A great location in little India Penang. Not busy when we arrived for a spot of lunch . Great old building with loads to look at , the staff were wonderful and friendly and nothing but nothing was too much trouble. Toys for the children to play with , and the staff loved interacting with our children. Freshly made lemonade that was delicious and cold. Now for the food it's was delicious . I would so go back again . Show less

Author: Graham_from_LaosChichester, United Kingdom
Title: A real find
Review: The attraction was Lemonade, real lemons lemonade, but I also had a pumpkin and a sweet potato soup but a great range of different options. The building is fantastic recently renovated, you don't notice it from the outside, I thought it was just another small cafe in Little India. Looks like it has a real range of wines too, and it is also a hotel so next time I am in Georgetown I am going to stay there! Intriguing building, I want to explore more!Show less

Author: danadology
Title: good vibrations
Review: Ridiculously delicious food. Incredible decor and ambience, great music, great coffee. Friendly  and relaxed service. LOVED IT!

Author: Andrew WSingapore, Singapore
Title: Pretty good
Review: Nice atmosphere, friendly service and a nice break from the hustle and bustle of outside. We simply had a coffee, one cold drink and a home made brownie. The brownie was a bit dry but not had and the drinks were good as well. A nice place to stop by.Show less

Author: TravellingAsia2013Amsterdam, The Netherlands
Title: Quality food in a cosy bistro
Review: We had drinks and a small bite here while exploring Little India. This place is truly a small oasis. Very nicely decorated, good choice of music, quality food and drinks and the staff was very friendly. Only downside for us was that they were a little pricey for Malaysian standards, especially in the food capital of Georgetown where you can get great food on every street corner for a few ringgit. But the atmosphere was definitely worth it.Show less

Author: alberteriBudapest, Hungary
Title: Nice chill place with very good food
Review: I think I had one of the best meals of my life here. Their menu offer quite an international selection. Their home made juices and shakes are a delight. The food was delicious, and the passionfruit meringue is something to die for. Good chill-out music and nice decor make the place even more pleasant.Show less

Author: Kanan AAustralia
Title: An oasis in Little India
Review: It was nice to find a new bistro serving fusion food in the midst of curry country.Actually we have walked past before, but didn’t go in because it looked expensive. This afternoon we were wandering around little India in the heat of the day. We were hot and tired, and not much else open so we ventured in, and glad we did.Immediately we were greeted warmly and made to feel comfortable. Although there is no aircon it was cool inside. There are several different seating areas, including a raised platform with cushion seating and a back courtyard. The place feels clean and modern, but funky at the same time.Prices we found to be reasonable although the serves were rather small. We ordered potato wedges, vegetable bruschetta and a plate of 3 dips. With drinks the bill came to RM47.50. I think it was reasonable value despite the small serves (see my photos). I would stop by here again, but more for a tasty snack than for a full meal.Show less

Author: lienx
Title: A place of peace in the craziness of Little India
Review: This place truely is a hidden gem. Tucked away in the busy and chaotic streets of little india, it is worth a visit. The place used to be a Chinese medicinal hall and has been converted into a bistro, as well as a hotel. The owners restored it with patience (more than 2 years!) and respect to this heritage. I tried their laksa, which is very tasty with all it's fresh herbs. The portion was big, specifically in comparison to the price I paid (something like 10 RM). The waitress advised me to drink their signature drink called Calamansi Freeze. Very resfreshing!This place is another good reason to come to Penang.Show less

Author: wintermelonKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good food, great coffee and friendly service in the midst of Little India
Review: The food is very good. The salad came in huge portion and excellent taste. I tried the Laksa and the Fish and Chips on different time dining at this bistro cafe restaurant. Both dishes were very good. Excellent coffee. Very efficient staff and friendly service. Reasonably priced and great dining atmosphere.Strongly recommended if you are in Georgetown. It is located in the midst of Little India and easy to find. It belongs to the Ren-i Tang Hotel.Show less

Author: Eean_0518
Title: Local Penangites Review
Review: Hi , I visited your place twice and i cant forget the linzer Torte without cream dish, I'm a fan of Swiss and German dish, and this place suits me, I love it. My boyfriend mentioned your restaurent before, and he told me you have cheese fondue, and we decided to find a day to drop by. My my my, that cheese fondue and linzer torte was delicious, it was beyond my expectation. You have the best swiss and german dish ever, as a local Penangite who love German and Swiss food , and having a hard time finding a Swiss Cafe. This place is literally serves delicious Swiss and German Food, its pricey but definatly worth it, I would like to go for another round 4 or even 5 in few months time.Show less

Author: Rainer_F294217Hong Kong, China
Title: Best Schnitzel, Southeast Asia
Review: A great night out at Edelweiss. Probably the best Schnitzel I had for years (Being an Austrian) this is really authentic. German beers, and if you are a nice guy ask for Schnaps.The place has been visited from royalties to movie stars, but my hero is the current Swiss owner, who runs the cafe with passion and love.Show less

Author: DaudRayPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Terrific food, unusually fascinating resto decorations, good service
Review: We had a wonderful dinner here. My wife had gluten-free beef rendang on austrian-swiss rosti (a great fusion idea!), and I had Malay-Indo style Soto Chicken soup. Both were terrific. The huge gravity driven clock became a point of fascinating conversation with the manager (owner?). We definitely like this resto.Show less

Author: apricotprincess
Title: Fresh and Welcoming
Review: My friends and I were casually exploring Armenian Street on a Saturday afternoon. The weather is so hot and we felt hungry + drained after the exploring. There were various hipster cafes around but mostly selling desserts. We wanted something filling. Somehow we found this cafe although the sign shows alcoholic drinks, they do serve simple foods to keep you going. We ordered Plain fries, 3 Creamy Seafood pasta and Iced Cappuccinos. Honestly, we wanted to order more but the weather was simply too hot we couldn't really focus on what was on the menu. Shoutout to the guy waiter! We randomly suggested to sit at the courtyard table ( i think that's what it's called ) and he did let us sit there and even switched on the fan for us. A lady approached our table wanting to get to know us, she was very friendly and she does check on us from time to time. Even provided us with some maps and list of recommendations. Food was good + drinks were refreshing especially on this overly sunny weather. I can say the service here is genuine. Beautiful setting with the plants and nice ambience. I'm happy we decided to eat here and you should too.Show less

Author: LondonHotelinspectorLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Historic Charm and great service
Review: If you’re in George Town you must visit this place, even if it’s just for a cocktail or a beer.The building is fantastic, full of historical charm and some interesting antique pieces, including a huge wall sized mirror rescued from the E&O hotel.The service is impeccable and the food excellent.If I happened to live here this would definitely be my local.Show less

Author: TheCount69Rochdale, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent
Review: We stumbled across this fantastic pub/restaurant down a busy side street. Dont ask me to find it again, I couldn't.The Paulaner sign drew me in and we were welcomed by a Swiss guy running the place.He was very friendly and we stayed a couple of hours drinking German beers.Its dominated inside by a massive clock and a pleasant courtyard in the back.A very chatty host, good service, good drink selections and the food people were eating looked very good too.A great find and certainly recommend this place.Not overpriced eitherShow less

Author: Toni-as-criticRhineland-Palatinate, Germany
Title: A unique place with excellent food
Review: There is shame in wanting some familiar food, when travelling in Asia. So this is the place for all liking Swiss or German food. The restaurant has a unique interior with old clocks, gas lights (most of them now electric) and the menu is great in choice of drinks and food. The service was fast and very friendly.Unfortunately it closes on Sundays at 6pm and stays closed on Mondays, so we managed only one meal there. Show less

Author: PaulElb
Title: Nice swiss restaraunt
Review: We went there mainly for the Currywurst as you cant find that in asia and it was soo nice. All the food was very swiss like and the staff and also the owner were very welcoming and friendly.

Author: FandLtours
Title: Great cafe & restaurant!
Review:
This is a lovely quiet & calm cafe in the hustle & bustle of Georgetown Penang. Fabulous food and a great range of beers & spirits. Lovely place to sit & chat and watch the world go by.
Do go!!

Author: Keiralm29
Title: Super place
Review: The greatest service you can ask for, lovely people. The beer and food is excellent too!!! Can’t wait to visit again.

Author: MartinR2203
Title: Good Food
Review: We came here because of tripadvisor and it was perfect. The food is very good. Typical swiss and german food as you know it from home. Perfect for days when you dont want to eat asian and want to feel home.

Author: Lyser P
Title: Excellent
Review:
Very nice place, the food is excellent (the cheese fondue is so good !). 
In a tourist area, easy to find and a so pretty old style decor.

Author: mrmontfoort
Title: Delicious cheese fondue and soto ayam
Review: Aaaaand chorizo was also good. Friendly owner. Great vibe. At least 100 characters blablabla Jesus I just wanted to leave a good review ok.

Author: CanmoreFunkyDudeCanmore, Canada
Title: Pricy, but pretty classy!
Review: Roesti mit - well its called big pork sausage on the menu. Sort of a cross between weisswurst and a very lightly smoked cervelat. It was good, and the Roesti was a work of culinary art, although I put salt and pepper on it. There was a small fresh side salad on the plate as well. The place is located around the corner from the Kapitan Keling Mosque on busy Armenian Street. However, once inside, it is cool, and relaxing, with some decent tunes in the background (Did I hear some Lennon/McCartney?). The antique decor resembles a small clock museum, and the bar could be in any well established bistro on the left bank. The service was measured, efficient and sedate, with fine attention to detail. Paulaner beer was on offer, so I had a bottle with my lunch, ice cold, and professionally poured. Not cheap, though, Beer, Bratwurst and Roesti - MYR 90, including tax and tip. Luckily, they take credit cards, or I’d still be washing dishes!Show less

Author: alsuk84
Title: Good food and ambiance
Review: Friendly service, great ambience inside this old colonial building. Had the chicken curry, which tasted great. Serves ice cold beer which was a godsend. Also has a good selection of Paulaner beers if that is your thing!

Author: jacobs60nz
Title: Very Relaxing
Review: This bar, I’m like some others in Penang, did no smell like a bar. It was clean, funky, had great lazy music, and was a great place to relax. Extensive drink options. Loved it!!!!

Author: Ros T
Title: Good Retreat from Heat
Review:
Escaped the heat (and crowds from shops outside) for a couple of cold beers. A nice bar if you can grab a couple of stools, cold beers and a relaxed setting.

The toilets are the cleanest we've experienced in Penang!

Author: traveggieBreda, The Netherlands
Title: Good vegetarian curry
Review: We noticed this place many times before over the years, but never tried it before, probably because of the name.We are vegetarians and somehow didn't expect to get anything vegetarian in a place called Edelweis.This time we did try it and were proved wrong.The vegetarian curry was very nice indeed.The restaurant is in a interesting old building andThe owner is friendly and sociable.Recomended.Show less

Author: EmbracetheUnknownLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Not exactly very wallet friendly!
Review: Came in here on a hot afternoon to have some beers, chill & get away from the balmy heat!Nostalgic old world feel, the bar stands out with its really old teak wood structure and design against the wall. Not exactly wallet friendly, the beers cost like more than double what one will pay in Chulia Street!Overall, if you are in this part of town and really need to chill out, it's still a great place to unwind. Owner & staff are a happy bunch of people.Show less

Author: edward p
Title: A nice place for people watching
Review: Had a nice cold beer and my wife had a nice glass of white wine,if you fancy a Bavarian beer they have them too,a nice place to have a break and people watch before going to the Piers.

Author: 788graemegPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Friendly owner, generally good food
Review: My wife and I went to this restaurant on a week night. It was not very busy. The service was good and friendly. The first course for me was very good but the apple flan I had for dessert was sub-par and had virtually not flavour. My wife was satisfied with her meal.Show less

Author: nguy_nt_ihSingapore, Singapore
Title: Great place for a cold beer! Super nice owners!!!
Review: We were walking around Penang and we wanted some beers. We came to Edelweiss and everything was perfect. They have nice music, nice German beers. I didn’t try any food but I have the feeling it’s nice as well. When we wanted to leave, we asked some recommendations from the waiter and somehow the owner came and gave us a lot of brochures and she introduced to us a lot about Penang, where we should go.... she was amazing, super nice!If you’re walking around Penang and want to have some information from a local, you should definitely come and talk to the owner of Edelweiss. Or just for a beer. Highly recommended!Show less

Author: ChristianB553
Title: Stopping for a drink in Penang
Review:
Very atmospheric, great decor, exceptional staff including Swiss owner of 20years.
Excellent cocktails and the perfect ice cold beer. Loved it

Author: sd12lfs
Title: Don´t miss this!
Review:
Wonderful restaurant in the old school way, peaceful and quiet. Very friendly staff and good food and drinks. Get tips on what to do in Georgetown from the friendly owner Hors. Highly recommended.
Leif from Stockholm,Sweden.

Author: MileHighMarkSalt Lake City, Utah
Title: Why is it rated so high
Review: It’s quaint. It’s romantic. They play music from the 40s and 50s. Lovely!The food comes at a glacial pace. The staff is not attentive at all. Once it arrives the food is uninspired. The menu is chaotic. Not really sure what the place wants to be. Also, if you plan on reading or looking at your options in George Town don’t plan on doing it here, there is no WiFi. MHMShow less

Author: TravelDreamsPortland, OR
Title: I nice break from Asian food
Review: I went for lunch, and while it was a little lonely being the first one in there, I enjoyed the decor and looked through one of their many picture books to keep myself occupied. I treated myself to a Negroni- very well made and tasty.Lasagna had a lot of cheese, but it was very tasty with good flavors. I would go back!Show less

Author: Romax58Bolton, United Kingdom
Title: Great welcome and meal
Review: Excellent restaurant to visit whilst in Georgetown. Full of character and very special food. We loved the chicken curry with a great fusion of spices and the Schnitzel. The selection of beers was also very good. The ice cream with coffee liqueur was as promised, heavenly. We will definitely be back.Show less

Author: Brigitte2351
Title: Charming
Review: Lovely cafe and good food.  The owners and staff are very helpful and friendly.  My husband and I thoroughly enjoyed our time at Edelweiss.

Author: sauraumpfaWels, Austria
Title: Beautiful Ambiance, rare old items, good german beer and nice food
Review: we arrived short before closing time and despite the team already cleaning up and preparing to close, they received us well and let us enjoy a good meal and nice cool German beer.THE SETTING IS TRULY AMAZING - one should go there just for that - it's like a museum and you will find items there long forgotten.Can only recommend the restaurant - will come backShow less

Author: Philip I
Title: Swiss bar on Armenia St.
Review: Stopped in for a beer and was surprised at beverage list.  Nice place, good service.  Interesting art and antiques

Author: Y8594YHnatashac
Title: Edelweiss Cafe- our heritage gem in Georgetown
Review: Having known the couple for quite a while, it is clear their passion and care that is put into this beautiful, humble cafe/restaurant. A gem in its own right. It lies in the middle of UNESCO George Town, the owners have restored this heritage building and called it Edelweiss. Humble home-cooking combining Swiss as well as Asian dishes. Not only is the decor self designed, parts have been collected over the years to furnish this restaurant.A personable and fantastic service that extends beyond the ordinary customer. It’s as if you’re stepping into your own home.Excellent food, not to mention one of the best rösti’s you’ll ever have. Great drinks that quench every thirst, whether it be a cocktail, beer, juice or coffee. Not just a restaurant, but a bar, and a museum where the owners have collected antiques and artifacts over the years.Owners are always willing to help any traveler or local with their queries re Penang, food and tours. What more can one ask for? Show less

Author: RG59Traveler
Title: Visited Again - Great Beer and Pasta
Review: I always visit this place when I am in Penang.  Greta place to stop in to get out of heat and enjoy a fantastic beer.  This time I tried pasta with chorizo sausage and it was excellent.  I highly recommend any dish on the menu.

Author: NRO2014Penang Island, Malaysia
Title: Charming with crazy good Rösti!
Review: I highly recommend the place. Besides a charming atmosphere and lovely staff, the Rösti could probably be one of the best in the world! Try the Rösti with the eggs or with the B52 sausage... or curry! A nice German beer accommodates the food just nicely! Crazy Good! ... all the other dishes look delicious as well! Cheers!Show less

Author: ck1873
Title: Best Swiss restaurant with good foods
Review: A very unique restaurant setup with good ambient. The foods was excellent and the owner (Mr. Capol) was super friendly. Don't miss out this restaurant if you happen to be at Armenian St.

Author: Boyd T
Title: Must visit! Charming, ambient Cuban cool in the centre of Georgetown UNESCO
Review: This place sums up Georgetown to a 'T'. Excellent, well priced, quality offerings (Food & Bev) with perfect friendly service from the Swiss owner (Urs) and his Team. I accidently came across this place looking for some respite during a hot day walking through the UNESCO listed streets and returned twice during my week in Georgetown. It would be unfair to say it is a Cuban Bar/Cafe because it has its own style, but I think those words give the right impression. Its a bit of a cool museum with lots of interesting artefacts and antiques (even a few tourist attractions!). But whilst the aesthetics are great, the drinks, food and service are the key to a happy traveller like me. Ill definitely be back next time - thanks Urs (Rico)Show less

Author: nathaliemF6469CH
Title: Swiss food in Penang
Review:
If you want to eat Swiss food while you are in Penang, this is the place to go.
It is in a beautiful shop house in Georgetown. I ate Rosti, loved it. Can cater to Vegetarians.

Author: goodsvejkGlatton, United Kingdom
Title: Charming restaurant with great food
Review: We were very excited to hear about the Edelweiss Cafe, a Swiss German restaurant--bratwurst, fondue, imported German beer! We were even more excited once we arrived and were greeted by a wonderful atmosphere, a charming host, and outstanding food. All for a reasonable price. We got a starter of pommes frites and salad, followed by the fondue for two and were not disappointed. The beer selection was great. And everything was very authentic. Highly recommended if you're in the mood for something other than Malaysian or simply want a relaxing and fun evening in the Georgetown.Show less

Author: RG59Traveler
Title: Great Place for Beer and Sausages
Review: In heart of tourist area is this small Swiss restaurant which serves great beer and food. Super place to stop for lunch or just a rest and drink. Old Penang historic shop house converted to bar and restaurant. Fantastic.

Author: nzukzau
Title: G&T
Review: A top spot to stop for a refreshing G&T and beer, when exploring arty Armenia Street!Friendly service. There are a couple tables out front, ideal for relaxing and for people watching.

Author: asiaexpat62Bangkok, Thailand
Title: Nice lunch in great atmosphere
Review: Just stopped for a cold drink while sightseeing and decided to try the food. Although quit expensive for lunch we enjoyed the German food and deserts. The place is worth a try just for the beautiful antique decor. Very comfortable place to take a break while touring Armenian street.Show less

Author: 138lovetoeatLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent, Recommended
Review: Discovered the restaurant by strolling along the street, when we walk in we were welcome by a western owner (I assumed) with big smile on his face, very friendly and warm, then we were fascinated by the old antiques decoration inside and found it very interesting and unusual, love it.We had 2 different pasta both lovely, mine was carbonara sauce, it was so tasty and creamy, then we regretted right away as we were continues nose around the restaurant we noticed some other diners are having cheese fondue, apparently is the restaurant signature dish but it was too late to changed our order.Would definitely go back again and highly recommend this place to anyone if they craving for good cheese in Penang.Show less

Author: 645oliverf
Title: Amazing food, friendly and great beer
Review: While touring George Town for the street art, we had lunch here, The food was excellent, great variety for food and drinks, really friendly and helpful staff.

Author: rodf814
Title: Brilliant quaint place
Review: My wife and I stopped in for a cold drink whilst looking at the street art in the area links.  The Elderflower spritzer is great for a refreshing drink after sightseeing.

Author: JoziAudrey
Title: Delicious!
Review: The mac & cheese was wonderful. And then I topped it off with a wholly unnecessary Linzer torte that I still dream about a year later. In a beautifully restored space, with friendly service from the owners.

Author: suggs1965Brisbane, Australia
Title: Great beers on offer!!
Review: If you want something different from the usual tiger beer, pop into Edelweiss Cafe. German beers are on offer - and hubby even found one being served that he'd never seen before! Great place. Beautifully restored. Small open courtyard at the rear. Definitely worth a visit. Show less

Author: claudiarV9116PSTijeras, New Mexico
Title: More than a great meal
Review: We stopped in to see why a cafe in Penang would be named after a pretty white flower found in the Alps. Our curiosity was rewarded. Penang has long been a town renowned for its mix of European and Malaysian cultures and this restaurant represents that fusion in delicious meals, great drinks, and a most interesting atmosphere. The owners, Urs and Teresa, have created a haven for tourists looking for something a little different from other Georgetown restaurants. And if you are interested in the history and culture of Penang you will be surprised to see what lines the walls and fill the upstairs of Edelweiss. The four of us enjoyed a delicious Swiss fondue, bratwurst, lasagna, calamari and fries for lunch. Now that we've found this treasure, we will return every time we visit Penang.Show less

Author: nadia089Huddersfield, United Kingdom
Title: Lazy drink
Review: A really lovely place to sit and relax and be taken back in time , the decor is colonial with lots of dark wood ,ceiling fans and palms,also some very interesting clocks. I had a mocktail and my friend had a bottle of German beer, the prices are very reasonable. We called in at about 2.25pm so only had time for one drink as they close at 3 till 6. I would highly recommend edelweiss cafe.Show less

Author: tjnltn
Title: An excellent atmospheric alternative in George Town.
Review: After sampling both their local and western (Swiss/German) dishes can wholeheartedly recommend, especially as it provides an alternative to the usual offerings in the heritage area.

Author: Petals23Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Unattended
Review: Waited for a good 15 minutes before anyone came and only to tell us the food will take 30 minutes or more to come. The table was never cleared. Waiter didn't bring the menu, don't think he had the intention to even take any order from us. I think its highly overrated Show less

Author: Robert d
Title: Cheese Fondue in the Tropics
Review: We went there for the cheese fondue because we were told that the Edelweiss Cafe uses the right cheese mix for it and is not stingy either. Both proved to be correct. Also outstanding were the Roesti. So if you want to binge on the inner Swiss in you, come here and indulge.Show less

Author: DerekFGuadalajara
Title: Enjoyed a good lunch in the quaint surroundings
Review:
The owner was present the day we visited and was enjoyable to talk with.
We found the food very good and freshly prepared; you will enjoy the surroundings.

Author: 1globaltraveler2Houston, TX
Title: Did not find a more charming place in George Town.
Review: Do not write restaurant reviews since everyone has their own preferences, even though we did have a lovely dinner here. This place is packed with wonderful ambience, & absolutely worth a visit for drinks &/or food. We happened upon it while strolling down Armenian Street, & went it for drinks & then returned for dinner. Did not find a more lovely spot anywhere in George Town. Obvious attention to detail by the owners, makes this place worthy of a visit in & of itself. The name Edelweiss gives no hint of what you will find inside. Do yourself a favor & visit.Show less

Author: SylviaG1543
Title: Great rösti
Review: After almost three weeks in Malaysia, I was craving for some potatoes. The rösti was fantastic. Great service, excellent food, very friendly staff!

Author: rzingerGeorge Town, Malaysia
Title: Nice Little Place with Good Food and a Nice Beer Selection
Review: Stopped here for dinner and enjoyed the food as well as the nice selection of German beers (good to deviate from the usual menu of Carlsberg and Tiger featured at most restaurants! Fondue with Chili is a great off-menu order. Bratwurst was nice as well. Friendly service. Good food takes time, this is not the best choice if you are in a rush. Show less

Author: STELLA08AucklandAuckland Central, New Zealand
Title: Outstanding food - but don't go if you're starving
Review: We sat outside to have dinner,so we could watch the world go by. Great situation, right in the middle of Georgetown. Took ages & ages for the food- so long that we were debating whether to say we had waited long enough & were leaving. Then it arrived and it was beautiful. I had the local chicken curry and can thoroughly recommend it.Show less

Author: binks2013singapore
Title: Chili Fondue - For those in The Know
Review: I will tell you a secret that will change your fondue -loving life. If you like fondue, and you love chili peppers - eat them together and you take cheese and "the burn" to a whole new, unforgettable culinary level. So - here is the secret - Edelweiss will do a chili fondue. It's not on the menu so you must request it - but, like a member of a secret club, you will partake the cheesy chili goodness that this restaurant offers so very, very well. ENJOY!!!Show less

Author: Regina_Lum
Title: Amazing food!!
Review: Delicious western food, and the green pea soup was amazing! Very authentic heritage ambiance. Price is slightly above average but well worth it.

Author: Harrisbacker
Title: A little piece of time travel
Review: What a lovely place, visited completely by accident to shelter from the rain, turned out to be a lovely trip back in time with the decor and the music.

Author: johnsN970JLEssendon, Australia
Title: Hidden Treasure
Review: Came across this restaurant when out looking for another.Its doors were open, no customers at such an early time. However, breaking our maxim of not eating in a restaurant if no one is there, we decided to gamble and eat in this Hidden Treasure.The decor is heavy European with a touch of Asian. The food is similar .We sat at marble top tables and enjoyed a Tiger beer with Calamari , chips plus a very tasty Pork fillet curry .The service was excellent and the price about $15 (Aus ) each. No complaints about food, service or decor.They had fans but would have preferred air conditioner, but that is only a personal observation.Would highly recommend this restaurant to allShow less

Author: Steve B
Title: Nice Change of Pace.
Review: Stopped in here to escape the heat and ended up surprised that they offered poached salmon. Tired of noodles, I had to give it a try. Very good, along with the best iced tea I have had in years. In this heat that counts for a lot. Pricey by Penang standards but still less than 1/3 of what i would pay in the states.Show less

Author: BuxtinoNottingham, United Kingdom
Title: Good set menu
Review: We ended up here because everything else in the area was closed and this Restaurant looked nice. They have quite a good choice of german/swiss cuisine. We decided for the set menu Pumpkin soup, meatloaf&fries, ice cream and drink (Rm 30pp). It was very tasty and a good value. The owner and staff were nice. Worth a visit.Show less

Author: deki_mandela
Title: Awesome!
Review: I wasn't really expecting finding Swiss place in Penang :-) .Edelweiss is  great mix of Swiss inspired food and colonial interior with nice service. My Rosti with smoked salmon was delicious.

Author: GabouxWhangarei, New Zealand
Title: A real gem
Review: It feels like you would step back in time into a chinese restaurant full of character. So much interesting things to see....Lots of artefacts that the owner collected over many years. Not only is it highly interesting to visit the place because of that, the food and service are excellent as well. Swiss quality and a good wise selection of dishes (swiss mostly but other choices too like curries). We had chicken on pepper sauce. Highly recommenable. Enjoyed every bite. Closes early on sunday and completely on Monday evenings and is situated in the armenian quarter.Show less

Author: andreas_expatSeremban, Malaysia
Title: must do
Review: after a 5 year stay in Malaysia as a European I have been surprise what I found here in this place. Very unique environment, beautiful decorated Restaurant / Bar with friendly and caring owners. They love to make there guest happy, not just make business. you can stay there to relax just for a drink but I would recommend to try the delicious foot as well. Highly recommended is the excellent original cheese fondue.Show less

Author: tmawhinneyCheshire, United Kingdom
Title: Great Bar
Review: We came across this bar by accident while strolling around Georgetown. Having read all the other reviews I can only agree this is a great place for a drink or a meal. The owner is very friendly and proud of the bar and that comes across in the service. We only had a snack for lunch which was excellent. Well worth seeking out.Show less

Author: Andrew MPerth, Australia
Title: Search it out and you won't be sorry
Review: Wandering around the area we stopped out front to look at our map and a voice from the shop asked if we would like an iced coffee. Great idea. Lovely food, drinks all freshly made and served with passion. Ended up going here 3 times during our stay. Wife loved the craft shop out the back. If you need a drink great food and want to escape the heat, get to this place. You won't be sorry. Andrew MShow less

Author: Ernesto V
Title: The best escape from the heat
Review: We had a very refreshing stop in this beautiful place. Top service, ambience and drinks. We will definitely come back to try the food.One of rare examples of restaurants with very dedicated owners with lot of passion about what they do, quality and guest service.Highly recommended place if you are in Penang.Show less

Author: paulinebullSingapore
Title: You must not miss this beautifully restored shop house and restaurant
Review: This shop house has been lovingly restored by its owners. Chatting with them is as good as any history lesson - amazing knowledge of the region. The furnishings are original with quirky touches, while the background music takes you through the decades. One minute you're in the 1940s - the next, the 80s. The food is splendid. We ate here four times for lunch and dinner and were not disappointed. The German beer is chilled and poured to perfection. Guests can enjoy just admiring the many artefacts while they eat.If you don't go in, you will miss a real treat!Show less

Author: Jeff MVancouver, Canada
Title: Surprise! Best Chicken Curry in Gtown.
Review: It's almost embarrassing to go into a euro style bar when in Georgetown, but in a week moment (hot as hell) we did. What a surprise! Their menu includes 5 Malay dishes. We had a simple fried rice dish and the chicken curry. Turned out to be amongst the best food we had in Georgetown! Very personable owners. Show less

Author: DenHaagTravellerKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Stands out from the crowd
Review: Enjoyed a few decent beers here and a nice meal on a quiet Sunday afternoon. It's super quirky with lots of wood at the front giving it that Swiss feel with some Asian fusion towards the back. Beers were fine and so was the food but the portion was a little small and my poached salmon was a little bland. I will return though. I just won't order the salmon :-) Could not fault the friendly service. Shame there is no wifi.Show less

Author: Kayenne90Johannesburg South, South Africa
Title: Good if somewhat expensive food
Review: I had read about this restaurant on line so one night, while wandering around Penang looking at the street and wall art, we decided to try it out. My son ordered a pork dish and I ordered the kasmiri curry dish. When the food arrived, my son declared that he had food envy. My curry was delicious.Show less

Author: brucel15
Title: A perfect lunch!
Review:
A peaceful place in a busy street.
We highly recommend the wraps, the lasagna and the brownies.
An interesting collection of antiques upstairs.

Author: sheronlee
Title: Amazing Dessert
Review:
Visited this cafe on Christmas day for some dessert after our dinner. The apple flan is simply amazing. The chocolate brownie is gooey and delicious. 

The cafe used many quirky stuff and antiques as decoration. Very unique and interesting.

Author: 423tamarasBerry Springs, Australia
Title: Yummy drinks and food, good haven from the rain
Review: Dropped in here to hide from the rain. Had already had some small dinner so had a salad and small German plate to supplement which was just perfect and fresh. Had a few cocktails and beers and then had a great discussion with the lady owner who was really informative and helped us out Si Ce we had only just arrived on our first trip. Really friendly eclectic atmosphere, enjoyed very much.Show less

Author: cdwood77Bangkok, Thailand
Title: European Style, Nice Decor
Review: Great spot for German beers but as they are imported, expect Euro prices as well. Wide menu but can only review the German sausages and house wine both of which are good but not great.Primarily a European hang out and very busy last night.The Bratwurst & Chicken sausages were not up to the standard of my favorite German restaurant but prices are good for the location, service fine, ambience very good. The goulash was very good, this one is great for a change if tired of Asian menu.Show less

Author: 112fionaf
Title: A fabulous place to chill and have a beer
