Review: I loved this place. A relaxed haven in the centre of the Heritage trail in Georgetown. Atmospheric and good beer and food . My Partner's German and he is working over in Penang so I have a feeling he will be a regular there .

Author: NEOH SOON HUENG 梁Penang Island, Malaysia
Title: Great hangout to rekindle romance
Review: Been here with my wife since they open years ago. This place serves German beer from the bottle the right way. It's poured 90%, and the 10% remaining will be stirred to bring out all the yeast from the bottle. We also love the meat loaf and spaghetti offered that goes perfectly with the beer.Show less

Author: Bee D
Title: The only Swiss cuisine in Georgetown
Review: So far, this is the only place serve Swiss cuisine. The atmosphere was great and good for relaxation after the walking in the town. The food was great.

Author: megandjerryNew Delhi, India
Title: lovely little cafe
Review: My partner and I came across this lovely little cafe after a long walk through the streets of Georgetown. Hungry and thirsty we gave it a try. This cafe has a great atmosphere, with walls covered in vintage photographs. We ate in the little open air garden courtyard at the back, whilst perusing the many photo books of the history of the local area and Malaysia. The food was tasty (i ate the salmon and partner had the sausage) although I was still left a little hungry, all the better for dessert! They have a selection of delicious homemade treats, e.g. brownie and apple flan which were really yummy. The mocktails and fresh juice we had were also very yummy and hit the spot! We enjoyed very good service from the owner and a young local man who was very friendly and pleasant. I would recommend this cafe as a lovely place to relax and enjoy some good food and drink.Show less

Author: atamraoSan Jose, California
Title: Great atmosphere
Review: The owners (Teresa and Urus) of this renovated and interestingly decorated bar and cafe have created a wonderful place in historical Georgetown. They have an interesting collection of antiques in several rooms above the cafe - ask for a personal tour.We stopped by for desserts and a coffee after dinner and were very pleased with the offerings.Show less

Author: Euan MGlasgow, United Kingdom
Title: Hemmingway would have liked it here
Review: Lovely chilled out bar with a colonial feel, but German twist. Very relaxing place with good home made food, great beer and good wine.Owners took time to sit down with us and recommend places to visit and eat in Georgetown. Really enjoyed our visit and as others have said, there is a surprise in the ladies toilet!Show less

Author: v_lianySingapore, Singapore
Title: good torte and coffee
Review: Was pouring that afternoon and this cafe located in front of our hotel. Had cardamom coffee, which was good and also a really good torte..dont remember the name but i think it was made of raspberry..An old shophouse with nice interior..and friendly owner..Check out the female toilet..Show less

Author: epicwanderingsPortland, Oregon
Title: Gorgeous, quiet hang out with superb beer and food!
Review: Edelweiss is perhaps my favorite place in Penang. Our family goes to the island regularly, and whenever we are in Georgetown, we go to Edelweiss daily! Everything from the foreign dishes ( spaghetti aglio olio, french fries, salads, cheese toast) to the assam laksa are absolutely delicious. I'm particularly fond of the vegetarian curry.The beer selection is perhaps one of the best on the island, and the staff are always delightful, as is the owner and his wife. The architecture is stunning and the indoor-outdoor garden and seating area is magical.Show less

Author: ileftmyheartnseattleDavis, California
Title: Excellent meal and Superb service and hospitality
Review: My husband and I enjoyed dinner tonight at this beautifully restored shophouse. The food was delicious and the drinks were sublime. I had the bora bora and elderflower drinks and both were very unique and refreshing. The portions were generous and we both enjoyed our dinners. I had a bowl of soup and my husband had the fixed price dinner which was: soup, salad, sausage, fries, drink, and ice cream. What made the meal extra special was the kindness of the owner. She went out of her way to welcome us to George Town and give us helpful information and insight on the fun things to do around town. She has a museum upstairs and I can't wait until we return so I can visit with her more and see her collected treasures.Show less

Author: CharlieRenfrewshire
Title: Interesting  cafe
Review: We had a lovely meal here after the cafe was recommended by our rickshaw driver!  The owners are delightful, the surroundings quirky. We had Swiss korma curry and  Asiann curry, both were delicious and very reasonably priced.

Author: susanandrainaSeattle, Washington
Title: Charming Cafe and Owners
Review: I discovered the Edelweiss cafe(on Armenian street)on my second day in Penang and ended up going there everyday for the rest of my stay.The cafe is a delightful place to have a meal or just a few beers at the end of a long day of sightseeing. The cafe itself is charming with the heritage touches that make you feel like you are getting a small glimpse in to the past. The owners are very kind and make you feel right at home. They remembered me every time I came back and made me feel very welcome which is so nice when you are travelling alone and also I think that they are just really nice people in general.Show less

Author: lenemeGeorge Town, Malaysia
Title: Highly recommend
Review: I love all the food especially Swiss Cheese fondue (rm99 per pot for 2 pax) which you couldn't find in any other restaurant in Penang or may be malaysiaFor cheese lover you shouldn't miss itAnd for not a cheese lover you may try the German sausage and ribsI bet you will love it tooThey serve variety of beer and wineBut beware of their opening business day and hours So that you won't get disappointed Rated 5 star for this restaurant especially for the cheese fondueAnd ambience despite their waiter and waitress service Show less

Author: johnmur49
Title: Definitely worth a visit
Review: Good food and beer great situation don't walk past! The b52 sausage was very tasty and the salmon melted in the mouth .

Author: Jools053Tenerife, Spain
Title: Great place, food and excellent host and hostess
Review: We arrived in December and were exploring George Town in the rain when we found Edelweiss in Armenian Street. The place is intriguing even from the outside but inside is a wealth of heritage, and the old shop house has been lovingly restored by Theresa and Urs who are passionate about Penang's heritage. Theresa served us the first time and furnished us with a wealth of local maps and information, as well as assuring us that the rainfall was unusual for the time of year. Theresa is also a heritage tour guide. We returned again and met Urs, who was equally welcoming and friendly. On a further visit, we chatted with both of them and learned so much about Penang and the people. Add to the ambience with great food, but epic in size (we are used to Thai size portions now) and it was a very enjoyable experience each time. We can't wait to come back and see you again. We thought Penang might be the place for us, and now we know it is.Show less

Author: ThaiFranzPhuket, Thailand
Title: Good food and quiet
Review: We dropped in there just looking for a drink but then stayed for a lunch at the place. Really nice setting - particulary the back end of the restaurant. Food was very nice and reasonably priced. Drinks (beer in our case) is a bit more pricy as we did choose some "german inported beer" - so understandable. Really enjoyed the experience and will be back for more. Show less

Author: JeliyaBamako
Title: A place between the tick and the tock
Review: Edelweiss is a lovely cafe that encapsulates the heritage revival in Georgetown. It is that rare place that has been at the vanguard of the movement to preserve all that is wonderful about the city. It has somehow endured the different phases of enthusiasm, idealism, hope, advocacy, acceptance, recognition, and finally full World Heritage status. I have no doubt that others fell by the wayside during all these phases, but at least Edelweiss and its owners remain to give testimony to deserved recognition of this amazing Quarter. For me, Edelweiss is a place between the old world and the new, the place between the tick and tock. On one hand, you could say that time stands still here; on the other, it is utterly contemporary and is that space beyond the avaricious world. It is a place you could happily pass through in 15 minutes. Or you could linger for hours as you savour the decor, chat to your hosts, write your postcards or sit and try to write down all that Penang and Georgetown have revealed to you. It is a somewhat dark-wood long shophouse, whose sections each have a different ambience. Half-way down, there is a collection of books on Georgetown, Penang and Malay culture (and cuisine) that merits a visit in its own right. The food is good, there is a nice selection of beers, and service is excellent. The place closes at 1500 (I don't understand why), which is the only fault I could find with it.I gather that Edelweiss had been closed for several months, and by chance we came to it on the first day it re-opened. I wish it a long run from here on.Show less

Author: jolijdamPulau Penang, Malaysia
Title: love the spare ribs
Review: finally had dinner after the disappointment in jawi house.just a few guest but comparing the interior with jawi house we found some similarity but the difference was the in edelweiss there are unique real antique pieces and the doors, windows,etc are still authentic. nice setting.ordered a nice weiss bier and spare ribs. toke about 30 minutes which was a good investment in time. perfectly cooked, soft meat and easy to take of the bones.salad and french fries completed it; perfect!the house wine was good.Show less

Author: Christine FPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: A good stop on your heritage quarter trail
Review: This is one of the few boutique-restaurant that have survived in the last years as eateries in this neighbourhood open and close at a fast rate. Run by an energetic lady who occasionally doubles up as a certified tourist guide and her Swiss husband, it serves an eclectic menu of western (Swiss oriented) dishes but visitors can ask her to produce excellent Indian food as well. Informal seating in a lovingly designed interior crammed with an array of antique ornaments, which the owners have collected over many years. Upon request, you can visit the first floor where she keeps many more, some of which are for sale. The food is hearty and unpretentious and prices reasonable. A good address. Show less

Author: ytlouise
Title: Cafe with alot of heart & soul
Review: I could have spent an entire afternoon here. Pity it closes at 3pm. Its obvious that the owners put alot of care and personal attention to maintain this cafe-restaurant, given the acute labour shortage. Keep it up!

Author: globe658Bern, Switzerland
Title: cosy place
Review: A very quaint cafe in the heart of the heritage zone of Georgetown. Very convenient to drop in for a drink to cool off in this heat. The food is swiss inspired. Simple but nice. The owner is a Malaysian lady who knows a lot about the history of the city so learn a thing or two when you have to chance to chat with her.Show less

Author: michadeLausanne, Switzerland
Title: Delicious salad, great advice!
Review: Had a salad and rosti. The presentation of the rosti was very sweet, and the salad was delicious! It was a real treat to eat a fresh and crunchy salad! We old had two days in town, and received great advices from the owners, thank you!Show less

Author: Bitten_by_the_bug_10London, United Kingdom
Title: Expensive western food but ok if you're in a pinch
Review: Went here the first night we got to Penang, tired, hot and hungry. Heard about this place in our hotel guide and decided to give it a whirl. This place is friendly enough but very slow service and pricey. Ok selection of western food and drink. A good option if you're out late around Armenien street and either don't want or don't know where local food halls are. Show less

Author: Tony BStoke-on-Trent, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent refuge for the weary traveller
Review: Cool, quaint and good value refuge in the mid-day heat of Georgetown.the beer is varied and nicely cool and the food, from many nations, is excellent and reasonable in price.Situated in the heritage quarter, strongly recommended for lunchtime food and drink served by pleasant friendly staff.Show less

Author: Adeaemma
Title: Nice spot to take a break
Review: Just sat there, outside on the little terrasse, enjoying a paulaner while watching what was going on in the street, very relaxing. The waiter had an impressive technique to pour the beer which came ice cold.

Author: elsiekLondon
Title: Nothing special
Review: This is more restaurant than cafe and is perfectly placed in Armenien Street when out on your tour of China Town. Western food at Western prices. Very expensive given that normally Penang food costs very little. The food was OK but nothing really to get excited about. The crispy pork baguette was soggy and smoked with no crispy at all. The pitta bread around the tuna mix was stale & very hard. The beef stroganoff with mashed potato was about the best. All variety of Western beers, wines & cocktails are available but again at a price. Service was very slow. Our quick lunch dragged on for ever. Look out for local food halls for an authentic reasonably priced alternativeShow less

Author: Joyce S
Title: A nice place for a leisurely meal
Review: Had the pork sausage wrap, which was satisfactory.  The fries was meant to be spicy fries but Like the ambient atmosphere.

Author: beepbeepzSingapore, Singapore
Title: A Humble Swiss restaurant
Review: Despite how small and rustic this restaurant is, the food here is just marvelous. Went here for my partner's birthday, and we love how retro this restaurant is. My partner ordered pork belly with sausage with sauerkraut, and when it comes, we looked at each other. It's huge! But you will never regret, the pork cooked to perfection with layer of goodness of juicy fat (i know). Served with mustard and ketchup that makes this dish perfect. I ordered pork sausage wrapped in bacon alongside with thinly-cut fries served with mustard and ketchup too. What else can you ask, sausage and bacon? Perfect meat attack. Feeling that we can't get enough of this restaurant, we decided to order dessert. We ordered bananas that have been marinated with cinnamon sauce served with vanilla ice cream and sprinkled with almond chips. The sweetness of the ice cream and the bananas jive perfectly with tanginess of cinnamon sauce. Will definitely come back to this restaurant for our next Penang's visit.Show less

Author: debbie_williamswood
Title: Great little bisto
Review: We found this by chance wandering around the streets of Georgetown.  What a great little place.  Excellent service, good food and a very nice glass of wine and cold beer! The toilets were also very clean.

Author: SKBrizzlesBristol
Title: Great
Review: We stumbled across this bar / restaurant after spending hours walking round Georgetown. It was a very welcome relief to be able to sit down, relax and cool down, and the staff are very friendly. The strawberry milkshake is amazing and perfect for cooling down! We went back the next day just for another strawberry milkshake!Show less

Author: NancyVCork
Title: A refreshing pint on a hot evening
Review: A cool oasis on a hot evening. The food was good and a welcome break from some of the more exotic flavours of Penang!

Author: Kerrie HDundee, United Kingdom
Title: Little Gem in Georgetown
Review: My husband and I had a lovely meal here at Edelweiss on our last night in Georgetown. We both had a homemade curry which was delicious. The restaurant is an old restored house with some beautiful and interesting artifacts; one being a beautiful mirror that once graced the walls of the Eastern & Oriental Hotel. The clocks on the walls were delightful and innovative.Teresa, the Malaysian owner and her Swiss husband couldn't have been kinder. Teresa was most attentive and showed us pictures of before and after the restoration. She was charming and most interesting. As a tropical storm occured towards the end of our meal, she insisted that her husband gave us a lift back to our hotel.It was a lovely evening and we would recommend this restaurant to anyone visiting Georgetown. Should we return to Georgetown ourselves, we would certainly come back.Thank you both for a lovely evening.Show less

Author: KR_EDINBURGHEdinburgh, United Kingdom
Title: Nice looking cafe, shame about the tea
Review: Ordered the spicy ginger tea. It tasted like a spicy teh tarik. Not what i was expecting. Milky ginger tea just does not seem right. I give it 3 out of 5 as an average of the drink and establishment. 4 for the establishment, 2 for the drink!Show less

Author: 100RobPFremantle, Australia
Title: Chill after a hot sweaty trudge around the streets of GT
Review: This is a great cafe/bar to stop off and get a cold beer or soft drink after a hot sweaty trudge around the streets and sights of Georgetown. I have visited Edelweiss 6 times, sometimes for a beer, sometimes beer & a light lunch & also for a fine evening meal. OK the food isn't 5 star Michelin but it's well presented, tasty & wholesome. Contrary to another reviewer saying "The owner of the Edelweiss is a Swiss, but he is never there. His Malay wife is running the restaurant and she seems to be rather unfriendly. She became quite angry ......" We found Teresa a really friendly, informative & interesting lady in her own right.If you are visiting Georgetown drop into the Edelwiess for a beer of meal if not you will miss out on one of the gems of Penang.Show less

Author: VirginiaRoss
Title: Closed for renovation
Review: Said reopening June but not open yet. Shame we missed it as friends say this is where to organise the best heritage walk guide

Author: Stefano MPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Malaysian-Swiss cosy gem
Review: Spelling: TripAdvisor take note. It is EDELWEISS (the High Alps flower which is one of Switzerland's symbols), and NOT "Elderwise".In the most charming part of Georgetown, a small bar and restaurant impeccably run by a Swiss-Malaysian family. Very elegant interior; an old Chinese shophouse, elegantly restored with some brilliant add-ons like a whole Malay doorframe which frames the bar and a purpose-made giant Swiss clock.Very good cocktails, full range of drinks. The menu concentrates on Swiss traditional fare, and succeeds (if calories-conscious you shd ask for a half portion...)Show less

Author: dwoodwar7
Title: Good food at popular place
Review: We enjoyed a delicious meal during our first evening in Batu Ferrenghi.  Good food for our family and the place sure filled up as we were eating.

Author: DaudRayPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Still a great place to eat and hang out in Batu
Review: Despite the COVID crunch, Ben & Amy's Livingroom Restaurant keeps on going providing excellent tasting food at reasonable prices and in a cool environment--often with live music. I'm not sure I've ever had a dish here that I didn't really like. More people need to discover this gem as things begin to open up again.Show less

Author: Climber24096761603
Title: This favorite hangout and
Review: This favorite hangout and foodie place among expats & locals is still open despite the COVID lockdowns. More prople need to discover this place!

Author: DaudRayPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Excellent rendang as well as fish dishes
Review: Ben and Amy run a really great restaurant--very popular with tourists. And there's a reason--they give attention to buying quality ingredients and producing some of the best beef rendang around. Also, their Thai-style and Kapitan-style fish dishes are to die for. A great place, near all the action in Batu Feringghi.Show less

Author: Kendra RKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Delicious, fresh and fast!
Review: Delicious, fresh and fast, friendly service. Excellent - best ever vegetarian Laska with fresh herbs and veggies. Generous serving, made fresh and fast. Also large tasty G&Ts. People coming in and out 2 nights in a row. Very popular with locals and foreigners. Best of the few restaurants there on the street. Enjoy! Show less

Author: Knysna123
Title: Excellent! Excellent!
Review: Excellent! Casual atmosfeer, good ambiance, wide variety on menu. Tantalising the taste buds. Cold wine and beer. We had the lemon chicken, nyongan prawn, sizzling beef, pineapple rice and veg.

Author: Drivers22Poole, United Kingdom
Title: Still the best Nasi Goreng Nonya I have tasted!
Review: We are regular visitors to Penang and have eaten at Ben and Amys Living Room for quite a few years now. We love the food here and have never been disappointed. This year due to a lack of staff they were a bit stretched but despite this still produced great food.Show less

Author: Mike T
Title: Great place
Review:
Lovely food. Good prices . Nice music .
We had a lovely evening. 
Especially enjoyed the sizzling prawns.

Author: VintindSheffield, United Kingdom
Title: Relaxed evening meal
Review: No space at the front. The bar was busy. So we were seating in the back near kitchen and boxes .Pricing is excellent for the area.Food is cooked fresh. For our first visit we had nasa gerang and black bean with chicken. Simple and tasty.Tiger beer by the bottle was a typical price for the area at 10 ringgits. Other beers are available.The living room is a popular place with brits who seem to revisit it regularly.Show less

Author: patapata2015
Title: Great food and atmosphere
Review: Ate at this restaurant several times during our stay. The food is beautiful with lovely fresh ingredients. Loved the relaxed atmosphere and the ad hoc music - definitely not to be missed!

Author: 990karenaDubai, United Arab Emirates
Title: The BBQ ribs are a must
Review: Living Room – Penang 2019/2020The food is freshly made good quality and delicious. This is a friendly restaurant with a large selection on the menu. Both my husband and I do not eat much due to the heat so we generally had the bbq ribs. They were always delicious, exchanged the chips for rice and had the dish between us. We ate here at least once a week during our 2 month stay at Park Royal and found it advisable to reserve as it can get very busy as it is so popular. If you have not eaten here it is to be recommended to try as you won’t regret it.Show less

Author: CMcC18City of Greater Geelong, Australia
Title: Definitely have dessert here!!!
Review: We originally where going to try The Boathouse, but the lovely owner of The Living Room won us over, and we were not disappointed. After a day of hiking across the National Park we had quite the appetite at dinnertime. We started with Chicken Satay sticks which were the best we had had. It was a smokey/roasted slightly spicy satay sauce which I could have bottled!! Oh boy! Then we had the Beef Rendang (served with streamed rice) and Fried Kway Teow. All amazingly lick the plate clean! Our 10km hike appetite didn't let us stop there...time to check the dessert menu.I had the Fried Ice Cream and my husband had the pineapple fritter and ice cream. Oh boy it was possibly the best Fried Ice Cream I have ever had. The Ice Cream was solid, not sloppy and the batter so light and fluffy, no excess oil! Definitely have dessert here guys!!! Show less

Author: Richard C H
Title: Excellent service and a great menu
Review: My wife and I had dinner at this restaurant 3 times during our stay and couldn't fault it. The menu was varied and the level of service very good

Author: mikkoe811
Title: Very nice and homely place.
Review:
Very nice and homely place. 
The food was very tasty and wine also. 
Staff is very friendly. 
Best place in this area 😊

Author: Rachael T
Title: Highly recommend!
Review: The food here is amazing! The owners and staff are really nice people and were able to alter dishes to suit different food and gluten allergies. If you’re looking for fresh and delicious food, highly recommend the Living Room

Author: KarenBrock
Title: Fab evening all round!!
Review:
Well worth the walk!
Situated at the end of the Batu Ferringhi strip - excellent food (esp. local dishes), excellent hosts Amy / Ben and a chilled atmosphere with live music.

Author: Bellj382019
Title: Best meal in batu
Review: This was by far the best meal we had, forget the others this is the real deal, beef rending and Nasi gorang was delicious. We will be back.

Author: 75_Krzysiek
Title: Very tasty
Review:
Very good and tasty. Must taste „Thai Fish Style”!!! It is perfect 🙂
Very good White Wine and nice service.

Author: TerjeHoegberg
Title: You can't miss this place, delicious food
Review: Good location, along Batu Ferringhi beachroad, lovely atmosphere, friendly and helpful staff and delicious food, specially their version of beef rendang and the curries. I was here three times and enjoyed every moment.

Author: lipsjus
Title: Definitely „must visit” in Batu Ferringhi
Review: Definitely „must visit” in Batu Ferringhi! Delicious food, the atmosphere there (positiv energy of Living Room owner + live Rock) make this place perfect!

Author: nathang61Dianella, Australia
Title: Fantastic food and value
Review: We visited this place whimsy holidaying in Penang. It's easy to miss but wow the food was fantastic. Pricing was great and the ambience was very chilled. I had the beef rendang and my partner had the salt and pepper squid whilst we shared some satay chicken. Everything tasted so good and we both left very happy and full. highly recommend visiting!Show less

Author: captainsimon
Title: It’s fine, but felt disappointed
Review:
Cheap and cheerful I guess. the Penang Curry was ok but I wouldn’t order the Beef Redang again. Most dishes 25-30Ringit

Wouldn’t return again, Long Beach food court was much better if you want a casual dinner 

Cash only.

Author: cherrychandran
Title: Taste Horrible
Review: Good reviews brought us here. The food taste horrible. We are family dined in here. It's kind of unpleasant as if we are not welcome. The owners gave more priority to white people and we have to call couple of times to order and again to remind of our food and drink that hasn't been serve even though we were here earlier than the rest of the table. Will not recommend to others who are not a tourist. You can see most the commentators here are from other countries whom he serves well to get good feedback but if you are Asian looking DO NOT DINE IN HERE.Show less

Author: Caroline197499Anchorage
Title: Still thinking about our amazing dinner!
Review: We’ve decided that food in Penang is our favorite in Asia. Living Room did not disappoint. A local friend brought us here last night. The owner asked if we’d like to go by her recommendations, and we were happy to oblige. She brought out 3 appetizers, 5 mains and a dessert for the kids. Everything was perfect! My favorite was the vegetable “pancake” and the Thai fish. You can’t go wrong with this place!Show less

Author: catherinel815Seascale, United Kingdom
Title: Another great meal at The Living Room
Review: Arrived in Batu Ferringhi on Saturday after what seemed to be an eternity, travelling from the UK. Feeling very tired and not really wanting to do much but knew we had to eat, so we headed to The Living Room. We’ve visited here previously and knew the food was always reliably tasty and fresh. Our first visit (I say first as we’ve just eaten there again) we had our favourite chicken satay starter and beef rendang, neither of which disappointed. The chicken satay was good but the beef rendang was fantastic, super tasty and authentic. We talked to Amy (the owner) who was her usual hospitable self making sure all the food was to our taste and being generally a good host. She explained business was slow so we committed to return again during our stay. The return visit was tonight and oh my word, the food was even better. We opted tonight for the spring rolls to start, followed by Thai Bee Hoon with chicken and Thai fish. I can honestly say, while everything tasted great, the fish was by far the best thing we’ve eaten in a long time. It was exceptional and would heartily recommend you go along just to try it, I don’t think you’ll be disappointed. Once again we spent time talking to Amy (we ended up being the last people there). It was great hearing of her holiday plans. If you are staying anywhere in the Batu Ferringhi area, I strongly recommend giving this place a go, great food with great service and live music on some nights. Show less

Author: Glzrevh
Title: Great food, great location
Review: Very delicious food and the owner is very nice and friendly. So helpful and with great recommendations. The thai style fish was our favorite.

Author: Professor_David_60Liverpool, United Kingdom
Title: Living The Dream: Food, Music, Nice People !
Review: We first called in for a drink after dinner and quickly felt very welcome so stayed all night. We were all invited to sing as Ben our resident host was banging out some nice tunes on his guitar and signing a range of songs. We can' t sing (in public) so I was invited to play lead guitar along with Ben, and as a closet rock guitarist had a ball. After about an hour we stopped for a drink as it was approaching closing time. Next day we went back for a meal and the food was excellent. The menu is small but the the dishes we tried were very tasty and well spiced. The Thai Fish was my favourite. The place is quirky and easy to miss, but much better than the big place next door. It has great food and very nice owners. I hope to be back as I found the place unique. The beer wasn't bad either !Show less

Author: Nunk
Title: Lovely food
Review:
Lovely food. Inexpensive. White wine by the glass was nice. Friendly staff.
Tables and chairs are ‘rustic’!

Author: Ken W
Title: return visit
Review: I have missed eating here for the past 2 years due to an earlier problem with food and service but decided to try again. It was nice to have a warm welcome from owner Ben. I tried my favorite dish here that being Beef Rendang and can say that the food was very good and served exactly as I like it. Maybe this place will again become a good choice. This visit has brought back memories of good dining here over the past years and I would hope that all will be good in the future. Good variety of food available.Show less

Author: sara20b
Title: Good food, good atmosphere!
Review: Best way to spend a rainy evening with an affordable beer, live music and delicious food - salt and pepper squid lived up to the recommendations and sizzling chicken was great too! Lovely owner, very friendly!

Author: shannons1977South Australia, Australia
Title: Loved it
Review: It's our first trip to Penang & honestly we were a bit overwhelmed with where to have dinner with 2 fussy kids.. After reading the reviews on trip adviser today we decided to give this place a go for dinner tonight ( it's a 5 minute walk from the Hard Rock Hotel) We ordered 2 x mains, 2 entrees & a large friend rice & 5 drinks (2 were alcoholic) and the cost was $35AU. We were happy with that. The mains were not massive serves which was appealing to us.. The food was great quality & my husband who works in hospitality saw the kitchen and was very impressed by the cleanliness. We will definitely be going back.Show less

Author: Good and Faithf... S
Title: Amy goes further than the proverbial extra mile
Review: Amy went out of her way to individually prepare a gluten free meal for my wife and for my daughter in law. Both commented on how tasty the food was. 10/10. We keep coming back here year after year for this very reason.

Author: JeanS3864Washington DC, District of Columbia
Title: Fabulous local cuisine
Review: If you’re ever in Batu Feringgi, DO have dinner at the Living Room. The owner chef will provide you great recommendations but her (vegan) Laksa was the best we had during our 2 week trip to Malaysia. The Thai fish was also SO good. My kids loved the fried ice cream that they ordered a second order!! And we all enjoyed our meal so much we went back again during our week stay in Batu Feringgi. Show less

Author: LadyBnMiniB
Title: Great food
Review: Lovely lady running this place.  One of the few restaurants that don’t push a menu at you when you walk past.  Great food, lovely service.  One of the best meals we had in this area.

Author: AlanrwhMelbourne, Australia
Title: Enjoyable Dinner
Review: Visited last night after favourable reviews and not disappointed. Friendly Caring owner makes you feel comfortable. Menu not extensive but plenty of choice. We had chicken satay, kuay toay, Mee Goring and Kng Kong Vegetable. All were fresh cooked and tasty. Spiced more to western taste. I suspect because of its location in Batu Ferringhi. We would have preferred a more authentic taste, but that is our personal preference. We are looking forward to a return visit to sample the Laksa and Beef Rendang. A very pleasant dinner.Show less

Author: jplummer2016Willetton, Australia
Title: Great Food
Review: The Living Room, recommended from friends, Very reasonable price and great food.Welcoming Hosts. Ben and Amy. Sometimes have a band playing or Ben might himself, otherwise he plays 60's and 70's music. Ben likes to talk when he has time.Amy made us a special dish with her own recipe.looking forward to going back when next in Penang. only 20 mins walk from The Lone PineShow less

Author: 746tamsinh
Title: Excellent home cooked food
Review: Great place. Food very fresh and no MSG! Portions a bit small for hubby and and 2 x hungry teenage boys but it’s very reasonable so we just ordered more!

Author: 240katiehChester, United Kingdom
Title: Food was simply amazing
Review: We visited tonight with our two young boys and were blown away by the quality and standard of food. We were spoilt for choice with the menu. All the food is homecooked from scratch and tastes amazing. We will be back. Would recommend the deep fried ice cream!!! Show less

Author: GoldenG008
Title: Great choice
Review:
We visited twice with a family of 11. Really nice food and great choice fod meat eaters and vegetarians! 

Defo recommend!

Author: Cheryl M
Title: Packaged salt and pepper squid
Review: We went to the living room tonight. We ate the Kapitain Fish which was really nice.but the salt and pepper squid was obviously from a packet for what you pay you can get 4 times as much house made and it was so much nicer for half the price at Long Beach. I think this place is overrated.Show less

Author: peterppatrick
Title: Nice atmosphere
Review:
Good food
Fast service
Accommodating staff
Pleasent place to sit and have dinner
No complaints
Nice for families

Author: Sentlenyana MBusan, South Korea
Title: Awesome!
Review: All I can say is we ate there twice in a row! Try the nasi goreng, salt & pepper squid and the thai style fish. Finish it off with the friend ice cream. This restaurant is unassuming with superb tasting food. Definitely worth the rave reviews.Show less

Author: DidsburyOwl
Title: Agree with all the other reviews
Review: Visited here after reading all the other reviews and had a lovely meal and evening. The owners were so helpful and friendly and it’s such a lovely atmosphere. Food was great. We had one of all the recommendations which included beef tending, salt and pepper squid (fantastic), sizzling chicken and fish curry. Been in Malaysia for 2 weeks and this was the best meal we have eat. Going back tomorrow to try other things on the menu!!Show less

Author: O6440STbarbararDublin, Ireland
Title: Lovely Restaurant
Review: Went two nights in a row to this restaurant. It is the best restaurant we ate in during our time in Malaysia. The staff are so friendly especially the owner who also prepares all the sauces and is happy to discuss who she makes each dish. The atmosphere in the place is really good and there is a lovely chilled out feel to it. The food and service were excellent. Can’t recommend this restaurant enough Show less

Author: 29rocky
Title: Amazing
Review: Stumbled across this on our last night. Food was amazing , awesome flavours & fantastic service. Thoroughly recommend

Author: georgiasing
Title: Best food in Malaysia so far
Review: This restaurant was outstanding! The staff were super friendly and gave us their best recommendations. It did not disappoint. We will be coming back again before we leave. A MUST TRY!

Author: nooshandGoofy
Title: One of our favourite
Review:
We have been here quite a few times 
The menu has enough variety to keep things interesting
Music and vibe make it great place to visit

Author: Rinni1974
Title: TASTY!
Review:
Nice variety of meals to choose from. 

Food was fresh and tasty. Meals were very reasonably priced. I had a squid dish and it was really tasty.

Drinks were served ice cold.

Service was good.

Author: 848nancyl
Title: Bland
Review: We came here due to the good reviews but we were disappointed. The chicken chop and the chicken with cashews were rather bland and tasteless. We also did not particularly care for the appetizers. Because everything was so disappointing, we opted to skip dessert.

Author: nay_holidayzBrisbane
Title: Ticket all the boxes!
Review: I was traveling with my husband and young son. They could not have been more accommodating for us. I’m glad we found this place early in our trip as we ended up eating here daily. The food was delicious! They would make my fussy toddler up food that wasn’t on the menu so he would eat. Very welcoming owners, always happy to have a chat. Highly recommend Show less

Author: 16Ayrfield
Title: Lovely food, friendly staff
Review: Beautiful food, friendly staff. We had a great night here with family. Will definitely be back. Dermot and Mags

Author: kjamesk76
Title: Living Room Cafe and Bar
Review: A nice cosy Café that serves really good beef rendang. Sedap!  Kid-friendly place with clean toilet. The lady boss is very friendly, and recommended the type of durians which are popular among the locals - the capris and the sweet flavored “Ao Chik”.

Author: RedTeddRossendale, United Kingdom
Title: Fabulous
Review: Food is brilliant,we had chicken satay and then the beef sizzler with sticky rice.Good drinks menu.Food and 2 rounds of drinks for 100 ringgits It’s the personality of the lady owner which gives you the happy warm feeling.She’d just come back from a holiday in Croatia and it’s fair to say she found it more expensive than Penang !!Show less

Author: dennismeggerland
Title: Great food
Review: Great food and beer in a friendly place a bit of music aswell very popular can't go wrong tried a few things all great

Author: Mark DPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: An most enjoyable Family run restaurant!
Review: This is a popular, "intimate" bar & restaurant [with an extensive menu] also has an "associated art gallery"... and entertainment in the evenings. Its really enjoyable... and the very friendly owners really love having guests... and are only too pleased to answer any questions that one might have. It is one of the most highly ranked [by travellers and locals] restaurants in Batu Ferringhi. It has also been awarded TripAdvisor's "Certificate of Excellence". A visit will be both memorable as well as very enjoyable!I hope that this Review has been helpful.Show less

Author: 3Kart6
Title: Nice Place
Review: The food is simple and tasty, it also has a good variety. The people there are super friendly there as it is family run. The service is good and there are a variety of activities for the young ones. Overall it is a wonderful place.

Author: limeyca
Title: A Night to Remember
Review: This place is friendly and welcoming and has many dishes to choose from and a few comfort foods for the Brit-Canadians in our party.  We enjoyed our meal and the atmosphere. Thanks.

Author: GillWatt78
Title: Delicious
Review: We went for lunch and enjoyed beef rendang, Malaysian chicken curry and our son had chicken schnitzel  (not v Malay!). Really lovely. Staff were friendly too. Highly recommend

Author: Arlene K
Title: Great food, friendly atmosphere
Review: Been here twice since we arrived, and dinner was great both times and the beer was cold. Tried several dishes between us and were not disappointed. Still a few days left, we’ll be back!

Author: _ajthoroldPeterborough, United Kingdom
Title: Good food friendly people
Review: Visited 3 times during our stay found the food to be very good with friendly service from the couple who run it.Definitely worth trying, we enjoyed the Thai squid which was delicious. However not disappointed on any of our visits & tried several different options between us.Show less

Author: Seville2Cheadle, United Kingdom
Title: Quirky little bar and restaurant
Review: Came for dinner with my husband,this place stands out from the croud with its hippy vibe. We only went in for a drink as we planned to eat somewhere else,but the food looked good coming out so we decided to eat here. Itt was very nice,homely simple yet yummy and good quality. The owners are lovely too..Show less

Author: KimOfTheNorthNottingham, United Kingdom
Title: Nice and relaxed spot for lunch
Review: This place has a relaxed and casual atmosphere and is a great spot to have lunch. The food is nice, although there are better places nearby if you are a real foodie. I really enjoyed the char kway teow and the sweet and sour fish though! There's a decent choice on the menu with plenty of drinks to choose from. I wouldn't hesitate to come here again.Show less

Author: Reiseprofi100
Title: Going down fast
Review: It used to be one of our favorites, but for the last two years it has gone down fast. What a pity !We tested it last year and were sorely disappointed. Again, this year, we gave it a chance and were again very disappointed.I took lemon chicken ( which used to be excellent) and got a burnt piece of chicken which had been deep fried (too fast) and was not really cooked inside. The sauce was too thin and did not taste right. A real pity....Show less

Author: MartinatDeskHorsham, United Kingdom
Title: A little rough and ready
Review: Attracts good reviews but not one that would pull you in through kerb appeal. It's quite narrow, quite small, has no beach view, tables are non matching, ours covered in some obscure peeling veneer...However, all of those points aside, service was quick, attentive and friendly. Food was good proportions, served quickly but you're not hurried, they do serve their red wine cold and explained that their "room temperature" is circa 35C which would make the wine warm. However there must be a halfway house as cold red wine is just wrong! Overall though a pleasant experience so 4 stars...Has live music occasionally but not on our visit. Show less

Author: Nick HGuangzhou, China
Title: Lovely friendly restaurant!
Review: I went to this restaurant twice for dinner during my stay in Penang and highly recommend it. The owners are very friendly and welcoming and soon get you settled with some drinks. I recommend the Chinese dishes but western food is available if you prefer. The pineapple rice and sweet and sour chicken are very good along with the black pepper beef! One of the evenings we were there they even had live music which was great. A very nice atmosphere and it is certainly a popular place and was full both nights we visited! A good sign!Show less

Author: michael c
Title: Decent authentic Malayan food
Review: Nice place. Service very good. Food selection good. There was some live music and we had lovely mixture of Malay and Thai food. Recommended

Author: dorothym821
Title: Lovely food. Reasonably priced.
Review: We had a lovely meal. Great food, and good varied menu. The owner was really friendly and could not do enough to please us. The cost was really reasonable. Can really recommend it. It does not have “posh” furniture but makes up for it with the friendly service.Show less

Author: travelnana2016Perth, Australia
Title: return visit to living room cafe
Review: Back to Penang after two years and had lunch at Living Room cafe - still great food and friendly atmosphere and people. My favourite Beef Rendang. My husband had salt and pepper calamari and he said it was good. Well worth a visit in Batu Ferrenghi.Show less

Author: Emma BNowra, Australia
Title: Best place in Batu Ferringhi
Review: What a beautiful little place!!!!! The service from the beautiful lady that runs the restaurant felt like you were an old friend, it was comfortable and warm. The food was spectacular!!! The best food I’ve had in not only Penang but Malaysia. The best bit, no one hassling you at the front of the restaurant. The restaurant is a small gem along the crowded front of the Batu Ferringhi stretch of commercial restaurants and finding it is the best thing you could do in the area!!! 5 star! Will be back!!!!! Thank you!!!Show less

Author: Smith01England
Title: Friendly
Review: Lovely food not expensive. Good food served by friendly, cheerful staff. On some nights the owner plays his guitar and sings very nice creates a good atmoshere.

Author: E9454YVmarkbGuernsey, United Kingdom
Title: Really nice place
Review: Have been here twice before on previous visits in the high season - last time around 18 months ago. Called in on our latest visit and once again fab service and more importantly, really nice food. Family run and super friendly. Give it a try but you may have to book if you visit in the high season. We will definitely be back again on this visit and future ones too.Show less

Author: JJScottyHunter
Title: Thank you!
Review: My wife and I visited during December and January and on recommendation from friends who spend each July in Penang and eat at the Living Room we visited. The Living Room did not disappoint. We loved the food, atmosphere and music. We ate here each night and got to try a wide variety of dishes from the menu! We loved it all but especially the Beef Rendang and Banana Milkshakes. Thank you to Ben and Amy for being so welcoming and offering us advice on what to do around Penang.Show less

Author: LachyRob
Title: Wouldn’t go anywhere else!
Review: Thank you for having us at your Living Room. We love spending time at the Living Room. Even during peak times the food was excellent with wonderful music and company. We especially love the variety on the menu and how you have catered for my specific dietary requirements. You have made eating meals out alot easier when we have been in Penang. Your expertise and understanding has taken the hassle out of eating out each night. Wonderful relaxed atmosphere, see you again!Show less

Author: mookeyesWoodville, Australia
Title: So cool!!
Review: We have spent a number of nights during our stay at this great and super cool bar / restaurant..We were so welcomed by Amy and Ben and Tweety and all the staff.. Great people serving really yummy food and awesome music and jam sessions every night.. Do yourself a favour and go there.. Try the really yummy beef rendang and beef satays ...Thanks Amy and Ben..we are so lucky to find your funky bar..we had the best times and will be back one day.. Leanne and Charlie Show less

Author: robw936
Title: Great atmosphere
Review: We found the food to be very tasty. The satay sticks are fantastic and the beef randang beautiful. The live music is fun and you can get up and sing along if so inclined. Worht a visit.

Author: Zidan82
Title: Great atmosphere
Review:
Great good, live music and family friendly.

Would highly recommend.

Good local Chinese cuisine and a wide range of drinks available.

Author: Donnievv
Title: Disappointing
Review: We went to the Living Room simply because of their great reviews. This was our last meal in Penang before going home and unfortunately it was our least enjoyable. Every meal we had during our 10 day stay in Penang was fantastic except for this one. Initially they did not want to seat us because it was new year's eve and they had a our table booked for 19:30 and we arrived at 18:00. They forgot to bring two of our meals that we ordered and the food really was not that tasty. They also seemed very rushed. I appreciate it was new year's eve and they were probably expecting a big crowd to come later but it was a very disappointing meal. There are many other better places in very close proximity with much tastier food, better ambiance and better service.Show less

Author: chrisinkl59
Title: Average restaurant
Review: I can see why people like this place, great place for tourists. I have been living in Malaysia for 12 years so my benchmarks are a bit different from most of the people eating there, and l must say that l have been desappointed by the size of the portions. Food is ok, but lacks of punch (which makes Malaysian food so nice).Show less

Author: jimtD8398YU
Title: Dinner visit
Review: A nice restaurant with good ambience. There is live music with people jamming. Food portions here are quite small but I think it’s quite standard for the area. Food overall was ok - it didn’t stand out for us. We had the salt and pepper calamari - that came out in a very sweet Chilli sauce. The rendang beef curry was ok. The fish kapitan was nice but small portion - and for 3 people sharing, you only really get a mouthful each. And the vegetables were ok as well. Our bill was wrongfully calculated - so just keep an eye out on your total. I’m sure it was an honest mistake but it was a RM70 difference so not insignificant. They were very apologetic.Show less

Author: y0gelStockholm, Sweden
Title: Horrible dinner
Review: Really don’t understand what the hype is about for this place! The squid had a 1cm layer of frying crust. The chicken was inedible and tasteless and had funky smell to it. The local fish was ok but way to much sweet sauce! Poor service and not to mention the horrible band! Show less

Author: 221jannep
Title: Ok but...
Review: A bit over rated. The food was ok but really nothing special. Only tourists were present. Live music was entertaining and the service friendly. But still...

Author: 779craigp
Title: First night dinner
Review: First dinner back in Batu, and what a gem. We will eat here again before we leave. The service was great, the live music a surprise and the food was superb. The dry chilli squid was the standout.

Author: thewallet
Title: Out Standing as Usual
Review: Best Dried Chilli Chicken ever. And the company’s great. Come to the Living Room & let Ben & Amy spoil you. Brilliant Food, Local Music & some of the Best Food I Penang.

Author: 606richardkMelbourne, Australia
Title: Family holiday
Review: Ate here last time in Penang and is still very good. My daughter just loves the “beef rendang” and it is very good. Owner always has a chat which is good. There are far more fancy looking restaurants close by but the food is definitely better here. Well done and hope to visit next time we are in Penang. Make sure you check it out. Show less

Author: GoPlaces64236135911
Title: Meal
Review: Loveley food, lady owner very friendly, closed on wednesdays, definateley recommend. Went on our last day for lunch but unfortunately it was closed.

Author: Pioneer09511184084
Title: Nonya laksa with assam laksa ingredients
Review: Good mix..of both world. Cross culture of nonya laksa ingredients with Penang laksa ingredients. Very creative

Author: ank1t
Title: Amazing vegetarian noodles
Review: I asked for spicy vegetarian dish and voila got just that. The dish was customized according to my taste buds. The hostess recives you with welcoming smile. The food is prepared quickly. Laidback setting.

Author: boulouko21Adelaide, Australia
Title: Lovely
Review: We went there twice. Suitable for all ages groups. Even our 4 year old enjoyed it. Their juices are fresh. The pineapple one is awesome . Even better if you ask them to add fresh orange too. They even helped us to book a GRAB as we lost internet. Nothing was to hard for the lovely husband and wife . Food is great.Show less

Author: HelenaK435
Title: Amazing laksa
Review: A must if you are in the area. Laksa best I’ve ever had and the Thai fish also brilliant. All really reasonably priced. Lovely owners.

Author: lounosta
Title: Tasty Dishes
Review: We had the prawn curry and mixed vegetables - both very tasty. Service fast and friendly. Happy to talk to customers about local area.

Author: Martina SDubai, United Arab Emirates
Title: Dont bother going anywhere else!
Review: On out 4th night on Batu Ferranghi beach we discovered this gem. It's a small, cosy, comfortable jungle infused friendly bar/restaurant just up the road to the right of Park Royal hotel. The Living Room prices are the best on the beach stretch. Ice cold beers & excellent home freshly prepared meals will not disappoint. Great service. Wish we had found this bar on our first night!! Will definitely be back and highly recommend to others. Note: Cash only payment.Show less

Author: moirvolleyPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Awesome cafe with great food and wonderful staff
Review: We went to the Living Room Cafe as a place with vegan options. It did not disappoint, I had the vegan laksa on the recommendation of Amy and had it another 4 times it was that good. They were happy to advise what was suitable for other friends with dietary requirements. We organised a large group dinner there and the food was well appreciated. Highly recommended for food, drinks and the hosts.Show less

Author: moirvolley
Title: must visit cafe
Review: we went due to the recommendations for vegan food and they were not wrong. the vegan laksa was sooo delicious. our omni friends loved it to and thry catered for a large group without any problems. a must go cafe.

Author: Ronaldinho EPhuket, Thailand
Title: Lovely local food, great vegan options and lovely staff
Review: We came here because of the great reviews regarding vegan options. They are very flexible and can change dishes, there are also a bunch of dishes that are already vegan.We had keoy teow noodles (probs spelled that wrong), laksa which was amazing, yellow noodle soup, stir fried mixed vegetables, spring rolls. All very nice.Manager was very friendly and helpful. Toilets were the cleanest I've seen in a restaurant in Asia! Had to walk through the kitchen to get to them and could see the chefs at work.There were some guys playing guitar and singing which was also nice and added to the atmosphere.Show less

Author: craigcampbellNZ
Title: Great food and drinks
Review: We stopped in after a days shopping in the rain and had a great meal. All five of us had a good meals

Author: RSBUk
Title: Really good food
Review: Enjoyed dinner here. The owner was really helpful and friendly. Food was tasty and well spiced. Recommeded

Author: pistonbroke28Liverpool, United Kingdom
Title: Lovey meal
Review: Had a really lovely meal here at the living room last night. There was a jamming session and the music was brilliant. We had oyster prawns and rice and our son had British fish and chips and the meal was absolutely beautiful. Definitely deserving of the five star rating. Show less

Author: Marty1340
Title: Tremendous find
Review: Looking for somewhere, cozy, friendly, with great food and reasonable prices? Look no further than here, it has it all. To top it off they had a live band singing folk songs taking me back in time, loved it! Would recommend to anybody 👍🏻

Author: NorthStar796818
Title: Great beef rendang and live music
Review: Terrific beef rendang. I also enjoyed the live music: a great playlist and not too loud for us to talk.

Author: thewalletperth
Title: Best of Batu Feringgi
Review: How can you describe Brilliance, as someone who Travels 11 months of the Year, Usually Five Star, got to Love a Business Credit Card. Ha ha. The Living Room is a Place I call Home away from Home and have for the Last Five Years. Amy & Ben will always make you feel Welcome & the Cuisine is outstanding. I can not recommend The Living Room More Highly. Eat Enjoy, Stay. Thank you Amy & Ben.Show less

Author: Jmc3330
Title: Excellent Night
Review:
Cosy bar with some great live music. Food was reasonably priced and very, very tasty. 

We had an excellent night here - thoroughly recommended!

Author: kristineoosthaugen
Title: Amazing
Review: The restaurant looked kind of shabby, but it didn’t really matter, because the food was absolutely amazing!!! I would recommend the sizzling chicken or beef, both were delicious!

Author: cardiffcwtchCardiff, United Kingdom
Title: Perfect family restaurant!
Review: We’ve been to Batu Feringgi many times but have struggled this time to find something that suits the whole family.Thankfully, we’ve now found The Living Room which has a combination of the perfect welcome from excellent hosts, a wonderfully authentic menu with some amazing nonya dishes and some great live music. Delicious and incredibly reasonable - we had salt and pepper squid, fish curry kapitan, beef rendang and beef steak burger and chips, a side of basil goreng, four large tiger beers, soft drinks and two ice cream puddings for around RM240It’s fabulous and we can’t wait to return. Show less

Author: Robert SOlney, United Kingdom
Title: Good food and friendly people
Review: We visited this place for breakfast one day and enjoyed it so much we went back the next night for dinner with some live music. Food was all to an excellent standard and we had a great tip from the owner to use Grab (Asian equivalent of Uber) as a means to get around for cheap. Show less

Author: Brisbane963
Title: What a great cafe bar and restaurant
Review: Fabulous evening of music and delicious food! Lots of great Australian singers play every Friday night and sometimes during the week! Lots of fun

Author: 128kirstinkTaupo, New Zealand
Title: Best Laksa ever
Review: Great service, amazing food in nice garden . We had one of our best food experience here at the Living room . We loved the fresh herbs and mouth watering tastes in the Laksa, fantastic for us too as Vegetarian. We also had a Kapitan Nyonya curry which again was jammed with loads of fresh flavours ( lime, chillies, Kaffa lime leaves , ) everything made from scratch with local ingredients. Had great chat to owner Amy and stoked to hear she only buys free range chicken and best quality vegetables which you could taste in all the dishes . If we stayed closer we would be back to try other dishes . Make sure you try the Laksa Show less

Author: CityFolks777Kuching, Malaysia
Title: A wonderfully furnished cafe with suiting ambience
Review: Had a wonderful time with friends at this joint. Reasonably good selection of fusion menu. Foods are served with generous portioning and assurance of freshness. Service personnel are well trained to serve. Prices on the menu are relatively steep but compensated by the assurance of quality and freshness of the foods. Show less

Author: Traveler462223
Title: An absolute must
Review: If you are in Battu Ferringhi and you don’t visit this place - you will be sorry! Amy is a fantastic host & guides you through her delish menu with all the passion of a traditional & proud home cook. All dishes are a good size & are totally delicious. We had the the laksa to start followed by beef rendang, beef Penang, special noodles, fried rice and the star of the show “Thai style fish.”Would absolutely recommend this place - very comfortable atmosphere and great local food. Plus when we were there, there was live music too! What more can you ask for?! Thanks for a great night! Show less

Author: Janette BMelbourne, Australia
Title: An instant party
Review: We are a group of 13 in Penang to celebrate a birthday. The food was excellent,especially the Nyonya fish curry. The evening was made though, when the jam session started. We sang along and with the two musicians...and danced as well. We all had a great night.Show less

Author: Alexandra SCanada
Title: Average food... overpriced and overrated
Review: The food wasn’t the great. We had the lemon fish and the sweet and sour fish, both with rice. There was barely any fish in one of the portions. The lemon fish was over cooked and the sauce was horrible... it didn’t really taste like anything. So overpriced for what you’re getting. Show less

Author: merds16Atlanta, Georgia
Title: Welcoming and Tasty!!!
Review: From Denver, Colorado and was looking for one last good meal prior to leaving Malaysia. I had an early flight but still went right when the restaurant was opening. The owners (an amazing couple!) opened up early for me and sat with me as I ate my first Beef Rendang dish (traveling alone after a business trip!). The highlight of my time in Malaysia. Good conversation, the sweetest couple, great environment, and EXTREMELY good food. If I make it back to that side of the world any time soon, that will be the first place I eat.Show less

Author: holidaysareiChelsea, Australia
Title: Delicious food
Review: Went to the Living Room by recommendation and we were not disappointed, the food was amazing. Only a small restaurant, but great atmosphere. The host discussed what was great and her recommendations and that is what we decided to do, we shared the dishes between 5 and were very happy with what we had eaten. Live music is also played to entertain you whilst you eat.Show less

Author: Yi Jia C
Title: Overrated
Review: Visited at less peck hour, the staff was rude, overpriced, food was served in small portion. Nothing special at all

Author: dottydesi214Phoenix, Arizona
Title: Excellent food, cozy amosphere, warm service!
Review: I was traveling solo in Penang for several days, and ate here three evenings! Dishes I enjoyed are beef rendang, kapitan curry chicken, satay, and char kuey teow. All were fabulous! Fresh tasting with high quality ingredients and very satisfying portions. Amy, the owner, was a lovely hostess. Eager to chat and tell me more about Penang. Once she learned I love to cook, told me about the ingredients she was using and provided tips on how I can recreate some of the food at home. . Please do drop in for a meal and cold tiger or two, you'll be glad you did. A real local gem and a highlight of my time spent in Batu Ferringhi :)Show less

Author: Jess E
Title: Great food and excellent service!
Review: This is a must on any trip to Batu Ferringi! The food is delicious and the owners and staff are lovely. We had two dinners here (on a 4 day long weekend from KL) and enjoyed both immensely. Try the Rendang and the spring rolls!

Author: O3034NSpaulbDartford, United Kingdom
Title: Superb final meal in Penang
Review: We had a great meal here on 2nd June. It was our last meal of our 10 day trip to Malaysia and Singapore and it was one of the best. Superb atmosphere with live music in a cosy palm lined restaurant. The service was excellent and friendly. We took advice on what to eat. The menu is very cosmopolitan and included fish and chips. We had mainly malay chinese food and everything was delicicious and freshly prepared. The spring rolls were amazing, as was their special chicken dish. We supplemented it with plenty of freezing cold Tiger Beer. The restaurant was not busy, but we would strongly advise anyone in the area to visit it. We w ill be back next time we come to Penang.Show less

Author: kfwrigleyLiverpool, United Kingdom
Title: Great food. Brilliant music. Excellent hostess.
Review: Recently visited here and we were not disappointed.Amy, the hostess was very knowledgeable and helped us choose our food.The general ambiance was chilled and the background music was brilliant (60s, 70s and 80s).The food arrived quickly and hot and was delicious.Apparently there are live jam sessions of on a Friday and Saturday in which anyone can partake. We will certainly try to get back on one of those days.Overall a really good experience.If you are staying at the Shangri La end of the strip it may be beneficial to hire a taxi as the walk through the night market may be tiring for some.We wish Amy and her staff all best for the future.Show less

Author: adamo011972
Title: Not cheep but reasonably food
Review: Well located cafe that has a broad menu and nice atmosphere. Food was reasonable and the beer was cold, not cheep by any means but nice enough.

Author: 432egl_b
Title: Coctails
Review: Best coctails (totally bests of the bests in Cyprus), atmosphere ( great music)  and service!  highly recommend to visit

Author: jamesy7
Title: Really good food
Review: Came here for lunch as I'd heard about the beef rendang, it was full of great flavour and generous amount of beef, delicious. Will return to try an evening here.

Author: DCDolcevitaPuerto Vallarta, Mexico
Title: Okay food, good service
Review: The menu doesn't give any details about what's in any of the dishes, and no pictures are provided. The beef rendang was tasty, but nothing great. The people are very nice and make you feel welcome, so it does feel like being in someone's living room. But the food didn't make me want to come back.Show less

Author: VintageClaret
Title: Ok..3 stars at best.
Review: More of a cafe restaurant really....nothing to shout about at all food or service wise. Needs to step up a bit in terms of decor certainly.

Author: andcur
Title: Friendly spot for a good meal
Review: We consistently frequent this cafe on our annual visit to Penang for the friendly service with good quality and value meals.

Author: Gerald CPortsmouth, United Kingdom
Title: Very Friendly
Review: Great atmosphere run by a husband and wife who really make you welcome. Get there for 6 pm and watch the family of monkees walking along the electric overhead lines and the climb into the trees. If you like a singalong then go there on a Friday and Saturday. Highly recommend the sizzling beef with special fried rice.Show less

Author: Elliot_BusbyUK
Title: Decent atmosphere
Review: We visited one evening for dinner. There was a band playing English tunes that were just ok . Everything is a little quirky once inside. Decent chairs not plastic with proper plates but chipped. The food was ok but as others have said small portions. Garlic prawns (overcooked ) & beef rendang with a couple of starters - spring rolls & samosas very tasty. The food wasn't wow but was above Average. The prices are definitely the same as other restaurants it isn't expensive at all. Service was ok.Show less

Author: Joy-holidaySingapore, Singapore
Title: Average, a little overprice
Review: We had Penang laksa, fried Kwetiau and curry fish. Curry fish is rich and tasty but too much flower coated the fish. Kwetiau is very oily and way too soft. Portion is small. However, it was only RM7.5. Laksa was not bad but overprice at RM20.Show less

Author: Y1294MUjameslTrinity Beach, Australia
Title: Welcome to the Living Room
Review: We went here a number of times on our holiday at Batu Ferringhi. The restaurant is a couple of minutes walk from the Parkroyal and Holiday Inn and you don't have to run the gauntlet of the night markets if you are staying at either of these hotels. Food is tasty, fresh and spicy, if you want, and the beer is cold. But it is the husband and wife team who own it that really makes this place special. It is like visiting friends for dinner. Nice music, great conversation, food to share and special holiday memories.Show less

Author: TimoK1478
Title: Good food and atmosphere
Review: Nice looking quite small place. Waiter was friendly and food was good and reasonable priced. Not far a way from 5 stars.

Author: james b
Title: VERY PLEASANT
Review: Enjoyed a few beers and some good food on a number of occasions during a 26 night stay in Batu Ferringhi. Food, service and atmosphere was good and I recommend this restaurant. Good value for the quality of the meals.

Author: marco cBrussels, Belgium
Title: Tasty food
Review: Colorful casual restaurant with nice atmosphere and good service. Me, wife and two kids went there for dinner the last day before the Lunar New Year closure and we didn't regret it a bit. We ordered various Chinese dishes to share and everything was good. Pity they ran out of fried ice cream... but the fried banana was a nice alternative.Please note: cash only.Show less

Author: Fiona S
Title: Small portion
Review:
Reviews are amazing for this place but it’s quite overpriced for malaysia and offers small portion sizes ? 
Food was ok

Author: elizakay
Title: Malaysian Lunch
Review: I ordered the Laksa which was awesome, my family all loved their meals-sizzling prawns, chicken cashew, red curry prawns - all amazing and very reasonably priced, staff friendly, stayed open for us

Author: purefinder
Title: Another gem
Review: Well worth it's high TA position ,could not fault the extremely tasty  dishes we all had,my wife thought it the best beef rendang she had ever had . A treat not to be missed.

Author: JCT1962Newcastle, United Kingdom
Title: Good food and service
Review: Visited here for first time last night and it lived up to positive reviews on TA. We found the service incredibly friendly and efficient as well as knowledgeable about the food. We shared samosas to start which were accompanied by a nice chilli dipping sauce. Main courses were beef rendang and lemon chicken accompanied by pineapple rice and fried rice. Food was very tasty with good spicing and portions were a good size. Accompanied by 3 tiger beer and a bill of RM94 was also really good value. I would recommend a visit. Show less

Author: Katrina P
Title: Amazing capitan curry!
Review:
One of the best restaurants we found in Penang! 
Amy the owner really looks after you. Food is cooked fresh! 
Missing our Malaysian food!

Author: SemiRetdNottingham
Title: Well deserved of rating- great little place
Review: Staying at up market hotel but fancied some tasty local food. Living Room cafe bar didn’t disappoint. Lady owner very friendly and helpful. Lemon fish was fresh battered snapper fillet with nice sharp lemon sauce (not gloopy like some places), my Nasi goreng was excellent as were sides of fresh stir fried greens and sizzling mixed vegetables. With drinks under MYR80 (£16!). Rustic arty decor with lots of plants. Clean and efficiently run. Much nicer than impersonal plastic chair food court but does not cost much more. Show less

Author: James GMaybole, United Kingdom
Title: Tourist favourite
Review: Located on the strip in Batu Ferringhi Penang is the Living Room a popular restaurant with tourists reasonably small but with character provides Chinese food mainly you are allowed to bring your own wine but you pay a corkage charge, my only complaint is that the table and chairs are uncomfortable to sit in.Show less

Author: Dave PBrisbane, Australia
Title: Amy and Ben, are both amazing friendly people who make you feel welcome.
Review: The Living Room Cafe is a must to eat at . The food is very tasty,authentic Malaysian / Chinese Cuisine & reasonably priced and Ben is a very relaxed and capable barman.The Cafe is clean, and has a very relaxed holiday atmosphere.Ben has a Jam session Friday and Saturday nights.Walk in diners are welcome to participate to demonstrate their musical talent.Show less

Author: sarahbV7796HV
Title: Ok
Review: Didn’t live up to our expectations after reading reviews on here. Food average, seemed more like a hotspot for tourists to get drunk. Won’t be going again, we found cleaner cafes to eat in on the food strip.

Author: Traceycowderoy01
Title: Great place
Review: First night out.. found this place and remembered seeing it on others reviews as places to eat... great atmosphere fab food...

Author: nathanl281
Title: The food here is great.
Review: The Thai chicken is my absolute favourite. The veggies are so fresh and the flavour is so light and yummy! This place is always quite busy and open usually earlier than Helena’s.

Author: kbmiller23
Title: Excellent Food, Great vibe
Review:
The food was really good and the service was very good.  Food came quickly and was delicious. The live music gave it a great feel as we dined.  Highly recommend!  
Cheers

Author: DarylWongSauYee
Title: Not for locals
Review: The set up was nice. But the dishes are really for foreigners and tourists. Definitely not for locals. Dishes were rather bland.  Price is tourists' price. Taste of the food is....a miss.

Author: phil P
Title: Delicious food
Review: For delicious food at a great price and excellent hosts, visit the Living Room Cafe.  We really enjoyed our meals at this restaurant and would highly recommend that you visit, especially on a Friday or Saturday night with the added bonus of free music.

Author: daisyduke70Huntingdon, United Kingdom
Title: Good food but expensive
Review: We went last night and really liked the ambiance of the place. Owners were welcoming although distracted with entertaining a couple of ex-pats who were drinking there. Food was good although the portions were small(In my opinion). Sizzling beef and the rending were lovely, our daughter enjoyed the BBQ ribs and chips. Nice merlot to wash it down with. We ordered 5 dishes which the owner said would be plenty, we had to order the rendang half way through as we realised there was not going to be enough food for us. RM 240 (including 2 beers and 3 glasses of red) and we weren’t exactly stuffed. Cash only accepted, restaurant is open until 10:30pm at present, closes in the afternoon, closed Wednesdays. Show less

Author: DarkdogZA
Title: Full of flavour
Review:
This was a random visit while we were in the area after an morning hike.

Really lovely family run restaurant with home grown herbs and spices. Thoroughly recommended.

Author: lovelycris
Title: Lovely place!
Review: This place is run by husband and wife. Both are easy going and very welcoming and definitely sets the tone for this place. Fried fish with kapitan sauce is a great recommendation on the menu.

Author: Tarrabrewer
Review: Went here for dinner and was treated like a long list friend. The staff were excellent and their recommendations from the menu were delicious. The two piece band added great tunes to a lovely home type setting.

Author: clarkes_in_asia
Title: Tasty and friendly.
Review:
Great beef redang and really friendly service.
Nice garden seating, it does get busy so don't leave it too late or you'll be disappointed!
Will go back.

Author: David P
Title: Living room a must
Review: Absolutely amazing food and service. Beef rendang is so good. Been there 3 times this holiday and it's been amazing

Author: meredith h
Title: Authentic Malaysian  foods
Review:
Lovely small cafe with authentic Malysian food, husband and wife team. Good prices.
Had excelllent vegetarian luksa, different from any other.

Author: alisonparkes
Title: Lovely atmosphere, good food, reasonably priced
Review: A must while in penang. Good food great atmosphere and well priced. A must visit when in Penang.  Try the Spring rolls and satay

Author: sunit1000
Title: Good food but there is better around
Review: Food here is by no means bad but having eaten in helenas next door the night prior I didn't find this food to be of the same standard. Nice place but not the best flavours

Author: colinppp
Title: Great food good price and service
Review:
This is a must as you do not pay local tax or service charge, which means you can spend more.

We had a variety of  food, well cooked and service well at a good., price.

Author: hml1010
Title: Not for local
Review: I went there with family for vacation as we seen tons of good comment about this place. However, the good is below average only, great disappointments. Maybe this is not for local :(

Author: jinx_val
Title: Excellent service
Review: Only been here for drinks but really impressed make I feel welcome as a solo traveller. Need to go back for food the menu looks really good.

Author: Ex-Slb-and-HappySt Leonards-on-Sea, United Kingdom
Title: Nice atmosphere and Great food
Review: Ate here last night, a last minute walk by and saw a table free so went in. Prices are good and food was well served. Tasty and well presented.We had the wontons and large crispy spring roll, followed by Nasigoreng and Crispy Chicken Thai style, with greens and rice. The bill was 70MYR for the two of us and thats with beer, Fruit juice and water. Very reasonable and recommended if you are passing by.The live music was a bonus and enjoyable.Show less

Author: laurawil85
Title: Delicious food, great atmosphere
Review:
Went here on recommendation from friends and so glad we did. Food was delicious and staff so friendly! 
Will definitely be recommending on!

Author: Jon_SuzyParkside, Australia
Title: Overrated Dining
Review: Last week I was in Penang and some of the guests had mentioned that this was a good venue for an evening meal, having been to Penang many times I thought I would give it a try as my favourite restaurant Andrews Kampung is closed on a Tuesday evening.The venue is just Norrh of the Park Royal Hotel at Batu Ferrungi.On arrival it was moderately busy all diners appear to be tourists.We sat down and it was quite some time before we received the menu.We ordered Steamed Fish and Steamed Vegetables.The meal arrived some 30 minutes later and the server was not the order taker, and had little knowledge of English.The Fish fillets were very smell and presentation was unattractive. The Vegetables were bland basically all cabbage only 3 slices of mushrooms and 4 pieces of broccoli.We had 2 sparkling water and the price was MR 83 which is $27 Australian $.Having read the reviews here this restaurant is way over rated and clearly is not even close the the venue I mentioned above.Jon & SuzyShow less

Author: waynes821
Title: You can't go wrong!
Review: We had the Nasi Goreng on our fist visit (yes, 3 visits in 2 days!) and it was fantastic! The best I have ever had, one of us had the beef and the other chicken.That night we were back, we had squid, it was so good, fish it was excellent and then the special pork. The pork was good but the others were to rave about.The next day we were back for the Nasi Goreng, yum.Oh, yes, the beer, ice cold, so good.I have never been back to a place so many times in such a short time span.Show less

Author: jennyashNorthern Ireland
Title: Real taste of Malaysia honeymoon
Review: Amazing food, my newly wedded husband had and loved the fish curry, I ordered on recommendation the beef rendang and was not disappointed! Highly recommend the living room, friendly staff and real food, unlike the market down the road which was nothing like the 'real' street food... loved the feel of the place, relaxed atmosphere and good food! What more would you need - will definitely be back if I have the chance to travel to this part of the world again! Show less

Author: MikeSealey
Title: Great atmosphere. Great food
Review: After walking the night market. It was a pleasure to sit in a place with character eating good food at a reasonable price.

Author: shirleyjoyAdelaide, Australia
Title: great atmosphere
Review: We went on a night when it didn't stop raining for about 2 hrs so we had plenty of time to enjoy the ambiance. We sat near the entrance as the water cascaded over the roof resembling a waterfall. The staff were very concerned we may be getting wet but we were loving it. Fortunately the food matched the surroundings. It was a lovely evening. To get an experience like that is rare and to eat an enjoyable meal in such a quaint environment is such a bonus.Show less

Author: 639BarbaraM
Title: Evening meal
