Review: Met up with a couple that my husband knew and they recommended restaurant not a big place but the food was great and cooked to how you would like it they have music as well owner very friendly would go back again

Author: thewallet
Title: Absolutely Brilliant, Well Worth a Visit.
Review: Just had the Best Laska ever. If you like wonderful Food in a Great location with amazing Hosts then this is the place for you. Beef Rendang , Sizzle Plates, Battered Fish, Noodles & Nasi Goreng all unbelievably Good. Well worth a visit.

Author: 0103raeMittagong, Australia
Title: Best Malaysian food in Malaysia
Review: The best food we have had in Malaysia, we have been searching for 2 weeks, and this restaurant is outstanding. Fresh food and freshly cooked, the fish in particular was fabulous, so fresh. The atmosphere was lovely, and staff very friendly, and lovely hosts. Prices were also very affordable, win, win.Show less

Author: shearer1974London, United Kingdom
Title: Nice Lunch
Review: This is a pleasant spot for a bite to eat and the beef rendang was one of the best I've had. Set up very much for westerners - staff very friendly and looked like they had live music at night. The prices were a little steep compared to the street food markets but nothing scary. If the streetfood markets are scary then this is a nice place to stop Show less

Author: Florey67
Title: Fantastic restaurant
Review:
We loved the people at this restaurant and the food was great too.
We went here many times during our holiday. 
The atmosphere was great with an open microphone for singing too.

Author: Nottyfruit
Title: cozy little joint
Review:
great fusion food, great atmosphere and music on friday evenings.
ben and amy are great hosts. it can be crowded on the evenings so get there early.

Author: Daine72
Title: Yummy
Review: The outside looks like any other food place but it is the food that nails it. I had the beef rendang which was so soft and yummy. My wife had fried rice which was quite tasty. Amy the host was friendly and I do recommend this place. The quality of the food is very good. We ate lamb skewers from Long Bay food court nearby and yes it is cheaper but the quality was not good. We found them tough. So if you prefer quality over quantity then go here and the quantity is a normal serving.Show less

Author: Gary-PK77Saudi Arabia
Title: Looks can be deceiving
Review: Great food, from the outside this place looks like all the other restaurants, bars and cafes in the area but its a whole lot more.Staff - so friendly and happy to talk through the menu to make sure you get exactly what you like Food - so tasty, fresh and great qualityPrice - Amazing value for moneyGeneral - Very clean and comfortable, a real gem amongst other placesWell worth a visit, only a short walk from Hard Rock Hotel Show less

Author: perthSeagullsPerth, Australia
Title: Mind numbingly good!
Review: Food here is so good we came back the next day for more. The local dishes - nasi goreng, Penang curry chicken, Nonya fish and beef rendang were incredible. The Thai Fish was my particular favourite. Really casual relaxed atmosphere, with live music on the Friday, warm and friendly staff. And the beer was served super cold with a stubby holder (to Aussie tastes!) and it was the best house wine we had in Penang. We had a large group of 9 and they accommodated us really well despite quite a small cosy space. My nephew loved it so much he was banging his head on the table when he had to leave! Great value too. Show less

Author: E4295BUjohns
Title: Excellent Value
Review: We had mixture of starters including salt and pepper squid which was fantastic. The mains were equally tasty not over spicy. One warning, bring cash . They don't accept cards.

Author: davidwkl874
Title: Amazing hidden gem
Review:
Fantastic traditional food for all family, we had beef rendang which was best I've ever had, chicken nyonya..nice and spicy but incredibly tasty. 
Forget all the pretentious larger restaurants in the area, this is unassuming and excellent.

Author: DdkentCanberra, Australia
Title: Great food and friendly staff
Review: We were recommended to visit the Living Room, and we are glad we did. The food was delicious, and very reasonably priced. The staff were very friendly and helpful. Altogether one of our favourite restaurants in Batu Ferringhi.There is also live music (singer and guitarist) on Friday and Saturday nights. I understand the restaurant is closed on Wednesdays.Show less

Author: SouthCoastFamilyManPortsmouth, United Kingdom
Title: Great
Review: Small, but hugely friendly, fantastic food and the best restaurant we found in Batu. Far better than the garden restaurant next door if you are looking for friendly service and well cooked local cuisine (with a slight western twist) Your kids will love the fried ice cream!Show less

Author: Warren WHong Kong, China
Title: Great local food
Review: It's a fairly innocuous entrance - so please don't miss out and walk by....grab a table and let the friendly staff help you.The food and surroundings aren't 5* but the staff are warm and inviting and give you some good recommendations.We had the spring rolls, salt n pepper squid and satay - they were all great - empty plates all round.We then shared beef rendang, sizzling chicken, pork ribs and red prawn curry. End result again empty plates and full stomachs - the food was excellent.Desert was some fun ice cream and fritters.All round it's great food - amazing value and a friendly, warm and inviting atmosphere.Like I said at the start - don't walk past - you will regret it!!!!Show less

Author: TriciaWeener
Title: Lovely reasonably priced family restaurant
Review: Had a wonderful evening at The Living Room - can highly recommend it... staff fab, food great and really enjoyed the Shiraz! Thx for a fab night

Author: LissC0011
Title: Fantastic food!!
Review: I stumbled across the place heading towards the Ferringhi Garden however it looked very inviting and I was not wrong. The food was priced well and tasted great, especially the black pepper beef. Wouldn't hesitate to visit again. Staff were also very friendly!

Author: Pat R
Title: Amazing cafe! Will definitely be back when I make to Penang the next time!!
Review: Awesome flair and the most delicious breakfast! Also the staff is super lovely. Thank you very much :D

Author: 803AliP
Title: Amazing food, friendly service
Review: What a find! Loved the rendang and the kuey teow was so good we had seconds. Deep fried ice cream was a hit with our daughter! Great ambience, wish we had found it before our last night!

Author: Cyprusmal
Title: Small venue good food
Review: Friendly owners Amy looks after you, her husband runs the bar. Cosmopolitan food..... bu the Malay is good! Very small restaurant or as Amy calls it "shop".

Author: Angelo442014
Title: Simply the best
Review: Ate at Living Room Cafe Bar & Gallery twice.  It was full of holiday makers.  Large groups of friends or families.  The service and quality was excellent.

Author: 692PeterH
Title: Great eats reasonable cost
Review: One of the best places we went for dinner whilst in Batu Ferringhi. Very popular and there is good reason a friendly host, ice cold beer and great food. A must to and visit.

Author: NessybumCambridge, United Kingdom
Title: Great little find
Review: We ate here and what a find thanks to previous trip advisors reviews. Very welcoming great ambience and tasty food. There is music and if you want to sing you can. It us cash only. I can recommend the sizzling beef and the Thai style fish delicious.Show less

Author: SarahG534
Title: Excellent local food
Review: Great place and the staff here are so welcoming. We got our waitress to recommend dishes and they were all fantastic. We really liked the fish and curries from the specials board.

Author: BeerbaitTurin, Italy
Title: Found it - Love it
Review: We found this restaurant and came back 2 times. It is really like a living room and you will feel like a family member. We were lucky to be there in the time, when special guests were singing and playing instruments What a great time. The choise of food and beverages was fine and so was the taste. If you stay in Penang, make sure you have your dinner there. Maybe you try this sizzling spicy chicken or fish.Show less

Author: leet301Sydney, Australia
Title: Just don't see the attraction....
Review: We went for lunch after reading rave reviews and being in the area. The lemon sauce on the lemon fish was gluggy, the prawns, in the prawns with oyster sauce, not particularly fresh and the sauce on the plate of vegetables again gluggy and reminiscent of Chinese cooking in the 70s. Living in Australia the price we paid was not high but by Malaysian standards it is for this sort of quality. We have had better, fresher, more flavoursome dishes at the hawker halls and markets and at much lower prices.Show less

Author: Frederic CSingapore, Singapore
Title: Cosy center amount large restaurants
Review: Food OK, Enjoy the songs with a solos singer. Tuck in a corner of larger restaurants. This Living room Cafe Bar is a good locations for a slow relax place even there no nice view, Good for Friends who loves to chats away the night while you on vacations, have some wines and beers and light foods.Show less

Author: Rinatk
Title: Good food, good service
Review: Food was good. Good service. Live music in the evening. They open for breakfast. Choice of local and western food.

Author: ebonyt985Tiong Bahru, Singapore
Title: We loved it!
Review: Went here tonight with my fiancé and our mums. It was our first meal in Penang and we all left raving about it. Very local and fresh. I ordered the hot plate chicken where they bring out and pour it onto the hot plate infront of you. We thought this was pretty authentic and fresh. Would recommend this if your looking for some amazing local food x Show less

Author: Brian Kathy BPalmerston North, New Zealand
Title: Best Food in Penang!!!
Review: This restaurant was just along the road from our resort and was the best meal we had in Penang. We ordered chicken satay and samosa for entree and lemon chicken, sizzling beef, morning glory and Nasi goring. The food was exceptional - fabulous flavours, great service and very cheap. Thoroughly enjoyed our visit - the bonus for us was that Friday was music jam night with live music - a really great night.Show less

Author: 826trishcSydney, Australia
Title: No. 1 restaurant in Batu Ferringhi
Review: This restaurant is the best in Batu Ferringhi the hosts were very friendly & happy to make your meal to your preference either spicy or mild. We ordered chicken satay sticks the peanut sauce was delicious, salt & pepper squid, its easy to see why this is one of the most popular dishes it's amazing & yellow chicken curry which was delicious. All mains are served with rice. The restaurant is cash only so make sure you've got cash. Live music topped off a great meal. Show less

Author: Nienke MThe Netherlands
Title: Great service and lovely food!
Review: We went here a couple of times during our stay in Batu Ferringhi. The food is very good and the restaurant also seems to be very clean! When walking to the toilet, you have to go through the kitchen, which was clean and organized. We had several dishes, all tasted great!The staff is very friendly and speak excellent English. There is no air-conditioning, but some vents make sure it's not too hot.Show less

Author: optimisticBeth
Title: Amazing food
Review: Go for the salt and pepper squid it was fantastic and the rendang curry. The staff were really kind and welcoming and all the food was great. Prices were higher than street food but less than in the restaurants around so definetly worth visiting

Author: Ian HMelbourne, Australia
Title: Number 1 in Batu Ferringhi
Review: Outstanding food, awesome value and the best service in the area. I have sampled many of the dishes and absolutely loved all of them. Our host Ina was the best and her food recommendations were spot on. It's a must for all who travel to Batu Ferringhi. Show less

Author: Frances LDuluth, Minnesota
Title: Wonderful Food and Service
Review: We found this restaurant just down from our hotel and what a pleasant surprise. We went back a second night for dinner. The food is spectacular and the owner sat with us and we had a wonderful conversation. The staff are also very friendly and explain what the dishes entail. Show less

Author: 145HelenR145Moora, Australia
Title: Delightful cafe in Penang
Review: Charming cafe, stumbled across it. Excellent food, the Laksa is superb, Nasi goreng excellent. Ice cold drinks. Wifi available. Fantastic friendly staff, nothing a problem for them. We were entertained by the Manager practising his guitar & singing, delightful. Love this cafe. Sat out a thunderstorm and downpour for about 90 minutes, it was beautiful & relaxing.Show less

Author: billdublin
Title: Charming
Review: Charming place with charming attentive service and excellent food. Great value. Definitely recommended. I regret that I didn't find it sooner on my visit.

Author: SineadB123
Title: Good cider, okay food
Review: Cold beer and cider at a great price. We had the salt and pepper squid, was nice and pork ribs. Only place I have found to have pork, however need a little more cooking... slightly chewy.

Author: intrepidexplorersid
Title: Left without being serves
Review: We stopped in her at about 6pm on the Sunday of the bank holiday weekend. One member of staff behind the bar, lengthy queue while she farted about making cocktails. After about ten minutes we left. Shame

Author: Ursula DLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Fabulous little restaurant
Review: Having seen the TA reviews and looked at the menu in passing, we decided to have dinner the following night. At eight on a Sunday night, the place was almost full, but we were lucky to secure a tiny table inside the restaurant. However, a little later we were able to move to a much more pleasant outdoor table under a tree in the front garden.The welcome from the owner was warm and genuine, she really enjoys interacting with her customers, and you feel like you're old friends.The menu choices are not huge, but everything is tempting. We had beef rending, a Malay chicken curry, stir fried kailan, served with rice. The beef was tender and could be shredded with a fork, the chicken came off the bone without effort, and the spicing was judicious and sublime. We couldn't resist the deep fried coconut ice cream which was simply delicious, although I did not taste much of the coconut flavour.Drinking beer with our food, we paid MYR105 incl. a tip. This is a little more than in other places along the beach road, but good value for excellent cooking, great service, and a very agreeable ambiance.Show less

Author: christinep947Rotherham, United Kingdom
Title: My sort of place!
Review: We enjoyed evening meals here so much we went 3 times on our 10 day holiday and each time the service was really good ,the staff were friendly and helpful and the food was gorgeous! It is not very big (size of a ,Irving room!) but the staff do there best to fit you in and they have a small waiting area. The food is authentic Malaysian. Well worth a visit.Show less

Author: Boroboy100Marske-by-the-Sea, United Kingdom
Title: Nice food great staff
Review: We decided to have an evening meal at this restaurant after recommendations from other people, it was very nice food and the owner and staff were very nice. But I must say that it is not good value as the same quality food can be got at a third of the price in other food outlets in Batu Ferringhi. Show less

Author: matthewhB6786ZQ
Title: Great
Review: Dont walk by this place if you think its small and no good. Stop in sit down and order the best meal in Penang. Warm greeting from friendly staff and the coldest beer in town. Great variety and value for money so dont walk past.

Author: AlexL84Southampton, United Kingdom
Title: Amazing evening
Review: We tried to visit this restaurant before but it was busy.Its fairly small but that adds to the atmosphere.We attended on a Friday evening.Unknown to us there is an open mic night where anyone can sing.This added so much to the evening.A variety of locals and tourists all taking part.It wasn't a tacky karaoke event by any means.The food was a typical local menu but all food was excellent and very well priced.The service was slick and friendly.A choice destination for everyone to sample during your stay Show less

Author: petet_007
Title: Great place to eat out without being expensive
Review: Excellent cafe to visit for a good inexpensive meal and drink and a bit of  live music, always popular with families

Author: glitterandwanderlust
Title: Really enjoyable
Review: We ate here twice and really enjoyed it. The food was delicious and it was One of the nights there was a band playing and they were brilliant and really built up a great atmosphere. It was very cheap and well worth a visit!

Author: Elaine J
Title: Another hidden gem
Review: If you stumbled across it you may give it a miss but you would be sorry. Very friendly and helpful staff. Meal was really nice, the beef rendang is a must and prawns in garlic (no problem when we asked for all shell to be removed. Prawns was small portion but otherwise the meal was well worth the price. Will be visiting again soon as we've still 11 days left of the holsShow less

Author: patriciarH8841JT
Title: Take away dinner
Review: We were looking for some local food but with tired kids walked in and asked if they would do a take out for us. We were greeted with hospitality and soon a very tasty fare was packed and ready for us to go away with.

Author: MrsAnderton44
Title: Had breakfast here
Review: Lovely little place... always very busy... had a delightful breakfast here and it was delicious... staff really friendly

Author: shannondE8671ZIPort Macquarie, Australia
Title: Fresh, Quick & Delicious Food
Review: Everyone in the family (kids ages 12 & 11) agreed that this was a 4. The food was fresh and quick and the service was friendly and helpful. The girls both had the spaghetti Bol, while my husband and I shared the salt & pepper squid and the sweet & sour fish. Well worth a visit. Show less

Author: ldx
Title: Fantastic food & friendly staff! Must visit!
Review: Quaint restaurant in Batu Ferringhi, we visited twice during our week stay. The staff are very friendly and the lady who seated us both times had lots of advice to give in regards to what to try, the food was incredible and traditional, it tasted so fresh! A must visit.Show less

Author: victoriav652Gothenburg, Sweden
Title: Flavors flavors and great hospitality
Review: We heard about Living Room from another couple last night and decided it was worth the 30 min beach walk. It was! We had the beef rendang (ginger, turmeric, lemon grass and thin sliced beef, cooked for hours and hours) and the Thai fish (snapper under cover; cover of julienned carrots, cucumber, onion with chili-lime-secret sweet sauce). And cold cold Tiger beer from the bottle. All under supervision of Amy, owner, head chef and clearly should be next mayor of Batu Ferringhi! Show less

Author: JessicaHR
Title: Small hidden gem of Penang!
Review: Over the past few nights my husband and I had walked by the living room restaurant and it was always full, never an empty table. After last night we can see why! Absolute fantastic food the best by far and very, very reasonable.

Author: XiaoMommySingapore
Title: Overrated at Tripadvisor
Review: We had dinner here on 7 Apr, Friday. We read about the good reviews on Tripadvisor and decided to try this place, which is near the Hard Rock Hotel where we are staying.We are the only all-Asian table amidst a very western clientele on the evening of our visit. We ordered Malaysian dishes since we are in Penang, which boasts of good local eats almost everywhere in the island! The Nasi Goreng had an over easy egg on top. Otherwise, there are no other visible ingredients other than the fried rice. No shrimp, no meat, no vegetables. It was likewise for the Penang Char Koay Teow. It was just fried rice noodles. These dishes are commonly prepared with a small amount of shrimp, meat and vegetables throughout Malaysia.We proceeded to ask for Sambal Belachan, which is a very common spicy Malaysian condiment. We were told they ran out (in a Malaysian restaurants?!). Whilst they offered raw chili as alternatives, one of the waitresses went on to comment that we should not need extra spicy condiment since the dishes are spicy enough. That comment did rub me off a little on the wrong way. Asians from South East Asia, including Malaysians, are known to be able to consume spicy food. An offer for alternatives would suffice, but there is no need to "tell me off" for requesting for the most basic of Malaysian condiment in a Malaysian cafe.The beef in the Beef Rendang dish were beef slices instead of beef chunks which is typically used for the dish.The chicken satay was ok. The best dish we had was the vegetable curry.We find this cafe mediocre and definitely overrated on Tripadvisor.Show less

Author: OzTrottingGlobe
Title: Dinner for two at this tiny Cafe/Bar
Review: Found this Cafe by accident while looking for a place to eat. It has a little garden and outdoor area in the front facing the street. Very simple menu and very friendly staff. Another inexpensive place for a meal in the Ferringhi Beach area.

Author: Mga1500Municipality of Cartagena, Spain
Title: Charming food and service
Review: Our cab driver (from airport) had recommended this place and we hadn't really listene, however after walking past one night we decided to give it a try and although it was packed the host asked us to have a drink at teh bar and a table would be free soon. Which it was. they really looked after us and the food was excellent. You can get some pretty cheap food in Batu and this was not just inexpensive but very tasty and fresh. Needless to say we returned on a couple of occasions during our stayShow less

Author: Abdul C
Title: Good selection on the menu
Review: Nice restaurant family owned. Good selection to choose from, very casual dining. Good atmosphere, some nights live music. Well worth a visit.

Author: WJudy11
Title: Great Experience
Review: We enjoyed the meals and music at this quaint place Very small so book or get there early  seating is rather limited

Author: Harry H
Title: Definitely worth a visit
Review: This restaurant was recommended to us by one of the hotel managers, and he was spot on. Good food at very reasonable prices. Very friendly chatty staff and great atmosphere. I would certainly eat here again.

Author: Bodinlondon
Title: Good plus vegan options
Review: We are here a couple of times - I'm vegan but my family are not and we have a super fussy 6 year old who basically only eats chicken and rice. We had some good food esp the spring rolls and the vegan curry. My mum had nasi goreng, my dad had sweet and sour fish and my husband tried a few different things. Service was good and we enjoyed our food Show less

Author: rachelfawke
Title: Great pick
Review: Came across here upon having a mooch around Batu Ferringhi. Excellent host with brilliant English. Very helpful, gave us some recommendations. Food is not too bad price wise and was delicious !

Author: cherily14Singapore, Singapore
Title: Fantastic food and service!
Review: The lady boss was really nice and friendly, and our lunch was superb with reasonable prices. Most dishes are about rm20+ each. We even came back for dinner on the last night of our trip! Come in a group and order a few dishes to share. The salt and pepper squid, sizzling fish and the beef rendang are highly recommended!Show less

Author: JoeBrophyPenang, Malaysia
Title: A poor lunch!
Review: Had been recommended, but a disappointing experience.... Rather run-down place, tables scruffy, dirty beer mats, place looks as if not decorated since opened 6 years ago. Hoped food would be good, but it wasn't! Beef rendang OK but the Curry Kapitan very poor. Pieces of pre-boiled chicken dropped into a starchy sauce. For info we are Penang residents (half-year), and a half-Indian couple! Kari Kapitan is our favourite!We mentioned our concerns, told it was meant to be like that!Show less

Author: r0bb054Normanville, Australia
Title: amazing food and value
Review: Just returned from another visit to Batu Ferringhi,and introduced on aussie friends to the Living Room. The service ,food and staff were excellent as usual. We all dined on our second to last night of our stay and after our meal i offered our friends to pick anywhere to dine on our next and last night. Somewhere special i said,so our friends turned around and asked the host to book us all in for the next night!!Show less

Author: Dil M
Title: Must visit
Review: If you're here for your holidays in the near by hotels than this is place is a must visit! Great hosts very accommodating and very friendly! The food is fantastic, definitely the best nasi goreng I've tried so far! Beef rendang and kapitan curry both great too! I'd definitely be going again before I have to leave Penang! Just wish I found this place sooner! Show less

Author: Drivers22Poole, United Kingdom
Title: Great Food, Great Hosts and great atmosphere!
Review: The best Nasi Goreng in Penang! Amy and Ben make you feel so welcome and if you go on a night when they have live music the atmosphere is electric. This is our favourite restaurant for dinner in Batu Ferringhi and we have never been disappointed with anything we have ordered. Try the Beef Rendang it is genuine Nonya!Show less

Author: Mango321Newtownards
Title: The best Restaurant in town !
Review: We discovered this little restaurant on our first night in Penang and boy were we glad! On walking past it was one of those places that had lots of people dining compared to other places. I'm not saying the food isn't good elsewhere but this was soo gorgeous! It's not a big place but the atmosphere is really special! The owners-Amy and Ben are such lovely people- so friendly and gave worked very hard to establish their business! I miss the delicious food so much! There us something to suit all tastes and the most difficult thing was choosing from the menu! The beef rendang is second to none as is the Thai chicken salad! The sizzling dishes are delightful and everything is reasonably priced! We ate elsewhere for a few nights as the owners went to a family wedding in KL and had good food too but The Living Room really is great. On certain evenings they have live music but on other nights Ben plays sounds if the 60's , 70's and 80's and the atmosphere is great! The other staff are really lovely - very friendly and polite! The service is excellent and we always managed to squeeze in somewhere! Rustic surroundings , nothing too fancy but just like home in your own Living Room . Super atmosphere and it was our regular for 6-7 nights during our 10 night stay! Loads of other eating places and although we usually like to try lots of places we made a good call to stick with this one! We made some great friends and have lovely memories ! I would recommend it to anyone- miss them all so much. Definite 10 out of 10 for this lovely little place!Show less

Author: Newquaygreen1Newquay, United Kingdom
Title: Atmosphere is electric!
Review: This was a surprise, it was truly a fantastic atmosphere and great food. It started to rain really heavily while we were here and those who were seated outside had to be squeezed in to the existing tables. Great to see all the diners shifting their tables to accommodate the wet guests and it became a party atmosphere thereafter.Great staff.Show less

Author: lynette r
Title: Quirky but good
Review:
Small restaurant with table tops on the bases of old sewing machines. Lots of other interesting artifacts.
Good malaysian food at a fair price and reasonable house wine.
Service could not be faulted

Author: CycleSean
Title: Good food and good value
Review: Try the specials - they are good. The food is tasty and authentic and tables fill up quickly at dinner. Prices are more expensive that a comparable meal in Georgetown but still an overall good value. Friendly and attentive service.

Author: Angela SCairo, Egypt
Title: Our favouite
Review: Do you want to eat the best Beef Rendang or Dried Chili Squid in Penang? Love a good Nasi Goreng but are often disappointed? Go to the Living Room. Great food, good prices, lovely hosts - Amy and Ben. You know who we are - who else always has the Squid?Show less

Author: 783jennih
Title: Friendly local restaurant
Review: Ate here our last 2 nights in Penang. Delicious food, super friendly service & very reasonably priced. The beef rendang (her Mum's recipe), salt & pepper squid & sizzling vegetables were particularly memorable & although we don't usually have desert the deep fried ice cream is thoroughly recommended! Will definitely visit again next time in Penang!Show less

Author: JonathanPaul66
Title: great place
Review:
right next Ferranghi Garden restaurant. 
nice staff , great atmosphere,  and good food - well worth a visit.

Author: ANTONY BPlymouth, United Kingdom
Title: Definitely the best place to eat in the area.
Review: Situated about 7 minutes walk from the Holiday Inn, this place has it all for this type of restaurant. Not a large menu (good sign!), the food is well cooked, nicely presented and adequate sized portions. A good range of Western and Asian dishes are available. We used it three times in our 9 days here and every meal was enjoyable, but it appears to be very popular and tables being vacated are soon re-filled. A group were playing on two of the nights we eat here. Apart from the food being top class and reasonably priced the two Chinese waitresses, were very welcoming and when 'service' was slow, were happy to have a chat with you. Good food, good price and a nice atmosphere, what more could you wish for ?Show less

Author: LCurrier87
Title: Great lunch
Review:
Went in here for lunch and enjoyed the samosas, beef rendang, kuay teow and chips for the little one. They were all delicious!
The mocha coffee however was more like a milky hot chocolate sadly and not so enjoyable.
I would recommend this place.

Author: 287kathryneSheffield, United Kingdom
Title: Relaxing atmosphere and good food
Review: Recommended on Tripadvisor, we ate here twice. Food was good both times, its reasonably priced. On both visits there was live music, a guy with a guitar and another with drums. Customers were able to get up and sing if they wished. We enjoyed both the food and the company.Show less

Author: 307liammGlasgow, United Kingdom
Title: Great food and service
Review: The food was really good, a mixture of Chinese, Malaysian and western cuisine. We had chicken satay, chicken with cashew nuts and sizzling beef and all were great. Staff were really friendly and by the time we left at 8:45 the restaurant was full. Also liked that the beers were served in coolers so didn't get warm!Would highly recommend.Show less

Author: Brian RGlasgow, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent range of food and drink
Review: Visited the Living Room three times during our recent visit. It had been recommended by a friend and lived up to expectations Friendly staff, great service and an excellent menu. On Friday and Saturday nights there is a musical jam session where anyone can join in. Not too loud and an enjoyable background sound. Show less

Author: Gillian J
Title: Great place to meet and enjoy the relaxed vibe and great food
Review: Amy and Ben are the best hosts.  The food is great, well priced and the decor is fun and relaxed.  A regular haunt for us and especially on a Friday when there is a regular jam session.

Author: Amanda SEngland, United Kingdom
Title: Great food
Review: The food here was great (if a little pricey compared to the more local places). The service was excellent and it has a good atmosphere. It's just such a shame to be so close to the beach but can't see it - just a view of the busy road. However, food and service can't be beaten.Show less

Author: donnasK5036MT
Title: rustic feel
Review: fantastic place to visit if yr in batu ferrengi .totally chilled atmosphere .everybody so friendly food is outstanding .amy and ben are the nicest ppl u could meet .this place is a must

Author: Positano1905West Sussex, United Kingdom
Title: VFM
Review: Visited this restaurant after we read all the positive reviews on trip advisor. It is a bit scruffy and you could quite easily walk past the entrance. We got the last table and the place had a positive buzz. The food was okay, nothing special but as good as anything else we had had in our week in Batu Ferringhi. The place is excellent value for money hence the 4 rating.Show less

Author: tmglovetravel
Title: jamming on a friday & saturday night
Review: good food and good friendly service and excellent entertainment from local jamming guys on a friday and saturday

Author: ZakiI39Baku, Azerbaijan
Title: A good place for dinner
Review: We went on Monday night around 8pm the place was full. Tried again on Tuesday around 7ish and was well greeted by the host, she remembered us from the night before and apologiesed for not being able to serve us!! amazingWe told her that we like spices on the low level and what was served was just right and so was the prices.Thank you for a lovely dinnerShow less

Author: A380ManchesterUKManchester UK
Title: Return visit after four years
Review: Last in Penang four years ago. Living Room was a favourite of ours then, so a return was called for.Like last time it did not disappoint. Good food and very friendly owner (and staff alike). At the time of our visit the resort was very quiet at night, with some restaurants having only a few (and some zero) customers. We visited twice, and it was nice to feel welcome and appreciated again on our return.Enjoyed all the starter and mains we had on each visit. Staff are more than happy to adjust a dish to your taste for strength etc.Deep fried ice cream was a house speciality, and a nice way to round off a meal. You get two decent sized portions, so one dish and two spoons was the norm.Like most restaurants its is nothing posh inside. The singer sewing machine tables were a novel idea. It is the food and service that counts though.The strip of restaurants in Bati is a good mile or so long. The Living Room is situated in a cluster of restaurants more towards the Hardrock café end of town. A bit of a walk from the Rasa Saya where we were staying, but its via the night market for an added attraction.Live music on some nights ,jShow less

Author: Bobbrittania
Title: Good food and occasional entertainment
Review: Very good food, frequented by lots of Brits. When they have entertainment it gets full early. Good service and friendly staff.

Author: ericabYork, United Kingdom
Title: Terrific food
Review: Having read a few recommendations to eat here, hubby & I did just that last night.The place is small but very atmospheric with great service by the really helpful & friendly ladies serving. We didn't order loads but what we had was terrific, we're quite new to Malaysian food so asked about a couple of dishes. I had a couple of glasses of very drinkable white wine & hubby a couple of tiger beers. The bill was very reasonable and even though the place was full, we didn't feel we were being hurried to leave. In fact every time a table became empty, it was filled again, it's clearly popular and understandably so.Can highly recommend, great place.Show less

Author: Elizabeth G
Title: Friendly place with lovely food.
Review: Lovely food, good menu and if you wish a little variation on something they are obliging, friendly and pleasant service. They occasionally have music jams in the evening, brilliant and fun.

Author: 268ANDREASurrey U.K.
Title: Always busy!
Review: My friend and I had came here one evening as we had seen good reviews on Trip Advisor. The owner was very friendly and found us a table outside which we preferred. Unfortunately they had a singer that night and we couldn't hear ourselves speak - we prefer no music when we are eating out, and find it refreshing here that most restaurants don't have music playing in the background. We both had Nasi Goring which was very nice, but no different from any of the other restaurants on this strip - they are all much the same.We found Pakeeza the best restaurant for curry - passed the larger night market on the other side of the road.Show less

Author: charliethecriticCrimond, United Kingdom
Title: Good start to eating out
Review: This was our first night in Penang and using TA we tried the Living Room which is near to the Holiday Inn. The tables are old Singer sewing machines and the place is small, quirky but very welcoming. We enjoyed Indo Chinese fare for about £5.00 a head for a main and a large beer for £4.00 so good value, can recommend.Show less

Author: wendy494Chelmsford, United Kingdom
Title: Cough a bit!!
Review: We visited on a Friday night as TA No.2 - did not really know what to expect.We had Diet Coke and I had about 7 white wines (may have had more) - truth is I lost count a bit as wine was cold and tasty so they just kept arriving and slipping down!!Part of this ws because of the great welcome and atmosphere - we were advised that Thai style fish was good for 2 to start so that's what we had - hot, sweet and sour - delicious. The we had fried rice and lemon chicken - I had prawn sizzler in oyster sauce - all really tasty Hubby had banana fritter and ice cream - by this time I was singing along to the jammers who were singing Rod Stewart and Nicky Thomas, Bruno Mars and the Rolling Stones - if you can sing or play and instrument get to the Living Room on a Friday/Saturday and play along. Really great atmosphere, although head was a bit sore in the morning. Oh, the title of this review... - you do cough a bit every time a sizzler is served but the taste is worth every cough and tear in the eye!!!Total bill 200RM and they put up with my singing so I think I probably should have paid them.....Show less

Author: maxandlester
Title: Great food
Review: Very nice food, we had the Thai style fish two nights in a row. Has a bar, cold beer and even a decent white wine.  The staff are lovely, very friendly, recommend.

Author: Mark GArlesey, United Kingdom
Title: Our favourite place
Review: We fell in love with Living Room right after our first meal there. Amy and her team produce a perfect mix of hospitality, location and to die for dishes. There is always a great soundtrack being played too. If near, thus is a must visit place, if not, get a ride here!Show less

Author: Robert S
Title: Great Chinese food
Review: I ordered sweet and sour chicken and it was great. Not too sweet like many Western versions. Service could have been better

Author: car0le3
Title: Brilliant food and really friendly place
Review: We visited this place three times whilst in Penang and every meal we had was excellent.  The Thai style fish was really good as was the chicken satay and the beef rendang.  The place was always busy with a great atmosphere.

Author: PaulC44_ReviewsSingapore, Singapore
Title: The best Beef Rendang we've ever had
Review: This is a great little place. It feels really authentic and has a lovely atmosphere. The staff were really friendly. This was hands-down the best Beef Rendang we have ever had. We can't wait to go back when we are in Penang again in March. We've recommended it to several friends and they've all said the same thing. Definitely worth a visit!Show less

Author: jacbrac
Title: excellent food and service
Review: the food is amazing full of flavour we especially like the red curry prawns and slat and pepper squid but everything we ordered tasted wonderful on the 3 occasions we went there and the owner and the staff are lovely a truly wonderful dinning experiance

Author: RogerB976
Title: Friendly small roadside restaurant
Review: Well cooked, small menu, local Thai recipes at a very reasonable price. Always seems to have a good following clientele. Very friendly staff who make you feel welcome. Breakfasts are also offered.

Author: 660alanh
Title: Been tonight . Fantastic
Review: Loved the place ,nice small place ,with great customer service . Food fabulous . See you tomorrow night

Author: Vincent LSiem Reap, Cambodia
Title: Small but charming place with good food and music
Review: This is just a nice place to grab a few beers and food. Service with a smile and rather attentive. Cash only but no tax or service charge. Live music was mostly from the 70's (although the decades do tend to blend together with me). Can be a little on the loud side if you happen to sit near the speakers. Weather permitting, there is an outside seating area as well as the indoor bar and dining area. Definitely a try again spot on my next trip to that part of Penang Island.Show less

Author: robert h
Title: Pleasant evening!
Review: Friendly service, excellent food, good value for money. Dined there twice on our visit to Penang. recommend unreservedly.

Author: Brendo67
Title: authentic local food
Review: Nice authentic local food... well priced.  We tried the Kaptian curry & beef rending, which was very good.  Friendly service from attentive staff.  They don't take credit cards though (not that it was expensive).

Author: Robert FKent, United Kingdom
Title: so disappointing
Review: we read the reviews before going and so on our first night this was our chosen destination. The food was bland and poorly presented by disinterested staff. Considering the rave reviews before you can imagine our disappointment but the is are much much better restaurants next door in both directionsShow less

Author: SeldaMehmetMelbourne, Australia
Title: EXCELLENT
Review: We went to the Living Room 3 times during our stay as it was just lovely. The food was fresh and well priced. The service was fantastic, the owner was simply lovely and generous. I loved the Thai Chicken/Fish which the owner recomended and infact she was willing to share the recipe with me which I am excited to try. My older children loved the Nasi Goreng, but there really was no dish we were dissapointed with. We were sad that they were closed on Wednesdays, but they must rest so I forgave them and was ready to go back on Thursday:)Show less

Author: kristyleeb
Title: Consistently awesome
Review: 3rd trip to Penang and this place is always a must. Have eaten here at least 5 times and every time the place is packed and the food and service is first class - our favorite place in Penang

Author: Janette T
Title: Quirky interior
Review: Quiet place opposite post office in batu ferrengi.  Service good. Food  nothing special but freshly cooked and hot.  Looked like a good place for breakfast and offers live music in the evenings(weekends at the moment).

Author: AussieBecsMelbourne
Title: Super yum and friendly service
Review: We ate here on our first night in Batu Ferringhi based on TA reviews and was not disappointed. The salt and pepper squid was delicious, as was the Kapitan Chicken curry - both coming with steamed rice. Chips for the kids were home made and lovely,Great service with a smile and very accommodating with the kids....highly recommend!Show less

Author: SandHCardiffCardiff, United Kingdom
Title: Good food, live music and great hosts
Review: We passed this place as it was so full. However we spotted a spare table on the way back so decided a full house was a good indication of a good place. Tried the we shared the Malay chicken curry and red curry both were superb, plenty of meat and really tasty. The atmosphere was enhanced by the duet playing all the old songs from 60's and 70's. Great friendly service.Show less

Author: PanizAmaniKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Must visit!
Review: A very lovely lady greeted us and as per her recommendation we had Thai Fish and Chicken Curry. Probably one of the meals I've ever had in Malaysia! Friendly and cozy environment and yummy food, affordable as well. If you're in Penang you must go and try their dishes xxShow less

Author: Mau_Mau84
Title: Yummy Nasi Goreng
Review: Definitely try the nasi goreng - one of the better ones we have come across! Good food and service is great. Get there early as not much seating definitely a place to eat while in Batu Ferrenghi.

Author: lovepatong
Title: Simply great food
Review: Just had dinner here with the wifey and kids.  We all left happy and that is hard to do lol.  Great food and a great atmosphere and great price to cap it all off   Thank you very much we will be back

Author: hallero74
Title: Good for a drink
Review:
Nice place with live intim music.
Close quite early.
Not the biggest place.
It is placed right beside Peringhii Garden

Author: stevendH7037EZ
Title: still great
Review:
Third visit in three years and this restaurant is still the same and still fantastic.great food, great service and just value for money.
A must do in Penang.

Author: WanderLustDavao
Title: Living room vibe
Review: Imagine yourself relaxing in your living room filled with eclectic adornments and furniture. Then imagine yourself enjoying hefty servings of yummy salt and pepper squid and black pepper pork ribs. Take the dining experience to a living room vibe. Nice? Like it!

Author: Vivi Y
Title: Recommended
Review: Good food, fair price, friendly staffs, quick service. Tried their salt n pepper squid. Also sizzling beef. Both were just delicious.

Author: Justin B
Title: Loved this place
Review: After seeing the reviews on tripadvisor we decided to find this place for ourselves. Well we went back numerous times over our 4 day stay. The food and service is brilliant. Even after all this time we still talk about this place.

Author: Tpg88
Title: Dinner
Review: Unfortunately food not authentic for Penang. Overrated and overpriced. Definitely nowhere near what Penang nyonya food should be like.

Author: maso023Wollongong, Australia
Title: Great food
Review: We always pay a visit here when we come to Penang, Ben and Amy are lovely hosts and remembered us from previous visits, the food here is always great and it is a very popular place, don't always go by the reviews go and try it for yourself and then decide if it's for you. It's closed on Wednesdays, they do a great egg and bacon sandwich if your missing your bacon fix Show less

Author: I1471SEbriand
Title: Mid year Holiday
Review: Amy and Ben are the owners and are very beautiful people. The food was awesome and the pricing is relatively cheap. With Ben playing the guitar in the background and Amy at the front of house makes the perfect place to eat while staying in Batu Ferringhi.Show less

Author: Suetlin L
Title: Cosy, friendly place to hang out at
Review: Chicken Rendang was spicy and fragrant. Very tasty indeed. Cheap beers and friendly staff. Owner was a superb conversationalist. Had a wonderful time. Not an easily forgettable place. Will certainly go back regularly.

Author: Aus_MiliPerth, Australia
Title: Simply superb
Review: Upon checking into Park Royal tad early, we decided to try the food at Living Room Café Bar & Gallery based on reviews on trip advisor. The host was very welcoming and the menu was equally welcoming serving for both the western and Asian taste buds. We decided to order the Nasi Goreng, Penang Kwey Teow and the chilli squid, and I can safely say these items definitely did hit the taste buds leaving you wanting more. All items had that home cooked taste, cooked fresh to order. Whilst there are ample hawker markets within walking distance, I would strongly recommend making an appearance to this restaurant at least once during your stay at Penang.Show less

Author: garyr375
Title: Review
Review: I only went  in here once staff were very friendly  and  welcoming  food that  I  ordered  was a western  breakfast and i enjoyed  it and reasonably  priced as well

Author: HungryTravelerSFSan Francisco, California
Title: Try the Nyonya Curry!
Review: We visited the Living Room Cafe for lunch today and it was so good I wish I had found this place sooner! (sadly today is my last day in Penang). Located on the main street in Batu Ferringhi, this open-air family-owned restaurant offers fresh and delicious food (menu has both authentic Malaysian cuisine as well as Western choices). I enjoy trying local cuisine when I travel so we tried the Penang fish curry and beef rendang (based on the owner's recommendation) and both dishes were excellent and reasonably priced. Nyonya refers to the descendants of Chinese immigrants who moved to Malaysia in the 17th century, so the Nyonya curry is a fusion of Chinese and Malay flavors. So good! The service was friendly and efficient. Definitely check out Living Room Cafe during your stay in Penang! Show less

Author: Donb897
Title: Good food
Review: This is a great restaurant with great food at a reasonable price the owner and staff are the best they talk,try to get to know you and are always welcoming.

Author: paw197Lincoln, United Kingdom
Title: Unbelievably good!
Review: My wife and I had visited this very friendly place a few times during our holiday for drinks (fantastic prices) but friends we met at our hotel said the food was great. So yesterday, our penultimate day of our holiday we had lunch there. My wife had spicy squid ( she said it was the nicest she's ever had) and she's had it everywhere! I had the nasi goreng (fried rice) with beef. Our friends joined us at this point and had the mee goreng (fried noodles) with chicken. Every dish was stunning, all cooked fresh and to top it all off, the bill for 2 mains and 2 bottles of strongbow cider, £14!!!!!!!! Amy and Ben the owners are lovely friendly people too, always made us welcome. Why this place is number 2 in the area I have no idea...... I can't imagine there is better. Thanks so much, Phil and GemmaShow less

Author: Jane831
Title: Amazing
Review: Went here due to tripadvisor reviews ....we were not disappointed. Had the satay to start then shared the calamari salt and pepper and the chicken sizzler both where delicious.great dechor and atmosphere...will be back

Author: beach_babe2011_11High Wycombe, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent Eatery - Highly Recommend
Review: Ate here three nights during our 8 night stay as the food and service are excellent. Amy and Ben are wonderful hosts and make you feel very welcome. Amy will offer advice on recommended dishes etc. This restuarant should be number one in my view. Great Atmosphere and service with a smile whenever you go. (it is also the only place we have found that sells cider!)Show less

Author: sarah b
Title: Miss sarah bird
Review:
Great great food. U must go! Have the sizzling prawns! Only open until 10pm unfortunately like a lot of the restaurants in Penang. 
Not quite what we expected for a holiday resort

Author: sveltedinerBucks
Title: Just the sort of place you always hope to find for local food
Review: Cosy feeling to place, quirky chill decor, warm welcome - host will sit and chat with you, great food, couple of reasonably good random singer/guitarists on Saturday night. Go early in your visit - you will probably want to eat there more than once as confirmed by the steady stream of regulars and repeaters on our two visits.Onto the food.Everything really good, work your way through the favourites on the board.Beef rendang, their signature dish, is awesomeSatay one of the better ones, especially the peanut saucePenang fish curry - excellent - real taste of Malaysia with nice sweetness and balanced heatChill squid - best food so far according to familyStir fried green stuff (can't remember name) - outstandingCold beer at reasonable prices, also do G&T which is not the case with all of these smaller places.Also went to Andrew’s which I would recommend for a visit, but this was the winner for a second evening out.Show less

Author: 888PeterL
Title: Walk in dinnner
Review: Looks like a well frequented,tourist restaurant. And it was with all the comforts of home,cold beer,good food and ultra friendly service.  PS, don't forget to try the deep fried ice cream.

Author: NanpacificSpringfield, Missouri
Title: Nice Atmosphere but Average Food
Review: We selected this place as it was rated number 2 in Batu Ferringhi. I thought the food was really pretty average, and much pricier than other places I felt were better. This restaurant has a nice atmosphere and is located on the main street of Batu Ferringhi. It serves Chinese, Malaysian and Indian food. My husband had fish and chips which he said was greasy and tasteless. I had Thai and was also disappointed. I would not return here again.Show less

Author: frank v
Title: Amazing living room
Review: Third time on a row, we had a fantastic evening at the Living Room. Gorgeous food combined with a charming owner and her staff. Prices are in balance with the quality , just like the owner is. This is a must to go to.

Author: MGoslingNorthamptonshire, United Kingdom
Title: Check out the food delights
Review: We found this as number two according to trip advisor, we also went to the number one (Andrews Kampung), we think as regards to the food this should be number one, the other restaurant had a real character in charge and he probably made the difference and got the higher rating!Both are well worth a visit!Show less

Author: IanMcPGold Coast, Australia
Title: Better than Mom ever cooked
Review: The Living Room is one of the many restaurants along the Main Street of Batu Feringghi and apart from the garden fronting the Main road there is nothing to distinguish it from the others. However if you are looking for GREAT food that is prepared fresh, cooked like mom used to cook it is the ideal place to have dinner . The restaurant promotes itself as delivering home cooked meals and based on our meals it was better than my mother ever cooked.and . There was a very wide choice of Malaysian, Indian, Chinese and western meals. It is worth walking the 100 metres pass the Parkroyal, pass the Guan Guan (also highly recommended and before the Ferringhi Garden (also recommended.) Enjoy the casual atmosphere, the fabulous service and the chat with the owner. Recommend any of the sizzling dishes.Show less

Author: angolaaladu13
Title: great atmosphere...
Review:
Meal are good, but could be better.
Environment are awesome, peaceful, a right place to give yourself a rest after exhaustive working week.
Service might need improvement, the owner are less friendly, look selective, staff are great.

Author: Ian HBirmingham, United Kingdom
Title: Returning visit
Review: Wonderful atmosphere in this friendly restaurant with excellent fresh cooked food.Jamming session nights at the weekend make an added feel with a casual attitude.The food is reasonably priced and always superbly prepared with that special Penang touch. Good choice on the menu.The owners Amy and Ben run the place very efficiently and must give special mention to Ina for her cheeky service.Show less

Author: MPF333Victoria, Australia
Title: Delicious great food
Review: This was our second visit to this wonderful island and to this restaurant. The food is freshly prepared and is delicious. The menu caters to Western dishes also, however the malaysian authentic dishes are really worth a try. Food is extremely well priced and the hosts are really welcoming. Definitely going back before we head home.Show less

Author: GraeAwayWangaratta, Australia
Title: Great family atmosphere and good music.
Review: Saturday night in Batu Ferringhi a bit of rain about and I'd done the night market the night before. What to do? I heard music in the distance. I found this oasis of friendliness.Ben, the owner, was sitting at the bar at his laptop selecting music to play to his guests, his wife Amy was busy making sure we all had a drink and something to eat. About 8 pm another guy strolled in and started playing guitar while seated on the couch. Ben then joined in on his guitar a violin player arrived and then another guitarist. I later found out this semi impromptu thing happens on Friday and Saturday nights where local and visiting musicians drop in for a "jam session". Speaking to Ben at some point during the evening, I mentioned I played drums and percussion and was immediately invited to join.If you are in Penang and are a musician, most equipment is there. Even if you are not a musician and you love live music and good food, check this place out. Show less

Author: mei17
Title: Dinner
Review: This is a small restaurant which serves western and peranakan food. Food is ok but the serving size was small for the price.

Title: Breakfast and dinner
Review: Small cafe/restaurant, wonderful food, very nice and friendly staff. We ate breakfast and dinner here.

Author: jaseet88
Title: Cozy Place with Vibe
Review: Old sewing machines are used as table legs/stand. All the furnishing in this place are made of recycled materials. Kodos to the owners. Think home-cooked food with live music & songs. Not bad.

Author: Sally B
Title: local food with light music entertainment
Review: Good local food although limited, pleasant local join in  music. Would visit again, good value for money.

Author: Sonya G
Title: Fantastic food, staff and atmosphere
Review: Love the beef rendang, sizzling beef, sweet and sour fish.  All food amazing and love the staff while holidaying in Penang always eat there.  See you next time girls.  Xxxxxxxx

Author: angelor960
Title: Great Food
Review:
Excellent food at great value good choice of food and drinks and the owner who sat for a chat was superb!

Worth a visit? YES!!!

Author: Larna MPerth, Western Australia, Australia
Title: So helpful!
Review: After reading the reviews on here, we decided to give Living Room a go & we weren't disappointed. We had a couple of ciders with our char kway teow & samosas. It was lovely food & a great atmosphere with live music. We got great tips on where else to go/what to do/ what to eat. Show less

Author: Danaletchumi
Title: Banana fritters with ice cream!
Review: Loved the environment and food..the price was average. It had an open concept and people could sing and pkay music there, the service was good.

Author: mkf49
Title: Better restaurants around
Review:
Tried this place through trip advisor , food pretty ordinary better choices available in the area .
Had the house recommended dish of beef rendang and all thought wasn't that good 
The salt and pepper calamari was great !

Author: Tom and Pat CPenang
Title: Great Cafe
Review: We visited this place for dinner last night with friends who had been there before. The service was great and the food delicious. I had the sizzling chicken platter and it was really good and very reasonably priced. They also have a good selection of western food. We will definitely be back. Thanks.Show less

Author: Matthew M
Title: Great prawn curry
Review: A lovely atmosphere and great hosts. Of the 8 items we tried, all were good however the prawn curry was great!

Author: ajr493Orpington, United Kingdom
Title: Great Asian curries
Review: Visited this restaurant last night. Had a wonderful prawn red curry and beef Kapitan, the salt and pepper squid was pleasant but a small portion. Had the beef Rendang last year and that was also good. Recommended for people who like Malaysian curries and the opportunity to jam with the owners. Show less

Author: HildybluesKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Bar with fun atmosphere
Review: From the time we walked in to when we left, we had good attentive service. From the suggestions to the choice of wines and beers and how our drinks were served chilled - all this made our visit feel a fun and relaxing place to be. We popped in after dinner so we weren't able to try out their menu.Show less

Author: AndyMacauleyHouston, Texas
Title: Great laid back dining with good food!
Review: Great little restaurant in Batu Ferringhhi. Simple Asian food done very well. Staff are friendly and attentive. 6 of us had dinner (4 adults, 2 8yo kids) and we all thought the atmosphere, food and service were great. There was a band (two guys with guitars, singing) who were great and even invited the 2 kids up to play the bongos with them.Show less

Author: 676JS
Title: Nice place
Review:
Tasty food, cold beer, friendly staff not sure you need anything else. 
Would definitely go back, beef rendang was delicious.

Author: denh0g
Title: Nice restaurant
Review: We had a nice dinner over here. Also had a nice conversation with the owner. Would definitely eat here again.

Author: Steve BMelbourne, Australia
Title: Very cool cafe
Review: Very cool and relaxing cafe - very inviting with friendly staff. Food was fine. First cafe we found that was full of fellow Australian holiday makers, and it was busy in comparison to a few the other restaurants/cafes nearby. They had live music too which was a nice surprise. Show less

Author: Maria P
Title: Very nice
Review: A cute little bar-restaurant next to ParkRoayle Resort. They have live music in the evening. Very good and kind service. The food was tasty (I wouldn't say extraordinary, but still good). The portions however are a bit small.

Author: JulianCordenOsaka, Japan
Title: Nothing flash, just great food and service
Review: I love it when a restaurant sets out to do something and does it really well. A lovely laid back, slightly quirky environment on the main road. Great service from the moment you call and book. Friendly, helpful, prompt.Simple but delicious food. Incredible value. Our group of 9 people (5 adults and 4 children - 3 to 7 yrs) all enjoyed the food and setting. We had a range of dishes from Satay, Salt & Pepper Squid, Beef Rendang (love it), Noodles, Fish & Chips, Banana Fritters. A really good night out, I would totally recommend.We didn't go but it looks like it's got a pretty good breakfast menu as well. Worth a trip.Show less

Author: BorisTheMudcrabWollongong, Australia
Title: Relaxing place for a Drink & Feed
Review: The Living Room had a musician play on both nights we visited. Nice relaxing music ably assisted by other diners made this little venue a nice place to enjoy a Tiger and a moderately priced feed.The food was honest without being spectacular and the beer was cold. The reason that I gave the Living Room a 4 star was that it somehow pulled off the hard to get relaxing atmosphere in the middle of a bustling streetShow less

Author: rustygeeza
Title: Amazing food
Review: Cosy small place with excellent food must try, fast service and friendly staff. We had the thai style fish and sizzling prawns with oyster sauce finished with the deep fried ice cream and it was excellent and came to less than 100 ringget.

Author: Marjorie D
Title: Great meals
Review: Friendly staff and reasonably priced food. Clean and tidy. We visited twice never disappointed. Quick service.

Author: Neva-nev
Title: Real bacon !!
Review: Had lunch and dinner 29th Sept. Doesn't have all the fancy decor, but great service..great food and great prices. Asian foods, european foods, both kids happy at the same time... we'll be back a few more times ths week

Author: Nztourist16
Title: Living room cafe bar
Review:
Excellent service..food comes out 
Fast ..understands tied hungry children 
Friendly
Safe to eat ice!
Tokiet cleaniest I've seen by far..
Went every second night as food so good and choice fab..

Author: gemmaa653
Title: Always awesome
Review: This place is always amazing. The beef rendang is one of the best on the island. Great food, great service, and a few nice pieces of art available for sale. A must visit.

Author: 979mariei
Title: Great reasonably priced food
Review: Lovely Malaysian food but they also have western dishes , including real bacon! We will definitely be going again.

Author: Janette R
Title: Excellent
Review: Another quaint family run business who take special care of their guests. We went there on the recommendation of Trip Advisor and were not disappointed. Excellent food and prices. Please add to your list of places to eat while in this area.

Author: Jason BMelbourne, Australia
Title: Fantastic fresh food with great service!
Review: We stayed in Batu Ferringhi for a week and ate at the living room almost every single day as the food was that good. Amy is a fantastic cook and an excellent host. She made the best beef rendang I have ever tasted as well as a vegetarian laksa which was explosive in flavour. For desert I couldn't go past the fried ice cream every time. Highly recommended to anyone staying in the area!Show less

Author: Susan HMarple, United Kingdom
Title: Great beef rendeng
Review: Friendly warm welcome to the restaurant. For starters we had beef satay which was very good and we also had Spring cups they was ok but a little soggy in texture. We followed with Malaysian chicken curry and beef rendeng both was really tasty the only thing I would say is they was served with to much rice so I could not finish my meal. Live entertainment while we dined which was very good. All in all a good retaurant give it a try.Show less

Author: JaydeWilliamsMelbourne, Australia
Title: Amazing food and service!
Review: This is by far the best restaurant in Batu Ferringhi. The staff are extremely friendly and welcoming! The menu has a lot of variety and is quite cheap for people travelling. Everything that we ordered - we ate lunch and dinner here 3 days in a row - was AMAZING! There is nothing bad that I could possibly say about this place.I highly recommend and will definitely be back :)Thank you for your amazing hospitality.Show less

Author: BusYawbusSingapore, Singapore
Title: homely setting, friendly owner, great food
Review: Our first meal in Penang. It was lunch, and not so crowded. We were a party of 7, some ordered western food and some local food. We all enjoyed the food.Chatted with the lady boss too and she was friendly and shared with us many local tips.As I was walking toward the restroom I had to pass their kitchen. I was quite impressed that their kitchen was actually very clean. I became even more impressed by its cleanliness after I had visited a few other restaurants during the next few days.Show less

Author: flutes9
Title: Deliccious Food
Review:
Delicious food, friendly owners 
One night  there was live music it was great.
After finding this cafe we didn't eat anywhere else

Author: DLaw82Dubai, United Arab Emirates
Title: It's all about the glorious food!
Review: Amazing food! Me, hubby and daughter have visited a few times in our 2 week stay in Batu Ferringhi. I have to say it's one of very few restaurants on this island that actually sell good quality meat! Proper chicken breast! This is rare I've noticed. The dishes themselves were fabulous - the flavours just burst, and even such simple dishes such a sweet and sour chicken were outstanding. The staff are so lovely, not in your face but also very friendly and accommodating. Please look past the decor, and enjoy truly good food! Absolutely #1 restaurant in Penang! Go here, and eat as many dishes as u can. Show less

Author: Y3838ADrichardm
Title: Tasty food, tastier juices!
Review: Wow such friendly staff, tasty local food, juices that are so delicious and refreshing. All at very low prices. Looking forward to my next visit

Author: mooloomoo
Title: Delicious food and drink!!
Review: So incredibly awesome!!! We were after authentic Malaysian dishes and the Nasi Goreng and Fried Mee were delicious. Also, Banana and Watermelon juices were just as yummy!!!!

Author: David BPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Tasty food, good price
Review: Nice restaurant, good menu with some different dishes, had the rendang which was very tasty, wife had sizzling chicken which was also very good, both were good size portions.wasn't very busy so the service was great and quick, and very pleasant conversation, will definitely be back to sample some more . The final bill was on the cheap side so very happy, good all round.Show less

Author: aml1999Dubai, United Arab Emirates
Title: Superb food at local prices
Review: Read about this place on Trip Advisor so gave it a try, on the first visit we ended up ordering 5 dishes between 2 of us. The food tastes incredible, all the specials are worth trying. Home cooking at its best. For 5 dishes and beers , lunch was around 200 ringitt( 8 beers and 5 dishes). Do not miss this place, the decor may put you off but give it a try you will be delighted you did.Show less

Author: MMPET STruro, United Kingdom
Title: Very welcoming atmosphere, great food
Review: This is the only restaurant we visited twice during our week in Batu F. It was well worth the walk along the entire length of the night market.A very relaxed and welcoming atmosphere, tasty food and reasonably priced. Eclectic 60s-80s background music but not intrusive.NB. Cash only and no nearby ATM. We didn't realise this until the bill arrived but the owner offered to collect cash from our hotel reception on her way home later which we duly left for her. Fantastic service from great staff.Definitely worth a visit.Show less

Author: Paula T
Title: Living Room
Review: Nearly walked past this place but so glad I didn't......The food and the staff are excellent and I would be definitely return there if I go back to Penang

Author: MySemillonNewcastle, Australia
Title: Cheap and cheerful
Review: We enjoyed a pleasant meal here and would recommend the Living Room for people seeking a relaxed and tasty dining experience. For about $AU 30 we enjoyed nonya style curry prawns, steamed green veg, and beef rendang plus a couple of glasses of wine. The food was enjoyable and the service prompt, but don't come here if you expect a resort-bland experience, the atmosphere is quirky and casual.Show less

Author: muzzyboyCanvey Island, United Kingdom
Title: Devine food and staff
Review: It is not every day that a restaurant is so comprehensively spoken about in glowing terms that we just had to try it out. It is one that you can walk by but that would be a mistake. Ami at the front of house is welcoming and not pushy. When ordering she will explain what you have ordered and make recommendations for you. My wife changed her order and was so glad that she did. Her fried rice was fantastic and the curry sublime. I was only drinking and the beer is cold. This is one place we will return to again before we leave. It was like the United Nations when we were here with all nations and colours represented. One fine restaurant loved by many. Drop in you will be a friend forever. Show less

Author: Jennifer M
Title: Good food & lovely staff
Review: Loved the food & the staff very friendly, we had dinner here, however we didn't get the opportunity the eat breakfast as they don't open until after 11AM. Definitely recommend for all the family,

Author: iNutKunG
Title: Food was wonderful!
Review: We had Beef Rendang and Pineapple fried rice, both of them are very good and friendly staff. I highly recommend this place.

Author: charlesf16
Title: A nice place in Batu Ferringi
Review: A nice place to have a coffee , lightmeal or more..A plesant ambiance..Ben and Ami are great hosts...Well worth a visit.

Author: GordonHartPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Small Friendly Restaurant
Review: This is a relatively small, family run restaurant on the Main Street in Batu Ferringhi, on Penang Island. The food is terrific, all cooked freshly and guaranteed no MSG!The owners are very friendly and welcome all guests personally. On Friday and Saturday nights they have a jamming session where locals play music for the diners, which is great fun.Service is always fast, friendly and of a consistently high standard. Thoroughly recommendedShow less

Author: mike c
Title: a bit of a let down
Review: after reading glowing reports , we were a bit let down by this little café.the staff were very nice, but the food was just ok, the pricing was a bit over what you should pay in penang, for this style of dining.ok but not great.

Author: delinda66
Title: Great food and entertainment!
Review: Had a delicious meal and listened to some great live music. ! A nice small intimate restaurant.  Staff friendly and efficient.

Author: 75daver
Title: Yum Yum
Review: Fantastic food friendly staff. My wife and I shared sizzling chicken and beef rending, both of which were delicious, followed by fried ice cream which was a big hit with all. We will definitely be back. A must try.

Author: missingscrewMelbourne, Australia
Title: great food and price
Review: we were pleasantly surprised withe the quality of the food at this cafe. They have a good variety and Annie the owner will help you with meals and we sometimes just let her pick them for us. we normally like to try different places but we had nearly all our dinners here. due to the variety quality and price also nice cold beers and soft drinks. I cannot recommend this cafe highly enoughShow less

Author: Carmel Julie TMelbourne, Australia
Title: Beautiful meals
Review: Once again on our recent visit to Penang went to Living Room and saw Amy & Ben who were welcoming to us. How they remember sooo many faces I do not know. The food was beautiful and even my fussy daughter found something to eat which is a real feat. This restaurant is more than just a restaurant it is like revisiting friends from long ago. Food was prompt in coming to table and always fresh and appetizing. I would definitely recommend this restaurant to anyone visiting Penang.Show less

Author: ladolcevita73London, United Kingdom
Title: One of our best meal
Review: It may be your "cliche" aussie-style expat hole in the wall cafe complete with Bruce and his guitar, but don't let that detract you from the tasty and delicious local food being served here. We would recommend any of the curries and noodle dishes. It is busy so show up early and be prepared to wait a bit for your order, so order enough cold beers and enjoy them while you wait.Show less

Author: Jen S
Title: Expected more
Review: Read some great reviews about this place and expected great food, so was really disappointed. This is quite a rustic restaurant which looks good from outside because it has lots of lush plants and is situated beside a few nice restaurants. It is, however, not a really comfortable dining experience with old fold out wooden chairs. Was concerned that if I moved too often my chair might collapse!THe best thing about the place is the staff who were really friendly and helpful.My advice, try somewhere else where the locals eat. The place only had white tourists eating there which I believe speaks volumes. Most people we talked to said they had tried it due to trip advisor rating and not because the menu looked good.Show less

Author: BabsioSydney, Australia
Title: Wow, wow wow!
Review: We had dinner twice at this location during our stay. The food was superb (Penang curry to die for). Did not have a bad meal or plate of food. Continually surprised and pleased with the quality of the food, the flavours and service.Ensure you try this restaurant if in Batu Ferringhi!It is not 'fine dining' but it is not street food eating. Show less

Author: karmasolo
Title: Tourist priced, underwhelming food
Review: Food was expensive and underwhelming. Ordered the fried noodles, which was too oily, and the fried rice which was uninteresting. Also ordered a soggy egg sandwich.

Author: lindasQ8054RMHeritage Park
Title: awesome food Amy and Ben extremely friendly
Review: We recently went to Penang AGAIN and we visited the Living Room many times, Amy and Ben are very friendly, they sit down and have a drink and chat with you, the food is awesome very fresh and just devine, the kitchen very clean, very reasonable prices, we go there every year when we go on holiday to Penang, its not a holiday without visiting the Living Room THANK YOU AMY AND BENShow less

Author: haggis27
Title: Good eatery
Review: For good food and pleasant staff this is one off the best in town Amy is very good at customers relations the menu has western and Malay food

Author: Zandra L
Title: Must be on your to do list!!
Review: Owner and operator is truly something else! We visited during a busy period when a large number of staff were off because of a number of celebrations like Eid and Malaysian New Year. Her family and friends were the staff for the night...and what a great job they did! Food came out speedily and our glasses were never empty! Food was delicious...definitely worth at least one visit if you're in town! Show less

Author: simonka28
Title: Great place to eat!
Review: We had a group of 10 people and Amy (owner) and her family were so accommodating anf friendly. The food and service was great. We've  eaten here twice and will definitely be coming back.

Author: tungmayw
Title: A bit overrated
Review: The food was okay but definitely not the best I've had in the area. More european selections than other places tho and the price was average. Really nothing special.

Author: 091063scotland
Title: Evening meal for 4 adults
Review: Staff friendly. Service good and quick . Food was lovely . 4 main meal Malaysian beef curry. prawn curry 2fried rice and 2 boiled rice 2 French fries sweet sour chicken. randan bottle wine 2beers 2 juices and 1 deep fried ice cream. Enjoyable evening background music appreciated. Would go back roughly about 270 ring its. 55 British poundsShow less

Author: rjf1002014
Title: A great find
Review: We almost missed this little gem as we walked along the street looking for a place to eat our evening meal. It is quiet a small Cafe and unassuming. We were invited to try the menu by Amy and we were not disappointed. Amy was keen to explain the various dishes on the menu to help ensure we picked something to suit our individual tastes. My only regret is that we found it on our last evening in Penang and didn't get a chance to try their breakfast. Thank you for a warm welcome and a wonderful evening.Show less

Author: Townhopping
Title: Food excellence
Review: Nice and clean place to eat at this place with friendly environment and food are excellence and unique cook

Author: swampylee
Title: Living room
Review: What a wonderful place .The owners Amy and Sam are so welcoming and make you feel so at home .The food is beautiful never disappointed

Author: karensM6934GL
Title: Found a regular haunt
Review: Recommended by regular visitors.. Best recommendation ever... Food was lovely, service so friendly..atmosphere just what was needed .. Will definitely be back often

Author: SJRAustraliaAustralia
Title: A warm welcome
Review: A warm welcome and excellent service awaits everyone visiting this little restaurant. The menu is not huge, but the food is well prepared and presented, always with a smile. Amy and Ben feel like old friends, even after just one visit, and one is guaranteed god food at a reasonable price. Show less

Author: PamOKenO
Title: One of our favorite places.
Review: We love this place. Great food, great prices and best of all great owners. Amy and Ben are the owners of the Living Room. Very customer service oriented and they remember what you like to eat and drink.

Author: Zoop1305Perth, Australia
Title: Curry heaven ..
Review: We dined at this Café as it was recommended to us by friends and we were not disappointed. They are renowned for their curries and that is what we chose. Excellent flavours, good portion sizes and the most tender of meats. Service was excellent - drinks really chilled and a lively local band (not loud) playing great music. We would recommend this Café to anyone and hope to return.Show less

Author: andreas_ws
Title: Simple n casual
Review: Great night with friends for first night dinner in Penang.nice simple and relaxing atmosphere.the lady owner was very cheerful and the staff was good.food was great.
