Author: trudydubaiDubai, United Arab Emirates
Title: Second review and still thumbs up on quality and atmosphere
Review: Honest fresh food without the use of MSG, they are very flexible to adjust the dishes how you would like to have it cooked. You feel like you are in the living room enjoying nice food and people around you, very relaxed and the prices haven't gone up since the last time we visited. In the weekends they still have their jamming sessions and everybody is invited to join in if they feel like it.Over the years I find them very consistent in quality and hospitality!Show less

Author: The_posh_packer
Title: One of the best in Batu Ferringhi
Review: The atmosphere here is awesome. The owners are super friendly. They have live music on Friday, Saturday and Sunday nights and everybody has a great time. The food is the best part though, we ate here 3 times on our last stay. Highly recommend .

Author: rozayasuk
Title: Relaxing atmosphere
Review: If you want to chill and/or listen a good live band and/or have some tasty food, do not hesitate to stop on the way... Pleasant!

Author: steven_n_au
Title: Amazing dining experience
Review: We ate here 2 nights during our stay at Batu Ferringhi. The service and food were awesome. Lot's of drink options. It's a real oasis in a sometimes hectic place. The gardens and fish ponds are beautiful.

Author: sk840316
Title: Food were okay.
Review: The food were above average. Ambience is good, food served quite fast. A bit disappointed with the beef rending, the fish is great, would recommend anyone to try the fish.

Author: Caryl CWoking, United Kingdom
Title: Great value and flavour
Review: It was the bank holiday Monday. A lot of places were booked out.We were told we would have to wait 15 minutes. After 5 were sat at a table and ordering.A narrow place with a seating area outside and more inside with a bar. A nice atmosphere. Friendly staff and good service.We had Samosas and mushroom soup for starter. Followed by Beef with ginger and chicken and cashews. Desert we both had banana fritters. All full of flavour.Along with the normal large beers.Only 125 Riggits. Well worth a try.Show less

Author: JWP23Bromley, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent Value for money
Review: We ate here on several occasions and the food was always excellent along with the service, the owner of the restaurant always had time to chat with you. Everything was good value and the food was always brought in fresh that morning,the owner was very peticular about this as she didn't want old fish and being a fisherman I can agree the fish was excellent quality. Give this place a go you wont be dissappointed.Show less

Author: yama50George Town, Malaysia
Title: relaxing Place
Review: Found the Living room after a stroll across the beach, immediately felt at home.. Had a beer, best priced Anchor on the strip.. Then had a lovely conversation with the owners, Any & Ben. Went back later for dinner/tea.. Food was awesome and the hosts and staff where very friendly.. Would go back again again, if had the chance.. I don't normally recommend eating places, due to peoples preferences but would recommend the living room to any one.. Amy and Ben are lovely hosts and the staff and food are "Bob on" Top PlaceShow less

Author: Baz510Adelaide, Australia
Title: An experience not to miss out on.Great food, Great service, Relaxed atmosphere.
Review: We have visited Penang quite a few times and never miss out on dining at the living room. You will need to visit many times to sample all the excellent food available. The hosts Ben & Amy are very friendly & take the time to come to your table & have a chat. They make you feel like one of the family. We love the atmosphere of the living room, especially on Fridays & Saturday nights when they have live music. Some times they will have an impromptu jam session when you least expect it. We have had breakfast lunch, dinner & snacks & late night drinks, all excellent. Part of a good relaxing holiday is chilling out & enjoying the local cuisine & friendly people. You will experience this and more at the living room. Don't miss out. We are visiting again in late May 2016....See you soon Ben & Amy....Tracy, Baz & Kez.Show less

Author: LredmanUlverstone, Australia
Title: Great food, close to Park Royal
Review: The service at this place was awesome they were friendly and helpful. The food is not as cheap as some places (29myr) for a rendang curry but the food is delicious. I had the Penang chicken curry which was very yummy. We were staying at the Park Royal and it is very close with 2-4 minute walk away.Show less

Author: broughbadgerDunbar, United Kingdom
Title: Nice reasonably priced restaurant
Review: Have eaten before on previous visits and went back again on latest trip. At edge of the strip near the Holiday Inn hotel. Smallish restaurant with outside and indoor sections. Shared satays then 2 main courses and beer for 2 came to RM100. God menu and offers Nyonya cuisine which is a nice change from normal Show less

Author: JAMHampshire
Title: Super tasty and attentive service
Review:
Had dinner here, second time lucky as was fully booked the night before.
Excelled Beef Rendang. Staff were very friendly and service excellent. Partner had salt and pepper squid and pineapple rice.

Author: Shirley T
Title: Fabulous
Review: We ended up going here twice for dinner as the food and service was excellent. Amy was great recommending dishes which we all loved so had to go back the following evening and try some more of their dishes. The beef rendang and crispy fish were favorites for the group. Would definately recommend trying this place. We all had a wonderful time.Show less

Author: MariekeK973
Title: Good food
Review: It's a nice location and homely atmosphere. Nicely decorated. The food is not cheap/cheap but very nice.

Author: Maxieboy12
Title: Delightful
Review: I was recommended to try and was happy I did food fabulous staff very friendly quite chatty and funny will be back food came out quickly and was hot and delicious

Author: john m
Title: good food
Review: we where made very welcome by the staff our orders taken and our drinks arrived the food was  really super and our bill was reasonable under £20-00 and of course we where back there again.

Author: 769navidh
Title: Good feel family place
Review: Prices a bit higher than average but the quality of food is good and the service from the caring hostess great. Very relaxed atmosphere. AC would make it perfect

Author: NedaJayTehran, Iran
Title: Good food, nice environment
Review: I believe this cafe is one of the best places in Batu Ferringhi you can eat in. Delicious local food and good price. Like most of the other cafe and restaurants in Penang it is not very neat (Or maybe I am very much concerned about hygiene?! I don't know!)Show less

Author: Sue PLeicestershire, United Kingdom
Title: Great food, great atmosphere!
Review: We loved this place so much we ate there 3 nights during our stay in the town. Owners and staff very friendly, live music on Friday night from owner and group of friends. No air con but plenty of fans to cool you down. Stayed at Holiday Inn, so just a short walk through the night market to get there.Show less

Author: OlliewiseWarton, United Kingdom
Title: A Must Try
Review: My wife and I recently stayed at the Rasa Sayang, and had read so many good reviews that we wanted to try the living room.We were in Penang during an unusually extra hot period.We hadn't realised just how far it was from our hotel to this restaurant, probably seeming further because of the extreme heat and humidity.By the time we arrived we were very hot and tired, so probably didn't get the best out of our experience.The people were all lovely and the food and service was excellent, but please be aware if staying at the Rasa or the Golden Sands, it's a fare distance in hot sticky weather.Show less

Author: Jampet1London, United Kingdom
Title: Awesome food!
Review: Great cafe in the heart of Batu Ferringhi. Fantastic local food and great ambiance. This place is a hidden gem. The owners Ben and Amy are very friendly and the service is great. Check out open Mic night on Friday evening if you're a Muso..Beef Rendang and Keoy Tow rocks!! Went 3 nights a week..Show less

Author: Susan CMinnesota
Title: Came for the beef rendang, left very happy!
Review: In looking for a quick bite in Batu Ferringi, I read that the Living Room had excellent beef rendang. That's been on my list of regional foods to try and so I decided to give it a go. Our party of three were the only customers in the restaurant, as we were late for lunch and early for dinner. The hostess (owner?) was very attentive and friendly. We shared the beef rendang, the Thai style fish, and spring rolls. All were delicious, but we all agreed that the beef rendang was the highlight of the meal. I'd be happy to go back and order it again.Show less

Author: Colin R
Title: Good food and friendly staff
Review: The Living Room has a good selection of well cooked food at very reasonable prices. The serving staff are friendly and helpful and we very much enjoyed our visit there.

Author: HotelsurveyqueenBallarat, Australia
Title: Simple, honest Malay cuisine at a great price
Review: On a recent trip to Batu Ferringhi we visited the Living Room based on TA reviews. We loved it so much we returned again and again! Great food including Malay specialty curries, beef rendang & Nasi Goreng. Authentic Malay atmosphere - open street front, numerous fans trying but failing to keep the diners cool, rainforest plants - loved it!Show less

Author: Paul HHarlow, United Kingdom
Title: Great food - Amy is a great, friendly host
Review: Great food - not at all pretentious - it is what it is. Amy is a great, friendly host who makes you so welcome and feel like you've known her for years. The music is a bit dodgy but it adds to the sense of fun and enjoyment. Thoroughly enjoyed it and would highly recommend it !Show less

Author: AhirwalSanjay
Title: Home cooked yummy food, attention to details, the place to have meals in Batu Ferringhi
Review: We had a delicious dinner at Living Room Cafe Bar & Gallery. It is a small joint, but food was great, and the service was immaculate. Total value for money ! And owners are very friendly !

Author: Lindsay5856Brussels, Belgium
Title: The owners are great, the food delicious, we went last year and wouldn't have missed going again this yea!
Review: This is quite a small restaurant and you well may have to queue to eat there, queue, it's worth it, authentic food, delicious. The owners make the place, by their kindness and eager to make sure you enjoy your food by giving tips and helping choose the dishes. The fruit juices are just as I like them, not too sweat, loved the lime juice.Show less

Author: 449markp01Southampton, United Kingdom
Title: Best food by far
Review: Went to the living room after reading the reviews , and was well impressed!!Amy the owner welcomed us in and made us feel like nothing was to much trouble.When selecting our food we informed Amy about my sons nut allergy and she could not of been more assuring and helpful meaning we could all relax knowing care and attention was being used .What ever you choose in this restaurant will be a good choice , the food is that good. We returned to the living room the following night as well and food was if possible even better!! And the jamming session was really good as well .Personal favourites the crispy fish, dry chilli squid . A must place for any visitor Show less

Author: Krissy3033Gold Coast
Title: Awesome food
Review: Excellent food for a couple with teen kids. We could get fantastic and authentic Malay food and the fussy kids had options. Chicken chop for super fussy 11 year old on 3 nights. Beef rendang us to die for. Really great value as well both for food and drinks. Eat enroute to the night markets . Show less

Author: carlc764Chinley, United Kingdom
Title: The best food on batu ferrengi
Review: After seeing all of the great reviews, we decided to try it as our hotel is only 500m away.All i need to say is that all of the possitve reviews are spot on, even though they were very busy the sevice and food is first class.The chicken kapitan was amazing and the sweet and sour chicken was possibly the best i have had, also try the pineapple fried rice.We will deffinateley go back here again.Show less

Author: EhyokyKuopio, Finland
Title: Cheap-eat with great malay food
Review: This is one of my favorite restourants in Penang island. Location is convinient to Hard Rock Hotel guests and everyone staying in Batu Ferringi. Atmosphere is living roomish as the name of the restourant reffers. Food is really good home made malaysian. There is also nice art on the walls. We enjoyed many meals here, lunch and dinners. You can eat easily under 20 ringits per person. Lunch for two of us were about 30MYR. Show less

Author: samf633Washington, United Kingdom
Title: 1st Class
Review: Fabulous chicken & beef satay, sauce very flavoursome! My husband & I shared Nonya Chicken Curry & Beef Rendang & finished off with the classic deep fried banana. Service was friendly & efficient in a buzzing setting! Wish we'd been earlier in our trip but will come back for lunch on our final day. 3 courses, a bottle of wine & 3 anchor beer came too 211 MYR - just over £35 gbp! Excellent value for money! Show less

Author: 888albert999
Title: Great food and music
Review:
If you look for a good place to have breakfast and dinner, Thai style.... go there!

Friendly staff, very good food at reasonable prices!

Author: Checkmate1
Title: Nice Food
Review: We went here twice and both times had a lovely food. Both nights we were there, they had some local musicians playing and singing some nice songs so the atmosphere was enjoyable.

Author: crinkly52North Yorkshire
Title: Love the Living Room
Review: Have been going to the living room since it opened and the quality of food is still excellent. Amy and Ben are great hosts and the atmosphere is electric on jam session nights. If you don't go anywhere else you must go to the living room.Show less

Author: 429christies
Title: Great dinner!
Review: Great place for dinner and very nice staff. Highly recommend it for dinner. Food was great and price good. Decor is fun as well

Author: AlmostJBirmingham, United Kingdom
Title: Don't be put off by all the foreigners!
Review: Don't be put off by all the foreigners. This place is great. Authentic Malay food with great service and yes, wine! It is priced than the food courts, which is to be expected but the service is friendly and the decor quirky. Can recommend the sizzling beef (you'll need to wash your clothes after having this - it sizzles!) and the salt and pepper squid. Super tasty !Show less

Author: OuseboyMelbourne, Australia
Title: Most enjoyable in every way!
Review: Great spot to relax and chill whilst in Batu Ferringhi. The food is delicious, the wine by the glass was very pleasant, the service was very friendly but not intrusive and the music choices very good. Great spot for lunch and dinner. We went three times. Great vibe and most enjoyable in every way.Show less

Author: BucksBishop
Title: Beautiful Food
Review: The food here was delicious. We had curries and the were great. Very Malaysian restaurant but that was all good for us, however if you are looking for something that is more polished this is not it.

Author: Nursetraveller91
Title: Cosy
Review: Nice small run restaurant. Fab tastes and cooked how you want it. Nicely priced and you can see many people who return like we did due to the warm welcome and great taste.

Author: UlliRahn
Title: Not special but ok
Review: Food was ok, nothing special. The veg curry was nice but quite expensive, as well the mixed veg. The staff is very friendly and it's nice to sit there in this relaxed restaurant but don't expect much just a normal meal out ...

Author: Travelling_gerbil
Title: Must go!
Review: The food at this restaurant is amazing - make sure you try the specials.  Service is so friendly.  We love it here!

Author: KazWBerkshireBerkshire
Title: Lovely food, lovely staff
Review: We were so pleased to have found this lovely little restaurant. The owner was very pleasant and helpful. Our food, ( local dishes) was excellent and so cheap too. We returned a few days later and again had lovely food and a warm welcome Recommended.Show less

Author: RonA_PlymouthPlymouth, United Kingdom
Title: Worst food in Malaysia
Review: Being out this neck of the world since last year and have family living on Penang, so have tried a few eatery's. By far and away the food here is the worst, all I ordered was a chicken nasi goreng, it arrived without chicken and the only taste it had was the oil it was swimming in. The rest of my party had similar poor quality food, the people who have been giving this place glowing reviews should really try getting out of Batu Feringghi. For those not brave enough try the food courts just down the road where the food is ten times better for a fraction of the cost.We will be telling all our friends about this place so it will only probably have unsuspecting tourist for future trade.Not recommended.Show less

Author: RoyF31Newark-on-Trent, United Kingdom
Title: A well earned reputation
Review: We had a long walk to find this restaurnat but pleased we made the effort. We were looking at the menu and a local man told us it was very good food and that he eat there a lot. He was right the food was delicious and the chilli kick in the Nasi Goreng was just right My wife had ribs but couldn't manage all of them so they boxed the remainder for her.The service was excellent the host ready to explain all the meals and it is not surprising it has obtained such a good reputation. We went on an oppresively hot evening and sat outside but under a fan would have been preferable. Out of all the restaurants this is one not to miss.Show less

Author: Colin522
Title: Charmingly relaxed
Review: Amy & Ben are delightful hosts and the environment is 'off beat' different and vibrant   Spring rolls and Thai Fish to die for!

Author: Jonathan OGainesville, Florida
Title: Great local place to hang out
Review: Many local food choices on the menu, relaxing atmosphere. Food quality is excellent. Always busy which is a great sign and the owner is very helpful and friendly. Pricing is in live with local costs so you won't brake the bank. Went there numerous times while staying at the Hard Rock.Show less

Author: The8FischersPerth, Australia
Title: Great food
Review: We were lucky to discover three excellent eateries just minutes away from our hotel (The Park Royal). The food was fresh, tasty and great value for money. The only challenge is thyat your beer doesnt stay cold because of the hot and humid climate of Penang.Show less

Author: RushLakeIslandStanchfield, Minnesota
Title: Great food, great atmosphere, reasonable priece and extremely freindly. y
Review: Our family of 4 adults and 4 children ate here one evening. The restaurant is opened up to the street and is very informal, like a home town bar with tables. We were entertained by a guitar player playing popular songs and asked for requests. It was crowded but very "home like." Like a living room. A jovial atmosphere prevailed. A good selection of excellent, relatively inexpensive food was served in a timely manner. The waitress treated us like we family. Great service and fun evening. It is usually crowded, but wait a little while and a table will open. The children also enjoyed being there.Show less

Author: Keith R
Title: Great restaurant -local food at good prices
Review:
One of the better restaurants, food cooked to perfection - and reasonably priced accordingly.
Nice atmosphere, friendly staff- food cooked to order
One to try!!!

Author: Daniel ABangkok, Thailand
Title: Pleasant little restaurant
Review: We enjoyed our meal here last night. The food was nicely prepared and presented, the staff were friendly and efficient and there is a good feel about the place. There was no band playing last night. It doesn't pretend to compete with its more sophisticated neighbour Ferringhi Gardens yet for a few ringgits more you get totally different experience at the latter!Show less

Author: MizzTravellerPenarth, United Kingdom
Title: Unmissable!
Review: We were only in Penang for 4 nights and we found this place on our 3rd night. After a disastrous meal in Batu Ferringhi on our first night it was so good to find Living Room Cafe and enjoy not only fine food but excellent hospitality from the hostess. She advised us which were the best local dishes and their ingredients and levels of spiciness. The beef rendang was absolutely superb, as were the satay and fish dishes we chose. We returned for our final meal in Penang and tried more dishes which were again excellent.The cafe isn't very big and it does get rather busy so you may have to queue but you won't regret the wait! There was live music both nights we were there which wasn't really to our taste but not enough to drive us out!Show less

Author: beckki
Title: Excellent ambiance throughout a power cut
Review: Ate here for dinner on Thursday 21/1/16. Shortly after we arrived the entire area suffered a power cut. Candles were quickly provided and cooking continued as it was on gas. Fantastic tasty food and lovely white wine to wash it down. Certainly would recommend.

Author: Jane_nrj
Title: Good dinner and lunch here
Review: A popular and friendly eatery with good, tasty food. The Chicken Curry was delicious. I believe there is live music here too but not when we visited.

Author: anglesey_lassanglesey north wales
Title: fantastic food and brilliant prices
Review: been here a few times now, great value with tasty home made food. we order just 6 satay, big mistake. They were so good we had to order 6 more. i had prawn red curry absolutely gorgeous. My hubby had beef rendang. he said it was fantastic. def worth a visit. Show less

Author: potsUkWilmslow, United Kingdom
Title: Great food, great value
Review: Packed little restaurant on the strip in Batu Ferranghi Penang. Lived up to its reputation as we had a lovely meal of various dishes for well under the equivalent of £15 for 2 and that included the drinks! Best restaurant we went to whilst in Penang. If you go try the sizzling vegetables as a side order to shareShow less

Author: qualitynotquantity99Newquay, United Kingdom
Title: Best food in Batu Ferringhi
Review: If you are looking for some authentic Asian dishes then this is the place. The owner is a friendly lady who came and said hello as we looked through the menu and gave us an insight into each dish which is her unique recipe. The Rendang dish was simply stunning.... seriously good. The restaurant is homely rather than being flash and the food is what makes this place the best in Batu. Often they have locals playing music in the back ground and you are not rushed and could easily spend the whole evening enjoying the atmosphere should you wish. Show less

Author: Trevor R
Title: Food and music
Review: Good atmosphere food and welcome as always here Amy and Ben and staff on good form live music nice background

Author: Jan L
Title: Holiday in Penang
Review: Lovely to hear live music it gets very busy here but we can honestly say we had the most disappointing food of our holiday here .

Author: DollyBillyBenfleet, United Kingdom
Title: Really Good Food
Review: Ate hear four times during a two week stay in the resort and it was some of the best food we had. We nearly always had to wait for a table that shows how popular it was and frequented by locals as well as tourists. Amy and her waitress run around keeping everyone served whilst Ben is busy behind the bar and sometime singing a duet with the guitarist (not the best vocals but adds to the atmosphere). Worth noting that in the evening they are open from 18.00 - 22.00 as they are also open for lunch, a lot of other local eating places open and close much later to coincide with the night market. Amy and Ben have a great little restaurant serving good food at a good price, definitely worth a visit.Show less

Author: pmaraun
Title: Tasty Local Fare
Review: We are the entire local menu over a number of nights. It's all great food, friendly service, great value and some live acoustic music for a bit of added ambience. Definitely recommend the beef rendang and kapitan curries. Hainanese spring rolls are awesome as well.

Author: Lin B
Title: Great food and lovely surroundings
Review: Noticed this place when enroute in taxi to our hotel, looked different to other more basic food eateries in Batu Ferringhi. Then saw reviews on Trip Advisor and decided we definitely had to go. Was full when we got there but after a few minutes sipping an ice cold Tiger at the bar a table was ready for us. Plenty of choice on menu and specials board, well priced and it tasted great. Live music was a welcome bonus. Lovely place.Show less

Author: WellyWebber
Title: Excellent value.
Review: Lovely hosts providing great Malaysian/Asian cuisine. We had the specials and it all tasted fabulous and all excellent value for money.

Author: retiredGoaCambridgeshire, United Kingdom
Title: Slow service, poor food
Review: Sad to say this cafe does not live up to expectations. As I spend most of the year in Penang I have visited Living Room many times. Amy is a lovely lady but sad to say the food is now over priced for here and of poor quality. There was a queue for tables which does not make sense in Batu Ferringhi as there are hundreds of better cafes. I am sure it will get better again but the prices certainly are way too highShow less

Author: Edingir
Title: Very good
Review: A really small place with very good food and excellent service. We went as a group and I would suggest that you book as really small place. Curry was good and also had nice wine.

Author: V446CZdavidn
Title: So good we went back 3 times!!
Review: We found The Living Room from great reviews online and we were not disappointed. We were greeted on our first night in Penang by the lovely owner and her big smile. She gave us some recommendations on what to eat and we were delighted with our choices. The owner spends time to speak to all her customers. We enjoyed it so much that we came back 3 times (and we usually never go to same place twice when on holiday). Food elsewhere did not compare, that is why we kept coming back. We also went there on Christmas Day. The live music was great and made us comfortable. There was live music on 2 of the nights that we visited. It was the only place that we found with live music. Would go back to Penang, just to visit this place again.Show less

Author: Lindi M
Title: Holiday
Review: Friendly staff n owners. Great atmosphere. The food came quick and was absolutely delicious .whole restaurant had a great vibe

Author: astyliMelbourne, Australia
Title: Absolutely loved it here
Review: The owners and the food are fantastic here. We had beef rendang which is a must and the satays were probably the best we have eaten I can tell you we have eaten them everywhere! We had alot of the speciality dishes so they were a little more in price but still extremely reasonable. Between the four of us we had two entrees, 4 main meals, 2 large tiger beers and soft drinks for 200 ringgit about $70AUS. Highly recommended Show less

Author: 863rachellfMudgeeraba, Australia
Title: Penang Perfection
Review: This place is fantastic.. it was recommended to us and well worth it. Its only little so get in when you can, you might have to wait a little. The service is good, the food is good, the price even better and there is even entertainment. We had the famous penang curry, delish.You have to try atleast once.Show less

Author: Martin A
Title: Quality food
Review:
While the motor bike noise a bit much the food  was excellent but not as good as other places

Beef Rendang tender
Sizzling Prawns in Oyster sauce excellent
Sizzling Chicken also good

Author: Ainaz M
Title: Dee-lish dinner for two
Review: Just had dinner at this lovely restaurant while in Penang. If you are ever on the Batu Ferringhi strip I highly recommend you do the same. It's always quite busy so expect to be told to wait but with table turnovers are quick so don't be put off. We had the fried wontons to start which were OK. The main dishes were all excellent. Bbq ribs with fries were in a nutmeg and clove spiced sauce and very tender. Nyonya curry prawns were fresh and in a delicious aromatic sauce. Had it with white rice. Also had the fried rice and fried yellow noodles. Both were served with fried shallots as a great finishing touch. Drinks were probably the most reasonably priced on the strip. All in all, paid 167 RM for 4 dishes and 4 beers. Make sure to leave a tip as they don't add an automatic service charge unlike many other spots in the area. Large Bottle of Tiger 20 RM Mains 20-35 RM Small Dishes 6-15 RM Show less

Author: Franicle7
Title: Yum!
Review: We ate here for dinner last night, had wontons, samosas, chicken curry, fish and green veggies. Everything was delicious and fresh. Recommend a visit while in BF. It gets very busy though! Live music was great too

Author: stevendH7037EZ
Title: Still Fantastic
Review: Came here 12 months ago and it was sensational then,and no exception 2 nights ago as well.Very well priced, great service, very friendly, and the food was amazing. You wont be disappointed.Must do in Batu Ferringhi

Author: JeanSydney_AustraliaSydney, Australia
Title: Nice food, nice owner
Review: This is a quaint little place with good local food and friendly staff. The only thing that spoils it is the terrible noise and pollution from the gangs of motor bikes that rage up and down the street . Shame the police don't take action as it's a big deterrent for all the eating places along the Batu Ferringhi stripShow less

Author: A7043FLdavidf
Title: Decent food and service
Review: One of the better options in the area. Good food (we had Malaysian) and good service - worth a visit of staying nearby....

Author: pedrc2015
Title: Safe bet!
Review: Have eaten here many times. Always good always friendly and lots of fun.If you are sitting outside ask for the sizzling rendang! Have to be outside as the steam from the sizzling plate can bring tears to the eyes! Amazing dish!!One of our favorites!!Show less

Author: jjboyzCardiff
Title: Traditional food, Wonderfully cooked!
Review: Have been staying in Batu Ferringhi for a week, and have eaten here twice in three days, after recommendation by a bar man in our hotel. The food is perfect, and value is excellent - 3 courses and wine for two, at about £30 total. Everything we ordered has been really delicious, the service is very friendly and the in-house entertainment is really good and creates a great atmosphere to spend a relaxed evening. Would not hesitate to go again.Show less

Author: juletcka
Title: Nice place with friendly staff
Review: Very good restaurant. Welcoming people. Kids friendly. It has a good choice of tasty food. Live music. Good value for money.

Author: H468JZrickbHervey Bay, Australia
Title: Christmas dinner
Review: We have been here quite a few times now but we heard about the fish dish they do that is not on the menu , well what a delightful surprise we had the fish was just yum , fish in batter with some very on top with rice , sorry didn't get any pictures of the dish it look so good could not wait to get started and the meal was nearly over before thought of taken a picture of the meal , next time will do .I must take my hat off to Ben and Amy for a great night and to Finnish off with a fruit salad and ice cream ⛄Show less

Author: joanp927
Title: Among the best in town
Review:
Eaten here several times. The welcome we have received was warm and cheerful. The  food is tasty and enjoyable. 
Can recommend eating here 100%.

Author: scannings
Title: Brilliant service, lovely atmosphere
Review: The only place we ate at twice during our stay, very nice food, the captains curry is spot on. Live music done nights was great, just a nice family run brilliant value place, give it a go.

Author: Spainy2
Title: Quirky but brilliant
Review: Almost like eating in their living room, but wonderful service, food was the best we had during our stay (and all the food was superb). Prices are really good, and a much cheaper option than the shangri la.

Author: FusspotFineDiner
Title: WOW FOOD!
Review: Having spent five nights in Penang this was where we ate our most enjoyable meal. The fish curry (nyonya) was the best I've had anywhere in the world. It's a little place just by the road where the staff are friendly, the beer is cold and the food is superb. The owner happily chatted to us about the ingredients & recipes when we asked which was great. Can't recommend enough! Thanks for a great mealShow less

Author: Leanne TAdelaide, Australia
Title: The best food in Penang
Review: We found this restaurant after being in Penang for 6 days and we wish we had have found it on the first day. The food was totally amazing. We went there every day for lunch and dinner up until we left. There was absolutely nothing negative to say about the food, the service or the prices. Amy and Ben are totally amazing people and deserve every bit of credit they get .Show less

Author: Rosette CAdelaide, Australia
Title: Best value great food Laid back atmoshere
Review: We ate here for dinner and lunch multiple times, Their food is amazing. Ben and Amy (owners) are very welcoming. They are able to cater to your tastes, so dont be scared to ask .Salt and Pepper squid and the Sweet and Sour chicken. Pork Ribs .Nasi goreng. Keow Teow are all amazing.If you are in Batu Ferringhi make sure you try here.On a Friday and Saturday night Ben and a few locals have a jam session .Great relaxing environment.So Support the locals we will be back!!!!!!Show less

Author: Ian HBirmingham, United Kingdom
Title: Great atmosphere and tasty food
Review: A owners personally run restaurant with very friendly staff very eager to please.We ate a number of times and enjoyed every meal for the special flavours, all delivered in quick time from ordering.Prices are very reasonable for both the food and the drinks.The atmosphere in the venue is relaxing and friendly especially on a weekend with the informal music jam sessions.Hopefully the reputation will continue to grow and we hope to spend some time with Amy and Ben again soon.Show less

Author: Derek PMelbourne, Australia
Title: Awesome salt and peppered squid and beef rendend
Review: Delicious food, friendly staff, awesome atmosphere, the owner and another musician played requests. After dinner we happily sat at the bar singing along.we went back several times during our stay.They are closed Wednesdays, but are open for lunch as well as dinner.10/10 service and food.Show less

Author: Shona C
Title: Welcoming
Review: We ate here twice during our stay in Batu Ferringhi - lovely food at great value in an outdoor eating area. Obviously fresh food and very welcoming staff and owner Amy

Author: 447reinergAugsburg, Germany
Title: casual dining
Review: We went yesterday evening to the living room restaurant, due to the many positive feedbacks here on tripadvisor. The ambience is very simple, the setting is more a "warung" then a restaurant. old metall chairs and tables. So we where not sure if we want to eat there. But we where greeted very friendly and warm, so we decided to give it a try. So the staff here is really doing an amazing job, you feel that they like what they do and giving you the feeling of an "living room". The menu is a mix of asian and western dishes, so we opted for the asian stuff. We started with some spring rolls and fried wonton. Both ok, but nothing special to be honest. For the main we had a chicken black pepper and dry chilli beef. Here we have to say the quality of the both was really great. The meat was juicy and tender and the sauces where very tasty. For desert we had a pisang goreng (fried banana). Was ok, but nothing special again. For all the above plus some glases of wine we paid around 35 EUR, what is a real bargain. So if you are looking for a very simple but good place for dinner, thats your restaurant.Show less

Author: HappytilerLondon UK
Title: Good food and friendly service
Review: Thoroughly enjoyed our dinner at the Living Room. The Rendang was delicious as was the Thai style fish. It's a small place so maybe we were lucky that it wasn't busy when we went as the service was attentive and friendly. Will certainly go back for more.Show less

Author: Sammyboy95
Title: Good burger and fish
Review: we went here for lunch today and ordered a pork burger and kapitan fish. The burger was juicy and patty was thick. Kapitan fish was excellent! it was really fresh one plate of rice wasn't enough. And the portion was very generous enough for 2

Author: fastrac10199
Title: Not my type of place
Review:
Food average, small portions, old decor, open air no A/C, fans only. HOT!!!!

Wpuld not eat here again

Author: Alexbdx
Title: Decent lunch
Review: Three and a half stars for this cute, basic bistro. Had lunch here which was good but not unforgettable.

Author: Nick P
Title: Dinner
Review: Enjoyed a tasty dinner - sizzling chicken & beef rendang. With rice and 2 soft drinks came to all of 62ish MYR. Probably best not to let guests (who can't) sing though!

Author: ajr493Orpington, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent prawn Kapitan curry
Review: We ate here during a torrential downpour. My beef Rendang was nice but a little chewy, also it was cut in large slices which were difficult to cut with a fork and spoon. However, my husband's prawn Kapitan curry was amazing. The wine was quaffable and the atmosphere encouraged chat between tables. Five glasses of wine later, the bill was still incredibly reasonable. We will definitely go back. Show less

Author: pkm68Ko Lanta, Thailand
Title: Really good.
Review: I read the reviews, popped in for a coffee and a sandwich and returned for an evening meal. The owners and staff were very friendly, the music was good so we sat at the bar for a while then moved to a table. The menu choice was fab and the price, really reasonable. When they asked if we would like a last drink, we said yes but were also recommended a place close by for our nightcap ! The toilet is situated at the back of the building but you actually have to walk through a nice , clean kitchen to get there ! All good and highly recommended.Show less

Author: Georgia OMelbourne, Australia
Title: Yum.
Review: We ate here twice after reading reviews on Trip Advisor and we weren't disapointed. The food was lovely and fresh, service was fast and the fans created a lovely cool setting to escape the humidity outside. The rendang was some of the best we've ever had (almost beating the rendang we had in Ubud!) and the burger was surprising great. Satay was fab and the Nasi Goreng was perfectly cooked. If you want some decent food with a smile, come to The Living room.Show less

Author: CjsummersStroud, United Kingdom
Title: A Gem in Batu Ferringhi
Review: Looking for somewhere to eat in Batu Ferringhi is a mind field so we checked the reviews on trip advisor and selected the Living Room as it was rated 1st and it certainly didn't disappoint! The meal and experience was certainly the best we had in Malaysia.The owners and staff were very friendly and attentive, service was extremely quick and with their help we selected some delicious dishes.Our favourite was the Thai Style Fish - the flavour combination was a real treat for the taste buds.If you're in Batu Ferringhi you must eat here, I'm sure you'll be delighted if you do.Show less

Author: La-femme-niketaLondon
Title: Brillant food Brilliant service
Review: We stayed in Penang for 8 nights and we had dinner here for 6 nights. The food is excellent with a choice of traditional and western food. The family run business makes you feel at home and it was a quite and relaxing experience while eating good food and listening to the man playing guitar. This is a must place to eat and drink. Show less

Author: gabriel peter s
Title: nice service, ok setting, poor food
Review: went there as it was rated nr1 on tripadvisor! huge disappointment! the food is neither western nor asian, it is just bland. more like the ones from the supermarket.

Author: ToshHusky
Title: Another great experience
Review: Just home from a week on Penang.    Visited Living Room twice for dinner and were welcomed back by Amy and Ben.     Food was wonderful as was the relaxed atmosphere.

Author: 11SeVeN11
Title: Great curry
Review:
Went there for lunch and had the fish curry, salt pepper squid and noodle soup.

The curry is a must. It was pretty damn tasty.

Author: Margot WPort Douglas, Australia
Title: We Knew All The Words
Review: Great little restaurant, very friendly staff and icy cold beer. We left it up to waitress on what to eat, certainly not disappointed. Very entertaining jam session, 60's and 70's songs and we joined in. So sad when you know all the words to songs from that era. Give restaurant a go, it was fun.Show less

Author: fraserwil
Title: Definitely recommend
Review: Great wee atmosphere here. Asked staff to choose our food (based on our likes) and they didn't disappoint.  You walk through the kitchen to use the toilets so at least you know it's also clean.

Author: hcsaw
Title: Excellent place to hangout
Review: Back again to this bistro run by an exceptionally friendly couple. The beef rendang, Kapitan chicken curry, red curry prawns, are "must tries".A good selection of simple western food too. The bistro also have a good selection of 2nd hand books to give away left by clients after their trips. Art pieces personally selected by the owners are sometimes put up for sale.If you are up to it you can also have a jamming session at the music corner.Show less

Author: nellielimKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Small cozy cafe with good food
Review: Small cozy restaurant with live music located along Balu Ferringhi road between Hard Rock Hotel and Park Royal Hotel. Menu has a wide selection of Asian and Western cuisine which is reasonably priced. Service efficient, friendly and warm. Food tasty and beers cold. Jam session on weekends which was entertaining.Show less

Author: glenys590Geelong, Australia
Title: Just ok......
Review: I'm not sure about the hype for this restaurant. Hubby and I came for dinner after reading all the reviews on Trip Advisor and were sadly disappointed. Hubby ordered BBQ ribs after seeing the photo on the front board. His dish looked nothing like that. I think his ribs were ox or something. 4 very large fatty ribs that were tough and had no sauce! I ordered Salt & Pepper Calamari expecting to get some lovely fresh squid. What I got was packet frozen crumbed squid served on lettuce in a cocktail glass with some sort of gravy on top! Very disappointing! Cold beer and nice watermelon juice though!Show less

Author: paulao285
Title: Great atmosphere, friendly place, good food.
Review: We had such a good time here singing along to the great live music while eating really good food. We did not want to leave. In fact we bought an extra drink just so we could stay as it was quite busy.

Author: LorrainepatriciatoddPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Nice home cooking and friendly owners
Review: Ben and Amy are a lovely couple who are locals from Penang and they have a nice arty restaurant, bar, cafe right beside Ferringhi garden. It is worth a trip to try out their food and have a cold beer guaranteed. they also have a jam session on Friday and or Saturday evenings which is a lot of fun and nice too. Definitely try them out whilst you are in Batu Ferringhi.Show less

Author: Rusty2315Melbourne, Australia
Title: Excellent food best in Penang and Malaysia
Review: We went here for the first time, had 5 dishes, servings aren't to big which is great cause you can try a few dishes this way. Host was fabulous, food sensational, price was fantastic and had to tip, well done guys, keep up the great work, we will be here every night when we revisit Penang, so guys, support this wonderful restaurant Show less

Author: Milan P
Title: Mama´s cooking
Review: Cozy little place with nice atmosphere and live music, you can choose place inside or on terrace. Staff and food made us feel like home. Make sure to order starter and main dish to make you belly full.

Author: Lyn LPerth, Australia
Title: Let down by the fruit juice
Review: We went here based on Tripadvisor reviews. Wednesday was closed we we went back the next night. I ordered an orange juice, and when it came and was clearly watered down I called the waitress to enquire if I was correct. She told me they only use 2 oranges per glass so of course the rest is water!! What? I have never come across this before.Ever. Not even at any of the other restaurants in Penang. This was such a disappointment that spoled an otherwise good restaurant. The food was good, and it has a pleasant surrounds.Show less

Author: r0amingtravellerEvesham, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent simple Malay food
Review: For a 'no frills' approach to eating this was a great choice. Great little place which appears very unassuming on the main strip in Batu Ferringhu. The staff are most welcoming and the dishes are very tasty. Enjoyed great Malay/thai influenced dishes and well worth a visit. Thank you for your hospitality!Show less

Author: Rob688Halifax, United Kingdom
Title: Looks can be deceiving
Review: Went on recommendations from TA, looks like one of those places you would just walk past, but how wrong could you be, defiantly home cooked locality owned. Lovely staff who where attentive but not in your face. Menu simple and easy to understand. The Beef Randang was recommended, and wow, nice and spicy. Others had the sizzling beef which was just as tasty. Whatever you have is well cooked tasty and really good value. Nearly forgot to mention the satay starter with the tastiest satay sauce I've ever or likely ever to taste again.Show less

Author: MartinNCC
Title: Traditional Fresh Malysian Food Well Priced!
Review:
Fresh, well priced great variety and authentic malay.

The beers were also well priced. We ate here twice and wasnt disappointed.

Author: Trudie FPerth, Australia
Title: Excellent food great service felt like a local by the end of the week
Review: We visited The living room for food on 2 occasions within the week, but called in for a drink most nights. Jam night was a success very welcoming, had the sizzling dishes and egg fried rice were tasty and the wine was good reasonably priced too.Show less

Author: Trevorthedriver
Title: Great food in a nice atmosphere
Review: We went three times and each time the food was delicious. Great atmosphere with live music on one night. Excellent service and Ben and Amy made us very welcome

Author: mcollier_84
Title: Very Tasty Food
Review: Best Penang Curry I have ever had!! the food here was very very good. We mixed it up by coming here a couple of times rather than being at Long Beach every night and we were not disappointed. Highly recommended. And the staff are amazing

Author: Cholla1
Title: Very nice and enjoyable
Review: We went there as half of us wanted local food the others wanted western, the food was very good and staff excellent. The next morning we went for breakfast equally as good. Will visit again

Author: Dowls04Perth, Australia
Title: Great cafe!
Review: We went to this cafe on the recommendation of other posts here on trip advisor and were so glad we did.The food is great with many choices to choose from and so affordable, the staff are very friendly and we enjoyed it so much we went back twice (and we saw many others do the same) would highly recommend this cafe to everyone travelling to the Batu Ferringhi area. Show less

Author: TraceyAdelaide
Title: good service and value for money
Review: Good variety of both local and western food at a very good price.  Pleasant atmosphere with quick service of meals.  Very popular spot even late into the evening for meals.

Author: Darren F
Title: Best fried rice ever tasted
Review: Amazing food last night. Really friendly staff. A must visit. Home cooked food. 10 out of 10. Had deep fried ice cream,  very clever.

Author: Carmel Julie T
Title: Excellent
Review: The location, décor, friendliness of staff, and most of all the excellent food. Caters for all having western dishes and also Asian which suits "fussy eaters". All customers made to feel welcome and special.

Author: TomasHermansenTrondheim, Norway
Title: Another good choice for eating out
Review: This is a small and nice restaurant right in the heart of Batu Ferringhi. The food is great, and with live music and good atmosphere its almost always filled up (live music Fridays and Saturdays, but it can be filled up also other evenings). It is close to the main road, and lots of guests in a small space can give some noise. The price level is average, where we paid 24RM for a pepper beef (worth every ringit). It is hard to compare different restaurants, but this is a different eating experience than the neighbor restaurant (that I also rated very good).Show less

Author: 495lieslwKooyong, Australia
Title: Greta food and service
Review: This is probably the best restaurant in Batu Ferringhi. Satays are awesome, and magnificent nasi goreng and char kway teow. Service is so friendly and the beer glasses come out icy. This is a small restaurant so book ahead to avoid being turned away. The western food was also good and enjoyed by our kids.Show less

Author: O9951SXpauljLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent food
Review: Stopped for dinner as the restaurant was packed, so you'd guess the food was good- it was.Good portions, good service.Compared to other local restaurants and hawker stall the food was expensive for Penang, but for a western budget, it was still cheap.Would eat here again.Show less

Author: Scrapbookluz
Title: Good food!
Review: Be sure to come early.  This restaurant is always full because the food is excellent! Clean and great service.

Author: Steve CAdelaide, Australia
Title: Wish it was my Living Room.
Review: Ate twice here on a recent trip including a Saturday night which is a must if you love listening to musos jam.Mixed green veggies in oyster sauce, Nonya beef curry and chicken with cashews was just brilliant and perfect for two! Good value and a great host in Amy. Show less

Author: sfuller88Penang Island, Malaysia
Title: Our favorite place to hang out on the weekends!
Review: We discovered this place while riding our scooters around the island. We started in Georgetown and stopping at Bora Bora (another great spot in Batu Ferringhi right on the beach!) for some drinks at the end of our ride. We were talking with another group and asked them where to go for dinner and they recommended Living Room right down the street. Me and my roommates go back there at least once a week now!Our favorite nights to go are Friday and Saturday because there is a live jam session with the owner and a bunch of local musicians. Jamming starts around 8 and ends around 11, but they will stay open later if everyone is having a great time! Black pepper beef and mixed veggies are the two dishes we order every time and I highly recommend them! If your not sure what to get just tell the waitress or the owners wife what you like/don't like (whichever is shorter) and they will set you up with an awesome combination of flavorful dishes.If you come in on a Friday or Saturday and see an ex pat drinking tiger and eating black pepper beef and mixed veggies come over and say hello! You can also thank me for convincing you to check out this great place by buying me another beer! =DShow less

Author: cansavage
Title: Ask for the spice
Review:
Very friendly and helpful staff and ownership.
Clean tables and ding area.
Service in English and other languages.
Central location for major hotels and shopping and beaches.
Eat the local specials!  Penang curry... great!

Author: snoogstaaar
Title: Great food that does take away also
Review: Really great food especially the local dishes. I really like the fact you can get the dishes takeaway too.

Author: dhcfMontreal, Canada
Title: Great food!
Review: Location was easy to find, across from the art gallery, beside Garden Ferringhi, on the main road. We ordered only Malaysian/Asian food (beef rendang, fish curry, and stirfry vegetables). Everything was delicious. It's nothing fancy. It's a casual eatery with some mighty authentic and homemade/made-from-scratch food. The staff was friendly and courteous and the owner took the time to engage with all the clients. Yes, it is more expensive than hawker stalls but there is a place to sit down and relax and plenty of fans to keep us cool to enjoy our meal. If you want upmarket or splurge for a special event and eat in a gorgeous setting, try Garden Ferringhi but the food is definitely better at Living Room Cafe!Show less

Author: margaritaparrishSydney, Australia
Title: Central position, nice food, good music, fair prices and good ambience
Review: Nice, little comfortable cafe/bar where one can enjoy a little music and good food at reasonable prices. It is in a very central location in Batu Ferringhi just down from the night markets, one of the nicest things about the "living room " is that the hostess of the restaurant is always around and engages in conversation with all her guests.This is lovely, and a nice way to acquire information or advise on different issues in which one may be interested.Show less

Author: Marriedtheenglish_80Brisbane, Australia
Title: Not as wonderful as I had hoped
Review: I must say they have fantastic satay… but that was the only fantastic thing. As someone else has mentioned, there was nothing wrong with the restaurant, but I have had much better sizzling beef at my local in Australia, and the orange juice we had the second time we visited the restaurant tasted totally watered down. It was very average… Long Beach Cafe which is heaps cheaper is actually heaps better.Show less

Author: MarkDReviewer
Title: Great atmosphere and food.
Review:
Book in advance as they do get busy.
Great service and food was exceptional.
Cost - approx. £15 a head but worth it. 
They also serve wine which can be difficult to get elsewhere.
Try the open spring rolls.

Author: kernowtraveller77Newquay, United Kingdom
Title: Outstanding
Review: Batu-ferringhi during our visit in May was very quiet - not many tourists and most restaurants were empty but not this one. That tells you how popular this restaurant is. We first visited 3 years ago and found the food delicious and Amy the most attentive and engaging hostess. Our return was not disappointing - again great food. I recommend the nasi goreng - the best I've had.Show less

Author: RebeccaK150Kellyville, Australia
Title: Fantastic food!
Review: Such beautiful food and fabulous Beef Rendang. The deep fried ice cream and banana fritters are the best. Our son enjoyed the most crispy fish and chips he has ever had.Thank you Amy and Ben for 2 awesome dinners during our trip. We will be back!!!Show less

Author: ramsgate19Dubbo Nsw Aust
Title: Usual Good Fare
Review: We dined here on a number of occasions on our last visit to Penang and found the food excellent on each visit. The staff were very friendly and accommodated us to find room inside as the rain started one night. The curries were beautiful and full on flavour. Live music on two of our visits with an Aussie guy on the harmonica was a real bonus. Highly recommended.Show less

Author: MichaelShortlandsBromley, United Kingdom
Title: A friendly place
Review: I'm not a great fan of Malaysian food generally and am more inclined in these circumstances to place more importance in the atmosphere of a place. This is a small, informal but friendly restaurant, the proprietess being particularly charming and helpful. We enjoyed the Beef redang and Nasi goreng, and I was pleased to find Strongbow cider (canned). By the way, unlike some other establishments in the resort, they serve real pork bacon.The toilet is at the rear of the premises through the kitchen, so you can see how that meets your comfort factor, and is about what you would expect in this type of establishment.Use mosquito repellant if you are seated near the entrance.We liked the place well enough to visit for two dinners and one lunch (bacon sandwich).Show less

Author: mickeymostIsle of Wight, United Kingdom
Title: Still outstanding
Review: I last reviewed this restaurant in 2013 and if anything from the reviews it seems to have got even more popular. We only managed two nights, the first being very busy and the second much quieter. The food was up to its usual excellent standard and the service good. The only slight reservation I have in view of past experiences is that the portions seem to be getting smaller though the quality is still high.Show less

Author: Jay S
Title: Try the prawn currie !
Review: Our family came here for dinner. The staff was very friendly and the service was excellent. The prawn currie was amazing, and the beef with ginger was very good. My daughter wasn't crazy about her burger, so maybe western food isn't their forte .

Author: eleriannejAnglesey, United Kingdom
Title: Great food well worth a visit
Review: Having looked on tp we decided to visit this venue.we weren't disappointed. It was exactly how most people had described it, by no means up market, the opposite but for what you got and what you paid excellent..... Keep up the good work. One thing I will say if your a strongbow man like my husband you'll be glad to know they serve it here!!Show less

Author: shuraxSingapore, Singapore
Title: Second Visit
Review: Been here before 2 years ago, lady boss kindly introduced us to her homemade sauces and food, was really impressed by the taste of it and freshness of the seafood. Now 2 years later we are back again, and amazingly the lady boss can still remember me! The food is excellent as usual, always the place to dine in when im visiting Batu Ferringhi. Thank you for your hospitality!Show less

Author: ollymac_9_10Kent UK
Title: The place to go
Review: We have visited Living Room on past trips to Penang and on Holiday again we visited on about 3 more nights in April 2015.The place cannot be faulted. Food as always was excellent and reasonably priced.Our friends who were experiencing Malaysia for the first time were equally impressed.The service is great and Amy and Ben will go that extra mile to have a chat and ensure all is ok.What also added to some great nights was the music being played by Ben and two other cracking musicians/singers, you could even join in or sing if you wanted. (We did a great rendition of Sweet Caroline on)Its a must visit place if in Batu ferringhi-just along from the Ferringhi gardens-close to the mosque.Show less

Author: Ken W
Title: The place to eat
Review: This is a great friendly place to eat, food excellent, prices good, Jam sessions Friday and Saturday nights, and the welcome from Amy and Ben is super

Author: N19HWD
Title: Just what we needed
Review: We eat here after seeing it on trip, great tasting food , cheap beer & wine & great service what more could you ask for . Give it a try you won't be disappointed.

Author: Chris M
Title: Great find
Review: Visited in off season so not so many choices. However then we found this gem - great food and cold beer. I will return.

Author: 89JamesM
Title: Fabulous Find
Review:
Stopped here for dinner & drinks. Beer was cold and cocktails great ! Alas, Guinness does not travel :-(
Food was excellent and great value.
Topping it all off was the friendly and efficient service and cracking live music.
Very well recommended....

Author: LibbyKKChichester, United Kingdom
Title: Great food, friendly staff, cold beer!
Review: Love this place - we visited a few times during our stay in the area. They have a live music jam session some nights - definitely worth finding out when it is. The food is lovely - and very good value. It seemed to always be busy which, I guess, is testament in itself!Show less

Author: Bob CMelbourne, Australia
Title: You never know who you will meet ,
Review: Had great couple of visits to living room, food and service excellent , amongst our group were three musicians from Melbourne who we're invited to join in a jam session with Ben and his Muso friends, a really friendly night was had by all, it was a big night .visitors should check out when the boys play and combine good food with live music.You might get to crank out tune.Show less

Author: Lynette CAustralia
Title: A little bit of home
Review: The Living Room Cafe Bar offers a relaxing place to sit and enjoy good food and watch the world go by. The Fish Curry was beautifully cooked with great flavour. The Fish with Thai Salad was delightfully refreshing - taste and texture. It must have links with Australia as all of the stubby holders were from Australian companies.Show less

Author: msssing
Title: Worth for value
Review: We had a great time for lunch here and it came to excellent. Food and drinks were fantastic. The atmosphere and ambience were relaxing and comfortable. The price was acceptable for what we paid!

Author: HMorphitisHaringey, United Kingdom
Title: Great food and music
Review: This cafe and bar has an authentic feel. The live music gave the place a welcoming atmosphere. You could chill out and let the evening roll on. The food was excellent - esp. The chicken satay, spring rolls (crispy cups), sizzling beef and nasi goreng. 2 courses with beer was about £12 each. You are not rushed and can stay in for drinks and music. It's a lovely place to spend the night . Show less

Author: Singapore-td10
Title: good food
Review: enjoyed the food here, service and close to hotel- would go back and try more of the menu - service good

Author: Sue MPerth, Australia
Title: Excellent food and great entertainment
Review: We've just returned from our first Trip to Batu Ferringi and we were told by other hotel patrons to go and check this place out. Friday and Saturday nights the owner and others have a jamming session which is just amazing and fun. The food is delicious, fresh and well priced and the beer is also cheap and Cold. Staff are friendly and welcoming. We had the best night of our holiday here at this little gem, definitely pay them a visit, it won't disappoint.Show less

Author: Freda Mcroston
Title: Excellent food
Review: We had consistently superb food at a reasonable price here during our recent trip to Penang. The service was excellent and the staff very friendly. Wine was always nicely chilled and we spent several evenings here during our stay at the Park Royal. We highly recommend.Show less

Author: JonM17
Title: Food review
Review: Fab food really fresh had sizzling chicken and Thai style chicken with fresh green vegetables great value and lovely people!

Author: soularch
Title: Really friendly place with great food
Review:
Really nice atmosphere in the place, with very attentive and friendly staff. Had tender Beef Rendang and some classic Chinese dishes. Loved it.
Music often on the go from the owner and anybody along for a jam.

Author: Richard MGlasgow, United Kingdom
Title: Consistently good and always welcoming
Review: This is my second holiday to Batu Ferringi and this gem of a restaurant does not disappoint. The signature dish is the Beef Rendang which is delicious and definitely worth a try and very reasonably priced. We stayed at the five star Rasa Sayang and it is surely a tribute to this little restaurant that so many guests end up at the Living Room at some point. On Fridays and Saturdays an acoustic jamming session from the owners and their friends is quietly enjoyed. Recoomended.Show less

Author: GregB923North Perth, Australia
Title: A fun place to dine
Review: This place is a little gem. Whilst only small ( and closed on Wednesday), the food is terrific and the servings generous. The staff are a fun bunch of people who are only too happy to make suggestions and offer descriptions of food. We'll definitely return on our next visit to Penang.Show less

Author: JonCrossley
Title: great little restaurant
Review: Only small, but has very friendly staff  and really tasty food. Live music "free and easy" on Fri/sat nights in the background creates a  great atmosphere to sit and eat/drink. Cost is very reasonable and a lovely way to spend a Fri/Sat evening.

Author: crinkly52North Yorkshire
Title: Great Maylasan Chicken Curry
Review: Visited the Living Room several times and just love the food. Great Sizzling meals and the Malaysian Chicken Curry is just super. Amy and Ben are the perfect hosts. Weekends you can enjoy jammin sessions with Ben and other musicians from all over the world. Great place to just chill. Prices are good and portions are just the right size.Show less

Author: 911bellaMid Sussex
Title: Superb
Review: We ate here several times during our stay in Penang. A real genuine welcome from Amy and her team and exceptional food. I had the best fish curry outside of Kerala, spiced up at my request. It's great value and fully deserves its reputation. Give it a try.Show less

Author: SveaInverness
Title: Great
Review: This is a great little restaurant. Nothing too pretentious, just great food at great prices. I had red chicken curry which was delicious and the best banana fritters I have ever eaten! I just wish we had found it sooner. We might have eaten there every night!Show less

Author: NICK R
Title: A relaxing place to eat!
Review:
This restaurant deserves it's popularity.

Very friendly service, staff that care, welcoming ambiance and tasty home cooked food.

Author: 44basHornchurch, United Kingdom
Title: A wonderful place
Review: We've visited this little place twice so far and both times the food has been excellent. The staff are very attentive and helpful in choosing if you are not familiar with the menus. The even recommend dishes to compliment if you are not sure. The toilets are exceptionally clean, which is a must for me.We will be back before we go home on 6th Feb.Show less

Author: trudydubaiDubai, United Arab Emirates
Title: Cosy Livingroom, Friendly Hosts and Honest Food
Review: Don't expect a fancy restaurant, but it's unique. If you happen to walk in on a Friday night you might experience a Jam session where even Mick Jagger would love to join in.......!Amy and Ben are great hosts with a real interest in their guests, whether they are tourist or residents. They care!Honest Food is served, home cooking without MSG!!!!!! Our favorites are: Spring-rolls, Beef Rendang, Sizzling Beef and the daily fresh veggies with oyster sauce and garlic. Chicken Capitan is also lovely. Enjoy!Show less

Author: Hilary SNottingham, United Kingdom
Title: Good company, great food and drink
Review: The owners of this little bar are the perfect hosts. The atmosphere is very welcoming and friendly.We ate here several evenings throughout our stay and found the food excellent both in quality and a great price.We would certainly eat here again on our return to Penang.Show less

Author: jdelucchi8Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Reliably consistent
Review: I had last visited this place 2 years ago, when I was living/working in Tanjong Bungah. Always friendly, always good quality, always helpful. The same owners and the same good feeling about the place. I never did a review, before, so I need to put that right. Try it, I'm sure you'll like it. Real BACON in the breakfasts, good coffees and a varied main meal menu.Show less

Author: LarsJ399
Title: Chicken Capitan
Review: If you go here, and you should, the Chicken Capitan is a must. One of the best I have ever eaten. Cosy little restaurant, don't look much for the World, but be sure not to miss it.

Author: Laurence GPerth, Australia
Title: Great Food and Cold Beer
Review: Very tasty dinner at a very reasonable price. I loved the Nonya curry prawn dish especially but everything was great and they serve large Tiger beers in big zip up stubby holders. $110MYR for plenty of food and a few beers. Atmosphere is pleasant and staff very friendly. Definitely worth the visit and I look forward to returning to try more of the menu.Show less

Author: 934janep
Title: Lovely atmosphere
Review: This little cafe has a lot of character, the service was excellent and the food good. Very friendly little place with a welcoming atmosphere

Author: caroleWarwickshireUK
Title: Best food in penang by far
Review: Visited twice and saw the same people there from the night before. All dishes were excellent hot tasty and authentic.

Author: Hayley21
Title: Love it here
Review: We came here 2 nights in the run. Lovely laid back vibe, cheap beer, friendly staff! The food here is just perfect! Lovely place 👌.

Author: Leana P
Title: Amazing
Review: Amazing food. Family friendly. Great price. Would recommend the satay, salt and pepper squid. Kids loved the float drinks

Author: ikramaluminasBandar Lampung, Indonesia
Title: Good ambiance, good food, great host!
Review: The food was good for non-asian palate but it shouldnt take anything away from it. The trouble with asian dishes, due to the condiments/spices used, is that a little more can drive the taste balance off the cliff. The living room got it spot on.Good ambiance and a great host! Show less

Author: RLJ2010_25Dubai, United Arab Emirates
Title: Excellent value!
Review: We had dinner based on trip advisor reviews and we enjoyed it. We ordered a bottle of white wine and 4 dishes which cost 122 RM which is amazing value! We ordered all Chinese dishes and enjoyed them. My 4 year old ate chicken pineapple rice and loved it. Service good. We will be back.Show less

Author: tony k
Title: Excellent food and friendly service
Review: We found this little gem last year and re-visited. We went for a lunch a couple of times and dinner a few times over our two week holiday - its close to the Park Royal (out the door and turn right)Ben and Amy give very friendly and efficient service - the food is a delight - the beef rendang is the best we have eaten and the Kapitan Nonya style curried prawns and chicken is delicious (as is the Thai style chicken and so on)We have seen some of the reviewers think that the restaurant is over rated but we dont think so - it is very nice, not too big, very fresh and tasty food (and nice cold drinks in chilled glasses) with friendly hosts and staff. The cost is more than some restaurants in town but lower than a whole lot - the quality is very good.Well done Ben and Amy for creating this little jewel - we will be back!Show less

Author: brownbag68Geelong
Title: One of the best meals in Malaysia
Review: We had a wonderful night at the Living Room. It was one of the tastiest meals I've had. The Nyonya chicken curry was superb and we also had a hot, sweet and sour fish which was very well balanced. The ribs were also excellent, albeit a bit expensive. And two of us really enjoyed the calamari. Fried ice-cream was also a cut above the usual in Malaysia. Great, friendly service too.Show less

Author: sadstone1
Title: Not worth it
Review:
After reading all those exciting reviews we decided to have dinner there.
But all we got was small portions, expensive prices and not so tasty meals.

Author: Drsusanf
Title: Quite nice
Review: We dined here Christmas night as a family of five, and enjoyed our meal. The service was very friendly, and the atmosphere nice. All our dishes were very much what we would expect from an Australian style Chinese restaurant , and I'm wondering if this is why the place is so popular. The dishes were nice, but probably not necessarily "authentic" Chinese such as you would find in the hawker's markets. I can see why perhaps European visitors might be attracted to this tasty but safe option of cuisine in Penang. There were also western dishes on the menu, which I noticed were popular with quite a few of the patrons tonight. Our meal of 5 mains and rice, plus entrees of samosas and salt and pepper squid, including ciders and beers for five, cost around MR 140 (roughly $50AUD), so not really that expensive unless you are comparing to the markets.All in all, certainly not a bad option when in Batu Ferringi.Show less

Author: andrewooi78
Title: Nice Food
Review: Nice foods and fair price compare others along the road......the restaurant quite tight, not much spaces....... My wife complain about mosquitoes bite but i didnt feel it. I request for mosquitoe repellent and lucky they hv it. Good service.......

Author: ZoZoMelbourneMelbourne, Australia
Title: Hidden from the hustle and bustle of Batu Ferringhi
Review: what a gorgeous funky cafe! The best chicken sate in Penang! We ate here with three adults and two children, walked via the beach from the Golden Sands with a gorgeous sunset! A warm greeting by Amy and we were seated. Lots to look at, local craft I assume, and the menu reads very well. We ordered Beef Rendang, two different fried rices, on with pineapple for the kids, YUM! Noodles and a sit fry veggie dish. Good size serves, not hot but elegantly spicy! We had some extra hot chillies on the side! Wonderful atmosphere and great value for money. We ate in the food hall the previous evening, which was also nice, but this was delicious! Coupled with some good local beer, perfect!Show less

Author: TheBigW5
Title: Living Room....Excellent!
Review: Great food and service, good  prices would recommend you eat out at the Living Room when in Batu Ferringhi.

Author: nolanar
Title: Great food and fantastic value
Review:
It's just after parkroyal
Hotel. 

Good selection of starters and mains. The beef rendang was excellent, kapitan fish and the chicken Thai style. 

Desert was limited. 

Do book as it was full on a Thursday night. 

Would definately go back.

Author: GadgetmunkeyLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Still the best place to eat
Review: I wrote a review four years ago singing the praises of this gem of a restaurant. Having dined here tonight, I am pleased to report that nothing has changed to sway this opinion. The place was packed out at 8pm when we got there- always a good sign considering even the food courts we passed were half empty. We ordered the chicken curry Kapitan and the beef rendang with steamed rice, some veg and two drinks. We knew from experience that food would take a while coming since everything is cooked to order. So we just relaxed with our drinks until the food arrived.The chicken kapitan is still the best I have ever tasted and the rendang was tender and flavoursome and appeared to have been slow cooked for hours. The sizzling veg was also well cooked. Nicely full for around £14 for two including drinks. Not the cheapest around but certainly the best food for the money. A little sad to hear that due to rent increases Amy and Ben may have to move on, but heartened to also hear that they intend to stay in the area. We will certainly follow them anywhere they go.Show less

Author: NinaTomStandish, United Kingdom
Title: Our best meal so far.
Review: This turned out to be our last meal before leaving Malaysia and it was certainly our favourite. There is a lovely atmosphere about the Living Room - no need here for a hawker out the front as the charming interior lures you in. The menu has a good selection of local favourites as well as (spotted on a nearby table) some very nice looking Western dishes for those who want it. Our Won Ton, Chilli Beef and Sizzling Prawn (Oyster Sauce) were excellent; tasty, nicely spiced and not overpowering in flavour. The piece de resistance for us however was the Deep Fried Ice Cream; I've never had anything deep fried that tasted this delicate, so much so we almost had a second portion. Friendly owner / waiters, they were busy and a bit short handed when we went but they kept the service going well; it was nice not to be rushed and be able to sit, relax and enjoy the evening. Show less

Author: hcsaw
Title: Feel at home
Review: Feel at home in this cafe. Husband and wife team running it is extremely friendly. The food is very good and gives you a taste of Penang home cook food. The beef rendang is excellent.

Author: sanlauMelbourne
Title: Best Resturant
Review: this is a must when in Penang, the food is to die for. The owner is really lovely and you can not go wrong the prices are great and the curry is to die for. Thankyou Amy for the tips on the spices and showing me the spice book. Sandra in Melb australia !!!Show less

Author: Etphonehome67
Title: Superb!!
Review: Had lunch and dinner here on multiple occasions. The food is outstanding the staff are friendly and a very relaxed vibe in cafe. Tried most things on the menu and I have to say they were all amazing.

Author: HailzdYattalunga
Title: Amazing food and people
Review: Such a lovely place to experience whilst in penang!! We went there 4 times in our 7 days and the food was fabulous each time as well as they excellent service from the super friendly staff. A must try is the beef rendang. Will always go back when we are here again. Show less

Author: Dave P
Title: Relaxing holiday
Review: Proprietors Ben & Amy fantastic people, great authentic food and great hosts.  Top jam sessions on Friday & Saturday nights

Author: Neil CPerth, Australia
Title: Great if like flavour in small portions
Review: Four of us went for dinner last night based on the reviews. Price was more than reasonable but that is because of tho oration sizes, small. Food was tasty, turn around time was quick and if your after a lighT dinner or eating following a late lunch then I recommend this place. If your starving for a big feed then this is not the place.Show less

Author: AfroLankaninOzSydney, Australia
Title: Living Room Cafe
Review: Read lots of great reviews about this restaurant so went there for dinner on our last night. The food is as good as the reviews say and the service excellent. The kids absolutely loved the dinner and the milkshakes. The menu isn't huge but offers a good variety. We found the portions were the right size, and the food was on our table within 10 minutes of ordering. Definitely a must doShow less

Author: RossC212Shefford, United Kingdom
Title: The best in Malaysia!
Review: We went to the Living room based on trip advisor reviews and we weren't disappointed. It's some of the best food you will find in Malaysia! The beef Rendang (would love the recipe) was amazing, the best I've ever had, and the deep fried ice cream is a definite must try.The staff are very friendly and the service is quick, very good value for such great food.I would come back to Malaysia just for the food here!Show less

Author: KnimbrodBeijing, China
Title: Didn't live up to the hype
Review: After reading all of the reviews we expected outstanding food and prices. The food was good, don't get us wrong, but it wasn't better than everything else in the area. The prices are a little high for the area and the portions. We had the specials for the day, they were good, but small. It is good food but we wouldn't go back, would try other places on the strip.Show less

Author: 571stephenrLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Great place for lunch, dinner & drinks
Review: Fantastic food both at lunchtime and in the evening. The owners are really friendly and the food is great. They serve really ice cold beer, and make great ice cream floats for kids. We had fried rice and noodles everyday for lunch and came back for dinner in the evenings on some days, we would have come back everyday for dinner had we discovered it earlier!! My kids really enjoyed the ribs and the fried rice, my wife and I enjoyed the beef rendang and the nonya curries.
