The food is great value and really fresh, and the menu varied enough for everyone, there is also a hidden, but well supplied wine selection - definitely worth asking about! We found this by chance before we read reviews, and it doesn't disappoint!Show less

Author: AndyB-GC
Title: Must Go
Review:
Extremely tasty food.
Great service, well worth the visit.
Had the best Beef Rendang. 
We stayed at The Park Royal, this restraunt is only 150 metres from the hotel entry and very easy to find

Author: Alison01924Leeds, United Kingdom
Title: Great food but choose your time to carefully
Review: We had the best night of our holiday at this restaurant and bar and the food was to die for too. We decided to repeat the experience a few days later at an earlier time (7pm) and this was their busiest so service was not great. I ordered 2 dishes and only half my order arrived so that by the time the rest of it came, the first half was stone cold and had to go back. These things do happen but are much less likely to if you go later or before rush hour. Enjoy.Show less

Author: 906shellyjSydney, Australia
Title: Delicious food and great value
Review: This was by far my best meal in Batu Ferringhi over my 7 days here. I enjoyed the pineapple rice, satay chicken skewers and the spring rolls. All delicious. Very spicy and tasty satay sauce. Really flavoursome spring rolls with a nice thin and crispy wrapping. My partner had sweet n sour chicken. The batter was light. The vegetables were very fresh. Lovely sauces. He enjoyed the fried rice. Very generous servings. Great service too. Very friendly staff. We then tried the banana fritter and icecream. Yummy. I had an iced coffee for dessert as it is incredibly hot here today. Very good. I asked them to make it on mainly water with a dash of milk. Real espresso coffee in a tall glass with iced water and icecream and a little milk. Exactly how I asked them to make it for me. Highly recommend this cafe for lunch or dinner. May not look as pretty as others nearby with beautiful gardens and furniture, but the food is better in comparison. Nice peaceful ambiance. Shade available and fans. Total cost 74 RM with 2 soft drinks. Around AUD $25. Excellent value for 2 courses and drinks. Show less

Author: Rayleen H
Title: Terrible
Review: Loved the look of the this place but very disappointed with the portion size of the food. The pork ribs was a big disappointment and looked like beef ribs at first when it was brought to the table. We ordered sizzling chicken but there was no sizzle. Food is expensive not worth going to eat there. Show less

Author: ToshHuskySouthern Highlands, Australia
Title: Great restaurant
Review: Just returned from Penang and paid our annual visit to Living Room.As usual it was a wonderful experience. The food is always delicious and Amy and Ben, the owners are so friendly and welcoming.We had dinner on the Friday night and were entertained by Ben and some of his friends who have a band and were playing in the restaurant. Very good.All in all a great night.Show less

Author: Welshmole
Title: Great food, superb hosts.
Review: Visited first on the back of a TA review.Came for late dinner; beef rendang and nasi goreng - both fab.Staff really friendly though not intrusive. Gave us good advice on day trips etc. Finally, when we left mid lightening storm, the owners offered to call a cab and loaned us a brolly too. Much appreciated!Returned the following night.. To coincide with great music jam session. Again, super, well priced food and fantastic hosts.We will be back...Show less

Author: Brian Y
Title: Friendly restaurant.
Review: Ate at 4 different restaurants in the area and this restaurant is the best one. The owners are exceptionally welcoming without being intrusive. The food is very good and very reasonably priced. Service is fast and good and the owner plays some nice live background music whilst you enjoy your meal. Give it a go!Show less

Author: johnp37
Title: Great Authentic Food
Review: We ate here twice on our trip and the food was fantastic. Food was local authentic, my favourite the Beef Rendang was amazing. The service was great and very personal Amy the owner made all our party feel very welcome

Author: Whitbred
Title: Lovely Food and Service
Review: This is a lovely friendly café, the food is very good and freshly prepared.  The setting is lovely, almost cosy!  Prices are reasonable and the staff will explain any item on the menu and offer suggestions on what to try of you ask.  Lovely café!!!!

Author: WizzyDerbyshireDerbyshire, England
Title: Small, but perfectly formed.
Review: We visited this little restaurant twice recently - and we were not disappointed.The restaurant is tucked away between the Ferringhi Food Garden and Helenas. It is overseen by, presumably, the owner, who takes the time to speak to all of the diners.The menu offers a choice of Malaysian and Chinese food, with a nod to the 'Western' palate in the form of a few dishes of the more familiar.We tried various dishes (not Western) and were not disappointed at all. The food was served promptly, the portion sizes were good and our plates were consistently cleared.The bill, including starters and drinks for three of us, never exceeded 100 ringgits (about £20)Don't be deceived by the handwritten menu at the entrance, this a a lovely little restaurant and highly recommended.Show less

Author: Lyn LLara, Australia
Title: Great food and excellent value
Review: We have eaten here since it first opened and the food is getting better if that's possible .Excellent value for money sure you can eat at places nearby that a marginally cheaper but the quality isn't there .Amy & Ben strive for the bestHighly recommendShow less

Author: spiesw
Title: Most probably the best non-hotel restaurant
Review: Great food and great setting. Good location in the main strip. Clean and good service. Good wine list.

Author: David R
Title: Dinner
Review:
We visited this restaurant on 3 occasions during our recent stay in Penang.
The service was quick and attentive.
The owners Amy and Ben where very welcoming hosts.
The food sublime.
They can cater for small or large parties.

jUST GO!!!

Author: asw323Munich, Germany
Title: What a great surprise ...
Review: I took a little risk and booked the Living Room for a international group of 32 people without having eaten there before - just based on the good feedback in Tripadvisor. We loved it. Excellent local food combined with a super fast and very personal service - and very affordable as well. Thanks for hosting us, Amy. We will be back when in Penang next.Show less

Author: meatm8New Zealand
Title: Great Value
Review: We ate here from recommendations from friends but as it was a Wednesday night, and they were closed we ended up eating next door at Helena's which we preferred. The Living room was nice and great value for money and I would recommend this place to friends.Show less

Author: jeromeBali
Title: Average
Review:
Was very excited to go there after all the reviews. Food is not very good, not cheap and portions are small. 
If you have no choice go there but better to go somewhere else!
And also not to come to Penang.....

Author: Katerfitzroy
Title: I never write reviews
Review: This is one I can't let go silently. So delighted were we, to take what seemed a punt on a very authentic venue, starving at noon one day. We were impressed instantly! Amy and her staff were welcoming, efficient and so accommodating. Not only did we have lunch that day, we came back that evening for more, trying every dish on 'the must have' black board, and some twice. Delicious, affordable and such an experience. The owner Amy was recognised by majority of her customers, or like with us, welcoming to new friends dining for the first time. So fantastic! Highly recommend the Living Room, and on particular the beef rendang curry- the best we've ever eaten!!Show less

Author: Nathan WAlice Springs, Australia
Title: Ridiculously good food
Review: I don't tend to write many reviews but when something special comes along I feel obliged to help contribute to their success. The food here is truly unbelievable, some of the tastiest curries I have eaten. The ribs from the specials board were extremely nice also.The staff are extremely attentive and friendly. I can't recommend this place enough.Show less

Author: GerrybenneyBrisbane, Australia
Title: hendrix h do not agree
Review: We have eaten here for last 4 years and have just eaten there tonight, had a fantastic meal of sweet and sour prawns with fried rice my husband had a calamari meal both were excellent in 4 years have never had a bad meal in this restaurant,we have travelled extensivelyShow less

Author: JuliemaryInvercargill
Title: Excellent Food
Review: We found Living Room while looking for somewhere to have breakfast. The food was so goodwe broke our rule of only eating once at a restaurant and went back for dinner. Amy was so helpful in guiding us to a selection of local dishes. The place a very busy but she made time for us. The food was great, lovely and fresh and so so tasty. Thanks Amy and Ben, keep up the good work and the smiles, especially the smiles because they were pretty hard to come by in some places.Show less

Author: Hazel H
Title: Wonderful food
Review: Lovely atmosphere and novelty tables with sewing machine foot wells.  The staff were so friendly and attentive and stopped for little chats in between serving with genuine interest in their customers. The sizzling beef/chicken was just soooo good!

Author: BackToMelbourne
Title: Ate here twice. It's a lovely little place.
Review: We ate here a couple nights. The menu is quite limited but the service and quality of food is great. I highly recommend it.

Author: GingerRufus
Title: Brilliant!
Review: Discovered this little gem by accident, but what fantastic food. Small, friendly with excellent service, and food which is freshly cooked and absolutely delicious. Sizzlers sizzle better than I have heard elsewhere. Excellent prices too. Would recommend to all.

Author: Dunfunny
Title: Lovely place
Review: Lovely place great food giving excellent value for money...The lady that runs the place is really welcoming and friendly and has some of her beautiful art work on display ... well worth a visit. ..

Author: Hendrix H
Title: Shop bought deep frozen rubbish.
Review: 2 curries both off the specials board. The prawn curry was mostly prawn heads. I had a very dry and re heated pork chop under the description of Bar b qued Ribs. There was easily more bone than anyhing I could eat, coated in a dark sticky sugary goo, accompanied by packet frozen chips.Kids had salt and pepper squid. Again deep frozen packet rubbish, all the same size and shape and 5 pieces each! Disgraceful. The priced were very high for such runbbish,the service dis interested. Avoid!Better food? Andrews Kampung restaurant opposite Golden Sands on second floor above CIMB bank. 27 RM all you can eat, FRESH cooked.Show less

Author: ZimKiwiTravellerPerth, Australia
Title: Cafe with character
Review: We ate breakfast here twice while staying in Batu Ferringhi recently. We had the usual bacon and eggs with toast, jam and butter. We didn't think much of the quality of the meal and presentation was distinctly lacking (pretty much two eggs and a piece of bacon slapped on the plate, garnished with toast) but we were won over by the awesome atmosphere of the place and the friendliness of the owner and his wife who seem super-chilled and interesting. Based on previous reviews, perhaps we should have had dinner here instead!Show less

Author: Dawn046Wolverhampton, United Kingdom
Title: Our favourite eating place in Penang
Review: We had read about Living Room in the Lonely Planet guide and it didn't let us down. The lady who owns the bar/restaurant is lovely and welcoming. We ate here four times. It has a really nice feel to the place. Food is excellent and so cheap. Would definitely recommend it!Show less

Author: Olivia WSt. Albans, United Kingdom
Title: Best meal of the holiday
Review: If you're travelling to the Batu Ferringhi, you don't want to miss visiting this restaurant! The atmosphere is great and the staff are extremely friendly and helpful. I would particularly recommend the beef kapitan and the sizzling beef/chicken dishes. Much like everywhere in Malaysia, the food is also fantastic value. We visited the restaurant twice for dinner and on both occasions noticed it fills up very quickly due to its popularity. Consequently, I would recommend arriving reasonably early in the evening to avoid the disappointment of being sent away!Show less

Author: chimaerad
Title: Best curry on the island
Review:
Great food, good atmosphere and great and friendly chef and host.
The food is out of this world, we returned twice.
Thanks!

Author: Sammy6dSydney, Australia
Title: Delicious and delightful
Review: This is a great little food find in Batu Ferrenghi. Down the road from the Park Royal Resort. The food is absolutely delicious. Definitely try the Kapitan curry, it's a Penang curry. Real funky feel, retro and recycled furniture, the tables are old sewing tables. There was a little band playing cool acoustic music, a girl who sounded like Nora Jones. Great service, they even made our curry not too spicy and checked if it was ok. Definitely worth a visit for some authentic Malay food and really cheap. Show less

Author: john w
Title: Best food on the strip
Review:
Returned here twice for the sizzling beef and garlic greens with steamed rice. The best sizzling beef we've ever had anywhere.
Small restaurant but well patronised, next door was empty and we waited for a seat so that tells you a story.

Author: cb466Perth
Title: Lovely little restaurant
Review: After reading reviews on Tripadvisor we decided to try this restaurant on a recent visit to Penang. We turned up on a Wednesday but unfortunately they are closed on a Wednesday. Luckily we managed to return a few nights later, within a couple of minutes we were entertained by a procession of monkeys walking along the wires across the road. We all thoroughly everything that was ordered from lemon chicken to beef randang and much more. The food was tasty & reasonably priced, the beers lovely & cold. The staff were excellent, very attentive & friendly. The thing I liked most though was the charm of the place, lots of art work & nick nacks about the place giving it a relaxing atmosphere.Show less

Author: jogPerthPerth, Australia
Title: Best food of our trip
Review: I really liked the feel of this place, but it was their food that was just outstanding. We had dinner here on our first night and our last night in Penang and everything we tried was wonderfully fresh and so delicious. Their vegie Curry Kapitan was amazing.Show less

Author: Alissa DChicago, Illinois
Title: Pleasant and Inexpensive
Review: This restaurant is conveniently located just at the end of the night market. The seating is all outdoors, the Malaysian menu is cheap enough ($2 beers, $5 wine, $3-$7 entrees), the service is great (and the servers have great English), and the food is tasty. If you're looking for a relaxed meal outdoors, you've found the right place.Show less

Author: Megh17
Title: recommended
Review:
We have eaten here on our visits each year for past three years  The food is reliably excellent,the service friendly and efficient,the prices reasonable
Try the nonya fish curry  Outstanding

Author: RockerstellaPerth, Australia
Title: Large menu
Review: Went for lunch I ate Malaysian breakfast noodle, husband ate salt n pepper squid, both quite nice although we thought the squid wasn't particularly good value smallish portion with quite a high price(mr20) it was served in a martini glass with the bottom of it filled with lettuce and a portion of rice however in saying that it's not like he left still hungry and it did taste good.Show less

Author: Kate2112
Title: Lunch
Review:
We arrived just in time 2.45pm - the next people who arrived were turned away.
We had beef rending - delicious and a curry also good. If you like a little ambience and a friendly patron this works.

Author: nelboy
Title: The friendliest restaurant in Batu Feringhi
Review: Excellent breakfasts and the best hosts you will find in Penang let alone Batu. Go there you will enjoy the experience.

Author: Rebecca S
Title: Cheap and cheerful
Review: This is a five minute walk from parkroyal hotel. Tasty food with only a small amount to chose from. Owners very friendly with food fresh and fast.

Author: LorraineAdelaide
Title: So Welcoming!
Review: Great restaurant, wonderful hosts. Returning to Penang, necessitates a number of visits to The Living Room. Amy and Ben are such amazing hosts and the food top notch. Not to be missed.

Author: Salpal1970Brisbane, Australia
Title: Disappointing
Review: After all the rave reviews on this eatery we left very disappointed. The owners are trading big time on trip advisor reviews and have even had signs made to reflect this. Whilst the food was ok for a western palate, it certainly lacked the usual Malay flavours.Good for kids with fussy appetites but for better value and flavour it's back to Long Beach hawker centre.Show less

Author: bobkapChicago, Illinois
Title: Good food and friendly owner
Review: My wife and I visited living room on our first day in Batu Ferringhi. We are staying just down the street at the ParkRoyal and had arrived from the airport around 2:00 in the afternoon. After checking in and putting our clothes away we dropped by the Living Room for a late lunch. It was pretty quiet (only one other table was busy, but it was late). We had a beef rendang and a chicken curry both of which were very nice. My wife particularly liked the beef. The owner was serving us and asked us how we liked the food and if it was too spicy. We let her know it was very good (and not too spicy for us as we like spicy food). She mentioned that she had recently had a trip advisor review that said it was too spicy. We told her it was good for us and could even have been a little spicier. "Too spicy" depends on the person so it is always going to be tough, but for us the food was great. The service was nice, the discussion with the owner was pleasant. We will definitely return when we come back to Penang.Show less

Author: divergenttravelersSuperior, Wisconsin
Title: Friendly Staff and Good Food
Review: During our 11 days in Ferringhi we ate lunch at this cafe 9 times. The food is good and the service fast. Prices are good and the banana juice is to die for. Amy, the owner, is so friendly and welcoming. Be sure to make a stop here while in Ferringhi!Show less

Author: meljabu
Title: not as great as we expected, but ok
Review: nice milkshakes and ice chocolate. chicken & cashew nut was yummy, green chicken curry had gristle on the chicken. casual service (forgot the entrée of wontons), relaxed living room setting

Author: aandlkchKuching, Malaysia
Title: Good place for coffee
Review: As it was Ramadan, many places in Batu Ferringhi were closed at the middle of the day, and yes, everywhere looked rather gloomy. We were very pleased to find that Living Room was open, and we were able to sit there and relax whilst having a coffee, a juice, and a bacon sandwich. All of these were good, and in fact the coffee was the best I had in my 6 night stay in Penang. We also had an interesting chat with the friendly owner, and we enjoyed listening to her husband quietly playing the guitar in the background.Show less

Author: Frances M
Title: Small Living Room
Review: This restaurant was raved about by friends but we found it disappointing. Quite a small menu and curry so hot we had to choose and pay for something else.

Author: clare pWellington, New Zealand
Title: The best place we have eaten in Malaysia
Review: We spent 10 days in batu ferrenghi and we're so pleased to have discovered the living room. The food here is the best we have eaten so far since being on the road since April. We tried a lot of different things on the menu (lunches and dinner) and everything was delicious, the beef rendang was amazing and the sizzling dishes are fantastic, everthing here is prepared fresh. A few times our children asked for something that was not on the menu and it was made for them without a second thought. I would recommend the living room to everyone. Friendly hosts, nice setting, great food, great value and clean toilets, what more could you want?!Show less

Author: SingaSomers
Title: Awesome beef rendang
Review:
My family had lunch here. The beer is cold and the food is excellent. The service was very friendly and accommodating. 

I would definitely eat here again - beef rending is a winner.

Author: gracieharrizleBrisbane, Australia
Title: Reasonable Quality and Cheap Food
Review: Went to the living room on our first night in Batu Ferringhi. The salt and pepper squid was delicious and tender. The Beef Rendeng had good flavour but the beef was well over stewed. I ordered a vegetarian curry (wanted a safe option as we didn't want to get sick on our first night) and it was delicious! Very good value for money. Waiters were ok a little bit pushy with getting your orders. We went back for the lunch another day of the trip. Good place to go if you don't want to be overly adventurous with the local hawker food.Show less

Author: Sallie FMelbourne
Title: Reasonably cheap food
Review: We ate at Living Room Cafe after seeing good reviews on TA.We ordered Beef Rendang and Penang chicken with fried Rice.The chicken and rice dish was above average but we were not happy with the Rendang as the meat was not tender like we'd expected, the flavour was good but the type of meat used was not the correct cut of meat.Show less

Author: jellyjack75
Title: Cheap, cheerful and super tasty food
Review: The food was delicious with good variety!  The staff were attentive and friendly.  The bill was cheap!  We were so pleased to find this place and would highly recommend.

Author: JoelikestotravelUK
Title: Great authentic food
Review: Great food at a reasonable price. Also a lovely host who took time to speak to us discussing local attractions and cuisine - making recommendations on the menu

Author: thomashulme
Title: Excellent food, excellent price & super service
Review: Very convenient for people staying in ParkRoyal. Great Malay food with local service with a smile. Superb value for money and the beer jackets they put on bottles are a nice touch!

Author: loubie_loo78
Title: Friendly and traditional
Review: Wonderful little restaurant for very good quality and traditional regional food. The Thai fish and beef rending were beautifully cooked and very tasty, as was the rojak (deep fried ice cream) we had for dessert. Well worth a visit as the staff are very warm and friendly and give you lots of advice and suggestions on what to order Show less

Author: 218Mark7225
Title: Superb food
Review:
We loved the Living 
room - lady was genuinely lovely and natural

Thai fish was one of the best meals we had in Penang and Langkawi

Definitely recommend this low key restaurant
Visited twice

Author: kes100
Title: Great find
Review: The food was always excellent with a great choice. The staff were always so friendly and always made you feel welcome.

Author: Tzeni660Richmond, Australia
Title: Great Value
Review: We had a great meal here recently. There were 4 of us and all the meals were terrific. I like the concept of the restaurant. They don't have an extensive menu but all the dishes are interesting. The people who run the place a very helpful and friendly. You need to book a table as its gets very busy.Show less

Author: JamesF71Brisbane, Australia
Title: Malaysia Beach Holiday
Review: Fantastic small local resturant.We stumbled across this place on our first night. Amy, Ben and the staff are very friendly and welcoming and make you feel like family friends coming for dinner. The tables are old singer sewing machines which adds to the vibe of the place.The service was quick, the food amazing and the beers/drinks always cold.We ended up eating here 3 times during our week long stay!Excellent value for money!Show less

Author: Coldev
Title: Very friendly
Review: We use this restaurant 3 time out of our six nights it was nice food and nice staff and reasonable price even the rain couldn't put us off.

Author: openlancelot
Title: great food, good prices
Review: Tried this cafe after reading good review on Trip Advisor. Ordered the Squid Thai Style, Kang Kong, Satay, and Banana and Ice Cream. Great tasting food, I should say. Plus the owner, Amy, was very friendly and accommodating. Would visit again!

Author: robertosweddingessex
Title: Great service fab food
Review: This was often difficult to get a table as it was so popluar but we did manage to get in twice during our stay. Great choice of food best beef rendang ive ever had amazing ! it was nice to have the choice of a decent glass of wine at a reasonable price, they staff even remember what we had ordered on our previous visit , well done great place Show less

Author: Ezby83Canberra, Australia
Title: Delicious food and great service
Review: My husband and I had a lovely dinner and this cute restaurant while we were in Batu Ferrighi. Unfortunately we only found it on our last night, otherwise we probably would have gone back!The menu had western and Asian options, we ordered a few of the Asian dishes. The nonya chicken curry was delicious! The salt and pepper squid was the only slight let down, it seemed to be the frozen bits of squid that would be served at an RSL club at home in Australia. But was cooked well and tasty enough.Show less

Author: Kathryn GEast Riding of Yorkshire, United Kingdom
Title: Best food and atmosphere in the area...oh and don't forget the "jamming" on a Friday
Review: Thankfully we found this little gem on our first day and in our 2 weeks stay we have been back every alternate night, as we cannot fault the food and the lovely hospitality. Ben and Amy make this a very welcoming venue. They and their staff work so hard to ensure everyone gets first class service and food at amazingly low prices.The "jamming sessions" have been lots of fun and we cannot praise this lovely place enough.Well recommend this fabulous bar/restaurant. Many many thanks to Ben, Amy and staff for making our holiday to Penang. Ps in addition to local food they make excellent bacon butties!!!Show less

Author: rachegoManchester, United Kingdom
Title: Lovely food and great atmosphere
Review: We were recommended this restaurant by some friends we had met at hotel, we liked it that much we went back the following night, had squid starter and prawn curry and chicken both excellent, Friday night they had singer on very busy but good. Dont forget to tip as its one of the few restaurants that does not have a service charge. Best restaurant. Show less

Author: ShetlandGirlScotland, United Kingdom
Title: Best Food We Had In Batu Ferringhi
Review: We ate here on 3 nights during a recent 10 night stay in Batu Ferringhi. We loved the food, particularly the satay and samosa starters and sizzling main courses. Great service and amazingly cheap for the quality of the food (our typical bill was around 75 ringgits for 2 starters, 2 main courses, beer & water). We chose this restaurant to eat at on the last night of our holiday and it was an easy choice. Highly recommended.Show less

Author: SchmynBrisbane
Title: Best restaurant ever
Review: Went to penang on a holiday. After eating at one of the recommended hawker markets and getting sick- we stumbled on this place and ended up eating there every night- and some lunches. Prices are slightly higher then hawker markets but then so is the quality of food. Dish size is just right. Food delicious. But most of all the hosts really make u feel welcome. We left penang feeling as if we had made a new friend. Our kids loved this places claiming if was the best restaurant ever. My daughter already misses the satay sticks. A must try in penangShow less

Author: Bexat4Manchester, United Kingdom
Title: well worth a visit.
Review: At the south end of the 'strip' and after many self promises over the years we called in and can only say that all the positive reviews do not let this place down. Very good quality food at competitive prices with very friendly , helpful staff. Try it, you won't be disappointed.Show less

Author: sunlover191282
Title: Always a warm welcome at the Living Room.
Review: Amy and Ben are such good hosts its not like going for a meal its like spending the evening in their home.The food is great and good value for money.The Living Room is a place not to miss.Friday and Saturday great for music lovers.

Author: StevenW191Jakarta, Indonesia
Title: Great place, great people, and fantastic atmosphere
Review: Amy and Ben run a fantastic little restaurant along the main road of Batu Ferringhi, the atmosphere is relaxed, food is fresh and great (and large sizes), and there is plenty of area in an unique little cafe/restaurant.Spend some time to get to know the local crowd, as there is a complex mix of local and retired expats who are enjoying their relaxeation and the space provided.Get there on a Friday evening and the "local band" will entertain you with their jam session, playing and singing their renditions of all our favourites, but in their own style. Or enjoy brunch and a coffee while allowing the day to roll by...Show less

Author: 46neilc
Title: A Nice Little Restaurant on the main strip.
Review: We chose this little restaurant by chance and it was ok.  We have had better food, the price is good and the service and surroundings excellent, not the best food we have ever had, but certainly not the worst, worth a try.

Author: DaudRayPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Great place to eat on the main street in Batu Feringghi
Review: Amy & her husband do a great job preparing quality meals at a good price. This is the kind of place you'll enjoy coming to again & again--which is why it sometimes becomes a bit crowded at night. Go on Friday night & you'll likely enjoy live music.Show less

Author: Davidbruno882Singapore, Singapore
Title: Accidental find
Review: While out running errands on my bike on a hot day, i was looking for a place to stop and cool off with a nice cold beer. While most places were closed, I was mostly forced into the living room due to not many choices at this time of day. I have to say I was pleasantly surprised with the environment of the restaurant and the staff and ended up staying for more than one cold beer. While cooling off and taking in the decor of the living room I looked at the food menu and determined this would be a great place to bring my wife back that night for dinner and drinks. After a site seeing trip late that day we stopped at the living room for what we thought would be a quick bite and back to the hotel, but the environment and owners Amy and Ben made us feel so comfortable we remained for more drinks absorbing the decor and local staff. Other than the great food and the pleasant people I do have to say it was one of the cleanest kitchens and facilities I have ever found in a locally owned small restaurant. Highly recommended if you are out looking for local and western food with a local culture. Thanks again Amy and BenShow less

Author: colinspain
Title: Good food for all
Review: Enjoyed the food - didn't leave anything on the plate. The staff were efficient and food arrived quickly, however, they need a uniform to improve the 'look' of that efficiency.

Author: 193sandymWestern Australia, Australia
Title: Friendly
Review: My husband I visited this cafe on 2 occasions, a lunch and dinner, staff were very friendly and helped us to choose from the menu, for lunch i had western food of spaghetti bolognese and hubby had fish and chips, then dinner we had spring rolls, beef randang with boiled rice and a seafood dish.Show less

Author: Tony BStoke-on-Trent, United Kingdom
Title: Food to travel 7,000 miles for!
Review: Read about the Living Room on Trip Advisor.4 of us on holiday in Singapore and Penang, and came here on 2nd night of stay in Penang, and intend to return on other 4 nights of our stay.Food, setting, friendliness of owners and other customers, all result in truly memorable dining experience.Cannot recommend the place enough!Show less

Author: elsiekLondon
Title: Average
Review: Despite the reviews our experience was not the best. The food was moderate. Started with spring rolls and satays which were ordinary - have easily had better elsewhere. The sizzling chicken was fresh and tasty but the spare ribs were almost inedible. The fried ice cream dessert kinda worked. But what was most irritating was the speed at which everything was served. Seemed we no sooner had we finished one course then the next plate was arriving. Have never been pushed to eat a meal so fast but perhaps this was caused by the line of customers waiting for our table. Oh - and this was the first restaurant in Batu Ferringhi to charge us corkageShow less

Author: pumpkin69
Title: Mouth watering
Review: Fantastic food and very, friendly attentive staff. Came back three times during our stay.  Great value, meals were delicious.  Fab place to try the local dish beef rendang. Chicken satays also heavenly.  Get in between 6.30-7pm to avoid the rush.  Thanks Amy!

Author: Brenda WCramlington, United Kingdom
Title: Living Room Restaurant, Batu Ferringhi
Review: Not to be missed!!!! While in Batu Ferringhi we had a number of meals here. We noticed it was full when we passed on our first night, so made a mental note to re-visit the next night. We were made so welcome by the hosts, Ben and Amy and the two delightful waitresses. Nothing was too much trouble, the food was excellent and good value. Also enjoyable live music Saturday nights. Well-deserved Trip Advisor Award.Show less

Author: JonK1
Title: Friendly and feels like you are a local
Review: This place is great went there based on other TA reviews. Very nice staff which make you feel like you are a regular! Portion size is large and price is very reasonable.If its your first night in Batu Ferrenghi then go there you won't regret it, it allows you to sample all the night market before having some good nosh!NOTE: Closed on WednesdaysShow less

Author: KeithW2009
Title: the living room
Review: i found it to sell nice food at a decent price,a lot cheaper beer than bora bora's happy hour & no tax on top of it,the staff are very friendly

Author: KerryScouseKellySydney, Australia
Title: Charming and homely
Review: Lovely friendly and welcoming staff who are happy to talk through menu options. Excellent value food in a very low key relaxed surroundings. We stayed at our table having drinks for a good while after we finished our food and felt no pressure to move on before we were ready.Show less

Author: Csinti
Title: Excellent dishes
Review: My husband and me were in this small restaurant twice! It was good choise, fantastic food, reasonable price and friendly staff! Go there and try it!

Author: MalrevHook, United Kingdom
Title: Local quality!
Review: Visited on recommendation of a friend and wasn't disappointed. Owner helped me through the menu and chose well! The Beef Rendang was excellent and the deep fried ice cream a must! Atmosphere is great and, although small, the general ambience and quality of the food is excellent. Overall great value and well worth a visit.Show less

Author: crinkly52North Yorkshire
Title: Great eating and meeting place
Review: Have been coming to the Living Room since it opened and it is still a great place for food and the owners Ben and Amy are great hosts. My husband uses a wheel chair and we have no problems getting in and out as Ben is always ready to lend a hand. The food is good mix of Western and Local dishes. All reasonably priced and well cooked. A must place to try when inBatu Ferringhi.Show less

Author: vivienAberdeen
Title: Excellent food
Review: This was a great little restaurant , staff very good & friendly , good sized meals & plenty choice , went back 3times and never disappointed & price was great to would definietly recommend to others

Author: mezzonholsMelbourne
Title: Quality food, very good prices
Review: Our family of 4 ate here 3 adults 1 teenager. We ordered beer, soft drink and milkshakes (which were enormous). My daughter is a fried rice expert and gave it the thumbs up. We ordered to share chicken satays, spring rolls, salt & pepper squid and chicken with cashews which came with white rice. Everything was cooked fresh and was really delicious. Bill came to $104 RM (approx $35 au dollars). Highly recommend.Show less

Author: ClarandaYork, United Kingdom
Title: Ordinary
Review: Although the welcome was warm, we found the food to be unexceptional and the location rather depressing, with an outlook onto the police station. Badly presented starters - one on a chipped plate - were succeeded by average mains. We did not return as we found better restaurants without difficultyShow less

Author: drawbridgeeChelmsford, United Kingdom
Title: Great food at a great price !
Review: Having read the reviews for this restuarant , we stood outside in confusion that this small unassuming little cafe could produce the food quality that the reviews were holding in high esteem.. We looked at the menu outside on the street and the one thing that really caught our eye was how cheap it was compared to surrounding restuarants, my partner had Malaysian rice with chicken at a cost of just over £1, I had beef rending a Malaysian speciality and that came in at under £4 and drinks were a good price too!Great atmosphere due to the popularity of this small cafe with good quality toilets abiet that you go through the kitchens to get to them! Will definately return and recommend you do the same.Bravo living room ! Ps no sales tax or service charge !Show less

Author: worldtravellerproLondon
Title: A must restaurant to visit
Review: Simply the best place to eat in Batu Ferringhi, we did five times. Wonderful atmosphere created by a great couple running the place. We chose different food each visit and it was all top notch cooked with fresh ingredients, so try anything on the menu. Perhaps the star by a small margin was the pineapple fried rice.Show less

Author: Ger_hall
Title: Just eat here
Review: the food in this place was simply amazing.. the sizzling chicken is to die for.. just go there you have to.. so cheap and very friendly

Author: goodoldowlBatu Ferringhi, Malaysia
Title: Good food, reasonable price
Review: This restaurant is in a row restaurants, beginning with Guan Guan, running past the mosque, and ending with The Boatsman next to the new condo construction. It is well worth eating here. Chicken curry was good, and the staff was friendly. Not substantially different in quality from the surrounding restaurants, which means they are all worth a visit.Show less

Author: 4thtime
Title: Fantastic couple run restaurant
Review:
Food is fresh, local and tasty. Curries are all made by owner so authentic flavour allows for impressive dishes.
Great to experience local food at ridiculously cheap prices. Allow $10 -15 a head for a fabulous meal.

Author: BigHeadVirusFrankfurt, Germany
Title: Nice chill-out cafe
Review: A nice little shop that serves good food, and live band too. Recommending their bbq pork ribs, and beef rendang. It is nothing WOW-able, but definitely the comfort of having homemade meal.Everyone there is just enjoying the time over a glass of beer or a bottle of wine, live music, and good food!Show less

Author: Jo FSydney, Australia
Title: A Little Gem
Review: We arrived in our hotel and were looking for a place to have a quick bite for lunch. This was recommended by people who were in our hotel foyer and were about to leave. Thoroughly enjoyed our quick bite to eat. The only thing I would say is that the serving sizes were a bit small but the flavours and service were very good. Would go again in a heart beat.Show less

Author: RobtaneStockholm, Sweden
Title: Really busy night and great menu
Review: As this was a really busy night the waiting staff were a bit run off their feet. However the menu was mealy good and once again our kids (7 and 10) were happy. My son loves good fries and burgers. Their burger was excellent - thick and tasty. The fries were tasty - so very happy boy. There was so much to choose from and all our meals were good. The ice cream for desert was also a hit.This restaurant definitely deserves the ratings it gets.Show less

Author: PaulQuinn51
Title: Paul Q
Review: Attended restaurant 02/01/2014 .The hosts are lovely an the food is excellent. Beef radang is a wonderful meal as is thai  style fish .A place definately not to miss on your journey.

Author: Neil R
Title: Excellent food, excellent value.
Review: We ate here twice during a long weekend stay at the Park Royal Hotel alongside. Grandparents, parents and a 3 and 4 years old. Good choice of food for everyone, well cooked, excellent service, great prices.  Our best meals in that area.

Author: GrowlerGirl
Title: Superb
Review: Great food and service - it actually arrives hot which we have found a problem in Penang, and you get what you ordered too! Red chicken curry is out of this world. Quirky surroundings and a fun place to hang out

Author: Dkkeeling
Title: Excellent
Review:
Excellent service and good quality local foods. Freshly cooked and good attention from the staff and working owners.
Recommend to everyone.
We ate 2/3 times. 
Limit choice for real foodies but don't worry.
Quality dishes not quantity.
Great price.

Author: Pauline182Perth
Title: Busy and lively
Review: We ate there after a couple of days in Penang after we had eaten at Long Island and another restaurant. Atmosphere great, as was the food, wine and service. The portions were a little on the smaller side, compared to the previous nights at Long Island. The salt and pepper squid was yummy, the sizzling beef portion and stir fry vegetables were tasty but the serves small. Would we rush back, probably not.Show less

Author: tcollins321
Title: Nice place- servings a little small
Review:
Great place with selection of Chinese and Western dishes. 

Nice relaxed atmosphere. 

Dishes were on the smaller side considering the price, and it is very similar to other hawker food up the road. 

Definitely with a visit to relax and enjoy the food.

Author: GKfromTO
Title: Solid Malaysian Food
Review: Came here with a group of six. Great spot. Was very busy and lively.  Reasonable prices. Great prawn dishes. Great local cuisine. All were quite happy.

Author: Sarah KToronto, Canada
Title: a delicious introduction to penang cuisine
Review: We ate here on our first night in penang and it set the bar pretty high for the rest of the trip. A few of us suffering from a cold tried the vegetable soup which was so flavourful and really hit the spot. The rest of the dishes followed suit - koay teow and nasi goreng are a must try!! We also had satay and stir fried vegetables which were great. The free wifi was an added bonus. Highly recommended.Show less

Author: chungbpeng
Title: Good food and service
Review: Serve a good range of local and western style cooking. Good portion. Fantastic service and PR from the husband and wife owner. Have gone to this cafe bar many times for lunch and dinners.

Author: RB777Carmarthen, United Kingdom
Title: Spicy food, salty more like it.
Review: Second visit this week. First was ok. Second very disappointing. Had the squid Thai red curry. Warned it would be spicy. Like Tom Yam I asked? No more spicy! In reality all I could taste was an overdose of salt, couldn't taste anything else because it was overpowering. Saw some kaffia lime leaves, not a chili in sight or to be tasted. Sizzling chicken was equally disappointing. This time no salt but too sweet. Complained about the squid, but no comment from the chef or owner!Show less

Author: JULIE_ADRIANNORWICH
Title: VFM
Review: Visited several times whilst in Penang. Yes the food is slightly more expensive than hawkers but the main dishes we had we appx £4.50 to around £5. Yes if you have wine this pumps the bill up but wine is expensive in all restaurants in Malaysia. I had sizzling prawns or the Thai style fish. Other half sizzling prawns or the Kapitans curry. Both of which were very tasty.In total went there 4 times (2 of which I went on my own as partner had gone home and did not feel uncomfy). Every meal was real tasty.Fridays they have live music - jam session. Which is very popular.On the times we visited they were busy and there were certainly no complaints from the other diners.Place is run by a lovely couple Ben & Amy. They are there 6 days a week, 52 weeks of the year. They both work very hard.Looking forward to our next visit in March 2014Show less

Author: 2018RBVancouver, Canada
Title: Great Food
Review: Went for lunch - had chicken satay (6 pieces - 8.50RM), springrolls (10RM), Beef Renang (22RM), chicken cashew (22RM), bananna milkshake (10RM). Food was great. Prices are definately higher than the hawker stalls. We loved the hawker stalls for the variety and reasonable prices. Service was ok - nothing compared to thailand service.Show less

Author: YesminMLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Relaxed
Review: Went there for breakfast- they serve a mean omelette. If it's not listed, you can request your preference.The fresh coffee and freshly squeezed juice was excellent too hence we stayed and had several. This rolled into luchtime so we ended up having luch there. The menu had an excellent variety from Western to local dishes so I opted for a local dish with rice. I was asked the level of spiciness I wanted the dish so it was adjusted to my request.This is a very relaxed place to pass time and see the world go by. The proprietors are very welcoming and friendly and the kitchen was spotless hen I walked through it to go to the back to use the bathroom, which was also very clean.Show less

Author: Gunner47Beaconsfield
Title: Went here
Review: Three times twice the food was great third time was disappointing but this was probably just the choice of dish, friendly staff and a nice atmosphere.

Author: KrisSurreySurrey
Title: Classic local dining
Review: We ate here three times as we found the food to be excellent, we didn't interract with the owners, but found the service friendly and efficient. The Beef Rendang is particularly good. It was busy every time we went and food always arrived within 10 minutes of ordering, hot, fresh and tasty. The seating / tables are basic, but there is a warm / busy atmosphere - coupled with great tasting food. Recommended. Show less

Author: sistersouthwestsouthwest
Title: Amazing food great company
Review: This is my third year if going to this amazing place. Stay with a friend in batu every November and she always takes us to the living room. The food is fantastic, very affordable and Amy and Ben, the locals that own it are the nicest people you could come across.  We have had many lunches and dinners here and the food has always been fantastic and they have a great range if wines and cold cold beers. Give them a visit you will not be disappointedShow less

Author: Scott WLeicester, United Kingdom
Title: One of our best meals in Malaysia
Review: My wife and I recently completed a road trip of Malaysia with three nights at the Lone Pine Hotel (I'll review separately, but a great place to stay) in Batu Ferringhi. The evenings were wet and so we didn't want to stray too far from the hotel for our evening meals. Having eaten well at the hawker court next door to the hotel for two nights running we decided we'd like to try somewhere different for our last night on Penang island and, indeed, in Malaysia. We found the Living Room on Tripadvisor and have to say it certainly lived up to the great reviews on here. It's a relatively small place with seating for maybe 30 people at the front and a bar at the rear. The sewing machine bases used as tables and decor all add to a quirky charm that instantly made the restaurant warm and inviting. A number of people on here have commented on the hosts and I have to confess that we didn't really interact with them much at all. We simply enjoyed a truly delicious meal that proved to be one of the culinary high spots of our trip. Based on recommendations on here, we went with the beef rendang and capitan chicken, plus a special that I can't remember the name of but that comprised prawn balls in a crispy batter with a hot and sweet sticky sauce. Fantastic. If you are in Batu Ferringhi and like great Malaysian food at ridiculously low prices, the Living Room is a must!Show less

Author: Janelle_9Brisbane Australia
Title: Another great find
Review: Tried this restaurant after reviews on Tripadvisor. I have stayed in Batu Ferringhi many times and have never been here. We stayed at Park Royal ,just turn right when you walk out of the foyer .It is only a short walk.Great service and great food .Will definetly be abck next time we in Batu Ferringhi.Show less

Author: tony k
Title: charming cafe bar which is very relaxed and inviting
Review: We only found this place on our last two days in penang and very glad we did. With the sewing machine bases for tables and lots of art and photos around the place it has character and charm. Would be just as good to drop in for a drink or two as a meal. Amy is very good host and anni did a good job of waiting on our table. The food is very moderately priced, completely fresh and delicious. Was difficult to chose from the menu but we went for through red curry prawns and nonya kapitan chicken one day and the Thai chicken salad and beef rending the next. Could nearly run out of superlatives to describe the tasty food and the beef rending was something else, in class of its own!!!!!! Can't wait to get back next year!!!!!!!!!!!!Show less

Author: Flora949Leeds, United Kingdom
Title: Fun and Friendly
Review: We ate at The Living Room a few times during our recent stay with friends in Batu Ferringhi. The food, especially beef rendang, was delicious, and the service very friendly. Amy made us very welcome and the informal music sessions were entertaining with host Ben's singing and playing a highlight. But if like us, you're looking for something to eat on a Wednesday lunchtime when Amy closes, then try the Coffee Garden next door - we had delicious soup and the "scrumptious wrap" really lives up to its name. Great coffee too.Show less

Author: stevenlwk
Title: Food was good, only if you can put up with the bad service.
Review: I was there because of the earlier reviews. Host wasn't attentive and it wasn't a busy time.Definitely won't visit again.

Author: jbmb1982Melbourne, Australia
Title: True Oasis in Batu Ferringgi
Review: Terrific little cafe,bar near Park Royal hotel. Not only is the food excellent but the host, Amy and her waitress, Anni make the whole experience worth visiting many times.We were staying at Golden Sands which is about a 10 minute walk from the cafe.We asked Amy what she though we should try. She recommended the Beef Rendang. Amy told us how it takes 4 hours from start to finish to make her rendang. I cannot express the words as to how delicious it is. We favoured her malay dishes predominantly ,but also do yourself a flavour and try her Ribs. Not traditional but nonetheless ,wonderful. Pricing of all meals is cheap but not stingy on serves . .Drinks are well priced.You may be treated to live music some nights which is more of a jam session with local talent. You will get warm and friendly service, a meal to remember and a feeling of being somewhere familiar. I can guarantee you will go there more than once .We will miss and have fond memories of Amy,Anni and her wonderful cafeShow less

Author: eternalnomaddBarcelona, Spain
Title: Decidingly Average
Review: Followed tripadvisor reviews and visited this place but was very disappointed. We found the food to be over-seasoned, oily and unbalanced. If this is one of the best Penang has to offer I would be very surprised. I've traveled all throughout SE asia and this was a very average dining experience. Nothing special here and very uncomfortable seating. We could tell that ingredients were not the best quality.It was also expensive for what is was. We enjoyed a much better meal and nicer ambiance next door at Ferringhi garden for the same price.Show less

Author: sandrabayfieldManchester, United Kingdom
Title: Best food in Penang
Review: The living room serves the best food in Penang we went through all the menu and enjoyed everything we ate and ben and Amy are the most friendliest people you could ever meet this was our second time in Penang and we enjoyed as good as the first time Friday night they have jamming night which is great entertainment ben sings and has very good voice we will be going back all customers which are locals was very nice and friendly we met lovely lady called sue from Liverpool whose husband plays guitar on the jamming night . Can't wait to go back Sandra and jon from Manchester Show less

Author: Buderim-babe
Title: Lives up to its rating
Review: A very friendly little place with some very tasty and reasonably priced food. The salt and pepper squid is extra nice.

Author: Jonbeone
Title: Great food and surroundings
Review: The best little eatery in penang, We ate here most nights as it was our favourite from last time. So pleased the food was still gorgeous we went through the menu. Ben and Amy are excellent hosts allways going that extra mile to make your visit a memorable one. Try the living room you won't be disappointed Show less

Author: smileysylv
Title: lovely little cafe bar
Review: lovely tasty food, very friendly, just one thing to remember its closed on a Wednesday, wish we had used it more - I totally agree with the other reviews that have been posted.

Author: steve mBrisbane, Australia
Title: Clean - Great food - Great hosts
Review: I read all the reviews before traveling to Penag ( Batu Ferringhi )I thought they were pissing in everyone's pockets but I was wrong the food and the service was absolutely sensationalOh and they have real pork bacon not that turkey bacon,Fantastic hosts husband and wife team really make everyone feel welcome with a smile and they speak fantastic English.I asked to use the toilet while I was there, had a few beers, I had to walk through the kitchen to get thereI must say it was clinically clean and spotless. And the toilets were just the sameMy wife and I ate there 4 out of they 5 nights we visited, Will be back in jan 2014 and we know where we will be eatingShow less

Author: ba0ba0_neoSingapore, Singapore
Title: Cosy ambient with live band, home cooked food
Review: Location was good if you're staying around Park Royal Hotel or Holiday Inn. Traveled all the way from Georgetown to try their food, since it is ranked #1 here. We're lucky we did not need to wait for seats as the area ain't that big. Furniture used was some old sewing machines and some wood tables, making the ambient nice and cosy. Happened to have a live band that day, not too sure whether they're there daily. Was quite romantic to sit outdoors enjoying dinner for the 2 of us. Food was served hot, freshness guaranteed. Tried their stirred fried mixed vegetables & thai style fish. Fish was similar to Fish N Chips with really appitizing Thai sauce. Service was prompt and staff is always smiling. Owner was a friendly lady, chit-chatted a bit. Definitely going back again, probably with a group of friends so we can order more food.Show less

Author: Neil SLangwarrin, Victoria, Australia
Title: Great food and atmosphere by Ben and Amy
Review: The Living Room is only a small place, but it is always packed out and busy. Why? Because their food is amazing, so fresh and tasty and good value for money. Of course it isnt as cheap as a hawker centre, but the chef does pay more attention to your meal and the presentation is far better. If you dont see something on the menu and you ask Amy, she will try to see if their chef can prepare something similar. My daughters were so happy with the impromptu noodle dish that they prepared for them, what more can you ask for?There are plenty of fans to keep you cool and a good selection of cold drinks. The restaurant is just a short walk from the Parkroyal Hotel.Show less

Author: Steve MKuala Lumpur
Title: Disappointing
Review: Reading the reviews on this site it is hard to believe we were in the same place. We called in for a coffee and a sandwich early afternoon. The coffee was fine. The salad sandwich used the type of cheap white bread common in Malaysia, toasted. The filling was mainly lettuce. The bacon ciabatta was disgraceful. The ciabatta was from a freezerpack, and a lettuce ciabatta with a bacon garnish would have been a better description. It may be that their asian food is better. My advice: 2k to 3k down the road is the Monkey Tree restaurant at the Spice Gardens. Similar prices, superb food.Show less

Author: Mathsman_perth
Title: Best meal we had in Penang
Review: We stayed at the Park Royal and had dinner there several times. Saw The Living Room on trip advisor and decided to give it a go. The whole family were super impressed with the food even Miss Fussy who is not a fan of spice. Everyone enjoyed the meal and I enjoyed the bill. Not much more expensive than the Long beach Cafe (Hawker's Market) but in a completely different category in quality. Ben made mention of Little Mister (12) who not only ate his meal but also helped every one with theirs. Kids enjojed a HUGE milkshake one night and both loved the fried ice cream the other night. This will be a regular stop on future visits.Show less

Author: LNB1968
Title: Great food
Review: it's all been said in other reviews - great food, service and unbelievable value. Definitely worth a visit when in Penang.

Author: joe1968Ulm, Germany
Title: good food, good value with reasonable prices
Review: compared the so called food courts or food stalls this place has - with similar price level - the better value. Food was nice, service as well and prices are (still) reasonable. the other 3 cafes next this place have similar prices and I suppose similar food and service (acc. to TA)Show less

Author: SJWJRLeicestershire UK
Title: Good food
Review: We ate here just once during our short trip and we were not disappointed. We ordered three dishes, two beers, one cider and a sprite and the it came to 103RM. The salt and pepper squid was so good. The owners are very helpful and took the time to explain the dishes on the menu.Show less

Author: Shanty_10Sydney, Australia
Title: Too salty
Review: I found this to be reasonably priced for tourist (but not good value by local standards), I noticed some of the local dishes (after some real local eating) it was more than doubled. Food were served pretty fast but found it to be quite salty (I had the Fish Curry Kapitan and green veggies). Will try the stalls in Long Beach and hope to find better food.Show less

Author: suewMelbournemelbourne
Title: Fantastic food and hosts
Review: We went to this restaurant based on the reviews on tripadvisor and loved it so much that we went back four times during our 10 day stay. Amy and Ben are great hosts and take the time to sit down and chat with their guests, we were treated to some great music with Ben and some of his mates on the saturday night, it made for a great atmosphere in the restaurant.The food is delicious, we tried many dishes including the beef rendang, thai fish, lemon fish, fried rice, pork ribs, satay, spring rolls, kapitan curry, salt and pepper squid and the deep fried icecream is to die for.Well done Amy and Ben we loved your restaurant, may you keep doing what you do best for a long time to come.Show less

Author: Julie ACoolangatta, Australia
Title: Reviews are True - but beware if you are tall!
Review: We ate here on our last night as it had so many great reviews onTtrip Adviser. We were greeted by Amy and once seated, we asked her which curries we should order. She recommended the Beef Rendang and the Chicken Kapitan, and we were not disappointed with her recommendation. The curries were SENSATIONAL. The staff are very attentive and the overall feel of the place is inviting. The only downside - which was not a reflection of the service or the quality of the food, was the cleverly converted old sewing machine benches into tables. Because of the frames, they leave very little leg room for tall people, so choose your table carefully. There are plenty of other tables to sit at that will be far more comfortable if you are tall. Will definitely come back here next time!Show less

Author: muddyoldengr
Title: Super supper
Review: Had tried a couple along this strip and found them good. This was very good too. Great service, great grub, decent portions and great prices. Great recommendation and will definitely return.

Author: helen pAdelaide, Australia
Title: a great place to eat
Review: We come back to the Living Room every time we return to Penang and are never disappointed. Amy and Ben are great hosts and the food is sensational. I can recommend the chicken kapitan, the rendang, the Thai fish, the nasi goreng, the noodles - in fact everything.Not to be missed!Show less

Author: LynS189
Title: Best in Batu Ferringhi
Review: Enjoyed the meal so much first time, went back again the next night. Great home cooking, welcoming atmosphere and friendly service. Highly recommended.

Author: Ken MInverness
Title: Outside to inside by Amy
Review: Last time I was in Penang, Amy had a batik shop in Batu Ferringhi and this Time I couldn't find it! Suddenly, looking into the open courtyard of the Living Room Cafe Bar, I saw Amy and her husband Ben. They now run an excellent restaurant in the same premises.Wow! her restaurant is even busier than her batik shop had been. Quirky tables and fine food - no wonder the place was hoochin' (That's Scottish for VERY busy.)Amy had a Tripadviser logo outside, claiming that she had excellent ratings and I am happy to give her one more.Show less

Author: Nattyko
Title: A little gem
Review: All the reviews are true to its word! We were not disappointed with the beef rendang and Thai fish! Yummy and will be going back there again tomorrow night!! Can't wait!

Author: missyk75
Title: Never disappoints
Review: Love the Living Room, Amy and Ben are the perfect hosts, the food delicious and great value, the setting lovely. Thanks again and see you again

Author: PiliPala_83London, United Kingdom
Title: Brilliant restaurant
Review: The restaurant has a great feel. The decorations/tree trunk tables made it welcoming and relaxing.We had a few drinks then ordered food later without being pressured into ordering food. The food was simple but well cooked, full of flavour and very good value.Highly recommended for a relaxed dinner.Show less

Author: tripster25
Title: Amazing
Review: Great atmosphere, great food, lovely attentive service. Highly recommended. Located just down from the bayview hotel

Author: Travellingagogo
Title: Brilliant- go!!
Review: Amazing food, staff and atmosphere, could not recommend this place highly enough! There were 5 in our party and we had prawns that were beautifully fresh, tasty cashew chicken and 2 bottles of house wine that went down too easy! Best restaurant of our trip so far!Show less

Author: TACustomerZurich, Switzerland
Title: Rendang to die for
Review: The Beef Rendang at this simple, but highly popular, restaurant in Batu Ferringi was easily the best I have ever tasted. 'Slow Cooking' is the theme at the Living Room. It's small and informal and the atmosphere is as warm as your own living room back home. Don't expect linen tablecloths and fancy decor - it's not that kind of place. On the main strip through the village, close to some of the big hotels and near the end of the busy night market, it's worth going early to get a table, though it's open late for night owls too. Prices are really low for the standard of cooking that you get and the service is fast and friendly. No wonder that it is so highly-rated on TA.Show less

Author: Lek-byrneMill Park, Victoria, Australia
Title: A must do!
Review: After doing some basic research on trip advisor we had dinner 2 nights in a row here!Fantastic , fresh, all the spice we were looking for and more. Staff were very friendly and happy to discuss any dish.We had Thai fish - freshest food I have ever experienced ! Salt & Pepper squid , Penang Curry, Sizzling chicken and Beef Rendang cannot rave about it enough :) Only sad note is that I have to travel so far to experience this :) would love it to be in Melbourne but don't visit Penang without going to the "Living Room" and do it early in your trip as you will return - trust me ! :)Show less

Author: Leanneh3280
Title: Great food and very cheap
Review: Great food and very inexpensive, the service was fast and the staff very friendly and helpful.We will definitely be eating here again.

Author: geoffmarkMelbourne, Australia
Title: Fantastic Food
Review: This restaurant mightn't look that great but the food and atmosphere is fantastic. We were going to eat there but didn't have much cash so decide to go elsewhere (they don't accept credit card) but after eating there the following night were sorry we didn't go in the night before. The table and chairs are a mixture of outdoor type settings, table made from tree trunks and some living room designer tables. Service is fast with a mixed menu with something for everyone and a list of house specialties which are I strongly recommend you try. The owner explains all of the specialities and how they are made and make suggestions depending how hot and spicy you want your food. The food tastes amazing with authentic flavours and makes you want to order more. Prices are cheap compared to a lot of places and its well worth trying it if you don't mind walking a bit further than the main tourist stripShow less

Author: Alex B
Title: Good food and atmosphere
Review: Food and service was excellent. Good value for money. Nice owners. We enjoyed the evening. The sizzling beef was perfect and also the salty squids. We enjoyed also the pineapple fritters with ice cream.

Author: jneedhamMapperley, United Kingdom
Title: Fabulous, fabulous food!
Review: We went to the Living Room Cafe Bar after reading reviews on Trip Advisor. We were not disappointed.Amy works hard to create the lovely meals, there is only a small menu but most of the recipes come from her Mum. She uses all fresh, local ingredients and spices, using local fishermen for the fish and a local for the chicken (using breast meat not leg like other places) - not from Tesco which is taking over even over there!We did eat there most of our holiday - we did try other places but were disappointed and ended up going back there the next night.I was so impressed with the Chicken Capitan and Beef Rendang I will try to make it at home.Very tasty and reasonable food, the deep fried ice cream was amazing!Show less

Author: Clongy
Title: Lovely food at a good price
Review: Lovely food, tasted authentic. It was an eclectic looking place and had artwork. While we were there this was very popular for lunches. We went there twice and both times were all happy with our meals.

Author: PerthscousePerth Australia
Title: Good food,great value
Review: After reading the reviews on here my wife and I decided to check the place out and we were not disappointed. We met Amy, and what a lovely lady she is,we explained that my wife is allergic to prawns and Amy then advised us of what not to have as some of the sauces actually contained some prawn oil. The food was delivered promptly, was of good size portions and tasted superb. The place had a really friendly atmosphere and the final bill was more than reasonable.great value for really good food, will certainly go again.Show less

Author: 383grahamsBournemouth, United Kingdom
Title: Liked it a lot
Review: The only reason we went in is because they advertise 4 star trip advisor. And we got really friendly service and lovely food. The fried ice cream went down well as did the banana fritters and ice cream. Mains were very nice too and great pricesShow less

Author: SHeff54
Title: Pleasant surroundings with occasional jam sessions from local residents
Review: Staff were very friendly and helpful and the restaurant was not crowded with tables well spaced. Served breakfast which was very popular with tourists. We had a good dinner of local food of good quality and portion sizes.

Author: Parry LNottingham, United Kingdom
Title: Greatest Curry
Review: My fiancée has always told me from experience that Malaysian curry is the best. After experiencing chicken curry Kapitan at the Living Room I toaly agree.If its high class furnishings and surroundings you are after this is not the place. But if you are looking for top quality traditional food with friendly service and extraordinary value, this is the place.Show less

Author: travelcarolMelbournemelbourne
Title: Great iced coffee
Review: Amy and Ben run this place so well and have a loyal band of customers, including a large group of expats who enjoy this unpretentious cafe and meeting place. They are interesting people to talk to and have a good take on life. Amy makes great Beef Rendang and Nyonya chicken (sorry for recommending them Amy because I know how labour intensive making the pastes are for you but they really are delicious). Ben makes a great coffee and he and his mates have a 'jamming'session most Thursday and Sat nights. If, like us you are holding out for some 'real' bacon after two and a half weeks without, they do a good BLT.Show less

Author: TourleaderasiaKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Lovely place
Review: We strolled along this road, to find a cozy, affordable place to eat a simple meal. We had the nasi goreng with chicken satay, which was really delicious and cheap. The girl who was serving us, gave us helpful information. atmosphere is also good, although they start packing up by 10pm. Show less

Author: Lisa H
Title: Average
Review: I must've got this place on a bad night - as it seems to review well.  Both my husband and I had very ordinary meals and the service was super slow,  didn't go back......

Author: davnjanWestern Australia
Title: Enjoy the atmosphere
Review: Have been in here on several occasions on a Friday night, the food is very good with a varied menu. The entertainment by several ex-pats who just call in and settle for the night is most enjoyable. Playing rock n roll classics which both young and old seem to enjoy, and it's not so loud that you can't carry on a conversation or hear yourself think. A very good not out without breaking the bank. Show less

Author: Mashvi
Title: Best meal in Batu Ferringhi
Review: My party were all vegetarians and this was by far the best meal we had in Penang.  Don't go on a Wednesday as it is closed.

Author: SJRAustraliaAustralia
Title: A gem.
Review: This little restaurant is a real find. Amy, the owner, is a warm and friendly person who has a talent for recognising people who have been there before. The menu, whilst not huge, is varied with a number of choices - but we like the Nonya food the best.. We were in Penang for a week, and ate at the Living Room three times; we were never disappointed. The decor is rustic and the service excellent. The beef, prawn and chicken kapitan can be recommended, also the beef rendang. We have never had a bad meal and would heartily recommend this little restaurant for good food and good value. There are some new much smarter restaurants that have opened nearby, but we weren't tempted. Show less

Author: chloesmarrMelbourne, Victoria, Australia
Title: Delicious food and friendly staff
Review: We ate here just the other night based on other Trip Advisor reviews and were not disappointed!The food was lovely. We had their specialty Beef Rendang and Sizzling Mixed Vegetables accompanied by a traditional Malaysian rice dish.The staff were very attentive and good for a chat.Prices were reasonable compared to other places we had eaten in.Show less

Author: Suz47
Title: Family friendly
Review:
What a lovely little friendly family business this is. Once a dress shop and now converted into one of the best food outlets in Penang. Their signature dish is Beef Redang - just beautiful !
Not a big restaurant but well worth a visit.

Author: Paul113London, England
Title: Excellent
Review: Our pick of the three cafe restaurants just west up the road from the Holiday Inn. Good breakfast, lunch and dinner options with western, indian and malay options. My wife asked for the beef rendang recipe, so it must be good. Meal for 2 about £20 with drinksShow less

Author: johnreardon75
Title: Little gold mine
Review: What a great place this is. fantastic staff great food and drinks.The best part is they don't charge the tax. So if you like a nice meal remember get in early as it fills quickly.Helena's next door is also another great spot.

Author: moonman19
Title: chilled and relaxed
Review: layed backed little street cafe that served good food and coffee.May have been resting on its number two rating on tripadvisor.Could of sold its self a little better,but worth a visit if you are in batu ferringhi.Just near the park royal.

Author: HquivooyZaltbommel, The Netherlands
Title: excellent atmosphere and low prices
Review: All the raving reviews led us to this one, it's right next to Helena's (also high on the top spots) and yep, they are right. The food is good, but the location and atmosphere is even better. It's small, but is's cozy. And their prices are really OK. I've tried their western food (their ribs) and some asian food. I'd pick the asian food again, their ribs were ok, but not spectacular.Show less

Author: PeterT996Perth, Australia
Title: a little gem
Review: every now and then you just find one of those small but very enjoyable places to eat that provide great food,somehow engender a wondeull; ambience in a very small space.living room in batu ferringhi is suchAmy and Ben who seem to work extraordinary hours provide great food served with smiles and also very quickly,you can get a decent table wine that is not horribly expensive but the food is excellent highly recommendedShow less

Author: HuliwaliSydney, Australia
Title: Western food
Review: Had to try the food here due to trip advisors great ratings but was disappointed . Food tasted westernised and a little heavy on the oil. I like local food when I travel and I expected nice local food but tasted like a curry I'd buy in Australia. My husband also commented that his local fried rice was very oily . Maybe we just ate on a bad day . Average priceShow less

Author: gohomemumbai
Title: Nice place for lunch
Review: Friendly staff and great food.  A really lovely place for lunch after a walk down the beach. The menu is quite long with a variety on offer so you can have a hot curry or a simple egg and salad sandwich.

Author: krissylou
Title: Yum yum yum!
Review: Ate here a couple of times while in BF. small menu but delicious food, great juices and best of all great service! Prices are reasonable and its a lovely leafy restaurant. Thanks for the great food :-)

Author: Samantha F
Title: Great family dining experience
Review: This quaint restuarant offers great value, service and food for the whole family. We loved the sizzling chicken and beef and the salt and pepper squid was delectable. The kids loved the chicken fried rice followed by their unique fried ice cream. The Living Room had us coming back three times during our week long stay!Show less

Author: Di APerth, Australia
Title: Wonderful dining experience
Review: We dined at the living room cafe twice while in Penang Amy and Ben provided us with sensational service wine and food. Their salt and pepper squid is second to none their curries rate with the best on the island. See you guys next visit. Many thanks. Di and cliff Show less

Author: mariusjacobsenOslo, Norway
Title: Authentic taste for a great price! Highly recommended
Review: Went here with my girlfriend; she ordered the Thai style chicken, and I ordered the Pepper chicken. Both were fantastic. No frozen or industrial ingredients here; everything tasted FRESH.Service was excellent, and the price was good too. We paid 45 Ringgit in total, including two soft drinks.No air conditioning, but they have plenty of fans around the restaurant.I'm going back tonight :)Show less

Author: SChandra1
Title: Weekend routine
Review: Feels right at home! Love the char kuetiaw and my baby girl always go for the same thing, bacons, egg and cheese croissant

Author: Travelpluis
Title: Lovely place!
Review: We had a great night at the living room. The staff is friendly, atmosphere is great. The food was great too!

Author: Frank-n-PaulaPerth
Title: Needs work ....
Review: If you have expectations and want something nice walk past ......This is ranked well above were it should be................The owner is very nice and works hard. Food is cheap and very average quality even in this price bracket...owner needs to spend some time improving the simple [and free] things like the surroundings compared to next door, i.e. plants and upkeep of the tables and chairs. Food was only average quality and could be easily improved even at this price and presentation was non existent. Waiter staff was badly dressed and lazy and also let the owner down. Sorry but true.Show less

Author: JUANDDDD
Title: Great atmosphere and people
Review:
Good food and great place to have a chilled beer. It's very well located and easy to find

Owner and stuff are very friendly.

Author: kymbowats15Adelaide, Australia
Title: Excellent food in a lovely setting
Review: We visited here twice during our stay and would've gone back again if we'd had time. The setting is beautiful with both open air and undercover dining.The food is delicious and would highly recommend the Beef Rendang and Penang Chicken. There are also western options available but i'd try the local food. The staff were very nice and helpful.If you're travelling with a large group (+12) then it might be difficult to all turn up at once and expect to sit together but give it a try. We had about 20 people and managed to fit in but that was lick. Would highly recommend this. The milkshakes are great too!Show less

Author: megasandSydney, Australia
Title: Lovely Food, Great Value
Review: We ate at this restaurant twice (2 adults and 3 kids) and it really did live up to the reviews. The food was gorgeous and incredibly reasonable in price considering the quality. The staff were very friendly and the owner would always have a lovely chat with us.Show less

Author: HotfootedkiwiAuckland Central, New Zealand
Title: Lovely place
Review: My husband and I went there twice for lunch while staying on Penang. Both times we tried dishes off the 'must try' black board and were not disappointed. Both times our meals were delicious, I tried the local curries Beef Rendang and Penang Chicken while my husband had the salt and pepper squid and sizzling chicken. The astmosphere is also was great, lots of interesting artwork and photos to look at, staff are friendly and beer cold. Highly recommend! Show less

Author: LKMacaDerby, United Kingdom
Title: Great atmosphere and food
Review: We ate here at the end of June this year, we would have returned for another meal if we had more time. The place is tiny, it sits on the main road through Ferringhi Batu. Very quaint and quirky inside.The food was lovely with some local specialities on offer and reasonably priced. The staff were very helpful and friendly. We had a great evening and would recommend it.
