They don't accept card payments, so make sure you have enough cash on you when the bill arrives. We are a family with two grown up sons and we saw the staff making some young family's very welcome which was nice to see. I'd say the restaurant is equally suitable for couples and family's.Show less

Author: D3RRICK
Title: Nice ambience
Review: Not sure how can I post the pic of the restaurant. I like the ambience. This place will look better in the night I supposed. Went there for lunch. The fish and chips not bad. Can try!

Author: adamazzoComo, Australia
Title: Nice lunch close to hard rock hotel
Review: Had lunch here whilst staying at hard rock which is about a 7min walk to the left as you leave the hotel. The traditional dish of beef rendang was was very good. Place is reasonably priced and we paid MYR60 / AUD20 for 2 mains, 2 soft drinks and 2 bowels of ice cream. No cards accepted but they happy to accept AUD for payment there is however a money chance. Nice alternative to the hotel food we had been eating for a few days prior.Show less

Author: travlr9Melbourne, Australia
Title: One of the best eateries in Batu Ferringi
Review: Firstly I would have liked to give this cafe a 4.5 score, but it is not quite a 5. We had a very nice meal all freshly cooked - chicken & cashew, sizzling beef, seasonal greens and two drinks under 60 ringgit. we ate it all and enjoyed our meal. The hosts are lovely and very welcoming. The cafe was full and we were told there would be a bit of a delay with service. In the end we had some drinks and were served our meals within 15 minutes which was very reasonable. so why not score a five? We felt that the eclectic menu (western food, thai, chinese, etc.) was a little safe and the cooking style is a bit westernised to suit the palate of the target clientele which was almost exclusively British holiday makers, many of whom are clearly regulars. So in summary this is an excellent option if you are not brave enough to try the hawkers food courts and don't want to pay top prices in the hotel restaurants.Show less

Author: 3charlotte
Title: Great eatery - though a little on the expensive side for the area!
Review:
Nice staff, nice food, good service but I think there are probably cheaper places to eat. 

It's in another gorgeous location & we thoroughly enjoyed the meals we had.

Author: whitarm
Title: Must dine here when in Batu Ferringhi
Review: Discovered The Living Room on our first night and we were made very welcome by Amy and Ben.  The food was excellent, very tasty and very reasonably priced.  We went back several times and were never disappointed.  Would highly recommend.

Author: Cadbury1Hyden, Australia
Title: Another delicious meal
Review: Our group of nine including 3 children enjoyed a lovely dinner with Amy as hostess ensuring all was well. We had a range of dishes from western to Asian and there were no disappointments. I enjoyed a cold glass of wine and others had juice or beer. The children also had ice cream for sweets including some fried ice cream. A very pleasant evening. It is worth arriving early if you are a large group or there may be no tables left. Show less

Author: TokyoTim
Title: Good food. Quick Service
Review: Found this place by accident but remembered seeing the name on TripAdvisor. Very happy that I tried it. Dinner for 2 with a couple of beers each was RM76.

Author: Cr4ftym00Seaford, United Kingdom
Title: Delicious authentic home cooked food
Review: We went here last night for a lovely meal of Haiananese Spring Rolls (vege) with a delicious dipping sauce, hubby had beef rendang and I had Nyonya prawns. The food was sooo scrumptious and excellent value. The owner Amy is a lovely and very welcoming lady too. She's not open Wednesdays.Show less

Author: jan o
Title: got expensive
Review:
use to be at attractive restaurant with average quality food, typical local dishes, and good prices.
now prices more than doubled!
place and service remains the same so........

Author: ladydarlingSingapore, Singapore
Title: Great food great service...
Review: Had dinner here the night before leaving.. Got the tip through trip advisor.. Loved the food.. The beef rendang was nyum! The owner amy was really nice and chatty.. We came back the next day to have lunch there. Must definitely try the fish curry..their specialty.spicy and sour goodness! Will def come back if ever at batu ferringhi again..Show less

Author: sw1w26Hong Kong, China
Title: Friendly Owners and Good Food and Nice Environment
Review: First visit to Penang and visited this restaurant on our first night in Batu Ferringhi.The owner was friendly and introduced us to the menu - we ordered their signature dishes including the Thai-Styled Fish, Beef Rendang, Salt & Pepper Squid, Prawn Curry.The prices weren't incredibly cheap, similar to hotel prices but with much better taste.Tips:-We stayed in the Golden Sands and its around 10-15 minutes walk along the night market. Once you step out of GS, turn right and keep on walking until you see the Park Royal Hotel and it is on the next junction (you should see many lights ahead of you as Ferringhi Garden is next door).-Order one of their juices as they are all freshly squeezed.-Beef Rendang + Salt/Pepper Squid was one of their best dishes in the Cafe!Show less

Author: wigwam_7surrey
Title: Chef who knows her stuff!!!
Review: After trying all the top 5 places to eat wasn't expecting to be wowed by the living room... Spoke to the chef ,a passionate foody who loves her ingredients and will let you know in detail how much effort she takes... The beef mussaman curry was brilliant fresh and beef as tender as!! Live in Singapore and spoiled for food but this is really special . Worth the 5 ringgits more than any other in batu.Show less

Author: maggs1Bunbury, Australia
Title: Coming Home
Review: First visited in 2011 and returned this year to a "family style" welcome from Amy & Ben. The food is still awesome (Amy is now cooking for the daytime service & has a chef for the evening service) and during our 10 day stay in Batu Ferringhi , one,two or all of us had at least one meal if not two meals here every day and we worked our way through the menu. Most days I just had Amys recommendation which never disappoints.Absolute musts are Beef Rendang and for a special treat Fried Ice cream, although everything is delicious.We are all looking forward to returning in 2014 for more delicious meals and fantastic company, spending late evenings drinking "tea" with Ben and listening to his insites into the Penang way of life is most enjoyable.If you are fortunate enough to be in Batu Ferringhi stop in for a meal, you will not be disappointed.The cafe is just past the Parkroyal on the same side of the road.Show less

Author: Rachel M
Title: Delicious Value
Review: We ate here twice on our 3 night stay in Penang and really enjoyed it! The food was amazing and was incredibly well priced! The spring rolls especially were delicious!

Author: Andy T
Title: Nice ambience, good food with authentic dining tables
Review: Liked the lunch with good tasty food!  Nice recommendation on the Thai style fish which my wife and mum liked a lot!

Author: lolacol
Title: best food in town
Review: we found this place after a recomendation from a rep we was a none beliver wow was we wrong u will fined it hard to find price with quality but here u will b very happy beef rang dang my fav enjoy

Author: TexaninMalaysiaKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Fantastic food and wonderful friendly service
Review: We were in Penang for just a quick weekend trip and found this restaurant down the street from our hotel. We enjoyed it so much on the Saturday afternoon for lunch that we returned for dinner the same evening. We ordered a different set of dishes each time and thought all of them were fantastic - Thai chicken, beef rendang, curry, etc. And to top it all off, you must try the fried ice cream ... amazing.Our family (includes 3 kids) thoroughly enjoyed this place and will go back again next time in Penang. My boys were asking to stop by Sunday morning for breakfast as we headed out of town. That's how much they liked it.Show less

Author: mickeymostIsle of Wight, United Kingdom
Title: So glad i found this restaurant
Review: As a regular reader of TA reviews I got on the Laptop and renewed restaurants in BF. Staying at the Holiday Inn the LR is only a short distance away and well worth the short walk, nearer if your staying at the Ferringhi Tower. We used to frequent the restaurant run by Lena and her late husband which was actually next door and has been incorporated in the Ferringhi Gill. Amy made us so very welcome on our first night that though we only had 8 nights we managed to have 3 meals at her restaurant, it would have more had we not had other commitments, needless to stay the food was terrific I had a lovely beef and black plus great banana fritters, the other half had beef rendang a house speciality. The Tiger beer is very reasonably priced and the service was impeccable. Thanks Amy I promised to review your restaurant so I've kept my word. Cant wait to return next Year to reacquaint myself with the great couple.Show less

Author: puffaenquiriesNorwich, United Kingdom
Title: £6 and under
Review: It was great to revisit this lovely little hideaway in Batu Ferringhi and enjoy the food and company of Ben and Amy once again. I have recently read reviews that were concerning as it seemed that all their good work in the past may have been slipping but I am pleased to say my concerns were falsely guided by reviews that are possibly expecting fine dining. A little perspective is needed when you are reviewing a restaurant that serves excellent food for £6 a meal and under.Show less

Author: Oratory1Singapore, Singapore
Title: BEST BEEF RENDANG
Review: A comfortable and charming cafe near to the holiday inn hotel. The food is excellent as well as the value. The beed rendang( a type of curry) is the best I have ever tried. The owners are friendly and warm. It also has an interesting selection of art that you can buy.Show less

Author: Denise TAustralind, Western Australia, Australia
Title: The best restaurant on the strip
Review: Saw Trip Advisor reviews and thought it worth a visit. We ended up having dinner there 3 times and couldn't think of a better place to eat on the last night of our holiday. All the food we had was authentic, local cuisine and cooked to perfection. Service was great and the prices very reasonable. Relied on Amy to recommend dishes which she did with enthusiasm and knowledge. The stir fried local greens (fresh water spinach) were delicious and the beef rending the best I have tasted. other delicious dishes we tried were salt and pepper squid, stir fry mixed vegies and red curry chicken. Well worth a visit but just note; they are closed on Wednesdays.Show less

Author: robinarobrobina
Title: from a australians point of view part 3
Review: 3rd visit in 3 years , and nothing has changed , still a really good place to eat and chill out with a few cold ones and after a gap of 12 months between visits the owners remembered us by names , the salt and pepper squid is to die for , The service provided by Amy, her husband and staff was superb and nothing was to much of a problem , .... and serve the coldest beer in batu ferringhiShow less

Author: lil-miss-sunshine
Title: Amazing Food !
Review:
4 of us ate here on the last night of our holiday (wish we had gone sooner) all our meals were top quailty, service was superb. The price was nice too ;o) 

Will make sure we come back more than once next time we visit

Author: Nick DBlandford Forum, United Kingdom
Title: Worth seeking out
Review: Fairly straight forward Chinese cooking with good service. The owner is very lively and attentive. I had sweet and sour fish and my wife had chicken in black pepper sauce (although we actually ordered beef!) both with boiled rice. We had a spring roll to start which was't too inspiring but quite substantial. The food was freshly cooked, tasty and reasonable sized portions. Show less

Author: Waddlerstrikesback
Title: Basic reasonable food
Review: Not haute cusine but good local food and good quick and pleasant service from a nice hostess. Reasonably priced.

Author: Paddo WLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Pretty good and amazing manager..read on
Review: Food was good - mix of local and western. Obviously pulling in clients due to tripadvisor so very busy with tourists. Only found out it was cash only half way through meal. "Pay me tomorrow" was the managers response. No ifs or buts. That in itself is well deserved praise for this place. Give them a go and stick to local fare.Show less

Author: tommyC64
Title: Lovely food and good ambience
Review: Ate here twice and not disappointed on either occasion. Friendly owner and cold beer as well as good food.

Author: RuthP56Worsley, United Kingdom
Title: Restuarant with great food, service and atmosphere
Review: We tried this restaurant for lunch and were impressed with the food so we thought we would give it a try for dinner. We ended up there 4 out of 5 of our remaining nights. The menu is chinese/malay. Whilst it is a simple menu there was plenty of variety. All the dishes prepared were freshly prepared and excellent. Our favourites included the beef rendang, salt and pepper squid, garlic prawns and deep fried ice cream. The service provided by Amy, her husband and staff was superb. The atmoshphere is relaxed. We were not alone in liking this restaurant - we saw many other returning customers who enjoyed the food, service and friendly atmoshphere. The restaurant is child friendly too.Show less

Author: LizR240
Title: Fantastic food and great value
Review: We ate here on our last night in Penang. Wish we had found it sooner. Best meal of our two week holiday.

Author: Desert_BlondeSingapore, Singapore
Title: Disappointed
Review: We had heard such great things about this little cafe tucked away in Bau Ferringhi that we had to visit while we were on the island. My meal was amazing but my husband and 11 year old daughter were disappointed with their meals. My daughter had the lemon chicken and my husband the Thai fish which just happened to be one of the chef's recommendations on the blackboard. Possibly this was to get rid of the fish because it needed to be thrown out! All 3 of us suffered from food poisoning. As I only had a very small amount of the chicken I was the least affected. My daughter only ate a small amount as well and we ordered her french fries to replace her meal. My husband ate all the fish and half of my daughter's chicken. We dined at the restaurant on Saturday night and my husband is still violently ill and had to visit the doctor this morning to get prescription medication. Not very often that food affects him like this, normally he just has an "off" day. The service and staff were very good and it was a lovely little restaurant. The owner had told us that they had been exceptionally busy for months and the last 2 nights very very quiet. I am guessing they had way too much food that needed to be used an wasn't as fresh as it should have been. I would imagine we just got lucky at the drop in business and they have adjusted their ordering quantities by now. Shame, my meal was delicious!Show less

Author: Hby3Gold Coast, Australia
Title: The best place to eat in Batu Ferringhi
Review: Our family of 3 just returned from 10 nights in Batu Ferringhi & ate 4 times at The Living Room. We tried different dishes on each visit & they were all superb -- fresh, high quality ingredients cooked beautifully by a lady who really understands flavour! The owners, Amy & Ben, are down-to-earth & incredibly friendly & somehow this serves to make the food seem even better (if that's possible). It's difficult to make any specific recommendations as every dish was incredible -- so our recommendation can only be to VISIT THIS RESTAURANT!!! We don't usually return to restaurants when we're travelling (as we like to try as many as possible) but one visit to The Living Room isn't enough. As a comparison, we ate at Ferringhi Gardens one night & the meal was tasty but for the price we paid we could have eaten 3 times at The Living Room & enjoyed much better food & atmosphere. We loved the excitement & cheap food at Long Beach & also ate there on a few occasions but The Living Room was our favourite & I'm sure my husband & son would have loved to stay longer just so they could eat their way through the menu!!Show less

Author: TerryB313
Title: Soo friendly & tasty
Review: Wow, wow,this was the best place to eat in the area. The owner was so friendly, accommodating and not at all pushy. Lovely environment, excellent food value for money. I would definitely go back and recommend this a a great place to eat.

Author: 95JohnL95
Title: Great rates
Review:
Very good food at very reasonable prices.
Service was great.
Portions a bit on the small side though, but still good value for money.

Author: Joelangdon
Title: Tasty!
Review: We tried this place based on good ratings from trip adviser. No disappointments. Redang curry was very tasty and the fried icecrean was a nice touch. I would definately come back.

Author: BethanyA889Melbourne, Australia
Title: Great food and staff
Review: Had a wonderful meal here! Loved the Beef Rendang and Fried Ice Cream! Also, the owner was so friendly, she rounded our bill down when we were short a few ringit as we were leaving the next day! She didn't have to do that, but it was much appreciated. Very friendly staff and great food. We will go back!Show less

Author: 5113Berkshire, England
Title: Very, very nice food
Review: Paid two visits to this restaurant and, had we found it at the beginning of our stay, would have been more. Service by the owner was friendly and helpful, food was good with lots of local dishes to try. Curries were excellent, tasty rather than mouth scorching and the prices very reasonable. Look forward to revisiting on future trips to the area!Show less

Author: Peterplus2Brisbane, Australia
Title: Great night at living room
Review: Just had a great meal at the Living Garden. Great service great food lovely atmosphere.The beef rendang was fantastic and my wife had the prawn Kapatain. The fried ice cream was the best I have had. We topped the night off with a rickshaw ride home.Wonderfully night.Show less

Author: MkinrossStonehaven, United Kingdom
Title: Well worth a visit
Review: We were staying for 3 nights and went here for two nights. The service was very friendly and the style of the restaurant is rustic. The food was excellent and I particularly loved the nyonya curries and deep fried ice cream (it sounds strange but was well worth a try). All in all we would recommend it.Show less

Title: Do not miss this place
Review: Went to this restaurant twice on our recent holiday. Food was amazing on both occasions, the Beef Rendang was second to none and the service was first class. Can't wait to return.

Author: Adelemp
Title: Not to be missed if you are in Batu Ferringhi
Review: Food is very good , decor is rustic, they are fairly busy so service can be a bit slow - prices are reasonable try the curry Kapitan its amazing. Fragrant flavours.

Author: raffles2012Isle of Wight, United Kingdom
Title: Can't understand the rave reviews
Review: Ate here a few nights ago after the reviews on trip advisor. If you are looking for fish an chips or some other British culinary delight I am sure it's okay. We had local food which frankly was poorly cooked and expensive. The place obviously caters for the British tourist and probably meets their needs. Benidorm is awash with places like this, I hope this is not a taste of things to come here, literally. We would not bother going back. Plus point service was okay. How any body could rate the place as romantic is beyond my comprehension.Show less

Author: AnneLize020
Title: Good vibe!
Review:
I loved the furniture; no plastic chairs no table cloths just original wooden tables.
Loved the very helpfull and friendly staff. 
Felt comfortable, good no-nonsence food.

Author: amarolnorth east england
Title: even better
Review: Just back from penang and ate several times at amy and bens , meals even better than last year service good , and always a good atmospere The british fish chips are excellent, also the many other choices to nemerous to mention here , try it you won't be disappointed!Show less

Author: Vin n
Title: Good food worth a visit
Review: My wife and I decided two eat at this place two days ago based purely on the reviews on tripadvisor and decided to see for ourselves.. We arrived there a little after 6pm and were told that they are not serving food now we can either wait and have drinks or come back later. We came back around 6:45pm and were the first people there. Quite a rustic looking place with some of the table top made from plywood that looked like it had been exposed to the weather for a few years. The lady owner was really friendly and offered to assist us with the items on the menu if needed. The priced are not really cheap and are around the same as the hotel we are staying at. My wife ordered a banana juice and I had a pineapple juice. it looked really good in a tall glass and froth at the top but both was terribly watered down. Was like just plain water with a bit of color and the cost was around 4rm. I have had concentrate juiced that tasted way better. I cannot understand why they would even try this tactic to boost their profit in a place where good quality juice is easy to get. I would not have minded paying more for pure fruit juice. I thought it would just be downhill from there. We ordered the chicken satay as and appetizer and was pretty good. For mains my wife ordered a spicy prawn dish (30rm)which the owner suggested she have the spicy version of for 5 rm more. It's basically is the same dish just served on a hot metal dish. When it arrived it made a hell of a lot of smoke and smelt terrible choking us and the other couple a few tables away who proceeded to give us dirty looks. The prawn dish tasted we good. Had about 6 good sized prawns. Prawns were still in shells and were not de veined either. I had the dry chilli squid at 22rm. It was battered spiced and deep fried it seemed. Best tasting squid I have ever eaten. Place started to fill up with patrons after 7.30 ..mostly from Australia. The owner seemed to know everyone coming in on a first name basis at which point i started thinking to myself maybe that explains all the good reviews. Once the place filled up we were soon forgotten. Struggled to find someone to take our dessert order and when we did it took almost as long as the food to arrive. We got the banana fritters with ice cream. It tasted really good. Overall I would rate the food as really good but would not really rush back there. The total bill for two people was 85rm. If you are coming with a strong currency like us$ or British pounds then I can see why this place would seem so cheap for many. If I compare objectively with the prices back home it would be the around the same cost for a similar meal at an upmarket restaurant with proper tables, cutlery and better quality food. Watering down drinks in order to make an extra buck to me is a no no and quite insulting and proper cleaning and preparing of ingredients should be a given(had prawns at long beach cafe a day later and even tho this is a hawker market even they took the time to de-vein the prawns) Show less

Author: TrevandadyScarborough
Title: Good value and above all friendly
Review: If you're looking for reasonably priced food and drink, with a warm friendly atmosphere, then this is the place for you. Rustic hand painted tables, made from old sewing machine bases and set amid an interesting array of local flora and wood craft, set the atmosphere. Whether it is day or night, personal service, from owners Amy and Ben and their staff, ensure a warm welcome, and a reasonably priced menu, delivers a good selection of quality food, freshly prepared. If you are looking for expensive, candle lit, a' la carte dining, with crisp white table linen, and an extensive wine list, then, you will be disappointed. Just a few moments walk from the Holiday Inn, we found this a great place to eat, and later over a cold beer, listen to Ben and a few of the locals strumming guitars. We will use this restaurant next time we are in PenangShow less

Author: 99Martin
Title: Cheap as chips but really good!
Review:
Not a posh establishment but with some character, good and friendly service and some very good food at very reasonable prices.
For those who want a break from malaysian food, my wife strongly recommends the fish & chips!

Author: TravelAdvisorMunichMunich
Title: arrogant
Review: I went to that place because it was rated so high. But was dissapointed. Prices are almost as high as in the restaurant of the Holiday Inn Hotel. Owner was unfriendly. Did not make the impression that she cared about us being there. We talked about the preparation of food. When I told her that the dish called "Thai Style" was not the way Thais would do it, she replied, this would be her restaurant and she would define what Thai Style was.We ent to the the Gan Gan restaurant next to it. Owner was very nice and friendly. But prices again were quite expensive and dishes small. We found best value for price at Bora Bora restaurant right on the beach.Show less

Author: Teena H
Title: Wouldn't rush Back Again
Review: This was recommended by a tailor opposite our hotel-Were disappointed with the food and as we where the first table seated for the night,we felt we where being rushed to get in and out again.Much better places to eat.

Author: Rjs85
Title: Feels like home!
Review: Beautiful atmosphere. The host's Amy and Ben are so welcoming and like to meet people from all different cultures. Food is of a great quality and prices are cheap. This was my second time back to Batu Ferringi and Amy and Ben remembered mefrom my initial visit! Very impressive, relaxed and friendly restaurant. Show less

Author: barcarangerAndorra la Vella, Andorra
Title: Nice service and atmosphere at a reasonable cost
Review: This place is very nice but the food is certainly not spectacular. It also not particularly authentic.It does provide pleasant unchallenging fare in a nice atmosphere. Service is excellent.Bear in mind like most places in the resort you are sitting outside so can be hot and humid.Show less

Author: Loutro12Geelong Australia
Title: Worth more than one visit
Review: Loved the way the cafe has been decorated and the personal feel it has for customers. The food could not be beaten for flavour and presentation. Take notice of the female owner who recommended the vegetarian spring rolls to start with 'cos she knows her food. We arrived just as the monsoon rain did and we were sheltered from the torrential down pour and ate like kings and queens. 8 of us seated around the table and every dish was tasty and enjoyed by all of us.Show less

Author: fmoura77
Title: Good place.
Review: Very nice place and nice food, but the place is hot just with fan, no air conditioning. The owners are very friendly and give nice tios to visit Penang.

Author: 74davehLincoln, United Kingdom
Title: Great food at reasonable cost
Review: We have just returned from Batu Ferringhi and can say that the food at the Living Room cafe is ecellent in quality and value. The owners, Ben and Amy, are really friendly and will go out of their way to serve whatever is requested. One evening we had a lobster with some traditional rice and dressings. It was absolutly perfect. Another evening we were amazed to see 'Fried ice cream, on the menu. We had a chuckle at this, but decided to order and can say that the experience was one that we would like to have repeated, but as it was our last night we will have to wait till we return. Dave and JuneShow less

Author: BricodustSouth West France
Title: It's ok, nothing special
Review: Whilst the owners, Ben & Amy are very friendly, the food quality and cost puts this restaurant down my list. The place has a 'rustic' design, with bare tables and a piece of kitchen roll as a seviette!Food was served reasonably quickly but was somewhat overspiced with chillies. Mains are around 20-25 ringitt with a glass of wine costing nearly 16. From previous years I feel this place is starting to slide, not my favourite!Show less

Author: Richarda9094Tweed Heads, Australia
Title: Great venue for lunch
Review: Came across the Living Room by chance. It was so good that I ended up having lunch there four times in one week. I thoroughly recommend the Char Kway Teow and Beef Rendang.Hosts Amy and Ben are pleasant and helpful.Food prices are very reasonable.I'll definitely go back again on a future visit to Penang.Show less

Author: Jurgen COostende Belgium
Title: Thai / malaysian and western food
Review: We had thai fish and thai Squid. The vegetables and sauce for both "Thai" dishes were the same. These were OK only a bit spicy. So if you do not like spicy you better indicate well before (I asked if it was spicy and they told me it was not ...). Both Squid and Fish were fried, this is not well indicated on the menu. Our children took a hamburger with a limited number of fries.As drinks we took a fresh lime and orange juice which were ok (no addition of sugar or sirops could be notices), tasted very natural and fresh.We arrived at the moment that only two tables were occupied and had to wait maybe a bit longer than should be, but still acceptables. After our arrival the restaurant filled up completely and service had problems to follow (taking orders and delivering food). Some customers were not happy about this situation.We paid in total around 65 RM (three main dishes + four drinks).Show less

Author: tonyis
Title: A Happy Place
Review: A friendly cafe with an excellent varied menu. I especially liked their fish and chips!  A strange choice maybe for such an exotic island.

Author: HuochemiNottingham, United Kingdom
Title: Cheap and cheerful
Review: Good cheap grub (fish and chips, fried mee plus veg), friendly lady host and IMHO, the best of the three cafes which are in a row. Very popular with the local expat community. It is a pity the cafe is so near the rather noisy main road. They will need to buy some new furniture before long.Show less

Author: Mark K
Title: Beef redang
Review:
Had a fantastic beef redang last time I was in penang.
Wonderful staff spotless kitchen and a great evening enjoyed by all.

Author: 17billv
Title: Good & clean
Review: The meals were very nice and they were exceptionally clean, good value and authentic. The beer was cold and the prices were very reasonable, will definetly revisit.

Author: SunshineandblueskiesSingapore
Title: Over-rated
Review: We dined there on 17th December 2012. Love the ambience, and great service from the owners and staff. But the food was truly over-rated (after reading the reviews on Trip Advisor). We had the Fish and Chips, Pork Burger (recommended by the owner that it was home-made) and a Koay Teow Soup. The fish wasn't fresh, the chips were ok, the pork patty was dry and tasteless. The Koay Teow Soup was good comparatively but rather salty. Prices are about $10 - $15 more than hotel prices, but I think I would rather go for good food than save the $10. Hope that food standards will improve so that it will live up to the ratings here.Show less

Author: guildfordians
Title: another great meal
Review:
Thankyou amy and ben for another great meal
thankyou for fitting in our family of 10 so easily.
great service and friendly, nice and clean, tasty food.
wish we could of come back again but time got away...see you guys next year

Author: ssssssnakeBurnie, Australia
Title: Best so far
Review: 11th night in Asia (Thailand /Malaysia), cheapest meal to date, but best so far. Have had 2 very enjoyable meals next door but The living room is a must. Great atmosphere, cheap drinks, friendly service and authentic food. Only problem is our family of 4 found this on our last night so couldn't return.Show less

Author: dockersfan
Title: Lovely place
Review: Were recommended by neighbours in Perth and agreed with them, fantastic place to eat and really lovely people.

Author: riderukberkshire
Title: Superb food
Review: We were recommended to try this place by another couple staying at our hotel. we are so glad they did. The food is superb and the atmosphere is amazing! All the dishes are really well prepared and are a credit to the chef and the owners who have come up with a varied menu. The salt and pepper squid is excellent along with the sizzling red prawn curry! If you are staying in Batu Ferringhi, do yourselves a favour and try this place!Show less

Author: A380ManchesterUKManchester UK
Title: Good food and friendly service
Review: Visited after reading Tripadvisor reviewsWe were not disappointed. The restaurant is next door to another Tripadvisor favourite, Helena's which we also visited.Very similar in atmosphere, food and service etc. Happy to make dishes to your own taste, i.e. more spice, less heat etcFriendly service, good food and decent prices. Relaxed, informal and friendly, Appears to get a lot of repeat visits, talking to others in the restaurant. This was the same with Helenas next doorVisited twice to eat and once for drinks during our stay in Batu. Would have returned, but wanted to try other TA recommendations as well.Show less

Author: Britt J
Title: Real Nonya Malay food
Review: This restaurant is new, eaten here a few times and the Malay food was fantastic, Done properly and the service was great. Owners are friendly and inviting. Good value, Try the satay, Rendang ,wantons and Curry Capitan beautiful! Will go back there next time.

Author: maemsthmorang
Title: Living Room
Review:
Good food with great service and well priced suited to families
2 entrees , 4 mains & 6 drinks RM140

Author: Sally KSydney, Australia
Title: Fantastic food, chilled company
Review: This little Gem situated at the northern end of the main street must be visited while in Batu Ferringhi. The living room cafe gets you away from the hustling markets and feels less touristy than most parts of batu ferringhi. The owner is extremely friendly and recommends ome fantastic dishes. The salt and pepper squid is amazing and the nonya food is full of flavour. We asked for local spicy and got the kick we were after! If you are after a relaxing, chilled out joint with great food, I'd highly recommend this joint.Show less

Author: lindat44
Title: Delicious food
Review: We ate here on our last night and wish we'd visited it sooner.  The food was delicious, particularly the Chicken Kapitan Curry. It will definitely be first stop for us next visit.

Author: donga100
Title: Great place to eat
Review: The food here was cheap and delicious! Like the other reviews have stated, Amy & Ben are fantastic hosts and go out of their way to satisfy everyone. You won't regret coming here for a meal.

Author: JOHN CDouglas, United Kingdom
Title: Good food and friendly service
Review: We first took shelter in here during a tropical downpour and were given a very warm welcome. The owners are hands-on, friendly and generally helpful. The drinks and food are very reasonably priced; there is an interesting menu and the dishes are well cooked and delicious. Highly recommended.Show less

Author: OldaussiemanDien Bien Phu, Vietnam
Title: nice people make a nice place
Review: this is a lovely little place with great owners. It has annual repeat customers from around the world which is always a good indication that they do something right. A really nice affordable place to have a beer and relax with a book from Ben's library before enjoying a tasty meal. The do a good western breakfast for this with a need for home cooking, although not before 10 am from memory, so perhaps I should have said brunch. Show less

Author: Amy_kiwiLondon
Title: Great spot, recommend.
Review: As everyone else says, great food, service, atmosphere. Friendly etc. Good value.Love, love, loved the Thai style fish. Was in need of some plain food, but ended up going for this on recommendation (but it fit the bill). It was like the best battered fish I've ever had. Batter was good, fish amazing, moist, tasty, excellent. And the accompanying sauces & veges/salad enhanced the dish. The beef Penang (noyonyan) curry was also very good. Milkshakes pretty good & huge, bout 600ml! Lime & orange juice both excellent. Recommend.Oh, they also do Western food, including breakfasts if you need that or are with people who only eat western. And they do pork!Enjoy.Show less

Author: Canuck1948
Title: Good food at great prices
Review: Loved the tasty Chinese-Malaysia fusion food; nothing to dislike except for the "music" from the mosque next door.

Author: FayeYong
Title: Great Food with Warm Hospitality
Review:
Great tasting food. Must try:
1) Salt and pepper squid
2) Chicken & sweet corn soup
3) Curry prawns
Very affordable prices

Author: bsteenSantiago, Chile
Title: penang in a nutshell
Review: Amy and Ben (owners) are extremely welcoming. they provide an amazing service and are always willing to communicate with the customer. This is important for those who are unsure what is in each dish because Amy and Ben speak close to perfect English. I strongly recommend this eatery as the coffee is the best in penang, as well as the service. The food is very cheap compared to locations similar to this and you definitely get what you paid for!If you go the fried ice-cream is a must!you can easily get a great meal and learn a lot about Malaysia through stories shared with the owners all for a cost around $20 (including drinks!)will definitely come back here Show less

Author: jm7409
Title: Home Cooking
Review: Very cosy and homely, as the name suggests you could almost be eating at home with friends.  Again a good varied menu, the emals are tailored to each persons like or dislike or spices.

Author: David B
Title: In the shadow of its next door neighbours
Review: The food was very tasty and more authentic than it's neighbour but it lacks the overall ambience of the larger place.

Author: FordyPerthPerth, Australia
Title: Perfect for our needs
Review: This is our second visit to this restaurant and once again this trip we were not dissapointed. Amy and her husband are so welcoming and inviting that it intices you to come back for more. We were only in Penang for 4 days and ate here 2 out of the 4 nights. The menu has alot to choose from and you will not be dissapointed. Yes the wine is yummy and a very nice change from drinking Tiger Beer, especially when I only drink wine when at home, but to order it here at The Living Room was affordable to be drinking wine.Keep up the great work, could not fault the food, service or the atmosphere. Thanks.Show less

Author: mickstar25Perth, Australia
Title: great food & service.
Review: a fantastic place for a feed.Only a 5 minute walk from the Park Royal heading towards the Hard Rock.Great variety of food , and the staff are fabulous.Try the fried ice-cream so much better than back in Perth.$$$$ the 4 of us shared and entree of satay, 4 main meals , 4 desserts , 2 big beers,6 juices,which=Aus$60.00,+ tip.Show less

Author: Sue SHobart, Australia
Title: Good food, busy cafe, friendly staff
Review: We came upon this cafe by luck one night and returned again twice as the food was so good. The beer and wine were both very acceptable. The service was good. Only one chef each night made the food a little slower in coming out but it was worth the wait. Try to go at 9 pm rather than 7.30 pm to avoid the rush.Show less

Author: OzWokGuru
Title: Awesome Atmosphere
Review: Great food & atmosphere.Breakfast is good value.Real Australian bacon & espresso coffee.(you can get nasi goreng too)Nice milkshakes & fresh juices made to order.Don't spend 60 ringgit ++ at your hotel for more food than you can eat.Save you spending money & visit this place-won't disappoint.(closed Wednesdays- Amy's day off)Show less

Author: stona7Melbourne, Australia
Title: Great food & service
Review: Loved this find that was recommended to us by Sarah at a fish spa. It's a really quirky atmosphere, most furniture in the restaurant recycled & drinks delivered in different stubby holders. The menu is varied & very well priced & it was here that I enjoyed a couple of glasses of wine as it was too expensive everywhere else in malaysia.We went a few times & certainly recommend a visit.Show less

Author: becnant99
Title: Great food.
Review:
We went for dinner one night and really enjoyed the food. The serves are a little small, not a lot of meat, but when you order a few dishes it definitely enough to feed the family.

Give it a go.

Author: YasminMaskPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Great food, great service and great price !!
Review: We are just about to finish our 10 night stay in Penang after many visits here previously. This trip we discovered the Living Room and have been back 3 nights in a row. The service and food was great and really cheap. The restaurant looks basic from the outside and certainly doesn't compare in decor to the ferringhi gardens next door but for what it lacks in decor it certainly makes up for with food, service and price. The salt and pepper squid comes highly recommended as does the fried Penang kway teow. The owners go out of there way to accommodate any special requests.Two courses plus wine cost an unbelievably cheap 80 rm. Can highly recommend and we will be back again next trip.Show less

Author: Max M
Title: good food
Review: Very tasty food,fantastic and friendly service and very good value for money.It was the kind of place that you could have stayed and chatted for hours.

Author: barbaraf1962Barrow-in-Furness, United Kingdom
Title: Just don't unless you want to be ill !!
Review: Went here once during our stay in Batu Ferringghi as had read such good reviews on TA. We must have gone on a really bad night!!!! Though then again did we......????? After all the toilets being directly off the kitchen with no washbasins wouldn't be a for 1 night only situation!!!! Hubby felt they were disgusting when there was nowhere to rinse hands after going to the loo, so he held on until we left...... Even the spray commonly found in Asian toilets didn't work??? Unfortunately because we had already eaten here before he saw toilet situation, the damage had already been done obviously as we had the most awful D&V for the next 48hrs. Really not what you expect from a supposed number 2 in resort restaurant. This was the only place we had both eaten the same food, so nowhere else could have been the culprit.Oh and as if being ill afterwards wasn't enough of an insult, upon leaving the restaurant the owner came over for a chat, and procceeded to tell us we had chosen really bland meals and should have chosen something with more taste and spicier!!!! Was she really telling us she puts tasteless meal choices on her own menu?? Very odd, or do they suggest spicier to cover up problems with the meat of ingredients used? Try here at your peril in our opinion.Show less

Author: Cottzo
Title: Great place to eat!
Review: The Living Room has it all - good character, a great hostess and delicious food at very reasonable prices. We enjoyed squid and their chicken capitan (one of their specialties). It was the kind of place that you could have stayed and chatted for hours. We would definitely eat there again. Show less

Author: AussiePam47Australia
Title: Quirky decor & good food
Review: Having read great reviews on the Living Room Cafe we decided to give it a try this visit. Last year we hadn't walked up far enough to locate the restaurant. It's opposite the Yahong Gallery, past the Park Royal and all the hawker stalls. The quirky decor appealed to me. Stenciled table tops atop old Singer sewing machine bases intermingled with rough cut slabs of timber tables and an assortment of chairs. Various local artists display their paintings near the bar area. The restaurant is open fronted which is great for people watching and there are fans inside if the heat gets to you. Proprietor Amy together with husband Ben are extremely welcoming and you leave with the impression they've known you for years. We ended up going there on three occasions - twice for dinner and once for a late breakfast (we'd missed breakfast at the hotel). Good eggs and real bacon, good coffee and great freshly squeezed juices. Seafood dishes are fresh and usually battered or fried which seems to be the overwhelming trend in Batu Ferringhi. One night it was so humid due to a smoke haze from Sarawak that trapped the heat that eating was not a high priority so we opted for a weird combination of great thin crepes with icecream and a couple of beers. Amy puts you under no pressure to order a 'real meal' and you can simply order a juice or a beer if that's all you want. This is real low key dining with a nice feeling and great prices.Show less

Author: Mal P
Title: Great food and even greater hosts
Review: Wonderful tasting food and great surroundings.  Amy is a wonderful hostess who has turned her father's original fabric shop into a great eatery.  Best Capitan Chicken around.  And terrific prices!!  Will be back again soon!

Author: Tracy P
Title: Good Food
Review: Really good home cooked food, nice & not pricey, new one to try this time around, try the beef in black pepper sauce

Author: LorraineAdelaide
Title: The Ideal Combination
Review: Incredible hosts, great food and immense value. As always Amy and Ben made us extremely welcome. One of the best total eating experiences in Batu Ferringhi. Highly recommended!

Author: FeetonforeignlandsMelbourne, Australia
Title: Excellent food, friendly service
Review: Great food at reasonable prices. Amy was very friendly. We were there for dinner and lunch on two different days. Both times were excellent. It is an unassuming place from the front, and relatively basic decor, but don't let that put you off. My 8 year old daughter still raves about the salt and pepper calamari, weeks later.Show less

Author: wildflowerbAdelaide
Title: Amy and husband are just great- value for money
Review: We found this in our first mosey down from the Hard Rock Hotel. Amy and her husband do great simple food and great juices. It's great value for money and Amy has made sure her prices are competitive. Ask her about how the bar was made and what used to be in that shop. Some of the tables may give it away. We went here only for lunch but it does get busy, so go early. Go early for dinner as well and be prepared to wait if it's busy. We loved it here. Show less

Author: buaya65
Title: Good quality food at a reasonable price
Review: Went there with a big group. Not much of an ambience, but the food was excellent and very reasonably priced

Author: miss_moochyNapier, New Zealand
Title: Great place for lunch!!
Review: This restaurant was awesome, we got recommended to go here by the guy at sparks suits so we thought we'd give it a go and it was such a cruisey atmosphere with great service. The food was delicious, a mix of western and authentic and really reasonably priced, we ate here several times while staying in batu ferringhi. The thai style crispy chicken is AMAZING! It has a really clean toilet which I think says a lot about a place too.Show less

Author: shawcarterdelolio
Title: Ben and Amy rock!!!
Review: lots of great music and eclectic furniture. Loved the range of art work on view for sale. Great menu that caters for all needs. Friendly staff and free wi-fi to customers!!!

Author: shobs76Bangalore District, India
Title: Nice setting, OK food
Review: We visited last evening and the owner said there were HUGE prawns, so we ordered them but they were not @ all that big :(We ordered salt and pepper calamari and expected the deep fried rings we usually get, but these were very deeply fried (more brown than golden) balls served like a shrimp cocktain in a big martini glass - also not great.Overall, disappointed with the place, maybe I'll try to order something else next time?Show less

Author: inca-7
Title: Brilliant Food
Review: We went to The Living Room a few times,it has a grat atmosphere,super service and is very resonably priced,but the best thing was the BBQ spare ribs,really tender they just melt in the mouth,will be going back on our next visit to Penang.

Author: 652408Mike
Title: THE place to dine!
Review: Friendly atmosphere; great food; great people;the prawn dishes are to die for and the British fish and chips are better than the original ones!

Author: jospaulRayleigh, United Kingdom
Title: Great food
Review: Very tasty food,fantastic and friendly service and very good value for money.The red snapper was cooked wonderfully. Typical cuisine from Penang. No need to look elsewhere!Very clean .On a rainy evening,when we were leaving th owner offered to call for a cab to our hotel.As we wanted to walk back he lent us an umbrella.A very nice experience.Show less

Author: floolyMalaysia
Title: Great place
Review: Friendly service, good food, value for money. Although this place has no view, (only street view), it is an excellent choice for a simple meal. The taste is catering more to tourists, but we as locals are also ok with it as the seafood is very fresh. Prices are local prices which would translate to "very cheap" for tourists.Show less

Author: CrozStut
Title: Great Kway teow
Review: we had some fantastic meals here. Staff really friendly. Food great and great value for money. ,definitely recommend it.

Author: Susan D
Title: another reason why i should go back to penang
Review:
A very recommended restaurant, which makes me want to go back to Penang all the time...
Other than nice beaches, Penang is one of the culinary heaven, and this Cafe, is one of them...

Author: Jamie2601England
Title: Would recommend
Review: You get a big warm welcome here. Very friendly. Only place I found that did Strongbow Cider so was a big winner for me. Food was fantastic and cheap, large menu with thai, western and chinese food. They welcome you even if you wanted a drink, you dont need to buy food to enjoy the company of owner.Show less

Author: Deborah FMelbourne, Australia
Title: Real bacon for breakfast!
Review: This is a lovely little place, with super friendly staff. After six days of 'beef bacon' in KL, we were thrilled to have real bacon at the Living Room and returned for breakfast twice more. The setting is very relaxing - I was very happy settling in with my book, sipping on my freshly squeezed juice.Show less

Author: ruby1pearl
Title: Second to none......
Review: We are four travelling together,my sister and i -late  forties and two daughters early twenties.Food was beautiful,we visited on a recommendation,went back each day after initial visit,friendly,well priced,thoroughly enjoyed each time we visited,highly recommended .

Author: Lili SSydney, Australia
Title: A welcoming place to eat
Review: My boys and i just returned from our stay at the Park Royal Penang and discovered this little cafe early on. From the first meal, we were impressed by the friendliness of the staff and the quality of the food at very reasonable prices. The three of us were able to enjoy lunch and/or dinner for about $20 (au) or less. Both Ben and Amy took the time to chat with us and my boys enjoyed the atmosphere and the food so much, that it was their first preference for every meal afterwards. There were western options, but we did not choose them, as this kind of defeats the purpose of travel. If you're looking for a clean, casual, friendly environment and good basic meals, i would reccommend you give The Living Room a try.Show less

Author: Per G
Title: Good food, good service and good price :-)
Review:
This place serve super food, and at a very good price.
We ate there twice and can only recomend it. Nice break from hotel food and hotel prices.

Author: Debbie RSydney
Title: Good food and great service
Review: Loved this place, it was a bit far from where we were staying (Lone Pine) but worth the walk through the very busy markets. Food was great and at a decent price. This is definitely catered more to the tourists than locals but would still recommend to everyone.Show less

Author: shazza059
Title: Expected more
Review: Food was good, service was average.  It came highly recommended to us and we went out of our way to eat here especially after reading reviews, but we were disappointed that most of the menu was actually western food.  Tables and chairs not comfortable.

Author: 25penguin888Melbourne, Australia
Title: Food with a Smile
Review: My husband and I visited Penang for the 1st time. We stayed at the ParkRoyal Hotel in Batu Ferringhi. The atmosphere, cleanliness, and menu of the Living Room atracted us to try it. We were greeted with a smile and a very cold beer and cold glasses. Amy guided us through the menu with advice on the various choices of dishes. Kapitan prawns served with steamed rice, and Kapitan fish with prawn Nasi Goreng is a must try.Delicious! It was also a refreshing change that Amy even found the time to pull a chair up and have a chat. The Restaurant was busy but the wait for your meal was minimal. We went back three times, and would not hesitate to visit this quaint Cafe when we next visit Penang.Show less

Author: Kanan AAustralia
Title: Living it up at the Living Room
Review: Good to find one cafe in Batu Ferringhi not participating in the “Let´s rip off the tourist” game.We were attracted to step inside for some refreshment after a late afternoon walk on the beach.Actually we had earlier eaten Lebenese at Tarbush, but refrained from ordering desert because of the overpriced menu. Here we were able to order apple pie with ice cream for a mere RM6, a rather large water melon juice (as pictured) and a can of bitter lemon for RM3.75.The proprietors have both lived in Australia, speak good English, were very welcoming to us and seem to know what it takes to make a cafe/restaurant attractive to ferringis (foreigners).Funky slab tables, mood lighting and greenery all helped add to the ambiance. We promised to come back some time for breakfast.There have been some negative reviews here from Singaporians, and I note that perhaps the food here, catering as it does to tourists, may not be suitable to the more spicy palate of the Asians.Show less

Author: Pamela_J70741The Entrance, Australia
Title: Best food in Penang
Review: We visited Penang in June 2012 after 14 years and found so many changes some good some bad.....But this little restaurant in Batu Ferringhi made things so much brighter for us the friendlyness ..... the great food ........and of course the cleanest restroom other than our hotel that we came across in the whole of Penang ,Congratulations to Amy & Ben and we hope your business continues to prosper.Show less

Author: kittycatperth
Title: OK
Review: We thought was nice but nothing special. When you went near the back to the kitchen smelt like dead rat which put us off our food.

Author: DDD999Hong Kong
Title: Amazing Place
Review: If you are not quite up to venturing into the hawker eateries along Batu Ferringhi, Living Room might just be the place for you.Living Room is sited towards the end of a long stretch of hawkers between the Golden Sands and Hard Rock Cafe. It's easy to miss if you are not careful, and even the concierges at some of the hotels along the road are not aware of this restaurant. Don't be fooled by the location and the neighbouring dicey restaurants.The owners are a Malaysian-Chinese couple, extremely friendly and very hands-on in everything from recommending daily specials, preparing cocktails and clearing dishes.The menu is in English and written in a language that is easily understood.If you are tired of hotel food, wary of the hygiene of the hawker stalls or sceptical of the restaurants that only cater for tourists, this is probably the best deal you can find along Batu Ferringhi.Show less

Author: rubyshoesSurreyUk
Title: cosy resteraunt
Review: lovely people. very helpful with the menu, ask about the specials

Author: plemMaffra, Australia
Title: Very friendly service. Beautiful food
Review: Ate at the living room 3 out of our 6 nights in Batu Ferringhi. We were made to feel very welcome and got lots of advice on food choices. Very fresh tasty food. Every dish we tried was delicious. Also catered well for our 16 year old son. Hosts spent a lot of time chatting to us. Great prices. Excellent value for money. Highly recommend!!Show less

Author: Jemmy T
Title: Average breakfast with a little high on price
Review: We ordered Char Kwee Teow, Fried Mee, Toast with Egg. The taste is average. Service is good. But the price is a little bit on high end i think.

Author: ericamcquadeAdelaide, Australia
Title: Wow...Great food and friendly owners
Review: We were taken to the living room by some other people that had enjoyed the food .We were so happy with the food and Amy and Ben ,the owners ,made us feel as if we were in their living room .What I also really loved was Amy,s help in deciding what to eat ,she was right in every thing she chose for us .Well done guys .Show less

Author: vegitaPerth
Title: Very Friendly and great service
Review: We went to the Living Room Cafe about 3 times in a week.We chose this place based on the reviews from other holidaymakers. We were greeted very warmly by the owner and she gave us advise on what was a good choice on the menu.We loved everything she recomended especialy the squid. I would definately recommend this restaurant as a great place to dine.Show less

Author: ahlimama
Title: Excellent food and service! 
Review: We tried Thai fish, fried mee (noodles), cold white coffee and banana juice. The food is delicious. The staff is warm and very friendly. Leisure and relaxed environment!

Author: Catherine L
Title: Friendly with great food!
Review: We had a few meals here during our stay in Penang. The staff are very friendly and the food is delicious and reasonably priced. Among our favourites: Salt and Pepper Squid, Red Chicken Curry, Nasi Goreng and Fried Mee.

Author: swampduckgy
Title: Best Satays of the Holiday
Review: We popped in here most nights of our 7 night stay. The owners are very friendly, service is good and the food excellent and reasonably priced. Walk past the more expensive places and eat here.  You won't be sorry.

Author: EvickaBusuttilSt. Paul's Bay, Malta
Title: Fantastic!
Review: Thankfully we found this restaurant when we still had 3 nights in Batu Ferringhi. The food is fresh and your host is excellent! On one of the nights she did not have prawns but promised me that the next day she will save some for me...and so she did! the sizzling food is Great! Highly recommended and you will surely return again and again!Show less

Author: tracy_balidreaming
Title: nice-priced meal
Review: We had a lovely meal here - good price. great service, very tasty.  Husband had ribs and he said they were very nice, but the milkshakes were our favourite!!  Large and yummy!

Author: EllieManchester
Title: Excellent place to eat
Review: Very friendly hosts, and great value food. Went here a couple of times to avoid silly prices at our hotel. Good for breakfast, lunch or dinner.

Author: robinarobrobina
Title: from a australian point of veiw
Review: second visit to this restaurant 12 months apart and was good to see nothing had changed , same freindly staff (ben and amy) same good food , am good priced ice cold tiger beer !!!!Amy and Ben were very friendly, having time for a chat throughout the evening and showed true interest in anything we had to say.with a good range of food on the menu with western, chinese and local food options , I would have no problems to recommend this place to anyone.Show less

Author: chipsmom54Melbourne, Australia
Title: Food and Atmosphere
Review: I tried this restaurant because I like the look of it and the sign out front said it was well rated by trip advisor. I was certainly not disappointed in the food or the service - I am vegetarian, and ordered a dish called Fu Yong Hai, which is egg and vegetable cooked with a bit of Chinese wine. It was delicious, a very generous portion, and I thought the price was reasonable. I loved the eclectic furnishings (tables made from bases of old Singer sewing machines, etc., but would have appreciated a slightly more comfortable chair. None the less, I will certainly return and try the vegetable curry!Show less

Author: Wayne GPerth, Australia
Title: One of the best
Review: The Living Room, run by Amy and Ben is one of the best that we ate at in Batu Ferringhi.The food was cooked fresh, the service very good, the beer cold (and served in a stubby holder) and the prices comparable to other places in the area.Amy and Ben were very friendly, having time for a chat throughout the evening. Do yourself a favour, do NOT miss out eating here.Show less

Author: David HGeelong
Title: Over rated
Review: Mmmm what a disappointment... We had to check this place out after many good re Jews but I must say we were very underwhelmed. The lady owner super friendly and made us welcome, however food was average. We had a curry which certainly wasn't a curry, we had a beef in oyster sauce but more like just beef in gravy, and fired rice was like a curry rice... Prices are reasonable but I would suggest you go to long beach for a much more enjoyable meal, greater selection and greatet "local " atmosphere and expereinceShow less

Author: Lilian853Macau, China
Title: Best Squids Ever!
Review: We went to Living Room Cafe for lunch and tried a few of their dishes. Their Thai Style deep fried squids was heavenly. They do offer some Penang dishes but I would not say this is the right place for trying the local cusine as this particular cafe tends to cater for westerners.Show less

Author: Expat4Life
Title: Decent food, friendly staff
Review: Decent food, decent prices, very friendly staff.  Beers were nice and cold, lots of westerners.  Nothing really special though other than the friendly staff and good service.  I didn't see any gallery except for the art gallery across the street.

Author: Barbara LBrisbane, Australia
Title: Great food, atmosphere and service
Review: On arrival drinks came out very quickly, nice iced glasses for beer and stubby coolers as well. Food fantastic, try the Chicken Kapitan- beautiful. Lovely to be served good quality Chilian Red wine. All at a great price. Hosts Ben and Amy make you feel at home. Show less

Author: Reggyr
Title: It was easy to go back!
Review: We stayed in BF Penang for 4 nights and visited this restaurant about 4 times. We had Breakfast, Lunch and Dinner meals across several days. It was very easy to sit back and relax and enjoy your food at this local style location. Try the ribs here not at the other “rib restaurant”. I will definitely return! Price is similar to other surrounding restaurants.Show less

Author: 259HappyTravellerBrisbane, Australia
Title: Terrific food and the best hospitality in Batu Ferringhi
Review: We visited the Living Room 3 times during our stay in Batu Ferringhi in March, and we returned there after eating there several times last year. We found the food was fantastic, and have not found anywhere else with better service. The owners are the loveliest people and their kindness shows through in their service and truly lovely food. We recommend the Living Room Cafe whether you like local dishes or are looking for western meals.Show less

Author: DTandDR
Title: Good value
Review: Good value, friendly - definitely worth a visit. Clean with a good atmosphere. Reasonably priced, lots of variety.

Author: Paul593London
Title: A nice meal
Review: One thing is for sure, you wont get the worst meal in Batu Ferranghi here, but equally, you wont get the best either. We had a reasonable meal at the Living Room, but it suffers by being No 1 because we expected something special, which although it's very nice, this is not. Food was well cooked, service reasonable and people friendly, but the tables are very basic and close together. Because they were quite full on the night we went, I had the feeling that they tried to manipulate us into ordering certain items that might have been easier or quicker to prepare. Having said that, it was done in a very nice way and the food was fine. Seemed to have a lot of regulars so it must have something going for it, but that gave it the ambiance of "Brit Abroad" of which I'm one but prefer not to admit :-) !Show less

Author: Pods83Perth, Australia
Title: Not sure if it should be #1
Review: Similar to Mechatorakichi below we visited this cafe because it was top rated by TA, and were a little let down by the offering. The overall layout didnt bother me being a casual cafe, but we found the smaller tables (meant for 2 ppl) very close together so you couldn't have a conversation without sharing it with the 2 tables either side of you. This ended up working in our favour on the night as we did a "I'll have what she's having" to the meal on the table next door. This same scenario was then repeated half an hour later when the table on the other side of us arrived and did the same pointing at our food. The dish we all liked the look of was the Thai style chicken salad (I know, not Malaysian but everything else we tried was). This was without a doubt the best dish of the night, nice and light and the flavours were fresh and tasty. Unfortunately the rest of the food we tasted was just average and I enjoyed the flavour of the satay at Long Beach much better in comparison to here. We also found the service was a little slow as we seemed to wait an eternity for our entree. Expectations are a funny thing, and I won't lie I was expecting the best local food for the area to be served here. Whilst it was enjoyable enough I dont know if I can give it the overall tick of being no. 1Show less

Author: donnybaggieboyDoncaster, United Kingdom
Title: great food even better service
Review: we ate here twice the owner was so freindly and funny the place was packed when we went the first time and we had a nice cold drink while we waited she was so apologetic about our wait ,butwe were on holiday!!!whats the rush .when we got our table the food we ordered was fantastic and would recomend this restaurant to anyone .it is not fine dining if that is what you want ,what it is is great food and a freindlywelcome .this couple try really hard to make you welcome and it worked!!!Show less

Author: sunlover191282
Title: What a pleasure
Review: What a pleasure it was to vist the Living Room.Amy &Ben make you feel  so welcome.The food is well cooked  and there something for all tastes.Do go and you will have a great time

Author: CressEastAnglia
Title: Good experience
Review: We went here  on 2 occasions and both times had a lovely meal.Amy the owner did everything possible to make sure you had an enjoyable meal and evening there. The restaurant itself is basic but the food was excellent value for money.

Author: Canadian079Toronto
Title: Warm hosts, relaxed atmosphere and good food!
Review: We ate at the Living Room twice on a recent trip to Penang. Like last year, the owners were friendly, accomodating and helpful with the menu. The food was excellent and the price was right. We would recommend this restaurant to all who visit Batu Ferenghi.Show less

Author: I_B_Travellin_TwoTurtleford
Title: Just an average place to eat
Review: We ate supper one night at this restaurant based on the claim that they were rated #1 on trip advisor. Ordered the ribs. The meal was reasonably priced (ribs a little tough but good enough) - clearly a controled portion - geared for senior citizens. The atmosphere was friendly, food average, service average. Was suprised at the #1 rating after eating at this restaurant??? (Perhaps Senior Citizens tastes are directly attached to their wallets - hence #1)Show less

Author: AmandaE71Palm Cove, Australia
Title: Good value, Good food, Excellent service
Review: Enjoyed 2 dinners at the Living Room Cafe during our stay in Penang. Food was fresh, surroundings clean and the service provided by the owners was excellent. I especially enjoyed the Kapitan Chicken. A good range of food on the menu with western, chinese and local food options. I wouldnt hesitate to recommend this place to anyone.Show less

Author: amarolnorth east england
Title: never disappoints
Review: We used the this restaurant last year Amy and Ben are good hosts and have improved their menu , , and good value for excellent food , they even do british fish and chips which does not disappoint , the chef has been with them since they opend in 2010 so if you are goign to Batu Ferringhi this is a must.Show less

Author: Gill KChesterfield, United Kingdom
Title: Wish we were still there in Penang!!
Review: THE LIVING ROOMAimee & Ben......What can we say, but a huge thank you for making our stay so welcoming and a pleasureable experience.You will not find anyone in the whole of Malaysia to match this couple's hospitality and their unique friendliness.They introduced us to many people whilst we were visiting the Living Room, of which we hope we can call our friends. We never heard anyone complain and most nights, there was no room at the inn!!They have an eating area and then you can move to a comfortable seating area, should you wish to remain there for the rest of the evening.The food is excellent, thus sampling the majority of the menu, we can honestly say, we never had a bad experience. Unlike that of Fantasy Ribs!!!!So, if you're staying in Batu Ferringhi, Penang, make sure you go to the Living Room and tell Aimee & Ben, with a smile........... that Mike & Gill sent you.We wish you a very happy and pleasant holidayShow less

Author: sunbabe_9perth
Title: Great food nice owners :)
Review: We visited the Living Room twice during our Penang trip in Feb and found this little gem.Owners(didnt get their names)were friendly and will go thru the hassle of making some special drinks or food even though its not in the menu.We had the house special squid,lovely.the fried kway tiao was also yum n a couple of other stuffs..overall a very pleasant dining experience n to top it up,it has got a very clean kitchen-at least u know u r getting clean yummy food :)Show less

Author: mechatorakichiChicago
Title: I let my expectations get the better of me -- It was just a diner in Penang
Review: I wanted to give this place a single circle rating, but it wouldn't be fair. It wasn't bad at all. I just thought it would have excellent food. I am NOT a foodie and I wasn't expecting anything fancy, but just good quality food and it really wasn't. It is just like a greasy spoon, breakfast place or diner that you could find in any rural place in the United States or Canada. A place to get steak and eggs or a sandwich only it had Asian hawker styled food as well. It was fine, but due to it's number 1 spot on tripadvisor and all the rave reviews, I thought the food would be...better. We tried their house specialties -- some Asian, some Western. It was like food from a hawker stall in a cleaner environment. Don't get me wrong, I love hawker food. It's cheap and tasty, but it's not using high quality ingredients. Everything we had was like that. I had a rib eye...and it was the kind of rib eye you have to pour A1 sauce all over so that it has taste -- just like you'd get at a truck stop or a diner. Maybe this kind of food is a rarity in Penang, but there was nothing impressive about the food there at all. The atmosphere was pleasant. The staff were friendly and attentive (and knew most of the patrons there). I would say that the average age of the patrons on the night I went was about 68 years old. That takes into account the babies and children present to bring the average down. It was like a Denny's on a weekday -- most customers were pensioners who obviously frequented the Living Room often and loved everything about it. Living Room food was probably a nice break from the nursing home food. As I sat in the Living Room, I was wondering if the kind elderly folks there (who were obviously loving the place) could actually log on to tripadvisor to rate it themselves, or if they had their grandchildren do it for them... It would probably be a cool place to have breakfast and the food was not bad -- it could almost be described as home cooking, but I'm confident that most people are capable of making better food at home. They offered three types of beer in bottles or cans and some house wines. Needless to say, this is not the kind of place that accepts credit cards. Most dishes ranged from MYR6 to MYR30. It's a cozy place with lots of greenery and friendly staff, dedicated regular patrons (some mentioned they have been frequenting since the early 90s) and diner/hawker type food at reasonable prices. I'm not the type of person that regularly eats at fancy Michelin rated restaurants or spends any time contemplating what vintage might be good on the wine lists, but I can confidently say there is nothing gourmet about the food at Living Room and if you are looking for truly good , quality, delicious food you won't find it here.Show less

Author: xited07Melbourne
Title: Very friendly people and nice and clean
Review: The owners are really lovely people that take the time to come and have a chat and get to know you. Nice food that is geared towards the westerner. Well worth the visit. They were always busy and are closed on Wednesdays. We enjoyed the sizzling chicken and the squid was nice also. Very well priced. A main meal costs about $4-$5 and a bottle of wine was $25 - we paid approximately $45 for 3 of us with the wine...I didn't try the wine but my friends said it was good - from Chile.Show less

Author: BonesyKentKent
Title: Very nice food and spotlessly clean
Review: We went on trip advisor and we had lovely meal . My wife had Kaptains chicken and I had sizzling chicken , both meals were lovely and fresh and the price of the beer was reasonable (Tiger beer) 8 ringgit . The owners sat and talked to us for an hour at the end of the night , it was a really nice evening. Many thanks to Ben & AmyShow less

Author: lassie79Brisbane, Australia
Title: wonderfull food and spotlessly clean, and so reasonable
Review: Ben and Amy make you feel so welcome, the menu is not huge but caters very well for everyone. The food is delicious and all fresh. The chinese is lovely as are the standard british meals. Malay dishes also very popular and tasty. Its nice to find such a well run eatery and bar. that doesnt charge a lot, and it gets very busy at night so go early . cannot recommend enough... once you go you will be back several times as we were. Thanks for such lovely food. You made us feel so welcome....cheers from the Aussies L, G & JShow less

Author: Julia186403
Title: Friendly service
Review: Friendly and good value. Only tried breakfast and lunch so unable to comment on evenings

Author: kiwiozziesAlexandra Headland, Australia
Title: Great food and friendly service
Review: We dined at the Living Room 3 times during our 4 night stay at Miami Beach. Thoroughly enjoyed the food, especially the Kapitan curries and the welcoming nature of the hosts. Sometimes there was a bit of a wait for food but that is to be expected at the busy times but who is in a hurry when on holiday in Penang. Just gives more time to sit back and enjoy the lovely cold beer. Well done Amy and Ben, your number 1 ranking is well deserved. We will definitely return when next we visit Penang.Show less

Author: Taracook
Title: Lovely fresh food and friendly staff!
Review: We visited on 2 occasions and both times were served excellent fresh food. The staff were all lovely and really made us feel welcome. Can't wait to return.

Author: DanielleF932Marple, United Kingdom
Title: A bit of a disappointment
Review: After seeing all the good reviews on trip advisor we made a point of eating here. The food was nice but nothing to write home about & the portions were definately on the small side. We had a few confusions over the drinks order as well. After all the hype we were definately disappointed and it was no way near one of the best meals we had whilst in batu ferringhi.Show less

Author: guildfordiansPerth, Australia
Title: Number one in Penang
Review: We travel to Penang twice a year and always make a point of visiting the living room cafe.The owners are the most wonderful honest people you could every meet and would do anything to assist. we ourselves run a small business and know what it takes to make a successful family business.The food is sooooooooooo good ,very well priced, soooooo clean, service is warm and friendly and quick. bacon cravings can be fixed here.....It's a very homely place and all the people are friendly that eat there too.If you have read any reviews contrary to my review make sure it is written by another tourist as white anting from other cages can occur. But once you have been to The living room cafe you will be writing your own great review.....A big hello to all at the living room cafe we were there last week from Perth, thank you for the great food, the 3 kids love the food the best in Penang......and thank you for the bacon sandwiches you made for us just before we headed to the airport..........See you guys very soon...xxxxxx lots of love and happy Chinese new year, we hope your year is smooth.....Show less

Author: CatherineWatson70Wellington, New Zealand
Title: Great food, atmosphere and service
Review: We stayed at Ben and Amy's rental villa nearby in Batu Ferringhi and visited them at The Living Room a couple of times for a drink/breakfast. We found Ben and Amy to be very friendly and personal. They even remembered our three kids names straight away (Hi from Liv, Oscar and Hugo!!!) Although we preferred to dine near the beach/sea we found most of the best dining spots in Batu Ferringhi are actually along the roadside. The food was good and the beers cold. I wish Ben and Amy all the best, they work hard but always take the time to pull up and chair and have a chat.Show less

Author: Home27
Title: Good food at a good price
Review: Large menu selection of good quality food at a very reasonable price. Recommended.

Author: 1Mandy1
Title: HAVING A GOOD TIME!
Review: Visited this lovely and cozy place up in batu ferringhi. Owned by a cute chinese couple, Amy & Ben. Met my first love....really chilled beer...followed by good food and excellent service! The salt and pepper dish is a must try..definately a memorable experience..

Author: johnalison888Edinburgh, United Kingdom
Title: Best in Batu
Review: We stayed in BF for 12 days and had breakfast and dinner in quite a few of the eatries.The choice of restaurants, especially Malay, is disappointingly limited in BF and the Indian/Arabic/Lebanase did not offer great value for the higher cost. The Living Room was the one we ate in most frequently because of the combination of food, value and atmosphere. The food is cooked to order using fresh ingredients which sometimes means waiting when they are busy - but well worth the wait. Good mixture of Asian and Western (the burger is partiularly tasty) and their signature dish of salt and pepper squid a must-try.Ben and Amy are excellent hosts, offering a warm personal welcome and they are happy to accommodate food intolerances where practicable. The Living Room provides solidly comfortable furnishings softened with exotic greenery, and the loo (reached through the squeaky-clean kitchen), is fresh and clean and holds no asian terrors.Alison and JohnShow less

Author: Georgia__1818Melbourne, Victoria, Australia
Title: Great food, great company, great music! :)
