Review: The Living Room offers great service, delicious food and pleasant surroundings. We enjoyed many meals there and always felt very welcome. Amy and Ben always took time out to chat with us on each occasion and we all really enjoyed eating there, or just popping in for a drink and a chat! If you visit Batu Ferringhi The Living Room is an absolute must!Show less

Author: swanmark
Title: Great food and fantastic prices
Review: Just spent 10days in batu ferrengi and ate several times at the Living Room, the staff are so friendly and the food was excellent, 3 meals and drinks came to about 50rm which converts to about £10, try it out.

Author: H0nestReviewsKenilworth, United Kingdom
Title: Best in Batu Ferringhi
Review: We have looked at a fair few restaurants whilst in Batu Ferringhi, but this stands out as the best. A great family run business, with good malay food. The spring roll and satay starters were great. It is closed wednesdays, but don't worry- Helena's Cafe next door is also well worth the visit.Show less

Author: JoanneTW2011Manchester, United Kingdom
Title: Really gorgeous food and lovely hosts
Review: My husband and I visited the Living Room twice during our stay in Batu Ferringhi, we loved the food it was so tasty and really very good value. We especially loved the massive spring rolls and the chicken kapitan. if we return to Penang we will be back here! I even got nicknamed Kate ;-) Show less

Author: marilynbrocengland
Title: An absolute treasure in BF
Review: We can't stop ourselves returning to this lovely little cafe. Friendly service where absolutely nothing is too much trouble, on first name terms with the owners almost immediately and utterly delicious food. As a bookseller on holiday the book swap has been such a bonus too! As a small-business owner I'm all too aware of the importance of good customer care and these two are second to none! Make it your breakfast of choice - and lunch/dinner for delightful authentic cuisine.Show less

Author: PatriciaM224Narrogin, Australia
Title: Good food, great service, very reasonable prices
Review: Visited this place several times, either with husband or with friends as well. It is a casual dining atmosphere and designed to make you feel at home-hence the name The Living Room. You can eat, relax, sit on the couch and read a mag and just chill out. It is open 6 days a week. I am pretty sure it is only closed wednesdays. I tried the vegetable curry and it was superb but too big a helping for me. The chef was horrified when the plate went back with a third of the food left on it and came out to see if I was really full or ifthere was something wrong with the food. Very relaxed atmosphere. Can really recommend this place. If you need help finding how to get there, then if you are staying at Park Royal hotel or Holiday Inn(Beach Wing side) come out to the front of the hotel and turn right. Walk to the next street, cross over the road and it is the third cafe on the right. EnjoyShow less

Author: 30-somethingwomanHannover, Germany
Title: Friendly atmosphere and gorgeous food
Review: This place may look like a cool chillout bar for backpackers but don't let that fool you! The food is really fantastic and very affordable. Being a "foodie" I had been up and down the Batu Ferringhi strip looking at menus and checking out the atmosphere of restaurants and whether there were any people in them. I finally stumbled upon this place and went back the following morning for breakfast and the following evening for another dinner. It opened a year ago. The lady who runs it used to have a tailors shop for many years (which is visble under the very cool tables), but decided to try a new business. She joined forces with a friend who used to be a chef in a top hotel, so he knows all about food hygiene etc. The produce is local, the seafood fresh and the recipies local and traditional. The atmosphere is really friendly and laid back, suitable for single female travellers, and the owner makes a point of chatting to all guests. But if you are on your own and prefer to read a book in peace, you'll be left alone to do just that. If I go back to Batu Ferringhi, this is the first place I would go!Show less

Author: geophilhkHong Kong, China
Title: what's the hype?
Review: Honestly, number one on Tripadvisor?Yes the place is friendly, however it's got a minuscule outside area on the road side, a couple of plants, and that's about it. The food is not very different from the other places you can choose from, juices a little watered down.In short, nothing bad, nothing great, just expected a lot more from such a highly rated place.Show less

Author: Bolbo243Melbourne
Title: Great food and friendly service
Review: It's 8.30pm and the place is full. We are offered a seat at a long table sharing with 2 other diners who inform us they are regulars. We eat nonya chicken, mee goreng and Chinese water spinach with chili. It is all delicious and the service is very friendly. The couple we are sharing a table with tell us about their Siamese cat. We leave with plans to return.Show less

Author: Paula VTweed Heads, New South Wales, Australia
Title: THE BEST FOOD ,HOSTS & ATMOSPHERE In PENANG - Cant stop talking about it
Review: Hosts Ben & Amy go out of their way to make everything perfect for you .Food is AMAZING, Great selection , super fresh ,& Delicious. LIVING ROOM ,has the BEST Food -Hosts & Atmosphere in Penang .We cant wait to go back in Feb 2012Show less

Author: fearsomepuppyKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: An absolute delight!
Review: My family and myself dined out at this cafe/bar/restaurant multiple times whilst we took a short trip over Xmas in Penang. The Living Room is a cosy spot located centrally along Batu Ferringhi almost next to the Park Royal hotel and opposite the Yahong gallery. We tasted both Western and Malay Nonya cuisine. All were excellent in quality of cooking and ingredients used, though it should be noted that the Western food is priced relatively higher than the Malay options, though still very good value.Highlights which I'd recommend we're the Fish and Chips, Salt and Pepper Squid, Nasi Goering, Char Taoy Teow and if you have a sweet tooth the banana fritters with ice cream. It's rare that my entire family agree with liking a restaurant, but the Living Room certainly lived up to its reputation.Show less

Author: harvlawBeijing, China
Title: Great resort restaurant
Review: My family ate at the Living Room after passing by it a couple of nights and reading other reviews. We were really impressed with the service as well as the quality of our meals. We had a range of items from banana pancakes, lamb chops, pork ribs as well as Chicken curry Kapitum. Regardless of whether the item was based on an eastern or western menu, the food was delicious. There is something for everything to enjoy. Prices were very reasonable. One thing to note is that the restaurant did not accept credit cards, so make sure you bring enough cash. We would definately head back to the Living Room on future visits. Show less

Author: smith711Solihull, United Kingdom
Title: The Best in Batu Ferringhi
Review: We ate at this resturant on our first night in Batu Ferringhi due to the reviews on TA, and can confirm that everybody was right, the food was excellent, well priced and Amy is lovley owner and makes you feel very welcome.We did try a few other resturants which where also good, but Living Room was the only one I visited more than once.Recommendation - Dried Chilli Squid, Thai Chicken and Fish Curry Kapitan style washed down with a Tiger Beer.....Show less

Author: jolijdam
Title: nice place
Review:
the place is cozy and the food is good. menu has both malay and international. typical home cooking style.
ben and amy are nice people who remember faces and names!
price are ok.

Author: RannochStudioPitlochry, United Kingdom
Title: Friendly Service and Great Bacon!
Review: We went to the Living Room based on Trip Advisor Reviews and enjoyed a really nice breakfast of bacon, eggs, beans and toast ~ which fulfilled the craving for 'home' food! It was nicely cooked and the bacon was advertised as 'real bacon' ~ not sure what 'pretend bacon' is but can verify that this was just like you get back home.The owners are very friendly and quite happy to sit and chat away with you when not too busy. For me, it's the 'service with a smile' and friendly chatter that makes this place that little bit special ... really worth a visit, or two, or three!Show less

Author: robinarobrobina
Title: great food and service
Review: we went here in march for our 20 th wedding anniversary after reading the reveiws we found the atmosphere great the cleaniness really good the food really tasty and the owners really friendly we also met some really nice travellers here aswell we went 3 times for dinner here and enjoyed each meal every time the chicken curry the ribs and the salt and pepper squid is great didnt have one bad meal and the prices are very reasonable.we are actually going to peneng again in febuary 2012 with our kids cant wait to take them for dinner here. a must do on your visit.congatulations on being open over 1 year.Show less

Author: RosliSydney, Australia
Title: Just okay
Review: I know that this restaurant get rave reviews from travellers. I tried it once for this reason. The owners are lovely and even though this is their first time in the food business they appear to be doing well. On a whole it was just okay for us. I feel that with so many other places to compete with that you have to be offering something extra special and 'Living Room' doesnt have that on offer. I personally still prefer the hawker food of Penang. Show less

Author: DesmondChuaSingapore, Singapore
Title: One of the Best F&B in Batu Ferringhi
Review: On 10Dec2011, our family of 8 (6 adults & 2 children) had our dinner at Living Room Cafe. We really enjoyed the Food, fruit juices & ice cream. The ingredients used was very fresh and the food was very delicious. The Salt and Pepper squid is a MUST TRY if you are in that area. Amy is such a nice person who gave us free steam rice when we request for it. If you compare to The Ship which we had our first dinner, this place is much better in terms of Food and drinks. Forgot to mention that the price is also cheaper.Show less

Author: saber13
Title: Over rated
Review: Was quite disappointed with the overall experience. Honestly, the food sucked.

Author: Lvinlife57Laguna Niguel, California
Title: Great Food, Ambience and Service
Review: This was a very enjoyable experience. It is located on the strip in Batu Ferringhi and can be difficult to find. (It is just past the Park Royal Hotel) We just happened to be walking by and liked the ambience. It had a lot of interesting foliage throughout. It is an open air restaurant as many are in the area. We were warmly welcomed by Amy, whom we found out later is the owner. She took the time to share with us her concept for the restaurant which we found quite unique. Ask her to share when you visit. The food was great! We had the Salt & Pepper Squid and the Nyonya Kapitan Curry. You can't go wrong!Show less

Author: Helen N
Title: Lovely food, lovely people!
Review: Found this place rather late in our holiday when we had a bacon sarnie craving one lunchtime! We went back for a meal that night. Food here is lovely and Amy and Ben are really nice people who are eager to please, Would recommend wholeheartedly.

Author: NerylSydney, Australia
Title: Do not miss this lovely cafe
Review: Don't miss the chance to dine at this friendly, relaxed cafe. Owners and hosts Amy & Ben are so welcoming and hospitable, and love to get to know their visitors. The top quality food, coffee and ice-cold beer will have you going back again and again - just irresistible. Chef Michael works wonders in the kitchen and provides local and western dishes using the best and freshest produce. The stuffed eggplant, vegetable kapitan and salt & pepper squid were our favourites, while many came for the quality fish and chips and bacon and eggs. You will not regret trying this lovely cafe and I guarantee you'll go more than once during your stay.Show less

Author: Neil SLangwarrin, Victoria, Australia
Title: Best food in Batu Ferringi
Review: The food here is excellent, you wont find a better salt and pepper squid dish anywhere. The spring rolls, samosa's and nasi goreng are all superb and the prices are so low. The hosts Amy and Ben are very friendly and always chat with their customers. You can find this place just to the left of the Parkroyal hotel. Give it a go as you will not be disappointed.Show less

Author: Sunseekers8910
Title: Nice food and service
Review: Great value for money local restaurant with friendly staff

Author: grubduck
Title: Freindly staff and good food
Review: Amy and Ben have a great little cafe. There is a mix of food styles available, but we enjoyed the Malay dishes, especially the Fish Kapitain - delicious. And the beer is really cold, too.

Author: plc69Crewe
Title: Very Good but could be improved
Review: We really enjoyed the food at The Living Room. After we'd left the restaurant I asked my friends what they thought and whether they considered it worthy of the #1 spot on TripAdvisor (as of Nov 2011), I think we all agreed that it was excellent value for money but not our #1 choice overall. That award belongs to Ferringhi Garden which is more expensive but also more special in terms of both food and atmosphere.So back to The Living Room, in the main the food is tasty and excellent value but the atmosphere and ambience is cafe-style rather than restaurant-style. The menus are fine for diners during the day expecting a good breakfast or lunch but could do with being 'upgraded' for evening diners.We tried the Sweet & Sour Chicken, Beef with Ginger, Nasi Goreng and a number of other items on the menu. All were very good. Beers were all served in bottles, nothing is available on draught.If you're looking for somewhere to eat in Batu Ferringhi which serves good quality food which is good value then The Living Room is definitely worth a look, however if you're looking for a romantic evening out or a great place to take friends or you're simply on holiday enjoying yourself then I would recommend Ferringhi Garden over-and-above this restaurant, as the setting, food and ambience are the bars which I set other restaurants by. The Jewel Of The North is also highly commended, we ate some fabulous Indian-style food in there.Show less

Author: ToshHuskySouthern Highlands, Australia
Title: Lovely restaurant owned & run by lovely people - Amy & Ben.
Review: The Living Room was recommended to us & we enjoyed it so much we went back. Amy took our orders & helped us with our choices. Beautiful fresh food was presented to us. Both she & Ben have created a lovely eatery with such a great atmosphere. Definitely recommend it. We will be back there on our next visit.Show less

Author: Alywin CSingapore, Singapore
Title: Comfy setting, welcoming hosts, alright food
Review: Had to visit the place after seeing its ranking in trip advisor. After having 3-4 meals there, its more than the food that makes this place special. Nice comfy setting and the hosts were very engaging. We had Penang Char Kway Teow (Fried Rice Noodles) the most, quite good. There was also pork ribs (not easy to find pork dish in that area). They are open for breakfast, lunch & dinner, good since the area is quite "dead" in the day time.Quite an easy walk from where we were staying in Holiday Inn. If you are staying at the Ferringhi Wing, its turn left after coming out from the lobby and walk 3-5 minutes, its opposite the art gallery.Show less

Author: ogajimDubai, United Arab Emirates
Title: Pleasant but not exceptional
Review: This place stands out on the strip of restaurants & cafes which it occupies because of it's good decor and welcoming frontage but there are other places which offer better reasonably priced food and which give a better feel of the 'local' Batu Ferringhi & Penang. For those who like Stongbow and Guiness (bottled) it is available here although expensive. This is a comfortable place with excellent service from the proprietors offering a good selection of local and western dishes (including breakfast with 'real' bacon) but none more than many other more 'authentic' Penang establishments nearby. Prices are reasonable but better food at better prices is available elsewhere locally. This is a place which appears to cater for western & Australian/NZ tourists who are not at ease outside of the general environment which they are probably used to back home.Show less

Author: Steve LAdelaide, Australia
Title: Caters well for westerners, serves bacon for breakfast
Review: The sign out the front said" best coffee in town" it's true. Truly well riding all over the island for. Excellent service, is quick, fantastic prices. Rustic timber furniture, very comfortable little place, but gets busy, go early for dinner then the markets. Real bacon, all over great food.Show less

Author: ClaudiusSgSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good value small family restaurant with nice staff
Review: A very pleasant time with the friendly staff and quite good food. Menu offered Asian and western food and decor is quite unusual - old sewing machine tables as bases and a few tops were large wood slabs.Service was very friendly and food was pretty good rather than being brilliant.Show less

Author: Leanne TAdelaide
Title: So worth walking back to the hotel in the rain
Review: After walking past this place during the day I thought it might be worth the walk back for dinner. I was so right!! The owners were super friendly and the only thing better than that was the taste of the food - the Salt & Pepper squid is easily the best Ive ever had anywhere.We arrived 15 mins before they were scheduled to open and we were still welcomed in with friendly smiles. In the next hour the place filled up so its clearly a popular place to eat. We heard plenty of comments from the other diners who were all really happy with their food. Oh and they also serve 'real' bacon and pork ribs if you're missing it!We had 3 adults and a child in our group and for 2 courses each and lots of beer it was less than 130 MYR (around $40 aus).Show less

Author: william q
Title: cheap & cheerful
Review: ben and amy are the owners here , very nice people who get to know most of their customers and often join for a beer or chat . food is lovely and cheap too . nice place to relax and unwind

Author: DagenhamdivadeeLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Fabulous, a warm & friendly atmosphere.
Review: When we had decided to take our holiday in penang, the first thing I did was look up where and where not to eat as my huband is a very fussy eater. After reading the reviews on the hotel we were staying at (The ParkRoyal) a few people mentioned 'The Living Room'. They said how value for money the food was and how warm and friendly the staff were. How true they were!At first we had trouble finding The Living room, our taxi driving didn't seem to know of it when he picked us up from the airport. It was only when we took a little walk up to The Hard Rock Hotel that we passed it by chance. When my husband and I entered The Living Room we was greeted by Amy the owner. She was really friendly and chatty and made us feel so welcome.We found ourselves eating there quite a bit during our 2 week stay, not just because the food was good and reasonably priced but because of the atmosphere Amy and her husband Ben had created. You just found yourself being drawn there for a chat and to socialise.We would like to Thank Amy and Ben for making our holiday memorable and all the advise as to where to go, what to see and how to travel - we had a fantastic holiday.Denise and Tony x x xShow less

Author: pinnychanCatania, Italy
Title: what a deliciuos food!
Review: it's a very little restaurant on the main street of batu ferringi between others...you had to be be care to the plants to find it.the owner really friendly and she explain us about the receipts and the ingredients...every dish is prepared follow homemade receipts.absolutely delicious!taste the black pepper dishes....Show less

Author: NutritionForLife
Title: A must visit - fantastic host, amazing food and more....just like dinner at your best friends
Review: Wow, where to start? A must first dinner destination in Penang. The Living Room has it all- a relaxed setting, amazing home cooked food, and service with a smile. From the moment you enter you feel at home. From the moment you taste the food, you know you have made the right choice. The salt and pepper squid simply melts in your mouth and the flavor is just delicious. The chicken curry, also a house speciality, is also very tasty. We finished it off with a banana pie- a dessert I haven't had before and once again it didn't disappoint.An amazing meal, with great hosts, personalized service and advice on Penang - simply the best!BTW, The Living Room is located about 200m past Holiday Inn on the beach side (turn right out of Holiday Inn). Look out for the welcoming smile.Show less

Author: Elliot MNorthampton, United Kingdom
Title: friendly restaurant, good food
Review: Having discovered trip advisor and visited this restaurant based on recommendations then I wanted to add my thoughts:- The restaurant had 3 couples in when I got there, for October and a small place, a good sign!- Previous reviews do not lie, the owners are friendly and welcoming- food was tip top- price was very cheap- would recommend!- Oh and they do real bacon apparently (not sure what unreal bacon is...?)Show less

Author: ranajoysanyalRedmond, Washington
Title: Good food and ambience; very friendly owners add that extra bit of warmth and hospitality
Review: We had lunch at Living Room café during our visit to Penang. The place is a approx. 2 minute walk from Hotel Holiday Inn. As you come out of the Tower wing, turn left; you will see Hotel Park Royal; continue walking, and you will see a couple of restaurants to your right. Helena’s Café comes first, and next to it is the Living Room Café We tried out the Fish and Chips and a Malaysia specialty dish; both were really really good, especially the Fish and Chips. The Malaysian dishes were priced around 5RM; other items like Chicken Capitan, Fish and Chips, etc, around 12-15 RM. Had a good time chatting with Amy (one of the owners) as well. Definitely worth a visit if you are visiting Penang.Show less

Author: IDHAdelaideAdelaide, SA
Title: Deserves it's Trip Advisor rating
Review: Stopped into the Living Room cafe for dinner with our two kids. Friendly staff and great and reasonably priced food definitely warrant the Living Room as a great place to eat whilst in Batu Ferringhi and to appear high on Trip Advisor's best restaurant list. The kids were a little "noodled out" so they relished spaghetti for a change followed by tropical fruit pancakes. The curries were exceptional. Coldest beer in BF.Show less

Author: PeteandSueTamplinChertsey, United Kingdom
Title: Great food, great atmosphere and Amy just making you feel so welcome. Perfect
Review: 12 times in Penang and we have found another special place to eat. Fabulous menu and a great atmosphere. Amy makes you feel so welcome and does her best to make everything perfect every time you visit. Well done. Going back time and again. Highly recommended :-))Show less

Author: PeterCraigQueenslandQueensland
Title: Excellent, superb and friendly staff. Food perfectly prepared and presented.
Review: This place is often busy but a short chat with owners will let you know how long the waiting is and a great excuse to pass the time with a drink at their bar towards the rear of the restaurant. Looking forward to my next Penang visit early 2012 when I will have the "Living Room' at the top of my list for a visit. Hope to reunite the owners with a 'flour bag top, shorts and cap'(if I can find it) purchased mid 1970's that has historic links to the original use of the 'Living Room' premises and why many of the tables are made from old 'Singer' sewing machine bases.Show less

Author: jackw53London, United Kingdom
Title: The Standards Are Still Great
Review: It is always disappointing when you return to somewhere only to find the standards are not the same, Thankfully this is NOT the case with the Living Room. We first visited this excellent eating place back in January and were very impressed with Amy and Ben and how they operated. On our return in September we found the same welcome accompanied by the same great menue at exceptionally compentitive prices. We are working our way through the menu and so far not found anything that doesn't live up to the high standards we have come to expect from this excellent establshment - well done Amy and BenShow less

Author: puffaenquiriesNorwich, United Kingdom
Title: Batu Delight
Review: As a frequent traveller to Batu Ferringhi it was a pleasure to find this new small and quaint restaurant which is full of personal art and crafts and great food at an excellent price. The hosts Ben and Aimee take great care of their guests and I can fully recommend this restaurant the best for quality and value that I have experienced for a good few years. The strange quirk of the toilets being through the kitchen proves the cleanliness.Give it a try as they fully deserve it.I ate here 4 times in two weeks with no disappointment and with prices at £4 for a main course it is great value.Show less

Author: annexinKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: excellent host, special experience!
Review: warm, cosy and homey are the words to describe the atmosphere of the cafe. We wanted to try the 'real bacon' that the cafe claimed to serve, but it was sold out (tips: try hitting the cafe before evenings if you want to try the bacons! ) Upon the owner's recommendation, we tried the chicken chop and some western dishes, of which are all awesome especially the mushroom soup! there is one western dish that we tried which turn out to be like malaysian tosai though which i think its nice, but not so value for money. another thing to note is the chocolate milkshake, best ever!!! and the coffee is a strong recommendation too.We returned to the cafe the next morning for breakfast and tried the bacon, and its really nice!! =) =) We talked to the owner for quite a while and she is really friendly. We found out that she is a designer and in fact, most of the furniture and decorations in her cafe is handmade by her! i find the tables which is made out from worn-out sewing machines unique! **tips: you can also bring your books to exchange in the cafe, or just read some books from the bookshelf!! =)one thing worth noting is that the owner is really honest on her recommendations, as she would point out that which dish may not appear to be special among the locals or among the foreigners. =)its a wonderful highlight of my trip and i will definitely come back again! **p.s: at the end of my 2nd visit, i told the owner that i actually found out her cafe through the reviews from this website, and promised her to write an honest one! if she is seeing this, sorry for the delay and well done! =)Show less

Author: Womble1973Bedfordshire
Title: Fantastic hosts and great food
Review: We had dinner here several times during our stay in early September. Amy and Ben are lovely hosts and very welcoming. We pretty much tried everything on the menu, as did our baby, and the food was fantastic, my favourite being the asian fish. I loved the fresh lime juice, and our baby enjoyed banana juice.We highly recommend this lovely little place, eat there once and you'll be hooked!Show less

Author: missyk75Melbourne, Australia
Title: Dinner with friends, Amy and Ben the perfect hosts
Review: My Daughter, parents and I ate quite a few times at the Living Room and loved it, the food is fresh, tasty and cheap, good honest food that makes you wan to return for more. We loved the lemon chicken, steak , fried rice, and sauteed green beans were delicious, but we all went back for the pancakes my fave being with lime and honey mmm. Amy and Ben make you feel like old friends stopping to chat with interest and both so friendly, taking the time to learn your name and on return visits what you like, highly recommend this Cafe/ Restaurant, Thanks Amy and Ben We will be back Melissa, Annabelle, John and DianneShow less

Author: alit71Perth, Australia
Title: Fantastic local dining
Review: We went here several times and thoroughly enjoyed it. The owners, Amy and Ben are very friendly and if they have time sit down and chat with you. They serve "real" bacon and a good coffee. The kids thoroughly enjoyed the desserts - fried bananas or pineapple and ice cream. They serve Nyona food (chinese malaysian food) as well as some western favourites such as burgers, fish and chips, steak etc. We loved the local cuisine and it was very cheap.Show less

Author: travelmonkey1982Belfast, United Kingdom
Title: BRILLIANT!
Review: Great food, lots of choice on the menu, very friendly staff and all at a good price. They even reccomended various places for us to go/things to do/see. I would go back! Also, it was very clean and the bathroom is accessed via the kitchen so you get a chance to check that too. Also very clean. Only downside was the sandwiches. Not the as good as the rest of the menu but still good.Show less

Author: grahamhelen_11_11Blackpool, United Kingdom
Title: Great food ,Great atmosphere
Review: this newly opened restaurant is a little diamond,the food is top quality especially the dry fried noodles wich my wife has with every meal, we ate here on several occasions for evening meals and also for breakfast including full english with proper bacon,which is hard to find in penang.Amy & Ben are great host and make you feel welcome from the moment you step in,this is also a good place to go even if you only want a drink with back ground music and lovely surroundings. we came as holiday makers and left as friends, we will certainly be using the Living Room again on our next visit,thanks Ben & Amy well see you next yearGraham & HelenShow less

Author: Biggababoinka
Title: Very nice food and service
Review: Try the Thai style fish, it is the best!! Great customer service, the owner is very friendly, it is well worth the visit. Prices are good.

Author: Mel169KL
Title: warm and inviting!
Review: Having been to batu feringghi many times over the last few years, safe to say that i have enjoyed and savoured a fair amount of batu feringghi's widespread cuisine. hence, upon my most recent trip to penang, i decided to pay living room cafe a visit after reading all the rave reviews on trip advisor. after all, eating is believing! when i arrived, i was pleasantly greeted by the friendly owners and the inviting atmosphere. despite the loud music and noisy ice machine, the place was surrounded by friendly chatter and the clinking of cutlery of people enjoying their meals. now THAT is good noise.the menu options were pretty decent, not too little, not too much. Just enough options to make a fast but satisfying order. The food portion was quite generous and tasty most importantly! For the prices they charged, I would say that the customer is on the winning end. I have eaten at 4 star hotels and their quesadillas can go head to head. And i am not paying double the price! Overall, it's a good place to go to if you are looking for decent good food, somewhere to catch up with friends and observe the hustle and bustle of batu feringghi.Show less

Author: Jet Age Explora ABallarat, Australia
Title: Good atmosphere, food, service & price...
Review: We only had two nights in Penang & unfortunately we only stumbled across this gem of a cafe on the second night! As an Aussie, this cafe that has worked out & provided what we really wanted; relaxed atmosphere, decent food & drink at decent prices. The people there were very friendly, thank you for providing such a great experience.The prices on the menu is exactly what you pay at the end of your meal, inclusive of all charges & taxes. It was the only restaurant, cafe etc. I been to in Malaysia that does this. Wish a lot more of them take after this great establishment.Would love to come back to Penang just to eat there again.Show less

Author: milney2291adelaide, south australia
Title: Absolutely fantastic - Highly recommended
Review: This was the first time we dined at the Living Room - it was a fantastic meal, great service, good prices and the atmosphere was very relaxed. We loved it. The service from Amy and Ben was unbelievable they made us feel right at home.This restaurant is close to The Parkroyal Hotel and is highly recommended we can't wait to go back next year and dine here again, it was probably the best meal we have had in Penang and we have been 5 times! Next time I'm having the ribs!!!Show less

Author: rossm330Perth, Australia
Title: Friendly Service - Great Food
Review: I first visited this Cafe purely by chance. The rain started early afternoon and didn't stop. I took refuge at the cafe. I indulged my Aussie culture and received a very cold Tiger beer. I sat at the front of the cafe and enjoyed the views to the hills. The numerous potted plants were beautiful and i noticed that many of the tables used old Singer sewing machine frames. I had a very nice chicken soup.My wife and I returned a number of times for a meal, a snack or just for a beer.I gifted my Rottnest Island stubby holder to Amy when we left, so ask for it if yr reading this.Show less

Author: crosslefPerth, Australia
Title: Delicious food for family with young children
Review: We ate here several times throughout our 8 days in the area. The couple that run the cafe were delightful and so happy to accommodate the needs of our fussy 3 year old. They even made chicken nuggets for him one night! The food was tasty and the menu was comprehensive. I would strongly recommend this cafe!Show less

Author: Pouxinette
Title: Excellent, good prices & Friendly
Review: Living room cafe quickly became the best spot in Batu Ferringhi! Great food, excellent service all within a very nice price! Ask for the recommendation or for fresh fish plates which may not be on the card, you won't regret it!! Ingrid & Marjorie

Author: FordyPerthPerth, Australia
Title: Not expensive and great food
Review: We spent one of our first nights in Penang at this restaurant, as I had checked out Trip Advisor prior to going to Penang found that this restaurant was voted #1 so decided to try it out and I personally was not dissapointed but some of the others we were with did not really enjoy their meals, but definately worth trying out the food at "The Living Room".Service was great and we could not really ask for much more. The meals are really quite in expensive so if you are on a budget you will not be let down by this restaurant.Show less

Author: Colleen A
Title: Enjoyable meal and very friendly staff
Review: Our taxi driver recommended this place on our last day so unfortunately we only had one night to try it out. Food was lovely  - especially the salt & pepper calamari.

Author: chrisbrocklebankWeymouth, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent food & very friend atmosphere
Review: I'm taking the time to review "The Living Room" because we feel you should not miss this little gem in Batu Ferringhi, and its fair to say I dont usually take the time to comment/rate, but on this occasion I feel its a must to highlight this gem for fellow travellers.Owned & run by Ben & Amy, we spent 10 of 14 nights eating here!If you want fast food, go to McDonalds, if your looking for real authentic food cooked in a relaxed & very friendly environment you should eat here! They cater for Asian & European tastes.Its great value for money & excellent portions to go.Our family of 4 tried almost everything on the menu & were not disappointed, Ben & Amy really try to make you feel at home.Thank you Ben & Amy for making our visit memorableSue, Chris, Ross & TomUKShow less

Author: KiwilassChristchurch, New Zealand
Title: Good for the western palate
Review: Good range of dishes for the western palate.I had a fish curry and it was beautiful,light and delicate flavours.I think that this is a good restaurant to go to first during your trip so you can get a taste of malaysian cuisine western style!!!the service was fantasic,warm and inviting!!! Show less

Author: maggs1Bunbury, Australia
Title: "BEST BY FAR"
Review: We tried restaurant on the first day of our 12 day holiday as I had read such good reviews on TA. We were not disappointed and spent most lunch times and a lot of evenings here.  From the moment we set foot in the restaurant we were made to feel most welcome by Amy and Ben, we really felt like we were visiting with old friends. The meals were delicious, (My daughter recommends the Mushroom Soup) Service was wonderful, as was the conversation, this restaurant is a great way to start or end the day.If you are going to Batu Ferringhi I recommend that you visit early in your stay as you will want to go back again and again.Can't wait to go back.Show less

Author: Annarina
Title: Wonderful place! Friendly owners.
Review: First time in Penang. We ate here a number of times. Food and service great. Amy and Ben the owners were very friendly and helpful. Real coffee and fresh food. Watermelon juice was awesome. Highly recommend to everyone traveling to Batu Ferringhi.

Author: PeteTurnerBracknell, United Kingdom
Title: Pretty Good
Review: Visited the Living Room after reading the many good TA reviews, and found it very pleasant, mainly because of the friendly service/welcomeFood was good, and service was very friendly - so if you fancy a change from Long Beach it is worth a visit.Restaurant is fairly small and basic - I only mention this as Amy told me that many people arrive expecting someting grander, and it is not grand - similiar to the Boatman (also very good), and several other similar restaurants. Fairly extensive menu, and reasonably priced wine and beer (you can also take your own and pay corkage)The restaurant is opposite the Yahong Art Gallery, just past the police station (if coming from Golden Sands direction)Show less

Author: c1deb2017Woodvale, Australia
Title: delicious food
Review: after taking advise from trip advisor, went to see for ourselves what this restaurant was like and true to what everyone's been saying on trip advisor, the food was great and Amy was so nice we felt like we were visiting an old friend. we really enjoyed the food and the company very much. Thanks Amy it was very nice to have met you.Show less

Author: PennyPenangDarwin, Australia
Title: Disappointing
Review: After reading the great reviews in Trip Advisor and having friends staying with us we decided to go along and try it out. Whilst the food was ok, we must have been there on a bad day as the service was not up to standard, it was noisy with the music too loud and the ice machine grinding constantly in the background. Sadly it just did not live up to our expectationsShow less

Author: JerryThirteenKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Living R00M ~ It's worth the efforts going there !!
Review: Hi folks, we were there on 21 June 2011 to have lunch. Sure, it wasn't easy to locate the bistro rightaway. So for direction to the Living Room, please read on for the details. The LR is located along the arterial road, Batu Ferringhi, on the seaward side. Driving up from Georgetown to BF direction, you should be able to find the LR soon after you have passed the Holiday Inn & Park Royal Hotel. It is located next door to the Ferringhi Garden Restaurant and almost directly opposite the Yahong Art Gallery. You may take Rapid Bus #101 - airconditioned, from Komtar to BF. Bus fare ~ RM2.70 ~ 45 mins journey.It is open everyday except Wednesday - (10 am to 10 pm, approximately)..... Hey, Amy and Ben need a break too. haha.We tried the signature dishes such as Salt & Pepper Squid, Fried Chicken Thai style and some fresh vegetables. The owner, Ms Amy ~ gets her stocks delivered fresh & directly from fisherman or from Ben's farm. So customers are assured of good quality food and not those deep-freezed stuff. Isn't that nice? We actually witnessed how some fishes were delivered to the doorstep by the fisherman on a scooter on that afternoon. Beside the food price is reasonable; you could even get your favourite beer, wine or even expresso- coffee to go with you meal if you fancy. ~um ... good food plus good ambience. Additionally, Amy is eco-friendly and she cares about the environment too. Just take a look at the wooden furnitures and decor there. The bar counter is made from recycled hardwood from a previous shop and the wasted wooden windows are creatively made into beautiful table-top. Obselete k-legs from redundant sewing machines are salvaged and turned into robust supports for the dining tables. Drift wood and tree bark are cleverly converted into art pieces and lamp shades. An excellent efforts to Saving Gaia !A cordial couple who is so willing to make your dining experience there 10/10. Thanks!Show less

Author: HokiangaNorthland, New Zealand
Title: Fantastic Food, friendly owner
Review: Went to the Living Room on 3 occasions on our last trip to Penang. Usually we only eat at Long Beach but called in there one lunch time and had the best Chicken Kapitain ever. My partner has squid prepared a different way each time and it was cooked to perfection. Next time, I had Prawn Kapitain (Nonya) and it was even better. The owner given half a chance will sit with you and talk about her food and life in general. While it was not a priority for us, the Living Room serves pork which can be difficult to find in a Muslim country. All in all, we will make this a regular haunt for subsequent trips to Penang.Show less

Author: Thetraveller98Rugby, United Kingdom
Title: Where to eat in Batu Ferringhi!
Review: The major Hotels and restaurants in Batu Ferringhi are generally expensive to eat at. There are of course many reasonably priced places to eat. However, I found one cafe/restaurant worth a visit!! The food whether it be breakfast, lunch or dinner was great and REAL bacon for breakfast!! The hosts were friendly, welcoming and very helpful with any questions you may have about the area of Batu Ferringhi. The cafe is situated about 200m north of the Holiday Inn on the beach side of the road. Give it a try as I am sure you will not be disappointed. Thank you Ben and Amy for the wonderful food and your hospitality!!!!:)Show less

Author: lyallrichardsPerth, Australia
Title: Hospitable, friendly and great value
Review: Amy and Ben are a most friendly and hospitable hosts, the restaurant has a really friendly atmosphere where you feel most welcome. They serve real bacon for breakfast and the best salt and pepper squid ever. The drinks are cold and it's the best place for breakfast lunch or dinner.Show less

Author: PeteFeran
Title: Great Local Restaurant
Review:
The Living Room restaurant is a fantastic little restaurant in the heart of Batu Ferringi. The food is great, cheap and the best thing is the service. The host/owner is fantastic!!!
Will definitely recommend to those travelling to Batu Ferringhi, Penang.

Author: thewarenGeelong, Australia
Title: Best Salt 'n Pepper Squid around
Review: Went for a meal into Living Room because it was recommended by Tripadvisor and we were not disappointed. In fact we loved it so much, we went back again for the yummy homemade spring rolls and delicious salt'n pepper squid. The owner Amy was so helpful during our first visit she recommended our entire meal (4 adults) and she supplied us with the best food in town, not to mention best value. Would go back again and againShow less

Author: RichRach1970Stoke-on-Trent, United Kingdom
Title: The Living room cafe/bar good cheap food in a friendly atmosphere.
Review: The Living room cafe/bar serves good cheap food and drinks from 9.30am till late. The cafe itself has a very relaxed atmosphere and we were instantly made welcome from the moment we walked in. All sorts of exotic plants are dotted about the place hanging from the walls which just adds to the ambiance.I would recommend this cafe to anyone, 10 out of 10.Show less

Author: Hilar21
Title: Great food, great service, great atmosphere, what a find!!
Review:
Really enjoyed out visits to the Living Room, it was hard to walk past and find something else, so we did'nt bother, as this was truly the place to visit! 
Quirky and unique decor and very much welcomed by the owners!

Author: Essexman08Essex, UK
Title: Excellent little cafe
Review: The Living Room is a wonderful little bistro restuarant. Amy and Ben always find the time to check on how you are enjoying the food and welcome any comments. The place is usually busy which adds to the feel of a cosy little meeting place. The signature dishes of pancake rolls and salt and pepper squid are superb, as is the rest of the menu. You should also note that they pay the same level of detail to those guests who are a little shy of ordering something local and prefer to keep to burger and chips. The prices are very reasonable, infact one of the best value for money places you'll find on the whole strip.Show less

Author: Irene43056Milton Keynes, United Kingdom
Title: Didn't want to eat anywhere else!
Review: Tried this little gem of a restaurant on our first day of an 8 day holiday as I had read such good reviews on TA. We were not disappointed. The moment we set foot in the restaurant we were made to feel most welcome by Amy and Ben. The meals were delicious and Amy would spend time explaining each dish. Indeed my husband tried different dishes of varying sizes of prawns in a variety of sauces each evening. Amy also put us in touch with a taxi driver - Jason Sim - who put together a most marvellous tour of Penang over 4 days. The good company, good food and excellent sight-seeing absolutely made our holiday and can't wait to come back!Show less

Author: TheRuddos
Title: Excellent value and friendly service
Review: Well worth a visit, the food was good, the owner was very friendly and helpful with choosing dishes even though my husband had chips with every meal!

Author: Us52Perth, Australia
Title: A great little cafe with good food
Review: Like many others before us we found this lovely cafe through T/A.We walked up from the Golden Sands one hot, steamy and slightly rainy evening and hoped it was going to be worth it. It certainly was as the food was great and hosts very welcoming. We shared the Capitan Chicken (cooked to your liking - mild, medium or hot) and the Salt and Pepper Squid. We loved both and don't think we have ever eaten squid so tender. The stir fried vegetables, we chose to go with it, were very fresh and still had a yummy crunch.The drinks list has juices, soft drinks etc and beer. I asked if they had wine and a nice cold glass of SB was placed in front of me. I don't know why it's not on the menu but if you ask you can have red or white.This is a cafe with good food and good prices. They even make mention of their T/A fame on the black board out the front!Show less

Author: onziegMcLaren Vale, Australia
Title: Lovely food, very cheap but got that british tourist abroad vibe!!!
Review: We visited The living room cafe last night and were impressed with the food. I had the sweet and sour chicken, which was lovely, it tasted exactly like the one from our local Chinese in Australia. My bf had penangs famous noodle dish which also was delish and only cost $1.75! There was limited choice of drinks, no wine or cocktails but beer and cider very reasonably priced!If your after an authentic Penang experience this isn't the place, the other 8 tables were all vacated by Brits or Aussies. I would say it was a good place to take young, slightly fussy kids or if you like your home comforts while on holiday! You will get a lovely meal at a low price!Show less

Author: WorldwideTraveller95Yateley, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent Food, lovely people, ate best 2 meals in Penang here
Review: We visited this restaurant following reviews on Trip Adviser, we had the most beautiful food best Fish & Chips I have ever eaten anywhere in the world and the Beef Capitan was absolutely delicious. They have a vast menu of Asian and Western food. We were in Penang for 8 days and ate in expensive restaurants and hotels before finding this treasure. We would highly recommend this if you like good food and good company as Amy & Ben welcome you in to their lovely restaurantShow less

Author: Daniel_BelandaMalaysia
Title: Very good Malaysian food
Review: We tried sweet & sour chicken all over Malaysia, this was one of the best. The lemon chicken was very tasteful and a Heineken beer for just RM11.All the food was very well prepared and tasteful and for us this place is on the same level of food quality as neighbour Helena's, where excellent Indian food is served.Our only remark was that the food was not spicy as we love spicy food. But the owner responded quickly by bringing chopped chili's and soya sauce.Total price for 2 persons RM52. This place is definitely worth a high ranking place.Date of visit 26 May '11Show less

Author: GissysLytham St Anne's, United Kingdom
Title: Good food, great value for money, marvellous hospitality
Review: Paid 4 visits to the Living room (including breakfast this morning) whilst in Batu F for 5 days. Food is very good value for money, the welcome from Amy & Ben could not be faulted. We were on first name terms very quickly and each of the owners came and sat with us offering good help and advice. When we were there or whenever we walked past there were always people in the place - unlike many other places who try and entice you in from the pavement.If you want a refreshing drink try Amy's Banana Juice, it is just exceptional. If you have finished reading your book there are a few to swap at the top end of the cafe.Show less

Author: gloandbobLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Can 50 TA reviewers be so wrong, or were we incredibly unlucky
Review: We tried this restaurant in anticipation following the reviews in TA but were bitterly disappointed.Perhaps our Aussie friends fit the bill here better, because everyone else (it has about 10 tables) seemed to be from the other side of the world to us, and all seemed to be enjoying themsleves.Starters - calamari/spring rolls. Former rubbery, latter pretty good - mind you I can make decent spring rolls!Main course - before we got it the waitress brought it out and tried to give it to about half the tables, before realising it was ours. My wife's chicken dish was ok, other than the overpowering sauce. I had beef with black pepper sauce. There was so much sauce, it was dripping over the dish, and I thought I was home having my Sunday lunch as there seemed to be a strong taste of Bisto gravy! I left most of it.There was no "did you not like your meal"? Our plates were taken away, we would not have had sweet, more drinks or coffee, but we were not given the chance as the bill arrived. Fortunately it came to a nice round sum, which I deposited on the table and we left. No "goodnight" from the staff.There are much better options in Batu FerringhiShow less

Author: Enqvistlim
Title: Great place to hang out
Review:
been there once and the food is awesome, price is reasonable. definitely will return for other nice food. 

Penang Food Review, http://tasteiest.blogspot.com

Author: GHGB
Title: Good value for money
Review: We ate here once. My food was good, my wife's OK. Service was excellent on arrival, when there were few other customers; it slowed right down as the place filled up, as the effects of having only 2 people to cover the tables and the...More

Author: penangvisitor
Title: Sensational food easily enticed us to return
Review: With a great variety of tasty food (the salt and pepper squid was succulently tender and to die for), and a friendly owner and staff, we found space for a return visit during our short stay in Penang. If overwhelmed by choices, be guided by...More

Author: gothere123
Title: The food blew us away
Review: In search of good non-hotel food, we took a short walk from Hard Rock Hotel to Living Room Cafe. Our first meal there (dinner) consisted of Thai style fish (nicely fried fillet, crispy on the outside and flaky within, with sweet/sour Thai sauce underneath, served...More

Author: guildfordians
Title: yay we found it
Review:
JUSt got back from penang
we read about this cafe in trip advisor , it took us a while to track it down and find it but once we found it it was a great find.
The food is awesome and a must try are...More

Author: CCSandL
Title: Great food, great prices,fresh,clean,authentic,worth a visit.
Review: Found this place on the second last day of our holiday, we dont eat in hawker stalls or markets, only hotels, as food hygiene and freshness is a priority. Word of mouth and recommendations made us try out the Living room and we were pleased...More

Author: AussieDogga
Title: Lovely hosts and great food
Review:
Lovely hosts with excellent food and coffee. We ended up going here 3 mornings in a row for their coffee and were greeted with excellent hospitality every time.
Thanks guys! From Luke and Jenni

Author: JanetCook
Title: best cafe/restuarant in Batu Ferringhi
Review: What makes this place special are the Chinese owners Ben & Amy, who are the most warm and friendly people you could ever meet. We were only in Penang for 5 nights but in that short time they made us feel like we'd been friends...More

Author: Shroet
Title: Great food, great people, great price would recommend to anyone!!
Review: We were recommend this place and ate there every night, the service and food was fantastic and the hosts are very helpful

Author: KelvinPg
Title: Cosy,great service & good food
Review: Located within walking distance of Park Royal Hotel, Batu Ferringhi, Living Room definitely is the restaurant that lives up to expectation. Varieties of food from western to local. Price is reasonable. Kitchen is clean. So is washroom. Good hospitality too. It is still kind fo...More

Author: monambyth
Title: Great Hosts !
Review: Amy and Ben at the Living Room cafe are great hosts. The food is tasty and very reasonably priced, we tried the local breakfast on Amy's recommendation, and it was delicious. It was a great place to walk to down the beach from our hotel,...More

Author: GordonAdamsMusicCoventry, United Kingdom
Title: Wonderful Hosts, Wonderful Food, Wonderful Music
Review: I stayed in Batu Ferringhi for 7 weeks and my first choice cafe was always The Living Room.Ben and Amy were always welcoming, freindly and helpful even at the busiest times. Food was always good , they have great chefs in the kitchen. The living room has a nice atmosphere and good music to relax to, I miss my english breakfasts, evening meal and beers and most of all the warm company of Ben and Amy.Show less

Author: Milotennis
Title: Great Food Great Hosts
Review:
First visit to Batu Ferringhi Wont be our last
The Living Room came highly recommended on Trip Advisor & we were not disappointed
Great Food & Friendly hosts
Try the Salt & Pepper Squid & the Chicken Thai Style  Yummy!!!

Author: kenwadePeterborough, United Kingdom
Title: A much visit!
Review: Made the longish walk(and hot)from the Lone Pine Hotel on the recomendation of Tripadvisor reviews. Well worth it as the food, sevice and atmosphere where second to none. Despite being busy they both still had time for a chat.We ordered four dishes and cold drinks and I can honestly say everything was great and the price was fantastic!!Really hope they make it work, but there is a lot of compatition along the strip and I bet overheads are not cheap. Give them a helping had and do your self a favour and eat here at least once on your stay in Penang.Show less

Author: FrankiehibeeScotland
Title: A new restaurant but what a treat
Review: This is a new restaurant which shows signs of great promise. It is owned by a very hard working couple who go out of their way to make visitors comfortable and welcome. The food is excellent and the choice is overwhelming.. Unlikely you would find something you did not enjoy. Michael the chef is outstanding and produces mouth watering dishes. The restaurant is very clean and tidy and the host and hostess make sure your requirements are up to a very high standard. Sometimes they are rushed and you may have to wait for your order but we can assure you it is well worth waiting for. As a personal preference we would like to see the restaurant close earlier in the afternoon and reopen from 5.30 pmShow less

Author: PlanetJames04Slough, United Kingdom
Title: Great food and now great friends
Review: Once again, prompted by reviewers on this site we just had to check this place out - and aren't we glad. Our mains were Prawn Kapitan and Sweet & Sour Fish. My wife resisted pud but I had Banana pancake and ice cream. What can I say that hasn't been said already about the wonderful flavours they conjour up with good quality ingredients. And their coffee would teach some Italians a thing or two.The food alone was enough to give this place 5 Stars, but what really made our night were the so very amiable owners Amy, and her good natured husband Ben. You immdeditely get the feeling that they really want you you to enjoy everything, not just the food and your time in their restaurant, but also the time you spend in Penang.We arrived as new customers, full of anticipation. We left happy, fulfilled and friends - and judging how busy the retausrant is each time we pass it, they have many friends.And, oh yes, the prices are very reasonable too.JamesShow less

Author: 259HappyTravellerBrisbane, Australia
Title: Living Room Cafe - Highly Recommended
Review: We visited this restaurant based on the positive reviews on Trip Advisor. We were not dissapointed. It was so good, we went back more than once during our stay. The salt and pepper squid and curry chicken were especially fantastic. The friendly service made us feel very comfortable and we were never rushed to finish our meals. The owner is a polite and hospitable lady who makes a great host and will recommend dishes to you. The restaurant is clean and the meals are very good value. We really enjoyed eating here and hope you will too.Show less

Author: Nomad_Chris_1975
Title: A must try!
Review:
Go there just for the Salt & Pepper Squid - it's the best in Penang!
Great atmosphere, delicious menu, Amy & Ben are so friendly and welcoming. And they have real bacon!
Make sure you visit and say hi.

Author: SMH1160
Title: Amy is very amicable!
Review: Just got back from lovely meal - highly recommend Salt & Pepper Squid and chicken curry Kaptain - all on Amy's recommendations.  Looking forward to pork ribs on Friday.  Thanks Amy!

Author: Mitch_sing18
Title: Laid back family run business. Serving good food at cheap prices.
Review: We ate here twice. Had steamed fish and fried rice the first time and the second time opted for the owner's recommendation: salt and pepper squid and Thai style chicken. Both times we had the chicken satay as a starter. The staff are friendly and down to earth and new to the business. The food is good and great value. Portions are filling but not too big. One of the few places we found with a crowd. Show less

Author: sandrabayfieldManchester, United Kingdom
Title: fabulous
Review: this is a must ben and amy great host nothing to much trouble bens the man for chocolate milk shakes everything the chefs cook is very tasty also met lots of nice people in here only been home a week missing them all already cant wait to go back john and sandra manchesterShow less

Author: ollymac_9_10Kent UK
Title: Great find-go try
Review: Ate at this restaurant a few times in the evening on a recent holiday to Penang.Situated off the main street and you dont get hassled to go in and eat-which can be a welcome relief unlike some establishments.Its small but the decor, furniture and abiance is great as are the prices of both food and drinkFood was excellent quality and service efficient.-only slight downside was that the portions were no overly large-but with prices this good just order an extra dish or starter. The hosts are great and happy to chat or share advice and as a nice touch as we were there just prior to them closing for chinese New Year we were given a present of Oranges for each of us.All in all we recommend to anyoneShow less

Author: Al-Donna-ZanePerth, Australia
Title: We loved it!
Review: This was our first trip to Penang and after trying a couple of the more expensive places in town we decided to give the Living Room a go as it had caught our eye as we had walked past it on previous nights.Needless to say we were not disappointed and subsequently ate hear for the next 5 nights in a row. Amy and Ben are the terrific hosts and always find the time to come and have a chat and make you feel welcome.My eleven year old fussy son was in heaven with his real bacon and egg white toasted sandwich and I can safely say that the salt and pepper said was the best I have beer had! We can't wait for our next trip to enjoy the food and hospitality of this great little place.Show less

Author: ADandSA-GunnBerkshire, England
Title: Great Hosts, Fantastic Food & Good Value for money
Review: We visted this restaurant on a number of occasions during our short stay in Penang(for Breakfast , lunch & dinner). We found the hosts(Ben & Amy) to be most amiable & a great source of local knowledge. The food was fantastic (we tried the traditional local dish of Nyonya) and it was superb.Would thoroughly reccomend to anyone!.Show less

Author: Laura SBrisbane, Australia
Title: great food and service
Review: This is a great little restaurant. Clean, cheap, good service, and a very friendly owner. They don't harass you out on the sidewalk as lots of other places do. They have a high-chair and accommodate little people with a smile. We enjoyed all the food and ate here several times.Show less

Author: cathotatewegKaitangata, New Zealand
Title: Excellent food, service, drinks, decor and atmosphere!
Review: Travelling alone I was stoked to stumble across this place on my first night. As everyone else has said the welcoming atmosphere and good priced food is what makes it so tempting to go back for every meal. I was staying in the area for 3 days and ate every meal here. Amy was always really helpful to me in showing and telling me about things to do in the area. 10/10!Show less

Author: sunshineseekerUKuk
Title: A ray of sunshine!
Review: My husband and I stumbled upon this place on our first day in Batu Ferringi. We had stupidly decided to go for a walk along the strip in the hottest part of the day and needed to escape the hot sunshine! We were welcomed as old friends straight away. The food and value for money was outstanding and we ate here several times during our holiday. The salt and pepper squid is the best we have ever tastest. If you fancy it pork is available on the menu. Would recommend it to anyone staying in this area. Lovely!Show less

Author: jackw53London, United Kingdom
Title: Deserves it's Number One Position
Review: Having been returning visitosr to Penang we wanted somewhere to eat and on checking TA this place came up. Boy was the visit worthwhile. Everything said about the ambience, value and welcome is bang on the mark. We were greeted as if we were old customers and quickly realised most of the clientele were just that which speaks volumes in itself.The menu is varied and we went for local and it did not disappoint. The value was exceptional and at least half of what we were paying elsewhere on "the strip" with not the same standards of service or cooking.Show less

Author: ChevycLeigh, United Kingdom
Title: Fantastic food, excellent service. You must eat here
Review: Visited in October, the Living Room had not been open long. It really is a great pplace to eat. The owner, Amy, was excellent, explaining how she had use recycled items to create the tables, we had an excellent carved wooden table. The menu was wide ranging and excellently presented. It tasted as good as it looked. We somewhat stumbled on this pace, near to a fancy over done restaurant, only criticism is to make the actual menu look a bit better. This place is excellent, nicely priced, I will go there again.Show less

Author: NorwayTravellersNorway
Title: The best place in Batu Ferringhi
Review: If you ever go to Penang, then you have to visit Amy and Ben at the Living Room Cafe. Everything is good here; The food, the service, the atmosphere, the surroundings +++They serve breakfast, lunch and dinner, which are all highly recommended. They serve real pork bacon, which is a big plus. All together we were staying in Penang for over two weeks, and we ate here almost every night. Most of the dishes was tested out, and I can't say a bad thing about any of them!!! The service is also great here! Amy and Ben have plenty of time to talk to their guests, and they are so friendly! We made two new good friends during our stay :-)Show less

Author: SM2RattlerU.K.
Title: Do not pass it by...
Review: This little place is a real find, Ben and Amy are the standout hosts on an island filled with happy, smiling people. The food is incredible - menu or otherwise, I let the chef decide what to cook for me and it was always incredible. The beers are as cold as the welcome is warm, a real home from home. I watched many people stop to look at the menu and move on, maybe they were waiting to be pestered to come inside (as they would be not so very far up the road) or were hoping for some flash of inspiration to strike them - all I can say is that they missed out on something very special.Staying in Penang for a while and need a new book - speak to Ben, he'll swap what you have for what he has.On another island or in another city this would be right up there with the best, here it simply is the best - it hasn't been open long but if it isn't a complete success then there is something (else) very wrong with the world. If you are in Batu Ferringhi then do not pass it by!Show less

Author: S3353FFpaulrDublin, Ireland
Title: What a find!!! Don't go to Penang and not go here
Review: My girlfriend and myself stumbled across the Living Room whilst waiting for our hotel room to be made available and we are so glad that we found it we chose it as it was the onlyplace that did not have anyone standing on the street thrusting menus in our faces. The Living Room is a new addition to the Batu Ferringhi landscape and is run by Ben and Amy, the most amazing hosts where nothing is too much trouble.The cafe itself is a triumph in design and recycling with some of the tables being made from old sewing machines and the others coming from the original shops windows. All the plants have come from Ben's garden.Now the important bit the food. The food is excellent and Amy is more than happy to discuss where the ingredients come from and is more than happy to get the chef to make dishes that are not on the menu or not sold anywhere else. On our first day we noticed that they sold real pork bacon and being a little cheeky asked for pork ribs, i was told that they were special order as they get them fresh from the butcher and they marinade them for twelve hours, not put off i requested them for two days later (not expecting to get them). We returned as promised and as i walked in to the cafe i could smell them, i ordered three portions and can happily saythey were amongst the best ribs i have ever had.I would easily recommend this cafe and i can proimise that if you go you will not be disappointedShow less

Author: schellsshesellsKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: best on the strip!
Review: ben, amy & the ‘squeeky clean kitchen team’ at the living room cafe run the best show on the batu ferringhi strip. friendly hosts, fabulous meals, tiger beers you can slug from the bottle with aussie stubbie holders to keep the beverage ice cold and great coffee all in a beaut little garden setting all make the living room your best choice when venturing out in batu ferringhi. check out the uber-comfy, over-sized wide bottom wooden bar stools, oddly shaped sawn log tables, tables made from old doors with stained glass highlights and a few sturdy tables built atop classic singer sowing machine units. all this stuff in a trendy cafe in london or sydney would not only be the talk of the town but would cost a fortune. prices here however, are down to earth. no need to study the menu, amy will delight you with suggestions about what's fresh in from the market on the day. also don't forget to bring a book. ben used to trade second hand books and now runs a 'book swap' club with a stack of great novels!living room café is located just down from the mosque opposite the yahong art gallery. highly recommended, do yourself a favour!Show less

Author: crinkly52North Yorkshire
Title: great newcomer to Batu Ferringhi eating
Review: Checked out The Living Roomn yesterday and it was just what it promises to be. A very friendly cosy eating spot. Great food - good menu choices. Amy and Ben are really good hosts. Will certainly go there again and will also tell all my friends to try it.Show less

Author: Hellolc
Title: Fresh, amazing food. Lovely staff!
Review: Skip the hotel restaurants, this could be some of the best honest food in sth east Asia. Great menu constantly changing depending on what dishes are popular, staff are wonderful and give great recommendations. Try the squid, no teeth required it's that fresh. You can get a meal for 2 for the price of some hotel cocktails. 10/10Show less

Author: Globaljoy
Title: High potential newcomer
Review: Lovely service and food; great coffee and cozy decorated. Go and see/ taste yourself! Sanitair is very clean although entry is via kitchen. Since the kitchen is clean it doesn't bothering at all. All and all and an excellent contribution to the neighborhood!

Author: GooddRiddance
Title: Very good
Review: Nice people, serving good coffee and they actually got the bacon right. It's quality, well-priced and great atmosphere.

Author: BigozpeteMelbourne, Australia
Title: Home from home
Review: Had dinner here a few nights ago. Service from Amy was wonderful, as was the conversation. Food is excellent and very well priced. Four adults with a few drinks was around AU$ 60. (depending on what you eat or drink of course)Selection of local and western food, she serves Pork chops and mash once a week, check which day with her.Show less

Author: anjoneli26wales
Title: inviting, friendly, best coffee
Review: we were in batu ferringhi in november stayed for 2 weeks before moving on to langkawi.we could not get a decent cup of coffee anywhere until we went to the livingroom. ben and Amy were warm and friendly with the best latte and flat white. We had breakfast there on numerous occassions this was always excellent. From the park royal turn right continue straight past the turning to the beach, 3 cafes down. WE would recommend this cafe and will return on our next visit to penang.Show less

Author: LynnandQAberdeen, United Kingdom
Title: This restaurant were friendly, very clean, great food what more can I Say...
Review: Ben & Amy own this restaurant which is just opened tucked away at the side of Ferringhi Garden. The chef has came from the Holiday Inn and has won awards in cooking and the food is excellent and a very reasonable priced. For breakfast we had two slices toast with two poached eggs and bacon (this is the only place we managed to get proper bacon), also the best coffee in town!!! We ate here most of the time, we did try other places but always ended up back here especially for breakfast! The proprietors are very friendly and full of information if you may need to know where to shop, tourist attractions etc. Also, the music that Ben plays is the best! You can't go to Batu Ferringhi and not visit this cafe/bar!Show less

Author: Millie_673511
Title: Simple yet delicious malaysian cuisine
Review: It's was my first time having dinner with friend at Mews.The cucur udang and spaghetti masak aglio e olio is so delicious.The caramelised banana fritters paired with ice cream is yummy too..Most of the staff there are polite and friendly especially Mr AJ..Surely will be back again!Show less

Author: Graeme L
Title: Great lunch
Review: We went in for a late lunch.  AJ tbe waiter was most helpful. Roti Baba and two types of mie were ordered. All were very tasry and reasonably priced.

Author: bobbyong99Batu Ferringhi, Malaysia
Title: Great experience
Review: Being new in Penang we were looking forward to look for new places to eat. With dine in allowed, we want tonight to experience it. We were the only table tonight. Had a bottle of wine and the local fusion food tasted good. We like the atmosphere with nice outdoor sitting. Service was attentive too. Plenty of road side parking .. should be a good place for brunch too. Must try Show less

Author: henrysusanti
Title: Tasty and Creative Food
Review: Delicious food, all dare spices food are tasty especially Moroccan Food on my first attempt. From appetiser , salads, pita bread to grill fish; so good! Very recommended!

Author: Chris CSingapore, Singapore
Title: Great place to have birthday dinners
Review: Elegant and vintage feel to this restaurant tucked in the old part of Georgetown, you feel like you're dining with history and the food is perfect - crabs, seafood and different dishes. Old horse stables and architecture give you a feel of what Penang was like before. Highly recommendedShow less

Author: dila2lala
Title: Great food, place & services
Review: This place is so cozy & comfortable for small gatherings with families or hangout with friends. I organized my aunty's birthday & my colleague bachelorette because I love the ambience as well as the food. Surrounded by green, I could feel the warmth of this place. Very clean and hygiene inside & outside. The servers especially AJ is very attentive & professional. I'm so impressed that they get our orders without writing it down on the paper. Good memory!! As for the food, I've tried all in the menu & everything is good esp cucur udang and curry me! Hope they keep the good work & maintain the quality of the food & services.Show less

Author: Sooria_PragashPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Food is Good
Review: I and my son came over to check out the ambiance and the food. The ambiance is beautiful and well decorated with plants especially the outdoor. The food we ordered was simple finger food. Satay and cucur udang ( prawn fritters) . It was very delicious really our of the world. Never in my mind I taught this place will service good appetizer.Show less

Author: dr_ganltSubang Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Fabulous Penang Food
Review: Nice and cozy cafe with authentic interior deco. Located in the Munrti Mews Hotel. in the hertage area of Georgetown. Good ambience and comfortable. Good range of food to choose. Five of us had different choices: Helen's Curry Mee, Mee Rebus, Nasi Kunyit Rendan, Nasi Goreng and Sayor Lodeh. Nice and tasty food. Friendly service.Show less

Author: LociOwen
Title: Hygiene, good service and impeccable local delicacies
Review: Being a local here, i enjoyed the ambiance and personal servicing. No doubt, you are able to try out a handful of different local delicacies that ensure you have the treat of Penang. No doubt, I usually accompany with a glass house wine as well. :)Show less

Author: shearersx4Canberra
Title: First rate food and service every time
Review: As an expat who has lived in Penang for four years I can recommend Mews Cafe as a destination for superb food and excellent service every visit. The menu has a great selection of dishes that can be shared, which is advisable as everything is delicious and this allows you to sample as many tasty options as possible. Don't be fooled by simple sounding menu items like Garlic Cheese Naan - the flavour is exceptional and the light and delicately flavoured chick pea curry it's served with is incredible. Similarly, the satay is a cut above. The mocktails are refreshing and should not be missed and save a little space for the Kuih Sago which is cool and sweet and the perfect finish to any combination of dishes. Even a pot of tea is done beautifully at Mews Cafe. The staff are attentive and responsive and always professional. The attention to detail in the service and the stylish surroundings makes Mews Cafe a calm and charming spot to relax and escape the heat and the hustle and bustle of Georgetown.Show less

Author: Mallory M
Title: Delicious and affordable
Review: We stopped here for dinner without a reservation and they found us a nice table outside. Food was delicious. Great place for traditional Malaysian food. Nice outdoor seating area. Reasonable prices and good service.

Author: DKTravelPixManchester, United Kingdom
Title: I had longed for it be as remembered.
Review: I first visited The Mews Cafe around 3 years ago when staying just up the street at the wonderful Muntri Hotel. On that occasion I ate a memorable meal, a coconut based prawn curry that was simply divine and had me raving about this place since and longing to return. Return I did last night with my partner and my expectations. The decor hasn't changed, nor does it need to as it has a nice French bistro style ambience. On ordering drinks glasses of ice chilled water were brought to the table which I thought a nice touch. Onto the food, my partner ordered a Prawn Nassi Lemak and found it underwhelming and a bit stingy on the prawns, he got 2. The prawns were marinated in what was described as a tamarind based sauce. Now I am a huge fan of tamarind, but this was a letdown lacking in depth of uncotous sticky flavour. I was delighted to see the dish I had raved about for years was still on the menu. Unfortunately, this too although good, lacked the depth of flavour of the original being a little too thin in consistency. I guess if it proves anything, an amazing meal is probably best preserved as a delightful memory. The question, will I be back? The answer on this one is a no I'm afraid as there are far too many good new places to try in Penang in persuit of taste sensation. Show less

Author: goncaloluz
Title: Tasty, well served local/fusion delicacies, and food
Review:
A friendly and warm place to try some well done local and fusion food.
Been there two times and really enjoyed the service and the food.

Author: sch8Singapore, Singapore
Title: Yummy
Review: We came here for dinner on the first day of Chinese New Year. The surrounding street was Super quiet. As for the restaurant, it was quite small. We were early but gradually filled up. Nonetheless, the food was generally scrumptious. We ordered the rendang, laksa and curry mee. I'd recommend the laksa (tasted similar to Assam laksa) and rendang. Really really good. We also had the rojak. I found the taste a little strange (it smelled like the sea) and not like the rojak I am used to eating. Prices were reasonable. Definitely would recommend this place. Show less

Author: iammarsSingapore, Singapore
Title: Nothing special
Review: This place was recommended so we thought we would try it out. And while it was nice and all, I wouldn't necessarily recommended it myself. I usually try to eat vegetarian or vegan, but this place had little to no options in those categories so I had the Beef Rendang instead. It was ok without being great.Show less

Author: Trivinator
Title: Nice place to rest.
Review: Very friendly staff and nice and cool to get out of the heat.  The beef rendang is excellent. Good for breakfast too.

Author: Ian AIpoh, Malaysia
Title: A Delightful Lunch
