Review: This is a very nice place to enjoy a pleasant rest while having tasty food, well presented.Muntri seems to be a little off the beaten track as it was quieter than other more popular streets, but it is well worth a visit. With some beautifully restored buildings there is quite a bit to see and plenty of p,aces to eat.We chose the News Cafe as it is on a small shady side lane with tables inside and outside. We chose the latter.The staff (apparently all Malaysians) were very friendly and quietly efficient. We chose local food which was clearly very fresh and properly cooked.I recommend this cafe.Show less

Author: 763niallw
Title: Breakfast
Review: Great breakfast. Nice omelettes and coffee. European & Asian options though focus on European. Friendly staff. Good value

Author: EllBel
Title: Delicious breakfast and coffee
Review: We were hotel guests at Muntri Mews, and greatly appreciated the ability to start our days at Muntri Cafe. Excellent customer service, good menu offerings.

Author: 4t3
Title: Excellent little restaurant tucked away
Review: I went for the rendang and wasn’t disappointed. Attentive staff and good value for money. I’ll definitely be back the next time I’m in Penang.

Author: restym2015
Title: Birthday lunch😊
Review: All the meals we ordered were delicious and outstanding,Mr. Durga and Aj as our attendant was so  helpful and attentive. So, I would like to give five stars for that restaurant specially the food nasigoreng,ayam percik and service as well.

Author: ArdyMohd
Title: An exquisite cafe
Review: The recent visit to Mews Cafe was truly a great one. The ambience was spectacular and equally amazing was their food and beverages. The food was nothing short of delightful which left me wanting for more every time.

Author: 502hannahs
Title: Delicious and good service
Review:
Very happy with our meal at Mews cafe. The food was really tasty and the cocktails were good too.

Service was also good.

Thought this was really good value for money. 

Only shame is they didn’t have any of Helen’s curry

Author: Jifannaetan
Title: Good environment with delicious food and excellent services
Review: The food is very delicious with both I ordered aglio olio and my younger sis ordered fried rice with ayam goreng. The food is in a normal to big portion which it worth the price. The environment is quiet and clean and service by the waiter over there is excellent. Nevertheless, the song played is nice, suit the environment and the overall outlook of the cafe.Show less

Author: Kevin A
Title: good food  at a reasonable price
Review: I only had breakfast there but would recommend it.The Roti chenai was lovely the coffee was great and the menu choice was ample. Great for families.The prices if you pay at the restaurant is very reasonable. The service is great.

Author: ContentedTraveller51Melbourne, Australia
Title: Delicious Restaurant Food
Review: We have eaten here twice now and both times found the food to be excellent. Last evening we had the Cucar Udang and the chicken satay - both were delicious. The first time we ate there we had the asam laksa and the mews java mee. Unfortunately on both occasions Helen's Curry Mee was unavailable.Show less

Author: Andy OSydney, Australia
Title: Above average
Review: It was fairly good. The chicken of the Nash lemak was very tough. The mocktails were good, the coffee was standard Nespresso stuff, the satay was good and we also ordered rojak which was OK. The setting was pleasant and the service nonchalant. Overall, better than average but not spectacular.Show less

Author: mervdunia
Title: excellent food
Review: Great food here. Flavourful Malaysian dishes on offer.The place looks nice but the modern decor does seem out of place for this part of Georgetown.

Author: cross m
Title: my favourite
Review:
not just the quality of food but also the staff. it became my hangout whenever i feel
like eating quality local penang food with a twist. you get what you paid. never fails me.. this is a place u should visit!

Author: BehnamJaEindhoven, The Netherlands
Title: Go there!
Review: The food here was absolutely amazing! The beef rendang was out of this world, and all the other dishes we had were true flavorbombs as well. Everything is plated with an eye for detail, the quality of the seafood was great and the staff very friendly. If we’ve had the time we definitely would’ve gone back. Show less

Author: rosabatlleicaria
Title: Excellent food and service!
Review: Excellent breakfast, desserts and food in general. Great quality for Western and Asian food and attentive staff.

Author: sanju72015
Title: Very good satay
Review:
Good satay (chicken) and good fruit rojak (peanuts, pineapple, guava, belinjo). 

Good place to take a rest and have some
Snacks.

They serve lunch and dinner too.

Author: AlanGeaBMalang, Indonesia
Title: Underrated!
Review: Best fusion nasi lemak around!The nasi lemak served with japanese mackarel and sweet-sour prawn. The pickles is nice. Dried fish wasn't smelly. So i think every piece make it great combination.Well the price definitely above the average, but if you consider the counting the warm ambience and service, its worth and reasonable. This is my second visit, and would be back for the third!Show less

Author: millyklKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: DISAPPOINTING PLACE
Review: We were a group of 7. Made reservations and in fact told them that we would like a table outside. He told us oh no inside is much better. Went there at 730pm.and showed us a table that was set inside. I was appauled to see that it was cramp , stuffy with harsh spot lights shining directly to your face !!!!. And to top it off the air conditioning above us was not working ???? IT WAS HOT ! To the management - i made a reservation and even requested for a table outdoors ! And you give me this ???????????? . And you tell me that indoors is much better ? Seriously ?? In terms of food , there are much better ones around Georgetown than here . The only thing we liked was the banana fritters. Show less

Author: Elaine S
Title: Ikan Sambal with Blue Nasi!
Review: Love the local dishes on the menu. The nasi lemak and ikan sambal were amazing. Presentation and taste were great. Value for money. Give it a try!

Author: wearin_smith
Title: Delightful cafe
Review: The Mews Cafe was a perfect place for dinner after a full day of sightseeing around George Town. The Malaysian meal was delicious, the service was wonderful, and the atmosphere was relaxing. We definitely recommend the Mews Cafe!

Author: Feds294201Penang Island, Malaysia
Title: An enjoyable evening
Review: We visited this restaurant based on a list of best restaurants in Penang. The write-up didn't get it quite right--there are no Western selections, but my husband found a fried chicken meal he liked. Mews manages to avoid the pitfalls of many restaurants in Penang: the food for both of us arrived at the same time; our cutlery included knives; the napkins were a normal size and useable. The place was filling up with Westerners so obviously others appreciate the efficiency and professionalism as well as the good food. We will be back.Show less

Author: EllaOscar
Title: Excellent food
Review: This is quite a gem. Great menu and excellent peranakan dishes to choose from. Excellent service and great location.

Author: louisee501Essendon, Australia
Title: Fantastic Malaysian food
Review: My partner and I first went to Mews on recommendation from our hotel and we were so impressed by the food (especially the beef rendang) and the friendly service. We went back again for lunch a couple of days later and again the food and service was brilliant. Highly recommend! Show less

Author: travellingteachers1Harrogate, United Kingdom
Title: What a first impression of George Town
Review: This was recommended to us by our hotel for lunch and we really enjoyed it. Authentic Malay food that is delicious. We were so impressed that we returned on a Saturday evening to watch live music and to have a few drinks. The service on both occasions was excellent with very attentive staff who are always smiling and topping up your water on a hot day.We would definitely recommend for food or a drink. Show less

Author: Karen H
Title: Dinner at Mews Cafe Georgetown
Review:
Excellent food, cocktails, dessert and lovely service. Choice of garden setting or a/c. 
Set menu was so cheap and yummy!
Lovely toilets!!
Definitely recommend

Author: hovnav
Title: Excellent for breakfast
Review: Loved their breakfasts, particularly the grilled sandwiches.Need a bit more consistency though. Day one we ordered a breakfast and it came with two slices of bread and butter and jam. Day two, ordered exactly the same meal and it had one slice of bread and no butter or jam. Show less

Author: magdielvanderwerf
Title: So lovely food
Review: A vew words... but you can't bring the taste in words, just go there to proof. Cosy, friendly, life music and very very very tasty modern Maleisian food. Fresh herbs, kids loved the food, very friendly people.

Author: sondramac
Title: Great Food!
Review: What a great place to eat!  The food was delicious, the staff great, and the atmosphere really nice.  This is a place we will return to!

Author: tsulee69
Title: Awesome dinner
Review: I happened to walk pass this little cafe last night, was greeted by a helpful friendly patient staff (A.J) and I decided to make reservation for tonight.We just had awesome dinner, nice ambience, delicious steamed sea bass in banana leaf, beef rendang and dessert sweet potato banana in coconut milk, attended by A.J and his colleague(forgot to take down his name) great service. We will be back when we come to penang again next time, well done A.J and all the mew's staffs Show less

Author: johnmcgarry3515
Title: Very nice food.
Review: The food & service were very good.Starter main sweet & coffee & four tiger beers came to only 120 ringgit very reasonable.

Author: SalzagalbackpackerMelbourne, Australia
Title: Cute cafe with tasty food
Review: This cute cafe has a diverse menu and will adjust several dishes to be vegetarian. The staff were lovely and the cafe was cool and pretty. We enjoyed all our meals - we all had Malaysian influenced meals - there were other options. Also had the lovely juices. It’s a bit pricy compared to many cafes but the quality and presentation and service are worth the extra few $.Show less

Author: Lyn L
Title: Awesome little cafe
Review:
Loved eating at this trendy little spot. The staff were very friendly and helpful.
We enjoyed the tasty spring rolls and delicious chicken satay sticks. Loved our dessert of gula Melaka. We recommend this delightful eatery.

Author: lilihsiangl
Title: Best cafe in Penang
Review: It was my second time to visit Mews Cafe. All the staffs are so friendly and nice. Last year we were all satisfied with the meal and drinks. And this time I ordered coffee latte, I felt amazing. For me, this’s the best coffee latte. Thank you AJ and other staffs. My Penang trip was always beautiful because of Mews Cafe!!!這是我第二次到馬車房.去年,我和好友到檳城旅行時入住這裡,對馬車房的早餐及餐點非常滿意,而且員工們都很熱情.今年,我又來到這裡,很喜歡這裡的早餐及咖啡,還有AJ以及所有人員,我的檳城旅行因為馬車房而更美麗!馬車房是我在檳城最喜歡的地方!Show less

Author: Aver25
Title: We will come again!
Review: Mews cafe is a super cute and quiet place. We have been there twice for lunch and dinner. All food that we tried was excellent. Staff is super attentive and very knowledgeable.

Author: olaf1969
Title: Awesome place & Hotel
Review:
We have been for dinner.
We took the menu with beef and fish.
Great task of herbs and place to sit. Not hot at all.
Service was excellent.

Author: RBT2122Penang, Malaysia
Title: Impeccable Service & Delicious Food...
Review: great Smile great Food great Service great Ambience great Chef...thx to A.J Amin Raj Thaik Durga James & Ari just to name a few...mee siam...mee goreng...ikan sambal... mews passion... satay... beef rendang...french toast...mee jawa...banana fritters...taste so so good...anything on the Menu is good...not to forget..a Latte or a Flat White to blend along to conplete the entire Lunch or Dinner, as per se...Show less

Author: Rittika D
Title: Tasty food and lovely service
Review: Mews cafe was recommended to me by a friend and I am glad I tried it. A cute and quiet little cafe in the bustling Georgetown. The waiter who served me was so polite and helpful. The food looked and tasted great! A good place to try if you are looking for a bit of peace and quiet.Show less

Author: Anthony JAdelaide, Australia
Title: One of the best in George Town
Review: Have wandered past the Mews many times over the years but this time was determined to try it. Welcoming & friendly, small and stylish the food on offer was fantastic. Had seen good reports of the rendang which turned out to be without fault - wonderful. Other places in George Town offering Rendang should seek advice from the Mews chef on how it should be done. No one else comes close to it. Highly recommend a visit.Show less

Author: Robyn_Ains
Title: Supreme Indulgence
Review: Food, venue and service absolutely impeccable. Highly recommend this lovely food experience. We had a group of 8, very happy and content with yet another Georgetown food, beer and cocktail indulgence.

Author: YKYPHOEBEKowloon, China
Title: Exceptional
Review: They serve authentic Malaysian cuisine and a variety of desserts and both taste really good! Their service is a highlight— the waiter (called James if I rmb correctly) took really good care of us! He is friendly, patient and attentive! Overall a very enjoyable lunch :)Show less

Author: Andre_maya
Review: Highly recommended If u searching for innovative concoction of Malaysian dishes. Good and friendly staff. Aj one of the staff who guide us on the menu.

Author: viktoriavarga
Title: Fantastic food in the middle of the city
Review:
Great, great, great food. Penang is a foodie paradise and this place proves it.
Friendly staff and delicious meals. You should try it when in Georgetown.

Author: robync573
Title: Great interesting food and fab service
Review: The food was great, especially recommend the Beef Rendang and Gula Melaka. The winged bean salad was so different and tasty. Service without fault.

Author: vanvansa
Title: 10/10 will go again
Review: Very nice, our best meal in Penang. Polite waiters with very informative advice and a nice attitudes. Fabulous place we enjoyed our afternoon there. The platter is highly recommended, the curry mee is a close second. Reasonable price for tourists but may be slightly expensive for locals. Will revisit if we come to Penang again.Show less

Author: dianaaW3193YXBatu Ferringhi, Malaysia
Title: Best Nasi Lemak
Review: Pop in accidentally for Breakfast as the other place was yet open . We ordered Nasi Lemak and Pratha for Breakfast . The Nasi Lemak came with sambal prawns , big piece of boneless fried fish , pickles , egg n dry anchovies . It was one of the best Nasi Lemak I ever had . It was tasty , crispy fish n sambal fish just slightly spicy n perfect taste for breakfast . Went back for breakfast again 2 days after . Recommend for those like Nasi Lemak but couldn’t bare for spicy. Show less

Author: hsmomtravels
Title: Tasty Nasi Lemak!
Review: Excellent breakfast menu! French toast was great, Nasi Lemak amazing! Small but cosy, great air-conditioning.

Author: Lisafluffylisa
Title: Lisa miller
Review: Amazing food so tasty and traditional fantastic staff,  clean restaurant highly recommend to pay a visit if in Penang amazing value for money

Author: GOBinSAAscot, United Kingdom
Title: Local food but poor quality
Review: I was a little surprised on ratings on line that this restaurant got. The ambience and furniture is pretty basic , seating is not comfortable at all. It was meant to be good quality Asian cuisine , but this was not the case, it was served very quickly , the fish was over cooked and very dry. In a prawn dish there were only 2 prawns and we had to ask for more. We felt everything had been precooked and just reheated.I am sure you can find better for the same priceShow less

Author: Anne F
Title: Great food
Review: Had a nice evening at this cafe/restaurant.  The service was great as the staff were very attentive and the food was awesome.

Author: Simon O
Title: Simple but great
Review: Nothing fancy here. only great cocktails (that actually contain booze) and great quality simple food.  Coupled with a very competent and pleasant staff it makes for a great experience.

Author: Bozgu64Guam, Mariana Islands
Title: Delicious Satay and Flavorful Beef Rendang with Music
Review: We were staying across the street at the Edison Hotel and were told by the staff for a quick Saturday late night bite we could go to the Mews Cafe! We were not disappointed. The Satay was both tasty and quite nicely done not overcooked the way many do it. Nice peanut sauce to boot! The Beef Rendang was quite solid and spicy! The drinks were Ok but otherwise a solid night out and really good singers! That is what attracted us in the first place but we stayed for the good late night snacking!Show less

Author: Edith S
Title: Delicious, GREAT service and good WiFi
Review: I searched Penang high and low for good WiFi, this cafe was the only place I could find with decent WiFi. The staff is VERY friendly and attentive to the guests. The green bowl salad is SO good! I will miss that salad when I leave tomorrow. The Ayam Peychik (traditional Malaysian meal with local spices is also really good! The atmosphere is really mellow and clean. It’s a MUST visit on your trip to Penang!Show less

Author: malabarflyGravesend, United Kingdom
Title: What it lacks in local ambience it makes up for with the quality of service and food
Review: This café is part of the George Town Heritage Hotels group and as such attached to the Muntri Mews hotel (although this is not apparent) as well as linked to the nearby Muntri Grove Hotel. It is modern, clean and more up-market than other cafes around and is consequently quite pricey by local standards but popular with tourists and ex-pats. It offers a good menu of Malaysian and fusion dishes which, on the two occasions we visited – once for lunch and once for a drink and snack of satay – the food was good. The air conditioned restaurant inside is relatively small, but there are also a number of tables in the attractive leafy courtyard outside, where there are fans to keep you cool. The staff are very friendly and helpful to offer advice on the dishes, so although a bit more expensive than more ‘local’ cafes it’s a matter of ‘you get what you pay for’. What it lacks in a local ambience it makes up for with the quality of service and food. They have live music in the courtyard every Saturday evening.Show less

Author: Jeff_KostyBangkok, Thailand
Title: Impeccable versions of local food
Review: I had the beef rendang. It was immaculate. This place doesn't so much reinvent local favorites as try to construct them with exacting attention to detail. I'd just taken a cooking course and the beef rendang we made lacking. The recipe was good, our execution not so much. I can identify most of the mistakes we, the students, made. We did not handle the beef with enough care and attention. Mews, on the other hand, treated their beef LOVINGLY. the beef itself was tender and flavorful, and the curry spot on. The cocktails are nice too. I particularly recommend the lychee martini. If you actually LIKE martinis just get a martini. But if martinis remind you of drinking out of a liquor bottle, the lychee calms it down without making it too sweet. The default version on the menu is vodka, but they'll make it with gin (Gordon's) if you ask for it. If you order with gin remind them stir, don't shake (it's a gin thing).Show less

Author: UKtraveller077London
Title: Mainly a tourist restaurant
Review: With so much excellent food in Georgetown I have to say that this was good but not the best we had.The outside area of this restaurant appear to be divided into 2 halves with the more attractive part set back from the street for hotel guests only.Prices are definitely set with tourists in mind. However if you don’t fancy street food this is a reasonable enough option.Show less

Author: TimAndJessBlack
Title: Wonderful sanctuary of calm
Review: Ate an amazing meal here of high class local food, set in a paradise of calm. Service is amazing, food is delicious and the drinks are perfect. Our waiter was funny and delightful.

Author: htanjung89
Title: Perfect food, heartwarming service!
Review: We came for lunch. The owner was so sweet, she offered us cold lemon water as she saw us drenched in sweat after walking under the hot sun. The waiters were all attentive. Food cooked to perfection OMG ❤️

Author: howard r
Title: nothing special
Review: this is a very average restaurant. The best thing is it's off the crowded hot streets. the food is just so so. Nothing special

Author: Milky99Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Marvelous Food
Review: With so many good reviews.. there muz be something.Greeted with very polite staff.. that made my day and felt very welcome. The deco is simple but felt classic...We ordered pie tee and satay..Pie tee is one of its kind added with fried shrimp.. very fragant. Satay was so meaty with excellent taste.For main course, we had ayam goreng, percik and beef rendang.. all were so delicious... the taste was on point.For dessert, had gula melaka sago with creamy santan.. omg.. my family simply love it. Just like havenly made dessert. For cake of the day.. the chocolate cake is quite average and a bit dry...Overall, love all the food so much.. very good and polite service.I seldom rate excellent in TripAdvisor.. this is one of them.. when you read this.. don't think further anymore. Move yr butt and proceed to this placeShow less

Author: Travel555962Sydney, Australia
Title: Excellent
Review: The cafe/restaurant attached to Muntri Mews does really good food and its courtyard setting slightly off Muntri Street means you can watch the world walk by. Staff are friendly and helpful, making solo dinners feel comfortable, not giving you the hustle to move on for bigger groups. Menu doesn’t look vegetarian friendly but ask the staff - the cook is happy to adapt much of what is there. Delicious vegetarian Helen’s Curry Mee one night and vegetarian laksa on a return visit. Show less

Author: LJB145Sydney, Australia
Title: Finally found beef rendang!
Review: You just wouldn't think it would be so difficult to find Malaysian food in Malaysia but it is. However all is not lost, despite looking very western, the Mews Cafe serves up delicious beef rendang and the spiced seabass steamed in banana leaf was equally good. Tables outside in a leafy courtyard with festoon lighting make it just a little romantic.Show less

Author: TomGuppySherborne, United Kingdom
Title: One of my favourites in George Town
Review: My wife and I visited Mews Cafe about 18 months ago with our toddler. We decided to go back with our family after our fantastic meal last time. I have to say, we were not disappointed! Great service, excellent food and drinks . Great experience had by all. Tasting platter is well recommended as is the beef rendang. Thank you for giving us such a pleasant dining experience once again. We will be back for sure. Show less

Author: Jialin21Petaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Excellent
Review: Overall experience is great, having dinner with a very chill vibes, totally worth the money with those scrumptious food, can’t say no if my family or friends were to come here again for a meal! Had rojak that taste very locally, Food platter that’s for 2 is AWESOME, and the dessert that tasted heavenly Show less

Author: Eni S
Title: Great breakfast options
Review: Love all the breakfast choices, the staffs could be a bit more smiley and friendlier.  Love the old-school cutleries that were used.

Author: bizbaz22
Title: Great food in a nice little garden.
Review: The food was excellent and in a really nice setting. They have a lovely patio and garden area you can sit in.

Author: Delta49
Title: Check it out, highly recommended
Review:
Looking for somewhere for dinner in George Town?
With fabulous food, in a relaxed garden setting, live music & professional service from Ryan & the staff - you can’t go wrong. We ate here twice in a week it’s so good.

Author: Paradise08269035999
Title: Excellent dining experience
Review: We had a delicious food experience for 4. The chicken and beef satays were tender and the accompanying sauces very tasty. The duck was beautifully cooked and flavoursome. The beef Rendang melt in the mouth. The pasta was a surprise with its delicious garlic flavour.

Author: ditchnapper
Title: Very nice, small and friendly
Review: We had several meals here because we stayed in a room at the inn.  Very nice local food, great setting outdoors along a relatively quiet street.  Cant be beat if you want a simple but tasty meal with limited fuss/

Author: Christina052Perth, Australia
Title: Excellent!
Review: We were recommended this place by the hotel owner and we had the most wonderful meal here tonight. Everything cooked to perfection and the waiter was attentive and helpful. Portion sizes were just right and pricing was good. We will be back again soon. Highly recommended for anyone looking for authentic decent food in George Town. Show less

Author: OregonMom123
Title: Fantastic flavours!
Review: We had a delicious dinner for six. Chicken satay, vegetarian pie tee, chicken, fish, papaya salad— all amazing. Some dishes were a bit spicy but not too spicy. Lots of flavour. The portions were very large. Also great fresh pressed juices.

Author: Fiona MEdinburgh, United Kingdom
Title: Great find
Review: As is often the case Trip Advisor helps you find a gem - off the main roads and one you are unlikely to stumble across. This was one such restaurant. Close to our hotel we probably would not have ventured here without the map. The food was delicious. Husband - a Nasi Limak fan - pronounced it the best he had ever had (and it looked good (meal envy for me had my Kerabu Beehon - chicken and prawn noodle salad - not been so good). Unusually I decided to have a pudding and the Sago Gula Melaka was amazing!Iced ginger tea was lovely - served with liquid syrup to sweeten to taste. Such a good meal. Very reasonable compared to prices at home, not the cheapest by Malaysian standards.Show less

Author: Ho S
Title: Good place
Review: The service and food are good. The staffs are also friendly. We feeled comfortable Here. Will come with friends again

Author: SabaideeJ
Title: Good beef rendang
Review: This restaurant serves a better rendang than most other places in George town, the meat is tender and tasty. Nice setting and good service.

Author: AngelineT67
Title: Breakfast hunting
Review: Was supposed to go to this place for Breakfast, but then did not managed to find the place, so end up we went some place else

Author: traveller2044
Title: Mews
Review: We went to check out the café after all the great reviews. Cute atmosphere, romantic music, staff very nice. One of the waiters made a mistake in telling us that there was vegetarian food. However, another one of waiters, A. J. , managed to bring vegetarian food even if it wasn't on the menu and it was very tasty! One other staff member got us a map and handwrote recommendations of where to go. The Laksa of my boyfriend was very tasty apparently!Show less

Author: Passenger560670
Title: Dinner and drinks
Review:
Delicious fresh Asian fusion food enjoyed alfresco in a cool tropical setting.
Particularly recommend the rojak rice paper rolls and the cucur udang - prawn fritters . 
Very attentive staff. Thank you Ryan for looking after us

Author: momo402London, United Kingdom
Title: Hipster Malay fusion cuisine
Review: Nice modern Malay inspired cuisine served in chic surroundings. Very “instagrammable” presentation, plates, decor, etc. We had a late lunch/brunch: I had the grain salad with egg and although it was assembled by someone who has clearly no interest or experience in salads the components were delicious. My partner had the Nasi lemak which he said was good. Satay chicken starter was also tasty while the coffee and fresh juice were above average. Prices reflect the above so good value if you like your pretty pictures! Show less

Author: peterwu16
Title: Great breakfast
Review: Very friendly staff and great food..  Copy place for breakfast.. Food a bit expensive for breakfast hotel price but hey quality don't come cheap. Worth every penny...

Author: Raisa HEngland, United Kingdom
Title: Amazing food!
Review: We have been in Penang for 5 nights and on our last day here we found this Cafe! Probably my favorite meal whilst in Penang. We got the platter for 80RM which serves 2 people - 1 starter, 2 mains, and 1 dessert. Loved the beef Randang and the Banana fritters.They had a high chair for our two year old as well as plastic cups and plates which was really helpful.Good customer service.Thank you Mews!Show less

Author: koenr97
Title: Great!
Review: The setting outside is very nice, so are the food and the staff. Dishes very reasonably priced and large portions. 2 starters and 2 mains were too much for us!

Author: coling797
Title: Quiet location, unusual in Georgetown
Review: This is a really nice place to sit outside in the evening, a quiet road, great food and reasonable prices for a simple menu. We visited twice during our stay

Author: msetoSingapore, Singapore
Title: Beef Rendang is over-rated and overpriced, plain and simple.
Review: Firstly, heard so much about everyone raving about the beef rendang, so decided to try it. Dish comes with yellow rice, three other goodies, the rendang itself, veg side dish and achar of some sort. Rendang is soft, lean no visible fat (a good sign) however, the saltiness of the rendang eats away the delicate spices, the veg makes it even more salty...very unbalanced. Pickled item is okay, refreshes the palate a little, but too little given. On the whole, I don't get why people would pay 31RM for this. Over-rated and nothing like how a home cooked rendang should ideally taste. Show less

Author: BigYungMiaw
Title: Excellent café
Review:
We had lunch here and the food was amazing. Great service too. Beef rendang, satay and fish were perfectly cooked. French toast was great as well. 

Only downside is the parking space which can be hard to find.

Author: inviaggiodal64Singapore, Singapore
Title: Loved it!
Review: We went twice during our five day stay . We loved to sit and eat in the garden on a Saturday evening when they had great jazz live music. Food is excellent and local, fish is fresh, cocktails are good. Service is very attentive. Try the banana fritters, they are highly addictive. Show less

Author: RandomGuy23Phnom Penh, Cambodia
Title: Very nice.
Review: A very nice restaurant with good food and an ambient atmosphere. I had the beef remdang, which was excellent except for the accompanying (green) veg. There was something in the flavour that just didn't appeal to me, but tat's a personal observation. My wife had chicken and prawn noodle soup, which she enjoyed (although she didn't like the texture of the fishballs in it.) $7 for a bottle of imported craft ale was a bit pricy, especially as it was the only one of the 4 or 5 on the menu they had in stock. The cheaper draft Tiger was just as good. Good service, and it was nice to have a guitarist and a singer perform while we ate.Show less

Author: bbgg12345Sydney, Australia
Title: Delicious!!
Review: My friend and I shared the prawn fritters for starter, the sea bass and a noodle soup dish for main. It was so tasty and the setting is beautiful. Honestly, the food is outstanding!!! The staff are also really friendly and offered us some great travel tips. Our waiter Ryan was really helpful when we were asking questions about the menu. It’s probably a bit pricier than standard food but it’s so worth it.Show less

Author: 487amyt
Title: Quiet lunch
Review: Awesome spot away from the crowds.Food wasn't too expensive considering the setting, service and portions.Very good Curry Mee and chicken dish. The dessert of sago with Gula Melaka and coconut milk such a treat.Service staff were attentive,friendly, and quick to provide a highchair for my little one.Show less

Author: Bordow86
Title: Relaw
Review:
Nice place to relax, I order the curry mee and coke.

The waitress a Philippine guy was really nice and courteous. 

The soup was really nice. Recommend this place if you’re in the area.

Author: MikeT2608
Title: Lamak Laksar!!
Review: Have been in Penang for one week and I've been back 3 times (that good). Ate several different dishes each night and was more than satisfied every time. Personal favourites were the chicken satay, beef rendang and the Lemak Laksar was the best I've had in Malaysia. Service with a smile also. Highly recommend!Show less

Author: B d
Title: Calm terrace and good food
Review: Very close to our hotel, we had noticed the night terrace and we decided to have dinner there. It’s been a great choice : wonderful food, nice and efficient staff, very pleasant terrace, with a view on the street yet calm.

Author: Alessandro MLugano, Switzerland
Title: Love it
Review: The restaurant is just great, food great and so was the service. Portion are quite big so you won't leave the table hungry.The place is quite small and creates a cozy and familiar atmosphere, a lot of employees going around the restaurants make sure that everything is up to standard. You liked it that much that we came back for breakfast the next day.For one starter, two main course, 2 beers, water and 2 coffees we spent only 27$Show less

Author: 527amarilisb
Title: You have to order the duck!
Review: I had the duck with the tumeric rice... OMG.... it was A...MAZING 😋😋😋 great place. Price was good for the food. Specially if you convert to USD (about $15 per person). The nasi lemak was okay but the duck was terrific!!!!! Worth visiting.

Author: melbourneros
Title: Elegant  outdoor dining
Review: In contrast to rustic experience of street stalls this cafe provided a garden to sit in cooled by fans a varied Asian fusion and western menu and good service .

Author: Jdread2000ad
Title: Excellent
Review: Wifey's friends spoke highly of the cafe. Since we were in Penang over the weekend, here's a chance to sample their dishes. Highly recommended is their Laksa Lemak. Much more better than most in KL. Cosy ambient and friendly staff.

Author: KwT26
Title: Good
Review: Good cafe to visit ! I discovered this place with my friends accidentally and I was so love with this place now .

Author: Karen RByron Bay, New South Wales, Australia
Title: Henna Party - Pre-wedding
Review: I wanted to utilise various aspects of the Georgetown Heritage group and the Mews Cafe was perfect for my Henna Party - we had traditional Peranakan cakes, tea and coffee and brought in our own champagne for the event. We had a section of the cafe reserved for our group of 15-20 people which swelled as the guys wanted Henna too. not just the ladies - the staff took it in their stride and we spilled outside as well. So much fun and great food as were able to order other snacks as we pleased throughout the event. The Henna girls sat at a table and we rotated the guests through - so much fun and thanks to the great staff for all their support, service and delicious food to make this event special.Show less

Author: moonbase11Leicester, United Kingdom
Title: Fabulous ambience and food
Review: This restaurant is hidden away on a quieter street bit well worth seeking out. The food was fabulous and the service excellent. It is more expensive than many Malaysian resturants but for our 3 course meal including non-alocholic drinks it was under RN 60 per head (£12)Show less

Author: owen04Christchurch, New Zealand
Title: Mews cafe
Review: We are here because it was down the road from our hotel and the same owners. The food was good quality and the drinks were tasty too. The service was great, maybe even a tad too attentive, and our waiter from the Phillipines was a lovely chap who was very interesting. The restaurant was expensive for Penang but we felt it was still reasonably priced for what we got.Show less

Author: Phuong277Hanoi, Vietnam
Title: Nice coffee
Review: We total 4 people had Lasi Lemak, chicken ham croissant, bread with sausages and egg, cereals. Drink: we had latte, capuchino and mango calamansi. Food was plating on the traditional plates. they looked colorful and unique. Food is just okay.The server was nice when he said hello in Vietnamese. The asmosphere was cozy, wheather was cool at that time so we sat outside. We were really enjoy the breakfast.Show less

Author: Suzanne33335805Chicago, Illinois
Title: Fun and fabulous
Review: Had a lovely evening in this cool little cafe set in the heart of the heritage area in Georgetown. Surrounded by old shophouses, ambience and atmosphere.Food was great - beef rendang, spicy chicken with green mango salad and my favourite sago and palm sugar and coconut. The place was packed but chill. Wonderful personal service - thank you for a lovely evening gentlemen!We recommend and will happily return when back in your town!Show less

Author: earlgreyane新加坡
Title: Expensive but quality food.
Review: A plate of Nasi Lemak cost about SGD10, and it tasted normal as I thought it might be special. However, exclude the Nasi Lemak, the rest of the food in the menu are actually worth the try and I especially love their Caramel Macchiato. Love the aroma and taste of the coffee, and I had at least one cup per day during my 3d2n stay at Muntri Mews. Show less

Author: tricial724
Title: Delicious food
Review: Had the duck leg massaman curry with duck fat potatoes for lunch - delicious! Beef rendang was tasty as well. Will return!

Author: Los_BubusQuito, Ecuador
Title: Not the best but good!
Review: Its a cute restaurant but certainly not the best in town. The service is pretty good the servers were really nice and attentive. We ordered the malaysian food platter for two it was a lot of food for dinner. The food was good but not excellent! Keep in mind thst the resturant for dinner gets totally packed so is important to make a reservation! The prices are a little bit high for the other restaurants. Fyi for the platter we payed 88MR Show less

Author: CarolynElizabethBirmingham, United Kingdom
Title: Little gem
Review: Just had second evening at Muntri Cafe. Select number of dishes but really tasty. Served by Ryan who was happy to explain the food and was always filling up our water glass without being asked. Lovely atmosphere and cooling fans. Perfect afternoon hard day of sightseeing. Cafe attached to Muntri Mews hotel which looks great from the website. Show less

Author: noguchililiTaiwan
Title: Great food and super friendly staffs
Review: Nice foods, cozy environment and super friendly staffs! Many many thanks to AJ, Ashraf, and all the staffs, we had great time in Penang. I love breakfast, cocktails, desserts, coffee and delicious meals here. All the foods are awesome. This is a great experience for us. We will definitely go again soon! I love muntri mews cafe! Show less

Author: ROBYNJEPerth, Australia
Title: GREAT MEAL- LOVELY STAFF
Review: All we seem to have done since arriving in Penang is eat, eat, drink and eat. Not wanting to go too far from our Hotel (we stayed at the Eastern & Oriental) we had already earmarked this small Cafe/Restaurant because of the reviews that we had read and it was an easy walk. The restaurant does not have a big street frontage but is on the right hand side and on the corner of a small lane. We were greeted by friendly staff and invited to select a table. We asked for a recommendation for a local beer and were delighted with the light beer suggestion. We both ordered Beef Rendang as it is a favourite - the dish was well presented and the beef was tender, succulent and tasty with just the right amount of heat to suit all palates. If you prefer spicy just ask for more chilli, but it was perfect for us. A.J. was our waiter and he took wonderful care of us with a ready smile and friendly demeanour.Would highly recommend this place for a lunch or dinner when not wanting to go overboard with a full dining experience, but also not wishing to make do with an average meal. This place delivers good quality food in a pleasant and comfortable environment. We enjoyed the evening immensely. Thank you.Show less

Author: Genny147
Title: Top quality fusion food in relaxed atmosphere
Review: Really good Asian/fusion food with Malay emphasis.  We enjoyed the relaxed atmosphere after a busy day. It can get a bit crowded on weekends,  so I suggest booking ahead.  Staff are friendly and efficient. We went there twice when we were in Georgetown.

Author: CindyG2619
Title: Excellent food and service
Review: We chose to come here and had our last meal in Penang which turned out to be a very good decision. The food was just fantastic: the beef and fish were so delicious. The staff was very friendly. Definitely recommend it!

Author: wweennSingapore, Singapore
Title: Cosy cafe with excellent food, drinks and staff
Review: We stayed at Muntri Mews and visited the cafe many times throughout our stay. Staff are all very attentive and friendly. Great recommendations on food, especially the platter for 2. Fruit juices were delicious as well, and we loved the coffee! Special thanks to AJ and team who made the stay very comfortable for my mum and I. (AJ, say hi if you’re dropping by SG!)Show less

Author: pugetsound2016
Title: Excellent meal
Review: WE had a very tasty, ample meal for two for 88myr or roughly $22. Great flavors and one of the best dinners we have had on this trip. AJ is very personable and provided warm service.

Author: RBT2122
Title: 5 Star Service...
Review:
10/10...all almst perfect   !

Good Service from A.J Ryan Kerwin Ashraf and not to forget superb Chef Ariey Chef Thaik...Good Teamwork !

Author: sporestrikerSingapore, Singapore
Title: Food and service excellent!
Review: Tried this place as it was located near our hotel. Later found out that they shared the same owner. The signage is not very clear so you might miss it. But the atmosphere is nice and service great. We ordered the platter for two which could easily feed three. The dishes were very tasty and service warm and friendly. Made us feel very comfortable.Would definitely recommend this place for a great dinner.Show less

Author: crispAustralia
Title: Tasty,Fresh and Smiling Service
Review: Great efficient service for snacks,lunch or dinners.Ate here many times over a week and can recommend their fruit juices,chicken satays with rice,and my favourite was a roti with tasty chicken curry.Medium priced and great surrounds.

Author: -Miss-Williams-123London, United Kingdom
Title: Lovely food with good service
Review: We walked past mews cafe one night and decided it was so cute we had to come back and eat here. The setting is lovely, very relaxing and super clean. The food is very good and even the 'light bites' are very filling. Good value for money for a 'fancy' place.Show less

Author: nesaar
Title: Classic and delicious
Review: Classic local and western food with a twist. Absolutely delicious food.. well it is Penang, cant expect anything less.

Author: sarahrJ29CNBang Kruai, Thailand
Title: Enjoyable meal for the most part
Review: Had the Curry mee noodle soup - the oil swimming on the surface was a bit off-putting, but it was tasty, and the portions generous.It said 26myr on the menu but I was charged 27.55; when queried the waiter said that's how much it was, and I didn't want to create a fuss over <2myr after a mainly enjoyable meal.Service was prompt, and fast. I don't drink, and noted there were mocktails available on menu.There was an amazing guitarist/singer performing at the restaurant, which gave the evening a funky, laid-back vibe.Show less

Author: JamesKMTanPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Great place
Review: WeThis restaurant/cafe is located also g Muntri Street. It has an out of the world atmosphere with wonderful alfresco dining. Hal of the tables are indoor. We were serenaded by some wonderful singing. The food was fantastic. We ordered the cucur udang which came with excellent satay sauce. The staff is very friendly. We also ordered the fish which is the chef's recommendation. The fish was really fresh and the curry sauce was well textured.Will definitely come again. Show less

Author: kram66Melbourne, Australia
Title: Amazing food
Review: We ate here on our first night in Georgetown and ordered the prawn fritters which were full of flavour and although deep fried, there was no taste of oil. The Margaritas we also great. Decided to go back on our last day to try more of their food.Show less

Author: JohnandBridgetTauranga, New Zealand
Title: Nice place
Review: We went to the mews cafe on our last night in Penang..the waiter recommended the platter so we went for it..we ordered beef rendang and chicken satay, but got beef satay and a chicken dish.To be honest it tasted great and we were tied and hungry so ate it all..The waiter a while later realised the mistake and was very apologetic and gave us 30% off the bill which was a great gesture as we never complained..Would certainly come here again as the service and food was excellent.Show less

Author: ScenicShoreCourt
Title: Will Come Back
Review: We went there for dinner on the last day of our trip. Ordered the mews platter with satay beef, beef, duck and mews passion. The drink mews madness isn't my favorite.

Author: ljosgood133Dartmouth, United Kingdom
Title: Great food and service!
Review: We ate here quite a few nights during our stay in GT because we loved it so much. The first time we went we ordered the set (RM 88 for two people) and it’s generous portions meant that we couldn’t get as far as the dessert. We cheekily asked if we could go back and have the dessert the following day, which they happily agreed to. We loved it so much we went back on our final night, the Redang beef was to die for along with the banana fritters obviously. A.J. and team provide fantastic, friendly service too and the place has a nice intimate atmosphere. Show less

Author: 642cherylf
Title: Always good...
Review: We've been several times, together, with friends and for business. We like the very attentive service, the creative and flavorful nyonya apps and entrees and love the quiet patio that feels like we're sitting in the jungle. Food is reasonably priced... Cocktails are okay, could be more creative for the price. Show less

Author: EvaP1270
Title: Cozy cafe
Review: Love the food; service and ambience, only thing is I need inside seats. Outside the mosquitoes are not my friend

Author: Trueam
Title: You must visit....
Review: We went here after reading the reviews on Trip Advisor, we were not disappointed, the food was lovely and the staff very friendly.

Author: Frank DKota Kinabalu, Malaysia
Title: Lovely
Review: A nice secluded spot of the road, in an interesting area of the Old Town. The place is very clean and staff are efficient and friendly. The menu isn't overly extensive, but there are good choices, including a very nice platter to share. Would recommend the place warmly.Show less

Author: PaulaP456
Title: Oasis - what a find
Review: On a really hot day we sat in aircon and enjoyed amazing food and drinks. Well worth the effort to find.

Author: CurlyWireMelbourne, Australia
Title: Great fish meal at the Mews
Review: Our party of three shared a meal of beef rendang, duck and a wonderful fish dish. The fish was definitely the star plate. We dined inside in the A/C room and enjoyed cocktails mixed by June. If you wish to eat outdoors, there's also a great terrace where on the night we visited, most people were enjoying themselves. If you're after a place to eat in a relaxed atmosphere you can't go wrong here.Show less

Author: jonw_c_jun13Singapore, Singapore
Title: Welcoming atmosphere, passable duck with onions, excellent sago dessert
Review: Cafe was cosy with about 5-6 tables in the aircon section. Almost all were occupied as it was a hot day, with all the outside tables empty. I had a main course of duck with onions in curry sauce, with some potatoes and yellow rice. I asked for blue rice, but was informed that this was already finished ( about 2pm). The duck was too salty. It was different from other duck dishes in that the skin was crispy though it had a curry sauce. The sago was served separate from the gula Melaka and cream, which came in 2 smaller bowls, so you can add to your preference. The wait staff made you feel welcome. Price is on the high side.Show less

Author: Stay41796631735
Title: Excellent in All Ways
Review: Food is great, atmosphere outstanding (especially when a combo is playing), service very good. A bit on the expensive side but worth it.

Author: vimmyjegas
Title: First meal in George Town
Review: Good service. Unique patio environment for the neighborhood it's in. I try to eat veggie and they were accommodating removing the chicken from my spring rolls. It was tasty.

Author: kevinbP1402RJ
Title: Great Vietnamese Summer Rolls
Review: Nice little Cafe with great food and nice service. We had dinner and breakfast there. The Vietnamese summer rolls are amazing - the best we’ve had so far. In general food is very fresh and delicious.

Author: LeeJoh87Penang Island, Malaysia
Title: Beautiful place and good food!
Review: I went here with my wife and my daughter.We start with the Vietnamese roll and the Cucur Udang. It was very delicious!Also the beef with rice and vegetables was very nice.Great atmosphere with the trees and the plants. staff was very kind and friendly!We will come back again!Show less

Author: minikittenBristol, United Kingdom
Title: Lovely dinner
Review: Great food, good value. Easy walk from our hotel after a long flight. Great beef Rendang and satay. Really good service and a lovely green courtyard setting. Fans to provide a nice cooling breeze as well as large canopies for when it started to rain. The meal deal for 2 is good value. We had satay, duck, beef rendang, rice and a chai Creme brûlée to share. Tried the local craft ales, they had on offer, they were passable but In my opinion I think Tiger is a better option here at the moment.Show less

Author: GudGollyMsMollySydney, Australia
Title: Cosy little place with good food & service
Review: Service was great, staff extremely attentive. Mojitos were awesome. Of the 4 dishes we ordered, 3 were excellent (chicken satay, Beef Rendang & curry chicken mee) & 1 wasn’t what we were expecting - it wasn’t quite up to the level of the other 3 dishes. We ordered too much food & couldn’t eat it all. Food came to about MYR100 which we thought very reasonable by our standards. Then there was the MYR125 we spent on Mojitos which was still cheap by our standards. We had a gr8 time & would certainly go back.Show less

Author: Easywander
Title: Cosy garden, good breakfast.
Review: I liked this cafe  because it feels tucked away in a quiet n green corner.   Its a simple n pretty hangout n the open terrace is nice for morning n evening.  There are indoor seats too.  Service staff are cheerful n friendly.

Author: jenlim2014
Title: Nice and reasonable price
Review: The staffs are friendly and food is simple but good.  Nice and clean place.  It is a sister restaurant of Kebaya.

Author: GrannyBEnglandEngland
Title: Attractive small old mews restaurant. Cater for Gluten and dairy free.
Review: We sat outside in what was the old mews, tall garden shrubs gave a tropical feeling, there is an air conditioned restaurant inside. It has a small boutique hotel upstairs. Very friendly welcome, good menu, a bit limited for my gluten and dairy free, but they managed well for me. It’s in China Town and rather tucked away, it took us about 15 minutes to walk there from E&O Hotel. Not expensive and we enjoyed our evening there.Show less

Author: WilliamL81
Title: Great Food, Good Prices
Review: I did not stay here, but ate here regularly over 6 days. Great Penang fusion food & health-oriented Western dishes.

Author: ScotKPEdinburgh, United Kingdom
Title: Delightful spot in the bustle of George Town
Review: Very friendly, well presented staff in a great little Mews not far from Love Lane. Cocktails were delicious and well made and the duck massuman curry is probably the best I’ve tasted! Satay and other starters were also really tasty. Went here twice during our visit and really recommend it Show less

Author: Richard B
Title: A friendly restaurant and the food was good
Review: This is a very pleasant restaurant and the staff are very friendly and helpful.The food was good, we had the meat platter for two people which was excellent.The prices were very reasonable. There is air conditioning inside or you can sit outside. We ate inside as it was quite a warm evening.Show less

Author: sundarv672
Title: Cozy eatery
Review: Great food in a cozy location. Air conditioned well and has a great variety of drinks to check out .

Author: intoTheHorizonAustralia
Title: 2nd Visit at this cafe, nice ambience with great food. Highly recommended.
Review: This cafe is located in Jalan Muntri, Georgetown. Great place to quench your thirsts after visiting some of the great touristy spots in Georgetown. Great food, good customer service. Nice courtyard, surrounded by lush greeneries. It has a bar and the food menu was enough to whet your appetite. You have a choice of outside dining or in the comfort of airconditioned inside seatings (go for the outside seatings on a balmy tropical early evening). We shared satays and and rendang - they were delish. We had fresh juices - they hit the spot (especially on a very hot day). Good spot, brilliant food. Who goes there, foreigners and locals and guests from the hotel.Show less

Author: juanaise53France
Title: Quality with a beautiful smile.
Review: Muntri Mews is in the centre of the Heritage old town. This spotlessly clean restaurant serves fresh , authentic local foods , and if you don’t know , just ask the waitresses June and Sheila who will explain expertly the different sauces and ways of cooking ! All the staff here are wonderful and June and Sheila deserve my extra compliments on making my holiday week a happy and welcome one. It would be hard to recommend one dish, as I tried nearly all , and they were all delicious. The Green Bowl salad is original and fresh, the best salad I’ve ever eaten. The Rendang very tasty, the chicken dishes juicy, and the sea bass cooked to perfection. Don’t miss this restaurant, or the cocktails !!!!!!!Show less

Author: Rose PPortsmouth, United Kingdom
Title: Cool Stop
Review: Stopped here for a long cool drink on my walk of the Heritage Trail in Old China Town. George Town area. Very clean. comfortable seating. Fans outside to keep you cool while relaxing. Toilets very clean. Prices here reasonable. Very calming place have also eaten here.Lovely. Very attentive staff.Show less

Author: TravellingNewburys
Title: Ore dinner cocktails
Review: Great cocktails, competitively priced and a good range! Try the muddled mojito, probably the best prepared I’ve had :-) Sheila very helpful, tables and area very clean, great to sit outside and people watch.

Author: AzurianWorthing, United Kingdom
Title: Good food.
Review: It was very quiet the night we ate here; we've passed by before and it had been busy. Service was good, and the food arrived quickly; the menu is not that big, so we both had fish- my wife's mackerel fillet with rice, and I had a fish fillet with a lovely spicy tomato sauce. The fish tasted really good and fresh, the seating area was comfortable and the staff friendly- a great evening. Credit cards accepted.Show less

Author: No_BS_svp
Title: Very pleasant
Review: We shared a platter for 88 MYR. It was plenty of good and excellent quality. Very good service and enjoyable outdoors seating area. Recommended.

Author: ScottLoarPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: We four were all new to the Mews Cafe: A cooler afternoon on the patio
Review: Sunday lunch on the patio as the outside temperature was only 27C in George Town, and we were all new to the Mews Cafe.Our lunch:Vietnamese spring roll - the sauce was excellent, not nuouc maam but something quite different) - RM19.08Chicken satay - yes, yes, satay is everywhere in Malaysia and Singapore but this sauce was not the common oily, hot peanut sauce but tastes unlike any we'd had before - RM21.20Amok - a great name for a dish that I can only describe as a warm seafood mousse served with prawn crackers - 19.08Then on to the mains:Duck - roasted, served with potatoes done in duck fat - RM29.68Malaysia noodle salad - not Chinese and not Thai but right in between and unique - RM27.56Thai fried rice served with pickled vegetables and a nice, delicate omelette - RM27.56Fish - eaten up so fast by our Chinese friend we didn't have much chance to comment - RM29.68Desert, just a single serving of the Mews Passion (a crumble mixed with mango slices and a passion fruit cream dolloped on top) at RM18.02 and a Tarik Creme Brule of, well, chai tarik, RM16.96.Mews Cafe is well worth visiting and repeated visits. This cafe belongs to the Muntri Mews on Jalan Muntri, and is a cafe, not fine dining to be confused with Kebaya at Seven Terraces.Show less

Author: I5768GYjohnmSt. Helier, United Kingdom
Title: Nice restaurant with good food and service
Review: Went here late on our first night as not far from the Edison Hotel. Kitchen was closing (9:30) but they let us sit down and order. Food was very nice, not to spicy and the service was good. Live music also which was nice but the restaurant is quite small so glad we were not sitting right in front of the duo that were performing!Show less

Author: fredzipSouthern California
Title: Good food at the hotel
Review: Very good food, nice staff, good selection and best of all, right at the hotel. We came to taste the street food but found out there was this gem right in our hotel. The staff all spoke english and the food ranged from traditional Malay to a fusion of SE asian food. A great experienceShow less

Author: PerthgourmandBedford UK
Title: Authentic Malaysian flavours
Review: We never eat twice at the same place when roaming new territory but we enjoyed our first meal here so much that we had to come back the very next night.Situated in a quiet street of Georgetown, yet only a stone's throw away from all the busier bits of night time hawker stalls. The food was authentic and so interestingly delicious, the staff were very friendly, professional and warmly welcoming. The quiet outdoor terrace made it even more special for dining under the stars! The loos need a mention as they were absolutely spotless. I would rate the dinners we had two of the best meals for my week long visit to Penang. Show less

Author: Wongluk
Title: Nice breakfast
Review: Came for breakfast on last day. Come before 11 as their breakfast finishes at 11. Standard western and some local choices. Coffee is good. Come if staying nearby.

Author: jessmcd1985Brighton, United Kingdom
Title: Very very good
Review: We had a delicious dinner here last night. It wasn't cheap, but everything we had was tip top! The flavours, cooking, and service were all excellent. We had some fresh rice paper spring rolls with lovely sticky peanut dip, a fresh and zingy plate of chicken in sauce with salad and pickles and an amazing roasted duck dish served on roast potatoes and onions in a delicious massaman curry. We were so impressed we ordered three deserts! Really wonderful high end opportunity to savour flavours of Malaysia. Thank you Mews!Show less

Author: travelandee
Title: Great service
Review: I had a good time with friends. Such a lovely place,  great place to chill and awesome service of the friendly faces of their crew members.  Good to recommend!

Author: GSWTay
Title: Food and service
Review:
Food and service no longer the same... ordered nasi lemak, banana toast and hot coco. 
Wanted to reserve for morning breakfast and was told will be full.... We walk into a empty cafe.

Author: Andrea L
Title: Lovely food
Review: We enjoy eating at Mews Café and the garden is lovely but unfortunately last time we were there we had to wait 1.5 hours for our main course. Quite a disappointment as it was a special night.

Author: 750indrag
Title: Great ambience and superb staffs.
Review: I have been living in Penang since 2011, and The Mews Cafe is a place we must go on regular basis. It can be for breakfast, lunch or dinner. The foods are nice and delicious, be it western breakfast or the nyonya cuisines or even tea time. What I like so much is the staffs, each and one of them are very pleasant, attentive and never failed us. They are great with my kids and of course their communication level with guest-customers is excellent. Since I posted my check in at Mews Cafe in FB quite frequently, my friends did asked where is the place so I recommended them to come and they did and loving it too. Cheers Mews and to all of you. Show less

Author: Amelia_MeiSingapore
Title: a perfect place to end off the night
Review: walking the whole day under the hot sun, and there is nothing like a good drink at Mews Cafe. Live-band was present and we had some light snacks. The staff were lovely and attentive to us. They knew we were staying at the sister hotel and helped to call up the hotel to get the voucher for us. really wonderful service .Show less

Author: Flyinglarks
Title: Delicious Lunch
Review: A cool shaded haven on a hot day.  We enjoyed our lunch at the Mews Cafe.  We were seated quickly and our order arrived promptly.  A nice lunchtime experience

Author: foodpanatic
Title: Good food & service
Review: We found this place while walking around Georgetown. It was a perfect setting for a wonderful night. Actually we just plan to have some drinks but the waitress was so nice that we try her suggestion. And to our surprise the food suggestion is really good. We try the Cucur Udang and Banana Fritters. We really enjoy especially the service. All the staff are very friendly and helpful. Would defenitly recomment this place.Show less

Author: starbelleeeSingapore, Singapore
Title: Disappointing service and food
Review: Went on a Tuesday evening - excited for the food/ambience/service, given the great reviews I read on Tripadvisor.Was sorely disappointed by the service and food- the waitress was very curt when we asked for food/dessert recommendations, forgot our dish of chicken satay, and it was also very hard to get her attention (eg to order dessert) as she was talking to her colleague half of the time. We were also told that the live music was only on Saturday night.What we ate:- beef rendang (6/10, rice was really aromatic but the beef was very dry)- Laksa (7/10, mix of Assam Laksa and Singapore’s Katong Laksa, but quite an acquired sour taste — either love it or hate it! I personally liked it but my mum ate a spoonful and would not eat any more)- Gula Melaka sago dessert (6/10, interesting at first but it was too filling after about 3 spoonfuls)- Banana fritters (8/10, the bananas were deep fried and delicious- the vanilla ice cream 3/10 as it tasted really artificial)Overall: good ambience, average food, and poor service. Would not come here again even if I had the chance to.Show less

Author: LondonBezzaLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Terrible Service
Review: We stayed at Seven Terraces which is the sister hotel to this place and therefore had high expectations. However, it became clear as soon as we arrived that this place wasn’t anywhere near as good!There was a large group of about 15 on the night we visited and the staff tried their best to put us off eating even though it wasn’t a private hire/party. We suggested that they took our order whilst the group were enjoying their drinks which they reluctantly agreed to do - not the best start!!Our waiter was rude and stroppy - it really seemed that he didn’t want our custom and frankly was lazy as he didn’t want to serve anyone else other than the group even though it became clear that they had all pre-ordered their food so not exactly a difficult table to wait on!! Oh and they also didn’t sit down to eat for at least 45 mins after we arrived so he had plenty of time on his hands...When he took our order he suggested we skip starters so that it would be quicker for him - we told him no which made him even stroppier!! He practically threw the dishes at us. The food came out quickly and was very tasty but the service left a sour taste which ruined the night. They clearly couldn’t cope with what most restaurants would consider to be a small group. Perhaps they should consider private hire only for groups of 10+ if this is the case?Very disappointed especially as we had such a great stay at Seven Terraces and dinner at Kebaya. Based on our experience I wouldn’t recommend. Show less

Author: jermpins
Title: Nice terrace, food was average
Review: The restaurant has a very pretty terrace. Food was average. We were only allowed the breakfast menu as they were hosting a wedding luncheon. Coffee was not acceptable.

Author: Susee1980
Title: Rendang
Review:
The beef Rendang! What a treat.

Beautiful little place with great food, wine and ambience.

I really liked the live singer and guitarist too - I've ever saved his Spotify album :)

Author: Nancy BFranklin, North Carolina
Title: We went back for more!
Review: This is a nice small restaurant with WONDERFUL food. The people are friendly and helpful and the price is right. It seemed like an oasis on a hot day. I had the Chicken Satay - twice- and loved it. I had Chicken Satay at other restaurants and they were a disappointment compared to Mews Café.Show less

Author: canbax
Title: Lovely little cafe
Review: A friend of my daughter met us here for lunch. The food was very good and they served wine!—Not every place does. They also accept credit cards. The air conditioning was welcome after a hot walk shopping in the little shops near by.

Author: girlinagirdleKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Best meal in Penang - seriously!
Review: I love Georgetown and the food in Penang is known to be among the best in Malaysia, but honestly I would drive past the street food (Gurney drive etc) to eat here. The food is delicious, freshly cooked and served in a glorious shady and green setting. Portions are ample and service charming. I really like the fact they do veggie options of all their favourites.I think it’s priced absolutely fairly for the quality it is and unless you are on a very strict budget it’s accessible for most people. We love it and will be back!Show less

Author: GeraldeaneKMannum, Australia
Title: Breakfast
Review: We had heard a lot about this place from different people traveling at different times on the Rapid Bus, so we decided to go and see for ourselves. We decided to try their local breakfast (when we visit a different country this is what we like to do, try all the local foods) - we have been trying to remember the names of the dishes ????? But they were very yummy - give it a go well worth it. CheersShow less

Author: JulioG
Title: Avergae
Review: We ate here because the Indian restaurant that we wanted was closed for whatever reason. Food Ok, but nothing special. Pity.

Author: nguynavBrussels, Belgium
Title: Worst cafe experience for me!!
Review: I came to this cafe with a lot of expectations looking at the picturesque images shown. It was fairly ok. But to my utter disappointment, the food in the cafe was extremely limited and very expensive, For someone who have travelled to Europe and US, i find the portions extremely small and inadequate, Talk about cutthroat experience! For e.g., it would cost RM 32.00 for small plate of croissant sandwich plus tea plus a small glass of orange juice!! For 10 euros i could probably get huge plate of sandwich in Belgium! In addition to that the taste was extremely bland and i had to repetitively ask for chilli sauce. It was indeed a very bad experience for me!!Show less

Author: Viraj247
Title: Lovely Lunch
Review: Discreetly hidden cafe in Georgetown which is well worth visiting. The food we ordered was great quality and taste. Freshly made juices to order and rounded off with fresh Ginger Tea which was wonderful. Would definitely recommend you go here if in Penang.

Author: Warren M
Title: A must stop
Review:
The lovely ladies who work here could not have been more hospitable or charming.
Service was amazing, beer cold, all the appetizers were delicious.
I would recommend sitting outside to enjoy the relaxing atmosphere.

Author: Flora002
Title: So delicious !
Review: A restaurant in a quiet, well-positioned street offering delicious cuisine. An attentive and very pleasant service with Ryan and Shida. I highly recommend this restaurant.

Author: beckso
Title: Lunch
Review: Nasi lemak is peranakan style, which is pretty good. Nice ambience, quiet with good internet connection plus tentative staff

Author: Jesusloveyou
Title: A must-go in Georgetown!
Review: Ordered the popular beef randeng, banana fritters, watermelon juice and Mews' Madness for our lunch. The food quality was top notch and matched with travelers' previous comments. Hope to be back one day!😋😋

Author: mole562
Title: Great service
Review: Very friendly staff who are very accomodating. They offer a reasonable vegetarian menu and do a great vegetarian pad Thai

Author: mammupHo Chi Minh City, Vietnam
Title: What an awesome place!
Review: I'd found Mews on TA with tons of good comments, so I came here with high expectation. This cafe was really excellent, came beyond my expectation. Food: we ordered 2 dishes: a laksa and a grilled chicken served with rice. Both tasted very good, I especially loved the Laksa soup, I think it's a must-try dish at this cafe. Drink: mango smoothie was great with taste of fresh mango, not of syrup like some other cafe. Mocha is fine.Service: service is the coolest thing here. The manager was so nice that he helped me to check my adaptor then lended me his one. He also talked with my friends and me to learn some words in my language. Other staffs were friendly, quick serving, too. Show less

Author: TeenserBWashington DC, District of Columbia
Title: Delicious dinner in a Euro/Malay setting
Review: Enjoyed a delicious dinner next to the courtyard here on the first night of vacation, not alot of people when we ate so of course great service and spectacular intro to some Malay dishes.There were some decent cocktail options too. Perfect place to sit back and relax with a nice breeze and light chatter.Show less

Author: Derek675
Title: Service and food are excellent
Review: Very friendly service and excellent food. Had the tasting platter which was first class. The fish was exquisite and though this was more expensive than other restaurants it is well worth the money. Decor and ambience made for a very pleasant night out.

Author: TomGuppySherborne, United Kingdom
Title: Fantastic meal and atmosphere
Review: Read the reviews on TA and knew this would be a place we would have to visit whilst in George Town. Walking distance to our hotel it seemed a perfect place to celebrate my wife's birthday with our baby daughter. On arrival we were really impressed with the decoration and the greenery outside of the restaurant. You can tell a lot by simple touches, and you could see that the owners have really made an effort. We were greeted by staff to the table outside and they straight away got a highchair for our baby daughter, without us asking. Throughout the whole entire the meal all the staff were so friendly and helpful and catered to our every requirement. They also were extremely playful with our daughter, which mad sour dining experience a whole lot easier.The tasting platter my wife and I chose to share as we liked the concept of trying lots of dishes on the menu, and this did that. Wow! It was incredibly good. Each dish was so flavoursome and authentic. It included sides and a little desert. Our meal was very reasonable we felt for what we paid and we enjoyed an excellent evening. All to the help of the staff and the chef. Keep it up Mews! Thank you for providing such a fantastic meal on a special occasion. Show less

Author: Barbara H
Title: Good food
Review: Relaxing atmosphere.  Good variety of food Western and Asian food. Vegetarian friendly.  Touristy but good food.

Author: RolandP636
Title: Friendly delicious and relaxed
Review: A lovely little restaurant with quick friendly service and really well cooked tasty food. We had the vegetarian options which were variations on the standard dishes, but excellent in their own right. Spicy coconut milk based soup was particularly good. Banana fritters for dessert were a real indulgence.Show less

Author: Pacificwoman59Brisbane
Title: Lovely atmosphere and delicious food
Review: We were looking for somewhere special to go on our last night in George Town and we were very happy with our choice of the cafe at Muntri Mews. This isn't the cheapest place in town but the food we had was delicious and the drinks were cold and reasonably priced.The building has been beautifully restored and there is a lovely ambience to the cafe area.Show less

Author: Craic59Melbourne, Australia
Title: Excellent Food and Service
Review: We found the Mews on TripAdvisor and were not disappointed we went for the tasting plate and our waiter explained all the dishes and they were all excellent even the desert was amazing. A taste of Malaysia and I can't pick a favourite! They also had a nice Australian WA 2013 Merlot which went down very nicely. We found the tasting plate portion quite adequate and left very satisfied. Definitely recommend and thanks to google maps for getting as there!Show less

Author: kempy55Singapore, Singapore
Title: Stunning food & reaonably proced
Review: Came here for dinner - Super relaxed and attentive staff - love the heritage building and the food was incredible. Highly recommend the vegetarian spring rolls, chicken satay and for dessert you can't go past the delicious banana fritters with vanilla ice-cream - easily enough to share between 2.Show less

Author: RoseinGarden2017Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: A boutique, luxury place to eat
Review: I was invited by a family member to dine here, the atmosphere was heritage-like and most people were tourists staying at muntri mews boutique hotel. The food was not great, but it was nice. The portion size was a bit small for the price charged. the staff were friendly and attentive. Recommend for heritage visitors but not recommended for more than once or twice.Show less

Author: LinusNgNewton, Australia
Title: ok for a cool break
Review: We stopped by during one of our walks and the place was a wonderful cool break for a drink. As the place was well rated on TripAdvisor, we decided to order the satay chicken for a snack. Presentation was good, however, the satay lacked the delicious Malaysian coal fire taste. Show less

Author: ASCKK
Title: Touristy but good food at a reasonable price.
Review: We both had Malay dishes and enjoyed them thoroughly...presentation was excellent.  Yes, this is a tourist haunt but the food is good and, surprisingly, the live music was OK even if a few less mainstream songs would have been appreciated.

Author: LinhTran89Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
Title: A nice place for chilling out
Review: I were here with my friends on our last night in Penang and we did not regret anything at all. We went there after 8pm on Saturday night so the live music was already started but there were still some tables and we had a table for four. The food was quickly served and was very good. The cocktails we ordered were also very nice and they brought us good memory there. Definitely will go back there if we would be in Penang next time.Show less

Author: Edith Suk Hing C
Title: A cozy little cafe where you can relax as long as you like
Review: There are indeed many types of laksa available in the city but the one in Mews Cafe is just right for even the most picky eaters! This is the third year I flew to Penang for their Laksa, or perhaps just for their laksa!

Author: bruce iGold Coast, Australia
Title: Tropical setting
Review: The all day menu is excellent. This well run restaurant is attached to the boutique hotel called Muntri Mews but the hotel is discreetly located with no infringement by way of noise etc. The staff are well trained and attentiv Go at night and you might be mistaken for being at a tropical resort.Show less

Author: SeacroftKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Meah Mews
Review: Pleasant enough little cafe which is part of the Muntri Mews boutique hotel. Feels a bit backpackerish. Pleasant service with a reasonable Asian menu. Malaysian food all tasty but not very spicy. Decent prices and a useful place to grab a quick meal on the move.Show less

Author: NatalieS4449
Title: Excellent food and cocktails
Review: Food is wonderful, fresh, and so tasty.  Real mixture of traditional and modern dishes. Cocktails are pretty good too :)  Staff are very friendly and helpful.

Author: I7372YDmariec
Title: Excellent choice!
Review: Had a great dinner there. I had the "special menu" which was composed by several small elements. Everything was good and tasteful. We were pleased by the food and the service.

Author: urbandivaLondon
Title: Lovely food and great service
Review:
Delicious food with lovely ambience. 

Helpful staff and courteous service. Treat your self to good local food in a lovely setting!

Author: WhereIsMarkNowFort Lauderdale, Florida
Title: What happened?
Review: Was my favorite place and now it's not. Paper menus, poor overall food choices and just disappointing. Its clear the restaurant and its food have gone into the can. Some of my favorite people are still around but I fear this too will pass. At this point in time, I'd say pass here, too. Sad, really. Show less

Author: Pippetss
Title: Had high hopes...
Review: I was very much looking forward to visiting the Mews Cafe, having read such fantastic reviews.I'm something of a nightmare diner, with the awkward combo of being vegetarian and celiac, so I always Google "gluten-free" when deciding on somewhere to eat. This place seemed to tick all the boxes, so off we went.Ordered the veggie Vietnamese Spring Rolls (which were absolutely delicious!!) and the veggie Sayur Lodeh. I couldn't spot any gluten suspects in the ingredients list but I double-checked anyway, just to play it safe. The server went to check with a colleague and informed me that it was made with coconut milk and asked if I was allergic to that. I explained that coconut was fine but I couldn't have anything which contained wheat flour.When my dish arrived it was a bowl of coconut milk with some (sparse) vegetables in it, without tofu, Tempe or tofu skin described on the menu. I was a little disappointed to say the least, since it's not the cheapest place to dine and I wasn't told that they would be taking these ingredients out.I asked if the tofu/ Tempe had been fried in wheat flour, since neither contain gluten unless they're battered and fried. I was then sent a plate of tofu separately but I'm still not sure whether they were or were not deep fried in flour! I believe there had ultimately been some confusion about what gluten was and I'm only writing this post because it might benefit to have some extra training around this. The place itself is very ambient and lovely and the staff very friendly, I just couldn't enjoy my meal because firstly it was lacking and then subsequently I'm now worried about whether I was just "G'd" or not. Oh well!Show less

Author: jimwijaya
Title: Homey Atmosphere Cafe
Review:
Pros :
