The Food taste, cleanliness, services were great. All the staffs were really friendly as we really enjoyed having a dinner there. 

Cons :
The price quite expensive and you need mosquito repellent if you plan to have your dinner there.

Author: MAChanoiHanoi
Title: Exquisite little place with welcoming staff and perfect menu
Review: When you have already "done" the street food George Town is famous for, do yourself a favour and come here. Sit out on the tiny terrace and feel sheltered by the cool tree-cover and pampered by the friendly staff. And then the food! You will not be disappointed. This was my favourite "find" in George Town -- they won my heart by listening to my allergy concerns and treating me like a queen. Special tasting menu without prawn sauce! No small feat. Penang signature dishes, a few western and vegetarian items as well. For me: Pricey but Perfect.Show less

Author: jeremykmlLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Good local food in a restaurant environment
Review: We had a good dinner there. Drinks are good too. The food is good, the ambiance of the alley is great. There is some live music playing too. You can book a table if needed. I will recommend that place for dinner however : the service is not at the level of the place and the food. (Example : the waiter standing on my left was serving the plate to my wife that was seating on my right) If it improves that will be good. Show less

Author: ponnapa2016Bengaluru, India
Title: Safe retreat for comfort Peranakan food
Review: After visiting two dozen restaurants with our excellent food guide in somewhat humid and crowded spaces, one begins to look out for having a meal in peaceful surroundings without having to compromise on the quality of food. We had a wonderful lunch in very comfortable settings - great ambience, excellent service and good food. We also ordered a proper seafood "tiffin" for two the next day, which was sumptuous and very convenient. Strongly recommended.Show less

Author: 88sh8
Title: Nice spot for breakfast or lunch!
Review:
Positives:

- nice little spot for breakfast (get a table outside) or lunch (try the fresh coconut juice!)

Negatives:

- none!

Author: meiling_9Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Local favourites in a comfy cafe setting
Review: I'm quite sure that Mews Cafe is not going to be serving the best local fare - it is Penang, after all. If you want "the best", head out to the stalls/street. But that's not to say Mews Cafe does not serve up tasty dishes. The nyonya laksa was light, creamy and full of flavour - no mean feat for this dish. Service is friendly and attentive. No complaints. And the space is pretty, your typical Peranakan-style cafe. The old-fashioned marbletop tables are perfect for that Insta-snap.Slightly more expensive, by Penang standards but not astronomically so. In the heat & humidity, it's a small price to pay for good local food in a pretty, comfy setting. Show less

Author: 318lindsaya
Title: Beef Rendang - Boom!
Review: This place is great. Been busting to try a beef rendang and they delivered. The portion is a little on the small side if you are very hungry, but perfect for me today. Iced coffee not bad also.

Author: NQ_NganHo Chi Minh City, Vietnam
Title: Nice place, good food
Review: It's the only restaurant in Geogre town that I can eat curry (the others' curry is too strong for me)The rice with coconut milk is tasteful. Yummy salad.Expensive but worth it.The only minus: the restaurant is too hot outside but too cold inside. Feel sick after finish my meal.Show less

Author: CarlosCazorlaSingapore, Singapore
Title: Tasty food
Review: The menu is not very extensive but the food is really good. The waiters were extremely helpful and friendly. I will not think twice about eating there again. It seems that they have live music on Saturday evenings. Not sure about the rest of the weekShow less

Author: KRA20
Title: Brillant cafe and restaurant in the heart of old George Town
Review: Super little cafe and restaurant attached to the Mews Hotel. Food is very good; the staff super friendly. Nice little spot to watch world go by

Author: 968cherylnManila, Philippines
Title: Fave spot in Georgetown
Review: Whilst Penang offers lots of places to dine, I highly recommend The Mews Cafe. So much love and attention goes into the food and it's staff are so dedicated to attend to your every whim. Though the modern interiors are not the traditional Penang style, this wonderful cafe offers a glimpse of its bygone past through the genuine service and hospitality of its service staff. I am particularly impressed with my server June who recognized and welcomed me as if I was a regular at the cafe the 2nd time I came for a meal. Her recommendations were on point and she anticipated my needs before I asked for it. Kudos to this little oasis. Show less

Author: Ronan Ray FKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Condescending and Rude Management
Review: While the service staff were helpful and nice, the owner/manager is rude and condescending. She probably shouts or embarrass her staff all the time that she forgets and extends this attitude to a paying customer. Next time a customer has difficulty opening the toilet door, there is no need to shout and be condescending. The food wasn't too great as well. It is overpriced for a kiddie-sized meal.Show less

Author: DanielleGAustralia
Title: Beautiful food and service
Review: We were on the search for vegetarian food and had a wonderful pad thai here. The staff were very accommodating and friendly. Great drinks spot in the heart of Georgetown, close to the graffiti art with stunning decor. Tranquil little spot. Highly recommended 🐵

Author: B2006HCmarkwMelbourne, Australia
Title: Major disappointment
Review: We were recommended to come here by the folks at Kebaya (it might be a sister eatery). We ordered Nasi Lamak Bento and struggled to eat it owing to the poor quality of the chicken cooking. Considering how many cheaper hawker options with amazing quality there are in Georgetown, it was kind of heart breaking to pay good money for this. Wine list terrible. Not recommended. Go instead to Kesum instead.Show less

Author: JenniferJ2626
Title: Brilliant food!
Review: We came here on out last night and had the pad Thai and beef rending, it was amazing food!! Definitely recommend, great prices too for a top class restaurant! Service was excellent as well. 5*

Author: JKJYSingapore, Singapore
Title: Mediocre local food
Review: Service was really fantastic here, and the restaurant was very quiet with 0 waiting time on a Tuesday evening. However, I find that the food is very mediocre and on the pricey side. Wouldn't come here again.Show less

Author: blufeather
Title: Very enjoyable
Review: Great meal in a lovely atmosphere.  Staff were attentive and drinks were cold and quick to be served. We enjoyed everything we had, satay, Vietnamese spring rolls and Pad Thai. Ingredients were fresh and delicious.

Author: Stewtop
Title: Brilliant little place
Review: Excellent food and service on a quiet street away from the vibrant streets of Georgetown.  Breakfasts, both the international and local dishes, were good.

Author: BellaRosie74Melbourne, Australia
Title: Fabulous food in lovely setting
Review: We stumbled across Mews Cafe on our last night and I'm so pleased we found it. Initially we planned to stop for a drink only but the menu looked great so we stayed for dinner. The service was fantastic, the good delicious, especially the beef rendang - fabulous presentation. There was also a good selection of wines by the glass. I'd highly recommend Mews Cafe, a lively oasis to sit for the evening. Show less

Author: Funquoir
Title: Enjoyable meal
Review:
Final night meal. Was very enjoyable. Portions are quite large including the biggest 'starter' I have seen...

Pleasant atmosphere and friendly staff. Like many meals food can come quickly so ask for a break between starter and main course. Was too full to order dessert.

Author: primoferio
Title: Very welcoming
Review: I visited mews cafe last week..  food was excellent.. my wife and i experience a very welcoming atmosphere ..staff was very efficient all pinoys by the way and all smiles.. hope to see you again..

Author: JacobO634
Title: Great ambience great food
Review: We ordered the platter ($72 ringgit), laksa spaghetti and nasi lemak bento. Being foodies, we all feel that the flavors are great :) love the alfresco dining atmosphere and the off-track feel of the restaurant. Enjoyed the dinner thoroughly with my family.

Author: moonuchz
Title: Pleasure time with lovely breakfast here!
Review: Yummy food with nice ambience and clean restaurant. We like Roti and poarched eggs a lot. Beef burger is also recommended. Very good service and friendly staff. Thanks to Mr. A.J. for your friendliness and hospitality!! :)

Author: wheelsie24A
Title: Great lunch spot
Review:
We enjoyed the Malaysian platter - a good range of food and not too much for us.
We had a nice chilled white wine with it.
The staff were friendly and helpful.
We would certainly go back again.

Author: pibandpob
Title: Good food, great service and a delightful setting
Review: We had the platter, which was lovely. The waiters were very attentive, and the setting was a calm oasis. We paid equivalent to around £40/£45 in total, which included a shared starter and four cocktails!

Author: sophiat1084
Title: Excellent Malaysia food
Review: Personally, this is not the best food I have ever had. But this is the best Malaysia food that I've ever had. Love the Vanilla Latte.

Author: r0bb054
Title: best food in georgetown
Review: Ate outside several nights with friends from Australia and told others to visit ,food was excellent. The location is excellent with many bars close for a pre dinner drink,lovely laneway location with outside dining as well as inside,service ,food and ambiance was perfect.

Author: Jane R
Title: A Hidden Oasis
Review: Hidden between back packer hotels in a rather scruffy Georgetown street, this little cafe is an absolute treat to find. You can relax and cool off, with the world passing by just a few feet away, but in your own quiet oasis.

Author: Toller7Mellbourne
Title: Dissapointing meal
Review: We had dinner here based on earlier reviews. If seated outside the courtyard is nice for ambiance and shade . We were seated inside and found the menu selection and meals a little disappointing and overpriced compared to other restaurants. I didn't want beef or chicken and consequently felt that choices were very limited ( chicken seems to be a standard ingredient in many Malaysian dishes )Three of our group of four didn't finish our meals as we didn't find the flavours or combination of ingredients that inviting. My third son ordered fish and chips and was happy with this selection. We headed for dessert to Safe House after this as we left Mews cafe still hungry. Show less

Author: A1154TZmelanieb
Title: Great Place
Review: This cafe is a great location to start the day. They offer several choices of breakfast variations. The coffee has good quality and the fresh juices are refreshing. I can highly recommend this place.

Author: MEAFaroAlgarve, Portugal
Title: Friendly and tasty
Review: Having messed up the day of our booking for another restaurant we did not feel like going too far and this one was right near our hotel. The day before, when we arrived, we had tried to eat there but it was late and they did not serve food. So here we come and enjoyed it. Nasi Goreng, a mango salad, satay, among other things. Without being excellent the food is tasty. Fast and friendly service.Show less

Author: MaksmumMelbourne, Australia
Title: Lovely
Review: Lovely cafe with a relaxed atmosphere. The menu was eclectic and I decided on the special of the week. It was a take on a local dish and was delicious. Excellent presentation. The service was good and the pricing was very reasonable. I was very happy to have found this cafe and will frequent it again.Show less

Author: NickL163
Title: Great little oasis to eat
Review: This lovely restaurant is one of the must places to eat when in Penang. Believe it or not the chicken pie is fabulous as is the fish and chips all served along side a good local menu. Prices very reasonable.

Author: Global-K-TWTaipei, Taiwan
Title: Simple and relaxing place for local delicacies
Review: The seating arrangement in this cafe was simple, clean, and relaxing. Moreover, the wait staff in the cafe were friendly and attentive. They would listen to the customers and provided the adequate information and advices for the selection of dishes for us. It was not so easy to find a vegetarian dining place for my parents during the holidays of the Chinese New Year because of they strict diets. However, we all had a enjoyable lunch here because of the tasty food at reasonable prices, as well as their good services.Show less

Author: Josephine O
Title: A late find
Review: While staying at their sister hotel we were directed here for a meal.Everything was perfect and the staff very friendly.Think our next visit we will choose to stay here.

Author: Photodude45
Title: Excellent Malaysian Food
Review: We had lunch in this excellent restaurant. The Malaysian food was well prepared and very tasty. The service was great and we really enjoyed the outdoor seating in the garden. We highly recommend this Malaysian restaurant.

Author: Peter M
Title: Good find
Review: First night in Georgetown and took advise from Trip Advisor for somewhere to eat. Great Vietnamese Springs Rolls for starter followed by main good of chicken satay. Very enjoyable! Nice seating outside under trees and good seating inside with cooling fans. WI'll return!

Author: emmiemie
Title: Nice place to relax
Review: We took a good break here after visiting the blue mansion. The food was nice and the environment was very relaxing.

Author: InnnaKhiChiang Mai, Thailand
Title: Cozy place
Review: Very cute cafe with friendly waiters and delicious food. Our order was accepted quickly and waiter advised what it is better to try. The food was prepared and served unusual. I really liked the salad with smoked salmon. The salmon melted in the mouth. Highly recommended to fans of tasty fish. We dropped the spoon, the waiter came up immediately, does not allow us to pick it up and bring a new one. Location quiet and no noise. It's nice to spend a relaxing evening. The only disadvantage - a little expensive.For one glass of wine, one beer and 2 dishes we paid 100 ringgit.Show less

Author: ginoj1967
Title: Good food
Review:
Good food eaten. Great service. Friendly People. 
Take time to explain  what  the local food is. No hurry. Good food good price

Author: TmenziesJakarta, Indonesia
Title: Lovely Relaxing Cafe
Review: A nice little cafe attached to a boutique hotel. The cafe has a small courtyard plus indoor seating. The menu has a variety of local dishes, from which I chose Ikan Sambal. The food was cooked and presented well (the fish was lovely and moist), with the blue rice being an eye catcher!The courtyard is the sort of place that you could while away an afternoon, but sadly I had other plans which kept me from doing so!I will definitely come back!Show less

Author: Roznat2013Bangkok, Thailand
Title: Best meal we had in Georgetown.
Review: We went for dinner and everything from the beautiful outside setting, the amazing food, friendly staff who kindly charged our phones for us - (whew!) was fabulous. Every dish we ordered was great, the chicken samosas and Nasi lemak were stand outs but then the shrimp Vietnamese spring rolls and beef randang were a close second. We ordered the house wine which was very reasonable and cannot recommend this place enough, by far the best meal we had in Georgetown and didn't cost the earth. Compared to those ranked higher on TA this place was fantastic food and value for money.Show less

Author: EmmaT1978Perth, Australia
Title: Gorgeous Find
Review: My step daughter and I were just wandering when we came across this gem of a place, lovely terrace and food was amazing. We had Helen's Curry Mee and the Nasi Goreng which were fantastic. The service from the staff was great and I must mention the toilet-very clean which has been a rare find on my visit so far! Show less

Author: Dallas H
Title: Good food on offer
Review: Good food here and reasonably priced with a great location and sitting among the palms is really lovely.

Author: Dai N
Title: So so
Review: I came for breakfast and coffee, the foods were okay. When I finished the maple syrup I asked for a bit more to finish my French toast, then brought me honey and mentioned nothing about they changed the maple syrup to honey. They thought I can't recognize that's not maple syrup? I called them to comment and they said they'd already finished the maple syrup. I asked them to take back the honey cuz I don't like the taste suddenly changed, after a few minutes stopped eating, they brought me some more maple syrup and said "sorry the maple syrup still stays". ???!!!! What do you think about they are??!!! ;(Show less

Author: lasatuArgenton-sur-Creuse, France
Title: Staff could be more welcoming
Review: We were staying at the sister hotel Muntri Grove so called in here after dinner for cocktails and the occasional dessert. Despite going every evening for 5 nights there was never a sign that we had been before- apart from the one girl but she wasn't always on the evening shift. This goes against the GTH brand as we have stayed at Seven Terraces and then at Muntri grove where everyone goes out of their way to be friendly and helpful. At Seven terraces they even remembered us from the year before. It's such a small thing which makes such a big difference. Having said that the cocktails were good as were the banana fritters. Others have said how good the food is but we were always too full to try.Show less

Author: Ian_70_UKSunderland, United Kingdom
Title: Quality Establishment
Review: If you are looking for an authentic Georgetown restaurant look no further. The menu caters for most tastes and the Malaysian food does not disappoint. Excellent food and excellent service in this very picturesque colonial period building. Did not stay in the hotel but it is set back off the street which will make for a quieter stay. Enjoy!Show less

Author: savarin-bkkCambridge, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent service by Cafe Manager Rizal
Review: The highlight of our stay at Muntri was the excellent service we had at the Mews' Cafe. We had just checked in and wanted to have something close by, but we were told that the restaurant wasn't able to seat 10 guests. We would have happily gone elsewhere if not for the fact that we had elderly members in our group. The manager Rizal arrived shortly after and moved the tables around to accommodate all of us. At this stage we were already very happy, but the food that we ordered were amazing. The cucur udang was the best I've had, the ayam percik perfectly cooked, and the gula melaka so rich I could have had it by itself. We'll definitely be coming back, especially for the warmth of hospitality by Rizal and the Muntri staff.Show less

Author: 256hafizs
Title: Breakfast disappointment
Review:
They have a great menu but very limited breakfast menu. Really bummed out when we went there for breakfast.

The place is nice, but this is the first time in penang weve encountered such expensive food. This was our 3rd day btw.

Author: Arran W
Title: We stayed here
Review: Good breakfast ,great friendly service,ate one night here,nice surroundings and quiet,good tasty food not big choice but did not expect more as this is in essance a cafe /small resturant serving a boutique hotel

Author: Robert S
Title: Good, but westernized
Review: Good food, but small portion sizes and somewhat westernized dishes. Around 30 MYR FOR a meal for one person.

Author: maestrroBusteni, Romania
Title: Very much overrated
Review: Average food, high prices, low variety. All in all... nothing special. I wouldn't return here. This place doesn't worth the rating it has on TripAdvisor.Show less

Author: Aoipha
Title: Expensive
Review: I recently had breakfast here with my partner during our trip to Penang. I had the French toast and it was tasty but expensive for the amount given. My partner had the salmon with scrambled eggs and he found it was rather flavourless. However, the room is beautiful and the staff very friendly. Show less

Author: Hambeary
Title: 5 star service!
Review:
Loved the deco so popped by for a drink when passing by.
Service was soooooo good I felt compelled to let everybody know!

Author: SpyGirlTravellerSingapore, Singapore
Title: Cute Little Cafe with Good Food
Review: I loved that the this little place was lined with red palms, which provided a welcoming, cozy space. There was a good selection of food, which was tasty & well-presented & a good choice of drinks as well. I noticed that the other patrons were also enjoying the food. Service was attentive, though a tad robotic. Show less

Author: AlmyhappySingapore, Singapore
Title: A pleasant cafe-like restaurant with good food
Review: A western cafe but the local food was surprisingly tasty. Had the sampler for 2 pax and the serving was generous. The chicken, rendang, vegetables, fish were delicious. The skin for the samosa was the least tasty as the dough was too thick and a little powdery. The kuning rice is fragrant and the blue one is not so nice though - tasteless and hard.Overall, enjoyed the meal.Show less

Author: longika
Title: Wonderful food in the a very nice location.
Review: The food is just amazing, good taste, nice portion, good price. The drinks also very nice. Highly recommended.

Author: FengXueSGSingapore, Singapore
Title: Nice cafe
Review: The good thing about Mews is that they are open the whole afternoon and their menu has excellent selection of local cuisine. So if you missed lunch time (a lot of restaurant and food court close in the afternoon), you can still have a good local meal in this nicely set-up cafe. The price is a bit expensive though.Show less

Author: hohoclara
Title: Amazing food
Review: We order curry soup noodles, fish sambal and nasi goreng. Everything tasted amazing and cost averaged around 26MYR per main. If we have more nights here in Penang would definitely want to have dinner here again.

Author: milham82
Title: Delicious Christmas meal
Review:
I booked this place for my wife and i to avoid turkey. We opted for the local tasting menu which was divine. I'd happily eat here again. 

The food was delicious and the staff went out of their way to accommodate us. Thank you.

Author: inna2005
Title: Cozy
Review: Cozy cafe to have ur breakfast.. super friendly staff and basic tasty food.. try the beef bagels. . Recommend 👍👍

Author: JoceyJ
Title: Brunch at Mews
Review: Lovely cozy place.We had their Breakfast set with is yummy.local/Asian Prata with curry & Nasi Lemak + Toast with eggs & ham, baked beansEach set comes with Hot Coffee or Tea & a small bottle of cold-pressed juice. ~ approx RM30 each.I'll like to visit it again in the evening next trip I'm there.It's very walkable to -The Blue Mansion (pls note the tour hours)-Chocolate/Coffee Muesum, -and v. nearby to HaiNan Clan/Temple (see pic)Show less

Author: annie_ladybird
Title: Amazing little place
Review: We spent Christmas Day evening here which also happens to be my husband's birthday. The tasting platter was beautiful and well presented and a great way to try several things off of the menu. They presented my husband with a birthday cake and sang to him which was very sweet and kind of them. Highly recommend. Make a booking to ensure you get in! Show less

Author: 371nicolasd
Title: Wonderful food !
Review: We had an amazing lunch at Mews cafe. I highly recommend the sample platter for two. Very tasty! Prices are very reasonable and service is very good.

Author: DCtravler244Washington DC, District of Columbia
Title: Excellent Tasting Platter
Review: We had lunch here and shared the local tasting platter. It was a great introduction to Penang cuisine. The service was attentive and friendly. We sat inside, which is air conditioned, but there's also an attractive outdoor seating area. The cafe accepts phone reservations. A find!Show less

Author: 451nicka
Title: Beautifully presented and delicious!
Review: The food is a delight and the service was something that I have found hard to find in Malaysia. Thank you to the staff and the chef for making it so special

Author: MirmeOrillia, Canada
Title: Gorgeous courtyard delicious food
Review: Just had a salmon bagel with refilled cappuccino and fresh pressed juice and it was devine. This place is a bit of a treat price wise, but worth the quality and atmosphere if you are looking for a serene morning. Service is also great! (Thanks A.J!)Show less

Author: Patricia OLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent food with charming service
Review: The food in this very charming setting is well above average. The chicken satay with peanut butter sauce was abundant and the sauce was among the best peanut butter sauce I've ever tasted. The Malay dishes we both had were beautifully cooked and well presented. The service was excellent. The place itself was set in a well vegetated, small garden with the banana trees giving it a great jungle like appearance.Show less

Author: RoryG286
Title: Awesome!
Review: Great service and beautiful food. Good place to go as a couple. Nice and quiet spot but only a stone throw from all the busy streets.

Author: EronyWKuching, Malaysia
Title: Friendly service with good food
Review: The place was not crowded and we didn't need to make any reservation. We ordered 2 appetizers, main course and a dessert. Costs us RM116, a little expensive for normal standard but worth your money. The chocolate cake with ice cream is heavenly!Cucur udang comes in a big portion, we couldn't finish it. Aglio Olio a little too greasy. I was contemplating between nasi lemak and the steamed fish with sambal and the server recommended the fish. The fish was really delicious. The waiter is attentive and friendly. We are happy with our meals. Show less

Author: Caroline WBattle, United Kingdom
Title: Great local food and service
Review: The service in Georgetown leaves a lot to be desired but it is always good here. We bring guests from UK here on a regular basis and have always had a good time, with great food. At weekends they also have live background singing in the courtyard area.Show less

Author: thompeyMale
Title: Love it 😍
Review: Absolutely love this place so we went twice. Beautiful people, a polite and kind guy Mr. Arief look after us the first time. Energetic and absolutely loving what she is doing Ms. June, look after us on our 2nd visit. It's a very beautiful thing to meet people who are so passionate about what they do. One of the best local cuisines in Penang for sure. comfy and cozy ambience. Reasonable prices. Gotta love it ❤️ Show less

Author: jordanm652Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
Title: Nothing special to write home about
Review: After reading the positive reviews we thought we'd give this restaurant a chance on our last night in George Town. We tried a sampling of the local cuisine for two. The portions were tiny and apart from the bass in banana leaf which was good, every thing else was mediocre and no better than the hawker street food. The Penang beef was too chewy. The desert, banana fritters and ice cream, was downright very oily and awful. Show less

Author: LakeanahuacAberdeen, United Kingdom
Title: An Amazing Evening
Review: My wife and I showed up at Mews Cafe without a reservation and the staff went out of their way to make us feel welcome. The food was wonderful. We started with spring rolls and then Aglio Olio pasta. Even the presentation of a serving of ice cream was impressive.Our evening was made even more special by the duo singing and playing guitar. Overall the evening was memorable and we will return the next time we are in Penang.Best regardsShow less

Author: faridafaizMale
Title: Welcoming service + Delicious food
Review: A place you would want to visit again even at first sight. Vintage interior, authentic and heartwarming vibe the place itself gives out is something I couldn't miss out. Friendly and splendid service is the best and one of the many reasons I want to go back again. Food, amazing! So far, Aglio Olio Asian style is amazingly delicious and a must try. I would visit again and try more and for sure enjoy every moment. One more reason to visit Penang and love! Show less

Author: ByxbeeLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Impressive vegetarian selection!
Review: We went here for dinner and loved it! Friendly staff, great environment, and very tasty food. Plus there are plenty of options for vegetarians!The menu is mainly traditional Malay dishes. I had a vegetarian version of Sayur Lodeh which was outstanding- a coconut broth with the right amount of heat plus tofu and veggies. My boy loved the traditional laksa, which was mentioned in a lot of reviews. Food was very reasonably priced (RM18-28). Booze was pricier (RM28 per drink). Staff was all very friendly. I highly recommend it and will be back again!Show less

Author: alexrolfe4London, United Kingdom
Title: Trust the reviews, top place for lunch/dinner
Review: If you are looking for a well located, cheap to middling cost restaurant, you couldn't do better than Mews Café. Frankly I am surprised that the food was as cheap as it was considering the quality, location and the level of service. It was easy to find, just within the heritage zone of Georgetown, set within the historic streets. We ate outside in the courtyard along a quiet street. The view is of some of the local houses and despite the quiet it is very entertaining watching the locals and tourists pass by. You'll not be bored!The food is obviously the main draw. It's not expensive, roughly 18-26RM per main meal, and is very good quality. I went with the banana leaf wrapped sea bass, and my fiancée with the phad Thai. We also had vegetarian spring rolls and chicken satay, which was more than enough food wise and cost less than 80RM. The sea bass was well cooked and the curry was fantastic, and the blue rice was a bit different. The choice on the menu is all for variations of local food so don't expect anything western (which is a good thing!!). Overall we would certainly come back here when back in Penang. The staff were polite and attentive and we had a good laugh, so definitely a safe bet for lunch and dinner.Show less

Author: James E
Title: Great food in a great place
Review: This place is great. It is full of character and charm and the food is fantastic. It's not cheap but the portions are huge. We had to cancel one of our dishes when the starter arrived because we realised we had ordered way too much!

Author: RaniskaJakarta
Title: Good food, good service
Review: I had dinner at the cafe and at first was unsure what to choose from the menu. Ryan, the Philipino guy recommended Ikan sambal (steamed seabass with sambal in banana leaf, salted egg, rice, cracker and salad) and this appeared to be one of the best foods I had in Penang! I would go there again if I visit Penang next time.Show less

Author: F179DOthomasm
Title: Nice place
Review: Nice place away from the noizy areas in central george town. We spend one evening eating outside with live music - very good evening. Price level resonabel and food snd drinks high level.

Author: Julie S
Title: Hidden on Muntri
Review: Lovely food and good coffee in the heart of George Town.  I would recommend this restaurant/cafe to anyone.

Author: joycelohlamPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Cosy Restaurant
Review: Cosy place for foursome for a meal and catching up. Food choice limited but quite good in taste and portion size. They've the air-conditioned side of restaurant as well as al fresco. Could be warm outside during the day and cooler in the evening. Staff are pleasant and friendly. Prices are around RM25 to RM30 per person for a meal. Worth a visit.Show less

Author: The_Rh1no
Title: Amazing food, reasonable price
Review:
Pleasant and helpful waiting staff. Would definitely recommend. We had 3 course meal with drinks for about 110rm.

I would definitely recommend for that special meal, or if you just like dining in style.

Author: MTRChicagoFoodiePenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Consistently very good, don't miss
Review: We went with another couple and had a very good meal. We enjoyed the spring rolls, followed by the sambal fish with blue rice (spicy but not too hot), and loved the beef rendang. We ate outside on the small but beautiful courtyard area which allows you a glimpse of the action on the street as well as a view of the very nice garden they have there. They offer beer, wine and mixed drinks so no need to bring your own. I would definitely recommend for any meal as we have had breakfast, lunch and dinner there. The service was very good by western standards, top notch by Malaysian standards. This is definitely a place to visit.Show less

Author: Ruth MLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Perfect outside seating area!
Review: We ate there several times, as it was such a lovely place. Set in a small courtyard, next to the street...quiet, but also good for people watching. Fantastic cocktails(thank you lovely June), great food every time and friendly, perfect service from fantastic staff. My husband and I loved this place and highly recommend it.Show less

Author: Wingecarribee
Title: Nice meal.
Review: Stopped here for a very well presented and tasty meal. Friendly service. A good retreat from the heat or rain. Muntri Mews and Residence provides various services. I only made use of the café restaurant but there is also accommodation etc. available.

Author: RaphaelaK4
Title: Best place for high quality food
Review: We went twice to have an awesome dinner. Great food, amazing staff and superb atmosphere. I can highly recommend for dinners, coffees or even breakfast.

Author: lolitsme48Petaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Perfect for every meal
Review: The menu includes a variety of food and my girlfriend and I came here thrice. I will definitely recommend the sago for desert lovers and also the kerabu dishes. The sago is a common desert in Malaysia but mews sago is extraordinary with the right balance of coconut milk and brown sugar. The other food on the menu is tasty and we love Ikan sambal and noodles. Comes in the right amount of spicy. All we had is plain water so I can't comment much on the drinks but definitely a huge selection .Show less

Author: Tay08
Title: Nice little cafe
Review: A good place to have a bite or a drink after walking through the narrow old streets of Georgetown.  The atmosphere is relaxing and service is good.

Author: Turn176
Title: Muntri Mews Cafe
Review: Fast, efficient and friendly staff, clean premises. Somewhat more expensive than nearby outlets but perhaps that means good value for money. Food is authentic and rich in flavours without being over done! Expectations wont be disappointed. This was our 5th visit.

Author: opinion3
Title: Good food and service in a nice setting!
Review: The Mews cafe offers a nice setting with good food and efficient, friendly, service. The cafe is set back from the street with lush foliage and fountains.

Author: 72fengmingl
Title: nice place with local food
Review:
been there at 9:00pm for dinner. nice place in western enviornment. live music singers.
food arrived in 30min due to many guests. mis send the food for my wife and we accepted. local food tastes ok. expensive

Author: 286iantTangerang, Indonesia
Title: Quaint Dinner
Review: We chanced upon this place while walking. It is hidden among lush greenery and features black and white films on its walls. The food is not bad but the price is slightly steep for its local hawker root. We had the Nasi Lemak which was well composed but the rice was slightly salty. Nevertheless it is still a nice a hangout place.Show less

Author: torycoates
Title: Tasty rendang
Review: My brother and boyfriend enjoyed their delicious beef rendang and I found the flavours in the banana leaf seabass - good level of spice without being overpowering! Good value although cocktails quite weak.

Author: martvdkooi
Title: Comfy dining amongst green foliage
Review: Well recommended for a comfy secluded dining, good food, attentive and speedy service. Thumbs up guys!

Author: Seng K
Title: Good food and ambient
Review: We ordered nasi goreng, nasi lemak, gado gado. Food was good, not really spicy. The sambal chilli was excellent. And gado gado well done. Great. It could be a little over priced though. However, the ambient make up for it.

Author: Mahe_F
Title: Positive stay
Review: Good food, Nice staff, nice terrace in shadow, a bit expensive for Malaysia (i paid MYR35 for meal+drink). The area is calm and reposing.

Author: Sjors v
Title: Very nice food and friendly staff
Review: We had the gadogado and it was very nice. The menu is a bit pricey but alright. The staff is very friendly and will help you with your choice. A lot of tourists but it was no bother. Would recommend for lunch.

Author: Sabrina D
Title: Excellent food and service
Review: Lovely evening with great local food, good service (thanks Ryan!) in a nice atmosphere. One of the best on our round trip in Malaysia!

Author: Ikoikokam
Title: Relaxing place and outstanding food
Review: Just arrived to Penang we went to have an early dinner. Everything order was more than good and the tables outside in a small green area very relaxing

Author: movingsin
Title: Heavenly authentic
Review: This cafe is situated in one of the Georgetown Heritage Hotels (a group of truly marvellous restoration projects in the gorgeous historic centre) and has a comfortable, relaxed vibe to it. Perfect for a quiet lunch or coffee if (like was in our case) the sun is getting just a little too scorching. If you do drop by, though, I strongly recommend trying out some of the mouthwatering food Mews Cafe offers on their menu. We had the local tasting platter with a dessert of fried banana and it was sublime.Show less

Author: ChaksLAKLKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Delicious food. Charming Setting. Great service
Review: I had lunch there yesterday. A lovely comfy oasis in the heart of historic George Town. Beautifully restored heritage building with stunning, elegant boutique hotel attached. Felt very welcomed by the staff as I got there. Was given a cool cloth box to keep my bags in rather than chuck them on the floor or clutter up chairs. Got a fresh neat tasty mango juice while waiting for my friend. Once she got there I got superbly presented blue rice nasi kerabu with sea bass cooked in a banana leaf. See pic vYummy! She had the special which was baked fish with cheese. They were happy to give her extra vegetables instead of fries. She enjoyed both. I was told they don't used farmed fish and many of the spice mixes are based on recipes from the owners' family members. And you can tell from the fresh home cooked taste. For dessert we shared perfectly done, caramalized banana fritters. Together with an espresso and a long black. Both excellent. Recommended. Show less

Author: M30_MOLLY
Title: NORMAL FOOD
Review:
This cafe has a small and nice garden outside with a relaxing and beautiful ambiance. Read good reviews hence decided to try it out.
Ordered the local food, nasi lemak and laksa. Taste was mediocre, nothing special but quite expensive. Service was also average.

Author: ady2
Title: Shady cafe with great coffee
Review: I went for breakfast here every day that I was in Penang. It has the best coffee under lovely shady foliage. What a great way to start the day.

Author: mumbaimonkeySingapore, Singapore
Title: Average food
Review: Stayed at the Muntri Mews..heard about the food. Decided to give breakfast a shot. Mum had Nasi Lemak while I had Roti Chanai. Mine came with chicken curry. We both felt the meal was average and not worth the high price. But others seem to rate it highly so it could be just us. Show less

Author: amyroyce
Title: Laksa is incredible
Review: Sit here and watch the world go by along Jalan Muntri while enjoying your laksa and relief from the hot Penang sun. As good as the reviews say.

Author: ahmedeA4934GD
Title: Great food and atmosphere
Review:
This is a lovely little place with great reasonably priced food and friendly staff.

We tried and would recommend the laksa lemak, beef rendang and ayam perchik. For dessert, the Pengat Pisang was lovely. Be sure to try to fruit juices.

Author: tungmayw
Title: Sweet escape from the heat
Review: Little cafe with good atmosphere. The food and drinks weren't cheap like one drink could be 15 MYR but it was good and the portion is big. Aircon was the best part to escape the heat in the middle of the day.

Author: therealglenntuazon
Title: Great tasting platter
Review:
The tasting platter is fantastic. It has a little bit of everything and is more than enough for two people.

The fish in sambal sauce and the vegetable samosas are a must-try.

Author: 580ivyw
Title: Lovely cafe
Review: The place is quite charming at night. Nice ambience, above average food. We had 4 dishes and 4 drinks for less than MYR100.

Author: H6630VAjamiel
Title: Fantastic
Review: Great food, great ambience. Lychee margarita is to die for. Reminds me of Surrey Hills in Sydney. Highly recommended spot. Great service too.

Author: woodylightyear7
Title: Delightful setting. Perfect after seeing the Cheong Fatt Tze Mansion
Review: A quiet spot off Muntri street near the Cheong Fatt Tze Mansion (Blue Mansion). Food was reasonably priced and of very high quality. I had the Nasi Lemak and was not disappointed. Also has very good air con and free wifi. Would recommend.

Author: andrewmY8759PFMount Lawley, Australia
Title: Small size, Large flavour ,Small in price and Large servings
Review: We loved this resturant. The resturant choices were excellent. I chose a cheaper Gado Gado, I am glad I did. Home made satay sauce, all the original ingredients plus it vegetable fritters . My friends and beef/chicken malaysian style and the other dish was was a soup dish. The entres were large and delicious.Make this a must when staying in Georgetown .Show less

Author: EddieTdotToronto, Canada
Title: Great food if you are tired of hawker stalls!
Review: I have stayed at the same place and had their free breakfast 4 days in a row. The food is Malaysian style and it was excellent every time. I have also paid for a meal one night after getting tired of eating at the Hawker stalls. Also very good, but a bit more pricier compared to other places around.Show less

Author: EvaP1270Penang
Title: Dinner for friends
Review: I had a dinner for friends with their set dinner served. ALl was super excellent from the time we step in till we leave. Set dinner portion was good and dessert was really nice. Atmosphere was great as we chit chat and eat and laughter was in the airShow less

Author: PassionatehawkerMelbourne, Australia
Title: Very nice meal in a lovely setting
Review: We enjoyed our dinner share plate very much - I really loved the Beef Rendang, my husband the chicken. Ambience was lovely, on a humid Penang evening sitting outside with a bit of a breeze was great. Staff were very attentive and our drinks were also very nice. For the service, setting and quality of food and drinks I thought this was more than reasonable (AUD $40). Show less

Author: justinhewettHo Chi Minh City, Vietnam
Title: Breakfast or Brunch?
Review: Mews Cafe located about 500 meters down on Muntri Street is one of the top-rated restaurants in Penang, and a seemingly excellent place for breakfast or brunch. This was the last of the places I had on my list to eat and I'm glad I made it before I left. The food was quick, tasty, and inexpensive. I am eager to come back and try some other things on their menu.Show less

Author: Laena R
Title: A nice cosy quaint cafe
Review: The mee curry was a popular choice at the cafe. It has a really nice ambience at night and seems like a popular dining spot for tourists.

Author: Animir
Title: Very good but a little bit expensive
Review:
Food is really good, nice choice of fusion Asian food. Staff is really friendly and attentive. 
Price is a bit too high though even if portions are quite big.

Author: Lingyun
Title: Romantic place
Review: I came here thought it was a cheap place for local or Malay food, because there is one $ sign at trip advisor. Big NO. This is one of the more expensive ones for Penang. Meals at 20-30, coffee at 10+, beers starting at 13, Sommersby at 20. Having said that, the ambience is romantic and service is very good. This small cafe sits in a quiet corner. You have a choice of indoor and outdoor, equally good. Show less

Author: 878kellyx
Title: Great looking food!
Review:
Wanted to look for local delights and went for this cafe. Expected a simple fare but the presentation of food that came awed us. One would feel hungry just by looking! Food was great! 
Would hope to have more choices though.:)

Author: katriinaiLulea, Sweden
Title: Not so good value..
Review: The prices are OK, not so cheap. The food was very tasty. We took the platter for two. It was quite a big dish. Inside was toi cold so we wanted to eat outside. There it was good, especially when the waiter put the fan on. I had a hair inside my juice, but I got another one. Average, little bit "better place" for fine dining.Show less

Author: Yasmina2311
Title: Great food!
Review: This was recommended to us by our friend who lives in Penang and it did not disappoint! Great food with some Nyonya style cuisine. Very good decor makes the place very open and welcoming. Good prices too

Author: graemewest
Title: I good service and food
Review: Stayed at Muntri Grove a short distance away.  Same owners and both are excellent at service.  Good value for creative food.  Blue rice on some dishes shine.  A diverse menu and good environment.. far from a  street food experience and a nice indulgence

Author: KadazanMum
Title: Good variety!
Review: Love the breakfast concept, pick an breakfast item on the menu and it comes with a glass of freshly squeezed orange juice, coffee/tea. Good variety on the a la carte menu.

Author: Joris W
Title: A MUST DO IN PENANG. Great restaurant, Malaysian food at its best !
Review: Food is simply awesome, just like the service. i got a the discovery platter for 2, and it's big, finger licking good and give a real good overview of Malaysian cuisine. Price is actually very affordable for this type of quality. every details is good, juices are not full of sugar, service is friendly, smiling, discreet and very professional. JUST PERFECT ! the whole family was completely pleased with this place.Show less

Author: Damien KMelbourne, Victoria, Australia
Title: Great food in a lovely setting
Review: Only went to Muntri Mews for a meal, but it was well worth it, and would certainly consider staying on this basis. It may be that some corner stalls and street hawkers serve as good or better food, but combining the quality of the food at Muntri Mews with its ambience is pretty special. Not cheap, but not over the top expensive, especially for the setting. Their curry mee is up there - maybe 9/10, while the coconut alks with vegetables and prawns was extra good - 10/10! My wife's mojito was also excellent! This is a place I'd happily come back to.Show less

Author: Moon1215Europe
Title: Average only
Review: We thought food was average. Nothing to write home about. How they got to Number 2 of 635 restaurants is baffling. Perhaps reviews done by people who dont know much about the local food. Staff were good but other then that I doubt they should be no 2. Seriously!!Show less

Author: 123AliciaR123
Title: Very nice cafe
Review: Went there with my friends and it was very nice. The food was very good. Service was good as well. There is outdoor seating in a small court yard. I enjoyed my Phad Tai, but the chicken was a bit dry. Loved the atmosphere.

Author: londonerac
Title: Okay but overpriced
Review: This was fine but overpriced for Penang. The satay was good but here were only two prawns in the Pad Thai and this was the most expensive meal we had in Penang. The atmosphere was lovely, the service was good but the food was average at best.Show less

Author: Iris S
Title: Rendang chicken
Review: We enjoy lunch here,food is nice special Rendang chicken rice! Hottest at outside,air conditioning is good feel comfortable!

Author: Manie G
Title: Overnight on business trips
Review: The food is excellent. Good quality and tasty food. Red and White wine is also available. Staff is excellent, always frendly and smiling and willing to service and to help. It gives the impression that they enjoy working and service at Mews Cafe and that is why I go back once a month on my business trips and drive 38km further to have dinner and breakfast at the Mews.Show less

Author: Wendell DNew York City, New York
Title: Might be better to arrive off-hours if you want to sit inside where it's cooler.
Review: This pleasant cafe and bistro has seating in a pretty terrace or small air-conditioned dining room. Not surpisingly, people seemed to gravitate to the limited number of tables inside, and I doubt we would have gotten a seat had we not walked in for a late lunch. Service was very good. Our food and drinks were flavorful and rich.Show less

Author: Tracey LCanberra
Title: Beef Rendang to die for
Review: We stumbled upon Mews Cafe by accident and were blown away. The tasting plate from across the menu covered everything beautifully, the beef rendang was so sublime we went back the next night for more of the Mews Cafe. The service was impeccable so where the cocktails, the whole experience was fabulous. The vintage crockery and serving trays were a nice detail.Show less

Author: 2RightyPerth, Australia
Title: Pretty Good
Review: Only popped in for the Rendang and not disappointed, particularly like the small salads that came with it. Thoroughly enjoyed the Sago desert too, one of the best. Service was excellent, such a quiet happy group, 5 stars to them. Guess the only point against the Rendang was that it was a little dry for my liking, but the flavours were certainly there.Show less

Author: MrsTMLJ
Title: Good little find
Review: My family of 5 ( 2 adults) really enjoyed having dinner at this place. My kids really enjoyed the Satay and Phad Thai. It had great atmosphere and good local food. This restaurant is clean, has good vibes and great food. We would go again.

Author: Hannah RLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Beef rendang! Order it
Review: Wow, I have to say I don't normally have high expectations based on reviews as they are good for an idea but we all have different opinions on what good food is.However, I came here two nights in a row at the end of my stay and ordered the beef rendang on both occasions. It was that good! It was the best meat dish I have had in 3 months of traveling and the best I've had in Malaysia. I don't normally go to the same place twice when there are so many other options, let alone order the same dish.Go here! You won't regret it (they do a good lychee margarita too).Show less

Author: 470drewp
Title: Awesome meal
Review: Terrific food, outstanding service and an amazing setting. The staff were also totally fine and helped with our daughters dietary requirements. Very impressed.

Author: EhyokyKuopio, Finland
Title: Great food, friendly staff and stylish place
Review: I had a dinner with my girlfriend here. The place looked very nice, touch of old and modern put beautufilly together. We were given an option to eat inside or out, we chose the patio. I ordered some noodle dish she ordered rice with chicken satay. Both meals were beatiful to look at and taste was great too. We saw some cakes inside and decide to order some dessert also. We wanted to taste the cake of the day with vanilla ice cream. There were two cakes, carrot and chokolate. Chokolate cake was really delicious but the carrot cake was probably the best carrot cake I have ever tasted. This all costShow less

Author: 968cherylnManila, Philippines
Title: My fave in Penang
Review: I spent 5 days in Penang trying out the all supposedly best places to eat, fromThe hawkers to the posh places, I even joined the heritage on a plate food tour but I dare say the best meal I had was at the mews cafe. I had the fish seamed in banana leaf and beef rendang. The meats were tender and the balance of flavors were perfect.'just the right touch of sweet, salt, spicy and aromatic. It wasn't too spicy that it drowned out other flavors, the meal came with a cup of blue tinged rice which I'mTold was naturally colored with butterfly pea flower. The pretty server June gave me some buds on warm water. Which gradually turned it a light shade of blue. The cafe itself is a welcome respite. The lush row of birds of paradise gracefully beckons and sways with the wind a tropical paradise in the heart of Georgetown Show less

Author: jshulzeSingapore, Singapore
Title: An oasis of great food and ambience
Review: This restaurant more than lives up to the rave reviews, a must visit in Georgetown. We had dinner and drinks there on a Saturday night. I had the chicken pot pie and my partner had the sea bass cooked in banana leaf. We are choozy foodies and I can say the courses were carefully prepared from scratch and the flavors really came through as we ate. The cocktails, Long island ice teas and a special version of Mojito prepared with Jaegermeister (it works!) expeditiously delivered and expertly blended. There was a guitarist and a singer, softly cooing out international favorites in the garden outside from our table. The interior of this small restaurant had open windows but just enough air conditioning on to cut Georgetowns night heat. Service and drinks first rate and the prices more than fair. A thoroughly enjoyable dining experience in Georgetown.Show less

Author: surreygirlSurreyEngland, United Kingdom
Title: Helpful staff and delicious gluten-free food!
Review: I called in at this restaurant, armed with a translation of the gluten-free diet I have to follow to remain well. (I have Coeliac Disease.) The lady I spoke to could not have been more helpful. As a result, my husband and I returned for dinner that evening and I enjoyed a delicious Beef Rendang with steamed rice and a little pot of vegetables, in peaceful, attractive surroundings.Show less

Author: Carlo FFlorence, Italy
Title: I had an evening drink, then dinner, with friends
Review: the place is pleasant. An outside space quite repaired with plants which is appreciable. The space inside is well proportioned and offers spacious wooden tables. Food is very good (we ate chinese and malay) and served generously, and service is assiduous. You may think differently, but I definitely prefer to eat in the absence of conditioned air - and this is possibleShow less

Author: 684eval
Title: Food is ok but service a bit uncoordinated
Review: Had dinner and the food was good. Nothing special but ok. The service was a bit uncoordinated and it took quite some time just to get the drinks to the table after ordering.

Author: arhamid
Title: Musing on Mews Cafe
Review: I stayed at Muntri Mews for two nights and enjoyed it. Other than the interesting old 'barrack' style rooms, the Mews Cafe offers laid back old coffee shops atmosphere but with some good food. I didn't miss a breakfast!

Author: j cLucerne, Switzerland
Title: Good food
Review: Its a good mix of asian food and western food. Of course you cannot compare with a good plate of italian spaghetti, but its good enough to have a small taste of pasta. The live band was also very cool and they covered their songs very good. The waiters are very friendly. Try it!Show less

Author: aantillaSeattle, Washington
Title: Yum yum yum
Review: Seriously so great!! Our first Malaysian meal and I'm not sure if anything else will compete! From the tasty iced tea and the spring rolls (fresh rolls) to the amazing meal my boyfriend and I just had! We will definitely be coming back!! And wifi too!! Show less

Author: UlliRahnMelbourne, Australia
Title: Delicious + they have vegetarian dishes!
Review: I'm vegetarian so in georgetown it's maybe hard to find places for vegetarians but here they have some dishes as vegetarian version. Awesome! I ordered noodles and wow so many different spices and herbs, was really tasty and portion is big. Bit more expensive but totally worth the money. Very nice restaurant/cafe. Would definitely come back.Show less

Author: philli1Hagley, United Kingdom
Title: Really good food and service
Review: Came here during CNY when a lot was closed. We were lucky to get an outside table. The food is really individual and good. The curries were excellent but the starters were to die for, especially the Vietnamese spring rolls.The service was up to the Malaysian standards.I should say that it was so good we came back again.Show less

Author: RoyF31Newark-on-Trent, United Kingdom
Title: A Great Place to Discover
Review: My wife had seen the reviews on this place and after we found the Junk Cafe was closed unti March we set about finding this place and were not disappointed. The food was delicious my Nasi Goreng was the best I have had my wife thought her noodles could have been hotter and was not as enthusiastic me. The ambience was good and the staff efficient and friendly and the price very reasonable. I would recommend this restaurant without hesitation.Show less

Author: Ian_is_homer
Title: Had lunch here
Review:
Lovely surroundings and good food and drinks.

On the pricey side and coffee is in a tiny China cup, the vegetable noodles were lovely, but again on the steep side for asia

Author: HoiW2000
Title: Great food and service
Review: Very delicious local fare with decent prices and excellent service with a smile. Try the Penang Assam Laksa and Nasi Lemak Bento! For desserts, the banana fritters and chocolate cake are a must!

Author: Singapore1704Singapore, Singapore
Title: Amazing Resetaurant Serving Food with TLC
Review: Lovely restaurant in Penang's historic Georgetown area. The food was full of TLC - lovely potpourri of flavours. I had ayam percik (roast chicken), the best I have ever had. Finished off with sago pudding - very rich and just the right amount of sweetness. Even the coffee was very good. Highly recommended!Show less

Author: LuckyLoversBlairgowrie, United Kingdom
Title: "Delicious Malay Food"
Review: We happened upon this lovely little place and really enjoyed the food. I had Sea Bass cooked in a banana leaf and my husband had Beef Rendang. Both plates were gorgeous and very reasonably priced given the quality of the food. Service was very attentive and we can readily recommend this place for lovely local food!Show less

Author: balirunner88
Title: Oasis on a Hot Street
Review: Hot day in Georgetown but enjoyed a couple of hours sitting in the shade at Mews. Great food, great service. Would recommend to anyone looking for a break after taking in the sights and sounds of the city.

Author: championstuart
Title: Delicious food, nice service
Review: We stumbled upon this walking down a nice colonial Street. Menu looked fabulous and the food did not disappoint. Had the beef rendang and it was perfect. It is not the cheapest place in that area but the food and service is second to none.

Author: greendoc
Title: Great food, don't miss the prawn fritters!
Review: This is the restaurant for the Muntri Mews hotel where I stayed. Their local food is great, their prawn fritters (cucar something or other) are fabulous. Great coffee too.

Author: sergioa464
Title: good place and food
Review: traditional Penang Food, very satisfy! the palace is as well very nice, just the service could be better

Author: Trang T
Title: We love the food here
Review: Very nice food and staff. We tried the local taste platter and chocolate cake with vanilla ice, we both love it very much. The blue rice is very beautiful to look and nice to eat 👍🏻

Author: POWxPOWBukit Mertajam, Pulau Pinang, Malaysia
Title: Small but cozy..
Review: Small place, cozy.. Food is quite nice but charge at premium.. A nice place for family, friend or couple but not big group.. Parking is a problem though..Show less

Author: EricY598
Title: Cosy spot in the heart of George Town
Review: Great local selection from snacks, mains and desserts with a wonderful ambiance in the heart of George Town.

Author: Davidlye70Singapore, Singapore
Title: Overrated food
Review: This cafe was rated number two in Tripadvisor so it was with much anticipation that I booked a family dinner over the lunar new year long weekend.The "kueh pie tee" and Vietnamese spring rolls were average.The coconut milk laksa was average. My mother complained of fish balls that were not fresh.I had fried rice with chicken satay. The rice was not spicy. The peanut sauce for the satay was bland.The only good bits were the carrot cake and the chocolate walnut cake.Will I come back? Only for desserts.Not worth the reservation. When it comes to food, it is a real disappointment.Show less

Author: WillMS777Chatel, France
Title: Great forest meal in Penang.
Review: We arrived after a pretty hectic trip from Hanoi. We had booked through a hotel company 3 nights at Muntri Mews but they had some bad/lucky news for us that unfortunately we 'had to be' upgraded to their sister hotel (which is amazing -review coming soon). But we did have a meal here to settle in and it was delicious. Service was fab. Good value too. Cake was surprisingly big and treated good. Cant speak highly enough about the staff though. Thank you! Show less

Author: KGB777Singapore, Singapore
Title: Popular with good desserts
Review: Came here for a quick dessert before heading to the airport. It seems like a popular venue, almost completely full on a Sunday evening. The menu seems to focus mainly on local food types - didn't try any of the main courses, but the desserts were good. Good atmosphere with helpful service.Show less

Author: jfmontouto
Title: Amazing food and service.. As good as advertised!
Review:
Had the chicken satay and the beef rendang as I'm quite picky with seafood. Incredible. The smoothies are also of the highest quality. 

As a Spaniard, I have trouble finding decent places to eat when abroad, but Mews was up to my standards.

Author: Denise B
Title: Stayed at the hotel and ate there often
Review: My boyfriend and I stayed at the hotel for three nights and ate multiple meals at the Mews Cafe (the hotel restaurant). The breakfast is amazing and the service is great. A little pricier than some other places, but still affordable compared to anything in the US. Show less

Author: DebbouiBirmingham, United Kingdom
Title: Delightful dinner!
Review: Thoroughly enjoyed having dinner here. Had a satay starter, beef rendang curry and cake for dessert. All three courses were delicious! The service was fantastic and the atmosphere was relaxed and welcoming. The staff were particularly keen to recommend dishes and explain the ingredients, which was a great introduction to the local cuisine. Show less

Author: Anita_MKMilton Keynes, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent intro to Penang's great cuisine reputation..
Review: On our first night in George Town we went to the Mews Cafe. We very much enjoyed the sharing platter so much so that we had difficulty deciding which dish we liked the best.Prices good and staff friendly and attentive. Would not hesitate to go back or recommend to others.Show less

Author: CarolCSCSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good food but ...
Review: what actually marks it out from the dozens of equally good food places in Penang? Not a lot, really. You can always eat well in Penang, but I didn't think, "WOW! I must come back again!!". We had the Jawa Mee and the Curry Mee, both full of flavour, if a bit on the sweet side for our palate. Still, both were chock full of ingredients and the gravy looks like it had been simmering for hours in order to achieve their flavours. I thought the menu was a bit expensive, too, for the place that it is; i.e. a cafe. Don't be put off though, it's still a nice respite from the heat (air-con! Air-con!) and a chance to rest with a good lime juice.Show less

Author: VeronicaLiew610
Title: Local favorites done right
Review: Have always enjoyed the food at Mews Cafe because of the attention paid to consistent quality and the emphasis on local flavours. The mocktails are great on a hot day as well!

Author: snen15Chiba Prefecture, Japan
Title: Modern Translation of Traditional
Review: Stayed 3 nights at the Muntri Mews Hotel, and enjoyed 5 meals and 2 night caps here. Started this trip from Bangkok, trying "local food" as possible - a bit tied, frankly, for our age. Every meal served here seemed "fusion" of modern and local. "Destructed Kebab" was a good example, please try. Checked out at 5 am for Malacca, the Cafe prepared "basket breakfast" - like mother, that we enjoyed at the airport with many thanks and tears.Show less

Author: Manori WColombo, Sri Lanka
Title: Excellent food & service
Review: We had breakfast here twice during our stay at Cititel, since its less than 3 mins walk from the hotel and the Cititel breakfast was awful. Muntri Mews has an excellent breakfast menu with many choices, food is fantastic, its value for money and the setting and service were superb.Show less

Author: Tuktuk_13Hua Hin, Thailand
Title: Nice restaurant, good location
Review: Enjoyed an OK meal here, good location and atmosphere. Staff friendly and helpful. I tried their Nasi Goreng, it was nice enough but not the best I've had, a little bland if I'm honest, my husband had Beef Redang which he didn't rate much either, however the others in my party had different dishes and all enjoyed theirs. The draft beer served on arrival was flat so we asked for a new one, I watched as the staff tried to "fizz' it up buy whisking it, it didn't work and they brought us bottled beer.Show less

Author: MumtoScruffyYorkshire, United Kingdom
Title: Really Enjoyable
Review: We had dinner here on two occasions during our recent trip. The good was well cooked, tasty and reasonably priced.We were served by a delightful Philipino waitress who was very pleasant and welcoming as indeed were the other workers.We will definitely return on our next visit.Show less

Author: 920yenas
Title: Good food good service
Review: We found this place thru tripadvisor. Food was good, not great but okay. Few local food from the menu were not available, even though it's just 7 PM when we ordered the food. Chocolate cake is recommended as dessert. Service was good, all the staffs were friendly and helpful. Show less

Author: sorayaputraKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Lives up to the reputation
Review: Food was great (and I've lived in malaysia for almost 30 years so I know what I'm talking about).Staff were super friendly.Free wifi.You can charge your phone.They have desserts.Great place to try good quality, very well done local fare. Would absolutely go back.Show less

Author: allycat3030
Title: Great tasting food
Review:
Found this place from previous trip advisor reviews and it didn't dissapoint.
The chicken Samosa's and Veitnamese Spring rolls tasted great as did the Mee Jawa.
Great little resturant in Georgetown.

Author: hong2205
Title: Excellent foods and service!!!
Review: One of the best cafe in Georgetown area! Delicious food and good service! Must try the Curry Mee and Vietnamese Spring Roll!!! Good environment, by the way behind is the hotel. It converted from mews. It look great! Will come back again!

Author: 755lucky22
Title: Great food
Review:
The Mews café serves really fresh, tasty food. The staff are friendly and the Pineapple and mint frappe is to die for, I had to go back a second time for more.

Lunched here twice and would definitely recommend.

Author: everclearskiesAuckland, New Zealand
Title: Pricier than stalls, but great food.
Review: I had a craving for pad Thai and also wanted to take a break from food stalls. This place was on the pricy side, but the food was well worth it. My pad Thai satisfied my craving and my husband had a beef/glass noodle/green mango salad dish which was very good as well. We sat outside under the trees and it was great to relax away from the heat and busy streets of Penang.Show less

Author: PrairieSailor123
Title: Premium local dishes.o
Review: Our party of 7 ate very well. A small but comprehensive menu of local and regional dishes. Good service, good food, good prices. We enjoyed ourselves.

Author: jbmadigan
Title: Very nice food
Review: A great place for a tasty snack. I had their chicken salad which was very good. It's a cosy place to stop on your travels. Only problem was that some of their drink options were not available which made for some tricky negotiations.

Author: pri1602
Title: Great Nyonya food!
Review:
1. Must-try: Ayam Perchik (with blue rice) & Fish laksa & Caramelized banana dessert.

2. Vietnamese rolls are decent.

3. Coffee is disappointing.

4. Service is excellent.

Author: larag978
Title: Lunche
Review: Good lunch after a warm walk. The satay was very good and the Vietnamese loempia's very healthy. Nice staff angry quite ambiance.

Author: Aditya K
Title: Best Laksa I've ever had! this coming from someone who lives in SG
Review: Their Nonya Laksa is to die for. Lemony with a twist of mint the taste doesn't leave for a while after. The rest of their food is also delicious and their staff is very friendly, professional and courteous. Also very communicative. That definitely helps.

Author: horhoruwm
Title: Great food and atmosphere
Review: A very cozy place to chill out with friends. Tasty food - we shared a dish called Local Tasting Sample and Pie Tee - and nice coffee!!!

Author: Anni H
Title: Cosy
Review: Pretty little restaurant with great food for a reasonable price. We had phad thai and nasi lemak and for dessert their carrotcake with a scoop of ice cream. Everything was so good,  and the staff was friendly. Recommended

Author: 445kieransHunchy, Australia
Title: Quality Food with Good Service
Review: I visited Mews Cafe a couple of days ago. The Gardens caught my eye as I was walking past one day earlier. The inside area is air conditioned but quite small, it also doubles as the reception for hotel guests. The outdoor area is lovely and lined with a tropical garden. I ordered a main meal and ginger tea. The portion was very adequate and very tasty. The quality of the dinnerware and cutlery was very high. This cafe is a little more expensive than some others nearby, however, the meal and ambiance well and truly justified paying a little extra. I would recommend this cafe to anyone looking for a quality served meal. The menu is not large but I think it would cater to most tourists looking for somewhere comfortable and tasty to eat.Show less

Author: amirahpMadrid, Spain
Title: For foreigners... Not very tasty local food
Review: Having been in Malaysia for a year and having very high expectation on Penang's food, this was rather disappointing. It was listed number 12 on Tripadvisor and decided to give it a go. We ordered some rice dishes and they were tasteless.. My advise is that, when being in Malaysia, go for the "less fancy looking place", there is where you find the best food.The food wasn't bad and the place was cozy but if you want to have a taste of real Malaysian food, this is not the place.Show less

Author: 423tamarasBerry Springs, Australia
Title: Dinner was yummy, good service
Review: Would return. Dropped in for dinner to this, the sister of the hotel we were staying at, which didn't have a restaurant. Food was yummy, fairly authentic. Service was good, although I don't know if I would remind the cocktails as they were a bit strong.Show less

Author: KW9999Swadlincote, United Kingdom
Title: Great food!
Review: My husband & I visited this restaurant on our last night in Georgetown, which is a shame as we'd have definitely gone back to try more on the menu! Great Malaysian food, best cocktail I had in town & very friendly efficient staff.We would certainly recommend to anyone staying in Georgetown! Laksa & Mojitos were fantastic! Show less

Author: 842heatherm
Title: Nice atmosphere and good food
Review: We had a nice and quiet dinner here, and enjoyed the food. The menu is mostly Malaysian style with a good range of options to try.

Author: wong_martha
Title: Quiet, green oasis
Review: Excellent breakfast with a good chose of local and western sets. Very good Chicken curry and my husband loved the coffee.

Author: RickKRTKratie, Cambodia
Title: Limited menu, but everything we tried was good
Review: We were staying in the adjacent hotel, so we had our breakfast here from the a la carte menu. Everything we had was delicious starting with fresh-squeezed OJ and fresh-brewed coffee. They have two Malaysian breakfast options with chicken curry and the rest is western. We also had some of their delicious snacks later in the day like chicken samosas and Vietnamese style cold spring rolls. One night we ate dinner there. It's one of the nicer restaurant options in the immediate area, and while small, the quaint boutique hotel environment and the tropical landscaping make for a very relaxing option to enjoy good food. Service is attentive and efficient.Show less

Author: j11gough
Title: Had a lovely dinner
Review: Very nice varied menu.  My husband and I are vegan and we both had different choices.  Very good food and excellent service.

Author: Kent W
Title: Small, lovely cafe
Review: This is a lovely little cafe.  I enjoyed the Penang sample platter.  Had live music which was also nice.  Price very reasonable.

Author: gregorioz191
Title: Discrete romantic location
Review:
A good authentic asian meal with a bit of a twist!
Service impeccable. Recommended for a romantic dinner.
We had a Laksa and Noodles.
Desert was surprisingly good for our european expectations.

Author: Olle A
Title: Nice little cafe with good food
Review: This cafe serves good Malaysian food. The chicken with cucumber and bean sprouts salad was particularly tasty. The chicken and shrimp noodles were good but not great. The staff was very friendly ad attentive. The coffee was excellent, both the black and the cappuchino.

Author: GaryW1387
Title: Lunch.
Review: Fantastic food and service at great prices. The Ikan Sambal and Vietnamese Spring rolls were a taste sensation.

Author: CK2012_12Singapore, Singapore
Title: little Cafe with great Food and Service
Review: You will need to have an open eye when locating this cafe along Muntri Street, it serve Nonya food, prices are very reasonable with huge portion and tasty. It have an indoor and outdoor sitting area, very peaceful place to dine in. I have a party of three, the server recommended the sampler, very good recommendation with the "blue" rice which gets it color from flower know as Butterfly Pea flower. Must visit and dine in when u are along the Muntri Street.Show less

Author: 841madelineh
Title: Not worth the price
Review:
Went there for dinner last week. The traditional rice dish was not really tasty. 
Furthermore the atmosphere of the cafe is cold and it seems the service is not at all interested in their guests wishes and needs.

Author: gerardn451
Title: Average lunch
Review: Not great food really.  No sense that it was fresh and funny enough, the table beside us who are regulars when in penang gave out to the waitress about the food

Author: epicwanderings
Title: Excellent for Western style breakfast
Review: Although pricey, Mews Cafe serves up a mean omelette and I had one of the best cappuccinos I've ever had. The interior is beautiful, with marble table tops. The staff were pretty friendly and welcoming too.

Author: Bonnie MMelbourne, Australia
Title: Good lunch choice in Georgetown
Review: A welcome respite from the heat we experienced in late October. The locale, although easily missed in what we thought was one of the nicest streets in the old town, was friendly, clean and provided ample choice for those after a distinctly south east asian menu. We would happily recommend this place to anyone wanting to take a breather from the sight seeing, as well as trying to find all of the 101 pieces of street art featuring cats that are scattered throughout the area! Well worth the visit. Show less

Author: MilindaD
Title: Amazing food and drinks.
Review: The bar has live music which is soothing and with a talented couple singer band. The beef rendang is recommended. The drinks menu is good and the staff are friendly too.

Author: Catherinetas
Title: Lovely setting
Review: Outdoor tables among frangipani trees provide an unexpected oasis from the eclectic jumble of the laneway. Food is good, some western influences as well as local fare, espresso coffee, lattes etc a bonus, a little pricier but quieter and more pleasant than other nearby options.

Author: AbsoluteHudaIpoh, Malaysia
Title: Cozy environment
Review: A lot of great reviews of this place brought me and my husband here to check it out for ourselves. As a local we know for a fact that food is of average taste. Noting too special... Orang putih can be easily blown away.... Hahahaha.( If you know what I mean.) The environment is cute and cozy.... I think that would be the main attraction of this little corner Cafe. More appropriate as a hang out place on a date night out or with buddies rather than with kids. My kids wouldn't know how to keep quite too long especially in a small area like this..I wouldn't be OK if they made noise here where the environment is suppose to be all about chillaxing and disturbing others peace of mind. I would give It a mother go... For dating purposes... Lingering till late. One thing I have to say is that service could be better... I know we are locals... But can't help feeling the foreigners are somewhat treated better by the waiters... Mmmm... Maybe is just me. Show less

Author: Roohi A
Title: Holiday in Penang
Review: The breakfast was divine. We also had a lunch sandwich which was excellent. A beautiful casual dining area with fantastic freshly brewed coffee.

Author: PearlPureheart
Title: Just chill out here!
Review: This is a very pleasant place to sit and watch the world go by.  Right in the middle of the old part of Georgetown.  Food and drinks good, service pleasant.

Author: 211selinan
Title: Unique and cosy
Review: A nice place to chill.  Not many tables but that's the whole reason it is cosy.  Try their banana fritters served with a scoop of vanilla ice cream.  Their Vietnamese rolls are good too.

Author: davidbarlic
Title: Nice quiet place
Review: Me and my girlfriend  went there for a dinner. Found it on tripadvisor for their recommendations, must say did not get disappointed. Friendly staff, nice location, good food! Will come back...

Author: WideWorldGirl
Title: Comfortable setting and good food
Review: Friendly staff. Food was good but I wasn't wowed. Could use better wine selection. We enjoyed their outdoor seating.

Author: catmarinho
Title: Average food, small portions
Review: Portions size seem to be a common issue in Penang. And I'm a petite woman who doesn't eat all that much. I can only imagine how that goes for guys! Pasta was good, nothing special. Staff was friendly enough. Ultimately not worth what it costs.

Author: BennWilson
Title: Great food!
Review: Very good Laksa in a nice setting. Also has something called Cucur Udang which I hadn't tried before. All Recommended!!

Author: Mei J
Title: Great cafe for local food with a nice atmosphere
