Review: Very good breakfast and local cuisine. The gula melaka and nasi lemak were very good as were the fish and grilled chicken. Cafe is small and has a nice relaxed homely atmosphere. There are inside and outside tables. Friendly and helpful staff. Very good wifi.

Author: Faizal2885
Title: Great!
Review: One of place that must be in your list when in Penang. We love the cucur udang and it peanut sauces. Will come back again to try other menu. The service is excellent and very attentive staff.

Author: MartynC_HKHong Kong, China
Title: I thought it was OK. My wife didn't...
Review: The MEw's cafe is very close to the Muntri Grove hotel where we stayed and we had dinner here the first night of our recent stay in Georgetown. I think this restaurant has the same owner as the Muntri. We ordered the spring rolls, the steamed sea bass with blue rice, chicken satayThis was a weird experience. My wife is Asian and a foodie. I am British and generally see food as something that stops me being hungry. Most of our arguments are food based. While this was not one of the best meals I have had I did enjoy the food and ate most of it myself. My wife went back to the hotel and had instant noodles....The saving grace for my wife was the singer who we both thought was very good.Show less

Author: Sandemahuman
Title: Good food, friendly staff, high prices for what you get
Review: The staff are friendly, but the menu is limited, mostly high-priced versions of local foods, Everything was well prepared, but the price is way high for dishes that one could get from authentic locals nearby. The price simply reflects the gentrification (and eventual undoing) of Georgetown.Show less

Author: 26evelyneMelbourne, Australia
Title: Nice cafe
Review: Decent prices, good selection for vegetarians.We ordered three dishes and three beers this was less than $60aud. The food was tasty and decent portions.The staff are great here considering this is a cafe! I think the bad reviews are expecting this to be 5 star restaurant.Worth a visitShow less

Author: simmoGoldCoast
Title: Great cafe
Review:
You name it, they've pretty much got it.
Great food cold beer. Hot coffee and teas with great service.
Good manners goes a long long way when travelling, remember to pack them.

Author: Rebecca  A
Title: Great for allergy or GF travellers
Review: Friendly staff who modified their menu for our son who is gluten and egg free and made us feel reassured that his food would be safe for him to eat. Nice quiet location and close to everything.

Author: EmC_caFrankfurt, Germany
Title: Great Food
Review: We visited the Mews Cafe based on TripAdvisor Review.The Cafe has a nice outside seating area. All the menu items looked delicious. We ordered Laksa and the spicy rice noodle salad. We liked both dishes. The fresh mixed juice was also tasty.The service was friendly, though the price is a bit on the high-end compared to other cafes.Show less

Author: Charissa PMalaysia
Title: Peaceful with privacy
Review: Located on one of the heritage rows, this place offers great locol and western food. Suitable for a quiet morning bfast, a great afternoon catch up and a nice evening dinner.The cafe.comes with a boutique hotel too Inquire with them. Holidays are great at this place!Show less

Author: BricodustSouth West France
Title: Nice, quiet and cool spot
Review: We just visited for a coffee whilst wandering some of the streets of Georgetown.Good coffee, served quickly and courteously.Excellent place to spend some time enjoying the quiet and calm whilst you read your travel guide or newspaper.Did not eat there but the menu looked comprehensive and reasonably priced.Note, the cafe has a number of publications for sale, dont buy they are cheaper in the bookshopsShow less

Author: NomadicBoys
Title: Good service and decent food
Review: Service was smart and professional. Food was quickly served and tasty. It's located in a romantic setting off the main road.

Author: EvaStockholm
Title: Average experience
Review: OK food. OK service. The place is OK but we did not understand why so many reviewers are so excited by his place.

Author: Lynne M
Title: Nice place
Review: Very nicely set-up small cafe with both indoor and outdoor seating. We visited mid morning for breakfast and had a tasty roti-canai and a decent latte. Service was friendly and efficient and prices ok. 30 rm for fresh O.J. the roti and a coffee.

Author: kirstieyatesLondon
Title: Great little place - not to be missed!
Review: We were so pleased to find this place, tucked away on a little side street - we ended up visiting 3 times during an 8 night stay! We wouldn't normally do that, but the food and wine was great and the service really friendly!We fell in love with the prawn jah mee - a light to medium spiced soup-based meal which is truly delicious and I would highly recommend it. We also tried the Laksa and the curry mee - all were lovely!This is a sister venue to the Seven Terraces, which we also tried during our stay. The difference at the Mews is that it is not a set dinner and you can choose to have as many courses as you want.Highly recommended!Show less

Author: Monie_LauKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Lunch here on a hot afternoon muntri street
Review: I was hunting for wall art near by muntri street during 12pm, I was very hot so decided tp drop by here for cool down a little bit, ordered beef rendang, not bad also not cheap to dine here. But have to mention the service here is real good. Show less

Author: Kuroneko300Penang Island, Malaysia
Title: Good place to escape the heat
Review: Quiet, cozy ambiance with great choice of authentic local dishes. When the streets of Penang get too hot and hectic, this is a good place to hangout and savor the local food. Price is of course on the high-end, but if you don't want to put up with battling for a table and the cacophony of a local kopitiam, this is a good option. Show less

Author: Manky11Eltham, Australia
Title: Delicious food
Review: Had dinner here which was a very pleasant experience. Nice courtyard location with a pleasant ambience. Staff very polite and good service. I had the Nasi Goreng which was absolutely fantastic - loved it. Very reasonably priced for the quality of the food. Not to be missed if you want a restaurant that caters for both local and western food tastes. Show less

Author: martinhongkong2015
Title: Good food
Review: The family went there for dinner. Reasonably priced food, freshly made juice and we enjoyed our selection of local favoured noodle and rice.

Author: SMLoxtonCanberra, Australia
Title: Lunch
Review: I was wandering around George Town on my own and I was thinking I am hungry, where can I have something to eat and I came across Muntri Mews Cafe. I decided to go in and sit down and order some food. I ordered the chicken samosas. They came out with a separate side salad with a vinaigrette dressing and a pot of sweet chili sauce and yummo they were very nice. I have had vegetable and lamb samosas before but never chicken. They had little pieces of potato in them and the right amount of spices. The cafe latte was also good. I would definitely select this cafe again.Show less

Author: clyn88Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Lovely place for tea
Review: The food is excellent, e.g. their Family platter for Father's day. Awesome local nyonya dishes. Do try their chocolate walnut cake, it's super awesome and moist. Another great dessert is the caramelized banana fritter. Reasonably priced and value for money. Good ambiance and good for people watching too.Show less

Author: JimmyKLLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: Nice Asian food with little twist
Review: The Muntri mews Cafe was reasonable and good me. The lunch menu is quite extensive Asian choice. the nasi lemak, for example has good portion of nasi lemak, the (seafood) sambal, the egg, standard condiments and curry chicken i had the Kerabu pai tee which was a good twist. The pad thai was ok. Wish they would grind the peanuts as it would be easier to eat. . But staff were lovely. Service is immaculate. Recommend for a nice mealShow less

Author: MaxR664Elwood, Australia
Title: Delicious food and nice ambiance
Review: we were staying down the road, so used this cafe as our local during our stay in George Town. We had lunch and dinners here, and all food was tasty and beautifully prepared.We liked sitting outside, so you could take in the passing parade of locals and tourists.Staff were very helpful and fun.Show less

Author: MgdanKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Sweet Potato Tarro and coconut milk....is there anything else...SO YUMMY
Review: I had just consumed a local coffee next door ....my partner wanted more "western" style...coffee so we stopped in...What a treat ....very cozy surroundings...attentive staff. It appeared to be a mixture of local Georgetownians with a couple of Chinese tourist thrown into the mix. We had only coffee and desert. BUT WOW the traditional Malay desert of warm coconut milk, which Tarro and sweet potato is the best I have had in my 25 yrs in Asia! Go there and enjoy!!!!!!!Show less

Author: PhlashmairTbilisi, Georgia
Title: Penang on a plate
Review: George Town is not short of places to eat - every other shop seems to be a coffee shop these days! The Mews drew us in because it looked so cool and inviting with a lively mix of admittedly well-healed local and foreign diners.Al fresco lunch offered a select of Malay based dishes presented with true panache (we had ayam percik, ikan sambal and the delightful pea-flower blue rice), the Long Island Melon Tea was the best cold drink of the week and my partner indulged her mango craving with a smoothie.We returned the next evening and enjoyed a leisurely meal in the ac interior complemented by a well-rounded Merlot, one of the house reds, and fresh home-made chocolate cake with prefect, chewy ice cream.We were impressed by the menu, the helpful service, and the spirit of the place, so much that we will definitely consider staying at the Mews on a future visit.Show less

Author: Naphatsakan W
Title: Good food good ambience
Review: The cafe was lovely with outdoor space. The lady staff recommended me to try the popular menu "Ikan Sambal". The portion was a little bit small but good taste. The food presentation look so nice like traditional Thai food. After meal I requested staff to see the accommodation. the room look lovely and cozy. Show less

Author: LeemakkieSingapore, Singapore
Title: Yummy food, good service
Review: Went for a late dinner, reaching around 9pm. Mews Cafe was still open and the service staff was polite and prompt in seating us. Service staff was patient in taking our order. He spoke excellent English as well.We chose the nasi goreng and udang cucur to share, as well as a lemon honey. Food arrived promptly. The nasi goreng was frangrant, well fried and nicely accompanied by sides like satay and chips. The spicy belacan that accompanied the nasi goreng was good. The udang cucur was not overly oily with a right mix of vegetables and prawn. The fritters came with a warm thick peanut sauce which my partner thoroughly enjoyed. I actually paired my fritters with the belacan from the nasi goreng as im not a fan of peanut sauce. Thoroughly enjoyable meal with good service staff! Thank you so much! Will definately be back to visit(and hopefully stay) at Muntri Mews!Show less

Author: Nuraini AKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Great staff, generally good food
Review: Dessert and appetisers, and some of the signature dishes were good. Breakfast menu was just ok. The roti canai was average, and would be better if it came with dhal curry. Nasi lemak had not enough sambal and egg, and if you want to go for value add, it's better to upgrade it to a really good seafood sambal than to add curry chicken. Show less

Author: KEEHOCK
Title: excellent mee rubus & cucuk udang
Review: the taste is great , prawns are fresh and so is the chicken. The soup is wonderful no MSM,original taste. Please try it when u visit Mews in Muntri street Penang.

Author: Made S. L
Title: Ambience
Review: Going there for coffee n desserts Friendly staff plus free Wifi. The ambience very nice, like the concept of the restaurant

Author: tawonmaduSemarang, Indonesia
Title: Forgettable
Review: Not bad, but just very ordinary food in an atmosphere that was pleasant but didn't say much about where it is. Could have been anywhere in any vaguely tropical resort. Maybe if Penang all gets a bit much for you, come here and look at some brown furniture and listen to lite jazz classics and imagine you are somewhere else. Service was impeccable. Not great value for money for what it was.Show less

Author: Vinay A
Title: Great food, lovely setting!
Review: Penang is all about street food I know, but if you get tired of the heat and the bustle, this is a great place to get away from it all and have a really great meal in a comfortable, air-conditioned setting. Highly recommended!

Author: keltzarBelconnen, Australia
Title: Nothing special, Service leaves a lot to be desired
Review: Stopped by for a drink over the weekend, and was debating whether to have some food. Did not - in part put off by all the sulking waiting staff... who were at the same time unhelpful. Did not help that they gave me the wrong amount of change for the bill.Cafes in this part of Georgetown are plenty, and there are other hotels/ guest-houses which are more vintage and quaint. You lose nothing by giving this one a pass. It's just a very expensive cafe clearly targeted at foreign tourists with its pricing ... and nothing particularly special.The cafe I visited next after this one was clearly better too.Show less

Author: donaldf673
Title: Excellent place to go for a meal after you have had a few nights of Hawker stalls!
Review: We had done 3 nights of food halls with great Hawker food. We wanted something different, so this quiet romantic place fitted the bill. Close to Eastern and Orient Hotel, cost £22 for two. Food excellent.

Author: PenangfanaticPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Beautiful Setting
Review: We stopped for lunch here because of the Trip Advisor reviews. The place is beautiful. The outdoor dining is lush and tropical. We chose to eat inside with awesome aircon since it was a really hot day. The food is pricey for Penang but very good. I had a prawn/chicken and noodle salad which was very nice. My partner had the beef rendang which was also very good. The server was a tad stuffy but other than that it was a lovely lunch. I would go again. Show less

Author: UPASNA KKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Quaint and nice
Review: We stopped by for a quick lunch and ordered Asian pasta and pie tee. Not only was the service fast, staff was really friendly without being intruding. Would love to have a nice long supper or lunch here sometime! The location is great as the street is not a busy one and decor is very tasteful and appropriate for the kind of space it isShow less

Author: CMLimSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good delicious food!
Review: We had the ayam percik and kueh pie tee, and they were delicious! Yes, it might be a little expensive, but I guess the food made up for it. The staff were also friendly and attentive. So overall this is a pretty good restaurant/cafe along Muntri Street to escape the heat on an afternoon.Show less

Author: BipsiGraceLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Great Tasting Platter
Review: This was by far the most expensive place we ate in comparison to everywhere else we had been in Penang but had also the best ambiance.The location is on one of the nicer streets in Georgetown and is really beautifully lit in the evening. The tasting platter we shared was very well presented and everything was delicious. If you are willing to splash out a little and are tired of the fluorescent lit diners, I would give this place a try. You probably won't regret it. Show less

Author: Z6771UA_Magong, Penghu
Title: The best modern Malaysian cuisine in George Town
Review: Every dish is awesome! We came here twice in two days. Tried many starters, rice cuisine and noodle cuisine. Every dish is giving us a feeling of "wow".In addition, the manager is good Chinese speaker說中文, you can ask for recommendation.If you come to George Town, don't miss it.Show less

Author: Kabir O
Title: Second visit here
Review: I have only had breakfast here on two social visits to Penang, and liked it every time. It's a cozy place with nice atmosphere. They have a wide selection of breakfast sets.

Author: eric sSingapore, Singapore
Title: delicious food in a relaxing cafe in one of the nicest streets of Penang
Review: Parts of Penang were getting crowded and too touristy but this street is not there yet, although signs sof too many tousist business are starting to emerge. The cafe sits on the street and is part of a small boutique hotel. It serves excellent food with friendly service. Show less

Author: MumtoScruffyYorkshire, United Kingdom
Title: Enjoyable
Review: We originally walked through the blistering heat for some refreshments at Daily Dose Cafe and was disappointed to find that it was closed for renovation. We had read favourable reviews for Muntri Cafe so ventured down the road gasping for a drink.We received a warm welcome and given a free choice of where we wanted to sit. After quenching our raging thirsts we ordered a warm chicken sandwich served with fries and a vegetarian Pad Thai and both were equally delicious and plentiful. Sadly I left some of the Pad Thai because we were having dinner at their restaurant Kebaya and I would have been too full had I finished the noodles but I really wanted to!The price was fair for what we had and we would have no hesitation in recommending this cafe.The only reason for dropping a point on the score is that whilst we were eating, a member of staff started to varnish a piece of furniture very close to where we were seated and the overwhelming smell was not very nice. Other than that we really enjoyed our visit here and would certainly return.Show less

Author: warutch
Title: Brilliant food and atmosphere
Review:
Food here is awesome and atmosphere is very nice.
There will be jazz singer live band around 8pm too
The price is not very high. Definitely worth a visit

Author: Blackers79London, United Kingdom
Title: Georgetown coffee hang out haven
Review: Although Penang's forte is hawker food, Muntri Mews offered a delicious break from our more casual hawker dining experiences. The menu still has a Malay bent, but is perhaps a safer option for those who are not adventurous enough to eat hawker style. The menu of refreshing drinks (including delicious iced coffees) has a more Western feel and offers a welcome break from the humidity and exploring Georgetown. Definitely one to try.Show less

Author: Dianne O
Title: Delicious, portions for sharing
Review:
Food is delicious and good for two so price is worth it.
Place is beautiful to dine in. Service is great. 
I love their desserts too!

Author: AngelwithalineSingapore, Singapore
Title: So-so food, so-so service
Review: It was a hot day and I had been walking for hours when I passed by this cafe, which looked cool (lterally & figuratively). There was indoor seating and a little courtyard with about 5-6 tables. I chose the former due to the weather although there were some tourists happy to dine al fresco.A party of 2 plopped down at a table next to mine, and the server almost immediately brought them glasses of ice water with lemon wedges, unasked. I waited for mine, but nada, zilch. Curious, I asked the server why I didn't get any water. He sheepishly smiled at me and walked away without a word. And then brought me a glass of water, again, without a word. Mystified, I was hoping the food would make me forget this oversight.It was mid-day, between lunch & dinner, and I was just feeling peckish so ordered a drink, the Bergedil (deep-fried potato patties popular in the Malay cuisine), Kerabu Pie Tee (deep fried flour shells with fillings of a variety of shredded vegetables & sometimes sliced prawn with sauce and chilli), and the Sago Gula Melaka (a chilled Peranakan dessert of starchy "pearls" with brown sugar from Malacca and coconut milk).I've had much better Bergedil in cheaper places, and the Pie Tee filling was tasteless and bland. The saving grace was the dessert (can't go too wrong with that simple-to-make dessert). I waited a quite a while for my food and had to ask the server to check with the kitchen. Again, he smiled weakly and left without a word (no "let me check", nothing). And it wasn't a full house or peak hours.It was a very disappointing experience overall, especially after very good service at other establishments I've patronised in Penang.Show less

Author: N A
Title: Nice pit stop
Review: A convenient pit stop for a drink after walking around Muntri Street. Located alongside Cat Café and Camera Museum

Author: HLCheeGeorge Town, Malaysia
Title: Excellent show case of George Town
Review: Nestled in the heart of George Town's heritage area, this small cafe serves one of the best foods. Loved the french toasts for breakfast and the very delicious ethnic local dishes for dinner as well. Service is excellent, staff very attentive to one's needs. Good job, keep it up!Show less

Author: ChrisE258Avondale, New Zealand
Title: Small restaurant cafe with great food and staff
Review: Walked to the Mews Cafe today in the heat - the effort was well worth it. The cafe and courtyard area outside are very clean and the staff are welcoming and efficient. It isn't large and could get pretty busy - we were there about 1:30pm and there were quite a few tables available inside where it was cool without being like a freezer.I had Nasi Lemak which was superb - in fact I would rate it as one of the very best curry dishes I have eaten anywhere. My wife had a noodle dish which she found very good. Both dishes arrived very quickly and the waiter and waitresses were accurate, friendly and efficient.There is a reasonably varied menu offering both local and some western choices and there are wide choices of beer, wine cocktails and non alcoholic drinks including juices and smoothies.The prices are reasonable - we paid RM24 for what was an excellent lunch in pleasant surroundings - great value.Show less

Author: 182victorial
Title: Cool cafe
Review: I know I should be paying less and eating Georgetown street food, but sometimes when you are hot, tired and hungry, it's just wonderful to come across some air conditioning & a really wonderful menu to peruse. The food lived up to it, just lovely.

Author: Pitea2000Amsterdam, The Netherlands
Title: Beautiful place, delicious food
Review: We stayed at Muntri Mews and of course we tried the restaurant. It's a small place situated in the middle of the heritage area with a beautiful setting, a very nice garden and ambiance. The food was great, nicely presented and a little different than other restaurants nearby. The staff is very attentive and helpful. Highly recommended.Show less

Author: jtfroggerCalgary, Canada
Title: Nice oasis
Review: The prices are a little steeper than most other places, but it is definitely worth it. The ambiance is wonderful and the staff is great and speak English very well. For two main dishes, an extra side of rice, two iced teas, a watermelon juice, a dessert and a coffee it came to about 130 RM. The food was great and beautifully presented. The drinks were freshly prepared and very refreshing. The extra touches such as a nice washroom and napkins were very much appreciated. Show less

Author: Sarahlovesrome
Title: Delicious.
Review: My partner and I ate here and loved it ! It's a little pricier than what's around on the street but it is just such a cut above that if you chose to dine here you shouldn't expect to compare it to street food prices! It was delicious. We had the Fresh spring rolls with the most amazing dipping sauce, then I had the fish steamed in a banana leaf with blue rice and sambal- loved it!My partner loved his Malaysian noodles. The setting outdoors was like a gorgeous little oasis with Palm trees and was quiet even though it was just off the street. In fact it is well positioned and there was a lovely few bars around and a gorgeous atmosphere on this strip. A great few cafes (funky modern western ones) to check out.A great dinner!Show less

Author: breascleteMona Vale, Australia
Title: Good lunch during Chinese New Year
Review: With not much open on Chinese New Year Thursday we opted for this cafe after some local advice. The spring rolls and pad Thai were very well done with fresh ingredients. House red wine ok , the total price for 3 persons around 130-140 ringgit so more expensive than other hawker options as we only had 2 starters and 2 mains with one glass of wine and 2 soft drinks. Ambience was ok but service was pretty decent. A good safe bet for lunch if not I'm a budget.Show less

Author: JudyfromjulySingapore, Singapore
Title: Lovely ambiance and good food
Review: We were staying at the Mews on the Penang leg of our Malaysian trip, and rolled in quite late at night. Tired and hungry, we decided to try the cafe food without any expectations, though we were surprised that the cafe itself seemed crowded for dinner. The udang fritters and kerabu bee hoon were superbly tasty! More than decent for a hotel cafe.Show less

Author: FudCondat
Title: Food better than service
Review: Chose the Malaysian set evening meal which was delicious - highly recommended.The staff then disappeared, forgetting their outside customers so we could not order further & in the end gave up & went in to get the bill.

Author: LauridsUglvig
Title: Visiting Penang
Review:
We had a late lunch and enjoyed the friendly and fast service. There is a nice atmosphere both in and out. 
The food was well prepared and very tasty. 

Excellent value for money.

Author: Natalia I
Title: Nice Ambient with garden style
Review: this cafe located at Lebuh muntri infront of Muntri Mews Cafe, Friendly staff and delicous food they offer there.

Author: MakatiJoePembroke Pines, Florida
Title: Quaint elegant cafe in historic George Town area
Review: This pleasant little cafe is perfect for a late breakfast or early brunch. The set menu at MYR 30 is not cheap but reasonable for the area and setting with coffee (with free refills), fresh squeezed orange juice and a main dish. The atmosphere is pleasant with the shaded courtyard and fans. Definitely on my recommended list.Show less

Author: Sebastian LPoland
Title: Relaxing!
Review: Another must visit restaurant along Muntri Street, we were immediately captivated by the lovely design of the gardens which provided the restaurant with much needed shades and touch of green while having a coffee break. We were too full for food but had a good break with coffee and snacks. Not the cheapest but you pay for the nice settings.Show less

Author: LostWanderluster
Title: Very good food, comfortable setting, just darn enjoyable
Review: We sat outside (January) and thoroughly enjoyed the setting, service, and certainly the food.  We shared the Nostalgic Local Platter RM120 with some wine.  The hotel this restaurant is associated with is also a great little place worth checking out.

Author: Victoria ZMexico City, Mexico
Title: Wish the food is as good as the environment
Review: Lovely settings especially the outdoor seats being surrounded by plants and greens, it was actually love at first sight for nature lover like me. Did not feel warm sitting under the frangipani trees even we were having a brunch around 11:30am during a hot sunny day. The brunch however, was slightly disappointing as the sunny side up we ordered was hard, while the curry chicken was overcooked as well. Luckily the beef rendang saved the day. Service is friendly but wish for more attention as the waiters can be overwhelmed by the crowd when it got busy.Show less

Author: NICK RCheltenham, United Kingdom
Title: A lovely terrace and great food
Review: Mews cafe has a very nice outside terrace - the nicest outside ambiance we have experienced since we arrived in Georgetown.We choice the selection of local food which was really tasty and consisted of beef, chicken and fish dishes as well as salad and samosas. All was very good.They also serve great banana fritters and coffee.Service is very good.Show less

Author: Babiebaloon
Title: Fantastic
Review: Food was best ever, tasty and delicious in all ways. The restaurant was clean and tidy, the atmosphere was so comfortable and the price was not expensive.

Author: kennethKhong
Title: Nice ambience
Review: Great cafe to hang out among the greens. Nicely decorated and air conditioned, it's a great place to chill out and enjoy some local cuisines, especially in the evening. Will get a five stars if the coffee is equally great.

Author: YRafiqueWelwyn Garden City, United Kingdom
Title: Exceptionally good
Review: Went to Mews Kafe for dinner and found the staff to be friendly and offering an efficient service. We ordered the local platter, which was made up of a selection of dishes for 2 to share. It contained chicken satay, bees rendang, steamed sea bass and some other tasty items. The food was amazing! Highly recommend this place.Show less

Author: archana_mrao
Title: Loved the food, great service!
Review:
We visited the Mews Cafe for breakfast and loved the food - the service was also great.
They served vegetarian food even though options on the menu were limited.
Hope to visit again!

Author: darshenPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Really awesome
Review: An ex penangite. I took my girlfriend for dinner on nee years eve. Prices are great even for local standards. Food is above standards. Service is soft polite and with a genuine smile. Ambiance is really nice. Upper class feel. But you can wear ure shorts and t shirt and enjoy either the outdoors or indoors ( outside nicer)Show less

Author: Laura J
Title: Great food, nice atmosphere!
Review:
Really good food, and nice atmosphere. At Mews Cafe, we sat outside in Georgetown's old town, and had a really pleasant evening. 

I ate "Helen's curry Mee" which was delicious, and the service was great! 

Would definitely recommend for a nicer evening out.

Author: simonb353Derby, United Kingdom
Title: Ok
Review: We called in based on reviews but found the overall package ok.We had a main and a dessert the food was nice but not special and the service could have been better factor in the prices that are cheap in western standards but not locally we wouldn't rush backShow less

Author: yagizaSingapore, Singapore
Title: Great place with yummy food and friendly staff!
Review: It was our first visit to Mews Cafe after reading great reviews about their food. Undeniably true, the food exceeded our expectations! We ordered Nasi Lemak and the Roasted Chicken and we had a hearty meal. We wanna express special thanks to JP, one of the waiters, who did great help in planning a birthday surprise for one of our friends. His service is really commendable and we look forward to visiting this cafe again in our next visit to Penang!Show less

Author: flyingpatrick75Crete, Greece
Title: Cozy little restaurant with friendly staff.
Review: Me and my wife have both enjoyed our dishes in this little restaurant. I took the beef rendang which was very tasty. The salads on the plate combined well with the meet and the rice. My wife had a more western style grilled chicken with potatoes, which she enjoyed as well. The restaurant offers a few tables outside for outdoor sitting. Staff was attentive and happy to help. Toilet was reasonable clean. Free wifi available. Show less

Author: CraigLaronta
Title: Lovely setting
Review: Relaxing atmosphere. Love the green ambient and nice setting. Food is good and coffee acceptable but service is indeed attentive and welcoming.

Author: Sv T
Title: Pleasant inviroment, good food
Review: Good food served by excelent staff. Great mix of western and local dishes. The ones we tried where very tasty. Looking at meals served to other diners made us resolved to come back and sample more of the menu. Of note was the pleasant background music that was such a contrast to other venues doing non stop Christmas carols. We will be back.Show less

Author: MargC1955
Title: Lovely quiet oasis in the back streets of Penang
Review: The food here was great.  The cafe was clean and not overly loud.  The staff were very friendly and helpful.

Author: Manoj1973
Title: Lunch with family
Review: Outstanding food, nice service.  We were in group of 7 which included children and a vegetarian. There was great food to meet every taste. We got to taste authentic Malaysian cuisine in a nice environment.

Author: KeepOnTravelling2014
Title: Very Tasty Lunch in nice setting
Review: Stopped here for lunch during our hot tramping around the heritage town and were wowed by the delicious food in this little cafe restaurant.

Author: lawc22
Title: not-so hidden charm of muntri st.
Review: Certainly one of the best and unpretentious restaurant in the city. Tried their beef rendang and the taste is as authentic as ever. Just the in-door seatings is seems not enough, but nevermind its should remain as it for exclusivity.

Author: VivianCyfEast Coast, Singapore
Title: A good cafe under a big hot sun
Review: We walked pass Jln Muntri during lunch hour, hoping to get a good airconditioned cafe to take a rest. Found Mew Cafe, the location and set up is very ideal for lunch and the staff is very welcoming and friendly. We had Java mee and nasi lemak, the Java mee is really nice, althought the prawn is a bit overly cooked, nasi lemak is good and the curry chicken is not very spicy, therefore kid can have it. However, the recomended is the java mee, hopefully can have improvement on prawn.Show less

Author: Brenda C
Title: Best alternative to hawker stalls in George Town
Review: Extensive menu (local and international dishes), reasonable prices.  Excellent coffee!  Indoor (with AC) or outdoor seating in open courtyard (with greenery).

Author: Suus_12
Title: Oasis
Review: Beautiful quiet place in the middle of old Georgetown. Lovely juices , perfect service: a great place to take a break from strolling around!

Author: BosbeekBrunssum, The Netherlands
Title: Very nice, Malaysian food in a non-traditional environment
Review: The good rating on Tripadvisor triggered our choice for this restaurant. The restaurant itself is quite different from most restaurants in George Town. It's a modern restaurant in a neighbourhood with many backpackers. We were able to have a table on the small but beautiful terrace outside. The staff was very friendly and professional: no glasses of wine fully filled up until the edge of the glass. The quality of the food was in accordance with the excellent ratings of previous visitors and reviewers. Show less

Author: knowhowtotravelBuderim, Australia
Title: An oasis in George Town
Review: We attended this cafe after a recommendation by a local. It is close to the Camera Museum. The cafe was exceptionally clean, it had great food, the carrot & raisin cake & coffee were fantastic.The service was great, there is inside seating in the A/c or a nice garden setting if you don't mind the heat.There is a western style toilet which was very clean... No wifi.A great place to visit when exploring George TownIf this is helpful please hit the LIKE button, it shows that people are thankful for the effort to assist fellow travellers.Show less

Author: gattinarosa
Title: Perfect last meal in Penang
Review: We visited Mews Cafe for our last meal in Penang, based on the great reviews on here.We were not disappointed!The food was delicious - one of the tastiest meals we have eaten in the past 2 months in Asia. The iced tea drinks were amazing, with surprising cubes of lychee in! Delicious.The service was brilliant. Very friendly and attentive. It is a bit pricier than other places we have visited in Georgetown. Our meal for 2 was RM81 (£16), including the 10% tax. However, you really do get what you pay for. Highly recommended.Show less

Author: samscvg
Title: GREAT MEAL, GOOD SERVICE
Review: Stopped by for a meal with some friends at Mews Cafe. My friend had the chicken sandwich while I had the Kerabu Bee Hoon. Both turned out to be delicious and well presented. We tried the dessert menu as well and ordered the sago gula Melaka and the banana fritters. Both were sensational. This place is really a hidden gem. They do both local and continental food very well and the service is tip top.Show less

Author: JunC285
Title: Amazing cafe
Review: The cafe is unique in the inner city because of its beautiful garden. Once we were seated in the open air dining area, it felt like we were in an oasis - calm, green and relaxing. The food and service were very good too. I especially like the Ikan Sambal which came served with blue rice which has been naturally coloured by a local flower. Lovely experience. Will be going back soon for another visit.Show less

Author: huanyinchanMalaysia
Title: Small restaurant, Nice food, Great Service but Arrogant Receptionist.
Review: Visited this small restaurant last week during weekday. The deco is lovely and I love the fact that the weather was superb during my visit. We decided to seat outside with lots of greenery and nicely done landscape. The waiter was super friendly-brought us 2 glasses of iced water and did not hesitate recommend us what to order. Asking his permission to have a look at garden area behind the gate seeing there is a sign stated the garden area only open to resident- I got shouted by the reception once I walked in. I thought he can reminded me politely rather than yelling at the guest. Food was superb especially the Ikan Sambal (fish cooked with chilli) served with blue flavoured rice but my wife did not like the Pad Thai (Thai Fried Noodle) which she thought is not authentic enough.Show less

Author: Jenny J
Title: Great food and good service
Review: The Pad Thai was really yummy and the prawns were huge. The staff were really friendly and helpful as well.

Author: pamcyySingapore
Title: Excellent food & service
Review: Freshly juiced orange & strong coffee served with breakfast. We had one of the best salmon scrambled and egg & ham croissant! Was very impressed with their service my attention to details such as warmed milk for the coffee. Definitely a must visit place in Georgetown.Show less

Author: MikeCarmonaManila, Philippines
Title: Great coffee and ambiance... Food is average.
Review: A nice place to hang out and have coffee or drinks. The servers are all pleasant and attentive.I ordered their Clubhouse sandwich and it was good. An appetizer, vegetable fritter was average.I'd say the good rating this place got was not because of their food. Hope they put more things on their menu. Show less

Author: annensteve
Title: Good food and service
Review: Lovely location in the middle of the historic district. Food and drink well priced. Service was efficient

Author: ruru66Yogyakarta Region, Indonesia
Title: Good nasi lemak
Review: I went to here to eat lunch and it was pretty good. I ordered nais lemak which was very big, it included chicken curry. for dessert i had the scones with jam which was not so good. The scones were too hard. I enjoyed the main course more. atmosphere is nice though.Show less

Author: OiseauchantantMontreal, Canada
Title: Good
Review: Prices are a bit higher than other local places, however the first minute you set foot in the cafe it's clear that this place is clean and of good quality. I'm more than happy to pay $6 instead of $3 for a meal in Georgetown if it means the meal is made with fresh ingredients, is tasty and is worry free for hygiene. If you are walking by and wondering if you should go in, just go.Show less

Author: SeanN52
Title: Nice afternoon break stop
Review: The location is kind of hidden from the busy chulia street. It's quite and that's what I like it. Great cafe feels, we didn't order much of F&B but the smells of rendang chicken from next table was no wrong.  Worth a pit stop sometimes.

Author: PandoraOfMerricksMerricks
Title: Magical place for a special event with great food and wonderful staff
Review: I was celebrating a big birthday party at the Mews Cafe's sister restaurant Kebaya at Seven Terraces so I decided to have a cocktail party at the Mews Cafe to warm up the guests the night before the main event. The theme was Hawkers' Night and what an amazing experience it turned out to be. The cafe was turned into a magical oasis The inner and outer gardens beside the cafe were opened up and 5 hawker stands were interspersed between the trees and the canopied seats. There was char keow teow, mee goreng, satay, hokkien mee and chendol, and guests were able to order and see the dishes being cooked. The cafe also provided for its staff to serve pie tie and udang kerabu in bite sizes together with wines. And there as onde onde to finish it off. It was a delightful evening. The staff were very attentive and organising the event was easy and hassle free. All in all, fantastic ambience, great food and wonderful staff. I cannot recommend it highly enough.Show less

Author: Derek Teh H
Title: Freaking good
Review:
It's a must for me to order the sago gula melaka every time I come here. It's rich in flavour and sinfully good.  I've tried Helen's Curry Mee...its authentic and one the best I've tried in Penang so far.
For the foodies...A must try Cafe.

Author: Karen L
Title: Not to be Missed!
Review: Every time I'm in Penang I have to make a pit stop here. Was in town again a couple of wks back with friends from KL & Shanghai and they were so impressed with the food we ended up eating there three days in a row inspite of all the irresistible street food Penang has to offer. Personally, particularly loved the "kerabu mee hoon" and "pai tee" starter. Very traditional nyonya dishes but with an inspired Thai twist. Perfect balance of sweet, sour & savoury. Kudos to the chef. Service as usual was excellent. Attentive, accommodating, unobtrusive. An unbeatable choice if you're looking for a place that serves Penang style flavours in a relaxed cafe setting.Show less

Author: Lois RVancouver, Canada
Title: A delight
Review: We were warned away from this restaurant with the comment "it's just a cafe!". Well, then most restaurants should strive to be cafes! We felt a third of the value of this restaurant is the ambience they have created: open doors between the inside tables and the outside terrace with the gorgeous plants - all cooled by the aircon. Where to sit was simply a matter of taste. The food was perfect...all the food courses and the margaritas were delicious. To top this off the staff was warm and welcoming, attentive without being cloying. All this for a fair price! So glad we didn't listen to the poor advice!Show less

Author: Janet YSingapore, Singapore
Title: Penang and its jewel!
Review: Mews Cafe was recommended by a friend. We walked in after having walked the better half of the day. Its cool interior was welcoming and service spot on. We had from the Pie Tie to Bee Hoon to the Laksa and they were all yummy!The attention to detail from the staff was indeed refreshing. I had a piece of sticker which I had peeled of and was looking to throw it but since I did not see a bin, I placed it in my bag and I heard a staff member saying "would would like me to take care of that'? I was pleasantly surprised. You don't find this much attention to detail in KL or in Malaysia!When I am back next, would definitely make a beeline to this cafe!Truly, Penang's pride!Show less

Author: YHChinPuchong, Malaysia
Title: Wow!!! a real hidden gem!
Review: I can say, though I've been to Penang a few times, this is IT! Heard so much about how Gerogetown has changed over the last few years but this is now what I have in mind. One of the best experience I had during this trip is meal time at Mews Cafe. It was highly recommended by a good friend and truly it is. The food is authentic Penangnite and i have to the say the service level is "WOW". The staffs are very friendly, very knowledgeable about the menu and makes very good recommendation. I would definitely recommend this place and my favourites are Pie-Tie, Nasi Lemak and make sure to end it all with the Sago & Gula Melaka!Show less

Author: TristUKCroydon, United Kingdom
Title: Fantastic food, staff and setting!
Review: We stayed in Muntri Mews for 5 nights and had breakfasts each morning, a few lunches and dinner a couple of times too. Despite so many excellent other place in Penang to eat, we kept coming back for the great food, lovely atmosphere, romantic setting and lovely staff. Breakfast has a few choices with Nasi Lemak, Roti Paratha, a few more western options of eggs and breads, etc. The Nasi Lemak and Rot Paratha are huge so only take them on if your very hungry. The bread basket was surprisingly good with a very nice warm croissant. Bread really seems to be the new food phenomenon since my last visit to Malaysia. Bakeries popping up everywhere! There is a relatively small choice of options for main meals and starters but in some ways that is reassuring as they concentrate on doing these very well. Everything we ate was delicious and Helen's Curry Mee and the Beef Rendang were two of our favourites. Price wise it's more than the local places in Little India but compared to prices back home and considering the service, setting and quality of food an absolute bargain in my opinion. Oh and regarding the review criticising the staff, I couldn't disagree with it anymore strongly. On that night (with the live music) there was a massive thunderstorm and it starting hammering it down with rain. I wouldn't be surprised if this was why they packed up a little early. This place is excellent and the staff, in our experience of our 5 day stay, have been truly fantastic, the best we have experienced on our trip. When I come back to Penang this is where I'm going for my first meal. I can't wait already! Trist and JaneShow less

Author: robbwill_10Sydney, Australia
Title: Must try Restaurant
Review: Found this place whilst walking around George Town and decided to have dinner there on our last night. Wish we had found it earlier!Indoor/outdoor options in the small eatery. Very good drinks (try a Lychee martini) excellent service, friendly staff and very good, well-presented food.Show less

Author: Smita SKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: A place that doesn't try
Review: I've been here now and then since it opened, and the service and food have really gone downhill. At my last visit (and that will truly be the last one!), food was served on dirty plates. Cutlery had little crusty bits on them. Food was meh, but then again no one (I hope) goes there for that, just a relaxed time, some music, some beer. Anyway, we went pretty late (close to 10 pm), and I asked if they were still serving. Server said "oh yes" seated us took our order, and then before we even got our food everyone started leaving, the musician packed up, and by the time our mains came, the whole place was being swept, chairs stacked, the place all but closed. And when I complained about this, all I got was a half-hearted "sorry" from the manager. My advice: skip this place and head to Steak Frites for food or Mish Mash for a drink. Mews Cafe is not worth your time or money.Show less

Author: Michael MGlasgow, United Kingdom
Title: Can't be missed!
Review: My mate and I had a late lunch here on Saturday, July 19, 2014. The atmosphere is wonderful, whether you sit on the patio or inside (later has ac). The food is fabulous . . . they make excellent coffee and a variety of non-alcoholic ice-drinks (for the lager louts, yes there are cans of Tiger available, but come on, this is a café). We liked the place so much we returned Sunday afternoon for an encore meal (staff remembered us, and once again we were welcomed with warm smiles and handshakes!).Forgotten the name of my meal . . .a chicken dish . . .served with BLUE rice . . . I never had seen blue rice before . . .awesome food.They are open 7 days a week, breakfast, lunch and dinner.The Mews also has a small hotel which looked quiet, trendy and very, very well maintained. Don't know too much about the hotel, didn't stay there, but its' worth checking out (parking may an issue with the hotel if it is needed)Don't miss the Mew's Café, it is the best in Penang, George TownShow less

Author: Lishia T
Title: Delightful :)
Review: Was at Mews cafe for lunch and also to get out of the heat after a long day walk around the heritage sites. The cozy ambiance in the cafe immediately made me feel at ease. Had the ikan sambal - blue rice with steamed seabass, mango salad, salted egg and emping and a berry crumble for dessert. Both were excellently prepared and absolutely delicious!! The berry crumble is served in a chinese bowl which is kinda cool. Very nice attention to detail. Another plus point is the interesting books about Penang they have there which made me stay a little longer and enjoyed another cup of nice coffee. Really enjoyed my lunch there. Mews cafe has it all--fabulous food, nice coffee and cakes, friendly staff, pleasant atmosphere, good books, and most importantly they serve ALCOHOL too. Only wish I had the more days in Penang to try more dishes on the menu and come for the live music on Saturday. Could imagine this to be a great place to hang out in the evening with a glass of cocktail and some good music. Will definitely be back for more!Show less

Author: MengHooiKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: A must-visit heritage cafe in Penang
Review: Simply love the place - great food, friendly staff and love the ambiance and it is 1 of the few must visit heritage cafe in Penang. Will definitely come back for more and will introduce the place to friends as our new hang out place :)Show less

Author: CheryllKamPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Oops! They (Muntri Mews) did it again!
Review: Helen's Curry Mee blew me away during my first visit but it was the Nasi Lemak Bento this time that intrigued me. Even its name is a giveaway. The combination of our local favorite nasi lemak and my favorite japanese cuisine incorporated through its presentation of the bento box made it an enjoyable second visit to Mews Cafe.Show less

Author: francisleepc
Title: Weekend chillout spot
Review: Love the long black.  I usually have sugar with my coffee but not at Mews Cafe because it's so well-brewed that I don't need sugar. The music is very chill and interesting crowd. Good place to hang out at the weekend.

Author: BjornOoi
Title: Heaven on earth
Review: Nice ambience, very friendly staff especially Brian. Love the banana fritters, Mews Madness mocktail and the mee rebus. Great to people-watch and getting watched. : )

Author: Chepeow
Title: Reliable good food
Review: Whenever I go to Mews Cafe, I like to order the drink called Mews Madness. It has lime, lychee and something extra in it. Can't put a finger on what it is but the flavour is unique. It's very refreshing and cooling. I also have the habit of ordering Helen's Curry Mee and the chicken satay. The tastes and quality are very consistent. It's a hard habit to kick.Show less

Author: Leong S
Title: A hideout away from the buzz
Review: We came by this place for breakfast.  Love the quietness and friendly service from the staff.  The food is lovely, wish we have more time to try out their lunch menu too.

Author: driPJ
Title: Nice little cafe at Muntri mews
Review: Happy to find a huge selection of drinks and smoothies after our walkabout in Georgetown. We tried the curry laksa and some cakes. A bit pricey but nice ambience.

Author: chloechoykl
Title: Worth a visit.
Review: Travellers or backpackers would definitely adore this place for their tasty food. I would highly recommend Helen's curry mee as it is One-of-a-kind. Literally. The ambience of this place is rustic and enchanting which makes visitors recollect the memoirs of the olden days.

Author: LuckykristyPetaling Jaya, Wilayah Persekutuan, Malaysia
Title: Third Time's the Charm
Review: I have been here many times, the first visit was when the cafe first opened. However, this time, I visited again as the third time for an official visit with my family and relatives. The waiter asked whether we were here for drinks or food, and prominently prepared a table for the 7 of us despite the small interior of the cafe.The food was delicious as expected, along with the drinks that came with it. My favorite is the Nasi Lemak, which they served in a bento container. They were very generous with the sambal, which is a real delight as I prefer lots of curry and sambal to consume my meal with.Random Fact:The papadam is not to my taste, as it tastes too healthy and crisp. I prefer my papadam to be more mamak style.But then again, it is my personal taste.I look forward to my next visit and await the surprises that the cafe will have in the future.I hope the food will continue to improve in terms of quality and value, and remain the top as it should be.And I hope the next time I visit, I look forward to an expansion of this cafe as I suspect that more people will come the moment they knew that such good food exists in a heritage site near the mural arts of Penang.Show less

Author: azrilein
Title: Will come back..definitely
Review: We visited this small cafe based on the review on Tripadvisor and it did not dissapoint us. Fantastic food and great service. I really enjoy the good coffee and cakes were fresh and tasty. We would definitely recommend and will come back.

Author: HazzzMBurringbar, Australia
Title: Modern Asian Fusion
Review: Stopped here for lunch after seeing good reviews. In a quiet street just behind Leboh Chulia this chic cafe has superb, chef quality food at just above street prices. We have rarely eaten such high quality food in Asia. Well worth seeking out for a treat and a change from the standard Indian and Chinese foodShow less

Author: NanNajmiSungai Petani, Malaysia
Title: Great experience!
Review: Ate here last night with my friends, The food and service was fantastic, The restaurant was very comfortable and we shared a number of dishes. The taste of every dishes we tried was amazing, especially the Ikan Sambal and Prawn Oglio. Nice ambience at very reasonable price. Listed as one of my best spot in Penang to have dinner or lunch.Show less

Author: Frederic MParis, France
Title: Stayed at Muntri Mews loved their restaurant too
Review: Posted a comment about the hotel already. Was there few days and ate down at their restaurant several times. Loved the food. Nice staff as well. Only one comment : they could have more international selection. Everything was fresh and tasty. By the way, I ordered smoked salmon salad and I was not poisoned. Ridiculous review. I will recommend the restaurant for sure.Show less

Author: Wazza6890Leicester, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent Breakfast
Review: Breakfast is the most important meal of the day! Having done a simple google search for good breakfast spots in Georgetown 'Kafe Mews' appeared as a result. The breakfast was great if not comparatively expensive with other food we had in Georgetown and there was a lot of choice on the menu, from a 'full english' to yoghurt and granola. Good fresh coffee too!Show less

Author: c_nadjaPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Food poisoning!!!
Review: We ate at Mews Cafe last Saturday, we enjoyed the atmosphere there and just ignored the high prices. It looked nice and clean. Two of us ordered the Smoked Salmon Salad, which was very tasty when eating it. The day later, we both got terrible stomach issues with fever and black-outs, why we ended up in hospital. With stomach problems of course you can never be sure which was the cause. But considering the usual time and the fact that this was the only thing we both ate and the others did not feel bad at all, we are sure that this is where we got it. It might be that we were just unlucky, since none of the other reviews tells something about sicknesses. However, it's my third month in Penang where I ate in all different kinds of restaurants and food stalls and this never happenend to me before. Will not go there again!Show less

Author: Helen SEdinburgh
Title: Simply delicious
Review: We stumbled on this little cafe by chance , been travelling for a couple of weeks , by far the best food we have had for our money . We had the set dinner,it was beautifully presented and tasted absolutely delicious from start to finish . The cocktails were devine and freshly made. Service ,attentive,helpful and friendly . The cafe was spotless . Can't wait for another visit . Thank youShow less

Author: ChipFondue
Title: Breakfast sets you up for the day
Review: This cafe serves a selection of great breakfast items, scrambled egg with salmon, choice of eggs with ham, beans, tomato and toast, and you can add fruit or juice and tea/coffee for a few RM more.The staff are great, but need to organise themselves a bit more when clearing tables and taking orders.Show less

Author: TWinUSAStaten Island, New York
Title: Very nice little Cafe! Well worth a visit...and I visited a few times I enjoyed it so much.
Review: This is a very nice little Cafe--they also had accommodations but I didn't stay there nor check those out. I went for lunch one day based on other TripAdvisor reviews and enjoyed it so much I ended up returning for lunch and had breakfast there 2 or 3 times the same week.Nice, comfortable, friendly staff providing good service, reasonable prices--not cheap but reasonable and good value given the quality of the food.Wi-Fi available (free). Credit cards accepted. Both indoor and outdoor seating. Really nice. Show less

Author: William189158
Title: A very good escape
Review: If you are "tired of the city" it can be a good escape. Good music, very good food and the price is very good to.

Author: Erlend1984
Title: Great place to have lunch, dinner or just drinks
Review: We stayed at Ryokan which was just across the street, and came here twice for drinks and a snack. It was quite expensive, but well worth it. Very attentive staff, whom most of them actually spoke english.

Author: TimLim63
Title: Nice Quiet Cafe
Review:
Pros: Nice decor, landscape, interesting reading material.
Cons: Mediocre food, smoking patrons, boring music.

Author: Nuanda_1974
Title: Nice atmosphere
Review:
If you want a good meal in a relaxing atmosphere you have to come here in the little garden under the beautiful frangipani
The place is little but you can eat easily
Very good

Author: Inirap
Title: Nice place, good food and lovely environment
Review:
We highly recommend this restaurant thanks to the high quality ingredients it uses, the pleasant environment and its location. We only had a roasted chicken and a burger but they were both quite good and well served. 

Highly suggested

Author: Rhgartner
Title: Beautifully presented, great service
Review: The place and the food are all beautifully presented and the food is great tasting. The chef ran me through what I was eating when he brang it to the table. Good place will come again

Author: BrotherMark223George Town, Malaysia
Title: The best restaurant in Georgetown!
Review: Simply the very best that I know of in Georgetown. You can't go wrong with anything on the menu.The service is top notch, the food and atmosphere are the very five star best.Sarah the manager makes it all seem effortless with her gracious and loving kindness style.If you want a good meal go to Mews Cafe and they will take good care of you!Brother Mark:)Show less

Author: SimonHawlSydney, Australia
Title: Yummy
Review: Went here 3 times during our visit. Why? Because of the cleanliness (when travelling with young children), the great friendly service and because the food is so yummy, every meal we had was great, especially the satays, pumpkin soup and the desserts and homemade cakes. Definitely worth a visit.Show less

Author: singcatloverSingapore, Singapore
Title: Quiet Cafe Oasis
Review: Went to the Mews Cafe for lunch and enjoyed a beautiful meal with friends. It was a small menu but food was very well executed. The laksa was genuine, and was highly satisfying because of the high quality of ingredients used and the generous portion, with attention paid to subtle balance of flavors. Excellent place for either a local or Western meal.Show less

Author: singcatloverSingapore, Singapore
Title: Charming quiet cafe
Review: Went to the cafe for lunch and enjoyed a beautiful meal with friends. It was a small menu but food was very well executed. The laksa was genuine, and was highly satisfying because of the high quality of ingredients used and the generous portion, with attention paid to subtle balance of flavors. Excellent place for either a local or Western meal.Show less

Author: Chigg71Perth, Australia
Title: A good find
Review: Once again trip advisor come up trumps with a well reviewed place to eat in Georgetown. The Mews Cafe is very clean and the staff were attentive and polite. The menu is quite small but I don't mind this and there was more than enough choice of Eastern, Western and Malay dishes. We both went for beef Rendang which was excellent! The coffee and cake selection was also really good and we will definitely go back before we leave Georgetown.Show less

Author: StudleyToowoombaToowoomba
Title: Don't overlook Mews Cafe
Review: We stayed at Muntri Mews for 5 days, and thought the food there was sensational. How tough would it be to be in the restaurant business in a place like Penang, and yet this was among the best bistro food we had in all of Malaysia. OK, Mews Cafe is pitched squarely at the fussy, foodie Gourmet Traveller types who are attracted to Penang because of its reputation as one of "the" places in Asia, and it doesn't disappoint. You won't find fish head soup here, or unrecognizable but delicious bits of offal sitting on a cracked plate, so to that extent it isn't an adventurous menu or even an extensive on. But who cares and who needs it, when the standard Nyonya, Malay and Indian fare on offer is so expertly and perfectly done, served by some of the nicest people in the business in one of the classiest restorations in the beautiful heritage area in Georgetown. Nasi Lemak and Roti Canai might be a bit hackneyed to a jaded street food afficionado, but only if you haven't tasted the Muntri Cafe versions - unpretentious, authentic & perfect. It's pretty well impossible ro walk around Georgetown without straying into Muntri Street and walking past Muntri Cafe. Don't leave town without having a drink and a meal here. You won't regret it.Show less

Author: KraZkatladyThe Hague, The Netherlands
Title: Oasis amidst the madness
Review: A peaceful and serene environment to relax and enjoy a truly delicious lunch. I had the pineapple mint frappe which was so refreshing and good, I had to have another. We had the tuna fish cakes and the fish curry in banana leaves ( the one that comes with the blue rice) to share. Both dishes were not only beautifully presented, they tasted absolutely divine. All that with the 2 bottles of tiger came to only $110.....a real steal, if you factor in the friendly and efficient service of the staff there. If you like the finer things in life, you will definitely appreciate this little gem.Tip : for those of you staying at the E&O, this place is only a hop, skip & jump away from the hotel.Show less

Author: nurnadhira
Title: Awsome
Review: my first time here at mews cafe,its awsome n fantastic. The meal/food taste good.the enviroment is really nice, cozy and warm. I'm sure that I'll return for the service given such a friendly staff.. Well done.. AWSOME :)

Author: Magda Z
Title: amazing
Review: During the trip to Malaysia here is where we experienced most amazing service. The csfe also stands out with very good food and pleasant aymosphere. Same goes for the hotel above. Cool place where both locals and tourists come to hang out and relax.

Author: LuckykristyPetaling Jaya, Wilayah Persekutuan, Malaysia
Title: One of a Million
Review: One thing I like about MEWS CAFE is the fact that the atmosphere is wonderful. If it's a hot day, one can just sit inside and enjoy the luxurious heritage atmosphere with pictures of the old days in the midst of cold air and available drinks. Plants surround the area, giving one an ample amount of oxygen as we exhale carbon dioxide while we consume the delicious food. Regarding the food, I would just randomly select any choice and MEWS CAFE would meet my expectations of Penang food, which is really high since I consider my grandmother's food the best in Penang and other food are the lesser kind. Although there were at some points where miscommunication might happen between the waiter and I, but I would overlook it as they were also learning in the process of creating a wonderful and better experience for the rest of the customers as well.Their Nasi Dagang with beef and Helen's Curry Mee (no beef) is at the top of my choices when I come to this Cafe. Along with my favorite drink of milk, cookies and cream (forgot name, sorry.. >.<), it surely made my day as I would go home with a bloated stomach with a contented heart as I left my footprints behind.Regarding the price, it is a reasonable as it is a Hotel Cafe and as the store is located along Penang's Heritage Walk, one would have expected the price to be as high as the moon.But, this was not true for MEWS CAFE as the price is reasonable, even for a student as I. My family would always come here, to not only experience the fine dining experience, but to also consume the wonderful food, which cannot be found anywhere else in the world as it has a taste unique to this cafe only. (;All I got to say to the staff is keep on improving no matter how long you worked there. Your experience in serving us are one of the factors that keep us, customers coming back as well. :)Show less

Author: CheryllKamPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: First but most definitely not last
Review: Penang is well-known for its mouth-watering delicacies. I've been from morning markets and hawker food by the roadsides to hotel buffets. So, why not give this cafe a try since we were going for lunch?  The cafe gave a very peaceful ambience and I love the way they had a row of trees at the side. I felt as though I was on a getaway from the hustle and bustle of the city. We took a sit on the inside. The waiters had a smile on their faces which made us feel most welcomed. We each ordered something different off the menu. I decided to try Helen's Curry Mee. It had a unique flavor to it. Different from all the other curry mees that I've had. The taste was nicely balanced out.  In a nutshell, it was a pleasant lunch we had. Our taste buds were satisfied. It may have been my first but most definitely not my last visit to Mews Cafe.Show less

Author: junithaPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Nice ambience and fine dinner
Review: i have visit Mews couple of time. I must say that the beautiful arrangement and decoration, taste of food together with the great service that I received, it give me a full satisfaction. I have tried some of the meal and its all very delicious from the western food to local cuisine. I would definitely come again to this restaurant and would recommend to my friend as well.Show less

Author: vn_hoangnguyenHanoi, Vietnam
Title: Nice place to break the walk
Review: As I was late for the tour at Cheang Fatt Tze Mansion, I walked around to the near by street and stop by Mews for a refreshment. It was very nice outside sitting with great drinks. try the mango lassi. Staff were very nice and accommodating. There's wifi as well. They also run a small hotels with very nice rooms next to the cafe.Show less

Author: wagetKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: pet-friendly cafe
Review: this cafe is one of the few places in penang which are pet-friendly. they have an outside seating area by the garden and you can bring your pets to sit with you while you enjoy your meal or drink. it was nice talking to brian who is also a pet lover.Show less

Author: AdrianCheahPenang, Malaysia
Title: Something blue, something rice, something nice
Review: Yes, this blue-coloured rice dish from Mews Café that is simply delicious also titillates the senses. It looks amazing, smells appetizing and tasted heavenly as well. The blue juice from re-hydrating dried bunga telang (Butterfly-pea flower) is used to make this beautiful dish called Ikan Sambal. It reminds me very much of the traditional Nasi Kerabu (Salad Rice) from Kelantan – a northeastern state in Malaysia. Mews Café’s version serves the blue-coloured rice with steamed seabass marinated in herbs and spices, encased in a banana leaves parcel to lock in its flovours. On the side, an offering of spicy mango salad, salted egg and 'emping' is served to enhance its indigenous taste. 'Emping' is a bite-size cracker made of 'melinjo' or 'belinjo' (gnetum gnemon) nut. The 'emping' crackers add texture to the dish. I highly recommend this dish to tourist visiting the island to encounter the wonderful flavours Penang has to offer as well as locals, who will be happy to recognize its savory delights. Mews Café serves Asian and international specialties, prepared with fresh local ingredients. The kitchen serves breakfast, light bites as well as homely chicken pies, burgers, fish and chips, pasta dishes and Penang favorites. The special board changes daily and is worth checking before ordering. Diners can choose to dine in a cozy air-conditioned setting or alfresco.Mews Café is located at the heart of the UNESCO heritage zone in George Town, Penang. If you are exploring the streets of George Town, this café would be ideal to stop by for lunch, dinner or coffee. It opens from 8.30pm to 11.30pm and the warm and friendly atmosphere is just so welcoming.Show less

Author: Leesa DJakarta, Indonesia
Title: Cute cafe, good service
Review: My husband selected this place for lunch and I was sceptical however I was pleasantly surprised by the attentive service and the food was quite tasty. Pricier than other lunch options & the staff were fine with us sharing Vietnamese rolls and a noodle dish. The laksa special looked good too but we were only looking for a light lunch so couldn't fit it in.Show less

Author: lin3_13George Town, Malaysia
Title: Lovely way to spend a Saturday evening - good varied food and live music
Review: Was looking for a place to take my Mom - a fussy eater, a friend on a vegetarian diet and another friend who is a good cook of local food. And I wanted something "western". We were all pleased to find something on the menu to meet our different tastes and expectations - a smoked salmon sandwich, broccoli soup and vegetarian pasta, Johor laksa, and roast chicken. The little cafe has great ambience - in the heart of the heritage site but relaxing and welcoming. The staff were cheerful and attentive. And it was an extra treat to have live music and a lovely singer. What would otherwise have been a wet and miserable evening turned out to be very pleasant indeed.Show less

Author: joseph kSingapore, Singapore
Title: some of the best local food we had in Malaysia, spotlessly clean and tres chic.
Review: This was a wonderful discovery on our visit to Penang. We found it walking along the amazing Muntri Street which is one of the grandest and well preserved streets in the heritage site but more residential and less commercial ( and less touristy) than so many other streets.Wonderful breakfasts and the best cafe coffee. We returned for lunch the next day and had marvelous malay and chinese cuisine with service that was warm friendly and incredibly caring.There is also a good selection of western food.The cafe is part of a beautiful small hotel which is gardened and like and oasis and very very tasteful. So chic and yet so incredibly affordable.Well done Muntri Mews ThankyouShow less

Author: Edlow75Pulau Perhentian Kecil, Malaysia
Title: Hideaway Breakfast Nook
Review: This morning as it was cloudy and gloomy, with a light drizzel, i took a friend to the one place i've always felt served good food and amazing desserts. Not forgetting the fantasic ambience. What suprised me was this little place had a Breafast menu, that was so well planned and chic. They served us 3 types of fresh fruit, coffee/tea and the most amazing scrambbled eggs and cold salmon, of course healthy hot toast and generous supply of butter. No1 place for breakfast in my books for now!.Show less

Author: PolishTraveller_blogWarsaw, Poland
Title: Lovely little cafe
Review: Lovely little cafe to sit dow with a coffee or a beer while taking a break from exploring the beautiful George Town. Very pleasant atmosfere, good food and reasonable prices. Hidden away from the traffic, quiet and very relaxing. Free and reliable WIFI, always a plus. Muntri accommodation also looks great although slightly on the pricy side.Show less

Author: Petar PDubrovnik, Croatia
Title: Tasteful food, great service
Review: Mews cafe is definitely best place to eat in George Town. I ate breakfast once and two times lunch in this restaurant because I was so happy with the food and service. The terrace is very nice with the surrounding trees, on each table there are roses, very relaxing atmosphere and great place to escape from sun as George Town is very hot and humid. I ate here best breakfast in whole South East Asia, croissant with eggs, ham and cheese with English Breakfast tea served in very expensive Chinese porcelain. They offer also some interesting magazines to read. For the lunch I ate some very tasty Indian meals. Each meal they served in different plate (depends how "complicated" is meal) what I found very interesting and unusual. The waiters were very friendly and professional. It is little expensive for Malaysia, but service, quality and presentation of meals were 5 star so I was happy to pay little extra.Show less

Author: 3sarah_d
Title: Pleasant place to stop by
Review: Can't comment on the food because we only stopped in for a few beers, but were glad we did.  Really pleasant spot, convenient location, but feels like a peaceful escape.

Author: David A
Title: Wonderful lunch get away
Review: Fantastic quiet and cool cafe. Lovely escape from the heat and bustle of Georgetown. Extremely tasty food and great coffee with very attentive staff. After days of hotel food this is something different. Highly recommended.

Author: PinccasAlor Setar, Malaysia
Title: Good food!
Review: The food in Mews Cafe is good. We had tried chicken satay and salmon salad of this cafe. The chicken satay tastes really good and we can say that it is the best satay we have tasted so far. Yet, the price is quite high compared to those stalls at the roadside. The salmon is fresh enough. For those who have higher budget on food, it is worth trying.Show less

Author: TaylorPeeAdelaide, Australia
Title: Tasty, authentic food, but a little pricey if you're on a budget.
Review: Mew's Cafe is situated down the quiet and beautiful Muntri street. The atmosphere is peaceful and candlelit, which makes it the perfect location for a romantic dinner or if you are in the mood for something less noisy than the surrounding main streets. The two of us shared three entrées (what they call 'light bites') and one main course which was the perfect amount, we left very full. In terms of the food, it was very good. We shared the chicken somosas, which had a good amount of flavour and a crisp light pastry, the tuna fish cakes, which were light, fragrant and served with a plentiful salad, and the Vietnamese cold rolls, that were refreshing and accompanied with a delicious peanut dipping sauce. For main, nasi goreng that was served very generously with satays, fried egg and all the extras. However, I think the prices were a touch too high, but this is probably because it is attached to quite a classy hotel. Overall, the food was very good, but not exceptional, the staff very relatively friendly and it is a nice atmosphere. If your budget is a bit higher and you are travelling with children, Mew's Cafe is probably a good place to eat as they also have western menu options.Show less

Author: Richie WPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: superb malaysian noodles
Review: me and my friends went there and ordered different noodles - mee jawa, curry mee and their "today's speciality" laksa melaka ... all were very very good and the best part is, the place is nice and cozy, not your typical coffeeshop place. after having the noodles, we had coffees and was surprised to have been served cappuccino in a chinese bowl. it's one interesting experience and will definitely go back there. the staff were very friendly and were all smiling and accommodating.Show less

Author: vincentcP7017RBShinjuku, Japan
Title: Not a good choice for dinner
Review: Nice atmosphere and a good place to chill. But not a great place for dinner. The choice on the food menu is limited. I had Malaysian food, but they also have western food on the menu. The food was ok, not bad but not great. For Penang it is probably too expensive. Show less

Author: Citygal12456Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: east meets west ...
Review: they have a limited selection of food items but everything was good. me and my friends ordered different items so we were able to try different things on the menu. they have local specialities and it is refreshing that these are presented properly and decently compared to those in hawker stalls. a bit more pricey than anywhere else but it is all worth it. they also have a good selection of coffees and teas. will definitely go back.Show less

Author: Josephine1987Georgetown, Malaysia
Title: Quiet place, pricey food but open from morning to night
Review: I made it a point to eat here today (June 3, Monday) since I saw that this cafe is listed as the 4th most popular restaurant in George Town on TripAdvisor. So I brought my mom for lunch there.We ordered the nasi goreng (RM22), laksa lemak (a recommended dish as reviewed in the newspaper) (RM18) and fresh watermelon juice (RM12). Service charge was added to the bill.My mom's nasi goreng's presentation was impressive. Well, it does cost about 10 times more than the usual ones that we can get from the hawker stalls. The satay that came with it was soft and chewy and it tasted nice.My laksa lemak was alright. It was quite a generous amount and it was different from the other laksa that I have eaten.They try to make it a relaxing ambience in the indoor section which had a nice, huge mirror on the wall. Soft music was played in the background. But I found that it was a too quiet atmosphere, like those places that I felt I had to be careful of any noise or the loudness of my voice during a conversation.It may sound weird but I enjoyed the bathroom. I love the black and white floor tiles. It really looks so inviting!The great thing about this cafe is that it is open daily from 8am to 11pm so you can have your breakfast, lunch and dinner (and supper if you want) there. On weekends and public holidays, it is open till midnight.According to the receipt, there is a live performance every Saturday and happy hour from 6pm to 9pm on selected cocktails.Show less

Author: banjapat
Title: quite a nice little place
Review: quite a nice little place to stop for coffee and snacks when u bike around town.  it's very welcoming and u can either sit in or outside.  i had a nice coffee here.  totally charming.

Author: paul t
Title: Nice Breakfast
Review: Although a little expensive by Penang standards, the staff were most helpful and allowed us to mix the set menu with a la carte which was to our advantage.  Pleasant surroundings and good food - well worth considering.

Author: fojo57Salzburg, Austria
Title: Probably best meal I have eaten in Malaysia
