Review: Nice stylish place- a bit more expensive than the usual restaurants in Penang but definitely worth it. They only have a few meals (around 15) n the menu, but the Nasi Goreng I tried was definitely the best rice meal I ate during our three weeks in Malaysia. Show less

Author: Herecy
Title: Very nice food n drinks...
Review: Very relax kafe n delicious food n drink...value price for food n drink....😃all staff very friendly ...tq Sara for serving me...🙏

Author: fftygun x
Title: great cafe
Review: Food is great, enjoyed their fish and chips, the service is quite slow. The food is expensive but worth it.

Author: GrouchoSydneyNeutral Bay, Australia
Title: Nice little Cafe
Review: Mews Cafe is a nice little spot with indoor and outdoor seating. Small but interesting menu of western and local items, very cold beer and excellent coffee. A nice break from the busy and hot business of expploring Penang. Its not cheap compared to the hawker stalls but its not too expensive. treat yourself, cool down, and carry on exploring refreshed.Show less

Author: PenangPuppyLoveGeorge Town, Malaysia
Title: Great Cafe
Review: A special find! Small, quiet cafe with great staff. Very relaxing setting for any meal or a tea/coffee break. Definitely up to date considered the surroundings and is perfect if your exploring the area by foot and need to stop for a bit. I think they actually have a restroom for customer use? (Which is hard to find in Penang...especially downtown Georgetown). Food is good and they have an interesting variety.Show less

Author: genericnicChiang Mai, Thailand
Title: Good but not the best
Review: The cafe has both indoor and outdoor seating though as noted in a prior review, the indoor seating is a bit limited. The outdoor seating has plenty of shade and they had fans out for air circulation. I was there in late morning and the temperature was pleasant.The cafe has a set menu with both western an local items as well an ala cart menu. I had the set menu which was a small banana smoothie, coffee, and nasi lemak. All the food was well prepared and well presented. However, if you are expecting traditional nasi lemek you may be disappointed. There are more traditional versions available within a short walk. The meal cost MR 25 or about US$7.50. I thought that a bit high since a similar meal with traditional style nasi lemek in Kuala Lumpur last week cost around US$5.00. The difference could be due to the cafe being in a very touristy, hostel, guesthouse, hotel area. The service was excellent with a very attentive staff. I would recommend the cafe with the caveat that the local food appears to have been modified to a more westernized version and you can find cheaper eats close by.Show less

Author: Michael Z
Title: Quiet Small Cafe, Good Service, Good Food, Inexpensive
Review: There aren't many tables inside in the air conditioning nor outside but service is good, food is good and the cost is reasonable.  It can be tight inside with tables too close to each other when it's crowded.  No smoking inside is a plus.

Author: SmagyarErdobenye, Hungary
Title: Nice terrace to enjoy an evening cocktail
Review: I visited Mews Cafe twice during my visit to Georgetown in January, once for a pre-dinner cocktail and the second time, also for a cocktail and a light meal. Both visits were very pleasant -- the cocktails were great, the service excellent and the atmosphere perfect.Show less

Author: NeeNee_ChoPenang
Title: A bit over-priced
Review: I went during a weekday morning for breakfast. The interior of the cafe is nice and the staffs are also quite helpful. Looking at the menu, it is a standard breakfast set with several selections. Each set include fresh fruits or fruit juice, a breakfast and a coffee or tea priced at RM30++. Ordered a croissant sandwich and a full breakfast set. I personally found nothing to wow about the breakfast, everything is standard but the price, I would expect to get something better else way.Show less

Author: ManU4ever_13Panania, Australia
Title: Good value and tasty
Review: We ate here on two occasions,first for lunch and then for a dinner. We enjoyed the lunch and it was very reasonably priced for the quality received. The drinks menu is generally quite expensive. We enjoyed our dinner and we would recommend. The service is very good with a friendly attentive staff.Show less

Author: mike_bielbyWakefield, United Kingdom
Title: Needed a break
Review: We had read about this place but stumbled on it by accident during an exploratory visit to Georgetown. We were ready for a break from the heat and noise and the timing was just right for lunch. It is quite small inside, with a few tables outside in leafy shade. We both had a chicken schnitzel and really one to share would have been ample. Very generous portions. It is not the cheapest place by any means, but the food was good, freshly cooked, so you need to be a bit patient when busy. Service was friendly.Show less

Author: wagetKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: it has improved ...
Review: i first visited in april 2012 and when i went back in november 2012, their food has improved. on both occasions, i tried their nasi lemak and it has improved 10x, they must have hired a new chef. even their lunch menu has become better. it is a decent place where local food are presentable. the place is nice and cozy for intimate groups. it can be difficult if you have a vegetarian with you but they are willing to accommodate your request which was fantastic.Show less

Author: dkfy
Title: Nice ambiance but too pricey.
Review: Went there for dinner, the setting is very nice. Food was just average. Not as good as the local hawker and way overpriced.

Author: Kingsley1234
Title: Nice place for tea break
Review: This little cafe is part of the Muntri Mews Hotel. We had our tea break there. Nice place, relaxed atmosphere and friendly staffs.

Author: abdulry
Title: Excellent Ambiance
Review: Really nice setting. I had breakfast there. good selection - western and asian. price, a bit on a high side. food quality above average, rate 1 to 10, I will give 7

Author: Evelyn K
Title: Great Ambience
Review: Mews is a great place to refresh and rejunavate quiet and cozy ambience. Staff friendly and accommodating.  On Sat evening listen to live music. Menu is something with modern twist creation.

Author: brutally
Title: Nice place for a espresso and sparkling water
Review:
Some good snacks too

Service is very friendly and every table outside go a fan so I can't agree with the post before me its to hot to sit

Author: amarisliu
Title: Excellent Breakfast
Review: I loved the Bread Basket, the coffee and their curry. The smell of the coffee is enough to wake me up, and their bread is nicely baked and comes with an assortment of butter and jam. A must-try if you are around the area.

Author: Andrew TSingapore, Singapore
Title: Small unappealing restaurant
Review: I had lunch here after a tour of the inner Georgetown, and especially after reading some good comments on the trip advisor and especially being so highly ranked.I am not particularly impressed with the cafe. It is very small with small indoor and outdoor seatings. Outdoor seatings could be unbearably hot in the afternoon. They serve mainly local foods. Quality of food is average but prices given the setup and ambience, I think it is little on high side.Nothing in particular that excites me. Definitely not on the top of my suggested list of must eat in Penang.Show less

Author: SandyGrain
Title: Nice staff
Review:
Food was only OK but it was a nice evening. We sat outside and the staff were very friendly.

Worth a try.

Author: ADS20092009
Title: Great food and service moderatly priced.
Review: Just had a great meal and a few beers here and it was excellent. Menu is a little limited but what is there is solid gold. Staff were friendly and attentive. Would recomend.

Author: Sunnybunny93
Title: Nice place with very good food
Review: We went there after reading about it on tripadvisor, and we did not regret it! We were served excellent food with a very good orange jus. On the other side; they used a little long time to serve us, one of the ladies who worked there looked kind of unhappy and the ketchup tasted vinegard. It was also pretty expensive. But the food and the place were amazing! Show less

Author: travelboy4
Title: A must try in Penang
Review:
The food is excellent at this cafe because the food is prepared by the mother of the owner, madam choy is a brilliant cook and all her specialities r served here.

The signature dish is the curry mee no1.

Author: H118Singapore, Singapore
Title: Average cafe in the core of Georgetown
Review: This little cafe is part of the boutique hotel. The menu is small and mainly local food plus some western dishes. It is pretty much an all day cafe as they serve breakfast as well. They have both indoor and outdoor seatings. Outdoor seatings can be very hot and humid during the day time.Decent food and decor.Show less

Author: Daniel JUnited Kingdom
Title: Fantastic food, helpful staff and lovely atmosphere
Review: We ate here twice on a recent holiday to George Town. Have only good things to say about the restaurant. I ate the laksa twice in a row as it was so good. The food was consistently superb and the staff were always on hand to give advice or recommend a specific dish. The surroundings were relaxing to eat in and the general ambience was thoroughly enjoyable. Super restaurant.Show less

Author: DavitowalkerKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: great atmosphere
Review: Nice change and touch to the 'heritage' environment. The decor still boast a heritage sense but in a simple, chic and modern way. They focused more on the food, drinks and service which is the right thing to do and they did it great! Have a quick drink there to break away from the monotony of styles throughout Georgetown.Show less

Author: lthooiPenang
Title: fab. cafe & priceless service
Review: Firstly, warm welcoming from the team leader Sarah, i never been a place that, a server asked me would you like to have warm water or ice water i feel special because most of the place were only pour you a sky juice without hesitate asking . We try the Salmon and also Nasi Goreng , original taste of malay fried rice, authentically and nicely done salmon can't even capture any sense of MSG inside it. Kudos to the chef. Jenny is very helpful providing us a floor standing fan because we had our meal at the petio. I would recommended this place as a place to have nice meal and nevermind to pay more for the priceless service...Show less

Author: lesley c
Title: Fantastic breakfast
Review: This may seem pricey but for a set amount you get wonderful coffee, fresh fruit, expertly cooked eggs,(plus bacon etc if desired), toast and posh jams. Heaven.

Author: BroombridgeSydney
Title: great malay food in a tropical setting
Review: Penang is mostly thought of as a chinese town but the malay influences are every bit as interesting and the malay food at this cafe is excellent.Service and presentation and decor are also very elegant and smart.We had lunch here twice as it was in the same street as our hotel.Show less

Author: markcallan8
Title: great malay food
Review:
relaxed friendly staff, great cocktails and yummy food.

A restored colonial building with a lush tropical garden where I could sit and read and think all day long.

Author: christina hSydney, Australia
Title: fab cafe in the old quarter
Review: just got back from a trip to georgetown , stayed at muntri mews for 5 nites and loved the little cafe that reminded me of home, potts point , sydneygreat coffee, relaxed atmosphere, friendly service. local dishes were priced higher than street food, but this was expected given the whole package, mentioned above and delicious food. the best part was sitting down and watching the street life, from the trishaws to monks, weander past. i will be back , thank you all , zul jenny junShow less

Author: tracey b
Title: delicious
Review:
loved this place for anything from cappucinos to great food
Great for lunch and within walking distance of the blue mansion

Author: Diogo N
Title: Afordable western food
Review: A really nice brunch and some asian food with a good environment. Good variety, nice service at affordable prices. A good option for food and drinks in Penang

Author: hoolifromhoustonNew York City, New York
Title: Delightful
Review: Yes, delightful. I don't use the word often but I can't think of a better way to describe Mews Cafe. We were staying at Ryokan across the street and were attracted by the cute Parisian cafe feel Mews has going on. We popped in for a late dinner and there was a local Malay couple singing Jazz tunes and cute old timey black and white decor that made us feel like we stepped back in time. The restaurant is small with a few outdoor tables and few indoors - both great options. The food was good. One of us got the Bento Box which looked to be an amalgamation of all of the sides that the rest of us had on their plate. I had fish cooked in a banana leaf - it was excellent as were two of the sides. There was also a soggy frittata on my plate that I didn't really care for. We also tried the chicken samosas, these were incredible!Show less

Author: pemblinBangkok, Thailand
Title: Surprsingly good food in a lane way
Review: Mews cafe is a part indoor part outdoor spot that seats maybe 20 people but it has the feel of a grander and more settled restaurant.The not extensive menu is well balanced and the food is deliciousFriendly staff and it has a nice vibe of all sorts of people dropping by from tourist to Penang Nonyas to Hi So types.Some just to eat and run others sit and soak up the atmosphereShow less

Author: LeChatEnVacancesBrienz, Switzerland
Title: Good Food, Cosy Laid-Back Ambiance, Prompt Friendly Service, Free Wi-Fi & 'Live' Music on some nights...
Review: Kafe Mews is located @ 77 Lebuh Muntri, within Georgetown's Core Heritage Zone. Perfect place to chill-out on a muggy day or sultry evening... It is open daily from 8am till 11pm. You can choose to dine in air-con comfort inside or sit out in the little garden where they have several fans to dispel some of that heat & humidity... There is free Wi-Fi & on some nights (Fri & Sat), they provide 'live' music entertainment.The Menu offers a small selection of local delicacies. We had the Curry Mee & Laksa Lekma for mains & shared a Sago Gula Melaka for dessert. Food was tasty & not too spicy, portion size was just right too. We enjoyed the Mew's Madness & Mew's Delight which were cool & refreshing but rather pricey for mocktails (RM14 each).Service was warm & efficient, our waitress was quick to recommend the House Specialities when asked and food & drinks all arrived within 10 minutes of placing orders. Total Bill for 2 pax amounted to RM75 which was slightly expensive by Malaysian standards.In Summary: well worth a visit if you're in the mood to 'splurge' a little ~ Good Food, Cosy Laid-Back Ambiance, Prompt Friendly Service, Free Wi-Fi & 'Live' Music on some nights...Show less

Author: NapatraBeijing, China
Title: Yummy everything (well, all the ones I tried!) & nice ambience
Review: Like Muntri Mews, I had a positive experience during my several meals at the Mews Cafe. Fresh juice and lovely coffee. I had one of the Malaysian dishes offered and it was tasty. Had a hard time restraining myself from ordering the second tiramisu. I also like the Muntri Street front view and the people watching opportunity from the cafe. Definitely one of the good memories of my Penang experience.Show less

Author: jdesalabSingapore, Singapore
Title: Lovely stop for a bite!
Review: Delightful little cafe ideally located on one of Georgetown's heritage streets - Muntri St. It has a short but sensible menu from coffees to a variety of blended fruit juices, from refreshing salads to local dishes. The food is tasty and served in sensible proportions. It also provides free wifi. A lovely place to stop for a bite after a few hours of exploring Georgetown on foot!Show less

Author: SF_KinKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Hidden gem
Review: Great little cafe ideally located on the beautiful Muntri St in Penang. It has everything from lattes (well-made), cafe classics and daily specials. The menu delivers quality over quantity, and the rendang and ikan bakar we had here was delicious. No better place to hang out in the shade and watch the world go by!Show less

Author: Priss58Singapore, Singapore
Title: Good cuppa!
Review: Found it by chance quite late one evening, just needed to sit down and have a cup of tea which was served in a beautiful tea set. Can't comment on the food as I didn't have any, however there was some entertainment in the form of a keyboard player and singer plus some 'karaoke' from some other diners. Pleasant, clean and relaxing.Show less

Author: Noirien
Title: Mews - a quick visit
Review: Drooped into Mews Cafe with little time to spare, a hot steamy day, it was a lovely cool sojourn. Just had a Laksa Lemak and lime juice. Served quickly, the food was great, Laksa was creamy with a tasty seafood stock base and the lime juice refreshing. A shame I was on the run as could have easily spent more time here. Coffee smelt good so will have to return.Show less

Author: Susie M
Title: Lovely little restaurant
Review: Local food and also has friendly staff.  Prices very reasonable and the tables filled up very quickly at lunchtime.  Second time there and still enjoyed our choices.

Author: Loutchas
Title: New home
Review: I'm french and i love and need cafe. At mews cafe i found the best cafe in town and the people and the atmosphere  are so beautiful! it's now my second home

Author: Lidija IMelbourne, Australia
Title: Heritage gem
Review: Mews cafe was a great find, part of the beautifully restored Muntri Mews accommodation. Offered great local cuisine with very clean presentation in tranquil setting. Beautiful spot for lunch after exploring that part of George Town. Fast becoming a trendy quarter with lots of Chinese shop fronts undergoing restoration and a few galleries starting to pop up.Show less

Author: Ruth B
Title: Cute place a great food and coffee
Review: We stopped by, by chance for a drink and ended up staying for the food. Very tasty and good service, the coffee is excellent. A little expensive compared to the other places we visited but worth trying for sure. Great art work on display.

Author: Hock-ChyeWashington DC, District of Columbia
Title: Addictive local cuisine in a chic cafe
Review: I was back in Georgetown for the heritage festival and have been using Mews Cafe as my base because of its location right in the heart of the heritage zone. For me, someone who enjoys local cuisine, two items in the menu stand out - Helen's curry mee and laksa lemak. They are both authentic in taste, served with a luxe touch.The curry mee comes with so many types of garnishing that I could hardly see the noodles.I also like the coffee that I am almost certain that the barista is Italian! Service is consistently excellent and comes with a smile :-)Show less

Author: Companion802750
Title: Wonderful east west selections. Great music.
Review: I had the laksa noodels. Nice round al dente noodles with an aromatic, spicy thick soup. Just right. The kids had chicken pie, fish and chips. Wonderful drinks and desserts. Well done!

Author: windermere99Melbourne, Australia
Title: Cosy and comfy
Review: Went there on two occasions whilst in Penang. Service was good and so was the food. The local delicacies on offer were not many in variety but they made it up in taste. Everything was good there including the drinks. I had their special iced tea that was infused with lemongrass and mint. The cafe was very private and quiet to sit in.The exterior surroundings were lovely too,set back from the street.Will go back anytime.Show less

Author: noooby
Title: Excellent Little Haven.
Review: Outdoors and indoor aircon seating. Menu and weekly specials. Great hazelnut coffee served in a bowl. Local foods and desserts. Close by the heritage paths.

Author: mkmaMelbourne, Australia
Title: Best of East West without the Confusion
Review: Firstly, the mixed menu was very well executed.....Western and Eastern (or should I say Penang) Favourites on offer without the 'confusion'. As much as I love hawker food when I'm in Pg,the classic Schnitzel Sandwich is hard to resist after a week of noodles. After having said that, the Curry Laksa or Nasi Lemak was very good as well. Do what I do......get a few friends to go with you and order a selection. Great ambience, great place to get out of the heat after all the exploring around,the other big plus is a great selection of cold non alcoholic beverages.Simply refreshing,may not be the cheapest in Georgetown but certainly value for money as far as quality and service are concerned.This was my 3rd trip over the last 18 months and I am very happy to find that the quality and integrity of the cafe remained as good as my 1st visit when it first opened.Show less

Author: iwishiwasonvacation
Title: Lovely Place For A Quick Beer
Review:
If you're on a tour of the nearby Cheong Fatt Tze Mansion, drop by Mews Cafe for a quick pint to cool off. They have a lovely courtyard for you to chit chat with friends. 
Pricing is decent, around RM10 for a Tiger Bottle.

Author: LilyanaAzizPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Dont miss this one out.
Review: Meticulous to detail, sensitive to ambiance. Pleasant, inviting, comfortable and best of all affordable. And the food is great! Muntri Mews cafe, is the next best alternative if you cant stay there. 9 out of 10, passers by would stop for a coffee, an ice cool drink or better yet a tall glass of Long Island, I had the '101 reasons why you like us'. Triple Sec, some other gorgeous poison and lemonade served with ice. Mojitos are a must try and the Muntri styled cocktails is a MUST ORDER. I arrive hungry, always, and the Nasi Lemak is naughty if you are on a diet but please do try it. Served so simply you'd think it was art on a plate. Generous yet reasonable priced this characteristic dish should be a bench mark for all food establishments. It shouldnt be expensive and it should be good, Mews Cafe delivers both. Today I had Helen's Mee Curry. A rich coconut milk curry broth with bean sprouts, fried tau foo, glass noodles and yellow noodles all tangled up with chunky chicken breast bits and mixed in with fat fat prawns. Browse thru the all day menu, there's bound to be some sort of fantastic dish that calls out to you. They had Garoupa fish and chips! insane! And when you're stuffed get one of the staff to bring you thier collection shop at the end of the walk way, lost treasures from sunken ships and babanonya antique bowls and tea cups are for sale. Some of the proprietors personal collections are displayed there too, 'strictly not for sale' says the staff. Oh and did you know Muntri Mews is pet friendly?Show less

Author: donald cBristol, United Kingdom
Title: Cosmopolitan cafe in a tropical garden setting
Review: After walking around the fantastic Georgetown we stopped off for a cool drink at muntri mews cafe as it looked so welcoming. Some 2 hours later we were still there and had tried the battered fish and chips as well as the beef rendeng, both great !International crowd as attached the muntri mews hotel . Highly recommend. Show less

Author: datin_tanPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Lovely place serving good food
Review: Their laksa is delicious!!! Price a bit expensive but is worthwhile.The restaurant is attached with a boutique hotel, and the hotel buidling was actually an old building about 100 year which just restored.Located at Muntri Street, where you will find easier to call it as "moon tree".Show less

Author: Lisa TKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good food at reasonable prices
Review: We were told to be there by 6pm ie when they open for dinner. We got there at 610pm and got the last table. By 630pm there was a queue. With the new SOP, the tables are well spaced and the restaurant is clean.We ordered the fried roast pork which is really yummy, stir fried potato leaves - a tad salty but flavorful, seafood tofu and the fried chicken which we saw almost every table ordered that, which was okay.Food was served within 10 minutes and overall really yummy experience. Will definitely make this a stop when I am in Penang next.Show less

Author: chrisrC3957GK
Title: excellent lunch stop
Review: authentic cuisine, great flavours perfect stop for quick lunch whilst touring Georgetown. Recommend claypot chicken.

Author: Kheng YMelbourne, Australia
Title: Good food and worth the wait in the queue.
Review: This restaurant has now been well established and is renowned for its "choo char" (or food cooked to order). However, the restaurant takes no reservation and if you are patient, join the long queue and wait. Most dished are excellent. Order any dish from the menu and you won't be disappointed. For dinner, be there at around 5 p.m. This restaurant accepts cash and cards. Fortunately, there is a pay car park right next to it. The restaurant is not air-conditioned and the dining area is clean. I visited the restaurant before the COVID lock down.Show less

Title: So so food
Review: Chinese Food. Some dishes were okay, some not so good. Seating on wooden stools not very comfortable.

Author: datin_tan
Title: Family type dishes
Review:
A very popular place for tourist. The restaurant serves Chinese family style dishes. Fried sio bak is one of their signature dish. Portion a bit small.
Not a bad choice for tourist.

Author: Iggies64Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Enough said. You must go
Review: We knew you needed to book, we’d heard there’s always line ups. Now we know why. Food selection is of a wide variety and with interesting combinations. The food is of a high quality in a very clean shop lot environment. Staff are helpful and friendly. Come again they said... and we will.Show less

Author: annayoong_26
Title: TekSen Restaurant Penang
Review:
Tired of hawkers foods in penang! Should 
visit to Teksen Restaurant for good  Chinese foods. Reasonable price, clean restaurant and fast service. Most importantly foods are yummy! Highly recommended to order the homemade taufu!

Author: Compass14392113320
Title: nice food, average enviroment
Review: if u are expecting a nice enviroment, this is not the place but their food is superb. i love the black pork a lot., since jan 2020 till now , and i am still missing the black pork

Author: jessye3000
Title: Delicious Food!
Review: Great restaurant, we definitely ordered a bit too much food but it was all awesome. It is a very bustling restaurant !

Author: justinl758Brooklyn, New York
Title: Local fare and feel
Review: Our dinner at Tek Sen was excellent. We arrived at 5:30pm for an early dinner, and good thing we did! As soon as we were seated we saw the queue become very lengthy in a hurry. We had the daily prawn special as well as sweet and sour chicken, both of which we ate every bite. The prawns were a little pricey, but were the size of a baby's fist- so good. Don't be surprised if you are seated with others at a shared table if you are a couple, as the staff fills every seat to serve as many guests as possible- this can be fun and lead to some unexpected conversation. Highly recommended to anyone visiting Georgetown, Tek Sen does not disappoint!Show less

Author: TerjeHoegbergOslo, Norway
Title: You don't get it better
Review: Good location in the heart of Georgetown in Lebuh Carnarvon street. It's worth waiting for 30 minutes or more for lunch or dinner. The Kankung with sambal and shrimps and doubleroasted pork with chilipadi was just delicious, almost out of this world. I went there again and again and enjoyed every minutes. You can't be in town without visiting Tek Sen.Show less

Author: sambissettMelbourne, Australia
Title: Good Chinese food
Review: Got here at 5:50 (opens at six), and they were already letting people in, so we got one of the first tables. The service is certainly no-nonsense. The menu is broad and there are decent vegetarian options. It certainly did not blow my mind, perhaps because we're used to very good Chinese in Australia, but it was a lovely meal. No wine, only beer.Show less

Author: ECKLKualaLumpurKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Less is More Part 430 - Ravishingly Robust Rollicking Ravenous Rendezvous
Review: Not the first time here but the last time was probably more than five years ago. Looks like this old-school eatery has become even more popular since then - quite surprising on a weekday and non-school holidays when vacationing families inundate the island. Fortunately the turnover is fast and our wait was not longer than 30 minutes. We ordered the usual go-to dishes here; Assam Fish (Fillet) Curry, Tamarind Fried (King) Prawns, Beansprouts with Salted Fish, Egg Fuyong Omelette and Salted Fish Bone & Tofu Soup. Everything arrived freshly prepared, piping hot and quite tasty. They do deliver very home-cooked flavours - truthfully nothing much to complain about. Don’t expect too much finesse in the service. They are there to serve the food and clear it when you’re done. Don’t expect small talk either - everyone is super busy. Prices have gone quite premium given its rising popularity. But still recommended.Show less

Author: 620maureeng
Title: Amazing to say the least ♡
Review:
This place is going to be my official dining table every day until I leave Malaysia.
Tonight we ordered the salt and pepper squids, the pork belly specialty and the chicken in Thai sauce... A.m.a.z.i.n.g. ♡
Don't hesitate to go!

Author: nmider
Title: Excellent and authentic Chinese Malay cuisine
Review: This is a very good spot for authentic and delicious food in Georgetown. Make sure you arrive early, ideally before 5:45 pm, so you get a seat and can order all of the signature dishes before they run out.

Author: Johnsnelgrove
Title: Perfect for a chill night
Review: Unpretentious. Great food atmosphere and price. This is not fine diningbut will satify your taste buds 100%

Author: HKG_Traveller2010Shenzhen, China
Title: Cheap restaurant in the old town with great food
Review: The restaurant is located in the heritage old town area and can be easily identified; as there is always a long queue outside the restaurant. The food is great and very cheap which is comparable to those street food stalls in the old town.In order to avoid the queue go during off peak but the restaurant only operates from 9 am to 2:30 pm and then 6 pm to 8:30pm.Show less

Author: BallardBeaver
Title: Still #1 in Penang In My Book
Review: I first reviewed Tek Sent in 2012 and again in 2015. Every time I've enthused about this outstanding place -- which is still my favorite restaurant not just in George Town, but in Malaysia. Not fancy, abut it's the real deal for Chinese cuisine.

Author: dtjt1
Title: Delicious delicious
Review: Delicious food and a must when in Penang. Queue starts at 540pm although operating hours start from 6pm. Very crowded on both weekdays and weekends. Come early to avoid long wait.

Author: dear_ChanSSurabaya, Indonesia
Title: Great food. Uncomfortable place.
Review: By the time we got here it's already full, luckily the queue was short. We were taken to our table after 5 minutes wait. I admitted the food was amazing. Tofu, veggie, soup, everything we had was delicious. Place was too noisy, and fan was too much for me, it gave me a bit headache. It's a popular destination for Chinese food, so make sure you don't miss it. I suggest you try Curry stingray fish.Show less

Author: Trivinator
Title: So cheap and good food
Review: There was a big queue out front and I can see why.  Really good local Chinese food and did not cost much at all.   Signature Pork and almost all their vegetable dishes are terrific.

Author: crh69
Title: Only ok and not cheap - dont line up for this
Review: The food is ok but does not at all measure up to the hype. I feel many of Chinese restaurants will be of similar quality. The price is a little high for what you get. I wouldnt go back or bring friends.

Author: kmquek
Title: Lovely tze char food
Review: Lovely tze char food. Really good. I really like the been sprouts with salted fish. The salted fish aroma (not salty just flavour) was like truffle exploding in my mouth. It was great! Also liked the belly pork and I actually like all the dishes.

Author: lucy_the
Title: Authentic taste and good price
Review:
Their famous signature dish never fails 
I always want to try again and again 
From roasted pork . Homemade tofu , etc 
Service was fast

Author: JLW78North Devon
Title: Lively Chinese food experience
Review: This was an amazing find. Initially put off by the queues but was then told about the system of collecting a playing card (4 clubs was mine) and then sitting while deciding on the menu. The lady organising this seeming chaos was cross between a school mistress and a referee and created quite a theatrical performance! The food was delicious particularly the steamed fish and red snapper. People we spoke too had been there many times and kept returning. If you are a couple and prepared to share a larger table you might be able to skip the queue. Worth waiting.Show less

Author: workingnomad20
Title: Lives up to the hype
Review: Excellent place and well worth waiting to get in. Try and go around 6pm if possible. We had a lovely meal here and it was a good portion size too.

Author: georgepaipaiSingapore, Singapore
Title: Solid restaurant in Penang with amazing BBQ pork (char siu)
Review: Pro tip:- Order the BBQ pork, or anything on the menu that has a Star next to it. - Be prepared to wait up to an hour. Well worth it. Originally saw this listed on a few foodie blogs so we decided to go and try it out. Initially, there was a long line, but don’t worry, it was definitely worth it. Additionally, the line itself went by fast. This place is known for their BBQ pork dish. It’s a perfect combination of sweet and tender pieces of pork. Honestly, I never knew that Char siu (bbq pork) could taste like that and now I’m hooked. The fried Chicken with Thai sauce and Green shoots w/garlic were also solid choices. Highly recommend if you’re visiting Penang. However the wait time can get long so either be prepared to wait or come when they open. Show less

Author: pooisze93
Title: Patience for Good Food
Review: The food here is awesome. The quality of the food remains the same as two years ago.  Long queue and waiting is a MUST.

Author: BrigTravelsSydney, Australia
Title: So Good We Went Twice
Review: 10 days in Penang and this was an absolute standout. We first visited for lunch and were so impressed we went back for dinner a few days later. There was a long queue for dinner but the efficiency and good humour of the staff turned the wait into a piece of street theatre. The menu is huge - we went for the recommended dishes (easy to spot) both times. The double roasted pork is to die for. The vibe is busy, the service super efficient and both food and drinks are very reasonably priced.Show less

Author: louise s
Title: Best Taste in Malaysia
Review: The food was absolutely amazing and delicious. After visiting this restaurant my taste buds couldn’t find any better. Whilst the ambiance isn’t anything fancy it’s definitely worth the visit in Penang.

Author: cclyeGeorge Town, Malaysia
Title: The TOP restaurant in Penang?
Review: This place is actually rated the No 1 Restaurant in Penang!? If you consider the queue waiting for a table outside the door (ie high demand), then maybe yes.On food, service and environment, a fair rating from a Penangite is only 4-star. It is actually a well-appointed “da chow” or “da pai dang”. Another positive point is fair pricing is maintained despite all the excitement from outstation and overseas visitors. My respect to the owner of this restaurant for keeping himself grounded.The most popular dishes are marked with a heart sign: the gu lou yok (sweet & sour pork), the deep fried chicken with plum sauce, stir fried roast pork and signature tofu.Show less

Author: JoKart
Title: Good food, reasonable price
Review: This place is famous among tourists. Better call ahead and reserve your table before going there to avoid long wait. The food is good, service a bit slow which is understandable given the crowd. Price is reasonable.

Author: YONGMANAmpang, Malaysia
Title: LOVELY LOCAL FARE
Review: This is a place where you must here there early. If you go during normal "lunch time", be prepared to wait. But the wait is certainly worth the wait as the chefs here can whip up a lot of lovely stuff that your mum or auntie used to cook! And when you used to drool as a kid.Show less

Author: LakwatseRoyceDoha, Qatar
Title: Excellent food!
Review: It can be very busy if you go there right after they open. It took me sometime to get seated but it was well-worth the wait. Loved that caramelized pork, which is a bestseller I think, and I had sauteed veggies with shrimp paste I think.Show less

Author: cyrus h
Title: Best for the Money
Review: Arranged by friends for a table of 10 in the backroom, we didn't have to wait like others. Despite the crowd, our food came promptly, piping hot. Our host ordered 10 dishes: curry fish, sambal prawns, diced pork, deep fried chicken wings etc, all excellent, the real Penang experience.The place was clean. The meal with beer came to RM60 (US$15)pax ~ a steal. Go early 6pm & be prepared to wait, or best to get a local friend to book in advance a big table if you have such friends there.Show less

Author: stevemG9926LY
Title: Filling
Review: When traveling and looking for somewhere to eat, I tend to look for places where the locals eat and the establishment is busy. Tec Sen didn’t disappoint, the food was very very good, very reasonably priced and the service was quick and pleasant. Thoroughly recommend.

Author: Mzliyu
Title: Relaxed dinner without feeling touristy
Review:
While they are probably frequently by tourists but the vibe is chilled and food is good. 

roast pork - sweet!
Plum chicken
Bean sprout (tou Miao)
Curry fish 
Herbal drink is good- not too sweet. 
99RM

Author: pamelahs89
Title: decent chinese food
Review: a very long queue, but very fast service. couldn't ask for any better service. ordered all recommended dishes, not disappointed at all. quite bit pricey, but worth the delicious dishes and top service.

Author: LoisSaraBennettManchester, United Kingdom
Title: Best food in all of south east Asia!!!
Review: I don’t usually leave reviews but this place is out of this world!!! The food is definitely the best food we have eaten in all of our 2 month trip around south east Asia so far! We had the double fried pork with chilli and chicken with sour plum sauce and they were the stuff of dreams! The restaurant is always packed with locals and people queue outside for tables which tells you what amazing food they have! Also super cheap 62RM (£12/$15) for 3 drinks, 2 main meals, 1 rice and 1 vegetable dish! A MUST visit if you are in Penang! Show less

Author: F3328TAjohnkLeeds, United Kingdom
Title: Very busy! Very tasty!
Review: There’s a good reason this restaurant has long queues. The food is fantastic. Pitch up, join the queue, get a playing card from the waitress to secure your place and wait! It may be half an hour or longer but stick it out and you’ll get to eat some amazing food.Show less

Author: Kiwisinpenang
Title: Great for family
Review: Delicious food - so fresh and flavoursome. Great selection. Our kids love it here. Friendly staff, fast service.

Author: AhKwangSingapore, Singapore
Title: Revisiting Penang after 30 years
Review: 2nd night dinner experience. No reservation. Arrive around 7pm to get a queue number and placed our order in queue. We had a good size grouper which was well steamed. Kachang Betul in chilli was good. So was the squid. Prawn paste chicken was just right. Pork in vinegar with ginger slice was excellent. Service was efficient. Overall thought the cooking was on the sweet side.Show less

Author: hungryfizzio
Title: opaque serving size, but wonderful everything else
Review: Overallfor the full unabridged review, please refer to hungryfizzio at blogspotAmbiance – wazzat? Get your ass back in line. X/5 because its not countedService – 4/5Food – 4.5/5, lowered by opacity of food amount that varied far too greatly, with one tofu with only 3 pieces and another of similar price 6-7 pieces.TL:DR – go early, do not anger the line manager, order everything you want beforehand lest they run out because of how hot it was, and better take 2 tofu dishesShow less

Author: gloryd870Hillsboro, Oregon
Title: Worth to wait
Review: We have been there during weekend and long que in front of the restaurant. First we were a bit worry of how to order but when we saw the menu with symbolic of chef recommend. We selected them and every meny were great especially the deep fried squid menu, and pork. Waiter were great service and could speak some Thai which we impressed.Show less

Author: C4622HXjohnkAdelaide, Australia
Title: Best local restaurant in Georgetown
Review: We had dinner here one night and enjoyed the evening. It is a busy place, mainly filled with locals. We made a booking, otherwise you just have to wait in line on the footpath. Some of the best food we had during our five night stay in Penang. Good service, atmosphere and reasonable pricesShow less

Author: Cfarr96Manchester, United Kingdom
Title: Best tofu I’ve ever had
Review: We stumbled upon this place whilst looking for a casual lunch in Chinatown. It was filled with local people. We luckily got the last table for two. Really busy atmosphere with excellent and efficient service. The homemade tofu with fried anchovies was amazing. Wish there was more than 2 of us so we could order more off the menu. Show less

Author: ContentedTraveller51
Title: Great Pork
Review: We ate here while we were in Penang - we shared a roast sweet pork and squid curry and found both to be quite delicious. The only comment is that the squid was a little tough and chewy however the sauce was gorgeous!

Author: Hammie2015
Title: Yummy Chinese food
Review: Second time at Tek Sen . Managed to make reservations for party of 6 easily. Food came fast even though the restaurant was crowded.

Author: graemeyo
Title: Chinese food
Review: Reasonably priced delicious Chinese food. But always busy and there are frequently queues for tables. But the restauarant is so efficient the wait is not long

Author: csurakka
Title: Best Double Roasted Pork Ever!
Review: This restaurant is fantastic! The double roasted pork was the best I have ever had! Everything I tried was delicious. This is a must if you are in Georgetown! It gets SUPER busy so there is a bit of a wait but it is well worth it! The line up is a bit confusing but the locals are helpful and will tell you what to do. Enjoy!!Show less

Author: Cherina L
Title: Reasonably priced  & yummy food
Review:
Food is yummy,moderate prices.
Only downside is long Q most of the time.
Its good that now they have an extension of sitting at the back of the restauant which is air-condioned.

Author: amyj8708
Title: Asian Food!!
Review: We see there is a long queue and we wanted to try, we have ordered few foods and delivered quick than our expectation. The food was delicious, worth a try!

Author: shopagagaHakata, Japan
Title: Good good food
Review: Our first visit and definitely won’t be our last. Since it was our first visit, we decided to order the all-time favourites indicated in the menu and they didn’t disappoint ! Service was good and efficient. Last order for dinner is at 8:30pm as the restaurant closes at 9pm. No reservations. (Best time to get there is around 7:30pmOnwards.) Show less

Author: Florian L
Title: Great local food - worth the wait
Review: Came for lunch in Sept 2019, very authentically run restaurant, so don't expect any frills. Double-fried pork and steamed egg are a must, plus we had some great aubergine and shrimp. Reasonable prices and doesn't feel too touristy.

Author: Ho MSingapore, Singapore
Title: A very nice place for your chinese meal
Review: We had our lunch on Wednesday and was directed to the building behind the shop front. It was a very nice and value for money. there were 11 of us and our total bill was MYR312.The dishes we like were 1. roasted pork; 2. Lady finger 3. soup 4. signature tuo fu.Highly recommended when in PenangShow less

Author: G4932SWkarensKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Tasted Good
Review: Very crowded but we got in really quick. They are very efficient in how they do their wait list. They give you a playing card and when that card it called you get seated. We sat with another asian women who spoke no english but it was fine. Food tasted really good and was reasonably priced and served quickly. However, I did get sick that night. Not sure it was the food though. My husband was fine and he ate the same thing.Show less

Author: PatrickLLLLHong Kong, China
Title: Where locals go
Review: We went there for a late (by Penang standard) lunch on a Sunday and luckily did not have to wait for a long time. There was a wide choice of local (predominantly southern China cuisine) dishes and flavours. Dishes can be ordered in small and large portions and service was quick. Forget beer once in a while and try the local cold herbal drinks which are refreshing and healthy. The prices are affordable too.Show less

Author: jokl78
Title: Nice food
Review: First time here after reading reviews here. Got here at 11.45am. Ppl already started queuing before is opens at 12 noon. Food is nice and very reasonable.

Author: jessicamul
Title: Dissapointed
Review: First time i went here was 10+ years ago.. The taste is different now. Hope they can manage to maintain the standard even when they are fully packed

Author: 381lyndalm
Title: Great selection
Review: Well worth the wait. The food is always tasty. There are a lot of choices on the menu and service is pretty quick. Try the chilli pork if you like it spicy. Some good nyonya  available

Author: louisee501Essendon, Australia
Title: Best meal of our trip!
Review: We were recommended to come here when in Georgetown and we were not let down. You have to queue up out the front but it’s definitely worth the wait, which doesn’t take too long. Legitimately the best sweet pork I’ve ever had! We also had a fish curry and green veggies. Highly recommend for authentic food and a great atomosphere. Show less

Author: BrightonKaren
Title: Great food
Review: Definitely worth a visit. The pork chili padi is a must. Gets very busy - we arrived before opening and there was a queue. Loved the lady working there organising the queue with the playing cards “number 7: move”... very funny!

Author: Mulrobs
Title: Worth the queue!
Review: This may look like chaos at first sight, but don’t be put off by the queue. The lady who greets and seats you has the waiting area organised to a T. Delicious food in a popular restaurant packed with locals - try the five spice marinated pork!Show less

Author: semaj2307Singapore, Singapore
Title: Yumz the word
Review: We arrived just before 12noon(opening time) and it was packed. Thankfully our tour driver had made a reservation early. Food came quickly once we ordered. The fried roast pork was fantastic. As was the belachan kangkong and the fried belachan chicken. Prices were very reasonable. Strongly recommend this restaurant.Show less

Author: yiuyiutHong Kong, China
Title: Delicious local dishes
Review: The pork was highly raved by friends and therefore decided to go early just to get a table. We got there right when it opened and already people were waiting to get in. The dishes were delicious but I had higher expectations due to the many good reviews. Food came really quickly and we were able to finish in about 40 minutes. Worth trying if in Penang!Show less

Author: mtamalate76
Title: Great food
Review: It's an old style Chinese restaurant. The food is delicious. There will be a long queue, so you will have to arrived early. They will give you playing card as the queue number. Quite unique.

Author: Paul NLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent food
Review: During the early evening you will often find a queue to get seated here. Don’t let that put you off as the turnover of tables is quite quick and the staff will take your order as you wait so food get served soon after you are seated. You can choose normal or large portions from a wide range of Chinese dishes. We went for sweet and sour chicken, chicken in oyster sauce, chicken and chilli and some vegetables. It was so delicious we ate every speck of food on the plates. Total cost less than 20GBP / 100 MYR including drinks. We liked it so much we went back the following night even though there is so much great food all across Georgetown.Definitely recommended. Show less

Author: dan2963eveGeorge Town, Malaysia
Title: Go early or be prepared to wait
Review: This place is extremely popular with tourists and locals. They open only for dinner and try to get there by 6pm. One all tables are taken be prepared to wait as they cook each and every dish upon order. They are famous for the stir fried roast pork. This signature dish consists of small chunks of roast pork stir fried in dark soy sauce, sugar and fiery small green chilli known in local terms as cili padi. A must try as it goes well with rice. Show less

Author: kewpierose
Title: Overrated
Review: Ordered chili pork, assam fish, kangkung belachan and mapo tofu. Mapo tofu is too salty can't even finish half of it. The rest is average, nothing special about the taste. Sorry coz my mom can cook better.

Author: maviskl
Title: Mad crowds but food comes out fast once seated
Review: Mad crowds at dinner time but once you are in and have ordered, food comes out fast and is tasty. The signature pork dish is fantastic!

Author: 980magnustWillesden, United Kingdom
Title: Very good food
Review: We were looking for a place with a good atmosphere and good food. Tek Sen delivered both. The restaurant was full, and we waited a couple minutes when we arrived for a late lunch. However, the staff was very polite and in a good mood.Restaurant feels clean. It has a great vibe, but you can still feel relaxed by your table. The food was really great, and service was excellent. A small minus for the toilet facilities. Overall: our best eating experience in George Town. Show less

Author: MikeCarmona
Title: Sooo good! A Penang destination
Review: Best place to taste local Penang food favorites. Don’t miss their Kangkong belachan, home made tofu with crab meat sauce, sweet n sour pork, and fried chicken belachan. Friendly staffs but can be hot inside on a warm day.

Author: tnt43731
Title: Rice needs to be better
Review: Excellent food. Pork, vegetables, tofu all are very tasty and should match very well with steamed rice. However the steamed white rice here is not as good as other dishes and really needs to level up. Otherwise it’s damaging the quality of the meal in general.We came at 2pm Sunday, still crowded but quick service. No A/C.Show less

Author: perseuskualalumpur
Title: Not as good as before
Review: Always busy, generally fast paced service. Some good dishes, gulai tumis  disappointing,  fried roast pork  too sweet.

Author: kcakraJakarta, Indonesia
Title: The food is GREAT, dont get me wrong, but why 1 star?
Review: Went on 5 July 2019, for dinner. Get there by around 5.30pm. queue for 30 mins to be seated. Queue for 25 mins to be served. Food: extraordinary good with acceptable cost vs resto near garney plaza.Service: wonderful, nice queing method - cards.System: cooking, desk preparation: clean & advancedly well ahead.Atmosphere: THE WORST EVER IF u are with kid less than 3 years old. DO NOT REPEAT MY MISTAKE! Evenings are so hot and resto have huge fans gives strong winds. Great for family & friends but NOT toddler(capslock bold). Somebody needs to WARN people away: TODDLERS are NOT welcomed.Show less

Author: Kang C
Title: famous local "zhu char"
Review: you can have a typical local penang lang daily home dinner food in this restaurant. awesome and price is cheap. asam fish and pork fried plus sambal vege, awesome.

Author: hollebollegeeza
Title: Back at Tek sen
Review: Teksen restaurant hasn't changed much over the past five years. And thats good we would say! Service is still speedy (if you manage to get a table ;)). Food is great! Can recommend the sweet and sour chicken. Prices are reasonable.

Author: SawitW
Title: Great food !!
Review: We went here in June. The food is great but you may expect to queue up in front of the restaurant. We ordered almost all of the recommended dishes. All of them are very good.

Author: BushymartinKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good food but great value
Review: A supplier took my boss and I to this Penang institution.Lucky we had a booking as it was full and many people waiting outside to get a table. The question is why ?Well I thought the food was good, not brilliant but good. I guess it’s because the food is very good value.I believe this resturant has a very old heritage and respected by 1000’sShow less

Author: hawktengSingapore, Singapore
Title: Everything was great!
Review: We came back for a second round over three days. The Twice Cooked Pork was to die for. Come early because they run out fast. They very good with sambal vegetables, the best I have had in a while. Tofu with silver fish was excellent. I do not give excellent ratings lightly. Show less

Author: TheKgGuy
Title: Over-rated Food
Review: The young lady who took my order was pleasant enough probably because I could speak her lingo but I made the mistake of calling her "aunty" which I quickly corrected when I saw her face. I did not wait for long after that LOL even though it was a weekday public holiday. A small table quickly became available so it was good that I did not have to share a table with other diners as that could be very uncomfortable. I did not plan to eat here but since I came face-to-face with the restaurant after coming out of a lane right in front of it I decided to ask if they serve one person and they do. I was actually looking for Chulia Street but was glad I got to try it out anyway.I ordered a small plate of stir-fry mustard leaves/choy sum which costs RM12 because of the 6 medium-sized prawns which were fresh. I must say the dish was good as it was not salty in the least. However,the roasted pork belly was too sweet,cloyingly sweet in fact. That spoils the taste. Perhaps if I had ordered the spicy version it would not have tasted so sweet. Whatever,I guess they could reduce the amount of honey to just a drizzle. A small serving costs RM18!If I ever go again I would not order this dish again but I would rather try other restaurants because this one charges 6% for service which I feel is not fair since their food is on the expensive side already.By the way,the next door dessert shop is equally expensive. A half small container of quilinggao/herbal jelly costs RM4.90 and you could finish it in 7 mouthfuls meaning that you pay 70sen for a mouthful. Penang has become truly expensive unless you're spending S$/USD/euro or British pound.Show less

Author: mjlotharGeneva, Switzerland
Title: Pricy but excellent
Review: Saw many people waiting in line up eat there so I went at 2.30 pm midweek and was able to get a table, food was really good but 30-50% more than anywhere else - you can see from the clientele that they cater to wealthier folks. Restaurant is kept extremely clean including bathrooms which I liked. Service was quick and excellent so in the end def worth it ! Show less

Author: DawnKohSingapore, Singapore
Title: Will love to visit again!
Review: Crowded tze char, but they turn around the tables pretty fast. Love the taste of the food which has wok hei for the stir fry. Price is reasonable too! We had big prawns (not seen in the photo attached) and had 4 barley drinks. The meal came up to approximately MYR140. If there was time, I would have love to visit again. Show less

Author: WolfeeSingapore, Singapore
Title: Busy place
Review: This place is really packed during meal times. The wait for us was not too bad as we did I not need a large table. Good was good and it came rather quickly. Would be a nice place to eat if you have the time. Price was acceptable. Show less

Author: RobinLeChaudLapinNoosaville, Australia
Title: Tasty
Review: As others have extensively commented on the food here the restaurant is well worth a visit. We had the usuals (pork, tofu) and were so glad we had come. Service was friendly and helpful and the meal for the two of us at MYR60 was good value.Recommended Show less

Author: byronm786Bangkok, Thailand
Title: Popular venue
Review: Had a quality meal here last month. The food was plentiful and of good value. I would make sure to go during off hours, otherwise you may be stuck in a line. We looked at going during the night and it was jam packed, so we returned the next day around 3pm, a lot less crowded then. In order to maximize space, they will sit you a large table with other guests whom you may not know. While this may not always be ideal for some, it turned out to be nice as the guest we sat with was by themselves. We were able to learn a little about one another over a pleasant meal.Show less

Author: wendys_hy279
Title: Pork belly!!!
Review: Visited on a Saturday for dinner at about 5.50pm. There were already about 8-10 tables (or more) having their dinner. Came in a group of 4 and we still managed to get seats. Ordered 4 dishes and they were all great! Their best seller is definitely the pork belly, worth ordering! Tofu’s great, veggies great, Asam fish’s great too! Worth visiting! Show less

Author: Karsonleo
Title: Good Chinese/Nyonya Food
Review: Dishes are tasty. Depends on timing, may need to queue up for a table. Recommended: signature stir fried pork (招牌小炒)

Author: gentman
Title: Good food
Review: This restaurant serves good food. There was usually a reasonable waiting time but in Chinese restaurants in Asia usually it usually quick. I would like to visit again.

Author: dolphinxy
Title: Worth the wait
Review: Food was great and was worth the wait! We went in the evening and there was already a queue. There were seats and the weather wasn’t too harsh so that helped. Lady took our order and was able to also recommend dishes :) local flavour and suits our taste buds!Show less

Author: Mark672Napa
Title: Nice locals place
Review: We had lunch here, on a day that the Princess cruise ship was in port. We were the only non Asians in the place, so I would disagree with the reviews that called it a tourist restaurant. The place was clean, the service friendly and prompt, and the food good. I had the twice cooked pork with chili and my wife a mixed vegetables with garlic. We liked both. The pork was spicy but not too spicy.I would not call this a vegetarian friendly restaurant. Most of the dishes in the vegetable category also had meat or seafood in them.Show less

Author: leonardil292
Title: Tek Sen Restaurant
Review: Tek Sen Restaurant Penang, location at near jalan Chuliah main road, this restaurants always full of tourist customers, need a reservation if want to enjoy the foods ...

Author: wortonmillerHolmfirth, United Kingdom
Title: Great food fast service.
Review: Having been warned in advance we were braced for a wait as this place is popular and gets very busy. It was only about 10 minutes wait before we sat and were served great food (roast belly pork, stir fry aubergine and fried rice) which was absolutely lovely and washed down with a large beer each. Quite reasonable at 90 MYR. Recommended.Show less

Author: BobLumSingapore, Singapore
Title: Delicious food for dinner!
Review: Our group of 13 had dinner in a big table. It was good that we had a booking because there was a long queue outside the restaurant. We are led to another unit behind the main building. The best dish was the double roasted pork with chilli followed by the assam stingray. We also had the ginger chicken, signature tofu, kangkong, 3 types of steam egg, etc. The bill came up to about RM510 including service charge and tax. If you have a big group, you must book on advance or risk having a long wait. Show less

Author: ko883
Title: Delicious Hainanese Food
Review: I have brought friends and family members to this restaurant many times. The food was also great especially the Black prompet Gulai Tumis which is the best so far in Penang. Others such as sambal prawns, roast pork belly are great too!

Author: Tay08
Title: Good but a bit over-rated by tourists
Review: Some dishes are good but the atmosphere is hot and crowded.  Prices used to be very reasonable but not any more.

Author: lozzersaur
Title: Tasty chinese
Review:
You can book a table but the card queue.
Some of the best Chinese food we have ever eaten and authentic local experience 

Top value and enjoyable night out

Author: chris2pherwongCanton of Zug, Switzerland
Title: Favourite Resto in Penang!
Review: This restaurant was a must-visit on my recent trip to Penang. I tried calling a few times to book as I was aware of the queues but no one picked up the phone. We decided to just rock up shortly after opening at 12pm and the restaurant was already full! Luckily we did not have to wait long for a table and ordered the signature dishes, including the amazing pork, tofu with prawns and scallops, tau miu vegetable, steamed 3 egg, amazing fish maw soup and pork with 5 spice. Usualy from any order there will be some dishes that I do not like but Tek Sen has surpassed all expectations where I loved ALL of the dishes we ordered! We managed to tell the staff to book a table for lunch the next day and happily came back with a friend from Oz who was so enamoured by the place she came back herself for dinner the same day :o) Yes the queues are long but if you know how to work your way around it, you can book beforehand. In any case, the food is totally worth the wait and, having now returned to Switzerland, I can still smell and taste the food there and this is one place where the cravings are all too real!Show less

Author: gohg624
Title: Yummy
Review: Never miss this place if visit penang , luv thier chilly padi roasted pork , fish curry and tofu ... recommended

Author: 1966cbuk44Farnham, United Kingdom
Title: Chaotic Chinese food
Review: We got our concierge to book (fortunately ). 20+ Locals queuing to get in all the time we were there. We got shown almost immediately to a table . Menu u was no sooner given than order expected in a rushed manner - the hole thing moves at 100 miles an hour and you need to k kw what you want ! We were in an out in half an hour - I would go again but would probably opt to stand in line with a playing card and use this time more wisely to study the menu so we could engage with the waiter as soon as we are allocated a table !food we had was good I’m sure we missed some other options though - not expensive Show less

Author: purefinderCleethorpes, United Kingdom
Title: Locals queuing.
Review: The title gives it away,about 16 locals waiting to get there playing card for a table . The card system does work fairly and eventually got a table. Ordered the speciality. double cooked pork and 5 spice pork with special rice, just hit the spot ,it was magic.Show less

Author: 849verenaeBerlin, Germany
Title: Great and inexpensive Chinese food, awesome service
Review: I went to the place on accident as I saw that there were people waiting in front for a table. I waited for about 5 minutes until I was seated. The service was fast and the food was great. It’s a great place to come with a group as you can order many different platters and all share. Show less

Author: Roger H
Title: Wonderful example of local food
Review: Six of us thoroughly enjoyed an authentic local meal (as attested by the three Penang members of the group).

Author: away2explore
Title: Good local food option
Review: Very popular restaurant. A lot of fried foods and curries, fewer healthy options, but the flavor was wonderful. Local "flavor" with old style tables and stools, open to the front, plenty of wait staff and the food came quickly.

Author: CanmoreFunkyDudeCanmore, Canada
Title: Popular and busy, usually lined up.
Review: You’ll find this eatery on Carnarvon, half a block from Chulia. Its very popular with the locals, I arrived 20 minutes after they opened, and it was already full, with a short line up. There is a deck of playing cards stacked next to the menus, take the top one to chope your place in the line up. No cheating, or no food for you! The queue is managed efficiently, your order is taken while you wait, and as soon as the right size table is available, which wont take long, you will be seated. Ask for a table near the front, away from the (constant) traffic to the restroom, and the kitchen door. Its worth waiting a bit longer for that consideration. And, of course, be prepared to share with other diners, its a great way to meet people. I came here twice, and neither occasion was perfect. The first time I was placed at the worst table in the house, which prompted the comment above. I had stir-fried gai lan with salted fish, salt & pepper fried sotong, and a steamed rice. The portions are not large, but that sufficed. The second time, the place wasn’t full, so I was seated immediately. They brought me a drink and the menu, but no-one showed up to take my order. In fact, the folks at the next table (who were seated after me) felt bad for me, and offered to share some of their food, which I had to decline, as I didn’t even have a plate to put it on! Eventually, I was able to place an order: A signature tofu dish, a baked fish, and some rice. The tofu showed up quickly, but it was not what I ordered. It was also a stone cold. (Maybe an orphan, looking for a home?) I ate it anyway, not wanting to delay further. It was actually really good! The fish showed up a bit later, and was not very warm either. The fish itself was great, the sauce it had been cooked in was pretty lame. I have had a lot better elsewhere. And then, halfway through eating, the folks at the next table (not the same ones as before, they were long gone!) managed to spill a sticky drink over my leg. They do not supply napkins here, and none was offered to clean myself up. Luckily I had my own. I found the prices higher than I’ve experienced so far anywhere in Malaysia for similar restaurant fare, but when you are lined up all night, I guess it doesn’t take long to find the best price point. The service was quick, not attention-to-detail oriented, efficient, polite but not chatty. Its obvious table turnover is key here ($$$), tables are cleared and reset almost before the last occupants step out of the premise.......Not for the first time in Malaysia, I found it inauspicious to dine solo. I have had way better luck in hawker centres, for a third the price. Expect to pay about MYR 70 per person, including drink, tax and tip. Show less

Author: nickki401
Title: Worth the wait
Review: Excellent service and assortment from Chinese to Malaysian - staff helps explain the dishes and the Chinese tea

Author: VitieddieSydney, Australia
Title: Not sure if it’s worth the wait
Review: Went for dinner and it was packed. Had to queue up for about 40min and then finally got the table. We had given our order already so was expecting maybe a 10min wait. Nope. Took about 30min for the food to arrive. The food was great but would I wait again to eat here? I think your time would be better spent elsewhere. Note we had to re-schedule our night plan, after dinner took so long.Show less

Author: Mark ABudapest, Hungary
Title: Great place.....always crowded, just have to deal with it
Review: This place does casual meals, mostly Chinese-based dishes but ALL really good and legit. The twice fried pork is excellent - get it spicy. It's always crowded, the only solution is to try and pick a time when it's not as bad (mid/late afternoon for example). Go here, totally worth it.Show less

Author: goodwork123
Title: Overated restaurant
Review: very bad service, noisy, expensive and lastly the taste of the food is very normal like any other restaurant (choo char)

Author: Stef_6478
Title: Worth the wait
Review: It takes a while to get in, and the waiting line feels kinda messy, but the food is worth the waiting. Pick one of the recommended dishes such as the double fried pork or the chicken in prune sauce

Author: Amanda TWoolpit, United Kingdom
Title: What an amazing experience
Review: Sometimes you queue, sometimes not but which ever the basic experience of good local street food served on a plate at a plastic table - often shared with others is just simply fabulous.This is a true gem of a restaurant in a back street of Penang.Cheap as chips but sound, clean, fresh and a true unaldultered meal experience both for lunch and dinner. A must do in Penang I would love to see some English chefs visit for the food quality!Don’t change a thing if works great guys !!Show less

Author: Derrick1230Hong Kong, China
Title: Maybe a little over hyped
Review: So we had lunch here and the food was good, but I think this place could be over hyped. I felt the food was good but our group agreed that the meal the day before was better at foong wei heong restaurant was better.We had the tofu with pork meat, it was ok, but I preferred the same dish at the restaurant the day before. The pork dish here that they are famous for is very good!! Gotta have this dish!The duck soup of the day was ok, but very very salty. The French beans here was also very very good!!The dish that we were not too crazy about was the Thai Chicken. Overall it was ok, but not really outstanding great. You should go to both places and see what one you prefer in my opinion!!Show less

Author: Bliybliy
Title: Be Prepared to Queue for a Table
Review: This restaurant offers some good Penang foods but you have to be prepared to queue and wait for your table. Anytime before 830pm there is a huge crowd in front of the shop taking numbers and waiting for their table.

Author: David SHong Kong, China
Title: Star of Penang
Review: Time and again, this gem offers a unique combination of outstanding food, friendly service, and local atmosphere/flavor. Each dish is prepared fresh and served piping hot in reasonably sized and fairly priced portions. Make sure to take some risks on local ingredients, spices, and preparations! (That’s presumably one of the reasons you are in Penang.). Also pleased to say that all the success and publicity has not detracted from quality, hospitality, or local-atmosphere. Show less

Author: ozcmgKithnos, Greece
Title: Great Food
Review: Everything about this restaurant great. It is a typical chinese restaurant, its busy, its noisy, its no frills and its great in what it does, serve amazing food.The food is just amazing and the place is spotlessly clean, cannot recommend enough.Be prepared to queue up for a while.Show less

Author: brianhQ272YJ
Title: Worth the visit
Review: This place was recommended to us by a friend and we weren't disappointed. Its not surprising there's a queue outside every day. The double cooked pork was amazing and we now come here every time we're in penang 😊😊

Author: Cat A
Title: Worth the queue
Review: We had to queue for about 10 minutes, even though we went at around 8.30pm.  But the fantastic food is well worth the wait.  Some of the best Chinese food we've had.

Author: JohnsnelgroveHong Kong, China
Title: Just outstanding
Review: What can i say. 10/10. Great ambience and fantastic food at a reasonable cost, It is busy we waited but our order was taken when in the queue. We shared a table with other guests and it made for a great evening. Recommended the double cooked pork with chilli. ma po to fu and the squid with chilli. $110 RM for 2 including beerShow less

Author: Chow-Yang L
Title: Awesome food, nice environment
Review: I am a local Penangite.  I love this restaurant.  I always bring my visitors to dine here.  The best foods served here include roasted pork with chili padi, Tek Sen Tofu, Gulai fish, Sambal petai, etc.

Author: ThuTrang92
Title: Aewsome food with reasonable price
Review:
We were walking around to find a good place for lunch, and luckily found Taste of Teksen.
The food r extremely good with reasonable price.
I am writing a review while having lunch.
Highly recommend!

Author: claudesuppiah
Title: Amazing Food
Review:
A bustling restaurant, full of chatty happy people enjoying their food!

Amazing food, served quickly, and extremely affordable.....

Author: marisammutPhuket, Thailand
Title: An experience not to be missed!
Review: Wow what an atmosphere! Packed with people of all nationalities, process of getting a table and placing your order is absolute fun and a totally new experience to us - won’t tell you how it works not to spoil the surprise! The food is amazing and very reasonably priced. Highly recommended for all types of travelers. Definitely an experience not to be missed Show less

Author: Lauramustgetfit
Title: Long lines, yummy food
Review: Loved double something pork and sweet sour pork. Get a number first then look through menu to order food while waiting or a table

Author: crakylWollongong, Australia
Title: Ridiculously good food
Review: Stopped by TekSan restaurant while I was in George Town based on a recommendation. The place is always busy but only waited 5 minutes. They provide you with a menu to look at on the footpath and the variety is amazing...ordered way too much and ensure you get the pork..This is a must do and is conveniently locatedShow less

Author: paulpianezzeMelbourne, Australia
Title: Simply the best in penang
Review: Staying at the oriental and eastern and thought 130myr was a bit steep per person. Found this gem. 90myr for two. Best food and service I've ever had. My only regret is we found it on the last day. A must for dinner in penang, one of the oldest, spotless in comparison to others, be prepared to wait, but it's worth it. Match it up with dessert at "the AIS" around the corner....Show less

Author: angkolaindradewahJakarta, Indonesia
Title: One of Famous Resistant in Penang: It taste very good
Review: This is my third visit to the restaurant, the food wanna make me come back. This visit, I came to the restaurant 15 min before open, and there are some visitors queuing. Please pay attention to their serving time -they have two opening, lunch time and dinner time.I ordered Pork With Chili Padi every time my visit. It taste really nice. And will come back for the forth and counting for the same food. Show less

Author: VegasToEssexEssex, United Kingdom
Title: Tasty luncg
Review: My husband and I visited Tek Sen for lunch around 1:30 pm, and waited around 15 minutes for a table. Not too bad. It’s a busy and loud restaurant - please don’t expect a peaceful lunch.We ordered the pork with chili and the aubergine. They were very slow bringing us our meals. We had the feeling that they forget our meals, but once we caught the eye of a waiter he quickly brought our dishes out. I thought the pork was delicious - slightly sticky and tasty. My husband thought it was too sweet. He loved the aubergine, and I thought it was just ok. We ordered the extra large versions of each dish for the two of us, and that was perfect for lunch. £13 for lunch including two large bottles of water was a bargain.Show less

Author: priorityfoodKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Very crowded average food
Review: This restaurant is a family type restaurant located in central Georgetown. It was recommended to me by some friends. Half an hour after the opening time, the place is raving with diners with long queues. Thankfully I had booked and we were ushered into the back portion of the restaurant. This part has service tax as it is air conditioned but the portion of the restaurant does not impose the tax. Service is very slow due to the sheer volume of diners. Food is at the most average for the price that we have to pay. There was nothing too special in the menu. From the look of surrounding diners, they are all tourists. I wouldn't recommend this restaurant if you want to have local Penang fares or a decently priced dinner or lunch.Show less

Author: maheshc941Bandar Seri Begawan, Brunei Darussalam
Title: What can I say
Review: Looked up this place on fee sites and asked locals were to eat. I must saunter food was deliciousssss. We had the double roasted pork chilly, sweet and sour pork ribs, prawns in tamerine, stir fried chicken in black bean sauce and few week fried quid salt and pepper. All the food was amazing. We ordered extra double roasted pork ad it was soon good. Enjoy ummm. Note get playing card and order food while queuing. Show less

Author: anchtiger06Seattle, Washington
Title: Delicious Chinese Meal!
Review: I came here TWICE for dinner with my partner because was just soooo good. As noted in the other reviews you must get the double roasted pork. I can probably eat that whole plate without rice. But I suggest also choosing their other speciality vegetable dishes like the potatoes leaves or their fried tofu claypot.You can call to reserve but I suggest going there in person. Get there immediately when dinner starts or else you’ll have to wait in line.Will come back if I’m in George Town!Show less

Author: michaelmphotographerKihei, Hawaii
Title: Worth the wait
Review: In Asia, if there is a line of locals waiting for a seat in a restaurant, get in line! This place is loud, crowded and bustling. There will be a line no matter when you visit. You will be given a card that holds your place. While you are waiting grab a menu and pick what you want to eat. You will need to order before you sit down. If you don't know what you want, they will ask the next group in line for their order first, so be ready. Everything on the menu is great, I can say that the fried rice is the best I have ever had in any country. This is a Chinese style restaurant so it is best enjoyed with a group. If you are a single or a couple, find a few people in line and join up so you can enjoy more dishes. Show less

Author: Linbaba1972
Title: Excellent Food and Service
Review: Be ready to wait in a line to get into this popular restaurant. the food is excellent, great pork and tofu, also serve beer, but they close at 9pm and last orders at about 8.45pm but it's worth it.

Author: GlobetrotterTwo
Title: Must eat here
Review: Great restaurant, staff and delicious fried pork. V reasonable prices. This place is humming, rightly so

Author: sarahoward2Rossland, Canada
Title: It’s worth it!!!
Review: The line can look a little daunting (opened at 6pm, we arrived at 6:20pm) but everything goes quickly. We only waited about 15-20mins. The food was just delicious. We had the Brussels sprouts with prawns, deep fried Thai chicken and the roasted pork. SO GOOD. 50RM for all 3 dishes and 2 rices. A cool experience to have in Penang and great selection of Chinese food. Easy to see why it is so popular !Show less

Author: vonnysu
Title: super duper yummy
Review: read so many recommendation so we went there. unfortunately it was Tuesday where the restaurant is closed. managed to come back and finally tried its double roasted pork. two thumbs up! better come on lunch time and reserve beforehand

Author: harnyw
Title: Delicious food
Review:
Delicious food.
Must come at 5 pm. If not, there are so many people and need to quee. All the food is so good

Author: cyp5613
Title: Checking out highly recommended tai chow
