Review: Was a very busy place but the turnover was fast, unique queuing system of playing card. The curry fish head was fresh and the homemade tofu with chye poh was very good.

Author: koksengy
Title: For dinner
Review: Usually crowded with long que waiting. Many tourists want to try out this place cos of publicity on line. Best to make reservation with specific time of arrival. Food reasonably priced but quantity not too big.

Author: CYKLGermany
Title: Tasty food, got the order right
Review: We read earlier reviews that we should book, but when we asked the hotel conceige to call, we were told they do not take reservations.Opens at 6pm for dinner. We arrived at 7pm on a Sunday evening, took a queue number and stood around to wait (did not need to wait in line since there was a queue number). Waited 20 minutes for a table. Ordered, and then waited another 20 minutes for the food to be served.Food was tasty. Ordered the dishes with the “chef recommendations” symbol. Cost almost RM 190 for 7 dishes to share (3 vegetable dishes, 3 meat dishes, 1 fish curry). Considered mid range by Penang standards. Not cheap eats.No ambience to speak of. Good ventilation.Show less

Author: Antontam
Title: Chinese restautant in George Town
Review: One of the well known heritage Chinese restaurants in George Town. Located 18 Lebuh Carnarvon. We try some recomended food, taste was delicious but a bit salty. Our favorite is roasted pork 😋

Author: Andras S
Title: Recommended
Review: Food is marvelous and authentic! Book in advance, otherwise you'll have to wait! Could just recommend it!

Author: MeadowGarden
Title: At the table writing this...
Review: I’m still sat at the table in the restaurant writing this review because it is just SO good! My bf and I live in KL and so are used to eating good Chinese food but this was impressive! Double roast pork and chicken & onion in ginger were delicious. Cannot recommend highly enough.Show less

Author: 729blackm
Title: Amazing food
Review:
Great place,good services but you need to line up
The food are amazing and i hear local say this place already open more than 40 years
Generation by generation of they familys.

Author: Fiona MEdinburgh, United Kingdom
Title: Worth the wait
Review: Having eaten here before we were keen to go back and were gutted to find in closed for renovations when we were staying in Georgetown. However it was open when we passed through Georgetown later in our holiday. The food was every bit as good as we all remembered, and he renovations meant the restaurant had a nice clean, well maintained feel about it. Would always visit when in Georgetown. Closed Tuesday though (we’ve been caught out with that in the past).Show less

Author: SK F
Title: Great chinese food
Review: Super delicious chinese home cook food. We really enjoyed all food range. Especially their clay pot egg plant, pork , curry, kangkung sambal, steam 3 eggs and many many other variety. Never get bored coming back again and again. Strongly recommend but bear in mind needtm wait for table. Show less

Author: 162joelsHobart, Australia
Title: Great food and quick service
Review: Although very assuming (open shop front) don't be fooled. This place is great. We arrived just after opening and were seated immediately. The place filled up quickly and when we left there was a line of people waiting for a table. I had chicken in plum sauce whiich was supurb. Show less

Author: ritchieorlando
Title: Very nice food
Review: Nice food really delicious.  quite cheap.  I had to queue for 15 min because it was crowded. They closed on tuesday. Please be aware about it

Author: DCailinSasta
Title: Temporarily closed
Review:
Unfortunately my friends and I went along here to here yesterday but it's closed at the moment - back in business on the 17th.
Saw a few people turn up here and were disappointed - must be good!

Author: longytravel
Title: Double roast pork!
Review: Excellent. Local, authentic restaurant and nice and cheap. Would recommend the double roast pork, best thing I ate in Georgetown! Be prepared to wait but it's worth it!

Author: 394jesdBristol, United Kingdom
Title: Amazing place
Review: My boyfriend and I ate at Tek Sen two out of three nights that we were in George Town. We loved the pork, the house veggies with prawns, the deep fried chicken with plum sauce and the aubergine. Got a bit pressured into buying the duck with ginger which was nice but expensive (we didn’t choose this again the second time). Amazing lively place that is amazing to experience as it is a little bit bonkers. Best Chinese food we have eaten. Show less

Author: PaimanPai
Title: AVERAGE FOOD AND OVERPRICED
Review: We were attracted to Tek Sen Restaurant by the long line of people waiting to be seated. My usual rule of thumb is: If there is a long line of people waiting to get a seat, the restaurant must be really special. This time, it didn’t work out that way. There are many small Chinese food establishments in Georgetown that specialize in one or two dishes which are prepared to perfection. However, if some members of your party do not like those particular dishes, there are no other options. It appears that the main attraction to this restaurant is that it has an extensive menu, and there is something for everyone. We were seated after a short wait. We placed our order with the waiter, deciding that if we liked what we were served, we would order more. However, the waiter did his best to entice us to order their “special braised duck” which happened to be one of the most expensive items on the menu. That being said, the food arrived rather quickly. At best, the dishes we ordered were average. Something that a very good home cook can prepare for a few people. The roasted pork with chilli padi, was flavorful, but not as good as some stalls that specialize in that one dish. The other dish we ordered, Brussels sprouts with prawns, was savory, flavorful and had a faint taste of wok burn (which is a good thing). The Brussels sprouts turned out to be small cabbage leaves and the prawns were small and few in number. As mentioned above, the dishes were acceptable, but did not warrant what is considered in Penang a steep price. Considering that the restaurant’s décor consists of white walls, your basic plastic stools and tables, and that you are shuttled out as soon as you finish eating, the prices charged are mostly for the ingredients food only.Noticing that there was a long line waiting to be seated as we exited, the owners’ goal of maximum profit, over maximum quality, will continue to be met.Show less

Author: gunaselanv
Title: Great tasting food, some different flavours, things that you dont see in KL
Review: They have got some interesting dishes , we tried 3 of it, 2 of it was good. The third the fried squid just tasted very ordinary. So hence the 4 star and not 5. They seem to have a flair to turn some for the normal Chinese dishes into something different, a little twist to their normal flavour.Show less

Author: Tay08
Title: Good food but getting very expensive
Review: Some of the dishes are still good whilst others are only average.  However, the pricing has gone very high considering the type of food served.

Author: leashyjellyLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Get the chilli roast pork
Review: Best roast pork and salt & pepper squid I’ve ever had. Not spicy if you avoid the chillis. But you can get extra chillis if you like a punch! You will have to wait and probably share a table if you are a couple. But no problem with that! The organisation from the host was excellent and we ordered before we were even seated. From arriving to getting our food was about 15 minutes including waiting for table. Must try. Some of the best food of my life, and best chinese hands down. Show less

Author: pakabayAdelaide, Australia
Title: Fantastic Food & Service
Review: We visited Teksen for dinner last night and yes, there was a queue but, perhaps because it was Sunday night, it wasn’t too bad. We arrived around 7:00 pm and wouldn’t have waited any more than 15 minutes.But even the waiting is entertaining. Yes, you are handed a playing card, in sequence, and a menu and when your number/table comes up, you place your order, then get taken to your table.Because a large table became empty, we were asked to join 3 other couples at the large table, which wasn’t a problem for us.The couple that we were next to were young locals who said that they come to Teksen at least once a month.The food was served quickly, hot and full of flavour. Our 3 courses (plus steamed rice) were just fantastic, some of the best food we have had on this holiday.Watching this well oiled machine work was amazing, the logistics and time management to get so many people through, seated, served was impressive.Well worth a visit.Show less

Author: ilnero2015
Title: Worth the wait!
Review: Great restaurant no frills! We found a very long queue and we decided to wait, and it was the right decision. We had prawns stir-fried and grilled and rice. All very good.

Author: LeeNClarkeSydney, Australia
Title: Tai Chow or Chzi Char that is excellent!!
Review: We are often put off by queues and would not contribute to it. This time, for the insistent of our host, we comply. Queue that is so long that you queue for the Q number too! Those nearer the front can order their dishes and and sit on the few chairs. WOW!! The minute we sat down, the food rolled (since we ordered in the queue). Tek Sen is a Chzi Char that is 1st class! The service is very efficient once you are sitted and the food is second to none. It is not like restaurants where the price is high but TekSen is one where there is a great atmosphere of local crowd and robust tasty dishes!! Even with the wait, this one is THUMBS UP and we would come again, even if the queue is longer!!Show less

Author: momo402
Title: Tasty Malay-Chinese cuisine
Review: We enjoyed a lovely and simple but tasty lunch in semi-authentic surroundings (it felt like the restaurant had undergone renovation/modernisation to cater for foreigners). Great for a quick lunch in the area.

Author: O3312MBalexc
Title: Nice food
Review:
Is good to make one day reservation in advance to avoid waiting. 
We had the Assam black promphet fish, sambal okra/ long beans/ egg plant, fried toufu and Assam grilled prawns. 
All of these taste nice. Staffs were friendly too.

Author: Penangite888New York City, New York
Title: Over rated and over priced
Review: I really am not impressed with the food here as I find it average in term of taste. I would not waste my time waiting in line for the chance to savor it. There are much better and cheaper alternatives in other eateries nearby. Just don't assume when there is a crowd. There is a deal. Definitely not this restaurant. It's not worth the wait.Show less

Author: Epicure134London, United Kingdom
Title: Knockout Chinese Food
Review: This place is hugely popular and quite rightly so. It has been going for over fifty years and is always packed normally with a queue outside. It is worth the wait. The double cooked pork with chilli, the steamed pomfret with ginger and the bak choi were all perfect. The service is friendly but brusque. They serve ice cold beer which goes well with the food. Everything feels fresh with top quality ingredients. You really have to try this place.... and quickly go again!!! Show less

Author: mollythecat2015
Title: Great Restaurant!
Review: We had to cue up 30 minutes before it opened, but well worth the wait!  Incredibly tasteful Chinese food, the best that we had on our travels.  Everything we tried was very, very tasty!

Author: AngelZombieSingapore, Singapore
Title: Average, Super Long Q. Better to order a takeaway.
Review: The fried chicken with plum sauce was normal. Chicken was crispy and good to eat with a without the sauce.The roast meat is bit special. Chef smoked it well with a good tinge of sweetness and smokiness. Another dish was forgettable.Long Q, best to take away like we did if ur hotel is near. If dining in, be prepared to take a Q number and wait. Show less

Author: graeme799
Title: Very good
Review: Food was delicious, but we had to wait a bit first because it was so busy. The fish and pork were very tasty.

Author: SaharaFeliz
Title: One of the oldest Restaurant in Town
Review:
It's become more commercialized compared to the last generation when operated by the owner father.
Now with the younger generation taking over, services have improved to cater more tourists.
The food & flavor still remain the same...simple dishes like the mother home cooked style.

Author: teohk2018
Title: Great restaurant in town
Review:
Great food, great staff!
Located closed heritage area.  Foods which suitable to all lever of people.  You don't be suprise when you see people from different countries visited to this restaurant.  It is b'cos of its famous and delicious food ever in town!!!!

Author: C626ZPvaleriel
Title: Best Home cooked cuisine
Review: We had to book a few days ahead and was given the 2nd seating for 8pm. Even with booking we had to wait a while for them to clear the table from earlier seating. All the dishes are my comfort food. Good and clean restaurant even though they are so busy.Show less

Author: Tia20Winnipeg, Canada
Title: It’s worth the wait!
Review: TekSen is the ultimate in fresh food! Every dish is made with top ingredients and served with a smile! If you have a larger group, they toll in table tops to fit your party size. We ate here 3 times and loved every meal! Fresh rice, garlic bok choy with prawns, sweet and sour pork, fried chicken, mixed vegetables, garlic chicken were all delicious! Great for lunch or dinner! Show less

Author: Gfan1990Copenhagen, Denmark
Title: Simply superb!
Review: Indeed, this place is perhaps more expensive than other spots in town. But the food here really is great!We ordered their famous pork dish, along with vegetables, a stir fried chicken dish, and nutmeg juice! It was incredibly tasty and I wouldn’t hesitate to come back here!Show less

Author: RollingWithTheStones
Title: A Truly Excellent Lunch!
Review: We went here on the recommendation of a friend and were not disappointed. The service, the atmosphere and the food were excellent. We went at just before 2pm and did not have to wait for a table though the restaurant was still busy. We had the deep fried chicken with thai sauce, stir fried aubergine with fermented bean sauce, minced pork and dried shrimp, and home recipe double roasted pork with chilli padi. We would recommend all 3 but the aubergine was the star of the show. The meal was also excellent value. Tak Sen is a definite must when in George Town.Show less

Author: Joe T
Title: worth waiting restaurant
Review: this is the best Penang local hainam and nyonya food i have tried. must try specialty: Fried siu bak and assam prawn, steam egg and curry fish head etc. do not miss it when u visit Penang

Author: kostam2015Brussels, Belgium
Title: Vy Good in a rush
Review: Interesting mixes of sweet/salty ingredients used in most dishes. The concept rests upon sharing. Relatively small portions but perfectly adapted to the concept.The service is very very fast (which can be a - for European customers but ... we have to merge into the culture so why not !)N.B. : Closes early (21h00)Show less

Author: adeline1989
Title: Very nice food #recommend
Review:
Good food and service 
But must go early very long q 
Business 12.00-14.30 ,18.00-21.00 pm 
Totally price no so expensive

Author: ZoeM1896
Title: Good food
Review: Went to Tek Sen for dinner and the food came very fast. The food was very good, loved the fried chicken with plum and the garlic chicken.

Author: JGissing
Title: Fantastic lunch.
Review: Family of 4, all food devoured by both adults and kids! Just awesome. Worth the walk in the midday sun and the wait. Recommend the duck if it's on.

Author: BaliGalSydney
Title: Still the best in Penang!
Review: Over the last 10 years we have visited Penang our first and last stop is Tek Sen. Never disappointed. Always busy but the freshest best Chinese food ever! Cannot recommend enough. Value and quality.

Author: Adeline F
Title: Best chinese food
Review: Came for dinner with family many times and never get bored as Their dishes are all great taste. Only concern is need to wait long time. But will definitely come back again and again.

Author: Jonathan S
Title: Dinner
Review: Starts at 6pm but the queue starts from 5.30pm to enter. Gets very crowded with long waiting line if arriving at 7pm. They take reservations. Great zhe char style food in Georgetown.

Author: 609LeenYi
Title: A place to visit when travel to Penang
Review: Basically our whole family went for a short trip in Penang as we have friends in Penang so we actually didn't have to Q up as they just called to reserve the table. Our friend's told us that Teksen Restaurant is the famous restaurant and one of the best places for dinner in Penang. We were quickly seated, orders taken and the food came in no time.  You are expected to leave once you finish you meal so that table can be vacated for the next batch of customer. Not able to chit chat with friends as many people is in the Q. We have ordered the following dishes and I will said so far food was great. We ordered:Asparagus Bean Sprouts Signature Tofu Oyster Sauce Chicken Lala Tou Cheong Kao York Steamed Fish teochew style SotongSmall Pak Chye R.Pork C/P If we have a chance, we don't mind going back again. Overall Food are great. Show less

Author: benedettaferraccioli
Title: Don’t miss the twice roasted pork!
Review: One of the most famous Chinese restaurant in Georgetown! Don’t miss the twice roasted pork (around 7€).

Author: 236adamsReading, England, United Kingdom
Title: Tasty food!
Review: You have to queue to get in. Be aware you need to pick up a menu and a playing card when you arrive. The queue moves very quickly though and it really isn’t long before you get a table. Food is reasonably priced and great quality. Maybe a little more than some street food stalls but really good so worth doingShow less

Author: 647freyap
Title: One of the best pork in town
Review: The Pork with chili padi is superb!! We ordered it along with steam fish, choy sum, and tofu. Will come again here for that chili padi pork and try other menus...

Author: FlyingCougarShenzhen, China
Title: This place rocks! Don't miss this place!
Review: Was recommended this place by our guide. Was there at 6 pm but there was a queue already. Had to wait about 30 mins or thereabouts. But this place is definitely a great place to have a Chinese authentic dinner.The taste is great and when I saw the bill afterward, I was surprised it was so low. The Michelin guide has definitely missed this place out. Do yourself a favor and don't miss this place while in Georgetown.Show less

Author: Paulus H
Title: Lot of people
Review: Queue up . So longgggg .so crowded. So come fast if you dont want wait for more longer, Tastes great for authentic chinese cuisine . I will revisit here next time .

Author: jpsquareSacramento, California
Title: Only place in Penang with a queue for dinner
Review: And there's a reason for that. Reasonable prices, big menu and great local cuisine. We were impressed both times we went. But the second time we had to wait in a long line barely sheltered by the rain and eat at a small table on the sidewalk with wet hordes passing by. That kind of ruined the good food.... Show less

Author: lynnlyn09Singapore, Singapore
Title: Not to be missed!!
Review: Read up the reviews prior to the trip and decided that we should be there to q up before it opens at 6pm. we past thru the restaurant during the day and it was crowded and with many ppl still queuing up at 1plus. We went there around 5.45p.m, the shop has yet to open but there are people queuing up. the place was full-house when it open at 6pm. Lucky us, we got a table. :) All dishes were nice, thou a bit salty. go with rice and it is perfect. Definitely will come again.Show less

Author: JimmyinChinaHong Kong, China
Title: Indeed Quite Good
Review: This place works like a machine. Our local friend booked a table for 7:30 pm so we did not have to wait. We were quickly seated, orders taken and the food came in no time. Be aware they have a rule whereby you are expected to leave once you finish you meal so that the table can be vacated for the next customer. We had soup, braised pork ribs, some vegetables fish curry, steamed eggs (quite special with 3 different types of eggs), pigs knuckles and all were quite good. Service was friendly and swift. Not a bad place for a “quick” meal with reasonable prices. However, as in many places, you have to bear the heat if it’s a hot day.Show less

Author: bennyvectra
Title: Fabulous Food, but a bit pricey for Malaysian price range
Review:
Fabulous Food, but a bit pricey for Malaysian price range.

Great dishes - Fried roast pork, Nonya turnip, Nonya meat rolls

Go early before meal times to avoid long wait

Author: JonathanY989
Title: The best food in town
Review: Every dish served had an authentic, traditional unique taste which really caught my liking. My favourite dish there was the sambal kang kong, in which there was pork lard and prawns added, making it different from normal kang kongs. The dishes were not too oily too. The double roasted pork with chili padi is one not to be missed as we ordered two large plates of it.Show less

Author: erwinersJakarta, Indonesia
Title: Best Chinese Local Food in Penang
Review: This restaurant have an old style loval chinese selection of food.The food is the best in Penang.For pricing maybe not really cheap compare with other local food but it”s worth to try.This resto also still keep their heritage that we can look from the building. Surely come back again to this place...Show less

Author: 880cindywChichester, United Kingdom
Title: Outstanding experience
Review: We decided to visit Tek Sen after reading the TA rave reviews and trust me they weren't an exaggeration! We were lucky to hit at just the right time as we were seated immediately but a long queue soon formed afterwards. The food is simple but authentic and SO good! We had their speciality roasted pork, duck and choi san with prawns with rice. Service is super quick and its entertainment watching the staff do their thing. Only wish we could return.Show less

Author: Annaliza OSingapore
Title: Delicious Dinner
Review: All the dishes we ordered are really delicious. Prepare to queue if you are there for dinner, we went earlier about 6pm and manage to get a seat fast with sharing table. We ordered their specialty double roast pork, tofu, fried rice, vegetables and salt & pepper sotong (market price). Everything was so good, we finished it all, 2 of us only.Show less

Author: Hendra G
Title: Bad serving servant.
Review:
Servant asking not politely for menu.
I'm not local Penang, i'm seeking best menu at your restaurant.

Local driver grab also said the price is overwhelming righnow.

Author: ehlesAdelaide, Australia
Title: Superb and great value
Review: This is a restaurant where tourists are in the minority and local families come to feast on delicious Chinese food. It is bustling, basic and colourful. The choice of food is extensive and offers interesting options, many of which were new to us. We benefited from being a large group so could try a range of dishes. Everything we ordered was superb. Be prepared to queue to get in. However, we did not have to wait long for a table, and the short waiting time gave us a chance to enjoy the street activity, look at the menu and ask about special dishes.Show less

Author: JerzeeGrlinEurope
Title: Dee Licious!
Review: Yes this place is highly rated on Trip Advisor, so there are many tourists visiting. However it is full of locals as well. And that is a testament to just how delicious the food is. Definitely worth the visit.

Author: Martine SCanberra, Australia
Title: Dining highlight of our trip to Georgetown!
Review: Dining at Tek Sen was the dining highlight of our trip to George Town (apart from ALL the wonderful hawker food, of course!!). We had lunch here and we ordered the French Bean with Minced Pork and Dried Shrimp, the Double Fried Roasted Pork and the Fried Chicken in Shrimp Paste and it was all AMAZING! We all dream about this lunch because we enjoyed it so much.The staff were friendly and efficient and the food backed up their already great reputation they have on the food scene in George Town. We cannot wait to come back and dine here again - highly recommend.Show less

Author: DanieltravelusSingapore, Singapore
Title: Arrive on time!
Review: The restaurant opens at 6 PM, yet you can place first orders around 5.45 PM. I‘d recommend to be there on time or after the crowd left... otherwise you‘ll have to wait for a table.Food is good; service excellent. However this is not the place for fine dining, nor a romantic candle light dinner! We spent 140 bugs for two people, which included 4 dishes and drinks.This restaurant is defnitly worth a visit!Show less

Author: MitchellWinesClare, Australia
Title: Best food in George Town
Review: Sorry we found this on our last night as would of returned If you know your Chinese food makes it easier to orderedWe ordered while standing in line and where pleased with our choice of authentic cultural dishesBucket of Tiger beer seems to be a must!From sticky pork,Tofo, whole fish,greens all so good Friendly and very efficient staffShow less

Author: asilam88Chonburi Province, Thailand
Title: Authentic Local food
Review: We tried this restaurant because it was the most rated one on tripadvisor and it was well worth it. The lady that took our order did not speak any english but we managed to get an order of 4 dishes. The chicken satay with the dip were really delicious.Show less

Author: 624jennywEl Albir, Spain
Title: Best Chinese food in Penang
Review: This is not a place to linger - it is all about the incredible food they serve. We ordered the house specialities, which were heavenly. The staff are fast, efficient and helpful, and the place is packed.They open at 6 in the evening and last orders are at 8.30, so be sure to get there in time. An awesome experience! Show less

Author: tungmayw
Title: Tasty food
Review:
If you don't mind the heat and long queue, then you should definitely go. 

Food was nice. It offered both local dishes and also comfort asian food.

Author: SmurfSingaporeSingapore, Singapore
Title: No wow factor
Review: Waited about 20mins. Ordered the double roasted pork belly with chilli padi, stir fried asparagus with sambal sauce and prawns and a deep fried chicken cubes with oatmeal. The chicken is using breast meat, so it's too tough for my liking. Cost RM57.65 for 2 of for 3 dishes, 1 barley and 2 rice. Won't bother to come back if I'm not in this area. Can go Narrow Marrow, a rustic cafe for coffee after that which is a 5-10mins walk away (head towards Armenian Hotel).Show less

Author: Adventurer0889London, United Kingdom
Title: Best Chinese dishes we’ve ever had!
Review: We ate here twice whilst in George Town because it was so delicious! The first time the bizarre queuing system was very confusing - you have to get a playing card from the lady at the front of the queue (it might seem chaos but she knows what she’s doing!) to signify your place in the queue, then order your food before you are seated. It was quite a wait the first time on a Saturday evening but I’m so glad we persevered! The famous pork dish is sticky and delicious, as is the deep fried sweet and sour chicken and chicken in sour plum. We found one rice wasn’t enough for both of us. Definitely eat here if you can!Show less

Author: victoriabS4647UQ
Title: Best food I've eaten in SE Asia
Review: We were only in George town for 3 days and went to Tek Sen twice but I wish we had gone more! The double roasted pork with chilli was one of the most delicious thing I've ever eaten and I'm not a huge fan of Asian food! I went back again solely to have it one more time. We also had the stir fried chicken with turmeric and chilli which was good but the deep fried chicken with Thai sauce was absolutely delicious. 2 mains, a veg dish, 2 rice and 2 drinks came to less than £11 so really reasonably priced. The tables are turned around quickly and full of locals which is always good sign. The owners also own the Hakuna Matata coffee shop across the road which does great coffee. If you mention you've been to Tek Sen they will give you a 10% discount. I highly recommend both places. Show less

Author: WorldCosmonaut
Title: Excellent food ...
Review: This is good family ran Chinese restaurant in the heart of Georgetown Chinatown. Excellent food and usually very busy during he day and night time. Closes early so get there for a early dinner ... locals and tourists all rub shoulders. Not to be missed.

Author: 572jacquelinet
Title: Good food at affordable price
Review: The restaurant was recommended by our hotel. The restaurant is normally closed on Tuesdays but we were lucky because they swap their rest day to Thursday when we went because of Qing Ming. Sister Sally made good recommendations! We had the pork cooked with chilli, Assam prawns, house special tofu, vegetables and homemade drinks; all were fantastic. We paid about MYR100 for 4 persons, which is reasonable, considering the quality and quantity of food/drinks. I would recommend this eatery for the good food and good mix of locals and tourists!Show less

Author: Hux_JEChester, United Kingdom
Title: Stunning food
Review: First impressions weren't too favourable - it had a canteen vibe to it - but it was heaving to the rafters, mainly of locals which is always a good sign. We queued to be seated and then oddly had to give our order at the front of the queue. I guess due to its popularity it's just a way of turning tables around quicker. As a result our decision felt rushed. The menu was filled with interesting Chinese-inspired dishes, so choose carefully.After a ten minutes wait, we were led to a table. We had ordered four dishes and three of them were really good, especially the pepper squid and a dish the waitress recommended, pork belly and yam (which had a very sweet, almost alcoholic tasting sauce). All of the food we saw - on other people's tables - looked delicious.The restaurant ran like a well-oiled machine. When a table was vacated, two women literally ran to it, cleared and wiped it ready for the next customers. The staff here work very hard and had huge pride in their work. This restaurant is obviously very popular and deservedly so. Highly recommended.Show less

Author: rishabmukherjee
Title: Mapo tofu. Chilli pork. Awesome!
Review: What a great restaurant! Throughly enjoyed the spicy Chinese cousine. We had the mapo tofu, pork with chili padi and a mixed vegetable which all went great with each other. Service was quick and efficient and prices quite reasonable. Highly recommend!

Author: Sebastian F
Title: Good food
Review: All deep fried are fabulous! Also i tested some local juices with excelent taste. Take care at the program!

Author: Clarence YSingapore, Singapore
Title: My favourite place does it again ...
Review: This is my favourite restaurant in Penang. I can't advocate for it enough, and I recommend everyone coming to Penang to surely must eat here. In my head, it has become some mythical place; such that sometimes I wonder if I had build up a legend in my own head. Then, I came back to Penang for a 4th time and visited it again to eat there. Once again, it did not fail me. The taste of the food was as heavenly as I remembered it to be. (And to complete the awesome dining experience, the great service here remains stellar, no matter how busy they got.)Show less

Author: glenn1979Surabaya, Indonesia
Title: Excellent
Review: Our most favorite restaurant in penang, time after time we come here and its getting more and more queue / crowded. Amazing. As always the food here is excellent, the portion is big, quality is excellent. Recommended for tourists, just mind the queue, enjoy the experience.Show less

Author: michael y
Title: Good restaurant, well done Tripadvisor
Review:
Went there 31 March 18, ordered  :
1)1411 TS signature tofu, 
2) 1011 asparagus 
3) 1701 prawns 
4) 1501 fu yoong egg
All delicious

Price moderate

With drinks 4 persons RM 110

Will come back again when we are in Penang

Author: MelissaG94Marbella, Spain
Title: Best Chinese for a reasonable price
Review: We came here by chance and after almost leaving the queue we got called into a table. We are sooo pleased we did!! We only ordered a couple of dishes but we’ve never had such tasty food. The pork ribs were to die for and we are going to have to come back before we leave! If you want Chinese in Georgetown, this is the place to come! Show less

Author: sdc1234Nottinghamshire, United Kingdom
Title: Best chinese in Penang!
Review: On turning up at this restaurant there was a massive queue and the place was packed up with people, mainly local Chinese, both of which was a very good sign that the food must be good! We chose a few things to share off the menu and each was delicious and packed with flavour, plus at a decent price compared to how expensive some of the food in Penang can be. Overall would definitely recommend a visit here!Show less

Author: Stay41796631735Rye, NY
Title: Way Over Rated
Review: If you like to dine in a lighted restaurant that could serve as a surgery suite, don't mind be served within a few minutes of ordering, like poor service, and like to wait 15-20 minutes for a table during prime dinner time, then this is your restaurant. On top of this, our food was just OK, but maybe we didn't order the right things. Compared to food courts, this is upscale, but we like a more comfortable environment.Show less

Author: UKcritic
Title: Still very good
Review: Food, as always, was great. It also seemed to me that they manage the long lines to get in better than in the past but, either way, it is well worth any wait you may.have.

Author: teohk2018
Title: famous Zhu Cha restaurant at Georgetown!
Review: Tek Sen restaurant, located near to the Georgetown heritage area which is a famous Zhu cha (煮炒）restaurant by most of the local and foreigners. it provides Chinese dishes such as signature dish (roasted pork with chilies) ; yam Duck; bitter gourd fried with duck york, sweet and sours prawns are all the famous dishes you should order here! when come to Georgetown, a "MUST visit" restaurant for dining which i never forget. Although you might be shock with crowed, however the food serving are fast, typically less than 20 minute in peak hour upon ordered.Show less

Author: ERBfdUSA
Title: Wonderful. Suggestions on how to stand in line.
Review: The food at Tek Sen is great and very inexpensive. It is always crowded. To make your visit a bit less tedious, here are a few suggestions on how to stand in line.Do not just get on the end of the line. There is a woman in front who handles seating and does a great job. Go to her (leaving other members of your part in line) and tell her how many people. She will give you card from a deck of cards and a menu. The card not only let’s her know you are officially in line, but often the number on it will be called when you table is ready or she may just wave at you if she remembers. The menus are not for quick looks. They are given to you so you can decide what everyone wants before your table is ready. When she call you she will usually (especially for small parties) take your order before you are seated. If you are not ready you slow the whole process down.And very often she will yell “2.“ There are tables for 2 people next to the right wall and when one is ready she was act to fill it ahead of the large parties. If you are the next 2, but busy talking or playing with your phone and do not hear “2,” but someone behind you in line does and say “we’re 2,” they end up with the table.The sign says they are open until 8:30, but they may close earlier depending on food supply or possibly pure exhaustion. The staff is excellent and works very hard.Be sure to go to Tek Sen and enjoy your meal. The food is great.Show less

Author: JHRYU84
Title: 추천 맛집
Review: 많은 후기들처럼 음식 맛있게 먹었어요. 굉장히 메뉴가 많은데 별표시 되어 있는 인기 메뉴 중에 시키시면 무난하실 것 같아요. 약간 짭짤한 편이라서 공기밥도 추가했네요. 손님이 굉장히 많지만 종업원들도 굉장히 서빙 빠르고 친절한 편이예요.It is good place to go with more than 3 people. They have plenty of dishes but there are star marks on the most popular menu. Food is more than average. Service is good either.Show less

Author: GudGollyMsMollySydney, Australia
Title: Brilliant street food
Review: Supposedly a locals only secret but now getting well known by tourists we rocked in just before 12 noon & by 12.15 the place was full. Service was really friendly & prompt & while the atmosphere was fairly basic there was a really gr8 vibe of couples, groups, families just enjoying good food. Like most ‘street food type’ places make sure to bring your own wet wipes as serviettes aren’t provided. We had 2 juices, Mapo tofu, deep fried balacan chicken, double roasted pork & rice for ~MYR60.Show less

Author: tudora380
Title: Try out local food
Review: We've had pork, fish and chicken and they were all very good. For a tourist, the price is not that expensive, and is in line with other restaurants in George Town.

Author: GinieMaryPerth, Australia
Title: Popular with the locals
Review: It is always a good sign when a restaurant is crowded with local people. We were dropped of here by are rickshaw driver, when we asked him to take us to a good place for lunch. It was pretty busy, but they found a spot for us with a small table and two plastic stools. I chose salt and pepper squid. This was excellent. The squid, tender and moist with flavoursome crispy exterior. There was plenty to chose from on the menu. Everyone there was helpful and we were made to feel welcome.when we asked if they would call us a taxi, the proprietor, insisted we should have a free ride back to the hotel, which was a lovely gesture.Show less

Author: LusyKororL
Title: Expensive for local food but good quality
Review:
Really nice food but just a little too expensive and they do try and get you in and and as quick as possible because of the people waiting
Get there at six if you want a seat otherwise you have to queue a long time

Author: Howard BToronto, Canada
Title: My favorite
Review: The reviews for this place are excellent so I was prepared for a letdown. In fact I was blown away. The food is even better than described. The double roasted pork is amazing and enough to bring me back again and again. When a place has line-ups waiting for a table, there is usually a good reason. Show less

Author: jorgebmx69Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Delicious food
Review: Very good service with friendly staff and spacious tables, clean and organize restaurant, that in fact we didn't know that would be that popular as we found it by accident as we were walking around looking for food.The fried rice, simple but delicious, along with the speciality of the house, the roasted pork and the tofu were amazing, even my 3 years old kid enjoy it, and to me is a prof of a good food. It's definetly it's must try in Penang and be patient as you may have to wait for a bit to get a table. Highly recommendShow less

Author: raffydad
Title: Arrive just before 6pm to avoid the queues...
Review: Excellent.  Try to arrive just before 6pm to avoid the playing card themed queuing system.  Pork and Squid dishes particularly good.

Author: galacsea
Title: Fun place with good chinese food
Review: Loved this place and it’s authentic chinese food. It’s also entertaining. Worth the wait if there is a line.

Author: HSeeingtheworldWelwyn, United Kingdom
Title: Superb food
Review: We spent an hour walking up and down the street until we found itWas it worth it? Absolutely yes! The crispy pork is to die for. The duck in plum sauce is nearly as good.Ling, “the lady with 5 eyes” is fantastic at seating everyone in order and our waiter, Binod, was always there, the moment you needed him. His colleagues on the cash desk ( sorry I did not get your names, but you know who you are) were superb at picking up signals for another dish and/or beer. Delighted we came this evening and we hope your well deserved success continuesShow less

Author: Nightdj31Singapore
Title: Best chinese restaurant!
Review: Our last meal in Penang and the best! No regrets for stopping over before we head to the airport. The restaurant is cooling, clean and comfortable. I highly recommend the chilli pork and tumeric prawns. The chilli pork is fragrant and surprisingly not too spicy! The tumeric prawns are fresh and juicy, the tumeric added a nice tangy flavour to the dish. We ordered tofu and veg and fish too, and the whole meal for my family of 7 came to a reasonable price of SGD60. Will definitely recommend and will return again! Show less

Author: Thorbourne62Canberra, Australia
Title: Best fish curry!
Review: Was taken here by friends who know this restaurant well. I was not disappointed. I love a good fish curry and the one served to us at Tek Sen was one of the best I have tasted, and I've tasted a few in Asia and Australia. The rest of the dished picked for us by our host were also excellent. Couldn't fault the food or the service. Will be back!Show less

Author: PutneydrifterLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Lives up to the reviews
Review: Dashed here in the rain, short wait for a shared table. The queueing system seems to work fine! Food is super tasty and arrives quickly. Beer is reasonably priced and cold. Had the bbq pork with chilli, fried rice and cabbage, all highly recommended. Great value too.Show less

Author: GrannyBEngland
Title: Good for gluten & dairy free, huge menu of Chinese style food.
Review: We had excellent lunch here.  Very friendly staff, huge menu, bustling simple restaurant, round tables and metal stools, great fun.  All fresh cooked food and plenty to choose for gluten, dairy or even vegetarian meal.

Author: Chay N
Title: If you are looking for vegetarian food don't eat here
Review: The tofu had no flavour it was disgusting. Everyone else in the restaurant was enjoying their food mainly because they were all eating meat dishes. Honestly so disappointing. The tofu was bland, no spicing or seasoning, no sauce, nothing.

Author: 219vincentlSingapore, Singapore
Title: Highly recommended for chinese cusine in Georgetown
Review: Be there before shop opening hours (6pm on the Sunday that we had our dinner). We reached there at 6pm sharp ... and the tables inside the restaurant was already filled. Choose the house specials (those with hearts) if you are unsure what to get. Waiting queue was organised. Food was great Price was definitely reasonable.Show less

Author: TravellingNewburysNewbury, Berkshire, UK.
Title: Traditional eating at its best!
Review: Open 6-9, get there early, late and food is mostly gone. Any later than 6.20 and you could wait 30-40 mins for a table. Don't be put off the food comes out quick, hot and tasty! Service is good and most of all it's cheap by Western European standards!Show less

Author: kmsWashingtonDcWashington DC, District of Columbia
Title: Fabulous
Review: We got to Tek Sen early to try an avoid the crowd and it worked pretty well. Our wait was short on a Sunday evening, however within minutes a big line had begun forming. This is a good indication on how wonderful the food is. We had many great meals in Penang, but this definitely stood out. It was more expensive than our other meals, but still not very expensive and worth it.Show less

Author: kathryn9003
Title: Great Chinese food
Review: Get here early to avoid the queues. Prices are more than reasonable and food is absolutely delicious. Would return.

Author: 626luker
Title: Amazingly good food and service
Review: Ordered sweet and sour pork, duck with ginger, Chinese sausage and rice. Incredibly good quality, some of the best Chinese food I've ever eaten. Service is also very good and the price is good!

Author: TheJoinersUKSouthampton, United Kingdom
Title: The best Chinese in Penang. Worth the wait
Review: Our last night in Penang and we had heard about this amazing eaterie but be prepared to wait a little. We arrived with about 50 people in a huddle at the front with a young girl trying to sort them into some kind of system. We waited about 40 mins and couldn’t work out what the system was. Eventually seated and watching the staff run around was a show in itself. The same girl took our order, she was a real character. We had stewed duck, sweet and sour chicken. Prawns and pork with rice. It was more than worth the wait, nothing flashy but simply stunning food. We will be back Show less

Author: bobsabran
Title: DELICIOUS
Review: Delicious chinese food, extremely delicious.. their double fried pork is super tasty.. everybody order soup also, and we ate a lot there. Portion is not big, but it worth every penny you spend

Author: RaratravelerSingapore, Singapore
Title: Home cooked style good zi char
Review: You will see the long lines of people waiting for their table outside the restaurantWholesome home cooked style zi char is what I would describe the food.Do order the pork belly fried with dried chili, tofu.Portion are relatively small to medium, so you can order more dishes to share.Show less

Author: Jeffrey TSingapore, Singapore
Title: This Restaurant is a Must Try if you visit Pulau Pinang
Review: Tek Sen Restaurant is a well known heritage Chinese restaurants in George Penang . It is a must try for all tourist . You can ask any Taxi driver they will be able to drive you there . The staff are very proactive and efficient, Manage to clear long queue very swiftly and orderly.The Double roasted pork which is unique to this restaurant , the asam peddas black pomfret , sambal sweet potatoe leaves, claypot tofu , Kway Hua fried egg with sharks fin are some of the must try dishes. Food Serviing was fast too. It is also value for money eating place.Show less

Author: Glen C
Title: Late lunch
Review:
Good food, prompt service, good value.
recommend that go slightly later or face a queue for table. 
Better yet call ahead to book if in a big group.

Author: clarebJ2451LZGeelong, Australia
Title: A very efficient restaurant and great food!!
Review: We very much enjoyed our meal at Tek Sen.We didn’t have to wait more than a few minutes luckily.The female staff member out the front handing out cards and taking orders is amazing!It’s like she has 5 sets of eyes. She sees and hears everything! She was also very helpful in helping us Australians with our order.The food was fast, fresh and delicious!!! We fed 2 adults and 2 children with drinks for 133RM = $44AUD - great value!!! Highly recommended!!! See photos as part of my review :-) Show less

Author: I5768GYjohnmSt. Helier, United Kingdom
Title: An experience with great food but so cheap!
Review: Went here based on reviews and not disappointed. Place was so busy you need to be prepared to wait but you can buy a beer and wait in the queue for a table (or part of one!) to come free. We booked but made little difference!The restaurant was full of locals and Europeans/holidaymakers alike with the latter guessing at what to eat! A bit of pot luck but at around £3 a plate us holiday makers can afford to guess at a few extra plates!Good fun, good food and a good way to meet other travellers. Definitely recommend.Show less

Author: ashesbar
Title: Fab
Review: Absolutely loved this restaurant. We had to queue, and I hate queuing, but it was well worth it. We had twice cooked pork, ribs, wok fried chicken and garlic, and more, and couldn’t fault it. This place is fantastic value, and I’d highly recommend it.

Author: AnaHappyAllTheTimeLos Angeles, California
Title: Pork Heaven
Review: There are many restaurants in Penang you can try and all of them are good. But, Tek Sen is famous for its Crispy Pork and oooohhhh it's so good. At first, my cousin who went there a couple months before we did raved about it but I didn't think it would be THAT good. I was wrong. The price is not as cheap as the Hawker places but man.. try it for yourself.Show less

Author: reviewsfromfinland
Title: Great local food with affordable prices
Review: Very popular but they have a great system for people waiting to get in. Tasty food and fast service. Affordable prices!

Author: taffwillMelbourne, Australia
Title: Lively with locals and tourists
Review: We decided to return despite seeing the queue an hour beforehand. Glad we did. There was still a queue but because there was 2 of us we were immediately given a table to share which was fine. It was prompt service, we had help with the menu, it was great food and was topped off with being very inexpensive. We highly recommend! Show less

Author: imademokatLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Fantastic meal!
Review: Our local cooking instructor and fancy hotel recommended this place. Wow! The food was amazing and staff super friendly. Very busy. There was quite a queue but t moved fast. Lovely pork, tofu (if all tofu was like that I would eat it all the time) and awesome homemade drinks. A++++Show less

Author: NicoleSheHuik
Title: Nice Food , Price reasonable
Review: The food is nice, taste like very local home cook. Price is reasonable and acceptable. Will  one again next trip!

Author: 588phisBangkok, Thailand
Title: Gone in 60 seconds
Review: We came here for dinner and then came back again for lunch the next day. The food was so good that our group chowed down all the dishes in "60 seconds" after they were being served on the table.We ordered the assam curry fish head, famous stir fried chili pork, three cups chicken, signature homemade tofu, stir fried 4 vegetables and belachan fried chicken. The dishes had the aromatic burnt Chinese 'wok hei' taste, which shows how hot the wok was.This is a very simple place serving no frills Chinese 'tze char' dishes at a reasonable price. Show less

Author: LondonBezzaLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Great food in a fun atmosphere
Review: Our hotel recommended Tek Sen and we loved it! We came on a Friday night and although there was a queue we only had a short wait. Even though it was crazy busy the service was really friendly and good and we were given lots of help choosing our food. We also weren’t rushed. Everything we had tasted delicious and it was super cheap which was an added bonus! Great place if you’re looking for a lovely atmosphere and tasty local food. Show less

Author: JennyH4493
Title: poor attitude of girl staff
Review: The food is nice. But the portion for XL is quite small. more like S or medium. The gal staff has v poor attitude. She tends to chase ppl out if the customers have occupied the table for a period of time regardless u have finished up ur food or not. i understand there are quite a long queue but i don't think customers should deserve this kind of treatment. U should at least let us finish up our food first. I hope improvement can be made on this as we are paying to enjoy our meal.Show less

Author: 309jackiepPerth, Australia
Title: Can't understand the hype
Review: I will not queue to eat here again as I don't understand whats so special about it. The food is plain average.The special dish, double cooked pork is small slices of roast pork refried with garlic, black sauce and plenty of sugar making it too sweet. Really didnt like the Assam fish. The gravy tasted like it was prepared from a commercial paste and had no depth in flavor.Only decent dishes for the night were the veggies. Show less

Author: jermpinsKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Very popular, good food, friendly staffs
Review: Tek sen is a very popular restaurant, judging from the long queue. The food was good, and of reasonable price. The tofu is definitely a must try. Staffs were friendly, which is not what you would usually expect from a restaurant of this crowd. However, due to the long queues, you may want to take note of the following to avoid disappointment. 1. We arrived a day before hoping to get a table for dinner. The restaurant supposedly closes at 9pm, we arrived at 8pm. Only to be told (nicely) that they won’t seat us anymore due to the long queue. 2. We came back again the following day, earlier at 6pm. Got a table and ordered 3 dishes. The waiter was very honest by offering us the smallest portion (there was only 2 of us). We wanted to order more after, but was told that they do not allow seconds (again to accommodate the long queue after us). Overall, we had a pleasant dining experience, and will definitely return again, with more orders the first round. Show less

Author: BallardBeaverSeattle
Title: Worthy of Six Stars
Review: When I first reviewed this place back in 2012, it was #1 in Georgetown on Trip Advisor. Now it's merely #3 out of 804 rated restaurants in Georgetown, but it's still easily #1 in my book for food, ambience and authenticity. A genuinely Penang experience. It's clean and tidy, but far from deluxe, with seating on stools at metal tables. The clientele is overwhelmingly local, but the staff are used to dealing with international tourists and the wide-ranging menu is in English. My absolute favorite dish is the clay-pot aubergine with salted fish -- perfectly cooked slices of Japanese aubergine with a smoky, complex flavor. My wife favors the sweet and sour chicken, a truly superior version of this too-often insipid dish. Double-roasted pork is a hit with carnivores and there are a lot of brilliant vegetable dishes, as well. Do NOT leave Georgetown w/o eating here at least once!Show less

Author: 240baBrisbane, Australia
Title: Delicious lunch at Tek Sen
Review: We were told about Tek Sen by the people at the guesthouse we have been staying at. Went there for lunch and we were very impressed. Probably the best “Chinese” food I’ve ever tasted. We tried Roasted pork with chilie, Thai style fried chicken and Chou sum with prawns. Absolutely delicious. Highly recommend all dishes. The place was filled with locals and tourists, with multiple Uber’s showing up with families to have lunch. This place is the real deal. Show less

Author: IsabellangeMoutePignan, France
Title: Great lunch at incredible cheap price
Review: When you walk by the street you know this is a good restaurant as it is always full and had to wait a little to find a table . It was wortwhile though . We had double rasted pork and the calamars . Staff was helpful and efficient ... you should really goShow less

Author: eunice77
Title: Good food,  reasonable prices
Review: Double boiled soup is good,  big trotters vinegar is good,  fried caramelised pork belly too sweet. Service is fast and price is reasonable.

Author: jimmyhendriks
Title: Outstanding traditional lunch in Penang
Review: Used my Trip Advisor app to find a good restaurant a little off the tourist strip and wasn't disappointed. The twice roasted pork in particular was fantastic and really enjoyed the indoor outdoor and somewhat rustic setting. Highly recommended.

Author: renee6764Singapore, Singapore
Title: Great food, service - must try
Review: this place was recommended by the hotel staff. it is within walking distance from the hotel, easy to find. we arrived 45mins before the stated closing time of 830pm on saturday night. there was a short queue but we managed to share a table. the staff are really efficient. the quality of the food is very very good. we had the signature roasted pork-definitely must try. the kang kong with sambal and the bittergourd with egg are really good. the place was filled with lots of locals and some foreigners. it was so easy to order and the place is clean. definitely worth the wait and the price. we paid only RM50 for the meal.Show less

Author: BusymummyJRSingapore
Title: Good Chnese food
Review: Went there for lunch. Tried the signature pork dish, fried promfet, home made bean beard and sweet potato leaves dish. With drinks, cost RM 92. Promfet is crispy. Pork is sweet but oily. Taste and look a bit like chay tau kuay (fried carrot cake common in Singapore). The vege and bean curd dish taste good. Clean and nice environment. Steady stream of customers. May have to wait during peak hours.Show less

Author: evs1305Sheffield, United Kingdom
Title: Fast Service
Review: Amazing service- the waitress took our order whilst we waited for a table (the place is always packed) and it arrived about 5 minutes after we sat down. The food was tasty and when we asked for more drinks we were served promptly- and again with the bill. A really efficient place to eat! Show less

Author: unclelumpyHingham, United Kingdom
Title: Best Chinese food we’ve ever had
Review: Wow! Been here three times so far and all the food we’ve had was excellent. The place is always busy so you may have to queue but the service is superb and they turn around the tables with speed. Try the boneless ribs, deep fried chicken or anything else, it’s all good!Show less

Author: Donny W
Title: The food.....
Review: This place is not as good as the reviews....I once came here and the foods were so so... and the price is not cheap for that kind of restaurant, without AC.

Author: Ian HBirmingham, United Kingdom
Title: Basically good Chinese food
Review: Recommneded by friends who live local we visited on a torrential rain night and were treated to some of the best Chinese food we have ever tasted. As with most of these sort of places the the decor and furniture was very basicbut functional.The food however was quick in arriving considering it was completely full, it was hot and the flavours were amazing.We will definitely return to sample more of the large range of dishes at very reasonable prices.Show less

Author: 713SteveC713Lisburn, United Kingdom
Title: Fast, friendly and fresh,
Review: I do love my Chinese food and this place hit the mark. Double roasted pork with chilli was definitely something you should sample. The fried rice with cutlets was tasty. The staff had great English and were attentive. The place was clean and cokes were cold. Excellent.Show less

Author: cy_sgSingapore, Singapore
Title: "Gem"
Review: My wife and I recently had dinner on a Friday evening at Tek Sen. This was my first visit but my wife had been there on a previous trip and highly recommended it. Tek Sen is located along the busy Carnavon Street and its reputation clearly showed with the mix of locals and tourists.We arrived at about 6.30 and there was a queue for me along the five foot way just outside the restaurant. Fortunately, the turnaround at Tek Sen was very fast and we were seated within 10 minutes of arrival. Menus were presented, orders were taken and food served all in a span of 10 minutes from being seated. Mind you, the restaurant was operating at full capacity. Between the 2 of us, we ordered 4 dishes - their famous BBQ pork, sambal string beans, salt and pepper squid and a steamed tofu, along with white rice and barley drinks. For the price, the quality of food was excellent - very tasty and full of flavour. The meal cost us no more than 70 Malaysian Ringgit, which was a real steal considering the portions and the food quality. My wife is certainly pleased with her recommendation; and we'll certainly pass the word along that Tek Sen is a must-visit when looking for a decent Chinese meal in PenangShow less

Author: cityofbeautySingapore, Singapore
Title: Delicious Penang Chinese Food
Review: We visited this restaurant after reading the good reviews in Trip Advisor. Not to our disappointment, the food were delicious especially their homemade tofu, fried roast pork, Kai Lan with salty fish and dark soya sauce pork. However, make sure you made reservation at least the day before as the restaurant is very busy from 6pm. The price is also reasonable as it costs us RM 90 for 6 dishes with drinks (for 3 pax) Will we visit again? Definitely. ;)Show less

Author: BudakKepongSungai Buluh, Malaysia
Title: Home cook style food
Review: Highly recommended by friends.Came here for dinner (8pm booking) and must be on-time. Make sure you come early so that you have time find parking.Ordered food whilst waiting to be seated and food was out within 15mins.Reasonable price. Good food.Just be prepared to wait if you didn’t make any reservations! Show less

Author: JulioGLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent food
Review: The food here is brilliant, only compared to the best in Hong Kong. Some people may not like it because one has to queue, but not really a problem.It is a pleasure to eat Chinese food where each dish tastes differently, not just the same sauces or flavourings.Although I cannot read the specials on the borad (in Chinese), I ask for them from the menu. If sold out or not available that day, though and ask for another one.Duck and pork dishes very good, but explore the vegetables - a delight.Do not be put off by the bad reviews of people who go to restaurants for other purposes than to eat well. Although it welcomes tourists, plenty of locals eat there.Show less

Author: steventanth
Title: if you love Penang home cooking, there is no better place. Prepare to wait for a table...
Review:
They don't take reservation, so everybody waits for a table. Fortunately, a staff will take your name and seating. Very orderly. Unfortunately it can take some time, and when tou get a table, you wait again for your food.
But...it's worth the wait!

Author: Sun NSingapore, Singapore
Title: Nice lunch in Penang
Review: I know this restaurant from tripadvisor, and saved for my trip when I am in here. I went along there, ordered 3 dishes which I enjoyed very much, very down to earth restaurant, good portion of food, friendly staff, food and drinks are really great. Since I want to try more dishes, I ordered more than I could eat and take away those unfinished, and later regret I should order & pack more. Will definitely eat there when I am back.Show less

Author: Welly9898
Title: The best local chinese food in penang
Review: Simply the best local chinese food in penang. You can choose any dishes and its great. They open 18:00 to 20:30 usually

Author: S9287ITpeters
Title: Authentic Local Chinese
Review: Went here for dinner and had a very nice meal. My wife asked for vegetarian and they err happy to supply this. The tofu was perfect.

Author: HorstvonsandenMelbourne, Australia
Title: Outstanding
Review: After having read all the positive reviews on Tripadvisor we certainly expected great food and good service, and our expectations were fully met. However, what really impressed us on top of this was the extremely professional, efficient and friendly management of the waiting crowd. Everything just happened extremely efficiently and with a smile. So, even waiting was not annoying and the food was fantastic. A stand out of a casual and always packed restaurant. We will be back before leaving George Town.Show less

Author: HendrachtJakarta, Indonesia
Title: Delicious and good value
Review: Non halal restaurant.Serving delicious Chinese style food.Located right in the middle of Lebuh Carnavorn street, just a few step away from City Heritage.Price is more reasonable and cheaper comparing to KL Alor street.Preparing for the queue, usually will take about 5-30 minutes to wait to be seated.Show less

Author: GeraldineH
Title: Great Casual Local Dining Experience
Review: It is was recommended we try Teksen, really enjoyed this bustling restaurant, quick service, recommend crispy pork and delicious tofu. Very well priced

Author: bonzalifeManagua, Nicaragua
Title: Good food but no ambiance.
Review: The place is super busy and unless you get there early, prepare to wait.Everything is a mad rush which does not make a great dining experience. It would be preferable to get takeaway and enjoy in peace at home. The food is good and obviously their system works for them as is obvious by their popularity.Show less

Author: catupoverMelbourne, Australia
Title: Full tables say it all.
Review: Uber driver recommended this place so we went without expectations. Were impressed with the range of vegetable options given we've been eating a fair few curries. Packed with locals and some tourists it was doing a roaring trade. Had stir fried asparagus with prawns.. great fresh and crunchy. Had double cooked pork with chilli like pork toffee so good. Only checked trip advisor later and so can say good rating well deserved.Show less

Author: S_England19Manningtree, United Kingdom
Title: Incredible Chinese food in a cool setting in George Town - must visit if you are around!
Review: My partner and I ended up eating at Tek Sen after seeing a line outside earlier in the day and deciding to give it a try. When we returned for dinner we totally understood why. It's a big call, but this is one of the best meals I've ever eaten.We had the double roasted pork with chilli padi, garlic stir fried chicken, roasted aubergine with pork and steamed rice. It all fitted together perfectly. Everything tasted incredibly fresh. We rarely visit new places twice, but would have definitely come back for dinner the second day if it was open!Packed with locals, it's clearly a winner for everyone. It also has a cool, warehouse type feel to it. Service is fast and efficient, despite the restaurant being packed. If you go eat anywhere in George Town, make sure it's here and don't miss the pork if you eat it!Show less

Author: argotrix
Title: Amazing
Review: Title says it all. Amazing dishes with fresh veggies and perfect seasonings. Just go. You won't be disappointed!

Author: LeeAnn58Queensland, Australia
Title: Bustling Chinese Restaurant with a nostalgic feel
Review: This restaurant was recommended by staff at our hotel. It was indeed an experience. You queue with dozens of people after taking a "playing card" as your position in the queue. The matre'd is efficient and ensures no one skips the queue. Ordering happens whilst waiting in the queue and you tell her your order as she marches you through to your table. The place is packed with tables increasing and decreasing in capacity by the exchange of table tops. A must see experience. Like an episode out of Seinfeld. BUT the food was sensational. We ordered Pork five spice, chicken in clay pot, fried rice, and two drinks and the cost was about RM50. Tasty. Authentic. Smaller servings but delicious. Show less

Author: Foodie480BSingapore River, Singapore
Title: Great food, Great Service
Review: If you are in the heritage area of Georgetown and are looking for a locally renown place for lunch or dinner, Tek Sen in Carnarvon Street is the place. You have to get there early as the place opens up for lunch at 12 noon or dinner at 6 pm if you don't want to wait a long time to get a table. The place fills up quickly as the food is really good and not too expensive. We had their famous chilli fried roast pork(that has a little sweetness to it, and crispy), asparagus stirfried with sambal (local chilli paste) and nice fresh plump prawn (or shrimp as known by some ), and soup with salted vegetables and tofu (plus some meat). The dishes were served up very quickly and by pleasant staff too.Show less

Author: emsijayne87Sheffield, United Kingdom
Title: Must visit!
Review: This is an absolute must visit in my opinion, it was unreal. I loved the atmosphere and how busy it was without feeling like you weren't looked after. The food is incredible, and definitely the best Chinese food I've ever tasted. Tried a variety of dishes and all are great, but the stand out dish was definitely the double fried pork chili padi, I will dream about this dish until I return to Georgetown again. Absolutely amazing! Show less

Author: Doreen L
Title: simply delicious
Review: The place to go to for authentic Penang food.  Old world coffee shop that was clean and offered good service.

Author: lelmaz
Title: Amazing food!!!
Review: Try the fried squid and fried chicken. Service is very fast and efficient. Will definitely come again on my next visit!

Author: Quân T
Title: Delicious Chinese food in town
Review: Have dinner at our first night in Penang. The food is wonderful. Luckily we do not have to wait. Nice service.

Author: KatrinaC18Bangkok, Thailand
Title: Ok food
Review: We've been recommended to visit this place for a great food. We've lived in Thailand for over 3 years now and were looking forward to Penang street food experiences but this place didn't live up to our expectations. Food was ok. Nothing to rave about to be honest. And the fact that most dishes containing sea food didn't have prices listed always is suspicious for me since it can vary for locals and tourists and cane be made up based on who you is a diner. They do offer a very dirty and unstable baby chair as well, so be vary of that.Show less

Author: pooisze93
Title: Dinner
Review: First try ! Awesome taste of FOOD! BEST LOCAL FOOD I TASTED! Location beside heritage sixteen guest house. Open at 12pm and 6pm on the dot. Will be back to try again ! Service is good and fast 💨

Author: souldoc7
Title: Great food
Review: The food is delicious and not very expensive. There's a queue but I would say waiting time not too long as service is pretty fast. Try their signature dishes. This place is s little hard to find by car as it's at the busy Lebuh CarnavonShow less

Author: Annie0608
Title: Great zi char
Review: You must pre book before you go, else there is a high chance you need to queue. The 梅菜扣肉 is Super yummy.

Author: zeeyeng
Title: Delicious
Review: Loved their roast pork with chilli. Reasonable priced. Need to queue during peak hours. But food serving is quite fast.

Author: SArrows
Title: Kung Pao Chinese
Review: Really great Chinese food.  Kung Pao chicken was spicy and delicious.  little pricey for some maybe, but well worth it for me.  Get there early, by 7:30pm the place was full with a line outside waiting for tables

Author: elainedawson678
Title: Absolutely delicious!
Review: Really excellent Nyonya (Chinese Malay) food! Was recommended the pork and sour plum chicken .. did not disappoint. A little more expensive than other restaurants but worth it.  10/10

Author: Rizki I
Title: It has character...
Review: My friends and I just left this place and we enjoyed it very much. I can't really remember the names of our dishes, but we ordered the dishes that has the heart on the menu - and it was worth it (and I suggest you do the same). For the five of us we had two vegetables, a pork dish, a duck dish, one of the clam dish, one of the shrimp dish and one of the fish soup to top it off with rice all around....all for under 200 MYR including drinks too! Yes the waiting line is long, but we booked a table and they showed us our seat just as we arrived - so I also suggest you do the same. To be fair however, the flavor this restaurant provides is typical, so don't expect an explosion of new flavors of chinese food - sorry to say but I have had better...but for the price they offer you can't go wrong. I personally liked the nuance of the place which was breezy with all the fans on in the ceilings and it takes me back to a restaurant I have once been to in Shanghai. Its not a michelin star restaurant and it doesn't give you a fancy plate. But its good food at an affordable price and its worth the visit while you are in Penang.Show less

Author: KawiwaSingapore, Singapore
Title: Was disappointed with the fish, otherwise good
Review: After reading all the raving reviews, my husband and I lined up for dinner. The experience was overall enjoyable, except we made one mistake of ordering fish. It was 2x the price of the rest of the meal added together (we ordered 5 dishes total), and was not fresh. We explained to the hostess and manager, but nothing was done about it. A pity, as otherwise a pleasant meal. Show less

Author: matthewbA2512QCMelbourne, Australia
Title: Don't believe the negative reviews
Review: Reading some of the negative reviews it makes feel like never go near that restaurant. Well, in this case, I went there and loved it, compared to approximately 20 other restaurants of all types and categories, this is the best in Georgetown. Is pretty casual and full of locals (which is a good sign), food quality is consistent, service as good if not better that any competitive restaurant in town, price is excellent, the only annoying thing about it is the queuing up to get a table, (which is a sign of being good).Show less

Author: HayleyR256Sydney, Australia
Title: Delicious food!!!
Review: Yum yum yum - our first meal in Penang & we loved it. We turned up at 11:45am on a weekday. Got a table straight away. Food was amazing. Staff were very friendly. We walked past later that night & the queue was huge. Suggest turning up early.Show less

Author: mrsmalkey
Title: Divine dinner
Review: Tek Sen lived up to its reputation & delivered a scrumptious dinner with every dish we ordered worthy of 5 stars. Highly recommend the BBQ pork ribs. Sensational

Author: Manuger123Berlin, Germany
Title: Ridiculously expensive fish
Review: Food is not bad but nothing special. Most street kitchens offer the same. We ordered a small deep-fried fish that was delicious but they charged 30 USD for it. This is what you pay for a 4 course meal in one of the best restaurants in Georgetown. Come on.Show less

Author: Chia1234Singapore, Singapore
Title: Great zhi char
Review: An established restaurant with crowds descending at peak hours, book to avoid disappointment. The double fried char Siew made from Pork belly is an interesting take on this popular dish. Stir fried clams were sweet albeit difficult too eat as they were tiny. The home made tofu is deep fried to pillowly softness with a satisfying crunch. The stir fried kang kong aka morning glory is the winner. More dishes, too little time and have to keep space to try other delicious local offerings and did I forget?? the durians in Penang are a must. Remember make reservations Show less

Author: Malkey_AUSMelbourne, Australia
Title: Great meal
Review: Arrived just before 6pm and the place was already packed, we were lucky enough to get a table. Very basic set up but ideal for the location & type of restaurant. Service was incredibly friendly, all 4x meals were delicious. Would recommend this restaurant to friends and family; look forward to returning for another scrumptious meal on our next trip to Penang. Show less

Author: fennychow
Title: Good Homecook Food
Review: Always a long-q. Delicious local chinese homecook food, curry asam fish and roated pork..yum yum, but oily a bit.  Penang style, small portion.

Author: 149yannickmNeuchatel, Switzerland
Title: Perfect - Best - <3
Review: I'm crazy about Asian food really... and I'm quite complicated as well... but that one is really all you can expect : efficiency, that is also part of the experience (it's a bit the rush for the waiters but they handle it perfectly), the food is crazy good and fresh, I still can't get how they can serve as many people as that with fresh meals, the prices are really correct (2 people, we ate for 4 people, 4 drinks, 20€.... what can do ?).Finally, maybe my favorite Chinese restaurant of all time, and I know what I talk about.Show less

Author: qwertyuLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Best sweet and sour chicken ever
Review: My husband and I went here with my parents who live in Penang and know this place very well. It is very popular so there is a big queue, but we got there at 5:45 (it opens at 6pm) and we were the 3rd group of people in the queue and were seated as soon as they opened. We had the best sweet & sour chicken we've ever had plus some yummy BBQ pork and Kailan with salted fish. All very delicious. If you go here you have to get the sweet and sour chicken. Show less

Author: Rikanova
Title: A really busy peranakan food
Review: Their food is kind of chinese-malaysian food. Good price, good food, but the wait can be quite long. We came around 6.30 (restaurant open at 6) and had to wait for 10-20 minutes. It was so busy that it makes me feel like I have to eat quickly.We had crispy chicken, sting ray, kangkung, and the braised pork. They came in a good portion and very tasty. The nutmeg drink was really nice as well. Staff are very efficient, they work hard and do things fast, also really friendly. It also in located in the heart of the downtown. So easy to find.All in all, this is a really good place to eat, and nice experience of the local food if you are not from this part of the world. For me personally, I'd say this is the best food experiences I had in Penang so far, in term of price, taste, staff, and location.Show less

Author: SuziiwSydney, Australia
Title: We loved it and so glad we booked first
Review: I found Tek Sen on Trip Advisor and we loved it. Great atmosphere and delicious food. We certainly felt like we were in the real Penang and Georgetown. The line up to get in was huge. So glad I read the review that recommended you book! The food was deliciousShow less

Author: GilB916Jersey, United Kingdom
Title: Worth the wait
Review: After reading the reviews of this place we decided to risk the wait outside which didn't take long and was time well spent checking the menu.The food was very good and the atmosphere busy but polite.We Thought to go back on our last night which was a Tuesday little realizing that was there night off Show less

Author: BornVivantSingapore
Title: Get there early - pork sells out
Review: Got there at 7:30 and had to join a long queue of other tourists (everyone in front of me seemed to be carrying a map or guidebook). Waited 45 minutes and by then the signature pork belly with chili padi dish had sold out! 5 of us ordered 4 (small) dishes: kachang botol vegetable with prawn sambal, fried tofu with egg and prawns, Szechuan ribs and fried pomfret in sweet and sour sauce. All were ok, nothing to shout home about and not worth the wait.Show less

Author: JeanneC1175
Title: Excellent taste!
Review: very authentic penangite food with strong flavours. booking is essential to avoid long queue. definitely a must try chinese restaurant in georgetown!

Author: MrandMrsNomadUnited Kingdom
Title: Nicest meal in Georgetown
Review: We got there 30mins before opening and joined the queue! It opens at 6pm in the evening. We order those dishes that the place says are its signature dishes. Particularly enjoyed the deep fried chicken in belacan (shrimp paste), it came in pieces and was succulent. The nicest chicken we had in Penang. The house roasted pork was just OK, and other food good. Most locals seemed to be ordering the chicken. We were one of only two tables of "foreigners", but the menu had English descriptions and the staff were impeccably professional and helpful, if a little abrupt due to being so very busy. By the the time we left there was a queue of about 30 people waiting outside and when we passed by again at 7.30pm, the queue had at least 50 people waiting. They say they don't take reservations over the phone, but if you drop by, who knows.......a couple of tables were reserved. We did not feel rushed while seated, no pressure to get our order in fast etc. They did forget to deliver one dish, but promptly rectified this once we hilighted the problem. I wish we had told them earlier though. I could see the kitchen and it was much cleaner than others I have seen in town. Show less

Author: JoostG3Amsterdam, The Netherlands
Title: Come early - excellent food
Review: Getting in - Restaurant opens at 18h, and we got there around 17:40, with already c. 10 people queuing. They opened up early around 17:45, and all tables were packed at 18h sharp. As we left at 18:45, 25+ people were waiting already (refer to pic).
