Take-away: get in early!The food - We had the twice cooked pork, stingray curry plus stir fried eggplant, all of which were of great flavour and served within c. 15 minutes of ordering. Meals come in different sizes (S to XL). Three meals plus rice was enough for 2 personsService - Obviously used to busy nights, as the seating and ordering process was very smooth with lots if personnel on tbe floor. Personnel speaks decent English and is very quick in helping. Price - Ended up paying c. 90 MYR for the three dishes (twice in medium and once in small) plus a large beer and a coke. Bit more expensive than the regular restaurants in town, but with great value-for-money.Recommended.Show less

Author: Audee C
Title: Restaurant to go to
Review: The best restaurant to go to in penang. Good food as usual. Long Q to wait. Please book in advance...

Author: 88eunjinkSeoul, South Korea
Title: Just Fantastic lunch
Review: Best meal in the entire Georgetown. period. Stayed in Penang for four nights and tried many authentic Penang restaurants but Tek Sen was absolutely the best of all restaurants I visited. Highly recommend a visit and you'll probably visit here again.We had their signature port, kankung, and the fish soup with rice and every dish was delicious.Show less

Author: markrein2Bangkok, Thailand
Title: Another great meal - worth the wait
Review: You can't make a phone booking anymore - their phone just rings and rings - they say it is because they are inundated with booking requests. No matter, just turn up early, as the queues get long by 7pm - an hour long at least. I noted a lot of foreigners eating this time, it must be because their Tripadvisor score is so high.This is our second time this year, and food is unfailingly fantastic. Their claypot eggplant is fantastic, the sambal kangkong pretty good, and their pomfret curry outstanding. My humble advice is to come early - they are really busy by 7pm. They turn the tables 3-4 times a night, especially Fri, Sat, and Sun. Come between 6 and 6.30pm, before the crowds.Show less

Author: 198jasontGeorge Town, Malaysia
Title: Good local food !
Review: When you are here, please do order their MALAK CHICKEN (sweet and sour) and get their Michael Jackson drink ! I promise that they will not disappoint you! Although, this place may be quite busy and you might have to wait awhile before getting a seat.Show less

Author: MelbourneStickMelbourne
Title: Be prepared and you'll have an excellent meal.
Review: The first time we went it was about 12:30 and there was a significant queue forming. We were told there would be a 20 minute wait. My partner couldn't face standing around so we left and went somewhere else.Later that evening we got a good tip that the thing to do is to grab the menu and order while standing in the queue. The next day we went back determined to do exactly that. To our surprise we got seated immediately. The lunch rush slows significantly around 2pm.Amongst the dishes we ordered the House Made Tofu was a real standout, Everything else looked really good too. Sadly there were only two of us eating so I didn't get to try more dishes.Show less

Author: SeacroftKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Tempting Tek
Review: Reviews on TA were so tempting we thought we had to visit this establishment before we left Penang to return home to KL. Heading all the warning we went at 6PM and the place was already open and two thirds full. This was on a Wednesday evening in a quiet Penang. We chose a variety of dishes but had to keep the spice level down because of our guests. So the food was OK but probably could have been better if we had chosen some spicier offerings. Having said that the double cooked pork or char Siu was very hot and so so good. Great place to visit for Nonya Chinese food.Show less

Author: westozPerth, Australia
Title: Tradiitonal oPenang style cooking
Review: It is easy to see why a booking is recommended as queues stretch out onto the road.Original and traditional Penang style food cooked beautifully. The place is very popular with locals and is a bit of a madhouse with waiters rushing everywhere, Low metal seats are barely comfortable but no-one cares, the quality of the food prevails. Well worth a visit.Show less

Author: ar_sgpWoodlands
Title: It pays to go early!
Review: This is one of the restaurants you must try if you are ever in Penang. When I first learned of this place some years ago, it was a very popular haunt to patronise for locals only. Word has spread, they have grown and today, if you don't go early when they open for dinner at 6 pm, expect that you will be in a queue of some 30-40 people on the street by the time you show up at the usual dinner time of 7 pm. They have a variety of dishes and if you are not sure of what to order, just ask the young crew for recommendations and they are only too happy to assist. Check them out soon!Show less

Author: duncanc697Oxford, United Kingdom
Title: Best meal in Georgetown
Review: We knew we had to get there early but even 7pm was only just good enough to get a table for 4 after queuing but it was well worth it. The restaurant is the 'no frills' type but delivers where it matters - the food. We had a variety of tofu, pork, squid, prawn and veg dishes and all were excellent - fresh and tasty. Best meal we had in Georgetown, and excellent value for money too. Go.Show less

Author: shufangina
Title: Awesome tze char
Review:
One of the best tze char we have tried in  Penang!

Do take note that you'll have to go @ around 5.30pm-6pm for dinner as there will be a super long queue after that.

Author: markhZ1351MS
Title: Great food
Review: Very busy , just like everyone else has said, the double roasted pork I had was excellent. We really enjoyed our lunch .

Author: kenngsgsingLos Angeles, California
Title: Busy but great
Review: This restaurant was so busy at nighttime and it was located only 10 mins from our hotel and we got here by hotel staff's advice, food was fantastic and it was not expensive and great for group of friends. It was busy and you might also find your seats.Show less

Author: Elton_77
Title: Super local and delicious food!
Review: Super local place that is always fully packed. The setting is nothing special and you just go to this place, if you want eat delicious food! :) I went 4 days in a row (lunch and dinner!), superbbbbb!

Author: LaniSingaporeSingapore
Title: Excellent coffee shop food
Review: When in Panang one is normally overwhelmed by the food choices available. This local coffee shop is a stand out for the quality and variety of dishes it serves. It's zhe char at it's best. Go early for dinner as there are snaking Qs daily, even if you make a reservation. Have the assam fish, bean dish, steamed eggs - so smooth it slides down your throat, pork, everything is good!We went back twice for dinner. Show less

Author: arthwelz87Kota Kinabalu, Malaysia
Title: Amazing Chinese Food in Town
Review: We have ordered 5 dishes, assam curry stingray, pig trotter in black vinegar, double roast pork in chilli padi, mapo tofu with mince pork and sweet potato leaves with garlic and its so amazingly delicious! Thumbs Up! Personal Fave is the Double Roast Pork & Assam Curry Show less

Author: Jo LSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good food at reasonable prices
Review: Nice place for a good tze char meal! Restaurant was pretty full when we were there for lunch around 12plus, and also lots of locals. Had a soup, tofu and chicken for 2 pax and was more than satisfied! Would be great with a big group so you get to try different dishes :) Show less

Author: LHBL13
Title: Great!
Review: Food is delicious! Went for dinner with some friends. The twice cooked pork was delicious and the plum sauce chicken was also a huge hit!

Author: Kristen DMelbourne, Australia
Title: Recommended for a reason
Review: I received many recommendations for this restaurant both before, and during, my travels in George Town and I'm so glad I went. The double roasted pork with chili padi is definitely the pick of the menu (in my opinion - in fact I went back a second time just to savour more of this dish), though everything I tried was incredibly tasty and well cooked. The decor and ambiance are nothing flash, but the quality of the food more than makes up for that. Super popular, be sure to get there early or make a booking lest you spend a fair bit of time waiting in line. More expensive than anywhere else we ate in George Town but worth it!Show less

Author: nickpags_47Ossining, New York
Title: Yes, yes, and yes.
Review: First night in George Town and holy moly did we luck out. IT WAS SOOOO GOOOD. Thw food was just outrageous. We got one thing from every section for the two of us. It was ALOT of food but we finished it all bc it was that good. A must go if you're into Chinese food. The REAL DEAL Show less

Author: Christian M
Title: A must visit restaurant in George Town
Review: Went there with my family one night and we enjoyed the experience very much. We ordered the double roasted pork with chili padi, sweet and sour chicken and mixed vegetables alongside steamed rice. Great food. Defenitely a must visit restaurant in George Town. Make sure you be there early or have a booking. The place is full every night. Opening hours from 6pm to 9pm.Show less

Author: Mpua66Singapore, Singapore
Title: Come for the food, and not much else
Review: Coming from Singapore where the food is always expensive but the quality is hit-and-miss, this restaurant is expensive by Penang standards but the taste is far and above any similar open-air resto in Singapore. Simple, tasty and uncomplicated food and menu, very fast (but perfunctory) service. Don't expect aircon or other niceties, and on holidays / weekends there will be a queue. Still a must-go if in Penang.Show less

Author: AIK71Singapore, Singapore
Title: Good seafood and the famous char Siew bau
Review: Came here with a local friend and he was saying it's been his family's fav place and taste still ok even after upgrading or modernizing the facilities. I love the Assam pan fried prawns which came as 4 big pieces for 2 of us and it was so good that I ordered another plate. The Assam fish is fresh too and the the total bill is RM$120 with drinks. Love it. Show less

Author: JDI-SGPSingapore, Singapore
Title: Tourist Only Eatery
Review: Tourists who like to be charmed by old authentic restaurant will have enough reason to be delighted here. Specially contrived for such purpose, the restaurant must have seen a regular throng of adventure seekers who arrived in tour buses. Food is fair but the price is rather steep. We like the fried chicken which is a house's specialty and the assam prawn has a rich flavor. The steamed fish we ordered was good but at RM118 I rather give it a miss! I won't return again as this looks like authentic no more!Show less

Author: mousevandemole
Title: Absolutely Yummy!
Review: Tek Sen is definitely a must visit during your stay in Penang. We came for lunch here almost every day of our visit (apart from the day that it was closed) and absolutely loved the food and the people.

Author: Westiekhoo
Title: Great food!
Review: Been around for a long time. This restaurant presents a surprisingly varied menu each time you go. The roast pork is a must! Do book before you go if you want to miss the long lines of waiting.

Author: GrasipBangkokBangkok
Title: A must!
Review: Every dish was perfect. They had long lines but it moves very quickly. The staff were friendly and efficient. The restaurant is clean and well maintained. Despite being so busy, they could accommodate a request for non- MSG. It was impressive.Must order dishes are: famous double roast pork, morning glory and steam fish. Show less

Author: Michael_Teoh
Title: Delicious Chinese food
Review: Local famous Chinese seafood restaurant and the food are tasty. Have to long waiting during Dinner timing.

Author: Jet705700
Title: Sweet, sour & spicy
Review: It was my second place to eat in George Town and i walked in because it was super busy. Sometimes you just follow the crowds and it was not a place i could give 5 stars. The food is mostly sweet and it does satisfy the taste buds but it's a use of simple counter sauces, nothing fancy. Hopefully the next crowd restaurant will be better. Show less

Author: popcin22London, United Kingdom
Title: Delicious
Review: This was our favourite meal in Penang! There was a short queue however no more than 10 minutes and we were hoping the high expectations wouldn't't leave us disappointed. This place certainly didn't! We had the twice cooked pork in chilli (so good). We also had some fried chicken and vegetables and all of it was fresh and delicious. It's a busy place but we didn't feel rushed. Definitely eat here! Show less

Author: jschwa1United Kingdom
Title: Well worth the wait
Review: This is such a popular place that you are likely to have to queue, however, the food makes it well worth any wait. The waitress who takes your order is very efficient and does a good job in speeding up the process, getting people seated etc.A large range of Chinese dishes to choose from.We found the 'medium' sized dishes were adequate for one, so not sure how big an appetite you would need for a large dish.Excellent valueShow less

Author: Tim88888888Sydney, Australia
Title: Went for dinner here because had some good reviews
Review: Had to queue for about 20 minutes, order taken before we got a table. Waited another 20 minutes for one dish to arrive. Menu is straightforward Cantonese/ Western style Chinese, nothing at all special. Portions fairly small, each dish very oily even vegetable. One chicken dish fairly poor and overcooked. Prawns deep fried, oily and no flavour.Show less

Author: shannondE8671ZIPort Macquarie, Australia
Title: A Must for Every Foodie
Review: This place was amazing. We arrived shortly before it opened for the evening service and there was already 20 or so people waiting. While we waited the staff bought out the menus for review and by the time the doors opened soon after the restaurant was filled with people still lined up. The food was spectacular (chilli pork, salt & pepper squid, tamarind prawns and homemade tofu with prawns). My suggestion is to get there for the start of service or be prepare to wait - it will be worth the effort!! Show less

Author: Theresa6315Stevenage, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent food
Review: We had lunch and ordered 5 dishes with 3 veggies dishes.Love the double cooked pork and the fish curry .We got there just after 12 and had to wait but they were very efficient with sorting out the order whilst waiting for a table.All dishes were excellentShow less

Author: SaraAnnK_saskySingapore, Singapore
Title: Good food. Eat fast.
Review: The food here is consistently good. But I would say it is not that cheap. 4 of us ordered 5 dishes to share and our bill went up to 200 ringgit. Which is pretty pricey for zi char. But we also had stingray and fish. So that might explain it. The fried pork is a must have item. First time I went we had three plates! The fried chicken is also a winner. The steamed egg was delish. But be warned - there is a long wait for tables as this place is constantly packed. No reservations allowed. (Only certain hotels have an in with the cranky auntie upfront who can be swayed if you trot out some hokkien.) There is a mozzie friendly ditch in front of the restaurant, where most people usually wait. Forewarned is forearmed. Show less

Author: sophiatedjaCirebon, Indonesia
Title: I miss the chili pork
Review: When we first arrived, the queue was so long .. it was like a queue to a nightclub. But simply said it really worth a visit. All foods are good, tasty but not too oily. We enjoy the atmosphere. Too bad the famous chili pork was sold out. So we set a plan to go back Show less

Author: huntlr
Title: Busy cafe with great food
Review: You have to queue here. Sharing tables is fun and added to the experience. Ask the lady who takes your order for recommendations. Double baked pork was really delicious plus a yummy chicken dish. You can order more later on.

Author: vsw198
Title: Worth a visit
Review: Visited the infamous TekSen today for lunch. We arrived at 12pm sharp and the place was already packed. We were seated on the table outside. Service was very prompt, as soon as we were seated, the waiter approached us with menu and waiting for us to order. She is very friendly and explained cleary to all of our questions. We order the favorite Stir-fried Pork Belly with Chilli Padi, Sambal Kangkung(Morning Glory), Stir-fried Potato Leaves and the Asam Fish(Black Pomfret).We didn't have to wait for too long for the food to arrive. Everything taste so delicious, and we didn't come starving. We came right after we had the CharKwayTeow and Lorbak at Tiger Stall.This is not the first time I visited this place, always stopped by this restaurant whenever I came to Penang. Service is always top notch and the quality of the food is still the same through the years. No wonder it can stand the test of time (established since 1965).After the horrible experience from the HauHauyu restaurant yesterday, I highly recommend this place.Make sure to come early or you have to wait for quite some time as there are always crowds. Oh, you can make reservation in advance.Show less

Author: sengwey
Title: Good value
Review:
Popular dishes - sweet fried roast pork, aubergine, assam curry stingray. Verdict - good. Price - reasonable. Service - fast and good. 
Advisable to go early to avoid peak hours as this place is always packed.

Author: Johnny TPenang, Malaysia
Title: Highly recommended
Review: This is a nice restaurant for 'home cooked' meals. Good for locals (especially those returning from overseas for a visit home) and visitors. My favourites includes the 'Assam prawns', 'Stir fried pork in dark soy sauce', 'kangkung fried with belacan sauce' and the 'deep fried belacan chicken'. Prebooking especially for dinners and also weekends / holidays recommended.Show less

Author: ChristineMayYong
Title: Super Yummy!
Review: This is the place to be if you're after a local, home cooked Chinese meal. Come early for dinner, but be prepared to line up with the crowds. However, crowd control is very good and the meal even better! Highly recommended.

Author: cathydelCairns, Australia
Title: Yum!
Review: We read other recommendations for Tek Sen and our experience was great too. The double roasted pork with chilli Padi is definitely their signature dish. We tried the pork trotter in black vinegar as well - different and delicious. Daily specials all sounded delicious and if you went with a group it would be a wonderful sharing experience. Lots of locals coming and going in family groups and lots of tourists as well. All tucking in to good food! Quirky tin chairs and tabletops. Latest menu said they are closed Tuesdays. Open 12 to 3 for lunch. Check latest menu for dinner times. They seem to vary! No wine available. We had to ask for chopsticks and bowls and napkins. Staff were very efficient. Recommended for a quick and delicious lunch experience. Show less

Author: gnjamesSwindon, United Kingdom
Title: Tasty Tek Sen
Review: Went here from our room on Jalan Hutton. Everything was lovely. Service was speedy and we were seated quickly. There seemed to be a couple of waiters constantly changing the size of tables to accommodate different groups. Despite being sat in a little table between the kitchen door and the toilets, it didn't spoil our experience at all. We chose a few items from the menu, sticking to those with the heart symbols next to them (favourites).3 dishes with rice cost us RM75 (less than £15). Well worth it. Might be back tomorrow!Show less

Author: FengXueSGSingapore, Singapore
Title: A very good Chinese restaurant
Review: I actually missed out this place during my holiday in Penang in last December. It was closed for evening during Christmas. So I actually went there during my free time to check out their opening hours. As currently I know, they open 11 to 1pm for lunch and 6-9 for dinner.The dinner time is actually very crowded and has long queue. So recommend to hit here before 6:30 for dinner.I managed to get a seat in my last day there in this business trip. So the long queue has a reason. The dish is very nice and the price is very decent. That explains why it is popular for local (which I always consider a sign for good restaurants)Show less

Author: pml8855
Title: Advised
Review: You can get the food anywhere in GeorgeTown n no need to q up wait to long there n wast your time....

Author: Land-n-Sea678San Diego, California
Title: Great food and efficient service
Review: This is not a formal sit down kind of restaurant. It takes orders at the door as you wait for your table and employees communicate via efficient blue tooth earpieces. After being seated the food that arrives at the table is insanely delicious. Would highly recommend a pit stop here for lunch or dinner. Show less

Author: 164ulysses
Title: Best food of the trip
Review:
This busy restaurant serves some of the most delicious Malaysian food you're likely to find anywhere. Double-braised pork a stand-out. Be prepared to queue and go earlier rather than later as they can run out of some dishes. 

Don't miss it!

Author: Alfra_13
Title: Excellent
Review: Best food we had in Malaysia! Very nice owner and service, also an authentic atmosphere❤️ Definitely worth the price, as well!

Author: SamyLast
Title: Excellent food !
Review: As everyone said, the food is excellent, tasty, flavoured, chicken is pure breast no bones at all, if you are in georges town you should really give a try. I recommend stir fried chicken home recipe thai sauce and also stir friend chicken basil leave and rice wine in claypot, yummy !!!Show less

Author: Scoobiefreak76
Title: A MUST TRY, the assam prawns are to die for.
Review: Without fail, every trip to Penang must include lunch at TEK SEN. The ASSAM PRAWNs are just to die for.

Author: D_Widhiarto
Title: Happy Yummy Tummy
Review:
Food, yummy, portion have SML, can choose.
Chinese dish restaurant
Waiting time when dinner time about 30 minutes, you have to ask waiter for table
In my opinion all food good
Price not expensive, reasonable.
Take UBER for easy way to go there.
Must try

Author: yeewei101
Title: Yummy Chinese food
Review: I love all their dishes especially claypot eggplant , fried roasted pork and asam curry fish. Their soup also delicious. Try to come early or not u need to wait for seat. Very pack during holidays.

Author: Adriana_trips
Title: Highly recommended
Review: We loved this restaurant. They have a rich many of different dishes and the waiter has recommendations. The service is quick and good.

Author: CurlyWireMelbourne, Australia
Title: Delish meal
Review: Restaurant was recommended by our hotel - and we were not disappointed. A previous reviewer recommended arriving later, so we did that, arriving at 7:45 and only waited a few minutes. It was busy but this didn't t impact at all - wait staff were efficient and we didn't wait too long at all for drinks and meal to arrive. We have friends joining us today in Penang and hope to get back there with them. Warrants another visit! Even if it's pouring with rain, grab your brolly and head for this Penang gem.Show less

Author: ChungK44
Title: Awesome chinese cuisine!
Review: Good food, very crowded place everyday. Went there with bunch of friends and leave with a satisfied tummy

Author: JPS594
Title: The best
Review:
We walked into the restaurant by accident, but what a wonderfull surprise. 
There is always people waiting to be seated, but the wait is worth it.
Wide range of Chinese food on the menu and the service was good.
Must visit!!

Author: aaong86Singapore, Singapore
Title: Good food!
Review: Make sure you reach this restaurant before 6pm to avoid the crowd. We reached at around 5.30pm and there were still tables available. The crowd started coming after 6pm where the restaurant will be full house and there will be customers waiting outside as shown in the photo.The food is nice but the staff seems to be rushing us to place our order the moment we sat down. Probably because they want us to eat and leave asap as they are expecting lots of customers after 6pm.Good Chinese food with very reasonable prices. Highly recommended.Show less

Author: BricodustSouth West France
Title: Cannot understand the hype about this place
Review: Arrived at 6:10 pm to find the place pretty full but we obtained a table outside on the pavement but this was a mistake as we were next to the entrance, within minutes we were surrounded by people queuing, bumping in our backs and nearly on the table.The food was of a good standard but not exceptional, twice cooked belly pork was very small pieces that seemed to have been dipped in a caramel sauce, the portion was very small, The chicken with ginger and garlic was a better size but the chicken was tasteless, just a few small pieces of ginger. The green veg with prawns was OK but just 4 small prawns in total. The bill, including a large Tiger beer was 69 RM, not bad price but still enough for average food.Staff and service OK but not particularly friendly.This place is living on its laurels (and Tripadvisor reports giving it 5s).There are far better Chinese restaurants in Penang, search them out.Show less

Author: Dulcedeleche1985
Title: Crowded but worth every penny
Review: Long queue and crowded, but people do not go there for the ambience. Their food is really tasty and fresh. Prices slightly more expensive than the cheapest street food alternatives, but still value for money. Highly recommended, try their tofu!

Author: ChoowaiSingapore, Singapore
Title: Long queue but food was nice
Review: Food was good here, especially their Double Roasted Pork, Steamed 3 Eggs, and Assam Stingray Fish. Ma Po Tofu had too much bean paste in it, so wasn't authentic and was too salty. Staff discouraged me from ordering more dishes initially and said that there was too much food. When we wanted to add on in the midst of the dinner, another waitress said that we need wait for an hour for it. Show less

Author: Krissykris156Woodford, United Kingdom
Title: Fantastic!
Review: We arrived early to find a big queue but this moved quickly and the super efficient lady in charge seated us very quickly.Service was swift and the food was outstanding. Pork belly with mustard greens, sweet and sour pork and chicken in black bean sauce were all superb.As it was our first time I leant towards dishes i knew however I sincerely look forward to revisiting to sample the rest of the extensive menu.Ace!Show less

Author: MstrViolinist
Title: Great Nyonya Cuisine
Review: Went just after 5pm when they opened and were able to get a table right away.  There was a long line after us though.  Prawns were very good.

Author: famelial2016
Title: Must visit when you in penang
Review: I love the food here, everything is so tasty, staff were friendly and they are really fast when do service, been here several times and the food never failed me, if you love Chinese home cooked food, this is a place worth visit !!

Author: Roland DLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Fantastic food
Review: We were advised to arrive before 6.30pm, as we did. By the time we left, about an hour later, there was a queue to get in. The tables clear quite quickly, though, as it is not a place to linger. It is not air conditioned, although there are fans, and it is noisy. The food was very good, though, and reasonably priced. We stuffed ourselves and even ordered one dish twice as it was so tasty (twice cooked pork). Between four of us, we had one large beer, one Chinese tea, one barley water with lime, curried fish (the only dish I did not like and, oddly, the most expensive at £17!), the aforementioned two dishes of pork, some beans, some tofu, squid cooked in pepper and salt, fried chicken and a packet of tissues. The total bill was 241.60 ringette (about £44).Show less

Author: chosuntangGeorge Town, Malaysia
Title: Great authentic local food
Review: Truly an amazing place to indulge in authentic local fare. You will never have enough of the traditional flavors of Chinese cooking with some Nyonya dishes. A great place to bring guest over to experience the local culture that have shaped Georgetown to its core as the city of food haven.Show less

Author: PaulH356CQueensland, Australia
Title: Clean restaurant, authentic and very well priced
Review: The restaurant was as busy as a busy thing on a really busy day. So we hopped on to a table which we shared with a random person.We ordered a chicken and a vegetable dish and I also ordered a homemade grass jelly drink. I stupidly got a hot one and when I asked for ice the lady serving was very helpful The food was tasty, the service was quick, and the atmosphere was fantasticShow less

Author: lonelyasian
Title: Good local Chinese cuisine.
Review: This restaurant provides good local Chinese food. I will call it home cook style. Be prepared to wait for a while. The restaurant is small and crowded. This is very common in Penang.

Author: uncle_albert5
Title: Great family style meal
Review: Good for early supper as the restaurant fills up fast. We had 5 dishes, all excellent. The specialties are all very tasty. There was a long line when we left at 8:00pm, but seemed to be moving pretty fast.

Author: laikitmun
Title: Food quality
Review:
Great place for Chinese food with a good choices and budget variance
Generalll good meat & vege choices
The soya sauce Siew yuk ( risks crackling skin pork) is to die for, perfect with hot white rice. You will scream for more

Author: iamonpreeyaPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Great taste for dinner!!
Review: We had our dinner at this place.All the dishes that we ordered were super delicious. All the pork dishes were so tender and juicy. The soup of the day cannot be left out. These dishes are recommend to have together with rice.This place is a must when you visit Georgetown.Show less

Author: MarkWong007Sydney, Australia
Title: Great local restaurant!
Review: We were so happy to have found this place by accident when we walked pass after dinner and it was busting with people queuing up and we thought we had to go there for lunch and we did. It was not too busy lunch time, full of local and tourists. Food was fast, fresh and delicious so we decided to go back again but unfortunately it closed during CNY. The menu is pretty big and we did not know what to order (no pic) but there was some remarks said signature dishes and we just ordered a few to try. Every thing was delicious. I would definitely recommend this place.Show less

Author: FlamenqueraSan Diego, California
Title: Well Worth the Wait
Review: This eating establishment has been around Penang for a while now. My friends took me here for dinner. We got here just a few minutes before 6pm and it was already a full house. After we got seated, I noticed that people started lining waiting to get a table. I understand that the line gets really long and people are willing to wait.My friends who were Penang locals, did the ordering of food and when our food arrived, I see why people are willing to stand in line and wait. It's because the food was off the hook! So tasty and delicious! Perfectly seasoned and even their fried chicken, which was one of the food items that was ordered, was out of this world! One word for all the food we ate...Delish!I highly recommend this place if you're ever in Penang. Make sure you get there before 6pm so you can get a table. Show less

Author: hampus10
Title: Very nice!
Review: Super nice food, and worth the wait! I tried a bunch of different dishes, because I ended up there two times during my 2 night stay here. I recommend everyone to go there at least once!

Author: Aoipha
Title: Such a surprise!
Review: I stumbled upon this place by chance and I was so lucky! I ordered a chicken dish and my boyfriend had the pork ribs. We both loved our dishes. We planned on coming back but unfortunately it was closed the day we went. Would have loved to have gone again! Would recommend to any tourist Show less

Author: JohnnyKoay
Title: Lunch & Dinner
Review: Overall the food there is fantastic, however the pricing can be higher than other air con restaurant.

Author: suggs1965
Title: Came recommended - and did not disappoint!!
Review: Definitely worth eating here!  We had to queue for approx 15 mins - which we took as a good sign.  We were not disappointed.  The food was amazing!  Staff were very friendly and very happy to make recommendations.

Author: Coastal807503
Title: One of Penangs best
Review: Very good service. Food came swiftly. Tables are cleared very quickly and as with most Chinese restaurants on the Island is very efficient. Only down point is not taking cards. In Malaysia and for a restaurant that size and how busy, it really should do.

Author: Dakoolau
Title: No Credit Cards
Review: The food is excellent however they do not take credit cards. If you do not want to have a long walk down to the waterfront to an ATM, make sure you have enough cash with you.

Author: VDV11London, United Kingdom
Title: Outstanding Chinese Food
Review: Visited Teksen as it was recommeded in a guide book.....wow. Possibly the best chinese food I have ever eaten.The restaurant is basic but clean, atmospheric and rammed full of locals. We ordered 3 small mains and a large rice which was perfect for 2 people. We could not seperate the Pork in Chilli (it was called something similar to this), the 5-spice pork and chicken in plum sauce. They were all absolutely superb.The price is also worth a mention - all the above plus 2x tea and 2x mineral water clocked in at around the equivalent of £10. Enough said!!Show less

Author: MarkandBrendaKCoburg, Australia
Title: Fabulous Chinese food!
Review: Very popular local Chinese restaurant, there was a constant queue to get in but moved very quickly. The service was very efficient and the food was just amazing! We had double roasted pork, Mapo tofu, sambal kangkung and Assam fish fillets, and we devoured every fish!Show less

Author: Kate MLeeds, United Kingdom
Title: Worth the trip
Review: Went for early dinner. The staff were friendly and very efficient. The place filled up very quickly which helped create atmosphere and appeared to be very well run. The food was lovely and washed down with drinks, which included the really refreshing nutmeg juice. Definitely recommend, especially the roast pork. Show less

Author: 573pedrof
Title: Great food!
Review: Always crowded, a cheap place with really great Chinese food. The crispy chicken with Thai sauce is a must.

Author: WanderLustDavao
Title: Taste of history
Review: If you're looking for heritage Chinese food in Penang, this is the best stopover. Never forget to sample their home recipe double roasted pork.

Author: CWAJW15Leeds, United Kingdom
Title: Great food - well worth the wait
Review: The food was very good, particularly the soup. The place was very busy but the staff were efficient and organised. It was cash only so had to find a cash machine but not a problem, we just had to wait a little longer to eat. Don't be put off by the outside - it is not flash or plush but the food is excellent - ate there twice in 4 days.Show less

Author: HuangJooSingapore, Singapore
Title: Be prepared to wait
Review: We arrived 5 mins before 6pm. However it was already crowded and we had to wait 20mins to get our seats. Waited for another 20-30 mins for our food. Food comes in different portions. We ordered small portions dishes and they are really small hence it is not so value for money - eg we got two pcs toufu for the seafood toufu dish. Food is so so hence am not sure what is the hype for. Show less

Author: TengKiatSingapore, Singapore
Title: Excellent
Review: Came maybe an hour after they opened. Didn't manage to make a reservation, but thankfully did not have to wait too long as it was just two of us - tables for pairs open up quicker. The food was fantastic - the double-fried pork in particular. The homemade tofu was very good too. Prawn-paste chicken wings was a bit of a letdown but still good. Worth the wait and good value - around 15SGD I think for five dishes.Show less

Author: Harker69Chelmsford, United Kingdom
Title: Looks can be deceiving
Review: Great place to eat, maybe the best Chinese in George town. If I could one piece of advice it is to book in advance. This place doesn't look much from the outside but all the food is great. We went as a group of 5 and ordered lots of dishes and shared which was nice as we go to taste lots of dishes. The staff were friendly and helpful. They only accept cash. Prices are reasonable for George town with a main between 12-25 Ringgit depending on the size.Would highly recommend, book in advance or be prepared to wait in line for a bit.Show less

Author: anggingyinSingapore, Singapore
Title: Overrated
Review: Be ready for a long wait if you reach after opening hours, arrived 5 mins before 6pm (opening time) and the restaurant was already full. Waited 20 minutes to be sitted (longer if you are in a big group) and another 30 minutes for the food to be served. Ordered sambal Kangkong, homemade tofu, fried chicken w plum sauce and a single portion of soup of the day. The food is nice, a little on the salty side but certainly not fantastic and not worth the hype. Tek Sen is really popular among tourists. The bill came up to be 25 ringgit per person, pricey given the tiny portion. Overall, it's good to try once but certainly not worth queuing up for. Show less

Author: MHBJSydney, Australia
Title: Famously Fabulous
Review: The staff at Kebaya recommended this. So I knew it would be good. And it was. Really good.It showcases regional Chinese cuisine (although some of our dishes were Thai). The duck was insanely good. Melt off the bone and the very definition of a master stock.The chicken with holy basil was amazing. Probably the best I have ever eaten and I love this dish.The asparagus and prawn dish was lovely and light (first time I have seen asparagus in Malaysia).The meal cost me less than 20AUD. What a bargain. HINTDon't stress out if there is a queue. The host will take your order and by the time you sit down the food will be served. They are incredibly well organised and very fast.Show less

Author: Selina TSingapore, Singapore
Title: Family Holiday
Review: We managed to rush back from our shopping at Gurney Plaza and join the queue for dinner. We were the last customers for dinner! The food was very good and there was a wide variety to choose from although some items were not available because we got there so late. It was good value for what we paid. Excellent meal! Show less

Author: JoAunty
Title: Friendly service, tasty food
Review: We ordered the salt and pepper squid and various dishes, such as fried rice, fried tofu, sambal kangkong, sweet and sour pork etc.  Cooling area to dine in for local zhichar styled food.  Queue was quick, food served quick too, parking is a challenge, though.

Author: TheReal_ToysAreUs
Title: Satisfying Nonya/Chinese fusion cooking
Review: The crowd is never wrong. Long and huge queue waiting to go in.Reservations available and highly recommended.Due to the crowd, cooking and waiting time...they will not entertain additional orders when your food is served.I do not think you will go wrong ordering that extra plate of fried chicken wings, tofu, or meat...we finished it , even the kids, despite being "not hungry".Show less

Author: hohoclaraHong Kong, China
Title: Nice food
Review: We arrived around 7:15pm, there was already quite a long line. Fortunately we weren't too hungry yet so we've decided to wait in line. We were assigned a table after less than 30 min. Not too bad! We ordered the infamous homemade tofu, tofu was really soft. Must try! Also ordered prawn with sambal, curry string ray and stir fried veg and mushroom.. Everything was lovely. Love the curry string ray there most. Final bill came to around 80 MYR for 3 people. Good value indeed. Show less

Author: idoltraveller
Title: Noodlevana
Review: Watch them make the noodles which, damn, ain't easy. Then eat them. With dumplings.  BBQ with honey dipping sauce is also recommended. This is the spot.

Author: kwca700
Title: Excellent food.
Review: This is a must try place when you visit Penang. Several dishes which needs special mention are the roast pork with dark soy sauce, asam fish and fried chicken.

Author: ferrymulSingapore
Title: Excellent food
Review: I was here for lunch, ordered their favourite menus such as dragon spinach, char siew, tofu. All of them is good, and we wash it down with 4 cold barley and accompanied with 4 white rice. It was a pleasant experience and also relatively affordable (est RM 70++). Will be back again when time permitsShow less

Author: mathelaci
Title: Very nice lunch!
Review: We had lunch at this restaurant and we thought that the food was very very tasty! We will definitely go back again!

Author: Hammie2015
Title: Good and cheap
Review: This place was recommended by a friend.   Had dinner there after spending an afternoon walking around Armenian Street. Delicious Chinese zhi char place with fresh seafood . Expect to wait if you do not make prior reservations.

Author: vsw198
Title: Overated
Review: Home style cook food that tastes just ok. I really don't understand what with all the hype. Tried several times just to make sure if it's really that good. Food taste just ok, not too bad but nothing to be bragged about.

Author: angstansg
Title: Ok food
Review:
Came here to eat upon recommendations from taxi driver.
The food is ok. Perhaps it's because I just landed and so has not warmed up yet.

Author: YC HPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Great Chinese cuisine in heart of Chinatown.
Review: It is usually crowded, and customers are mainly travelers as it is well located in the heart of Chinatown in Penang. They serve Chinese cuisine, and I noticed that the service is fast and efficient. Perhaps a little pricey, but taste is good. The place is reasonably clean and easy to access as it is by the roadside. Sometimes we needed to wait for an empty table especially during lunch and dinner times. They serve breakfast too. Car parking can be a problem because this place is busy and near to the Campbell Street market.Show less

Author: PCWeeSingapore
Title: Great food
Review: We enjoyed the food at this restaurant. We chanced upon this place while walking past one late afternoon and decided to make dinner reservations. This proved fortuitous as the place was jam packed with people even as early as 6pm and we glady walked past the snaking queue of people to our seats, unable to avoid the envy of those in the queue of course ;)We had the salted fish soup, laden with its umami flavours. We also had the well-known pork belly dish, fried with old and dark sauce. Yummy!In addition, we had other vegetable dishes as well as nicely deep fried chicken. All these were wonderfully tasty. What would bring me back for another visit, though, is its fried bringal (eggplant) dish. Can't express how good it is, but all I can say is that you must try this.... for all its meaty goodness.Show less

Author: ezllePenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Good but a little pricey
Review: A group of about 8 of us turned up in 3 cars. Parking is an issue around the area. We were lucky to get a table fairly quickly as we didn't do any reservations. Place was crowded. Our favorite is always the stir fried roasted pork with dried chilies/chili padi. Servings is always never enough for all of us even when we asked for a large serving. The veges are cooked well, with many variety as well as seasonal veges available if you ask for it. Overall food is good, but a little pricey for Penangnites. The way food is served is based on when you order , so be quick to place your orders in. And i you're visiting as a group, rather than wait for all to arrive to order, best to place orders in when you're seated as it may take a while for food to be served if order is placed after everyone in your group arrives.Show less

Author: Helen N
Title: An average restaurant
Review: Average food offered with a big pricey bill. Food cooked with too much MSG. You will feel thirsty afterwards.

Author: sushsf2016Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good but bit overrated
Review: Definitely need to do reservations otherwise the queue is ridiculously long. Maybe because of this my expectations were much higher . However I find the food just average n prices are more for the western tourist. When in Penang the better place to go is still the hawker's centers .Show less

Author: MikeCarmona
Title: Consistently good!
Review: I come here everytime I am in Georgetown. Must try their homemade tofu, asam prawns, and kangkong belacan. Costs about $8/pax.

Author: Adline11Bratislava, Slovakia
Title: Disappointinh
Review: We came for dinner there following the Trip Advisor reviews. There was a queue but we got a table pretty fast. After ordering, we waited forever to get the food. My bf ordered the double roasted pork with chili padi (which is supposed to be the greatest thing they have..) but turned out to be something like pork belly with cotton candy taste. I ordered some stir fried chicken with garlic & rice wine but again the taste was not great - I still wonder if I got what I ordered! So very big disappointment.Show less

Author: CKSoonKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Need reservation if you plan to visit
Review: Food is good. But price is considered on higher mid range in Penang. Open lunch and dinner time only. Was waiting from 5pm for the opening at 6pm. The ordering was not organized as I was first to queue but ended up 5th to order. Disappointed with that. Show less

Author: jthamKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Tasty food and fast service
Review: Although we arrived about 2.00pm, the place remained packed. We were lucky we had made a reservation earlier for a table of 10. We ordered mostly the popular dishes such as the fried roast pork with chili padi, special home made tofu with scallop sauce, kangkung belacan, etc. All the food were served speedily and were tasty. A good place for lunch. However, parking may be a bit difficult. Prices are very reasonable and the restaurant has a nice olden shop ambiance. Will surely return to try the other dishes.Show less

Author: melly2002Denpasar, Indonesia
Title: never goes wrong
Review: the best chinese restaurant in town!!!! the best dish that i have is bitter gourd cook with salty egg and pork. the best bitter gourd i ever had!!! must try!!!the staff is so quick! they clean the table and change the tablecloth. so ur table always clean. the portion is enough for sharing and the price is cheap. really2 reasonable price!!!love....love...this restaurantnext time i'm gonna try LIPSTICK CHICKEN. sound's weird but i'll try!!!Show less

Author: S AToulouse, France
Title: For foodies
Review: Hidden down a side road between Lebuh Chulia and Lebuh Campbell, this restaurant is for foodies. It is not romantic, not for kids, and definitely not relaxing! Don't expect service with a smile - just eat and be happy!As someone who grew up in Malaysia and Singapore, I find the quality and choice of dishes meet a higher standard than the surrounding Chinese restaurants on Lebuh Campbell, Lebuh Kimberley and Lebuh Chulia (excluding specialist soup and noodle restaurants).My best tip is to arrive 10 minutes BEFORE the start of the lunch/dinner service to avoid the fray! There will be a queue within 30 mins no matter which day of the week and the queue is HELL! If you end up in the queue, obtain a menu and be sure to place your food and drinks orders while waiting. If you're flying solo, find a group of people to share a table with and you'll get seated sooner.The menu is extensive and consists of dishes my family would eat on weekends at home, so don't just stick to what you know. Try a couple of dishes that you can't get in your home country. A note on the signature pork dish - the honey and soya sauce make it sticky, a little sweet and delicious (note: no sauce). It's a large portion/enough for 2-4 people, so don't order it unless you like pork! Many of the curry dishes contain 'assam' (= tamarind) which is not a taste everyone likes, but very common in Indian curries. Go in a group so you can experiment and share the cost.The morning glory, here called, "kangkung with sambal" is the best I've ever tasted for both balance and chilli seasoning.I will definitely go back to this restaurant time and time again.Show less

Author: 639abbieCanberra, Australia
Title: Hidden Jewel
Review: Best tip you can get, book ahead and turn up in time otherwise you will lose your table to others and have to queue for a long time. Tip 2, best dishes r all their specialties especially their sambal kangkung well balanced in taste and any of their bean curd dishes being homemade. You will want to come back so do it not on your last night. It's location is off the main road on lebuk carnavon. Enjoy.Show less

Author: heewonk152
Title: Amazing food!!
Review: We returned 3 times while in penang. Everything we ordered was amazing. The tofu dishes, stingray curry, double roasted pork, plum source fried chicken, sambal kangkong, the list goes on. We wish we went to the place earlier. Price was usually around 50-60 ringgits with 3 main dishes which we felt was very reasonable for the standard. Show less

Author: msnakimSingapore
Title: Great Food, Prompt Service
Review: We came at noon on a weekday, because we read reviews of people (without reservations) being turned away at dinner time. Even then, the place was bustling with people!The food was excellent. Loved their signature curry fish (stingray).But being crowded, there were also a few boo-boos. For example, they confused my drinks order (which they changed without fuss). And someone else's drinks were spilled (cleaned up in 2-3min).A good place to stop for lunch. Will visit again.Show less

Author: zlunniss
Title: Super busy but yummy food
Review: When we went it was super busy so took a while to get our orders taken etc. was really good though and food did not disappoint. Just not as much customer service due to how busy it was

Author: ritchieorlando
Title: Great food great price
Review: Must try!!!!!! But i think this restaurant is closed on monday. So you better make a phone call if you want to go on monday.

Author: GSWTay
Title: Great dinner and we love it!
Review: We had our dinner family of 5 adult and 1 child. Clean place and great food served. Reasonable price!

Author: Barry W
Title: Do believe the hype.
Review: The origins of this justifiably well-loved restaurant can be traced back to when it was just one of the many street vendors that proliferate all over Chinatown and beyond.What elevated it to the superstar status it currently enjoys?My guess would be a dedication to the philosophy, food is all.They revere their ingredients here, and rightly so.If an element of the dish is unavailable that day, they pull the dish.No slap-dash or short cuts here.And many ingredients are sourced from the mainland.That's mainland China, not Malaysia!There isn't space to dissect the long but well structured menu here, and anyway, I wouldn't want to steer you in any particular direction.There are gems to be found everywhere.Especially in the 1st section headed "Vegetables".And I say this as a chef and confirmed carnivore.Just come with an open mind and an equally receptive stomach, ideally in a group of 4 or more, then pick a minimum of 3 dishes each. Most dishes are available in 2 different sizes, some in 3. What you will then have, is a banquet.This is most definitely a place to venture outside of your comfort zone. Proper nose-to-tail eating with a few beaks and feet thrown in for comfort.Make sure you get here early though, they queue out the door for the 12:30-2:30 & 6:30-8:30 lunch and dinner service (Closed Tuesdays).I guess that when you have been doing things this well and for so long, you don't have to work all the hours going.They've got it down to a fine art. So if in Penang, you owe it to yourselves.Get involved.Show less

Author: Al-Net-Olo
Title: Good food done well
Review: Went there on a Friday evening. Crowded but manageable. Turnover was brisk. The superlatives start the moment the first dish arrives. Comfort food done well. We had the salt and pepper squid, the prawn paste chicken, the Assam fish and the double roasted pork with chilli padi.The chicken was fried to perfection and the fish dish well-balanced : piquant but not overly spicy. The standout was the pork - caramelized "sio bak" with a hint on chilli kick. Yumz!Show less

Author: Katie TLondon
Title: Good sit-down meal
Review: We finally managed to eat here on our last day for lunch (it closes 9pm and every Tuesday), excited by the hype from friends and other reviewers. Good tasty meal which felt more relaxing than eating at hawker stands (and the clean western loo was a welcome luxury after getting used to squatters everywhere else we ate!), but nothing particular to write home about. The house specialty pork is essentially sweet sticky fried bacon lardons, not finely sliced char siew as we were expecting, but tasty all the same. And the plate of mix veg 'with various cutlets' intrigued my offal-loving husband. Show less

Author: gun47
Title: Chinese comfort food at its best
Review: What can I say, the food is delicious, the service is prompt, and the place is clean. There are numerous local Chinese dishes to pick from, will take a few more trips to try them all.

Author: Benrose74Singapore, Singapore
Title: Wonderful spot for lunch
Review: I visited Tek Sen with my 12 year old son in November 2016. It was packed but we managed to find a table, even without a reservation. The food was really fantastic. We ate chicken in ginger and spring onion, Brussel sprouts with prawns, bbq spare ribs, salt and pepper squid and rice. Then ordered the chicken again, it was so good. Would definitely return again (and again).Show less

Author: 977freddywJakarta, Indonesia
Title: Try out their roasted pork!
Review: We came here when it was raining so luckily the place wasn't very packed. We ordered braised tofu, steamed fish, assam curry, and double roasted pork with chili padi.All turned delicious but the steamed fish was very expensive (RM 125!!). My favorite is definitely the double roasted pork.Show less

Author: 435alo
Title: Delicious!!
Review: Absolutely delicious food - get there early to avoid enormous queues which shows how good it is! Tried a lot of dishes and all were great!

Author: Ed B
Title: So worth it
Review: Go here!! Super authentic feel to the place, back up by amazing food!! You will not be disappointed. Main cost around 15.rm but it is worth it. Get the pork belly, wow it is too good!! Can't back this place enough

Author: 166alessandrosMilan, Italy
Title: Must try the signature pork.
Review: When on vacation I never go to the same place twice because I like to try different places. This time I came here twice: the dishes were flawless. There's a huge selection of food and some daily specials (you'll have to ask because they're written in Chinese on a whiteboard, unless of course you can read it).The double braised pork is one of the most good things I ever ate.很好吃!Show less

Author: sutasinobonc
Title: Good food
Review: I was surprised because I thought food gonna be oily but here it was not sooooo good food. I in love with this restaurant.

Author: shaunlamKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: True Penang food
Review: I had been here before on previous trips to Penang - it's now evolved from a roadside stall to a full on "chu char" restaurant with aircon and lots of tourists. But this has not changed the standard of the food. If you want to experience a true Penang meal - go here!Show less

Author: Alice S
Title: Some of the best foot we ate in Malaysia!
Review: So good we returned for another meal! Everything we ordered was absolutely delicious, in particular the morning glory and pork belly! I'm sure we would have returned for a third time if we had longer in Georgetown!

Author: WeeyahnehVail, Arizona
Title: Best mapu dofu outside of China
Review: I am a huge fan of mapo dofu and it is difficult to find it made properly. It tends to come out too oily and lacking sufficient chili to tickle the back of the throat like it should. Ah, but Tek Sen did it right!! Mapo Dofu heaven!!Show less

Author: darkstar15Singapore
Title: Yummy food
Review: This is the place to go for great local zhi char. Be sure to go early as long queues form from 6pm. We had teochew pomfret which was very fresh and well done, sambal emperor vegetables, assam squid and homemade tofu. All the dishes were well done and not too oily, greasy or salty. Service was efficient and friendly.Show less

Author: Crazyfeline
Title: Dinner
Review: Delicious. 3 of us. Had soup, their specialty roast pork, vegetables, steamed bean curd with scallops and prawns. 4 portion of rice and 4 cold drinks, all amounting to 70 ringgit. We were full and smiling with that price and standard of food. Highly recommended. Queue of people waiting outside while we left. Service was excellent too.Show less

Author: Karrie T
Title: Almost SG price but food is nice
Review:
Went for lunch and all the dishes ordered are very nice! But two pax four dishes spent about $30sgd /$90ringgit 

Will go again Cus fried sotong is so nice haha!

Author: WtteoSingapore, Singapore
Title: Excellent Chinese restaurant
Review: Very nice Chinese cuisine. Very pack at night. Need to call to book if big group.Price is very reasonable. Not much ambience though. Very Coffeeshop style kind of restaurant.A bit difficult to find parking space along the street although there is a Pte carpark nearby.But will definitely go back again.Show less

Author: robwu
Title: Yum
Review: Super popular with tourists and locals. Delicious chinese food with local flavors. Gets busy at night.

Author: ConradTwins
Title: Good choice
Review:
Asked a Uber driver and he recommended this place. Crowds build really fast so should try and get here before (noon) for lunch. 

Portions are good. Gives you enough choices with authentic local flavours.

Author: DavidMOS13Birmingham, United Kingdom
Title: A very local experience
Review: We ate here for lunch having just arrived in George Town and the restaurant being recommended by our hotel. If the hotel had not recommended it, we would have probably walked straight past - open shophouse, metal tables and stools, white tiled walls and very noisy. But happily we took the plunge. The place was very clean and we were served quickly and efficiently. The food was tasty - we had tamarind prawns and pork belly with yam. However the most interesting part, from a tourist's point of view, was observing how local families eat together. Show less

Author: JeslynhoChangi, Singapore
Title: A great local restaurant
Review: We had it easy, was told the queue is always very long but we managed to beat the queue just by a few minutes for lunch. The food is very local, a very authentic kopitiam style (local coffee shop), and very inexpensive. We ordered about 4-5 dishes for two persons and it came up to be less than RM100. Dinner will be pretty crowded so if you can, do lunch. They are famous for their kang kong (morning glory), we tried their Moi choi kao yok (seasoned vegetable and braised pork), their Assam fish and a few other dishes. If you miss home cooked food, this is the place to go. Show less

Author: Stefany CJakarta, Indonesia
Title: That Fried Roast Pork Was AWESOME
Review: Please do a reservation before coming, as its very crowded. Good food, good service and good company. Had the mapo tofu (very recommened: soft & silky), steam fish, fried chicken, veggies, but u have to try their amazing fried roast pork glazed with honey and a little bit of dried chili flakes. Nothing like I've tried before.Show less

Author: flutterby59
Title: Fabulous
Review: We keep coming back to this amazing place as the food is sensational.The chilli pork is a must as is the sour fish curry.It is a shame so many people have discovered this place as I now have to wait to get a table.

Author: mpenel0pe
Title: Best asian food
Review: Delicious Asian food, probably the best I've tested in South-East Asian, home recipe double roasted pork and steamed fish with soy sauce were perfect, fried rice was incredible and vegetables were absolutely fabulous. Staff was nice and friendly! I would definetely recommand to everyone!

Author: SinghGauravSingapore, Singapore
Title: Nice tofu dishes
Review: A whole lot of homemade tofu dishes. Been here in the past and always come here when u crave a certain taste. The place is mostly busy. The staff is efficient and food about average priced. Not bad for one of the places to eat while your on a food holiday in penang.Show less

Author: 505liamc
Title: Very good cheap food
Review: Went here for lunch (roast duck with sour plum sauce - very good!). Really nice place, nice local food. Filled with locals and tourists alike.

Author: GeorgetownPenangPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Local Homely Food
Review: This restaurant has maintained its standards over the past 10 plus years! From father to son. Lovely family run place. A must try is their fried roast pork dish, curry fish plus any of the vegetable dishes. The turnip omelette is also a favourite together with their soup of the day. Show less

Author: erazer316Singapore, Singapore
Title: Not a bad place for chinese food
Review: Saw the review and went there tonight. Everything is just fine if you are looking for coffee shop standard chinese food i must say. But the signature did not impress me , xin nan huat BBQ pork is much better than this double bbq pork. Being a chinese i failed to eat alot of reviews wasn't posted by a local chinese , my bad. Although food is not bad here but there are many places better but at a higher price i must say. Btw the steam prompret in teochew style although is delicious but price is kinda steep , cost me 125ringgit .Beijing Lou in johor is 1 of the best chinese food i would recommend in malaysia.Show less

Author: Jacky KCheras, Malaysia
Title: Tasty Food and Fast & Efficient
Review: Nice food and clean environment. Lots of nice foods like Curry based stingray, double roast pork with chili padi and many more. You never want to miss a chance. Lots of international tourist visiting and enjoy the foods here. All of them also put THUMB UP. They dishes come out quite fast and price is reasonable too.Show less

Author: R3418BJ
Title: Tasty Chinese food
Review: Busy Chinese restaurant. Not air conditioned but it was airy. Homemade beancurd was delicious, as were the other dishes. Ordered 4 dishes and 2 non-alcoholic drinks for around RM70+. Lovely meal, will definitely recommend.

Author: Fiona091
Title: Great food, casual atmosphere
Review: Dined at Tek Sen, had a short wait. Service was quick and efficient. Never felt staff were rushing to turn over the table. Food was very tasty and reasonably priced. Pork dishes to be recommended. Hope to visit again soon.

Author: David S
Title: Great tasty food, you will love it
Review: A great place to eat. Wonderful flavor and great fast service. Had to wait to be seat but did not take long. The staff are very efficient. We had double cooked pork belly, sweet sour chicken and Thai chicken . Just delicious. Not like Australia where there is too much batter and very little meat. We thoroughly recommend you eat here if you are in Penang.Show less

Author: Will W
Title: Great! Fast paced
Review: Ate here twice during stay, was excellent both times. recommend the plum chicken and the double roasted pork. Bean curd is good too. Honestly the best chinese i've ever had. Constant queue outside, but didn't have to wait too long really, to me it was more reassuring than anything. also, it was exceptionally good value for money.Show less

Author: CribwilliamsWorcestershire, United Kingdom
Title: Wow! The food was delicious!
Review: Have just got back from Tek Sen, the place was absolutely buzzing!! Which is always great to see! We waited a few minutes outside, giving us time to look at their menu, gave our order to the lady in charge of the ever growing queue and was quickly seated! We ordered 3 main meals and rice, everything was fantastic! Definitely will be back tomorrow! Don't miss this place if you're in Georgetown! Expect a wait during peak times however they really do move fast! You shouldn't have to wait long! Staff so friendly and happy even with a full house!Show less

Author: DavidoffbaliBali, Indonesia
Title: Our Home Foods
Review: Searching this place because just walk 10 minutes from my hotel in heritage areal . First impression ...mamma mia , just 18.30 but business already busy and 3 family queue for entering. You can choose the meals while you are waiting in outside. Just few minutes , you already taking the table . The Girl in front is very talkative and attractive. She know all the best food in restaurant and good in handle a guest . Food are waiting around 15 minutes and all coming together . Taste are best , specialist in fish curry and pork . Sure for comeback again . Show less

Author: ebony07Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Simply delectable
Review: We had lunch here. Every dish we had was simply delectable. We enjoyed the vinegar pork, pork and yam, sambal petai, taufoo caramelised siew yoke (BBQ pork) curry fish head most. The restaurant is packed and you've got to book a table in advance. A no frills, coffeeshop which serves fantastic food. Not to be missed when you are in Penang. Show less

Author: Aimee AManila
Title: Just Delicious
Review: We dined there twice as the food was just delicious and the service fast. We had the sauteed spinach and Malaysian tom yao vegetables, steamed grouper, double roasted pork and chicken in thai sauce and was definitely the best meal of our trip. The place is very basic-open storefront, with electric fans only and chairs with no backrest; however, you forget all these once you start eating. Show less

Author: kiangtravellarGeorge Town, Malaysia
Title: A tourist favourite restaurant..
Review: Tek sen was once a favourite local restaurant. It was housed in a shack a few doors next to its current location. It serves local comfort fare at cheap prices that overlooks ambience and service. However, in recent years, this has not been the case anymore. They are more tourist focused, and the food being dished out are relatively pricy for the locals. Anyone who says that this restaurant serves cheap food is obvious denominating the price either in US dollars, Pounds or Euros. Tek sen has to keep its prices in check if it wants to remain a relevent restaurant to the locals. Remember, the food served comprise cheap ingredients. Hence it should not try to be what it is not. Also, though it has modernised, old habits die hard. If you order any fish, take note that a few slices of its body have been carved out ( obviously to make another dish - old time trick ). Show less

Author: paul s
Title: Never fails
Review:
Great traditional hainanese and chinese food. I find mostly traditional cooking to be bland, but Teck Sen food is flavourful

Asam fish is the bombs

Author: mollydeecollie
Title: Lunch
Review: The steamed fish and boneless pork ribs were both outstanding, and the Tiger been plenty cold. Bustling scene, colorful, and really good food.

Author: Marwan1985Serpong, Indonesia
Title: Excellent dishes
Review: Oh wow we are astonished. Came here for late lunch and the place is still crowded. We are expecting an old famous eateries that is old...and tired. But this place is not old and tired. The staff are all young and energetic. Food is really really good. Awesome. The double roast pork with chili padi is to die for. All the food is good and with those price its really a bargainWill make sure to come back again next time we are at penangOne more customer satisfiedShow less

Author: biaancatCork, Ireland
Title: Fab food - no frills
Review: Booked for 8.30 pm one evening during our holiday but when we arrived we were told they were closed. So disappointing. Apparently they close as soon as they run out of food. We returned twice for lunch as it's very difficult to get a table at night. Food was fabulous. Loved the double roast pork and sweet and sour pork. The duck with yams was huge. We also had fried grouper which was gorgeous. They serve beer but no other alcohol. They do a lovely refreshing lime juice though. Metal top tables, plastic chairs and plates. I'd say nothing much has changed here in years. No frills. Staff were very helpful. Lovely change from hawker stalls. Ridiculously cheap. Go there.Show less

Author: Mahe_FInterlaken, Switzerland
Title: Tasty food!!
Review: Had an amazing dinner last night there. Took the chicken with thaï sauce they recommend and waw, was Delish. The place is very popular and you queue maybe 10minutes to get your table. They make it very smartly and give you the menu while you're queuing such that you order before being seated. It fastens the service which is good! Paid MYR21 for a medium meal with meat, rice and a drink.Show less

Author: CKWJ30
Title: Great local restaurant
Review: The food was amazing and reasonably priced. Highlights were the double roasted pork, assam fish and fried chicken. Nice clean restaurant with brisk and polite servers. A georgetown institution.

Author: Kev M
Title: Delicious Food and Good Price!
Review: Very popular restaurant in the heart of Georgetown. We arrived early evening and the restaurant was full with the queue out the door. We were given a menu while queuing and our orders were taken. Once we had a table the food arrived within 20 minutes and was delicious. Would definitely recommend! If you're travelling with a larger group, it's probably best to pre-book a table - we noticed that some people had done this and were seated straight away. Would definitely return here for dinner if staying in Georgetown again - some of the best food we had in Penang. Show less

Author: maridontreksKuching, Malaysia
Title: Great Food & Service Again
Review: Our 4th time dining here since our last trip to Georgetown a year ago. We're pleased to see that the good standard of food & service has been maintained. Kudos to the owner and team for dishing up great dining experiences every time. The fish assam curry is a favourite of ours. Show less

Author: MySemillonNewcastle, Australia
Title: Ultra popular .... ultra tasty!
Review: We enjoyed a really tasty and reasonably priced meal last night. We arrived early but still needed to line up. We had a nice time sharing a table with another couple. The clay pot fish was very tasty, as was the pork. This is not elegant dining, but lots of fun in a no-frills sort of place.Show less

Author: NicolasZaw
Title: Great Taste and reasonable price
Review:
If you are in George town and hungry, you must try this restaurant. But need to get the table and be patient to wait.
The double roasted pork is very tasty.

Author: Statler1Foster, Australia
Title: Fast & Fresh Chinese
Review: I visited Tek Sen twice during my stay in Penang. We enjoyed it so much on the first night after trying the tasty fried bean curd & choy sum & squid. On our return as I'm a duck lover I tried the braised duck with yam. It was luke-warm, over-cooked & dry in an ok, but not brilliant sauce with soggy yams. Looks good for pork lovers. Go at opening time or you will be waiting in the queue in the street. Show less

Author: 748maxlSingapore, Singapore
Title: Repeat visit
Review: Been here once with family and this is my 2nd visit with friends. I introduce them this as I have a very good experience with the food the last time here and what is more satisfying hearing my Friend comment "very good" a couple of times each Show less

Author: MikeCarmonaManila, Philippines
Title: Great local dishes at above average prices
Review: Came here again with a local Penang friend. We ordered: twice roasted pork, home made tofu, pomfret curry and kangkong belacan. Everything was great except for the curry as the gravy was watery and quite expensive for its portion. Don't miss the tofu and order their fried chicken belacan.Guess for a local to be impressed with their food, you should try this place too. Show less

Author: denisep365
Title: Tourist restaurant
Review: Portion small vs price.  Service fast.  Food is delicious yet you can find similar at a reasonable price.

Author: dancinstar
Title: Amazing pork
Review: Had the double roasted pork and the five spice pork. Absolutely amazing. Had to queue for a bit to get in as very busy but didn't take long. Good food at good prices, would definitely return.

Author: MIL1251Byron Bay, Australia
Title: All a bit rushed!
Review: After all the hype, I didn't feel it met up with my expectations. Big line ups to wait for a table and it all felt a bit rushed to order (no time to ponder over menu!), to eat and move on. Restaurant only open for very short lunch and dinner service. The homemade tofu is delicious, however. Lots of locals with their families having dinner, so other menu items must be good! Price is reasonable.Show less

Author: Champ1gnon
Title: busy place but great food & service
Review: we went there twice during our stay in penang as the menu was so extensive and there were many things we wanted to try. everything we ordered were yummy and the staff were always smiling and friendly even though the restaurant was always overflowing with people. better book your table in advance or you'll have to wait.Show less

Author: HughF170
Title: Good variety
Review: Was here as part of a food tour. The food was really good and from what I saw, value for money. Tried 2 dishes and a dessert, though the latter didn't live up to the expectation.

Author: Peter vPenang
Title: Briased pork and homemade tofu
Review: They do an excellent job. No less. The braised pork and homemade tofu were excellent. The only reason for not a 5 star is that I found the portions a bit small for the price. That said, I recommend it for a great Chinese meal in George Town.Show less

Author: Davidsanfeliu
Title: I'll miss it
Review: Great restaurant with super nice food. The menu have plenty of options even for vegetarians. We went two times and everything was excelent.

Author: Patrick CSingapore, Singapore
Title: Popular with local & tourist
Review: Went on a Monday night & a good thing I made a reservation in advance. Even with a reservation, still had to wait for 5-10 mins before I got a table.Food was served pretty quick & for 7 adults & 7 dishes it cost only RM210. I would say it was quite reasonable but don't expect high class restaurant fare.Menu in english with a wide variety. The assam stingray & black pork is among their most popular dish.Go try if you want a taste of home cook meal. Not bad but nothing to rave about.Show less

Author: MartinyawParit Raja, Johor, Malaysia
Title: Good food but pricey
Review: I have heard a lot about tek sen since i arrive in Penang. So , i decided to give it a try with my GF. Fortunately, the food was great and the service was good too. The price was pricey and that is expected. Well, If you don't mind paying for satisfaction then this is a place you can drop by and enjoy your dinner.Show less

Author: judithekkel
Title: Good food
Review: Very nice and good food. Busy place i had to stand in line for 10 minutes. But worth it. Not cheap for malasian standart. Choice enough on the menu.

Author: 285edithv
Title: Yummie!
Review: This place serves the best Chinese food we have tasted so far. Nice to see that the locals also eat here. If you like that they can help you out with your choice and tell you the daily specials. But you can come al long way because the menu is also translated in English. Show less

Author: lchialPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Tasty food but pricey
Review: The food here are quite good (most of them are above average) except they are quite pricey (comparing the portion and the price). They have few signature dishes that a must ordered every time I dine here such as stir fried roasted pork with chillies, assam prawn, stir fried vege with fungus and their signature soup. due to the popularity among locals and tourist, this queue will be long during dinner time or lunch time especially during weekend and public holiday.Show less

Author: yoonpauline
Title: Tasty and one of the local favourite place
Review: Must try the stir fried pork with chillies, morning glory sambal and assam prawn. One of the local favourite place. Sometimes the queue can be quite long

Author: KorapukekoeNew Zealand
Title: "Over Priced, Over Rated!"
Review: The food is not bad except that the portioning served did not equate with the price charged. Due to popularity, the waiting time is long, especially when you have children. Next time we need to prepare some snacks for the kids. We could easily overlook these but when the person who came to take our order wasn't too patient, she showed signs of discontentment when we took "too long a time" to order (my foreign guests could not understand why this person behaved that way when we chose to patronize this famous restaurant). But my party commended highly on the migrant servers that work very fast and efficient and alert too. Sadly a couple of the local ones avoided eye contact even when we waved in the air. :(My guest also confirmed that this restaurant has become a pricey place to eat.Show less

Author: vanesxin
Title: tasty food
Review: Food is good, but sometimes bit pricey. Be there early or after peak hour to avoid long waiting time.

Author: wllmwong1
Title: Chinese home-cooked food
Review: Good tasty home cooked style. Mixture of Cantonese and Hokkien dishes. But can be bit pricey if you order fish and other special dishes.

Author: David GChristchurch, New Zealand
Title: Great flavours
Review: We went to this expecting a traditional restaurant and were surprised by the open air nature of it. Despite that we loved the food and enjoyed the hustle bustle around us. The service was great and what we wanted when coming to another country for the experience of the culture around us. We did get there late in the day and they had run out of their specials but it didn't stop the choice of food available.Show less

Author: Pauline CPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Over-Rated
Review: Tek Sen used to be really delicious, however the food standard has dropped. There are better restaurants out there. It is a good place for tourist to dine there but not for locals. We had a few dishes that was a tad too salty. The dishes lack "ooomph" and it was pretty disappointing. Perhaps the cook was rushing out dishes as the place was packed with people.Show less

Author: PLeeTanGeorge Town, Malaysia
Title: Great food at reasonable price
Review: Chinese Tzu Char restaurant. Unfortunately, difficult to park in a narrow lane. Long queue to get in but there is a waitress always monitoring the queue and organising patrons seats so the wait was not too long. Service was efficient. Menu was un english and chinese and the waitress recommended some specials. Loved the pork belly in black bean sauce in claypot. Was very delicious. The assam prawns was great. Overall the dishes made a great impression and definitely will be back to try the rest of the menu.Note: there is a private car park down the street, costs 2RM next to the fish head beehoon restaurant.Show less

Author: Agnes T
Title: Makan makan with friends
Review:
Nice fusion of nyonya & chinese.Popular with locals and Singaporeans.A must try for tourists
