.Famous for their fried roast pork, Assam Prawns,Hea Yah Keh Pork& Curry Fish to name a few.

Author: Mumbakes
Title: Good food
Review: All dishes are very good and tasty.  Enjoyed the food very much especially their fried assam prawns, claypot salted chicken, spicy fried roasted port with dark sauce,  Will definitely go back there.  However, their food is pricey compare to restaurant.

Author: chriskonstapel
Title: Best Food of our vacation
Review: We had to wait in line to get in but that was worth it! The place was packed with locals and the food was very good. The chicken with home made Thai sauce was the best we've eaten during our vacation.

Author: YingkaiOoi
Title: Yummy food
Review: Good food with childhood taste. All the food are great. I personally like the curry fish and the fried roasted pork the most!

Author: Kelly TGeorge Town, Malaysia
Title: Famous Chu Char
Review: My all time favourite: roasted pork fried with chilli padi, assam curry fish, sambal kangkung, bayam egg soup, assam prawn... I think they are also serving the authentic dishes like vinegar pork knuckle, yam pork, yam duck, salty fish slice pork pot etc. never try because everytime will stick with the standard order, but believe to be good... More pricy than normal chu char place.Show less

Author: HerianiJakarta, Indonesia
Title: Good Food bit Expensive
Review: The host was horrible, well, maybe because the restaurant were busy but people kept on coming. Food was really good though, we ordered 6 types of food with 4 plates of rice and 3 bottles of drinking water cost more than 200 ringgit. The restaurant itself was clean and organized. Show less

Author: Laryngospasm
Title: Delicious and affordable
Review:
We loved this restaurant so much we visited twice.  A good tip we learned is that this restaurant also accepts reservations.

We would recommend all the dishes with the hearts beside it. Loved

Author: Alan OPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: True Penang food
Review: This is another great nostalgic restaurant in Penang. They have quite a large menu, and all the dishes are very authentic local, home cooked food.The steam fish, tow yew bak,assam tumis fish, tu ka chor(vinegared trotters and the list just goes on. Food that my late mum and aunties used to cooked. Certainly brings back beautiful, nostalgic and tasty memories. Keep up the good work.Thank youShow less

Author: bsrepasky8Bangkok, Thailand
Title: Phenomenal food
Review: If you're looking for some unbelievable and unforgettable food, this is a mandatory stop in Georgetown, Penang. I have gone back twice already bc it is so amazing. Service is very fast and you literally can't go wrong on the huge menu, everything is delicious. *Recommend the Thai Chicken and Plum Chicken dishes with some white rice. Will definitely go back for thirds tomorrow! Show less

Author: 286thereseh
Title: Interesting chinese food
Review: The dim sum was interesting and tasty, and service was good. Price was also good. Not fine dining at all, but a interesting experice. Worth a visit.

Author: YYprivatelimitedLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Yummy local food
Review: Found the restaurant on tripadvisor and just tried the restaurant. Love the shophouse setting with high ceiling and fans. The restaurant is very well run and organise with friendly staff. Very busy restaurant with well manage waiting time. We ordered some very authentic dishes including vinegar pig trotter etc. The good was so delicious that I wish I had two stomach for second dinner. We had 4 perfect dishes for 3 person and the bill was under rm80 including homemade drinks. There is a car park nearby if you are driving. Show less

Author: johnsN970JLEssendon, Australia
Title: Highly Recommend
Review: An unique experience of local food in a crowded restaurant.We arrived at 6:45pm and there was already a line up to get into the restaurant. We at once gave our ordered for food from the displayed menu. Then We were given a number and within 10 mins were called into the restaurant to be seatedAfter 30 more minutes the beer plus food began to arrive.It was a crowded place, a table cloth here or there and spoon and fork placed in front of us.The food was out standing and that overcame all our other needs of:- fast service, elegant table arrangements, classy environment or even fast service.We had prawns. Double cooked pork, rice. fried chicken and greens. All dishes were outstanding. Plus two beers were enjoyed The added delight of the evening was the cheapest of the night.Highly recommend a visit here to delight your tastebuds.Hopefully will be back next week!!Show less

Author: 730reneej
Title: Unforgettably Decent Food
Review: Hearing about this famous local eats from a local friend, we made reservation on the day to avoid the long queue. We arrived on time yet still waited a bit because the place is overwhelmed!We ordered the roasted pork with chili and it is surprisingly yummy! The meat is tender and perfectly flavored, even though the presentation is not so impressive - but who cares?! I'm usually not a pork fan but I have to admit that this dish is really addictive!We also ordered a signature tofu - very small but crispy on the outside, oatmeal chicken - the oatmeal is not too thick to cover the taste of chicken, sambal Kang Kong - probably the least oily I've had so it doesn't dilute the spicy taste, and a dish of the day (some pork rob in spicy sauce) - not quite what I expected but still tastes nice!Of course this is not a high-end restaurant that offers you some elegant fancy dish, but it does make your stomach comfortable and satisfied by the authentic homemade style.Show less

Author: lkwangliSingapore, Singapore
Title: Simple, home cooked lunch
Review: The place was packed from the instant they opened their doors at 12pm. The flavours are done just right, without the blend of spices overpowering one another. We had the pork belly with chilli, steamed pomfret, and beans sprout with salted fish. Simple home-cooked comfort food, done perfectly. Show less

Author: Juboraw
Title: Delicious!
Review: Authentic food with fast service and delicious! Totally worth waiting in line for.  We had several dishes that included fish, prawns, chicken, pork and veggies! The menu is to understand and varied.

Author: HoC421
Title: Luscious Chinese Meal. Must go and worth trying!
Review: We arrived the restaurant around 6pm and the restaurant was already full. While queuing for our turn, their staff gave us the menu, recommended us some signature dishes, took our orders and gave us a number. We waited for around 15 minutes and we were brought to our table. Since they took our orders earlier before, the dishes were served not long after we were seated. I was really pleased and amazed with their professional and prompt services. I love all the appetizing dishes I ordered especially their Home Recipe Double Roasted Pork. The staff recommended their signature Home Recipe Double Roasted Pork with Chilli Padi, but we preferred something without chilli as the weather in Penang was scorching hot. The waiter said we can have it without chilli, and the dish turned out to be one of the best meal we had in Penang.Show less

Author: jjpms97Woodford, Australia
Title: All good
Review: Had the pork belly dish, a bit disappointing but the other dishes were fine. We went Sunday night and found a line at the door at six thirty. Our order was taken while in line then we waited to be seated, ten mins. Good place to eatShow less

Author: Kris B
Title: Delicious reasonably priced Chinese food
Review: You have to order the double braised pork dish.  It is out of this world yummy.  Everything there was good.  If you love Chinese food you will love this place.  It's located off of Chulia Street.

Author: 791michalr
Title: Excelent food and staff
Review:
WE had recommended food - chicken a pork and it was amazing. This restaurant is for everybody who love delicious food :)
It's a big mistake be In Penang and dont visit TEk Sen Restaurant!!!!!

Author: angels227
Title: Worth to try!
Review:
Very good food!!home cook style! will go again with family! !
Took Grab car cost 6 dollar from Gurney...

Author: Judith APittsburgh, Pennsylvania
Title: One mouthwatering dish after another
Review: From the outside Tek Sen Restaurant doesn't look like much, except for the crowds spilling out into the street. Fortunately we had looked up the best restaurants in Penang on our handy Trip Advisor app, and Tek Sen was at the top of the list. We went more than once, always sharing our table with friendly locals who kindly pointed out the best dishes and smiled approvingly at our use of chopsticks.Show less

Author: Sophie MLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Total Must in Penang
Review: Found this restaurant on TripAdvisor - was close to where we stayed. We were not disappointed. We arrived at about 7 and although there was a small queue it moved quickly and we were seated very soon. The place was clean with efficient service. We ordered the double Roasted pork, deep fried chicken in plum sauce and a delectable squid dish. All the food was fantastic- the chicken was our personal favourite. We chose the recommended dishes on the vegetables list which were also lovely. The food is good value- we spent about 20RM per person and were full. Incidentally the next day on a cookery course we asked the leader where we should eat in penang - and tek Sen was her first recommendation!Show less

Author: Jaturungkabart
Title: Must eat in Penang!
Review:
Will always have a meal here if you're in Penang.

Local chinese food.  Must go in a larger group to try as many dishes as you can.

Try to go early around 6pm for dinner... after that a queue builds up pretty fast.

Author: AllyW193
Title: good food & good food!
Review: super yummy bbq pork fried chilli, I can eat this everyday! all dishes are good, so just sit back order & enjoy!

Author: Winston LPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Lunchtime stop
Review: We have heard so much about this place and read about it on TripAdvisor. So on this trip to Penang, we decided to give it try. We made prior reservation but unfortunately our table was given away as we were late by 15 minutes (we tried calling to inform the restaurant that we would be late but no one answer our call). The person whom we spoke to was rude and unhelpful. Fortunately we only need to wait a short while for a table as it is not a place for decent conversation. Thankfully the person who took our order was efficient and helpful. Our order came quite quickly. Food was decent but a bit pricey considering the restaurant is nothing fancy. We paid RM403.70 for 11 person. Will we come again? Probably not. Will consider it as "been there done there".Show less

Author: _Hanna_5533Munich, Germany
Title: Extremely tasty
Review: After reading all the reviews here we went for dinner at Tek Sen tonight - early as we read about the queue - and were not disappointed. We asked for recommendations and went with the chicken (2. on menu) and the last vegetable dish with beans, shrimps and eggplant. Both dishes were simply amazing and tasted sooo good. While we were sitting there we could already see people waiting for a table, so we were really lucky to be there in time. Also the service is very friendly and quick.Show less

Author: deborah1212
Title: Great flavours and pleasant service.
Review:
We dined tonight- got there before 7pm and there was a queue by the time we finished. 
We really enjoyed the tofu dish. Also the stir fried potato leaves with sambol as well as the famous twice cooked pork.

Author: felecia_christinMedan
Title: Fantastic Dinner
Review: I ate here everytime i visited Penang. The Malay Chicken, steamed egg with century egg and salted egg, stir fried pork belly with chili padi and steamed fish in Hong Kong style is the must orders. The Malay chicken is kind of sweet and sour blended beautifully in juicy and tender chicken. You can taste the freshness of the fish by biting at the first bite, so good. Pork belly with chili padi and steamed egg which is so soft and melts in your mouth is a good side dish to enjoy with rice. If you are not a seafood allergy, order the stir fried clams with 'kam - heong'. For the beverage, i would recommend Iced Lime Juice which is slightly sweet and goes well with Penang hot weather.Show less

Author: Steve B
Title: There is a reason for the line.
Review: Stumbled into this place because I noticed a line, even before they were open. Figuring it must be good, gave it a try and it was tremendous. Found out later is is #1 on TripAdvisor and I can see why. Great food, cheap prices.

Author: Jonathan_NadNashville, TN
Title: Great food. Wish they'd accept credit cards though
Review: First off, the only reason why I took one star out is because they only accept cash. I just find this a major inconvenience, specially considering they attract a lot of people from all over the world and they are more a restaurant than a food stall. So tips if you are reading this, please take a wad of cash with you if you plan on splurging on some awesome food.The food here is excellent and so is the service. Lots of people have commented on the food, so no point in me repeating it.Show less

Author: alvinzaiSingapore, Singapore
Title: Rude, rude, rude. Just plain rude.
Review: Upon arrival, we were greeted by a male waiter who randomly pointed at an empty table. He then grabbed a few menus and threw them on the table after we were all seated. At first we thought that he was busy, thus the seemingly unfriendly behaviour. When we were ready to order, a lady (around her thirties) approached us with a REALLY grumpy face, and her attitude while taking our order was EXTREMELY TERRIBLE. It was as if being there in the restaurant was a big inconvenience to her. Being born and raised in Malaysia, my family and I understand that to be working in this particular industry, especially during the peak period is tough. However, the waitress's behaviour was totally inexcusable, she even told us to hurry up and tell her all our orders. She sighed, and clicked her tongue, and even rolled her eyes at us. She was so rude. Before the food even came, we all lost our appetites already. If you are someone who wouldn't care about the service despite paying service tax, this is the place to go. Cuz the food ain't that bad. Just the service. Show less

Author: travelbug81SingaporeSingapore
Title: Not bad for a meal
Review: The place was packed with people, including tourists, but the service was relatively fast. Service was good, friendly and the place was clean compared to most other similar eating places in Penang. We tried the recommended signature pork dish and it was different and good but definitely not something out of this world. The prices were reasonable as well, around MYR$10-$20 per dish, and we also tried the recommended mapo tofu dish and once again, it was decently good, but nothing out of the world. But all in all, still a good place for a meal that combines the local cuisine with some good service.Show less

Author: AlbangsarGeorge Town, Malaysia
Title: Tasty local dishes
Review: A restaurant that grew up from a roadside shack bears testament to its success over the years to be a full fledged local restaurant noted for its consistent quality in terms of food preparation and taste from the Old days. Reservations are a must for dinner times as they are really packed till about 8-830 in the evenings with locals (a good indicator of quality food as Penangnites are very particular about good food), expatraites and tourists alike. Dishes of note are the roast pork sauteed with dark soya sauce and chili, vinegar pork trotter stew, spicy and sour curried fish, asam or tamarind prawns....Show less

Author: Luvi L
Title: Great Food
Review: This restaurant deserves its good reputation. Service was swift, food is extremely tasty and prices are reasonable. Do visit this place if you're in Penang! (Go slightly before its lunch/dinner opening hours so you don't have to queue)

Author: n b
Title: DON'T MISS!
Review: We had a little wait to get a table but took that as a good sign and was not disappointed! THE BEST pork dish I have ever eaten!

Author: Joris W
Title: Great food !
Review: BE ready to queue as the place is always crowded! But there is a reason for that, it's awesome. Don't expect fancy decoration, chair or table cloth... you're not there for that. The food is amazing specialy the home made tofu as well as the double grilled porc. they serve you fast and the price is ok, not cheap not expensive, it's value for money. Squid is cooked to perfection... i really got nothing to complain about this place. JUST PERFECTShow less

Author: lizzzzzzzpOxford, United Kingdom
Title: Delicious
Review: Reasonably priced food that is absolutely delicious. Speedy service- don't be put off by the queue! Have the fried chicken with red Thai style sauce, it is so so good (we went back for more!) Whilst here in Penang we have found this closed on a Tuesday.Show less

Author: Edmund M
Title: Good food at cheap prices
Review: Went to the restaurant after seeing recommendations on trip advisor. Food is decent considering the cheap prices. However, services could be improved.

Author: Mike1238Woking, United Kingdom
Title: Wow
Review: Just visited this place, I went on the suggestion of a friend who is from Penang and I'm so glad he told me about this restaurant. Went at 7.30 and it was busy, people queuing outside but luckily as I was on my own I got a table straight away. Pretty big menu so I just went with the suggested dishes of the double cooked chilli pork and the mapo tofu. Pork was good, sticky and juicy with the just right amount of spice but the tofu was just perfect, silky and spicy and salty just what it is supposed to be like. Portions are a reasonable size and the price is good it's not the cheapest place to eat compared to other local places but this is definitely worth it. Show less

Author: Damien KMelbourne, Victoria, Australia
Title: Very good, bording on excellent!
Review: Brilliant pork signature dish, fat juicy prawns (if a little too heavy on the batter and a lack of garlic in the mayonnaise) and a slightly insipid bok choy with small prawns. The pork was 10/10 and well worth going back for. Bok Choy is a fairly tasteless vegetable (we have it at home regularly) and can benefit from a little bit of additional flavor (garlic, lime and a pinch of salt and pepper works well). Prawn batter a little closer to tempura would have been good, but in all a pretty decent meal. Obviously popular with locals as well as tourists, the 'specials' board was written in Chinese characters, which was a plus rather than a minus for authenticity! For the money, it's hard not to give it a go.Show less

Author: YWengCKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good and competent
Review: We went due to the great reviews and also took into consideration the wait should we arrive late. However, it was our lucky day and we were seated at one of the last tables. Service was fast and prompt. Food is good but not outstanding. Fried pork was a tad too sweet. Maybe we ordered the wrong dishes. We still think it's a good choice if someone has had too many days of street food.Show less

Author: Nancy C
Title: Yummy😋
Review: Excellent food and service!  Roasted Pork was simply delicious and the other two dishes were tasty as well.  Portion was good for a family of three.  Will be back😊

Author: beanooGeorge Town, Malaysia
Title: Best Roast Pork fried with Chilli Padi & Thick Black Caramelized Soy Ever
Review: Tek Sen has been a staple for family outings ever since it started as a tiny road side store until it expanded into a full fledged restaurant today. Locals call By many names including one called "Top Hat" because one of the chefs used to wear a chef's tall hat when he was working. It serves really good "Choo Char" which literally translates to "Cook Fry" a local term for fresh cooked food usually various dishes served with rice. Favourite dishes include their black soy sauce roast pork fried with chilli padi, pomfret curry, steamed egg, morning glory fried with sambal and many more. Be prepared to pay for the food though. It isn't the most economical meal in town but totally worth it. Popular with locals and tourist alike be sure to go early to get a seat. Show less

Author: Bianca H
Title: Divine food and great service
Review: We went here twice in our 3 day stay because the food was so good. The service is also excellent, friendly and fast. I urge you to try the fried chicken in Thai sauce!

Author: Cheah D
Title: Delicious food
Review: They provided good food here . Any of the foods are nice especially the pork , I'm not a pork lover but their pork really make me fall in love 😁

Author: J_Tan_KLKuala Lumpur
Title: Underwhelming and over hyped
Review: Visited this place due to good reviews everywhere. Went on the dot 6pm and it was most full. We ordered all their recommended signature dishes. It was edible, not awful but I really wont miss any of them. If its much of a wait and long queue, I would suggest going elsewhere. Show less

Author: LaVoyageuse777
Title: Ok
Review:
Lots of choices, but a bit of a touristy feel (apparently it's features in several guide books). 

Food was ok, but there a plenty of way better and way more affordable options in Penang!

Author: drjonathann
Title: Still as good after 15 years
Review: yes, my last visit to this eatery was 15 years ago and nothings changed. Food is still as good as ever. Prices have gone up of course. Ask for price before placing orders.

Author: frydayukHigh Wycombe, United Kingdom
Title: Best Chinese food i have ever had!!
Review: Being from England i have tried a lot of Chinese food over the years. Until visiting Tek Sen i never knew Chinese food could taste so good.You have to queue to enter and the place is always packed being a no frills restaurant. The prices are cheap and the quality of food is amazing. We visited twice and would love to go back.Show less

Author: WTBAALondon, United Kingdom
Title: A must if in Penang
Review: Come early and just enjoy. An experience of a lifetime for me and one of my best meals ever. This place is a gem, an institution. I could not get enough of the chicken with Thai sauce. The locals flock here in droves. They also take bookings. Service is excellent and very friendly. Everything we had was just superb.Show less

Author: phouska
Title: Traditional
Review: As this place is a very traditional outfit we had to try it. My roasted port was splendid however my girlfriends tofu not so much. You got to choose carefully. Anyhow, good food for slightly higher price than you would expect in georgetown.

Author: 2RightyPerth, Australia
Title: Pretty Good for some
Review: As a westerner I thought the meals too small and not that good. Overrated in fact. The moth that landed in my beer was not impressed either. My wife loved the food using the boiled rice and small portions to eat Asian style, and she was impressed. Kids were not fans. Relying on fried rice to save the day did not work as it was pretty poor and quite anaemic.Show less

Author: Andrew T
Title: Awesome
Review: Surely worth the wait.  Food are served quite fast and quality is consistently good over the years. Price is reasonable.

Author: Hannah RLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Fantastic local food
Review: This is a great place to eat with the locals some amazing dishes.We were overwhelmed by the menu, so we asked the staff for recommendations. They didn't disappoint - we had special of the day which was chicken in tamarind, fish curry and a pork dish (I can't remember what it was but it was lovely!).Far too much food but fantastic to try a few dishes. Everything was delicious.The place was packed which says how great the food is. Show less

Author: andrasbuBudapest, Hungary
Title: not impressed
Review: looking at the amount of people queuing every night and the reviews on tripadvisor we arrived with high expectations. Some of the food (fish in soy sauce and the starter - vegetables with prawns) was good, the chicken main was boring, and the daily soup was outright inedible. The prices are not cheap for Malaysia (2 soups 2 starters 2 simple mains and 4 nonalcoholic beverages for 2 people 120+ ringgit) and the quality is nothing to be excited about. you are much better off eating some street food just around the corner.Show less

Author: indobestcoffeeMedan, Indonesia
Title: Still marvelous
Review: Been there tonite for a dinner with my spouse. The foods still delicious as before. Come there before 7 pm to avoid long wait. Try their fried lala, roasted 'sio-bak' and kam heong prawns which are among their signature dishes. Price is worth it. Not expensive. Service is fast.Show less

Author: carsam ckuala lumpur
Title: Home Cooked Meal
Review: Our Penang guide took us to this restaurant & judging by the long queue, the food must be good. We ordered Ginger Vinegar Pork Knuckles, Fried prawns, Kow Choy, Salted Tow Fu soup, Fried Chicken,Assam Fish, Bean Curd & Fried Roasted Pork. The food was average & on the high price as we paid RM 400.00 I was told by the guide it was the foreigners who upped the the price.We met the owner, Mr Chan & he was very modest. He started off as as a Road Side stall & now he has 2 shoplots.. Check it out.Show less

Author: Storyteller149210
Title: Excellent
Review: You know it's good when there's a queue of about 8 groups waiting outside to get in. And when your in a Chinese restaurant and it's packed full of Penang locals that's another good sign. This place is definitely worth a visit for a great lunch or dinner- it's even worth queueing up for.Show less

Author: Sien Mei TManchester, United Kingdom
Title: Great food, great service!
Review: Looked on trip advisor for local food and we saw that this place was near us and had a great rating. Ordered prawns which were very fresh and delicious. Was full of local customers which is always a good sign. Would recommend coming here for local food and a reasonable price! Show less

Author: Zheng D
Title: Amazing Chinese food!!!
Review: Friendly and fast service, clean environment and good quality of food!! Various choices of food. Love it!!! Will go there again next time!!

Author: Judy P
Title: Good food,good service
Review: Didnt plan to have dinner there cos most reviews said it's hard to get a table.Passed by at 6.15 and saw a few empty tables so just walked in and greeted by a young man and recommend us to try their specials of the day.We had 5 dishes plus 2 types of soup and the bill was just $102.When I returned on the same street at 7.45,there were a dozen customers waiting outside,so go early to enjoy some good food and service if you trust our reviewsShow less

Author: d0ndequieraLos Angeles
Title: Bring an appetite
Review: Tek Sen is popular and fills up quickly. Luckily turnover at the tables is also fast, so you don't have to wait long. The food was all delicious with a great variety of dishes. It's Chinese, but it may not be exactly what you expect from Chinese food if you are from North America (even good Chinese food there). We loved every single dish we ordered and found ourselves looking at other tables wishing we had more room to order more food.Show less

Author: xienyao
Title: Good, cheap food but have to queue for tables...
Review: Good, cheap chinese cuisine in the heart of Penang but be prepared for the long queues for a table!   Still the dishes justify the wait... remember to order the stir-fried pork belly with sweet soy sauce, heavenly!

Author: Justin E
Title: 5-star dining 3-star price
Review: I'm here at least once a month for dinner. The crowd here is madness therefore I come as early as possible. 6-6.30pm for early dinner. The staff are friendly and you can ask what's their specialty. Many tourists and locals will try to make their way here whenever the can. Even before we managed to finish our dinner, you can see people gathering/queuing to get tables. Some were waiting just next to our table waiting for us to get up. Sometimes it's uncomfortable to have people stare at you when you are enjoying the food on your table. BUT, that is not the restaurant 'so fault. It's the people that are impatient. Food review: 5 stars.Show less

Author: sheila026Vancouver, Canada
Title: Do not know what the hype is about
Review: Food was ok. Nothing spectacular. Service was good up to a point. But it is a get a table, sit down, order, eat , and leave place. Recommended by a hotel employee who has heard only rave reviews, but not tried the food at the restaurant.Show less

Author: 997richardpRockhampton, Australia
Title: Lines out the door...for a reason
Review: This place is permanently packed...and with good reason...we ordered our food from the outside steps before we could even enter...by the time our table came up. So to did our foodAnd it was delicious...the twice cooked pork was great and on trip advisor recommendations I tried the sweet and sour...this was more for western tastes but was still ok. The. We dad the tofu and salt and pepper squid which was greatThis place is worth the high rankingShow less

Author: 579mst
Title: Excellent food
Review: There was not enough of us to try everything but the homemade tofu was excellent, the pork mouth watering and the squid divine. This place is frantically busy but worth the wait.

Author: TeeBirdFliesPortland, Oregon
Title: Holy Crap.
Review: I'm so glad I checked this place out before the end of my trip! You HAVE to go there and go there early! We went there 15 minutes before the listed opening time and it was already open! We snagged a table and within the next 10-15 minutes the entire place was full with more parties waiting to be seated. At the time, we were the only foreigners, so maybe the locals know to go before the "opening time." The service was a little shoddy. It seemed as though we were forgotten about or were perhaps not given as much priority as the many locals/regulars, but eventually we caught someone's attention and got our order in. Food was fantastic! Most of us got the double-roasted pork and those who didn't regretted it (not because their choices were poor, but just because the double-roasted pork is SO good!). Prices seemed reasonable. I also tried one of their homemade hot tea blends (chinese), which was delicious.It's also a short walk from Love Lane, not difficult to find, but not on the main drag.Show less

Author: calvin2424Boston, Massachusetts
Title: Good Chinese food.
Review: Friend and I visited this restaurant. It was popular because the line was long. Lucky the line moved fast. The service is really fast. We ordered the fried tofu, stir fried water spinach with shrimps, pork fat with garlic, stir fried prawns with tamarind sauce (must have) and curry fish stomach. All of the dishes are good.Show less

Author: JinTheTravelerSingapore
Title: You. Must. Go.
Review: Actually did't know about this place, but followed my random friends from hostel. Thought it was just normal restaurant but when we got there it was full of people. (and it was only 18:20!) Ordered some vegs and porks. Veg was just so-so, was okay. But when we started to eat pork, we said like 'oh. my. the best food i've ever had in Malaysia.' it was caramelized pork or something if i'm not wrong. And I talked about this restaurant to my local friends, they all know this and even locals said this is one of the best restaurant in Penang.Show less

Author: STEVE Q
Title: The reviews are right this place is very good
Review: This is a definite must visit even if you are only in Georgetown for a short period.  It is worth it on a VFM basis even if no other reason but when also combined with great food and a good atmosphere it was really enjoyable

Author: Leonie GKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Absolutely fabulous
Review: This restaurant was a standout for our 6 days in Penang. Traditional food cooked and served fresh with loads of flavour. Many locals lining up to get in so book in advance if you can. Must try this restaurant if you are looking for great food and good prices. Show less

Author: OrderForSteve
Title: Good food. Reasonable price
Review: Family with 18 month. Had dinner at the restaurant, no aircon but lots of fans which was ok. Service was nice and quick. Food was nice and well priced. It was very busy with a line waiting out the door. Would come back again.

Author: GGxoxoMelbourne, Australia
Title: A restaurant with fantastic food and no frills
Review: The food was some of the best we've had in our lives let alone in Penang. The place was packed with both locals and tourists alike, and while the service was not overly quick and not much ambiance to speak of, if you want real authentic food at reasonable prices, it's worth a visit. Book to avoid disappointment - we had to wait about 15 minutes and were seated on a table with another random couple. it's only open about 5 hours a day and seems to be constantly pumping. We had the double roasted pork, deep fried chicken with chilli, and stir-fried bitter gourd with minced pork, diced prawns and duck egg, The pork and chicken were unbelievable - so much flavour and a generous serving for only 16 RM each! The vegetable dish was honestly a random choice - we were craving some veggies and this dish had a little love heart next to it. Neither of us had ever tried gourd and it seems to be an acquired taste - quite bitter and an odd texture. I assume it's nice for people who like gourd! There were plenty of other dishes available too. I also tried a nutmeg squash which was very interesting but very nice. All in all, pay it a visit if you enjoy good food and can do without a nice setting for an evening.Show less

Author: katharinebooth
Title: The best food in George Town!
Review:
Friends took us here one night, then we returned almost every day after!

The food was absolutely delicious, the service was brilliant and the prices are good too.

Try the double cooked pork, but you have to get there early- they sell out everyday!

Author: 8hereandthere8London, United Kingdom
Title: Fantastic venue for lunch
Review: If you want a really authentic local restaurant with lovely food at a very reasonable price then this is the place. It's packed with locals so this tells you how popular it is. The menu (in English) is sophisticated with lots of great choices. Try the barley with lime as a refreshing drink the pork with yam and the salt and pepper squid. All really delicious. The staff were super helpful and friendly. A great choice for a lovely lunch.Show less

Author: Missbee18
Title: Great food and good value
Review: Takes around 20-30 mins for the food, but it is very worth to try!! Too delicious especially for their special menu.

Author: RonA_Plymouth
Title: Very busy
Review: If you want to eat quickly this is not for you as it is very busy. It is noisey atmospheric and the food is great, worth a visit.

Author: BigDadd
Title: Good Malaysian Home Cooking Food!  Very popular with locals and tourist
Review: Good family restaurant.  Food is Malaysian Chinese home cooking. Low use of MSG which is good. However, gets very busy and be prepared to wait. Crowd builds up outside in the evenings.

Author: davidpY6897KDHappy Valley, China
Title: Great food and good value
Review: Good authentic Asian food in a restaurant founded in the 1960s. Prawn omelette, sweet and sour pork, twice cooked roasted pork, deep fried chicken with oatmeal, braised tofu and rice all good. Good value: fed four adults and four kids for 120 Ringgit.A good mix of locals, other Asians and a few expats.A word of warning for Westerners - the toilets are clean but Asian; there is no toilet paper so either take your own or be prepared to use the hose!Show less

Author: Daphne C
Title: Very very awesome food
Review:
Delicious food with reasonable price
Highly recommend the Char Siew Bak, Sambal Kangkong, Plum Sauce Chicken, Lai ya soup
Good variety
Clean and comfortable interior
Friendly service

Author: B WMelbourne, Australia
Title: Get the duck
Review: Tek Sen is a great restaurant with an comparatively extensive menu. Prices are a bit higher than a lot of George Town (~16 ringgit for std main) but the service is very quick and easy so it balances out.What this set this apart for me was the duck with ginger (24 ringgit) from their specialty menu. It was huge, I couldn't believe it. It was probably a whole quarter with heaps of delicious breast meat and a wing and some thigh as well as some organs (kindey or liver? I didn't eat). Easily enough meat for two with some veg on the side. Probably literally 3-4x as much meat as I've got with any other meal here. And delicious. So tender.Missus got a prawn omelette, was also good but nothing on the duck. Show less

Author: yinster
Title: Best Meal in Penang
Review:
Great Hakka food. Everything tasted so fresh. Great value for money. 
We did not have to queue as there was only 2 of us.

Author: Katherine B
Title: Good food, quick service
Review: We went as a group of 8 for lunch. The service was great - fast and friendly. The food is typical Penang dishes, all done well with plenty of choice. It doesn't have comfy seats and air con so don't go if that is what you're looking for. However, if you want a place that does good local food I would definitely recommend it Show less

Author: indobestcoffeeMedan, Indonesia
Title: Price not cheap anymore
Review: We have eaten since many many years ago and we always came to the restaurant each time we come to the town. But on our latest visit (actually today) we are a bit surprised with the price which according to is not worth it and not cheap anymore as their trade mark for many years, serve good food with reasonable price. Anyway the quality of the food still ok.Show less

Author: sooch74
Title: As a local, I know better spots but food is ok la
Review: Food prices are good for tourists not so much for locals. It's certainly home cooked but it's not that great as the ratings on tripadvisor has given

Author: brucel15
Title: Delicious food
Review:
We had a lovely lunch at Tek Sen as the food is really tasty and fresh. It is worth a visit.
Go early to avoid queueing!
The only drawback is that the place is noisy as it is set up like a top-end food court.

Author: Yap KNegeri Sembilan, Malaysia
Title: Food Okay
Review: Food is quite good & the price ok. Come early if you want a table for dinner or you have to queue for a table when the crowd begins to pour in. Now is the holiday season, the crowd keeps filling up on every table there's available quickly. Friendly waitress to take your orders. Try it. Btw, this is a non-halal restaurant.Show less

Author: socdev25Sydney
Title: Wonderful local food - traditional Peranakan
Review: This is a very busy traditional restaurant - that is, no frills, no fuss, but the food is stunning. We had Asian greens cooked with garlic and shiitake mushrooms and crispy chicken with subtle spices. The food was served quickly and very freshly cooked. We arrived at 7:45 pm and seemed to miss the busiest time as the queue in front of us moved fast and we got a table for 2 quickly, while behind there was no queue. The woman taking orders while we were in the queue and then directing the tables was a performance to watch in her own right. My one negative point is that the only beer they had when we were there was Heineken (which just didn't seem authentic); there is Tiger and other beers on the menu. Overall great value for money and one of the most extensive and varied menus I have seen in this type of restaurant. This is not a smart restaurant but it is genuine and for someone from my part of the world great value.Show less

Author: MPCURLYSingapore, Singapore
Title: A highly recommended local delight
Review: My last visit was exactly a year ago, and what I liked about this local restaurant, which is also a popular spot for the local is the consistency in their food quality. The speed of serving the dishes despite a packed restaurant is also a plus point for this efficiently managed restaurant. My pick of "a must try" is : the spicy fried roast pork, the steam 3 eggs which is very smooth and their assam prawns. I am not a prawn lover, but this assam prawn dish really leaves an impression. I ordered a green lime drink, and I really like the refreshing lime aroma, the citric and yet not too acidic drink really freshened me up for a hot afternoon. 6 dishes with drinks for 4 of us , cost us about RM$105, very reasonably priced. If you have a craving for a home cook meal after tasting all the great Penang hawker foods, this is really a highly recommended choice.Show less

Author: david_in_oregonPortland
Title: Tasty and reasonably priced
Review: A somewhat scrappy, casual place. Sit down, order quick. The food appearance was basic, but the taste was remarkably good.People complained about long waiting, but we walked right in at 6.00pm.4 points out of 5 because the food exceeded expectations for such a place and such a price. It's not haute cuisine, but it seems good compared to the general standards of food quality in Penang.Show less

Author: hweesuantSingapore, Singapore
Title: SIMPLY Yummy
Review: We ordered 8 dishes and they all tasted superb. The steam teochew promfet was fresh and delicious. Assam prawn was well cooked with right level of sweetness. Sambal Kang Kong was surprising not spicy which suited my taste. Overall , also value for money. I would recommend to whoever misses traditional home cooked food. Show less

Author: VC S
Title: Excellent food with very traditional setting
Review: Great food, especially the chasiu with chili. Very easy place with traditional set up, come early to get a seat.

Author: jennyannecatherineEast Peckham, United Kingdom
Title: Amazing - some of the best food I've ever eaten. & a total steal!
Review: Absolutely loved this restaurant- so much so that we went back the next night for more(!). Our favourite dishes were the Boneless pork ribs, the deep fried chicken with umeboshi sauce & the steamed fish with home recipie soy sauce...but you rally can't go wrong! Good service too. Well worth a trip, although be warned - it's more local street food rather than fine dining restaurant & it closes early!Show less

Author: AdriannaAye
Title: Really busy but worth it!
Review: This was recommended to me by the hotel I stayed at. It was really busy when I visited at lunchtime, but that was because of the great food on offer.  Quick service, good prices.

Author: TanKokTongSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good Food, Great Atmosphere
Review: Reach around 2pm where crowd was thinning out.Had a table for 10 people, service was fast and friendly.Ordered 9 dishes, ranges from fish to chicken to pork to vegetables to eggs..Every dish turns out great with sufficient proportion.Total bill came at RM250 which was acceptable.Great place to visitShow less

Author: Kopite52Sentosa Island, Singapore
Title: A Hybrid experience = 50% upmarket hawker / 50% low end restaurant but great food
Review: The Chinese-Malaysian food is freshly cooked and delicious and inexpensive. No booking and you may have to wait it's like an upmarket hawker stall, cash only, no cards. Their double cooked pork dish is oily fatty and delicious, their signature dish. Highly recommended. Tofu is also amazingly good.Show less

Author: peterpatterpotGeorge Town, Malaysia
Title: Over rated, normal but overpriced
Review: It started as a simple local food place with reasonable priced dishes and friendly service ... BUT with its popularity and crowded tourists the restaurant food and service has deteorated in its quality. And price has increased esp if you order fish , please ask for the price first! We ordered a steam fish for 4 adults and ended up paying rm105 for that one fish alone ! Service is very abrupt and unfriendly n impatient waitress. Now we do not go there to have meals anymore. Show less

Author: PizzaWithFetaBasel
Title: Excellent authentic diner
Review: We visited once for dinner. It is more a diner than a restaurant. The ambience is a bit noisy, but agreeable. The personnel was very kind and fast. But most importantly the food was very nice and tasty. There was a big variety of Chinese dishes. Overall totally recommended Show less

Author: gregorioz191
Title: Real food experience
Review: What a meal! In a nut-shell: easy, affordable, good quality, good service, quick, diverse range of foods, very good waiters recommendations, local, a must for a stay in Georgetown.

Author: 664annabellem
Title: Love love love it!
Review: Went here for dinner and loved every last bit of it! We turned up and got a table straight away but when we left there was a big line to get in, so get in early or be prepared to wait.

Author: 15steenw
Title: Very clean, great food and great atmosphere
Review:
Also very good priced. Great staff and loads of locals says something about the quality. 
Come at 1920 as all locals seem to arrive at 1930.

Author: JoTong888Penang Island, Malaysia
Title: If you would like to try Penangites Home cook food at reasonable price
Review: This is really authentic home cook food at very reasonable price. Though presentation may not be like those in air-conditioned restaurants but what the heck....Tastes like mom's cooking from the good ole days!! Yummy! It is always very crowded. To avoid disappointment, do try to arrive earlier...say 6pm.Show less

Author: allfunandgamesAuckland
Title: Bustling, Delicious, Order the Duck.
Review: Went here on a recommendation from a local chef (at the also excellent Junk Cafe), and had a terrific meal. Clean and simple setup, with an extensive menu that helpfully highlights what the most popular dishes are. HIGH RECOMMEND the braised duck stirred in chilli (bottom left of the menu). We ordered a second plate it was so good - it isn't very spicy, but if you order it without the spice it is still amazing. Of of the best plates of food we have ever eaten.Mains are around 18R each for the medium size, and you probably need three dishes of that size between two hungry adults. A good way to try other options on the menu:)Show less

Author: Tom1397Houston, Texas
Title: Enjoyed it
Review: Went here with a friend on a week night. It was very crowded, but the friend had made reservations, so we were easily able to get a table. The food was very good but we had to substitute an item for another that was sold out. The atmosphere was OK, but it is not fine dining.Show less

Author: Jajourney06
Title: Always crowded = Great food :)
Review: This restaurant always crowded on dinner time. recommended came early. There do have today special menu & the routine one. Good is very good taste and quality. I think is time for they to expand their space :)

Author: ryanteoGuangzhou, China
Title: Excellent food
Review: This restaurant is popular among local residents for family dinner or entertaining visitors. If you would like to avoid the crowd, have your dinner here before 6pm. Dishes are served promptly, cooked to quality local taste and staff service is good. We especially like stir-fried roasted pork, vegetable curry, signature tofu.Show less

Author: M ASingapore, Singapore
Title: Good value Chinese food
Review: A busy traditional coffee shop style establishment. We went for dinner on the late side so didn't have to wait for a table. At peak meal time, probably worthwhile making a reservation. The food was delicious and very affordably priced. Portions are on the small side but good for small groups; allows you to try more dishes. A great place for dinner and when you wish to take a break from Penang hawker food. Show less

Author: 873madelaineb
Title: So good we went 3 days in a row...
Review:
We loved it here - the history, service and above all, the food. The balance of flavors were spot on - salty, chili, sweet...our favorite dishes were the twice cooked pork chilli padi and the fried tofu with egg and seafood. 
Best food!

Author: ChalkmqEnmore, Australia
Title: Best Chinese food I've had in Penang
Review: We stumbled on the Tek Sen restaurant when we were heading back to our accommodation and saw the crowd gathered inside. As is always the case, if there is a crowd of locals inside a restaurant it is guaranteed to have pretty bloody good food. Not wanting to miss out on a great feed we went in and had the double roasted pork, eggplant, and sweet and sour chicken. Oh boy! Everything was so fresh, flavours superb, great sauces, meat tender, and service quick. A must go!Show less

Author: mikefromnoosa
Title: Best in Penang
Review:
Very interesting  and innovative menu and the food we ordered was sensational.
Suggest you order the most popular dishes which we did and all were fantastic
This is not street food, this is trendy , innovative food at bargin prices

Author: Peter_Clare_50Perth, Australia
Title: Assam to die for
Review: We had a lovely meal in this busy restaurant with lots of locals.The Assam fish curry was amazing. Such a fine balance of sour and spice. Just perfect, I ordered more rice as I had to finish all of the amazing Assam broth. A dish not to be missed.We also had twice cooked pork and a green vegetable dish. Both good and we walked out very full and satisfied. Price was very reasonable.Show less

Author: TIMOTHYWETTONUK
Title: Try the pork dishes
Review: We went here twice it was so good. It's rustic and no-frills. It's can get busy in the evening. The dishes we had were all fantastic. The prose dishes stand out the most and also the cereal chicken. Would go back for sure. A good place for first time travelers to Asia to more cautiously try street food dishes. Show less

Author: alipoonSydney, Australia
Title: Perfect mix of Cantonese food with Malay influence
Review: We came as a recommendation from a food guide. Perfect way to experience the way locals eat and what they eat! The kai lan with salted fish is just like my grandma's cooking. You do have to wait in line but they'll have you look at the menu & get you to order before being seated. There was a mixture of foreigners & locals alike! Great prices, great food, great atmosphere! Show less

Author: IverrencePenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Used to be a great dining place
Review: I've been a regular customer of this place ever since I was young, way before they relocated to the current shop lot they are at now, the pork was always good, same goes to the stir fried water spinach with chilli paste. However, as their popularity increases, the quality and value continue to deteriorate. From the perspective of a Penang local and my fiancée who is from the States, we both agreed that this place isn't worth of its price. Don't get us wrong, we are not some cheapskates who only go for cheap yet big type of deal food. We patronise upper scale restaurants down to local eateries, we enjoy all kinds of food. But for this place, it has just gotten ridiculous, a regular plate of veggie, its signature pork, and also the claypot chicken, all these dishes were over priced and yet the portions were ridiculously small, simply pathetic. The bean curd (tofu) was RM22+, bean curd at such price? Not only that, the staff asked us to try one of their signature dishes, salted fish with pork, we tried to say no but the staff was rather persistent, so we agreed. Guess what? It was RM26+ for that small claypot of pork. We were rather disappointed with the overall value of the meal. The food quality was average but the value itself was poor. I must say, as a regular customer, I am extremely disappointed with the restaurant as it is now. Would I still be a regular? Probably not.Show less

Author: familyinabackpackToulouse, France
Title: Small overpriced portions
Review: We ate here based on a recommendation from our hotel.The food was nice enough but the portions were extremely small and expensive for Penang.It is fine, but we are on a tight budget so there are better places that do as good food for much less.Show less

Author: haany2017
Title: Just awesome
Review: Fantastic dishes. Wouldn't think twice about going back especially the pork, the fried kangkung in sambal and bean curd soup 👍🏻👍🏻

Author: MrinalP30
Title: Wonderful Chinese food!
Review: Very nice and tasty chinese food. Must try!The food is simple, home cooked and delicious! The entire decor is simple and nice! Excellent!!

Author: Solesouljoy
Title: Best Assam!
Review: We loved the Assam stingray (fresh), honey pork (double cooked pork dish highlighted on the menu) and prawn omelette!! Service is fast and we appreciated that they had many fans around to keep the place ventilated. It's crowded over dinner time so do make reservations

Author: 996claudinetAng Mo Kio, Singapore
Title: Good & Fresh
Review: Travelled with a bunch of foodie friends to Penang for a weekend getaway. We ordered 9 dishes + fish maw soup. We had steamed pomfret (teochew style), honey pork, prawn paste chicken, grilled prawns, eggs with onions, assam stingray + vegetables. Must say that the fish was very fresh (my favourite dish here). Honey pork was obviously a winner and we had to order a second helping. Assam stingray was equally good with sizable portion of stingray. Was somewhat disappointed with the grilled prawns as it was overcooked and the sauce was overpowering the taste of the prawns. Our bill including a few bottles of beer was just over RMB500.Overall, I must say it was a great meal and good value. Will certainly visit again if i'm back in Penang.Show less

Author: Sgp_traveller74Singapore, Singapore
Title: Good service, Simple Chinese Tze char menu done well
Review: Beyond the Hawker fare that Penang is known, if you need a simple Chinese dinner with rice and dishes, this is it. Reasonably priced, but not so elderly or child friendly with its metal stools and lack of child utensils. Still the older Chinese folks will be satisfied by its quality of its food.As a tourist I felt rushed with its long queues. I got there early and didn't have to wait for a table unlike the rest. Still most locals eat and go, and is not a place to linger during dinner time.Show less

Author: Girlie TGeorge Town, Malaysia
Title: Food like mom used to make
Review: Thiis is d kind of food i grew up eating...wholesome and delicious! Unfortunately I hv not inherited mom or dad's skills in d kitchen so am constantly in search of home cooked style food.There are many choices but I would recommend d steamed fish, in any variation. Soups, especially d ones with pork ribs. Veges, fried just with garlic or d more spicy sambals. Go early as it gets full pretty fast. It's also quite warm so bring along a hand fan. But I think the great food will occupy more if ur attention!Show less

Author: MarioC352Helsinki, Finland
Title: The best indoor street food in Penang
Review: One of Georgetown's great attractions is the so called "street food". Tek Sen, with its open space, could be called the best "indoor street food" in Penang. There is a queue, the place looks like organized chaos, it is noisy, but the service is quick and the food sublime. Not to be missedShow less

Author: RobertJGray
Title: As good as it gets
Review:
Don't expect fine dining but excellent food, quick service and no hanging about. This is Chinese at it's best.

The double cooked pork belly is exquisite.

No faults.

Author: StarstruckTravelerAustin, Texas
Title: Chinese food at the heart of Penang Island
Review: I visisted this place as a recommendation from one of my friends. It was pretty full when we got there and they took our others very promptly. It was a little disorganized when the food came out of the kitchen as they didn't know which dish belonged to who. Their drinks are pretty good and they have reasonable prices.You only have to be careful about those dishes who have "Market Price" on them so be sure to ask before you order! You can spend between 16 to 35 RM depending on what you order excluding the special "Market price" dishes as the prices vary.Overall is it was a pretty good experience and they have a good customer service, will come again! Very recommended. Note that it can get really crowded at times so don't be discouraged if there is a long wait line, it is worth it.Show less

Author: sophiang
Title: Penang home cooking at its best
Review: Authentic Chinese coffee shop refurbished with typical steel round tables and chairs. Food is bloody marvelous and yum all the way. Highly recommended and one of my favorite spots

Author: RlylySingapore, Singapore
Title: Superb good food!!!!
Review: Their food is tip top and very very good... Should try their speciality that changed daily so you will always surprised yourself with what they will offer you.. Eaten for 2times but never get any dissapointed... I dont think they charge too expensive and i did being charge overpriced for some kind of not nice peranakan restaurant mum's kitchenShow less

Author: Tizian R
Title: Amazing Food!
Review: The meat is perfect and we had much fun sharing the food around the table! Sometimes it is really busy, so take some time.

Author: Ryan K
Title: a must try
Review: get there early. The food is crazy good and its a must try. Some dishes more expensive than others some more suited to an adventerous pallette.

Author: feltroneuGeorge Town, Malaysia
Title: Unreasonable pricing
Review: Having dinner there with some of the visitors from China. We are 5 together and order 6 dishes. The portion is relatively small which did not match to the price they charged. The most unreasonable price is the Asam prawn where 6 average size of prawn costing RM47.70 including GST. My visitors complaint they have never ate so expensive prawn before. I really felt shame. The other dish is taufu where they only serve 3 pieces of small taufu and charged us for RM19+. Taufu is a very cheap dish. Taste is so so and service is not up to our expectation as the waitress was a bit rude. I think I am not the only one complaining the food is pricy. With same price I think I can order even crab at another restaurant. So be aware.Show less

Author: Jenni W
Title: Great
Review: Just YUM ! The double cooked pork and the home made tofu are just wonderful. Get there early or book during the day it's worth it.

Author: SkaramooshEdmonton, Canada
Title: Loved It!
Review: This establishment lies within the UNESCO Heritage Site and has gained a reputation for great Hainanese food. They open for lunch between 12 noon - 3:00pm and then for dinner between 6:00 - 9:00pm...closed on Tuesdays.We were a party of 7 and we ordered 9 dishes. They were all tasty! They serve cold beers which is always a plus for me. Price-wise it was reasonable. Staff were friendly. Service was fairly quick. The atmosphere is very local and no air conditioning which lent to the ambiance. There was a fair mix of tourists and locals when we were there.Food was awesome! Highly recommended!!Show less

Author: MeiLeongGeorgetown
Title: Nice food but a bit pricey
Review: Been there always when they have not moved to this new place. It's was just few doors away. Visited twice after they moved and prices has increased. Menu choices also added alot. It has becomed a tourists area instead an eating place for the locals where it used to be last time. Overall the food are good just to me its not cheap. If cost rm50 for the 3 dishes. Because as a penangite, I can find equivalent good food at a lower price. Still I recommend you all to go and have a try.Show less

Author: sorboman1
Title: Cheap and cheerful
Review: two visits on our recent trip and both were most satisfying. Food good. Great delivery system from order to table with everybody fully understanding their role. Not a place to "hang about" more eat and go.

Author: sfuller88Penang Island, Malaysia
Title: Everything is awesome
Review: Everything is awesome. It's that simple. I've eaten here approximately 5 times and have tried new dishes everytime. After having 20-25 different dishes (I eat here with a group) there is not one I don't like. Prices are good and the service is fine. The only challenging part is showing up when they are open. We still have yet to figure out their hours.... Usually we get lucky showing up after 6 and before 9. They usually stop taking customers at 9 and close shop pretty quickly. This is a get in, eat, and get out type of place. No one really lingers around to talk after since it's usually packed and there is always a line. It moves fast and is only 2-10 people depending on group sizes. Smaller groups will get a seat faster than others. Don't be surprised if you end up sharing your table with strangers, it only adds to the experience!Show less

Author: dhcf
Title: Must go!
Review: I wish we had found out about this place near the beginning of our stay in Georgetown. Excellent food, inexpensive. Good service. Plenty of fans to keep cool. Many locals. Go before 7 for dinner to avoid long lines.

Author: JmooeyAuckland, New Zealand
Title: Nothing short of perfection
Review: Penang is renown to be food heaven and Tek Sen is testament of the accolade. I tasted literally every restaurant that was renown for their savoury dish on trip advisor and Tek Sen is the only one I have felt compelled to write a review about. Food in Penang is spectacular full stop, however, while one kuay teow may stand out more than another or one wonton noodle better than the other, Tek Sen is consistently delivering amazing food across the entire menu. Food was simply amazing, the kitchen is clean, staff were friendly and efficient, there was nothing to criticise. We ordered the famous twice cooked pork with the chilli pad - beautifully stick with a perfect balance of sweet and savoury.Home made tofu - silky smooth coated in a clean flavoursome chicken/crustacean base sauce.Pork belly - simply divine home cooked pork that melted in your mouth. Perfectly balanced.Greens - flash fried seasonal greens, gently spiced and perfectly seasoned.Tek Sen is a restaurant that constantly strives for quality and it is no wonder that there is always a queue at the front during dinner time. TL;DR, Fantastic value, perfect food, one of the many defining restaurants of Penang.Show less

Author: Chin Meng L
Title: Home-cooked food to crave for!!
Review: We had 8 dishes for the four of us (2 adults and 2 kids) and we finished all of the dishes!! The food was simple but excellent and we enjoyed it very much. The cereal prawns were fresh and juicy, the bitter gourd spare ribs soup was tasty, the roast pork was tender, the sotong was chewy, etc. The service is fast and there was not much waiting time.Show less

Author: PCSimSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good homecooked style food
Review: Went to this restaurant after reading reviews on it. The restaurant is pretty full at any point but turnover is high. Ordered the fried roast pork with chili padi, curry fish and tofu which were recommended by some traveller a. They dishes lived up to their name. Enjoyable. The tamarind prawns I found it to be on the pricey side. RM30 for 3 big prawns.Had enjoyed my meal. Will probably visit again as long as with no long waits Show less

Author: MayLim86
Title: Good food, taste good!!! A bit too expensive on some dish,
Review: I have been to this restaurant for several time for lunch and dinner but only today I realize that some of the dish might be to costly, e.g. prawns 4PCs cost RM 30. The white rice portion compare to other local restaurant might consider small also.Show less

Author: 268caseylPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Don't leave Penang without visiting this no-frills restaurant
Review: I never miss eating at this restaurant whenever I am in Penang. Simple but delicious and flavorful home-cooked Chineses dishes. Service is efficient and quick; not sure if it's because I am always there at 6 pm to be one of the first patrons before the crowd turns up!This restaurant's attraction is not just the good food, but also its reasonable price. If you skip a fish dish, a meal for 4-5 won't reach rm 100.00. Among its huge variety of offerings, my favorite dish is the signature double-roasted pork stir-fried with hot chili padi.Show less

Author: PsychomunkKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Lovely food and quick service
Review: A great local favourite. Be sure to go early as the queue starts as soon as they open. Going in a small group or as a couple can give you a better chance of securing a table but you can't order as much. Food is awesome here!Show less

Author: Brian A
Title: Reputation fulfilled
Review: This was our first meal in George Town and probably the most authentic and best. We arrived at 6 pm and the restaurant was packed. There was a short wait in the queue before we secured a table outside on the pavement - basic plastic chairs and tables. We had the double roasted caramelized pork, duck in ginger sauce and Asian spinach - beautiful food. The place is far from posh but the service was fast and friendly. Many well-heeled local patrons despite a humid rainy night.Show less

Author: atomm2015Cyberjaya, Malaysia
Title: Back to memory lane. Priceless
Review: To those fancy good home cooked food and a traditional touched. This is the place. Its not a great place, posh dining venue but food quality is equivalent to those served in 5* outlet. You will never complete your Penang experiance without a visit to this place. Local taste well preserved over 3 generations. Local cooked and family owned. Simply love this place. Will definitely come back for moreShow less

Author: Yvette12345
Title: So good! Will definitely be back!
Review: Had their special pork, belacan kangkung and special tofu. I enjoyed the first two more than the tofu. Service quite quick as well! Worth the visit!

Author: carolinetan
Title: Highight of Our Penang trip
Review: Tek Sen was really the highlight of our trip in Penang. Every menu we ordered was fresh and well balanced.

Author: Made S. L
Title: My favourite coffee shop in town
Review: Always like to have lunch here with friends.  I love the good, the steamed pork never go wrong! Recommended!

Author: watimeyrickCanggu, Indonesia
Title: The Best Chinese food in Penang
Review: Coming early dinner to make sure get the table otherwise you have long queque. Welcoming with friendly staff. The story of the food so intersting. Special double pork caramelize to die for.Curry asam fish very nice little bit sweet but thats special from this restaurant i think all dish with sugar. Stir fry clams ask for spicy so good. For local restaurant we happy with all dishes. Very recommeded. Show less

Author: lauplusAntwerp, Belgium
Title: We ate here very night. (It did hurt our wallet a bit but it was SO delicious).
Review: (+)- Great food (try the trotter!)- Quick service(+/-)- Closes at 21h I believe: come early so you can get on the list and ensure you have seat (prepapre to wait a little).- It's not super expensive but there are cheaper places, and if you eat here every night your wallet will feel it :)Show less

Author: CrocodileFan83
Title: nice food..amazing..but
Review:
have a small gathering with college friend..5 dishes we ordered..good taste but cost will a little bit higher them what we expect..
sure will support and plan for my next visit to penangXD

Author: audreyhomesSingapore
Title: Not fantastic
Review: We ordered a few dishes and found that the food is not fantastic. Not sure why it is recommended highly by the locals and the people who posted their reviews. It was really crowded so if you intend to try it out go for early dinner :)Show less

Author: Alsek810Chapel Hill, North Carolina
Title: Outstanding Chinese Food
Review: Two of us had dinner tonight at Tek Sen Restaurant. There was a short line to be seated when we arrived at 6:45 pm on a Saturday night. The friendly hostess gave us a menu and took our order before we were seated, very efficient. WE ordered the double cooked pork, duck in a ginger sauce, kang kung ( sauteed greens w/garlic), and rice. The restaurant was full but our food came in a reasonable amaount of time. Everything was delicious, absolutely no complaints about anything. The bill came to 68 ringett with beverages which I consider to be an outstanding value. I hope to return before leaving Penang. Highly recommended.Show less

Author: Traceylee0404Canberra, Australia
Title: A Penang 'must visit'
Review: This place quickly became a favourite...food is great, service is quick, and the price incredibly reasonable. Stand out dish was the double cooked pork, and the lime sodas were great too. Will be one of the first places we go when we go back to Penang.Show less

Author: lexadkJakarta, Indonesia
Title: Recommended!
Review: We tried bitter gourd and cincalok (somekind of a nyonya sliced pork). The gourd is quite nice. The pork was too sweet for our taste. Maybe double roasted pork is a better choice. Will visit and try other menu next time we visit penang.The restaurant was packed, but thankfully we managed to get seated right away. Great and fast service!Show less

Author: 701sriw
Title: Chloe-Indonesia
Review:
I LIKE IT
The best restaurant in penang, cleans, cheap dan serving fast. If i go to Penang...i must go in Tek Sen Restaurant. Must try

Author: 289gretchena
Title: Good food, good prices
Review: I had a wonderful lunch of the double roasted pork.  They were quite busy but they served everyone quickly and the wait was not long.  I will be back.

Author: renesohn
Title: Delicious food
Review:
Definitely worth a visit. If you don't wanna wait in line, come early or book a table. This place seems to be quite popular :)
Can't remember what we had, but it was delicious! And so was the fresh lemonade.

Author: IrishGirlinThailandBangkok, Thailand
Title: Delicious!
Review: We stumbled across this restaurant as it was near our hotel and packed with people, so we thought we'd give it a try. Food was delicious! We ate there twice in our four day stay in Penang, and would make a point of returning on our next visit.Show less

Author: ileftmyheartnseattle
Title: One of my favorite restaurants in George Town
Review: The food is delicious every time I dine here.  Great food and excellent service.  I recommend the pork with chilli padi and the fish fillet curry.

Author: Lindsay C
Title: Best meal we had in Penang
Review: Went here yesterday by chance because we were staying at the hotel next door and it was always packed with people! Sat down and had the best meal we ate in Penang. The double roasted pork with chilies was a definite highlight, as was the fish curry and fried chicken. The lime soda was also very refreshing from the midday heat. Definitely a must stop if you are in Penang.Show less

Author: Soon Yiu OMalaysia
Title: Good food in Georgetown
Review: Been there for multiple times. High recommended chinese foodYou can consider one of your option for lunch and dinner. Less crowded during lunch time, expect long queue at night. Is an establish chinese restaurant which not only local dining, even foreigners dining there tooRecommended dishes : roast pork, asam prawn, steam eggThey adjust the portion according to the amount of person dining and amount of dishes you ordered.Difficult to find parking if you drive however there is a open parking area which you need to pay 3 ringgit per entry.Good food is not cheap, but i would say the price is reasonable.Show less

Author: Circlethetree
Title: Best Chinese food I've ever had
Review:
Amazing.  Sweet and sour chicken was so good... And then the chicken with turmeric and chili blew me away.  
Waited a few minutes for a table.  Worth waiting for.

Author: LallahChozenBangkok, Thailand
Title: Best chinese in Georgetown
Review: Tek Sen is a well established local restaurant that started off very small and now is busy every evening with people queuing for a table. Its not much to look at from the outside and u have to sit on stools but this is a case of substance over style. The food is what brings people here and their house speciality is double roasted pork delicious!! but anything u choose will be good. It is a truly wonderful local experience, do not miss it if u are in georgetown.Show less

Author: ChristineMMLCardiff, United Kingdom
Title: Perfect for a family dinner
Review: One of the best restaurants in Penang! My family and I first visited this place almost 5 years ago and we still do, although it's always packed. Do go early (around 6pm) to get a table for dinner. However, during peak times, it takes a long time for the food to be served. The pork with green chilli, foo yong egg and bitter gourd chicken are amazing!! Definitely must try.Show less

Author: 142gavinc
Title: Worth all the Hype
Review: Chanced upon this gem while exploring the old lanes of George Town. The lunch time crowd comprised locals and tourist alike and this piqued our curiosity. Having had lunch, we made a mental note to come back before we left Penang.We returned on our final day for dinner. A queue had already formed at 5.30 pm. The restaurant opened at 6 pm and was promptly filled. Thankfully we got a table. Ambience - It's an old style restaurant. i.e. No AC, no comfortable chairs, communal style kind of dining. Food - I like it that they cater even for small parties. The small was really just enough for 2 people. We ordered 4 dishes and were satisfied with everything. The food assimilated the "wok hei" (literally translated as wok breath) ; something people look out for in Chinese stir fried dishes. This usually involves stir frying quickly under very high fire that produces a smokey sort of caramelization in the food. You'll know it when you taste it. Try the double cooked pork which was a standout dish. (Please see photos for the rest of the dishes)Cost - the final bill came out to be RMB 45 per person which was ok given the fare that was served. It's expensive by street food standard but by no means an expensive meal. The local taxi driver concurred that this is typically restaurant price as well. It ranks really highly on Tripadviser and for good reason. I'll certainly return the next time I visit Penang. Show less

Author: LA3112
Title: Amazing!!!
Review: Best place on the island!!! Try their amazing double cooked pork. It's unforgettable. We went there twice. I still think about that pork and wish I could eat it!!! Must try!

Author: Christine FPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: An authentic feel of Penang Chinese food
Review: A friend of mine and I wandered into this restaurant-café as we found that the place we had planned to go to was closed. What primarily attracted us was that it was packed with people who seemed to be very seriously focused on their food and appeared to enjoy it. Almost always a good sign in Penang We were not disappointed with the food which was very good, served in generous portions and reasonably priced. This is not a place to go to if you want a quiet meal with a special friend or are looking for an elegant environment but a very good choice for lunch with friend(s). A place that seems to have succeeded in maintaining the standards and authenticity of good Penang Chinese cuisine when many are unfortunately lowering theirs.Show less

Author: Allison DMorpeth, United Kingdom
Title: The Real Deal. Delicious!
Review: OK, so the decor is basic but the food is fantastic! Who cares what colour the walls are when the food is this good. Tek Sen is always packed, often with local families enjoying a meal out and it's fun to hang out there and enjoy the bustling atmosphere. You might have to wait a little while to get a table but it's well worth it. It's also great value. We had 4 dishes and 2 beers for the bargain price of RM55, and everything was super tasty too. I'd recommend the pork and duck dishes, and the prawns were pretty good too. Having visited China on many occasions I felt like I was back on a street corner in Heng Yang. Loved it!Show less

Author: A T
Title: Favourite Georgetown eatery
Review: We were never disappointed with the food. Came here 3 out of 4 dinners! Decor is very basic but if you overlook that this place is a must do. Try the special bbq pork and aubergine stir fry. There is always a queue of locals and tourists, and you will understand why!! Show less

Author: anamafalda8
Title: Really good food! worth to try :)
Review: It was one of the best restaurants I've tried during my stay in Malaysia!!Really nice and tasty food, worth the waiting!!The restaurant will not attract you from the outside, but it's really worth the try. would definitely recommend :)

Author: hvdmeebergAmsterdam, The Netherlands
Title: Vibrant Tasty Chinese Restaurant
Review: Always a line at Tek Sen. I ' ll understand why! The food is really value for money and tasty. Succulent porkbelly with yam, nice veggies and homemade tofu. Only thing that's missing is perhaps a winelist. But Good wine is always hard to find in Malaysia.Show less

Author: TartahoySydney, Australia
Title: Get in the queue!
Review: Joined the line and we were not disappointed. Shared a table as this place is busy. Got excited and ordered way too much food. Even though the place is busy, the service is fast and the hostess was very friendly. The fried rice is good, the plum chicken was tasty, (i had hoped to order the double roasted pork but they had run out) the mapo tofu hmmm different but I had no idea what we were ordering anyway and the star of the show was the steamed fillet fish in ginger.This place is worth a look when your in Georgetown.Show less

Author: Sunfl0wer55
Title: Reasonable price
Review: I went there two straight nights. It was so crowded around 6.30 PM.We had mapo doufu and deep flied chickens with chills. They were so nice.

Author: Mark G
Title: Best Chinese Ever
Review: We enjoyed two dinners here. Sweet&sour chicken, garlic chicken and house speciality pork were all delicious. Very popular so may have to queue but it's worth the wait and staff are efficient. Good value for money.

Author: Ling_Lok_Lee
Title: Food is OK.
Review: Food is OK but not big dishes. The most famous shrimps which s a little sweet is worth to try. Price is cheap but the shop closes early at 9pm that need to hurry to eat for Hong Kong people.

Author: alexsacePenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Unreasonable charges
Review: I was having dinner at the restaurant more than 30 times because their foods are amazing till the very last time, as usual orders and I ordered additional JUST sweet & sour sauce, they gave us in medium bowl and charged us RM8, and I looked up the menu, the sweet & sour pork dish cost RM16. (How is it possible the sauce price as same as the MEAT!?) it's so ridiculous.. I asked the owner how can it be so expensive and it doesn't make sense at all, and he said, we specially make the sauce for u. I don't mind to pay RM4 but RM8 is toooooo much!!! Well, it will be my last visit after >30 times!!!! p/s: By the way, they don't even give a ISHHH about it because business is too GOOD!Show less

Author: Barnes312
Title: The Get Some!
Review: Amazing food for a great price. Everything they have on the menu seems great. Been here 3 times and I'm never disappointed nd mind blown every time I try something diffrent. one of my favorite restaurnats of all time for sure.

Author: Maggles_12Sydney, Australia
Title: Great Value / Good food
Review: After reading so many good reviews I went by myself at about 7pm. I only had to wait a couple of minutes for a table outside and was given a menu and left alone to study it. The twice roasted pork was a must so I ordered pork, stir fried greens with garlic and shrimp and a fried rice. I ordered small dishes and a large beer and they all arrived pretty quickly. Another couple of tourists were seated at my table with my consent and we chatted while waiting and eating. With another beer my total bill was 64 Ringgit (about $A22-).
