The food I had was tasty and fresh, the pork sweet and the rice full of squid, egg, veg and chicken, the greens were crisp and delicious. The food was as good as any meal in Chinatown in Sydney but at a fraction of the cost, especially considering that the two beers made up half the cost. Some reviewers have mentioned that the staff here try to get customers 'in and out' as quickly as possible but my dining companions and I sat well after we had finished our food sipping our beers and chatting even though people were still queuing to get a table with no pressure to move on.I would return to Tek Sen for as many visits as it took to work my way through the menu.Show less

Author: ericjeffKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Home cooked style food
Review: Although it's a little expensive, roughly RM 25 /pax (without seafood) maybe we ordered too many dishes, 4 person1. Fried pork (big)2. Salted egg bitter gourd3. Belacan kangkung4. Plum sauce chicken5. Famous toufuI would say the fried pork is one of the best in the world. Remember, either you call up make a reservation first or be there early for lunch / dinner. It's super crowded during holiday / weekends.Show less

Author: HLKohSingapore, Singapore
Title: A bit disappointed.
Review: My expectations was hyped after reading earlier reviews. Can't help but feel slightly disappointed. Food was good but not amazing. Neither overly salty nor oily. However, portions were small. Prices were reasonable. Do arrive early. The restaurant was due to open for dinner at 6pm. We reached at 5.50pm and had one of the last remaining tables. A long queue has formed by the time we finished dinner.Show less

Author: PsykitGeorge Town, Malaysia
Title: Not worth your money for the portion and taste
Review: More touristy place right now than before. It was cheap and good during those days but now after the younger generation took over, things are not as reasonable as before and portions were small. There are a lot more local restaurant with the same genre. Worth to look elsewhere around that shop. You'll find a few at the corner of Tek Sen.Show less

Author: ntlchin
Title: Penang food is not as great as proclaimed
Review: This shop is crowded. Food is so sweet that it does not make sense. Belacan fried kangkong is sweet which it should be savoury. The beancurd with egg white is sweet. The famous pork dish is sickly sweet. Not to my taste.

Author: Laura PKuala Lumpur
Title: Everything you want from an Asian eating experience!
Review: We where recommended this place by are hotelier he said to go early as they get very busy. we went down, we had no trouble finding the place as there was a queue of people waiting to be seated which could only be a good thing as the majority of them where locals. as we waited in the queue we were handed menus to look at and then we were seated within about 5/10 minuets of arrival with another western couple. This evidently made for a more enjoyable evening as they where Canadian (luckily not French). This place was a real treat for the senses: from the plastic stools to sit on from the waitresses rushing by shouting at one another from across the restaurant to the tables full of chatting locals enjoy large bowls and plates full of steaming exotic smelling food, the service here is fantastic casual but somehow very efficient. the food also lives up to that we ordered a number of dishes to share from the double cooked pork with chilli, sweet and sour chicken( the best I've ever had) sauteed broccoli with garlic and fermented black bean pork ribs all of witch where fantastic...so good that we ate here 3 nights out of our 5 night stay in penang. also a must try is the Ribena with lychees! all in all tek sen is a fantastic cultural experience that won't hurt your wallet either.Show less

Author: MeiLeong
Title: Good choices of food with food like home cooked food.
Review: This restaurant have variety of home cooked food. It's difficult to find duck dishes but teik seng offers few types. However they are not serving theses dishes everyday. The price of the duck dish is RM20 with is reasonable for me.

Author: F0RELuzon, Philippines
Title: Delicious food
Review: Was here for lunch with friends. Came away very satisfied. Food was delicious especially the double cooked pork and chicken in sour plum sauce. Service was efficient even if the restaurant was packed. Cost of the meal was reasonable.Come early to avoid the long queues waiting for tables.Show less

Author: TommyTomTomTommoMelbourne, Australia
Title: Best Food on the Island
Review: Prepare yourself for the wait to get in this place, I'd say bring your own ice if you want cold drinks as they come out room tempurature... but you might have to wait for a seat during peak times.This place is guaranteed to have something delicious that you are chasing, whether it is local mono fish or satay. Highly recomend the twice cooked pork - Don't miss out!Prices arn't too bad eitherShow less

Author: Abraham SMelbourne
Title: Really yummy food
Review: We had read so many reviews on this place so we found it in the hot penang sun..il tell you right now that it was worth the walk in the sun..we ordered BBQ pork..fried chicken with mayonnaise, fried rice and kailan and garlic..one of the est meals we have had in penang!! Show less

Author: LazyBeeBooLos Angeles, California
Title: Double-cooked pork is delicious
Review: The service here isn't that great, but that's not why we came. The double-cooked pork is definitely worth trying and the greens with salted egg is great. This place is good if you're a big eater or have at least 4 people so you can try a bunch of different dishes. Some of the dishes were a bit too salty for out tastes. The prices are a bit higher than other places but that's what happens when you become popular. There can be a line sometimes but it moves quickly enough because the staff is quick to clear the table once a dish is finished. Don't expect any pleasantries from them.Show less

Author: trchuMelbourne, Australia
Title: Yummo
Review: Went for lunch on Sunday and encountered controlled chaos! Full to the brim and overflowing with people, we sat where we were told and when by the "I haven't got time for any nonsense" Aunty who greeted us with a quick smile and hyper efficiency. We had the twice cooked pork, sambal prawns with asparagus and belachan chicken. All terrific. Cheap and cheerful, full of taste. Great value. Don't miss it if you're in town. Show less

Author: hollebollegeezaHaarlem, The Netherlands
Title: Simply delicious!
Review: This restaurant invested in good food rather than decoration. Be prepared to wait in line and don't come to late (no new customers were allowed after 9PM when we where there). Although the place looks simple, the atmosphere was good. We wanted to try the twice fried pork after reading an earlier review here, but unfortunately this was finished. We tried the sweet and sour chicken as well as the chicken in oyster sauce and they were both delicious. We tried quite some sweet and sour chicken in different countries, but this topped them all.Show less

Author: SarahgoodyAuckland Central, New Zealand
Title: Loved it!
Review: Had to wait for a table but was worth it. Twice cooked pork was amazing as were the other dishes we tried and at 54rm for 3 people thought it was reasonably priced. Staff are very friendly and helpful even though they are so busy. Ate here twice while we were in Georgetown and would definitely go backShow less

Author: chrishulkPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Good Chinese Food in Georgetown
Review: Tek Sen Restaurant located in Georgetown is one of my favorite restaurant. I have patronizing it regularly for last 30 years. My favorite dish which I ordered without is fried roasted pig with dark soya sauce. Other good dishes are fried kangkung with sambal, fish fillet taufu with fermented soya bean, fish curry and many more. Taste is good and price is reasonable. Place is clean and pleasant. Show less

Author: TomR1519
Title: Not bad
Review: First up I went alone and only ordered the roast pork, some vegetables with sabal, rice and a drink. It tasted pretty good but I think its the sort of place to go with a few people and order plenty of different dishes because I found the roast pork abit sickening after whole plate. Service above average. Was 30 ringit so price was cheap by western standard but above average for malaysia. From my experience I wouldnt say it was amazing like others have said but it is obviously pretty popular with locals so I guess that says something.Show less

Author: RObertinLove14Penang, Malaysia
Title: Tek Sen
Review: My now-wife (being from here) loves this restaurant. Sometimes you have to wait for a table, but usually one of the servers will usually take your order while you wait. The rice is of good quality. Usually get a number of meat and vegetable dishes, very nice. I like the Nestum-crusted prawns, as well as the Thai-style chicken and roasted pork.Show less

Author: jjh2042Chicago, Illinois
Title: Yum Yum!
Review: Thanks for squeezing us in just as you were closing for the afternoon Teksen. We quickly picked three items - the house pork, tofu with tiny river fish, and mixed veggies. All were outstanding and you didn't rush us out. Love the stools and tables. We will return!Show less

Author: CMSKeralaErnakulam, India
Title: My best meal in Penang!
Review: Rough and ready, always crowded with locals and having "trying to be friendly to the foreigners with language problems" staff, I had my best meal of seven days here. Chili prawns, braised pork belly with preserved vegetables, rice and Tiger. But watch the Tiger, as anywhere in Malaysia, a couple of beers can equal the cost of the food. Would I go again?: In an instant.Show less

Author: klawspawsManila, Philippines
Title: No wonder this place has amazing food
Review: AMAZING Chinese food! We had a beef dish, a tofu dish and fried rice, and each of them were equally AMAZING. Great bang for your buck. Quick service. No-frills restaurant but the flavors more than made up for it.Last order is at 9PM so don't go later than that!Show less

Author: Bianca PSingapore, Singapore
Title: one of my must visit restaurants when I'm in Penang
Review: Ever since I discovered this restaurant some years ago, I must visit this place whenever I'm in Penang. This trip I was traveling with friends and we ended up here for dinner one night. My friends loved the food too. It is a very popular restaurant, so be prepared to wait for a table or come early. Many local families eat here in the weekends and they open for lunch and dinner. Check out what others are eating to find out the popular dishes. The food is nice, simple local fare, not too sweet, not too salty, just the right amount of flavours without overdoing it. Tastes like home-cooked food. Must try the bittergourd with salty duck egg and the sio bak (roasted pork) was very nice too. The service is so-so, but it's the cooking that brings the customers back for more! Show less

Author: JuliemaryInvercargill
Title: Busy but good
Review: The food at this place was really good and really cheap. There were four of us so we had four dishes and a couple of sides. We tasted a bit of everything, fish, pork and chicken. No twice fried pork, all sold out. Fast food, friendly staff with smiles, even though they were so busy. We ate late so no wait for a table.Show less

Author: Joe MManchester, New Hampshire
Title: TWICE FRIED PORK - GET IT
Review: This place was fantastically close to our hotel and was recommended by our staff upon checking in. It's open air and sit down, like most of the restaurants in the area. I simply looked around once we sat down and noticed most people were munching on the twice fried pork, so naturally i ordered it. FANTASTICI've never had anything like it! We ordered other items as well and they were prepared perfectly. If you're in Georgetown for a day you would be doing yourself a disservice by not coming here.Show less

Author: narni4Perth, Australia
Title: Great Food
Review: Had dinner here twice,double roasted pork both timesplus other dishes as well.All were very good and well presented.We found service excellent and a great atmosphere.even though very busy on both visits.On way to Tek Sen try the Lok Lok stall on corner of Chulia and Carnarvon.Delicious Penang specialtyand is a skewered hotpot.Try not to eat too much beforeTek Sen!!!!!Show less

Author: 692alastairlLondon
Title: Best food experience in Penang.
Review: Don't fall for how this place looks on first impression. Hectic atmosphere, full of friendly noise, families, young and old, locals, and visitors. A fun place to be and the food is first rate. A short queue leads to the most delicious flavours. Great menu which is full of complimentary dishes, and the price is fair and good value. Thoroughly enjoyable experience.Show less

Author: sinny7
Title: Overrated; nothing special
Review: We were hoping for a delicious meal going by the queue of people waiting outside for a table. The portion size was quite small. The food was ordinary home cooked style. I wouldn't say it is value for money in Penang.

Author: Kwong Tiong H
Title: Awesome food, wrong address
Review: Food is simply awesome! Good location near famous Armenian Street arts. TripAdvisor however wrongly pointed to a location at Geodesic Dome (near Komtar). The correct location is at intersection of Lebuh Carnavon & Jalan Buckingham. Despite some reviews commented about long waiting time & unfriendly service, we didn't experience such during our visit.Show less

Author: LalycFort Mill, South Carolina
Title: perfect for local flavor
Review: The people at Campbell House recommended this restauant and we were not disappointed. We were lucky enough to get a seat as soon as we arrived with a great view of the dining area, but outside so we could get a breeze. We had the double roasted pork - fabulous! We also had shrimp, which I did not really care for, and spinach with fungi. Best vegatable dish I had in Penang. Service was fast and we felt that we were experiencing a local eatery, rather than one that catered to tourists.Show less

Author: dkh117Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania
Title: Perfect timing
Review: We stopped at this restaurant based on the recommendation of our hotel and were not disappointed. Thankfully others had included descriptions and reviews of their food so we knew what to order. We had a tofu appetizers that was not as firm as what we typically get in the US but was very good. We also had a plate of the pork and each had an order of rice. This was enough for the both of us with 2 beers. We weren't sure if we should order other food but this was fine. There was not a wait when we got there which was probably 5:30 - 6 but when we left at about 6:30 there was a line of people waiting to get in. Servers were efficient and they moved people in and out quickly. There is no AC at this place but they have fans going to keep it somewhat cool. It was still very hot inside but the food was tasty and the beer helped cool us down.Show less

Author: Great_ExplorerSydney
Title: Must Try
Review: My wife and I had dinner at this restaurant 2 times and both times we were very happy with the meals we chose. This has very basic decor but it is about the food not the ambiance. Both times we went the restaurant was full and on the second occasion we had to wait to be seated. There was a queue waiting to get in for most of the time we were there. The food has good flavour and is very good value. Definitely worth a try.Show less

Author: Keith JGaborone
Title: Delicious food
Review: Very good Chinese food, as others have said the pork is delicious, we also had the claypot fish which was also excellent. Great service, simple, the place is buzzing. Closes at 9pm. About RM50 for two excluding drinks. NB the location of the restaurant is wrong on some map services. It is on Carnavon Street close to the corner of Campbell Street.Show less

Author: cheah99
Title: So so food
Review: This restaurant has been around for a while.Its only in the last few years did it become well-known to tourists. I find the food quite oily and salty. For locals, there are much better restaurants serving similar style food that are better priced nearby.

Author: PeggieFearlessKyoto, Japan
Title: Excellent Nanyang flavor!
Review: After so much Malaysian food, we'd like to have some home flavor, so we chose this restaurant near our hostel. The taste was excellent and the bustling and noisy just brought us back home. Loved the fried noodle thingy (don't know the English name). Price is 50RM for two.Show less

Author: pppinotStrathfieldsaye VIC
Title: Magnificient pork dishes
Review: Went to Tek sen twice for dinner. Had double roasted pork twice and curried stingray. The place is very busy with both locals and tourists. Plenty of tables but you may have to wait. the service is good and the place is very clean. The prices are very reasonable given the quality of the food. Wish Tek Sen was near my place. Do not miss the experienceShow less

Author: PaulJ317
Title: Wonderful!
Review: First night in Penang and most gorgeous meal in this fantastic place recommended by a friend. Cheap but delicious food!

Author: Nomes_BNEBrisbane Region, Australia
Title: great food in a simple setting
Review: Ate here last night, which was Monday and no trouble getting a table for 2. Between us we got the double cooked pork, rice, mixed vegies in garlic and 2 drinks for under 40 ringgit. Staff polite and English good. Food came out quite quickly. The pork is delicious, sweet and you just want more. Restaurant was clean and had fans to try and cool you down, so yes it does get hot in here. Tables and stools are stainless steel. Definitely come and check this place out.Show less

Author: JHM05
Title: Oh my god, yummy food
Review: I decided to go here after reading the lonely planet. The food is amazing, especially the spicy bbq pork. To die for. I want to go back!

Author: Siew Ping YKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Tasty and delicious
Review: Got to eat at this restaurant after many trips to Penang and reading a review about it in a local newspaper .Even on a weekday, the crowd builds up fast to fill up the tables.We ordered the asam prawn ,kangkong belachan,steam fish and roast pork.The asam prawn was tasty with its unique sauce -sweet and slightly sourish that added a nice flavour to the prawn .However, we were not impressed with the roast pork , supposedly one of the signature dish here.You can see many tables ordering this dish .The pork is sliced into tiny bits and the portion is small .In our opinion , the taste is not special ,we have tasted better similarly cooked pork in may other Chinese restaurants and the portion is just miserable .Not sure why some people rate this dish highly. Kangkong belachan was nicely fried with some prawns in it ,this dish could increase your appetite for rice .Overall service very prompt ,guess they have to turn -around the guests quickly for ehough seats .Show less

Author: peterkarAuckland Central, New Zealand
Title: Deservedly World-Famous
Review: This place is another excellent reason to stay at the Yeng Keng hotel on Chulia St. We followed advice and were early (6pm-ish), got a table for two, and watched the place fill very rapidly. We were the only roundeyes there for some time and were able to get out just as the Australian adolescents arrived....Food was simply superb: we took their advice and had prawns, various forms of chicken (until our waiter suggested that we would have enough food - we did, but it's a big menu with lots to try). On our return visit we had their double-roasted pork belly - fabulous - and an aubergine dish which was not quite to our taste. Watch out for anything claiming to be based on brussel sprouts: what we got was a cabbage dish, which was delicious but not sproutish.This place is a must, not because the food is haute cuisine, but because of the buzz of the people in it. The staff are very efficient, friendly, and service is quick. NOTE: this is a Chinese restaurant, not (primarily) Malaysian.Show less

Author: MikeCarmonaManila, Philippines
Title: Consistently serving good, local favorites
Review: Came here again and ordered Curry fish, Asam prawns, fried pomfret in Thai sauce, kangkong belachan. Ummm! Tastes still authentic and fresh, reason why this is one of the "Must Go" places when you are in Georgetown, Penang.Flush it all down with their fresh lime juice, and your set to brave the heat of this city. Be prepared to pay $10/pax. Will surely go back again! Burp!Show less

Author: brutally
Title: Amazing Local Food
Review:
very good food the original way you can see so many locals there more then  tourists thats always a good sign for me.

very close to major attractions  near chulia  road.

try their  homemade tofu in soy sauce its very nice dish

Author: Flash G
Title: Arrive early!
Review:
Fab food but it gets busy very early. Leave plenty of time to dine here as you may have to wait a few minutes.
We arrived around 12pm for lunch & managed to secure a table. Amazing food at very cheap prices

Author: Gerald KSingapore
Title: Great food! Try their specialties...
Review: We were recommended to try Tek Sen, and after finding their doors shut on the first day that we tried to eat there, we found them open for lunch the next day. They seem to open only for lunch, and close around 2pm. We ordered the spicy barbequed pork, assam curry fish, and dragon spinach with eggs. The food was great! I especially liked the taste of the spicy pork, which is one of their specialties.Show less

Author: Amy G
Title: Worth the Wait
Review: We went here after reading about it in the lonely planet guide. It did not disappoint. We ate many items but the double roast chili pork was the best and is a recommended dish. We only waited about 15 mins and ordered while we waited. So one we sat down at a table food was quick. Go to the toilet before you order and look what the locals are eating. The lime juice was great. A bit too sweet at the start but wait for the ice to melt and it's just right. Don't let the cue deter you!Show less

Author: NesslouTravelsMelbourne, Australia
Title: Best food in Georgetown... Go early or take a number!
Review: Wow! By far the best food we had during our stay. Penang has a variance of the cheap to expensive and many tacky eateries (think processed plastic looking MacDonald's themes). If you are like me and do your research before choosing where to dine, you will take note of the many food blogs that are not wrong; this place has many specialties but try not to look past the sticky double cooked pork with chilli padi (we went back for seconds!) Fresh Asparagus with sambal prawn and the crunchy oatmeal chicken - these 3 dishes definitely complimented each other well texturally! Also the black current and lychee drink and lime juice were refreshing and something different than the normal tea and juice options - dont miss this place when in Penang!Show less

Author: PDBthailandKo Pha Ngan, Thailand
Title: The best chinese food!
Review: Fantastic chinese food. We had sweet and sour chicken and the double fried pork. Both were incredible could have sat there all day and eaten! Lots of tables, and was super busy when we arrived, but food and service was still quick. This is a MUST whilst in Penang!Show less

Author: MY LDublin, Ireland
Title: Home-cooked food with poor service and environment
Review: The dishes were home-cooked and fairly good. We called to book a table a day before. we brought a birthday cake as we planned to celebrate birthday of a friend after the dinner. The restaurant was crowded, noisy and hot. it was not suitable to chat with friends. The waiter was rushing us to order the dishes. The way he talked to us with the impolite tone disappointed me. We left without celebrating birthday of a friend there after the dinner because the waiter were unhappy and rushed us away as there were customers queuing up outside the restaurant.Show less

Author: A WSan Francisco, California
Title: Best dish in Penang
Review: Tek Sen's signature double-roasted pork was the best dish we had in Penang, by far. Wonderfully sweet, and every bit as delicious as the other reviews say. Cost was 18 RM for the large, which was enough for two. Also ordered some other dishes, but we honestly can't remember what they tasted like -- all we remember is the pork! This is a very simple one-room, no frills restaurant that's popular with the locals, so try to get there when it opens. We arrived for lunch around 1pm and the place was packed! Once we were seated, we did have to wait awhile for someone to take our order, and after 10 minutes it did feel like they were ignoring us. But this was probably not a deliberate snub on their part; we suspect the waiter who finally came around was the only one who could speak English. In any case, the food is worth it. Tek Sen is open from 12-2:30pm and 6-9pm, except on Tuesdays when it's closed.Show less

Author: Anne DOttawa
Title: Simply Excellent
Review: This place was recommended by our hotel after we had tried a couple places that had disappointed us. We arrived just in time (rush starts around 7:30pm), and were seated right away. We ordered rice for each of us and 3 different plates. The food and our lime juice were most excellent. It did take a while before we were able to be served ( I think they were waiting for the English-speaking staff to serve us), but the wait wasn't too long and the whole experience was definitely worth it.I strongly recommend visiting this place if you are staying in Georgetown.Show less

Author: 80scarlettnOxford, England, United Kingdom
Title: Amazing home cooked, delicious Chinese food!
Review: We were recommended this restaurant by our hotel, and it was without a doubt one of our best meals of our whole trip. We had the duck special (in a clay pot with sweet potato, SO tender), beansprouts, a delicious crispy fish, and some amazing sweet char sui pork. Even the lime juice was particularly good! The staff were really helpful with recommendations, and when it came to paying the bill we were a couple of ringgits short - so our waiter promptly gave my boyfriend a lift to the nearest cash machine on his bike! This restaurant is extremely popular with the locals, so arrive early (6ish) to make sure you get a table - also they sometimes seem to close quite early, around 8.30. Fantastic meal, genuinely don't have any criticisms to make!Show less

Author: Amy J
Title: Know what to order and you'll be golden.
Review: I went twice. The first time I ordered the starred items on the menu thinking they're a delicious safe bet. The prawns were huge but a little fishy and chewy, and "market price" was 37RM for a plate of 5!

Author: 150janetkAbu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates
Title: Best food and people watching in Malaysia!
Review: Although we had been planning a trip to this restaurant based on its ranking on tripadvisor, we had passed it unknowingly one day and noticed that although in appearance it looked like any other unremarkable eatery in Georgetown- plastic chairs, Chinese symbols on the sign etc it was packed with ques out the door! Bizarre considering the restaurants all around we're empty. The food was... Out of this world good. We had the house special double roasted pork and deep fried chicken in plum sauce, fried rice and 4 beers which came to 70R about 15 euro. Atmosphere was fantastic we couldn't get enough of the hustle bustle and Chinese familes sharing their meals together- definitely worth a trip! Show less

Author: Adam WNewtownabbey, United Kingdom
Title: Go early so as not to be disappointed
Review: I went here a few times whilst in Georgetown and I loved it. The sweet and sour chicken and the lime juice drink were just amazing. I have tried to recreate the lime drink myself but it's just not the same. Definitely a must eat place in Georgetown!!!Show less

Author: Nicolef494
Title: Best food in Penang
Review: We got there early because had gone another night and was a huge wait for tables. Service was very good from moment we walked in the door. Food and drinks were excellent. Prices were good for restaurant quality.

Author: Leconcombre2014Luxembourg City, Luxembourg
Title: Over rated
Review: I went twice recently to the restaurant invited by friends. I have been disappointed each time. They have a very large menu and the place is busy. However all the dishes we shared, Chinese way, with my friends and relatives, were tasteless, basic and the fishes were not very fresh. I have not eaten anything great there. the service is fast and relatively efficient. . Show less

Author: aza613Brunswick East, Australia
Title: AMAZING FOOD GOOD VALUE!!
Review: AMAZING FOOD!!! EVERYTHING THAT WAS RECOMENDED BY THE WAITER WAS DELICIOUS! If your unsure don't be afraid to ask them! Get there early to avoid missing out on crispy pork!!Marpo Tofu was delicious! ORDER IT!! Plum chicken was alright... order the lychee blackcurrant drink was good I had 2!YUMMMMMMMMMMShow less

Author: LizCleereJakarta, Indonesia
Title: The best Chinese food I've tasted, and that includes in China
Review: Can't believe it took until our third visit to Penang before we tried Tek Sen. Lonely Planet raves about it, and I see from the reviews here it is also popular... and I can't disagree.We had stir fried kang kung with sambal, stir fried prawns with tamarind sauce and home recipe double roasted pork with chili padi ('char siew bak'). Each dish was sensational, exploding with flavour and without the stickiness or gelatinous gleam of much Chinese cooking. I opted for the homemade barley with lime drink (so good I ordered a second glass, there's something about the way each barley grain zips up the straw and hits the back of your mouth which is addictive).It was the last night before Chinese new year and the place was buzzing, packed and lively, but our waiter still had time for a laught and a joke.It's going to become my local when we move to Penang. I can't see much point in eating anywhere else.Show less

Author: Oregon-Trout-Hunter
Title: Stood up to the Hype
Review: Clean, quick, responsive & most importantly...fine food. Great meal at a great price. Whole family so happy mid meal ordered another plate.

Author: Keeliat
Title: Best Nonya food and local food
Review: Best Local food i ever tried in Penang. The dish is good and variety choice. we need to book earlier if we want to taste the best food serving in town. They serve lunch and dinner and finished quite early.

Author: blokototerminous
Title: Quality maintained despite increased popularity
Review: Tek Sen is always on my itinerary when I visit Penang each year. The crowds waiting to get in seem to be getting bigger -- still more local families than foreign tourists, which is a good sign. During the nine years I've been visiting, the restaurant doesn't seem to have compromised its quality or tried to appeal to tourists by becoming more chi-chi because of its increased popularity. This time I had a nice dish of pork belly with a side of kangkong (greens) cooked with prawns and sambal, plus some herbal tea. A simple meal but well done; I'm never disappointed. Don't expect something too fancy; just reliably tasty food at a reasonable price in a simple setting.Show less

Author: BonEcosseBrussels, Belgium
Title: Expectations exceeded
Review: We always take Lonely Planet's advice with a pinch of salt, they often give poor places rave reviews (for reasons unknown), but in this case they are spot on! The certificate of excellence from Trip Advisor is deserved. The food was full of flavour, everything well cooked (though clearly prepared in advance en masse). Avoid lines by eating a little later, but it's worth the waitShow less

Author: The_GrumpsterPerth, Australia
Title: Queues give it away
Review: This restaurant has a great reputation, and there were queues outside on a Monday night, whilst nearby restaurants had practically no customers. The food is original and absolutely delicious. This is a family run restaurant where you go for the food, not the ambience. Who cares about ambience when you can eat some of the best food in a city known for the quality of its cuisine?Show less

Author: armenian2013
Title: Noisy and messy place............
Review: We went there for lunch and had to wait for long time to be seated. The place was noisy and messy. Food was average. Overall, the experience was comparable to having food at hawker center.

Author: TKH25122013
Title: Excellent food
Review: On of the best Chinese food restaurant in George Town. Had dinner at Tek Sen several times and food is excellant at price is reasonable. Cater to locals as well as tourists.

Author: masha2010Boston, Massachusetts
Title: maybe the best chinese food I ever had !
Review: I happened by this restaurant which was near my hotel and noticed people waiting to get in. Well "in" is not quite accurate, since the restaurant is basically open air. Anyway, I checked it out on the web and went back for dinner. It was fantastic (and inexpensive). I had the asparagus with prawn and sambal and fried chicken with plum sauce. Fantastic !! Now, that I'm back, I dream about it :) !.Show less

Author: snowycupSingapore, Singapore
Title: Nothing fantastic
Review: The food at this restaurant is a bit overrated. The cooking is no doubt Penang style. However, you can find similar cooking at many other zi char restaurants in the island. We ate there as a family of 9 for dinner. One group of us had to go earlier to queue for a table. When we called earlier, the restaurant told us booking was not necessary since we'll be early at 6pm. Maybe a booking system will be better for diners. Show less

Author: KraZkatladyThe Hague, The Netherlands
Title: Average food, bad attitude
Review: Got our hotel to book us a table for 7pm. When we arrived at 645pm, saw a table for 2 with a 'reserved' sign , told one of the servers that our hotel had booked the table for us 3 times and she just refused to listen. We wanted to sit down at that table and was shooed away to go sit on a ridiculously big table next to it instead. This table was big enough to accommodate 8 pax. She even shouted across to the cashier guy to verify if indeed some hotel called to book ahead and the guy acknowledged by shouting back 'E&O' and still she refused to let us sit there. Only after 15 mins and halfway through our beer did she realise she could use this big table for the large crowd of people gathering outside the eatery. We were then promptly shooed to the table we wanted to sit at in the first place!!! We ordered the double fried pork (that everyone was raving about), assam prawns and sauteed winged beans with shrimp and were wowed by none of them. If you love eating very ordinary food in a chaotic, grubby environment, this would be your place. Show less

Author: ECChan81Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Best choice if you need a break from hawker food
Review: Most ofthe tourist would be craving for local hawker food when they are in penang. However I would need a break from these scrumptious hawker fare after 2 days of indulging. This restaurant would be most ideal given that serve local home cooked style dishes and most importantly at reasonable price. Yes the queue may be long but they practised a system where they take your order while you are waiting for the next available table. Overall a great experience and satisfied meal at this place.Show less

Author: TwoToGo2Sydney, Australia
Title: Superb!
Review: Wow - we happened on Tek Sen on our first night of six in Penang and it was to be our favourite -the flavours just superb and the homemade tofu outstanding. The only pity - we wanted to go back there on our last night - but the restaurant was closed! Seriously good food here!Show less

Author: KymmieGibblerCoquitlam, Canada
Title: Delicious!
Review: A typical Asian dining experience, cement floors, stools instead of chairs and delicious, reliable food. I can see why this place is busy every night. We had deep fried tofu w prawn scallop egg white, Kang Kung sambal sauce prawns and curry fish filet. It was too much for two people but we ate it all! For a drink, I had a Michael Jackson - soy milk and black grass jelly.Bring your own tissue/napkins or you'll need to purchase them there. Another typical element of the Asian dining experience.Show less

Author: BeachesAreBest123Columbia, Connecticut
Title: Delicious home-style Chinese food, with extensive menu!
Review: This is not a fancy restaurant, but it serves up tasty food from an extensive Chinese, Malaysia menu. Really packs them in, you might have a short wait. We were recommended to this place by the proprietor of our nearby hotel, and liked it so much we went back on another night. They had a lot of dishes to choose from. I was so happy to find that they had one of my favorite Chinese home-style dishes, ground pork with dried fish and ginger. It was utterly delicious. You can't go wrong here.Show less

Author: ChanML
Title: Pretty good fare
Review: Worth having a meal at tek sen. They serve good nyonya/baba cooking. I would want to go back there again

Author: LovingHubbyMalaysia
Title: Nice food with clean environment
Review: As I am a local here, I found that this restaurant is really one of the best here in Penang. I have been to this restaurant for few times. Every time even though the queue is long, the waiting time is acceptable. The staff took order is very familiar with the food and can recommend you what is the specialty of the day, and nevertheless caring enough to give advice to my expecting wife which food is not suitable for her to eat and should be avoided. When we were ushered to our table, another waitress again change the chair for my wife to sit. Their service has surprised me as other high end restaurant also never did that.The food here is great yet with a reasonable price tag. The table, utensils, and even sauce containers are clean. It is a great restaurant that suitable for everyone!Show less

Author: Guo_88Shanghai, China
Title: Great food at cheap price!
Review: Saw many good reviews from trip advisor so i decided to try out this restaurant and it turn out to be my best meal throughout my stay in Penang! Delicious chinese local food at a very good price.This place is always crowded -doing very well therefore be there before 7pm for dinner to avoid dissapointment as it will be full after that or you will have to wait for a table. Worth to try!Show less

Author: TAHITI-VAEAPapeete, French Polynesia
Title: Good mid range restaurant in Penang
Review: Why mid range when you only pay 12RM for a dish? because compared to the Chinese or Malay food stalls (where you pay 5RM) well I consider it mid range.Nevertheless the food is well prepared, the service is good (they speak English and menus are in English) and quick. Restaurant is always full so it might indicate that it's doing well..Show less

Author: KiwiDerekTauranga, New Zealand
Title: cheerful, cheap, very tasty
Review: I'm astonished that someone should describe this as "overpriced". Perhaps it is if you want to eat on a dollar a day, but if you actually want good food in a sanitary environment for a couple of dollars (which is about what 10 ringit translates to.)... The staff are open, the menu has English translations, and the food - especially the double-cooked roast pork (with or without chilli padi) - is fantastic. At lunch it fills up by 12.30 (though they seem to open a bit earlier than the advertised 12.00) but this is well worth a visit. Tamarind (assam) prawns are also great and the chicken in sour plum sauce, and pretty much anything you fancy. If you want a break from pure Malaysian flavours and feel like something a bit more Chinese this is just the ticket. Also - and a bit more downhome but with great pork (BBQ, belly, honey) and roast duck - try the (weirdly-named) Sky Hotel just round the corner on Chulia St (no English menu, but they'll tell you what to do!).Note: Tek Sen closes on Tuesday (but there's usually a crowd of backpackers waiting anyway since the Lonely Planet guide doesn't mention this. Or the roast pork. Don't miss it if you're there - it really is that good!)Show less

Author: markhP1613IC
Title: BEST MEAL IN PENANG
Review: Thanks to Trip Advisor, we found another beauty.  Packed with locals and the food and service were first class.  Had to wait 10 minutes for a table, after the meal would have waited an hour.  This is Penang at it's brilliant best

Author: FrequentfeederCanberra, Australia
Title: Fabulous food
Review: The food at Tek Sen is truly fabulous. I really loved the twice cooked pork with chilli. Garlic chicken was total flavour and the sides of winged beans with belucan and broccoli with prawns were excellent. Beer is by the bottle with Tiger, Guinness and Carlsberg at reasonable prices.Show less

Author: Yutaka KMeguro, Japan
Title: Nice but a bit overpriced
Review: Had a quick lunch here without knowing that it was so highly rated on tripadvisor. Just went in as it was crowded with tourists as well as locals. The food itself was quite good, although I felt it was overpriced with all dishes starting from RM10, particularly just after having had a bowl of wan tan mee for RM5. But after all it's just a difference of a dollar or two per dish, so shouldn't be too much of a problem for tourists. I know it's hard for tourists to find good stalls here, so from that point of view it's worth a visit. But if you know locals, definitely ask for their recommendation to point you to the right stalls.Show less

Author: 69Penny
Title: Yum
Review: Tek Sen was probably the culinary highlight of our stay. The roast pork, tofu with crab, morning glory with garlic were just to die for. Chaotic Chinese and worth every ringgit and second you are there,

Author: Needmorehols593Cardigan, United Kingdom
Title: Amazing food
Review: Get there early as you have to queue outside for a table in this chaotic restaurant but it is definitely worth the wait. The food is amazing we had twice cooked pork with chilli and garlic chicken which was to die for. In a three day trip we ate there twice which shows how good the food is.Show less

Author: MangoPanda2013Seattle, Washington
Title: Good food, accomodating people.
Review: It was our last nigh in Penang, my husband & I, coming back from a trip to the Botanical Garden and could not find our way back because the bus that took us there apparently only goes one way. I hailed a local guy and he was very nice enough to show us the way back since he was going in the same direction. I invited him to have dinner with us at the Tak Sen Restaurant, upon arrival, there was a long line of people outside, I went in to talk to the owner, as I have in the past few days, and suddenly a waitress gave me a table, so I called my husband and the local guy we invited to the table. Both him and my husband was impressed, I said I just lucked out, but it was the best dinner we've had and even the local guy acknowledged that he'd been wanting to try the place but always had no luck getting in.Show less

Author: Christopher N
Title: Worse and expensive
Review: Worse food in penang and disappointed with the service. The fish that I ordered was not fresh and I felt nauseous after the dinner. The dishes were simple and overpriced.  Bad first experience for my wife and I. Will be the last for us.

Author: Food_Art_JunkieSingapore, Singapore
Title: Decent Penang "Tze Char"
Review: Went to Tek Sen for dinner on the recommendation of a Penang foodie. Having been warned that it gets crowded, we tried to make reservations for dinner but was told that they do not take reservations and we had to queue. Indeed, when we arrived past 8 pm, there was still a pretty long queue. But turnover is fast, and we waited only for about 10 minutes before getting a table.Ours was a party of 5 and we decided to indulge. We ordered the soup of the day (pig's stomach), sambal kacang botol (not sure how to describe this -- so please refer to pic), bitter gourd cooked with salted egg and minced pork, double fried roast port, assam (tamarind) prawns, deep fried belachan (fermented prawn paste) chicken wings and their signature toufu with minced pork and prawns. The soup was a disappointment because it was clearly laced with MSG, a usual short-cut adopted by restaurants to avoid the hassle of making proper soup stock etc. The other dishes, however, fared better. The sambal kacang botol was excellent. It had a nice crunch, with no "green" taste or the characteristic "stickiness" you find with lady's fingers (which I was expecting when I first saw the kacang botol). The bitter gourd with salted egg and minced pork was also good. There was only a mild tinge of bitterness which was well balanced with the salted egg. The double fried roast pork was also well done with the sugar properly caramelised. The meat used had a good balance between lean and fat portions and went well with rice. The tamarind prawns was well done too, with a good balance between the sourness of the assam and salt/sugar added. The prawns were large and fresh. The belachan chicken wings was not bad although I would have preferred a stronger taste of the fermented prawn paste. The wings were well fried, crispy on the outside, juicy inside. The toufu dish was normal.All in all, a good meal and reasonably priced at that -- our party of 5 paid RM150 for all the food we ordered!! Do bear in mind that because of the crowd, they run out of food and stop accepting customers quite early around 9 pm.Show less

Author: UnderBigHillGeorge Town, Malaysia
Title: Authentic Penang Home Cook Style
Review: I remember visiting Tek Seng with my parents when it was still a small stall at the road side decades ago. Since moving into a more appropriate restaurant, it hasn't change a bit. It still serves a lot of my favorite dishes.First of all, you must be able to accept the chaotic ambiance (It is exactly how most "kopitiam" in Penang was like a few decades ago, and even today). Secondly, you must have the patience to wait in the line (well, again, you are always in the line waiting in most of the famous restaurants in Penang). Thirdly, it is strictly an authentic Penang restaurant, so you must be able to accept the relatively small portion of the food serve (the portion serve here is perfect for most old Penangites) If you can accept the above 3 conditions, you will love this restaurant.My favorite dishes are mostly the simple ones:1) the roasted pork fried with chilli padi. Even if you don't like roasted pork, you will fall in love with this dish since the sauce and the hint of chilli padi make it very fragrant. 2) 3 flavored steam eggs - They mix salted duck eggs, chicken eggs and century eggs and steam. The steam egg is extremely smooth.3) Belacan sailumi. "Sailumi" is a type of vegetable that you seldom see nowadays. Most people and restaurants forgotten about this humble vegetable. Hence, this is the dish that I must order everytime I visit because it goes very well with belacan chilli.Show less

Author: RK649
Title: Excellent food in local ambiance
Review: Well worth a visit. We arrived early but still had to wait. The food was great and the setting was local and very chaotic. I wish we had a place like this at home.

Author: TangerineW
Title: Overrated But still enjoyed
Review: Our minibus driver recommended we try this restaurant. It is more of a joint in a shophouse. It serves dishes that one would normally find in homes. Common fried tofu in gravy, pork belly in black sweet sauce (but I wished the chunks were bigger), stir-fried bean sprouts with spring onions and salted fish, curry fish-head assam (you can choose stingray meat as an alternative), fried chicken wings marinated in shrimp paste (belacan). Those are my kid's favourite together with the pork belly dish. Worth a try if you pine for home-cooked style dishes. Show less

Author: JoseLuisG160Benicasim, Spain
Title: Fun experience in Penang
Review: This is one of the most popular joints to eat in Penang.You eat amongst locals and tourists which blended well without making the restaurant loosing its character.Typical chinese shophouse offering local food. You may have to queue to get a table but only for a short while due to the high turnover.I would think the great atmosphere outweighs here the excellence of the food which remains basic although consistently tasty.Good value as well. And again even if we found better flavours elsewhere, I am happy granting top marks here since it was very good fun indeed.You will not be disappointed.Show less

Author: namealusDallas
Title: Homemade tofu and double cooked pork with chili
Review: Excellent Chinese food; probably one of the best I've ever had. Simple presentation and subtle yet complex flavors. Don't expect fancy service (or air conditioning), but they do provide prompt and patient service (and many ceiling fans). Go to this place if you're in Georgetown and order the two items above.Show less

Author: AnnieTMooreMelbourne, Australia
Title: Worth a visit in Georgetown!
Review: Visited this very busy restaurant, arrived approx. 7.30 and was lucky enough to be seated straight away. Within 15 minutes there was a lengthy queue. Excellent Chinese food. We chose the signature dishes and thoroughly enjoyed the Twice cooked pork with chilli, spinach with fungus and egg, sweet and sour pork with steamed rice. Appeared to be lots of regulars which is always a good sign. Plenty of noise and activity.Show less

Author: SChandra1
Title: Not to be missed
Review: Call ahead to make reservation, this restaurant practically packed from the minute they open til close. Tell the staff you want a "Michael jackson" drink, you wouldn't have guessed what actually it is :) soya bean drink mixed with grass jelly, surprisingly a good combo

Author: 4EverHungry115Hong Kong, China
Title: All-Star Good Food!
Review: When a local Penang foodie recommends, it must be good. So armed with a sketchy map, no address, we managed to find this restaurant: the only bright light on Carnarvon Street. There was already a queue when we got there past 7pm, which is a sure sign of great food to come! While waiting, we studied the menu: so much to choose from, everything also want! Basically, if you order from their star-recommendations, you won't go wrong. While we were tucking into our numerous dishes, we sudddenly heard shouts. One of the staff was waving his arms, signalling that the restaurant has sold out of food and closed for the night's business. We were shocked: it was not yet 8:30pm!!! So come early, have a feast! It's really good value for money, and everything's fresh and yummilicious!!Show less

Author: MahoutMalSandringham, Australia
Title: Great - a Georgetown must!
Review: This a great restaurant which started life in a different location as a hawker stall so make sure you have their specials. They've been cooking them for a long time and do it right every time. Full of locals, which is a giveaway to quality and value. We couldn't help but go back to have more meals. Their pork and chilli is just fantastic as was the Asian spinach, fungus and egg, the chicken and ginger was just wonderful. If fact every plate we had was an experience we raved about. Also loved the lime drink in a mug.Great food, great price. A beauty!! Show less

Author: JuliaQAVaerloese, Denmark
Title: Excellent food!
Review: We came twice while being in Georgetown.It is very busy around 7-8 pm, but the staff is very nice and makes sure you are seated.Everything seemed very fresh and well-prepared!I can definitely recommend the squid with salt and pepper and the spinach with eggs. Enjoy!Show less

Author: BaliGalSydney
Title: Buzzing restaurant!
Review: Get here early if you don't want to queue! Very popular with the locals and quite well known now to tourists. The Chinese food is amazing and so tasty. Authentic Penang restaurant. Try Tek Sen for the food and the people watching!

Author: Gary LSingapore, Singapore
Title: 2nd Best Roast Pork In Penang
Review: Had only a few hours in Penang, and this place was packed during lunch time. The food was good. It depends on your taste buds, but, I think, the best roast pork comes from "SKY CAFE" in the backpackers area. Having said that I must admit, their claypot chicken rice with salted fish was excellent.Show less

Author: SaudiArabia1002Saudi Arabia
Title: Noisy, busy, popular, don't miss it
Review: This is were the locals and their familites eat, its noisy, busy and crowded but fantastic. Metal tables and chairs don't be shy order lots don't think you will be disappointed, try new things or look, point and order what fun. Cannot imagine anything is not good, have fun.Show less

Author: Dr_Les_Sg
Title: Brilliant penang food
Review:
If you are in Penang please visit.

The double roast pork is heaven, and all the other dishes worthwhile.  Get there early, and Coe relaxed, sit under a fan, act lie local, enjoy a tiger beer.

Author: BlueGTSingapore, Singapore
Title: Worth a visit, nice double-roasted pork!
Review: Went to Tek Sen for Lunch on a recent trip to Penang, overall, it was a reasonable place for lunch and prices were not as high as expected (total bill of 37 MYR for two).Between the two of us who went, we ordered one small seasonal vegetables, one small double-roasted pork, and one small Claypot chicken with salted fish. Each dish was around ~10-12 MYR. Drinks like a Lime Juice or Barley with Lime were between 1-2 MYR each.The food was good, vegetables were cooked properly and the sauce had a nice flavor. The claypot chicken was also good, though I didn’t particularly like the parts of the chicken that they used, too many bones. Finally, the double roasted pork was excellent, highly recommended if you are to visit Tek Sen.They are used to foreigners and therefore can explain things in English and will seat you, come take your order, bring a proper bill and so forth.Worth a visit if you are in Penang, make sure to not miss the roasted pork!Show less

Author: GrouchoSydneyNeutral Bay, Australia
Title: Great authentic local Penang food and atmosphere.
Review: Tek Sen is a great place for people who appreciate a locals experience with authetic local food, friendly service and excellent value. It may not be the best restaurant in Penang but it is certainly up there with them. Despite being criticised by some for slow service, or having to wait for a table people who know good food will overlook the aluminium table tops and little stools and enjoy its great tastes and good value. It is a an essential addition to a foodies list of must tries in PenangShow less

Author: laetitia gParis, France
Title: The best sweet & sour pork of the Malaysia ...
Review: we went to Tek Sen tonight ... and we try the sweet & sour pork (we are a kind of "sweet & sour specialist" and we already ate a lot in different country). Honnestly ... it was the best we never eat! congratulation to the cooker and the team. a busy restaurant but for sure you will find the quality !!GO GO and enjoy the best chinese food of Penang !!!!Show less

Author: TeikhinKuala Lumpur
Title: No surprise but worth trying
Review: We visited this restaurant many years ago and I had long forgotten the taste until my mom suggested going there last Sunday. As this was a holiday, we had to wait for a while before getting seated. This restaurant is still preserved its local traditional Chinese 'kopitiam' in the old days. Atmosphere was ok with friendly staffs. We ordered the recommended fried tofu, sting ray curry, fried pork slices and fried veggie. No doubt, the food did preserve its local authentic taste which usually served on an ordinary dull plate (without any décor). However, I personally think that the food is over-rated. Probably, as a Penangite, this original taste might not be able to overwhelm me. However, I do recommend giving it a try especially non-Penangite. As mentioned by other reviewers, the price of the food is slightly more expensive if compare with other local kopitiam. As this restaurant is located near the wet market and does not have its own car park, finding a parking lot may be a problem. As a conclusion, not bad but not that great either.Show less

Author: choihoweboonPenang
Title: A bit over-rated restaurant
Review: As a true Penangite, I think a lot of tourists flocking to this restaurant had over-rated it. The 'biggest' dislike that I have for this restaurant is its price. One example is the 'Spinach Soup' which will cost you MYR$15 while other typical restaurant will only charge you MYR$8 to MYR$10.Bear in mind that there are a lot of 'choo char' restaurants in Penang and so, why limit yourself to this one only? Just around the corner, there's a restaurant called Ghee Hiang (in Hokkien) or Yee Heong (in Cantonese) along the Campbell Street which serves better dishes in terms of tastes. And the most important of all is that it's cheap. There is also another chinese 'choo char' restaurant (Hai Beng Coffee Shop) ~200+meters away along the Pitt Street or Jalan Masjid Kapitan Keling. Their famous dish is the fried fish with small onion. So, just go explore more restaurants or coffee shops in Penang. You will meet wonders!Show less

Author: bleudauphin2805
Title: Average
Review: Food was average given the Trip Advisor award that we saw hanging on the wall so we were expecting a lot more!

Author: UnderBigHillGeorge Town, Malaysia
Title: Authentic Local Food
Review: I grow up eating at this restaurant. It was a small stall at the roadside a few decades back. Now it is at a nicely renovated shop. The food is fantastic. Very authentic local Chinese home-cook-style.This restaurant is always full of both tourist and local. They have a few great menu that I always like to order, including:- 3-flavoured steam eggs- stingray curry- Char Siew Bak ( fried barbeque pork) with black soy sauce and chili padiPlease also you check for daily special from the waiter/waitress.It is hard to find a parking space nearby. If you drive, please make sure you go earlier.Show less

Author: LyndaHLLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Favourite local restaurant in Penang
Review: I've eaten here a number of times over two years. The food is fantastic and the atmosphere is great. This used to be a roadside stall and has grown and grown into a restaurant. Decor is shabby chic without trying. Service is very friendly, and the prices are extraordinarily low. Tofu dishes are very good and also highly recommend the chrysanthemum tea. They will give you this to take away in a little plastic bag and all the food can ordered as takeout. I love the fact that it is on a street with a busy fruit market, although this closes around midday. Adds to the bustle.Show less

Author: alanandlouiseEdinburgh, United Kingdom
Title: Amazing food
Review: Went last night after checking out the reviews on here. Got the last table at 7pm, by 7:30 there was a 20-min wait. As it's Chinese New Year the place is full of Chinese families, both tourist and local. We had the chicken with sour plum sauce, double roasted pork and morning glory with sambal. Each dish was excellent, but the chicken was supreme. Total cost with 2 portions of rice was 38RM, around 8 quid.It's easy to see why the locals love this place, we're going back tomorrow, off to Red Garden (no8 on list) tonight. Show less

Author: tommodonohoelondon
Title: great atmosphere
Review: Loved this little open aired local Chinese cuisine cafe , not for the unadventurous though as no AC , plastic plates, on a noisy street which restaurant opens up onto but fantastic food , waiter can chat about the menu in English , an authentic experience !Show less

Author: santigomezruizToledo, Spain
Title: Amazing food at a very low price
Review: This restaurant is maybe one of the best that I have visited in my stay in Malaysia and Indonesia, the price was ridiculously low and the food was excellent with a wide variety of items you really want to eat all...I ate the chicken with plumb sauce and a similarity to nasi goreng that was excellent...totally recommendable, the only thing is that is crowded the whole time, but that's normal for the best restaurants I've visited in PenangShow less

Author: CrookedviewGeorge Town, Malaysia
Title: Delicious local fare
Review: Nice local Malaysian food at a good price. The service was friendly service but not so accurate on orders, had to repeat ourselves a few times. However the waitress was friendly and willing to help where she can. The food all tasted good and was presented well.Show less

Author: GajaNelson Bay, Australia
Title: Extensive Menu
Review: We arrived at 8:15PM and were seated at the last available table, a large one for 8. Soon after a English couple asked could they join us and we proceeded to have a great night. We ordered a asparagus sambal, a roasted pork done in small pieces, a sliced double roasted pork and rice. All were of excellent quality and flavour and arrived at our table quickly. The service was excellent with the waiter providing suggestions when our first choice, a nonya pork dish, was unavailable The menu covers about 5 pages and has descriptions in English. We chose Tiger beer to accompany our meal, but there are many drinks to choose from. They close at 9PM and we were the last to reluctantly leave at 9.20PM. We will arrive earlier next time to casually enjoy the ambiance and fine food.Show less

Author: Koenwar
Title: Best food so far in our trip thru malaysia
Review: After reading so many good reviews we went to tek sen. We had high expectations witch were truly met. The pork is great, but the sweet and sour chicken is even suberb. In two weeks Malaysia the best food we had.

Author: frankie27
Title: Best pork dish I had for a long time
Review:
fantastic food, clean and cheap, buzzing with locals - may have to queue but so worth it
house special pork dish was heavenly; being alone, I shared a table with a mother and son and it made the experience even more fun
highly recommended

Author: Tobypoh
Title: Nice Chinese cuisines
Review: A good place to enjoy Chinese cuisine, should give a try. Place was quite clean as well if compared to others local Chinese restaurant.

Author: TeenieBearSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good food good price
Review: Despite its standard setting, you can tell the food is good by the queue. We're not of Chinese descent and was recommended this place by the hotel staff. We loved the food! The unpolished setting just adds up to tge Georgetown experience which we find unique. We ordered sweet and sour chicken, sambal veggies and omellete. All were satisfyingly good.Tip: go there early for dinner to beat the queue. The waiters don't speak English too well. Just point at the menu and speak slowly and clearly. Menu's in English.Show less

Author: ChernLamKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Delicious Nyonya and Baba Food..
Review: Had a lunch and dinner there, was looking other than hawker foods then found this place a street away from the place we stayed. Order for the curry Fish, assam Prawn and bellman Petai and the turmeric Fried Chicken and not too forget the steam Egg. Imagine so many dishes but me and my wife manage to finish it.Show less

Author: AlHaViVienna, Austria
Title: Excellent food
Review: Had the pleasure to find Tek Sen. They server very good food. I liked it very much. The place gets crowded so it might happen that you have to wait a little bit for the table, but it is worth doing it.The guests are mainly local people, which also confirms the quality of food. In a nutshell go there and eat.Show less

Author: Newfie013
Title: Interesting experience
Review: Went at 8pm on a Thursday and it was very busy.  The atmosphere of the restaurant is interesting and the food is well prepared.  The service was friendly and efficient.  The most interesting part was people watching!!!

Author: CoylumVancouver, Canada
Title: Great Chinese cafe
Review: As a regular visitor to excellent Chinese restaurants in Vancouver, I can say that these people are really good. This is a Neighbourhood cafe, with a little bit of gloss. It is not fine dining. Plastic plates etc.. However, if you are looking for good food at $5 or $6 a plate and think you know your Chinese, you'll like this.Show less

Author: 4066Brisbane, Australia
Title: Yum Yum
Review: This place was recommended by a taxi driver and did not disappoint. The place is full of locals, testimony to the fact that the food is sure to be good - and it was! The restaurant is in an open shop front and has aluminium tables and stools. The staff are run off their feet but remain attentive and cheerful and are happy to discuss the menu. The menu really is extensive and the food is fresh, different and out of this world. We went for lunch and returned for dinner! It cost us less than $60 Australian to feed a hungry family of five. Can't imagine a trip to Penang without stopping here for a feed. Very highly recommended. Try the double roasted pork, the black pepper chicken and the potato flowers.Show less

Author: Fred o
Title: Wow!
Review: Had the double roasted bork and their soup of the day: Ling Ngau soup (Lotus flower soup with boiled spare ribs). Both excellent, going back there tonight for our last Georgetown meal.

Author: hoolifromhoustonNew York City, New York
Title: Delicious
Review: We were looking for a sit down place, something a little nicer than the food stalls, so a local foodie recommend we check out TekSen. He said that there are a lot of Chinese restaurants in Georgetown but this is definitely one of the best. We had their specialty pork, vegetable and fish dishes -- everything was great! We even went with a friend from Hong Kong who was impressed by the food.Show less

Author: seek
Title: Local food
Review: This place gets crowded pretty early. food is above average and good service. do plan to visit this place  when you are in penang. you will like it.

Author: wintermelonKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Reasonable priced Chinese food in Georgetown
Review: After eating the street hawker's food in Georgetown for many days, I wanted to eat some rice and vegetables to balance up my diet, as there is not much vegetables in street hawker's food although they are really tasty to eat.And this restaurant is very close by my hotel in Lebuh Chulia.Service was good and efficient.The taste of the food that I ordered was good. I ordered the stir fried broccoli with seafood and clay pot tofu with seafood (The vegetables dishes here are usually cook with some pork meat and pig's liver, but I didn't want to eat pork and liver), There's no problem to personalize your own taste and ingredients. Just tell them what you want and don't want...I also had the homemade Chrysanthemum tea. It was very nice too. Cooling and refreshing especially after eating so much street hawker's food which are quite heating.Cleanliness is good.I paid about 23 rm (6 Euro) for the rice, two dishes and the drink.Recommended for decent Chinese food in Penang.Show less

Author: ar_sgpWoodlands
Title: Excellent "chir-char" style Chinese food
Review: We checked out this restaurant that was highly recommended by friends of ours and what a treat it turned out to be! Located on the ground-floor of two shop-houses, it is very popular with the locals (actually a good sign already of its quality). We were not sure of what to do and neither did they offer us a menu to choose from. So it was based on recommendations of the waitress, whose constant reference was to invite us to look at this table or that table to see what the dish she recommended looked like. We had excellent sting-ray done assam style, kong bak, siow bak and some veggies. If you want to beat the crowd, get there before 6.30 pm.Show less

Author: MacDaddyinSingLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Best food we had in Penang
Review: A very local place packed to the gills: always a good sign. We had several delicious dishes, the most memorable were the double roasted pork (best with chilli but our daughter wolfed down 2 plates without), chilli chicken and kang kong.If you value quality authentic food above fancy furnishings (or a/c), this is the best in Penang: if you want fine dining perhaps try elsewhere.Show less

Author: Wandering_Soul_Au
Title: Delicious
Review:
Most of the food we had in Penang was delicious.  Then we visited Tek Sen on our last night in Georgetown.  Heaven in my mouth.

Try the double roasted pork with chili.  Just thinking about it makes my mouth water.

Author: Wendy TKlang, Selangor, Malaysia
Title: Deserve to be ranked No.1
Review: As Tripadvisor ranked No.1 restaurant in Georgetown, it's really worth to have a try for their recommended dish such as Fried roast pork, Stout Chicken, Asam Fish, Fei long (spinash with fungus and egg) with reasonable price. But it's very small portion for the food served. There are always long queue and hard to get parking around there. Not easy to get there if you are not familiar the place.Show less

Author: pemblinBangkok, Thailand
Title: A great palce for a local feel
Review: As other reviewers have said this place is nothing fancy to look at. But the food is excellent and a place full of locals lets you know its good value and good food and it is.Staff are helpful for out-of-towners like ourselves.It does get pretty busy so their is a fair chance you will have to wait but worth the wait.Also let the waiter order some dishes for your. Their choices were excellent and not the most expensive things on the menuShow less

Author: Pam L
Title: Oh Yum!
Review: Went several times and had really good Chinese food.  Excellent service and really good value.   Highly recommended.

Author: AaronB101Norwich, United Kingdom
Title: Delicious
Review: A typical Penang restaurant with metal tables and plastic chairs but great food. I was the only westerner there and was put outside, im not sure if that was to entice more in (if so it didn’t work) but I'm happy there.I had double roast pork, aubergine with fermented bean curd, some rice and a beer and paid just over RM30. Food was delicious and fresh, service friendly and quick. Worth a try if you are looking for dinner.Show less

Author: CeaserBoyBangkok, Thailand
Title: Simple but good....
Review: The Chinese food served here were pretty delicious, fresh and appetizing. I can see why the place is at number one in Tripadvisor as most reviews were spot on. Its a typical coffee shop setting, no fancy decoration, just good service with good food. Price can be quite expensive if you are on a budget but then to me its worth paying a little extra for good food. Finding a seat during dinner can be a challenge as this place is always full, very popular with locals and tourists.Overall a good place to explore some local Chinese cuisine, go with the recommendations from staffs...they know what they are doing.Show less

Author: Noirien
Title: A Taste of Tek Sen
Review: Went to Tek Sen after seeing it on tripadvisor and it did not disappoint. Much more than a tourist attraction, it is always a good sign when a restaurant appears to be full of locals, yes it is a bit basic but just close your eyes and take in the sounds and smells. A busy Friday night, we were seated straight away and orders taken after a short wait. We had; stir fried Kang Kong with Sambal Sauce, Mapo Tofu, stir-fried chicken in black pepper sauce and the days special, duck with beetroot. All of the dishes were faultless, a wonderful array of flavours all well made, well balanced and mouth wateringly good!Show less

Author: watchwinnGeorge Town, Malaysia
Title: Local street food.
Review: A good place for breakfast and lunch. Tek Sen goes back to the early days when it was a food haven in the town center. Nowadays it is a tourist attraction, by its name. The hawker food is nothing to shout for, but the ice kacang is worth a try, though pricey. The other attraction is the char koay teow, but there are better choices elsewhere. A nice place to drop by to experience the local kopitiam setting.Show less

Author: jennyMalaysia18Penang Island, Malaysia
Title: Good authentic food
Review: Went to TekSen Restaurant for dinner recently and find that the quality of the food is still maintain.This place is always crowded and you have to go early. Operating hours Lunch - 12.00 noon to 2.30 pm and dinner 6pm to 9 pm. You have to take a number if the place is full and wait. Also cash payment and no credit card. Total cost of dinner comes up to RM247.80 inclusive of drinks for 7 adults. 2 bowls of clear shark's fin soup, with scallop and chicken meat - RM90/-Scallop taufu - RM20/-Curry fish - RM30/-Bitter Gourd - RM12/-Asam Prawns - RM30/-Kao Yok - Pork dish - RM14/-Squid - RM20/-Kak kua ( another form of gourd ) - RM14/-7 rice - 7 drinksShow less

Author: italyItaliaitalia
Title: What a disappointment
Review: I really didn't understand the good reviews about this restaurant on Tripadvisor: this place is lousy, shabby, expensive and the food is tastless. I followed the suggestions of the owner in ordering my meal and as the dishes came I was more and more not satisfaied. A lot of better options in town.Show less

Author: Jaja000Breda, The Netherlands
Title: Simple, authentic,good price
Review: Our hotel receptionist pointen us to TekSen, two blocks from our hotel. If you are around this is a nice place to have some good Chinese food for a good price. The restaurant is quite big, and very crowded when we arrived, but after a five minutes wait we got a table. The interior is very functional, your in out of the restaurant before you know it, but the food is good and the owner very nice. Good value for money if you want to have a quick dinner.Show less

Author: Debstar2000
Title: Simply yummy
Review: Our hotel recommended this place as the best place for Chinese food in George town - they weren't wrong! Its probably one of the best authentic Chinese meals I've ever had and although the dining area is basic, the atmosphere is buzzing and the food was amazing as well as very reasonably priced.If you're ever in George town you simply must go, its too good to miss.Show less

Author: Gwei10
Title: Great food in buzzling setting
Review: This is like a restaurant version of a hawker market. The choice and food quality is as high, ambiance and pulse is still there. What you don't have to do is walk around to order and walk away smelling like a kitchen. The chairs and tables are not the worst plastic you can get out of China but instead a nice stainless steel version which matches the overall well designed interior but keeps the cozy hawker feeling.Definitely worth a visit.Show less

Author: susBelgi_belgië
Title: best food in georgetown
Review: restaurant was closed first days of our visit so we could only eat at Tek Sen last day of our stay in Georgetown.And ... if it was open the first day, it would have been several times!Excellent food! nice atmosphere ! clean !Busy with local people having dinner.Must go !Show less

Author: Amy M
Title: Amazing food in the heart of Georgetown.
Review: Our hotel recommended this restaurant for lunch and we are so glad we went! Awesome food, the place is so busy which is a big giveaway of the quality of food here.

Author: CrozStut
Title: Local Gme
Review: We absolutely loved this place - even the queue to get in. Garlic chicken, chilli chicken and twice fried pork were highlights.  we ate there twice on our three night stay. Great value for money

Author: Wen96
Title: Delicious!!
Review: This is one food place I will miss in Penang.  We ordered tofu, fried roasted pork, assam stingray and vegetables with salted fish.  Cleaned out the plates in record time despite not being hungry.

Author: journeymanDublin
Title: Tastiest food ever!
Review: Simply the best Chinese food I've ever tasted. Their signature dish, double roasted pork, is sensationally good. Service is prompt and friendly. Food is amazing.

Author: TravelFromSingapore
Title: Lunch & Dinner
Review:
Chinese food. It was so good that we went for lunch and dinner. 
Must-try: the herbal soup, the pigs feets, etc.  and the drinks (all!)
Very crowded during the week end. For dinner, start at 6PM!

Author: cyclingmansitiawan
Title: Ate here once, top notch!
Review: This is definitely a restaurant to check out. Located in a side street of Chulia street. The restaurant is always busy and you most likely have to queue up which is not really a problem as you can order when you wait for a table. One of the restaurants to eat when you're in Penang.Show less

Author: 700Family20Den Bosch, The Netherlands
Title: Average food and really bad athmosphere
Review: We went Sunday, july 15 th, we got a table near the kitchen and the trash cans, it was very chaotic, we were still eating around 9.15 pm when they started cleaning and putting chairs on tables next to us. Rice was cold when rest of the meal arrived. Average food and bad atmosphere, we never go again.Show less

Author: Rob MDordrecht, The Netherlands
Title: Nothing special
Review: Went here because of the ranking on this site but were disappointed. Food was just ok and relatively pricey. Certainly not much better than what you will get in a hawker place but much more expensive. People are queuing to get in though so you will get the eye to move on when you're finished eating. Compared to the many good restaurants in Chinatown, Singapore this is substandard.Show less

Author: Kris403Melbourne, Australia
Title: Heaven!
Review: We went here for my birthday dinner, and whilst we had enjoyed EVERY meal in Penang no matter the price (and some were REALLY cheap) Tek Sen was a standout for service, food and atmosphere! It really is where the cool kids hang out in PenangShow less

Author: Ruth B
Title: Delish!
Review: A must visit in George Town. Try the double roasted pork, a Tek Sen speciality. And the lime juice was divine too. We were truly stuffed afterwards! Very friendly and welcoming also, good service and very good prices.

Author: LeilaSeattleSeattle
Title: There's a good reason why it's #1
Review: Okay, I only had one dish the two times I was here - sweet and sour deep fried chicken - but it was the very best sweet & sour chicken I have ever eaten. You'd think it would be a simple enough dish to prepare well, but I had given up ordering it because of how unpleasant it usually turns out. The sauce here was not made with a bunch of thickening agent, and actually had a little heat in it, which I loved. I also tried my companion's dish - eggplant with salted fish - which was also really good. Very successful dining experiences for both of us.Show less

Author: DisasterdarceCottesloe, Australia
Title: Authentic food and service
Review: Westerners need not be afraid.Steamed riceBraised duckDouble roast porkKai Lan garlicS&S chicken2 x large beers = au$25The main fellow serving (owner?) helped serve our western palates and everything was spot on. The pork and chicken were absolutely fantastic and the beer suitably cold.Show less

Author: hotanditchyEl Paso County, Colorado
Title: Cracking good feed
Review: Very popular restaurant that any visiting food reviewers or travel writers always go to. A food writer from Sydney described one dish as 'pork crack', and was such a fan he ate there twice in one night.Locals consider it to be 'a bit expensive', and it costs more than eating on the street, but the food is good quality. It's best to go with a few people, as then you can try more dishes. Try and go earlier in the evening, as a few times I've rolled up after 9pm, and they are already in wind-down mode. The vegetable dishes are interesting, and offer more variety than the standard Chinese menu.Show less
