Author: BallardBeaverSeattle
Title: The Real Deal
Review: There's a reason this is the #1 rated restaurant in Georgetown, according to Tripadvisor reviewers. Outstanding Chinese food, great variety, cheerful and efficient staff. This is by no means a fancy place -- metal tables and stools and limited decor. But it's about the food. My companion Elizabeth thought her sweet and sour chicken was just about perfection for this too-commonly insipid dish. She ordered the small portion on our first visit and jumped it up to medium-sized on our second visit. I started with the bitter gourd and prawns in fermented bean sauce -- a very Chinese item. Honestly, although good, it wasn't my favorite-ever bitter gourd dish, but I think that was more a matter of my personal taste than any flaw in the preparation or concept. It was still quite good. The second time we went, I ordered what turned out to be a total winner: claypot aubergine with salted fish. The "small" portion was very generous and just delicious -- probably the best aubergine preparation I've ever had. The taste was salty and smoky in a lovely blance, and the aubergine was perfectly cooked -- done, but not mushy.The staff were exceptionally cheery and welcoming and efficient.This is a great, very Penang Place (on both visits we were the only Westerners in sight, but there's a full English menu and the staff we dealt with spoke good English).Show less

Author: WiserTravellerLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Simple but great Penang style food
Review: We had this place down as one of our must-eat restaurants on a short trip to Penang. The decor is simple and down to earth and not really anything special. However the food was great and authentically spicy. We were asked how spicy we wanted the dishes and so we opted for 'medium'. We enjoyed the double cooked roasted port (Siu Yok) which was a nice change from the usual way it is cooked in Cantonese style restaurants. Here it comes stir fried with chilli/sambal and has a slightly sweet taste. It was very more-ish. The stir fried potato-leaf with sambal was also very tasty and quite an unusual dish to see on the menu. Our favourite dish was the Curried stingray fish which came in a fantastic sauce which was slightly sour possibly by the addition of tamarind or other souring ingredient. Definitely recommended.Here in Penang restaurants seem to close when the last patron leaves so this can mean they close before the official closing times. Best to arrive a little early as we had to persuade the staff to stay open for a little longer as we were late arriving for lunch.Show less

Author: lixTKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Yummy but pricey food
Review: 4 of us had dinner yesterday and we ordered 4 dishes, deep fried fish fillet with black soy sauce and ginger, stirred fried roasted pork with chili, seaweed soup, toufu. Overall their standard of food still maintain but the size has really strung ! Their famous stirred fried roast pork with dry chili has strung so much and almost became mince pork ! We got only 3 pieces of fish fillet for the 4 of us and the same goes with the rest of the dishes. The price came up to RM 96 inclusive of 4 glasses of herbal tea and we have to go else where for a second round. IMO, the dishes we ordered was just ordinary so be prepared to pay more if you order prawn, fish and other seafood. For a restaurant in the heart of town with parking problem and no aircondition, price is steep.Show less

Author: MelbourneJUSTMEYarra, Australia
Title: Fantastic food
Review: We went to this restaurant because we had read about in a review in Australian Gourmet Traveller. It was amazing food. The flavours were all very distinctive in the dishes. Also for a local family restaurant the staff were great and suggested other dishes for us to have. The top dish was Pork Trotters in Black vinegar - delicious. Very good value.Show less

Author: Hwee K
Title: A must try!
Review: The food was simply yummy and every dish was cooked with much effort, we could feel it! Don't miss the roasted pork:)

Author: NLBSToronto, Canada
Title: Casual, local and very good food!
Review: REcommended by our hotel, and a very short walk from the hotel, we arrived close to closing time, but were made to feel welcome. Most customers were local and was packed. As indicated in other reviews, no aircon but big fans and open to the street, so was not uncomfortable. Arriving late also meant they were out of some of their specialties, but good alternatives were recommended.Wait staff were helpful in advising us on quantity to order as well. Had we stayed longer in Penang would have gone back. Delicious and inexpensive...and ice cold beer!Show less

Author: Melissa GWoombye, Australia
Title: Delicious chinese food
Review: This restaurant was recommended to us by one of the staff from our hotel. He advised us to go early or we would'nt get a table - he was right! We arrived at 6.30 pm and were lucky to get a table, as a group was just leaving. The food was delicious - we had a pork, chicken and tofu dish to share between us - it came with bowls of rice that the owner's wife filled from a giant steaming pot. It was fascinating sitting and watching the constant action of the owner and staff moving and clearing tables for the next sitting, bringing out steaming plates of food from the kitchen and replacing the plastic table cloths while sitting under the huge fans eating and drinking cold beers. A very authentic, enjoyable experience.Show less

Author: peterpatterpot
Title: cheap and good
Review: very tasty, no frills, good cantonese cooking. When you are craving for tasty good home cooked Cantonese food, this place will come to mind. Its like what your grandma would cook " back in those days "..

Author: discerningdiner52Belfast, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent Chinese food
Review: We tried this restaurant out based on other reviews on Tripadvisor. Sadly, we only went the day before we left Penang, otherwise we would have gone back to try out a few other dishes, as the food really was delicious. For a start, it was PACKED with local people - that is always a good sign. The owner was friendly and helpful bringing us an English menu and suggesting dishes to try. The pork belly (with added chili) was delicious. My husband never eats pork and he LOVED it. Chicken in plum sauce was tender and again, delicious. We ordered a veg dish of braised lettuce - cruchy and full of flavour. If only Chinese restaurants in the UK could cook food to this standard! The only downside was the fact that several customers lit up cigarettes while we were eating, thankfully the open plan nature of the restaurant and the many, many fans meant that it wasn't quite as bad as we thought it would be. If you aren't quite adventurous enough to try hawker food, at least you'll get a fabulous authentic meal here.Show less

Author: Lissoni_LamingtonSydney, New South Wales, Australia
Title: Try the pork belly
Review: We ate the twice cooked pork belly and aubergine (eggplant). Pork belly was amazing. (We had the version without the chilli.)It was sticky and had complex flavours we were still trying to analyse on the way home. Yes, it doesn't have aircon, and the seats are rustic, but I loved the artwork on the wall and enjoyed the meal a lot.Show less

Author: IGH63
Title: Brilliant, go no further
Review:
Duck special, omelette with onion slices, prawns in tamarind sauce and some lovely spicy vegetable. Amazing. All wonderful, staff helpful and food terrific. Very busy and full of local people.
Sometimes have to wait a few minutes. Just do it!!!

Author: Wes LHong Kong, China
Title: Great Value and Tasty!
Review: We arrived by 7:30pm and many people had already been waiting for seats. As a Hong Kong guy, I have to say that the Chinese food here is very good! We ordered a dish of chicken, in Chinese+Malaysian style, which was simply delicious. I guess that the chef used some lemongrass to make it very tasty. Although it's very hot, we enjoyed the foods very much while sweating.Show less

Author: Gelo YSingapore
Title: Delicious, Value for money and Energetic staff
Review: Walking distance from Chulia Heritage Hotel; Went to this restaurant at 830pm on a Monday and yet der are still group of people waiting outside for avilable table., their last call for orders is at 9pm. They are close on Tuesdays.4 yunmy dishes and drinks for 5 adults summed up to 70MYR. Hochiak!Downside is their famous dish supply runs out during night time.Show less

Author: Centravanti
Title: Yummy... yummy... yummy
Review:
Good food, good service, the menu is in english,  the staff  speak quite good english.
average price is RM 12 for small portion, RM 14 for medium and RM 18 for XL [yes, there was no large there :)]

Author: Pennydoctor
Title: Tasty, tasty, very very tasty...
Review:
Unpretentious restaurant, really good food, menu in English.
Was very busy when we were there (probably a result of Trip Advisor!) and we had to wait for a table.  Value OK.
Would recommend.

Author: waterfall9999
Title: A nice place with quality dishes
Review: The food was good and tastey.  A nice mix of ingredients.  The staff was very nice.  But keep in mind it is just a regular chinese restaurant.

Author: tieneit
Title: Authentic home-cooked meal
Review: Simple deco with old fashioned steel table and stool. Nice aroma of authentic chinese home cooked meal. The signature dish that I like is Roasted pork with cili padi and Assam curry black pompano.

Author: Stu531Brighton, United Kingdom
Title: Great Chinese food, good price, lots of locals, gets busy
Review: This is a great place. Just what I like.Simple plastic chairs and as is decor.But a great menu and great food. The service is classic no fuss but very efficient.We had th double cooked pork with bird's eye chilli and the French beans with mince pork, and we can thoroughly recommend both.The dish come in small, medium or large about 12, 14, 16 myr per.This is the sort of place I could come back to again and again.A little greasey if I had to pick a negative but fat is flavour.Does get very busy and can be queues (worth the wait). Come early if you don't want o queue (6:30 - 7:00 ish).EnjoyShow less

Author: EscapingScotlandEdinburgh, United Kingdom
Title: Delicious food with locals
Review: Absolutely packed when we arrived and spilling onto pavement when we arrived. Full of locals which we took to be an excellent sign. Has English menu and staff have basic English. Food was delicious and at local prices. Decor not up to much (we sat on plastic patio chairs) but all that matters is the food! Highly recommend and easy to walk to in central GeorgetownShow less

Author: Angela MBanbury, United Kingdom
Title: Good place but not for health freaks!
Review: Having eaten at hawker stalls for the last week, this was a step up - we could be seated and our order taken! However, as others have said, it's still a basic place.It is busy but we managed to get a table at around 18.30. The staff are all really friendly and the menu has a good choice & range of dishes. The prices are around 10MYR for a small portion, 12/14MYR for medium and 20MYR for extra large. I had medium which is enough for a meal if you have rice or choose 2 dishes.Based on other reviews, I chose the double cooked pork with chilli and aubergine in fermented bean sauce. If you are a vegetarian, don't assume all veg dishes are suitable, The aubergine dish had minced pork in it. To be fair, the girl taking our order did tell us this when we ordered. The food was good but too oily for me. The pork seemed to be lardons cooked in a delicious sauce but with lots of oil too. The aubergine was also very oily. This was probably compounded by the fact that I didn't have rice which may have soaked up some of the greasiness. I enjoyed the meal, especially as we had a table outside and could watch the comings and goings in the little street. It didn't smell and it wasn't too hot but then we have had quite a bit of rain so it maybe in a really dry spell that would not be the case.Would I return? Probably not. But I would recommend if you're not a health freak like me!Show less

Author: Howie603Northumberland, UK
Title: Fabulous food, lovely staff, a must if in George Town!
Review: If you get a queue make sure you ask a waitress for a number. We were no 4 but we didn't wait long. Ordered deep fried chicken in plum sauce, deep fried squid in Thai sauce and home recipe double roasted pork with birds eye chilli ( wow!) oh my the food was outstanding, service great and very cold Tiger beer too! 70rm - very cheap.Show less

Author: marianmanPeregian Springs, Australia
Title: Fantastic food, amazing value
Review: We ate here twice recently, we had the best Nyonya food that we have ever had on both nights. The place is very popular and really busy, on our first visit (on a sunday night) we had to wait in line for a table and even then we had to share! but it was worth it. On the monday night we did not have to wait as table had just been vacated.Although pretty new the restaurant is housed in an open fronted shophouse and is very basic with metal tables, plasitic or metal stools, nothing fancy at all. The place is noisey and bustling, but the food makes up for all of that. They have a menu in english, but the specials are displayed in chinese on a whiteboard, the wait staff speak good english and can explain the specials.Everthing we ate was superb, including the duck with dried oyster mushrooms, frog with black chillies, whole fish with red sauce, but the best was the twice cooked pork. It was so good we had it on both nights. Prices were very low considering the quality of the food.If you want to experience the very best of Penang's local cusine then you have to try this place out, it is outstanding!Show less

Author: nigolaschZürich
Title: Tasty food at great prices
Review: Don't be shy! You might be the only non-asian sitting in this busy restauranat, but that's a good sign after all! Tek Sen offers great Chinese dishes at very reasonable prices. I've really eaten so great Chinese food before! The staff is nice and helpful. Certainly worth a visit while you visit Georgetown.Show less

Author: blokototerminous
Title: Why are all these cars clogging this little street?
Review: Before moving into a renovated, high-ceilinged shophouse, this restaurant used to plant many of its sheet-aluminum-clad tables out on the street; it was then a scramble when rain started to fall. Now everyone can eat under a roof, but Penangites' cars still fill every space up and down the street at dinnertime. I've learned to go there on foot and close to opening time at 6 p.m. to get a table. Ask about the daily specials written on the board in Chinese, or ask the server for recommendations from the English menu. This is one of my must-visits when coming to Penang about once a year. Most recently, it was a Teochew-style pomfret, with ginger and sour plums, steamed to perfection. How will I treat myself next time -- a duck dish, or prawns fried in salt? How about a bowl of the daily soup, which might have chunks of pork and turnip in it? And I can never pass up a plate of greens or asparagus stir-fried with sambal and prawns. This kind of food would win raves for a high-end eatery in a posh hotel, but instead it can be enjoyed on plastic plates and without pretension (or even tablecloths). Of course it's not as cheap as the nearby hawker carts, but it's very good value for the quality of the food and the relaxed setting.Show less

Author: Victoria451Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
Title: Romance, no, food YEAH BABY!
Review: This place is the real deal. We headed there on the recommendation of a local, and found it every bit as good as advertised.Looks like the new generation have paid attention to processes and service, without losing what the punters really come for - the FOOD.We agonised over the menu - Mike bottled out of the dragon spinich with the Judas Ear fungus - however we really enjoyed the petang with belecan and other well balanced, perhaps unique and seriously taste bud expanding choices.It was packed with locals rather than mat sallehs (always a good sign), however communications were no problem thanks to our zippy and helpful waitperson.We loved it!Show less

Author: lemonkatGeorge Town, Malaysia
Title: Go local here!
Review: I practically grew up with this place, hence, a regular! Simple and clean atmosphere but getting a car park can be tough on the weekdays. Absolutely delicious Chinese cuisine. Fresh ingredients and value for money! I love the "roast pork fried in black sauce" and "curry fish". Don't forget to try the "leng teh" while you're there ;)Show less

Author: ECKLKualaLumpurKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Less is More Part 13
Review: bright, cheery and clean - that is the first impression one gets upon arrival at the (new) tek sen which now occupies two yellow-painted shop lots along carnavon street. the spartan steel tables and stools are reminiscent of its humbler roots when this establishment used to occupy a small storefront around the corner on chulia street. you know a place is good when hordes of local chinese families start queuing up around dinner time. signature specialities not to be missed are the assam curry pomfret with lady's fingers (okra), chilli-fried roast pork, pickled mustard and duck soup, stir-fried clams with pickled leeks, curried stingray, kangkung belachan. cooking here is approached without a hint of pretension, just good honest homestyle cooking with lots of firey wok skill. to top it off, the prices are unbeatable and four can still dine for less than RM50, if you go easy on the premium seafood like pomfret and prawns. there is enough variety on the menu to have three straight meals without any repetition! highly recommended for authentic hearty local fare.Show less

Author: efpattersLos Angeles, California
Title: Licked the plates!
Review: I'm not sure we would have found this place or ventured in on our own, but it was recommended by a person living in Georgetown, so we went in search of it and took the plunge. I think we were the only caucasians there that night (Friday night of a holiday weekend), but we were greeted warmly and served with smiles by the staff. The menu lists everything in English too, so its easy enough to point to what you want and be understood. The food all seems to be cooked to order, very fresh, so it does take a little time but well worth it. And cheap. Come casual because you'll be in plastic chairs at metal tables (maybe sharing a table) with electric fans as cooling, no a/c. The place is clearly a local favorite -- so go!Show less

Author: Pieter ZHonfleur, France
Title: Magnificant food
Review: We had a late dinner here on Friday night. As recommended, we had the double roasted pork. The pork was so magnificantly tender that we wanted to order a second one. However, the kitchen closes at 9pm already. Don't let the strange surroundings detter you. This is a fantastic and affordable restaurant.Show less

Author: Biggababoinka
Title: Great food
Review:
Definitely try this restaurant!! Only annoying thing is we waited for about half hour to get our food, but they were very busy!! 
Note location is shown wrong on trip advisor site.  It is about 500m south of carnarvon rd and chulia rd intersection

Author: skittledogCambridge, United Kingdom
Title: Perfect chinese restaurant, full of locals but friendly to visitors
Review: Tried this place out after reading the 5 star reviews on here and was not disappointed. (Also allowed my menu choices to be dictated and can confirm that the double roasted pork is indeed sticky and delicious, and that the lime and barley drink is very refreshing, although I kept accidentally drinking the barley grains and wasn't sure if I emwas meant to or not...)Due to the busyness of the place, I ended up sharing a table, but this was fine as I ended up talking to a friendly Dutch couple who gave me tips for things to see.One thing to note - do not trust the map on tripadvisor, which places it at the back of the KOMTAR complex - it's actually at the northern end of Carnarvon St, near the junction with Chulia St.Show less

Author: nasi_ayam_searchBerlin, Germany
Title: excellent Chinese food
Review: There is a reason there is ALWAYS a huge queue of locals waiting for dinner here. While vegetarians don't get a look-in, the fish head curry, BBQ pork, and even the greens are excellent. Make sure you order a barley and lime drink as well - so refreshing. We will be back.Show less

Author: KewLAngPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Great Food with Home-cook flair
Review: This is one of our favorite restaurant as the chinese food dishes they offered has the Home cook flair to it. Must try: Twice Cook Pork, you will notice almost all tables has it, Sweet & Sour Pork, Fried Long Bean and Assam Prawn. The service is efficient and price is reasonable. The place will be pack during dinner times.Show less

Author: retrolinaCopenhagen, Denmark
Title: Excellent food and service
Review: Went here in July '10 and again twice in July '11. The menu had greatly expanded on my last visits, but each dish was absolutely delicious. It's a mix of Chinese and Malaysian dishes. Service is quick and efficient. The twice cooked pork is and absolute must-try.Show less

Author: Anthony GCambridge, United Kingdom
Title: Get there early before the locals
Review: For once we agreed with a Lonely Planet recommendation, and we were not disappointed with the food at this superb locals eatery. We arrived at 6pm and managed to get the last table. After that you had to join the queue of people waiting to eat, something we haven't seen anywhere else on our travels in Asia. The menu had some very unusual and interesting sounding options but we stuck to a couple of straightforward dishes; the chicken in plum sauce was superb, as was the sweet and sour pork.Considering how busy the place was the service was prompt, the ambiance was great, as you would expect from a place full of locals.Would eat there again if we were staying longer, definitely worth a try if you are in China Town.Show less

Author: Matahari_Bulan
Title: Delightful Ferringhi Grill
Review: Celebrated my hubby’s birthday with my big family.Truly felt pampered and fussed over by the attentive staff.There was complimentary roses to greet us and tasty surprise treats came in between our courses. Food was consistently good and fresh. Highly recommend this venue for the sweetest of memories for any special occasion.Show less

Author: davec916
Title: Best Seafood in Asia
Review: Excellent experience. Staff were very friendly and professional - particular commendation to the Manger, Safari and the team - went out of their way to make our evening unforgettable. Food was fresh and delicious - highly recommended.

Author: soonterngp
Title: Good but lack of details.
Review: Although short of staffs, the crew try their best. As our group is big, confusion in our orders is expected.I order a steak but forget to order a side dish. Steak is good but presentation is blend, no garnishes at all. A bare slab of meat !Show less

Author: ekeat79George Town, Malaysia
Title: Excellent fine-dining experience
Review: I managed to dine at this restaurant for the first time, when I took my other half there recently to celebrate her birthday. Despite being fully aware of the price range here, at least the restaurant really makes up for their "price tag", by offering patrons (esp. couples) with an excellent and romantic fine-dining experience that one would remember for the rest of his/her life. There is a dress code for dining here (i.e. smart casual), and it is advisable to make reservations prior to coming here (after all, if you have all plans on dining here, you wouldn't want to be disappointed by being rejected or made to wait if you just walk in without reservations).In terms of its food, the menu here is focused towards quality over quantity. Its premium dishes include wagyu beef, lobster, tiger prawns, salmon, scallop, etc... although ultimately, the focus is more towards the dining experience and the wonderful ambience here rather than the food. In addition, to further enhance your dining experience, choose from their wide variety of wines to go with your food.All in all, it was a truly unforgettable experience for me and my wife here... and I would certainly want to bring her back here again in the future!Show less

Author: ymt888Petaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Breakfast at Feringgi Grill
Review: Be spoilt by good service when you have breakfast at Feringgi Grill. Order all you want from the menu and it will be beautifully plated and served to you. While the choices are limited compared to the buffet but you will be spoiled here as they try to cater to your requests.Show less

Author: Halim777
Title: Privacy, Relex, Excellent Staff
Review: Breakfast concept 'Serve To Your Table'... Breakfast, exclusive for Rasa Wing Guest only.. Ala -Cart Eat All U Can... Thanks to 'Awesome' Staff especially Mr Fernandes Calliman ( Duty Manager), Mr Ahmad & Mr Mamu.. Well done!

Author: SgSlingKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Had a fantasctic dinner.
Review: This restaurant is more than a grill and more of a sophisticated french restaurant. The service was impeccable, very attentive and discreet. I had the foie gras terrine (excellent), the snapper and the crêpe suzette flambeed by our table. We had a fantastic dinner and will definitely return.Show less

Author: BenMoraisPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Dinner with Style and Class
Review: My party of six individuals chose this fine dining restaurant for a special wedding anniversary dinner. The dinner was on a Saturday night and the restaurant was almost full to capacity. The place had a nice feel to it and the ambiance was just perfect. We all had starters: some had Caesar's salad,others chose soups.............the tomato soup was excellent.For main course, I had Wagyu Tenderloin, others had Grilled Salmon, Lamb Cutlet, Snapper and Tiger Shrimps and Cannellioni. I know for sure that my steak and the lamb cutlets lived up to expectations. The others were good.We also had a bottle of champagne with the meals .....OW -V. Clicquot.For desert, we chose Crepe Suzette............one of our regular favourites.The meal on the whole lived up to expectations. The service was of a high standard and the staff were extremely courteous..The one drawback to the whole dining experience was the unusually slow service! Although we came in at about 8.00 pm or so, we had our main course at ten minutes to 10 pm! I guess the full house meant that the kitchen and staff had difficulty coping with the numbers.Show less

Author: Charissa PMalaysia
Title: Sweet anniversary
Review: We celebrated our wedding anniversary every year with the Shangrila group and it was our 3rd time 4th time celebrating at Rasa! Food still is number 1. We loved the service.. the food.. the environment. Everything at here is truly fantastic. Can't say more because they are the best thus far in the whole Penang island!! If you are looking for a good fine dining restro.. think no more and come to Ferringhi Grill!Show less

Author: PeterFiftyLondon, United Kingdom
Title: A timeless classic on the Penang dining scene
Review: Whether staying at the Shangri-La’s Rasa Sayang Resort, or at another hotel on the island state, dinner at the Feringgi Grill should not be missed. We always punctuate our stay at the Rasa Sayang with a number of evenings at the FG. The quality of food and service remained unequalled in all of our dining experiences in Malaysia. The menu is varied, though our favourite has to be the chateaubriand....a prime filet of beef for two to share - just delectable! During every evening in the restaurant, we also ensure that we choose one of the table-side prepared dishes, from classic Cesar salad, to flambé gin & tomato soup. All of the team, from the kitchen brigade to those on the restaurant floor, are warm, friendly & engaging and many have become friends over the years.... it’s what draws us back year after year. With the world currently unable to travel, we look back on many happy times spent at the FG and also looking forward to the time when we can enjoy our next visit in 2021. Show less

Author: Mike J
Title: Feringgi Grill
Review: A great food experience not to be missed, the chefs blend of spices and flavours together with magnificent presentation and the unobtrusive service one of the great resteraunts of the world not just the best in Penang

Author: Ee_OMKColorado
Title: A Great Evening Out!!!
Review: A week ago, four of us went out for dinner at the Feringgi Grill. It was a Saturday night and busy but the service was still impeccable much of which we attribute to the Manager, Izahan who seemed to have control of everything. When he wasnt engaging guests, he was a Sommelier, and he was even making tableside flaming desserts as well as starters. He and his team never missed a beat. The food from start to finish was great. We had the lamb, wagyu ribeye, snapper and many different starters. Each one was well prepared, well presented and tasted great. Feringgi Grill is not inexpensive. And for most of us, it has to be a special occasion. But if you want a wonderful meal with great wines, in a wonderful atmosphere, it is a great night out. Lastly, for some of us, this is a big deal...the bartender makes a great Martini.Show less

Author: amsteisvUzes, France
Title: Delightful and delicious dinner
Review: Had a wonderful meal at this restaurant last night. Beautiful meal, excellent service and good choice. A little expensive but you get a quality experience. I am vegetarian and finding good vegetarian menus is not always the case. I had probably the most delicious tomato soup I’ve ever had,flambé at the table quite a surprise. Followed by a red wine risotto, also delicious. The portions aren’t large but between dishes you get a palate cleanser & an amuse bouche to start. My husband enjoyed a salmon dish which was also beautifully cooked. Choosing not to have a dessert we were brought chocolates to have with our coffee. To top it off I was given a beautiful single long stemmed rose. I will be returning. Show less

Author: PHW87
Title: Excellent restaurant
Review: Excellent food with services made perfect by Mr Rosidi. The view from the restaurant is great too. Definitely a great place to be to celebrate any occasion.

Author: Godwin TPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: BEST FAMILY TIME
Review: First off I would like to compliment the waiter Mr. ROSIDI for his outstanding service. It is truly an amazing experience every time visiting this place. He remembers his customers. Cooks the tomato soup well and always carries a cheerful face. Thanks Shangri-la for giving us such memorable time always.Show less

Author: sandysbl
Title: Food Portion
Review:
Hakkaido scallop- entrée 
The portion for the above dish is becoming very small. There  used to be 4 scallops per  serving, while now there are only 2 scallops with something like caviar added. RM 95 for only 2 scallops is too expensive!

Author: tour_contactLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Generally pretty good
Review: We had dinner here recently. It was a generally a good experience. The food was great - the lamb that my wife had was cooked very well but it higher end prices. The wine list was excellent. The service was generally pretty good. The only downside was the pianist who - to be honest - wasn't great. His massacring of Beethoven's Moonlight Sonata was on the painful side. Show less

Author: somertonpark
Title: Xmas dinner
Review:
Beautiful dinner, fantastic service from Safari and Nazri. Not cheap but well worth the money.
 The food is A class with obviously a top chef, the ambience is wonderful but the service is A+.

Author: TonyC104Bedford, United Kingdom
Title: Good food but could be a better around experience
Review: This is in the Shangri-La Rasa hotel which is a lovely hotel. This is the fine dining option which serves good food with excellent service by the waiters. We booked for my wife’s birthday.The menu is steak/beef dominated and the food is well presented and tasty.Problem is that it just felt a bit stuffy particularly on arrival where the bar area lacked atmosphere (which differs from the other hotel bars) with little done by the front of house / Barman to change this. Once you are at your table service is very good.Overall good food but could be a better experience.Show less

Author: estherchilcott
Title: Beautiful ambience
Review:
We were surrounded by plants, sound of the man made water features, soft lighting. Indeed it is a romantic ambiance. Food was good. Service was good. 

There were 4 of us, we had Mongolian sizzling plate, Lamb cutlet, salmon and baked white fish

Author: Q3603DVanthonyc
Title: Quality restaurant and wines
Review:
The restaurant is in the shangri-la rasa sayang hotel.  It's a modern fine dining establishment.  The food is lovely with a good choice of world dishes.
Great for a special occasion.  It was a quiet night so a little lacking in atmosphere.

Author: lhheahGelugor, Malaysia
Title: Pleasant dinner
Review: It was hard to made a decision for a good fine dinning dinner and we end up here and Feringgi Grill never disappointed us. The lamb cutler and tenderloin are absolutely delicious. Awesome service by waiter. The atmosphere here will made you enjoy the dinner and service.Show less

Author: ko883Penang Island, Malaysia
Title: Nice ambience for steak
Review: The restaurant is located in Shangrila Rasa Sayang Hotel. The decor is rustic America stone suitable for steak dinner, like the ambience.It offers a good choice of wines and meat cuts at generally high price.The food and drinks are good but not the best we have tried.A good place for a romantic quiet dinner to get away from city noises.Show less

Author: Mariena BMelbourne, Australia
Title: Fine dining at its best
Review: Excellent food and service. We had the set menu which was delicious with an interesting selection. I would definitely recommend the set menu however the steak at the table next to us did provide food envy. I would suggest at least to visits for the set menu and the steak.Now the staff were friendly, knowledgable and made the experience special.A first class fine dining experience.Show less

Author: peterbH46UBHawthorn, Australia
Title: Well worth a visit
Review: This is a five star restaurant with excellent service and food. It is not cheap but the quality of the food, drinks and service are well worth the prices paid. Ahmad the manager is super efficient and does service the way it should be done.The duck we had was well cooked and an excellent dish. Dessert was exceptional. For a night out or special occasion you can’t go wrong.Highly recommend Show less

Author: AlexisvanDam
Title: Awesome meat & service
Review: For my wife’s birth day celebration we have chosen this restaurant. Perfect ambiance with very friendly and hospitable staff. We chose the wagyu degustation menu with wine pairing. It was really a stelar experience. Thanks so much in making it a celebration to remember.

Author: Kittycats5767
Title: Good service
Review:
We stayed in the Rasa wing so we got to use both the spice market and the feringgi grill for breakfast.
Food was good quality and staff very attentive.

Author: Crunchy_Fr0gWorthing, United Kingdom
Title: Absolute rip-off, and poor food too!
Review: This was without doubt the worst meal of our holiday. The food menu seemed to be quite good, but the wine menu had average wine at exorbitant prices. While i dont mind paying extra for a pleasant ambiance i dont like being ripped off and the wine had a tenfold mark uo.. My wife wanted water any way, when it arrived at the table the water was presented in an extremely pretencious manner for her to inspect the label. i chose the tomato soup, with flambe gin. (an odd combination) This was prepared at our table but for some reason the chef/waiter positioned himself behind me so i was unable to easily see what went on. I followed with the rib eye which was tough and stringy and very chewy. The accompanying vegetables were completley cold. My wife's steak was no better.When i asked the waitress to tell the chef that the steak was awful and the veg were cold she just smiled and nodded.At no point did anyone ask if we were enjoying our food - a sure sign the staff know the food is poor quality.The following day i saw a manager in reception and told him of our poor experience, he nodded wisely, agreeing with us that sometimes the food was not up to scratch.Our advise - give the Ferrenghi Grill a miss there are many other much better restaurants in the area.Show less

Author: dantwarner
Title: Awesome rib eye
Review: Well done to everyone at the Grill! Not cheap but you get what you pay for. For steak lovers, I would highly recommend the King Cut Rib eye - as good as anything I’ve eaten in the best of restaurants globally.

Author: y0gel
Title: New Years Eve Dinner
Review:
Wow! So impressed with the staff and the kitchen that made our evening so special! 

Honestly the best lamb I ever tried!

Author: rolandb945
Title: High quality dining with very friendly service
Review:
We had two dinner at Ferringi Grill. 
The food we excellent, I.p. the steaks. 
The service was very friendly and authentic.
We definitely can recommend!

Author: andreasL4524NO
Title: Visit while on holiday
Review: Food was good but at £50 per steak it's wasn't great my husband sent his back twice before they agreed to just take it off our bill.  He asked twice for rare it was too thin to do rare twice.  Rest of food was nice

Author: 47dudeCologne, Germany
Title: Outstanding food
Review: If you are looking for an upscale dinner and mouthwatering tastes, go for this reataurant and combine it with a drink at the bar and walk through Shangri La`gardens.The french chef is personally taking care of every dish leaving his kitchen and makes the difference to so many asian high end resorts with blend kitchens.Show less

Author: Crunchy_Fr0gWorthing, United Kingdom
Title: What a disappointment.
Review: Visited 19/11/2018.We were advised that it was most important we make a reservation, however during the time we were there were only 9 tables in use.Stupid prices on red wine, an €8.00 botle of Spanish red cost £85.00.We were presented with the bottle of sparkling water, for us to inspect the label-thats a first for us!We had 1 tomato soup, 1 prawn salad & 2 rib-eye various veg and potato gratin. (no wine) total cost £131.00Now dont get me wrong, if this had been an exceptional meal i would have been happy, but our veg was all stone cold (very obviously prepared well in advance, swimming in oil), the bernaise sauce (from a jar) was gone in two mouthfulls. During our meal no-one asked whether we were enjoying the food, in fact, when the waitress cleared the table i asked her to tell the chef the veg was all cold -no response -no apology.I strongly advise anyone not to visit here (the worst meal we've had all week) especlally when there are so many other great restaurants within short walking distance.Show less

Author: SusangermanyNew York City, New York
Title: Great evening....
Review: at the Ferringhi Grill. We had first a drink at the bar, where we missed the live music.We ordered our dinner and moved to the reserved table at the window.The dinner for all of us four was excellent!Steak, lamb, King prawns cooked liked we ordered. The starters too!! Service excellent! See you soon !Show less

Author: Bonnie UBrisbane, Australia
Title: Thank you Safari!
Review: My husband and I went here last Saturday night for my birthday dinner and Safari was our waiter for the evening and what a lovely gentleman he was, made our evening. We started with a celebratory glass of sparkling wine each and ordered the risotto and tomato soup for entree and we both had the tenderloin for main. Before our entrees arrived we each were given a appertiser of a tomato gazpacho which was absolutely devine! The soup was prepared at our table with some very nice theatrics and I have to say was very nice soup, this I recommend! I found the risotto to be a bit dry but my husband enjoyed it. We were then given a mango sorbet which again was very nice. The steaks were very enjoyable and cooked as requested however I was disappointed that they were not grilled from start to end. It appeared that they had been pan seared and finished in one of those steam oven type things. The Greens vegetables were beautiful but the grilled Mediterranean veges were very ordinary with hardly any chimichuri sauce. We enjoyed a moderately priced bottle of Australian red wine with our meal. We were unable to accommodate dessert.Our meals were very nice and also reasonable sized servings. The service was outstanding, thank you Safari. I do think that the prices here are a bit overboard for value for money, especially in Penang. We have had a number of very comparable experiences here for a lot less money and have spent less money dining on Sydney Harbour with outstanding seafood on the menu. Again, thank you Safari. You are a real asset to this establishment Show less

Author: SzeYeeThongPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Enjoyable music, elegant set up and friendly staff service. Excellent dining experience.
Review: I have been there a few years ago with company staff weekday. Last weekend was fully booked and we were the last few arrived. Both occasions were excellent fine dining experience. Food presentation, quality, set up, ambient and music. The pianist is superb, live songs played blend well for the setting.Show less

Author: Albert SMalaysia
Title: Disaster
Review: I want to bring my wife for a birthday dinner to Feringgi Grill in Shangrila Rasa Sayang , as a couple of years ago we went there was quite ok, as we know in Penang is otherwise not much, however. But the pleasure was not long and it end's up as a real disaster. The service is sure not a fine dining is normal general restaurant, as all the staff playing with there phone's instead of looking after the clients, When we where seated we have to ask finally for attention and ask for the menu card, The menu card is very basic only some standard over priced dishes. Same like the wine card the prices are inflated with at least 500% ( we are wine people we know the prices ) Finally we ordered our dish starter and main dish both typical French dishes. even the service is far below standard, we know we are in Penang and we know the standard in Ferringgi Grill is not that high so we where able to live with it , Than the first dish came served as in a coffee shop style one person bring both plates on one arm and ask who has what and she dumped it on the table without asking or we need anything and she was gone My dish was ok price ok I had Beef Tartare only was cut in to big peaces not refined done but ok, My wife was in trouble as they served here almost raw Foie Gras, this can't be eaten so it went back to the kitchen again for make it eatable. the result was i finish my dish already after a while my wife's dish came back, we both eat our dish by our self This type of restaurant they sell the wine so expensive even more expensive than Kuala Lumpur hotel restaurant, but still we have to fill the glasses our self no service at all, never mind , half way during our dinner what was prolonged longer due to the Foie Gras the menu card was still on our table even we are half the dinner. Than the second course, this became even a bigger disaster , We order based on the price Waya beef , but when it was served later on we believe was NOT wayu beef , however we dont want to argue, i ordered medium rare and my wife order medium well ... fine When the dish came mines was ok not that rare but served COLD but ok , i did not want to make noise so i accepted it, but my wifes was still RAW on the inside, She called the waiter and ask how is this cooked he said looks to still raw and my wife ask him what did i order he i am not sure but i guess medium well , he said ok i will send it back to the kitchen, It toke a while before my wife's second steak came, mines was already cold she said you better eat first is ok , i didI was finish my wife's steak came and was served so she wanted to eat the hot vegetables where in the meantime also cold , than she cut the second steak this steak was WELL DONE over cooked, she called the waiter again and ask when i cut this steak how does it look like he said complete over cooked. he know was wrong he took the plate and went to kitchen again second time. Than behind us a couple has a similar experience with a cod fish complete overcooked They where also complaining it looks like there dinner also screwed up.Than finally the THIRD steak came and my wife was saying how ever it comes i will eat it otherwise at midnight we still here waiting for the food , main dish again she had to eat alone the steak process was more than one hour. Between we looked in the kitchen include the head Chef they are all playing with there phones instead of concentrating on the food, they where more busy with there phones than putting the effort in the quality of the food, we wanted make a picture the Head chef was standing there a long time playing with his phone like he has nothing else to do. this was between the time the steaks went back to the kitchen. The morel of the story we order French food, 3 dishes in total went back to the kitchen and the head chef you believe it or not is FRENCH !!! and he screw up French food where is his focus on the food or on the mobile phones !!! He was so busy with his phone , NOBODY from the kitchen came and apologize or what ever NOTHING at all .... that's the worse of the event. When maybe somebody came and apologize we maybe feel not so angry but they don't care, playing with the phones is more important. As my wife birthday dinner was complete screwed up we have to eat alone and NOBODY apologized as its like normal, that make it worse We don't want to have coffee already as we where almost the last one in the restaurant there where only a few tables during the evening, than suddenly waiter comes with a small peace of birthday cake we never touched it, our dinner was already screwed up we want to go as it was really lateThink twice before you go to Ferringgi Grill , we live in Penang but its for us least it the last time.Advise to the General manager of the hotel , you better look in to this and look for a Chef who can really cook French food, and get these phones out of the kitchens and restaurants.Show less

Author: macksterzAlmere, The Netherlands
Title: Nice setting, excellent food and wines and best service
Review: We have dined twice in this restaurant during our stay in the Shangri La hotel.Make sure you adhere to the dresscode as I had to change. No shorts for men.We had the steak and fish. As a starter the Ceasar Salad which is prepared at yur tbel. One of the best we had.Ofcourse not cheap (for Malasyan standards) but we did enjoy and would definetely go back. Show less

Author: lucysilvers
Title: Delicious food great service
Review: We visited this restaurant during our stay at the Shangri la Rasa Resort Penang. The service was fantastic. We received some divine surprise dishes as we didn’t opt for a starter as well as delicious main. This was a culinary joy and worth the visit.

Author: Moh_AlmPerth, Australia
Title: Best Family Dinner
Review: The staff here are super friendly and very professional. This is the best restaurant we have visited in Malaysia. They simply made our night very special and memorable . The food was amazing. It was like a show, that they prepared some food right next to our table. Nothing more to say about the five course superb and yummy yummy dinner. Once again thank you very much for the five star class service. If we go to Penang will definitely dine at this place.Show less

Author: Tay08George Town, Malaysia
Title: Just short of very good, actually.
Review: I have been to Feringgi Grill numerous times and can say that the service is very good, polite and helpful and the food generally good. On my last visit, however, the lobster bisque was still good but extremely salty. What was disappointing was the introduction of metal plates and bowls when serving some of the entree and sorbet. This gives the feeling that you are eating in a "Banana Leaf rice Restaurant"!Show less

Author: TJSing2008Singapore, Singapore
Title: Unexpected
Review: We have just finished a lovely dinner meal at Feringgi. It Began with a warm bread basket, a complimentary Amouse bouce - chilled green pea soup and then two very unexpected complimentary starters of smoked eel & potato and sea urchin. It was all delicious, and actually filled us up before the mains arrived. We had the roast duck, snapper, and a side salad. It was all great.The restaurant is very spacious with live piano. The wine list had a good selection, spirits were limited. The staff were helpful and attentiveShow less

Author: KerryR290Indented Head, Australia
Title: Terribly let down
Review: Well I have to start by saying I totally agree and support Eric from California comments.This is not true fine dining, yes it’s a very nice setting but far from fine dining.Our experience was as follow.Table service was efficient and polite although one waitress was unable to answer my questions regarding how the dish was made and contents.Varied choice of wines and sparklings by the glass .Entre of scallops, I would have to say they would be the best I ever had. Just beautiful and attention to detail with presentation.Risotto main was undercooked and a little crunchy. Sent three quarters of the fish back.Linguine was bland and floating in oil, not pleasant.Cauliflower soup whilst was tasty it was so salty beyond belief.Overall: A very overpriced restaurant that does not match quality or true fine dining experience. Show less

Author: LaiAbWah
Title: Excellent food and service
Review: The steak was delicious. We had mushroom soup for starter which was very nice. The service was excellent. Nice ambiance except for a group of very noisy disrespectful foreigners (probably drunk!)

Author: Eric KMountain View, California
Title: Poorest Value for meal of anywhere in the world
Review: I have eaten at fine dinning and Michelin star restaurants all over the world, and in this experience I can say the Ferringgi Grill is by far the most expensive restaurant for the quantity and quality of food. One of the rating categories is "value". I gave it a "1" and that is a gift this restaurant does not deserve. I paid USD $65 for Lobster Bisque and Boston Lobster. The "lobster" in the lobster bisque was a single piece of lobster in the center of the bowl and was the size of my thumb nail. If I had sneezed on my soup that puny piece of lobster would have disappeared on to the floor. The Boston Lobster was about three pieces of thumb sized lobster in thousand island dressing and a bit of green lettuce garnish. Thousand island dressing on lobster in a fine dinning scenario? Who does that? I had the crepe Suzette, and the six or seven bites were nice, but I didn't see the cost and would be afraid to ask. I was a guest of a family friend and I was absolutely embarrassed by the value of the meal. I am thankful that I didn't ask to eat here.If you have more money then sense, or you have so much money that you burn it for something to do, then this is the place for you.Not to seem excessively negative, I will say the service was quite excellent and the atmosphere very pleasant and upscale. Please, do yourself a favor and skip this place. If you want fine dinning go to New York, Chicago, Los Angeles, Tokyo or any number of other cities with Michelin and/or fine dinning restaurants. If your on Penang Island eat at the Hawker stalls and sample the foods that make Penang famous and at an inexpensive price. You won't find it at the Ferringgi Grill.Show less

Author: Adam1630
Title: Excellent food and service
Review:
Wonderful food, would definitely recommend it. Is a little on the pricey side, buy hey ho, you have to push the boat out once in a while.

Would definitely qualify as fine dining, though don’t forget the dress code.

Author: Feds294201
Title: Exquisite
Review: We visited this restaurant for the first time for my husband's 65th birthday. The food was delicious and the service impeccable. The little touches like sorbet in between courses, and the chocolates we much appreciated.

Author: Antalyaman
Title: Quality dining in a good ambiance
Review: This is genuine fine dining with excellent food and service. Fois gras and seared scallops were particularly good.

Author: joanp927
Title: Fantastic restaurant
Review: Visited here twice during our visit November 2018. The food was sublime although a little more expensive than other venues. However,You don't go on holiday to be tight.

Author: Lance G
Title: Enjoyable night out
Review: Most enjoyable meal. All dishes were prepared and presented to a very high standard. Preparation of some meals were completed at the table with a degree of entertainment....kids loved seeing the alcohol of my dessert burned off in front of them. Excellent wine list too.

Author: vianneyjonville
Title: Very nice and quiet
Review: Ferringhi Grill is a nice place to take your breakfast for example and to avoid the busy place like the Spice market café.

Author: margief393
Title: Great place to watch the sun set
Review: This is an awesome little cafe right on the beach. Stop here for some light snacks and a few drinks to watch the sun set. Worth a stop and break when walking along the beach

Author: scottt976Lowry Bay, New Zealand
Title: Great staff. Great food. Great vistas
Review: Safari makes you welcome the minute you enter this restaurant. He and his staff are great ambassadors for Shangri-La Rasa Sayang. Surroundings comfortable, elegant and views of the gardens great. The food is a delight and menu selections thoughtfully sculptedAll in all a memorable experienceShow less

Author: rustytooMansfield Woodhouse, United Kingdom
Title: Tough meat
Review: We decided that we needed a fix of ‘comfort’ food so decided to go for the roast beef dinner.. How disappointed we were. A thick slab of tough meat,a spoonful of mixed vegetables, a very small square of some type of potato and a cardboard Yorkshire pudding. Very very disappointing. Never again.Show less

Author: ymt888Petaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Breakfast here
Review: Breakfast here is slow paced compared to the Spice Market cafe. As we were staying 2 nights, we opted for breakfast once at each place. To compare, breakfast at the Spice Market would give me more options and the varieties is plentiful. The breakfast at Feringgi Grill is more fine dining oriented, and they had a buffet spread of only cereals, yogurts, bread, fruits. The staff will take your order for the mains which would be prepared freshly.Show less

Author: NgKS9368
Title: Dinner
Review:
One of the best dining dining restaurants in town. Each time going there for sure will not miss out the Tomato soup as starter & Feringgi Crepe as desserts. 
Good atmosphere and served by well trained staffs.

Author: Elisabeth JPerth, Australia
Title: Memorable evening
Review: Had a wonderful dinner at the Feringgi Grill. The chateaubriand for two was outstanding and the crepes suzette made at the table were delicious. The staff do fine dining to a tee and I love the beautiful surroundings, white tablecloths, quality cutlery and glassware. It is an unhurried affair. The red rose for me at the end of the evening had me planning our next visit. I hope they don't change a thing as it is perfect!Show less

Author: Timea SBomaderry, Australia
Title: Top Quality fine dining.
Review: This Grill offers the best catering standards within the Shangri-La complex. Breakfasts are what you'd expect from a Five Star establishment, and the evening dining (smart casual attire mind you) is as good or better. Definitely worth at least one visit, and the staff are excellent, with a special mention for Mr Mohammed Safari who was just amazing.Show less

Author: Alan EReading, United Kingdom
Title: Treat
Review: Dined at Ferringgi Grill twice whilst staying nearby.This restaurant is beautiful with varied menu, the table side dishes that are prepared are fantastic and great fun to watch & the enjoy.If you fancy a nice treat would recommend dining here, although a little expensive.Show less

Author: dordognemarkBeaumont-du-Perigord, France
Title: Consistently excellent. Elegant and refined way to dine.
Review: The Feringgi Grill is our favourite restaurant in Penang. It is consistently good in many ways.Food:The menu is varied, contemporary and classic, it always gives you some old favourites such as the tomato gin soup and crepe Suzette prepared table side, but also some interesting European dishes like fois gras and prime rib of beef. Always excellent in terms of good quality, fresh ingredients, sensible portions, well presented. Setting: The restaurant has a comfortable bar area for pre and post dinner drinks, with a pianist gently creating a relaxing ambience which drifts through to the main dining area. The atmosphere created is elegant and sophisticated, a real sense of a occasion as others have said. Traditions table settings with crisp white linen, and the staff all in smart uniforms.Service:They have it just right, it is not at all stuffy, but the perfect combination of formality and interaction. The team are trained well, and knowledgeable about the dishes and wines. They are proud to work here and it shows, they take pride and pleasure in what they do.Overall, for a real sense of elegant special dining experience, you must come to the Feringgi Grill at least once.Show less

Author: PeterFiftyLondon, United Kingdom
Title: A Timeless Classic on the Penang Dining Scene
Review: Without a shadow of a doubt, the Feringgi Grill provides the best overall dining experience in Penang. A timeless classic with a winning combination of great food, ambiance & service that have remained a constant over our many (currently 10) stays at the Rasa Sayang in which is is located. The al la carte menu constrains both classic signature dishes, many of which are pre prepared table-side by the accomplished team; as well as new items the creation of the head chef (currently from France where we live). During our two week stay we will normally eat on four occasions at the FG, trying different dishes each time. We are now half way through our stay and very much looking forward to the wine pairing dinner next week. As a footnote, if you are visiting the Feringgi Grill (or indeed any nice restaurant) - PLEASE put your smart phone away, engage in conversation with the person(s) with you and enjoy the dining experience. The latest What'sApp message or Tweet will still be there to read when you leave and the world will not have stopped spinning! Show less

Author: EgilJessheimJessheim, Norway
Title: As good as its gets!
Review: Breakfast or dinner at this restaurant is an experience in its own right! Food and service is exigent and if you get a table by the windows, you will have a great view as well! If there is something special you want for breakfast, just let the staff know. They will get you just about anything your heart may desire. Show less

Author: LimlennaGeorge Town, Malaysia
Title: Perfect
Review: Everything was perfect. The ambience, service and food. We enjoyed watching the sunset while dining. The best part is the tables are further apart from one another as compared to other restaurants I have been to. Hence, it felt like we had more personal space. All the staff were attentive and friendly. For main course, we ordered risotto and steak. Both were equivalently amazing!Show less

Author: HSSSSSHGeorge Town, Malaysia
Title: Memorable Night
Review: I would like express my gratitude and thanks to all the staffs at Feringgi Grill who attended to us on February 18, 2018 especially Farooq who gave an excellent service not only to us but to all the diners!Our overall dining experience was excellent from greetings all the way to table service. It is the service and staffs which we want to be back in future! We may not be one of your biggest customers but we were treated as if we were and for that I would like to personally thank Farooq for his customer service also his team ! Show less

Author: GKen64Kyoto, Japan
Title: Decent breakfast and lovely cocktail time
Review: Delicious breakfast is served in an quiet atmosphere but to be honest,the selection of fresh fruit was limited and the taste of them was better in the Spice market unfortunately. The staffs were friendly and we liked them but seem a little too busy and forgot our order. Still we enjoyed both breakfast and cocktail time though. Show less

Author: myworld52Berkshire, United Kingdom
Title: fine dining
Review: the restaurant is based at the Shangri La rasa sayang. it has a dress code which adds to the sense of occasion. the standard of service was exemplary and very much what you might expect in a fine dining establishment anywhere. the menu was imaginative and enticing. our meal there was a nice end to our stay at the Rasa Sayang. recommended.Show less

Author: James GMaybole, United Kingdom
Title: Nice restaurant cold plates and food
Review: This is a stunning restaurant located in the upper level of the Rasa Sayang hotel in Penang the atmosphere is very nice and the menu upmarket but despite the excellent service and ambiance the food is let down by cold plates warm food and totally stone cold potatoes this restaurant was far better a number of years ago and now not worth paying the money.Show less

Author: 103reginaj
Title: Outstanding service and food
Review: I am writing you as i would like to feedback my experience in the restaurant as i was really impressed. Their service was divine and the food excellent. Thank you once again

Author: Oakmead1Bury St. Edmunds, United Kingdom
Title: Over rated, over priced, average service
Review: This is our 2nd visit to the Rasa Sayang and our 1st visit to the  Feringgi Grill and it will be our last. From the initial welcome which as not warm, my husband was asked to wear trousers, which we had no problem with, but then 3 ladies with shorts barely covering their cheeks were allowed in. This was sexual discrimination. However this sadly set the tone for the evening as no member of senior management came anywhere near our table. We chose the Wagui Degusation but were seriously disappointed. This is expensive neavou cuisine but without any real class. As with this type of cuisines, which was and is not explained at all on the marketing literature or menu, the portions are very small. There were some very good sized steaks served to neighbouring tables but when our signature dish arrived what a let down. Furthermore an accompanying sauce was only delivered after we were both ¾ through the meat. The Maitre D and other senior gentleman gave our table a wide berth all evening. Never once were we asked if our meal was ok. And then the final wine was served, we had the wine pairing, after the delivery of the desert, and that was the best part of the meal the Crepe Suzette. A very ostentatious place which unless you have money to burn we would advise avoid at all costs. Show less

Author: 639BarbaraM
Title: Great breakfast
Review: Had breakfast every morning and nothing was too much trouble you help yourself to cereal fruit juice fruit etc but order main staff very friendly service was great

Author: Gary-PK77Saudi Arabia
Title: Very Good food, service could be improved
Review: Easily the best restaurant in the area and if the service was slightly better would be one of the best on the Island.The restaurant is very nice and elegant setting.Quality of food ingredients was excellent and the steak cooked exactly medium as ordered although none of the food was hot enough in temperature. Restaurant was not busy so this was surprising.Also none of the food comes with any side or vegetable dishes, there is Sides / Garnitures section on the menu but we assumed this was for extras, considering we ordered 4 meals we were dissapointed the waitress never made us aware of this.If you order a steak then it will come with nothing else on the plate!During the meal nobody came to table to ask if everything was ok and we were never asked if we wanted additional drinks so our empty wine glasses remained empty shortly after our mains arrived.I would recommend the steak but order something to go with it. Also the Crêpes Suzette is well worth ordering to finish your meal.Overall a very good and with slight improvement would be excellent.Show less

Author: Zylang
Title: Everything was great
Review: We loved everything in here. The food and the service were great. The ambiance and the view just make it perfect.

Author: Ms-CJSTasmania, Australia
Title: Amazing Experience
Review: As guests of the Rasa Wing, we were celebrating the last night of our wonderful holiday and we weren't at all disappointed. Fine dining elegance with a lovely outlook and professional, friendly and attentive staff serving delicious food with flair. We had well cooked fish and lamb with crepe suzettes for dessert prepared at the table. There was a live pianist who sang a special "bon voyage" tune for us to round off a perfect evening. I can't wait to return.Show less

Author: tinhau
Title: Elegant Fine Dining
Review: Elegant setting with glass walls overlooking the lush gardens of the Shangri-La hotel. Enjoy top class service and a classic menu. The signature tomato soup laced with gin is amazing and a variety of steaks  are on the menu. A wonderful fine dining experience.

Author: Rebecca BQueensland, Australia
Title: Relaxed atmosphere, live pianist plus cigar room
Review: We enjoyed some wine and cocktails in the Feringgi Grill whilst listening to a wonderful pianist playing chilled jazz in the background. The barman was attentive, it was a comfy place to sit, chill out and have a good conversation. Bowl of nuts with your drinks. Plus there is a separate, small lounge room where you can go to enjoy a cigarette or a cigar if you prefer. It has comfy chairs and some interesting antiques and old photographs.Show less

Author: annies933
Title: Breakfast and Dinner 👌🏻
Review: We had a buffet breakfast and Dinner at the grill. The choices were ample and varied. I especially like their selection of local cuisines and fruits. My husband enjoyed the dessert section most.

Author: MichelleS534
Title: Elegent restaurant delicious refined food
Review: highly recommend the tomato soup with is cooked table side for a bit of theratrics and is also delicous. The seafood is fresh and perfection!  Service was also exceptional and the two nights we ate here!

Author: gilly482017
Title: Out standing
Review: The best meal of our holiday, we went to the Grill for dinner. The food was excellent and the service was second to none. Some of the food was prepared at the table in a very professional manner. Would recommend it to ant one.

Author: Aoibheann L
Title: Fantastic!
Review: Everything about this place was wonderful. I've been here twice now and both times the food, service and ambience were incomparable. Sitting outside in the garden was lovely. It's a bit of a drive from Georgetown, but absolutely recommended.

Author: irishrugbynut
Title: SISSAPOINTIG OVERPRICED FOOD
Review: I came here due to another expats advice.Starting with slow poor service.Was told best steaks in town.Typical try and rip off the unsuspecting Tourist.Having spent many years in the Beef Business know my Steak.Definately not what was advertised i suggest cheap tough Indian Beef that shoukd have been in a stew.The chef locked in arguing it was prime USA Ribeye i laughed.Once bitten twice shy as they say!Next night tried the Hard Rock much much better option.TOURISTS BEWARE !Show less

Author: ronp1954Langford, Australia
Title: What can we say - Excellent !!!
Review: Had breakfast there every day of our stay, and while there were other options, enjoyed it so much we kept going back. Very good selection of good food to choose from from a buffet, plus a range of cooked breakfasts which made our choice very difficult. All the food was first class and tasty and the level of service from all the staff there was excellent. Even when they were flat out they still had plenty of smiles to go round. The assistant manager spoke with all customers ensuring that they were being looked after and were enjoying breakfast, and Jasslinda who greeted us at the entrance each morning, still took the time to have bit of a chat to us each morning. On out lat day there, she brought us a little box with a couple of biscuits as a farewell or bon voyage gift. It was not much but the gesture made us, and others, feel special. The evening meals are quite expensive so we did not try them, especially after evening cocktails and canopes which filled us up, but we have been reliably informed that the meals are delicious, so maybe next time we might try there once.Show less

Author: Jesslia
Title: Disappointed and angry
Review: waited for full 2 whole hours for our main course. Racist behavior and terrible food. very overrated.

Author: SamuelMo18Singapore, Singapore
Title: Great service and value
Review: I booked a private room for my family of 7 as the restaurant had a strict policy of not having children in the main dining area during dinner time. This is my 2nd visit to the ferringi grill and I came specifically for the steaks. Compared to my first visit, the cuts of steaks on offer were visibly thicker and juicier. I ordered the ribeye while my wife ordered the sanchoku striploin. Both steaks were great but I could see why one would pay a premium for the sanchoku steaks on offer. I celebrated my son's birthday and the restaurant threw in a complimentary cake which was nice. \I would recommend coming here despite the high prices because the level of service and quality of food if what you pay for. Definitely would be back again!Show less

Author: kfwrigleyLiverpool, United Kingdom
Title: Fantastic culinary experience.
Review: The Feringgi Grill is a delightful culinary experience.Everything is geared to make you feel so special and it doesn't disappoint.First of all the view of the magnificent resort will take your breath away and the super efficient staff make sure that you will not forget your visit.The food is five star.Show less

Author: LaceyL146
Title: Great experience but slightlyexp
Review: The entire environment is so wonderful and relax. The food did great in both taste and plentiful. can say fulfiled all types of customers. Price slightly expensive. Not recommended for those looking for budget meal.

Author: R1928AXkevinfLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Professional Staff, High Quality food
Review: My wife and I enjoyed breakfast in the Ferringhi Grill every morning on our honeymoon, which was full of variety with daily menu changes. The staff here were courteous, professional and extremely accommodating. One member of staff offered to sort us a local breakfast for the following day, which the chef prepared for us, it was wonderfully delightful.My wife and I also enjoyed dinner at the Ferringhi Grill where we enjoyed one of the nicest meals of our life. The staff even surprised us with a congratulatory cake for our honeymoon. Just an all around wonderful experience. Would highly recommend.Show less

Author: See Wai L
Title: Excellent buffet place
Review: Great buffet spread, food was excellent, plenty of choices, so go with a hungry stomach! on weekends, might want to consider booking ahead.

Author: Caroline PLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Lovely Experience - Try It!
Review: We were staying at this hotel so breakfast was in this restaurant every day. However, in the evenings it transforms in to a top class restaurant serving delicious food at reasonable prices from a varied menu. It has a very nice ambience & the staff, as usual, are very attentive, professional & pleasant.Show less

Author: KathrynB2002
Title: Wonderful birthday meal
Review: Spent my birthday evening in the Ferringi Grill and had a fabulous time. The menu choice was excellent and something for everyone and is fine dining. The staff were very attentive and knowledgeable about the dishes and wine on offer. We opted for soup for my husband and I had the prawn starter and we both had the rib of beef as a main course which was excellent. There were lots of lovely little touches that made my birthday extra special which include a couple of extra courses, a rose, and birthday cake. Expect to pay 5* hotel restaurant prices and be rewarded with good food and excellent service.Show less

Author: Mei Lin OPenang, Malaysia
Title: Excellent Every Time
Review: Dinner at the Feringgi Grill is always a special experience. The quality of food is consistently good. the service is always attentive, yet discrete and the ambiance and piano music rounds it off. I live in Penang, and have returned to this restaurant many times. Each time Captain Farook and his team always have never disappointed us.Show less

Author: colinpennyfu2
Title: Superb Restaurant
Review: Certainly one of the Best restaurants I have ever used, the srevice and food is second to none. Simply a must when in Penang.

Author: David Ignatius LMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Wonderful ambience, excellent food
Review: Was at Ferringgi Grill with some friends in January. The ambience, decor ,food was so extraordinary. The service was so professional, it made my dinner so comfortable and enjoyable. Feringgi Grill will be at the top of my list whenever I'm in Penang. I rate it a ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️in my list.Show less

Author: Manishtully
Title: Fine Dining
Review: Choices are bit limited in this restaurant; but the personalised service is excellent and food is quite lovely and delicious. We tried their lamb and rice. it was great. Good Service.

Author: PeterFiftyLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Consistently Excellent
Review: The Feringgi Grill remains our favourite restaurant in Penang and will dine here on four occasions during our most recent stay. The quality of the setting, ambiance, menu, ingredients and presentation, combined with friendly, engaging and knowledgeable staff enjoy that each evening spent in the restaurant is a memorable one. For carnivores, you probably woulld not find better steaks in the whole of Asia - the chateaubriand remains a firm favourite of ours - however on the recommendation of Nazri we recently enjoyed a wagu tomahawk to share with friends - simply wonderful. For vegetarians, there is a great choice too, the menu is ever-evolving and only the freshest of ingredients are used. Having dined at the Feringgi Grill at least 20 times over our 10 visits to Penang - chefs may come and go, the menu changes, but what is consistent is the excellent quality of food matched with the service from the dedicated team who work here - we look forward to two more evenings before our 2017 visit to Penang draws to a close.Show less

Author: 852carmankHong Kong, China
Title: High food quality with live piano
Review: Very high standard food quality esp juicy and soft rib eye. Signature food like tomatoes soup cooking in front of you with fired wine show. We tried two nights each night around 400RM for two people. Food is tasty, fresh and value for money. Little portion like appetites soba dessert are offered by free, very like! Wine is over price. A live piano with songs make romantic environment. But be reminded spending very long and slow service there that may giving you more enjoyable chat.Show less

Author: agfang
Title: Beautiful fine dinning restaurant
Review:
- Service was great

- Scallops starters cooked very well

- Ribeye Steaks done well and excellent mash potatoes

- Moelleux au chocolat tasted good but not as good as the entrees and mains

- Excellent atmosphere, definitely need to dress up for this place!

Author: willi h
Title: Nice atmosphere
Review:
We had 3 meals there and were always satisfied.The fois gras is excellent,the steaks are nice, best of all is their tomato soup.
The drinks are expensive.

Author: dianneg623
Title: Elegant dining with views of lush tropical gardens
Review: Excellent staff, attentive and intuitive!, food beautiful, included three dishes prepared and flambéd at the table! Could not fault this for fine dining.

Author: Alexander LMunich, Germany
Title: Daily Breakfast and occasional dinner
Review: The 4 of us are staying at the RasaSayang, Shangri-La ,so we need daily breakfast. The service is excellent, food also excellent. Service at breakfast could not be complained off. We spend 2-3 hours there till 10;30am. By then we have decided the itinerary for the day. So to the food at night; for instance I had the roast beef with accompaniments. Superb. What can I say when the taste was so good. The others had other food, but they can comment themselves. For dinner, I would recommend it highly.Show less

Author: Susangermany
Title: It's the best...
Review:
Restaurant in Town!
The Service, the presentation all is perfect! The atmosphere is relaxing!
The prices are reasonable for this type of dining!

Author: Jeyasothy P
Title: Probably the best restaurant in Malaysia!
Review: Feringgi Grill certainly puts Malaysia on the map with perhaps Malaysia's finest fine dining restaurant. Justin the Chef, cooks up tantalising and exquisite dishes. Izzy makes pretty amazing cocktails including his own creations. The staff and impeccable service, exquisite food plus the nice ambience makes this in my book as perhaps among the finest restaurants in region! Show less

Author: PeteD60Ware, United Kingdom
Title: A memorable experience.....
Review: For most of our stay at the Rasa Sayang, this was our breakfast location – excellent – calm – cooked options plus buffet – not as extensive as Spice Market but not as hecticWe ate dinner here on the last night of our stay – again calm and hushedWe both had the veal dish plus a side – but first an amuse bouche of cauliflower – so intense in flavour – followed by pea soup – followed by a sorbet – and then our main – delicious piece of meat with asparagus tips and morel mushrooms with a jus – well-cooked seasoned and very tasty And then just when you thought it was all over – a selection of chocolates and pastries arrived And then given that it was my wife’s birthday the next day – the table had already been decorated with rose petals –there followed a chocolate birthday cake with a rendition of happy birthday from the waiter – all for the price of the meal Memorable or what? – thank youShow less

Author: SteveY399
Title: Only quality restaurant in Batu Ferrenghi
Review: Great food, very friendly staff, elegant surroundings. Only good quality restaurant in Batu Ferrenghi, possibly Penang. Not expensive by global standards. An oasis in the generally tacky surroundings of this resort.

Author: Tuban1
Title: Nicest meal we had in Penang
Review: This restaurant is a bit special and more on the expensive side if you are on a budget but absolutely delicious.  Presentation fantastic and staff very attentive. Food gorgeous....what more can I say but go for it!

Author: SherriffSSydney, Australia
Title: Resort dining to die for
Review: Elegantly appointed dining room, well spaced tables. Impeccable, attentive service with good wine recommendations. Delicious warm bread with olive oil and butter to begin with. Ordered the carrot risotto, divine. Grilled snapped perfectly cooked and flavourful, melted in the mouth. Mango sorbet between courses was delicious.
