Gifted a red rose when leaving which was a thoughtful touch. Probably the priciest meal to be had in the area but well worth the splurge.Show less

Author: Lucy092013
Title: Beautiful venue
Review: The food was good quality, portions not large. Dessert a little disappointing, however overall for venue and fine dining the price was what I would expect. If you want a special meal with beautiful setting this is the place to go!

Author: PCKK_69Singapore, Singapore
Title: Rasa Sayang Ferringgi Grill - a breakfast journey
Review: Booked Rasa Wing from 15/12~17/12 and part of the package was breakfast option in Feringgi Grill, do not miss this!! you get a menu for the day for a la carte dishes prepared FRESH by the chef ..service at the grill for breakfast was impeccable ..special mention to Farouk & team for excellent service and taking good care of my family of 5 and helping us to "reserve" some dishes for the next day even though it was not on the menu for the day..kudos! They also prepared a "farewell" gift for us knowing we will depart on 17/12 , very very thoughtful !!Overall...the experience is wonderful and I would return again in the near future. :) Show less

Author: RichardinSGSingapore, Singapore
Title: An awesome Saturday night
Review: Just back from the Saturday night 9.30pm sitting at this restaurant... OMG one of the best dinners out in a long time. The steak was stunning and every step of this meal was 5 star. I was looking for dinner around this area and this was the top rated for a reason. Love it... each step was wonderful. Show less

Author: jonny1953poulton le fylde
Title: good food
Review: Had a meal there food very good but one problem was it was freezing in there asked the waiter to turn the air con up a little bit they didnt but brought my husband a jacket and myself a shawl which helped. The atmosphere was lovely the down side was the price very expensive you are talking over £80 for a basic Chablis Show less

Author: Ams_111
Title: Fantastic but pricey
Review: The food here is amazing and I would thoroughly recommend it. Staff are very attentive and food is very good. We were there during off season so atmosphere was dead. The dress code is strictly enforced which is good. It was expensive but we really enjoyed the food overallShow less

Author: Saman_Kerryn
Title: Great Breakfast
Review: This review is for Catherine and her colleague whose name we did not get. The service from these 2 staff was excellent. The breakfast was lovely. We were disappointed overall with this hotel but these 2 staff are definitely great assets to the resort.

Author: E8542ZQmarkrGreater London, United Kingdom
Title: Last night highlight
Review: Thought we would have dinner at the feringgi grill on our last night at the hotel and weren't disappointed we started with a amuse Bouche I had tuna tartar which was delicious also a basket of warm bread with little pot of oil and balsamic vinegar added that extra little touch of class to the meal. I chose the scallops to start followed by the tenderloin steak both dishes were amazing and a side order of creamy mash , yummy and some garlic and chillie green veg which worked really well with the dish. My wife had mozzarella and asparagus to start followed by the linguine with aglioe olio and was really good to. We also got a cleansing mango sorbet between courses. We washed it down with a nice Pinot noir I must say the waiters made the night with great service and friendly banter with made us both feel really special I ended the night with a crepe Suzette cooked at the table with a spectacular flame shooting up was a great highlight to end the meal and very reasonably priced.Show less

Author: OsUhIGeorge Town, Malaysia
Title: Warm and cosy ambience with exquisite cuisine
Review: This is one of the popular places for having a fine or elegant dining for a memorable celebration among the locals. This restaurant is well received by many foreigners too especially the hotel guests. Guys need to wear in smart casual in long pants but no slippers allowed. Children below 7 also not allowed in the restaurant to preserve the ambience. Food prices basically on the high side with an indication of minimum RM200 spending per person with soup/entrees. We ordered one of thr signature dishes: slow cook prime rib beef in queen cut (280gram come with yorkshire pudding and red wine gravy) & one Australian Lamb Cutlets. Both were well done with great flavor and tenderness, particularly the lamb with no stinky smell at all. Complimentary bread, soup and small cold entrees were served prior to main course. At the end of dinner, there will be a few complimentary chocolates for you as well. Other signature dishes are tomato soups, caesar salad and Char-Grilled Beef Chateaubriand which come with tableside service. The service is excellent with attentive staff always there to serve you.Show less

Author: jennylbMargaret River, Australia
Title: WOW
Review: Did not expect to find such an upmarket restaurant in Batu Feringghi even it was located at the Shangri La.The ambiance is terrific the food exquisite the service impeccable and the prices although more expensive than an everyday restaurant still far less including a bottle of wine than we would pay back home.If you have a celebration planned I suggest you spend it here you won't be disappointed.Show less

Author: meaningremission
Title: Wine pairing dinner
Review: Attended a wine pairing dinner recently. Was here 6 years ago and the place looks exactly the same. Had their tenderloin steak which was done perfectly, medium rare. One of the best steak house in Penang island.

Author: soonamiScarborough, Australia
Title: Fine dining experience
Review: We stayed at the Rasa Sayang and dined in the Feringgi Grill every day for breakfast - we could not fault the service, staff were excellent, food was delicious - different cooked menu daily (malaysian, chinese, european) and a great variety in the buffet.We also had a special family dinner (10 people) where 6 of us had the King/Queen Roast dinner with Yorkshire Pudding. The service and facilities were fantastic (rose petals strewn across the table, candlelight, very romantic) but the food let them down a little (possibly the size of the group being the cause). The roast was presented and carved on the carvery trolley which was wheeled over to the table. The servings were then taken away to be finished and plated. 2 of our guests asked for their roast well cooked but the roast meat was served up rare. They were asked to cook them again, which they did, but when they were finally served again the food on the plates was cold. The Yorkshire pudding in no way (taste, shape or form) resembled the real thing. On the other hand, 2 of us ordered the Chateaubriand which was fantastic (although, again, the food was cold). Just a little bit more attention given by the Chef's will make this restaurant 5 star.Even though there were some disappointments, I would highly recommend this restaurant Show less

Author: Ali-TheTouristManchester, United Kingdom
Title: Brilliant service and breakfast
Review: Just returned from having breakfast here whilst staying in the shangri la rasa wing, breakfast was fantastic, service was also fantastic by all the staff here specially from Mr Mohammed Safri who went that extra mile to making sure we were comfortable and he also gave me rose to give to my wife whilst she wasnt looking, which I thought was a very nice touch.Overall brilliant breakfast and a fantastic service.Show less

Author: Susan HMarple, United Kingdom
Title: Fine dining with a beautiful sunset.
Review: On arrival we was a little disappointed to discover the signature dish had sold out and it was only 7-30. The dining room is beautiful laid out, the staff was very attentive we ordered a Starter of tomato soup infused with gin this was cooked at the table it certainly was very tasty. My husband had the tiger prawns which he said they was excellent. To follow we ordered the chateaubriand which was accompanied with a nice selection of vegetable we order a side of dauphinois potatoes. The food was beautifully presented and tasted wonderful. We had no room for dessert but was still presented with home made chocolates with our coffee. On the way out of the restaurant I was presented with a red rose which is a nice touch. I would recommend you try this restaurant especially if you are staying at the Sayang but be aware it is expensive.Show less

Author: 3vilfr3akybabi3
Title: Fantastic Food, Fantastic Service
Review: Very good service from the staffs. Very accommodating. Celebrated a friend's birthday there and they have provide complimentary cake and some desserts for the birthday girl. We had Grilled Salmon and Grilled Lamb. We are beyond satisfied.

Author: Muffin68
Title: An extravagant affair
Review: Food by our standards wasn't overly expensive but my goodness, it was delicious - you must experience this restaurant for a special night out.

Author: mcjmzfranco
Title: The best French food in town
Review:
We went for diner. Lovely romantic restaurant with high quality  food and small portions. Lovely presentations and very good service. Crêpes suzette should be improve. Not to the standards of the restaurant.
Price is quite high and nice for a celebration.

Author: jillianjinlynh
Title: Great food and service!
Review:
Great place for a romantic night out! The ambience was good and service was perfect. 
The food was great and steak was cooked to perfection:) we were both happy with our meals.
The waiter was attentive and pleasant. 
Worth the visit.

Author: ron8861Sydney, Australia
Title: Needs a revamp
Review: This is the second time I have visited the resort and the thirds time I have dined at Feringgi Grill. In all fairness a new French Chef has only recently come on board, and my memories a few years ago was a magnificent experience with a then Australian Chef who produced innovative and exciting dishes. Time will tell as to how the new Chef transforms the current menu. The décor is now looking quite old and tired, and is in need of a freshen up. The service was warm but tentative, and clearly wine service is something that needs some work. It took quite a while for the wine to be opened and a number of reminders for top ups. That aside the food service progressed at a good pace. The dishes were very old fashioned in design and concept, but fresh and well executed. The menu is limited and feels like a bit of a time warp form the 80's. As dining choices at the resort are limited, this is an important outlet to work with and ensure that it is a destination worth seeking.Show less

Author: poppybossSydney, Australia
Title: Wow - what great quality in every way
Review: My wife and granddaughter and I visited here on 13 July 2016 for our last night at the Shangri-La Resort.What a beautiful setting. A well decorated room overlooking the garden and ocean.We received a wonderfully warm reception and the pleasant service continue all throughout the meal.For starters my wife ordered the beef carpaccio, my granddaughter the soufflé and I the grilled Hokkaido scallops. All dishes were attractively presented and started the taste buds going. The carpaccio was exactly like it should be - high quality beef and supple flavours. The twice baked soufflé with mushrooms had a fine delicate flavour and was enjoyed. My scallops were cooked to perfection - just glassy - and I loved the beetroot puree.An amuse bouche of raspberry sorbet was served. Fantastic - a great palate cleaner - we could have had that as a course.For mains my wife had the Canadian cod, my granddaughter the lamb rack and I the Steak Au Poivre. All were cooked precisely as we had ordered. The Canadian cod on inquiry was said to be the Arctic black cod. We buy this great fish in Sydney and love it. A generous serve (my guess 150g) was perfectly roasted to "just cooked" and it went wonderfully with a lemon butter sauce. The lamb rack cooked to medium rare was pink to the edge. Loverly flavour with its dijon herb crust. My pepper steak was cooked on the rare side of medium-rare. Great quality meat cooked as it should be - an excellent dish. The sides of Brussels sprouts with beef back and the french fries were great accompaniments. The french fries were extra crispy as ordered.Complimentary petit fours topped out our appetites. We were unable to even think of desserts.We enjoyed the food with a couple of bottles of fine wine.The restaurant was a very high class restaurant and far superior to what we were expecting.Show less

Author: worktopsteveWalton-On-Thames, United Kingdom
Title: Beautiful Restaurant
Review: We ate twice at the Ferringgi Grill during our stay at the Rasa Sayang. There was a few minor problems on our first visit but the second time was just amazing the staff, food and service were second to none very big thanks to Rossi the most competent fine dining waiter I have ever come across who prepared food at our table with commentary and a big smile. Looking forward to seeing everybody again really soonShow less

Author: HishamZarinaAnwarKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: 22nd ANNIVERSARY DINNER
Review: Came back to Shangri-La Rasa Sayang for my 22nd wedding anniversary, we dined at Ferringhi Grill. The team there wont disappoint you. They even gave some surprises to make the occasion more joyful. My heartfelt thanks to Sapari, Nazri, Shukur, Catherine and the whole team. Pleasure knowing you all, we will meet again soon. Show less

Author: L CNew York, NY
Title: Elegant setting with good service
Review: Had dinner in one of the private rooms. Service was attentive but unobtrusive. Food was nicely done: the foie gras was beautifully prepared. The setting is extremely relaxing. The prices are very high (considering I had a great lunch the same day at a stall for less than $2) for Penang, but on par for a 5-star international hotel chain. Western cuisine, so it is good for someone who wants a change from Asian cuisine.Show less

Author: Keat2010
Title: Excellent Food and service
Review: The food is very nice with a nice ambiance for dinning. The staffs are very nice and polite. Very professional and well trained indeed.

Author: JWP23Bromley, United Kingdom
Title: Away from the noisey market
Review: We ate at this restaurant two or three times and the food was good but the thing that it lacks is the service is a bit hit and miss sometimes there's plenty of staff around being attentive other times there's staff but their more interested either texting or trying to get customers in off the street, If you can ignore that it's worth giving it a go. One tip I would give try to sit near a fan because the restaurant is quite enclosed in areas and theres not much air circulation.Show less

Author: idefixx76Jakarta, Indonesia
Title: Great food, wonderful service
Review: We came without reservation for dinner with our baby and were told that their policy is that families with kids could only eat in a private room (though the restaurant was almost empty). I am not blaming them for the policy more myself for not doing the research :)So we sat in this room that is more for 10+ pax and felt a bit lonely... but the wonderful and attentive staff did a fantastic job at making us feel comfortable.Food is modern and exactly what you expect for the price you pay.Show less

Author: Malim27Swindon, United Kingdom
Title: If you want to play at pretentious...make sure you do it right!
Review: This place tries hard to provide high-end cuisine in a sophisticated atmosphere. This also includes eye watering prices for average fayre. Steak was OK…poor if you account for the price. Cutting the meat at the table and then returning to the kitchen to plate it up…on cold plates resulted in guess what…cold food!! All that fancy play acting and carving, only to eventually delivering a poor result. Service again is lacking and patchy. Sometimes it was overbearing, other times non existent. Note to restaurant…if you are going to be fancy…do it right! Atmosphere does not mean just dimming the lights. I cannot for the life of me understand the previous glowing reports. Maybe we ate during an off-night…although I don’t think so.Show less

Author: LorrainepatriciatoddPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Chateaubrand delicious
Review: Everything was spot on. The ambience, service and food was delightful. Table cooking for the crepes. Quality of the food was great. Five star for sure. Well worth the extra money. IT is true That you only get what you pay for and you won't Be disappointed here.Show less

Author: Macca032Noosa, Australia
Title: Wonderful breakfasts
Review: We only dined here for breakfast and did so many times. The staff were exceptional, we loved Eva so much I was going to check the luggage to ensure my bride had not packed her to take her home. Food was also lovely and outlook spectacular.Show less

Author: John FMelbourne, Australia
Title: Nice restaurant for formal dining
Review: This restaurant is the a la carte dining room within the Rasa Wing of the Shangri-La Resort. It is available for breakfast, but our visits were in the evening. We ate here twice, once as a couple to celebrate a special occasion and once as a family group of nine in a private room. The menu includes a good range of mainly Western dishes, and the quality was very good. The wine list contains a choice of international wines, and while not an extensive list the wines appear to have been carefully chosen. Service was very good, particularly when it came to managing a group of small children. This is a relatively expensive restaurant but not over the top. It is worth making a booking in order to get one of the tables in front of the wall-to-ceiling windows looking down on the manicured gardens below.Show less

Author: JilllianLiverpool, United Kingdom
Title: By far the best
Review: The bar service wasn't great. Bar staff too busy talking to serve! Was a little worried about going into the restaurant and spending a fair bit of money because of this. However staff within the restaurant were far far more professional and we enjoyed a great evening. Not cheap but not expensive either. Delightful evening.Show less

Author: Checkmate1Essex
Title: Very Proffessional
Review: We were club at the Shangri-La and ate here for breakfast every morning. Food and service was first class. We ate fish, steak and many other meals prepared for us here and it was all very good. A special thanks to Walter who was outstanding and looked after us very well as I'm sure all his other guests also. There is an excellent pianist and singer called Ron in the evening by the bar. Staff there were also amazing.Show less

Author: KLcc007
Title: Superb Dining Experience
Review: I had a great dinner outing with my daughter. The service was attentive and friendly. The food worth the price paid and it very satisfying. Highly recommended for fine dining experience. Will definitely visit again.

Author: michaelbL4219NQCloverdale, Australia
Title: Our 36th Wedding Anniversary Dinner.
Review: From the welcoming arrival our evening became more special as we ordered and enjoyed our selection from an exciting and interesting creations contained in the menu. The wine selection provided you a wonderful selection. The wait staff were attentive asking when would we like the next course not rushing it. Your surroundings are plush and relaxing with an era if you wanted a pre dinner drink. We received a very rich chocolate cake for our anniversary. I am sure we will be back again in August 2016. Superb evening. We would highly recommend this Fine Dining restaurant.Show less

Author: AndrewN424Tadley, United Kingdom
Title: Oasis of calm
Review: Amongst the forest of local restaurants along the beach this one really stood out. The welcome was warm and the menu varied with more of a focus on western style. The food was very good and the service attentive, at times a little overly so. Despite not holding back on the drinks the overall bull was not extortionate.Show less

Author: pohling_foo
Title: Great food great ambiance!
Review: This restaurant serves fine food! Great steak. We love the ambiance. They have a pianist at night. We got to enjoy and chill at the couch for musics after our dinner. Waiters were very attentive. Will definitely return!

Author: James D
Title: Farouk and Kit made it amazing
Review: Firstly, the cuisine at this restaurant is WORLD CLASS. The steaks are to die for, any dish you order you can expect it will blow your mind. Farouk and Kit are what keep this restaurant alive, they are incredible hosts and Shangri-la are lucky to have them. Show less

Author: 922warrendSingapore, Singapore
Title: Romantic dinner with impressive cuisine
Review: In a part of the world where "air flown from Australia" is a mark of quality not environmental terrorism as would be the case in the UK, this has some of the best air flown (always wondered what the 'air' adds to the description of the mode of transport) ingredients from around the world cooked beautifully and served enthusiastically. It's SE Asia service at its best and if the prices weren't at the high end we would have moved out of the hotel and set up there for a week. $$$$ but worth every penny. Show less

Author: JadamrosPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Fine Dining at its best
Review: Batu Feringgi is not exactly a hotbed for fine dining; but if you ARE looking for a fine dining restaurant there, the Feringgi Grill must be top of the list.Located within the Shangri-La Rasa Sayang Resort, the restaurant has a smart casual attire policy, so no flip-flops or shorts please!We were there on a special occasion, and thankfully the night went well. Service was good and attentive, the environment suitably dark and romantic; and the food was excellent.We had the chateaubriand, which was presented and carved at the table by the server. Perfectly done medium-rare as we like it.At the end of the meal, the lady was presented with a red rose, which was a nice touch.Not a cheap restaurant, but well worth it!Show less

Author: Shniq F
Title: great staff! warm and cozy ambience
Review:
had our wedding anniversary dinner here. 
everything was beautiful!
staffs are warm and welcoming .
Food was delicious.

Author: JCT1962Newcastle, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent but pricy
Review: We always try to have at least one expensive me out when on holiday and we chose ferringi grill on this occasion having eaten here before. The food, service and wine were all excellent and the atmosphere is that of a fine dining restaurant and quite formal. We started with duck ravioli which was very tasty although a second piece of ravioli would have made for a good size starter. This was followed by lamb rack which was cooked superbly just as we had ordered and accompanied by very good vegetables. For dessert we chose pan a cotta and a chocolate and caramel tart followed by coffee and very good petit fours. Intermingled with this was an amuse bouche of tuna and a very good mango sorbet. As title indicated this comes at a price when accompanied by a bottle of white wine - middle of their price range - the bill came to 918 ringgits.Show less

Author: LAVISH888London, United Kingdom
Title: Good old fashioned delight
Review: We had a wonderful dinner at this restaurant. Best described as traditional fine ding with good old fashioned values. We started with a great Ceasar Salad prepared at the table followed by a wonderful chateaubriand. Both were prepared to perfection. Desert was a Crepe Suzette, again prepared at the table, and was delicious! Highly recommended.Show less

Author: Johnson_Lam
Title: GREAT FOOD! Great environment
Review: If you are ok with splurging a little for a fancy dinner, this is the place to go. Very nice environment and theming. If you love meat, order medium rare steaks. Yummy.

Author: Andrew MWelwyn, United Kingdom
Title: Lived up to all Expectations
Review: We were in the Rasa Sayang Resort where this is situated and chose it for a wedding anniversary. For Malaysia it is very expensive but it certainly lives up to its reputation for excellent cooking and service. Fine dining touches, such as a variety of breads, amuse bouche, sorbet, after dinner chocolates. Wine list varies from expensive to mega expensive, but our Chilean Chardonnay and NZ Sauvignon Blanc by the glass were so good that sipping slowly was most pleasant. We had fantastic souffles, grilled grouper/snapper with asparagus and egg, crepes suzette - delicious. And roses for the lady at the end! Good choiceShow less

Author: Jervis59Luxembourg City, Luxembourg
Title: Excellent food in a good ambience with efficient service.
Review: The restaurant is the "upmarket" option at the Shangri La Resort. Small children are discouraged and you have to dress smartly casual (no shorts etc..).There is a piano player in the bar area who sings Elton John/Paul McCartney favourites.The service is very good. Not obtrusive but always on hand.We had only two courses as we had been pigging out at the Spice Cafe during our stay but the Chateaubriand was superb, cooked perfectly and served with selection of crisp vegetables and garlic mashed potatoes. I had bresaola as an appetiser and my wife chose well with the lobster bisque, with chunks of lobster covered with a realistic French fish based soup.The wine list is select and reasonably priced. We had several "amuse-bouches" and sorbets to cleanse the palate, and petits fours at the end, so all proper touches.The Rasa Wing is designed for "adults" so I would suggest staying away if your children are under 12. Otherwise this was a very good experience.Show less

Author: shirleyandbrian2015South Molton, United Kingdom
Title: Disappointing
Review: We visited this restaurant on 9th October as we had friends visit us and we are currently stayng at this hotel. The restaurant had great reviews and this is what we based our booking on. I must say the service that you receive in this restaurant is fantastic and could not fault it at all, however we thought the food would be much better considering the prices that we paid. The starters that we had were excellent....2 caesar salads, a soufflé and tomato and mozzarella. ....although quite small they were delicious. ...they were priced at approx 33 malaysian ringgits each. For mains there were 3 sirloins and a kings cut roast beef, we found the sirloin to be quite fatty and chewey and for the price of almost 127 ringgits, it was disappointing. I know this is a five star hotel and that you expect to pay over the odds for eating at the hotel and i genuinely dont mind paying when the food is good, however as a currrent guest here we will not be eating dinner here again.Show less

Author: iamsuhainiPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Excellent!
Review: We didn't have a reservations, as we were out-of-towners, didn't think it would be so popular, but they squeezed us in anyhow. We waited awhile in a nice seating area while they set us a table, and then shown to our table. I haven't seen that in so many years! The menu was totally baffling, as in for a local but the staff was very professional in explaining some of the recommended items. Everything we ordered were superbly prepared. Even the bread service was spectacular. Very nice romantic ambiance, great for family dinners or corporates. Highly recommended.Show less

Author: MYAZANA1
Title: Excellent restaurant
Review: Just perfect breakfast and dinner restaurant with wonderful staff for those staying in the Rasa Wing..........................................

Author: TrericSaw
Title: Nice main course
Review:
Lovely like the main course(Beef).
Service was good,and the food also .The place suitable for family and friend.
If feel free i will bring my friend go again

Author: Ken MInverness
Title: Excellent breakfasts and dinners
Review: On arrival, we opted for the Feringgi Grill and treated ourselves to a couple of starters floowed by the tenderloin (UK - filet steak) steak main course. It was superb! Not the cheapest meal in Batu Feringgi - but well worth the cost.Breakfasts were wonderful. In addition to the bacon (beef or chicken!), eggs and mushrooms, waffles, pancakes, etc., every day there were specials from the chef, Malaysin, Indian and Chinese, together with help yourself from fruit, cold cuts, cheeses and sweets on the buffet. The specials are brilliant with varieties of fish dishes, dhals and other delicacies from the East.My wife and I are looking forward to trying out some of these combinations at home!Show less

Author: Mizan C
Title: Nice family meal
Review: I visited here for dinner with my wife and baby. On arrival I was told I needed a private dining room due to age of my child. I was more than happy with that as the privacy allowed a more intimate dining experience. The waiter serving us was excellent, very attentive without being obtrusive. The food was as expected, tasty caeser salad and well cooked steak. Price was a little on the high side but to be expected at this level of dining. The food and particularly the service makes it worthwhile. The only downside is certain dishes such as lasagne were not available and the menu could do with a few more dishes to add some variety. I'd like to go back however I would need some alternative dining options such as Malay or Thai food.Show less

Author: Nisha RDhaka City, Bangladesh
Title: Excellent Ceaser Salad, Great Atomsphere and Good Food
Review: My husband and I stayed at the Shangri La for our anniversary and decided to check out their stellar restaurant. The best Ceasar Salad we ever had in our lives was prepared by a young bar tender at the restausant. If you happen to be there, pleaae the manager about this salad and the yoing bar tender who makes it and I promise that you will not regret it! The rest of the food was very nice too. The soups, the fish and the steaks were all amazing, but the star of our night was the ceasar salad! The breakfasts that we had at the Grill were also bettet than the cafe's. So I highly recommend to gwt an upgrade on the rooms so that you can avail that option too. Show less

Author: Susangermany
Title: Still the best....
Review:
Dining in Penang! The service is excellent! The 
Life music perfects the atmosphere ! 
If you look for a great evening you should visit
The Feringgi Grill situated at the Rasa Sayang Hotel.
direct at the Beach.
Don't miss a walk thru the beautiful Garden!

Author: nellielim
Title: Wonderful meal
Review: Situated in the Rasa Wing of the Rasa Sayang Hotel, this grill offers dining in a warm and cozy setting. Great food, nice wine and the steaks always done to perfection. We had a wonderful time here and look forward to our next visit.

Author: Flyers007DublinDublin, Ireland
Title: We enjoyed our sublime breakfast at the Feringgi Grill on both of our mornings, highly recommended
Review: During our stay at Shangri-La's Rasa Sayang Resort & Spa Rasa Wing we had twice breakfast at the Feringgi Grill. Please see also our hotel review. Breakfast is one of the many benefits included when staying in the Rasa Wing section of this memorable resort. The fine dining restaurant was located on the first floor of the Rasa Wing and could be accessed via staircase or elevator.We were warmly welcomed and brought to our table. It was round, large and covered with a white linen cloth and near the floor to ceiling windows, so we could enjoy a gorgeous view too.The interior was elegant with a beautiful carpet.We were advised that the buffet included all cold items and a menu was available for hot items.We could request as many a la carte items as we liked. A friendly waitress took our order for our cappuccinos, orange juice, Eggs Benedict and waffles.We were asked what consistency of the eggs we wanted, which was a nice touch.The buffet was on the smaller side, but had everything one could wish for from smoked salmon to yogurt, berries, pastries and much more. One interesting item was the whole wheat croissant. My better half tried it and said it was very good.The waffles were an indulgence and the Eggs Benedict one of the best we had so far. All breakfast items were high quality and delicious.The staff was attentive and friendly. Once we were offered to try a typical savory local pastry. I don't remember the name, but we very much enjoyed it.Breakfast was something to look forward to and beside the overall experience a reason to return.Would we recommend this restaurant for breakfast to a friend? YES!Would we want to eat our breakfast there again in our future? YES!Show less

Author: DrBruciePenang Island, Malaysia
Title: A very fine dining experience indeed
Review: Taken to this restaurant by friends. Fine menu, fine ambience and fine dining, with excellent and unobtrusive service. Steak features on the menu; my steak au poivre was simply delicious. Even choosing a la carte there were small taster courses, sorbet and petit fours, all of which were prepared with the same attention to flavour, aesthetics and taste as the main courses. A wonderful evening.Show less

Author: Paulz71Dubai, United Arab Emirates
Title: Such a nice atmosphere
Review: We had drinks there on the night of Aug 23rd. The bartender there was an amazing person, very friendly, very helpful, he made sure my wife got all what she asked for, even getting her salad from room service as the kitchen was closed.Too bad i did not capture his name, but this is the reason i specified the date. Thank YouShow less

Author: kag-ok
Title: Simply The Best
Review:
Amazing food and excellent staff. This restaurant has been voted Number 1 in Malaysia in previous years.
Very romantic, relaxing and comfortable for couples.
The service is second to none and you can  have your food cooked at your table.
Please try.

Author: Phil LGreater Melbourne, Australia
Title: nice BUT $$$$$$$
Review: My partner and i experience alot of nice restaurants so our expectations where very high of this place . Upon arrive we were greeted and asked to take a seat at the bar , so we naturally thought our table wasnt ready however after a nice glass of wine we were informed our table was already avialable ?? ( 100 RB already thanks ) our dinner was very nice and the staff were pleasant , however was't worth 1100 RB ? NO WAY !!!!! for $400 AU i expect ALOT more .Show less

Author: NRKettle
Title: Honeymoon
Review:
From start to finish wonderful restaurant and excellent staff.
We had no idea of wine paring but the sommelier helped us choose and excellent wine to accompany our meal .

Author: benjaminc4Singapore, Singapore
Title: Great service
Review: We were staying at another hotel so visited the restaurant especially. The food was of great quality and I really struggled to pick something from the menu as it all looked great! The meat really is delicious and I would certainly recommend going there for dinner. The meal was made extra special by the brilliant service we had - very friendly and knowledgable staff that made the difference.Show less

Author: Allan C
Title: Fine Dining
Review:
The Menu is not large but the food is superb as is the service. There was a wide selection of wines to chose from.
Slightly expensive but good value for money.

Author: SardoniqueSingapore, Singapore
Title: Magnificence
Review: I visited this place on recommendation from a friend, and it is simply one of the best decisions I've ever made. I suggest going on a friday/saturday as that is when they have their prime rib eye availabl, which in my opinion was the best piece of steak that I've ever had. The chargrill aroma permeating into the parenchyma of the beef is simply magnificent. The cesar salad as well as the sorbets are a masterclass as well. Service was impeccable with tableside service for a few dishes including their excellent dessert. Do not miss this place at all costs.Show less

Author: chris wAdelaide, Australia
Title: Beautiful Chinese
Review: We opted for Chinese and were not disappointed. The waiter we had came from Nepal and was so very helpful and was an expert in making our choices etc. From the pineapple fried rice to the sweet and sour fried chicken every mouthful was amazing. The beef dish we ordered on our 2nd visit came with the most crispy onions ever. The chef was Penang/Chinese so this is why the food was so excellent. Can't say enough good comments about this restaurant. We had a bottle of sauv/blanc both meals that we had here and it was gorgeous. It came from Chile and called Santa Rita. If you enjoy a really good sauv/blanc then this wine is a must. We actually looked in Tesco's Supermarket and found it there, so we had to buy another bottle.The washrooms at this restaurant are amazing. Very very clean and out of this world. You'll know what I mean if you go here.Show less

Author: 169aziztSingapore, Singapore
Title: Fine dining at its best
Review: We ate at a private room to celebrate a family event. There were 15 of us. A few of us had the steak Au Poivre - beautifully cooked tenderloin flambéed in cognac and finished with a rich peppercorn sauce, served with roasted vegetables and gratinated potatoes - an excellent choice. I shared the chateaubriand and it was wonderful. It was served with Brussels sprouts, thyme roasted potatoes and other vegetables, served with béarnaise sauce as well as a Merlot sauce. For those that prefer the full flavor of the meat to be the hero of the dish then I'd recommend the angus king cut of prime beef. It had a smoky and robust flavor. The degustation menu is another excellent choice with a main focus on seafood- with Hokkaido scallops snd cod being part of the fare. I must say the tomato soup turned out to be s huge surprise as it is flambéed with gin and finished with cream giving it a very strong and rich flavour - using a recipe that has existed for the last 40 years. The intermezzos are surprising and service impeccable-we were given a chocolate cake to celebrate our event and handcrafted chocolates, some of which were infused with lemongrass cream.. Made it s perfect ending for e meal. Our meal worked out to be about $70 per person - SGD, which I consider reasonable for the quality of the ingredients and the cooking!Show less

Author: erin2503Penang Island, Malaysia
Title: Spectacular view
Review: If you’re looking for something special, there are a couple of establishments that do a first-class job of elevating the dining experience to elegantly delicious heights. Feringgi Grill at Rasa Sayang is one such example and one of the most esteemed and long-lasting institutions of its kind. Feringgi Grill offers a fine choice of wines by the glass. They serves 10 different types of home made ice cream, and I must say that the peanut butter ice cream is to die for! Luxuriously smooth and nutty!Show less

Author: Promtong M
Title: Nice food, good location.
Review: Food was nice. Staff were friendly & happy to do their jobs. Good location, on the Batu Ferringhi beach.

Author: Julie GTasmania, Australia
Title: Food disappointing
Review: The ambience of the restaurant was lovely but we were disappointed with the food. My husbands steak which he asked for medium to well done was very rare. The accompanying vegetables no flavour. My prawns were bland. Both meals lacked flavour. The staff however are amazing, you cannot fault the service provided by very good staff. Maybe we just had an off night in the restaurant. Would give it another go.Show less

Author: nikt w
Title: Excellent Dining
Review: The food here is no doubt a class above. (Although you pay for this) Service from waiting staff is professional, friendly and conversational. If you want a little treat and privacy with an ocean view this is the place.

Author: 3012IreneGold Coast, Australia
Title: Excellent Service but disappointed with the food especially main course
Review: Went there during my birthday recently. My husband and I are the regular guests at the Feringgi Grill for the past 10 years. A lot of good memories, we love the place and the food. I was very disappointed during my recently visit. The main course I ordered was the grill Hokkaido Scallops and my husband ordered the Beef Sirloin Steak. My Scallops were under cook and I have to send back. I was surprised that they actually re-cook my half eaten first piece of scallop and re-serve me with the same scallops, but this time was overcooked. Therefore, I have to return the dish for the second time and cancel the order. The Beef Sirloin was just average with the price that we were paying. The presentation of the dish were so pathetic with only 3 small miserable pieces of vege. Honestly, that night we were not happy with the dish and very disappointed. But, we will still go back and give them another chance as we love the staffs and the service is really excellent.Overall, with the price that we paid is not exceptable.Show less

Author: GuliWhere
Title: Lush romantic surrounds for a cuppa
Review: Foodwise not very good. What draws you here is the beautiful lush and romantic atmosphere . Just sit for a cuppa and maybe some dessert. Expensive but don't expect much. Enjoy the surroundings

Author: lorraine1223Johor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Fabulous service but over rated food ( especially Main course)
Review: Was booked a dinner at the private room for family, appetizer & soup are excellent. Staff are well trained with speak fluent English and they manage to answer every question we asked about the food.It just the main course disappoint me especially Wagyu Beef Tenderlion. Perhaps I had a better Wagyu Beef Tenderlion at another restaurant 2 months ago, therefore it doesn't up to my standard. Seafood Platter Grill with very heavy smoke taste which doesn't suit me.Show less

Author: SamuelMo18Singapore, Singapore
Title: A memorable dinner
Review: I booked a dinner at the private room for my family while staying at the Rasa Sayang. My wife and I ordered the rib eye steak for dinner. The steak turned out to be too salty for our liking and we informed the restaurant staff about it. They promptly offered to change the steak for us and the restaurant manager Mazlan(If I remembered correctly) came to us to apologize for the saltiness of the steak. What impressed me was the fact that the restaurant replaced our steaks promptly and the manager came not once but twice to offer us complimentary drinks as a gesture of goodwill. On top of that we were given complimentary desserts after our meal. I must say that despite the initial disappointment of the steaks, I will definitely return to the restaurant for it's level of service and hospitality. Well done to the staff of ferringhi grillShow less

Author: sjie
Title: Very classic fine dining restaurant in Penang.
Review: Like their degustation menu very much! the environment is cozy and like their Gueriedon service very special dinner experience.

Author: MarkDReviewerBasingstoke, United Kingdom
Title: Best steak I've had in a long time.
Review: Fine dining - approx. £50 a head including house wine (which is a nice Shiraz).Steak was amazing. Cooked perfectly. Amazing service too and as you would expect from high end dining, you get the extras like amuse bouche.. etc...Make sure you tell them if it is a special occasion and you'll get some extra treatment and possibly a cake.Probably the best restaurant in BF.Show less

Author: yuervtttt
Title: Feringgi Beach's Best
Review:
Certainly the best restuarant outside of hotels on the beach, clean, nice surroundings and reasonable service.
Expensive compared to,others but cheap compared to Europe, we've been here for 10days and used this for last 3 wish we'd have found it earlier

Author: Demonone
Title: Great food and atmosphere
Review: One of the best top of the range restaurants on the strip. Well worth a meal there. Good service and great food.

Author: floridareular
Title: Still stunning
Review: What can I say. Superb food fantastic service. Yes it is expensive (in bf) but anywhere else it would cost two or three times the price. The deserts and coffee are stunning too. We love this place a pleasant experience every time we visit.

Author: TanJohn016Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Friendly staff
Review: I used to like Ferringhi Grill whenever I am in Penang. It used to be one of the better western style restaurants,. However, on a recent visit, I realised that their signature dishes like tomato soup, caesar's salad is not as good as it was before. I do like their staff though who are friendly and the service is great. And giving a rose to the ladies when they leave the restaurant is a great way to say Goodbye! Show less

Author: LauridsUglvigSan Jose, Costa Rica
Title: Staying over in The Shangri-La
Review: We stayed at the Shangri-La and after dining out the first night, we decided to stay in for the second. Not a bad choice at all. The service was fantastic. We had reserved late, so only a couple of tables left, obviously not the best. Arriving at the restaurant they suggested waiting 10-15 minutes, as a better table was becoming available. While waiting we got to chose the wine and had a first look at the menu. Large wine list with something for all categories and spending power, and a very varied menu, with the traditional western dishes in a nice mix with the local.Preparation, presentation and service was perfect.We are coming back! Show less

Author: 44basHornchurch, United Kingdom
Title: Amazing staff & fabulous food
Review: We had breakfast here every day for 14 days during our stay in the hotel. The food was expertly cooked and presented. The staff were absolutely brilliant with their attention to detail, service and trying to accommodate every guest with the best view possible from their table. If this wasn't always possible, they were so apologetic for having to seat us somewhere else. Thank you for everything. We will be back!Show less

Author: Sandra CLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Do not miss
Review: We have been staying at the rasa for 10 days. Food in general was to a good standard. We did not envisage the superb food and service we received at the ferringhi grill, Caesar salad dressing made up in front of you and meat carved at the table. Fantastic attention to detail. Service exceptional. A must to visit!Show less

Author: James GMaybole, United Kingdom
Title: Please can I have my meal hot
Review: This is a very nice restaurant the grill room for Shangri-la Rasa Sayang, you will love the decor and the general ambience of the place a really nice place to eat in, the only problem that I have is the fact that ( it has happened to us more than once ) the food is not hot when you are served it, I asked for the Queens Cut which is a smaller portion of roast beef which used to be cut in front of you off the joint from a trolley in my case it was brought served from the kitchen 1 slice of roast beef at best it could be described as warm ( just ) the vegetables which are extra were also just warm all of them, the reality was that around half way through your meal the whole meal was stone cold Oh I forgot to mention that the plates were stone cold which was a major part of the problem, much as I like this restaurant in general will never return as I left feeling cheated that I had paid a hefty price for a meal that should have been enjoyed but in reality was let down ( again ) by a problem that could so easily have been preventedShow less

Author: 429DanielMMauritius
Title: Fine Dining at its Best
Review: Paola, Colm, Miriam and I spent an evening at this restaurant last night. The attention to detail in all that the staff do is impressive. All the waiting staff are impeccably turned out, know their menu and wine lists and are incredibly professional. The German chef, Matthias, certainly known his profession. Everything that he sent out of the kitchen was simply perfect. This is not the cheapest restaurant in town, but certainly is a "must" for a special occasion.Show less

Author: PFirst123Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Best Fine Dining in Penang
Review: I highly recommend this place for occasions and business meals:1) Excellent ambience and great view. Interior deco is very stylish2) Excellent menu, not fanciful, but sufficient good items for a fine dining experience. Try their Chateaubriand. If you need something fanciful, perhaps should ask for the chef to prepare something special.3) Excellent service - all staff are well trained and are very efficient. Speak fluent English.4) Don't forget to visit the bar before and after meal. They provide excellent life music and the bartender, Mr. Lee, is incredibly friendly and knowledgeable.Show less

Author: Wendy VSydney, Australia
Title: Absolutely Superb
Review: This is a fine dining Restraunt within the Shangri-la hotel. The restraunt was well patronised and delivered on its fine reputation at all levels. The service was second to none. The food was both delicious and dramatically presented, often being cooked at our table. My husband had steak Dianne and he said it was the best steak he had beer eaten. I had perfectly cooked salmon and my favourite were the crepe suzettes which were recommended by the chef. There was a good wine list to support the amazing food. My compliments to the chef.Show less

Author: barbaraf1962
Title: Amazing
Review:
We went here twice for chateaubriand, during our 11 night stay at the Rasa.
Service and food quality are fantastic. If you have the chance to have Nazri as your server you will be amazed at the fabulous quality service.
Well worth the cost.

Author: ian fDundee, United Kingdom
Title: THE SCOTTISH GLOBETROTTERS
Review: We ate here tonight and were delighted with our meal. The staff really excelled in every way. They were attentive without being in your face. The surroundings were beautiful. We were served a taster of salmon to start, then my wife had tomato soup which was prepared at the table. I went for the lobster bisque. Both were delicious. Next came a raspberry sorbet to cleanse the palette which was perfect, not too icey. For our main course we opted for fish. My wife had the salmon fillet while I ordered the snapper. Again these dishes were tasty and well cooked. Having no room for dessert we were served a selection of chocolates. Along with an apple juice and a small beer the bill came to just over £60 which for a meal of this quality was very reasonable. We would certainly use this restaurant again.Show less

Author: Jacqui FPerth, Australia
Title: Exceptional!
Review: We enjoyed an exceptional meal here on our last night at the Rasa Sayang. The service was wonderful, attentive but not too overbearing. The food was first class and very generous portions for a fine dining restaurant.The restaurant also has a great international wine list.We will definitely be back if we are ever in Penang again!! Show less

Author: Edwin NKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Missing the old grill
Review: Visited the Feringgi Grill recently for 3rd time to check out the latest offering, and it seems like my first visit before the refurbishment was still the best meal I ever had. Boy, how much I missed the Pan Seared Foie Gras, Escargot with cheese (no longer available), Tomato Soup and Caeser Salad, both were prepared by your table. The chef actually recommended us a limited edition of Blue Lobster which was sweet tasting but did not leave the lasting impression unlike the 4 dishes I ever had in Malaysia. Service was excellent as always, attentive without being intrusive, and atmosphere cozy and romantic with sea view of Feringgi beach. This legendary restaurant was captured the Malaysian Best Restaurant award before, and I look forward to the honor to be revived in near future.Show less

Author: Chris OWangi Wangi, Australia
Title: Fabulous food
Review: We ate here on 3 evenings while in Batu Ferenghi. Every time was a fantastic experience. This is an international class restaurant, serving international cuisine.They also had a good wine list with wines from around the world.A little expensive but not excessively so given the quality of food and service (mains US$35 for the lamb to US$130 for the lobster).On our final night in Penang our table was scattered with rose petals, there was a farewell sign on our table and we were given a special chocolate cake (delicious) for desert.Every night the ladies were given a long stem rose when leaving.Highly recommended.Show less

Author: worldexplorer1985
Title: Really tasty food
Review: Went here for lunch and the food and service was really nice. I'm new to the island and would recommend this place to friends. I'll return sometime for dinner. Had the burger and it was quick out and tasted really nice. Overall a good experience

Author: 374elizabethpWollongong, Australia
Title: Fantastic !!!
Review: We had dinner here on three different occasions whilst staying in the hotel. It was so good you just wanted to keep going back.Fantastic food ,the best service and a great atmosphere.On our last night they gave us a special table that was decorated especially for the occasion with a chocolate cake wishing us Bon Voyage.Show less

Author: BABU382Kolkata (Calcutta), India
Title: wow wow what a place
Review: My wife and I ate here to celebrate a birthday while we were staying at the Shangri La. We had the degustation menu which was brilliant. My wife has a shrimp allergy and one of the dishes was swapped out without any issue. Service as previous reviewers have stated is excellent whilst not being overbearing. Also finished the evening in the lounge next door which is a great way to end the experience! Worth splurging if you can! i swear calcuttans shld go once .....last not the least alcohol is great and cheap too..Show less

Author: James C
Title: Excellent Food
Review: The food was excellent and the service good. However, there wasn't sufficient staff. They seemed to be running around catering to the guess.

Author: tpkingHong Kong
Title: Fine dining with kid
Review: My wife and I celebrated our anniversary here with our 2.5 years old daughter. The restaurant offered a private room for guests with kids below 7, which is perfect for people who want to do fine dining but cannot drop their kids somewhere. They also have a menu for kids. Food is great. The beef is juicy and tender. Perfectly cooked. Service is good - attentive and warm. My daughter also loves the free sorbet a lot! Overall a great experience. Show less

Author: Alison L
Title: wonderful food and service
Review: A treat night out turned out to be everything we were looking form and more!  The ambiance was perfect, the service discreet and professional but at the same time very friendly.  The food, what can I say, beautifully presented, delicious and innovative.

Author: Meem R
Title: Expensive but good
Review: International cuisine, good food well prepared and presented along with attentive waiter.  We enjoyed the music in the bar adjacent to the dining area which did not overwhelm the conversation.

Author: bxcwxc
Title: Great food
Review: Garden setting was really pleasant, and food even better. Was a bit pricey. Staff were very good. Would go again

Author: Susangermany
Title: Great Dinner at the Grill....
Review:
again, but this was one of the best we had. The steaks are fantastic, wine perfect.
The service is outstanding. The Feringgi Grill is a perfect way to celebrate or just
to pamper yourself. Thanks to the team we had a great evening!

Author: Steve CAdelaide, Australia
Title: 1st class all the way!
Review: My wife and I ate here to celebrate a birthday while we were staying at the Shangri La. We had the degustation menu which was brilliant. My wife has a shellfish allergy and one of the dishes was swapped out without any issue. Service as previous reviewers have stated is excellent whilst not being overbearing. Also finished the evening in the lounge next door which is a great way to end the experience! Worth splurging if you can! Show less

Author: alwyn1Coventry, United Kingdom
Title: Fine dining, excellent service
Review: While staying at the Rasa hotel in the Rasa Wing we could enjoy breakfasts every day in the Feriniggi Grill if we wanted to, which we did on several occasions, always good service and an extensive breakfast menu. We also went in the evening to celebrate a friend's birthday. We had the usual excellent attentive service coupled with an interesting and first class menu. The staff made us feel special and we enjoyed a memorable evening. The prices are higher than other establishments in the area, but you get quality that other places can't match.Great place for special occasions or a romantic evening. Highly recommended.Show less

Author: Snowy_SallyJakarta, Indonesia
Title: A NICE "GRILL" NIGHT in Penang
Review: Since we had such a great meal "Chez Nous", for our second and last dinner in Penang, we decided to go to another well rated restaurant. After our Moules/frites, we felt like having a great steak. The restaurant in the Shangri-La hotel has a relatively pleasant atmosphere. The menu is interesting and offers a large selection of dishes and drinks. The decoration could be improved with slight renovations but was fine. The Chateaubriand we ordered was excellent, tender, juicy and cooked the way we expected it to be. The service was very professional. We certainly enjoyed our meal. Only one thing, it was maybe too pricy, something to be aware of when dinning at "Ferringhi Grill"Show less

Author: najieb
Title: Fine dining exclusive restaurant
Review:
Very exclusive place for fine dining, located in Rasa Sayang hotel. food are good, depends what you order. many selection of wines. staff are friendly and good service.

a must go for couples who wish to spend a bit more money on fine dining.

Author: Supervisor57Lincoln, United Kingdom
Title: Disabled Facilities
Review: Saturday 7th. June 2014You are advised to book a table.The Restaurant is accessed by wheel-chair by the lift which is situated at the Rasa Wing down the left side corridor from the Rasa Reception area. You need the 3rd. floor in the lift. as you exit left 10 metres at the side of the Kitchen then enter the Feringgi Grill via the double doors, you will be shown to your table.We made ourselves comfortable at our window table, all staff are superb and help a great deal, they moved my wife's wheel-chair well out of the way, so we could take in the experience like any loving couple.We was asked what drinks we required:I had bottled water also a Coke LightMy wife had a SpriteEntree for both of us consisted of Seared Tuna with a slither of Radish.Starters I had a Mushroom soup, my wife had a medley of lettuce with a Dressing.Next course was a Lemon Sorbet topped with a Blueberry (very refreshing)For Main course I had Rib of Beef Medium Rare (King size) came with Garlic Mash with a Medley of Vegetables and a medium size Yorkshire Pudding. The wife had the same but Queen size.It was all well presented and all staff were superb.Plenty of room between tablesPity there is not disabled toilets nearby, but if needed I could have got the wife in a Standard Toilet or popped back to our room. After Dinner we went through to the Bar area where I had a Coke Light my wife had a Sprite, a Cabaret Duo was singing.A nice ambiance to end the night.The total cost was RM396.70 (at the time you could get a rate of RM5.36 = £1)or approx £74 (British Sterling)A very good dinner, super attentive staff, reasonable price for a special occasion.(No disabled toilet at hand though)More "Disabled Facilities" to come for PenangShow less

Author: cheah99Penang Island, Malaysia
Title: Fantastic service and good food
Review: I 've been to the Feringgi Grill several times and so far, I've not been disappointed.The staff are friendly without being over-bearing. The steaks here are fantastic and cooked to just the way one likes it. However, this time round, their signature tomato soup(my favourite!) was not quite there. Also, for a fine dining restaurant, the bread served here needs some improving.Still, overall , this restaurant is certainly a gem not just in Batu Feringgi, but in Penang.Show less

Author: SuzieAyreLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Exceptional
Review: We came here on our last night in Batu Ferringhi and was so please was defiantly the cherry on the cake!! Staff was so friendly and helpful, service was fabulous (which was good considering I found service throughout Malaysia to be terrible) presentation with all the courses was fantastic and the food was consistently delicious, was slightly more expensive than other restaurants in Batu Ferrringgi but well worth the extra pennies spent. Show less

Author: loubie_loo78
Title: Exceptional!
Review: There is a genuine reason this restaurant is rated number 1 in Batu Ferringhi. The food is exceptional and the service received is of the highest level you will ever experience. We had the Degustation set menu which was wonderfully thought out and presented. It gave us a chance to try foods we wouldn't necessarily order from an a la carte menu. Yes, the prices are far more expensive than elsewhere and certainly for Malaysia but this level of fine dining, elegance and service should not be undervalued! The food really is as good as you would expect for a 5 star hotel but it is the service of the friendly staff and the talent of the chefs that should be appreciated. We stayed at the Golden Sands next door and whilst this is a good hotel, the Rasa Sayang is streets ahead! (Tip for the gents out there if you wish to try this restaurant is to ensure you pack long trousers and a collared shirt if you want to dine here)Show less

Author: ETphonehome73Chiang Mai, Thailand
Title: best steak I have had ... ever
Review: I went for a birthday treat with my partner and was very impressed. Upon first entering the restaurant I thought the styling was somewhat dated but by the end of the evening I was not the least bit bothered by this. Staff were friendly, wine menu extensive, sorbet refreshing, bread just warm enough , but the steaks ... oh the steaks ! Perfectly cooked, generous in size and with good side vegetables. I will be back !Show less

Author: NeeNee_ChoPenang
Title: Great Dinner
Review: It was my birthday dinner arranged by hubby. The interior of the restaurant wasn't impressive at first. Browsing through the menu, found quite some menu that I haven't tried before. We ordered half a dozen of pacific oyster and a bottle of Merlot to kick-off our dinner. The oysters were surprisingly fresh and then follow with a creamy mushroom souffle. The souffle was really impressed us. Main course was the Chateaubriand, grilled beef tenderloin to medium well. Dinner completed with a complimentary birthday cake and chocolate. By the end of the dinner, we were happy and satisfied.Show less

Author: Paul C
Title: Amazing
Review: We visited having walked through the night markets and were met with a friendly welcome. The staff actually recommended we try a different table to the one we picked initially as that can us a better view if the waterfall backdrop.The staff are friendly, knowledgeable and attentive. The food definitely matches that and is very tasty, very varied and very 'lazat'. I had the catch of the day which was Red Snapper, beautifully presented and really fresh. At the end of the night the staff took us under an umbrella to catch a cab as it was pouring it down. Hugely recommended! Show less

Author: suetopia
Title: Exceptional!
Review:
Fantastic restaurant!  Lovely staff, absolutely stunning food and a super wine list.  We treated ourselves to the Chateaubriand and loved it!
Note- this restaurant is western prices!

Author: 284jessc
Title: Perfect
Review:
There is nothing much for "review" , perfect and the best restaurant I ever been ! 
Food, atmosphere, service, staffs will definitely make your day happier,  Love it so much!

Author: Vicki B
Title: Perfect in every way.
Review: The food and service was amazing. We cannot fault one thing. A must when in Batu Ferringhi for special occasion or not!

Author: a284Perth, Australia
Title: Great dinner
Review: We wanted to try some fine dining in Batu Ferringhi as there is not much to choose from. The service is exceptional.... We were served by Safari a very nice man knows service well!. It is very expensive for Malaysia however one of the best nights we had in Batu Ferringhi.Thank you Safari... and staff!.Show less

Author: UnderBigHillGeorge Town, Malaysia
Title: Felt Pampered
Review: We organized a departmental dinner (total 26 pax) at Feringgi Grill to show our appreciation to our team. It was challenging as instead of having set menus, we decided to go for ala carte instead. We informed the total quantity of what we want to order so that the kitchen team can prepare enough raw material for the function, but we insisted to place our order only during the function so that some of the young colleagues could experience fine dining all the way. The restaurant team is very professional through out the reservation process and arrangement discussions. We had cocktail session before the dinner officially started. Because this is a departmental dinner, we actually prepared some simple games so that all our colleagues can warm up and have a sense of participation. The restaurant team arranged a spacious area for us, and served some free snacks to go with white wine.When the dinner officially started, they have us (6 tables) sit near the window. The sunset view was great and we love the table settings. Besides what we ordered, they also served free amuse, sorbet and coffee/tea after dinner.Since there were 26 of us, we tried almost every food listed on the menu. Conclusion: The food was superb. Make sure you try their tomato soup and Ceasar salad! (However, we did notice that some of the side dishes were served to the wrong table, maybe because of the slightly confusing ordering arrangement) We had 3 members celebrating their birthday on January. The restaurant team prepared a special chocolate birthday cake, placed on a cart full with rose petals. One of the staffs played guitar while the rest sing along. When the function ended, all the ladies got a free red rose as souvenir from the restaurant.Everyone felt pampered. What an experience!Show less

Author: mikewelhamLimoges, France
Title: First class
Review: The Feringgi Grill was the place to be on Old Years evening. It was the Indulgence set menu and comprised of 8 courses. The kitchen team were on top form and created perfection. The room was well laid out and not overcrowded. There was a festive atmosphere and the staff who looked after us were excellent at the tables were professional and friendly.After the meal you could go to the Retro Gala Countdown party in the Garden Wing of have drinks in Feringgi bar. First class all the way.Show less

Author: Shikha JChicago, Illinois
Title: Stomach was happy!
Review: We love eating the local food when we travel. However, every now and then we want some classic french food. The Feringgi Grill did not disappoint. First off the inside is a nice dark wood decor and reminded me of a Chicago streak restaurant. The entertainment were two singers in the back room which was a little weird but they both had nice voices. Most importantly, the food---excellent! And this is not just French food in Penang excellent, but overall a place I would love to go back to for dinner. The menu tells you which choices are served table side. I highly recommend the Tomato Soup…besides the interesting way it is made (with gin, which you do not taste), the soups is delicious. The soufle didn't really look like a soufle, but nonetheless was tasty. I had the snapper…ill be honest, the fish was cooked perfectly, but what made the dish was the lemon butter sauce it comes with. You can't go wrong with this dish.Anyway, overall the meal is pricey by Malaysian standards, but I feel like you get what you pay for and in this case we had an excellent meal and terrific service.Show less

Author: Brenda G
Title: As good as it gets
Review: We have never written a review before but felt prompted to say how amazing this restaurant is. We dined at Feringgi Grill on our last night in Penang and found the food supurb and the service unsurpassed. Australia's quality restaurants have a lot to learn. Thank you Narzi who looked after us so magnificently for the evening. We would definitely come back or recommend to others who want to enjoy a special occasion.Show less

Author: natalieg649Seminyak, Indonesia
Title: Fantastic
Review: Brilliant service, brilliant food, great value, would recommend to anyone. Even if it may seem a little pricey they bring small extra dishes such as bread, salads, starters, a palate cleansing sorbet and a cake for our last night all free of charge. Fabulous restaurant, would absolutely go again.Show less

Author: topcat1953ingatestone essex
Title: Dining with a difference
Review: The grill will remain at number1 for a long time it serves high quality food served in a lovely settingThe service is excellent we decided to have the set menu but could have choice any of the dishesAs all looked of the highest quality although dearer then most restaurants in the area it is well worth the extra.Show less

Author: jai8_LondonLondon, UK
Title: Excellent food and ambiente
Review: The Feringgi Grill is probably one of the best fine dining restaurants in Penang. The card offers a variety of fine dining options with a focus on steak and sea food. The sea brass baked in a salt crust must be tried for something ver different! Starters such as the caesar salad or tomato soup are prepared in front of the table by waiters which adds to the all round experience. The desserts are creative and delicious. A must go!Show less

Author: s_mnellbankVentnor
Title: fine dining
Review: This is the place for relaxed high days and holidays! Yes, a bit pricey but the value is very good. The menu does not change often and we still seem to happily pick the old favourites. As with anywhere in the Far East wine is more expensive than one expects however it is offered by the glass which is a small consolation. We have been regulars over the last thirty years and still strongly recommend this restaurant to our friends - in the hope that they will invite us! Show less

Author: Ira41Nottingham, United Kingdom
Title: very good dining experience
Review: Feringgi Grill is situated on the first floor in Rasa Sayang hotel in Penang with a nice view of the hotel's tropical garden. The dress code is smart casual and the ambiance is luxurious but simple.The service is excellent and the staff are very attentive and responsive.The quality off food is generally excellent but I was a little disappointed in the scallops. The wine list is very good and the prices are reasonable.Feringgi Grill compares very favourably with many good restaurants in Europe.Show less

Author: KrisSurreySurrey
Title: Fantastic Food and Service at the Feringgi Grill
Review: The Feringgi Grill is up there with the best restaurants in London / NYC - perfectly prepared and cooked food - excellent service and a calm, relaxed ambience. Try the caesar salad or tomato soup for a table side display of your dish being made. There is an extensive wine list - we had a very nice white wine for @ £35. It's not cheap by local standards (@ £120 incl drinks for a couple / two courses - although we did happen to choose the expensive grill / seafood options), but the food quality makes it very good value for money. If you're in Batu on holiday - make sure to try it.Show less

Author: Julie R
Title: Very Special
Review: We booked to eat here whilst staying at the Resort in April as a belated celebration of our wedding the previous December.. The staff were exceptional and made the evening very special. My husband chose to start with tomato soup, which was made from scratch with fresh ingredients, at the table and, in his words, "the best he had ever tasted". The table was decorated with rose petals and we were presented with a small chocolate 'congratulations' cake after the meal. Each lady was given a fresh red rose on leaving the restaurant, nice touch. Fairly expensive I guess, although we did have a bottle of champagne and a bottle of wine too. It was an evening I won't forget for a long time.Show less

Author: ShellywUKSeoul, South Korea
Title: Wonderful Restaurant with amazing staff
Review: We stayed in the Rasa wing in the hotel and ate here both nights, the food was truly amazing and we loved the table side service. The staff are beyond amazing and give such a personal service, the special touches like our leaving song and cake make this above and beyond most restaurants .We will be back and can't wait to come to the restaurant.We would like to give a special mention to the restaurant manager and Izahan.Show less

Author: CharlotteBadaLondon
Title: Birthday treat
Review: We went here for my birthday on the last night of our holiday and it really made my day special. The service was outstanding and the food was delicious. We had the tomato soup (sounds boring but was delicious and completely unlike any tomato soup I have every imagined) & lobster bisque to start followed by chateaubriand for main - all cooked to perfection. We were given complimentary champagne and a special desert to mark the occasion.We have eaten at plenty of michelin star places and I would rate this experience as completely on a par with these - the whole experience has convinced us to try and stay at the Rasa Sayang when we come backShow less

Author: PerthscousePerth Australia
Title: Expensive
Review: Food is certainly quite good but not that good that you would rave about it, but the prices are on a par with the up market restaurants of Paris and London, bit of a rip off in my opinion and you can certainly get better food at other places not too far away.tripadvisor is a great guide.Show less

Author: travelling-slumberSingapore, Singapore
Title: Great service, food was above average but not considered excellent
Review: After having read all but the last review this was the first restaurant we visited after we landed. Service was excellent. Like the last reviewer I also had the grilled scallops which was alright - funny mushy texture and I certainly had a lot better scallops before. They said the scallops were from Hokkaido . We had the sirloin with rice and baked beans which was an odd combination but tasted ok We also had palate cleanser in between meals etcThe service was impeccable which made it a great dining experience. Food could be better but I won't complain There was a dress code of smart casual which typically applies to men - no shorts or flip flops and they even have spare pants to lend to guests !Show less

Author: 2009H1N1Malaysia
Title: disappointed
Review: Have been dining here at least twice a year the last 4-5 yrs. Enjoyed the quality of the steak and of course the service. However the last 2 visits have been disappointing. On one visit 6 months back the scallops served for a starter was not fresh and tasteless and on pointing out we were not billed for it. On our last visit this July 2013, one tenderloin was extremely salty and the meat for all the 6 of us dining were 'rough and tough' in quality(not what we used to enjoy)The lobster bisque was tasteless and dilute (in comparison to the one I had at 1885 in E and O in May 2013).Show less

Author: victoriabainPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Indeed a wonderful experience!
Review: I went there recently with two of my friends. Overall, the service they provide was fantastic. the staff were all very nice and pleasant. Major thank you to the assistant outlet manager there MR Izdwan and Chef Mathies for providing us such an interesting and wonderful experience, it was by far the best restaurant I've ever been. The food was good too, worth every penny! I would certainly recommend this to my family and friends to dine in there, and would most definitely dine in there next time. :)Show less

Author: azriazizKuala Lumpur, Wilayah Persekutuan, Malaysia
Title: Best Steakhouse in Malaysia
Review: The place is amazing. Ambiance is great for a romantic dinner for two. Best to keep the kids in the room if you're going for dinner to avoid disturbing other patrons. Order this: Tomato Soup, Rib Eye, Ceasars Salad, Baked/Raw Oysters. Crepe Suzzette. Best Menu Ever! Show less

Author: HquivooyZaltbommel, The Netherlands
Title: Very Good, but also very pricy
Review: A restaurant like this could also be having 1 michelin star in Europe, its good, very good. It will not blow you away. but when you go, you must have their tomato soup for starters. it is their signature dish, and they will prepare it at your table. do try that. They also have a signature dessert dish, their Crepe Suzette, which will also be prepared at your table. That one is to die for.It comes at a price, but their service is impeccable, the room itself could be a little bit up-to-date. But if you have some cash to burn, do visit them, it will not disappointShow less

Author: S_Hu6161Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Expected Better for the price !
Review: Was there last month for my birthday dinner. Food wise, just average. Nothing to comment on the starters but for the main course, we ordered the beef steaks (medium rare) and both were over-cooked (medium/well-done). Did complained to the manager and he apologised. In returned, he offered us free tea/coffee, but "who on earth would like caffeinated beverage at night/dinner" and comparing to the price of the overcooked steaks that we are paying!Don't think we would patronage this place again soon.Show less

Author: Frank-n-Paula
Title: fantastic .........
Review: Deserves the acclaim, exceptional food with impeccable service...amongst the very top ..... anywhere, if you want the best this is equal with its sister restaurant in the hotel... a must if you want something special

Author: bedfordspursBedford, UK
Title: Stunning Food
Review: I'd be amazed if there is a better restaurant on the Island. We stayed at the hotel so that made bookings easy. The service and food were top notch and as good as any we ate in the whole of Malaysia and on par with the food served at the State Tower in Bangkok Show less

Author: PennyPenangDarwin, Australia
Title: A bit expensive
Review: Great place to go if you want first class service, but a bit over the top in the price of wine. The food is excellent however and the service very good. Although the night we went there was a large party going on in another room and the waiters were a bit preoccupied. Show less

Author: alejourPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Outstanding Food
Review: Outstanding food and service. Even at the Rasa prices, this still represents value. One person in our party is a vegetarian, and the chef went out of his way to create special dishes to suit. He was then happy to share the receipes when the meal was over. Fantastic dining.Show less

Author: georgieh598Townsville, Australia
Title: Food fantastic great service !
Review: Food overall was fantastic . We both ordered steaks and they were both we found a little tuff . Both were cooked perfectly and very tasty . We shared 3 entree and they were all very well done and presented. My only annoyance was they have gluten free on their menu options witch is great cause I need to eat gluten free..... but no dessert option witch was very very disappointing :( but like I said overall it was a fantastic evening , cant fault the service it was spot on I actually felt cared for all evening . My other half didn't pack long pants for or trip over here so they were kind enough to let us borrow some from the restaurant. I highly recommend this restaurant .Show less

Author: pickypinkyBristol, United Kingdom
Title: The most disappointing lobster bisque
