Review: We read rave reviews of this restaurant and its special menus from its past on Sundays, so decided to give it a try. It turned out the special menus aren't so special as many dishes also appear on its normal al a carte menu. I often can't resist lobster bisque if it is on the menu. I have to say this is the most disappointing one that I've ever had. I certainly didn't expect it to be that bad from a 5-star hotel. It is simply too watery. It has no texture and taste like dish washing water. My rib eye steak and the lamb chop my husband had are just average.Show less

Author: sd_doubledSan Diego, California
Title: Good food, used to be better
Review: They must have changed the menu and chef, because you used to be able to get aged Australian Beef that melted in your mouth. The last time I was here, the steaks were only OK and quite disappointing for the price. The seafood was outstanding, as is the setting, the service, and the atmosphere. This is THE place in Penang for fine luxurious dining. Sadly it is not the place for steaks anymore. Also, from experience, do not order a Mojito from the bar. Not only did the bartender not know how to mix a mojito, but when I sent it back, they still charged me for it!Show less

Author: sinetStavanger, Norway
Title: Fantastic menu and Great service!
Review: The Feringgi Grill exudes retro style in its set up which gives it great character. The lobster bisquewas delicious and there was great variety on the menu. My husband had the entricote which they prepared , garnished and served in front of us- he thoroughly enjoyed it. We couldnt leave without trying the flambayed orange pancakes which were also made in front of us and were devine.The service was great and the mood was romantic- perfect for a great date night !Show less

Author: Gareth ODublin, Ireland
Title: Expensive, but only quite good...
Review: We felt that this restaurant was trying to be something more than it was. Theatrical flambees at tables, soup made/poured at table, meat cut at table etc. But you have to have the best food in the world in order to make it work. The food was average I would say. And for the price we paid, I would say very average at that cost. Soup (poured by the waiter) was tepid. Steak was nice. Wifes salmon was excellent. Desserts very good.But the service was excellent as it was everywhere in the hotel. I probably wouldn't rush back to the restaurant as I think the whole experience was a little 'forced' and a little pricey for what it was, but it is clearly extremely popular with the guests and has a regular clientele. But next time I am back, I will give it another chance I think.....Show less

Author: pinacoladobabe
Title: Ferringgi Grill
Review: I can always rely to eat well in the Ferrnggi Grill especially the seafood - one of my many favourite eating places in Batu Feringgi

Author: Tazel
Title: Wonderful Meal
Review: We dined here on our last night staying at the hotel.  The meal was beautifully cooked and presented and the service was outstanding. Would definitely recommend.

Author: LesleyParrLeek, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent
Review: We dined here on New Years Eve, and it was so good that during our 10 night trip we ate here 3 times.It's a beautiful setting that has both an indoor restaurant and outdoor terrace. Despite being on the main road, it's set back and is all very peaceful with lots of plants, orchids, running water and koi carp swimming around. We never had a bad meal, the menu is extensive with a choice of Thai and Malaysian cuisine. It's not the cheapest place to eat (in comparison to other places in the town) but the ambience, service and quality of food ensure that you feel it is definite value for money!If you are in Batu Ferringhi, then this is a place you must try - you won't be disappointed.Show less

Author: PaperStoneScissors
Title: Excellent food
Review: Been to a couple of dinners here and the food is just excellent.  Used to be a great fan of the 1885 at the E&O but this place is much better.

Author: englishwifeyBerkshire, United Kingdom
Title: Birthday Dinner - Fabulous!
Review: Just visited this week for my birthday - we found a new wine on the menu that we have to find again when we get home! The food was really, really good - I had the lamb, Lee had Steak and both were cooked perfectly. The tuna starter was really good, we got the salad leaves with grains as a freebee course (surprisingly tasty!!) and as it was my birthday, a small cake came along at the end of the dinner, never have I tasted a chocolate mousee like it! Excellent service too - absolutely recommend for a romantic / special dinner.Show less

Author: david190725Ipswich, United Kingdom
Title: A Special Occasion
Review: After several days of eating inexpensively in the resort with two grandchildren we treated ourselves to dinner here on our last night.It was a different world,with standards of food and service up to high international standards.The menu was good and varied.I enjoyed scallops and excellent steak,my wife had souffle and duck-all enjoyable.But it isn't cheap:with the lowest priced bottle of red wine (MYR175) the bill came to MYR598(around £130).So,for us,a meal here is very much an occasional and special event.Show less

Author: massymas
Title: Disappointing Christmas Dinner
Review: Thought we were in for something special on Christmas Day, as the reviews had been good - all (family of four, two teenagers) of us disappointed. Food was definately not a feast - small portions, vegetables virtually non-existant and no amazing tastes - Chef tried too hard to create artistic plate/s instead of a well cooked, tasty Christmas menu. Atmosphere was lacking.Decor was a little drab and could do with face lift.Definately not up to a five star rating, although we didn't try it when there wasn't the set Festive Menu. We had booked the restaurant again for New Year's Eve, but after our Christmas experience we cancelledShow less

Author: FieldmoleBattle, United Kingdom
Title: Seafood on the seashore
Review: Truly excellent seafood, served overlooking the beach and the Straits of Melaka at sunset under palm trees...... Like so many of the best restaurants in Batu Ferringhi the restaurant itself won't win prizes for decor, but the food is excellent, location likewise, and the price very reasonable, between the 'hawker stalls' and the tourist restaurants. Show less

Author: dordognemarkBeaumont-du-Perigord, France
Title: Gets better and better!
Review: We stay at the Rasa Sayang every festive period, and the Feringgi Grill never fails to please. The service is exceptional and attentive, without being intrusive. The team here are well trained, polite and knowledgeable. The food is amazing, we have tried many dishes here, but my favourite is still the chateaubriand, cooked to your liking and carved table side to add the extra flair. Wines seem to have come down in price, but offer a wide range to suit every taste and pocket.We are due to eat here twice more during our stay, and we have avoided the special set festive menus as I feel these are a little pricey. There is a new exec chef and we look forward to his new menus in the new year.Highly recommend this restaurant.Show less

Author: FreekBHong Kong, China
Title: Good service and ambiance but food disappointing.
Review: The set Festive Menu at 185 RM ++ was not up to expectations. Fish overcooked and not crispy as announced, duck was tasteless. Our daughter was better served with a-la-carte souffle and spatchcock which was juicy and tasteful. The service was very good and friendly. The restaurant could do with a little update and we thought it had not changed since our last visit in 1991, but Penang overall is "past glory" and Shangri La is one of the few properties with class and it is well maintained.Compliments to the live music, piano and singer who was superb.Show less

Author: Susangermany
Title: Just perfect!
Review:
The service outstanding, the steak perfect. What else?, a wonderful place
to have a wonderful evening! Thank you Feringgi Grill!

Author: motherofluzza
Title: Fantastic
Review: Great Food, Great Staff loved it we ate here at least 4 times and we had no issues would with out a doubt go again

Author: jm7409
Title: Quality Local Cuisine
Review: Large establishment with a very varied menu.  Tables both inside and outside, but all with a/c.  Very reasonable prices and good quality.

Author: MauraLondonU_KLondon U.K
Title: Fabulous!
Review: We had dinner here to celebrate our silver wedding anniversary and weren't disappointed . The staff scattered rose petals on our table and presented us with an iced cake at the end of our meal! It was such a lovely touch and made us feel very special. We chose the tasting menu that evening and because there were a couple of things on it that i didnt like, the waiter helpfully arranged for them to be substituted for something else. The food was sublime, cooked to perfection we couldn't fault it and the service was impeccable. It was one of our more expensive meals on this holiday but we expected that & it was worth every penny.Show less

Author: Melissa_Cornelius
Title: the best restaurant atmosphere in penang
Review: i love this place.the best grilled salmon in the whole of Penang can be found here.the garden setting is so beautiful i never want to leave once i get there.

Author: SjpbingleyDubai, United Arab Emirates
Title: Definitely worth a visit
Review: 6 of us ate here on the last night of our stay in the town. 1 of the group was vegetarian and like most other places didn't feel well catered for. What we did all order though was excellent. Beautifully presented and well cooked by well trained and attentive staff. My main course was served cold and needed to be returned. It was handled quickly and pleasantly but it still affected our overall experience and I expected better. The wine list was extensive and well priced. There was live music which wasn't appreciated by many but all diners appeared happy.Show less

Author: kesharooPJ
Title: Good food with wonderful service!
Review: We celebrated our wedding anniversary here at the Grill and had the most wonderful night out. We had wanted a low key evening with a nice dinner and good wine and the Feringgi Grill delivered. The staff was again very, very good right from Farouk and Catherine, to the barman, Mr. Lee and our waiter for the evening Mohd. Safari. They made the evening memorable with their warmth and genuine pleasure in taking care of us. The food was very good especially the Caeser's Salad which was made on the spot and a signature dish. I am happy to report that it simply was divine. The prices were fair considering the quality of food and we would definitely be back.Show less

Author: Sue625
Title: No spot in resort - but a little pricey
Review: Tomato soup made and prepared at table - very impressive. Definately THE restaurant for superb service. Worth a visit for the treat!

Author: Fazrein_Meah1303
Title: Romantic ambience, immaculate service
Review: Very romantic setting, a definite choice for Anniversary Dinners. Staff are very polished and helpful. Please make reservations as they rarely have room for walk in diners

Author: barbaraf1962Barrow-in-Furness, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent service & food
Review: We went here three times during our stay at Rasa Sayang, all visits were superb.On the first occasion hubby had a fillet steak, which was just amazing and twice size would have got in UK. I had lamb which was fantastic. We also had the chateaubriand and Australian rib of beef (only served on Friday and Saturdays), both were just as excellent.The service and food quality is well worth the money paid. Especially worth a try if you like it is the tomato soup as this is cooked fresh and flambé'd at the table.Well worth a visit even if not staying at the Rasa.Show less

Author: David EFremantle
Title: Dinner at the Ferringgi Grill
Review: We had dinner here last night and it was absolutely lovely!! It is a massive restaurant and the place itself is very tastefully decorated and is deceptively large. The menu was a mix of Malay, Chinese, Thai and Western cuisine. I had the Yellow Curry and Crab Cakes and both were great. Prices were also very reasonable we thought. The staff were very nice and we even had a guided tour at the end of our meal from one of the staff. Well worth a visit if you are in Batu Feringgi Beach.Show less

Author: FloraWoodMelbourne, Australia
Title: Lovely experience
Review: Agree with previous reviewers. One of the priciest restaurants in Batu Feringgi but justified by the excellent service and delicious food. Loved the bread and complimentary amuse bouche and palate cleanser. My husband and I dined here and enjoyed three courses which included the chateaubriand which was delicious. After dessert our waiter brought out a slab of chocolate mousse cake for us but we were too full to eat it so he offered to pack it up for us to take away. We are so glad he did because we ate it the next day and it was sensational, we would return for this cake alone (although I did not notice it on the menu).The service was great and our waiter was charming, friendly and professional. All round a lovely evening out that I recommend and look forward to repeating next time I am in Penang.Show less

Author: LindseyErinMelbourne, Australia
Title: Its the extras that make it worth it
Review: I recently ate here with a friend during our stay in Penang. The service was outstanding. The staff were so lovely. The food was pretty good also, the bread was amazing, and it was nice to have the complimentary starter. I had the duck for mains, which was ok (a bit overcooked and dry) and my friend had the salmon which looked nice. Both sides we got were also lovely.The chef offered us complementary crepes given that the duck was a bit disappointing, which was a nice touch. I would definitely each here again.Show less

Author: Birkatron
Title: Lovely
Review: We ate here for my OH birthday and it was awesome, we had the Chateaubriand and it was the best ever!

Author: Sue56_12
Title: 60th Birthday
Review: Wonderful food and service, certainly pricier than the other restaurants but in Aus $ a lot cheaper than the same back home!

Author: Tauqir A
Title: Superb Food
Review: This is a must visit for every traveler going to penang. Great service and damn good food.

Author: Frances M
Title: Gastronomic Delight
Review: Lovely ambience, friendly service, excellenty-cooked food and, with only a little warning, they will prepare something not on the menu.

Author: tomboy11Co Durham
Title: Expensive but good quality
Review: This is a treat that is worth a visit. The service is wonderful with great attention to detail and your needs are constantly anticipated; that said the service is not overly intrusive. The prices are equivalent to what you would pay in the UK but the alcohol can be expensive. It is a nice experience and you will be treated like royalty. Show less

Author: ziggy10Queensland, Australia
Title: Outstanding
Review: This was the second time that we have dinned at this restaurant and it just gets better. The staff are so attentive and thoughtful. The food is fantastic, cooked and presented beautifuly. Table sevice was impressive and I would have to say it is the small things that the staff do that make for a memorable evening.We would recomend this to you highly.Show less

Author: thefareast
Title: Classic. Top Shelf.
Review: For service in Malaysia this stands out hands and shoulders above the local competition. How about getting all 12 meals served at the same time !! Very attentive service. Good wine selection. For a formal dinner with speeches try the private dining room.

Author: CanberraSully
Title: Beautiful food and service
Review:
Loved it all. The service was impeccable and the food incredible.
The tomato soup is definately one to order!!

Author: TravellerPete1475
Title: top notch for breakfast
Review: Staying in the Rasa wing, guests get the option of having brekky here. It's quiet and very civilized, and the coffee's good. Breakfast a la carte is delicious, and service top class. Didn't have dinner here though.

Author: TJD744Cranleigh, United Kingdom
Title: Great service if you want Australian steak
Review: Much lauded and a smart venue. Wines are expensive, service impeccable, but don't accept a table near the kitchen. Doesn't do much other than smart western food. We can have that anywhere so were disappointed and went out local the next night instead. The regulars all love it though so that says something.Show less

Author: maziemoomoomelbourne
Title: The Feringgi Grill
Review: Beautiful, but expensive, exclusive and great for a special occasion. We went back twice as the food was wonderful and service 5 star. Had the steak which is carved in front of you and shared between two. Make sure men wear long pants or else you might get knocked back or be made to wear a pair of their pants - this happened to my husband who wore shorts first time we went (we were on holidays!!!) SO nest time he went in long pants and no probs. A must visit at least once but be prepared to pay for it.Show less

Author: mojay_9penang
Title: Great valentines dinner
Review: My wife and I decided to splash out at Penang MOST expensive restaurant for Valentines Day,and we were most impressed.they have set price for dinner at Rm300 ($100) per head.it was a 7 course dinner that left us speechless.their service was remarkable and quality of the food was the best I have ever had in malaysia.a real treat and my new favorite restaurant.Show less

Author: Dave MWest Sussex, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent food with top class service
Review: My wife and spent last weekend at the Rasa Sayang resort and ate at the Ferringi grill on Saturday and Sunday. The ambiance is quiet elegance and the service is attentive and very friendly - you feel nothing is too much trouble for them. The real win is the food. We had the chateaubriand on Saturday and the meat was sensational - perfectly cooked, tender and melted in the mouth. Prior to that my wife had the tomato soup which is prepared table side. My prawn croquettes were OK but not a good choice on my part. Preparing food table side is something they do a lot, Caesar salad, prime rib, tomato soup and chateubriand are all a table side experience.Sunday evening we went for fish and both of us went for the black cod which again was faultless, moist and tasty. Trio of soups was also an interesting starter this time.Wines were reasonable and a good choice - the sommellier even suggested we change our original selection and suggested a less expensive wine that he felt was better and he was right. Overall we had two excellent evenings that sit as highlights of a short but excellent weekend here. It was better than most restaurants we go to in HK and we will be back.Show less

Author: Charissa P
Title: Awesome dining experience!
Review:
The 5Star fine dining restaurant is truly a 5 Star. Great ambiance with a sense of cozy feeling. Wide choices for food and drinks. 
The grilled cod fish, is truly mouth-watering.  To those fish lover, this is a must to try.!

Author: nellielim
Title: Fantastic buffet
Review: The fantastic and delicious array of buffet table. The friendly staff and good service. Nothing much to dislike.

Author: TAN W
Title: The best fine dining
Review: The best fine dining that I have visit. Food. Will come again .

Author: Jason CPenang
Title: Fantastic service, ambience and food
Review: Amazing service by their asst. outlet mgr, Mohd. Farouk and his team, They made us feel so welcome and pampered us with great food and impeccable 5-star service.The highlight of the dinner for me was definitely their service - top notch personalized attention. It so happened the table I was at was under an air conditioning vent that leaked water... halfway through dinner, a thunderstorm started outside, and water somehow leaked above the ceiling, and onto my head.The waiters saw the water dripping all over me, and were very apologetic. To make up for the inconvenience, dessert was on the house, and they even offered me a 20% discount on my meal. How wonderful!Kudos to chef David for the wonderful and yummy tomato soup and cesar salad - certainly deserving of a 5-star "signature dish". The only downside for me was the beef tenderloin steak was not so tender - I had it well done, and found it somewhat dry inside. I had to ask for repeated servings of mushroom sauce to wash it down, which the kitchen gladly provided.It's an expensive dinner location for locals, but we'll be back!Show less

Author: mangopudding10Australia
Title: good stuff
Review: We arrived at Feringgi Grill and were immediately shown to our pre-booked table, we ordered and waited a relatively long time to get our mains, but some tapas and bread were provided so it wasn't too bad. When the dishes eventually arrived, we tucked in, I had ordered the salmon, which was very good and was well complemented. My sister ordered the blackened cod which was also very good and came with a sidedish - she ordered the cauliflower gratin and it was very tasty. My other sister ordered the queen's cut and that also came with a side dish - she ordered the polenta. bad move. it was incredibly hard and so VERY salty. The meal ended with chocolates and a cake as it was my sister's birthday, both were equally tasty. I have a couple of complaints, the restaurant gets smoked out with cigarette fumes from the bar; still water costs a bomb from the bottle!; the live band's singer at the time was really quite bad and the dress code is stressed as 'smart casual', yet they allow people in jeans and trainers to come in...showcasing some double standards, as i'm sure if i had come in jeans and converse i wouldn't have been allowed in... i worry for penang. just four complaints for the evening. the waiter for our table was very friendly.Show less

Author: EnqvistlimPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Fantastic Meal
Review: went to Ferringgi Grill to celebrate my birthday and it a great memory.Scallop which is nicely cook, texture is very different from others as well. Normally I had scallop which taste almost like fish paste but this give a fine texture and sweetness, together with the sauce is very delicious.Five Spice Quail RM32, a great use of spice to create a simple look but complicated flavor, great use of various spices to lift the freshness and authentic flavor of quail serve together with mushroom and fungi. Australian Beef Ribeye 300g Grill Steak RM120, the manner of preparing the steaks for the grill make the difference in quality when they come off the grill. I put my trust to the chef by asking him prepare the best he could doesn’t matter what the cook level, he decided to go for medium rare and he prove to me his skill by how a medium rare steak can be so different from what I ate over the past 20+ years. The grill steak served with a sauce but do you still need a sauce when the original flavor is already the best? Normally a medium rare steak will has some bloody meat in middle but what I had here is pinky and outer part is just perfectly cook, steak is extremely tender and light bite can tear the meat out.My entrée serve with Cauliflower Baked Cheese, it is simple but rich in flavor. Cauliflower is crunchy while the cheese flavor is not too strong to overlap the freshness of cauliflower.Lamb Loin, loin include the ribs between forequarter and hindquarter which always consider as the best part and the most tender. Lamb loin is well cook with rich flavor of puree at bottom and various nuts on top.it a great place for dining, visit our blog review for more detail http://tasteiest.blogspot.com/2011/10/feringhi-grill-at-shangri-la.htmlShow less

Author: idlelayabout
Title: Very very good.
Review:
This was the perfect way to end our holiday. The meal and service were really excellent.
We would both recommend visiting this restaurant, you will not regret it.

Author: DolB
Title: Excellent
Review: Excellent food and servcie if prepared to pay- comparable to 5* hotels and western prices.

Author: NikkiChiltonBrisbane
Title: Great food and service
Review: We went to Feringgi Grill on our second wedding anniversary in January. We had an amazing three course meal - and were offered appetizers in between courses. The service was wonderful. At the end of the evening, we mentioned that it was our last night in Penang and also our anniversary and our waiter made a cake especially for us. We had eaten dessert and were so full, could not eat the cake, so he had it sent to our room especially for us. He also gave us a glass of champagne each to celebrate our anniversary. The menu offered a range of more Western delights - including great steaks, cooked to perfection. We did not notice any 'traditional' food on the menu, so I would only recommend if you are looking for a more Westernised meal. All in all a great night for us!Show less

Author: MinirenniZurich, Switzerland
Title: Excellent Restaurant
Review: Ferringhi GrillIt would be good to have a reservation. The food selection is excellent. It's quiet place with excellent food and very good service. While you wait you get a nice little treat. Basket of bread.The meat was tender and grilled to perfection. The presentation of the plate very nice. The side dishes could be a bit of a bigger portion so.Show less

Author: Richard_evs
Title: Ferringhi Grill - Amazing
Review: We went to the Ferringhi Grill twice during our stay and I would highly recommend. The food was second to none and although not particularly Malaysian (!), I would recommend the steaks!!

Author: Drivers22Poole, United Kingdom
Title: Consistently, very good food.
Review: This restaurant serves chines food to a very high standard. The service is efficient, friendly and professional. The food is exceptional and every thing I have ever eaten here has surpassed my expectations. Mai and her staff and very welcoming and good communicators so you always know where you are regarding timings etc. I would recommend this restaurant to anyone visiting Batu Ferringhi. They will even cook fish and chips if you are not in to Chinese. Brilliant!Show less

Author: Mike T
Title: Very nice little place . Really welcoming and friendly.
Review:
Had a couple of dinners here during recent holiday.
The place is quite small and busy but the service is great and very friendly.
Food is good and not expensive.

Author: neilsI6468JS
Title: A joyful food experience in Penang
Review: We eat at this restaurant as often as possible. Much variety with their menu and very reasonable prices. Don't let the basic external appearance fool you. Friendly service and they can accommodate your palate easily.

Author: 990karenaDubai, United Arab Emirates
Title: Tucked away hidden gem, mouth watering experience
Review: Boatman – Penang 2019/2020This is a friendly family run restaurant that caters for all taste buds. The food is freshly made and delicious. My husband really enjoyed the sweet and sour prawns which he had frequently, always plenty of prawns and very tasty. I loved the sizzlers, beef and chicken and so much more from the vast menu. It is advisable to reserve as it can get very busy as it is so popular. We stay in Penang for 2 months every year and eat here the most as its extremely good value and quality. If you have not eaten here it is to be recommended to try as you won’t regret it. See you upon our return at the end of the year Karen and Eric xxShow less

Author: harvey3705
Title: Got told to go
Review: Met a couple who had been here in the past and went back most nights. On outrlast night found it and got a table. Food good, service good, cheap but same as others in that location. No problems on our visit.

Author: AnnechadLeeds, United Kingdom
Title: Nice "no frills" Restaurant
Review: Rather hidden away, but had a menu up on the roadside so you know when you are there! Quite near the large Mosque, on the main road through Batu Ferringhi. We were told the Boatman used to be a garage so it is not very large for a restaurant, but does have outside seating on the little lane leading up to the main part. Not sure if it is family run, but the cooking is all done to order so is lovely and hot, and the service is great - our waitress knew what everything was and helped us choose from the largish menu. There was also a large choice of drinks both alcoholic and non-alcoholic, fruit juice, milk based drinks etc. We had Satay, Stirfried Pork and Sizzling Prawns with rice we both enjoyed our meals and would go again when in Penang. Show less

Author: Brian_Chris
Title: A visit is a must
Review:
Excellent food & very varied menu. Family run & friendly. There is both inside and outside seating and booking is preferable.
You would not be disappointed

Author: markbH651BF
Title: Delicious food and good service.
Review: Delicious food and good service. Especially for fish and seafood a good choice if you stay around Batu Feringgi

Author: Smith01England
Title: Friendly
Review: Family run buisness. Friendly, nice atmosphere,  good choice of menu, good portions at reasonable prices. Sit in or sit out. Would recommend.

Author: jackw53London, United Kingdom
Title: Much Better Than the last time
Review: Having visited this restaurant some years ago and had a very poor experience we have avoided returning. However having read the reviews on TA which are consistently good we thought it only fair to try again. This time we were much better served both with the food and the service. The place is fairly basic in the layout but does have some interesting "displays" and has an obvious relationship with those who have served in the RAF/RAAF back in the "old days". It also has a well stocked library of books to borrow. Now to the food - a reasonable choice of menu both local and western - I went for the sizzling fish with ginger preceded by Spring rolls. Both were okay - not outstanding but okay and definitely much much better than our last visit.Show less

Author: Walesvisit0r
Title: Lovely family restaurant
Review: Simple unsmart restaurant run by very friendly  ladies. Good food freshly cooked. Prices slightly high for Malaysia but low for a tourist centre so fair enough. We ate there several times and really enjoyed it.

Author: MattD723
Title: Superb food
Review:
Don’t be out of by the decor and seating - top quality food and service lovely people.
Cheapest and best food I’ve had so far.  Superb I had the Penang curry highly recommend.

Author: DrofpotsLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent restaurant
Review: This is a superb restaurant, yes the decor is not high class, but cruelly did to the charm. The food and service is brilliant. Now there is. Sign on the main road it is easier to find. It is great value for money. I would highly recommend this placeShow less

Author: Shane O
Title: Fresh and tasty food
Review: Although not particularly enticing from the street view, this restaurant is well worth the walk down the concrete driveway. We had the sweet and sour chicken and the fish and black bean sauce with extra vegetables and rice. Fresh and tasty and reasonably priced. Nice atmosphere and friendly staff.Show less

Author: Rachael W
Title: Favourite restaurant!
Review: We chose to eat our breakfast here everyday. Much nicer than the hotel- lovely clean restaurant. Dinner menu is good too. Changes to the menu not a problem. Definitely fresh!

Author: 819ulfn
Title: Food 👍 ambience 👎
Review: Certainly it may be a good spot for Rendang, Kuah Teow - much less for (defrosted!) Chicken or Spaghetti ...this is probably to be considered a cheap eatery on Ferringhi beach and that’s all you get, any hawker centre would do.Went there based on Tripadvisor reviews. Not impressed we won’t think of it again.Next to a never ending prayer house you can barely hear your mates... Not clean or cosy or nicely decorated- eat if you need and go... elsewhere!Show less

Author: ravinderb3121
Title: excellent boatman restaurent
Review: very good value; good food; excellent service; cheap but best food we had in Batu Ferringhi; it is small and appears quiet but really really good Asian food

Author: peterppatrickLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Wonderful experience
Review: This is a lovely family owned an run restaurant.The food is outstanding and the portions were a generous size.The lady who owns the restaurant with her family also served us and was very knowledgeable about the dishes and also made the curry less spicy for our young son.All in all you will not be disappointed and should try it. Show less

Author: JoshBrownn1504
Title: Fantastic
Review: The Boatman was our favourite restaurant in Batu Ferringhi. The staff are so friendly and the food is fantastic. And it’s so cheap! Make sure you eat here.

Author: uptheladderAdelaide, Australia
Title: A wonderful find
Review: We only popped in for a fruit salad and pancake and ice cream lunch. What a charming and welcoming hostess. The food was freshly prepared and nicely presented. The whole ambience was relaxed and we were glad to find The Boatman and wished we were closer to return for dinner. The restaurant and toilets were spotlessly clean. We thoroughly recommend this place.Show less

Author: dumpling_18Sydney
Title: So Yummy
Review: We regularly holiday in Batu Ferringhi and always dine at the Boatman Restaurant.The restaurant is set off the main road and is easily missed. Walk along the concrete driveway to a no-frills dining room where delicious and authentic nyonya and Chinese food is served.We cannot go past their Curry Kapitan Chicken and Beef Rendang. Also the fried Ma-Mee noodles are delicious. If you like tofu their Japanese braised tofu is really good. Everything is yummy.Servings are on the smallish side, so order extra.The staff are friendly and efficient and helpful, and it their toilets are super clean; probably the cleanest in Penang.EnjoyShow less

Author: 137craigeLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Hidden gen
Review: Had we not read the reviews, we’d have walked past this restaurant, set slightly off of the road and one that does not look like anything special. The service, however, was fantastic and the food even better. We had the beef rendang and chicken curry - absolutely superb. Show less

Author: Rinni1974
Title: Recommended!
Review: Enjoyed a relaxed dinner here with a large group of friends. Service was welcoming and friendly. Food was fresh and tasty. Prices very reasonable. The local crispy chicken was absolutely delicious. Would definitely return.

Author: adandang
Title: Best place for a full English
Review: If your looking for a good place for breakfast in Batu Feringgi then you won’t go wrong by choosing the Boatman. It’s clean and good value for money. Great service and great coffee.

Author: GrahamEdwards
Title: Great service and food
Review:
Went with my Wife and mother-in-law. We had a grilled snapper with sambal sauce - cooked perfectly and delicious. 
The owners were very attentive and helpful unlike many other restaurants in the vicinity.
Highly recommend The Boatman!

Author: manhdatn2017
Title: Delicious
Review: We stay in the resort just beside. Very good food. Service quick and very honest price. We’ll get back for sure. Thank you.

Author: Alan-HoldenPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: English Breakfast
Review: Had friends visiting from England. Decided to go for a full English breakfast as the hotel only offered chicken sausage and beef bacon.Needless to say we were not disappointed. A good fry up in a tropical country is not to be sneezed at.(and yes, I love the local food) Show less

Author: eileen24
Title: Popular restaurant great food
Review: Lovely food lovely staff lovely restaurant... It was a joy to eat here and the beers are super cold.....Reccomend this restaurant to anyone in the area.

Author: 746robinpLand O Lakes, Florida
Title: Good local
Review: We had a very nice lunch with a colleague of my husbands. She suggested this is a very good restaurant. We split a couple of dishes. We had a beef a seafood and a couple different types of rice. Everything was very tasty with a bit of spice but not too spicy. Service was good.Show less

Title: Excellent restaurant
Review: We have eaten here a few times and can honestly say the food is so delicious the best egg fried rice I have ever tasted and the people are so helpful. I strongly recommend.

Author: JackNIan
Title: Well worth a visit
Review: Tucked away just off the main this small restaurant is well worth a visit. An excellent meal served with an enthusiastic smile, a really positive experience, many thanks

Author: soniamajumder
Title: Seafood Lunch
Review: Excellent seafood and veggies! Enjoyed the meal! Good value. Waiter or owner wasn’t friendly or didn’t engage at all

Author: Dianne T
Title: Quality cheap eats
Review: Great little restaurant, tucked away with indoor and alfresco dinning, no ac but lots of fans, friendly service and great food, try this hidden gem.m

Author: Mattjack8
Title: Great local food
Review: Rich and spicy local food with great friendly staff. Sambal prawns was a fave as well as the chicken curry well worth seeking out .... looked after me and extended family welll :)

Author: B0b1314Adelaide, Australia
Title: Lovely food great service
Review: My husband and I visited on a Wednesday evening and had a nice meal here. The menu is very large with a selection of western and Asian cuisine. We paid 90 ringgits for 2 x waters, 2 x tiger beers, sweet & sour pork (yummy), beef rendang (delicious), fried mixed veg and fried rice.The service was very good they were lovely and very attentive. Well worth a visit.Show less

Author: JohnAberdare
Title: Nice food
Review: We ate here one night for a change from Long Beach, food was good and tasty. Service was friendly and good

Author: SandiC930
Title: Great food
Review: The food here is fantastic and well priced. The staff are great and service is pretty quick. There are fans inside so it's quite pleasant to sit.

Author: 851charlottew
Title: Amazing Dinner
Review: My husband and I took our today‘s dinner at Boatman Restaurant and we were happy that we had chosen this location. The food was amazing. fish filet curry, sizzling noodles, sizzling chicken and fried rice. We loved all of the dishes. The crêpe with lemon ice was so tasty as well and even the freshly brewed coffee was delicious.White wine very good as well. All together 116 MR. Perfect. We will return for sure.Show less

Author: MrParry18Perth, Australia
Title: Great service and value
Review: Came here for dinner one night as we liked what was on the menu.Small place a little bit back from the main road.The service we received was excellent and the food was very cheap but of excellent quality, you wait a little for food but that’s because everything is made fresh to order so that it’s of great quality. Went for dinner twice here and left both times very happy and very full. Well worth going for a meal.Show less

Author: Georgie2007
Title: Great food and service
Review: On the main road just north of Penang ParkRoyal.  Everything we had tasted delicious and the service was great.  Wish we had more time in Batu Ferringhi so we could have gone back again.

Author: E7174
Title: Home cooked, very good
Review:
Great restaurant (Chinese/Malay dishes).  Sensible prices, friendly staff.
Pork menu for those that fancy it.  Peking pork was excellent.
Highly recommended.  
Slightly set back from the road.

Author: Rich FBatu Ferringhi, Malaysia
Title: Breakfast and dinner spot
Review: Espcially on Friday, when my favorite Malaysian places are closed, this home-cooked style restaurant has a nice breakfast menu starting from 9:30 am, and serves dinner after 6 pm. Supper for me is a bodacious specially-ordered salad and chicken in various styles. Ms. May is very helpful and attentive. Closed on Mondays.Show less

Author: howard r
Title: home style cooking at it's best
Review: this place is great. Unpretentious family home style cooking. Local dishes are a specialty. Absolutely delicious

Author: sunnyc658
Title: Relatively "Cheap & Cheerful"
Review:
Good: Conveniently located only a short walk from where we stayed. Extensive menu offered for local and western food. Fried chicken was tasty, mee goreng was good. Friendly staff. Prices were good.
Poor: Friend spring roll was rather oily, small portion and rather pricey.

Author: lilianwong60
Title: Batu Ferringhi good eats
Review: Good mix of western and asian food, homey atmosphere. Very good pineapple fried rice. Recommended for simple no fuss meals.

Author: TaniaWee_13
Title: Friendly service, yummy food
Review: This was an unexpected find. Good comfort food of either asian or western. The service is very good, attentive and friendly! Pricing is reasonable for Batu ferringhi.

Author: jpf862
Title: Good restaurant
Review:
Good: Fried chicken, Nasi Oriental, Beef in black pepper sauce, Sea food mixed vegetables, sweet and sour prawns. Friendly staff.

Average: the fruit juices and the decor can also be improved.

Author: StefanF545
Title: Highly Recommended
Review: Have been here a few times and enjoyed the great food and the very nice staff. The prices are quiet low. It was for me the best restaurant in the area.

Author: KevinLee6456
Title: Nice food and friendly staff
Review:
The staff here are friendly and the food is fresh and nice. Very relaxing sitting here and having my dinner. Will come again.

Thanks for giving me and my friend a good night.

Author: Loshini K
Title: Wow!
Review: The food is delicious. I ordered seafood and well cooked with reasonable price. The place also very relaxing. I would highly recommend this place for seafood.

Author: bucketlisttravellersSydney, Australia
Title: Good meals with good conversation
Review: This is one of the few restaurants around Batu Ferringhi which is open for breakfast. We came here late in the morning and could choose from the breakfast menu or the lunch menu. They have western as well as Malaysian dishes available. We had the char kway teow and the Mee Goreng as well as the mixed juice. The meals were 9 ringgit each and the juice 6 ringgit. Everything was very tasty and the owner was a very friendly lady who grew up in George Town and moved to Batu Ferringhi after she got married. We had a nice chat to her while waiting for our meal and it was interesting to hear how the area has changed over the years from a small fishing village to a tourist town.Show less

Author: Travelfan1505Rockingham, Australia
Title: Looks can be deceiving
Review: The Boatman is a family favourite that we keep coming back to, just don’t judge this restaurant by its street appeal. Local favourites like chicken satay and Char Kway Teow are fantastic and even the ‘Western’ selections like steaks with chips and veggies are delicious. Service is great and Miss May will make sure everyone is happy. The lack of decor add to the charm of this lovely family restaurant. Show less

Author: JeanetteO661Oatley, Australia
Title: Nice family run restaurant
Review: We went to the Boatman after reading some really great reviews. This place is just a really “nice family run restaurant” where you could take a family and it not break the bank. When I read a menu full of pictures and as many pages of Malaysian food as Western food I should’ve known what to expect! We started with 12 chicken and beef skewers with a lovely peanut sauce, Penang beef curry and Pork with broccoli stir fry. The food was 70rm (alcohol extra) which was very affordable, tasty and hot. The service was very good the beer was very cold. There is nothing wrong with this restaurant it’s just NOT excellent and NOT outstanding as some reviewers have mentioned just “nice”. Show less

Author: Brisbane963Brisbane, Australia
Title: Great lunch spot
Review: We dropped in for lunch and enjoyed the salt and pepper squid and the pork with bitter melon. Finished off our lunch with a shared fruit plate. The family are beautiful people and have a great sense of humour too. We are going back for dinner tonight.Show less

Author: CmozziePenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Delicious
Review: Early dinner and they were just opening. Food was fantastic. The darling wife is celiac and they made her a special dish. My 8 year old was feeling adventurous and so we ordered the grilled tiger prawn. Cheap by Aussie prices but expensive here it was well worth the spend. My son ate the whole prawn sucking the last of the meat out of the shell. Probably needs a freshen up but seriously tasty food. Don’t judge the book by the cover here.Show less

Author: Michael L
Title: Better than average - good
Review: Fairly well hidden and a change from the nearby Hawkers areas. Very good staff and food is very nice with a reasonable range.

Author: Michael CAberdeen, United Kingdom
Title: Not the best, not the worst.
Review: I have dined at the Boatman a few times now and would return although I don't think that it is as good as it used to be. I nearly always have the same dish, Nasi Goreng, not because it is cheap but because I like it. There is always room for pancakes afterwards.Table service is functional with no customer rapport. Decor is virtually non existent, but the food is fine. Other restaurants in the village are more welcoming.Show less

Author: Alan REgremont, United Kingdom
Title: Outstanding food and great staff
Review: After trying a few local eateries in the area, this family run restaurant came out tops. Don’t be put off by the basic layout - the staff are super-friendly and the food is fantastic.We ended up visiting again and would’ve visited a 3rd time had the restaurant not been closed for a few days due to the family taking a holiday break. Starter, mains, dessert and drinks for both of us cost around RM120 (£24) - alcoholic drinks in any of the local places always bump the price up a bit (a large beer and glass of wine costs around RM35).If like me, you’re a fan of beef rendang, then you won’t be disappointed - it’s to die for !Show less

Author: ManFriday777Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Friendly family restaurant
Review: We were here mid June. Six of us with two kids. Found the food good and ambience comfortable. We visit Batu Ferringhi so we are always looking out for family-run restaurants because they tend to have better food and personal in their service. Boatman is quite like Guan Guan - 120 metres away towards Park Royal - in this respect.Show less

Author: Sharmeel KKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Nothing to shout about !
Review: We went to have dinner at this restaurant based on reviews....got there & there was hardly any crowd...tried their food, apart from the Kapitan Curry & the fried chicken, nothing great about their food, taste wise average. Would I come back again, probably not as Penang has far more better restaurants than Boatman....Show less

Author: Gazza59011Perth, Australia
Title: Good food
Review: Went to Boatman March 2017 with a group of fellow Aussie’s had good food and cold beers. As we are here again in 2018, just had another meal and beers, just as good as last year. Very busy ,prices reasonable came to 68 ringett,staff very friendly. We will go againShow less

Author: Leslie W
Title: Family run restaurant
Review: We had many good meals here. The variety of food is amazing and the staff very helpful and knowledgable. Probably the best meal we had was here. The toilets were very clean. Very highly recommended

Author: john mNorthampton, United Kingdom
Title: Best food in Batu ferringhi
Review: This is a family run restaurant with the best food in Batu Ferringhi .Staff are really friendly and efficient .When we are in Penang we eat at the Boatman every nightand all meals are superb.If you are in Batu Ferringhi looking for a restaurant don't miss out on the Boatman.Show less

Author: ERDFirefighterEdmonton, Canada
Title: Tasty meals well priced
Review: Service was excellent as well as both the meals that we had. Prices are very reasonable our dinner came to 62 ringgit. I would eat here again but before 7:45 in the evening. The reason being is there is a mosque next door and the service is broadcasted over loud speakers for about 1 hour.Show less

Author: TravelinAlan
Title: Very, Very Good Place For Your Evening Meal
Review:
Many choices on the menu.  I thought my fish and chips was outstanding. Large portion, very tasty and fairly priced. You will need reservations during high season. Very popular
place to eat and with good reason.

Author: Lizz M
Title: Good local food
Review: Really excellent food, although be aware about making the staff aware if you have an allergies as although food is in the vegetables section it contained prawns. However, the staff were friendly and helpful and the Malaysian Inch-kabin chicken was absolutely delicious.

Author: Fiona S
Title: Recommend
Review: Came here at 1.30pm one day, we sat and then were abruptly told that we needed to order straight away because they were closing. Felt rushed the entire meal, burnt my tongue because the curry was so hot... however- the food was reeeeally nice and cheap. I came back here a second time at night and it was much busier with local westerners . Much friendlier service this time and when paying at the counter the lady made an effort to ask where I was from etc. Despite a bad first impression, I’d definitely recommend. Show less

Author: Rose PPortsmouth, United Kingdom
Title: Breakfast
Review: Lovely. This place opens at 9.30 in the morning which is a bonus as nothing else does. Very clean. Service good. Make claim they serve real bacon and they do. Breakfast good value with nice coffee fruit juice toast and a lovely cooked breakfast. Definately does not break the bank.Show less

Author: Lesley CPerth
Title: Restaurant for all
Review: Whilst in Penang over Christmas we visited the restaurant on many occasions as the food is delicious with a wide variety to cater for all tastes and the service could not be falted even when busy. The prices are reasonable and we noticed that many locals frequent the restaurant almost every night. Highly recommend it.Show less

Author: B HLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Less than mediocre if you are Malaysian
Review: I thought the food was bland apart and very salty. The setting not very conducive for an evening. OK if you want fish and chips but you can get better Malaysian dishes at Long Beach stalls. Not going again.By the way, the call for prayers from the nearby mosque was deafening even their dog howls when the call for prayers started.Show less

Author: caroline bDarlington, United Kingdom
Title: Best food in batu ferringhi
Review: Lovely small restaurant owners so polite and friendly and great food it is great to support local Malaysians who are facing a tough time at the moment with increasing competition from incomers which is threatening their businesses.If you visit please show this restaurant owner and the local restaurant owners nearby support by eating and drinking in these local restaurants !!!! Thankyou.Show less

Author: Alan_Pratt23Newcastle upon Tyne, United Kingdom
Title: Boatman Restaurant, Batu Ferringhi
Review: I have been going to the Boatman for years, and the food has always been consistent. My favourite dishes are the Nasi Goering, Beef Rendang and Kang Kong Belachan. The owners and staff are always very friendly, food choice is varied, Western food and Asian Food, although having lived and worked in Asia for 30 years, Asian is my favourite. One of the owners is also the chef, they are happy to make dishes which are not even on the menu.A great restaurant, although you need to remember that their day off is MondayShow less

Author: kirkboom
Title: Dinner
Review: My wife and I had an amazing dinner here the prices were very reasonable and the staff were so friendly,we will be definitely back again

Author: CyrilVasKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: The absolute best place to eat in Batu Ferringhi
Review: This place is absolutely amazing for breakfast, lunch and dinner. Must try the pork dishes and my favourite spicy mixed vegetables with steamed rice. I eat nearly all my meals here when in Penang and have never been disappointed. The price is exceptional value for money. Try it for yourself.Show less

Author: Bodinlondon
Title: Good food unless you're vegan
Review: I ate here with my parents, husband and fussy six year old. On the whole all the meat/fish eaters enjoyed their food but the vegan vegetable dish I ordered was bland and we didn't go back.

Author: trevor_brooks1
Title: Excellent Asian food
Review: Best Asian food on Batu Ferringhi.  Hostess Mai is a joy to meet and her husband is the skilled chef. A must on your next visit

Author: David BMelbourne
Title: Still The Best
Review: My 2nd trip to Penang and just had to come back to the Boatman.Had 4 meals here this time and each one was so full of wonderful flavours. From the Kapitan Curry to the Beef Rendang & spring rolls in between - amazing.Service is swift & staff are great. Prices will suit the tightest budget.Show less

Author: 060501Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Awesome Fish Grill
Review: Went to Boatman RestaurantOrder Fish Grill Snapper With Butter / Garlic & Beer But !!Have to Wait 30' mint's No Worry's I Went Opposite Right Side Jest Cross the Road for Foot Reflexology had a Good Foot Reflexology The Name De Jo Foot Reflexology Ask for the Boss By The Name Tina Turner hahaha No Hang Key Picky.. By Than My Food Is Ready at Boatman Restaurant ...Good Food .. Will Recommend To Others / I Will Came Back Again To Boatman & De Jo @Bt. Ferringghi Penang .. Shaan kanda Show less

Author: Anne L
Title: Dinner for Four
Review: This place was recommended by some workers at our hotel. The Malaysian food was delicious, especially the garlic-butter grilled snapper. Highly recommended.

Author: mikethatch
Title: Worth going to Penang
Review: Best food and service on our 6 week holiday around Asia. We are going back in March this year. Service great and food great.

Author: Sro1234Penang Island, Malaysia
Title: Best food in the area
Review: Most of time when we try restaurants around, we may find one plate good, and one not. Especially when you come to western food, it is most of time very random.This small restaurant is surprisingly serving awesome food, both of the western and the local type. I have tried many Beef Rendang, even more expansive, and theirs is the best I have tasted. They know how to cook and what needs to be done. For instance, some other may have nice rendang sauce, but the beef is hard as they cook it at the moment. Boatman makes the beef cook 2-3 hours to have it really tender.If food is great, you will as well enjoy the service : very nice people, smiling and taking care of you. They will do their best to meet your special custom requests.Prices are higher than hawker's food, but it is normal : it is a proper restaurant and the quality is better. Still, it is cheaper than many around, with higher quality.If you don't want to waste time looking for an affordable, good quality restaurant that will please all tastes, just go there.Show less

Author: rpracy87
Title: Delicious
Review: We attended the Boatman Restaurant as a family with my husband, myself and parents. May our server for the night had excellent English and we had many great conversations with her. We all ordered an entrée. Spring Rolls 6 ringgit, a prawn cocktail 6 ringgit, chicken soup 6 ringgit and my father had a seafood cocktail 12 ringgit which was rather large and impressive! We all had mains which were pretty well priced and my husband was impressed with his Malaysian Beef Rendang. Overall a great meal with excellent customer service from May. A hidden treasure in Penang!!! Show less

Author: tmebayKelkheim (Taunus), Germany
Title: Good food, uncomplicated and very friendly
Review: This is a great place to eat if you're looking for a good combination of local as well as international dishes, e.g. for kids with their particular, i.e. typically rather conservative tastes in food. Very friendly and forthcoming staff and moderate prices -- not as cheap as the entirely local places, but well below those of the surrounding hotels and more ambitious restaurants.Show less

Author: Jennifer M
Title: Excellent in quality of food & very freindly service
Review: We ate here for Breakfast & Dinner on a daily basis on our recent holiday end of July 2016. The food is second to none (not looking forward to going home to cook) and the staff May & Kevin welcome you as If they have known you for years. Guys cant wait till we return in October 2016 for your fabulous food & service.Jenny & Billy in AdelaideShow less

Author: Glenys PMelbourne, Australia
Title: Simple But Great Local Easting
Review: We ate at this restaurant 4 times in two weeks and got to know the owner (May) very well during this time. She explained the delicious menu to us if needed, the service was great, quick or if you wished to spend time over your meal it was no poroblem. The food was fresh looked very appetising and we enjoyed every delicious mouthful. I would definately recomment this restaurant, it is very clean, the staff very friendly and food is top class. The restaurant is at the end of the Batu Ferringhi beach strip but well worth the walk further up the strip.Show less

Author: woohartyBrisbane, Australia
Title: Tasty food
Review: After a recommendation from one of the staff at the Bayview hotel, we tried out the Boatman restaurant, yes the decor might be a little outdated however the food was delicious. We had to go back for a second visit. Was definitely the best place we ate at in Batu Ferringhi.Show less

Author: paul9846
Title: Great food
Review: A great place for quality food. We had a full breakfast and it was the best we had in 2 weeks in Batu Ferringhi. Thoroughly recommend this restaurant.

Author: Rithvika GChennai (Madras), India
Title: Great tasting local fare at very reasonable rates
Review: Service was friendly and prompt. Informal outdoor and indoor seating arrangements. high chair available for babies. was perfect for dinner but might get a bit too warm during noon as heat from open kitchen also adds to the temperature. Banana fritters and banana pancake were awesome. Show less

Author: Robin L
Title: Home Style Cook
Review: Old style looking inside the restaurant. Served by a friendly owner. Having a delicious Chinese and Western food at there. Must try their Tomyan  soup and sizzling pork.

Author: unusedscreenname123
Title: Great place to eat
Review:
Delicious quick and tasty. Service was friendly and reasonably priced. Would definitely recommend it.
The setting is simple but clean.

Author: tomchurch
Title: Simple, excellent food
Review: Boatman is why you came to Malaysia. Excellent food, cheap prices, good service. The restaurant is simple, not fancy, and it's popular with ex-pats. You'll end up eating here more than once.

Author: Chantale L
Title: Delicious!
Review: Many kinds of very good food, served in a simple but so friendly restaurant, by very very nice people, including the child who get involved. She is pretty and always smily. Also, another good point: Breakfast served till 2:00 p.m.

Author: nellielimKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: A gem of a restaurant
Review: A gem of a restaurant in Batu Ferringhi with seating both inside and out. Serving a wide variety of Western and Asian delights, it is open for breakfast, has a break from 2.30pm and reopens at 6 pm until late at night. Food portions are ample and tasty. Friendly owner and efficient service staff. Pricing really reasonable. Well worth a visit.Show less

Author: taylord256
Title: Cheap food
Review: Super cheap food. Lots of different options. Friendly, helpful staff. Small portions though. I got a sandwich and if i went again, I'd get 2 of them to fill me up.

Author: Louise AWhakatane, Bay of Plenty, New Zealand
Title: Great place to eat
Review: Have been here many times and the food is always good. the service is excellent, nothing is ever a problem. Prices are very reasonable too. As it is at the far end of the beach parking on 'normal' days is fine but always busy on holiday weekends etc.Show less

Author: Trudie F
Title: Great place relaxing
Review: Cheap cheerful with good food very friendly. They were busy with a children's party and advised us they may be a little slow on service but that wasn't the case. We even entertained the children.

Author: Z5055AFcarolinec
Title: Good for families.
Review: The food was great, plenty of choice, very friendly customer service, cheap family dining. Surroundings old but clean

Author: JamesABr
Title: Great food better price
Review: Been here for 9 days and tried a lot of restraints, this little gem is somewhere we would never have chosen based on looks but TripAdvisor had some goods results and we where not dissapointed. If you like chinese food you cannot go wrong here. Easily the best tasting around,the price is a bonus.Show less

Author: Paigelouise97
Title: So good we had to go back the next night!!
Review: Oh wow the food and service at The Boatman was amazing! They had the biggest range of meals I've ever seen on a menu. Fast and lovely service, great tasting quality dishes at very affordable prices. It was so good that my family came back the next night. Would recommend going there for dinner if you are in the area.Show less

Author: NielsAndMaryHumpty Doo, Australia
Title: Boatman Restaurant, Batu Ferringhi
Review: Excellent tucker to be had at the boatman. Menu is great and varied, and vine and beer is available. The outdoor setting is great. We visit the Boatman whenever we're in Penang. The lady running the place is very nice and always have time for a chat. We can recommend the large king prawns eg 4 prawns to 500g. Beautifully grilled to your liking. The sizzling spicy pork dish is very nice too. We'll be back.Cheers Niels & Mary, Humpty Doo, NT, Australia Down Under Show less

Author: eleriannejAnglesey, United Kingdom
Title: Every cuisine you can think off
Review: Went looking for somewhere quiet and clean and weren't dissapointed. Food was excellent and I went for a Malaysian curry which was medium and it was that but lovely flavours and I'm a critic but couldn't fault it. Definitely worth a visit and staff very polite and helpfulShow less

Author: Bernadette T
Title: Excellent Service
Review:
We Had The english Full Breakfast @ 22myr, Service Was Impecable, Would Like To Try Asian Cooking (lunch/dinner), It Was Good Only Thing Would Be How You Personally 
Like It Cooked (grilled/poached/fried Etc) And I.m Sure They Would Do Best To Cook To Individusl Taste.

Author: bald45eagle
Title: This a great place
Review:
This restaurant is good food cooked individually always hot they do Chinese, Malay and some English food. Nothing is too much trouble for them long may they continue.
Kathy and Peter

Author: ollymac_9_10Kent UK
Title: A Must Visit -Great food and service
Review: Returning visitors to Penang and the Boatman does not disappoint. Located near Mosque it has tablesd outside or under cover.Menu is varied and excellentService always great with friendly staffDrinks cold and there is a choice of beers or winePrices are very reasonable and the food cannot be faulted.They even spiced up a noodle dish for one of us and remembered the exact recepie on further visits.Highly recommendedShow less

Author: 27pripUnited Kingdom
Title: Beef Rendang
Review: Excellent food, what a find in Penang, way down towards the Hard Rock Hotel, just after the mosque, you nearly miss it. The staff are very friendly and the food especially the beef rending is the best we had. Very popular with the ex pats and English visitors who return year after year, and they were all so friendly.Good value for money too. Well worth the walk from the RassaShow less

Author: john m
Title: Best food in Batu Ferringhi
Review: Just spent 8 weeks in Penang we ate at the Boatman most nights. We were never disappointed great food every night. Have dined there for years and never had a bad meal,hopefully we will eat again there next year.    Thanks to all the staff.

Author: JenS57
Title: great food, very nice people
Review: We went there for lunch almost every day. The food (mainly malay) is very good, staff is very friendly. You can have a look into the kitchen and see that even the spring rolls are freshly prepared

Author: Jean S
Title: Lovely food
Review: First time here for meals went 2 years ago but only for drinks too late to order food. This time we booked in advance and it was worth it lovely food we all had great meals really nice will go again

Author: Skpevans
Title: Another great place to eat
Review:
Food and service impeccable -very well priced

the only place that gave me 'dry noodles ' no sauce

just past the Ferringhi  Gardens

Author: owdgit1952
Title: Best food in Batu Feringghi
Review: Always eat and drink here. Tried a number of other restaurants and never had a bad meal at any of them but Hok, Lay Pheng, May and the rest of the staff at the Boatman make this a home from home. Excellent food and hospitality.

Author: Roaming-About-56
Title: Great food & clean facilities
Review: Great tasty food at this restaurant/cafe.Friendly staff. This would have to be the cleanest establishment in the whole of Penang; a credit to the owners and staff.

Author: saudfranPinner, United Kingdom
Title: A fair meal
Review: Someone in our hotel recommended this restaurant, not very nice looking from the outside but food was ok. We had Chinese but it was more for tourist and not authentic Chinese food. The mosque was right next door so the whole meal was eaten while the prayers were said on the loud speaker as it is Ramadan.The lady who served us was very friendly and helpful.Show less

Author: Anthony MAdelaide, Australia
Title: Best little restaurant in Ferringhi Beach
Review: This is a restaurant that is a favourite for Aussies in Penang. It has an excellent menu and out shines the flashy neighbouring restaurants, including the hotels. Not just in price and value but quality of the dishes. There was seven of us and a complete range of dishes all excellent even specially requested vegetarian dish. Penang Curry with Lemon grass and Lime was fantastic, their fried rice was the best we have ever had. The proof came from the teenagers in the party "are they open for breakfast" This is a must when visiting Batu Ferringhi as it sets the standard.Show less

Author: marview
Title: Authentic food at very reasonable prices.
Review: The food was served quickly, the staff very helpful and friendly. We enjoyed the food and went back frequently. The place is clean and tidy. Its location is a bit off putting however the food is genuinely good and with out fuss.

Author: Delyeo
Title: A good meal
Review: This is walking distance from the Hard Rock hotel we stayed in. Simple decor but the food was good. We paid slightly over $200 ringgit to feed our family of 5 adults and one child. This included maindishes, beverage and a dessert. Every dish we ordered was good. There was tom yam prawn, sizzling beef, chicken curry, stir fried kailan, fried chicken, fried fish with sambal. My favorite was the dessert - banana fritters with ice cream. Very friendly crew at the restaurant. Brewed coffee was thin (they need to adjust the setting to make thicker coffee) and fruit juices were too sweet and we had to wait for the ice to melt to dilute the juice soIt is less sweet (not sure if syrup was added). I was amused the had a banner that said they served proper bacon because most hotels serve halal food and pork bacon is always not in the breakfast buffet spread.Show less

Author: Mark Maura SPerth, Australia
Title: Good food but a little off putting from the road.
Review: Had it not been for reviews we would have walked past this one as it looks very basic from the road. Certainly not enticing. We took a chance and were happy with the quality and price. Seafood platter was $11.50 AUD and had good variety. Jumbo prawns were $3 AUD per 100g. We had 3 which came to 500g. A bit pricey but tasty. You could have Asian meals like nasi goreng ect for as little as $2AUD.Show less

Author: Sydneyblue69
Title: Dissapointing
Review: Heard a lot about this restaurant might have dined on a off night poor service average food lousy decor could need a upgrade.

Author: mojudeSittingbourne
Title: Best in Ferringhi
Review: Was was taken to this restaurant by our son who lives in Batu Ferringhi. Although we visited other restaurants during our stay, this was definitely our favourite. The food was consistently excellent and varied. It is also a favourite with long stay ex-pats, so that says a lot. The staff - although consistently busy (the restaurant is always full) - were unfailingly polite and friendly. Will definitely frequent it again next time we are in Penang.Show less

Author: john mNorthampton, United Kingdom
Title: Still the best in Batu Ferringhi
Review: Just returned home after spending six weeks in Penang we ate at the Boatman most nights,every meal was superb wether it was Chinese or western cuisine.The chef and owner Hock is a fantastic chef.Thanks to all the staff for great food and service,can't wait to get back next year.Show less

Author: Sherriann55
Title: Get fish
Review: They had great fish you can change what you have it with fried rice or salad and the best thing is western toilets and they are clean that says a lot about a restaurant

Author: Kanan AAustralia
Title: Gourmet in the Garage
Review: Attentive professional and friendly service with a smile from the Indian waiter and the Chinese waitress. …that’s what you get here, along with excellent cuisine, a wide variety of dishes, all at very reasonable prices.The pay-off is that décor is minimal, but who cares? The venue is an old converted garage with some el fresco dining in the old driveway. It looks better at night; they have set up some mood lighting (see my pictures). Inside it is clean and reasonably comfortable.But the main reason to come here is for the food. Every dish we ordered was cooked to perfection. Even the spaghetti bolognaise that my wife ordered was el dente, in the Italian style, a simple sign of a real chef. It is situated on the beach side just a little way past Ferringhi Gardens, and before you get to the "By the Sea" highrise, heading towards Hard Rock. It is well signposted at night when the signs light up. They close on Mondays.My suggestions to the management, if they want to go a little more up market, would be to paint the concrete floor, and provide a knife along with the fork for the Western food dishes, and maybe some cushions on the chairs. But hey, then they might put the prices up on us. I suggest you try this place before they do.Show less

Author: IMP58Crewe, United Kingdom
Title: One of the best in Batu Ferringhi
Review: Eating at the Boatman was always an excellent experience. We ate here on many occassions and always enjoyed it. Full roast duck, 2 crabs, 1 in white wine and the other in chilli were just two of the delicious dishes we enjoyed. All the food is of a very high quality and the staff are friendly and welcoming. David is a star and nothing is too much trouble for them.Show less

Author: Alan-HoldenPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Ho hum
Review: Ate here last night and went fo the Malaysian king prawn curry. It was ok, but nothing spectacular. Prices were reasonable and staff friendly and efficient.Not sure how it has got such a high Trip Adviser rating so will have to go back again to find out.Seems popular with the local expat community. Show less

Author: Disappointed807
Title: Excellent value
Review: Had several very good meals here when in Penang in October.  Their whole grilled fish was superb.  Pity the entrance area isn't a little more inviting.  Very friendly helpful staff.   Will certainly be going back there again.

Author: LNB1968Perth
Title: Fantastic
Review: Got chatting to a lovely lady, Val, at our hotel and she recommended the Boatman. Val was spot on, this place is fabulous, the food was amazing and the service was terrific. We will be eating here again when we return to Penang next year!we ordered beef kway teow, fried vegatables, Szechuan chicken, all of them were delicious. portions are generous, everything is fresh and to quote my daughter "scrumdiddlyumptious".Show less

Author: muddyoldengrEngland
Title: Little Gem
Review: Open area leads to gate entrance and then into a very simple looking eating area. Clean, well lit and ceiling fans over simple tables. Food was excellent, the best we've eaten so far in fact, and ample too. For less than AUD 160 for 4 including beers it's superb value. We'll be heading back before we leave. Closed on Mondays as we discovered yesterday!Show less

Author: Ken MInverness
Title: Almost didn't eat here - glad I did - twice!
Review: On our first night back in Penang, I was looking for a restaurant I had visited 8 years ago but it had gone. However, The Boatman looked good, so we went in. It was more than good, it was excellent. We said we'd be back but the owner said she was closing the next day for a week's holiday in KL.However, we were in Penang for 10 days so we returned when she got back. This meal was even better and, as we were relaxing afterwards, a couple of local Indian gentlement came in to an adjacent table. They opened a conversation with us and, as regulars, invited us to share a bottle of wine with them. Bliss. This is one of the friendliest islands I have ever visitied. All the cultures, Malasian, Indian, Chinese, and the odd European seem to co-exist in harmony.I really like Penang and am sure I will be back. I have said that one every occasion I have been there.Show less

Author: 652408MikeWhakatane, New Zealand
Title: Great food, friendly staff
Review: The Boatman Restaurant in Batu Ferringhi, Penang has to be one of the best eating places at the beach. You can find it between the new mosque and next door to the By The Sea condominium being built. What it lacks in ambiance it makes up for with excellent food and friendly staff and very reasonable prices. Example: three people dining; pan-fried snapper with garlic butter; pawn fritter for one; peach melba for two; banana split for one; one beer, one iced lemon tea, two cans of lemonade. Cost: RM91 which is about $36 New Zealand. Beat that if you can! The Boatman has an extensive menu of Chinese, Malay and Western food. Order a glass of wine and you get a full glass, not just a half glass. Mae, who will serve you, will always remember your last order!Show less

Author: Rosco_syd
Title: Great food Great service
Review: Had a really good value local meal here. The restaurant was quiet and doesn't look much from the road but it is a great value and authentic experience. Definitely worth a visit!

Author: OrangutangirlEngland
Title: Friendly staff and good food
Review: After reading the reviews on tripadvisor we decided to try it out. Initially we were a little hesitant by the exterior but don't let that put you off! The staff were really friendly and the food was lovely - especially the sizzling hot plates. The price was reasonable and wine was available.Show less

Author: amarolnorth east england
Title: still as good as ever
Review: This restaurants continues to be one of our favourites , just back from batu ferringhi , and had several meals there, the service ,quality of food , and atmosphere is excellent , to be a little critical the menu does not change much from year to year, but always worth waiting for . Sometimes the local mosque has the volume up to high , and there issome new building going up next door , but it does not distract from eating there , and always value for money.Although it is situated on the teluk bahang end of town lots of customers go there from the bay view park royal , holiday inn , all within striking distance .Show less

Author: kevinchan_NYSRochester, New York
Title: Once In A While Is OK!
Review: Ordered Chinese foods and overall the taste was good. Tom Yam soup is just slightly over than average and nothing WOW. If you are not local and wanted to try a local Chinese food at Batu Ferringhi area this is the place you should go. Reminder: You have to wait for about 30-45 minutes for your foods arrive on your table.Show less

Author: BricodustSouth West France
Title: Excellent food
Review: This restaurant is located at the Teluk Pahang end of Batu Ferringhi, next to the mosque and the new apartment block being built.Not much to look at from the outside but quite nice inside.Service is excellent as is the food, a very varied menu, the beef rendang is the best I have had and the T-bone steak at 40 ringitt is very good as was the snapper with garlic butter.Spring rolls for starters were good and the banana/pineapple fritter were also. One of the better and less expensive restaurants in Batu, avoid the Lebanese restaurants that have sprung up, our experience is not good service and pricey.Show less

Author: pinacoladobabe
Title: Boatman Restaurant
Review: I found that the Boatman Restaurant was such good value with a very friendly service.  I had lunch dinner and breakfast there several times and was always pleased with the quality price of the meal and always service with a smile

Author: JopBKKAshford, United Kingdom
Title: Lots of variety, good value, friendly service
Review: We ate twice at the Boatman and wished we'd discovered it earlier in our holiday. Doesn't look much from the outside, but the service within is really friendly and welcoming. There is huge variety on the menu, with both western and local dishes. The food is lovely and excellent value. The staff were willing to tweak dishes for the benefit of the vegetarian in our party. On our second visit - a Friday evening - the restaurant was really busy and we were lucky to get a table (just). So worth thinking about arriving reasonably early, or booking, especially if you're in a group.Show less

Author: john mNorthampton, United Kingdom
Title: best food in batu ferringhi
Review: Once again supurb food in the boatman restuarant at a very reasonable price.We ate at the boatman most nights and were never disapointed,the staff are very friendly Once again superb food in the boatman restuarant at a very reasonable price.We ate at the boatman most nights and were never disapointed, the staff are really friendly and it was lovely to see Annies smiling face again.On busy nights you may have to wait a little for your food but it is well worth waiting for.Show less

Author: tonyis
Title: Varied Menu
Review: First visited the Boatman in 2003 and enjoyed their various curries. Decided to visit again and was not disappointed. The food if anything was better than before. Just the place for a very good curry.

Author: tommomelbourneMelbourne, Australia
Title: I agree that the place seems over rated. Food was ok but not exceptional!
Review: I dined at this restaurant at lunchtime and choose it based on members recommendations and the high TA rankings.We shared Wonton Soup, Lemon Chicken and Fried Rice. Menu was mainly Chinese and I was preferring more Malaysian based dish choices.The food wasn't bad but I wouldn't say exceptional. I've had better but perhaps I diidnt choose the right dishes as the place gets great reviews from members. Service was excellent but as there wasn't many diners this is to be expected.On a positive note I bumped into Penang Forum regular Gaja who I only recognised from the TA avatar.Show less

Author: tammiKualaLumpurkuala lumpur
Title: This has been overrated by foreign tourists
Review: We googled for the best restaurants in Penang and found the boatman restaurant rated as the best for Chinese local food (overall no.2 out of 400) by trip advisor.
