We drove over and had dinner there yesterday. Had steamed whole fish, grilled prawns, sharksfin soup and kangkong (vegetables). Total bill $96.00.To a Malaysian, the food was not value for money as reported by other tourists. But in comparison with other foreign currency e.g. Singapore or Australian dollar, it's cheap.Try other food in smaller towns e.g. Ipoh or even Bidor. The food is fantastic and really cheap.Show less

Author: dockersfan
Title: Great experience
Review: Fantastic place to have a drink and food.  It was pouring with rain but we sat under an umbrella and had the most fantastic time.

Author: ThePepperCookiesCambridge, United Kingdom
Title: Lovely restaurant!
Review: It is a very humble establishment, but very clean and the staff delightful. The food was great and very cheap. We went there 3 nights and loved all three times. We recommended to another family and they loved it too. The staff is great with kids,Show less

Author: 191SusanB191
Title: Excellent food and service
Review: Wonderful tasty food and great service. Veyr reasonable. Unfortunately we only discovered this gem on our last night

Author: Henk MVlaardingen, The Netherlands
Title: Thank you, TripAdvisor, for showing the way to Boatman Restaurant
Review: Yes, thank you TripAdvisor for pointing the way to the Boatman Restaurant. In the ten years that I have annually visited Batu Ferringhi, I must have passed the unpromising entrance of Restaurant Boatman scores of time on my walks from the Bayview Beach Resort to the Batu Ferringhi night market and vice versa. As Restaurant Boatman does not employ a "barker" on the street, this restaurant is really for the initiated only. This week I noticed in the entrance of Restaurant Boatman a TripAdvisor notice with a raving rating for this restaurant for 2012 and a recommendation. Closer scrutiny revealed a somewhat hidden restaurant with an extensive menu (Malaysian ans Western) with very reasonable prices. Putting Restaurant Boatman to the test next evening I needed a short while to conclude that the food was excellent, the service was dedicated and friendly and the prices were indeed extremely reasonable. The fish dish was so good, it was decided to go to Restaurant Boatman again the next day. I can assure you that the food quality and the service standard were again high. Restaurant Boatman is a hidden gem in the endless row of eateries in Batu Ferringhi. I am really sorry not to have discovered this restaurant earlier.Show less

Author: Maxwell00Birmingham, United Kingdom
Title: Still the best food in Batu Ferringhi !
Review: On our second visit to Penang in as many years we knew from previous experience what to expect from Mae and the staff at The Boatman , and we weren't disappointed !Once again superb food , all freshly cooked and prepared , great value , clean, and superb service . Nothing is too much trouble , all our bills were accurate and the staff can advise you on what to choose , which is the only thing we had to do ! The food is so good that we often decided what to eat at our hotel , but in the 5 min walk had changed our minds ! A really good place to eat , breakfast , lunch or evening meal , excellent !Show less

Author: A380ManchesterUKManchester UK
Title: Good value and nice food, despite not being an obvious choice from the outside.
Review: Visited after reading a number of reviews on Tripadvisor.Roadside appeal as others have stated is not particularly attractive. The restaurant itself is fairly small inside, maybe 10 tables or so. In busier times (it was low season during our visit), more seating is available outside. The kitchen is open so you can see food being prepared.No complaints at all with the meal that we had, all of which arrived hot and freshly prepared. A separate pork menu was also available.Appears to be a family run business, given that a couple of small children were having great fun helping clear the odd plate away.Our only reason for not revisitng, was to try one of the many other Tripadvisor recommended restaurants in the resort during our stay.Opening hours 09.00 - 14.30 and 18.00 - 23.00 . I assume this is daily, but a lot of restaurants do shut one day each week Toilets were spotless which was an added bonusShow less

Author: VICK1
Title: THE BEST
Review: This is one of the nicest resturants in batu ferringhi, the food is fantastic, the staff are very friendly have been coming her years and will return on our next visit

Author: YorkyYork
Title: Food to Die for
Review: Great food, one of the best in Batu Ferringhi....and when you want a change from the local food, they do a Mean Bacon Butty

Author: PerthtravelersPerth, Australia
Title: Great curry
Review: We went there after reading the great reviews on here. Very glad we did. Although it doesn't look much from the outside, the food and service was excellent. We had the chicken curry and the Malaysian Rendang curry, both were good but the Rendang was amazing! Very good value too. We were made to feel very welcome as everyone was so friendly.Show less

Author: SjpbingleyDubai, United Arab Emirates
Title: Don't walk past...
Review: We went here solely on the back of tripadvisor reviews. And we were happy we did. Initially we were nervous. The place looks uninviting from the outside and it's very simple & basis. However after being very warmly welcomed we were seated at a table where we could see into an efficient, clean kitchen. There was a vegetarian in our group who didn't have many options. The rest of us chose traditional meat dishes after the server was able to answer our many questions about them. The food was simply served in average size portions. We all very much enjoyed it and felt it tasted authentic unlike what we'd had in other local restaurants. If we'd had more time we would've returned and definitely suggest giving it a try.Show less

Author: Cottzo
Title: Great food at very reasonable price
Review: We almost walked past this restaurant because it doesn't have much street appeal but don't let that fool you. Food and service were both excellent at very reasonable price. We would definitely recommend this restaurant.

Author: amarolnorth east england
Title: as good as ever
Review: Just back from batu ferringhi and ate in the boatman several time fot both breakfast and dinner , May and annie along with all the staff as good as ever cheerful nothing to much trouble and always willing advise on food choice, the food , always cooked to order and worth the wait,, Would not hesitate to eat ther again if we go back next yearShow less

Author: ssacha
Title: Fantastic food and great value for both food and drink. A meal for 4 with drinks cost 102 ringgit (approx £20).
Review: The staff are lovely. Try the sizzling noodles or the Yeung Chow fried rice & sweet & sour chicken, for me they were the stand out dishes.

Author: Mimi G
Title: The Breakfast Place
Review: About 10 mins walk from Bayview Beach Resort in Batu Feringgi. Close on Mondays. Yummy food and friendly people.

Author: ollymac_9_10Kent UK
Title: Good food- Great service
Review: Visited Penang Feb 2012 & used this restaurant on a couple of occassions. They have a good and broad selection of dishes including western. traditional dishes were of great quality although portion sizes for some western ones ie Fish & chips were rather small. That said the quality of food is excellent.Drinks are well priced and they have a good selection.Well located towards far end of Battu ferringhi hotels, such as Hard Rock or Bayview Beach. A reasonable number of tables some inside others outside. Inside can get hot and smokers will smoke in there which can slightly detract from your meal if you are a non smoker. Not all tables outside have sun shades/ covers and if it rains suddenly you may have a problem particularly as this restaurant can get busy because its popular.Big plus is the staff who will be polite and helpful and annie was great- they will welcome you wether you want a drink or main meal.Recommended - give it a try its on a similar level to the Living Room restaurant just along the roadShow less

Author: hewieandcoWestern Australia, Australia
Title: Great Food - never disappoints!
Review: Our kids have been waiting in anticipation to return to the Boatman since our last visit and told us we were eating there every night! Each night we tried different dishes and every night the food was fresh and wonderfully tasty - prices are fantastic. Annie and Mai are great - our son has a peanut allergy and they were always willing to tell us ingredients etc. The restaurant although basic is always clean and tidy, as to the toilets. Some complain about the mosque's proximity but we feel that is all part of the experience! It makes chinese food at home very boring and our kids are once again hanging out for a fix of crispy noodles!We highly recommend the Boatman - you will not be disappointed.Show less

Author: flutterby59Perth, Australia
Title: Wonderful Food
Review: We have been eating at The Boatman for over 8 years now and look forward each trip to our meals there. The chicken curry is delicious, as is the whole fish. We have now resorted to two trips to Penang a year to satisfy our need for meals from The Boatman. Mai and Annie are the perfect hostesses and go out of their way to ensure your meal is perfect.We only wish we could take frozen meals prepared by Hoc back to Perth! A must to eat at when in BF.Show less

Author: roostown
Title: Boatman
Review: the food and the host are fantasic...its location is easy to find

Author: Irina_IlinaMoscow, Russia
Title: very simple old interior, but EXCELLENT food and value
Review: we never ate at such 'simple' establishments running by a family before, but that was a great opening of such kind.a bit dirty (because everything there looks like a 20-years old) interior, funny staff without uniform, but you can forgive it all when you taste their food and compare prices with size of dishes!a little clarification: Boatman is located at Batu Ferringi district, but here it specified as just Penang IslandShow less

Author: FinnMcCoolAsiaAsia
Title: Excellent food by skilled chef
Review: The Boatman provides a wide range of traditional Malay, Chinese and Indian food,For starters try Wonton soup, then try tthe best Curry Kapitan on the beach. Any seafood dish will be cooked and seasoned to perfection. The kitchen is clean and owners are very customer focused. If your stomach is bloated from hotel buffet eating, try this place.Show less

Author: GajaNelson Bay, Australia
Title: A fire selection of Asian and western food.
Review: May and her staff provide a welcoming greeting. We had a group of 7 visit and enjoyed a varied selection from their extensive menu. If you want to experience their chilli and/or black pepper mud crabs, you need to advise the day before. We visited fo lunch and dinner, didn't try breakfast as it was included with our Hotel stay. Would recommendShow less

Author: Maxwell00Birmingham, United Kingdom
Title: Great food , good service , and quality staff !
Review: This little restaurant at the top end of Batu Ferringhi is real gem ! The food is fantastic , we ended up having breakfast (with real bacon ) and evening meals here during our stay.One of our group has a seafood allergy , and once the owner , Mai , knew this we could order anything as she would say wether it contained any shellfish or not !!The breakfast egs taste how eggs should taste , beautiful !Evevning meals were brilliant , nice, fresh, tasty , with quality wine , beer, fruit juices to go with it , an excellent menu , very reasonably priced , and all with such lovely people to serve you !!Thanks for looking after us ! I highly recommend you try The Boatman while in Penang !Show less

Author: senfaaaMalaysia
Title: Delicious & nice service
Review: The foods there weren't expensive but the foods were with quality. The mixed fruit juice was very nice as suggested by one of my friends. I ordered a seafood platter and it was magnificent in taste and smell. The waitresses there were so nice and friendly. I felt so at home with their services.This restaurant is located very near to a mosque, hence some people just feel it wasn't a good place to enjoy their food but, for me, you can really feel the local atmosphere by having the mosque near to you. Just take it as a native song will do. For me, the only drawback about this restaurant is it has no beach view otherwise it is great...XDShow less

Author: elizabeth s
Title: good food and cold beer
Review: when stayed at batu ferringi we ate at the boatmen,several times and didnt have onebad meal.the staff vey friendly,and their was a great choice on the menu,and the prices were good to.

Author: Sunseekers8910
Title: Nice Meal
Review: Nice meal and friendly service, but located too close to the Mosque (especially if a service is taking place)

Author: RegClaybrook
Title: Great food
Review: great service and top food. We dined there on several occassions..loved the steak!!

Author: Andrew OLondon, United Kingdom
Title: When you eat a Chinese meal in England and think "great" you go to the Boatman and realise what "great" really means!
Review: We have been going to Penang for twenty years or more. We have tried everywhere on Batu Ferrenghi, places present and past. The Boatman's food is beyond words. You come back to England and remember the taste in your head. Until you return to Penang after a years break you forget how good the Boatman's food really is. Always looked after by Mai and Annie, always a mention for Sue. Also, and of course Uncle who cooks to your individual needs. Anyone who has never been to Penang - Batu Ferrenghi the Boatman is a MUST. Try the twenty-four hour pre order of Duck and Pork, you will not get anything like this anywhere else. Returning to Penang in five weeks, cannot wait to eat this amazing food once again. In my opinion there is only two restaurants to eat on Batu Ferrenghi for guranteed great service and great food with lovely people - Helena's and The Boatman. Andrew Oakley, Daisey Oakley & Angie Oakley.Show less

Author: joveenchong
Title: Relaxing,Reasonable,not a bad place to eat.
Review: we having breakfast at there..full breakfast was not bad...and service was damn good..will make you have  good mood..

Author: Michael MLondon, United Kingdom
Title: BOATMAN A MUST GO AND EAT
Review: This restaurant was recommended by a few people so 5 of us went in one very rainy night . There were a few couples there. We had shared starters and ordered a dish each for mains. What can i say - all of us in the party of five -children and adults wree delighted with the taste, flavours and freshness of the wonderful food and the warmth and friendliness of the family run restaurant. The food here was better in flavour and freshness, than what we have had in chinatown ,london. We returned on another evening and it was equally good.Show less

Author: grahamhelen_11Blackpool, United Kingdom
Title: the best restaurant in penang
Review: we have been going to Penang for 8yrs and still go back to the Boatman on numerous occasions during our visits, the food is fantastic and nothing is too much trouble, Mai and anni speak great english so communication is no problem and the service is second to none.the boatman has a good atmosphere and very reasonable priced for such good quality food, i reccomend the whole deep fried fish it is delicious. so if in Batu ferrighi give it a try you wont be dissapointed.graham & helenShow less

Author: Meriem HPerth, Australia
Title: Fantastic food ! Wish we found it first day .
Review: The menu selection and service was the best . The prices were very inexpensive .A must try the banana fritter . Once we found The Boatman we returned every evening .The food was enjoyed by us all friends and hubby .Highly recommended . Don't walk past stop and go in !Show less

Author: DemononePenang
Title: Great food and a charming host
Review: I have been going to the Boatman in Batu Ferringhi now for around five years and while it looks modest from the outside, the welcome inside is warm, friendly and caring ... and then there is the food, which is definitely something to come back for time and time again.The menu is extensive, mostly Asian and I greatly believe that when in Rome do as the Romans do so I always have the curries or a rendang. You can get a cold beer, which is pretty critical in a climate like Malaysia's and they serve wine too.Prices are reasonable and May, the hostess does her job magnificently.Show less

Author: PennyPenangDarwin, Australia
Title: Great atmosphere, great service
Review: Boatman is a little out of the way, at the end of the small restaruant strip to the right of Holiday Inn and Park Royal, but once you find it you won't be disappointed. Open for breakfast, lunch and dinner (except Mondays) it has great food, both western and chinese. We like the Chicken Curry and the Beef Rendang, but there is a good variety of dishes to choose from. The service is very friendly and May the host is delightful. I guarantee you after you have been there once, she will remember your name the next time you go back. If you want to experience real Penang food and hosptlaity this is the place to go.The fact that locals go there says it all.Show less

Author: GeazahChristchurch, New Zealand
Title: Absolutely the best in Batu Ferringhi
Review: We have been going to Penang for the last 12 years and have seen some changes in this time but the one constant has been The Boatman restaurant. You cannot go far wrong with the service, value for money and for the food. Annie & Mai are absolutely fantastic and nothing is too much trouble for them. We have tried many of the restaurants in the area but still go back to them. Only down side is they close on a Monday.Show less

Author: PlanetJames04Slough, United Kingdom
Title: You've got to try it once
Review: We like to sample as many restaurants as we can when we're on holiday and so are thankful to Trip Advisor contributors for their reviews. Thanks to the ones on the Boatman we were there last night. We loved it. Efficient yet friendly sercice, reasonable prices and, most of all, I'm still licking my lips from the delicious food. It really is a must for any foodies itinerary.JamesShow less

Author: yychan69Manchester, United Kingdom
Title: great breakfast
Review: went to the boatman after reading the reviews, thought we would give it a go.the staff are great and the place is clean. the menu has western and local cuisine and the price is good.i would definitely recommend everyone who is staying at batu ferringhi to go and have a visit.Show less

Author: amarolnorth east england
Title: The boatman is a must .
Review: Just 2 weeks back from Batu Ferringhi , and this was one of 2 restaurants we used for breakfast and dinner , food, service , atmosphere, it's all there , very competively priced too. It has a front area for out door , or at the rear is the new indoor which I'm told was only built around a year ago. Annie and May both speak good english and very helpful with nothing being any trouble ,this is one I will use when we go back .Cannot speak to highly of it!Show less

Author: Carimakan77St. Andrews, Scotland
Title: Best restaurant on Batu Ferringhi without question.
Review: My wife and I have been holidaying in Penang since 1974 and, over the years, have possibly eaten in every restaurant on the Batu Ferringhi "strip". Many years ago we discovered The Boatman with its excellent food, very reasonable prices and extremely friendly staff. They offer a wide variety of dishes both local and Western and this restaurant has become a home from home for many of the regular visitors to Penang from UK and Australia, which speaks for itself. The restaurant is located on the beach side of the road about halfway between the Park Royal Hotel and The Hard Rock Hotel (ex Casuarina Beach Hotel).Show less

Author: hewieandcoWestern Australia, Australia
Title: Ripper little restaurant
Review: We loved the Boatman - we went 3 times on our stay and would have gone more except for a few wet nights. The food is delicious, always served in a timely manner and the staff are fantastic. Our kids loved going there and we loved the price. A great little restaurant that we would recommend to one and all.Show less

Author: whipit_good
Title: Fabulous food, great service, excellent value, Best in Penang.
Review: Pity we didn't find it until the last 2 days, recommended by others staying at our hotel. A bit hard to find at first but well worth it.

Author: ChriscrisHertford, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent value and friendly staff
Review: Only had one meal here but thoroughly enjoyed it. Usually avoid restaurants that offer food from many cultures as feel they are not always as good as specialists. Decided to try anyway and were pleased we did. We ate Chinese which was very good. Waitress very friendly and whole meal excellent value. To get to the restaurant turn right out of the ParkRoyal towards the Hard Rock and it is about 10 minutes along on the beach side of the road.Show less

Author: Rower
Title: Great food and friendly staff
Review: Great for breakfast, lunch or dinner. Everything we tried was good, and we were made very welcome. Gin and tonic at 10RM was very good value!

Author: KLFoodExplorer
Title: Batu Ferringhi Boatman, a place worth to go.
Review: If you happen to visit Batu Ferringhi in Penang, I would suggest u drop by one of the local restaurant by the name of Boatman. They serve good fusion cuisine and the crews are friendly and helpful. Drop by to try it yourself.

Author: Lynda APerth, Australia
Title: The best all round food in Batu Ferringhi
Review: Well, the title doesn't quite say it all because all the staff are delightful, the service friendly and efficient and the beer and wine icy cold.This unpretentious little restaurant was a wonderful find when were in Penang recently. From the first day when we stumbled in bleary eyed for breakfast, to the last sad farewell dinner, we were fed and watered like royalty. Each dish we tried was generous, delicious and nicely presented. They were even happy to make a special dish or two which was not on the very extensive menu.We've been to Penang a few times before and have eaten in many of the restaurants in the Batu Ferringhi area, but for quality and value for money, The Boatman easily comes out as number one. All the staff make you feel most welcome, almost as though you've come home. Special accolades to little Anni, the waitress, who was a breath of fresh air. Nothing was too much trouble for her. We were sad to say goodbye and look forward to visiting again soon.TravelkatShow less

Author: UkGilUK
Title: Unpretentious, but very good food & drink
Review: This restaurant has just about the biggest menu in Batu Ferringhi and will mix & match to your taste. All of the fish dishes I've tried have been excellent, Tom Yam soup is a great starter but a bit of a challenge if you're not used to hot spices. As a sweet the pancakes take some beating.Overall a good basic eating place with cold beer and good prices.Anni, the waitrees is a treasure.Real bacon if you got to beakfast!Show less

Author: suneeshak
Title: Worst service ever
Review: I have ordered us pizza few times before for delivery, usually wait is long but other than that no issue. I ordered tonight for my parents as a treat as they were craving for it, not only they asked my parents to come down n do a self pick up cs accordingly no delivery person, but they had to wait for almost another hour in pouring heavy rain such inconvinience. If they wan to promote it as a fast good chain then they need to be fast, and make sure they can cater for high no of deliveries if they are giving the option for delivery, sooo dissapointing. As my father is allergic to mushrooms i specifically ordered a pizza without mushrooms, and they gave him the wrong pizza with mushrooms on it, how terrible is that to wait 2 hours for ur order, drive and pick it urself and cameback n realise he cant eat the pizza..Worst pizza chain ever, i dont even know why are they expanding when they cant even handle one branch properlyShow less

Author: pianocello
Title: Good pizza
Review: While not really cheap, the variety of pizza is a step up from your usual franchise outlet. Service was fast. Side dishes were decent too. We will be back.

Author: amelianeoh
Title: Best Pizza in Town
Review: This outlet is a staple comfort food among residents here, and their mushroom chicken pizza is no exception! Two thumbs up!

Author: Ckm777Toronto, Canada
Title: CHEESE BOAT! Ooey Gooey!!
Review: Great vibe here with American south music, diner look and lighting! Not to mention the great food served. Lots of variety of pizzas to choose from.The cheese boat is full of melty mozzarella and can add duck and salty egg to it for another layered experience.About 5 tables indoors and many more in covered outdoor seating.Show less

Author: 525bernards
Title: Super delicious pizza
Review: Highly recommended place, the bolognese pizza is the best. Price also very reasonable, a place for family and friends

Author: Summon_2828
Title: Tasty !!
Review: Great and tasty pizza with unique pizza flavour to choose. The service there was great too!! Definitely must try out once!!

Author: john_u2828
Title: tasty!!!
Review: the pizza was delicious and the atmosphere of the shop was great. great choice of music and old school vibe

Author: JACQUELINE_CATHY
Title: Birthday celebration
Review: Enjoyed my belated birthday celebration here. All staff are friendly and helpful. Especially loving the Cheese Boat

Author: Fz_125
Title: Gud
Review: Very gud and very delicious food.Staff is very friendly.The female manager named shally is very friendly.I think she is the best manager for pizza restaurant in the world.

Author: RaymondLaw233
Title: Great pizza chain!!!
Review: This pizza chain served unique pizza with mixture of Malaysian styles!! They even have cheeseboat pizza which allows you to pull the cheese as long as you can!! Must try their pizza!!

Title: Very Good !
Review: The environment inside the restaurant is very nice and the food quality is nice. The staff is very polite and nice.

lots of choices and great environment.

Author: py200777
Title: Enjoy meal at US pizza
Review: I love the US pizza very much and definitely will come back again for meals. Recommended for those who loves cheese.

Author: ps211181
Title: Lunch at US pizza
Review: Very delicious pizza. I enjoy my lunch with my sister. The pizza is served hot from the oven. Truly recommended.

Author: zoeehjayess
Title: DELICIOUS!
Review: Tried US pizza for the first time today and it was superb! Food is yummy. Love the icedtea especially. The restaurant was fully packed when I arrived. 😱 would be better if the place was bigger tho! Other than that, 👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻

Author: rachelChock
Title: Delicious
Review: Yummy and delicious, definitely must try. Especially the durian, salted egg, cempedak pizza. Yummy...

Title: Wonderful food
Review: Awesome food and service , pls come and try! Definitely worth your try ! Will come back again very soon

Title: awesome pizza
Review: great and delicious food. excellent environment. i will repeat again because its delicious and yummy.. my friend and family also like this pizza

Author: aliaghazalee
Title: Perfect
Review: It’s so cheesy and i love it 🥰 perfect crust and the ingredients is well maintenance. Besides the food didn’t take too long with the good service.

Author: Susan T
Title: Delicious pizza
Review: Unique and various type of pizza to choose....the pizza is delicious and the price is worthy as there is a great amount of toppings!!

Author: kkei2019
Title: Best Food In town
Review: I love to come for their pizza, They Have best pizza in town and this is the best place to hang out.

Author: darrenreese
Title: Good stuff
Review: Good stuff... OK pizza.. Good people. . Uh, good pizza? Good people? Good stuff? Damn good lol.. Bruh, it's awesome... We got this..

Author: themonthofMAY
