Review: We had a few meals here and enjoyed each one. The beers are cold the curry is tasty and delicious ice cream. The staff are on hand and offer great service.

Author: Joanna O
Title: Very good!
Review: Tasty and cheap Indian restaurant, we order Chicken cashew with naan, can recommend to anyone in Batu Ferringhi

Author: Colin B
Title: Very Tasty Indian Food
Review: I was looking for some North Indian food and came accross the Enca Cafe and Restaurant. The reviews for this place are quite good and once you have tried the food you understand why. Very tasty Indian food!Next time I am in Batu Ferringhi I will be back.Show less

Author: djseige02
Title: Good food for both dine in and take out
Review: The food variety is really good. On our first visit to this place we enjoyed the dine in option and were quite amazed at the spread and variety of options this restoran had to offer. What was really good was the quantity and quality. Following our good experience with them we have dined here atleast 4 more times since we arrived here last week.Great food keep up the good work guys.Show less

Author: Louly TCalgary, Canada
Title: Food is mediocre at best
Review: On my first day at Batu Ferringhi, I decided to have dinner at Enca Cafe as it was right across the street from my hotel. Needless to say, I was very disappointed with the food here. I ordered tandoori chicken that came with “salads” and a couple of chutneys and naan, mango juice, and veggie raita. Don’t even bother with the mango juice unless you like drinking sour mango juice. Tandoori chicken clearly had food colouring in it, tasted ok but nothing to write home about! The “salads” that it came with was a tiny portion of raw white and purple onions and shredded carrots. Naan was not fresh, it came cold not even heated up! Raita was a completely different story as I’m very particular about my raita! How could you mess up raita?! It came very thick almost Greek yogurt texture and sweet???!!!! I asked the waiter if it had sugar, he said yes so I gave it back to him, asked him to fix the sweetness and the thickness. He took it back, disappeared for 5 mins, and brought me back the same raita! He fixed absolutely nothing! I was very disappointed not just with the food but with the service as well! I also killed two bugs, one was on the table making its way to my plate, the other on my elbow.Show less

Author: S_Li_2000Melbourne, Australia
Title: Great food and service
Review: We found this restaurant on our last day which is such a shame because it’s one of the best meals we had in Batu Feringghi. It was a five minute walk from our hotel, Hard Rock and had so much choice that everyone was happy. From pizza (kids declared it better than the one from the hotel!) to Indian (Masala chicken curry with naan was delicious) to Malay (chicken satay and fried rice was yummy). All washed down with cold coconut juice, lychee drink and teh tarik. Service was friendly and a fraction of the price compared to the hotel. Definitely one to try!Show less

Author: AnitaM1497
Title: Delicious food
Review: We have been in BF for a week and have eaten here nearly every single day! Delicious Indian and Arabic food, very generous serving sizes and fresh produce. The staff are really kind and friendly and have been happy to adapt meals to suit our family. Big hit with the kids.Show less

Author: shellj0Northern Territory, Australia
Title: Great place to eat
Review: We have had a few meals at Enca, great food, service and value for money every time, that's why we return! Can highly recommend the butter chicken and garlic naan. The pizza, fresh juices, lamb korma and chicken satay were high on the must have list too! Thanks Enca! Show less

Author: lizzygf
Title: Fabulous
Review: Great food, service and price. One of the best meals I had in Batu Ferringhi. Love it. Family friendly. Lots of choice, Local, Indian and western food. Vegetarian choice also which is not easy to find.

Author: anorakmarkChatham, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent Indian cuisine, Highly recommend
Review: We have visited the Enca Café and Restaurant for the 3rd consecutive year and again can only praise this place for excellence. The food is amazing and beautifully presented. If you like a hot curry then ask for an extra hot chicken Vindaloo, you will not be disappointed. The nann bread is excellent, especially the onion and garlic. I've tried all most every item on the menu and can't say a bad word. All the food is absolutely delicious. Very clean surroundings and lovely friendly staff and atmosphere. As an added bonus the owner also has a hawker stall at Long beach and again the food is brilliant. I will be returning to Penang in 2019 for my 4th visit and Enca Café and restaurant will be my first port of call. Well done to all the staff for a fantastic cuisine experience. I'm gonna miss you until next year. My rating is, 5 ⭐⭐⭐ with a massive 10/10.Show less

Author: Cathy A
Title: good indian tucker
Review:
very inexpensive restaurant serves a variety of food but we had indian, butter chicken and a curry with naan bread very generous servings and good food was hot but not too hot 
good service and nice cold beer

Author: jonw325
Title: Great curry and naan - we are definitely coming back
Review: We very much enjoyed our lunch. The lamb curry had excellent flavor and the cheese and garlic naan melted in your mouth. We are definitely coming back for more meals.

Author: s6sat
Title: Must Visit
Review: We went on recommendation and so glad we did, such excellent food certainly did not disappoint we returned a few time during our 10 day holiday. Flavours and spices in your food nothing like we have tasted before. Staff so helpful. Thank you.

Author: Smith01EnglandEngland
Title: Value for money
Review: We visited the Enca last year whilst on holiday and enjoyed all of our meals. We have been back again this last month and like last year we have enjoyed all of our meals. The menu is varied and inexpensive. The staff are friendly, helpful and very cheerful. The best Indian meal in Batu. Worth a visit.Show less

Author: rod sNewbury, United Kingdom
Title: great Food
Review: Located opposite the Bay view hotel this unpretentious restaurant caters for all tastes with an extensive menu of local,north indian and western food.Can get quite busy at times so service can be a little slow,but worth the wait .Staff are friendly food is delicious plentiful and in expensive .A great find .Show less

Author: robinarobrobina
Title: First time
Review: My daughter and I recently stayed at the Bayview hotel right opposite twice we visited this restaurant and we were not disappointed The first night we had Indian we sat at the front The food was fantastic so cheap but really tasty Second night we were late coming back from George Town around 9 pm they are still open we had a chicken tandoori pizza so good They have 3 different area for cooking One for pizzas one for Thai and the rest for everything else western food etc I highly recommend this restaurant Show less

Author: femiknitterBangkok, Thailand
Title: Best Indian food on the island!
Review: This is definitely the best Indian food you'll get in Penang. It's a simple an unassuming restaurant with such delicious food. I've eaten there many times when I visit Penang and I'll keep going back, it's that good. It's cheap and consistent so definitely check it out when you're in Batu. They have pizza and other Western options if you're with people who don't like Indian food.Show less

Author: Larry LSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good indian Food
Review: Normal looking restaurant without aircon. Serving different types of cuisine. We tried the Indian cuisine. Food quite tasty but service a bit slow even though there were only 3 tables of customer at that time. Not too sure about price relative to the food served but personally I think its a bit on the high side maybe because most of their customers are tourist.Show less

Author: becksoclockSt. Neots, United Kingdom
Title: Great food at a good price
Review: Staying at hard rock which is quite expensive. Went here and decided on Indian food, we were not disappointed!Poppadums & dipsChilli chickenCashew chicken2 naanRice4 beers All for less than £20!Service was polite and quick and the food was excellent.We will definitely go again before we leaveShow less

Author: C8875BOjasonr
Title: Never judge a book by its cover
Review: We would fully agree with some of the previous reviews, the external look and decor isn’t a good guide to how good the food is. The food, especially the Indian dishes, were extremely tasty with good portions.  A family of 4 left very satisfied.

Author: AndrewU_11Perth, Australia
Title: Surprisingly good
Review: I think, like a number of other reviewers, that my expectations for this restaurant were quite low given its appearance and location. However, after ordering form the extensive menu we were very pleased with the quality of the food.We ordered a pizza for the children, which they wolfed down, and my wife had saag aloo while I had chicken tika. The tika was a little dry, but he saag aloo was fantastic.Very enjoyable.Show less

Author: Donnievv
Title: Surprisingly good we went back twice
Review: This place was right across from our hotel. It definitely does not look like the nicest place but my friend popped in the evening before late at night as he was hungry and told us about it. We decided to give it a try and it was so good we went back twice. The service was great, the waiters were friendly and very helpful. There was no aircon but they had a couple of big fans. They served local food and western food. They specialized in Indian food and man was it good. They were crazy cheap as well. Very much worth a try.Show less

Author: GojavasBengaluru, India
Title: The best Indian restaurant in Batu Ferringhi area
Review: As mentioned in other reviews in tripadvisor, this place is ranked as one of the best restaurants in the Batu Ferringhi area and it definitely lives up to its billing. We were staying in Bayview resort and this restaurant is right opposite the resort across the road. We arrived here on Tuesday afternoon around 2.30 pm and were super hungry after checking into our room. We ordered Butter naan, Cheese naan, Chicken vindaloo, Veg vindaloo, plain rice, Mint lassi, nescafe and watermelon juice. All the dishes were excellent and no words to describe the taste !!! I think they have a specialist cook from India or Pakistan and do a great job in feeding hungry souls like us :-) The bill came upto RM 57 for all the above and we found it very reasonable. We went back again on Thursday afternoon for a lovely Teh Tarikh, Nescafe and some french fries. I would recommend a must visit to this place if you are staying in the Batu Ferringhi area.Note that this restaurant accepts ONLY Cash . Also parking is available on the road near the restaurant and in nearby Bayview or Hardrock if you are put up there.Show less

Author: alisonf90
Title: Delicious!
Review: Yummy food. Opposite Bayview Hotel. Great prices. I enjoyed an amazing veggie okra curry. Used by locals. Always a good sign!

Author: 779craigpAustralia
Title: Service or lack of
Review: Ate there tonight, the food was ok but not a pinch on the street food I had at lunch. But what let it down the most was their lack of service. They over looked us twice before taking our order, the food delivered was close but not what was advertised and at the end I sat and amused myself while I watched flustrated customers try to gain the attention of the waiter to either order or pay for their meal. All the time time dirty dishes were piling up on the tables of those lucky few that had managed to pay and escape. Not sure last nights efforts will do much for their ratings. Show less

Author: jpf862Zoetermeer, The Netherlands
Title: Good Indian food
Review: I had the lamb roganjosh, with plain rice and a cheese and garlic naan. The food was good. At first I though it wouldn't enough, since the lamb was served in such a small bowl. I left the restaurant feeling full.The location is in front the Bayview Beach Resort. I think this place should focus on the Indian flavours, perfect it and then promote it. Now they offer Italian, Thai, Malay food... Show less

Author: KevinG2627
Title: Family dinner
Review: Had a lovely  meal , chicken tikka was great how ever other dishes were spiceier than the meals, with the same name back home

Author: Tina_evilheartSingapore, Singapore
Title: Cheap and good
Review: Nice food and friendly staff. Had the tomyum soup which was good and also the naan. The teh tarik was soooo nice! Finished up our food even though I wasn't that hungry. Value for money if you don't want to spend so much on food. Thumbs up! Show less

Author: VeeraS120Helsinki, Finland
Title: Excellent food despite the appearance
Review: We decided to grab a late lunch at this place across our hotel, because of the high reviews. Despite the looks on the outside, we weren't disappointed. Our curry and vegetables dishes coupled with some rice, naan bread and raita yogurt salad were absolutely delicious. The staff was also very friendly. If I were to stay longer at Penang, might very well be coming back for the food. Show less

Author: Craig F
Title: Food!!
Review: Excellent food and service, as a family group if 6 we have eaten here twice and would highly recommend, do your tastebuds a favour and try this place

Author: rzinger
Title: Amazing variety of food!
Review: I always love eating here because I try something new every time and it’s always delicious! Lots of tasty food and good service.

Author: scootjaGeelong, Australia
Title: Delicious! Both vege or meat options were excellent.
Review: Delicious Indian food packed with flavour, great breads, rice and starters. Kids can choose more basic options such as pasta if desired. On one occasion service was very slow at peak hour, so plan accordingly. We went back several times during our stay and other times were fine. Very friendly staff, great value, wish we had this restaurant in our home town!Show less

Author: stephen2912Adelaide, Australia
Title: always value for money
Review: the food here is always so good and he large menu provided is sure to give something that you will like . The food and service was excellent and tasty , served hot . The only thing i did note is we ate here twice and 1 day we were served 4 slices of Garlic bread the next time 3 ? not a big issue . The Banana milkshakes are made with real bananas and a great as wellShow less

Author: EmilyS8712
Title: Friendly staff, nice food
Review: Our 1st time visit and once we entered the staff immediately welcome us.  The outlet is clean and variety kind of foods can be found here with reasonable price.  No regrets!

Author: JohnDavid_1956Adelaide, Australia
Title: Fabulous Food and Fantastic Service
Review: If you love Indian food then Enca should be your first destination when visiting Penang. I have been coming to Penang for more than 30 Years now and it is always my first dinner experience of each trip. Then, of course, I can’t resist coming back, again and again. My wife will often have a pizza or Italian pasta. It is as good as any Maxine has had in Italian restaurants in our home town of Adelaide. Surely that says it all. We love Enca and the friendly host, Manak, will always look after you. PS you must try the onion bhaji and samosa ... yum!Show less

Author: alokv895New Delhi, India
Title: Pathetic Food, Worst Service
Review: After reading the reviews on TripAdvisor......Have been there on 7th September in a group of 8 with family and friends..... Only for name sake they are the best in Indian Foods in Penang. Half cooked Indian food with no taste is their speciallity....by chance if you order multiple things it will take them 1hr to 1.5hrs to feed you. Half of your group will have nothing to eat during this time.There waiters will look more interested in other foreigners except Indians. Full of attitude and arrogance....High recommendation: Dear Indians, kindly avoid this place this is not for you. Specially North Indians.ThanksShow less

Author: RoweysBristol, United Kingdom
Title: Great food
Review: We had two great meals at Enca whilst on holiday in Batu Ferringhi, we were a group of 8 with children and everybody enjoyed their meals. Onion rings, bhajis and samosas were great. The kids loved their curries as did the adults. The staff were very friendly and food was great value.Show less

Author: Mike CPerth, Australia
Title: Superb
Review: Have been twice in the last two days. The first time we popped in for a mid afternoon snack and ordered chicken tikka and onion rings both were that good we came the next day for dinner and once again we were very impressed with the superb food and outstanding value for money. Do not walk past without sampling you will not be disappointed.Show less

Author: Pjf10
Title: Fantastic!
Review: Eaten twice and both times were excellent. Highly recommend onion bhaji, chicken jalfrezi or chicken tikka. Great staff and service.

Author: JoyD1491
Title: Delicious
Review: Had a lovely meal in here two nights in a row as we enjoyed it so much the first time. Delicious food, helpful and friendly waiters and very good value for money. We would definitely come back if we visit batu ferringhi again.

Author: troymcguckinKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Very nice.
Review: We ate lunch here today. Kids loved their parmys. My butter prawn was pretty good. My wife had the sizzling squid. She said it was nice but squid a bit overcooked but that could be due to me and my wife outfront for a bit while it sat on the table sizzling away on a hot plate. Yep our fault lol. So all in all a very nice place with very nice food and prices too.Show less

Author: cardiffcwtchCardiff, United Kingdom
Title: Best Indian Cuisine in Batu Ferringhi
Review: We visited Enca twice, drawn by the wonderfully wide range of curries. The food was generally great; my dish of chilli lamb with boiled rice will go down as one of the best curries I’ve ever eaten. Also enjoyed were the tandoori chicken biryani and the jalfrezi - both vegetable and chicken varieties. Naan breads were delicious. We sampled the very reasonable garlic, Kashmiri and cheese versions all of which were in sizeable portions.As we love a cold beer with our curry, we were disappointed to see that it didn’t appear on the menu. However, Tiger beer is available on request and is served in a sleeve. The only reservation I have about the entire establishment was the state of the toilets which left something to be desired. Staying at the Rasa Sayang, Enca was a substantial trek on a humid evening, so the second visit saw us take a taxi. At a mere RM13, it was well worth it. The bill ranged from RM 230-250, which was astonishing, given the amount of food. Enca may not look like much from the street but is certainly worth trying. Show less

Author: KayDawn97Arizona
Title: Curry
Review: My friends and I went here for lunch and it was delicious. We all got different kinds of curry- I had the chicken cashew curry- and loved it. Also, you have to get naan. The cheese garlic naan was really good. An order of naan came with about 4-5 slices. Show less

Author: D1755QOmichellepBentleigh, Australia
Title: Tasty Dishes and Excellent Service
Review: We noticed that this restaurant was always busy and gave it a go.. we were not disappointed. The menu is varied offering Indian, Malaysian, Western etc and we tried lots of different meals. All were delicious! The service was friendly and accomodating and it was all very cheap. If you are staying anywhere near the Hard Rock Hotel, this place is definitely worth a visit. Show less

Author: sharonmT201PQBentleigh East, Australia
Title: Great service and food
Review: Stayed at the Hard Rock Hotel but had most of our dinners here - just across the road and a little way up to the right. Food includes Indian, pizza/pasta, Western and some local dishes. We tried all cuisines except Western (can get plenty of that back home) and it was all good, but the Indian was particularly exceptional. Friendly service and good prices - highly recommended.Show less

Author: 911barrycAvoca Beach, Australia
Title: Average Indian
Review: We went there last night expecting a real good Indian meal as recommended by Tripadvisor as the best Indian in Batu Ferringhi.Came away a little disappointed.The lamb rogan josh was more like a madras, the chicken dopiaza was very strange, and the sag alloo needed more spinach.Not bad but probably wouldn’t go back.Show less

Author: meeganmac
Title: Good Indian food
Review: Great service and menu offers Indian as well as western food.   The Indian food is very tasty and Great value for money.         Decor is nothing flash but good overall.

Author: occasionaltravele939
Title: Varied cuisine at great prices with friendly service
Review: We ate twice at Enca, across the street from Bayview Resort.  The menu is quite wide, the prices very good, and the taste delicious. Best of all, the wait staff are very friendly and helpful, and speak English

Author: Malkavmax
Title: Last night short visit
Review: Overall good experience. Very broad menu that goes from western to local food. Good quality. Good service. Basic locatoin but everything fits well. My choice was ok (tuna sandwich), also local dishes are tasty and good size.

Author: Rob B
Title: Great Indian food and so cheap
Review: Starter of onion bhaji (shown on menu as vagi) were very light and tasty.Main course: butter prawns- superb. Lamb with spinach also excellent. Tiger beer and white wine- white wine was average. Surroundings not great but after reading previous reviews we decided to give it a go and was not disappointed. We stayed at Hard Rock Hotel and this restaurant is just up the road a very short distance.Very reasonably priced and well worth a visit.Show less

Author: Laurence GPerth, Australia
Title: Great Place - Love it
Review: Visited this restaurant again after being here three years ago. Nothing has changed, the food is awesome and the service is friendly. We had tandoori chicken, lamb marsala, some vegetable curry, onion bhajis, pappadums, garlic naans, mixed vegetables, beers and fresh juices. And my father in law, who wasn't well just wanted something plain, had fish and chips and thoroughly enjoyed it.At a cost of $140MYR for 4 of us it's great value. Super place. Show less

Author: LauraM17277
Title: Amazing Indian
Review: Food was tasty and decent portions! We tried the masala, butter chicken, tandoori chicken and the spicy lamb! We were very impressed by the flavours and loved the naan bread and raita ! Very decent price too.

Author: z_c00l
Title: Great taste with loads of variety
Review: thought I drop by to just have some local cuisine. Price was slightly high...tourist spot. But the meal was really tasty. I had Ayam Tandoori with Nan. Kids ordered Spaghetti Bolognese. Also had samosa.

Author: 170nicholasjFife
Title: Excellent food, don’t judge this book by its cover
Review: Chose this due to reviews on here and so glad we did. Looks like nothing from he outside, which is standard for restaurants along here. They all look pretty nasty with a few exceptions. Enca further worries you by having a menu that surfs across Indian, Arab, Italian and Western cuisine...its always a worry when a place claims to master so many things. Well we had spaghetti carbonara and garlic bread, chicken korma, cashew chicken and tandoori lamb. Lamb was a bit bony as a lot of meat is in Penang, but tasted superb. The curries and spag were exceptionally good. For the meal plus 2 seven ups and 4 beers was RM146. An absolute bargain at a place across the road from the hard rock hotel which I suspect would have been four times that. Enca is really REALLY good. Show less

Author: esstenn
Title: Great place
Review: Great service, very friendly. Tried their amazing indian food and naan bread, very authentic,absolutely delicious. Delicious mango lassi. Inexpensive

Author: benny_emmanuel
Title: Good food
Review: Loved the food and the cost was very affordable! Would highly rate the Indian food. The tandoori platter was delicious  staffs were friends and forthcoming.

Author: Ken W
Title: First visit here
Review: As we were staying at Hard Rock Hotel we tried Enca for the first time as friends had eaten there regularly.We could not fault the food, service, and cost, but were disappointed when we tried again a few days later that the place was closed for a day or two.we would certainly return here next trip and recommend the place.Show less

Author: caiof923
Title: Great food for an affordable price
Review: Friendly staff, clean place, cheap dishes and delicious food! A must try! We tried many fancy restaurants in the island and this one is a very simple with amazing food! Definitely recommended!

Author: FinjackNorth Wales
Title: Best Chicken Tikka my wife has ever had
Review: On first impressions the restaurant doesn't look overly inviting, but wait till you get the food. My wife had the Chicken tikka set and I had Chicken Jalfrezi. Both were excellent, my wife said it was the best tikka she had ever tasted. We returned on another evening and I tried the Chicken tikka and I can only concur with my wife's opinion. Excelent foodShow less

Author: james bOxford, United Kingdom
Title: Great Curries and Byriani
Review: Excellent Indian restaurant directly opposite the Bayview Beach Hotel where I was staying for 26 nights. I ate at this restaurant many times and thoroughly enjoyed the food. The staff, who were from Bangladesh, were very friendly. Service was excellent. As well as the curries and byriani the onion bahji, the nan and the soup were all excellent. They also do a wide variety of non-Indian meals. Highly recommended.Show less

Author: JEP30
Title: Extremely friendly staff and great food
Review: Went a few times during my visit to Penang and had fabulous food which included a wonderful tandoori whole fish the best onion bhaji I have ever had

Author: Noreena LJersey, United Kingdom
Title: A must try restaurant
Review: Beside the Bay View and Hard Rock Hotels on the outskirts of Batu Ferringhi this eatery is a must try for excellent curry and accompanying side dishes.cooked to order and taste it is definitely worth a trip up the hill.very friendly staff to advise on what to try.Show less

Author: KentuckyBob
Title: Best food of my whole trip
Review: This place has authentic Indian and Lebanese food that's every bit as good as what I know from long experience in Dubai, India and Lebanon. Three of us stuffed ourself for $25 total, drinks and all,  including a couple of beers.

Author: Anne Mary STaunton, United Kingdom
Title: Terribly disappointed with cashew curry
Review: I saw very good reviews on this Restuarant and as we are staying just across road at Hard Rock Hotel thought we would go tonight to have a curry. As I only ever enjoy a mild curry I chose a curry with cashew nuts and creamy sauce described as 'mild'. It didn't have one cashew nut in it or taste anything like cashew nuts - it tasted so hot, just like someone had just thrown curry powder into some cream and added some pieces of chicken breast. I couldn't eat it because it had no infused flavours at all and I can't take a very hot curry. When I ask where the cashew nuts were, the waiter just said the nuts were just blended in! There was absolutely no infusion of cashew nuts in there. Very very disappointed as I love a really creamy mild curry with cashew nuts back in the UK. Definitely the worst 'curry' I have ever tasted. Also the table cloth was really filthy so all in all a disaster meal here in Batu Ferringhi!Show less

Author: buddy195
Title: Good food
Review: Visited several times as just over the road from our hotel. Cannot fault the Indian style cooking they have on offer. Staff very friendly and very competitive prices.

Author: Purple0wl
Title: Good menu and service.
Review: Varied menu of curries, western and Italian food, service is attentive and it has a pleasant atmosphere. Curries can be made to your spice taste. Fresh juices are a must try here.

Author: finnternationalPerth, Australia
Title: Excellent
Review: We were tending to eat in the big touristy restaurants and wanted to try something a bit more local. We had 3 children and were so impressed with Enca we went back for a second night. They don’t have a kids menu as such but were very accommodating for the kids, they halved a meal onto 2 plates and made my daughter the pizza she wanted. Adults had Indian food and it was really good, as were the fresh juices. Cost about half the price of the fancier places which was the bonus at the end. Recommended especially if you are staying at the Bayview Beach and it’s pouring with rain! Show less

Author: Meagan506Moncton, Canada
Title: Good food and prices
Review: I stayed in Batu Ferringhi for two days, and I at here on both days. There are many options to choose from, and they're all reasonably priced. The staff are friendly, but not over-the-top (which is a plus for me, as I don't like to be bothered).Show less

Author: Arwa M
Title: Lunch
Review: Delicious desi food...butter chicken butter naan solid combination...friendly atmosphere....gave us helpful info

Author: annette6942London, United Kingdom
Title: Little gem
Review: Absolutely loved this restaurant. Possibly the best lamb jalfrezi I’ve ever had, so tasty. Also the spicy potato curry & biryani was extremely good too. If you are looking for good Indian food this is definitely the place to go. Prices very reasonable & service great. My favourite meal of the holiday. Show less

Author: 173s_bastienm
Title: Good food. Good price. Good service
Review: We went three time in this restaurant. Lot of choice. People are nice. Food was good This restaurant is a very good deal compare the the restaurant in hotel.

Author: juliewN3407XZ
Title: Indian
Review: Had dinner here after all the great reviews and was not disappointed in the least. Not the best decor. But food absolutely amazing and the service was awesome.. if you like Indian  food make sure you visit. Opposite Bayview resort..

Author: ahjojo
Title: Value for money and great food
Review:
Price reasonable and great food. We love the fried kuay tiao and tandoori chicken.
Staff were friendly. One of the better meals we had in batu area.

Author: Gary-PK77
Title: Dirty
Review: Provably the dirtiest restaurant we have ever been in, visited purely on the number of good reviews on here, can only assume the people who left before ordering or eating never took the time to review

Author: tiggeroneLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Fantastic little Gem
Review: We were staying at the Bayview Hotel across the road from this Cafe and Restaurant. The staff are extremely helpful and the food and flavours are amazing. We ordered Onion Vagi and Chicken tikka masala and an onion nan. The cost very excellent about £8.00 . Mohamed was great always smiling and happy to help. Hope to see you all again next year. Thank you again for all our meals.Show less

Author: alexbroadbent12
Title: Fantastic Food
Review: My boyfriend and I stayed in the Bayview Hotel opposite Enca and ended up going 3 times during our stay. Fantastic Indian food, so tasty and a great variety of dishes and flavours. We especially enjoyed the Lamb Spinach. Would recommend this restaurant to anyone. Great food and great serviceShow less

Author: skylinediary
Title: Good quality and value for money
Review: We were a group of seven each ordered a different dish and were all pleased with the quality and price and service we got.

Author: Searoo
Title: Good halal food in front of our hotel (Bayview)
Review: Indian food and it was pretty popular and relatively busy, also recommended by one of our taxi drivers so we checked it out. Can't recommend a specific food as its been a while since I was there and I forgot how they tasted, but was an ok experience with no highs or lows to mention.Show less

Author: LeighBlen
Title: Great food ..."".
Review: Not the flashiest street appeal but more than make up for that with quality food, good service and plenty of options. Highly recommended the curries and naan. Cold beer too.

Author: Ali D
Title: Try it!
Review: It's an authentic restaurant with fresh and delicious food. We tried grilled fish and chicken curry. Also the garlic naan bread was great - Yummy! Staff is very friendly and helpful.

Author: tahrad2014
Title: Good curries
Review: Good for curries, pizzas not so great. Friendly staff, good service  - definitely the best option for lunch outside of hard rock hotel.

Author: petet_007
Title: Inexpensive dinig with lots of choice
Review: We never go to Batu Ferringhi without at least one visit to this cafe ... always great food at cheap prices ,,, Indian, Chinese, Malaysian, Pizzas, Wester ... and more

Author: Ursula DLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Good Indian food
Review: We did not go to the main restaurant in the southern part of Batu Ferringhi, but to their branch in Jalan Sungai Emas (the street off the main road opposite the Golden Sands hotel) which is located in the lobby of a small hotel (they have three outlets now). The lobby was open fronted so you can watch the world go by.The menu featured a lot of the Indian favourites - there may have been some Malay, Chinese and other dishes as well, I don't remember as we were only looking for decent Indian food. We ordered chicken tikka masala, bhindi masala, and Bombay aloo with chapatis. Everything was fine, prepared by competent chefs although not outstanding. Three dishes were definitely enough for two of us. Service by the single waiter was pleasant, and prices were average. Drinking soda water, we paid MYR 54 incl tip for our meal.Show less

Author: Christine Y
Title: Awesome food and service
Review: Went to Enca for dinner. Ordered Pizza, pasta, tandoori chicken, chilli beef, lamb vindaloo and different types of naan. Their food are delicious and naan outstanding. Service are good as well. Will definitely return if we are in this area again.

Author: Efbe R
Title: every dish tasty.
Review: went there with family and friends. the local and the Italian food was tasty. friendly and helpful service. fair prices. came back many times.

Author: AlexL84
Title: Excellent Food
Review: Visited Enca based on reviews.I can't add anything that's not already been posted. Excellent Indian food served by friendly guys .Good value too.Cant see where you could go wrong really.

Author: Mclgs
Title: Average food
Review:
We eat the night we arrived to the Bayview Beach hotel because it was in front of the hotel.
Not very impressed with either the quality of the food and the service.

Author: anitac890
Title: Great Indian food
Review: Chicken tikka, sag aloo, onion baji all so tasty. Top quality food. Great service. The kids liked the pizza although I wasn't so keen on the processed pizza base. We will definitely come back.

Author: hazelkennedy
Title: Great food
Review:
We ate here on our first night in Malaysia and were not disappointed.  The food was extremely good.  They cater for all - delicious local dishes, curry and even pizza and pasta.  All really good.
Will definitely return

Author: Grandadfred
Title: Great Meals & Friendly Staff
Review: We ate here at Enca's on two occasions when in Penang.A very comprehensive menu.Malaysian, Indian and Western dishes were all available and at very reasonable prices.Staff were very friendly and helped with your choice of meal.When in Penang Give Enca a try----You won't be disappointed.

Author: OzTrottingGlobeSyney
Title: Simple, delicious and very reasonably priced food
Review: Had a dinner and a lunch at this friendly restaurant and was pleasantly surprised by the quality of the food and the friendliness of the staff. It's more a rustic street-side Cafe and a step-up from the street food places all around this area. It's clean, cutlery is clean and offers Indian, Arabic, Malay & Western food. Since we were staying at the Bayview Beach Resort across the road, it was fairly easy access. So anyone staying across at Resorts such as Bayview, Holiday Inn, Hard Rock, Golden Sands, etc., along Ferringhi Beach and feel like a non-posh simple, inexpensive meal, then pop into ENCA. Show less

Author: averageSurreyblokeCarshalton, United Kingdom
Title: Good curry but lacking spice
Review: There are 2 Enca restaurants in Town-this one is opposite Bay View.I enjoyed my meal here but for me it was lacking spiciness. I ordered Chicken Vindaloo,Vegetable Madahura,rice & garlic/cheese naan. When ordering I expressed that I wanted my food extra spicy-the man said no problem.The food arrived & from the 1st mouthful the dishes had no real spice kick!!! The man came around to see if it was too spicy-i said it was not spicy enough,he replied,next time I will do it more spicy!!! So what was the point of him agreeing to make it extra spicy when I ordered!? It would have been my fault if it was too spicy for me to eat.This is not a negative review,i just wish I had got what I asked for!Show less

Author: jackw53London, United Kingdom
Title: A Great Indian/Italian Eatery
Review: Having visited this establishment on many other occasions it is the first time we have tried their Italian offerings - mainly pasta dishes and Pizza but all well prepared and tasty. They even do a carry out service which is great if you want to eat back in your own room/apartment.Show less

Author: Vince Y
Title: Variety from Local to Italian Cuisine
Review:
Cleanliness : Yes
Food Variety : A lot of Choice from Indian Food to Italian Food
Beer : Yes
Price : Reasonable
Friendly : Yes ( Will advise if the food order is more than enough)

Author: Sylvia T
Title: Fantastic curries
Review: Went here a few times and had excellent food. A varied menu with the curry exceptionally good. Always seems busy so that tells you a lot.

Author: Mark G
Title: Marvellous Indian Food
Review: Anywhere where you can see the spices being ground freshly in the kitchen is going to be good, and this place was. Fantastic flavours I have not experienced outside of Goa!

Author: Rob GRed Deer, Canada
Title: Great curries!
Review: We ate at Enca a few times - lunch and dinner - and were never disappointed. The curries and tandoor are wonderful and it's worth noting that the chicken is well-trimmed breast meat, not the grisly, fatty meat we had at a few places. Dinner for two people with 2 beers and 2 wines was about RM70. We highly recommend Enca!Show less

Author: josephdavid2805
Title: Great Experience
Review: Awesome Naan breads, great and friendly service makes this a very good place for a decent meal on a budget.

Author: wendy494Chelmsford, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent Indian food - loved it!
Review: This restaurant, like many, looks nothing with dodgy chairs and tables, photos of food and plastic chairs but the food is some of the best we have had - we eat Indian food every week & know what good tastes like & such great value!5 beers - Ice cold glasses and jackets to keep cold.We had veg rice and butter nan - spicy potatoes - these were delicious - highly recommended!I had garlic prawns - 4 large prawns which I thought would not be enough but with everything else it was plenty - just me thinking like a pig again !!! - the sauce was soooo good - I licked the plate. Hubby had chicken masala - lovely chunks of white and moist chicken in fab spicy sauce. The great thing was that this only costs 113 RM which we thought fantastic value and we will definitely be back Butter chicken or maybe jalfrezi, or should I have lamb rogon josh.... butter or Keema nan...Show less

Author: kristyleebForresters Beach, Australia
Title: Great Indian dinner
Review: We stopped by at Enca after reading other Trip Adviser reviews and seeing how full the place was. We had a lovely Indian dinner - very well priced and all the food was delicious.Whilst we are Indian the restaurant also serves Pizza's which smelt great and a range of western food options Show less

Author: nathanshaine
Title: One of the best Indian Curry in town
Review: This restaurant is located across of Bayview Hotel. They served one of the best Indian curry in town. Their Naan bread is so good paired with curry. They served good food with affordable price.

Author: WingecarribeeCanberra, Australia
Title: Great Indian food.
Review: I visited this restaurant twice and enjoyed both meals. I only had the more mild curries butter chicken and korma with condiments but there is a good selection of spicier/hotter curries as well as grills. The food was freshly cooked and very tasty, much better than food served from bain-maries at Indian diners back home. Perhaps it is the locality being part of the Spice Trade Route and long connections with Indian culture.Basic décor setting but very friendly service and reasonable prices. Highly recommend.Show less

Author: Hel53
Title: Fantastic food
Review: We went here a few times across the road from bayview hotel . The food was excellent . They had varied menu , their currys were excellent and their onion bhajis were lovely . Would reccomend .

Author: T4456LIkevinr
Title: Top food, top service
Review: Food was first class and the staff were great. Extensive menu, the 4 of us all had different cuisines and all were great.

Author: maso023Wollongong, Australia
Title: Great food
Review: We make this place our first stop after we check into the Bayview and the food has never failed us yet. My husband has grilled fish fillet with lemon butter sauce and I always have Char Kway Teow, service is always good and the staff are very welcoming and polite......give this place a tryShow less

Author: 716jpv
Title: Fresh fish tandoori; what more you like?
Review: Fresh fish tandoori. Lovely fish. Lovely price. You like pizza? No problem. Also nice. Staff is friendly. A beer is not on the menu, but a nice, cold Tiger arrives if you ask for it.

Author: Jewels680Sheffield, United Kingdom
Title: A little off the strip but worth the effort
Review: Had the urge for that most english meal,a curry. This place is near the Hard Rock Hotel and i guess you could hop on there shuttle.Staff helpful. Fish jalfrezi for my,chicken tikka massalla for the wife.best she has ever had.Side of spicy potato (wow),2 garlic naan breds,4 beers 100 rm or £20Great meal.worth he trip taxi 10 rm each way from Holiday InnShow less

Author: derek5210
Title: friendly restaurant
Review: 4 of us walked in after passing staff very friendly and helpful food was excellent had a variety of meals between us eg beef vindaloo,chicken curry fried rice all were very good beer was icy cold

Author: Aleem M
Title: Not impressed
Review: Food ok but found a hair in the pizza and the waiters response was "we all have hair and it just happens " I was not impressed with that response so I won't be go there again.Their cooks did not wear hairnets or use gloves! He said he had run out of them..hmmmmmShow less

Author: delinda66
Title: Beautiful food
Review: Dropped in for a quick lunch. Food was tasty and judt the right amount. Service was friendly and relaxed. !!

Author: aussie_fireblade
Title: Acceptable quality, friendly staff
Review: Food was alright, considering they were one of three cafes in the area. Seemed to be the only one open most days. Food was acceptable, but nothing to shout about. Staff were very friendly.

Author: GeertVanWolvelaerUrgup, Turkey
Title: cheap and good
Review: We had a pizza at this location, which was not the best I had in my life, but that's hard to expect. You are not in Italy after all. It was fresh made though, and service was good for a local resto. Prices for other items seem very reasonable compared to its quality.Show less

Author: 61debu
Title: Nice simple meals
Review: Good menu with heaps of western options. Food is tasty with generous sized servings. They do a mean milkshake.  We visit regularly when in Batu Ferringi.

Author: Shazad2212Oxford, Ohio
Title: Amazing food with great service
Review: Visited this restaurant in December 2015, we had tried a few other restaurants along the batu ferringhi stretch which were nothing to write home about. We were recommended Enca and it certainly did not disappoint. Amazing food with great service and very reasonably priced. The menu is extensive and if you fancy something special which is not on the menu, then they will try and accommodate your request. Highly recommended and will definitely be visiting when next in Penang. Shazad London, UKShow less

Author: 454lindylouCentral Portugal, Portugal
Title: Good Indian food
Review: We went to their restaurant near the Hard Rock hotel. Food was very good, the best naan bread I have ever eaten were in this place. They do have a couple of other places near the centre of Batu Ferringhi which we didn't manage to eat at.Show less

Author: Koops31
Title: A little gem right across from Hard Rock
Review: Family of 4 all hungry & tired from an international flight. Served up some good Indian food and western food for the kids. Cheap, easy & accommodating for tired & hot toddlers.

Author: jackw53London, United Kingdom
Title: Something For Every Taste
Review: This establishment is almost directly opposite the Bayview Hotel. The menu really does cater for all tastes. There is a selection of Western including freshly baked Pizza, Local Malay/Chinese and an extensive Indian. We chose the latter and were not disapointed. a starter of samosa cooked to perfection was followed by garlic naan, pilau rice, prawn masala, aloo gobi, and beef all very well cooked and tasty. Service was good and value even better. Will definitly put this on my visit again list.Show less

Author: Gavin M
Title: Great food
Review:
Like other reviews we stayed at the Bayview.  So handy
We went there for lunch there everyday of our five day stint.
Fresh calamari, curry dishes,  pizza and cold beer.

Author: David SMelbourne, Australia
Title: Cheap Indian food with a bit of western trhown in as well
Review: The kids were happy that they could get western food (burgers/pizza). While we were happy having some really good, cheap Indian. The food wasn't blow your socks of amazing, but was good honest food and very cheap.Definitely worth getting out of the nearby resorts and having dinner here.Show less

Author: maroon25
Title: convenient
Review: opposite the Bayview- we had lunch here twice. nice Indian entrees, rice and noodle dishes. fruit drinks were watered down bit still OK.

Author: Relax803043Chilliwack, Canada
Title: Wonderful Food
Review: We stayed at the Bayview Beach Resort and this restaurant is straight across the street. We were with a group of 7 and they gave us great service. The curries were amazing, some of the best we have ever eaten, and all very reasonably priced. We loved it so much, we returned 3 times during our 6 day stay!Show less

Author: Bevan J
Title: Great food low cost
Review: Right across the road from Bayview Beach Resort. Friendly staff and really fresh delicious food. We had traditional local Malay meals but they do Indian and western as well. Three adults and two large boys ate till we couldn't fit any more in and had two rounds of drinks including beers and Lassi's 160 RM. we're going backShow less

Author: MCGIBBOZ
Title: Great indian food
Review: Great indian food at fab prices,all he usual dishonestly would expect and some local dishes too , cheap prices firewood and drink

Author: Georgia O
Title: Yum
Review: Some fabulous Indian food. The owner is lovely as well. Would recommend 100%. The prices are fab and it's not flashy. Just right.

Author: Hip2012Melbourne, Australia
Title: Not fancy but awesome cheap eats
Review: This looks like all the other street food restaurant but what a find. Friends living in Penang eat here at least twice a week. The food is excellent offering a large varied menu. Their specialty is Indian food. The friendly staff are warm and accommodating, nothing is a problem. They even do a great pizza. Exceptional value! If you go tell them Jesse (a four year old) says they're the best!Show less

Author: justbabycKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good Food
Review: This restaurant is located opposite of Bayview Beach Resort (or near to Hard Rock Hotel). I came here for dinner. It's pretty hard to notice this restaurant as the restaurant signboard is faded. I have tried their Manggo Lassi, Naan with Garlic and two other dishes which I cant remember the name. Their food is good. Price is pretty much Batu Feringghi standard. Friendly staff. You could give this restaurant a try.Show less

Author: jihan hanis j
Title: Must try their Lamb Tandoori
Review: Located not far from where we stay, we went to Enca Cafe after reading good reviews about it. We gave it a try and everything was just delicious. We tried both western and north indian food and the lamb tandoori is the best I've ever tasted. My kids finished their spaghetti carbonara so that means it's that good. We also had cheese naans and ordered buttered chicken with aloo gobi to go with the naans and boy, was it yummy. Would recommend this restaurant to anyone staying in Batu Ferringghi.Show less

Author: ubaiambiah
Title: Nice variety of food..
Review: A lot of menus variety of Asian, Italian, Western food. I try naan butter with Chicken Tikka.. Thump up for the Tikka's taste..I feel the same good taste 8years ago somewhere in Restaurant in Dubai..

Author: Shan0579Sippy Downs, Australia
Title: Lunch
Review: Spent 11 nights at the Hard Rock and went to Enca 4 days for lunch. Curries were excellent and the naan breads delicious. Kids enjoyed their butter chicken or pizza. One day we got takeaway pizza for lunch which was heaps cheaper and nicer than the hotel.Show less

Author: DcsimoNewcastle, Australia
Title: Cheap tasty eats
Review: Went there a night ago for a quick cheap meal. Food is really cheap and so are beers. I had a ochra curry with parathas. It was delicious and all up with two drinks, parathas for two and a curry to share we spent around 30 ringgit. For Aussie travellers that's about 10 dollars. Show less

Author: Lorrainepatriciatodd
Title: Good curries and raita
Review: Enca has a large menu and has something for everyone.  Their curries are nice and the service is always good. They are also very pleasant.  Well worth a try.

Author: Andrew123576
Title: Nice..indian food
Review: This is exactly opposite to Bay view resort. its a good place. indian food is expecially good...nice time . i had had roti .  with curry several times.. butter nan..is expecially vvv good...try some spicy masala.. not an expencive place. but can enjoy food

Author: Paul D
Title: A good family feed
Review: Late (for the kids), no one could agree what we wanted. We came here and they had everything, and it was all very good. Surprisingly so to be honest. Not one for date night but if you need a good honest feed, for it.

Author: JeshawnSingapore, Singapore
Title: Surprise Food Find
Review: Their Indian food is honestly very decent and tasty. Dunno if I was super hungry but I especially love their cheese garlic Naans.Their Butter Chicken, Aloo Gobi and Tandoori Lamb are good! Totally enjoyed lunch. Flies are a problem though, it can be very distracting to eat our meal in peace. One even 'dived' into my drink and ruined it. They do delivery so can consider doing that so as to avoid the flies.Show less

Author: Oratory1Singapore, Singapore
Title: EXCELLENT FOOD SERVED WITH A SMILE
Review: Enca's is just opposite the bayview resort and near to the hard rock hotel. The food is excellent with its variety of Asian and Western dishes. The Indian dishes are out of this world. Everything is cooked fresh and the kitchen can be seen from the tables. The service is excellent with friendly smiles from all the staff. The prices are reasonable and the quality of food is of high standards. My son enjoyed the home made chicken nuggets and french fries while we enjoyed the spicy curries.Show less

Author: ASTEGPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: not a bad place to eat, but I have been in better ones at Batu Ferringhi
Review: There are quite a lot of review talking about the friendly staff - when I was yesterday there, they made all a pretty tired and bored impression and from the welcoming smile was not much to see. I was early - around 7 and there was only 3 tables occupied and it still took quite a while until somebody bothered to bring a menu. Nobody was unfriendly, rude or unprofessional but feeling welcome is something different.The food was ok - had one of the chef's recommendations - a sizzling chicken Tika, some rice and naan. Nothing special but ok and I had a mint lassi - here I have to say it was the best Lassi I had so far on the island. Prices are comparable to similar restaurants along the main road and very reasonable.Show less

Author: vivadramPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: A plethora for your palate
Review: This place has pretty good food. Local and western alike. Seems to be managed by a group of foreign workers with an obvious rich boss behind it. But the staff are hard working and always try to please. They're always ready with a smile and try their best to accommodate your food orders. They seem to have another stall in Long Beach Food Court also in Batu Ferringhi and will deliver food to homes around the area with a minimum order of RM50 or so. Personal favourite - Grilled fish with pulao rice. YUMS! Their pizza's not bad either.Show less

Author: eleriannejAnglesey, United Kingdom
Title: Delicious
Review: Well after reading the reports of enca we decided to pay a visit and we weren't disappointed . I decided to try the chicken and cashew nut which was lovely and my husband had chicken penne which again was lovely. There was plenty of chicken!! Any body visiting this area well worth a visit and plenty to choose from the menu for every culinary Show less

Author: ollymac_9_10
Title: Great Food and Prices
Review:
Visited Enca while staying at Bayview Beach hotel.
Staff are friendly and the prices are very low. the quality and range of foods/dishes was excellent, coupled with value for money.
Would use again when in Penang

Author: Fleur PHastings, New Zealand
Title: Good food, great variety.
Review: Went here for a late breakfast, opposite Bayview Beach Resort. Quick service. I ordered a chicken cashew dish, with garlic naan and a local coffee. The meal was very tasty and plenty enough to fill me up. Service was quick. The menu has a good range. Price was ok for this area.Show less

Author: polarduck
Title: Cheap and edible
Review: Even though the restaurant lacks interior, the food on the other hand was okay. Not awesome but just okay. Not so reasonable pricing (coming from a Malaysian). I think they jack up the price for foreigners.

Author: Gunner47BeaconsfieldGreat Kingshill, United Kingdom
Title: Disappointingly average
Review: After reading Tripadvisor reports on this restaurant we decided to give it a go and how disappointed we were? Average service lack of atmosphere and worst of all bland food. I ordered a dish and the waiter asked if I liked it spicy which I replied yes. I don't know what the taste would have been if I had said no, it was the most tasteless dish I've had.Go to the hawkers you'll get better food and atmosphere.Show less

Author: Laurence GPerth, Australia
Title: Great food & friendly service
Review: Found this restaurant right opposite the Bayview Beach Resort. We had pappadums with mint yoghurt, a tandoori plate (with prawns, fish & chicken), naan breads with dhaal and a Greek salad. Washed down with several beers, it was a great lunch and very reasonably priced (110MYR). Being a clumsy oaf I spilled a beer everywhere but the staff were all smiles and changed the tablecloth and chatted to us as they mopped up. We found the Indian food to be very very good -full of flavour and well cooked. A number of other diners were enjoying pizzas and western style meals with chips and salad so it's got something for everyone and will be a great place for families to eat. Highly recommend this restaurant to all.Show less

Author: Klaus HHelsinki, Finland
Title: A delicious lunch and dinner :)
Review: We have a rule; do not eat two times in the same restaurant during holidays. We are happy to tell tell you, that we ate three(!) times in this same restaurant during our stay in Batu Ferringhi and there in the Bayview Beach Resort Hotel. :)The Indian food we ate was delicious in there and the service was also excellent. The restaurant was very conveniently situated just on the other side of the road of our hotel. it was not overpriced but a bit more expensive than a couple of other places around. Maybe because of the good service and the excellent food...? ;) We warmly do recommend this restaurant!Show less

Author: pooteggChiang Mai, Thailand
Title: was better than it looked and we imagined
Review: Situated across the road from a large chain hotel this restaurant caters for those that want to have good food but at a budget price. This is exactly what you get .. Not often you can have chicken chop and chips , pizza and full blown indian at the same table .. we did! The caller outside the restaurant is keen to show his menu - one family group walked away and we saw them a few yards along the street clearly disappointed with what they got while we were happy . Show less

Author: nabeelah_eSouth Africa
Title: Best food in Penang
Review: The service was excellent. Friendly staff and owners. Went to the place 3 times in 2 days. Food is great. We tried everything from pastas to authentic indian cuisine. Really worth it to try the food. The fresh orange juice was brilliant!! Would definitely recommend this restaurant to travelers looking for great food.Show less

Author: RebeccaN739
Title: Great Food.
Review: This amazing food was one of the reasons we came back to Penang. Did not disappoint. Food is sensational. Whole family enjoys the great tasting selection of food. Located opposite our hotel made it an easy place to enjoy.

Author: Sarah GWest Linn
Title: Amazing food and service - a must for your stay in Batu Ferringhi!
Review: Dined here twice on our 24-hour visit, if that tells you anything! Stumbled across it by chance with our group of 7 friends and the food was so good for dinner we had to go back for lunch the next day.The man who served us (pretty sure he is also the owner) was so friendly and nice. One of our group was sick and craving sweet-n-sour chicken, and even though it wasn't on the menu he immediately offered to make it for her (and it was delicious!).For the price the portions are pretty good (maybe a little on the small side) but the quality and taste more than make up for it. We all loved everything we got! Highlights were the mango salad and chicken vindaloo (pasta was good too). Homemade, fresh, and quality ingredients.And, again, the man who helped us was very friendly and gave us great service, among the best we've received in 6 months traveling outside the US.Show less

Author: jeff cCairns, Australia
Title: I can't go anywhere else
Review: We are staying across the road from this place and took a gamble once we had checked in to the hotel. The guys were friendly and attentive. I had butter chicken and it was great. We've been about 4 more times and will continue to go through the menu up until we leave. The staff all look like they enjoy working there. And I've been to a couple of other places and these guys are better by far.Show less

Title: Amazing
Review: we visited this restaurant 3 times on our recent visit to Penang because the food was so good, each time we had an Indian meal which was perfect, I would strongly recommend a visit here.

Author: Jackie MAdelaide, Australia
Title: Really good food and service
Review: We ordered papadums, raita, chicken tikka, onion bahji, Chicken dupiaza, Sag aloo, pilau rice and a nan, this was for just 2 of us...yes our eyes were bigger than our bellies! We also had 4 beers. The food was delicious, better than most Indian food I have ever had in Australia. The menu was extensive, and so hard to make a choice, hence our over ordering! The sag aloo is the best we have ever eaten and the chicken tikka was also amazing. Infact it was all great. The reason I have listed everything we tried is to indicate have reasonable Enca is. We paid 95RM which is equivalent to $35 aud. Best value in Batu FerringhiShow less

Author: stephen2912
Title: nice food nice price
Review: we have eaten here before and wanted to again , nice to see the same great food and still at a reasonable price. recommend this cafe to any one going to Batu ferringhi

Author: Brian Y
Title: Just okay.
Review: It's Indian food and its nothing to write home about. The naan bread is very good. Beware of the stubby holders as they are quite dirty. Looks like they have been used for 5 years. Service is good.

Author: coffdonk
Title: Yum!!!
Review: Quick n friendly service, delicious food n no tax which means its alot cheaper than others around. Recommend the grilled chicken 😊

Author: TasMissyHobart, Australia
Title: A little out of the way, but worth the effort
Review: ENCA – BATU FERRINGHIEnca restaurant is located directly opposite the Bayview and Hard Rock Hotels on the Western edge of the Batu Ferringhi strip. It is a large open fronted restaurant with simple furnishings but great food. The staff are friendly and helpful and the service quick.We have visited Enca twice so far and have enjoyed the food each time. The menu is basically Indian with some Asian and Western choices. We have tried different dishes each time we have been there and with a group of four we have seen quite a bit of the menu, and have not been disappointed by any choice. The seafood dishes and the curries have been well presented and extremely tasty.All of this, and it is cheap; we had two entrees, four main courses, rice and quite a few beers for under $30. We’ll be back before we have to go home, only another 40 odd restaurants to go to!Show less

Author: tpking
Title: Great curry
Review: Curry is great. We ordered garlic butter prawn and chicken tikka masala. Both are good. Also ordered bolognese spaghetti for my kid. OK but not excellent . Could definitely pay a visit but not as exceptional as some of the reviewers here said.

Author: Conrik
Title: tasty food, good service
Review: we have had diner with 8 people. all the dishes were good. espescially the local dishes were great. fast and friendly service for a good price. it can compete with the bigger retaurants. btw also the pizza's were excellent; for the children.

Author: CraygePoint Clare, Australia
Title: Great food handy to Hardrock hotel
Review: We stayed at Hardrock hotel nearby and stumbled across Enca one night when searching for a meal. Arrived around 930pm and received a warm welcome. We ended up eating there for three nights in a row. Their opening hours suited us as we tend to eat late , one time 11pm and they were still open. The staff are very friendly and all the meals we had were fanatastic . Very reasonable prices. We wanted to try other places but kept coming back to Enca.Show less

Author: Beh89
Title: Nice Food
Review: Nice food,my favorite is the Chicken Chop with Mushroom Sauce.... Recommended place for family and also the friendly staff....

Author: Justback87Pinjarra, Australia
Title: Simple surrounds yet amazing food.
Review: Have now eaten here twice on this Penang visit. I had the Garlic Curry King Prawns last night and was blown away! In a place famous for its food, this was the most amazing dish. It would have to rate as one of the finest I have had in three visits to the island. Now I have to try and bribe the cook for his recipe. Prices are great, service is good.You don't need fancy surrounds to have an amazing food experience in Penang. Give Enca a go. You won't be disappointed.Show less

Author: BackToMelbourneMelbourne
Title: Great food.
Review: Ok so this place isn't the flashiest in terms of its decoration, but the food is good. We were staying at the overpriced Hard Rock Hotel and came across this place after reading good reviews. The food is honest, the service is fine and the price is good. We had a butter chicken, naan, pizza and some drinks. All good. Give it a shot.Show less

Author: meljabu
Title: really good food
Review: we had a range of indian food as well as kids fish & chips. all of the food was very nice at a reasonable price. the service was friendly and efficient

Author: manyjaysMelbourne, Australia
Title: Delicious food, reasonably priced
Review: The cafe is located opposite the Bayview Beach Hotel and was a real find. Smiling waiters are efficient in their service and the Indian food is particularly excellent. My son ordered Rogan Josh with Naan and I ordered butter chicken with Naan. Both dishes were tasty, and the Naan sensational. On a later visit we had the satay sticks which were delicious and remarkably good value. Enca's also do takeaway which is handy. Considering the location which is near some of the top-end tourist hotels, the prices are more than reasonable. The menu is quite extensive and includes standard western dishes and Malaysian favourites; the cafe has a photograph album of every dish which makes the choice easier and a spice rating for the wary. Tasty dishes, smiling, cheery staff and good value for money make this restaurant a good choice in Penang.Show less

Author: Amrit_PreetAl Wakra, Qatar
Title: Too bad we discovered it so late..! Superb..!
Review: Well.. Next time whenever we visit Penang, will make sure to eat here whenever possible. We were returning from our visit to the Toy Museum and I pulled over after spotting Italian written on the restaurant board (My wife wanted to eat some nice Italian food). We were travelling with our 22 months baby and it was quite hot that day. We were greeted with a wide smile. I asked the host if there was any air-conditioned area as our baby was not very comfortable in the scorching heat. He tried his best to put us up in a corner which was relatively cooler and put two fans for us. After that what followed, blew us completely.I was delighted to see North Indian dishes in the menu. I ordered butter chicken and Lacha Paratha and believe me guys, it was as good as what you get in Delhi or Punjab. Even my wife had great time enjoying her Sphagetti pasta. She could not stop praising the taste. And the service.. wow.. that was one of the quickest services that I have ever come across.The host sees you off with a wide smile and you always end up thinking in your head, what the hell was I doing eating up at other places..! Should have been here in the first place..!Great food, superb hospitality. This joint is a gem which you wouldn’t wanna miss while being in Batu Ferringhi..!Superb..!Show less

Author: Greg SPerth, Australia
Title: Take a Chance!
Review: We've been celebrating our honeymoon in Penang for the last 4 days and still here for another 4. We discovered this little spot almost opposite the Bayview hotel.Amazing indian food! the butter chicken and naan is as good as we've ever eaten anywhere. The Staff are welcoming, friendly and always up for a bit of a laugh.We would highly recommend giving Enca a go!Show less

Author: ShetlandGirlScotland, United Kingdom
Title: Terrific Indian Food
Review: We only discovered Enca towards the end of our holiday which was a real shame as we would have eaten there more than once. We only tried the Indian food but everything we ordered was really delicious. As others have commented, the nann bread (garlic and cheese in our case) was outstandingly good. Basic surroundings but very clean with friendly staff and terrific value for money. We chatted to a couple of fellow diners who had eaten there 3 nights in a row and were tucking into dishes not even on the menu which they had specially asked for.A brilliant choice for anyone seeking great Indian food in Batu Ferringhi.Show less

Author: Brook001
Title: Nice food/Nice people
Review: Opposite Hard Rock Hotel which was really handy as the food was heaps nicer and cheaper than the Hard Rock, he was a really nice guy who even came and opened up the restaurant before his usual time

Author: lakerdude66Melbourne
Title: great food, friendly staff
Review: We ate here numerous times during our stay in Batu ferringhi. Why because the food was really tasty, good quality and well priced. They cater for western tastes as well as indian, we had a number of different dishes and all i must say were the best we had on our holiday. The place itself looks like a standard local restaurant but wow the food is good, beer cold and the service very friendly. Try the Tuna pizza, its so good. We did eat at a few other places but left disappointed but the Enca alwas delivered cheap tasty simple meals, perfect for a relaxing holiday. Thanks guys, we will return.Show less

Title: Not bad
Review: We ate here as it is across from where we were staying. Personally I would say the food is okay but not the best place around. We had curry, rice and char koay teow (excuse my spelling). While it was very cheap, the curry wasn't anything fabulous, the koay teow was average. The nicest part was the naan - which was awesome. We returned twice just to get naan. As I said above the food was okay and it's in a good location, with good prices. However when comparing to everyone's reviews - I expected more. Show less

Staff were very friendly. We tried a variety of different Asian dishes as well as Western meals, portions were large and reasonably cheap.Show less

Author: joseph Q

Author: IMP58Crewe, United Kingdom
Title: Fantastic food at a price we can all afford

Perfect walking distance from the Bayview Beach Resort (Right acoss the road). The staff are very attentive and friendly. What more could you ask for.Show less

Author: D7067TOmarkh
Title: great food
Review: After struggling to find great food for our first 4 nights in Penang we ended up at Enca and enjoyed a delicious meal of lamb biryani and lamb masala.  The best meal so far in our week in Penang.

Author: RobinandLexiKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Really Good food and Really Good Value
Review: Four adults and five children in my party ate here this evening and all of us enjoyed our meals. Curries, rice and naan plus pizzas and fish and chips for the children. Very tasty, speedy service and excellent value at RM160 for us all. Happy to recommend this restaurant.Show less

Author: Maree SWellington, New Zealand
Title: Our favourite
Review: I read the reviews after we had already discovered this place. It was great to read that others had the same experience as us. Its a very simple little place with fans and a mixture of indoor and outdoor seating. Enca is across the road from Bayview Hotel which was great after a busy day of sightseeing in crazy Penang. The staff here are lovely and were always welcoming. The menu is extensive and covers Indian, Italian and Chinese but they seem to be good at all of it and its good value. Penang has some quite expensive eateries. We became regulars. My boys aged 7 and 9 rated it the best restaurant in Penang due to the food and the welcome. In truth, we didn't try that many others as we so enjoyed our experience here. We even had to say goodbye as the boys thought that they would miss us.Show less

Author: tripster25Newcastle-under-Lyme, United Kingdom
Title: Wonderful find
Review: Ironically we were staying across the road from this restaurant at the Bayview Hotel but never took much notice of it... An Australian traveller recommended it to us. One of the best Indian meals ever and very impressive choice of dishes all cooked to order with welcoming and genuine friendly service. Have been back twice and noticed regular diners including locals so that speaks for itself... Asian and western food served. Italian meals looked nice. Very highly recommended. Having visited every restaurant in the resort I would say this is one of the best. And the cheapest.Show less

Author: Teresa RSecret Harbour, Australia
Title: The best Indian in Batu Ferringhi
Review: Just over the road from the Bayview Beach Resort, this restaurant has to be the best Indian in town - beating the Jewel of the North.....We ate there 3 of the 4 nights we stayed at the Bayview. The Butter chicken is to die for and so is everything else. They do serve other foods but it Indian for us all the way.....They also went out of their way to serve our friends 4 year old early so she wouldn't have to wait!!!!!Show less

Review: We had lunch here twice, the food tastes really nice & service is also fast. The only problem, I have is they are having very limited Veg options They should include paneer dishes in their menu. It seems incomplete with very limited options.

Author: hvtravellersHunter Valley NSW AU

Author: RebeccaN739

We especially loved the butter chicken, naan and basically everything we tried. Located right across the road from our hotel, it was convenient and delicious. Author: Andrew TAdelaide, Australia

They have a specialised pizza chef who also does their famous naans in his oven. When we were there, a German expat had his own table and a few beers, and is very helpful with local knowledge.Show less

Author: stona7Melbourne, Australia
Title: Great food & service
Review: This is right accross the road from the Bayview where we were staying but if you're residing further up the beach, I would still recommend a visit. The food is great, we mainly had Indian but I did try a tandoori pizza one night that was great too. Service is very quick & all really friendly guys who welcomed us back every night. Realllllly cheap, we couldn't believe the prices, our family of 4 ate for around $25AUD which included a couple of beers.Show less

Author: Kanan AAustralia
Title: Authentic North Indian Cuisine
Review: It´s not easy to find this style of food in Malaysia, the reason being that it´s North Indian cuisine (these guys are from Bangladesh), where the vast majority of Indians in Penang (and Malaysia) are Tamils, hailing from the south. Personally I far prefer it over the South Indian menu. Located directly opposite Bayview resort on the southern end of Jalan Ferringhi, on offer is a large selection of North Indian dishes. We shared the tandori lamb (RM14) and a spinach potato korma RM8, a carrot juice and a mango lassie. The food came quickly and it was all to our liking and very tasty.The staff are friendly without being try hard, and Mani spent some time chatting to us about India and Bangladesh.The decor is basic, but the place is clean with cloth on the tables. Toilet facilities are decent.As with all the other restaurants in Batu Ferringhi, you should know that you will pay a premium in the Ferringhi tourist haven. Having said that, Enca is not over the top expensive. The carrot juice was only RM4 and the mango lassie RM6. The total bill came out at RM34. There was no service charge or Government tax added.Enca has been added to my list of excellent restaurants that I love in Penang.Show less

Hope to be back before I town.Show less

Author: Ashirley2

The tiramisu crepe cake I ordered was pretty ok too except that the crust was a tad bit hard but otherwise the taste was just nice. Dragon sparkle took some time to serve (<20 mins). If you like lychee and bananas I will recommend this. The taste of dragonfruit isn't that apparent. All in all I think it's worth a trip to this cafe if you are in town. It's a great place that serves above average food AND to chill and unwind. Great music choices too!Show less

I ordered a latte hoping the caffeine could save me from the day, but the latte clearly tasted over-extracted even its a milk coffee. I told one of the young lady for a exchange and she gently offered me sugar not knowing what to do. Hence I waved to the barista for a new cup but he said the grind was set by the boss in the morning and he has no right to change it, even for a cup of request. At that point I just gave up on the coffee of this coffee shop.I guess there are few points to make it more customer friendly in this case. Maybe having a senior/ more experience staff at anytime of the opening hour to deal with situations, or simply give more authority to staff for reasonable request (come on who barista can't change the grind level).Pastry is good and fresh, need some work on the coffee (and staff).Show less

Title: Nice, warm, somewhat hipster-ish spot with wonderful food and drinks
Review: This was a wonderful surprise on a day when I was driven in here by a thunderstorm and somewhat poor timing (missing my intended lunch target by a block when the skies opened). After coming in for a coffee, I couldn't resist trying one of their crepe cakes -- the lemon one -- and both it and the coffee were excellent, so I decided to order the pesto pasta for lunch also (despite the rain having stopped by then), which was excellent as well. If I hadn't been stuffed, I would've continued trying things from their good-sized menu of creative options (that included a "popcorn latte"!).Lavish has a nice, warm, somewhat hipster-ish interior. It's a long, narrow cafe, with light coming from assorted types of bulbs/lamps and a mid-restaurant skylight, the latter which overlooks a section of the dining area that includes two tables with faux gardens under the glass tops. The staff was friendly and efficient. This really seems like great place for breakfast, lunch, dinner, or desserts...or even drinks, with a few beers available in bottles.Show less

Author: Leona_PetersSingapore, Singapore
Title: Slow service took the spotlight away from its food/drinks
Review: We went there around noon, and first thing we noticed was that there were quite a few empty tables, but they were not cleared yet (still filled with plates and cups and stuff from previous customers). We cleared our own table and ordered two drinks, one iced latte and a fruit slushie drink, as well as a piece of the tiramisu crepe cake.And then the waiting game began... About 20 minutes into the wait, our cake finally arrived. For info, the cake was already sliced when they are on display in the cake fridge, so it was quite mind-boggling as to why it took so long. The cake was also dry and not very tasty... Could have more cream in between. The tiramisu flavour is also not strong.A while later, with our drinks no where in sight, I noticed a lady from another table went up to the waitress to ask for her drink, so I followed suit. Another 20 minutes later.. our drinks finally came. Iced latte is not bad (too much ice though), while the fruit drink is good. However, after waiting for almost an hour... the mood to enjoy our drinks was gone and we were just rushing through the meal as we wasted too much time here.All in all, perhaps we just came during a bad time when they were seriously understaffed, but as time is precious on our short trip here, we couldn't risk spending more time to try out the otherwise interesting food menu.Show less
