Author: iisechewMalaysia
Title: An Amazing new partnership with Hungry Ranch
Review: Hungry Ranch at D'Loovi's (Non-Halal)Just the vibes of D’loovi’s itself is more than enough to attract music-lovers, gourmet food hunters and those needing a place to chill. Adapting to the new norm, D’loovi’s has now ventured into an amazing new partnership with ‘Hungry Ranch’, and boy, I’ll tell you that the food is amazing. This cafe-styled menu is clearly based on Chef Gobi’s pride and specialties; a Western-Asian fusion cuisine that’s handpicked at its finest. Hungry Ranch, founded by Chef G and DJ Stephanie Cass (I’m not kidding, she’s a real DJ ), blends in perfectly well with the ambience and feels at D’Loovi’s.  For starters, the Magic Mushroom soup was heavenly; just at the right creaminess, with crisp from breadcrumbs, and perfectly seasoned. It was delicious. I loved the Diablo Chicken Wings. Crispy on the outside, juicy in the inside, flavoured with their secret sauces, it was, in cliche terms, finger-licking good. Don’t miss out their pastas! The Aglia Olio was cooked ‘Al-dente’, and it clearly is a favourite among vegetarians. There were generous portions of mushrooms. Make sure to ask for EXTRA SPICY if you’re a chilli lover  The Pesto Pasta, Creamy Salmon Risotto and Grilled Lamb Shoulders were great. That’s about all the dishes I’ve tried, and everyone of them have been more than satisfactory. With Chef G’s years of experience as a chef in various cafes, it’s no wonder the cuisine lives up to its name. It’s a lovely partnership, with lovely people, amazing food, great music, and happy vibes. That’s Hungry Ranch @ D’Loovi’s.Show less

Author: iisechewMalaysia
Title: A place that epitomizes authenticity.. Amazing food, amazing music, amazing people
Review: D'Loovi's in Georgetown, PenangThis is a place that epitomizes authenticity - be it the food with its palatable home-made fusion recipes, or the live music at its finest, or simply the amazing company and homely vibes exuding from the people here, it makes for an amazing experience.To me, what makes this place stand out is the close-knit community that has been formed here. While I was taking photographs of D'Loovi's, a young gentleman walked in, and multiple times was he greeted cheerfully with the same question - 'How was Langkawi?!'. Everyone in D'Loovi's knew him; everyone pretty much knew each other. They laughed like old buddies, shared their stories; it was a very pleasant vibe. In time, others coming in D'Loovi's joined the throng. Musicians, office workers, and people of various occupations made this a welcoming community. The owner of this place, by the name of Kelvin D'Loovi, makes for a most friendly and genuine person.I enjoy music thoroughly, and I love how the violin is prominently displayed here (I am a violinist myself). The music sensation is strong, where musicians often gather here for live performances. Reading the reviews online, live music is often mentioned to be amazing here. I sadly have yet to experience the music scene here, as the Movement Control Order due to COVID-19 has had the wings of fellow musicians clipped. That will have to be an experience for another time.For dinner, I was recommended the home-cooked mutton rendang - and boy, it was impeccably prepared. Simply superb. Kelvin himself ensures that the dishes served are up to standard. When I requested for no Cole-slaw, he whipped up stir-fried vegetables with bitter gourd, and that, surprisingly, perfectly complemented the mutton rendang. As I previously mentioned, this place serves home-made fusion recipes at its finest.I don't at all drink alcohol, but the non-alcoholic beverages were splendid. Fresh juices and mocktails are readily available. They're constantly coming with new ideas for their menu, and I was recommended the vanilla milkshake. A little bit on the sweet side, but still, kudos to the innovation the team here has.D'Loovi's is beautifully designed. It boasts a majestic exterior of what looks to be grand pillars, with an entrance seemingly hidden to the eye. Enter the door and you behold an epiphany of colours, music instruments, and trinkets placed in an orderliness that complements the vibes of this place.I have a strong aversion towards cigarette smoke (being a doctor, oh well), and I love how the interior of D'Loovi's is a non-smoking area. Should one wish to smoke (which of course, I would discourage), there is an allocated balcony outside which comprises of an artfully designed garden.If you are into great live music, or into finding communities as such, this is the place to be at. Authentic music, authentic food, authentic people - that's D'Loovi's.Show less

Review: Came here several times for food and tried a few different things on the menu. All really nice, and really cheap! The chicken wrap was my fav

Author: LaurenC3627
Title: Best bar in Penang
Review: Great bar, friendly people. rocking music, what more could you ask for! Always the place I visit when I'm in Penang

Author: ghoghnoss
Title: Very familiar
Review:
Very nice manager Kevin
After first time we cannot go other places 
We came Penang fr 3 trips
Always we come here

Author: DCB1952
Title: Nice bar with good service
Review: I was invited in (I think) ended up sitting with the owner & his gf nice folk which makes all the difference. Left a 4:00am so must of been a goodnight.

Author: lochiel7
Title: small intimate music house
Review: Very friendly ambiance, informal, spontaneous and a class act all around. Greatmusic with Mondays and Fridays featuring  the pulsating Blusoin (sp?) rock band and visiting artists, great nights out running quite late/early

Author: 505jeanettem
Title: Best place in Penang
Review: This place is amazing . Good beer, great service, amazing food (loved my lamb burger) and extremely cool and friendly owner.

Author: Lovepattaya
Title: Back again for more!
Review: Visited 3 months ago and we're back again. Fantastic breakfast with bottomless coffee. Great place for a few chilled out afternoon beers. Love it.

Author: LisaG6101
Title: Best coffee and service :)
Review: The service is so good and the staff is very friendly and helpful. We absolutely loved the coffee here - it is sooooo good. Thank you.

Author: freejack69
Title: Mr arnold
Review: I've never been to d'loovi's yet but the food smells so good my stomach grumbles from up here in England. As for the atmosphere I've seen it on the net and wished I was there instead of here .And as for the owner /host well what can I say but we've been friends forever and I don't think you could ask for a kinder upstanding one .For all those lucky enough to visit I'm green with envy !!!Show less

Author: rmachnicsChina
Title: Mr Richard Mach
Review: What a delightfully experiential odyssey. Not only is the quality of the food superb, but the whole ambiance delivers the rock n' roll theme projected here! I happened to be in Georgetown for 2 days and I can tell you that this was the highlight of my trip. If you want great food, exceptional conversation and fantastic live music then this is the place!Show less

Author: naughtynig
Title: What an Experience
Review:
Great experience and spent a great night with good music,good beer and lovely attractive  staff
Well worth a visit

Author: Clarisse K
Title: Amazing place !
Review: Friendly staff and the roti canai is FANTASTIC. Must be descovered ! The music is vers nice..... A place you can easily spent many hours chilling,  drinking and eating...  Happiness

Author: Lovepattaya
Title: Fantastic!
Review: Great restaurant, excellent food and super friendly staff. Great place to chill and people watch as they pass by.

Author: Olivierbourg
Title: Amazing people and vibes
Review: This little resto/bar/cafe became our home away from home while we were in Georgetown. We came everyday numerous times to eat and just hang out with the people that work as well the guests. Kelvin, the owner, does a fantastic job of introducing himself and taking the time to sit down and get to know his guests, which drew us back, along with the other wonderful staff. I got to jam and party with locals. Every night there is live music and you'll definately be taken care off. Show less

Author: Z5581VZmikeaVancouver, Canada
Title: Great service
Review: Great place good live music. The owner is super nice also. We couldnt get a bus since it is some sort or hoilday but he helped us. When i come back to penang ill for sure be having more than one beer here. Highly recomend Oh ya stays open late if its busyShow less

Author: 259scottChiang Mai
Title: Excellent Music, Nice People, Great Vibe.
Review: As an amateur musician, global traveler, and great appreciator of all art that is live, spontaneous, and heart felt, I have to say that running into this place was my best experience in Penang. ( I live in nearby Thailand and have visited Penang several times over the years) I had the good fortune to meet and play some guitar with the legendary Penang entertainer "Raggy" who in turn introduced me to the owner of D'Loovi's, Kelvin, and his lovely family who were celebrating a double birthday party at the same restaurant.I was kindly invited to join them back at D'Loovi's. So myself. along with Raggy and a couple of stray Brit tourists we picked up along the way, all piled into Kelvin's car for the quick cross town drive.The great music, lively conversation, and all around good vibes carried on into the wee hours. What a blast. Thanks Kelvin (and the whole gang at D'Loovi's) for an excellent and memorable evening.. to quote Arnie.. "I'll be Back"..Show less

Author: Nuno C
Title: Signed
Review: Very good Indian and local food. People are very nice and kind. Not expensive. Real good place to stay and relax for a while.

Author: KatieO1755
Title: Doesn't disappoint!!
Review: Guaranteed go to spot for an awesome time. I keep coming back again and again for the friendly staff, on point tunes, and amazing atmosphere... I've had nothing but great nights out here... and the breakfast is good too!

Author: azghaz
Title: Awesome live band
Review: awesome live band. didnt catch the group name but it was playing on 7 may evening. awesome!!! the place was quite packed.

Author: FarahMes
Title: You just don't wanna miss it
Review: This place made me go home with such a big smile on my face. I randomly walked into this bar 2 days before I left Penang..fortunately I did (!), cause these 2 nights were the best and I will never forget them. The people there are more then amazing, the vibe is great and chill, the live-music is awesome and exactly what you need while having a drink. Perfect location, great for meeting people and before you know it, it's 3am and everybody's dancing. Don't leave Penang without visiting this bar, and don't leave this bar without seeing the upstairs area.Show less

Author: Preeta123
Title: Hidden gem In Georgetown
Review: Awesome vibe,sort of the 90s Cheers pub feel, good food, good music and great company! What else do you need?The passion the owner shows in his food is demonstrated in its excellent taste. Based on his reputation, we tried his famous spaghetti carbonara. Needless to say, one of the best I have tasted. It had the perfect balance of creaminess and flavor, not too bland or overpowering.Not to be missed if you ever come over to Penang.Show less

Author: Deva6071Penang Island, Malaysia
Title: Amazing place
Review: It was an amazing night and D’Loovi’s make it even greater. Thanks to Kelvin and the guys with amazing vocal skill and guitar - we reach D’ Loovi’s at 3am after a party from near club’s. The prize for a bottle of liquor is twice cheaper then clubs , the guys are super supporting with all the song request right from oldies and all the popular Malay local songs. The atmosphere was great and relax for a good chat and team gathering. D’Loovi’s place you definitely want to go back and recommend to a few other friends.Show less

Author: Gourmetanna
Title: No1 in Georgetown!
Review: Great place to eat, drink and have fun. I met amazing people here, enjoyed great live music till early in the morning. The owner is very friendly and welcoming. If you are in Penang you should definetly go here!

Author: Alli B
Title: Georgetown gem
Review: Delicious food, good drink prices, amazing live music nightly, and a rad owner to boot.  This is by far my favourite bar in Penang.  I found myself returning almost every night.  Highly recommend.

Author: Catherinel2808
Title: Awesome place!! ❤
Review: What a fab place to be. Open late with great live music, tasty cocktails and amazing food too. On Wednesday is Ladies Night which means a free cocktail for us girls which makes this place even better. I can't rate it highly enough :)

Author: LaurenCraw
Title: If I could live in a bar...
Review: You couldn't ask for a more chilled out bar than D'Loovi's, with the laid-back (yet meticulous and crazy-hard-working) Kelvin at its helm. Expect to find awesome live music, delicious and freshly cooked food, a vast range of drinks to suit every customer, and a personal touch to everything! Undoubtedly my favourite of the bars I visited in Penang; I just kept coming back, and next time I'm in Malaysia I'll be doing the same. ❤️Show less

Author: terence575Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Best Place to sit back & Relax
Review: This place really surprise me and gave me a really great experience. I was walking along the street and just randomly walk in. It has 2 floors, ground and upstairs. Your first impression gives you a place not you want to stay long, but once you go upstairs then you begin your discovery. It has nice sofa's, tables with chairs and a live band area. I was there on Saturday night and they had this great 4 piece local band. They were happening and played some pretty good selection I must say, like don't cry from GNR, Pink Floyd, wish you here and some reggae numbers.The owner Mr.Calvin was very friendly and always around to greet/chat with his customers. You must meet their one and only bar tender who we all call him "uncle". The old but charming man really gets everyone feel at home with his service and jokes. I call him the "MAN"Place is small but cosy. Drinks pricing was good 5 cans of beer for RM50 with live band.So if you are around THE STREET of Penang and do drop by this place and have the experience of just chilling, relax and enjoy some great music. There is no protocol on your dressing/attire , was with my shorts and slippers. You are in an island after all. Chilled.Show less

Author: jmb9193Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: A Hang-out with a Personal Touch
Review: A lively place, offering interesting new musicians with a good (mostly original!) repertoire. The selection of beers brings a smile to every beer-lovers face, the food is tasty, ample(!) and reasonably priced.The heart of this joint however is Kelvin, the owner, who himself takes personal of every guest at every table.A recommended place for locals and visitors to Penang alike.Show less

Author: taraghalePenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Cool place to hang out in Georgetown
Review: D'Loovi's owner Kelvin is the heart & soul of this great little place. The food is tasty, fresh and very well priced. I particularly like the Mee Mamak a local specialty done very well. In the evenings the place transforms into a musicians dream with great bands, open mic nights and the greats of the Malaysian music scene performing or just hanging out. For visitors to Penang it is great place to meet locals and maybe make a few new friends.Show less

Author: Harry SKuala Lumpur, Wilayah Persekutuan, Malaysia
Title: Home away from home
Review: The place is small...VERY small but makes up what is lacks in space by the largeness of the heart of its current owner Kevin. He just bought over the place in fact by strange coincidence I was at his bar the day he was taking over the bar. The patrons are a varied lot and come from all walks of life. The food is up there is amongst the best in Penang, be it the local stuff or the continental stuff. The fried rice is an absolute winner. The chilled beers are fantastic and even of they were not Kevin will find a way out.In a short span of time it has become my truly my home away from home.Show less

Author: Steven T
Title: Love at D'Loovi's Love lan
Review: friendly atmosphere ,   lots of happening in a small and cozy place. cheap food. friendly people and nice food and drinks. what more can u ask for ... :D

Author: rikE_91Nokia, Finland
Title: Guaranteed to have memorable night out
Review: Amazig small restaurant/bar on one of the coziest small streets in Georgetown. I stayed here many nights during one month. Their food is also spectacular and prices for food and beer are the cheapest in whole love lane. I really enjoyed the relaxed athmosphere and live music almost every night. I sometimes came alone and every time made new friends. And if you are too shy to talk, start with the owner Kelvin. He's amazing. Go and make some great memories here, I know I did.Show less

Author: DutombeBangkok, Thailand
Title: Great live music and genuine nice people !
Review: This seems to be the place in George Town where musicians meet up and start jamming until the last string is broken.I went there two nights in a row and witnessed great musicians performing their own material or just starting jamming with each other while in the bar next door all the drunk kids were screaming “wonder wall” in a disturbing hooligan style.You will meet the owner and “chief slave” as he calls himself going around and making sure everybody is having a great time.This is the kind of place where you intend to sit down for a quick drink and find yourself at dawn with a bunch of strangers around your table that have become your new friends overnight.Don't miss it!Show less

Author: 940joetPhnom Penh, Cambodia
Title: Great owner, great music
Review: Stayed in the hotel next door (which I wouldn't recommend!) D'loovi's however I will tell everyone to go to. Went there the first day because of its proximity to the hotel and because it was quite busy. Got chatting to the owner (which is not an unusual occurrence, he talks to everyone) he mentioned that there was going to be music later so I promised to come back after some famous Georgetown street food. Music was some of the best I've heard during my travels (10 months and counting), proper band singing songs that they like rather than the mundane stuff that most play. Met a few people outside (owner gave us some free food as one person was trying to get passers by in) whole evening was very good. Went back a few times during our stay and always had fun. Breakfast is also great. If your in Georgetown you have to try here! Show less

Author: Pam A
Title: Ms
Review: Great place to have fun!! Nice and friendly owner. Good food and wondered place to chill out. Try out their Mee goreng mamak, Nasi Goreng Kampung and Nasi Lemak for supper.

Author: AnnaFrdngrLinz, Austria
Title: You have to visit this place!
Review: The food is really good and you meet a lot of friendly people here. The owner is the nicest guy and he always tries to sit down with you for a talk!If you are vegetarian they manage every meal in a veggie way and they are open for any special wishes Also locals pass the bar all the time and sit down for some beer. We planned to go there for one beer but we were there till the early morning hours.You really feel welcome at d'loovi's. It feels like homeShow less

Author: Winston DKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Excellent Indian and Chinese food at reasonable prices for the area.
Review: We went to Helena's Cafe on two consecutive days with friends for dinner and were very satisfied.We had been there a few months ago and were impressed so we decided we'd go again on our latest trip to Penang.On day 1, we ordered primarily Indian dishes. We had mutton, fish, vegetable curry, rasam and some fried vegetables. Very good and we polished off everything.On day 2, we ordered tom yam soup (both vegetarian and seafood) , fish curry, lamp chops and sizzling vegetables with tofu. This was suprisingly good for a cafe we thought only specialised in Indian food.Helena's Cafe also serves beer and wine. Helena is a pleasant and friendly host. Dishes were served reasonably quickly.We know we will be going back when we are at Batu Ferringhi next. .Show less

Author: florayapz
Title: good for a quick lunch
Review: the food here is not oily and taste just good, not salty. children love the maggi goreng here , we also tried satay, but my hubby doesnt like the satay sauce, as its more to nyonya style , not the original peanut style.

Author: dwoodwar7KL
Title: Delicious curries from Family-run Restaurant
Review: We ate here on New Year's Eve and enjoyed some delicious food. Helena runs and manages this with her mother and others. Given the quality of the food and the generous portions, it was likely a top choice during our week in Penang. Certainly recommend! The portions were larger than at other places we've eaten this week and as a result we got a massive amount of food for similar prices as elsewhere. Great service and delicious food. Recommend the chicken curry and banana fritters for dessert - though everything was great, including for our family that includes a vegetarian and two gluten-free.Show less

Author: 410rhyst
Title: Excellent family run restaurant
Review: Nice atmosphere and home cooked food. The team are exceptionally friendly. The beef rendang is a personal favourite but everything on the menu is tasty.

Author: Gabriella H
Title: Visit here!
Review: Excellent well cooked food. Tasty and well cooked. Great service. Highly recommend - very handy to main beach at batu ferringhi ❤️

Author: anitac890
Title: Great food
Review: Great service. Good food. Very friendly family-run business. Mutton curry was highly recommended but they didn't have it.  Chicken curry was ok. vegetable and tofu sizzling plate was very tasty. Good kids meals. Cold beer. Reasonable prices.

Author: Samwilliams216
Title: Fabulous food and welcome
Review: A great little spot in Batu Ferringhi, where you are always welcomed with big smiles by this lovely family. Food is superb and I cannot fault a single dish that I have tried. Especially the chicken cashew and beef rendang, which has quite a spice kick. Must try restaurant if you are in the areaShow less

Author: dr_ganltSubang Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Marvelous Food
Review: A hot Saturday with young coconuts to quench the thirst at the Helena's Cafe. This is our first visit here to have lunch. Not a bad place and friendly service. The menu is well spread from Local Curry Food to Chinese and Western food for choice. I had Lamb Chop and my wife and son had Fish and Chips. Our granddaughter and DIL had rice with Sweet Sour Chicken and Fried Eggs. The Lamb Chop was superb and tasty, so was the Fish and Chips. Our granddaughter and DIL enjoyed their Sweet Sour Chicken and Fried Eggs as well. Awsome choices for lunch here. CheersShow less

Author: emmajburdenMalaysia
Title: Best local food and service in Batu Ferringhi
Review: Helena and her family give a great welcome and delicious menu. Great choice and it's cooked with care. Enjoyed every item we ordered and came back again in the same week. Their care with SOPs at the entrance was the best along the street. plenty of fans, great menu options and service with a smile. Will be back next time we are in Penang.Show less

Author: KarkouliamitKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Great Food service Excellent try the curry Fab!!
Review: We have been to penang many times and always Make for Helena's cafe the food is superb...Here the atmosphere is great, the location superb,just 2 minute walk from the beach and Helena and the rest off the staff really make the difference we had all our Breakfast, lunch and dinner here. if you are in batu feranghi, don't miss out!!!Show less

Author: Stuart294265Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Red Snapper you say ? that's a Dory Fish !
Review: My wife ordered fish and chips as she was told it was Red Snapper - it was Dory - the waiter said he does not use Dory and it was Red snapper - had enough Dory to know blood Dory when I see it... Tandoori Chicken had not been near a grill - it was like some 1980's boil in the bag chicken with tandoori Sauce. Got a large bill for the experience (but that is normal for Batu Ferringhi - over priced very average food in general)Show less

Author: Alibaker11
Title: Evening meal
Review: Visited this restaurant in the evening and had a lovely meal. Had food from the Chinese options available on their menu and we were not disappointed. Food was excellent. Definitely recommend people to eat here.

Author: salomek439
Title: Okey
Review: Okey food but not that tasty. Nice staff. Cheap and okey for the price. Could need little more spices or something that makes it little more nice.

Author: veronikaa656
Title: Delicious food, nice atmosphere
Review: The menu is a mixture of indian and asian food, during the week we tested 8 dishes and everything was delicious. Staff is very friendly and humorous. Atmosphere is bice.

Author: Z5109TWcarolinacLeeds, United Kingdom
Title: The best in Penang
Review: I have been going to Penang for 19 years now and Helena’s Cafe never fails us.Not only do they serve terrific food but the service is second to none. Theresa, Helena and the rest of their team are always so friendly and helpful, they make us feel welcome every time and I can’t imagine not going there.I cannot recommend Helena’s Cafe enough it really is the best on the island! See you next time! Show less

Author: Clarks09Harrogate, United Kingdom
Title: A Definite must.
Review: We have been visiting Penang for the last 19 years on and off and always visit Helena's quite a few times during our stay. We absolutely love the food. Helena, her mum Teresa (the cook) are a lovely family and we are pleased to have met them. The staff has grown over the years but they all make it a terrific dining experience.Show less

Author: 98rozb
Title: Must try
Review: Lovely restaurant in between night markets in Batu Ferringhi. Great food and very cheap. Remember to take cash as they don’t accept cards.

Author: rayw476
Title: Great curry.
Review: Only had one meal there, lunch. It was a tour group booking and as far as I could tell everyone was more than satisfied and the comments I did hear were all complimentary. I had a beef curry and it was excellent.

Author: Explorer597501
Title: Quality
Review: Quality food and amazing people, 3rd year running we have been to penang and Helanas is the best food in town. Not to be missed

Author: JennyB479
Title: Great local restaurant with items for kids!
Review: We ate here with our two children (ages 7 and 10) for 3 dinners during our week vacation. They loved the chicken curry. Such a friendly feel to the cafe, with the grandma cooking in the kitchen.

Author: Srjota6
Title: Great choice!
Review: Nice little quiet place, with live music just beside the restaurant! The food was delicious and the staff was very friendly. We had the Garlic naan, the Helena's special, the mutton mukbarak and the ice cream banana fritters, and all of them were excellent, good portions and great taste.Show less

Author: Cryim
Title: Great plce for simple food,well cooked and reasonably priced...
Review: According to the suggestions of the people, the food that went to Helena Cafe to eat dinner last night was very tasty.Last night the service was a little slow due to being very busy but still the food was very tasty and enjoyed waiting.The staff tried their best to provide food but was a little late but let's not worry. Highly recommended...Show less

Author: leestravel
Title: Avoid this place. Really (really)
Review: Avoid this place. Really (really) slow service and felt unwell after eating here, have to walk through the kitchen to get to the toilet. Good reviews are confusing? Really poor.

Author: tiagodcrMae Nam, Thailand
Title: Great food and service at a reasonable price
Review: We ordered one ginger chicken stir fry between two of us. The staff were very friendly and accommodating and the service excellent. We would highly recommend this restaurant. It was a very hot and sunny day and the ice cold beer went down a treat as did the most delicious mango lassi that I have ever had. Well worth a visit. Show less

Author: Ai9p
Title: The best food place in this Area super welcoming Delicious....
Review: The welcoming boy went to the Helena Cafe to eat dinner tonight was awesome, here Mutton Curry, Beef Rendung, Roti Paratha Very Tasty...If you are visiting Batu Fringahi, then I advise you to try it once here. Highly recommended...Helenas is the best food ,Good service,good heart and beautiful place. I have tried all the place but I was satisfied with Helena's Meal with welcoming Staffs Such a beautiful newly renovated with new look. 50 years Great rewards. Highly recommended this place.Show less

Author: LesleyB1953
Title: Lovely meal
Review:
We had a few meals at Helena’s and enjoyed everyone. Great family atmosphere.

Staff make you feel really welcome. Reasonable priced.

Thank you

Author: matthewhD3012WA
Title: Amazing food, family friendly!
Review: We ate at helens as a family and we’re made so welcome! We asked for some recommendations and the Chicken Curry, rice and Rotis were amazing! Will definitely be visiting again before we leave Penang!

Author: Thia123
Title: One of our favourite
Review: Always had a good meal here both lunch and dinner time. Excellent service and really friendly owners highly recommend

Author: act78Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: The place is full of flies!
Review: Not for those who goes for healthy lifestyle. Food was below average, everything was instant food. Frozen fish, frozen chicken chop, curry was just bland and overwelmed with just curry powder. The place was invested with flies, we had to keep chasing flies away all throughout our meal. Won’t come back.Show less

Author: DevonfishEngland, United Kingdom
Title: A surprise in the tourist concrete jungle
Review: Batu Ferrenghi, is both a tourist and a concrete jungle. It was a surprise to find this local family owned restaurant for lunch. The food was great and the service perfect. If you have come to a resort in Batu Ferrenghi and never go out then you will miss this gem.Show less

Author: janeQ7912VFYate, United Kingdom
Title: Great food and lovely friendly staff
Review: We ate here on our first night and came back two more times. The food was lovely , we can recommend the mutton curry, fish curry and the sizzling beef. The beer is reasonably priced and for anyone who does not want alcohol the Mocktail called Helena’s special sangria was lovely. Filled with fruit which was great to eat at the end of the meal. The staff are so friendly and welcoming and great to chat to. We would highly recommend a visit hereShow less

Author: Abelthina
Title: Best Food, Beautiful Place in the Area.
Review:
Helenas is the best food ,Good service,good heart and beautiful place.
I have tried all the place but I was satisfied with Helena's Meal with welcoming Staffs Such a beautiful newly renovated with new look.
50 years Great rewards. Highly recommended this place.

Author: benshack87Burnley, United Kingdom
Title: Very tasty and full of flavour
Review: Long flights from the UK to PEN, feeling hungry and tired - whilst unpacking so the reviews for Helena’s cafe and it doesn’t disappoint. We walked to it from our hotel Golden sands, it’s just down past the holiday inn. The staff were very friendly and welcoming with nice cold refreshing drinks served as soon as we took our seats.We ordered Chicken Satay with a cheesy naan bread for a small starter. The chicken was very soft and fell off the skewers. For mains we ordered the chicken curry (it’s spicy but doesn’t blow your head off) it’s full of flavour the lady told us it’s a South Indian curry. You can see some of the spices used in the curry when it arrives and it was packed with chicken, potatoes onions etc - very tasty. We also ordered a chicken in black pepper sizzler which arrived steaming :) with a nice selection of veg mixed in again full of flavour. Rather than eat what each one of us ordered we shared the two dishes with the rice so that we could try both as we sampled each other’s and they were both so tasty ! We’ve already said we will more than likely go back again as the food was fresh, very tasty full of flavour and the price was Fab!! Show less

Author: Rene W
Title: Delicious food
Review: In the Batu Ferringhi area, there are plenty opportunities for a nice dinner. A must-do in our opinion is Helena's. Nice ambiance, great food and a proud family and owner that pay attention to their gasts. Highly recommended.

Author: VicLaws7
Title: Good food and service
Review: Good food and service at very reasonable prices Two mains Nan bread g & t large beer and wrapped up with banana fritter for under 100 £20 for two

Author: Nunk
Title: Nice Indian style food.
Review:
Lovely curries and roti. Inexpensive. Friendly staff.
Table cloths often look a bit grubby. Chairs look very old and could do with replacing.

Author: Drofpots
Title: Good place for local food
Review: This restaurant is on the main road and is a good place for Chinese food. The only complaint is it is next to a live bar, which plays loud music and therefore we found it difficult to talk

Author: reneelee13
Title: Nice cheap food
Review: A group of us from Australia and England had dinner here, the food was good, there's a big variety to pick from, and very well  priced.

Author: Charles M
Title: Late lunch
Review: The mutton curry was amazing and a great price. Open anytime, happy to serve you whenever you are hungry.

Author: Climber247352
Title: Great food and service
Review: Great authentic Malaysian restaurant, very friendly and helpful staff. Wish we’d found this place earlier in our visit, highly recommend this restaurant!

Author: Grunta_aus
Title: Good food
Review:
Had a couple of simple - 
cheap meals here -
Ok for Western people.....
Satays are small but nice, sauce was good...

Author: Nette36
Title: Ordinary
Review: Mutton curry tasty and tender  ,chilli calamari tomato based couldn’t see or taste the chilli   Thought it to be expensive  had better for less

Author: Mjf2905
Title: Great Beef Rendang
Review: Good food, reasonably priced for Batu Feringghi. The beef rendang was a stand out. Staff were friendly and attentive.

Author: CityGuy1973Chelmsford, United Kingdom
Title: Great place for simple food, well cooked and reasonably priced.
Review: Ate here a few times and found the experience to to consistent every time. Whilst not the cheapest place along the road, the food is of a good standard with the owner managers obviously trying to make an effort keeping customers happy.Main dishes are around 25RM so the pricing is fair; you’ll end up with alcohol with a bill of around 200RM plus or minus.Show less

Author: 240katiehChester, United Kingdom
Title: Amazing fresh cooked food
Review: I have two young boys of 8 and 13. They and we totally loved this place. Food was outstanding. My boys had tandoori chicken naan. I had a chicken curry and my husband had beef rendeng. Great menu, with the tastiest ingredients. Service was excellent. Will totally return Show less

Author: GoldenG008
Title: Amazing food and service
Review: We were a family of 11 with some fussy vegetarians and everyone had a lovely meal. Helena couldn't have done enough for us. We went back again.

Author: msk4
Title: Great service
Review: Excellent staff and reception. Family dinner of 13 of us and they were able to accommodate all of our dishes. Great food at reasonable price.

Author: peterppatrick
Title: Great food and service
Review:
Exceptional curry made with lovely spice beautifully cooked and really tasty.
Great service from this family owned and run restaurant where the mum is in charge of the kitchen!

Author: thc2124
Title: Helena’s cafe
Review: This amazing family run restaurant is a must for local food with delicious cuisines fresh from their home style kitchen

Author: BernieandMandyCMornington, Australia
Title: By far the best
Review: Thank you so much to the beautiful food and service here at Helena’s . We saw a review on TripAdvisor and thought we would check it out - by far the absolute best meal we have had in this area ! We will be back again before we leave . Show less

Author: VernonC_13
Title: Really Nice Indian Curry
Review: This a authentic India style cooking restaurant. The curry and rendang here is damn good. Really authentic india curry. There are more curry selection here and you can bet ill be back to try it all out...

Author: dennismeggerland
Title: Great food
Review: Great food drink and a bit of music at the weekends best food we had on our trip in penang thanks drop in if your passing you wont be disapointed

Author: SBasavaR
Title: Great food at the most reasonable price !
Review: Superb quality, superb quantity at the most reasonable price. Service excellent. Try fish  and vegetable curry with rice.

Author: Bob W
Title: Basic, but fine
Review: The food is fine, but really basic. Service was fast. Setting is mundane. If you want some serviceable local food at a reasonable price, it’s OK.

Author: cl41r3Nottingham, United Kingdom
Title: Great food at a reasonable price great service
Review: I wondered around Batu Ferringhi looking for something to eat and cake across this little place. Busy with tourists which is a good sign. Also the guy who came to speak to me was really friendly. And spoke of this family run cafe. The menu has lots of choice including Malaysian, Chinese western etc. So plenty to choose from. The food was served quickly and hot! Kway teow and chicken satay and a small beer. Less than RM30. (Less than £6). It was really tasty. Would definitely recommend this place especially if you want a small local place over the larger hotel restaurants. Show less

Author: NicholaK49
Title: Delicious Food
Review: We have eaten here a few times and would totally recommend it. The food is really fresh and flavoursome. They have a lovely fresh vegetable dish which goes really well with the curries on offer. The Naan bread is made out the back and is some of the most delicious I have eaten.Show less

Author: _ajthoroldPeterborough, United Kingdom
Title: Fabulous food cold beer welcoming family business
Review: Visited this restaurant often during our 12 night stay. Helena s chicken curry was probaby the best curry I have ever tasted (I have had a few!) Would highly recommend the sweet n sour chicken however you won't go far wrong with anything on the menu. The beer is served cold & the family are very welcoming & happy to explain the menu. During our stay we recommended this restaurant to other guests & no one was disappointed. Thanks for coming!Show less

Author: rajncy
Title: Delicious Food
Review: We had a great time. Delicious food. It's a place where family can comes together to spend time. Peaceful environment.

Author: MidlandsArttravel
Title: Lovely little family run cafe with very nice food
Review: We visited this place based on the TA reviews and it was every bit as good as the reviews. A lovely selection of freshly cooked local offerings, I had the Beef Rendang. Very keenly priced well worth a visit

Author: 77thierrys
Title: Visited 5 times
Review: Thank you for your warm and friendly welcome the food is excellent and very good value for money in average you eat for £10  with a Tiger beer

Author: gary2507
Title: Still keeps you coming back for more.
Review: 2nd time for lunch at this place this trip and both times its lived up to expectation. The food was delicious and the price was on par with all the other restraunts. Well worth a vist for lunch or dinner.

Author: Departure792381Southampton, United Kingdom
Title: Our favourite restaurant in BF!
Review: This is a fantastic restaurant, serving delicious, quality meals at reasonable prices - just try the Sizzling Beef! You are warmly welcomed at the entrance by "Uncle" (as we came to call him), then greeted and seated by Helena and the team, who are all incredibly attentive and helpful. This is an absolute gem of a restaurant, and I can sincerely say we did not have a single bad meal here during our 3 week stay.Show less

Author: MartinatDeskHorsham, United Kingdom
Title: Family run business
Review: Usually when I'm approached on the street outside a restaurant I walk on but the very polite gentlemen had me listening and made some menu suggestions which sounded appealing. Service was friendly and attentive and food well presented and tasty. Well priced and you benefit from the live music being played at the Live Lounge next door without having to pay their prices.....Show less

Author: jhutchukLivingston
Title: Don’t walk past it
Review: Fabulous little place. Run by Helena and her family and it’s run as a tight ship. Food is inexpensive, not cheap, as cheap sounds wrong. The fish curry is wonderful as is the plum chicken but don’t pass on the pancake and ice cream as it’s actually crepes and they are a great way to finish the meal. It’s well worth the visit. The living room next door also provides music most nights so you get that for free.Show less

Author: Gregor K
Title: It's ok I guess
Review:
Decent food, but there are better cheap places around, although not on a such a good location.

Check my other reviews for more.

Author: tonyisWimborne
Title: Lovely Food
Review: When we visit Batu Ferringhi for a hoilday this is one of the first places we visit to eat. The staff are so friendly and welcoming. The Stir Fried Beef Ginger is a dish to die for and is my favourite. The Sweet and Sour Chicken is also delicious. For a sweet the Babana Split is mouthwatering. When we come to Batu Ferringhi again we will be visiting you can be sure of that. Thank you Helena for making us so welcome.Show less

Author: Helen WQuorn, United Kingdom
Title: A little gem! Great local restaurant in amongst the big hotels
Review: Tried this place as had same name as me and also appeared to have good reviews on board outside restaurant. It's only a small place on main road but staff very welcoming and quick service. I had the fish curry that came with rice and also had a side order of garlic nam, my boyfriend had the beef rendang. All food was hot, very well cooked and of good quality. Price was reasonable, around 27 RM for a curry. This place definitely deserves the good reviews it already has and nice to see a small place doing well amongst the big hotels!Show less

Author: 60mayanmaryPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Not bad place ..
Review: Food are great .. service a bit slow maybe they dont have staff enough .. place must be additional some fan outside coz its to hot and got mosquito ..but actually place is great even small only .. but how ever i still enjoy my dinner here shout out to the indian man outside his good even he didnt serve but he still keep asking how's food and everything . Thumb up for that cheers !Show less

Author: Patrick1122
Title: Superb food
Review: Great place, with a lot of local and international food, we where very happy about our choices. The service is great, and decent priced

Author: dorothym821
Title: Very basic but excellent food. Not expensive.
Review: The food is freshly cooked. Nice sauces. The tables chairs etc look very basic but the food is good and NOT expensive. Worth a visit. Don’t be put off with the owner trying to get you in at the door!!!

Author: Skuneswary
Title: It was ok
Review: Food was big portion but moderately tasted good..the rice for the fried rice was slightly soft..their seafood is fresh thus the flesh is sweet..overall it was okay for us..just beware if you are driving since parking around here is a pain.. never park infront of the chinese restaurant next to this restaurant.. the owner thinks he owns the parking when it is not even a parking stop .. he places orange traffic cones to book the road..he can be grumpy thus u dont want to spoil your evening just because of him..Show less

Author: stew2676
Title: Great food
Review: Went for dinner the staff were very friendly the service was excellent and so was the food all at very reasonable prices will definitely be eating here again before we leave

Author: Pusspuff
Title: The best restaurant on Batu Ferringhi
Review: We have been coming here for many years we love the people and the food.  This family restaurant delivers with love their home cooked food.  We would not eat anywhere else on Batu Ferringhi

Author: Jet19186437709
Title: Paul & Gill
Review: Excellent food and friendly service. Already visited twice and will be visiting again before holiday over.

Author: laalaapo
Title: Great Malaysian food
Review: Been here a few times on my holiday and loved the service and great tasting food! Noodles were amazing. Highly recommend

Author: simonbell992Shipston on Stour, United Kingdom
Title: Amazing Service and Food
Review: We have visited this restaurant 3 times this week simply because you are treated like one of the family. The food is out of this world, the best I have had on the Island. If you are on this side of the island PLEASE drop by this restaurant and say hello. Show less

Author: Lynette P
Title: Great food
Review: Very nice and food prices were very reasonable. Drinks were nice and cold and lovely relaxing area. Staff were very nice.

Author: rightiorowl
Title: Fantastic food
Review: Fantastic food, excellent service. Spring rolls are great and the Indian Malaysia flavours are great.

Author: MrP78_11Perth, Australia
Title: Flavours, Family, fantastic
Review: Beautiful food with such rich flavours. We only tried the curries but came back three times! Wonderful family running the place (for 40+ years) and offers a great option if you want food that’s not drowning in oil. A new Batu Ferringhi favourite . The very friendly owner is a great source of knowledge and local tips . Show less

Author: APBnew
Title: Very good attention and very good food
Review: It was a big pleasure to dinner two times in this cafe/restaurant, with very good food, especially fresh fish, and the nice attention from Helena and hers family. We were very pleased

Author: Bonnie UBrisbane, Australia
Title: Wonderful Experience
Review: We visited this restaurant on a week night after a long weekend so it was a little quiet which was great for us because we got to meet and have a good conversation with the owner and her family. Really lovely people who explained a lot to us about how they make their food, very interesting. The service was outstanding and the food was really good with sizeable portions. We had samosas for entree, mutton curry for main which was very very nice. Meat so tender and good quality. Also had chicken cashew nut, also very nice. We plan to return in the next few days to try the biryanis and are so looking forward to it. I should also point out that this is a casual restaurant with very reasonable prices!Show less

Author: jamesmuru06
Title: Great food, service and such beautiful people,cozy environment
Review: We there a few times n it was a great dinner ,I recommend everyone to come and try the Fish and chips here which is really tasty worth a try

Author: rajncy
Title: The Fish Curry was AWSOME!
Review: Me & my wife had our dinner at Helena's Cafe. The fish curry served was simply superb. Authentic tamil food. Finger licking Good 😊😉 . I would love to visit this place again & strongly recommend to others to try the food over there.

Author: Nick M
Title: Great value
Review: Went here for quick cheap meal and we were not disappointed - beef rendang was top shelf. Prompt friendly service and cold beers !!

Author: Roweys
Title: Great meal
Review: You could easily walk past and not give this place a second glance, we had a great meal here.  In fact I had the best Beef Rendang curry it was so tasty.  Everybody enjoyed their meals, delicious.

Author: RSBUk
Title: OK food
Review: Food was good. Decent portions and friendly staff. Quite a good variety on the menu. Something for everyone.

Author: Pjf10
Title: Great food and friendly staff
Review: Great place to eat, good menu and food was excellent, recommend Beef Rendang. Also only placed that served is a Malaysian beer, Anchor, very nice too.

Author: TroyM917
Title: Good place
Review: The family and i ate here and liked the food. The staff were very polite and friendly. Not flash to look at but still good price for good tucker.

Author: Jimconno
Title: Loved it
Review: A must visit.  -   don't be misled by appearances.  a superb restaurant with great atmosphere.   -   and the staff are just superb!

Author: Dustin JSydney, Australia
Title: Don't come on a Friday or Saturday night
Review: We loved this cafe. The food is delicious, the service is great and its very good value cost wise. Unfortunately is right next door to a bar where there is live music on Friday and Saturday nights. On the night we ate the singer was dreadful and went on for two hours straight without a break. It spoilt an otherwise fantastic meal.Show less

Author: heidy r
Title: Good best and good smile from the Uncle.. ❤
Review: Thumbs up to the Uncle there thats so fun and smiling no matter all customers calling him. So so friendly, feels good watching him smiling to everyone.. Tried the Hainese Chicken chop and the Singaporean mihun goreng. Really good food and cheap price. Definitely coming back there again. Show less

Author: JGissingBrisbane, Australia
Title: Excellent curry!
Review: Just had an excellent meal at Helena's Cafe. After walking by yesterday we decided tonight was going to be curry night. We asked one of the locals who advised us that Helenas was the place to go so we ventured down the road. The surroundings are not fancy but the food is fantastic. We had the tandoori chicken, chicken and mutton curry and roti. The curries were great but the roti which was freshly cooked and served with tonight's special of a fish head curry sauce which was to die for. All washed down with a super cold beer and finished with fresh mango.I can see why people come back here time after time.Show less

Author: E8668SMstevenpEdinburgh, United Kingdom
Title: Great food and friendly service
Review: I eat a lot of curry, and coming from the UK we have a great choice of good restaurants. Helena's Cafe though has rocketed into my top 5 curry restaurants after our very pleasant visit there on our holidays in Penang. The service is great, Helena herself is lovely and friendly. And the food is superb. I loved the Beef Rendang and my daughter was raving about the roti. It's very reasonably priced, They do nice thoughtful things like keep your beer cold for you. I cant fault the place.Show less

Author: _peterdawson2Belfast, United Kingdom
Review: Great food and atmosphere. The family are extremely friendly and welcoming. We have eaten here the past 2 nights and the food has been fresh, delicious and nicely presented. We would definitely recommend Helena’s the best food in the local area and is well worth a visit. Show less

Author: 449christophsAlmhult, Sweden
Title: Very nice place and good food 👍
Review: We have been four nights in Batu Ferringhi.After one dinner in the Hard Rock Cafe and two times very nice food in hawker centers (one in Batu Ferringhi, I love you cafe, and one in Georgetown) we decided to go for a restaurant on our last evening.We walked down the strip several times and already discovered the Helena Cafe when the man in front explained us the different food they offer, their specialities and that the restaurant exists already since 1970 (!).After reading many reviews in trip advisor which are pretty the same for many places, we decided to go to Helena‘s since we like especially Indian food.We went there and all the people were very friendly and happy that we came there.We ordered 3 dishes; stirfried beef black pepper, chicken curry (spicy) and (as a recommendation) the Chilli Crab Meat. The Chef herself served us the dishes and we can only agree with all the good reviews, it was very very tasty. We liked a lot that everything is fresh, for example in the curry you could also see the used spices. The meat as well as the crab meat was also fresh and you could taste it.Everything was very tasty so we can definitively recommend this place. Once we will go back there for sure, it is a bit sad that we could go there only once since there is much more to try.... Show less

Author: 101joshua
Title: Yumm mutton curry
Review:
Very nice mutton curry,seafood tom yam soup and roti prata,they serve very cold beer too. 40 years old cafe the same mum cooking always theresa and the daughter helena serve we love it 
higly recomend this place.

Author: jeshecas
Title: Best Food In The Area
Review: We went there during our holiday was very nice we don't expect to much fancy and it turn out good, food service, atmosphere and a lovely family cafe highly recommend This is Best One around the two cafe which is guan guan cafe and living room cafe.Show less

Author: 311janee
Title: Authentic Malaysian food
Review: Situated not too far to the right of the Park Royal, This cafe has been in the same family for 3 generations. Helena now runs the cafe and her mother does most of the cooking. Although there is a western menu I highly recommend the Malaysian dishes especially the spring rolls, rendang beef, fish curry and the delightful roti - all prepared and cooked from fresh ingredients. The service is friendly and food is excellent quality. Would have loved to have gone back again but unfortunately have run out of timeShow less

Author: MiluBeauty
Title: good restaurant
Review: very nice food and reasonable price at batu feringghi.....i recommend for local and foreign travellers to try the food here...............

Author: 869cherryd
Title: Roti parantha to die for!
Review: We ate at Helena's after reading some other reviews on trip advisor. We weren't disappointed. Excellent service from super friendly staff, we ate the fish curry on their recommendation & it was fab, plenty of options for our 3.5yr old twins too - and their roti parantha was to die for! Highly recommended Show less

Author: Michael CAberdeen, United Kingdom
Title: Unpretentious
Review: A down to earth little café on the main drag in Batu Ferringhi. The welcome from the owners, who also do most of the work, is delightful. The food is varied, mostly Asian which is what most people want to eat whilst on an Asian holiday. I have enjoyed my meals here as the hosts will tweak any dish to your personal preference. All the prices, to me, appear to be sub-competitive.Show less

Author: RICHARDB8956
Title: Richard
Review: What an outstanding meal. Can not fault in any way. The service was fast and the taste spot on. I had the tandoori chicken and probably one of the best I have ever eaten

Author: Kathleen J
Title: Lunch
Review: We had lunch here. Very reasonable. English and local food. We will go back for a curry as it was recommended by Dennis our driver.

Author: pcmolloy63Singapore, Singapore
Title: Awesome Food and great service
Review: We are at a few places around the main drag that Helena Cafe is on. Have to say that the food at Helena’s is wonderful. Very authentic and reasonable price. Mightn’t have the presence of Ferringhi Garden Restaurant but the food is better and easier on the pocket. Show less

Author: teedub2909
Title: Beautiful Food
Review: The Spring Rolls and Banana Fritters are to die for.  We ate at Helena's three days out of the eleven we stayed in Penang.  Helena and her Mum are such hard-working people, always available for a chat.  And the food is delicious"

Author: PhoonKHSingapore, Singapore
Title: A convenient place to grab a quick and simple lunch
Review: We stumbled on Helena’s Cafe after driving around trying to find a cafe that was opened in the late afternoon. The cafe serves local and Indian dishes. The murtabak goes well with the curry although is different from what we use to have in Singapore in terms of shape and size. Fried rice and fried mamak noodle was a let down. The crust of fish and chips was overdone but the fillet was a generous portion. The ice coffee is a must-try if you are here. Show less

Author: MarcWain
Title: Basic stuff
Review: Was a little disappointed, table clothes etc dirty , general aesthetics not great , food OK , Service good. Cheap.

Author: kfwrigleyLiverpool, United Kingdom
Title: It's always great to return here.
Review: We visited Helena's last night and as usual had some wonderful food.Freshly made Spring Rolls were superb and we had Sweet and sour chicken with mango and pineapple which was absolutely delicious.The staff were very attentive and eager to help in our choices.The Tiger beer was nice and cold.It's always a pleasure coming back here and we eagerly await our next visit.If you are staying at the Shangri La end of the strip it would be wise to take a taxi to Helena's as the walk through the night market can be long and steamy in the heat.Show less

Author: TamilS243
Title: Good Beef Rendang, Great Service and Clean Cafe
Review: We went there for dinner really enjoyed it mom Theresa 40 years of cooking experience is just great with Good manners of hospitality service daughter  Helena excellent they serve very very cold beers my husband just love it highly recommend this place must  try.

Author: jimbocarson
Title: Not bad
Review: I was on my own this time, the last time was 4 years ago with my family. We loved it then. For me this time it was ok but nothing special.

Author: DCDolcevitaPuerto Vallarta, Mexico
Title: Nothing fancy but good value
Review: We came here because the restaurant we had intended to go to was closed -- but we were not disappointed! The char koay teow was delicious and the samosas were good. Prices were extremely reasonable and the service was great. The atmosphere is casual but quite enjoyable. We will come back!Show less

Author: SusanG3799
Title: Great spot for quick top up
Review: We stopped on a hot day for a beer and found the restaurant very clean and promising. We then went on to order some food as the menu look ed enticing. Very good service, the food was very well presented and tasty. They alos offered free wi-fi which is always handy to international travalers. Overall very happy.Show less

Author: Elliot_BusbyUK
Title: Average !
Review: We visited for our evening meal one night during our holiday. Welcome was good and friendly. We ordered beer first whilst we checked out the menu. The server was helpful and spoke decent English. We ordered x2 main courses chicken & prawn dishes and some sides. The order came incorrect twice ! The service was ok and there was no language barrier not sure why it came wrong twice ?? Processed cheese on a naan bread ? Very reasonably priced but a tiresome experience. Food wasn't that good we wouldn't return it was quite bland and a little oily.Show less

Author: tonyisWimborne
Title: Lovely Local Food
Review: We ate our evening meal here on a regular basis. A family run restaurant who pride themselves on their friendliness and excellent food. The beef and chicken curries are superb as are the stir fried beef dishes. We will be returning to Penang next year and will be eating here again.Show less

Author: Gazza59011
Title: Friendly
Review:
Friendly,Good food
Really welcoming family run restaurant - Definitely worth a visit to make your own mind up

Author: Adrian C
Title: Excellent food
Review: Briliant food, low prices. Try the beef rendand, its amazing! Also had the chicken curry, excellent spicy taste, briliant aroma.

Author: JEP30
Title: Great local food
Review: Ate at this small family restaurant several times and each time had excellent food. The best curry capitan I had on the island and I tried quite a few

Author: Leslie W
Title: Brilliant food great service
Review: Great food and great service. We ate here a few times and were never disappointed. Highly recommend.

Author: rogeraK6363EO
Title: Good local food
Review: Best local food we've had in 7 days we've been here. Curry was excellent, very saucy, nice bit of heat. Chinese meal also very good. Beers could do with being a bit colder, but that's a minor point when the food is so good.

Author: SemiRetdNottingham
Title: Lovely southern Indian curry
Review: Had a lovely meal at Helena’s this evening. Chicken curry was full of fresh spices and packed with flavour. Mild was more like medium for uk curry house palate. Fish curry was almost as good. Efficient, friendly service. Simple but clean restaurant. Prices very reasonable. Under MYR80 for 2 curries 2 drinks and a Nan bread. Show less

Author: Susiemarshall7
Title: Quite expensive for local dishes
Review: We had dinner here. I must say it was shocked that one prata costs 4 ringgit and when we checked we were even more surprised to hear that it was the instant prata ...

Author: Ravi K
Title: Nice Food at affordable prices
Review: Been here a couple of times. Nice curry dishes and my daughter loves the squid and prawn curry. Tasty and priced in the right range

Author: 994cecileh
Title: Great restaurant, lovely staff
Review: My friend and I went in this restaurant three days in a row and it was always great. The staff is lovely, devoted to meet your requirements. They are so nice and always smiling. The food is also great and can fit every budget. As my friend and I had low budget, we ordered fried rice and Mah Mee (fried egg noodles), it was delicious and only 8RM. So delicious that we always ordered these dishes. They also are flexible as there was no problem preparing our dishes with no prawns, or to make them not spicy. They also remembered this for the next days we visited, which shows their devotion. I highly recommend this restaurant, lovely staff, delicious dishes and great service for all budgets. You definitely should give it a try ! Show less

Author: Charline C
Title: Lovely restaurant for a relaxing break
Review: My friend and I decided to give Helena's Cafe a try and we were not disappointed at all! Food is tasty and service is quick. The setting offers a cosy environment to enjoy your meal. I would like to give my special thanks to the staff which is absolutely lovely, smiling and friendly. Everybody is very attentive towards their guests and we were deeply touched with some of their little attentions. As a result we ate at Helena's Cafe every night during our stay in Penang. I would totally recommend this restaurant! They really deserve it!Show less

Author: Diana DMelbourne, Australia
Title: Wow! What a Gem!
Review: Great spicy well priced authentic food on the Batu Feringhi restaurant walk. Not pushy at getting you in so maybe missed on this food strip but give it a chance and you won't be disappointed. Food was great, service was quick and friendly. Prices very moderate for both food and drink. Clean, with fans and a portable air conditioner. One not to be missed when you visit the beach strip. We will be back!Show less

Author: Christina S
Title: Good tasty portions and quick
Review: Good sized portions, with quick and lovely service. Chicken cashew stir fry was great! Most meals come with rice (outlined on the menu - good rice too). Comfy seating, fans made it even better. Toilets are through kitchen: western toilet, clean, toilet paper provided, sink with soap outside; just no way to dry hands.Show less

Author: SwargsSolihull, United Kingdom
Title: Amazing food!
Review: The food here was absolutely Amazing! Our best meal in Malaysia by far. There was lots of options and everything tasted so authentic and homemade. The staff were lovely and pleasant and we will definitely be going back. The local roti was particularly divine. Thanks for a lovely experience. Show less

Author: debra b
Title: Authentic local food
Review: Visited here last night for dinner . Had the spring rolls and chicken curry . Amazing food lovely hosts . Highly recommend

Author: Alan-Holden
Title: Great food
Review: Great food and attentive staff at this very unassuming restaurant. I had the curry here and it was fantastic

Author: sunit1000London, United Kingdom
Title: Super friendly service and great quality food
Review: The food here tastes like it's cooked in a local persons house.... and that's pretty much what this is! You can see the chefs cooking away like it's they home. The service is very personal (even watched our live wire 1yr old whilst we finished our food!) And the food is great. No frills, flavoursome food Show less

Author: Lewis HHaverhill, United Kingdom
Title: Incredible Indian food!
Review: Me and my wife heard about this place from a couple we met on our honeymoon, so we went on search for Helena’s and at first walked past it but found it in the end and was greeted by a lovely family of the restaurant who gave us amazing service and the food was incredibly tasty! They are so flexible that if you want something cooked a special way(more spice, less spice, extras etc) they will go out of their way to make it happen. Amazing place and lovely pleasant family owned business, I highly recommend it to any one!Show less

Author: adelsteff
Title: The best ever fish curry
Review: I went there this evening. We had sweet n sour fish,fish curry,mix vege,deep fried squids,beef with black pepper and samosa for 5 pax. Total damage rm260. Overall rating 10 out of 10. The food was so good at a reasonable price. Fish was fresh. Nothing to complain. Keep it up and God bless!Show less

Author: 630imranmLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Stunning Asian food, well worth a visit...
Review: We stayed in Batu Ferringhi for two weeks sampling most of the restaurants up and down the one km strip and it was Helena's Cafe that we went back to time and again!If you are appreciative of proper Asian food (the curries are authentic and will compare most favourably to the relatively bland offerings sometimes served in the UK, assuming of course flavour is your thing!) then this place is truly worth a visit.Helena's Cafe is a family run restaurant where you will receive a pleasant greeting right at the front door. Mummy and son occupy the kitchen with spectacular fashion and the daughters run the front of house.The main chef hails from South India and the chicken curry is truly reminiscent of food from those shores; bursting with flavour, spices and curry leaves, it is not to be missed and must be eaten (in my opinion!) with some of the fresh rotis which are incredible.My wife ordered the local Char Kway Teow and beef with ginger; the noodles were amongst some of the best we have sampled during our holiday demonstrating the wonderful array of skills possessed by both chefs.So if you are after a diverse Asian menu offering truly authentic food, Helena's Cafe is definitely worth a visit, enjoy! Show less

Author: Theresa  A
Title: Great Food,Lovely People
Review: highly recommended this lovely place where got a great beef rendang, Mutton curry, Mix vegetables and Steam fish all home cooking and friendly people around feel at home.will be back next year.

Author: tahrad2014
Title: Not impressed
Review: We had chicken curry, peppered beef and beef randang. None of them were great to be honest. I'd go elsewhere.

Author: mudster2009
Title: nice
Review: very friendly and welcoming, a wide variety of food, very reasonably priced.  We enjoyed a number of meals at this place

Author: mosschopukMilton Keynes, United Kingdom
Title: Delicious food!
Review: We were intending to go to the Living Room next door, but thought we would give Helena's cafe a try instead, and we are glad we did! The service was warm and friendly, advising us about local dishes and providing recommendations. The satay was very tasty, and the beef rending was also very good. The prices were excellent and we will happily go back.Show less

Author: hornet24London, United Kingdom
Title: Fantastic!!
Review: Helenas, 19/6/17. We received a lovely warm welcome from Juanna and all her family, they were the most friendly and wonderful people you could want to meet , and the food didn't let us or them down. Lots of wonderful freshly made authentic Malaysian meals to to pick from. we had ........... Great food, great prices, and wonderful wonderful staff, we highly rate this restaurant. Our last meal here culminated in all the family coming out so we could take pictures, and also shed a few tears when saying goodbye. The people that run this restaurant could not have done more for us. This was our most visited restaurant during our 2 week stay in Penang. Please try it, you will not be disappointed. Show less

Author: mermaidmiss
Title: birthday holiday
Review: Visited this restaurant twice on our trip to Penang.Service was superb.The first time we just had drinks but the second time I had Satay which was superb

Author: 740katjas
Title: Local place with great food and good service
Review: Super food, very good service. Can highly be recommended 👍🏼a very local place where you get great food. We had soups, spring rolls, curry - all tasting great

Author: David MSydney, Australia
Title: Fantastic local restaurant
Review: On two week holiday here in Penang and stumbled upon Helenas on day 3, now been back 4 times. The curries are great, helenas special nasi goreng fantastic and the satay superb.We have two fussy kids (14 and 9) and no dramas with them.The staff have provided excellent service and all at a very reasonable price.We can't recommend Helenas highly enough.Show less

Author: 769mrsgBirmingham, United Kingdom
Title: Really tasty lunch and great service
Review: We had a late lunch here one afternoon. The food was so so tasty, special mention to the beef in black bean sauce. The waitress was really helpful and efficient, she made sure the fans were on our table for coolness and that my husband didn't run out of beer! A little oasis of greenery, give it a try.Show less

Author: SarahG534
Title: Great food
Review: We are here based on a recommendation from a tailor and the food did not disappoint. We had a variety of food between the 4 adults and 2 kids with a couple of drinks each. Great curries and great value for money.

Author: Robert C
Title: Theres a Rat in the kitchen.
Review: Enjoying my meal until until I spotted a rat the size of a small cat run into the kitchen. Hygeine standards poor, I also had to go through kitchen to get to the toilet.

Author: jilpet
Title: Dinner
Review: Had a beautiful dinner. Lots of selection but we chose Chicken Satay, Char Kway Teoy and Nasi Goreng. All delicious and big servings. Friendly staff.

Author: Talal H
Title: Awesome food and hospitality
Review: This place is one of the best places in penang. The food we have here was more than yummy it was delecious. The best thing here was their staff. Really these guys were so courteous n humble. Having a nice dinner with such a nice staff has always been a good option.Show less

Author: LeeFamily2013Singapore, Singapore
Title: Pretty Authentic
Review: We were caught in a passing shower and stumbled here to take refuge. Decided to have lunch and we ordered the special nasi goreng (fried rice) and the fish curry. The former was a little disappointing, especially given the price point. However, the fish curry was excellent. Fish was fresh and the portion generous. The gravy of the curry had assam so it made the dish lighter than a typical curry. We would return just for the curry.Show less

Author: KumareshMadhaven
Title: Beautiful view good food
Review: Fantastic view facing Batu ferringi beach. Thai food is served here, the pineapple fried rice is a tasty dish here.The tap Tim kroap ( Thai dessert) is great here. Also try the Virgin mojito , its extremely refreshing. Wish they can bring the prices down a little to a reasonable level. Show less

Author: LilyR663
Title: Friendly Reatoran
Review: We went the again for dinner,The beef rendang was great,mum cooking is best.you should try mutton.curry,one off.the best in town.

Author: Olivia C
Title: Fabulous
Review: Family run business with first class service. All the food is freshly cooked, and was absolutely fabulous. Highly recommend the vegetable curry, my personal favourite. Very reasonably priced. A family run business, made us feel extremely welcome, beautiful people.

Author: Alexandra V
Title: Dinner
Review: Food was amazing and the service was fabulous. Highly recommend if you enjoy home cooked authentic food. Family run restaurant who are very friendly

Author: kfwrigleyLiverpool, United Kingdom
Title: Super service and great meals.
Review: Recently visited Helenas for the first time and we had a great evening.There was a warm greeting from the staff and they went through the menu with us and we adapted our meal accordingl.We were given very generous portions of both starters and mains which proved a bit too much for my wife, but not me.The girls there were very attentive and offered me a beer as an alternative to 'Tiger' which I tried, it was fine. Excellent food at exceptional value.We think Helena's is well worth a visit, we will definitely be back.Show less

Author: Linda P
Title: Delicious food and wonderful service from family owned restuarant. She's been cooking for 35 years
Review: Our favourite restuarant. Mum does the cooking and daughters work there.  Nothing is too much trouble and the food is DIVINE!

Author: Z5109TWcarolinacLeeds, United Kingdom
Title: A must when in Penang!
Review: We've been going to Helenas cafe since 2001 and it never disappoints! Such a great family that run the restaurant, fantastic food and great atmosphere! Make sure to try Helenas special nasi goreng it's my favourite!! It's walking distance from all hotels and is open for lunch and dinner except on Sundays when it's closed. This place is definitely our local whenever we are in Penang!! Show less

Author: omega132857Chichester, United Kingdom
Title: Still serving great food
Review: So nice to be back in Penang, and just had to pop in to see Helena again. It was raining tonight , so just as our hotel was just down the road( Park Royal) we decided this was a good place to eat. Glad to say it has the same warm welcome and great food again. great food great place, not the most romantic but hay, we are here for the food. Service is good and the food is good, so pop in and try it.Show less

Author: katiee277
Title: Highly Recommended
Review: Fabulous food, Nasi Goreng and Curries in particular. Friendly staff and overall a lovely place to eat.

Author: hughesisaaceli
Title: Helena's yum
Review: Great little restaurant,good food,friendly staff and very affordable ,recommended by staff member at nearby hotel and we were very satisfied

Author: Mrs-white-winePerth
Title: Lovely food and service
Review: We went here last night and the food was very nice. They ran out of wine and went out and got some more rather than just saying they had run out. The service was great and there was a good variety of western, Malay, Chinese and Indian dishes. Prices were very reasonable. I would definitely return again to Helena's.Show less

Author: UK_SP
Title: Good local food
Review: We visited as it was highly listed on tripadvisor, its an average place in terms of the restaurant setting itself but food was lovely and service was attentive but they were very quiet.

Author: mia2000adeladelaide
Title: Great Noodles
Review: They do excellent cheap meals here the staff are really nice and the mum who does the cooking does it like a home cooked meal . Helena is a really nice young lady and made us welcome . i hope that she a great birthday the other dayShow less

Author: hopleys
Title: Good as ever.
Review: We  have been coming here for years, this time we had the mutton curry, steamboat and nasi goreng Helena special. All of it delicious. Well worth the walk from the Lone Pine.

Author: ZakiI39
Title: Good little place
Review:
Staff were great
Place was busy and we were told the food would take 20 mins..so no surprises on the waiting time. 
Food was tasty and will priced.

Will revisit.

Author: Robbie_Dublin12Dublin, Ireland
Title: Delicious Local Food
Review: I and my wife have visited this small restaurant many times during our stay in Batu Ferringhi.The inside looks pretty simple but the front garden is very nice and is surrounded by plants.Food was always very good; we tried many Malesyan specialties and we were never disappointed. Western cuisine is also available even if we didn't try it. The staff was very smiley and friendly, trying their best to please the customers. Last but not least, the prices are very affordable: for two delicious Kwai Teow with drinks you are likely to pay around 40 Ringit.Highly recommended to anyone looking for a clean, nice place where to enjoy local specialties.Show less

Author: PeterMelbourne108
Title: Helena's Cafe is Great
Review: Helena's serves good quality, authentic and CLEAN Malay, Indian and Chinese food. More expensive than Long Beach cafe, but food is superior and more authentic. Super friendly staff and pleasant environment. Well worth the extra MYRs.

Author: HLS12872
Title: Wonderful local cuisine
Review: Had a great meal here last night. The beef randang was fantastic as was the tandoori chicken. The service was great and very friendly and the price was extremely reasonable. Would definitely recommend a visit. We will be going back before we leave!

Author: Sylvia T
Title: Good service, good food
Review: Had a couple of lovely meals here, one clam dish in particular made on the co owners recommendation was excellent.

Author: Jill C
Title: Poor
Review: Long wait for food. Curries thin, watery and powdery. Not very exciting. Staff very pleasant but the restaurants either side are better.

Author: Mark G
Title: Nice food, slow service
Review: We ate here as many of our favourite places were closed due to Chinese new year. The food was absolutely fine and the staff good fun but even though the place was not full our food took almost 30 minutes to arrive, shame.

Author: 268ANDREASurrey U.K.
Title: A little more care needed in the cooking.
Review: It was lovely to find a local family restaurant with no piped music. We were greeted by a friendly girl, maybe one of the daughters? I ordered fish curry and my friend ordered mutton curry. We had to wait quite a long time, but that was fine as we assumed it was being freshly cooked. Both curry sauces were delicious and totally authentic, but unfortunately my fish was so overcooked, it was inedible, as was the mutton. We could understand the mutton being tough, but not the fish. They do have wine and beer, but are happy for you to bring your own. A little more care and it would have been perfect - shame!Show less

Author: Robert F
Title: good for the money
Review: For good nutritious cheap eats this pretty good We ate here a couple of times and were pleased withe the quality of food and service attention. Give it a try

Author: JoMcaughtrieBenfleet, United Kingdom
Title: Best Food Batu Ferringhi
Review: We tried most of the restaurants in trip advisor, but this has to be the best. The staff are friendly and welcoming and the food is awesome. We were here for a week and visited twice, it was never disappointing and very good value. This place is highly recommended.Show less

Author: Johanna24610
Title: Think we should have gone when not so busy
Review: The popular restaurant next door was closed so they were very busy which meant a long wait for food.  Food was good when it arrived and beers cold.

Author: Dorothy B
Title: good food, friendly service
Review: a streetside restaurant with Chinese, Indian, and Malay food. The vegetarian curry was dddeliciusif a bit mild and the sweet and sour vegetables surprisingly good. Service was friendly and helpful
