Author: Prest0nians
Title: Friendly,good service and fair value food
Review: We enjoyed an evening meal of chilli beef  and rice after 2 starters.The service was good,the meal reasonably priced and the atmosphere was relaxing.

Author: hammo25
Title: Not much good to say really
Review: Food took forever and was average at best.  Place wasn't busy but the kitchen struggled to keep up.  Tablecloths and furniture was all filthy.  At least we didn't get sick.

Author: ScubajoolsCalverton, United Kingdom
Title: Great food, overly friendly!
Review: A small restaurant conveniently located in Batu Ferringhi, the food was served quickly and was delicious. I found the staff very friendly and charming, almost too much so. There was a good choice on the menu and prices were very reasonable. Well worth giving this place a try.Show less

Author: sarah b
Title: Miss sarah bird
Review: Great food Great fun!! It's upstairs & could be easily missed. Andrew creates a wonderful atmosphere

Author: 888PeterL
Title: Dinner
Review: Feeling hungry,walked in to Mary Jane, who welcomed us in . Food ok ,beer cold,friendly service with no fuss. Worth a visit.

Author: E3904GUlindac
Title: LOVELY RESTAURANT.
Review: Helena was very friendly and informative about the area and things to do. The food was excellent as we had her recommendation which was her speciality. Would definitely visit again.

Author: Sonya G
Title: Great food
Review: Excellent food, service and friendly staff, will be back...  loved the sweet and sour fish and beef rendang.

Author: FamilyAdventure2011
Title: Family quick lunch
Review: This is a fabulous little find. We came in for a quick bite of satay and fried rice and it was delicious. The owner is amazing, friendly and helpful. Free wifi. Well worth the visit and we shall return.

Author: ricardofusballBrisbane, Australia
Title: Well priced local spot
Review: We had a few meals at Helena's cafe, both for lunch & dinner. The service & menu is pretty no-nonsense, but the menu does cover a lot of territory. We enjoyed all our meals here & ended up eating about 15 dishes off the menu. They serve beers too. It's a good spot for lunch or dinner if you're looking for somewhere casual & well-priced.Show less

Author: AgathaChristie2012Singapore, Singapore
Title: Amazing Prawn Curry!
Review: We eat at Helena's every time we come to Batu Ferringhi and we always order at least one bowl of the Prawn Curry - sometimes we both get it! Consistently delicious in a typical family owned street-side restaurant. Helena and her family also try to meet my gluten free needs as well. Highly recommended!Show less

Author: shazzerinthesunPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Good solid food with charming owner
Review: Had lunch here and enjoyed a terrific lunch. Mary Jane greeted us with enthusiasm and drew us in. Immediate hospitality, service and menus. Beers delivered quickly with a into to the menu. I was looking for prawns and they brought out four huge ones for me to see before they prepared them.They made a terrific prawn curry (and made it mild as requested). Also had mixed vegetables with tofu, rice, chicken satay and an outstanding raita.Helena - Mary Jane's daughter delivered the food and made sure everything was ok. A lovely lunch!Show less

Author: JenandPhill
Title: The best little café!!
Review: This is by far out favorite little spot in Penang. Helena and her family are lovely and the food they cook up is just out of this world! We worked out way through half the menu and never got a bum dish! Would highly recommend Chicken Biryani Helen's Special Nasi Goreng Beef RendangCrab CurryChicken CurryRotiLemmon chickenDon't be scared to ask off the menu if they can do it they are more than happy!They accommodated our family and friends and the kids had a ball! Can't wait to come back!Show less

Author: Jewels680
Title: Greaat tasty food.good host
Review:
Amazing sweet and sour fish,sizzling beef,noodles.
Very filling,nice ambience.worth a visit for chinese style food

Author: Y3838ADrichardm
Title: Delicious food and delightful host
Review: Mary Jane was super friendly and helpful, what a character. The food was all very good but the spring rolls were the best I have ever had, the chicken curry very fragrant and the roti naan so flaky and so delicious. We should have left room for more!Show less

Author: Charles TLondon, United Kingdom
Title: safe and simple but good
Review: This restaurant is on Batu Ferringhi so primarily focused on a tourist clientele. Menu reflected this with mix of western and local dishes. We were looking for convenient but still authentic food and weren't disappointed. Squid curry was very tasty, price was fine - neither cheap nor expensive.Show less

Author: charlotte b
Title: Lovely
Review: We ate here a few times and each time to food was great. Lovely local food which has a goid range. staff were friendly and its so cheap

Author: Carolyn M
Title: Great food
Review: We got a takeaway from here and we were impressed! The lady recommended chicken curry and a garlic roti and it was delicious! The spring rolls were good too! Good prices.

Author: mike c
Title: a little bit average
Review: my wife & I ,only visited once, the service good, menu fine, prices average, but food quality, so so, small servings , not great. maybe we went on an off night, the staff were very kind.

Author: LeiLei71
Title: Back again for another great meal.
Review: Very good prices and great service. All the family (15 of us) were impressed but the food. Everything we tried was delicious.

Author: Breakingwaves2001Tarland, United Kingdom
Title: Solid home cooking
Review: Very laid back, felt totally comfortable and welcome with my daughter, jug sized beers, and child friendly food. Kid running around belonged there, they had no problem with my daughter roaming through the kitchen and into their yard. Great simple home cooking, nothing fancy, clean food.Show less

Author: Margaret R
Title: Helena's cafe Batu ferringhi
Review: Great restaurant with friendly staff. Food superb and great prices. Best restaurant in that area by far.

Author: simonka28
Title: There's better.
Review: It was nice, nothing special. Prices ok but small servings. Service was good and staff friendly. Preferred next door at the living room.

Author: brookie0871
Title: Love, love, love.... Make sure you drop in
Review: Authentic Malaysian and lots of other local Asian food options.... Great service and food... Parking tricky in main road but worth the effort to enjoy the cheeky service and great food

Author: Gavin N
Title: Great for families. Owner super friendly
Review: Anyone that was in the RAAF in Butterworth in the eighties should eat here. Owned by a lady that used to cook at the "Hostie" you can relive those heady days through her razor sharp memory of everyone who passed through. For us it was a friendly welcome and a good menu. The food appeared quickly and was very tasty. Just has a nice family feel.Show less

Author: PedralbapeterPedralba, Spain
Title: Excellent food and great service.
Review: We ate at Helena's on a number of occasions and found the food and service excellent.The tiger prawns are the biggest and tastiest I have had anywhere in the world. Helena and her family make you feel very welcome .The price of the food is very reasonable.Show less

Author: roberthT3939ODToronto, Canada
Title: Fresh and delicious!
Review: I can usually walk right by the greeters out in front of most of the local eateries but Mary Jane makes you feel so welcome she's hard to resist. 46 years in business and I can see why. I enjoyed a fantastic curry chicken loaded with cinnamon sticks, basil and star anise. Spicey but not overly so and served with rice. A piece of Indian style bread and a glass of fresh squeezed lemonade completed my meal. I'm going back tomorrow to try the noodles.Service with a smile, a laugh and a story or two. Fantastic!Show less

Author: Caryl CWoking, United Kingdom
Title: Great atmosphere, good food
Review: Hard to say no to the lady with the menu!!A street side cafe with seating outside and under a canopy. We sat near a fan and ordered 2 large beers. After chatting to the staff for recommendations we ordered chicken satay. Followed by sizzling beef, chilli fish and mixed vegetables. the fish just melted in our mouths.Great value. 115.50 Ringgits.Worth a visit.Show less

Author: Ciepas
Title: Good no frills place to eat
Review: Very good food in large choice, friendly and fast service and decent prices. Try their sizzling pan dishes.

Author: UlliRahn
Title: Was ok
Review: Nothing special, food ok, price ok. Friendly staff and good is that the prices include the taxes...There is not much around in batu ferringhi...

Author: natashap895Alexandria, Virginia
Title: Tasty
Review: Went here for late lunch. The owner did a bit of a hard sell, trying to convince us what to order. But the truth is, no matter what we ordered, it would have been fine. We had the pepper chicken and beef with oyster sauce-both were really good. Traditional Chinese style, very good. There were also Malay dishes in the menu. Quick service.Show less

Author: MikeEaglescliffeEaglescliffe, United Kingdom
Title: Great value and good quality food
Review: Located at the western end of Batu Ferringhi where the night market comes to an end stands Kafe Helena. You can't miss it because Helena herself will be standing outside trying to entice you in and showing you her recipe book! The cafe is a family affair, with very simple decor (don't expect luxury) but really good quality food, well cooked and good value for money. We had fish which was clearly very fresh. While there were only a couple of tables filled when we went at 6.30 it was packed by the time we left. Helena clearly has a passion for life as well as food which comes out if you chat to her. Well worth a visit. Show less

Author: Anto876Madrid, Spain
Title: Totally disappointed
Review: We came here for lunch, we ordered tandoori chicken and lamb chop. As it often happen in fusion restaurants, they have hundreds of different dishes on the menu and none of them is good and original. The drinks... We ordered two blended juices (the waitress said that the fruit were fresh...) actually they were supermarket juice frozen and blended... The restaurant furnitures were very poor and the menu more expensive than average. I don't recommend this placeShow less

Author: The8FischersPerth, Australia
Title: Great food, Great hospitality.
Review: We stumbled across this Cafe because the one we wanted to visit was closed. We were all very glad we found this place after the meal. The vegetables were stir fried to perfection. Crisp and Yummy. The fish curry, The Biriyani (special order), the Bee Hoon, etc were all very tasty and very fresh. Great value for money. Thank You to Helena and her Mum (the chef) for their hospitality and great food.Show less

Author: Inga B
Title: Cheap local food
Review: I wouldn't say the restaurant has excellent food but it is good local food with affordable prices. The restaurant itself looked a bit like a museum, there were so many interesting, dusty, antique things.

Author: TheTimeBandits
Title: Excellent food and service
Review: Called in on the off chance, as not in top list of Batu Ferrenghi restaurants, excellent menu , good service at reasonable prices. Deserves a mention especially as competing with the Living Room adjacent.

Author: zeppelin71
Title: Food  and Hospitilty is out of the world
Review: Me and my Husband had a great time in the evenings in Helena/.s Café the food was great , and the Family who runs the Café is very welcoming and friendly.

Author: KerrylLovesMalaysiaPerth, Australia
Title: Fantastic Service and food!
Review: Helena's Cafe is renowned for their amazing steamboat which we usually have, however this time we opted for other items on the menu - local food.Again we were not disappointed as the food had amazing flavour and after it we were all extremely satisfied not only with the food, but also with the service. They also have amazing sour sop slushies which I have never found anywhere else in Malaysia!!!Helena and family, this restaurant is a credit to you - well done!Show less

Author: booLincoln
Title: Great food
Review: called by of chance and was very welcomed in by owner very glad we went in food was great and very reasonable we will be going again before returning get home

Author: 213JohnLMelbourne, Australia
Title: Not bad. Not great.
Review: Just middle of the road in most departments, including food, service and atmosphere. No real difference in quality to the nearby food courts / hawker stands but priced above those. Only had dinner here on the one night and appeared to only be frequented by Australians. Not sure this is a good sign if looking for authentic Malaysian food. The hostess did her best to engage. Did the job and left satisfied but not overwhelmed. Better value elsewhere.Show less

Author: X6426IItonyk
Title: Lunch
Review: Good on the day need to come a few times to get a better rating and opinion on the place till then cant say to much at the moment

Author: mosey3
Title: Nice  place to eat in Batu Ferringhi
Review: Very friendly and welcoming . Good  size portions of food and well presented Prices are very reasonable.   Very clean  pleasant surroundings.

Author: Lorrainepatriciatodd
Title: Nice crab curry
Review: We have eaten here a few times now.  They make a nice curry and they are a friendly family business with nice surroundings.  Average food and prices.

Author: goldman30
Title: nice restaurant
Review: been to this restaurant several times , service is great , price are very reasonable , recommend this restaurant.

Author: eli EKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: The homeliest food in Penang, none second to home.
Review: My friends and I were looking for a place to have dinner and had initially picked the Living Room as the place to go, but the food offered by it were expensive to our budget. Little did we know, we stumbled upon this cafe which is just next to the Living Room. We were hesitant at first when Aunt Mary Jane came and spoke to us. We then spotted the TripAdvisor excellent award given to Helena's Cafe. Without hesitation, we were guided to a table and we were also the first few customers of the Cafe that evening. Aunt Mary Jane recommended us foods that satiated our cravings and we felt respected and tremendously welcomed by the excellent yet simple and homely service.On this note, we would also like to thank Aunt Mary Jane for having our interests in her mind. According to her, a group of University of Sarawak's students had asked her if it was okay to take a photo with us but Aunt Mary Jane and her daughter Helen protected our privacy by politely replying them to ask us themselves; we enjoyed our dinner without interruption or unwanted attention. The food was great and the price is among the best along the stretch of restaurants and bars at Batu Ferigghi. Fellow TripAdvisor members, do visit Helena's Cafe for great food and to feel what home is like without bounds.Show less

Author: Edward L
Title: good
Review: food was good, the staff friendly. i enjoyed my dining experience here, would recommend if you want a good meal in Batu Ferringhi

Author: NRKettle
Title: On honeymoon
Review: No idea where the rest of the people eat who review this place.Food poor chef mike rules and the toilets are over looked my the kitchen staff and the other restaurant workers next to them.I was in the loo and in mid flow asked by the waitress "Everything ok?" Now what do you think?? Odd doesn't even close !!!Show less

Author: MPF333
Title: Great Food
Review: First time in Penang and so we found this restaurant totally by chance.  The food was great as we're the staff, they made us feel very welcome. I would definitely return on my next visit to this great island.

Author: floridareularChannel Islands
Title: Good honest food
Review: We had a great meal in here. Nothing too different from the rest of the cafes in BF but well cooked and tasty. A pleasant evening relaxed and fun. It is well priced and the food is fresh. A fair selection of items for all tastes.Show less

Author: karenpF9306VO
Title: Very Nice place very good food and very Nice staff
Review: Very Nice place very good food and very kind staff We went there tre times in five days, We had some straks and very Nice Indian food

Author: john m
Title: Great food and service
Review: The beef curry was absolutely delicious. Best curry I've had. My wife loved the chicken cashew do much that we went back another night for it. Excellent service and very friendly staff. Highly recommended.

Author: TinaLBalla
Title: So disappointed after all the rave reviews
Review:
four of us ate there.
Meals eaten were chicken cashew nuts.. Was ok
Other meals very average, but the worst was the cheese naan bread picture attached.
Expecting authentic cheese mann, only to get bread with melted cheese slice on top. Really!,,not good

Author: Henk MVlaardingen, The Netherlands
Title: It is difficult to shine in Batu Ferringhi
Review: Yes, with so many good eating spots in Batu Ferringhi to choose from, it is busy at the top and I am afraid that Helena's Café is not the top in Batu Ferringhi. Granted, Helena's Café fits in the expectation of a casual sit down, the service of the staff is polite and dedicated, but in my experience the food is a bit bland and mediocre at best, not to be compared with the Long Beach Hawkers center or Andrew's Kampung, to name a couple of shining stars in Batu Ferringhi. A positive point of Helena's is the flexible opening hours.Show less

Author: 139alanm
Title: Great spot
Review: Lovely staff and owner. Excellent food and very consistent. Very reasonable price. Sadly closed Monday's but plenty close by to chose from.

Author: 62shelleyb
Title: Quality food with excellent service
Review:
Myself and my husband eat at Helena's Cafe several times, the food is good quality, and served with care. 

Helena and her mom make a great team!

Best crab sandwich ever!

Author: Michelle CMelbourne, Australia
Title: Delicious and great value
Review: Mh husband and I wanted a yummy, local cafe to eat at as we were staying at the Hard Rock Hotel not far away. We ate here on two different occasions during the week. The food was yummy, hot and fresh. All great value for money and friendly, quick service. Would highly recommend anyone staying in Batu Ferringhi to eat here.Show less

Author: andrewooi78Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Tips From tripadvisor
Review: Base on tripadvisor review.. Just coincedence stop infront of this shop and remember tripadvisor review on this place. Why not gv a try.. We order fried mee,curry mutton,fried rice and roti prata (roti canai). Foods quite nice. We prefer curry mutton ( must try) very nice. Differ when we eat at KL. For me the roti prata quite expensive cost RM 4.Show less

Author: barbaraf1962Barrow-in-Furness, United Kingdom
Title: Good and safe
Review: Dropped in here as an alternative to the living room which was overly busy.What a find...... The food and service were great. We got exactly what we asked for. Fresh,hot and very tasty.It's clean and cheap.Give this place a go as it is well worth it.Show less

Author: HANCHEL12London, United Kingdom
Title: Best Curry in Batu Ferrenghi........ AMAZING.
Review: Helena's Cafe is a must when it comes to eating in Batu Ferrenghi . We visited twice. Family run cafe. The food and service is great!! A tip if you like curries is to try the Chicken curry . It is one of the best curry's I have ever had. Overall great value for superb foodShow less

Author: LeiLei71
Title: Best ever steak
Review: three years ago we were here...well back again. My husband thought it the best steak ever over in Penang. I love the family history...they have been there forever. The food cheap, service lovely. A MUST try.

Author: Leah L
Title: Great Food lovely staff
Review: A very basic decorated restaurant where you can sit outdoors the food was delicious - we had curry and it was yummy and they were happy to prepare it anyway you wanted it

Author: meatm8New Zealand
Title: Great Value
Review: When we planned to go to Penang, my wife and I agreed we had to try Malaysian satays and Helena's Cafe did not disappoint. In fact they are the best we have had. All the meals we ate here we great value for money and very tasty.Show less

Author: PackidgePenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Not the Spice of Life
Review: “I sorry, no credit cards”“Oh? Where does it say that?”“Sorry?”“I mean is it on the board outside or on the menu inside?”“No, sorry”“Is your machine broken?”“No have machine“"Maybe you could tell people that before they order and not when you giv them a bill for RM110?”"Sorry, cash machine down road”To be honest I was already a little a little miffed that the bill had come to RM110 but this was down to the prawn curry my wife ordered at 42RM. I was also disappointed that the food had not lived up to expectation whereas the wait for it, at just shy of 30 minutes, certainly had.Leaving aside the credit card debacle, the long wait time and disappointing food are perhaps connected. Everything here is cooked to order which is fine for hokkien, chinese and even western cuisine but for Indian the result is that you get spices which have not been cooked out and have also not had time to infuse the meat, fish or vegetables. In short, rather than being unctious it is edgy and therefore really not very nice.This was my first and, regrettably, will be my last visit to Helena's Cafe.Show less

Author: Edmondh75
Title: Food with a smooth flavor
Review: Went there for lunch today. Order roti prata, noodles and the saté all fresh made and very delicious. It was not to salty and not to sweet, just perfect Next visit we will come for a dinner.

Author: Doreen E
Title: Great Food Good Value
Review:
We were made to feel very welcome and the food was excellent so we found ourselves going back quite a few times. A very nice family restaurant that deserves to do well
Doreen and Josephine (Perth  Australia)

Author: jilk6
Title: worth a visit
Review: Good choice of menu - I have several food intolerances but found something to eat. Lovely food, excellent service, great price - worth a visit.

Author: DunfunnyWaterford, Ireland
Title: Amazing value
Review: Had lunch here on three occasions on my recent visit to Batu Ferringi and cannot recommend it highly enough. Run by 2 local ladies the food is excellent and amazing value for money. They serve local and western food but do try their curries made with fresh local ingredients absolutely delicious..... I had sizzling beef on one visit I wasn't sure that I would like some of the ingredients but they made it for me just using what I wanted in it loved it amazing service ... A must visit if you are in this area ...Show less

Cause it's Indian you should go for something Indian, which I'm sure would be tasty. We just had noodles and some vegetables which was ok but nothing delicious like living room next door. Very cheap. Show less

Author: john f
Title: Good food!
Review: Lovely clean place with simple tasty home cooked food. Staff were great too. Ate there quite a lot and look forward to going back next year.

Author: mirnag89
Title: Nice staff
Review: Went there ordered sizzling beef and satay  beef all was delicious ..service is good and staff were veryyyy friendly .

Author: nobbyHertfordshire
Title: fed up of long titles now, nice clean basic reastaurant !!
Review:
While battling our way through the myriad of stalls at the night market we thought we would try this place.

Friendly greeting, simple menu and food that was not fancy or overpriced but tasty none the less .

Worth a visit..

Author: taubs
Title: Delicious food, clean & inexpensive
Review: Our driver recommended this restaurant to us and we had lunch there,  The food was all freshly cooked, very tasty and although the decor was simple it was very clean,  Definitely worth a visit.

Author: robertosweddingessex
Title: Great tasty food
Review: Lovely family run restaurant, good tasty food a definate visit ! We ate here three times in our stay as you always recieved a warm welcome and the owners took the time to explain how dishes were made as we wanted to try to recreate the dishes at home. Could not fault it . We loved the hawer market but it was more relaxing experience to sit in the restaurant and be looked after ! Show less

Author: TravellingBlinn
