Review: Service is good and food is great! My partner are every last piece on his plate. They serve breakfast all day also with a great selection. This cafe is definitely worth a visit if you are staying in Batu Ferringhi.

Author: Perth_WAAshThe Vines, Australia
Title: Great place to go
Review: We love coming here for lunch when on holidays. Helena and her mum Teresa are the nicest people you will meet in Penang and always remember you. They are so grateful for your business which we find so nice. We look forward to seeing them again next trip round.Show less

Author: Pat0409
Title: Great food
Review: Cheap and great food, you must try.  Eat well then walk the market strip. Great food and well priced, with tablecloths and service better than hawkers huts.

Author: kccm2014
Title: Great food
Review: They were friendly and the service was very quick. The food was prepared just as we asked with two meals changed to vegetarian and still extremely tasty. And they has "real" bacon for my son.

Author: DalesRangerLeeds, United Kingdom
Title: Good home made food
Review: We just had snacks here but both the Veggie spring rolls (2 large and very tasty) and the Char Koay Teow (flat noodles with little prawns and sprouts and other bits n pieces) were freshly made. This was plenty for a light lunch and the service was friendly and prompt.Great value and quality for little money!Show less

Author: 864maxo
Title: Try the Capitan chicken!
Review: A simple, no frills restaurant on the main drag and nestled among many others. Helena's was clean with great service, cold beer and the best Capitan chicken you could possibly imagine. Don't miss it! :)

Author: 4thtime
Title: Great food
Review: Delightful, small quiet restaurant where food is cheap and tasty. Order a few dishes and share as the bill will be very reasonable.

Author: Jo F
Title: Went only once
Review: Good Food.  The restaurant was within easy walking distance from our hotel.  The food was good, not exceptional, we managed to find better value at another venue so we only came to this restaurant on a single occassion.

Author: food_demonDarwin, Australia
Title: The chef makes the difference
Review: When you have been around food as long as I have you begin to realise that it is the chef that makes a restaurant what it is, and Helena's in Batu Ferringhi in Penang has one of the best Indian chefs I have ever experienced. Her repertoire of culinary delights including her famed Mutton Curry and roti prata simply have to be experienced by anyone who likes good Southern Indian cuisine. The restaurant itself is simple and unpretentious, the service impeccable and the food sensational. I read in another review here that Teresa (the chef) has cooked in this restaurant from day one and it certainly shows. What impresses me is that lots of locals use eat in her restaurant and you can always tell a great restaurant when it isn't infested by tourists. Good value too, and if you smile nicely at the beautiful Helena, Teresa's daughter, after whom the restaurant is named, you can even bring your own wine for a modest corkage. Highly recommended as one of the great food experiences in Penang, one of the world's great food centres.Show less

Author: Penny M
Title: Great food
Review: This restaurant is a delight. The staff are great, the food is absolutely delicious and authentic. Try the mutton curry, it is really fantastic.

Author: RoamAnswer
Title: Lovely atmosphere, good food
Review: Decent menu, good food at fair prices and a lovely atmosphere.  A feel food place to be.  Would definitely return.

Author: Sonja S
Title: Excellent curry
Review: We ate there a couple of times and really enjoyed Helena's curry. The portions were generous, tasty and did not leave you feeling heavy as most curries do. We highly recommend this place to all that visit Batu Ferringi

Author: Kate OPattaya, Thailand
Title: best mutton curry anywhere
Review: Helena's mutton curry is so tasty you just want to eat it forever. Exceptional flavour, texture and generous with the mutton. Service is prompt, polite and informative. This restaurant has had the same chef since it opened - which is why the food is consistently great. Helena's is an absolute gem of a place and I will continue to eat here whenever I am in Batu Ferringhi.Show less

Author: CelestialtravelsPortland, Oregon
Title: Good food and prices!
Review: I was constantly worried about eating while traveling in Malaysia because I didn't want to get sick. So I did my research and was always careful in where we ate and what we ordered. (I'm from the US and our travel books cautioned us to only drink bottled water and eat only cooked food, no salads). We had read good reviews about Helena's Cafe, and with caution we ate there. We didn't get sick!! Also the food was delicious and we could tell it was carefully prepared. We asked lots of questions and our server was very helpful. Our daughter ordered the French Toast (for dinner) and she said they were the she's eaten!It's a casual restaurant with very good food and good selection including breakfast items all day. Very reasonably priced too. We enjoyed supporting the little local restaurants too!Show less

Author: EarthlingOnlineWorldwide
Title: OK basic restaurant venue. Mixed dining experience.
Review: Compared with other venues in SE Asia, I find Batu Ferringhi to confront visitors with the dilemma of beach resort communities in much of the world – how to maximize value and quality in a mix of nice but sometimes relatively high-priced upmarket restaurants (in hotels and elsewhere) and lower-priced but often grubby places with filler-rich (nutrition-low) meals which are still more expensive than neighbouring markets deliver. The apparent contrast between Batu Ferringhi and neighbouring Georgetown is a spectacular case-in-point. How to find an economical place in BF that does not make one regret not having taken the ride into Georgetown to eat?Staying at the ParkRoyal Hotel – one night we walked east, and didn't find a solution to that dilemma. So on the following night we walked west. We found one place that seemed to have more locals than foreigners – but was the patronization level high enough that this was a good signal? We walked on. Continuing as far as the Bayview, we decided that Helena's would be our place for the evening – despite the lack of local patrons at that time (to me a potential heads-up about authenticity and value).A glance at the menu demonstrated why locals might not be there in abundance. Prices were high across the board. When I say high – I mean that Westerners with BF as their first SE Asian experience may like the prices, but others might notice the prices as being high in the context of Penang or even Singapore. RM28, when converted to S$12, can get quite a nice curry in Little India or elsewhere in the island republic. Likewise – converted to ~280 Baht would get a fantastic curry (or a world-class gourmet pizza) or entire meal, in Bangkok. Yes, BF is a “beach resort” and one is used to higher prices at such places worldwide. But one can do better on price and quality at Hua Hin or Samui, for example. Bangkok residents have been known to drive the 4-6 hours r/t to Hua Hin just for a great outdoor hawker or restaurant meal. How many folks from Georgetown would head 40 minutes out to BF for a meal, I wonder? So why are BF's prices so high, and its food as a while so much lower in quality compared, say, to Georgetown? (YMMV, of course...)At Helena's prices we decided to defer ordering any curries for another time. We had char kway teow, nasi goreng, mee goreng, and roti paratha on the side. The main dishes were average. For their prices we would have expected more ingredients – at least on the veggie side of things if not also on prawn or chicken. If Long Beach and Helena's are any indication, BF may be like some places in Singapore in “de-contenting” dishes when faced with inflation and price competition. (We sense that much less “de-contenting” has occurred in the better value coffee shops in Georgetown. Good places in Georgetown seem to have kept high standards – and this is one of the great delights of that place.) The roti paratha, on the other hand, were delicious. Crisp on the outside, moist on the inside. The “dipping curry” was somewhat watery and absent of inclusions (e.g. dhal, chicken, potato) – but tasted OK if perhaps a bit too “northern-Indian” mild rather than “southern-Indian” tangy. BTW, the roti paratha, at RM3.50 were 50-100% more expensive than Singapore hawker or basic restaurant prices (of about S$0.7-0.9).Service was fine. When they saw us studying the menu – and discussing options (and looking at our appearance, dress, and behaviour might have noticed us as “more local” than the others in the room at the time) offered suggestions. From the reviews of Helena's curries – perhaps we should have tried a curry and dropped the mee goreng. But, then again, the prices of such dishes begin to approach prices in some hotel venues.Show less

Author: kr54pLightning Ridge, Australia
Title: Best food in Batu Ferringhi!
Review: We have returned to this wonderful family restaurant many times now and the food just keeps getting better. Whether it is a magnificent indian curry, whole fish cooked Malaysian style, Chinese or local food you like, this is the place to go to. We suggest you try their steamboat.....wow!If it's great food and service you enjoy, visit Theresa and her family and Helena's Restaurant and, like us, you will keep going back!Show less

Author: Mathilda_JAPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Home Away From Home
Review: An outstanding outdoor decoration with delicious home-cooked meals. Excellent customer service at a very reasonable price. In my opinion, I strongly encourage anyone to drop-by if you're searching for a good meal and time with your friends or family. Thank you for the amazing experience and the lovely pancakes!Show less

Author: Avril YJohor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Curries were good, but price of tofu was ridiculous.
Review: We ordered the mutton curry and the fish curry, both were excellent. We also wanted a tofu dish, so we asked if they had (since there was none listed on the menu), the lady there said yes, they can prepare sizzling tofu with egg. It was not bad, but was shocked when the bill came and it was priced as RM 25! Even more expensive than the mutton curry, fish curry and sea food tomyam. Tofu dishes are usually priced equivalent with vegetable dishes. They vegetable dish was RM 12.50 which was reasonable, definitely not the tofu. Service was good though, the family were pleasant.Show less

Author: iamslee
Title: Not sure what the hype is...
Review: Food was average. Had better satay skewers at the hawker stalls. Service was ok except when we tried to pay and one guy was busy combing his hair while we waited for someone to come meet us at the register...

Author: Barb06072016Seminyak, Indonesia
Title: Great food, great people
Review: We have been going to Helena's cafe for many years and will continue to do so. Theresa and her family always provide a very warm and friendly atmosphere. You will not find a better curry in Penang!! And the beers arecold. Excellent value for money.Show less

Author: Lionel888Melbourne, Australia
Title: Year after year great food
Review: We always pop out and get lunch from Helena's during our stays at Batu Ferringhi and take it back to our hotel as it is great value and fresh and tasty. The ladies are always so accommodating and I have never had a bad meal. It's a must go!Show less

Author: Steve M
Title: Ordinary
Review: We had a couple of curries at this place based on it being no 4 on Trip Advisor. We were the only customers. Not surprised, very ordinary.

Author: Peter_Dyer1Perth, Australia
Title: Great Home Cooked Indian & Western
Review: Helena's restaurant is a family owned and run business, daughter that looks after front of house and mother the great chef in the kitchen. Having just returned from Batu Ferringhi, during our 8 days stay, we had eaten 5 times as Helena's, this composed of a few lunches as well as evening meals. The satay was nice and fresh with a lovely peanut sauce, the samosas were heavenly and the chicken curries were very authentic and tasty. They also serve a good selection of western style meals, but these we can get at home in Oz. For the 3 of us 1 shared entree, 3 mains, 2 shared deserts & 1 large bottle of water set us back about $30 AUD. While there when it was not busy in the kitchen the mum (chef) would come out and check with us to see if the meal was OK, Of course it was. Highly recommend this little establishment, just 2 minutes walk up the road from the Park Royal towards the Hard Rock.Show less

Author: LNB1968
Title: Great satay
Review: We enjoyed a great meal here, the satay was divine. Great service, amazing value, we'd certainly eat here again.

Author: Tank49Perth, Australia
Title: Great food at a reasonable price
Review: This small cafe is owned and operated by a mother and daughter in competition with nearby seemingly luxurious restaurants. Helena Cafe offers you a variety of food choices at very reasonable prices. In addition they do not charge a service fee or tax which otherwise increases your bill by 16%. The food is excellent!Turn right from the Park Royal Hotel and walk about 150meters.Show less

Author: nz_stevo
Title: Unassuming but great food
Review: Food was awesome & cheap.  Something for the whole family & it was cheap.  Decor was meh, but the food & service was outstanding!

Author: Mitch1e
Title: Helena cafe is one of the best
Review: If you want good honest food then go to Helena's we have been going there for a few years and the food great every time,it's cheap clean and friendly.so if you like Asian food this is the place to go.

Author: Joseph BWidnes, United Kingdom
Title: Best curry ever!
Review: Nest door to the Living Room you will find this simple and straightforward no frills place run by a family. But the food is wonderful! I tried the sizzling seafood one night and the chicken curry another. That curry was the best ever! Don't be put off because it looks so ordinary - the food is fantastic. If you walk past you will miss a treat.Show less

Author: CCK01Surrey Hills, Australia
Title: Authentic family meal
Review: We had a lovely dinner here a few nights ago. The restaurant is basic to look at - no bells and whistles. This is a family run business with terrific service and meals. We wanted to eat authentic Malaysian cuisine which this restaurant delivered. We sat outside with fans which was nice. We ordered seafood, noodles, rice and chicken. They also had fries for our 5 year old. Fully recommend this restaurant. Show less

Author: tripster25
Title: Average meal good friendly service
Review: Was disappointed having read such positive reviews....Whilst the chicken and beef mixed satay was very good the chicken  stir fry was bland and like something you could rustle up yourself at home... Lovely service though so will return.

Author: SteveB692Eastleigh, United Kingdom
Title: No Gimmicks
Review: Made a wellcome return, been drawn back to Helena's for a number of years. This year no exception. Food is excellent, with a good range to suit all tastes, and thats the key. No gimmicks (eg live music) just good fresh food well prepared, served within a friendly atmosphere.Show less

Author: 7milo
Title: Authentic food
Review: Helena's cafe was wonderful. It doesn't look like much from the outside but decided to give it a try. The food was so beautiful and authentic, chicken curry was lovely! Even the cook herself came out to our table to make sure we were happy with the food...very sweet lady!Show less

Author: Jdubb1313Melbourne, Australia
Title: Good food however pushy at times
Review: Food is good, actually its great! Its location is also very good as is the price of food. The only reason I lowered its rating in this review is that after eating at Helena's a few times and having larger meals (which were more expensive), we felt that the staff (Helena the daughter of the owner), was beginning to be pushy on us ordering more food or extra beers (which are as much as a whole meal) when we chose to have just a snack. Advising us they are closing at 10PM and we should order/eat more one night when we just wanted to have a snack at 8PM then come back at 11PM for another snack, only to find out they were open till midnight just made the experience slightly awkward. I understand friendly and checking that everything is ok, however you know when you're being pressured to spend more just to spend more.Again good food but be wary of making 'friends' with the staff and perhaps look at the real intention behind their 'hospitality'.Show less

Author: 59nicolAuckland, New Zealand
Title: Superb Helena's as Always!!
Review: We have been dining at Helena's for a number of years and always a pleasure Helena remembers us each time and brings her Mum out to say hello to us. My husband enjoys the Indian cuisine and I usually opt for less spicy option drinks are cold and can't beat the price we will be visiting again in march 2014 againShow less

Author: moonman19
Title: Top little street cafe
Review: Food,service and a selection of wines,were just first class.Must visit if in batu ferringhi.Near the park royal.$6-10 a meal.

Author: krissylou
Title: Great food!
Review: Fantastic food in a small family run restaurant just a few minutes walk from park royal. Prices are slightly more than what you pay at hawker centre but reasonable given quality of the food. Great drinks menu.  Try the mutton curry its delicious!

Author: Eva MMelbourne
Title: Great food, good service, cheap price
Review: We went to Helena's cafe based on trip adviser reviews also. I had seafood Tom yum and hubby had squid curry. Both meals were delicious, service very friendly. I asked for spicy tom yum and while delicious, I had to pick out most of the firey little chillies so be careful what you ask for. Would definitely go there again and recommend this restaraunts.As earlier described, if you walk out of holiday inn (beach side) and turn left, it's about 200m up the road.Show less

Author: OzfamilyPerthHillsPerth, Australia
Title: What ordinary people do for you makes the difference.
Review: We chose Helena's based upon Trip Advisor reviews and were not disappointed. This small restaurant was not far from the Holiday Inn and we walked in off the street to be shown to a table towards the front. Orders were taken by a nice friendly host who hand wrote our selections which later became our bill. I was able to order House red wine by the glass for a good price which was served at the right temperature for the tropical climate. The dishes we ordered were home style, non pretentious and very delicious. The best dining experience we had in Batu Ferringhi, based on hospitality, food quality and price? Absolutely.Show less

Author: maryyeoHo Chi Minh City, Vietnam
Title: Small humble cafe, food is more exp but nice.
Review: Just 100m away from Parkroyal hotel is this humble cafe. Average food prices about double of Long Beach (hawker), but better quality. Not a fancy cafe, but nicer place to chill and relax compared to noisier Long Beach.RM6 for 6 sticks of satay seems exp for Malaysia's standard but the meat's really juicy and tender. The Tom Yum soup is full of fresh seafood, tomato and lemongrass. Worth ordering. Staff is very attentive, too!Show less

Author: 3charlotte
Title: Great place to eat!
Review:
Loved everything, food, staff, ambience, service - can't say much more - just go if you are there!

Cheers!

Author: GypsyMalayBBatu Ferringhi, Malaysia
Title: Great food, especially the Indian part of the menu!
Review: This might not look all that fancy from the outside, but the kitchen is fantastic. Prices very reasonable for Batu Ferringhi! And what might not be on the menu, can be discussed :)The Indian family that runs this place is very friendly and helpful, and they made a special spicy version of some Indian food for us! We loved it. Its opposite of the Yahong Art Gallery, you might want to pay a visit there as well before eating out :)Show less

Author: Katharina NBoston, Massachusetts
Title: Very warmhearted place for food
Review: We were looking for a nice place to have dinner at and ended up at Helena's after having a quick look on the menue. We were very warm welcomed by the staff which was soooo friendly.We had fish and chips which was very tasty. Really enjoyed our time there!Show less

Author: touring1893Gympie, Australia
Title: Aussie travelers say "Thank You"
Review: We discovered this cafe while doing the night markets when first arriving Batu Ferringhi Penang. Helena Cafe staff made us feel most welcomed with there welcoming and service they gave. Nothing was pushed upon us, and there was no rush to decide what to order for our lovely meals. We only had 4 nights in Penang and had 3 of our night meals at "Helena Cafe". My hubby had battered prawns salard and chips each time - loved them!! Chips beautiful, tastey orange juice to cool one down with the nightly heat - plus battered bananas and ice-cream went down well. Great prices for the enjoyable meals. Thanks to you all.Show less

Author: Vasantha G
Title: great coffee
Review: We visited the cafe one evening. Lovely food, great coffee, great prices, great service. Must visit.

Author: Pooh_tyanMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Little Gem in Batu Ferringhi
Review: Found this restaurant from TripAdvisor, and the food didn't disappointed us. We ordered the fish and chips, grilled fish, fried rice, mutton murtabak and roti canai. The most delicious was the grillled fish, first runner up was the fish and chips. The mutton murtabak is quite different from the type we usually eat at Melaka, their murtabak taste like "fried ommette with a lot of carrot and cabbage" (haha~). The curry that come together with the murtabak and roti canai was very delicious. The price was reasonable, worth to try. The atmosphere of the restaurant was ok and feels like home.Show less

Author: Helene M
Title: Good food cafe
Review: Nice atmosphere, good service and a good quality and selection of local meals while also catering for tourists who just want steak and chips -  sadly there are too many of those.

Author: Joninho75Middlesbrough, United Kingdom
Title: Ok but over rated
Review: Found the service to be very poor and the menu to be very limited. The place itself is a bit of a shocker, but then most places are in Batu Ferringhi. My meal was not great but the wife had a nice chicken chop. Prices were not that cheap, standard for the area. All told there are far better options close by.Show less

Author: Oratory1
Title: fantastic
Review: a wonderful charming cafe near to the night market. It is the ideal place for children's food( my son loved the sausages) and for currys. The chicken curry was a favourite of mine and the satay was the best I have tasted in Penang.

Author: Kat FPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Disappointment, somewhat mitigated by staff
Review: If you go to Helena's DO NOT order the Tandoori chicken or the naan. They do not have a tandoori oven, the 'Tandoori' chicken is actually a chicken breast covered in a strangely spiced glaze, and the naan is store-bought, as confirmed by the chef. I have not tried anything else from the menu, but the Tandoori selections are hugely overpriced (one Tandoori set is roughly RM 30) for the quality of food you are getting. Myself and two others visited Helena's about a month ago. We each ordered a Tandoori set. Tandoori chicken is widely made around Penang, and we were expecting our food to look and taste like the typical Tandoori meals we've enjoyed elsewhere. When our food came out, we were visibly disappointed to see it looked nothing like real Tandoori. We tried the chicken and the naan both for good measure, and it was not tasty, and about as far off as you can get from 'authentic' Indian food. Having lived in Penang for over a year, we've never run into an inedible meal anywhere except for here. That said, when the staff saw our disappointment, they called over the chef to speak to us about our meal. The chef, a very sweet, old lady, told us about the lack of Tandoori oven, and confirmed for us that the naan was store-bought, and apologized for the meal. The staff then took 50% off our bill at the end of the night. Giving a discount after a bad meal is a very rare gesture for most restaurants in Penang, so we were very grateful they were willing to do this for us. Because of the chef's apology and the staff's actions, it's hard to give this place anything less than a 3. But I'd suggest anyone who wants an authentic Indian meal to go elsewhere.Show less

Author: Pookie6972Adelaide, Australia
Title: Great for families, terrific value
Review: Great value for money - we walked away with a RM78 bill - that's around AU$26 for 3 different meals, roti, 2 g&t & a sprite. Service was unassuming but attentive when it counts. A number of children were in the kafe enjoying a range of food. If you want spice levels adjusted, just ask. If you've been on holiday for a while and desperate for veggies, order the veggie curry - fresh!Show less

Author: Nick DBlandford Forum, United Kingdom
Title: Straight forward good value
Review: The staff were pleasant enough and attentive but not overly so. I had a plain chicken curry which was freshly cooked and a good sized portion but not particularly special in its flavour. My wife had the tandoori chicken and thoroughly enjoyed and remarked on the freshly cooked naan bread.Show less

Author: sweetmillerManchester, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent Place,Service and Delightful curries
Review: We have been to Penang many times and always make for Helena's Cafe the food is superb from a simple sandwich to a breakfast then on to the wonderful Malay cusine, the fish with delicate herbs and the curries are to die for.This last visit my husband had been diagnosed with a stomach problem in the UK and was waiting for a operation , Theresa the owner and cook was fantastic she made him wonderful fresh fish dishes also beautiful vegitable soups with noodles and many other dishes which were not on the menu, this was so marvelous and made his holiday as the food side was a big concern for him,thank you thank you you are great.The food is very reasonable priced and excellent quality with the fish and seafood fresh everyday,also you cannot help but notice how beautiful and clean the place is,give it a try you will definatley not be dissapointed and it's amazing how every year we keep meeting people who ate there on previous years and return says something dont you think.This is a family business and they are very caring people,we have always been looked after very well indeed and Theresa's daughters who serve the tables are just great.Next time in Penang try this wonderful cafe you will not be dissapointed. See you again in 2014.Show less

Author: Mark H
Title: Great food and popular with expats
Review: Quite a surprise for its food and service. Small and not great presentation but clean and good value with well prepared menu.

Author: lady_well_travelled
Title: over rated
Review: Food was not good, service very poor.  Much nicer places to eat.  Menu choices are narrow.  Would not visit again.

Author: angeldass50London, United Kingdom
Title: Always The Best In Town Helenas!
Review: Everybody including the kids found something they really liked. The home cooking is very tasty and reasonably priced. The friendly staff made us feel extremely comfortable and we were well looked after and we have been going here for many years so there is no useless complaints like cheap plastic plates and so on.They doing really good job mother and daughter keep it up.Show less

Author: jaycloth82
Title: Excellent
Review: Tried this restaurant the menu is limited but wow what we were served was excellent . The staff were polite. The place is nothing to look at but don't be put off. Very clean.

Author: nilintentum_reliquitMelbourne, Australia
Title: Enjoyable family experience
Review: After some so-so dining experiences outside the hotel in Batu Ferringhi, we discovered this little place. Everybody including the kids found something they really liked. The home cooking is very tasty and reasonably priced. The friendly staff made us feel extremely comfortable and we were well looked after. We made a return visit and again enjoyed the variety in food and consistent service.Show less

Author: GaryL0505
Title: Good
Review: Went there bit late for lunch, excellent service with smiling faces, cool meal and reasonable price. My kids (3 and 1) enjoy very much though this was the first time for them to taste Malaysian food

Author: NLinTKOPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Poor experience
Review: Based on what we read on Tripadvisor we thought that we would get good food at this restaurant. Boy were we disappointed. The taste of the food was not good, and the presentation on cheap plastic plates made the overall experience even worse.The variety in restaurants and quality of the food is much better at Langkawi's Pantai Cenang than Penang's Batu Ferringhi.Show less

Author: Chris M
Title: Helena's
Review: Excellent food at great value prices. About 150 meters from the Ferrenghi hotel. We ate their many times, her beef randang and fried mee ma are to die for.

Author: Bexat4
Title: Walk on by.....
Review: Thought we would finally give this place a go after several trips to BF but found the food very 'bland' and service bordering on incompetant and miserable. Give it a miss and try either side at Guan Guan or Living Room.

Author: a60Brisbane, Australia
Title: Beautiful Home Cooking
Review: If you would like a lovely home cooked meal then Helena's Cafe is the place to go. It is run by mother and daughter. The mother is the cook and the daughter runs the restaurant and the food is amazing. We told them that we had come on the recommendation of Trip Advisor and they were tickled pink! They had a good amount of different foods to choose from and all were cooked fresh when we placed our order. It is not expensive to eat here and I would definitely come back again.Show less

Author: raffles2012
Title: Really good food at reasonable prices
Review: This is a good eatery which appears to cater for all tastes.  The service was friendly and efficient and the local meals were priced as good as the hawker market.  A pleasant experience at a good price.

Author: Teena H
Title: Better than Expected
Review: We ate here twice as we loved their Beef Redang and Sate's,it was friendly and was busy both nights.

Author: KerrylLovesMalaysiaPerth, Australia
Title: Great food and the best ever sour sop slushies!
Review: Helena's Cafe is fantastic. Every time I have visited Penang I go there and have steamboat and it is always fantastic - and they even remember myself, husband and my friends!!They also make the best sour sop slushies which are so refreshing and I have never found them anywhere else in Malaysia!Thankyou again, we will certainly be back soon!Show less

Author: 191SusanB191
Title: Great food and service
Review: Great food and service. We went back two times as we enjoyed it so much. It was slightly more expensive but worth it.

Author: AmyC383
Title: Good value
Review: I'd highly recommend the Indian chicken curry! The food is good value with a strong Indian Malaysian influence.

Author: mark_o134Perth, Australia
Title: Always a great meal
Review: I have made Helena's a daily lunch stop with my son for all of my visits to Penang since I first found this great place years ago. We stay at the Park Royal so it is only a short walk down the street. My family found the staff attentive and personable and they even invited us for a free Christmas dinner! My favourites are the mutton curry and crab sandwiches along with many others. The owners made us feel so welcome and Anna is a champion in the kitchen. We have sent friends there and they also have become regulars. We will definite return and I will post our pictures with the staff and my son soon. Great value for money.Show less

Author: SheilasWheels
Title: Very disappointed
Review: We chose Helena's because of good Tripadvisor reviews, but were very disappointed.  The service was very slow and inattentive and the food bland and disappointing.

Author: catarina S
Title: Good food and good service!
Review: we went here a couple of times for dinner. We ordered thai food both times. The food food was good, so was the service! Ok prices.

Author: sasha dBatu Ferringhi, Malaysia
Title: lovely restaurant with monkeys aswell !
Review: i had read good reviews so decided to try it, when i arrived I forgot my money due to jetlag and the owner said I could pay her tomorrow and not to worry ! ate there last night and the monkeys came down from the forest as it was raining and we ate our beehoon watching the funniest monkeys with big white lips and eyes, clean and friendly place , food always very good price.Show less

Author: jlegourd
Title: Nothing special
Review:
Overspicy sambal shrimps and undercooked vegetable curry. Overcooked rice.

Great mint sauce available with pappadam.

Author: Andrew TAdelaide, Australia
Title: Lived up to its reputation
Review: We ate there based on other reviews seen here. A family set up, with mother and daughter friendly and helpful. We had a lovely North Indian meal from an extensive international menu for around 20RM a head. The only reason we didn't go back was there were so many other places to try: highly recommended for family groups.Show less

Author: nickejmartinJeddah, Saudi Arabia
Title: Classic restaurant and probably the best in area.
Review: We totally messed up with Helena's. Sat down one evening and decided it was a bit too quiet so made our excuses and left. Having escaped god knows what from The Living Room next door, we went back to Helena's the next day for brunch.I suppose it's a bit like having a Nissan GTR. You can play with the Porsches and Lambos at a fraction of the price, and still end up smiling all day long. Helena's was marvelous. Food was superbly prepared, great quality, great value for money and wanting for nothing. It seemed the whole family came out to welcome us back from the night before.We all loved the place and will be sure to go back before we leave on Wednesday.Crab curry - to die for!!Show less

Author: djbshalNew Malden, United Kingdom
Title: Our group loved it.
Review: Food was the best we had in Penang. I believe mom was cooking in kitchen and the daughter was serving the food. I have to say the mom can "COOK"!! The rating speaks for it's self. I am going back again either tonight or tomorrow. We left extra tip after our lunch and we did it happily.Show less

Author: helenc54
Title: Good food, honest attentive staff
Review: Excellent salad and special fresh hot chips made to order as I am allergic to frozen chips. Accidentally gave the host a 50 rggt note instead of a one ringgit note. She gave it back. I would never have known . Staff also made a special dressing for me. Ingredients were fresh and tasty. I'll be backShow less

Author: Marc FKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Above average with a friendly touch
Review: Went there with my wife and mum. The food was good and prices were of the typical tourist belt. Nonetheless the personal touch was there. They also did a special curry vegetable for my mom as she was vegan. Next to another top rated wine bar.Show less

Author: Tannumtravelers
Title: Great place to eat
Review: This was another great place we ate at. The food here was sensational, it's a bit further on down the road, but worth looking for. It's after the markets finish down the main street.

Author: jOhnandjudy8
Title: Good Food Good Prices
Review: Had a nice meal here while we were in Batu Ferringhi.My wife and I both had western meals which were both great.Garlic and cheese naan for starters was delicious.Beer and wine prices were quite reasonable.We would go back again.

Author: harry hUncasville, Connecticut
Title: Great food...very reasonable price and highly recommended
Review: My wife and I have just returned from 6 days holiday in Penang. We stayed in Holiday Inn and its only 5 minutes slow walk to this restaurant, so it is very convenient. the food is second to none, the first morning when we found the restaurant we had breakfast there, and me being sottish who is known for being careful with money was highly delighted with the breakfast and the price I had sausage, eggs, bacon, toast and beans and tea for about MYR 14 which is about GBP 2.5 , and that breakfast set me up for the day, not like chinese food in chinese restaurant , 30 minutes after you had your meal, you'll be hungry.one evening, my wife had sirloin steak, french fries and the trimmings, and that was perfect.This restaurant is really high recommended and we will be back again next year, we booked already to go back on february and I know for sure, where we'll be heading ....HELENA CAFE..another thing which I like that you don't feel like being pressurred by taking staff outside the restaurant who dont take no for an answer like many other restaurant does which we find very off putting.Show less

Author: PhilipSurreyUKSurrey UK
Title: Great restaurant - a must if in penang
Review: In Batu Ferringhi there are loads of restaurants to choose from, so you won't go hungry but if you like the personal touch and a welcoming team, then Helena's Cafe is a must visit. The team are very friendly and Helena even came out of the kitchen for a chat. The food is all freshly cooked and very well flavoured - nicely seasoned and spiced. That being said, not all dishes come out together as everything is fresh, but a couple of minutes waiting whilst enjoying an ice cold Tiger beer is not a problem.The price is very cheap in comparison to the quality you food and most dishes come with rice. We had the Prawns Sambol which was delicious and the tandoori chicken which was cooked to perfection (the accompanying nan bread was excellent). The only thing that spoilt the evening was the rain and a grumpy patron who couldn't understand that not all nan breads are cooked like they are in England and that fresh cooked food in a small restaurant often comes at different speeds! Show less

Author: rustytooMansfield Woodhouse, United Kingdom
Title: Total Rubbish
Review: Been coming to Penang for many years never tried this place before.Will never go again.Chicken Curry was like curry soup.Naan bread could have been made of cardboard.Could not taste any garlic in it.Service was snail paced even though the place was not anywhere near full,a regular came in after us & was served first.Saving grace they didn't charge us for food.We wouldn't have paid anyway.Show less

Author: lindylo1
Title: Good Food
Review: We ate here twice, one lunch time and an evening, the young waitress was very helpful and food was good.  The price was very reasonable.

Author: MooliNornalup
Title: Wish we had discovered it earlier
Review: This was one of three restaurants we went back to twice. The food was excellent, particularly the curried prawns, and the owners/staff could not have been nicer and more friendly. I only wish we had discovered it earlier in our stay.

Author: LolaTheBean
Title: Lovely food made with love!
Review: We are just leaving Penang and we ate at Helenas several times. The food is fantastic & the staff really care about the food. Its definitely food made with love. Try the incredible fish or crabmeat Indian curry, add some plain naan bread and you're in heaven. The fried rice is great too, as well as anything to do with prawns. Crab is only available at night after the fishing boats have come in. We highly recommend eating here and its super value.Show less

Author: DiggerDealsMaddington, Australia
Title: Value for Money in Pricey Penang
Review: Lunch for two during busy public holiday.Fresh pineapple juice andTandoori Chicken set was very good and the bowl of plain yoghurt once requested really added to the meal. Rump Steak was average.Polite helpful staff and quick friendly service.We ate here when we saw the Trip Advisor certificate for consistent higher than four star rating on the street sign.Recommended for service and value for money.Show less

Author: Lauren W
Title: best food around
Review: the food was outstanding and the yummiest i had the whole time i was in penang everything i ordered was great and the service was also great cant wait to go back and have more

Author: Peter WScotland, United Kingdom
Title: they really care that you enjoy your meal
Review: Lovely tasting meal but next time i must ask for it to be mild, British tastes are no as spicy, not the resturants fault my fault, but once some yoghurt was added i really enjoyed my meal.Do eat here you will not be dissapointed with food or service.Show less

Author: MewKeeWoo
Title: Good and simple food
Review: Nice place, good food. Not expensive, unlike some of the eateries in the area. Seeing food from other table, looks good too.

Author: trebordoyl
Title: High standard
Review:
Great food 
Great service
Great atmosphere
Lovely family run restaurant

Author: flutterby59Perth, Australia
Title: Congratulations
Review: We have returned to Penang again and our first stop has been Helenas. Congratulations to them on being awarded a certificate of Excellence from TA. They definitely deserve it not only for the wonderful food they serve, but for the fantastic service they provide you with. Theresa, I only wish I could cook chicken curry like you.! We have travelled extensively and the curry here is one of the most flavour some Malay curries you will ever get to taste.Thankfully we have three weeks in Penang for us to visit this wonderful restaurant many times.Show less

Author: gdpoElwood, Australia
Title: Sensational, fresh curries
Review: The three ladies we dealt with were friendly, helpful - and very talented. As with a number of the local eateries, prices were great - AUD2-4 per curry. Everything was freshly cooked for us (we knew this as one walks through the kitchen to visit the toilet). The shop doesn't seem to be open for lunch, but the dinner we had there was great fun, right in the middle of the restaurant district.Show less

Author: IanHunt164
Title: Shame we were in a rush
Review: What a lovely, homely restaurant with fantastic food at a great price.

Author: kirtyauSydney, Australia
Title: Great food, no frills atmosphere
Review: As they say, "you get what you pay for"! As per other reviews, agreed the atmosphere is similar to some local lower market eateries, given the decor, plastic chairs and concrete floor. However one cannot complain about the service, very efficient and friendly younger woman ensuring rapid service and an older woman cooking in the kitchen. We ate lunch on two occasions at this restaurant and we found the food to be fast, fresh and very tasty, both western dishes for the kids and local and Indian dishes for my husband and I. Should you be looking for a low cost, no frills, value for money meal, I totally recommend this eating experience whilst you're in Batu Ferringhi.Show less

Author: robinarobrobina
Title: from a australians point of view
Review: we had a meal here one night and wasnt disapointed , The food is very good, the service friendly and the prices very reasonable for those on a budget We tried a lot of dishes from menu, and everything was very tasteful. would eat here again Show less

Author: Wayne G
Title: Good food
Review: There were 11 of us so we all had varied tastes. The food is as good as any in the smaller restaurants. Service was good, drinks cold. Value excellent. One not to miss.

Author: JonpatHants_
Title: Lovely food & staff.
Review:
We ate here three times.Fantastic food.Very clean and friendly. Your food is cooked fresh.If you want it spicy hot or extra vegetables just ask.
The fish curry was superb.I should have got the recipe.

Author: Karthi_12Petaling Jaya, Wilayah Persekutuan, Malaysia
Title: Fantastic cuisine and friendly service
Review: I went to Helena Cafe last weekend. I was amazed at the service provided over there! They are very friendly towards the customers and provide an stupendo fantabalously fantastical service. Their approach towards the customers is something i have not seen in my entire life until now........ They are so caring and treat each and every customer with full of love! Last but not least the food served over there was so yummy; i would have bitten my finger if i was not alerted by my mom..... Thank you helena cafe for ur delicious food, friendly service..... Good luck and all the best....Show less

Author: Kesh K
Title: Simple and Nice
Review: Went to Helena's for Dinner. Staff were friendly, especially Bala! Ha ha! What a chap! Nice food, clean and very affordable!

Author: KEGillesenVinterbro, Norway
Title: Great food and friendly service in family-run restaurant
Review: We went to Helena's Cafe a handful times during our four weeks in Penang. Despite the wide selection of eateries in Batu Ferringhi, very few could match Helena's.The food is very good, the service friendly and the prices very reasonable for us Scandinavians. We tried a lot of dishes from their rich menu, and everything was very tasteful. Our children aged 5 and 3 preferred pancakes instead of Indian food, which gave us the nickname "pancake family" among the staff :-)Show less

Author: tonyKentUk
Title: right up the list
Review: always above average in the past,helenas is now on top in terms of quality price and the service of the two lovely sisters helana and sharron not to be missed and the talents of mum who does the cooking

Author: easy1153
Title: Nice local eatery
Review:
Based on Tripadvisor research, we had dinner here on our first night in Batu Ferringi.

Family-run restaurant with simple, local food at very reasonable prices

Author: FJB_Melb
Title: Cheap Eats
Review: Cheap, lots of variety but thats as far as I will go. I would rather eat here though than at most places in Batu Ferenggi

Author: yumickey
Title: delicious
Review:
Very good cafe.
I visited every night.
Especially I recommend steam boat.
There is a menu in Japanese.

Author: susie sLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Please do not pass this little gem by! Stop and have some food!
Review: My Fiance and i discovered Helana's cafe on our second day of a 10 day visit to Penang, and we went back everyday for either a drink (banana milkshake!), lunch (bacon sandwich!) or an evening meal! The food is fantastic. It is all freshly cooked and you are able to see the kitchen which is clean and well organised. On one occassion we were offered a Grouper for our evening meal and Helena took us into the kitched to show us the fish, which you could see was as fresh as she said it was.The service is second to none. Helena and her mum Theresa work so hard (as well as the man at the front of the cafe and the other lady in the kitchen). They always have time to talk to their customers no matter how busy they are, and are always so welcoming and polite.As i said at the top of this review, please do not pass Helena's by, it is a real gem, and deserves to do so well for itself. It is a fantastic cafe run by an even more fantastic family. The review is late going up as we have had no internet since December, but hopefully it proves how much we loved this place as we are taking the time to write this review a month after our holiday. Thank you Helena, Theresa and all at Helana's cafe Susie and Dave PS - mum's curry is amazing!Show less

Author: Home27
Title: Our favourite - went here twice
Review: Good food food, good prices and excellent customer service. Lots of choice on the menu.

Author: MaliTaus
Title: A good choice amongst many.
Review: This is one of many cheap and cheerful eating places on the main drive, but at Helena's the food was good, the price was good and the staff were excellent.

Author: H0nestReviews
Title: A great family run business.
Review: This is a great malay place, with a lovely family atmosphere and fantastic service- they can't do enough for you.

Author: flutterby59Perth, Australia
Title: Again ,Perfect!
Review: We have been eating here for years and look forward to the wonderful food, the friendly service and the lovely chats we have with the family. One of the best Chicken curries in BF and the best Steamboat you will get in this area. Helen and Sharon will goout of their way to ensure you have the perfect meal.Show less

Author: Jeroen-San
Title: Too western.
Review: This restaurant does not serve authetic malaysian food but western style (britisch) asian food. For s it was really a disappointment. The satay were perfect all other dishes just too salty and too flavourless.

Author: addictedt0travellingEdinburgh, Scotland
Title: Quality food at good prices, cooked and served by lovely local family.
Review: It is not often I would go back to the same restaurant 6 nights during a 9 night holiday but the local prawns were wonderful. Having tried them in several different ways decided my favourite was sweet and sour prawns with rice. Quality food. I tried other restaurants including Long beach but they did not compare to the quality of the food served at Helena's restaurant. The service was excellent and it was a pleasure to meet the family. The mum is the cook and the 2 daughters help run the restaurant. Show less

Author: IficandoitCambridge, United Kingdom
Title: The most authentic, delicious, value for money food in Penang;)
Review: My boyfriend and I first went to Helena's cafe 7yrs ago!! Helenas' mum is such a wonderful cook, her food will keep you coming back for more. If you're looking for authentic, home cooking try this restaurant. A* a must try;D We've just spent December in Malaysia and took a trip back to Penang. The island is so built up now and has changed a lot. We were so happy to see helena's cafe and was surprised that Helena and her mum still remembered us.A big thank you to Helena's Cafe you made our stay in Penang more memorable. Xxx Show less

Author: Susan O
Title: We went twice .....!
Review: Great local food, friendly staff and inexpensive - Go!

Author: ShawAndrew
Title: Good Food and Clean Place
Review: Really enjoyed My Meals There Batu Ferringhi is a Nice Place and you should never miss this restaurants for your meals,Love the Spring Rolls

Author: Alywin CSingapore, Singapore
Title: There is more to the simple appearance
Review: Just next to "living room cafe", comparing the decor and setting Helena's was much simpler. We tried the mutton curry, satay and naan which were alright. Also had the Kang Kong (vegetable dish), this was spicy, try it if you want a kick. Service was good and that is probably the stand out part of our visit.Quite an easy walk from where we were staying in Holiday Inn. If you are staying at the Ferringhi Wing, its turn left after coming out from the lobby and walk 3-5 minutes, its opposite the art gallery.Show less

Author: Andrew OLondon, United Kingdom
Title: great local food from a beautiful local family
Review: been going to helenas for 20 yrs now.small family maybe.massive effort wiv service and food quality.spent xmas night wiv family last year,every dish is always excellent.we r going back in 5 weeks and so looking forward to going back.always been made so welcome.my daughter grew up wiv sharon as babys and so nice to see them grow up and still see each other,my daughters boyfriends 1st trip to penang this year,and his priviledge to eat such luvly food,cant waitShow less

Author: ogajimDubai, United Arab Emirates
Title: Do not let the outward appearance fool you
Review: This gem of a restaurant/cafe should not be passed by. It sits between two other roadside cafes and from the front it looks the least inspiring but go in to experience the most delicious fare served by mother and daughter proprietors whose family have been operating here for over forty years. Food is cooked by mum and freshly prepared. The Malay dishes (especially the soups and curries) were the best we have tasted on the island. Western,Indian & Chinese dishes are also served but do try the local fare. Western style breakfasts are available with 'real' bacon.Service is impeccable and so friendly and both mum and daughter (Helena) will gladly chat and give great advice about where to go and what to do. It is impeccably clean but could do with an external/internal face-lift and refurbishment to compete with the more glitzy competition in attracting passer-by customers. Prices are cheap given the quality of the food and having tried some of the glitzy competition Helena's is underpriced. Do not pass by this place if you want good home cooked food at a reasonable price - having tried it you will want to go backShow less

Author: LisalooyambaYamba, Australia
Title: Helena's Cafe = delicious
Review: Sandwiched between Living Room & Guan Guan restaurants is Helena's Cafe- Batu Ferringi beach. All 3 restaurants are great but Helena's was a standout for our little group. Every time we ate at Helena's the service was outstanding & friendly, the food just fabulous & no special request was ever turned down by the kitchen. The curry's are to die for & the whole deep fried fish was fresh & crunchy. Keep up the great work Helena!Show less

Author: ClaudiusSgSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good value little restaurant
Review: The restaurant is next to the Living Room, which is I think a bit more interesting. However, the food at Helena's was quite good (servings a bit small for westerners) and the service was very friendly. Prices are low and offers good value.Both these restaurants are little family run places and the service is probably the best aspect of them.Show less

Author: Gail PMelbourne, Australia
Title: Helena's is what Penang is all about: beautiful people & great food at the best prices.
Review: You will never be disappointed at Helena's. After visiting many years the food is still the freshest and tastiest. The curries are always a highlight but this visit the steamed whole fish is a new favourite. Helena & Theresa are so friendly and always make us returning customers feel so welcome.Show less

Author: JazzLiss11
Title: Great food, great value!
Review: Come one, come all!!! Delicious food and very affordable price!

Author: Sarah522
Title: Fantastic curry
Review: Helena's curry is the best I have tasted in Penang.  Beautiful home made gravy full of spices, very tasty.  You must go there and try it.  Also had the fish and chips, lovely and good value for money.

Author: Parisienne20001Kingston-upon-Hull, United Kingdom
Title: A pleasant eating experience in Penang
Review: This was our first holiday in Penang, Malaysia, we were staying at the Bayview Beach Resort for 2 weeks, and as usual the first evening consists of finding somewhere decent to eat, so approx 10min walk we came to Helenas cafe, we had passed other eateries, but for some reason this caught our attention. Dont expect plush surroundings, but personally we dont mind that. The staff were very welcoming and attentive at all times, the menu is quite extensive, with local and western food available and a good choice of drinks, all very reasonably priced. My husband loved the spring rolls and the rump steak (which he had on a couple of occasions). The starters were delicious too, I tried the Prawn cocktail, and crab cocktail on another visit. I also craved the fish & chips, which was very nice too. On our last visit on our final night I had the roast chicken, very tasty..I think in all we visited this place five times, and was never disappointed in either the food or the staff, who also checked that we were enjoying the food. They all spoke pretty good english too, so we often had conversations and had a laugh.All in all, yes we would definately go back there, so a big 'Thank You' to Helenas staff for making it a pleasant experience. Please go and try it for yourselves, you wont be disappointedNadine & Mike BoyceCottinghamHullEnglandShow less

Author: Penang_11Melbourne, Australia
Title: Best Restaurant in Batu Ferringhi
Review: My wife and I and our friends have recently been to Penang for holiday ( again ). I once thought Helenas the best restaurant for curry in Penang. I now believe it is the BEST restaurant for everything including Steamboat, Malaysian, Indian, Chinese etc. I can't belive they can serve up such superb quality food at extremely low prices. Great people too.Show less

Author: colette287Adelaide, Australia
Title: Absoloutly gorgeous place to eat great fresh food!!!!
Review: Threre are many cafe's and restaurant's along this strech of Batu Ferringhi, it is hard to pick but we visisted this Cafe on a few occasions and each time we loved it!!! the owners and staff were fabulous and very obliging. We had the best sping rolls and satays along with a local dish named char keow teow was really good, always fresh and tasty and extremelly good value. Would highly recommend a visit if you are there. I wish I could have somewhere this good to eat in my area, I miss there food!Show less

Author: Kelvin GBeijing, China
Title: Very Over Rated Sorry
Review: Sorry but I got really exicted when I saw such great ratings. I don't know what they hype was about. We tried Helena's and the restaurant was OK but if you want a taste of Penang this ain't really the real deal. Penang has loads of other restaurants which would be rated much higher. If you're a tourist and want something safe and tailored to western dining tastes then MAYBE this is for you.Just to give you an idea it's a place that sells both western, Indian, Chinese and Malaya food-open for Brekkie to dinner. Doesn't specialise in anything really.We had, Mutton Curry, Seafood dish and some starters. All were reasonably good... nothing flash. I did see them cook my mutton curry and they obviusly hadn't de-frosted the meat as they were throwing frozen bits of mutton into my dish. It tasted fine once cooked but I wasn't really happy.The Indonesian waitress was very nice and we liked the service but I probably wouldn't go back knowing about the hundreds of other restaurants that are around Penang. Next time I reckon we'll head direct to the Hawker centres.Show less

Author: RosaHeemskerkBatu Ferringhi, Malaysia
Title: Heavenly food and a very friendly family
Review: This restaurant is the best restaurant in town. They have the most delicious curry I have ever tasted! Also the fillet steak is very tasty. You would almost eat your fingers, that tasty. They also have great white wine (chardonnay) and nice fresh juices! You can not miss this place!! The family who runs this restaurant is very friendly and do everything to make you comfortable. We will miss you! Greetings Rosa and Rene from HollandShow less

Author: gourmettravels82sydney
Title: ... there is better
Review: We ate here after reading the reviews on TA... I am not sure what others are raving about, its ok but Penang is all about food and this was pretty average - the dishes we ate were nothing but ok not bad but there is so much choice elsewhere.. I suppose that it kinder lacked flavour compared to everything else we ate ? The service was good and reasonably priced - take your mozzie spray though.Show less

Author: LeiLei71Palmerston, Australia
Title: Magic!
Review: So cheap, and friendly. This place is a MUST. We used to go to this cafe 20 years ago when we were kids, the daughter used to be the waiteress and now is the owner, and it's STILL up to scratch, family friendly and no stomach upsets here! Enjoy. Mains are cheap at about RM 20, and good size servings. Alcoholic drinks cheap too RM12 for vodka and lemon. kids love the grape ice.Show less

Author: TonyDebLewMelbourne, Australia
Title: What a Gem
Review: Thankfully we came across Helena's Cafe on the first day of our holiday, as it meant we could keep coming back for more!! Helena and her mum Theresa have got it just right - great service and fabulous fresh food. Curries to die for, huge breakfasts , a must try is the steamboat. and the cost is minimal. We were always welcomed with a friendly smile, even by Rosy the dog out back ;). Tony, Deb & Lewis, MelbourneShow less

Author: DemononePenang
Title: Mutton curry ... ummmmm
Review: OK, I have to admit that I only eat one dish when I go to Helena's Cafe ... mutton curry but that's because it is the mutton curry of the God's. My friends tell me there are other wonderful dishes on the menu, but I cannot go past my favourite food.A couple of parathas and a cold beer or two to wash it all down and you have one of the best Indian meals in the world ... well, OK maybe I am being a little over the top, but certainly in Penang and that is saying something because there are some great Indian restaurants on the Island.The restuarant is run by a mother and daughter team, Theresa and Helena and head chef Theresa uses authentic Indian spices and herbs to whip up her wonderful creations. You can get a beer, wine or soft drinks too.Great value for money, wonderful warm people running it, what more could you want for an authentic Indian meal?Show less

Author: CastaMelbMelbourne, Australia
Title: Service terrible but food was nice
Review: After selecting this restaurant due to this forum & seeing it was not very full, we got an outside table & preceeded to order. The drinks took a long while & for someone who wants a second beer after 10 minutes, the wait meant I had to frantically wave for attention. However, the meals must have taken close to an hour before arriving and although we had nowhere to go, it was highly unusual & we were not on our own -perhaps just a bad night? Food & ambience were very good.Show less

Author: Travelover99Perth, Western Australia
Title: Great food and hosts!!
Review: Tried this restaurant after reading the reviews on trip advisor and it certainly lives up to its reputation. We had various dishes including satay sticks and the Chicken Curry all of which were excellent. The homemade pancakes and icecream for dessert finished off a great meal for our family. It was extremely well priced and the hosts were very friendly. Would definately recommend this restaurant to anyone coming to Penang.Show less

Author: Morrisfamily_11Manchester, United Kingdom
Title: Good value, clean and attentive service
Review: We stayed in Penang for a week in April and had breakfast most mornings at Helena's. Great value for money alot better than eating breakfast in the hotel, only a short walk from The Holiday Inn. My girls loved the chocolate milkshake. A fantastic team, mother and daughter made always made welcome. Plenty of choice for lunch and dinner too. Service fantastic and both spoke English.Show less

Author: stevandiWeymouth, United Kingdom
Title: Best Curries on Batu
Review: Being a curry fanatic, I found Helena's mums curries up there with the best .... Tasty, and as spicy as requested.. Excellent value. Friendly atmosphere and always full of regulars.An added novelty for my wife was going out the back to "pat the dog". She spent more time with him than me !!!!!!Show less

Author: TheRuddos

Author: DwozzzBirmingham, United Kingdom
Title: Good Value Food, Basic Appearance.
Review: Helena's Cafe provide a range of food including Chinese, Malaysian, Indian, Thai and Western cuisine. Their prices really are unbeatable and portion sizes are good. They offer a range of drinks including fresh juices, soft drinks (i.e. pepsi and sprite), Milk Shakes, Ice teas and even alcoholic beverages including beers and spirits. As a rough guide, a non alcoholic drink will only cost you around 2-3 RM. Likewise many of their traditional dishes, i.e. Chicken Bee Hoon will cost around 7RM. If you want the more sort after or western dishes expect to pay a little more i.e. Chicken Curry = 15RM. Breakfast is great value as toast with butter costs only 1RM and toast and jam (jelly) costing a few pennies more with a full cooked breakfast costing 15RM.On recommendation we suggest for a couple:Lunch = Starter = 6 chicken satay sticks (to share) (Appetizer section) = 5RM,  Main = 2 x Chicken Bee Hoon noodles (Malaysian section) = 14RM, Drinks = 2 x Iced Milo (Chocolate Milk) = 4RM Sub Total = 23RMTax 5% = 1.15RMService Charge 10% = 2.30RMTotal = 26.45RM (at current rate that’s about £5 for two!)The staff are friendly, and although it is basic it is clean enough. One of us has OCD and managed to eat here.One word of advice, do not expect a plush or romantic setting. It is a café and you should expect a café. If you are after more exuberant, elaborate or aesthetic surroundings you will be disappointed but as a place to feed a hungry belly or a good meal for a low price you can’t beat it.To find it (walking) head past holiday inn, then Parkroyal hotel (on the same side as this hotel), cross the road and carry on walking it is just a little way further on the right.Show less

Author: JimjilljaneMelbourne, Australia
Title: Tradition at its Best
Review: I have always shared stories of wonderful foods long gone with my children. We love traditions and authentic foods, cooked just the way it used to be and the way it should be. Not tweaked, not fancy to cater to hype. Dinner at Nyonya Su Pei was just that. Being able to share what was once stories with my children and rekindle old memories for my parents made this evening very special indeed.Together, with wonderful philosophy and technical food knowledge from Baba Jerry and Nyonya Su Pei with her skills and intuition, the food was beyond delicious. Pork is not my favourite meat but the Gulai Babi was so well done that it was not oily or tasted fat. I wanted a very authentic Gulai Tumis Ikan ( how through my search on the internet found Nyonya Su Pei ) and it was just amazing. Baba Jerry told us how it was prepared and it was no wonder I have not had an authentic GTI since when. In our family, we have always debated on how a Sesame Oil Chicken should be done. From the memory of my mother in law's recipe and my mum's cooking, my daughter agreed this is just the way it should be simply delicious!The Sambal Hae Bee brought back memories of my aunt who would spend hours pounding away. The texture was exactly the way it is meant to be. If you are younger than 55 you may not have know how 5 spice powder should smell like. For that you should get a bottle from Baba Jerry.Will I go back? I already have a list for Nyonya Su Pei the next time I am in Penang!Show less

Author: emilioeats
Title: Outrageously priced and subpar at best.
Review: Mediocre food that was outrageously priced with unpleasant lecturing by Baba Jerry.The 8 of us were in Penang for New Year's Eve and as most other restaurants were fully booked for a party of our size, we opted for private dining at Nyonya Su Pei. One of our family members read the positive reviews on TripAdvisor and immediately contacted Baba Jerry to secure our dinner reservation. We were given a description of their private dining mission and values. Though we initially thought 800 SGD for a Peranakan meal for 8 seemed somewhat pricey, we were told that it was fine-dining and of great quality. We proceeded to make the payment at the date of our booking and justified the exorbitant bill by assuming that they would serve us dishes consisting of equivalently lavish ingredients. Shortly, they sent us our Peranakan dinner menu featuring the names of foreign dishes we were unfamiliar with. In anticipation, we googled the dishes and were astounded to find that the menu items consisted of ordinary ingredients such as vegetables, fish and prawn. However, having already paid the full amount, with nowhere else to dine that evening, as per their address and directions we ventured into a quiet neighbourhood and arrived at Baba Jerry's garage.Upon entering, we noticed that his makeshift dining room was modestly decorated with one long table central to the dining area. Baba Jerry greeted us at the back door slightly flustered (on our way to his location he texted us to take our time), and let us take our seats. He went into the kitchen and emerged with his signature green pandan-infused water, introduced himself, and so began the diatribe of his life journey, hardships and accomplishments.One by one he served us the dishes, with ample duration apart from one another in which he had the luxury of time to explain each dish, its history, its difficulty level, and the amount of derogation and belittlement his wife Nyonya Su Pei endured from his family (Grandma to be specific) to be worthy of cooking these traditional and complex Peranakan dishes for the satisfaction of the men in his family (so that they wouldn't look elsewhere for another wife). Baba Jerry hovered over our table the entire meal and it felt uncomfortable and suffocating to say the least. He boasted on and on about the superiority of his family's Peranakan recipes and cooking, and lectured us on how critique was not welcome when not requested for (in regards to food). The quality of food preparation and taste of the dishes were acceptable, though they fell short of Baba Jerry's self-praises. We experienced dishes including eggplant, tofu, various other vegetables, as well as a grouper fish and prawn dish. Unfortunately, no dishes left a lasting impression. All we remembered was the hefty pricetag and Baba Jerry's relentless lectures with archaic viewpoints.Show less

Author: HappyinHK888Hong Kong, China
Title: AMAZING, 100 STAR* evening with a Master Chef Couple. WOW..Just...Wow!
Review: True lovers of food, DO NOT MISS dining at this spectacular private kitchen (open only Fri-Sat evening) with limited seating.The booking I made was for "Penang Home Favorites" out of various options but this is elevated, world class dining where every bite opens up a world of flavors, culture and history. Poignantly, it also reveals the dying culture of the Peranakan, also known as Baba Nonya. I promise, it's the best (and realest - is that a word?) dining and cultural experience in Penang, for me the best dining in the last 5 years.This lauded wife and husband chef team - Nonya Su Pei and Baba Jerry's - honest, heartfelt style of cooking is technically genius. Its also backed by generations of learning and experience with a wide array of spices and ingredients. Their proficiency underscores what's wrong with my recent experiences of living in HK and traveling to eat in Asia, the Americas, Europe where restaurants are oft overhyped (yes, even those Michelin starred ones)...These folks wield magic in layering and blending flavors you never knew your tongue can distinguish. First the meal -- Warning, the photos and review may trigger extreme food envy.Friday 7pm, we were seated in a starkly plain dining room (the focus is on the food, not decor) with another couple, but at our own table, as Jerry explained there would be so much food. First up - a tasty and elegant amuse bouche of compressed, marinaded tofu with a crunchy shell of white and black sesame seeds on a skewer. The fronds of pickled green papaya was light and delightful.Then the Heavenly kick-butt Achar - spicy, fragrant, tangy pickle (shallots, eggplant frenchbeans, long beans, carrots ,cucumber, sesame seed) in a puddle of violently red oil. Oh Gods, where do I start? Intense sugars and natural glutamates of the dehydrated then blanched veggies were perfectly balanced with the hint of sharpness of distilled vinegar; with added richness and crunch from peanuts. Danger, danger Will Robinson ...This stuff turns the brain's satiation switch off. I. COULD. NOT. STOP. EATING. Malaysian families protect their heirloom Achar recipes to the death, doling out home made cans to relatives and friends just to make them envious at Chinese New Year. So I've tasted more than a few. Nonya Su Pei's is hands down the best, worth the price of entry.The Achar was accompanied by fragrant home made fish crackers. This humble grayish disc of crunchiness is another jewel in the crown of any self respecting Nonya's repertoire of tough as a bastard things to cook right. Mackarel meat and flour, seasoning (mainly white pepper) are laboriously pounded until the paste is so tacky you could lift the mortar with the pestle. Then it's shaped, steamed, sliced thin, sun dried, then deep-fried.Then came the slow cooked Babi Pongteh - Kurobota pork belly and shoulder in a spiced home made soy sauce, with a hint of sweetness. A perfectly mellow, savory, slightly fatty dish with sauce that went magnificently with rice. My health nut lean freak husband actually fought me for the last spoonfuls.Next up, a small side dish of Belachan. This oft-maligned, pungent foodstuff is for us true believers the most complex, umami, dare I say spiritual (yes it twinges that part of the brain that hears angels sing when done right) yet earthy and nostalgic single dish in the pantheon of Malaysian dishes. Belachan confisungly refers to the base ingredient - a dried brick of fermented krill/shrimp/anchovies paste , a side dish or dip (when blended with chillies, shallots, garlic etc) , and a sauce base for many Peranakan dishes. When added to the stewed pork and the next dish to be served, Eggplant and Tofu, the Belachan side dish added an incredible depth of flavor - while not overwhelming the dish. Baba Jerry's secret is home made belachan of dried krill where the commercial belachan adds cheap fish offal and carcass that requires acid to dissolve, adding an acrid taste. So Jerry's belachan delivers a massive dose of natural glutamates without the nastiness.The Eggplant and Tofu itself is worth honorable mention and tied for second best with the pork. Can a dish be delicately assertive? This was - with its lightly spicy fishstock base and absolutely perfectly cooked eggplant. Then came the Paku Pakis Fiddlehead Ferns with Belachan, a dish I hadn't eaten in 30 years, a reason to both rejoice and mourn. Fiddlehead ferns are extremely difficult to come by due to deforestation, as they are foraged, (also I'd left the country for that long) hence the sorrow. But living for the moment, and the dish set in front of me, I masticated with eyes closed so I'd forever remember each delicately and perfectly al dente tender crunch of fern chased by the unabashedly funky, pungent, whiplash of belachan.Next, to our extended stomach's disbelief, Baba Jerry served a whole steamed red snapper slathered topped with heaping of shaved torch ginger buds, in a delicate tangy-sweet fragrant sauce with hints of lemongrass. But - wow- that evocative sauce resonated of longlost evenings by the Irrawady as teakboats drift by. The fresh, delicately steamed line-caught so tender you don't have to chew, let if dissolve on your blissed-out tongue. It speaks to the chefs mastery of not overwhelming such a magnificent ingredient.After all that, we couldn't even do justice to the dish of stirfried chicken and the dessert, a delicate, collagen rich snow lotus seed chilled soup! So now you know, the meal was an absolute labour of love and dedication to tradition. And it was worth every red cent. If you booking less than 10 pax, you pay and enjoy what's called "Open Session" dining format, designed by the chef. When you book he will quote a rate anything from MYR $150 per head, depending on ingredients. Penangites who pride themselves on frugality will scream at that price but I repeat, MORE than worth it by a mile!If you're interested in a little Peranakan history, ingredients and the chefs, read on..Yes, I'm being wordy but its in humble homage to the effort this chef couple puts into the meal. And it helps you fully appreciate the meal. - They freaking make their own soy sauce, not just the belachan. Low on sodium, high on living organism Koji so the flavor improves with age - the current batch we sampled is 5 years old, kick butt umami-meaty flavor and hardly any saltiness-Baba Jerry is an encyclopedia of all things food. He and wife Nonya Su Pei (Baba and Nonya are honorifics like Mr and Mrs) are proficient in 600 northern and southern Pernakan dishes. Their cousin specializes in health-boosting ingredients and they served a massive jug of green, cleansing chlorophyll tea made from Mulberry leaf.-They're also unique - the last Hokkien Peranakan family catering a private kitchen/restaurant. Other Peranakan are Hainanese, influenced by Javanese and southern cooking. The Peranakan culture refers to an assimilation of cultures of Chinese immigrants with the various dialect groups taking on more or less characteristics of Burmese Indian Indonesian Malay Thai.-The cuisine is ancient and fusion before the word even existed (and in many places are overworked and abused); it's also one of the richest in blend of cultures. The Chinese royal entourages and their highly skilled chefs left behind by exploratory voyages of Admiral Cheng Ho twice in the 15th century were desperate for ingredients to replace their depleted stores and turned to the original Indian inhabitants of the island, who turned them onto the island's spices. Then the Dutch, Portuguese, English colonists added their own ingredients to the melange, from tomatoes to Worcestershire sauce!-As you eat all that history and confluence of cultures, you can ask generous chef any questions. What I've written is a mere fragment of his touching and enlightening commentary. -Last but not least the heart and humility of the chefs shine through. Chef Su Pei was painstakingly taught to cook to perfection all the difficult recipes of Chef Jerry's mother and grandmother so she could bring the clan together through communal feasts. What you're served is also an intimate family meal.So, please, do experience this lovely private kitchen! FYI - I get a ton of joy at their success but NO compensation for this review,...Show less

Title: A vegan restaurant which serves great organic dishes
Review: I did not personally dine in at this restaurant, but only ordered as a takeaway due to the nationwide CMCO period in early August. Even then, the dishes that we bought were still good enough for me to give a highly positive rating for this restaurant. Indeed, they even put in some investment in their takeaway boxes, by using high-quality and bio-degradable containers. Taste and quality-wise, the food here was superb as well, with a good blend of both Oriental (e.g. laksa, noodles, etc.) as well as Western-style dishes (e.g. spaghetti and burgers) to suit various preferences. Who says vegetarian/vegan dishes have to be boring?Show less

Author: lohwx02George Town, Malaysia
Title: Excellent Vegan Restaurant
Review: However, I'm not giving it 5 stars due to slow services. The food is scrumptious and suits our Malaysian taste buds. Their dishes are very creative as they convert meat-based dishes into vegan dishes while preserving the taste we missed.I can assume that this restaurant is halal for Muslims as all food is vegan and do not contain any animal meat or products. However, most customers are chinese as some of them practice vegetarianism (related to Buddhism and stuff). Also, there are a LOT of visitors during some Chinese festivities, so you should expect some long waiting time (1~2 hours)Show less

Author: PhilC_UKPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Excellent Vegan Choice
Review: In an area that is only gradually coming to terms with accommodating the growing global trends of vegan and vegetarian cuisine, Pǐnxīn is a real gem. Great quality ingredients and presentation make for delicious meals with some amazing takes on traditional local dishes.Take out/delivery services do not compromise on quality and they also sell base ingredients for you to try yourself at home. Highly recommended whether you are vegan or not.Show less

Author: marjansipsma
