Title: Very nice food!
Review: Lovely food and good portions in a cosy setting. We had the vegan sate which was very nice and I loved the passion buddha bowl! A non vegetarian had the vegan burger that he really liked (only the sweet potato fries were not hot enough). Definitely a place to go to.Show less

Author: PER J
Title: Terrific and reasonably pried
Review: Terrific and reasonably pried vegan food in a nicely appointed restaurant. The menu gives even the most discerning customer an option.

Author: twistwis
Title: Service must improve
Review: A very bad experience. Last time the service was excellent, I came to pinxin yesterday I had my meals n my drinks,food was good but when I'm looking for an assistant no response from the staff, the staff keep talking at the bar area. I'm very disappointed! Train ur staff, thank you! Show less

Author: kriso474
Title: Vegan evening
Review:
If anyone likes vegan cuisine, I highly recommend it.  If you haven't tried this kitchen yet, go to this restaurant.  Delicious food, very nice service and great tea. Fiery, I mean hellish, really :-)
Recommend

Author: Lou H
Title: Amazing Food
Review: This place was so good we visited three times during our stay in Georgetown. Each meal was exceptionally good and the drinks were great too. It’s nice and cool too With the air conditioning going.

Author: RicardoBowieEdinburgh, United Kingdom
Title: Truly Amazing
Review: A great restaurant with a strong identity serving quality foods for the discerning vegan (or anyone) who just likes healthy food.The menu was varied and interesting. The strong focus is vegan, organic and natural. Truly enjoyed the experience.The restaurant has an effortless slick and polished edge (without fuss). A truly top dining experience in an excellent setting too.Really enjoyed the food experience - thanks. Show less

Author: Jean B
Title: Vegan worth going out of way for
Review: A stylish restaurant a short taxi ride from most downtown hotels. A treat to find a good selection of vegan dishes, lovely atmosphere, friendly attentive staff

Author: Duff99Bangkok
Title: Really horrible service
Review: The restaurant is above average price for Georgetown, and there are many vegan and vegetarian choices, even within a few blocks of this place. And although the food was mostly good (2 of the 3 dishes were tasty), the service was SO BAD that we tried to cancel our order and go elsewhere. Even though the restaurant was mostly empty, other tables were also complaining about dishes not arriving and drinks showing up at the end of the meal. Servers seemed entirely clueless, wandering around the tables not noticing/caring that one of us finished our food before the other one had received anything to eat. No one bothered to ask why one dish was completely untouched, and we watched waitstaff huddle behind the counter or stand at the counter eating their dinner in sight of paying customers who had no food.Show less

Author: Soyoung M
Title: Fabulous Malaysia vegetarian cuisine
Review: If you are vegetarian or not, must go here while in George Town. The food is beautifully prepared and delicious. We all had authentic Malaysian dishes -- best we've had in George Town. We loved the street food, but this was a nice sit-down restaurant on a quiet street, which was perfect for our last night in Malaysia. Show less

Author: kianglong81Malaysia
Title: Excellent vegan food in the town
Review: I book a table for three, and bring my family there just after I landed in Penang airport. We drove about 30mins from airport. We lucky to have a parking space just in front of the shop. There is a limited parking space, do take note those who plan to drive there. We arrived there around 8pm, Thursday evening. The waiter service is excellent, recommend us their signature food and we all have a great meal. The food is awesome and nicely cooked. The price of the food is above average, cost somewhere between RM20-25 per plate (order). The food portion is just nice for an adult. We ordered a bowl of soup noodles, two plate of mushroom themed rice, a Tonya soup, a side dish satay, a hot soy bean drink, a hot chocolate drink. Cost a total bill of RM115.50 includes 5% service charge. Wonderful dining experience. Will definitely visit this shop again. Show less

Author: HiBrillianceSingapore, Singapore
Title: The Chef Put Effort
Review: Straight from the airport, we went straight to this restaurant for lunch.The menu seemed modest but very neatly written & presented.The dining area was also catchy with a classic European theme.The satay and the nasi lemak deserved compliments. Their flavours were well balanced and rich in textures.The only mistake was to include raw zucchini in place of plain raw cucumber. If they had used Japanese cucumber then it would have been perfect.Keep it up and for patrons, don’t miss out on this hidden gem.Show less

Author: WaiYeong
Title: Penang Vegan Local Delicacies, yummy
Review: It's a rare destination for vegetarians like us. The taste is great. I have the opportunity to eat the local delicacies done in vegan way.

Author: gq987Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Food was just ok, service was BAD!
Review: This is my second time visiting the restaurant, it was worse than the first time. We ordered green curry mini pot, jawa mee and mixed vege rice. The tofu in the jawa mee was a bit sour. For green curry mini pot and vege rice, it was just normal. The highlight was the bad service. So we went in, made order, and asked for water first. It never came. I have to walk to the bar to pick up the water bottle, and even asked for cups. For the refill, it's the same, I have to do self service. I am ok with self service if this is a lower grade restaurant or fast food chain, but with the price I'm paying, I'm expecting more from the service. The bad service has been consistent. During my first time visit, our table is full, they refused to change us to bigger table (because the management was occupying the table even without dining), and the staff was clueless when I asked her 'how do you manage everything on our table'. In the end, I have to rearrange the plates myself! Management, please put more time to train your staffs! We are customer, not waiters!Show less

Author: G3831TRdavidr
Title: Just incredible
Review:
The place is very nice, unique decoration, and the bolognese pasta were so good !!!
I really recommend this place

Author: shiramckinlay
Title: Delicious vegan food
Review: Though a bit pricier than a lot of the places in Penang, it was still really reasonable compared to the US or Europe, and the food was excellent and fresh.  Gluten-free options were clearly marked (though there weren't tons).  The mushroom satay appetizer was incredible!

Author: supakornBangkok
Title: Food: 9/10 & Service 3/10; Definitely NOT Michelin Quality!!
Review: The food is lovely but we had a bad experience because of really bad service. We ordered 2 mains, 1 side and 2 drinks. Here is how things came: First, one drink (water). The we waited a while. Then one main (nasi lemak). Then, a bit later, the other drink. Then we sat there. One of us had food and the other didn't. This is okay at a hawker stall. We weren't there to share. We each ordered what we like. It's unpleasant to sit in a nice restaurant when one person has food and other doesn't. And we just sat there for at least another 10 minutes. This .was clearly a kitchen problem just making things and sending them out without thinking of the whole table.. Other tables were receiving food. After about 15 minutes, I went up to the counter and politely explained and asked to cancel our other dishes, since we had to get going. The teenage server.couldn't understand me even after I asked twice. So, I asked to speak to someone who could speak English (again politely). So, I explained a third time and this teenager started explaining why the food was later, which is irrelevant. At that moment, the next main came out. So we just sat down and ate. When we finished, the side dish arrived. The teenage server came to the table and dropped the plate on the far side of the table. Really immature behavior. The food was quite good, as other reviews say. It's not amazing. Our mains were very good but the side (sweet potato fries) were soft and bland. The atmosphere was nice. We noticed that other tables were also having trouble getting good service- people had to get up and go ask/remind servers for what they wanted. Anyway- we'd go back but with much lower expectations. Definitely NOT a michelin experience!! ;-)Show less

Author: Singtiandi
Title: Food with Love
Review: Unique dining experience in an elegant furnished restaurant not only for vegan lover but everyone. Food made with love and inspiration. A rare find in Penang.

Author: Louise KSydney
Title: Great food
Review: Beautiful, fresh & tasty vegan meals.Lovely cafeGood almond, or soy milk coffee!ONLY disappointment... the staff are very ‘relaxed’... both visits I had to ASK for a spoon & sugar for the coffee... AND cutlery when my meal was served. No napkins or serviettes provided.They also need to cook the air fried sweet potato better. Many were still raw. The majority were soft - not like fries.Overall, I enjoyed the food, smoothies & coffee, so will definitely return!Show less

Author: Audrey J
Title: Healthy & Tasty
Review: The food is vegan friendly. For something so healthy , I wasn't expecting too much but I was pleasantly surprised. My friend drank every drop of the soup and the nasi lemak was really good. The vegetarian chicken satay was amazingly well done where you can feel the different texture of meat, skin and fat. That's an art!Give it a try, you won't be disappointed. Show less

Author: wonderer1212
Title: Scrumptious vegan food you shouldn't miss!
Review: Didn't expect that vegan food will be tasting soooo good! A delicious meal plus a cozy ambient make this place the best vegan restaurant in town! Good services and fresh ingredients are used. Thumbs up!

Author: zalnikor
Title: Delicious food,very reasonable prices
Review: Enjoyed a Pinxin Nasi Lemak,very tasty also had a delicious avocado smoothie.Many interesting dishes on menu,i will definately be returning.Good service,nice atmosphere,comfy setting.Well worth the visit for Vegans and Vegetarians.

Author: KimOfTheNorthNottingham, United Kingdom
Title: Great food, lots of choice, the satay is to die for!
Review: I came here twice in January. The menu is large with a good choice of western and asian dishes. The food is really nice, fresh ingrediants and healthy. Even though I have had dishes I have enjoyed more in Penang (bear in mind I’m not vegan) the reason why I give this restaurant 5 stars is because it is one of the best vegan restaurants I have ever been to. The satay sticks are wonderful (infact, the mushrooms used in my plum sauce dish were the same kind... these are the perfect substitute for chicken!), the service is good and fast, and the premises is nice. Highly recommended!Show less

Author: Donmarn L
Title: Yum
Review: The satay is amazing would highly recommend. I had a glazed noodle dish which was delicious too. My friend unluckily had the laksa which she didn’t like and I tried it too and something didn’t taste right. My food was all delicious though. Little pricey but amazing vegan options.....that vegan satay. Yum! Show less

Author: Michelle D
Title: Vegan oriental heaven
Review: Great ambience, very tasty vegan noodle soups, the mushroom skewer blew our mind away. But most importantly - the vegan matcha latte is a drink of gods. Relatively not cheap for Georgetown, but still very affordable for westeners.

Author: noammohrNaples, Italy
Title: Disappointing
Review: The food was ok. I was expecting so much better, but I've had a lot better elsewhere. Hated the kwang chiang. The jasmine butterfly tea was disgusting, but I should know better than to thing mixing butterfly pea juice and tea would be good. The asam laksa was just ok. The other soup we got was better, not amazing, but pretty good. In general, adequate but that's it.Show less

Author: annafN2943ML
Title: Really terrible
Review: I love vegan restaurants around the world, but this one was truly awful. Burger smelling of rotten mushrooms, rubber-like pasta and dull tomato sauce. Unbelievably bad

Author: YaseLisaWellington, New Zealand
Title: Beautiful Restaurant/Cafe
Review: You walk in and enjoy the aircon!It is very nice styled and the chairs are super comfortable! With my short legs i can touch the ground and the high of the table is also right!As a shorty i don't sit often i sit comfortable!I came for a soy cappuccino because at least once a day i need a good cup of coffee!The soy cap is good here! You can taste the esspresso shot and the soymilk is not sweetend! It comes in a good sized mug too!Haven't had food but the menu looks good and I love that they use natural/organic ingredients!Show less

Author: chuchillaIstanbul, Turkey
Title: Dissatisfied
Review: I went here with 2 friends based on all the good reviews. But very disappointed..only few items on the menu were available, service was poor..waited up to an hour for our order and although food fresh, it was pretty bland. No oil or condiments offered. Prices alright and ambiance ok but honestly there is better veg street food.Show less

Author: timmiulder
Title: Very nice meal and dining experience
Review: This place is very welcoming, the food is displayed nicely and tastes perfect, lots of plates to choose from, all appear to be organic and vegetarian. Try the satay, really good for a vegetarian version. The staff is really friendly and correct!

Author: Yl N
Title: BEST VEGAN CUISINE
Review: Delightful and delicious are the dinners they serve, Closed as the clouds, religious as the faith of a saint; Colossal suffering undoes you, like the lying of a demon, Or the deceit of a devil - they sting our souls for their food. Deeply the defects are immeasurable, for food admits usInto the gardens of Paradise, when they attach fragrance. Calculate the ideas of the topics to be discussed In front of all of you, in front of the soul. This day was a day from God, on His Throne, Life has been won, life has been won, for all!Show less

Author: sweetsikhikLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Maybe I walked into the wrong one??
Review: Having now read the other reviews I seriously think I might have walked in to a different Pinxin or at least arrived on their off day as I found the food decidedly average. I ordered a couple of menu items from their lovely choice of vegan food, neither blew me away or deserved anything more than an average in my opinion. The noodle soup tasted slightly bitter but was passable, the bitter flavors completely masked any cashew milk base this once had, the sweet potato fries were a combo of oily and mushy despite it being claimed they are air fried !! I cant even claim the waiting staff were more than average although they were attentive and helpful I was given no napkins and after applying a considerable amount of soup upon my face I gave in and asked for some. I was presented with a half opened packet of Tesco's value range tissues (yes still in the pack) seriously?? you're going to waste all that time and attention to the decor and a fancy looking menu and then whip out a half open pack of the Tesco's less than finest, budget brand stuff...lolShow less

Author: IrfanA1020
Title: cruelty-free coffee
Review: Their coffee is so good . never tasted soy milk latte so good before this . The barista knows what is he doing with the coffee . love it !!

Author: Vince Y
Title: Not Many Vegan Cuisine in Penang
Review:
Environment: Average
Parking: Public Parking place...a bit difficult to find
Cleanliness: 3/5
Food Quality: 3/5
Food Quantity: 3/5
Food Presentation: 3/5
AirCon: Yes
Wifi: Didn't check 
Price: Slightly on higher site (A Coffee Latte at RM11.00)
Ideal for elder and Small Children: Yes

Author: Dee D
Title: Awesome Vegan vibes
Review: Really nice food and staff , we went there, then we came back for breakfast everyday. There are gluten free option, spicy options, smoothies, tartines... everything is delicious .

Author: moirvolley
Title: Excellent meal from lots of choices
Review: Highly recommend this vegan restaurant. So many options on the menu which made it hard to choose. the two mains and entree we decided on were very tasty.

Author: IvyB235
Title: Super nice restaurant
Review: The food is delicious! I‘ve been here everyday now, of my stay in Georgetown! The atmosphere of the restaurant is unique and the food tasty and delicious! Love it

Author: RobyntPhillip Island, Australia
Title: Fabulous !
Review: We’re staying in a hotel nearby and popped in for lunch, excellent food and service, with a lovely ambience. Menu options are varied, we had 3 cup mushroom/tofu dish and Nasi Lemak absolutely delicious, to many options to choose from but we thoroughly enjoyed our lunch and hope to come again whilst in Penang. I highly recommend!Show less

Author: PKB_1990
Title: Absolutely loved it!
Review: Excellent spot for local food in comfort. The interior of the restaurant was very quaint. Satay and nasi lemak were beyond just tasty

Author: backpackmegMargate, United Kingdom
Title: JUST INCREDIBLE!
Review: The restaurant has a lovely atmosphere the interior is very nicely layed out and the restaurant is very clean. The staff are all very polite and the food is just incredible. As vegans we love places like this and wish we could of tried every dish on the menu! The owner recommended us a few dishes and we enjoyed them very much. We highly recommend this place for vegans or non-vegans. The mushrooms (Hericium Erinaceus) were some of the nicest we've tasted and give the dishes a really nice touch. Show less

Author: MelvinL380Singapore
Title: Great ambiance and lovely environment
Review: We were recommended here by our hotel. Great ambiance and lovely environment to dine in. The food was generally delicious, but not quite what I was expecting? I had the Nasi Lemak and I wasn't quite sure about the contents served with the dish. The fragrant basmati coconut rice was served with nuts, pickled vegetables, papadom and rendang (which wasn't what I was expecting for this dish)? It was nevertheless delicious.Show less

Author: 309winstonl
Title: very very great
Review:
great food and service, love it so much!
great food and service, love it so much!
great food and service, love it so much!

Author: tezzacl
Title: Chilled vibes, great food
Review: Where have I been?! Stumbled on this place while running and devoured the charcoal breakfast burger. Been back since for lunch - mushroom satay and the health burger. New favourite in Penang. Staff really passionate about locally sourced food and great service.

Author: holliemclean
Title: Delicious food!
Review: I visited pinxin three times while in Penang and really enjoyed each meal, especially the breakfast Buddha bowl and mini pot. The food is fresh and beautifully prepared and the restaurant is comfortable and nicely decorated

Author: Sansnape
Title: Gorgeous food and place!
Review: We ordered the chee chong fan, nasi lemak, satay and minced meat noodles here and enjoyed it. It’s a cafe with character. The chee chong fan is seriously the best I have ever had! :)

Author: noraneeVillingen-Schwenningen, Germany
Title: Could be better
Review: First of all, the food is very good and the prices are absolutely fair for what you get. The staff is friendly and attentively. Unfortunately I waited longer than half an hour for a toast. So if you want to eat here, you should bring enough time with you. All in all the food is good but the style of the restaurant is quiet old-fashioned and the ambience is not that nice. Dear Stuff, please throw these lampignongs and old pictures in the bin and change the green wall to a modern colour with some cool pictures and this could be the best vegan restaurant in Georgetown, where you can not only eat good food but also have a nice and relaxing time in a nice place!! Show less

Author: Chiara D
Title: Extraordinary vegan
Review: Great food and amazing stuff. Was our restaurant for breakfast and lunch all the days we been there.

Author: SingaporeBagelSingapore, Singapore
Title: Delicious vegan restaurant!
Review: We are a family of vegetarians and always on a lookout for yummy vegan or vegetarian restaurants - this one didn’t disappoint.No msg and no mock meat, clean tasting food that doesn’t make you feel super thirsty!Great creation of vegan Assam laksa, very impressive and other yummy local Penang/Malaysian Chinese style dishes.Accept credit cards and have a peaceful, calm atmosphere. Super accommodating to children.High recommend.Show less

Author: lynkoay
Title: Buddha Bowl, Fruit Rojak
Review: Lovely healthy dish. Highly recommended. Fresh & tasty. Fruit Rojak is excellent. We scrapped the bottom of the plate, trying to clean off every drop of Rojak sauce. For drinks, we had the blue flower tea called Butterfly Pea antioxidant drink. All real healthy and yummy.Show less

Author: Celeste T
Title: Excellent food.
Review: Excellent food, great atmosphere, friendly staff, fresh drinks, good cleanness, instar am perfect for taking pics

Author: michelle_mumu
Title: Ms
Review: It was a pleasant visit, ordered laksa noodles and a hot blue drink, perfect match! Very tasty, and I would definitely come back again soon.

Author: mimsywimsy
Title: Incredible, tasty and healthy vegan food
Review: My boyfriend and I were absolutely blown away by how flavoursome and delishious the food here was. The salad was exactly what we were hoping for and the rice and noodles were the best we’ve had on our trip so far. Would 100% recommend. Staff were also fantastic and helpfulShow less

Author: MagdarmLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Will never forget this place
Review: How do you write a review about the best food you had in your life? PINXIN was amazing! I went there 2 times during my two days in Penang and I wish I visited more! Their food is tasty, portions are generous and the place is beautiful. I can't wait to go back to Malaysia and try that food again. Ps: Spicy does mean spicy! Show less

Author: poulh27Penang Island, Malaysia
Title: Ambassador
Review: "Converted" to Veganism four months ago.. So I have been checking out all the vegan restaurants in Penang. Pinxin is an incredibly good restaurant. In a class of its own. The food is based on the rich local culinary traditions, but consistently vegan. I went with two non-vegan friends, who enjoyed every savory bite. I also loved the interior, inviting, a mixture of old and new. The staff is extremely friendly and invites input from the guests. This place ought to attract all, vegans as well as non-vegans. Poul HoinessShow less

Author: therobertnGeorge Town, Malaysia
Title: WOW Factor
Review: With so many choices of eateries in Penang, it’s a struggle for anyone to stand out from the crowd - ‘PIN XIN’ have succeeded and are in a league of their own. As soon as we arrived we felt the WOW factor and it got even better ...delicious vegan cuisine, well thought through selection of dishes and great presentation. There was one last WOW ...passion fruit desert!!!Show less

Author: HeroshiFoxxAtlanta
Title: Best vegan meal in Penang
Review: The food was delicious. I tried several laskas while in Penang and this was my favorite. The mushroom satay was also very good. They were made from hericium mushrooms and the texture was meaty in a good vegetable way (not like faux meat). The passion fruit cheesecake like dessert was also good. All around the best meal I had although a little bit on the expensive side in comparison to most vegan/vegetarian restaurants in Penang, but well worth it.Show less

Author: Sammy BNottingham, United Kingdom
Title: Best Vegan Food Ever!!!
Review: This is the best vegan food I have ever had! It’s actually some of the best food I have ever had full stop! The Nasi Lemak was amazing. They create such incredible food that shouldn’t be missed during your stay in Penang! The staff took the time out to chat to us after and shared a genuine love for all things Vegan :)! Show less

Author: teoh t
Title: FEEL GOOD!
Review: Is a very nice place and foods for vegan, will visit again to this place with my friends & family soon

Author: LizzieP_11
Title: Good vegan food!
Review: So nice to find a clean, healthy vegan restaurant in Penang - this will be my go-to place on future business trips here!

Author: Fredgirl_PenangPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Love this place
Review: Great food in nice surrounding with excellent service from passionate and very kind people. Their laksa is amazing and I couldn't believe it was vegan. Their vegan Sate is delicious, with a superb kajang sauce. Highly recommended! My friend loved the vegan Penang Hokien Mee, very impressed. Show less

Author: LisaFreeBirdCafeChiang Mai, Thailand
Title: Delicious!
Review: I'll be honest, the first time I went, my curry was cold and my iced tea was warm and served in a ridiculously small glass, the staff was all laying around on the sofas and being loud. I didn't like it but I always give a second chance, esp when someone gives a recommendation. I'm so happy to say I went back today and even though they were just seating a table of 20, my food came out quickly, hot and delicious, I mean, sooo, soooo good! The Prosperous Hokkien Noodle soup was incredibly flavorful and the appetizer of Kuang Chiung was surprisingly flavorful and filling, the chili sauce served on the side is the perfect compliment. The Lemon Iced Tea is served in a regular glass thank goodness and the service was so accommodating and helpful, even though they had the huge party to take care of. I will definitely be back and also recommend others to go there. Show less

Author: Kun A
Title: Wow
Review: The food taste is indescribable. Simply awesome. Doesn't seems like a vegan food but it's actually vegan food. OMG you guys are the best. I've been a vegan for 30 years. This is the best vegan food that I ever had

Author: robkccPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Overrated
Review: Fairly new place in a row of renovated pre-war houses. Food is nothing fantastic. The matcha cake too sweet and soggy. Prices are very high for the quality of food. Guess you have to pay for their high premise rentals. Not my favourite vegan restaurant. Much better ones around Penang.Show less

Author: Pontus S
Title: Amazing
Review: I doubt there is any beter place to go in Penang if you are looking for vegan food. Amazing flavours with some of the best mock meat i have ever tried. Nice interior with air condition 👌

Author: Tan B
Title: Delicious vegan food with nice ambience
Review: I'm never a big fan of vegan food but when I chanced upon Pinyin, I really enjoyed the food there. They offer very creative and tasty meals. And friendly people runs the restaurant too! Also an awesome place to meet friends or to just hang out.Show less

Author: cimeronm
Title: Delicious food, beautiful restaurant
Review: Wow, just tried PinXin and it was delicious! And the decor is beautiful, comfortable and (thankfully) air conditioned. Stand out dishes are the green Thai tomyum noodles, the salad with kale, avocado, walnuts and dried cranberries (by far the best salad in all of Penang), the satay with peanut sauce, and veggie burger with sweet potato fries. Also, their signature tea (kafir lime leaf, pandan, lemongrass and pea flower) is super refreshing and if you get it cold, it has an adorable ice cube with mint, lemon and pea flower frozen within it. I love this place!Show less

Author: 186yvonnel
Title: Best Vegan cuisine
Review:
A restaurant where u will find healthy and tasty meets. It surprised me when their vegan laksa tasted even better than the usual laksa with a 5 stars environment. 
Not forgetting the vegan cake, another must try. Definitely will come back again...

Author: SandraL7428
Title: Best vegan restaurant in town!
Review: Pinxin Vegan Cuisine has got nice ambience, friendly staff and great good. They've got a wide variety of food ranging from Asian to Western. The price point is also very reasonable for food portion. Besides, it suits the taste buds of a non vegan as well. Absolutely recommended! :))Show less

Author: DwayneN50
Title: Nice Food
Review: The food is so nice. Should come and try it out, suitable for family, couples and friends. Especially the green tomyam! It's so goooddddddd!!

Author: lauchun2288
Title: Fine food, nice decor, great taste
Review: Came here for a tea but end up staying for a long time because they have so many things to offer.  From the wild orange and peppermint infused dark cocoa drink, nice vegan food until the best cake you can find in town.

Author: JATNEH
Title: Really really good
Review: Me and my boyfriend visited Pinxin for dinner last night. I can say they serve the best vegan cuisine in town. We had their signature nasi lemak, real salad and laksa. We also ordered their really special blue butterfly pea tea and dark cocoa wild orange. PS: their salad is really really fresh and good. So much love, we really love this place, love the environment and the food also their friendly staffs. Definitely will go back again! Show less

Author: gospidinmilojko
Title: Good food
Review: Liked the food and service. Nice location and interesting styled but don't understand the leather look chairs and couches in combination with vegan restaurant. They say it PU but still, it doesn't go together..

Author: SmillaRydeRyde
Title: Heavenly good - must if you're looking for vegan food in Penang
Review: Pinxin Vegan Delight is just as a delightful place as the name suggests which I just happened to walk past and the exterior made me stop for a second and then I spotted "vegan" so I had to give it a try. The place is very modern (air con) and fresh looking, a touch of Scandinavia with about 8 tables. All dishes they serve are vegan. I had two starters and a main and paid just over RM20 - a real bargain. The mushroom satay stood out as my favorite. The staff were incredibly friendly and the food in my opinion not only tasty but a nice and different take on how delicious vegan food can be. They are closed on Tuesdays.Show less

Author: Elly WLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Do the food was ok - not great
Review: Do the food was ok - not great but decent. However the set menu concept and the idea of customer service are a big fail (brought one course on top of the next and turned off the restaurant music to use the plug to charge and text on his phone) - so! If you want atmosphere, try somewhere else, if you want half decent food and that’s it - it’s not to worst!) Show less

Author: Deb KBrisbane, Australia
Title: Tucked away in Nagore Plaza..
Review: is a tiny restaurant called "What the Duck" - We read a couple of reviews before heading in, and it was a pleasant surprise. We enjoyed the salads as an entree; the duck maigret was perfect, and the Bek Bek chicken fine. Wines weren't too badly priced either. Service was slick, but there were only 3 tables in.Show less

Author: Anne WLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Big wow to WTD
Review: This small restaurant tucked away on the outskirts of Georgetown serves as its name suggests duck! But what duck indeed. We started with a salad and then shared the ‘Duck Lover platter trio, which consisted of the smoothest duck chowder we have ever tasted, lovely smoked duck on toast and exquisite Thai style duck roll. Main course was Balinese Crispy duck service with rice (spicy but wonderfully seasoned) and WTD Spicy Dirty Duck rice, a combination of pulled duck serviced on rice with a fried egg on top and pickled veg. Highly recommended and all washed down with an ice cold beerShow less

Author: Adrian_on_TAPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: All about duck and more at What The Duck Restaurant
Review: What The Duck Restaurant specialises in both Western and Asian-styles duck dishes among others. Claiming to be "the best duck specialist in town", my family and I had to sample its creations to see if this held water. The contemporary setting of a conducive casual dining was welcoming. The restaurant has two outlets in Penang, one in Setia Spice Canopy and the other in the heart of George Town at 40, Nagore Road.I was excited when I saw something different listed on the menu, something I had yet to sample. There were seven options to choose from under the What The Duck speciality drink menu. After much deliberation, I opted for the Salted Egg Affagato which consisted of a single shot of espresso and a scoop of homemade salted egg ice cream served in a cocktail glass. I loved the combination of flavours in this drink. However, I would have preferred if the salted egg had been blended smoothly into the ice cream to avoid specks of salted egg yolk floating in the coffee. My daughter ordered the Apple Ducky – a fresh apple juice with sprite topped with a scoop of vanilla ice cream. She enjoyed this refreshing drink very much.We began our dinner with a lovely smoked duck salad. Strips of smoked duck were served with fresh green apple chunks, garden greens and raisins, tossed in a tangy walnut dressing. The WTD homemade mushroom soup was rich and hearty. I was fond of the strong flavours of mushrooms and the rough texture of the soup.For the main courses, my daughter had the WTD duck confit served with kumara mash potatoes and roasted garlic. The crispy duck skin encased the tender meat within. She relished this dish immensely and was keen to return in the near future to sample more. My wife had the oven stewed duck with barley and red wine served with mashed potatoes, broccoli, cauliflower and gravy. The meat was very tender and fell off the bone easily. I opted for the Balinese crispy duck (bek-bek), a popular dish in Indonesian. An entire duck drumstick was served with steamed white rice and some pickled vegetables. I really enjoyed the crispy and crunchy skin and the amazingly tender meat. I appreciated that the sauce was served on the side and I had the privilege to determining to amount I needed. This dish would also go well with some fresh ulam (fresh herbs and vegetables) and a fiery sambal. We selected all our main courses with duck as the main ingredient and were contented with our meals. To conclude the dinner we shared a serving of sizzling brownies topped with a scoop of salted egg ice cream. It was served with caramelised bananas. Here, I enjoyed the texture of the salted egg in the ice cream. The winning ensemble of warm chocolate brownies, banana and salted egg ice cream was brilliant. The staff were friendly and service was good. We would definitely return to indulge more in the creative offerings of this restaurant.Show less

Author: Verry S
Title: 2 visits- 2 wows !
Review: Great food, lovely atmosphere, efficient, competent & friendly staff. The food on both nights we went was wonderful. Completely different dishes each time, with different approaches. All fresh, all presented with panache & tasted fabulous.

Author: 32aviramm
Title: Great Food
Review: We Cured Salmon Crispy Duck Bacon Salad,  Quack Chowder and Drunken Duck Clear Soup with Wolf Berries. The food was great ! Service Ok+. The place is very close to Urban Artisans Cafe.

Author: bebe93942017
Title: Impressive Duck Restaurant
Review: The restaurant is in a traditional house. Love the decoration especially of the duck wall pattern. The food is great and the price is really good. Such a great bargain for lunch for only RM30.60  with no service charge.

Author: 382sherisHonolulu, Hawaii, United States
Title: Yummy!
Review: This restaurant is in one of the most charming parts of Georgetown. We had the set dinner menu. Choice of two salads, soup of the day, choice of several main courses, dessert and soft drink. Every course was beautifully presented and delicious. There are a lot of choices on the menu, we will have to come back for more!Show less

Author: Andy OSydney, Australia
Title: Very average
Review: We ordered a Balinese duck meal and a duck with yam type dish. Both were very very average. Presentation was sparse on the plate and the duck, which is meant to be the hero of the dish, was tough and non tender or juicy. Quite disappointed after what appeared to be high ratings on tripadvisor. I would give it a miss.Show less

Author: RyanE1996Australia
Title: Good food and so cheap
Review: We visited after seeing the place rated so highly on TripAdvisor, the food was exceptional and was so cheap we got 3 mains and a desert and it cost us 80rmThe pek pek pasta was my personal favourite and the brownie for desert topped the meal off!Would recommend if you’re in the area and want a break from plastic chairs and outdoor eating Show less

Author: BitterballenbruidThe Netherlands
Title: Ok, but wouldn’t go back...
Review: Wine RM 19, beer RM 12. “Dirty Duck Rice” RM 14 ish... ok but not spicy as they say it is. Chicken Curry RM 16... but why chicken when it’s a duck restaurant? We really fancied curry so went for it anyway. Also not spicy when they say it is. Should offer a choice of duck or chicken if you’re really a duck restaurant. Staff were nice but we were underwhelmed with the whole experience. Show less

Author: ScottJTaipeiTaipei, Taiwan
Title: Not quite what we were expecting!
Review: We decided to try the set dinner, which was reasonably priced and had sufficient variety, and would give us a cross-section of what the restaurant had to offer. We also added 2 glasses of red wine, at RM15 a piece, which was cheap and cheerful, but of questionable quality.The salads, one was Siamese, the other had smoked duck, were very enjoyable and a pleasant starter. The carrot soup, with a large crouton, was also pleasant enough.The disappointment came with the mains. The steak was tough, tasteless, and the sauce was bland. The confit of duck was also disappointing, and had been over-cooked by deep frying before it was served.Dessert was a scoop of chocolate ice cream with chocolate sauce and small pieces of sponge cake. It was tasty!It wasn’t clear how long the restaurant had been open with the current format; however, the washroom area, adjacent to the food preparation area I might add, was extremely dirty and was in need of a deep steam clean or hosing down with disinfectant. It also looked to me as if food was being left in the open for long periods which would explain the bland taste of the mains. The waitress was clueless about handling cutlery, touching the bowl of the spoon with her fingers.Food quality ***Hygiene **Show less

Author: RockNRollRobotNewcastle upon Tyne, United Kingdom
Title: Ducking Nice Place to Eat
Review: There was a private function when we visited. So we were seated outside which was great service to accommodate us but a limited menu due to the amount of people ordering inside. However, there was still a large and varied choice of duck dishes and what we had received was very nice. Also great and attentive service.Show less

Author: annando36Warrington, United Kingdom
Title: Hidden Gem
Review: We would never have found this fabulous little restaurant had we not had the Lonely Planet Guide Book. What a great find! There were five of us and most of us had the duck and it was amazing! My youngest daughter wasn't a fan of duck but there was plenty on the menu to satisfy her as well. The desserts were not to be missed either. This restaurant was as good as any high end place and at a fraction of the priceShow less

Author: tome395Chinderah, Australia
Title: What the Duck Restaurant
Review: My wife and I decided after reading about this restaurant to go there for dinner one night during our visit to Penang. Very glad we did, upon arrival we were greeted by a very friendly waiter who seated us immediately and explained the menu to us. To start with we shared a walnut and duck salad which was large enough for both of us to share and was delicious. As a main course my wife ordered the Confit of Duck which she loved and she does love her duck. I ordered a dish of pulled duck and salad which I also enjoyed.The service and food at this small out of the way restaurant is excellent and we would recommend to anyone going to Penang in the future to search this greatly named restaurant out. As an added tick for service the young gentleman there arranged for a taxi to take us back to our hotel and he spoke to the driver to ensure he understood where we were staying, thanks guys.Show less

Author: 6784_dog
Title: Duck, duck and also some other food
Review: Yes, it's all about the duck and it was delicious. The Bek Bek duck was lovely - it was too hot either (even with the 2x chilli on the menu), the honey sesame glazed duck and also the Dallas hickory bbq duck were all yum. Definately worth the visit - I never knew you could have a successful duck theme menu! Show less

Author: Quest42n8George Town, Malaysia
Title: A wonderful and reasonable meal
Review: Three of us went for first time. Simply wonderful. Small but smart place with good service and very reasonable prices. The menu you is small but filled with gems.I had the 4 course ‘Set’ Menu. The price is set off the entree you select. I started with the Smoked Duck Apple Walnut Salad. Marvelous and large enough for my girlfriend and I to share with some remaining. The Salad was very well put together and pleasing to our eye. Then I had the pumpkin soup which was delicious. Again large enough for 2. My girlfriends 18 year old daughter tried it and would not give it back!Then the main, I ordered the Duck confit served with Kumara mash, Ratatouille, greens and a nice Longan Sauce. The presentation was elegant and photo worthy. For dessert they served ice cream with cubes of chocolate cake with strawberries and sauces. Oh it also came with a drink! I had the iced peach tea! Everything was delicious. The price for the set .... About 43 Malaysian Ringett or $10 US. Amazing.My girlfriend had the Duck Stew and daughter had a very eye catching wrap with salad. Both delicious and each cost about 20 Ringett or $5.Then my girlfriend ordered coffee. It was so well made, she didn’t want to put her usual milk and dilute the flavor!The area is nice with some bars, etc close by.Highly recommend and we will come back soon! Dinner for 3 adults total 102 MR or $25.Thank you for a enjoyable evening meal.Show less

Author: carolynandpeter2016Perth, Australia
Title: Brilliant food and service
Review: The only thing I regret about finding this restaurant, was that we found it too late in our time in Penang. It was our favourite restaurant on the island. The food was superb on both our visits, though most memorably the duck was moist and the skin was crispy. The waiters were welcoming and helpful. And the cost was more than reasonable.Show less

Author: MarjonBainbridgeAmsterdam, The Netherlands
Title: Great dinner
Review: We stumbled on this place based on the name at first and were pleasantly surprised at the quality of the food and the service. The waiter was very knowledgable about the food servec and the combination of the tastes was superb. Worth a visit for sure!! Show less

Author: adandang
Title: What a find!
Review: We went here for dinner after reading reviews on trip advisor and were not disappointed. The crispy duck was excellent and the sizzling brownies we had for dessert were amazing!

Author: Deborah G
Title: Just what we were seeking
Review: We were in Penang a few weeks ago.  We were hoping to have a Malaysian Duck dinner.  We went to the right place.  The meal was wonderful, the duck was perfect

Author: YeanMASHong Kong, China
Title: What a duck value!
Review: I am not sure why do people giving this restaurant negative review.I am not sure why there are complaints.I am not sure why there are so many idiotic person who dont understand the words "value". Well, value of quality and money supposedly place into consideration when giving review.This restaurant is awesome, no complaint at all. Great quality, great value and great in consistency. Just awesome.Show less

Author: June_Hall
Title: Holiday
Review: After 12months my daughter and I returned and it was just as good and friendly. We had the duck again it simply melts in your mouth.We also had sizzling chocolate cake with ice cream and it was delicious it really did melt in your mouth.

Author: Z6575NKjohnwHampshire, United Kingdom
Title: Well over-rated
Review: This place is just ok. My wife and I went tonight. The atmosphere is lovely and service good. We had a supposedly Thai veg salad which we shared. It was on a very big plate but the salad was microscopic, consisting of a couple of shredded lettuce leaves, a few small bits of rocket and a dressing which was pleasant enough but not remotely Thai. Following this we had the "crispy" Balinese duck, which tasted good though not crispy, and the Dirty Duck rice, which had a tiny amount of duck and, strangely, a fried egg on top. Barely a vegetable in sight on either. Both red and white house wines are very good and reasonably priced. Not expensive, though quite enough for what is delivered. Don't understand the hype given to this restaurant. 3 stars is generous. Would not go back. Show less

Author: Tom081254Oss, The Netherlands
Title: Yammie!!
Review: Conveniently close to our hotel this little pearl! What a surprise this is... we had a 4 course menu with choice of 5 or 6 main courses and it was simply delicious! Best food we had in our 10 day Malaysia trip, Western food by the way... Whenever in Georgetown be sure to check this place out..... and it is a bargain too! one small flaw though.. when bringing the wine 1/4 of the glass was spoiled by the waitress when bumping the glass to the table and this was not refilled up to a full glass... otherwise it would certainly be a 5 star scoreShow less

Author: Derrick1230Hong Kong, China
Title: Awesome duck!
Review: I had the 4 course duck dinner. I started with the smoked duck walnut salad. It was excellent! The creamed carrot soup was next and it was very good as well!And of course for the main course I had the duck confit. It was superb.Desert was mint ice cream. All this for $11 usd???? What a bargain!!!I would highly recommend this restaurant and I would return in a heartbeat!!! Yum yum!!!Show less

Author: cpertuti
Title: If you love duck
Review: Cute little restaurant in Nagore St. The duck salad and chili duck pasta were heavenly with generous portions of duck meat. Prices are reasonable.

Author: Sue DNew York City, New York
Title: Best meal in Penang. Not just for Duck Lovers
Review: Wow. Every dish was perfection. One of us did the 4 course set dinner and the other ordered a la carte. We started with 2 salads. The duck confit salad had a lot of duck and walnut. Some oranges. Very filling. A little too much dressing, next time I would ask for the dressing on the side. The duck apple walnut salad was a good combination of savory and sweetness—very refreshing. The next course—potato/vegetable soup was to die for. Creamy with a very subtle combo of spices. For main course I had the Balinese spicy crispy duck. Don’t be put off by the spicy notice on the menu. They will put the sauce on the side and it wasn’t insanely spicy. The duck was perfectly cooked. Crispy on the outside and moist on the inside. Nicely seasoned. My companion had the pasta with Balinese duck and loved it. The desert of the day that came with the set dinner was a few little chocolate cakes with mint ice cream and was a wonderful end to the meal. We highly recommend What to Duck. Portions are a nice size. It is pricey compared to street food but well worth it. Bill came to 72RM (about $18USD) for 2 people (the set dinner was 35RM for 4 courses and a nonalcoholic drink). We did not have alcohol. The service is good and the restaurant is very pleasant. Show less

Author: marisammutPhuket, Thailand
Title: Delicious Duck Dishes
Review: Very cute restaurant with extremely nice staff. It wasn’t at all crowded and had a very relaxed atmosphere. Wide selection of very reasonably priced dishes, duck being the most popular. Beer and wine by the glass also available. We had a fantastic evening and will certainly go again!Show less

Author: mikejuni
Title: Excellent dinner
Review: We had an excellent dinner in the restaurant. Very good hospitality especially considering that we have a family of 7 and 2 kids. All requests are properly fulfilled. Wonderful food here.

Author: Nalina N
Title: Fabulous!
Review: Love love love the food here. Just writing this review is making my mouth water. Had to wait for 30 mins to get a table but it was so worth it. My husband was a duck lover and i was not but this place converted me. Never knew duck could be so yummylicious. The duck egg caramel ice cream was creamy and salty and sweet. Wonderful combination. Dishes were beautifully presented. All in all it was a great night. I recommend everyone to come here regardless of wether you eat duck or not coz u wil b a duck convert after this..Show less

Author: 788graemegPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Best for months
Review: My wife and I went to the restaurant on Thursday 13th September. My wife had salad, a duck dish and we shared at salted caramel ice cream for desert. I had carrot soup, Lemon Honey Chicken with mashed potato. My wife gave a 9/10 and I gave a 10/10.We dine out each Thursday and this was the best for months and the price is very reasonable and good service.Show less

Author: Mike_DennehyTauranga, New Zealand
Title: First class dining on a mid-range budget - recommended
Review: We fancied a nice sit-down meal on our last evening in George Town, rather than our usual street-food grazing. We chose WTD despite some mixed reviews, the main concerns seemed to be around service.Our service was excellent, as was everything we ate and drank. Entrees were the trio platter (a duck wrap, some chowder and some smoked duck on a little toast thing), and the duck salad with apple and walnut. Both were excellent, delicious and tasty.Mains were the confit duck with kumara mash, and the spicy coconut duck curry. Again, both were perfectly cooked and very tasty. The rate of service was perfect too, just enough time between courses to relax and think about the next one. After a few minutes we were given the dessert menus and surprisingly we both had a dessert - the sizzling brownies with home-made icecream, which was pure theatre as well as being delicious, and the two scoops of home-made ice-cream with salted egg yolk for me. To be honest the dessert portions were almost too big, not a complaint usually made.We also had a very nice bottle of Australian chardonnay, which could have been improved only by being a New Zealand chardonnay, and were very pleased with the whole experience. The bill was very reasonable considering the quality and quantity of the food, and the quite high prices of wine in Malaysia.Definitely recommend this one, do try it and I'm sure you'll enjoy it. We did.Show less

Author: Ambassador580404
Title: Addictive!
Review: Been back 4 times now and absolutely enjoyed it every time! Prices are so reasonable and presentation of food is almost fine dining! I've only had the duck dishes and they were all really good.

Author: rubeneskKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Not recommended
Review: Let’s start with the meal. The food was so and so. Tastes dry and quite frankly seems to be just microwaved. What was worse what the way the staffs managed us. Had to wait and call a few times just to get the menu. The food was just dropped/slide off to the table without so much as a smile. Lastly they have poor English command. I asked for cutleries and they don’t comprehend. Ask for a fork, they still don’t understand. Had to say ‘sudu dan garpu’ to get what I want. Show less

Author: JoyceleejiayiMalaysia
Title: Superb meal in Georgetown
Review: We visited here because of seeing so many good reviews on Tripadvisor. It was really good and the price is not expensive(this makes me surprised and happy). Because the price still cheaper than some trendy cafe. The food portion is okay, enough for my boyfriend and I. (PS: I really loved their potato chips!!!So good)Show less

Author: ahxiong123Penang, Malaysia
Title: Excellent gem of a Western Cuisine
Review: It was an unplanned visit for my family, but the place looks inviting and cosy, and busy on a Saturday night. We managed to get a table without having to wait. We ordered three set dinner, comprising of the steak, lamb shank and grilled sea bass. Service was courteous and attentive. The food arrived reasonably quick. The salad was very good and fresh. This was followed by the soup, which was delicious. The main course was excellent. The lamb shank was tender and full of flavour. Lastly the dessert was also very good, not too sweet or rich. Overall the place is highly recommended and we will definitely visit again. Show less

Author: Tobit B
Title: Thé place to go in Georgetown!
Review: Sooo delicious! The only thing I regret is not ordering a starter. The two dishes with duck were amazing, dessert was show coocking, presenting it at the table. Overall really great food at low price. A true must when in Georgetown!

Author: FLBBPCMM
Title: Superb meal
Review: I ordered duck confit set comes with salad, soup, drink and dessert.  From appetizers to duck confit everything is so delicious.  Ordered lamb shank and the meat is so soft to eat. Services is good too.  They closed on Wednesday.

Author: 610jayg
Title: Wow
Review: We had our first meal in Penang here, gonna be hard to beat.I hope you get the same quality as we received. The duck and the seabass, wow, next level. $5 usd each wow again. Great value. Nice little spot in the old character area of George Town. Highly recommended. Can’t believe it’s ranked like 18th in Penang. Excited to try the 17 above it! Show less

Author: jacqqqNCL / KUL
Title: Good Value
Review: For about RM 20 or so per plate, you won’t break your bank to have a meal here.We were hankering for a proper duck confit and this place fitted the bill. Located along the refurbished shops/houses in Jalan Nagore, WTD is very easy to find.We ordered a duck confit and a honey sesame duck dish each. Former tasted slightly better than the other. But still not as good as our favourite duck confit place in Cafe de l’Academia in BCN.Anyway, it made for a nice change from our prolonged sessions of street food.Show less

Author: HarrisW47
Title: Amazing duck 🦆 cuisine
Review:
Amazing place though, not to big but definitely stands out, funny name for a restaurant and the taste is so amazing as well...

You can either sit inside or enjoy the breeze outside

Author: MatthewI284
Title: Excellent experience
Review: Absolutely amazing food, very friendly staff and quick service. Went for the chefs reccomendations and couldn’t fault anything with the food. If you are having red wine then you could ask them to take out of cooler when you arrive. Apart from that everything was delicious. Very resonantly priced for high quality food. Menu is predominantly duck based as you would imagine but there are other options available. Would highly recommend going here If you are staying in Georgetown.Show less

Author: PaulbearukDubai, United Arab Emirates
Title: What the *uck - it’s brilliant
Review: When you’re in a crowded market you need to stand out. The name is a great attractor, but the food has to also stand out. On my visit the food was the star. I had the duck salad and then spice duck and rice. Very very very tasty - Asian French fusion. But the highlight the sizzling brownie. FANTASTIC undersells it. Don’t be put off by the plastic tables and chairs - the food is well worth the visit. Show less

Author: yeetng
Title: Great Ambience and Food
Review: Duck has never taste so good.  We have dinner one day and when back for second the next day for lunch.  Highly recommended.  Price fairly for quality food.

Author: JudyL2046
Title: Lovely dinner
Review: Red wine lamb shank, WTD confit duck are so yummy..love those so so much. With reasonable price. Foods' quality are higher than price

Author: zoeb813London, United Kingdom
Title: Tasty food, a little overdone
Review: My boyfriend and I both tried the honey glazed duck. Whilst the portion was rather small, on the whole it was very tasty. The duck was a little over done and dry in places, but still good nonetheless. Also gutted we didn’t have time to try the salted caramel brownie as they looked amazing. Would recommend if you’re in the area! Show less

Author: geomanhor
Title: Delicious duck
Review: Their honey soy duck was so good.....l came back the next night for another serve.....the service was excellent and their deserts were delicious

Author: christophery2015
Title: Just average
Review: Cozy restaurant. Quite a variety of selection. Pleasant food presentation. Taste is good. Need to improve on the drinks.

Author: DebraH4879Cairns, Australia
Title: Wonderful first taste of food in penang
Review: This was our first meal in penang and it was so good we went back the 2nd night too. The food prices were quite cheap for the quality provided. The portion sizes would probably be considered on the small side by many but for me were spot on, i could eat the entire meal and be full up without leaving lovely food to go to waste. 2 ppl 3 courses $30aud (shared desert). Drinks are additionalShow less

Author: mcchrisgan
Title: Great dinner at WTD
Review: Thanks to Chef Daniel and team at What The Duck restaurant for a wonderful dinner for me and my guest from Singapore on 3rd Nov. Delicious Confit Duck and Spicy Bek Bek Pasta, topped off the amazing Sizzling Brownie for dessert!

Author: Iveta88BBrno, Czech Republic
Title: Best duck
Review: This was one of the best meals we have in Malaysia! 2 years before I was there and tried duck soup which was with whole duck leg, delicious. This time We tried duck legs and we were talking about it 2 days after because it was soooo good! I can recommend!!Show less

Author: KeithY267Batu Ferringhi, Malaysia
Title: Quiet weekends lunch
Review: Found this place via friend’s recommendation. An old heritage double story building restaurant in the middle of Nagore Road .It’s a great place for quiet weekend brunch. Very clean and quiet with good soft music .I ordered western set lunch with shredded confit ducky salad with orange , walnut and greens . Fresh green ! Main course is WTD duck confit served with potato and longan source .Duck is well prepared with soft , tender yet crispy skin . Side potato is pretty good with or without the source .With freshly brewed coffee !Taste : 8/10 .Price is MR$24 is a steal .Will be back !!!!Show less

Author: PaimanPai
Title: Excellent Dinner!!!
Review: I amsually wary about duck in restaurants I'm not familiar with. Many times it is cooked until dry and chewy, or under cooked and lacking flavor. What a pleasant surprise to have dined on duck the way it should be prepared. My dinner partner and I shared a confit duck salad with walnuts and oranges in a light dressing. Each element was fresh and flavorful. The confit was tender and not one bit oily. My partner ordered Creamy Smoked Duck Pasta. The pasta was al dente and the sauce was creamy, smooth with just a hint of smoke provided by the duck. I was fully satisfied with my Duck Magret, Described as served medium well done, it was closer to medium and had the perfect juicy interior texture and flavor, with a crisp exterior. The red wine sauce on the side was not overpowering and paired perfectly with the duck. The risolle potatoes were crisp on the outside, tender on the inside and a perfect accompaniment to the entire dish. Kudos to the chef. Considering the quality of the entire meal and the adequate portions, I would consider the price charged for the meal, a steal.Show less

Author: davegrasTokyo, Japan
Title: Great Service and Food
Review: I went in early October and had the duck confit along with the duck chowder soup. The duck was tender and delicious while the soup was so satisfying. The presentation of the food was quite nice, a touch elegant, and I sat at a nice table. The service was wonderful; attentive and patient. Overall a very friendly atmosphere along with great food at a great price. :-)Show less

Author: Audee C
Title: Great food
Review: Great food as always. Worth the price. Try the dessert. Salted egg ice cream. Look for the owner, he will entertain you with great dessert

Author: tomkate
Title: Excellent restaurant in a gorgeous neighbourhood
Review: Highly recommend this place especially if you like duck.  Had dinner here and teenagers enjoyed it too.  Wish it hadn't been raining that night as I would have liked to have walked around and explored this neighourhood a bit more.  Very pretty area.

Author: KristenN14
Title: What the duck for sure...
Review: From a non-duck eater to a converted duck fan, this resturant has amazingly friendly service to beautifully presented and delicious tasting food... loved it

Author: Feds294201
Title: No ambiance
Review: We didn't enjoy the poor ambiance or the meat-heavy meals here. Some of the dishes looked gruesome and my chicken was thigh rather than breast.

Author: ChristineMML
Title: Amazing food
Review: My friend and I both ordered the set lunch. Was very surprised how amazing the food were. We ordered the duck confit as well as the pasta with duck. We would definitely recommend this restaurant!

Author: LovelySR
Title: Duck. Everything duck.....
Review: Quite special meal. Ordered the duck confit lunch deal and smoked duck aglio olio. Both tasted yummy. Didn't really like the mashed potato though. Service was average and price were quite high for the portion.

Author: PER J
Title: Nice lunches
Review: Great little place often with novel dishes served by kind staff making for a nice atmosphere. Because of the reputation you might want to call in advance .

Author: meowleng92
Title: Good Taste
Review:
Must try the duck and the desserts.
The portion is small. Ordered few dishes and sharing among friends.

Author: ianmcc64
Title: What the Duck!
Review: Went on spec as couldn't get in elsewhere, so glad we did. food was fantastic(if you like duck!) and very reasonably priced. The only drawback andits Malaysia generally is that wine is expensive to wash down this delicious food. Enjoy

Author: sammi934George Town, Malaysia
Title: huge disappointment
Review: was attracted by the unique of its name. went in for lunch during peak hours...only to find out surprisingly we were the only three guests . food presentation and taste was overall way below expectation .. nice authentic peranakan building .. great strategic location BUT , what can i say, pls dont go :SShow less

Author: zedelfor
Title: Great food
Review: Duck lovers paradise. Very tasty meals, good serving sizes and reasonable pricing. Restaurant is on the small size so would pay to book.

Author: arienda
Title: Surprisingly delicious
Review:
Check for they operational hours before walk in.

The food was delicious and big portion.
The price is average and i guess it fit the food quality.

Friendly staffs

Author: Victor KPenang, Malaysia
Title: Lovely Cafe with Good Food
Review: What The Duck is located at Nagore Square in Nagore Road, between Hutton Lane and Burmah Road. It is an alternative precinct for food and beverage choices all within a short walking distance - Jalan Bawash, Jalan Nagore and Jalan Hutton. "Jalan" is a Malay word for "Road".If you have enough feasting on Penang's famous street food and looking for an alternative place to eat. Look no further. "What The Duck" is the place. ​My partner and I tried to come here on our last visit to Penang in March 2017. We wanted some place special on our last night stay in Penang. We asked Google and TripAdvisor. After a lengthy search, we decided on What The Duck. We caught an Uber to Nagore Square. On arrival, we looked for the restaurant which wasn't hard to find. It is in a row of beautifully restored terrace houses. It was closed. Our mistake. Next time we should check the opening hours before heading to a restaurant. A slight disappointment. But Penang city is small and easy to walk. We walked along Hutton Road towards Campbell Street and found another restaurant, called GOMO, a fusion Japanese. I have reviewed this restaurant as well on another post.Coming back to What The Duck. As a very determine person when it comes to food, I have decided to book What The Duck on this recent trip in June. Remembering that it is closed on a Wednesday, I booked a Tuesday night to dine with my cousin and his wife. I called the restaurant and booked a table for 3 of us. It was a straight forward process. Friendly and courteous over the phone, like most restaurant when taking a booking. The booking was for 8 PM. ​I arrived at Nagore Square half an hour earlier to check out the precinct as it was getting dark. Lovely with all the lights projecting on the character terraces. However, I am not sure about some of the brightly lit signage on the shophouses. They ruin the beautiful facade of the buildings. I don't believe there is any council regulation on what could be placed as a signage on the facade of a building here. You can see them everywhere dotted around the city even in the UNESCO heritage zoned precinct.On a Tuesday night, What The Duck was doing very well and all tables were taken inside the restaurant. This was a good sign. My cousin and I ordered their set dinner menu that came with a choice of salad entree, a soup of the day, a choice of main and a choice of dessert and drink. The price varies depending on the main course. My cousin's wife opted for a Duck Confit main and a Honey Lemon cold drink.​ We didn't have to wait long before our first course arrived - walnut salad. Fresh and delicious. Next was a creamy soup with a slice of toast on top. Warm and hearty. Not too creamy and rich. Just right. Main I had Duck Confit and my cousin chose the Bek Bek Pasta. I believed the Duck Confit is one of their signature dish. The skin was nice and crispy. The meat was tender and not too dry. My cousin either being polite or being geniune to me said his pasta was delicioius but very spicy. He was perspiring. He asked that he didn't want his pasta spicy. So if that was meant to be mild, I wonder what spicy would be like. I should have tasted it so I know. The dessert of 2 small slices of mud cake and chocolate mousse were just nice and right for the size. Otherwise, I would not be able to finish them.We all agreed that we enjoyed our meal and that each of the dishes was well presented and well executed by the chef. The service was attentive and not too intrusive. The total price came to $108.70 Ringgits, an equivalent of $33.50 AUD. That was an awesome treat for a nice dinner out in a cute little restaurant.​Highly recommended for those that have enough of Penang street food and have that extra cash to splash for a good meal in a cosy ambiance.Show less

Author: 1414jime
Title: Nothing flash but.....
Review: Small ,low key, quite plain but in the middle of Georgetown so already has atmosphere  you don't go there for the decor it's all about the food and it's is superb, the duck sensational and the cost very fair all in all a joyful experience

Author: Kim K
Title: Interesting take on Duck
Review: I went there to celebrate with my friends a few days ago. The waitress was very helpful when asked what items on the menu were "outstanding".I shared a Trio and a Confit with another person. Both were tasty. And the drinks were unusual and nice too. I especially liked their "Crazy Duck".I will definitely go back again.Show less

Author: Ashley WDarwin, Australia
Title: 6th visit in 2 years. This place rocks
Review: Now our favourite place to eat in Georgetown. Without exception. Daniel Tan and his team do a great job in this place. Duck is King in this place and I happen to love duck. Last week tried the Balinese duck and famed confit. This week the traditional Orange. I think I have had duck every way possible.Daniels training shines through and is testament to a solid understanding and love of poultry.Dont leave Penang withouth a try. Closed Weds much to our horror.Show less

Author: Mark LManchester UK
Title: OK and not that pricey with lots of duck dishes
Review: The food here is reasonable but nothing exciting or authentic, as is usually the case in these multi-cuisine places. I had Chinese duck and yam, which was rather bland but quite generous, not that expensive but not cheap either. Disappointments were the tiny portion of rice and the promised ‘side-dish’ again a tiny amount of cold plain steamed vegetables, mostly carrot, not well-matched with a Chinese dish.Service was quick and efficient and I was impressed that they provided free drinking water rather than making me buy it off the over-priced drinks menu.This place isn’t bad and for duck-lovers it has an extensive choice of dishes. But in this area of Penang with so many good cheap alternatives, I wouldn’t go back.Show less

Author: Peachmelba4meNYC
Title: Most delicious duck dishes ever!
Review: I took my 6 friends to have a duck dinner experience at "What the duck". All of them were very impressed at the food that were dished out. All the food was well presented beside delicious. I love the roasted sesame duck and my warm salad. The deserts were equally good and delicious. Ever tried creme brulee with salted egg yoke? The duck salt egg yoke make the flavor very intense so is the Salted egg Yoke ice cream it is to die for. Found out the master chef and owner Mr. Daniel Tan worked 15 years for some 5 stars Hotel. So come and get 5 stars food for cafe food prices!This place will definitely be on my top list of restaurant if I want to impressed friends. Show less

Author: Eddie SSingapore, Singapore
Title: Worth The "Authentic French" Title For Duck Confit Meal
Review: Not easy to find in Penang, but we found it = real great Duck Confit Meal.Table Presentation, Meal Presentation, Dessert, Ambience (including the street outside, Jalan Nagor) were great, even though it was a Monday (normally quiet).Met Daniel (Chef) & his lovely wife, Eileen & his kitchen & customer service team, experience real (user-) friendly, top service. Must-go place if you are in Penang.Show less

Author: bluemant2015Gelugor, Malaysia
Title: Disappointed!!!!
Review: We are in a group of ppl.. 6 adults and children.. we are been told they are not prepare to serve us! And rejected us to seat in even we are prepare to wait! Funny thing is they still accept small group of ppl to dine in when I leaving...Show less

Author: NickL163
Title: Great meal
Review: This is a must restaurant to visit when in Penang. The food was amazing excellent value and professionally presented. As with most of the restaurants in Penang the red wine could be better but this is the only negative.

Author: George AEnfield, United Kingdom
Title: Duck is the Main and Dessert
Review: Went there as a group of four, the first time we went it was fully booked and we had to return another night. Food was excellent so long as you like duck based meals.Excellent service and the chef came out and talked through what was on the menu so you knew exactly what to expect.Show less

Author: David S
Title: Great food with an affordable price
Review: I took my wife to WTD for our 32nd wedding anniversary and it didn't disappoint. The food was delicious, the staff/service brilliant and the price very affordable. I would've expected to may much more for this type of fare.

Author: spark41Copenhagen, Denmark
Title: Still as good as ever
Review: The warm rillettes, the confit on kumara mash and my plate of 3 duck preparations - duck chowder, duck roll & slices of smoked duck on toast, all were excellent. You can BYO at RM 30 corkage charge but Daniel has some really interesting wines too. Prices here are still fantastic value for money. For a very rainy Thursday night business was quite brisk!Show less

Author: YanfungLee
Title: What The Duck Restaurant
Review: Duck Confit 🦆is recommended !! The sauce is special. Dessert of the day is Crème Brûlée with brownie and vanilla ice cream. Very nice environment 👍

Author: LoLerpops
Title: Crazy Delicious
Review: My girlfriend and I decided to go to this place for the first time.The Apple Walnut Salad, Honey Duck, Seasame Duck and Quack Soup, juice and the honey tea were all delicious. The total was about 75 RM. We've eaten at other places since and keep coming back to this one.The restaurant is cozy and the staff is attentive and friendly. Prices are really affordable and I wish this place would franchise.Show less

Author: GypsyMalayBBatu Ferringhi, Malaysia
Title: quality is always same high standards
Review: Besides duck there are plenty of other choicesPrice - value is excellent, the service is fantastic, one feels spoiled on a night out.Their soups are recommended as starters, had three different ones, on 4 different visits to this lil restaurant and they were all superbShow less

Author: wla90Brisbane, Australia
Title: Interesting Dessert
Review: After gorging on a large selection of steamboat foods, my friend and I decided to try out dessert at this restaurant.Even though we were full, we still managed to fit dessert in, and was it delicious. We went along with the waiter's suggestion of the Chocolate Brownie which is served with salted egg ice-cream and presented on a sizzling plate which the waiter also provides a pouring sauce for.Surprisingly, this brownie is decadent and doesn't have an overly sweet flavour, unlike other brownies that you find on ordinary dessert menus. The brownie is also complimented by the sauce to give it a creamy-like texture. It was worth every ringitt.Service was very good and surprising for Malaysian standards(no offence). The waiter actually confirmed our order before sending it to the kitchen. I guess there is a lot of competition in Georgetown. Keep it up guys.Show less

Author: bryanlim14Penang, Malaysia
Title: Personally the best restaurant in Penang
Review: As the title says, this has got to be one of the best (if not already the best) restaurant in Penang. Great service from the WTD folks, food was AMAZING with unbeatable value and a cozy atmosphere to eat in. I personally feel that this restaurant should be an example of how restaurants in Penang should be operating in terms of delivering quality in food & services. Pricing wise is not an issue for me because the food standards are pretty much up there with the best. I am so, so happy to have found this place and I'm definitely coming back here many, many more times in the future. Keep it up WTD folks, y'all are doing the right thing!!Show less

Author: 228reiu
Title: A restaurant that is absolutely worth to pay a visit.
Review: although it was a small restaurant, the internal atmosphere was excellent, the chefs were trying their best to serve the best meals behind the glass. The prices for the foods were reasonable.

Author: 301lenaj
Title: Very nice diner!
Review: Really nice diner with friends, great food (confit duck delicious!), smiling and nice staff in a beautiful street!

Author: Sandra APenang, Malaysia
Title: Reliably delicious!
Review: This restaurant is on my list of favourites in Penang, and I have been coming here since they opened two years ago. Chef Daniel Tan and his team do a wonderful job. The duck confit is wonderful! You can't go wrong with any of the choices on their menu, really. Try their duck yolk homemade ice cream on a hot brownie for dessert! It's a very charming ambiance with friendly service and delicious food. There are other choices other than duck on the menu. Enjoy!Show less

Author: chao99Miri, Malaysia
Title: Top notch restaurant
Review: One of the best duck-oriented restaurants I've ever been to. Lots of different duck dishes for customers to pick, service was quite nice, requests were immediately attended with good manners. The only downside is the restaurant is too small and does not have many seatings so it's hard for big groups of friends to enjoy in it. Still, definitely worth giving it a try if any of you is new to Penang. Show less

Author: WinterfloodBath, United Kingdom
Title: Fantastic Cafe
Review: If you go here expecting a restaurant you'll be disappointed however, if good food is what you're after you won't be. If this place was in the UK we'd have walked straight past, but based on the TA reviews we have it a try. We had a great, relaxed meal and would highly recommend for a casual, no frills, tasty meal... provided you like duck (as it features in almost every dish).We particularly then Hainanese Duck (sorry for spelling error), and both soups we had were great. We visited end of season and had no problem getting a table for two but by many accounts it's busy in the peaker times.V good value for money - wine a bit dodgy but good for a cold Tiger beer. Would definitely recommend.Show less

Author: Katrina R
Title: Delicious Duck!
Review: My husband took me to this restaurant for my birthday dinner, a restaurant I had wanted to go to for quite a while. Yes, I love Duck! We were not disappointed. The restaurant has a simple decor and seats about 20-25 people. We booked as we knew it can get quite busy and is popular. The menu is obviously full of duck with a few other meat and vegetable options, but it's the duck you go there for. The menu has lunch and dinner options and there is a lot to choose from. We both had starters, I had the duck broth soup which has a duck drumstick in it. Delicious! My husband had a duck chili starter and loved it! For the main we both had duck bek-bek. I think this could be the restaurants signature dish as it was so delicious. If you like a lot of spice you can ask for more chili. There is a small wine and beer list and the House red/white was very good.Service was discreet and excellent. Greeted at entry and very attentive through out the meal. Lovely people, yummy food and perfectly positioned for an easy walk to after dinner bars. We will definitely go again to try other dishes from the menu and next time take our son as it is very child friendly. If you like duck, then What the Duck is a must-visit restaurant in Penang.Show less

Author: 936stevewSingapore, Singapore
Title: Scrumptious dinner, old-meets-new feels!
Review: Stopped by with the family. Housed in a restored old shophouse in Nagore Square, so remember to mind your step and clear the threshold as you enter.We had a feast of ducks made several ways - the confit, the Balinese Bek Bek, and honey glazed. All pretty awesome with a nice modern touch, some served on tiles. The creme brûlée was magnifique - a touch of savory with the use of salted egg, a happy marriage with the usual creamy sweetness. Cotton cheese cake is worth a try too!Will be back!Show less

Author: An-Fo-1979
Title: One of the best restaurants in Penang
Review: The food is amazing good, really good duck and other dishes. Nice located and very good service too.

Author: Sandy R
Title: Dinner
Review: Had a great feed at WTD. First time visitors and we were very happy with the quality of food and service as well as the prices. We would highly recommend others to attend and enjoy also :)

Author: 386plap
Title: Pretty good
Review: Nice looking restaurant with helpful staff and amazing food. What this restaurant lacks in looks it makes up in food and service. If you are still hungry after your main course i suggest you try their brownie.

Author: niikiiiicnn
Title: Need improvement
Review: Basically most of the food i saw on the menu was duck!I love duck meat !I had their duck salad it was nice but come on such a small portion and with such little meat!
