For that price!Lucky I had a late lunch My friends enjoyed their food so that was ok!But the food tasted good overallShow less

Author: AverageDave91
Title: Couldn't Fault the place.
Review: Found this place on trip advisor, and boy were we satisfied. We were looked after all night by a young chap who was very friendly and explained the menu very well. The food was absolutely delicious, would recommend the trio starter and the confit for main. Both faultless. Anyone in the area this is a must!! P.S something must be wrong with the pricing because the total bill amount wouldn't even pay for the starter in the UK no complaints with leaving a hefty tip!! Show less

Author: Myrte BUtrecht, The Netherlands
Title: Excellent food, reasonable prices
Review: I highly recommend the duck trio as a starter. For your main course, just order the starter again :-)The crispy duck and duck pasta were also really good! We were there on a Tuesday, didn't need reservations. I guess that it will be busier on weekends. Show less

Author: TrippyBM
Title: Delicious 5 star food.
Review: First class food. Great service.  Dessert was exellent.  Duck confit.  Coconut duck.  Rib eye steak was astounding.

Author: catherinesY772VECasinalbo, Italy
Title: Amazing!
Review: Located in the charming little street of Nagore Square, What the Duck did not disappoint. From the tasty Trio starter followed by the honey glazed duck and confit duck as main, everything was delicious... Also to finish the caramelized brownie was to die for! The staff was also great and attentive. A great meal, not to miss in Penang!Show less

Author: josd704Vessem, The Netherlands
Title: Good food, great atmosphere
Review: The restaurant is situated in a street with many restaurants. The area is really great and less busy than most other parts of George Town. The food looks great and you really can see the chef is taking care of the dishes. The starter with 3 different types of duck dishes tasted the best. Well prepared well presented. The main dishes were tasteful but a little easy. The kids ordered pizza and was great. The kids dish with broccoli, chicken nuggets and spaghetti felt as a strange combination. Show less

Author: Cheryl F
Title: Amazing!
Review: One of the best meals I've ever had! We ordered the trio to start which was phenomenal. The people are super friendly too and it's really cheap. A must in penang! Can't reccomend highly enough

Author: aandlkch
Title: Definitely  recommend
Review:
Had  dinner  here  2  evenings  running.  The  food  was  delicious  and  very  well  presented.  Also  we  had  very  good  service.

This  is  a  very  good-value  place  and  we  certainly  recommend  it.  Suggest  you  book  ahead  or  get  there  soon  after  6 pm.

Author: absolutelk
Title: great restaurant
Review: Portion of the food is small. Pricing was not too expensive. Must try is their duck egg ice cream. Located in the city.

Author: JotravelblogSingapore
Title: Hidden Gem in Charming Nagore Square!
Review: Crispy, flavorful yet melts in your mouth! One of the best duck dish I have tasted! The Duck Confiti served here is to die for! There is hardly any fat Between the crispy skin and meat which is a plus for health conscious people like me. Yet it is full of flavor, biting through the crispy skin and it ends melting off in your mouth. Layered flavors and textures that are simply heavenly! We ordered The duck spaghetti to share and am glad we did. Lightly seasoned with salt with all its natural flavors intact. A delightful dish indeed!They also serve an interesting selection of drinks. Another must dine restaurant in our Penang dining list. Worth every dollar! Nestled among the beautiful shophouses in Nagore Square is another plus point! It's the most charming cluster of shophouses in Penang. A must visit area! Highly recommended. Show less

Author: grays693
Title: Great find
Review: Situated in a redevelopment of colonial buildings What the Duck is an excellent restaurant with a varied menu (not just duck). The seasame duck was particularly nice and the sizzling chocolate brownies were special. A lovely meal at a very good price.

Author: rozainam
Title: Worth it !!
Review: I walk in this restaurant without knowing what's on the menu n by looking at the banner only. But what suggested by the chef is mouth watering. We ordered salmon , duck confiti n trio platter. The food presentation is superb with adfordable price. My favorite was duck confiti n the trio with duck chowder soup n the roll , its fresh n juicy. I was temp to order the desserts but we are too full. Perhaps next visit then. You'll never regret!Show less

Author: OzzieAliPenang, Malaysia
Title: Great Food in Nagore Square
Review: What the Duck is in an atmospheric old building in Nagore Square although the white plastic chairs in the restaurant add little to the atmosphere. However, four of us came here for dinner and we weren't disappointed.I tried an appetiser of duck and walnut salad followed by confit of duck. Both were superb. The duck egg ice cream for dessert was an indulgence that I didn't really need but I'm sure glad I had it. It was just as good as the first two courses.They also do a set lunch menu that appears to offer some interesting options.Show less

Author: cansavageComo, Italy
Title: Great Food in a Great Spot!
Review: Located in a trendy part of GeorgeTown where foodies will find heaven on earth, What the Duck mixes ethnic Chinese flavours with local spices and creates fusion food that will make you come back for more.Food is excellent with mid-sized portions, obviously focused upon duck choices. Service is excellent. Table settings are original and match the atmosphere. Decorations are basic but there is a nice patio section.Recommended by a friend, we were very satisfied and were able to order food to meet all family needs.No reservations necessary. Parking is outside and may be difficult. You can park around the corner.We will definitely come back for more from What the Duck!Show less

Author: Settlement04
Title: Very enjoyable lunch
Review: We went for lunch. Nice menu with plenty of options. Staff are very friendly and attentive. The Duck confit had a wonderful depth of flavor .

Author: Chris V
Title: Worth seeking out
Review: Agree with previous reviewers. Lovely surroundings (Nagore Road). Plain interior, but good food. Swift service. Great desserts.

Author: T4993DSpetersSingapore
Title: Great fine dining food at very affordable prices
Review: It is in the restaurant street "Nagore Square", doesn't have a lot of tables, still offers inside and outside seating. They have a'la carte and very affordable lunch sets as well.The food taste, preparation and presentation is fine dining by any western standard, however the spices are definitely Asian: best of both worlds!Eat confit duck, the 3 piece (duck roll, duck rillette, duck chowder) tasting starter, drink any of the "funny" mixes they offer. The Indonesian spicy duck pasta is also great.Show less

Author: AfghanHound
Title: Delicious
Review: Great duck confit and 'a l'orange'... Swift service.  Reasonable price.  Good dessert also! Not full early on, but gradually became busier with families....

Author: ASTEGPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Good and reasonable priced French restaurant
Review: Overall a very satisfying experience - liked all dishes served, just the main dish (duck breast) was to well done for my taste. I like duck breast medium and pinkish in the middle and not well done. But still the taste was ok. Presentation and service were flawless. Show less

Author: chooi kBayan Lepas
Title: not bad, but still got room of improvement
Review: im having the duck confit which is chef recommendation, and it tastes good.For the other dish, with rice, forget about the name,just recall is an indonesian style of cooking,and taste is just normal, and the vege with the dish is sour in taste,might be prickled, not saying bad but not my taste.Not bad for the soup as there are duck meat slices in it. Show less

Author: kikheemono
Title: Food Quality from 9 points dropped to 3 points....
Review: Quality of food dropping down. From 9 points (Sept 2015) dropped to 3 points (Jan 2016)..... Service wise, is just ok. Hope the owner of the Restaurant will look into this matter. Will think twice whether shd go back again in the future.

Author: travlin_cat
Title: Best duck ever!
Review: My husband and I came for supper and had the duck trio for appetizer which was superb! I had the very delicious Hainanese duck with yam stew and my husband, the wine braised crispy duck. Service and food were above and beyond!

Author: IzyClover
Title: worth a visit
Review:
tried the mocktails and the salted duck egg ice cream with brownies. It was so good. The presentation is as fancy as the restaurant set up. 

They do not serve pork or lard but they do serve alcohol

Author: Surendaran C
Title: Tried their salted duck ice cream and cake
Review:
The food was an interesting concept but then too much of salted egg, will make it unpleasant. Lesson learned. 

The ice cream was really good. i would recommend it as a dessert. Their cheese cake was not tat wonderful but it still tasted good.

Author: whyhellothereworld
Title: Lived up to the good reviews!
Review: Came here tonight with high expectations due to the other good reviews on trip advisor and was not disappointed! The duck confit lived up to the claims and was truly cooked to perfection. The service was prompt and the waiters polite and friendly. Servings were large and worth the money! Show less

Author: MatildaTheTravellerTampere, Finland
Title: Recomending! Especially the Christmas day lunch
Review: We visit the restaurant two times. The first visit was before Christmas 2015 for a lovely dinner and the second one was for the Christmas day lunch. Both times were excellent. We tasted both French and Asian duck dishes and the food just melted in our mouths. The Christmas lunch special was 3 course meal (French: 1. Chowder 2. Duck confit and 3.home made ice cream with chocolate cake) and affordable so that even a backpackers like we can eat this delicious food. Staff was very friendly, atmosphere most welcoming and the graphic design of the restaurant cleaver. We liked that you can sit outside or inside and you can pay with a credit card as well. “What the duck” offers great value for money.Show less

Author: larag978
Title: Wonderful
Review: A small restaurant with a huge  sense of flavour! We enjoyed it very much. Please order as a starter the trio of duck..delightful. very nice staff. Clean and open kitchen..so you can see how your food is prepared. Well done guy's! See you soon.

Author: Enhan
Title: Excellent restaurant!
Review:
I tried the Duck Confit; it is delicious and excellently prepared!

A group of us went there for dinner a few days ago. The ambiance was cozy; service was excellent and the food and dessert we had were worth the price!

Reservation is recommended.

Author: klmal61Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: A meal to remember........Yummmmmmm!!!!!
Review: Was brought to this wonderful restaurant by a "FOODIE" and boy was I glad for it.Located at Nagore Square in Georgetown,Penang.The restaurant has a warm and friendly ambience.On first impression, it may lead you to think that it is targeted at clientele who are in the tourist category but on further assessment of the menu one will quickly note that prefernces of the local are also met with gusto. Admittedly none of the members of the dinner party had any of the asian style dishes but can I just say that if the chef gave as much attention to the food of the western menu I have full confidence that the same will be rendered to the asian menu. The Duck confit, d'la orange the steaks were all cooked to perfection. The pasta dish I had ,had an asian twist but one that I found appetising and refreshing.Interestingly enough, the same can be said for desserts. I cannot commend enough about this restaurant. I was most pleased with the execution of the dishes.In short, a comfortable friendly restaurant offering good food and all at a fair price too. Well done and thanks to the proprietor,the chef and the staff of this venue. Show less

Author: ron255100Newcastle, Australia
Title: Great food
Review: Have visited here before for desert but thought this time we would try entire meal.Wasn't disappointed the food was excellent.Recommend trying the sample starter of duck , Main meal we had steak and Salmon both cooked well with good quality produce.Leave room for desert the sizzling vrownie not to be missed with salted duck egg sause.Show less

Author: Jarrod CGeorge Town, Pulau Pinang, Malaysia
Title: If you love duck
Review: If you are looking for something other than the usual roast duck, Peking Duck in Penang, why not head over to Nagore Square off Jalan Burma in Penang for a fusion meal that can include Quack Consome & Duck Confit? There is free one hour parking at an open space in front of the Continental Bakery, provided you produce a receipt exceeding RM50 purchase from any of the participating restaurants in Nagore Place. Their set lunch consisting of soup of the day or a duck salad plus one main course and a drink for about RM24 is value for money because you get a reasonably sized piece of duck drumstick. I particularly like the juicy duck confit, tho' others have showed a preference for the Balinese Bek Bek or roasted duck. There are lamb and chicken options if you do not like duck, as well as vegetarian selections. It's a cozy restaurant with limited square tables which can be joined up for larger groups of people. Reservations on weekends is preferable.Show less

Author: TiriniusVernon, Canada
Title: Delightful find on Nagore Road for duck lovers
Review: We stumbled upon this restaurant as Nyonya Baba where we headed, was closed! We love duck so decided to give this restaurant a try. The restaurant is very clean, welcoming and has a nice atmosphere. Service was very prompt and friendly. We enjoyed the drinks, starters and main course very much. Would recommend this restaurant highly. Try "Crazy Duck" for a refreshing non alcoholic drink. It is a delicious fusion of lemongrass, mint & orange juice with Sprite. The Summer Plum stewed duck (RM 21.90) served on super creamy mashed potatoes with vegetables and a small pouring server of plum infused gravy was melt in your mouth! I would love to try their other offerings .....we plan on returning it was that good!Show less

Author: Angela A
Title: Delicious duck
Review: Creative ways to cook all things duck. Lovely restaurant in heritage area, very popular. Be ready to wait a bit if you go during peak hours. Worth the wait.

Author: kingdomtravel1991
Title: Night Date
Review: Everything are in perfect order. Really enjoyed the food here and the ambience of the restaurant very comfort for couples.

Author: ToastyangelWest Yorkshire
Title: Fabulous
Review: Excellent food, beautifully prepared, great chef owner Daniel. My husband and I shared a starter and desert, and there was plenty. We both had confit duck main course, delicious and very well presented. And the prices are so inexpensive. I would recommend a visit and will certainly go againShow less

Author: AnnAnn428
Title: Thumb up!
Review:
Chef! You can cook!! 
The duck dishes was so good and really appreciate that you twisted the boring ingredients into something different! Salted egg ice cream is so special!

Author: 2009H1N1Malaysia
Title: Very good and inexpensive Duck specialty restaurant
Review: Stumbled on it from a local food blog website and has been back twice in 2 months. So far the duck confit, duck spaghetti and duck in orange has been well done in preparation and taste. The special salted duck egg ice cream with banana sauce on choc brownies is addictive and a must try dessert( either you like it or don't). The soup and all the salads were good too. The price is affordable and reasonable for such qualitywestern and fusion dishes.Booking needed for weekend dinners as was turned away one of the evenings. Parking can be a difficult as its a busy area with many eateries. Friendly chef and good and prompt service. Will be visiting again soon.Show less

Author: koshpatPenang, Malaysia

Author: Davy LSingapore, null, Singapore
Title: Come for the Biriyani - it's all in the rice!
Review: I asked a local driver for recommendations of good Indian food in Penang and being a biriyani lover, I asked specifically for good biriyani. He told me to come here.I was not disappointed at all. The restaurant is air-conditioned with decent decor. Service was prompt, and perhaps because it was around 9pm when we went on a weeknight, service was relatively courteous as well.I asked for the mutton biriyani, wife had the chicken one. The portions were decent.More importantly though, it's one of the best biriyanis I had. The rice was very fragrant, and the meats were well seasoned, not too spicy. My children loved it as well, despite not great fans of spicy-looking food.From the informative decor on the walls, I learnt that the rice used (not the typical basmati-type I'm used to) is the Seeraga Samba rice from Tamil Nadu - they're shorter and more starchy than basmati. This makes each spoonful more filling and fulfilling, even if the portions look relatively less than the typical basmati biriyani servings.If you're coming with kids, I would recommend one thing though - skip the pizza. Can't exactly remember which one, but it's the non-spicy and seemingly a kid-friendly flavour. Unfortunately the end result was a more sweet pizza than what was supposed to be a savoury one.Then again, I should have been smarter - why one earth order a pizza in an Indian restaurant? That being said, the restaurant probably should have more children-friendly dishes to choose from.Show less

Author: SghillHo Chi Minh City, Vietnam
Title: Poor quality food, spotty service
Review: We chose this restaurant for lunch based solely on Trip Advisor reviews, and we were unfortunately disappointed. We ordered several dishes for a family of four and the only ones that we ate were the cauliflower and fried chicken wings (hard to mess those up). The quality of the meat used in our fish dish and the mutton dish was so poor, it was difficult to eat. The sauces on the fish and mutton were just OK, making for a bad experience all around for those dishes. They also don't offer any type of bread for lunch, another huge disappointment. The restaurant was packed, and staff couldn't seem to keep up, although they were friendly enough. I ordered a coconut drink that was recommended by the gentleman who took our order, but it never came. We asked at least two different staff members about it after 15 minutes into our meal, they said I needed to pick something else because it would take too long - even though I'd ordered it 25 minutes prior. We had to flag someone down for silverware after our meals came. Napkins were an additional 'special request'. It seems from the reviews that our experience was an anomaly, but our dishes were so bad and service spotty that I can't imagine this was an isolated incident. We were disappointed to have 'wasted' an eating opportunity in Penang with so many great options.Show less

Author: R0peTechAuckland, New Zealand
Title: Devine dinner
Review: My wife and I came for dinner and we were very impressed. We were given great advice from our server about how much food to order and it was handy having pictures of the food to view on a tablet before ordering. All of our food was full of flavour and absolutely delicious. The mint julipe drink was extremely refreshing. I highly recommend a meal here if you are in little India.Show less

Author: sundarv672
Title: Excellent Indian food
Review: This place is as good as it gets for South Indian food.  The food is tasty, served quick and great customer service .  If you want to try Indian food in Penang island, this is it.

Author: 3SeniorsHuddersfield
Title: Definitely worth a visit
Review: Visited after reading trip advisor reviews.Nice clean air con restaurant, helpful ipad menu which shows you pictures of the dishes which is helpful as we hadn't heard of some of them.There is a strange thing in Malaysia that certain dishes are only available at certain times of the day which seems a bit bizarre to us!We visited twice and over the visits had the maharaja masala dosa, lamb masala, paneer butter masala (excellent) chicken biryani and garlic lappa (cross between a pancake and chapati) Very reasonable price and definitely recommend.Show less

Author: manoja744
Title: Best Indian food
Review: HIGHLY RECOMMENDED. You will not be disappointed. Number 1 restaurant in Penang. Staff are very nice

Author: Nitin T
Title: "Panner butter Masala"
Review: Very tasty made panner butter masala with Roti, Very good service by staff and price also very reasonable,

Author: Siilinen S
Title: Tasteful biriyani rice
Review: The restaurant had opening day in the new place. We had biriyani rice with vegetables and chicken. It was sooo good! Chicken was very tender, rice was seasoned very good. The place was very clean, nice and comfortable. We enjoyed and would definitely come back!

Author: K0Kaun
Title: Amazing crab masala
Review: Friendly staff, fast service, and fantastic food, make for the best Indian food experience in Malaysia.  The paneer butter masala was great, but that crab masala was incredible...and it’s already shelled, so not work for the hungry...just dig in.

Author: JohanN1018
Title: Soooo good!
Review: The best Indian food I ever tasted. Very simple place but really good service and food. We tried the honey chicken, lamb gosh, chicken masala and all was great.

Author: clarebJ2451LZGeelong, Australia
Title: The BEST Indian we have ever tasted!!!
Review: This restaurant is fabulous!!!Menus are interactive with the iPad to help with images. They didn’t have the dishes we’re used to back in Australia, but we spoke with waiter who helped us decide on some wonderful dishes!! We ordered:- Chicken Lollipops - SO good!! A brilliant way to start our meal - Mixed Vegetable Curry - very, very good!!- Chicken (Methi Murg Masala)- Lamb Curry (Jolly Ghost) - Delicious!!!- Vegetable Rice - So nice with fresh herbs and shallots through it- Parotta Breads. They make this out the front and it is light and flakey and scrumptious! Every single dish was packed with flavour. Herbs and spices. So fresh and tasty!Meals are generous portions and this was more than enough for 2 adults and 2 older children with healthy appetites! The bill came to 82RM, which is $27AUD. Brilliant value for money!!We very much enjoyed our meal and we will be back. Show less

Author: ryuo2018Yokohama, Japan
Title: so good!
Review: had dinner here this evening, have had chicken and maton as well as bread and fried rice. food was totally OK and mint julep was excellent. in addition using tablet for photos of dishes which was so helpful to choose actual image of dishes. highly recommended. Show less

Author: krispie41Dublin, Ireland
Title: Best Indian food we have had
Review: Menu explained to us with assistance of pictures on IPAD. .very helpful. Food was fast coming put I got a crab malasa, heaps of crab meat in it and best curry I have ever had. We had bread also which was delicious. Mango lasso and shake delicious also. Would go backShow less

Author: LoftusroadW12Doha, Qatar
Title: Overrated
Review: We were lured by the good reviews on TA, and left massively disappointed. Certainly as someone who uses TA all over the world, I've generally found reviews spot-on. However, this was a real let down and I suggest you read with caution when low-numbered reviewers write glowing reviews. Service was ok, and this being Asia, there is an element of it comes when it comes.We ordered a veg biryani and it was just poor! Veg were conspicuously rare, the rice was an odd grey colour and instead of being fluffy and flavourful, it was stodgy and tasted just like boiled rice. A butter chicken dish had good flavour,but the gravy was too runny. The dahl was too runny, lacked enough lentils and the onions in the dish hadn't been cooked through.The onion pakora isn't worth writing about! Based on our experience, I couldn't recommend this place.Show less

Author: Maja_VilufushiThaa Atoll
Title: Excellent Indian Food
Review: If you go and visit the Indian Street, go to eat at this restaurant, just a couple of steps from the main street, to your left. Don't be fooled by the look - the food and drinks are delicious! Their menu cover Indian from North to South, from mild to spicy and offer some very tasty drinks too. We had the honey glazed chicken for a starter and for a main the chicken and the lamb meal. It's like a Biriyani, but comes with 3 different sauces. (onions,herbs and coconut milk; curry and a sweet sauce) - absolutely delicious and satisfying. Try the masala chai or a wonderful lassie for drinks! But as you see from other happy customers, - you a spoiled for choices.And the best thing: It's not expensive at all! A big hug to staff and compliments and thanks to the chef! 5 stars!Show less

Author: Spacey1808Arundel, Australia
Title: Great Indian Lunch Twice
Review: Wow what great food - I would have to say THE BEST INDIAN we have ever had. Jolly Ghost is a must plus the yellow Dahl washed down with a lemon salted soda - You would be silly not to visit this restaurant - lunch for two $12 AUDShow less

Author: Anastasia O
Title: Very tasty :)
Review: Like this place. Highly recommended ;)very tasty curry and biriyany, friendly personal, masala tea is really nice.

Author: AmalS791
Title: Best Indian Food Ive Tried. Friendly Service
Review:
I would suggest everyone to order mint lemon drink and fragrance coconut. 

Staff gave us samples to try before ordering , amazing experience. 

Coming there again soon.

Author: SeattleWertySeattle
Title: Wonderful Food and Experience
Review: We asked a shop owner in Little India where she would recommend we eat. She recommended Bite N Eat. We are so happy she did. While we had to wait about 15 minuted because the restaurant was packed, it was worth the wait. I honestly do not know Indian food that well, so I just had the owner recommend his favorite items. They were all unbelievably good. We had the briyani, the chicken pops, and several other items that I am not sure what they were. Each was better than the next, including the mint drink he ordered for us. One of the best meals I ate in Penang.Show less

Author: tonytitaniumSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good Experience
Review: I hardly tried Dindigul briyani before, I personally think it was very delicious. The portion is huge enough to be shared by two persons. The staff was kind enough to explain the menu. It was a nice experience to have traditional Indian food in a modern indoor atmosphere. Recommended.Show less

Author: JAMcI
Title: Best Indian I have ever had
Review: My favourite cuisine is Indian so I visited this restaurant while in Penang. So glad I did, as it was the best Indian meal I have ever had. My two favourite dishes were chicken  methi murg masala and prawn biryani.

Author: evamU2397IE
Title: Best Indian food in Malaysia!!!
Review: We visited this restaurant 2 times in a row and twice we were fully satisfied! The food comes in big portions (curry with a good amount of meat/fish) and the waiters are friendly and forthcoming. The prices are absolutely more than reasonable. It was the best Indian food we had since a long time. Highly recommend this place to all! :) Show less

Author: Cameron LPenang, Malaysia
Title: Tasty Indian Food
Review: We have tried two popular Indian places in George Town and this one was the better choice by a considerable margin. In terms of decor it is fairly simple though it does have air-conditioning. The service is also helpful, though more of an Asian style than the Western variety. The main reason to come here, however, is for the food.We tried the chicken and mutton briyani and both were great. Sizes don't look huge but it was very filling. There are also a range of interesting sides. The dahl was especially good here. We advise washing it down with a mint julep or masala tea. Indian food fans will almost certainly enjoy this place.Show less

Author: paulrT9924BFBracknell, United Kingdom
Title: Well presented food
Review: The food was well presented and nice cool restaurant, but was a little disappointed with the flavour of the Biryani we had (Chicken and Mutton). Maybe it was toned down for the tourist trade, as i am used to eating these in local towns in MalaysiaShow less

Author: athinarayanasamyv
Title: Food capital restaurant of Penang.
Review: Taste and service are  the best. The manager,by name , MR Santhosh is giving immediate attention to the customers for their orders. The Service personnel are also          giving their best attention to their customers.

Author: Aravind A
Title: Super
Review: Very tasty and very good  item.                        Super.                                                           Briyani.                                                                    Super non veg.  Item.                                        Super veg item.                                                     Super service.                                                      Nice.

Author: AthieDev
Title: Ok
Review:
Have varieties.
Food taste is ok.
Briyani is ok.
Madurai fish curry is not fresh,used frozen fish.
Staffs  are friendly and service is good.

Author: Kelly M
Title: Delicious!
Review: 5 stars all round. The staff are amazing, the restaurant is super clean and has a nice atmosphere with fab mood lighting and low music. It's super welcoming and you don't need to dress up loads but above all the food is DELICIOUS! We had the paneer butter masala, mutton masala, bread, rice and drinks and it was all fresh and so tasty! Fab meal, thank you!Show less

Author: SPavDevPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Our always place to dine in
Review: Too much of varieties to select from. Been our first choice always. They have the best drinks from mint julipe and jigarthanda and coffees...and always a 6 star for service. Just a suggestion please do help to offer spicy chicken or mutton curries to go with briyani. Would loved it more.Show less

Author: B11antHalifax, United Kingdom
Title: Great biryani!
Review: Popped in for lunch. The food was excellent and the service very attentive. We had the mutton biriyani and it was absolutely delicious! The mutton was so tender and the flavours were particularly well spiced. The sauces that accompany the dish were really fresh and well matched. None of the food was particularly spicy but very tasty. Only problem was that the breads are only available in the evenings. A great place for excellent curry!Show less

Author: Mobile513166
Title: Best Indian Food Ever!
Review: My boyfriend and I went here for dinner tonight and it was AMAZING! First good sign is the smell when you walk in - the smell of spices... fresh spices! It is very clean and well kept inside, with a nice ambience. The staff were extremely helpful! They provide you with a tablet to go along with the menu so you can look at pictures of the dishes, which is helpful when ordering. Vignesh was our server, and he helped us order, as we were unfamiliar with some of the dishes. He made sure we didn't order too much food, and made great suggestions! We had the chicken biriyani, the yellow dahl, a masala dosa, and a parotta, and it was the perfect amount of food for two hungry people. The dishes come with different sauces on the side, and Vignesh gave us some helpful tips on the best way to eat the food! We also ordered the masala tea and it was delicious!This was some of the best Indian food we've had, not just in Penang, but anywhere! There were distinct, delicious flavours in each dish we had. Definitely recommend this place! Show less

Author: RichardDorai
Title: Semme briyani
Review: Briyani here was great like in India. I really recommend going here for the real taste of biryani. Really !

Author: Gerard R
Title: Yummy Rawa Dosa!
Review: We really enjoyed the Indian food here especially the Rawa Dosa in this restaurant even though it is more famous for their Biryani Rice. The food was freshly prepared and the staffs are quite helpful in trying to explain the different dishes available on an iPad! Highly recommended.Show less

Author: Mark ABarnt Green, United Kingdom
Title: Great food at a great price
Review: We visited here whilst having a walk around Georgetown old town. The menu is extensive but you are given an ipad with pictures on to assist with choosing. Also the waiter was really good at helping us choose a selection of items.We ordered 2 starters, 2 main dishes with one rice and 2 breads. All the food was delicious but we probably over ordered because we could not finish it all. We ordered mint juleps which were good. There was no alcohol which was not a problem for us.The total cost came to RM70 which was a great price for such amazingly tasty food.Would definitely recommend if you want Indian food in Georgetown.Show less

Author: rebeccaballantyneLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Delicious... but NO BREAD until after 4:30pm
Review: Scrummy food and the Mint Julip is a must! excellent value for money. The service is great and the use of an ipad to view the meals beforehand is a lovely touch. The only downside is that they don't serve bread until the evening rush. I am a massive bread fan so would have loved something to mop up the yummy sauces. Not a real concern but something to be aware of if you too are a bread lover.Show less

Author: Mimibah
Title: Very Delicious Food with Authentic Spices
Review: We have been to this restaurant a few times before and each visit we have ordered different dishes and thus far all dishes tasted fabulous.The spices they use in the curry dishes must be of good quality, unlike other indian restaurants whereby the curry dishes are normally sweet and just common. I strongly reconment the vegie dish called Aloo Gobi & curry prawn call Chinthamani Prawn. Absolutely Good!!!We will patronize into this restaurant again!!Show less

Author: msiewmPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Worth trying
Review: Ordered the chicken and mutton briyani. Meat was super tender to the bite. The briyani rice was somewhat different in taste from the usual briyanis served in Indian restaurants - not oily and seasoned differently. It was a full house when I went for dinner on a Sunday.Show less

Author: MalcolmA02Scotland, United Kingdom
Title: It's good but not amazing
Review: We went on the basis of the TA reviews as there are so many restaurants to choose from in Little India. We ended up going upstairs as the few table downstairs were all taken. I have to say it's pretty characterless and uninspiring but heh we're there for the food! Service was a bit lacklustre but the guys serving were nice enough. We'd decided to go for the veg biryani with a side of chilli veg mountain(more a hill than a mountain..!). We were glad we'd opted for the additional side dish as it livened up the meal. The biryani was good but there could have been a little bit more of the curry sauce on the side. I'd say good rather than the TA 'average' but I couldn't class it as 'very good'. Worth the visit but I'd like to try others. Portion sizes were ample but not huge. All that being said it was probably value for money.Show less

Author: Kimberley MLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Amazing Food and Service
Review: This was our last dinner in Georgetown before flying out to KL and it was the best way to leave!The service from the start was flawless, our server recommended the mint julip and the fragrant coconut as drinks and they were super refreshing! We shared a chicken masala with a vegetable biryani and some bread and it was definitely amazing! For dessert we ordered a gulab jamun which was on point as with the rest of the food. Would definitely recommend it to anyone who is in Penang, definitely worth it!Show less

Author: Jeffco99Penang Island, Malaysia
Title: Had lunch at Bite 'N' Eat today. It was great. Service, taste, portion sizes and value were all excellent.
Review: We went for lunch in Little India in Pinang. After an indifferent experience the night before, the Bite 'N' Eat really stood out. The staff were excellent...the I-pad which showed us the various dishes was an innovative way to help tourists like us. We had the spicy chicken wings, mutton curry meal and one of their signature biryani dishes. They were all well presented, hot, delightfully spiced and truly satisfied our hunger. Prices were very reasonable. We look forward to getting there at night to try their dosa.Show less

Author: jlchester0318
Title: Amazing food.
Review: Delicious, just asked for whatever dishes they recommend and had the Chicken Biriyani 👌🏽 Also mixed veggies. Place is clean and will probably return since I will be back in Penang after Langkawi.

Author: BartskieEindhoven, The Netherlands
Title: You will go back every day
Review: We are currently traveling in Asia and we even considered to make a stop in Penang just for Bite n eat where we had a couple of meals 2 years ago. Eventually we didn't but we thought if we like it that much it deserves to write a review. The interior could be cozier but the food is one of the best Indian food we've had (and we have been in India). We liked that the food was originally spiced and not adapted, what we unfortunately see a lot outside India. The shakes are delicious also. You can see the dishes on a tablet which is handy. If you have several days in George Town, don't go on the first day. You will feel ashamed afterwards you didn't eat any of the local food like we did. Bite n Eat, next time we are around we will surely come by;)Show less

Author: Maria_RapsoffAuckland Central, New Zealand
Title: Best indian restaurant in Malaysia so far
Review: I just got curious because of all this good reviews and so I went to Bite n Eat for dinner. Even though this restaurants speciality is Biriyani, I had a vege curry, some fried cauliflower and garlic laapa bread. It was just amazing! So amazing that I actually went back on the next day. Malaysia has quite a lot of nice indian restaurants but for me this is just among the best so far.Show less

Author: LaVite_Prachuap
Title: Worth visit
Review:
Good place, warm welcome, good food.
Ambience is clean, aircon is an appreciated plus.
Will surely be back

Author: MuraliWijayEngland, United Kingdom
Title: Reasonable restaurant with good food.
Review: The restaurant was a bit on the small side but they do have seating upstairs. The food was enjoyable. We loved the crab meat curry very much. The staff were very friendly and helped us with different disses. He was able to explain how they were cooked too. Show less

Author: Priyanka SSingapore, Singapore
Title: Tasty food, good value
Review: We went for dinner here, based on the good reviews on tripadvisor. We were not dissappointed at all. The food was delicious, as were the beverages. We had the hot and sour soup which was too spicy, followed by chicken 65 and chicken biryani both of which tasted yummy. For drinks we had the mint julepe and mango lassi. Both we tasty and fresh.The restaurant is simple, but clean. Good value for money.Show less

Author: prithan2016
Title: Excellent food
Review: We ate the biriyani...and we loved the fish..version... the crab roast was beyond words..My daughter enjoyed pulka with the chicken curry...My family enjoyed it thoroughly...thank u..for taking care of our stomachs...We loved the dessert fragrant coconut payasam...love it love it...please  come..and enjoy it here...😎

Author: SPavDevPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: The taste is getting stolen by
Review: Used to be my best ever place to eat mutton briyani and mint drink.. but now the curry is not too good, not spicy..and the rice is just... Normal... I come here regularly.. but now when I think briyani.. I wanna go somewhere else. They should bring back the old taste. Please help to maintain the food preparation.Show less

Author: MaxemaseratiBeijing, China
Title: Delicious
Review: After I have red some review's we decided to join that restaurant. It was delicious. Also they have improved since the last comment in October. Now they also have a menu in English language and the samsung pad is working perfectly to show pictures of the respective dish. We had gosht and garlic prawns and we ordered rice biryani. Everything was spicy (but ok) and delicious. When we left, it was heavily raining and the waiter offered us an umbrella to take away. So beside the food they are very friendly and have excellent service. Show less

Author: markdY5872ZU
Title: Mark
Review: Food was stunning..... The portion sizes are vey generous, the waiter was very helpful. Importantly in this part of the world the toilets were clean.  Probably go back again tonight!

Author: prudee
Title: Best Lamb Biriyani
Review: Such tender and tasty lamb and my wife really enjoyed her chicken biriyani. Very good price too. We've been twice in 3 days. Its halal so no beer but milkshake nice!

Author: Kay G
Title: Enjoyed every bite!
Review: We stumbled across this restaurant by chance on our first visit to Little India and enjoyed everything about the experience. So, we sought it out on our next visit. The food is consistently tasty and the service is fast and friendly.

Author: 749marcuskShanghai, China
Title: Great value, great taste..!
Review: Came here for a late lunch. Found Dindigul to be a calm spot in Little India with an extensive menu, quick service, and a helpful TV screen showing all their dishes in a loop to help you choose (if you're not so familiar with all the dishes.)Total cost... 65 ringgit for non-veg starter, two main meat dishes, 1 veg dish, rice, 1 soft drink and a dessert. Free flow water. Marvellous!P.S. Beware to come after 4.30pm if you want Indian breads. Show less

Author: svanhvitr
Title: Wonderful.
Review: Situated in "little India", this is a lovely little place that offers a lot. The food is amazing (chilli dosa is a must have - nice and spicy) and the staff is very friendly. Service is quick and good.

Author: gjsithRembau, Malaysia
Title: Fiery Taste Buds Fulfilled
Review: In need of some wake up call for your taste buds.Well this place is indeed the best place to visit in Little India Penang (Market Street).The food price is very much affordable and the food is really good.You can start with Honey Glazed Jai (baby corns)for appetizer.It is perfectly coated with honey and spices which is grilled to perfection.The caramelized coating just melts in your mouth. Later on we tried the Briyani. There is multiple choice of Briyani where everyone of it is really good, The rice is cooked well and the chicken or mutton is very tender with rich spice flavors. The Mutton Chuka is another item not to be missed. Just a gentle reminder, this dish is quite spicy, thus for those who can't take spicy food please be ready with a glass of water. The mutton is cooked in a spicy dry gravy with a lot of spices. The mutton is really tender and the flavors are infused well in to the meat. Last but not least do not forget to Try the Mint Julipe as well. This is a drink which entirely made up of Pudina Mint which is blended at the right mount of sweetness. It is very refreshing to have it on a hot day. In summary very good food at the right amount of price.Show less

Author: 123juancc
Title: Excellent restaurant
Review: Cozy and neat restaurant, with welcoming staff and solid food. The guava lassi and mint Julipe were great drinks to accompany our meal, which included fish varutha curry, mutton biryani, Manchurian squid, and a chili parotha. Highly recommended.

Author: 410jorisbMiami Beach, Florida
Title: Good Indian food in the middle of little India
Review: We went here after reading the reviews on trip advisor and we were not disappointed. The service is good, the food is good and the surrounding is nice (little India). Even though this place does not look like an 'authentic Indian restaurant', it really is. There were also a lot of locals dining here. Menu is mostly South Indian food. No alcoholic beverages. Show less

Author: HelenaE711
Title: Dinner
Review: Wow finally found a decent place to eat Penang serious this little place was full of lovely helpful staff explained the menu recommend things and OMG it was bloody fantastic going back tomorrow t try other dishes it was that good

Author: bullmay
Title: Good Taste. Who love smell of spice don't miss this place.
Review:
I love the taste of the food in this restaurant. I love to smell curry and spices and I found it in this place.  
Ingredients in every menu that I did eat  - - very awesome !!

Author: TravelBug1081
Title: Fantastic meal in good company
Review: Had briyani meal for lunch. Aromatic briyani rice accompanied by an excellent chicken '555', prawn, mixed vege curry and mushrooms. Washed down with non alcoholic mint julep. Wide variety of dishes and drinks to choose from. 4 pax meal adds up to rm81.90.

Author: Jamie-LeeForan
Title: Great Indian restaurant for lunch or dinner
Review: Great biriyani, and the set menu is delicious and allows you to try lots of different types of curry. Nice and cool with good air conditioning. Staff are friendly and helpful. Easy to find location in Little India. Vanilla was also amazing!

Author: scottyinchina2016
Title: Great Roti + Air Conditioning
Review: We tried a number of restaurants around little India and this one is my favourite. I wish we had discovered it earlier. The staff have excellent English, it's cool inside and the food is very tasty (even compared to the culinary delights of Ipoh).

Author: sunseeker8442London, United Kingdom
Title: Incredible Food!
Review: One our favourite meals in Penang. The staff were very helpful - explaining dishes to us that we may not have been familiar with. It was also useful to have the iPad with pictures on as others have mentioned. Really tasty biriyani, and the prawns we had to start were incredible! Highly recommend their mint drink too as it was so refreshing. One of the best Indian meals we've ever had and excellent value. Show less

Author: Darishini25
Title: the best indian cuisine in penang
Review: The food tastes like the authentic indian cuisine from India and the servers are very welcoming, friendly and informative. I recommend the refreshing mint julipe, the signature briyani and the chicken 555 side dish. Worth the visit!

Author: Selvam J
Title: Biriyani and other dish
Review: It is very nice taste... I felt the same taste as my hometown Biriyani... The service is very nice... I was fully satisfied as the customer.. Worth visiting and paying the amount...

Author: Vega7379Penang, Malaysia
Title: New menu -- prawn dishes
Review: We've been frequenting this place for the past two years. They revised their menu effective 1st March 2016.Were there last night and decided to indulge in nothing but prawns..!!!Ordered Milky Prawns, Ra Ra Prawns and Sintamani Prawns to go with plain rice.Milky Prawn was mild and smooth, it was more like a distant cousin to "Thai Green Curry" but not as strong or flavorful. Sintamani Prawn was spicy. The base was primarily chilly paste and unions. Could have gone well with "Nasi Lemak".Ra Ra Prawn was completely opposite of Sintamani. Lots of masala and the prawns were fried in a thin layer of batter. All three dishes, with its own different taste, complimented each other in providing a complete and satisfying meal.We finished our dinner with Pizza Thosai. (ordered one piece and we shared)This is something unique. I don't recall any Indian Restaurant serving this dish.It was very nice, soft, fluffy and cheesy (we asked for extra cheese).Went very well with Green Chutney and Chilly Sauce.......Show less

Author: UlliRahnMelbourne, Australia
Title: Very good value for money, great taste, friendly service
Review: This is a place I would definitely recommend if you like Indian food. The waiter recommended a coconut drink to my boyfriend which was delicious, like a dessert, sweet but refreshing. They show you pictures of the dishes with a small tablet computer which is nice. Our food was a lot (we had the rest as take away). My boyfriend thought there were to many different spices in it, for his taste. It was a bit to salty and oily but it was very delicious and we wanted to go back another time but it was the end of your journey. They are super friendly and want you to fill in a short questionnaire to find out about their service/food so they really try hard get better and better...Show less

Author: Tina_2502Penang Island, Malaysia
Title: Dissapointing
Review: Went to this shop after reading some of the good reviews. Food was extremely disappointing. Tried the thosai (dosa) and a thinner version of a chapati (which the staff recommended). The tosai was extemely oily, gravy that accompanied was mediocre. And the bread that was similar to the chapati was dry, and extremely small. Felt like a complete rip-off. Can't fathom the delight of other patrons...Show less

Author: Dershowi
Title: Amazing food!
Review: If you want naan or other breads come later in the day when they are available! The staff is super helpful and there are pictures of everything for those who don"t eat Indian food often. the Chicken Biriyani was amazing!

Author: Dutombe
Title: Best Indian food I had in Penang
Review:
I had the Mutton Biriyani, Mushroom Masala, Aloo Ghobi and Mango Lassi.
Could not have been better. In fact I came back two days later and order the exact same dishes. Friendly service, more local families than travelers what speaks for itself.

Author: sharondV8164NN
Title: Delicious and spicy
Review: This place was so delicious. My boyfriend and I struggle to get Indian restaurants to make food that is spicy enough because we are always judged by our white skin as not being able to handle it. Bite n Eat served us the the most delicious and spicy Indian food we've had in a while. Ordered the chili gobi, masala dosai, and aloo gobi masala. Everything perfect. A mango lassi at the end to cool down your mouth is the best way to end this mealShow less

Author: scotprague
Title: Great indian food and fresh breads
Review: We ate lunch here and the food was great and very cheap, i had a set menu  platter and it was great, paratha was fantastic and the staff were friendly and helpful. I recommend eating here and the prices are great.

Author: Harvind K
Title: Mediocre
Review: Not The Best.The Gravy Was Really Spicy With No Taste.The Biriyani Has No Flavour It Looks Like The Just Pour Colour And Boil The Rice Which Is Commom In Malaysia Nowadays.The Service Is Very Slow.I Suggest They Improve This Issues.

Author: mcandrew1234Lome, Togo
Title: Superb Indian Cuisine
Review: This restaurant we visited on the strength on previous reviews on TripAdvisor. We were not disappointed. Siva, our host, was very hospitable and his friendly and courteous service was more than matched by fantastic curried calamari for starters, followed by a number of fantastic biryani and curry dishes. We went to this restaurant for two more consecutive nights as it was so good.If you like Indian food, then this is probably the best Indian food we have had in years. Especially as we have a lot of choice of high quality Indian cuisine where we live (in the UK).Show less

Author: danni77Brisbane, Australia
Title: best prawns!
Review: Ate here our second day on recommendation. The food was excellent we ordered hot garlic prawns. visited again on our last day and even took some takeaway for the airport. It was one of the cleanest restaurants in Penang, They do not serve beer so make sure to bring a bottle of water as the food is spicier than western style indian.Show less

Author: AnitaK22Singapore, Singapore
Title: No harm to try this place out.
Review: It was recommended by one of the textile shop owners and so we stop by to try the food. The food was alright. Non-vegetarian as well as vegetarian food available. Service standard needs a little more work. Nice and comfortable setting. If tired and hot, this eatery may be just the place to hop into. The price is average. No harm giving it a try. Show less

Author: M R
Title: That what you call Biriyani !
Review: Excellent food and juices served in a clean and cozy place ! Very very good Biriyani, even better than some place I went in India. One of the most tasty Indian food in Penang island ! Damned, I miss it ! =0

Author: 465c_dricf
Title: Top
Review: Excellent. Clean, seems like an idian fast food, but no that "touristy". Don't expect smiles :-) but expect quality food. And great juices.

Author: Georgia E
Title: delicious
Review: really nice looking place, modern and clean.decent vegetarian selection. the aloo gobi was amazing- so full of flavour. there's one guy who makes the bread outside, we were wondering why ours didn't arrive until the end of our meal then we realised its just him!I had the lime soda to drink, which was a little weird for me cause it was salty...but I've seen salt drinks on the menus here, so maybe it's meant to be like that...just not my thing!Show less

Author: Steve MKuala Lumpur
Title: Delicious and interesting Indian food
Review: This was definitely the best meal that I have eaten in Penang, and I have visited the island several times. I had the mutton set meal, my partner the vegetarian set meal. Wonderful, every dish tasted different and interesting. The tamarind flavoured dish and the mutton curry were among the best Indian dishes that I have ever tested. I live in Kuala Lumpur but this restaurant would be one good reason for moving to Penang.Show less

Author: MeenadChitreKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Excellant ...!!!!
Review: After reading all the reviews I decided to visit this place just once during my short trip to Penang. I had listed other restaurants as well to try out but the amazing service & food I ate here dragged me to visit it every day.I highly recommend Dindigul Chicken Biryani, Chicken Chilly and Dal Tadka.Keep up the good work. Will visit again once I am back in Penang.Show less

Author: yaamyns
Title: Superb
Review:
The staff were very friendly and never disappointed us, answered all our questions patiently.

The menu had a wide variety of Indian food, and the food was affordable, the portion was big, and the food tasted excellent.

Author: KandJ52628
Title: An Indian Feast
Review: A must go if you love Indian food. A feast for a very reasonable price and a very helpful waiter who advised us we were ordering too much!

Author: soubhagyajena
Title: neat n good food
Review:
cozy place with free wifi and less crowd. menus are displayed in tabs. food are yummy.

i must recommend crackling mushroom. its my fav here.
u can try mint julipe or cinnamon drink.
looking for indian platter?? try thali..it s good.

Author: onerightshoeDublin, Ireland
Title: great Indian cuisine in Penang
Review: Great Indian Cuisine, Everything we ordered was fresh tasty and flawless, with clean flavours layered with depth. The friendly staff in this simple establishment helped us to choose complementing flavours and selections and pointed out their signature dishes, although to be fair everything we had could have been a signature dish.Show less

Author: shoshanagould
Title: Delicious and friendly
Review: Found this restaurant while wandering around Little India. If you go during lunch they have a pretty incredible deal - 10R for a full meal, drink and dessert included. Everything was delicious. The staff is friendly. Free wifi. Great location.

Author: madmatg
Title: Not too expensive and delicious as well as friendly
Review: Fast, friendly, delicious.  Right on little India street.  We stopped on the way to the ferry and got in and out

Author: kjschlegel
Title: AMAZING! Some of the best food I've had in Penang.
Review: I had the chicken dinner. A wonderful curry chicken with many side dishes. All cooked to perfection! We also had the chicken 555 and aloo gobi. Seems like you can't go wrong here!!

Author: staffanh2015
Title: Good food for a good price
Review:
A restaurant with very good food for a very low price. We ate lunch and received a lunch special deal which was delicious and costed only a bit over 1 USD. 

Definitely recommended this restaurant!

Author: Aldoaldo164
Title: Great food and helpful staff.
Review: Walked in and told the waiter to recommend something. He asked me a couple questions and then came back with reallu great chicken, rice and a drink. Food is also reasonably priced. Ac throughout the room. Great experience.

Author: SPavDev
Title: Wonderful
Review: Great place. Had a treat there for my birthday. Small but convinient. Had tried mutton briyani with the wonderful lime and pudina smootie drink... Top of the world. The chilli fish was tasty

Author: Amanda ISt. John's, Canada
Title: Great Indian food in the heart of Little India
Review: We went to this place based solely on Trip Advisor reviews, but were glad we did. Upon first entering we were among the only customers, however within 10 mins every table was filled with locals - a good sign! We ordered the mint julep (delicious), veg biriyani, mutton biriyani, a chicken curry (was advised that it was the medium spicy one, but I'd say it was more med-hot), the Chinese pepper chicken, and pulled tea. Everything was exceptionally delicious, with exception of the pulled tea which I'd advise against. Definitely worth a visit - accessible and fully English menu, great food, clean and modern atmosphere with air conditioning. Also, ask for the tablet which features labelled photos of many of the menu items. Show less

Author: PenangfanaticPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Fantastic Indian food, reasonable prices!
Review: We have been here twice so far and love it. The place is clean and cool. The food is nothing short of amazing. The only thing I would recommend for first timers is to get the iPad which has pictures of the dishes, otherwise the names of the dishes might be hard to recognize. This is our new favorite Indian restaurant in Penang.Show less

Author: Stevedwards123
Title: Favourite restaurant in Penang!
Review: Have visited Penang a number of times now and can safely say that Bite N Eat is my favourite restaurant - which is saying a lot!Very friendly and welcoming staff. Helped make fantastic recommendations for both food and drink. The price is very fair considering the quality of the food and the service outstanding. Thanks again and see you next time I'm in Penang!Show less

Author: 330bradens
Title: Best Indian food outside of India
Review: Went here for lunch after several recommendations and couldn't be more impressed! The service was very polite and prompt; the staff extremely friendly; and then the food came out!We had a mixture of Chicken curry, soft-shell crab, fried corn; prawn curry, and the list goes on! It is by far the best Indian food I have ever had outside of India.I highly recommend any travellers or locals stop by! You won't regret it, and I ensure you'll be back again!Show less

Author: AnthonyCB365
Title: Great food and good service
Review: Food was of good quality and came promptly, the guy that served us recommended certain things and explained what was in them and knew what he was talking about, they bring over a tablet with all the pictures of the food which is always nice to see before you order! Get the cold Mint drink! Show less

Author: alexcafc
Title: Delicious meal - great value!
Review: We loved the food here and it is great value for money. The waiter was also super friendly and helpful with recommendations. A must visit for Indian food in Penang.

Author: NICK RCheltenham, United Kingdom
Title: Great food in the heart of Little India
Review: We had a really good meal - chicken and lamb curries with rice and chapattis. The food was really tasty and well spiced. The restaurant is very clean and modern.Service was the only let down. I note that other reviewers have praised the friendliness of the service however we found it surly. Maybe an off night and would not deter a return visit.Price - amazingly cheap.They do a great range of delicious juices and drinks - no beer or alcohol!Show less

Author: 991hannesd
Title: Sophisticated Indian food and refreshing juices
Review: More expensive than streetstall indian food, but still very cheap comparing European prices. The dishes are of very good quality. We ate the crackeling mushroom and an incredible chicken dish. They have original mix of fresh juice. With the warm weather it is nice to sit in this aircon restaurant simple but nicely decorated. They combine traditional food with modern setting including tablet to see the dishes (practical when you are not familiar with al the dishes).Show less

Author: Sati D
Title: Fabulous food in a lovely place
Review:
A treat for the taste buds in a most pleasant place.
Faultless service.
 Best in Penang. Amazing choice of authentic south indian cuisine. The staff cannot do enough to please

Author: brownbag68Geelong
Title: What a surprise - best Indian I've had
Review: I've had a lot of Indian food in my lifetime and this was the best hands down. I can't remember all the dishes as it was a month ago, but we really enjoyed the sizzling mushrooms and the amazing carrot desert that sounds quite boring, but tastes amazing. Ordering was simple as they hand you a tablet with images of all the dishes. The food was unique, service exceptional and overall it was an extremely enjoyable experience. And even if you just go here to experience Little India, it would be worth it. Excellent value too.Show less

Author: Manu J
Title: South Indian food
Review: Really south Indian spicy food had a good experience here. Tried the paratha and quite suits my taste. Tasted a bit of mutton curry which my friends ordered and was better and more flavory than I imagined. Overall a clean and nice restaurant and nice staff nice placeShow less

Author: sarrie84Toronto, Canada
Title: Good food, clean restaurant
Review: We had the fish masala, the veg biriyani, a ried rice dish and two delicious drinks. My boyfriend doesn't like spicy food, so all of these suited him just fine. They were helpful choosing dishes that would suit us both. The drinks were amazing, one with ginger, and a coconut drink. YUM! Have one of their drinks. The dessert looked great, but we were full!I recommend this place, it was clean courteous, and most important, good food. Easy to find right off the main street. Enjoy! (only 11.00 USD for all of it)Show less

Author: OneModernCoupleToronto, Canada
Title: Our first "True Indian Cuisine Experience"
Review: Bite N Eat was the first time we were introduced to authentic Indian cuisine. Our experience went outside of our usual butter chicken, and became an education in Indian spices and cuisine. From onion pakkoda to carrot halwa, and their specialty drinks (mint julipe & ginger delight) our palates were on a tour of northern India to the south and eveverywhere inbetween. At the end of it all we were served spiced coffee and delicious Indian deserts. We highly recommend it especially if you are looking for a chance to experience authentic Indian cuisine and explore the country's many flavours. Check Bite N Eat out! It's simply delicious and a must try!Show less

Author: ericbprestonVancouver, Canada
Title: Great Indian
Review: Amazing spot with great food. The staff are warm and helpful and even have iPads to show you the dishes! Great atmosphere like a modern restaurant where you can feel comfortable sitting for a long period of time. I came every night I was here in Penang after I stumbled upon it. Highly recommended.Show less

Author: amirabeeEdinburgh
Title: Tasty, authentic Indian food
Review: This is a good restaurant with a menu slightly different to the usual mamaks that you get in Penang and other parts of Malaysia. The chefs and the waiters are from India so the menu consists of authentic Indian food rather than being a fusion of Malay-Indian food like most other Indian restaurants. The food and drinks are all reasonably priced and the dishes that I ate were superb. The food can be quite spicy so ask the waiters to tone it down if you can't handle your spice. At the end of the meal I was licking my spoon and just eating the sauce, it was just that good! The drinks were very different too and I would highly recommend the mint drink!Show less

Author: Stefen S
Title: Nice little spot with great Indian food!
Review: Clean interior, kind wait staff, and great Indian food. Best chicken masala I've ever had! If you're looking for a good place to eat in Little India, look no further Suggestions; maybe a little more decor in the upstairs dining room, and some pictures/descriptions on the menu so foreigners like myself know what we're orderingShow less

Author: sauharda911
Title: Should come
Review: Service is excelent and the foods are delicious.. Not all menu items are recommended since they can be very spicy for some people.

Author: oltzaVaasa, Finland
Title: Good food and great staff
Review: This is excellent option to see the little india and after walkng around go and sit down in ac and eat awesome food. We didn't know anything about indian food so the staff helpd us to pickup meals and told us all about the indian meals. Great staff and food with descent price.Show less

Author: John Rchiang mai
Title: Bite n eat Penang
Review: We were looking for a good Indian experience and found it in Bite N Eat. Service was great with some typical Indian confusion to add to the authenticity. Food was wonderful. Great chicken curry and amazingly good Dosa. If you go do not miss the carrot halva for dessert. Served warm which is unusual but is was amazing. It was great meal and a bargain price. Thank you Bite N Eat for making our evening and thank you to the excellent young guy who served us.Show less

Author: SangkerM
Title: Above the par
Review: Diff taste of the food. But not that nice if u expect something new regarding food menu. But drinks taste good. Recommend for tea time or late dinner.

Author: jcorn9986
Title: Cheapish simple food
Review: We had three biriyani, 3 cold drinks and a tea. It was just over 60 ringits so not bad.  Service was fine and food was simple but nice.  Probably expected more as their branding outside looked promising!

Author: Armin P
Title: Very nice
Review:
Definitely one of the nicer restaurants in Georgetown, in Little India in particular. 

Good service 
Good food
Reasonable prices 
Good (modern, tasteful) atmosphere 

I can truly recommend it.

Author: Chandramohan P
Title: A Must visit place
Review: A recommended place to visit for breakfast or brunch. Like the food & ambiance.staff is also very interactive. Bit disappointed with the limited dining time, but should be good enough for one visiting one time meal.

Author: Aditi PSingapore, null, Singapore
Title: Great for breakfast!
Review: My family and I loved and kept visiting Wheeler's for breakfast. The staff were pleasant and prompt, the menu has good range and the food was consistently delicious. We really enjoyed the smoked duck benedict, customisable "breakfast on your way", paninis and pancakes. The pour over, single origin and almond milk coffees as well as the cocoa freddo were good. As a vegetarian I was really happy to see many options I could choose from! Would highly recommend!Show less

Author: Sklimshan
Title: Awesome food with friendly staff
Review: Food and drinks were superb. Ingredients were fresh and they are quite generous with the portion. Staffs were friendly and checked with us twice to find out if food were okie. Will definitely come again

Author: dizzystar1
Title: Amazing breakfast
Review: Absolutely amazing breakfast and equally good service in a clean, spacious and modern setting. My husband said it’s the best scrambled eggs he has ever had! Lots of coffee options too. Highly recommend.

Author: HelloKenthAnthonyTNAPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: The only best-fried chicken skin in town!
Review: One of my favourite place in Penang, Malaysia. The location is strategic in the heart of Georgetown, minimalist design, friendly staffs are on point. I am amazed at Wheeler’s ability to cope up with the digitally QR concept and also can directly make an order. They served a variety of foods selection and manage to localize such as Spaghetti Tom Yam. Plus, those who love cold brew also can enjoy their coffees.Honestly, I am a fan of fried chicken skin dip into the spicy local sambal makes it tastier. In addition, Chicken Marinara has always been my choice. Show less

Author: ekeat79George Town, Malaysia
Title: One of the best foods I've ever tasted!
Review: This may be just one of the many small restaurants located along the George Town Heritage Enclave, but in terms of food quality, it is really exceptional! This was only my first ever visit here... but based on the dishes that we sampled, I can't wait to come back here again!They have a unique menu that looks unconventional but yet, excellent in terms of taste and quality. Some of my recommendations are as below:1. Espresso Chicken - uniquely coffee-flavored without compromising the overall taste.2. Fisherman - one of the best battered fish & chips in town... and the portion is huge too!Overall, a great place for a date or even a gathering. Highly recommended!Show less

Author: Graeme LKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Being older ordering by a mobile app is a real pain.
Review: Three of us had to sit at adjacent tables when in other places we could sit together. The menu is very limited for breakfast when one wants only a simple continental breakfast and not wraps or complicated sandwiches. Service was satisfactory but we had to ask for basics such as cutlery and sugar.Show less

Author: bobbyong99
Title: Great place to catch up
Review: We went for lunch to check it out.  Nice set up, strict SOP , good service and good was good , too. Would definitely go back again and again

Author: Freedom64899652423
Title: Wheelers cafe and bar
Review: Great food and drinks the staff are very warm and friendly highly recommended to my family and friends to visit in penang🙂

Author: HANITHAAJEEVANDRANPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Chilling out on weekends
Review: This place is always busy and crowded on weekends. If your a person who likes the noise and hyper person that you might be a fan of this location. The staff here are very friendly and very nice. The food I would say it's just normal but the price is quite expensive. Show less

Author: Teoh Y
Title: Very Impressive Pizza
Review: Ordered two pizzas from Wheeler's through Grabfood as we wanted to try something new, and both impresses my family and I! The caponata pizza was made with a variety of fresh veges usually not found in pizzas, while the charcoal hawaiian pizza was a unique twist to the usual hawaiian pizza.Show less

Author: Sunnyteh144
Title: Best cafe in Georgetown!
Review: Or I would say one of the TOP 10 in Malaysia!? Definitely come back every time we visit Penang. Foods are superb, delicious coffees (loveee their medium light roast flavour), wonderful service and cozy pleasant vibe! I wish they open a branch in KL.

Author: alessiaaC2757OXMilan, Italy
Title: Nothing special...
Review: We had a dinner and a breakfast there. The food quality is overall good, even if the pizza is definitely not recommended (it has a strange sweet taste). If you ask for an extra ingredient they will charge you consistently. The service quality could be improved. They were a bit slow, a couple of time we felt ignored by the waiter and he wasn’t really friendly. Very nice and clean location. Show less

Author: MicheleLaRebelle
Title: My favourite restaurant in Georgetown
Review:
Delicious healthy food. Best barista. Great menu. Yummy breakfasts. Generous portions. Tasteful without being pretentious. 
Highly recommend ❤️.

Author: shakhira1982Penang Island, Malaysia
Title: Third time visit and yet never fails to impress me.
Review: So the title speaks for itself. I first visited Wheelers last year and I was happy with the portion. Oh and also definitely happy with the price The portion was a lot and the price was reasonable. I recommended to a couple of friends. Good to see that they also enjoyed the experience. All in all it is a great place to hang out with friends and family.Show less

Author: wyintkfPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Cool place, good coffee & food!
Review: Their aircon save me from the hot whether! It was very busy bt staff was attentive. The best double cheese burger in Georgetown....Coffee was Great!Espresso chicken is their signature.Weird combination but surprisingly tastes very good., nd dnt forget to try their pasta variety. Show less

Author: 164h_l_nep
Title: Good place for a quick breakfast
Review: Good place for a quick breakfast or lunch but it is still a very touristic café. The service was quick though, much appreciated.

Author: guydC1564VO
Title: Great little cafe
Review: Stumbled across Wheeler's. Love the fact the menu includes salad options and a variety of food. Smoothies and iced drinks were a hit with 2 teens. Food and drinks are dearer than street food, but I wouldn't say unreasonable.

Author: MimsawadeePatong, Thailand
Title: NEWEST FAVORITE IN LOVELANE
Review: We went to different restos and bars here in Penang but today, we tried their beer promotion and ordered the four cheese pizza. The restaurant is very clean, food is delicious, waiter speaks english well, the duo male band with long hait is very entertaining, 10/10 indeed. Deserve to be on top stop. Don't think twice. Try it!!! Show less

Author: Helma BHanoi, Vietnam
Title: The food was simply delicious!!
Review: The food was simply delicious!! There's plenty of options on the menu including a variety of Vegan dishes and drinks. The only downside was that they didn't have enough waiters to serve the amount of diners. The manager was running around trying to help out. Overall a wonderful experience. We went here twice! Show less

Author: travelingtaliaStockholm, Sweden
Title: Bad Dinner
Review: My husband ordered the Fisherman as take out and he was very disappointed. The fries and fish were both soggy and we waited quite a long time to get the food. This place is rather expensive so it was a real shame. I would not reccommend this place.Show less

Author: SimonWinkler77
Title: Great filter coffee&food
Review:
Great filter coffee. Coffee heaven. 
Delicious passion fruit smoothie!
Great food.
Good atmosphere. 
Bad music.

Author: workingnomad20
Title: Great All Day Breakfast
Review: Surprised this place isn't higher because I have always had an excellent experience here.Good menu, decent prices, free water and some of the most professional staff in all of Malaysia! The portion sizes are good too. Their next door neighbors (Holy Guacamole) should take note as their portion sizes are a joke!Anyway, back to Wheelers. Highly recommend their eggs but make sure you tell them how long they should be cooked. Uniquely for Asia they are not overdone, but may even be slightly under done for some people's taste. Worth bearing in mind. Overall this place is very good.They cook eggs really wellShow less

Author: Sasori YSingapore, Singapore
Title: Joke
Review: I have no idea how this cafe can get a tripadvisor award. I visited this place with my friend and ordered a coffee, banana pancakes and matcha lava cake. There was no ambience at all. The atmosphere was merely customers talking and staff also chatting. The coffee was extremely normal and there is nothing special about it. The banana pancakes was probably the best thing I had which might be the only thing worth ordering.The worst thing of all is probably the matcha lava cake. When I ordered the matcha lave cake, I was told that I had to wait 20 mins for it. I happily agreed. After 30 minutes, a staff came and told me that I had to wait another 10 mins. I was a bit grumpy at this point in time but I nodded in acknowledgement. After 15 mins, there was still no cake. Another staff came over and said that the kitchen accidentally broke the cake so they will make a new one for me. I politely asked if I could cancel the order since it has already been 45 mins. The staff says she will check. After another 5 mins, she came and informed me that the kitchen was already making a new one and they wanted me to wait another 10 mins for the cake. If the cake wasn't out in 10 mins, then I could cancel the order. Trying not to make things difficult for the staff, I agreed to this. Eventually, after waiting another 15 mins, the cake finally arrived. I waited more than an hour for the matcha lava cake. To make things worse, the cake was not even that good. It was too heavy and feels like they just tried to cramp as much bad matcha powder as possible into the cake. It was a disappointment and I will never be back and I discourage anyone from going.Show less

Author: christianbS2148LI
Title: Disappointing
Review: Food is an absolute joke. Unseasoned blend raw onions etc. How on earth it can have that rating. Maybe bcs the shakes look delicious. But even expensive. Wouldn't recommend that tourist trap to anyone.

Author: 343limy
Title: Nice ambience, nice food
Review: Like the Christmas decorations. Service and food was very good. Portions and price are reasonable. They do have members rewards and it’s RM12 for lifetime. Each month get special rewards provided with minimum RM30 spend.

Author: SarahChermaine03Singapore, Singapore
Title: Ambience is not up to expectation
Review: Staff are talking & chatting very loudly. Chicken salad - meat is tough. Passion fruit smoothie tastes like soursop somehow. Apart from the strong aircon, nothing I would recommend. Dining experience is not up to standard - cos there are more noise from the staff than I could hear my hubby. Not worth the money. There are cooler; more sincere cafes in Penang.Show less

Author: 928jamesy
Title: fantastic place
Review: fantastic place for breakfast, right in the hot spot of love lane! The only thing that tops the decor, service and location, which are all great, is the food! It was delicious, strongly recommended

Author: TH T
Title: Oasis
Review: It was so cool and comfortable inside this cafe. The staff were fabulous and so very helpful recommending places to visit in Georgetown. We went there several times to use the wifi, drink coffee and escape the heat.

Author: MayaR300Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Fantastic Chill Spot
Review: Decided to get a drink here early on a Saturday evening - Wheeler's did not disappoint. The bartender was great and he made us amazing cocktails. The place wasn't too packed when we were there, but looked like things were picking up by the time we were leaving (around 8.30pm). We tried their Avocado nachos, which was also great! All-in-all, a really nice place to chill out when you're in Love LaneShow less

Author: Karen M
Title: Fab mango smoothie
Review: The food here was fine (baked aubergines were done really well) but the mango smoothie is what I went back for.  Wheelers also manages to be bright and calm on a road of pre-mixed cocktail bars.

Author: HotKhongPenang
Title: Great place but busy as heck
Review: Decent food, but the food service was a bit slow on the holiday weekend when I visited. This place gets really busy on weekend mornings.

Author: WojM
Title: Great selection of coffee
Review: We only stopped there for coffee, which there is a huge selection form all over the world. Wish I would try their breakfast. It looked delicious. Very helpful staff, helped my wife fix her shoe while we were having coffee!

Author: twistwis
Title: Nice food
