Review: Sunday morning having breakfast at wheeler's cafe. Friendly staff. Nice food👍Nice environment.Very like the watermelon juiceee.

Author: Tina_evilheart
Title: Breakfast at Wheeler's
Review: The food was good and the ambiance was also very relaxing. Can take Instagram-worthy pics. The price was reasonable too. Would highly recommend this place!

Author: Danny T
Title: Delicious Food
Review: Nice place, friendly staff with delicious food located at Love Lane, Penang. If you like lively, you can stay at ground floor. if you need quiet place, you can go up 2nd floor. their staff very friendly, price not expensive.

Author: Emel J
Title: Great food and lovely staff!
Review:
Loved this place on our recent trip to Penang Island. They do a fabulous vegan nachos, great coffee and dishes suitable for all the family, with and without meat.
Really lovely, helpful staff. Go here to eat and you won’t be disappointed!

Author: HKB2011
Title: So good we had to visit twice !!
Review: The food is fantastic, the staff are amazing... had lunch there and it was so good we had to return for breakfast.. staff are accommodating to dietary requirements... the coffee’s pretty good too!!

Author: mervduniaPhnom Penh, Cambodia
Title: Two visits - one very good and one so-so
Review: A good people-watching location on Love Lane...nice food selection. Service was rather 'relaxed' on both my visits. They were busy on my first visit so forgiven. The second visit they weren't busy and service a bit lacking. Nothing wrong with taking things slowly on a holiday but a little disheartening when a service charge is applied to the bill.Show less

Author: theamakGeorge Town, Malaysia
Title: food fantastic as usual, service slowly but surely going downhill...
Review: Absolutely adore the food here, and our meal was superb (as usual), thank god for that. One of the few places in Penang that is consistent and reliable. We will definitely come again, though might be a bit biased and peek to see who's on duty beforehand. The service we received from disinterested staff yesterday was a stark contrast from what drew us to this restaurant in the first place. We were originally drawn to this place by the friendly host and cheerful, professional waiters and were shocked at how drastically things have changed in a couple of months.There is really no reason to not have anyone at the hostess stand or at least nearby. It wasn't even busy, and I highly doubt that there was some briefing going on that required all staff to gather around the bar. When we finally got a table, we were not even asked if we would like the drinks menu (again, the first time we came the host had actually asked first if we would be drinking or not, and listed ongoing promos, etc.). After ordering (waiter was probably new, so I don't blame him), our waiter didn't even bother setting the table, instead just tossed our cutlery on it. Really don't mind doing it myself, and I don't doubt the cleanliness of your tables, but it wouldn't hurt to arrange it properly on the napkin at least. Our drinks did take a bit longer to arrive, and I noticed that the sangria I ordered was in a smaller glass than usual. Didn't bother measuring the volume and it tasted pretty okay, but the long island ice tea was disgusting. One of the things I remember from my first visit here was how efficiently they cleared away our empty dishes. Would not have minded if it wasn't busy and we had a bigger table, but if you're going to split tables then at least be alert if empty plates are almost falling off. Also noticed that staff, as a whole, did not give greeting to couples (another middle aged couple and I) however cheered up greatly when a couple of girls walked in. Discrimination at its finest. After our meal we were told that no, they would not give us the bill, we would have to pay at the counter. Note that this was after it took 5 minutes to get anyone's attention in the first place (there was one guy wandering around aimlessly but he didn't seem to notice). If my memory serves me right, previously they HAVE been able to send the bill to my table, and even told me to double check first, on A BUSY WEEKEND NIGHT. A minor thing, but still, I'm confused. Look, I have no qualms with serving myself, setting my own table, or paying at the counter. I wouldn't have such high expectations of wheeler's if I hadn't been so impressed the first time round. Perhaps if unable to train new staff then seniors shouldn't be so astoundingly brilliant and professional. Appalled by how different things are now, but the food is really very good.Cheers. Show less

Author: maximigiuMelbourne, Australia
Title: Fancy affordable food
Review: We were lucky to find out about this cafe right when we arrived, so it was our place to go. It was a similar price than restaurants in the area and offered much more. The place is already welcoming, the staff members also do a good work being kind and effective. The food was delicious and creative and the quantities were fair. We also liked that they rule was to not serve straws, meaning they are quite eco-conscious which is hard to find in Penang.Show less

Author: ricardo_teeuwenGreymouth, New Zealand
Title: For a specialty coffee not good enough
Review: To begin with; we ordered a long black and an double espresso (brazil single origin). The long black was'nt made as a long black but an americano unfortunately. The espresso beans should taste like dark chocolate, but was more soury and thin. Tasted under-extracted unfortunately. I think this may not happen with these prices! I am willing to pay more for a good specialty coffee, but not for a mediocre coffee! Show less

Author: Evelyn K
Title: Good Western Cuisine
Review: Love their pizza and deep fried squids.  Friendly and helpful staff which makes dining cool and pleasant

Author: emolot80Kampala, Uganda
Title: Yummy food
Review: This place offers fabulous food and coffees. The service was great, very attentive staff. We had a kids cheese and ham toastie and a Mexican breakfast wrap. Lots of power outlets too available for work or charging your phone. Was well worth the visit, left with a fully charged phone and a very full tummy.Show less

Author: StuB704
Title: Great spot!
Review: We visited Miller's a few times during our stay in Penang. It's situated in Love Lane, so is a great place to start the evening and people watch whilst having your meal. Great live singers in the evening too. The food was really good, and although slightly more expensive than some restaurants, is still really cheap for Westerners. Would definitely recommendShow less

Author: tohxinruSingapore, Singapore
Title: Espresso Chicken and Coffee Pudding
Review: The cafe was pretty, and we were able to take photos freely as we were the only people seated on the second floor. The waiter was friendly and gave us food recommendations. We especially enjoyed the espresso chicken and coffee pudding as they were rather unique concepts and tasted good. The chocolate and matcha lava cakes were disappointing as they were overbaked and the filling did not flow out. Nonetheless, the staff readily acknowledged our feedback.Show less

Author: ccliarobertPenang Island, Malaysia
Review: Food is awesomeeee. Loved it. The avacado salmon is a must try. And of cos their cold brew latte as well. The service staff are friendly.. My second visit and I have become their member. Quite pricey but no complaints when the food and service is good!Show less

Author: aacoyaa
Title: So good!
Review:
Very good breakfast, nice and clean tables and great layout. 
Really nice staff and quick service and food.

Author: George144CLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Full House With good food and service!!
Review: We went on the morning and it was full house and super pack. The crew arranged us a table and we had order Burrito and Smoked salmons avocado, the crew explained to us that the kitchen is busy and it will take approximately 30mins to serve and we are okay for that, after 20mins we were surprised that the food serve to us even with such busy crowd. We have to emphasise that the burrito taste superb as my gf like it so much!!! The coffee also taste the best among of our trip. We strongly recommend to visit Wheelers!!Show less

Author: chauthornAarhus, Denmark
Title: Ordered two paninis. Served more than 20 minutes apart
Review: Went with my gf to get paninis for lunch. I got mine after 5 minutes or so. 5-10 minutes later came our smoothies.Then another 10 minutes before the second panini came.The staff did apologize, but I noticed the same trend with the 3 tables around us (one person without food, the rest done with theirs).I give it two stars because the paninis were good.OH yeah - don't sit next to the speakers if possible. It's loud (above conversation-level). Show less

Author: rylskov
Title: Bad service, low quality
Review: We have been here with my wife and it was terrible. There are only 2 vegan options in the menu. Dishes was so-so, are not the worst but I hope I will never eat these again.The range of soft drinks is very scarce. For example, there is no good tea like Oolong or Puer. Only Earl Gray and another but similar quality.Very crowded, tables are very small, not cozy, too loudy, and the road is very close. Service was very slow.Extra tax 6% was added to prices.Maybe for alco-party on the road this place not is bad but not for us.Show less

Author: hovnav
Title: Portions are too big
Review: Tasted pretty good but really thought the portions were way too big. Ordered the vegan sandwich for breakfast and came as two whole sandwiches and fries. That much food is actually quite off putting.

Author: geraldchanSingapore, Singapore
Title: Great live band
Review: The bar/pub stands out on this stretch of pubs for its live band - singer has great vocals and promise, and she took our song requests gamely. Small issue is that the only other bar/pub with a live band is just located next to it, so the music can get a little hard to hear at times.Happy hour prices lasted to 10pm.Show less

Author: Maryam Q
Title: Awesome
Review: The food is amazing. They have vegan and vegetarian options, and the food came quickly. Coffee is also great. The vegan nachos are to die for, whether or not you're vegan. Will definitely come here again.

Author: samchan94
Title: So Good.
Review: Celebrate mum's birthday today. Wheeler's the busiest cafe i ever seen. Anyway the food is tasty, the hot latte smell good n i love it. The service is good n friendly. Keep it up guys. ;)

Author: x1nh0ngt
Title: Great service and nice food
Review:
The waiter there are friendly. And they give a good recommendation on the menu. Good service from the service crew👍👍
And the food is super duper nice😋😋

Author: Melanie49669
Title: What a disappointment
Review: 1. Food looks great in the menu but taste was average (cheeseburger way too beefy, fries no good taste). Overall too expensive for what you get.2. Service was too slow (staff was very busy but obviously not enough people). After waiting 35 min waiting for a dish we‘ve cancelled and left.Show less

Author: jhudsonnn
Title: Loved the staff, loved the food
Review: From the start, the entire staff collectively welcomes you and promptly offers you a table. This was very warming! We caught a Grab from the airport straight here to eat breakfast which was delicious (we had breakfast meal #1). The food came quick and was lovely to start the day with. Great place to go for familiar dishes if you are unsure about local, traditional meals.Show less

Author: JSP_TravelsKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Lively restaurant with average food
Review: There’s live music.Went for dinner on Friday evening, the pizzas were okay, we had the charcoal and pepperoni ones. The chicken in marinara sauce was so-so, sauce was tasty but chicken bland.Do not recommend that you sit outside by the street as there was a never ending stream of cars passing by during the weekends. The exhaust fumes were bad. Also the restaurant next door is a shisha cafe, so be prepared for the smoke.As it gets later in the evening, it’s very noisy as a number of cafes on the street have live bands performing simultaneously. Show less

Author: adventuree_seeker
Title: Really casual coffe bar
Review: I was looking for fast internet through Penang and this place totally meet my expectations. Downloading 400mb in 3min is amazing, can be busy and of course speed will drop but again better than most of the bars I've been on. Good choice of food and coffee as well. Staff Lee was extra polite. For sure I will come back.Show less

Author: mairead_mooneyIreland
Title: Decent food although order not fulfilled... twice.
Review: We came to wheelers for breakfast. The Café was nice and the front house staff were pleasant. We ordered a salmon bagel and toasted bagel with poached eggs. I asked for my eggs to be cooked 'medium'. When the dish arrived out it was slightly wet on top from the outer layer of the egg and when I cut into it ... the yolk and water flowed all around the plate. We asked if we could get the eggs done again... they returned minutes later... I cut into the eggs and could see the clear egg white flow on my plate. Needless to say I didn't eat them! However, The bagels and coffee were really good. Show less

Author: MidlandsArttravelShenton Park, Australia
Title: Nice service but very average food
Review: The cafe/ bar is clean and nicely presented. The staff were friendly and attentive. Unfortunately the night we were there her were no pizzas..no dough apparently..go figure...so half the menu was missing..my wife had a pasta with sauce that tasted like it came for a jar and I had a tasteless piece of chicken. Fine I guess if you have to have European food but generally dissapointingShow less

Author: aussierovermelbourne australia
Title: A Good Feed
Review: Been here many times before, last about 9 months ago. It has been updated since then. It's now much more open with a bigger kitchen and upstairs eating area via a spiral staircase.The menu has more emphasis on pizzas but apart from that, hasn't changed a great deal.Penne in basil sauce remains the best in Penang and the House sandwich with chicken, egg, cheese, salad and a rather too sweet (for me anyway) chutney served with a small side of chips and pickled vegetables was large and tasty.Coffee also remains of high standard.Prices are competitive for what is on offer at other places for similar items.Just a small minus-music can be a bit loud at times.We will be back again.Show less

Author: Seville2Cheadle, United Kingdom
Title: Classy joint on backpack road
Review: I love a back packer bar, and this little road has lots of good ones but this place sticks out as a more sophisticated place. It's the only place on the road that doesn't try to entice you in with happy hour, and the drinks and food are sophisticated and hip. Very nice...staff are lovely..xShow less

Author: McaffsPhuket, Thailand
Title: Worth a visit
Review: Good food, service , toilets and fast wifi. Not a surprise it is the only one full of customers. Why the 15 or so empty establishments surrounding it on love lane do not try and learn something from here is beyond me. Steak frites at the other end of the street is the only other little gem worth a visit.Show less

Author: michels518
Title: Awesome!
Review: At least one of the best kitchen -especially pizza- in Asia combined with an awesome service. Prices are even low in relation to the quality.

Author: AdrianRajOslo, Norway
Title: Nice place for a breakfast
Review: Super friendly and nice place to go for a breakfast. Great coffee and juice, definitely highlights! Only semi-bad thing was that on the classic breakfast they had poured syrup over parts of the pancakes, bread and scrambled eggs already. Not everyone likes scrambled eggs with syrup I guess. Show less

Author: MaritaP288
Title: Great vibe. Live band. Great food.
Review: Cool place for dinner. Great vibe and food. Really friendly and fast service. In Love Lane so generally good vibe aroun

Author: Januarytyp
Title: casualty wear to avoid hot weather
Review: Nice food, but it is open restaurant. Very hot in the afternoon. Better wear casualty to avoid sweating.

Author: ggtrees91
Title: Really Good Place
Review: Greta food and great service.  Very chilled place good menu and very relaxed.  There is obviously much competition between the other restaurants but they all respect one another whites great.

Author: Helen WQuorn, United Kingdom
Title: Surprisingly good pizza and pasta!
Review: Decided to give this place a go to make a change from rice and noodles. Its located on one of the busier tourists lanes and nice to sit outside and people watch. I had a salmon pasta dish which was packed with flavour and better than a lot of the pasta I have had back in England. My boyfriend had one of their charcoal pizzas which looks burnt when it arrives but isn't, it's just the charcoal that makes it look black. This was also very tasty with generous cheese topping. Good service too even though fairly busy, would definitely recommend if you fancy a change from the local dishes and reasonably priced for the quality.Show less

Author: domidiusKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: beautiful!
Review: I last visited Wheelers about a year or two ago...post-renovation, the place looks more modern, the decor on the lower floor and the upper floor are contrasting... I was there for dinner on Friday the 22nd, sat on the lower floor, it was dimly lit, perfect for the romantic dinner I was attending... on Saturaday the 23rd I was there for drinks post-dinner with friends, we sat upstairs as we were a group of 12 people... it was brightly lit, the decor felt welcoming, and conducive for conversations... honestly, I'd have prefer a bright environment for dinner and a dim environment for drinking...food was good, my favourite is the pesto pasta, unfortunately the coconut latte I had in previous visits there have been discontinued from their menu...drinks aren't too bad, reasonably priced (a bit pricey by local standards to be honest), and a good selection...Show less

Author: bjkahansen
Title: A pleasant retreat from the heat
Review: Great selection and service. Prices are reasonable and happy hour lasts a long time. Lots of options for cooling off on a hot day and simple, tasteful decor.

Author: gibbons65Hamilton, Canada
Title: Clean, Bright and Tasty
Review: We discovered Wheelers the first day we were in Penang and have eaten there once a day for the last week. The food is excellent, fresh and with enough variety that my husband, a vegetarian, and I had lots of choices. We sat at the bar and watched in amazement at the skill and variety of the drinks their very competent staff can make:fresh mango, watermelon, green apple as well as great coffee and a full range of liquor. Clean, bright and tasty.Show less

Author: TravellerSCK80
Title: WHEELER'S
Review: Visited this morning, is full of crowd. Everything is perfect from the staffs, food and coffee. The coffee is the best that I ever try during my trip in Penang, we ordered again and again. Thanks Wheeler's, keep it up!

Author: CanmoreFunkyDudeCanmore, Canada
Title: Good quality, great service, tiny toast.
Review: I usually avoid restaurants on tourist trap streets, and this one certainly qualifies, but it was a very hot afternoon, and they had great aircon.....The place is clean, well staffed, and comfortable. The menu offers basic western style food, chicken, fish, pizza, pasta etc, with an all day breakfast selection (yes they have bacon!), and decent coffee choices. I had the fish and chips, which turned out to be a generous portion of lightly battered (and not at all greasy!) tilapia fillets, with french fries and salad. It would have been nice if they had offered ketchup and/or tartar sauce instead of the sweet lemony mayo concoction, that reminded me of Dutch Calve Frite Sauce. I asked for extra lemon, he brought one small wedge, cradled on a dish like it was a gold bar, I’m surprised it didn’t come on a velvet cushion. I didn’t dare ask for another wedge. It was a good feed though, and satisfied my latent craving for fried food. I came back another day and had the Spaghetti Aglio Olio, which was very good, served with the tiniest portion of garlic toast I have ever seen. I have had larger pieces of Melba toast! You can eat a good meal here for less than MYR 45, including drink, tax and tipShow less

Author: Desinggi
Title: The right place to be with the right coffee
Review: The ambience of this place peaks in the morning or late afternoon or early evening and when matched with right coffee or tea, this place truly sparks the chill mood in you.my wife loved wheelers and this time I'm bringing over my whole family!

Author: ZiggyStarkPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: 5mm Creme (crime) brulee
Review: Creme brûlée was a disappointment, the spoon scraped the ramekin. The taste was fine but since they had to torch the sugar to caramel the dessert the creamy part below the caramel became soggy.. if they had increased the portion of this actual dessert, I would have given this a higher rating.. but I’m disappointed.However the mushroom soup I had here was much better.. Show less

Author: Jean G
Title: Average
Review: The location of this cafe is in a tourist infested area studded by a couple of different other cafes that are about the same. I had breakfast and mocha frappe. the quantity is decent for the price tag. Taste was ok, nothing to wow about. Coffee was also average. the outdoor seating was too cramped.Show less

Author: l0usb
Title: avocado and poached egg <3
Review: fresh juices, good coffee and wide ranges of good breakfast/lunch dishes!  avocado and poached egg ... you gotta love it! oh and good serice

Author: sneha0202Hyderabad, India
Title: A lovely cafe in lovelane
Review: This place has lip smacking delicious and amazing food and not so heavy on pocket too. I loved the eggs your way they offer. The white iced coffee in a bottle was to die for. best coffee i had in malaysia. We loved the sweet potato fries, the cheesecake and the salads. Must visit.Show less

Author: rainybaxx36
Title: In love!!!
Review: Ohhh. This is love at first bite! I really highly recommend their espresso chicken chop and matcha creme brulee! Located right at Love Lane, Wheeler's Coffee 😍😍😍

Author: O3312MBalexc
Title: Place to relax
Review:
Ordered a cappuccino and sweet potatoe fried so I can’t review on other food.
Both are good to my tastebud. The staffs are friendly. Reasonable price

Author: Hotelier_from_AUS
Title: Best coffee in George Town
Review: If it is coffee you are after, this is the place to be. Good location for people watching onLove Lane and the food was good as well.

Author: SalahA1793
Title: ‘ Amazing please ‘
Review: Tasty coffee..., Amazing food..., very lovely and friendly staff..., definitely is the best place to have your relaxing time....

Author: Joep BAmsterdam, The Netherlands
Title: Nice place to go for breakfast
Review: This typical backpackers hangout situated on love lane offers nice western style food for like wise prices. The place lacks a bit of ambiance due to the glass doors that split the restaurant in an airco and non-airco area. If you’re looking for a more quiet place to go for breakfast/lunch, I can recommend the pitstop cafe, just a block awayShow less

Author: Maria S
Title: Best cafe - healthy options - very accommodating of food allergies
Review: Of my 5 days in George Town I ate here every day (sometimes twice a day).I have a number of food allergies which prevents me from eating a lot of the amazing looking street food but Wheelers were really accommodating and tweeked almost every dish I ordered. Staff were brilliant - unfortunately I didnt get any of their names. Good size portions and all day bruch. Lots of healthy options. Show less

Author: 247stens
Title: Cosy place!
Review: We only went there for a drink but really enjoyed it! It has a nice interior and friendly staff. They have nice cocktails and a nice selection of local and European beers.

Author: herwanderlustlens
Title: Halal Cafe In Penang, great cafe in Georgetown
Review:
➨ Wheeler’s Coffee
     *hang out with traditional bike-arts; Darts Machine 傳統的自行車藝術; 飛鏢機

Wheeler's Cafe is one of the cafe nested in Love Lane... 
have great coffee, food and have fun with ur friends with darts ...

Author: Stella MCroydon, United Kingdom
Title: Best coffee I had in Malaysia
Review: Went to this cafe after reading the reviews. Did not disappoint! Great selection of vegetarian dishes, as well as meat. Best coffee I had in Malaysia for the two weeks I was staying (I travelled around different places). Berry smoothie was also delicious - tasted like ice cream. Highly recommend.Show less

Author: SamuelAlexandreSao Paulo, SP
Title: Frustrating
Review: By the reviews I had read it seemed to be a good place, but the food is not much, the loud sound becomes stressful and the staff kept making jokes about customers behind their backs what I thought is really disrespectful. I will never go back there.Show less

Author: anshuman m
Title: Best Cafe in George Town
Review:
This cafe is situated at Love Lane. They offer a variety of western food and drinks.
Staff is friendly, ambiance is good, food is awesome and overall experience is fantastic.
A must try when you are at George town.

Author: jonatanb844
Title: Great!
Review: Food (had a salmon steak) was delicious, great atmosphere and superb staff! So friendly and helpful, yet relaxed! Highly recommended!

Author: 360angelasKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: After dinner drinks
Review: We wanted to go to Holy Guacamole but the place was full so we came here instead . Lovely band here . The cocktail tho needs to be better . Either too much guava juice or too little gin such that it was undectectable. I give their staff top marks tho for explaining this to us . Tho clearly quite frazzled and busy the staff were still friendly . I would come again. Show less

Author: Lou S
Title: Best Cafe in Georgetown
Review: The Coffee & Food are so delicious and value for money. We ordered for their premium single origin latte and espresso chicken, it was surprisingly great, We will definitely come back again & again.

Author: Tygon C
Title: Nice and lovely coffee!!
Review: For me, is is really suitable for teenagers. It's both quiet but fun enough for the young people. You can come in groups for studying, discussing, or you can come here alone, both are OK. The prices are quite high if compare with the bars along the street, but it's worthy, it's another style for you to see. I extremely love the decorations here. Guests can draw in a paper cup and display in the coffee shop. I took the photos of the cups and the wheels on the ceiling.Show less

Author: Darron1970
Title: Lovely lunch
Review: We popped in for a late lunch. My partner had a vegetable panini which she liked whilst I had the Fisherman which was delicious. There is free wifi if that is important to you. We loved this place and very friendly staff too.

Author: YeeChuin27Taiping, Malaysia
Title: Prefers the Lunch Set Combo
Review: The salmon spaghetti is creamy and with chunks of grilled salmon and olives. Lunch set comes together with a scoop of ice-cream and iced lemon tea. A charming place for a treat after a long walk in the town. Friendly staffs. Also has free cold lemon waterShow less

Author: davidbaker72
Title: Great coffee and service
Review: Simply great atmosphere and excellent coffee in a handy location to Chulia St. We had coffee only but looked like a reasonable food selection too.

Author: lindy1993Amsterdam, The Netherlands
Title: The place you dream about when missing good Western food
Review: If you have been in Asia for a while, this place is the one you sometimes dream about and wish for. I tried a few sandwiches and pastas, and they were all of high quality. Fresh ingredients, awesome tasty combinations. The drinks are delicious as well and the staff is friendly. A bit pricy, but worth it for sure!Show less

Author: TwoAccountantsonTourLondon, United Kingdom
Title: A must visit for coffee lovers staying in the Love Lane area!
Review: Wheeler’s ended up being our go to place for the daily coffee we require to function! When we visit new places, we like to try out local, independent coffee shops and this one didn’t disappoint. Good food, fresh juices and excellent coffee! The staff are friendly and efficient and we didn’t have to wait too long at all for anything we ordered despite the place being full. Overall, a nice little spot for a relaxing breakfast or lunch!Show less

Author: noranee
Title: Finally some vegan food!
Review: I came from Langkawi where it is pretty hard to find some animal-free food. Just walked by these coffee and saw that they have vegan food. It was really good and the prices are super fair!

Author: ClaireC4647Singapore
Title: Drinks to end the night
Review: Went with my family of 5 for some drinks. We got the milk tea, black tea and a few smoothies. Drinks tasted good but nothing too fantastic, it was reasonably priced. Overall it was a relaxing place which is clean and tidy. The waiter was nice too. I have nothing negative to say!Show less

Author: 971danpBeverley, United Kingdom
Title: Lovely cafe, good cake, amazing WiFi!!!
Review: We just wanted the super fast WiFi, we'd heard this was the best in town! Malaysia and George Town in particular has issues with internet speed, but this was super fast and without doubt the best in town.Good coffee and nice cakes too. Polite and relaxed staff, chilled out cafe.Highly recommended.Show less

Author: 591gwendadNewcastle upon Tyne, United Kingdom
Title: Understated but great food
Review: We stopped in here as were looking for something to eat that looked quite easy. We had pesto pasta and king prawn pasta followed by chocolate cake. Also had 2 beers, 1 wind and 2 coffees and bill was less than £20. Not just that...it was delicious. Show less

Author: Steviekerr88Newmarket, United Kingdom
Title: Good food and coffee!
Review: Lovely cafe with just a lovely food and coffee. Ample of food to Alecia from breakfast bagels to fajitas. We had the vegan bagels with smoked salmon and was delicious with their hash browns garnish. Coffee was at an excellent standard too. Service was good and friendly. We also liked the chilled background music. Show less

Author: matthopkins1991
Title: Lovely little cafe
Review: Really cool vibe, super clean, nice staff. The food and coffee was amazing. Large menu and a lot of options. Poached eggs, a bagel, bacon and a latte for 5 British Pounds. Unreal. Wish I discovered this place sooner than on my last day.

Author: jlssmrd
Title: Awesome
Review: Lovely little restaurant located in a side street of Lebuh Chulia. Fajitas were nice and spicy Korean chicken wings were very good! I highly recommended you give this place a visit when you’re in the neighborhood!

Author: Natasha E
Title: Fajitas
Review: Chicken fajitas where nice, healthier option than most in Penang and good value. However missing some off the fajita spices. Nice atmosphere and free water.

Author: songlines
Title: Western style cafe with almost Western prices
Review: If you love bicycles and a familiarity with your favorite neighborhood cafe in USA or Europe, then this place is for you.

Author: ThomasFromEarthKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Okay place
Review: Wheeler's sells some of the best western style coffee around town. The staff is usually friendly and the place looks good and clean. They serve some good food here but not all dishes are good. They have nice live music a lot and the vibe is good here. The menu is a bit overpriced though..Show less

Author: clarebJ2451LZGeelong, Australia
Title: Great food!
Review: Our family of 4 dined here for brunch.The vibe is great - very Melbourne!!Fit out is well done.Staff are friendly and seem genuinely happy with their job.Cute coffee too with art in our latte and cappuccinos- very sweet.Coffee could be a little stronger, but still very good.Bagels are scrumptious!!We ordered:- Vegan bagel with cream cheese and jam. Yummmmmo! - 2 x serves of the chicken fajitas for the kids which they LOVED! Great serving size for kids or for an adult if not super hungry.- Apple turkey bacon bagel for husband. He really enjoyed it. Said it was different eating apple in a bagel, but still very good.Also ordered fresh OJ, yoghurt mango smoothie. Fresh and delicious!!Coffees and affogato - big hit!!!Bill came to $40AUD. Not cheap, but very reasonable for what we all had!!Keep up the great work!! Show less

Author: Karen N
Title: Good food and environment
Review: My first visit here, Had coffee, aglio olio pasta and chicken sandwich, was really good. Great environment  with great service. Will  surely come back!

Author: 165hanspetersDusseldorf, Germany
Title: Not delicious at all
Review: A example for a not good western cafe in town. - or if I see all the other comments we ordered the wrong dishes. We had the chicken fajitas- nearly without a sauce it wasn't delicious at all. Completely dried out. We also had the cheese omelette with spinach and onions - the cheese was a classy sandwich-toast slice who just laid on top off the omelette. That looked just disgusting. To my tea I asked after some honey - We had to pay it extra ... after 4 days in penang the only cafe that wants sth.... We don't go there again. And it even is pretty expensive for Penang. Show less

Author: Erica Y
Title: Tiny place with huge choices!
Review: They got so many things to offer. Foods, snacks, drinks, coffee, salads and even cakes! I was confused what to order but I ended up with fruits bowl and iced latte. I would not say its pricey, bcs i got huge bowls of fruits! I paid USD5 for a bowl of fruits and coffee! Show less

Author: JayKayDay
Title: Delicious drinks tasty food
Review: I enjoyed the banana smoothy immensely, and the poached eggs over sweet potato mash was a fun, creative treat.  The menu was a bit limited in choices but what I tasted was really great, as was the service.

Author: Regina_Lum
Title: Great food; Great environment
Review: I was here for dinner and they serve good coffee and a variety of ala carte choices on their menu, and also a selection of cakes. The staffs were friendly and there was not a long wait for the food to arrive.

Author: Melanie BCrewe, United Kingdom
Title: Ok food, awful & rude staff - money talks!!
Review: The staff had the audacity to ask us to move where we were sitting so a bigger group of people could sit where we were sitting instead. WHILE WE WERE EATING, AND THERE WERE PLENTY OF OTHER PLACES TO SIT TO ACCOMODATE THE SIZE OF THEIR PARTY! So very rude! We moved out of courtesy but would not go again!!!!! I even mentioned to the member of staff how rude she was and she just shrugged it off. The food is ok but is over priced for what you get and there are better place around. Give this one a miss!!Show less

Author: BakerS1980
Title: Cheaper than most
Review:
Great coffee,  good prices. 

Ended up here on my last day and it was refreshing to get a coffee and crossiant for a decent price. Also., the air con really helped :)

Author: Qunhui
Title: Nice food and service here...
Review: I came here for few times..nice place to come and have nice staff and delicious food here. The price is reasonable, too. It is highly recommended to have dinner here.

Author: dashlye2010Penang Island, Malaysia
Title: Great place to chill out
Review: Good and friendly service. Nice environment with live band on Fri and Sat. Food and drinks were good too, especially the chocolate lava cake. Was informed the cake burst while baking and offered to make a new one but have to wait 20mins. Can join as life time member for RM12 only and redeem monthly offer if spent above RM30. Have 5/10% discount for purchase above RM30/50 respectively. Free dessert on birthday month. Show less

Author: TimDVRPortimao, Portugal
Title: Relaxing place, good food
Review: Came here to have breakfast and wasn’t disappointed. The classic breakfast comes with turkey bacon and chicken sausage which I really liked. Less greasy than pork. Quick, friendly service, good menu, reasonable prices, and a good location make this an excellent breakfast spot for travellers located at Chulia Street. Show less

Author: Lynn S
Title: Friendly staff
Review: Good place to chill. The red velvet latte was pretty. Coffee lovers should ask for it with espresso added.

Author: millietan01
Title: For food lovers
Review: A nice place to relax and enjoy good food! The pasta is well seasoned and the waitresses are very helpful 🤗

Author: 429hannahq
Title: Really good breakfast!
Review: Lovely cafe serving great food and drinks. I had poached eggs and avocado on toast which was really tasty and a good portion!

Author: maiswoods
Title: Great coffee and cake
Review: I visited here twice, once with a friend for coffee and cake - carrot cake and latte came to just over 20rm and they were good! Second time I came and had the Wheelers big breakfast, it really was huge! Everything on the board was great, and caters to halal as it’s chicken sausage and turkey bacon. Really recommend this place, next time I’m back in penang I’ll be trying more from the menu! Show less

Author: WeiShenC3
Title: Great Place To Have Breakfast!
Review: Comfortable environment with friendly service. Food is awesome too! Having my Breakfast here on weekend, relaxing on cozy environment with a nice cup of coffee. They also serve nice pizza!

Author: FernandaMtz23
Title: Nice coffee shop
Review: Enjoyed a nice coffee ir aircon. Good carrot cake too. Would recommend for a chill out time. Like the style :)

Author: Nichelle L
Title: Sweet cozy café
Review: Very nice place to have brunch, the place are cozy and the staff are very friendly and they have many food option in their menu card 😁

Author: LauY214
Title: Coffee Time
Review: Great place to gather all people and nice taste of coffee. Nice service and superb beverages and foods.

Author: Ho T
Title: Having lunch
Review: Good environment and good food , convenient for parking, just park beside the restaurant and pay RM3/hour

Author: annekoh888
Title: Nice cafe with interesting variety of coffee
Review: Nice deco with interesting variety of coffee. Cosy and wifi speed is fast. Good for a chill out afternoon

Author: Choy Fun N
Title: Nice food and place
Review: The food is very nice and the environment also good for having dinner with family or friends. Highly recommended.

Author: charlotte8284
Title: Cozy place and nice food
Review: It's a good place to chill out with friends and family. The food is nice and we love it. Will definitely visit again.

Author: Cherv75
Title: Decent place with nice music
Review: We came here in the morning. We ordered Let’s Rock Sandwiches and Espresso Chicken. Yes, Espresso chicken in the morning . Let’s Rock Sandwiches is decent. Like normal sandwich. If we were to choose again, perhaps We will order something more special. Espresso chicken is covered with cream sauce and a small cup of espresso. The cream sauce comes with a tinge of espresso taste with some espresso powder on top of the chicken. Something different and quite special. See photos attached.We sat outside the cafe as we felt the ambience is more relaxing. We enjoyed our morning here. We felt like we are in Thailand. Relaxing day. Show less

Author: Adam N
Title: Visit lovelane at gorge town
Review: The food presentation and variety is good but for the coffee would recommend to take hot drinks.. try to chicken mariana, hawaian pizza, big breakfast and the salmon oli..

Author: brendapN4523JL
Title: Cozy environment
Review: It's a very friendly cafe to visit. Can feel the warmness of the staffs and the food is delicious! Highly recommended to friends and family small gathering :)

Author: LeeR2684
Title: Great hangout spot
Review: Good place to chill around with family and friends. Nice food. Nice coffee. Nice enviroment.Nice services

Author: xhong90
Title: Relax place
Review:
It is a relaxing place. I like it very much. I drink banana mocha, eat cakes.

It is a wonderful place.

Author: Annabelle40Sydney, Australia
Title: Terrific coffee!
Review: Always on the look out for good coffee when travelling, PK and I were delighted to visit Wheelers Coffee and discover exactly that. Barista Yee Man is enthusiastic about her coffee and has even competed so there’s a fair indication of what to expect. We haven’t tried the food....yet, but we’ll be back for more coffee so that will be on the list! Show less

Author: NikkiL1439
Title: Favourite place for brunch
Review: Cosy environment. Great place to hangout with family and friends for relaxing brunch on lazy weekends.

Author: Ivy L
Title: Morning Breakfast
Review: 1st time dining with friend for breakfast. Good coffee with nice environment. Friendly customer service.

Author: KeXinT11
Title: Good coffee and good food
Review: The Chocolate Chips Belgian waffle, double chocolate cake and caffe freddo are my favourite. 😋 Definitely worth visiting.

Author: lucyc405
Title: Amazing breakfast
Review: Great coffee, customer service and breakfast. I had the mashed pumpkin and poached egg with crispy ham on toasted baguette...amazing! Definitely recommend.

Author: MinghuiC23
Title: November holiday
Review: Comfort cafe with cosy place. Great to be here during holidays. ☺️Good place to chill around with great coffee!

Author: Sydney HPrague, Czech Republic
Title: Amazing! Good vibes, coffee and food
Review: We came here twice we liked it so much. Food is delicious and coffee is too. Try the banana mocha iced coffee. Georgetown is known for its delicious foods, so make sure to get out and try some authentic dishes, but when you need good Western food this is 100% the place to come.Show less

Author: travellingKarrieG
Title: Quirky bike-themed with good air-con and Wi-Fi
Review: Good service with friendly staff. Comprehensive menu although it's a shame to eat bland western food in George Town...

Author: TanP490
Title: Best in Penang Island.......
Review: Very comfort ambience, Very nice food especially the espresso chicken, Yummy!😉😉would come back again .....

Author: SeanK2622
Title: Good vibes
Review: Very good ambience. Warm and cozy. Good food. Recommend the aglio olio for those who like simple but flavorful food.

Author: LokeC29
Title: The bread is really good
Review: The big breakfast set is very satisfying. Surprisingly, the bread is really good. Not to forget to mention nice ambience for a chilled out spot.

Author: P4289YXdavidt
Title: Good food at affordable price
Review: Try the espresso chicken. It's very different but still yummy. Worthwhile to become a member. Monthly freebies, discount and birthday desert.

Author: Bella23232323
Title: Awesome
Review:
Lovely place, seating inside and out. A great range of dishes including cooked breakfasts, vegetarian and vegan options. 
Great staff and really welcoming, ate here pretty much everyday during my visit.

Author: LimS389
Title: Love their wifi speed and food!
Review: If you urgently need a cozy and peaceful place to complete your task on your electrical device, Wheeler's Coffee definitely is your first choice! If they could repair their PU leather seat (a bit worn out...) that would definitely increase the comfy level here! Of course they have a lot of mouth watering food too! I have tried the Espresso Chicken which is so nice and different from you can get from other cafe! Will come back again! =)Show less

Author: Jade S
Title: I love Wheeler's Coffee
Review: After a long day work, we visited Wheeler Coffee at Love Lane to had our dinner. The food so delicious and the aroma of the coffee smell so good. Special compliments to Ms. KF. She so friendly and she always remember us and the staffs friendly as well. Thanks KF.Show less

Author: YongYongG1
Title: Dinner
Review: My favourite cafe! The best cafe in town! A definitely must visit place if you are at Georgetown area!

Author: Pedley7
Title: Amazing Coffee & Food
Review: Wheeler’s Coffee is a really nice little place. Eaten here twice now and it’s been brilliant both times, the coffee is excellent as well! Had the Let’s Rock Sandwiches and highly recommend them as well as the Oreo Cheesecake! Will definitely be back again!

Author: jasmine cLeeds, United Kingdom
Title: Delicious lunch on love lane
Review: After exploring Penang street art we visited wheelers coffee for lunch. It’s a lovely coffee shop located on love lane and is extremely clean!! We ordered A Frappe, let’s rock sandwich with wedges and pumpkin soup. All the meals are extremely fresh and good portion sizes. The bill came to 40 which we believe to be excellent value. We cannot wait to come back & sample more of the menu ☺️Show less

Author: Dario O
Title: Absolutely delicious
Review: After so many tasty but heavy Indian meals in Georgetown, the two pasta dishes I had at Wheeler's hit the sweet spot. Rich but light with a tiny hint of chili, amazing pesto and salmon pasta, highly recommend them both!

Author: ThenK7
Title: Nice place
Review: A nice place to hangout with friends. Nice environment, clean and friendly staff! Unique and love interior  design. Simple yet nice. Recommended place for hangout with friends.

Author: GaryGT12
Title: Good food in coffee shop
Review: Have been here for quite a few times, my friend and I enjoy the food and coffee here a lot. The food is delicious with reasonable price.

Author: sarahhopkins18
Title: Best Coffee Shop in Penang
Review: This is the best coffee shop I have visited in Penang! Has great WiFi and good music selection. As well as good coffee and food.

Author: connorl262
Title: Wheelers coffee
Review: A lovely coffee house. Good coffee and friendly staff. We havent eaten but the food menu looks good too!

Author: Dsgsmith
Title: Delicious food, chilled atmosphere and great service!
Review: We were looking for a break from the street food (even though it is delicious- sometimes you just crave something else) and this place was perfect. The coffee is great, our food came quickly and was really tasty (potato wedges were yummy!). Would definitely recommend and we will definitely be returning!Show less

Author: Karolis R
Title: Amazing spot in Penang!
Review: We had a pumpkin soup and veggie panini and it was awesome, it had a really rich taste :) environment is uber too and staff is very friendly, highly recommend this place :)

Author: Astridhol
Title: Great place
Review: Highly recommended this place, great food and super friendly staff! Great both for dinner and breakfast :)

Author: Scenic739719
Title: Best avocado toast in Georgetown!
Review: The food here was delicious and the staff was very nice! I had the avocado toast here and ended up coming back a few days later to order it again. Very close to all the hostels and on a great street. Good vibes all around.

Author: NpPegueroBarcelona, Spain
Title: Great place !
Review: Here for a few days, I decided to have a break after walking all morning. The place is very clean, the design is all about bikes and very genuine, good music too. The service is very nice and the « coffee » (the cappuccino and the latte macha tea) are delicious. They also have food for a launch or diner. But we won’t stop here today. Oh and you also have free WiFi ! They have two lines! Show less

Author: SYoong
Title: Lunch
Review: Love the place and good service. The chicken expresso was heavenly! Ok I like the friendly staff, very helpful and accomodating!!

Author: Climber739034
Title: Nice environment and music
Review:
Got in love with their environment, good vibes, chill.
Being in the most happening street in Georgetown (Love Lane), night during weekend is awesome. Together with nice music, BEST!

Author: LaiPheng
Title: Nice coffee comfortable place
Review: And great breakfast too! Love their classic breakfast and lovely environment. If there's no street parking, there's a paid parking few shops away.

Author: Strider O
Title: Nice environment
Review: Nice and cozy environment and good food served, especially the waffle, the burger and the pasta... But very less parking lots here...

Author: lunqz
Title: Nice environment for a meet up and have lunch..
Review:
Nice and cozy environment..food are nice and especially the waffle..

Quite a few of lunch menu for selection and i want to try it all..

Author: Sing T
Title: Cozy
Review: Cozy environment, nice meal and coffee. I particularly love their bogolonese special. This cafe is definitely a little gem worth to visit.

Author: Tang H
Title: Lunch
Review: Wheeler's is a cozy environment and the delicious foods are server by the waitress with the good service

Author: ilrock
Title: Great cafe with great wifi
Review: This is one of the few cafes in penang with very good wifi. On top of that, the staff is real nice and the coffee spot on!

Author: ninacriz
Title: Very good coffee and sandwiches!
Review: We love this place as its great for working and they have excellent coffee. The wifi is very fast as well (which is pretty rare in Penang) and also love their sandwiches! We definitely will come back!

Author: karenmissy65
Title: Recommended Weekday Set Dinner
Review: The garden salad really worth it, it got crispy almond chips, thumbs up! The smoked Salmon Aglio Olio taste nice as well! Recommended as it is very worthy!

Author: ChrisY1829
Title: good environment & reasonable price
Review: good environment & reasonable price.easily to find a car park.all prices are nett,value worth.i recommend it.

Author: mikehicks100
Title: Great tasting coffee
Review: Great tasting coffee. Some of the best i've had. Recommended to give this place a try. Price is high but quality is good.

Author: SanHec
Title: Great Coffee
Review:
Great morning booster in Wheeler's Coffee in 67 Love Lane. Barista make a great brew latte. 

Nice selection of breakfast and cakes.

Great ambience with beautiful background music. Sit in air cond and out door available.

Author: Ilona152
Title: Quirky with great food
Review: Stumbled across this place for brunch and had a great meal. Extensive menu and cool 'instagrammable' venue. Staff were helpful and happy to swap items to be vegetarian / gluten free. Would happily visit again.

Author: meg13579
Title: Brilliant food and friendly staff!
Review: Couldn't rate this place more! Reasonably priced food and seriously yummy. Staff are really friendly and the food came quick! Good atmosphere and fast wifi, would highly recommend for a more western lunch/dinner in George Town!!

Author: KarenInSFMalaga, Spain
Title: Love it! Wish I discovered it earlier!
Review: On my first day in Georgetown I had coffee at a place that shall not be named but is famous for 3D coffee. In a nutshell, it was overpriced and not good. So I'm so glad I discovered Wheeler's Coffee. What initially drew me in was the cute bicycle decor. But the latte I had was awesome - best I've had in Malaysia. And they have proper bagels! That's something I'm missing while traveling in Asia for 3 months. Friendly service and fast WiFi! I'll be back during my time in Penang!Show less

Author: I_wander_asia
Title: Best coffee ever
Review:
I really love this place, we went back a few times for breakfast. 

The broccoli omelette is amazing and really good value for money. The coffee is so good you don't even need milk. 

Customer service is spot on...

Author: Anusuya N
Title: It's our regular spot!!! LOVE IT
Review:
Where do I start! Hahah, I love their food, ambience, people... Practically everything. My partner and I have been regulars here for more than a year now. 
Personal favourite : Honey milk, carbonara, aglio olio, chicken pesto panini 
Must try : mushroom soup!!!

Author: ErikaFiuzaSao Paulo, SP
Title: Nice place, worth a visit!!
Review: Emmy boyfriend and I were at Wheelers during our stay in Georgetown. The place is cool, nice decor and service was very good as well! We had spaghetti carbonara and bolognese. The carbonara was superb, we loved it! The bolognese wasn't bad, but it wasn't really bolognese. It was spaghetti with tomato sauce with some bites of chicken (like nuggets) around... I'd suggest to change the name in the menu to something else so people know exactly what to expect!Overall it is a nice place and we highly recommend a visit!Show less

Author: runningnose
Title: Excellent food, good service and perks
Review: Excellent cafe that serves great Western food. Been here several times and each time, it's always crowded! Service is good, with free water and wifi. Cute bicycle decor too.. what's not to like?! Highly recommend :)

Author: MpfrederikBangkok, Thailand
Title: Highly recommendable
Review: We stopped by for sun-downer drinks and stayed on to dinnerThere is a sensible variety of drinks and food on their menuWe didnt have coffee - opted for dinnerWhilst portions aren't all that large - nevertheless presentation and quality offered were top-notch. My spaghetti dish was how it should be - just right ( the 'Italian' next door is a total waste of time)My I suggest that Wheelers implements the numbering of tables - it helps to avoid the constant confusion of delivering food the the wrong tablesWifi was strong and steadyConclusion: a nice little place with quality food and very reasonable pricesShow less

Author: Patricia H
Title: Taste of goodness
Review: Welcoming staff, great coffee (I opted for the iced hazelnut latte). Food is so fresh and tasty. Will this be bringing me back to Georgetown? :)

Author: Nicolai_KehletKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Excellent coffee and sandwich
Review: I always enjoy this place. Clean and great service.This time I had the Sandwich called the best sandwich.... I think. Chicken, salad, and their own sauce I think. It was excellent. Very tasty. Also had a juice, and hands down the best espresso I've had since Italy last year. Try it, you will like it.Show less

Author: Chrislcc
Title: Decent coffee
Review: A very well decorated cafe with wide range of coffee and western food. The free wifi is stable and the coffee is decent, one of the best coffee in the area. Highly recommended.

Author: crcrowderDenver, Colorado
Title: Great western food
Review: After four weeks of eating mainly Chinese and Indian food I was craving some good western food and Wheeler's Coffee hit the spot. I had the chicken pesto panini and it was cooked to perfection and served piping hot. Delicious! The ambiance is nice as well as they had a duo playing the keyboard and a guitar so it was a nice way to spend an evening. Show less

Author: Malte1981
Title: Really nice, decent Coffeeshop with yummy food and nice stuff
Review: Had a really nice time there tonight, and the stuf is just friendly. Food is delicious and very well prepared. Very good wifi connection.

Author: amandar633Phoenix, Arizona
Title: All around perfect cafe
Review: We were so happy to arrive in Penang and have a selection of quality cafes. My husband and I came here for brunch and really enjoyed the coffee, food, friendly staff and excellent wifi. They had a good deal for 14.5 to get a scrambled egg croissant, salad and coffee that I opted for. We liked the ambiance so much we came back later in the evening for their happy hour special of a buck of beer and free fries for 53. I couldn't resist the carrot cheesecake and it was awesome. Show less

Author: SmillaRydeRyde
Title: A place to chill
Review: I first stumbled across this cafe a few years ago and been coming back when ever I'm in Penang. The staff are really friendly, coffees excellent and the atmosphere can make you forget you are In a big city. Located in Love Lane which offers several similar places but this is definitely my favorite.Show less

Author: Gabriel C
Title: A Good Place to Chill Anytime of The Day
Review: The excellent staff and service usually makes my day. Everything else from food to atmosphere is a thumb's up.

Author: Tiffany LHouston, Texas
Title: Incredible customer service
Review: I ate here nearly five times in three days because the staff were so great and the food was outstanding. I needed to use a credit card as I couldn’t get cash out of the ATM, but there was a minimum of 50 ringgit charge. However, they allowed me to ring up a tab throughout the day so that I could use my card at the end of the night. Hands down the best and most accommodating places I’ve been throughout Malaysia! And they had more americanized food - I was craving it at that point having traveled throughout SE Asia for a couple of months. Highly recommend this place! Definitely try the honey milk and chocolate cake. Thank you guys.Show less

Author: 803matildaaBerlin, Germany
Title: Nice lunch
Review: We had the Greek salad and sweet potato chips, both was really nice. Lots of feta in the salad witch we loved. Good and fresh juices as well. Didn't try the coffee but the girl who was sitting next to us got a really pretty pattern on hers. The people who worked was nice and smiley. Show less

Author: Capta1n57
Title: Musical surprise
Review: Went for after dinner Coffee and Cake. Very busy and had live music. Really nice atmosphere. Cool staff. Nice Coffee and Cheesecake. Deserved to be busy

Author: Ross W
Title: Great coffee
Review: Called in for an iced coffee on a hot morning, the staff are very friendly and the snacks are great.The decor i thought was great great artwork in the way of bicycles, the food that other customers had also looked very good.

Author: Siti A
Title: Friendly staff and amazing food
Review: We went to the cafe for our hospitality assignment and they were really friendly, allowing us to interview them for a few minutes even though they were clearly busy. We ordered the banana latte, mango milkshake (?), wedges and the fajita chicken wrap. The banana latte was definitely a new taste to us but somehow familiar, reminded us of banana cake and marie biscuit! The mango milkshake was amazing, creamy and full of flavors but not too sweet. The wedges were crispy outing and we finished it immediately, our only complain was the sauce were too little. The fajita chicken wrap is very good though can get a bit messy. Overall a good visit and definitely would recommend.Show less

Author: runningnosesingapore
Title: Great service, nice decor, good drinks
Review: Came here recently to escape the noonday heat. The staff are friendly, they provide free water and wifi, and they seem to be popular. Ordered a matcha latte as I'm not a coffee lover. It was ok. The decor of this place is quirky with bicycles as the theme, and makes great photos. Would come again. Show less

Author: OlaM524
Title: Great place for dinner
Review: Dinner was great as well as mango smoothie - highly recommended! Wide choice in menu, nice interiors

Author: Stripedpassports
Title: An artistic cafe with so much freshness!
Review: Great artwork in the walls and decor the cafe is nice and cosy with great food. Espresso chicken and salmon dishes are highly recommended!!

Author: SamuelP2769
Title: Best coffre around
Review: Good for breakfast, really good coffee. A little expensive but worth it to start a good day. On the street close to a lot of hostel and good little bars.

Author: MollymouLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Nice cafe
Review: Popped in here for lunch one afternoon while sightseeing around Georgetown, the food was excellent, my friend had the I am Vegan sandwich and I had the Greek salad with smoked salmon, both were delicious. My only gripe is that they forgot to place my order with the kitchen so was left waiting 45 mins for my food, when it did arrive it was great though so all is forgiven.Show less

Author: Roznat2013Bangkok, Thailand
Title: Go for coffee or cake but not for breakfast
Review: Sadly this place was a real let down for breakfast, I would say the worst in a week. It's a great spot for coffee and cake, unreliable wifi so don't stop for that. We read they did a nice breakfast so made a point of coming for that. We were so let down, sausages are frankfurters out of a tin, the so-called turkey bacon is fried spam like substance and my fried eggs were solid and full of grease. In fact when I picked up my toast the oil on the plate had been absorbed and it was awful. We barely touched all the breakfasts from the different ones ordered. I don't like to give bad reviews but honesty is key. This place is close to many of the hostels and I think it's a pit stop for back packers. A very funny couple of guys made a comment we overheard "it's crap but it's close and who cares what you eat with a hangover!"Show less

Author: KevinA85Brisbane, Australia
Title: Great Coffee friendly staff
Review: Dropped in on a hot day as we walked around old Georgetown. We were greeted by staff as we stepped in the air conditioning and had the best coffee in Penang. The food is fresh and delicious and you have to try their lava cake....to die for!Average price for a coffee is about $11RM and worth it!It has free Wifi and inside and out with comfortable chairs.Show less

Author: Liis P
Title: The best coffee in Penang!
Review: I had absolutely the best coffee I have had with soy milk ever! It tasted so creamy and good that I had to order another one! Wow! Also had their avocado sandwich-yum!

Author: loiseloiseUlan Bator
Title: Would be overpriced but okay if internet worked, but it doesn't
Review: Coffee was okay but very overpriced, which would only be slightly annoying if the extra services wrapped up in the those prices, like fast and reliable wifi, and strong AC, were good. Unfortunately, after we'd been there a very short time, the internet went out completely, and staff seemed totally uninterested in getting it to work again. AC was not quite as strong as should be.Show less

Author: DeimanteK2
Title: Excellent
Review: Good location, perfect coffee, friendly staff, sweet funky atmosphere, cool design, super delicious cheese cakes, probably best salad in Malaysia (had greek salad), and there can be mo better drink for he evening as apple cinnamon detox tee. By the way, no need to pay extra for change to soya milk which is a very nice surprise for me not using cow milk (if you want almond or coconut milk then should pay extra approx. 0,8USD).To sum up - excellent place in Love Lane from breakfast to dinner.Show less

Author: david_Z4449WR
Title: Excellent Coffee and Sandwiches
Review: Stopped here for an afternoon snack and a coffee and it was bloody delicious. The chicken panini was excellent and the coffee was good too. They even had soy milk for my lactose intolerant partner.

Author: AwarenessForexChumphon, Thailand
Title: Good veggie sandwich and pumpkin soup....
Review: I tried their pumpkin soup. Tasty, and I would have liked some fresh cinnamon option. And a wheat garlic bread would have made it more interesting. The i'm vegan sandwich was quite tasty pretty much on its own. And thankfully you made it large enough (2 sandwiches vs 1).Cant judge the coffee though. You order, pay first, then sit down. Wifi password is on receipt. _____What i'd like to see:The mushroom soup use a vegan stock or have vegan stock option. Pumpkin soup should also have that vegan option (e.g. using soy milk vs using animal milk cream). The OPTION will help sell more. Please avoid using a microwave for ANY heating process. Use toaster, invection, or gas oven please. Show less

Author: EthnicmaniaKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Bad coffee
Review: It was the first time that I didn't finish my latte in a cafe. The reviews seems to be not not bad about this cafe but the coffee I had on my visit was simply terrible.Show less

Author: Leng M
Title: Delicious
Review:
Great and Valunable meal at this. Nice atmosphere too. It so easy to find.

Recommended Fisherman or Carbonara.

Author: roundtheworldbex
Title: Delicious
Review: Just had breakfast here and wished I could eat again, so many delicious sounding items on their menu! Comfortable indoor and outdoor seating, good wifi, clean and airy.

Author: jlchester0318Puerto Penasco, Mexico
Title: Accept a visa but doesn't accept visa
Review: Claims they accept visa but they have an outrageous minimum. If you look on Visa's merchant website it states "DO NOT SET A MINIMUM" normally I am ok with the minimum or a small 2-3% extra but they go completely against the purpose of Visa. Coffee wasn't anything special either! Show less

Author: andje580
Title: Delicious
Review: It is a busy place at times but with good reason as their food is delicious as is the coffee. So good we came back again 🙂

Author: syamilmsc
Title: A must....
Review: Each time we come up to penang, it's a must to drop by here. We enjoy their coffee, western and fusion dishes and most definitely their desserts. Atmosphere is cozy and clean. 2 floors to accomodate more than enough ppl.

Author: Hotel-Motel91
Title: Decent coffee...
Review: The coffee was decent and the surrounding and nice, clean and bright however, it was a little overpriced for something that was just average. Although...I did get to color in a coffee cup for their wall which kept me amused and distracted from the overpriced yet average coffee....Show less

Author: Foodiemonkie
Title: Coffee ok (slightly below). Food good. Ambience chill.
Review: Was looking for a good cuppa but it's not to be found. Food is reasonable priced and good. Place is chill and service is good except when I ask staff of coffee bean was roasted locally, she said "dun know"...

Author: yxlim96
Title: Good service
Review: The place is nice. Good environment and had a nice drink here. It's not difficult to locate the cafe. Yipeeee

Author: Jay NUnited Kingdom
Title: Great food and drinks at a reasonable price
Review: As a backpacker I have found most coffee houses in penang to be quite expensive. This place is however is lovely and very reasonable! Two days now my friend and I have come here for coffee and juices, as well as wine, and food. The food is yummy!! Hash browns and the guacamole panini is especially tasty :) it's a lovely hangout tooShow less

Author: paulagR9333RR
Title: Awesome food
Review: Loved it! The decoration is really nice, chill out environment, good wi-fi, friendly staff, and the food is insanely good and very affordable!

Author: angi649
Title: Amazing for Brunch
Review: We went there for brunch and the have really good coffee and Breakfast dishes. The staff is very friendly and the atmosphere is very nice. Would go there again.

Author: Barry W
Title: Lovely Lou.
Review: This was the 1st place I stopped at in George Town.Had just taken a bus after getting off the ferry (could have walked)Arrived sweating and lost on Love Lane, wife and baby in tow.No hotel booked. Very few Ringits in my pocket having just hot-footed it in from Thailand on a visa run and not stopped at an ATM.Grabbed a table outside in order to get online and sort out the above.Of course wifi for customers only so we order a coffee (iced) not cheap at 11 Ringet (just over £2) but very good and badly needed.With only enough cash for one coffee, wifi painfully slow and baby boy screaming blue murder I was feeling more than a little hot under the collar.In steps Lou.Proffering a map she shows me 1st the location of the nearest ATM and points out likely areas for good hotels as well as all the local attractions.I explain to Lou or predicament re the cash and she says it's no problem for wife and child to wait behind while I go sort funds.And of course she can order another drink.Keep the map.Someone give that girl a raise.She's worth more than you know and definitely more than your paying.Thank you Lou for the welcome to your lovely city.We will be back to see you.Show less

Author: traveller7301
Title: People lie according to BeanHunter app
Review: Highly rated on BeanHunter, but disappointing overall. Coffee - averagePancakes - dont get your hopes upCake - double choc was not even close to chocolate (overpowered by raspberry jam)Overall , go to Pitstop No 12.Show less

Author: Phillisloh
Title: Great breakfast place
Review: Love this place, the ambience and food and service are fantastic. Coffee is good too. There's free wifi as well

Author: Alex YMilwaukee, Wisconsin
Title: Good service, Good English but a little pricey
Review: 4 star because it was a little too expensive for what you get but everything else was 5 star.FOOD TYPE: Western breakfast foodFOOD QUALITY: goodPRICE: expensive for MalaysiaSTAFF PROFESSIONALISM: Very professionalSERVICE: Spoke fluent englishWIFI: so-soDIGESTION: I had a stomach bug hours later so hard to tell if it was from here LANGUAGE: fluent english from the staffWOULD I GO BACK: Yes, but I can't afford to do it often.Show less

Author: matt19880
Title: Breakfast
Review: Very friendly staff that were very helpful, the food was good but the portion sizes of sandwiches were pretty small but the main course meals were a good size. The coffee was excellent.

Author: Pinyaphat N
Title: Lovely place for breakfast.
Review: We've walked pass this lovely place everyday during our stay in George town. Then we decided to have a breakfast here on our last day. Try their big breakfast set menu with choices of black coffee or tea. Staff are very attentive and helpful.

Author: Harvey C
Title: Not again
Review: This my second visit. The first 6 months ago - where I was similarly disappointed. In this visit, despite not being busy, the service was slow. After a long wait for a coffee, I had to request three times for a dessert that was already prepared. Arrived long after the coffee was finished. Won't go back.Show less

Author: Peter BCairns, Australia
Title: Great little coffee spot
Review: I noticed this place while wandering around Georgetown and decided to go in and try the coffee. Not only was the coffee delicious but the vibe of the place is really cool and laid back. I noticed the food that was coming out looked really nice and only empty plates were going back which is a good sign. Show less

Author: Joep G
Title: The place to be!
Review: The place to be when you are done trying Indonesian, Malaysian, Indian or any other local food! It all started while passing by. Just a 'normal' waiter asking if we wanted to see their menu. Not pushy, just elegant....at one one, what you wish for but never get at any place... Ate our best pasta pesto and carbornara ever! Very hospitable and friendly staff! Excellent! A little cliché but we definitaly will be coming back (probably tomorrow ;)).. see you there!Show less

Author: Eliza F
Title: A repeated favourite
Review: Wheelers offers a vast variety of western style meals and drinks! The simple cafe had the most attentive staff and most delicious coffee in Penang. We ended up coming here almost every morning as nothing else in the area compared to the quality of food and friendliness of the staff. The generous meal sizing at affordable prices makes wheelers an must stop for anyone travelling in Penang!Show less

Author: michelleyeahMelbourne, Australia
Title: Friendly fresh variety
Review: This is very popular with backpackers in the area - and for good reason! The coffee is wonderful and there is a vast selection of drinks for non coffee drinkers. We stayed a week in Penang and we came here for breakfast almost every morning because we were unable to find a place that rivalled their sweet enthusiastic service, delicious fresh food and affordable prices. I would highly recommend the smashed pumpkin with poached eggs. If you're looking for some avocado on toast the guacamole panini comes pretty close and is a real treat. We came as starving customers and left as friends.Show less

Author: 711marleenkUtrecht, The Netherlands
Title: Good place!
Review: I had dinner at Wheeler's coffee as I was craving for some good Western meal. I was surprised by the fact they offer pumpkin soup, as I never saw this on other menus. The taste was really nice and the value-for-price was awesome! The next day I came back to try the deserts. These were a little bit disappointing. There are better places in Penang to have some cake (cheesecake/carrotcake). The coffee is good though! Show less

Author: P'zah CMalaysia
Title: Cozy Coffee Corner
Review: We had cafe mocha and banana mocha, do try both. Quick service, happy staff made us feel welcome. Inside is air-conditioned but outside is okay too. You can hear the live band playing at the nearby bar but not as loud. The furniture is new, the decorations well done. Show less

Author: niknak-pattywak
Title: Good coffee, good wester food
Review:
Came at 9am and coffee machine not on yet though waited inside for 15 minutes and the coffee was good. Free wifi for an hour then you need to reconnect.
Had Mexican wrap and it was nothing special, though other meals looked good.

Author: cindyhayashiPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Good Pasta
Review: After my 3rd visit to this cafe i've decided to write a review. My 1st and 2nd visit was during Olympic game and i tried a couple food and drinks there. The price of their coffee is same like Starbucks and Coffee Bean. Their pasta is good and pork free but their pizza just a normal pizza doesn't taste special still have to improve if you are selling the same thing as others cafe can do then why you doing it and what's the selling point? The Cake that i had wasn't fresh also selling same price as Starbucks and Coffee Bean.Good ambience.Show less

Author: yudiliuBangkok, Thailand
Title: Nice little gem
Review: Small yet very nice coffee shop along Love lane. The shop has a very nice interior all about wheels of all sort of sizes and designs. The coffee was good too to relax and refresh from the heat outside. You get to meet fellow travelers from all around the world in this place.Show less

Author: maramakawiti
Title: Good eats good coffee
Review: Great little cafe with good food and good coffee. I had the Smashed pumpkin and patched eggs and it was perfect. The Wheelers big breakfast is pretty good and a decent size. Loved the mushrooms and potatoes!

Author: H9919IFjohnw
Title: Great coffee
Review: Nice clean tidy modern coffee shop. Still cannot get a flat white but the latte was close. Lights meals served and has free wifi

Author: Alexander6011Tauranga, New Zealand
Title: A cafe that doesn't seem to belong
Review: Wheeler's Coffee is pretty good. They offer light meals. But this is a cafe that has the look and feel of the one around the corner anywhere else in the world. It's a place designed to attract the tourists who have opted for cheap accommodation in Love Lane. But it is a bit soulless. It's as though it's an import and doesn't really belong, were it not for visitors looking for somewhere familiar and "safe." However, if you need some home comforts it might as well be here.Show less

Author: Erhus
Title: Nice atmosphere
Review: Nice and cozy restaurant where you can eat breakfest, lunch or dinner to reasonable price. Very good wifi as well

Author: Z5581VZmikea
Title: Panini
Review:
Good food and nice escape from the heat.
Friendly staff. Took a while to get my food but i wasnt in a rush. would recomend

Author: andrewmY8759PF
Title: A big for something different
Review: Yes unique scenery of bikes but gret coffee and cake .. so yes afternoon is a must here . The service excellent. I was offered a great choice of coffee and i had plain iced coffee on this occasion

Author: adeline j
Title: Nice café offering soy milk!
Review: Nice café in the center, nice deco/setting, and they have a soy milk option for lactose intolerants! Their cakes look good, too bad no vegan option...

Author: EvaP1270
Title: Cafe
Review: Neat cafe with just the right kind of menu for people on the mid range. Taste okay and coffee was alrite.The atmosphere was nice in the evening

Author: Mchylins
Title: OMG great coffee!!!!
Review: Hooray! Finally found a place that sells really delicious espresso coffee that is very similar to Melbourne coffee. The staff is friendly and the place is very trendy.

Author: Rachael B
Title: Great iced coffee!
Review: Visited wheeler cafe twice during our stay in Penang and highly recommend for a very decent coffee.We had breakfast here one day, which was reasonably priced but the flavour didn't blow me away. We also stopped by for coffee and carrot cake, which was nice.Free wifi and comfortable surrounds make for a nice spot to relax!Show less

Author: Tabitha TJohnson City, Tennessee
Title: Fun atmosphere for hanging out with friends!
Review: The place was usually pretty busy, and noisy (at least when I was there). It's a great place to meet with friends - not so good to read or blog. The coffee was amazing, as were the hot lattes. I also really enjoyed one of their brownies. MM. Show less

Author: veena_83Memphis, Tennessee
Title: great cafe and very good food.
Review: i loved my visits to wheeler's coffee. not only did they show replays of the nba playoffs at night [great for a sports-starved person such as myself], but the cafe was also a great place to hang out during the day. the bagels are very tasty, the wifi is efficient, and i was very happy to spend a few hours catching up on emails and reading my book in the lovely setting. the staff are great as well.Show less

Author: Codeblue79
Title: Chillex with great coffee
Review: Great ambiance and fantastic coffee. Place to just unwind after a long walk around town. We had delicious espresso panna cotta. It is always our hang out place when we are in Penang island. It's not hard to find.

Author: graemewest
Title: Great coffee and cool environment
Review: Good breakfast and lunch menu. Always busy with an excellent Barrista using great beans. Central location in the heart of old Georgetown

Author: leifstarkeyLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Hearty Breakfast - Fun Bicycle Themed Artwork
Review: This place caught my eye with the bicycle themed decor when I arrived early morning walking to my guesthouse. I decided to return for a hearty breakfast after checking in my luggage and I was not disappointed. The food was really scrumptious I greedily went for the largest full english breakfast they had which was so big it was served up on chopping board. Included coffee in the price and really set me up for the day.The cafe itself had an awesome vibe with stylish and interesting artwork and decor throughout whilst following the bicycle/cycling theme. You have a choice of seating from the air conditioned inside seating areas to the outside where there were fans. I chose to sit outside to watch the world go by whilst enjoying my hearty breakfast.The staff were also very friendly and allowed me to take photos of the cafe and artwork.I recommend anyone to visit this cafe even if its just for a coffee and to see the fun and interesting bicycle themed artwork. I came back twice throughout my 3 day stay in Penang.Show less

Author: JacekBKK
Title: Good Coffee
Review:
Good sandwich, great coffee, excellent fruit juices.

However, went on 2 separate occasions, 2 different baristas - first time the coffee was excellent, second time was good, but tepid coffee.

Author: HannahDuboisSudbury, Canada
Title: Very Delicious!
Review: You can choose between air conditioning or sitting outside. The location is very convenient. The prices were a little high but not bad. The chicken panini is to die for! Seriously delicious! It was 15.50 RM and the flavours were amazing! A must try! Their menu was quite extensive too which was great!Show less

Author: Sanyukta D
Title: Nice decor
Review: A row of sketched cups, cycles and interesting bar stools make up the decor of this little cafe. Had an okay cheesecake, but the coffee was good. Visit if you have time.

Author: GCC25Raleigh, North Carolina
Title: Great breakfast
