Review: I was with a group and we were on the move. We needed somewhere to eat breakfast before our day began. This little restaurant was great! I had the love wrap and the watermelon juice, which was not too sweet. I would definitely recommend this to anyone looking for a good breakfast!Show less

Author: Anna SFredericia, Denmark
Title: Breakfast
Review: I had a coffee and breakfast here and it was delicious. Staff is very friendly and happy to alter the menu for me so I got my breakfast exactly the way I like it.Can definitely recommend this place if your looking for a place to have a quiet morning coffee or brunch with the girls.Show less

Author: hkaidolaven
Title: Lovely Cozy Cafe in Georgetown
Review: Coffee is great at reasonal price.. Try the flavored lattes. They make good pasta dishes and waffles too. Backpackers love this place too ;)

Author: PEili KSingapore, Singapore
Title: Great Decos ~
Review: This cafe was so simple and nice. I love the way they hang their bicycles up on the wall or hanging anywhere. I love the ways they draw the cups and display it all up. The bagel we order was so damn nice too, simple tuna with side salads and not overly baked. The butterfly pea drink was serve beautifully with lemons in our tiny "tea" cup. Staff was friendly too =)Show less

Author: Mika C
Title: Good decorations and friendly staff
Review: The interior of the place is well decorated to the bicycle theme. First time trying the filter coffee there and the barista took his time to explain to me the flavor and blend and ways to drink it. Never tried the food

Author: Artabaz G
Title: Awesome Vibe!
Review: amazing ambience, great breakfast menu, decent coffee and friendly and helpful staff. the location is nice, the environment is modern and the food is delicious. service is quite fast and efficient.the morning opening time is a little bit late and if you are an early bird, u have to wait until 9ish. Show less

Author: Tony PUnited Kingdom
Title: Coffee was not great, a Latte was small, gone in one gulp
Review: They only do one sized latte, and at almost 10rm, I was expecting a decent sized cup, but ended up with a very small cup. When you consider in Starbucks a Tall Latte is 11rm, but much bigger then I consider this place too expensive.The coffee had a bit of a tang to it, wasn't bad, just seemed a bit odd.Cannot comment on food but looked ok.Show less

Author: Scott2573
Title: Nice find
Review: Excellent little coffee shop on love lane with a good selection of freshly prepared food and drinks,nice staff

Author: Syarifah N
Title: Awesome Breakfirst
Review: We ordered the omelet, Wheeler's breakfast and the classic breakfast. OMG it was sooo good!!! This cafe can beat a lot of good cafes in KL.

Author: parlinsitanggangLuzon, Philippines
Title: excellent place to rest with great coffee after hot city tour
Review: been to this place two days in a row and for sure will come back again. found this place as great place to rest after hot city tour. I like their filter coffee (Ethiopia), avogato and lime honey soda and don't forget their variety of cakes. I love the tiramisu.Show less

Author: Nick R
Title: Some beers at the Wheeler's Coffee
Review: Unfortunately we did not try the Coffee, just stopped over for some cold beer. Wheeler's Coffee is located on Love Lane in the city center of George Town. We had a basket of Tiger beer and got some fries for free, what was a welcomed suprise. Staff was very friendly and we did enjoy some nice hours in the evening at the Wheeler's Coffee. Full recommendation! Show less

Author: bubblyholiday
Title: Simply perfect
Review: Good place to take a break from the heat. Coffee, smoothie, bagels and pasta were very tasty.  Employees are friendly.

Author: danielwmnTawau, Malaysia
Title: Super like!
Review: Went there for coffee and cake. Nice environment with many bicycle decorations and details, creative and attractive!Service crew were friendly and helpful... Love their smile! Coffee taste was great but I'd prefer to get a bigger portion though. Cheese cake was fantastic!Definitely will be back again to try out its menu.Show less

Author: MikeCarmona
Title: Good for happy hour!
Review:
Been here few times. Location is good, near Chulia St and convenient. They offer free fries for evey bucket of beer during happy hour. Cheesecake is yummy too.
Just hope they improve their a/c. 😫

Author: Road631339
Title: Great coffee. Friendly service.
Review:
A nice cosy place.
Lovely ambient.
Good selection of music.

Amazing coffee. Yes. Try their honest unpretentious filter coffees.
And chat with the barista. 

Food is good too!

Author: eupraxiathai
Title: Excellent fruit juices and coffe
Review: Located next to julia street, this small place is clean with a good service and affordable prices for tasty food and beverages

Author: Thao PHanoi, Vietnam
Title: Nice place with great food
Review: I know that you are in Penang to explore the local food but I have to say I love Wheeler's Coffee. Their staff is very friendly and helpful. I feel welcomed when I got here. We got the big breakfast and it was delicious. This is a pork free coffee shop so they use Turkey bacon and turkey sausage for substitution. Compare to the street food of Penang, this place is in a higher range but you'll get free wifi, AC - I say it's reasonable.Show less

Author: Ciwi2013
Title: Coffee pit stop on love lane
Review: Perfect retreat from the hub bub that is love lane! Great coffee, free wifi, awesome air conditioning, super friendly staff..... That don't mind you staying hours after you're last sip of coffee to research that 'one last thing' via wifi! Thank you for a great experience..., if in the area and fancy a coffee, this is the place to go! Show less

Author: HarryThomas92Stalybridge, United Kingdom
Title: The popcorn chicken is amazing!
Review: Visited this small cafe on love lane several times, each time was an enjoyable experience. The atmosphere is very laid back, an ideal place to work or hangout with friends over a coffee. The coffee was ok for Malaysia, there are better places to go solely for the taste of the coffee. However, the apple tea was refreshing.The chocolate fondants were excellent and ordered more than once. The other food was tasty, but the portion sizes are not the biggest for Malaysia. Would definitely recommend trying the Thai popcorn chicken as a snack, absolutely fantastic. Show less

Author: Replacart
Title: Bit expensive
Review: Anything not street food in Penang is pretty expensive. But relative to western it's cheap. Smoothies are a lovely change

Author: goldenspoon
Title: Hipster
Review: If you're hipster, you would already have been to Love Lane. Might as well enter this hipster bicycle themed cafe. a good place to read and/or be alone. Coffee could be better though.

Author: Anina S
Title: Lovely!
Review:
The coffee is just lovely! We went there every morning cause it's a
perfect start in the day! Stuff was very helpful when we had questions about traveling around and you will find many other backpackers there!

Author: brittany b
Title: great breakfast
Review: came here for breakfast nearly every day I stayed in penang. they do a very nice fruit salad, great bagels, and a generous serving of pancakes. nice decor, music, atmosphere as well.

Author: NeilwmckaySingapore, Singapore
Title: Nice decor, shame about the cakes
Review: Popped in here for coffee and dessert after a meal at Mish Mash. Drawn in by the quirky decor and the promenant tripadvisor badge.The place is nicely fitted out with bike wheels, fancy lighting and art painted directly on the walls.My espresso was good but the cakes we ordered were disappointing. My tiramisu was dry while my wife's lava cake tasted floury rather than chocolatey.Given the number of alternatives in the vicinity I would try other places before returning.Show less

Author: 722andrewt
Title: Great coffee and fantastic atmosphere
Review: While walking the streets of Georgetown we came across this neat little cafe, very clean, polite staff and great coffee! Great if you are roaming looking for the street art in the lane ways.

Author: Dennis M
Title: Great little Stop
Review: Very clean little coffee shop that also serves food, smoothies and beer, with reasonable prices and air conditioning. There is also an outside patios for smokers.

Author: tabithaj2988
Title: Fun nite out with gud frens....
Review: We were looking for a cup of coffee after our regular beer session... So we walked past this cafe n found a cozy place to hangout... I loved the concept n it's gud to hangout!!!

Author: karohhMelbourne, Australia
Title: Excellent coffee and cake on a non smoking terrace
Review: We drifted past the cafe during a walk and decided to stop for coffee and cake. To our delight, the outdoor sitting area was non smoking: a rarity in Asia.Our coffees were excellent and were very nicely presented. The cheese cake was delicious and the staff was very friendly and efficient.The terrace is sheltered and a nice place to sit and see people pass by.Show less

Author: roshni45Bengaluru, India
Title: Themed cafe
Review: We came across this charming cafe while strolling the streets of the quaint Georgetown. It is uniquely adorned with cycles, coffee mugs and shades which makes the ambiance appealing. They offer a variety of snacks and pastries. We had potato wedges, French fries and Crème brûlée. The fries and wedges were perfectly fried and the sauce and mayo alongside were yummy. Crème brûlée was delicious! Totally in love with this place!Show less

Author: elizabethtC3368IN
Title: Delicious
Review: I ordered the tuna bagel with a toffeenut latte. It was so delicious! The staff was really polite and helpful! Great job!

Author: Flyers007DublinDublin, Ireland
Title: Gorgeous visit to Wheeler's Coffee, Love Lane, George Town, Penang, Malaysia, beautiful cakes and drinks
Review: While exploring George Town we were also in Love Lane and stopped for a break at Wheeler’s. Penang is famous for excellent cuisine and good coffee.The shop is quaint and easily identifiable because the entrance is decorated with bikes and there is a mural of a gentleman and his unicycle from a long bygone area, when bicycles were still in their infancy, plus a rabbit on a bicycle sporting a blue and red stripped balloons. The bicycle theme continues throughout the café. There were a lot of fresh cakes and sandwiches on display and a large board showed the drink menu.The orders were taken at the counter, but brought to the table by the staff.The different flavored teas, coffees and chocolates were mind boggling and fabulous.For him it was easier, but I had difficulties deciding which drink to take.He took the Nutella Hot Chocolate, while I had the Rose Latte. We chose two orange juices and two tiramisu cakes as well. All was delicious and fresh.We paid 63.60 MYR (ca. 13 Euro or 14.50 USD).Other customers were locals and Wheeler’s was very full, but quiet.We would return next time if we are in Love Lane again.Would we recommend this Cafe to a friend? YES!Would we want to visit this Cafe again in our future? YES!Show less

Author: erincollins82
Title: Good coffee
Review: Had a caramel espresso frapacino really enjoyed it after the terrible coffee at the hotel we are at. Would get coffee from here again

Author: harryw914
Title: Best chocolate cake of my life
Review: A really nice little coffee joint. The double chocolate cake was one of the best things I've ever eaten, but the coffee was a bit hardcore for my liking. Recommend it though!!

Author: Granturismo75017
Title: Nice experience
Review: Fine bagels, nice music, smiling staff. My kids had a great time and did not want to leave the place so we stayed longer and ordered a second round of hot chocolates.

Author: stanya91Penang, Malaysia
Title: Not impress
Review: We went to have brunch over the weekend.When we are there, there is only few people then we head to the counter and would like to order our food and drinks. There was a girl que in front of us buying a cake, the cashier was so busy looking for a box to put the cake, another guy was busy at the coffee machine, so no one attend to us even three of us are standing in front of the counter for about 10 minutes.We ordered Iced Caramel Macchiato, Iced Chocolate, Iced Toffee Nut Latte and Banana Smoothies. The Banana smoothies is very good but the rest are very disappointed. Coffee taste very diluted, not worth the price.Food wise, we ordered Applewood & Bacon Bagel, Big Breakfast, Mushroom omelette & mushroom bruschetta. The portion is ok but it is tasteless. Like just cooked and served, thats all. Not recommended as we are not the satisfied customers.However, the environment are chill and nice.Show less

Author: SnompiCanggu, Indonesia
Title: Great place to work or chill out
Review: Love this little cafe. Its perfect for working - reliable wifi and not too loud music. I had a flat white and the breakfast Mexican tortilla and both were amazing.The staff was pleasant and I liked that you can serve yourself with lemon ice water.I'd definitely come back.Show less

Author: POH BF M
Title: Good breakfast
Review:
The breakfast is good with ample choices.
The cafe is neat and creatively decorated. 
Good shots of photos beside excellent  shots of caffeine. 
Love it. 
Will come again.

Author: susuyoGeorge Town, Malaysia
Title: Drinks is good, sandwiches was fine, cakes is my favorite but not the main course
Review: I love the environment here and I really enjoy the services they provide. The ocean milk make my tummy so soothing but the main course really disappointed me and my partner. The aglio olio is bit too oily and tasteless and the mushroom chic is bit too over cooked. But they have various of choices for cakes and they cakes is really nice. Mille crepe, my favorite.Show less

Author: jeff1955malaysiaKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: A bicycle is hanging infront of the shop
Review: It is located along chulia st. I believe this is a new joint in town. Nothing much but just a simple coffee joint which you can relax and unwind. simple deco and hanging bicycles and wheeles. they serve nice coffee and wifi free. Staff are friendlyShow less

Author: Sheri S
Title: Wheeler's
Review: Great food, great atmosphere, great coffee! The staff is friendly. They even gave me an adapter for the outlet since mine didn't fit.

Author: Traveller9021
Title: Beautiful Coffee
Review: The Coffee is fantastic and the service friendly. The free WiFi  ages it a great stop to work out where you're going to go next.

Author: Lesley V
Title: Fabulous coffee in a beautiful setting
Review: Their coffee saved our life when we arrived!  Well made coffee (reminded us of home) with lovely staff.

Author: Ethan_LawSetapak, Wilayah Persekutuan, Malaysia
Title: Marvelous
Review: The cafe is very cozy and ambient...Good for a short/relaxing break. They serve simple breakfast (sandwiches & bagel etc) and mostly self service. WIFI provided free of charges for customer.A thematic cafe as the name denotes.Definitely recommended if you would like to kill your time.Show less

Author: 13bubbles13
Title: Perfect hideaway for a good book
Review: Very nice feel to this little coffee shops adventure out to the back with a book if you are killing time on a visa run

Author: PhlashmairTbilisi, Georgia
Title: Love Lane coffee stop to go to
Review: Superlative coffee (flat white), refreshing not-too-sweet iced strawberry tea, bagel with extras, just passing by, but saw the quirky decor and stepped into the cool interior for a welcome sip.Of course, TA lumps gourmet restaurants into the same bracket as wayside stops, so the star system is pretty meaningless. This is perfect for what it does and in a good location, but the ranking of so many of these Georgetown eateries makes the whole exercise a bit confusing for the unwary hence what must be a relatively unkind "average" when it is anything but average!Show less

Author: LouisealmerDenmark
Title: Really nice place!
Review: I went here a few times and each time was a really nice experience! The coffee is great, the interior is cute and the staff is really friendly! I went there alone once and got a bike in the foam of my cappuccino - how cool is that?!? If I come back to Georgetown one day I'll definitely go here again!Show less

Author: Afiqah Hanna AMalaysia
Title: Cosy time bubble
Review: It was my first visit in Georgetown and I really really wanted to visit at least one of the many cafes scattered around the area. We came into Wheeler's Coffee because we had to take cover from the rain and we needed a break from all the walking anyway.The interior had a lovely decoration, the inked paper cups lined up against the wall really caught my attention. There weren't many people when we walked in so it was really cosy to just sit back and enjoy our time.Friendly service, good food and a cosy little place if you'd like to stay for a cup of coffee or two and read a book.Show less

Author: David L
Title: Lovely Breakfast
Review: The breakfast at Wheelers was simply amazing and the service so great. Very happy we found this tiny coffee shop.

Author: EnglishGavNorwich, United Kingdom
Title: Great spot for cooling down and great coffee and food.
Review: During our time in Penang we enjoyed visiting Wheelers on a few occasions after a great experience the first time. Over the course of a few days I had some juice, coffee, sandwiches cake. All delicious. The inside of the café is really interesting with different parts from bicycles made into some sort of art. One pointer, ask what the 'Signature Coffee' is before you buy it. It was certainly not what we expected and sadly not to our taste (lets just say cheese was involved) - though the staff were kind enough to offer to replace if for us!Show less

Author: Steven MMelbourne, Australia
Title: Great spot for coffee
Review: This is a really cool little coffee spot in George Town. I think it was the best coffee I had in Penang and wish I'd found it earlier and that my hotel was closer. I'd actually stay closer to this place if I went back (read my review of Hotel Penaga). I didn't sample the food but it all looked pretty good too. Show less

Author: Greg H
Title: Wheelers Coffee Consistency
Review: It is always pleasing to find something reminding you of home while traveling that small item which helps anchor you to your normal life. Coffee does that for me. Wheelers Coffee does that for me. Keep making such great tasting coffee, but a bit warmer please.Show less

Author: Phoeberuth
Title: Nice coffee & staff
Review: Nice tasting coffee, super cool cups, and nice latte art. Lovely little spot but a little more expensive than other places nearby.

Author: WanderingWarner
Title: Great frappe
Review: Too hit to try their hit coffee, but their caramel frappe was spot on!! Great decor and ambience. Design your own coffee cup :)

Author: FauzanaAM
Title: Fancy coffee art
Review: Cool ambience, mocha - better than typical starbucks, CBTL and SF Coffee, fancy coffee art, like it better elsewhere

Author: WanderingAround257Gengenbach, Germany
Title: Best tunasandwich
Review: I went there for latebreakfast. First, the restaurant lookes really clean and welcoming. The menu has a great variety. I choose the tuna focaccia and a iced americano. Even though it is a little more expassiv than what a random backpacker is willed to pay (15 rm for breakfast) it was worth it. I think it was the best tunasandwich I had by far. It was really fresh and they added some appleslices which i never had before. For the hot weather just a good choice. The coffee is good but nothing special. So bad i found the place on my last day in penang. Would really recommend it.Show less

Author: Giogina R
Title: Good atmosphere
Review: Artistically designed and we were quite happy with the food and atmosphere until we spent a few hours without realizing

Author: pimritaLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Great coffee
Review: Nice cafe just off the main road. I've had a delicious iced Moccha that was just perfect after my arrival to Penang. Also nice little area outside. Wifi available but not working that great. Not cheap but it was pretty delicious... Smiley staff which is always an extra point !! Show less

Author: Nathasha K
Title: Another cafe
Review: Interesting deck but otherwise a normal cafe whose key reason of serving good coffee is somehow marginally achieved since the coffee did not leave much impression. The ambience is pretty relaxing though.

Author: Cafehop
Title: I like it!
Review: Heard that they have made some improvement recently. This is the second time I've paid my visit there and yeah, coffee and food improved a lot which have achieved my requirement! Definitely get into my list of most favorite cafe in town!

Author: Smith294265
Title: Very nice coffee
Review: This is a very pleasant coffee shop.  Excellent cappuccino, hot chocolates.  Comfortable place to sit down and relax while shopping or tracking down street art.

Author: CelineT17Singapore, Singapore
Title: Lovely ambience and decent coffee
Review: After spending 2 hours walking around Georgetown in the hot sun... I decided to pop into Wheeler's cafe for a break. First impression was the owner had put in a lot of effort to make sure that the decor goes well with their name. There was even a bicycle suspended mid-air between level 1 and 2 which added a "wow" factor for decor.I tried their Christmas offering - Peppermint mocha frappe which I quite like... while my friend had the cafe latte (which I presume is nice since she finished it at a faster rate than me).We also had the chocolate crepe cake which had crunchy chocolate bits in it... I like how they bother to decorate the plate with wordings "Happy New Year 2015!" and a drawing of a bike using chocolate sauce. All in all, we had a good time chilling out at this cafe. Show less

Author: Iza_T123
Title: Loved it!
Review: A neat little coffee shop with delicious food, good coffee and friendly staff. I really liked the theme of wheels that is used to decorate the shop. It's a really nice place to take a break from all that walking.

Author: rianif
Title: Me hearties
Review: We came down there for breakfast and I must admit, I loved it. Their sausages were baked to a perfect crispiness, I've never known any other places that had done so. A perfect start of the day.

Author: Jacky Y
Title: Dart machine is fun!
Review: Coffee is alright, great ambience, plenty of space for a group of friends, and has two dart machines too (you need to pay for the games though)! Couldn't connect to the wifi though. Overall it's worth a visit if you are cafe hopping!

Author: khooweiweiSingapore, Singapore
Title: One of the many cafes in town
Review: We needed a place to sit down and kill 1-2 hours and we needed a new place for all of us so we picked Wheeler's Coffee as it was relatively new. And the deco looks kinda nice.We have had our lunch so we didn't want to order much. We order two cups of coffee, a glass of passion fruit lassi, and a slice of chocolate crepe cake to share.The coffee is nothing to shout about, very average coffee. The lassi was too sweet. The cake is an average too. The most special thing about it will be the deco as it was all about bicycle. But the food and the coffee quality made them just one of the many cafes in Georgetown. Nothing memorable.Show less

Author: florayapz
Title: no complains, 5 STAR all the way
Review: wonderful food and staff. the food is very nice and family friendly. Just make sure u order non spicy for the kids, my kids especially love their chicken mandi rice, and also hummus with bread. their food is fresh and hot, will come back again next visit for sureShow less

Author: Gabriella H
Title: Delicious
Review: Delicious! Extremely generous portions and great pricing. Meat was tender, falling off the bone. Highly recommend 👌🏽 Very handy to main beach at Batu Ferringhi.

Author: ROZZ R
Title: REALLY GREAT FOOD
Review: We were very, very impressed with the food. Really really top notch. And the pricing was also very, very reasonable. Congratulations to chef Lisa. As well as that lovely Syrian guy who made the desert. Congratulations.

Author: DaudRayPenang Island, Malaysia

Author: Mursyi711

Lastly, their kunafa is the best that I have tried so far, a must try dish! Definitely would return here with family and friends.Show less

Author: carolkE3157YU

We tried a dessert there that we hadn't had before. It has cheese in it and I strongly recommend it. Everyone loved it at our table. We'll be back often.Show less

Author: NomadAnksNoida, India

Review: Well we came for Lebanon and since it was closed we tried this one and what a meal we had...we came twice after this so can tell how much we loved the food. the highlight of the place was the Sahlab milk drink that they serve, it was something i have never had and my entire team came again for it.The only downside the restaurant is Cash only.Show less

Author: micahr596Ban Khao Takiap, Thailand
Title: Never Disappoints
Review: We’ve loved Rubins ever since our first Penang trip 2 years ago! We’ve been thinking of Rubins for weeks before we embarked on our trip! They’ve moved locations about 500m from their restaurant since last time, but it’s still a short 5 minute walk from the Holiday Inn Penang. Prices are reasonable and the food quality is the best around! Our personal favorites were the falafel sandwiches, Greek Salads and the Hummus with Bread.Show less

Title: Surprisingly awesome
Review: A tiny ‘cafe’ along the popular touristy stretch of Batu Ferringhi offering Arabic food. Everything we had was absolutely awesome, so tasty & delicious. We tried the falafel platter, mixed grill platter, hummus, & Yemeni Mandy lamb which was like lamb shank, very tender meat which just fell off the bone. Highly recommend this little gem. There are a lot of Arabic restaurants along this stretch of road but this one is great!Show less

Author: Jeremytankimkeat
Title: Extremely good food. Highly recommended. Authentic and tasty.
Review: We genuinely enjoyed our lunch here. The food was fresh and good. I highly recommend this restaurant if you are nearby.

Author: Roslynn BPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Fantastic falafel!
Review: Having lived in Penang for nearly 7 years, I am so happy that my friend introduced us to this turkish/arabic restaurant. It is located in Batu Ferringhi road just before the Boatman Restaurant. Simple cafe restaurant but the food is amazing. We had the falafel (so awesome that we ordered a 2nd plate), moussaka, greek salad and rice with lamb stew. Everything is so tasty, not overly spiced and no MSG. The staff is friendly and very attentive. Prices are reasonable too. We will definitely be back again soon!Show less

Author: Rinni1974Newcastle, Australia
Title: FABULOUS, highly recommended!
Review: We had a fabulous dinner here. Very welcoming atmosphere and an owner that constantly goes out of his way to ensure that everyone is enjoying their meal etcMeals are super tasty, fresh, generous in size and very reasonably priced. We will definitely be back for another meal at Rubin Mardini before the end of our holiday in Batu Ferringhi!Show less

Author: SandraLP-3011
Title: Delicious Middle Eastern
Review: We came here twice because the food, service and value for money was so good. The staff here are warm, friendly and very responsive to guest requests (eg - managing a food intolerance). We enjoyed the Chicken Aqda, the Moussaka, Felafel, Hummus and salads. Thanks for feeding us so beautifully.Show less

Author: Zahid G

Review: Great food and good service. The guy is very friendly and made good suggestions. Portion sizes are big. Very good pricing. Probably the best local restaurant we have been to!

Author: 792jawadt
Title: Excellent food and service
Review: The place has some excellent food, we ordered Hummus and Mandi and it was great. Also the manager has a great smile and service is also very good.

Author: Travellkat

Review: Hummus to die for.  Creamy and rich moussaka.  A group of us ate here several times, and everything we tried was delicious!  Let the owner recommend for you, he never puts you wrong.  Very friendly and extremely courteous. 👍

Author: BrownKidsdotravel
Title: Delicious food in family friendly atmosphere
Review: Our severe was a gracious host.  The food was tasty, and reasonably priced.  The owner kept our glasses filled with tea well after our meal was over.  The lentil soup is a must try.

Author: KAB-CanadaStratford, Canada
Title: Tasty Dinner
Review: Our server recommended various dishes for four of us to enjoy. We began with hummus and fatoush. Yummy. Then our main courses arrived. We had 3 different lamb dishes. The portions are large and the bread is replenished. The food was wonderfully tasty. This restaurant is clean and cool. Service is excellent. Most importantly, the food is GOOD!No alcohol served.They offer take away, too.Show less

Author: Dennis146Penang Island, Malaysia
Title: This is a cozy type of restaurant, very friendly, helpful owner
Review: Immediately you enter you can feel a friendly and family atmosphere.All the dishes we had (5 persons) were very very good. Their Humus has to be the best ever tasted, the lamb was so tender and full of flavour.We took our own wine, they gave us glasses but no corkage charge!If you decide to dine here you will NOT be disappointedShow less

Author: vitaminzee1Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Delicious lunch
Review: We were advised by the owner, who was a smiley and friendly man, what to choose when we arrived. He noted that we were vegan and vegetarian and made sure we enjoyed an authentic Turkish lunch whilst in Batu Ferringhi.We shared the falafal platter which consisted of falafal, humus, salad and pirra bread and a fattoush salad. Would reccomend both these dishes. Personally I'd have liked th pitta bread warmed up, but it was still tasty. The portion of humus was quite small too. We saw people eating wraps and these looked excellent as well.The owner then offered us free tea on the house which we drank with some amazing baklava. The service was fantastic: despite how busy they were, the 2 staff members aimed to deliver the best service possible. 2 meals, a dessert and 2 drinks came to only 60 RM. We will be back. Show less

Author: Anica1970

Title: Best meal I’ve had in Malaysia!!!

The basmati rice were flavourful and aromatic, best of all, free refill! The owner, Halil, is a very pleasant man. He went above and beyond. Author: Adam S

Review: Had a great meal at this restaurant, food was all freshly cooked and delicious and owner couldn't do enough to please and accommodate.

Author: zeebee2016Roxburgh Park, Australia

Review: The food and the service was amazing here, the owner whom we made friends with quite quickly is SO friendly and so hospitable. He invited us over the next night and truly treated our taste buds with the most delicious and sensational meals we have had in Penang so far. I ordered lamb shanks with a side of rice and salad, the meat was so tender and full of flavour that I would travel just to Penang only to eat at this amazing place. He also complimented us a side of various dips and roasted eggplant dish seasoned with I don't know what goodness but it was out of this world, followed with some perfectly steeped turkish tea to settle the meal after. Such a great great restaurant and truly the best food in Penang. Thank you Halil Ibrahim!Show less

Review: ...but I thought the pita bread they served with it wasn’t that great – kind of generic actually. Very good food here nonetheless. The falafel was soft inside without an overly hard shell to it. My friend ordered the Aqda Chicken which he said he didn’t like. He also remarked that the picture on the menu had chicken breast chunks and what he was served was shredded chicken. I had the Mandy Chicken which I thought was tasty. The owner (as well as cook, waiter, cashier and a very friendly person) offered us a choice of two different rices or salad to go with the main course. More bread as well and complementary tea to boot. We came here during Ramadan and there were many people waiting for the proper time to eat. We were asked if we wanted to wait or if we wanted to eat now which was no problem. This place seems to be very popular with people who know how to order as I liked what I saw other tables getting.Show less

Author: Ronaldinho EPhuket, Thailand
Title: Lovely middle eastern vegan options
Review: We were greeted by very friendly and helpful staff. We quickly realised that this was a place we had read good things about on trip advisor whilst we were staying in Georgetown because the name is quite distinctive, however the trip advisor listing we had looked at a few days earlier said it was in Georgetown, which it isn't. It is on Jalan Batu Ferrengi, in Batu Ferrengi, on the main road just next to the beach, just down the road from Golden Sands resort. Luckily we just happened to stumble upon it as we were walking along looking for somewhere to eat in Batu Ferrengi and we saw the word Falafel, a beacon for vegans. I'm glad we hadn't wasted our time trying to find it when we were in Georgetown!We explained that we were vegan and they were able to tell us which dishes would be suitable for us.We decided to have Tabouleh salad, Foul moudamas, humous and a mint tea. We have read great things about the falafel which we will be sampling on another night when we return.All of the food was great, cheap, and the staff were great.It's a shame that the lentil soup is made with Lamb stock as we would have liked to try that, but at least the waiter knew and was able to tell us.Show less

Title: Too good to be true
Review: Dined on 3 September 2017 in the late evening for 3 people. We had warmest welcome ever! The Turkish chef & patron who entertained us was simply amazing and made us feel at home.We had lento soup that was looking like no other and tasting shocking tasty! It was simply out of this world, spiciness and acidity was very well balanced.We were amazed with the amazing flavour of the appetiser platter that consist of hummus, falafel and two signature dips and the hand & home made flat bread that was accompanied by this appetiser platter.Tabouleh and Greek salad was freshly cut to order which is not usual in these days, was a perfect touch.Now I will talk about the two meat dishes , one was the slow cooked lamb shank and other one was eggplant & lamb ragout and both were served with special steamed rice but the rice was not a simple white rice , it was a signature blend.Overall it was a gastronomic journey and a total experience that is nothing but memorable.Mr Ibrahim is the finest host of this place which is undoubtedly the best Turkish restaurant of entire Malaysia!Must try definitely!Show less

Author: rudy138Tanjung Bungah, Malaysia
Title: The Best Turkish/Middle Eastern Option in Penang!
Review: Tucked away on a less touristy corner of Kg. Kolam in town, Rubin Mardini has been churning out arguably the best Turkish/Middle Eastern cuisine in Penang. For those beginning to get sensory fatigue from the constant flavour 'explosions' one associates with most of Penang's culinary delights, this eatery is a welcome change. The brainchild of Halil and his wife, who also happen to be a 2-man team, the welcome is definitely friendly, and Halil's detailed explanation of the various dishes and his well thought out recommendations are not something you'd expect from such an unassuming setup. Having been introduced to his food 6 years and 2 shops earlier, I came with expectations, which I am happy to say have been surpassed. Our hungry group of 6, including a discerning Iranian and her well-travelled son, ordered a tableful to share. The hummus was smooth and light but with just enough chickpea and sesame nuttiness to warrant another dip, without being too overbearing. The Greek salad was well put together, and our only grievance was that one serving wasn't enough for our hungry group! The cacik was flavourful, but due to a silly mistake on our part, we said yes to the reduction of garlic, which would have otherwise added a nice rounded touch to the perfect cold soup. A plate of falafel was cleaned off within seconds, the complementing tomato based dip making such an impression, we asked for more of the dip for the bread as well as the platter of fries we ordered! Then the mains. The musaka was my personal favourite, brinjal being one of my favourite things on earth. The lamb was, as Halil assured, not too dominating, but gave a nice stewy richness to the dish. Then there were the 3 rice based plates, each coming with a huge portion of some sort of spiced and herb-flavoured long-grained rice, and either a big piece of fall-off-the-bone well-marinated chicken or lamb. We had kabsa, and 2 others, whose names do not come to mind. They were just perfect, and with the generous portions, we spent a good amount of time trying to figure out how the prices were so affordable. Halil then served us dainty little cup of hot tea, and we couldn't resist his asking for 2 little plates of baklava, with 6 pieces of pleasure-inducing nutty richness and just a perfect touch of sweetness.The total damage for this gratifying treat for 6? Only RM94! How is this shop not full of hungry diners?! We will definitely be back, with more hungry people soon!Note: In case street parking is full, free parking is available in the carpark of the hotel next door. Just inform the hotel that you are going to dine at Rubin Mardini.Show less

Author: 663philipv

Review: Tasty, super fresh food. On top, great service and a exceptionally friendly Turkish owner. Ate here three times ans every dish was excellent. Best food we had in Georgetown or maybe even Malaysia. And definitely cheap for the quality you get.

Author: Heather OLeeds, United Kingdom

The Turkish tea (9 ringgit) was great, & we will be back to try out the baklava - it must be good because they were all out! Author: Vasfi A
Title: To taste based people
Review: They provide Turkish and Arabic food, the best taste not only in Penang but also in Malaysia. Very kind people with smiling faces.

Review: Lovely packaging with nice sweet and savoury plus 2 cups of Latte. Delivery during Fmco. Tasty mini burger, mushroom pie, smoked salmon and caviar on Mayo bread, cookies and muffins. Happy with the food!

Author: ScottLoarPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Much, much more than a sandwich cafe
Review: We were four, all living in Penang, an expat couple and a local couple, first time at The Book in the early afternoon for our usual Sunday lunch together, and as the only Westerner I was tasked to order: shrimp quesadillas, garden salad, three kinds of sausages with dipping sauce, vegetable risotto and a scallop risotto to share.This quality is uncommonly good, the mix of flavors first-rate proving the talents of the chef, for a bill of about MYR150 or US$38.00, which by any measure is not expensive for four. I have no idea about the sandwiches, and having this lunch experience and having seen the full menu I've no interest in having just a sandwich.The interior is well done, in good taste and not pretentious or trying to be funky, very clean and the staff prompt, courteous and capable. There is parking for three or four cars in front, more if double-parked.Yeah, I like this place, and next time I try their wines.Show less

Author: Adrian_on_TAPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: A mini reunion at the Book Sandwich Café
Review: We started our dinner with the arrival of the BBQ roasted pork salad. The delicious "siew bak" (Chinese roasted pork) was tossed with some fresh garden greens, cherry tomatoes, croutons and a sesame seed dressing. It had the right combination of texture and flavours to whet our appetite. The classic homemade mushroom soup was made up of a mixture of wild mushrooms. The soup was more like a pottage – thick and full-bodied. It was topped with croutons and drizzle with cream. We also had the Book Signature Soup. This popular soup had a light creamy base flavoured with saffron and lemongrass. Bountiful seafood treasures lay within including salmon chunks, scallops, clamps, prawns and squids. The crispy garlic toast complimented the soup well.For our main courses, my daughter ordered the sous vide chicken breast encasing a mushroom filling. Roasted cauliflower, broccoli, vine cherry tomatoes and mashed potatoes made this a winsome choice. One of my friends selected the braised barbecue lamb shank which sat on a serving of mashed potatoes, surrounded by green peas and broccoli, topped with deep-fried Enoki mushrooms. He enjoyed the generous portion of the greens or it would have been a rather meaty dish. The lovely fresh mint pesto accentuated the flavours in this dish making it a winner as well. I opted for Hokkaido scallop risotto. The bright yellow saffron-infused colour of the al dente rice was flavoured with good stock, cream and Parmesan cheese. It was topped with caviar, microgreens and diced crispy bacon. The pan-fried scallops were tender, sweet and simply delicious. I enjoyed the risotto immensely! The lobster marinara as a real showstopper. The uncomplicated pasta was flavoured with traditional tomato concasse and cheese, served with broccoli. This was a deceptively simply but satisfying main course that should be top on your list of must-try items at the Book Sandwich Café. The tender grilled French cut lamb rack was equally impressive. It was served with vine cherry tomatoes, asparagus, baby carrots, Portobello mushrooms and mashed potatoes. If you love lamb, you will absolutely enjoy this offering. Tiger prawns Aglio Olio was another satisfying dish. The spaghetti was firm to the bite and flavoured with crispy minced bacon, roasted garlic, chilli flakes and sautéed mushrooms. It was topped with Parmesan cheese and Ebiko (shrimp roe). We also ordered both the grilled fish items on the menu – salmon and barramundi. The 200g grilled salmon fillet was served with mashed potatoes and with mixed greens on the side. For the grilled barramundi, roasted asparagus and potatoes accompanied the dish. It was an ideal venue for a small class reunion – the food was good, the friendly staff attentive and the festive-looking deco charming. It provided us a conducive environment to feast on scrumptious delights, reminisce about our schooling days while enjoying each other's company. How quickly time flies and it was indeed wonderful to be able to come together to celebrate life and good friendships.Show less

Author: DrAmuz

Author: 551nadinesunshine
Title: Lamb shank
Review: Its good located ...food was good big portion 2 staff men was give us a good service everytime they check our table if good or not (Kiru and i dont ask his name ) probably will recommend this to our friends and relatives.

Author: TommoATLiverpool, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent

Staff are very friendly and attentive, and the food was all perfectly cooked, we opted for the scallops and ceaser salad to start, very generous portions, and executed perfectly, next we had the prawns and black linguini and the 5 spiced duck, again excellent. Author: mariacox30
Title: Love it
Review:
Always my favourite restaurant for spaghetti.
However the price is increased, and the concept more towards to fine dining.

Author: PeeBee5
Title: Best meal in Georgetown
Review: In the middle of our tourist must do street art hunt. We stubbled along this unassuming cafe excited by the familiar words sandwich, grill, steak that we had been missing from our usual Australian diets. We were instantly comforted by the ample air conditioning upon entering from a stifling day riding the mo-ped and walking. The “cafe” title undersold this restaurant with an extensive menu including a m7 Wagyu steak that was appropriately priced out of our drop in lunch date. The staff were friendly and attentive, meals were served fast and we headed back to our street art hunting.If your starting to get over the street foods and stalls and want to treat yourself for only slightly more money I highly recommend.Show less

Review: Good service from the staff and the seafood is fresh. We had a lamb shank and a lobster sandwiches which tasty nice. Worth the price

Author: martinhelmantel

Author: Graham F

Review:

Author: Christofer_SwedenGeylang, Singapore
Title: Had a coffee

Author: BigYungMiawTawau, Malaysia
Title: Amazing

Author: sishengw

Author: Randy O

Author: TuneK

Author: matthuan86

Author: thetraveler2829Beijing

The chicken was too dry. The cod was bland even with all the sauce provided.Service was attentive. English proficiency of staff members could be challenging at times.We would give this place another try with other items on the menu.Show less

Author: Triplem53Victoria, Australia

My wife had the roasted chicken ceaser salad and loved the freshness.Show less

Author: lalatwinklebellSingapore, Singapore

Author: bundaoli

Show less

Would recommend sharing as it can get pretty heavy. The bread was really soft but toasty as well (think we ordered poppy seed as recommended). Author: AnnaS0507Hamburg, Germany

Author: CrogglepopBirmingham, United Kingdom
Title: The best meal I had in Penang
Review: I decided to go here for my last day in Penang and it certainly didn’t disappoint. It wasn’t very busy, just one other table, but that’s all good by me! I found the staff to be sweet and helpful. Onto the food! It was always going to be the Lobster sandwich for me and what a way to say goodbye to Georgetown. Penang is famous for having the best food in Malaysia, and most times I’d have to disagree with that. However, the chef at the Book Sandwich Café pulled one out the bag and served something incredibly tasty.  The electricity went off towards the end of my meal and the staff were very apologetic, but again, it didn’t bother me in the slightest. I was on holiday so wasn’t about to be bummed out by the lights going off when they put candles out.  My lobster sandwich and Tiger beer came to 58.60RM inc taxes (around £10). Support this great place!Show less

Author: dghayfieldBanff, United Kingdom
Title: Lunch and what a lunch

Author: Xonayoho

Author: lelmaz

Author: turkia221
Title: Lobster Restaurant
Review: British environment ... specialized in Seafood (lobster) ... perfect bakery and sandwiches taste 👌🏼👌🏼

Author: Octo E
Title: The Disappointment of a Lobster Roll's Fan
Review: It's solely because of you, I have downloaded this app. We knew it's a hard to find parking venue and yet we decided to visit this place. We've round and round and round the area just to get a place to park on this public holiday. Then we walked and reached your cafe, greeted by a voice from far end saying "We are closed." We're confused. We did make an effort to call just half an hour ago to ensure the lobster roll is still available and the lady who answered the call said "Yes, it is available. You may just walk in since you'll be reaching in half an hour time." Happily we came and on our way there, we even double confirm by checking the operating hours online and it stated open today 12pm -10pm without any indication of afternoon kitchen break time. There is a lady manager came to us saying "Hi, you're the one who called but I'm sorry as the kitchen SUDDENLY make an order to close at the time we reach." The reason given is there is a lot of customers in the early session so have to close from 3-6pm to ensure there is enough food to be served in the evening. Are you kidding me ?! This is such a big disappointment to a huge fan of lobster roll. Oh ya, do state EXACT operating hours online will be much appreciated.Show less

Author: charlottep293Birmingham, United Kingdom
Title: Amazing decor with character, very peaceful and tasty food.
Review: I came here for dinner and had a lobster roll with salad and fries. It was extremely delicious. The interior of the restaurant gives it character and it has a very romantic atmosphere, especially with the lighting. Would highly recommend this cafe for dinner. Would recommend booking at busy times because very popular.Show less

Author: BluemingSingapore, Singapore
Title: Nice escape from the heat
Review: To escape the heat, we decided to have lunch at The Book Sandwich Cafe. We discovered we made the right choice as the food was delectable and I have to say, the food here tastes better than China House. The only setback I have to say for The Book Sandwich Cafe is the lack of service from the people working there. They hardly smile and there is a lack of initiative. Show less

Author: PoppyPotatoeSingapore, Singapore
Title: Best lobster roll in my life
Review: Wooh. I am impressed, utterly. I found this place on Instagram through some food pictures and boy, not disappointed at all. The lobster roll is huge, succulent and has cashew nuts and grapes in it! The flavouring is the best. Even though I was super full that evening, I just had to have it :D Not to be missed!Just be aware that there will be a +16% (service and taxes).Show less

Author: Kevin CPenang, Malaysia
Title: Lobster Roll finally...
Review: I was craving for lobster rolls and finally was introduced to this place. It is a small cafe with little seating. So you might want to book the place if you are coming with a big crowd.Two orders. Lobster sandwich and soft shell crab burger.Lobster sandwich was great for me and it came with fries and salad. I felt the salad was a little overdressed but it taste quite nice. The sandwich had a nice bread and the cashew nuts added the crunchy flavor.Soft shell crab burger. Asian burger. And came with fries and salad too. It had the crab flavor even though it is fried. The burger had an egg and cheese. Cheese I understand but egg was a little out of place, it made the burger tasted weird.Show less

Author: AndriaA_12Larnaca, Cyprus
Title: Great sandwiches
Review: This place is great. Went with friends and we all chose to have a sandwich they were massive. Really lovely service,great sandwiches and would definitely go back again. A party of 4 with a sandwich each that is served with chips,2 beers and two orange juice, the total bill came to 199.85 RM €42. Show less

Author: cubbaSydney, Australia
Title: Contender for best sandwich ever
Review: This is a big call and one that's hotly debated as this review is written but facts remain, we both agree this is one of the best sandwiches we've had.Thanks to staying in the area for quite a few nights and walking past the place several times a day, along with having seen favourable reviews on tripadvisor, walking home one evening we decided to try the lobster sandwich for dinner.Food is incredibly cheap in Penang so this ended up being the most expensive meal we had - it's definitely not cheap as a couple of drinks and two sandwiches came to about 130 MYR; by comparison you easily get two mains and drinks for well under 20 MYR at a Hawker centre. Having said that, this was a very nice experience with excellent food. The sandwiches looked small when brought out but served with chips and salad, we both felt just right after finishing our meal.The place itself has a nice vibe and well air-conditioned to the point where we were both borderline cold. All in all it was such a good eating experience we contemplated going back and definitely will if/when we return to Penang.Show less

Author: jdw1961
Title: Really good food, service, well recommended
Review: Really good food, service, well recommended. Reasonably priced. Not a fine dining restaurant but really excellent at what it does

Author: brucelee360Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good food and coffee in historic Georgetown
Review: The restaurant is in an old prewar shophouse. There is a small seating area upfront and tables leading to the back. The restaurant can seat about 30pax comfortably. The place is decorated with books, pages of books. Menu is helpful - its greatest dishes are highlighted in boxes. It does a good lamb rack, the real burger is made with homemade meat patties, the crab and prawn sandwich is also good.Show less

Author: pippyboomboom
Title: Just ok
Review:
We had dinner here on a very busy night.
Had a pasta dish and a burger combo...not outstanding by any means, cold fries.
Service was also okay, but seemed to  have a great energy as far as ambiance.
Cute place though, inviting from exterior.

Author: PaulO3291
Title: A must goto Cafe
Review: Excellent, beautifully put together very ambient and comfortable for the perfect cafe experience in Penang this is a cut above most so far one of my favourite cafe's for food and ambient surroundings...food is of professional culinary experience that is very evident in every aspect from taste and combination to freshness and delivery A must goto for such a unique place to open.. its worth the search!!...Show less

Author: Ogi86
Title: Best for lunch
Review: Awesome place for lunch. The mini burgers are great. Oh loved the fries. Great location. Good service. Mango lassi was just perfect

Author: chriscS1444NQ
Title: Best meal in Penang
Review: The food at this establish was exceptional. We had planned to go elsewhere and stumbled upon this little gem. Waiters were attentive and food was exceptional. I would definitely return again.

Author: rzinger
Title: Great Burgers! Cool  Vibe.
Review: Great burgers do not abound in Penang, Book Sandwich Cafe has some really nice options. The atmosphere is cool - small and cozy. Get there early, or make a reservation, as it is popular and fills up.

Author: 1234_10Ann Arbor, Michigan
Title: Charming place
Review: I was very hot so I ducked into this place to get a drink & cool down on Christmas Eve. They were jamming the Christmas tunes. Everything was decorated with Santas, nutcrackers, flickering lights, snowmen, etc. So fun! They had a limited menu for Christmas Eve so I went with wine & dessert. Both were very yummy. The people watching was great--a young couple on a date; older gentlemen drinking scotch; a baby shower; families starting their holiday celebrations. They seemed to be local people & it was lovely to have a peek at how Christmas is observed here.Show less

Author: Robert d
Title: Great Little Place
Review: Amids the hustle and bustle of Lebuh Pantai (Beach Street) is a quaint little restaurant that is truly outstanding. The chef / owner knows his job very well and has created an outstanding menu of snacks, sandwiches and mains, and his sweets are amazing, too.The great ambience and very good service are then the crowing glory.(Note, if possible, don't come by car during main traffic times because parking can be difficult; Uber or Grab will do the trick of course).Show less

Author: Eric LPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Good Ambiance, attractive interior design, is very romantic Cafe.
Review: Very good environment! it's definitely a very comfy & relax place for me. Their lobster sandwich is recommended, but just a small lobster, tasted really good and succulent together with chips. Waitress are Filipino and speak nice English.Reservation is needed, make sure to get a place in the weekend. If you like selfie, don't miss out the Book sandwich Cafe...you sure like it.Show less

Author: TravelistajenKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Nice cafe ambience but servers can be more attentive
Review: Chose to eat at this cafe as it was just a 3-minute walk from my hotel. It was quite busy on a Fri evening so had to wait. Cafe has a nice romantic ambience. However, the servers need to be more attentive and listen better. Ordered a salad with salmon and asked for the dressing to be separated as well as a glass of red wine. Server's command of English was poor and did not really know the menu.Salad came drenched with dressing and the salmon was separated after 20 minutes. Another server offered to change it for me which meant having to wait for another 20 minutes which I was not willing to as I was already starving.Red wine (Cabernet Sauvignon) was served cold and tasted horrible. Asked the server if I could have red wine that is not chilled and was told that all their wines, both red and wine are in the fridge (not chiller). No wonder the wine tasted terrible as it was too cold. Thankfully, the server was willing to replace with a white wine for me.Tip : do not order wine here.Not sure I would come back here as the overall experience was not that great.Show less

Author: Syme0nAdelaide, Australia
Title: Expensive for a First Bite
Review: Taking into account as to how mediocre the ingredients are in whipping up a sandwich dish, the price can be quite hefty to bear. Though their saving grace would be the amount of portion served alongside an interesting ambiance, the rest were quite typical. A great place though to catch up with friends or romance your beau if food isn't your top priority.Show less

Author: doraemongerSingapore, Singapore
Title: Lobster sandwich
Review: Just had to try it after seeing the review. Priced at RM38.90 excluding charges, it's a tad expensive. Bread was crunchy which I liked it more than the fillings. Okay, main point. The lobster dressing was overwhelming that I got sick of eating it in just 2 mouths but got to forcefully finish it since I don't like to waste food neither do I have anyone to share it with. To the extend that I don't even know what am I eating and I don't even know whether is the lobster fresh or is there any lobster sweetness. Oh ya, the lobster meat was also rather little. Perhaps go easy on the dressing. See is gorgeous but tasting it, is... service was great though with nice ambience. Do try other food instead (oh man, the roasted pork belly looked damn nice!).Show less

Author: Chips89
Title: Good ambiance / Good food / Good Service
Review: Ambiance [10/10]:Very good environment! Not sure bout others, but it's definitely a very comfy & relax place for me. I L.O.V.E how they decorate and arrange the cafe. Food [7/10]:Rating it 7 out of 10 because this is my very first time here. The menu is just too many for me to choose. Pasta, burger, sandwich... And lots of flavour of pasta & burger & sandwiches! This time, I'm getting my self sandwich. You can choose your own preference bread. Can't remember but I know there are 3 choices). And I've got myself a crispy chicken sandwich (if I remember the name correctly, hah! I forgot the name of the bread that I chose. :/). The sandwich, it's just superlicious yummy! Im loving it! The sandwich is served with some salad and a lil bucket of fries. For me, the portion is quite big, but still able to finish it. For big eater, the portion should be just nice! Maybe for small eater, you can share with your friends. :) Service [8/10]:Nothing to be picky about how their service is. Giving 8 out of 10 because this is my first time here. Overall, good service. :) Conclusion: Recommended! It's definitely a good place to stop by and give it a try! Would definitely go back again to try out the rest of the foooooooood! :) Show less

Review: Seemed strange but ordered a burger. Had the biggest burger served with fries all very acceptable. Not my normal thing to order Western food whilst away but this made a very pleasant change.

Author: AmandaPXSingapore, Singapore
Title: Cosy little cafe
Review: A pretty great place for a dinner date. Their lobster sandwich was my favorite, with chips on the side and chunky bits of lobster that tasted really good and succulent. The signature soup we had was flavorful & really tasty, definitely worth a try. The main we had - roast pork & bbq king prawn was a miss for us. Going for their signature dishes won't go wrong. I would recommend making a reservation if possible, as the cafe was full house when we went on a Friday night. We had to wait for about 15-20 mins before we could get a table. Show less

Author: BenGL_83
Title: Nice food
Review: Unique setting with a bookish concept..abit dark though. Food here is the highlight. Love their lobster sandwich.

Author: AthieDev
Title: Nice place
Review: The theme of the cafe and its interior ws something different. Food was ok. Presentation of food was different. Service was just ok.

Author: 525trevb
Title: The Book Sandwich Cafe
Review: Cool cafe in old Georgetown. Menu offers good variety of western dishes. Excellent food, friendly staff, great service. Chilled atmosphere.

Author: quahy2015Penang
Title: Good ambiance, variety of sandwiches and burgers, average service, mix feelings on the food taste
Review: I visited earlier in April when i read a few good reviews on the lobster sandwich.We ordered "the book signature soup" and the lobster sandwich.Love the soup but it's a mix feelings for the lobster sandwich. I didn't like the sandwich at all other than the bread itself. nice presentation and looks so appetizing. 1st bite was ok, and then as it goes on, I am so confused with the taste. That's so many different kind of taste exploded in the mouth, thinking what are they trying to tease us with the taste bud. There's capers, walnuts, grapes, full of mayo, mustard and other dressing. everything they uses in the sandwich just kills the taste of the lobster, i can only taste the dressing but not the lobster, what a waste. We are kinda impress with the menu, so we went again for the 2nd time in early August.We ordered the mushroom soup, pork burger and pasta. Pasta was good, big portion as well.Mushroom soup, just ok as they are just using some cheap mushrooms to create strong mushroom fragrance in the soup, nothing to shout about.As for the burgers, the spices in the patty kills everything. the taste of 5 spices is so strong, taste like lobak (chinese pork spring rolls). Probably it should be called oriental chinese pork burger. On an overall, i enjoyed the pasta and signature soup only which i don't mind to visit again. I like the ambiance as well. I think the chef likes to uses lots of ingredients for the marinates that it actually overkill the natural taste of the meat/seafood. May be I am the odd one, as i see lots of good feedback but I didn't enjoyed as much.Show less

Author: Byung Mo C
Title: somewhere in NYC
Review:
feels like you are sitting in a cozy restaurant in NYC. Atmosphere, flavor, freindly serving, and even the price!!!

분위기 좋고 친절하고 넘넘 맛있는 음식! 식구랑, 친구랑 또 가고 싶은 곳입니다. 약간 사악한 가격이 느껴지지만 그래도 그것을 뛰어넘는 훌륭한 맛! 멋져요!

Author: VQuahPenang, Malaysia
Title: Very good lobster sandwich & signature soup
Review: This is our first time there and I must say that to find a car parking spot is a great challenge. Reservation is not allowed and we have to for about half an hour for a table. Will recommend to try the lobster sandwich and their signature soup. Service is good and friendly. Show less

Author: michellemM8284HY
Title: Cute little place
Review: We ate here twice for lunch during our stay in Penang. The service was friendly and fast. The food was also very delicious. Great place to stop for a bite to eat and to grab some air con.

Author: Ana S
Title: Great food
Review: Great food, good service and amazing environment. I'm vegetarian and they did a special dish just for me. I recommend it!!

Author: 331Eija
Title: excellent food and service
Review: The signature soup was really the best part of our dinner. Even if the main cources were excellent as well. And in the humid heat of Georgetiwn, it was a real pleasure to dine in an air conditioned room.

Author: Y3580JLnickbNottingham, United Kingdom
Title: Best Burger in town.
Review: A friend and I came here for an evening fill and weren't disappointed. We both fancied a burger so went for the real burger and the chicken burger. Both were equally delicious as was the chocolate mousse cake my friend had for afters. The fries and salad that accompany the burger and the quality bread they bake all help make this a great place to eat. Staff are attentive and friendly and the atmosphere is comfortable and relaxing. Show less

Author: AMANDA87JONES
Title: amazing food
Review: amazing amazing food. tried the burger, sandwich, pasta, meat :) all were delicious. but beware, after having ur meal there you'll smell when u leave. limited space. pls do call for reservation especially if you are going with a big group.

Author: jyowpp
Title: Must try lobster sandwich
Review: The food is delicious and there is a wide selection of western fare from Lobster Sandwich to burgers.  I ordered the Lobster Sandwich and the soup and both were very good.  Only thing is the price is on the high side.

Author: Ng87StevenPenang, Malaysia
Title: Absolutely satisfying!
Review: Its been a while since I go cafe hopping and since my buddy from KL who happen to be in town, we decided to try this Cafe.We look through the menu and just simply ordered what is nice and recommended.Portion was good, taste was amazing. Would recommend to friends and families.I would definitely, revisit to try their lobster sandwich.Show less

Author: Alexander6011Tauranga, New Zealand
Title: Cute, cool and pricey
Review: We planned to call in here for a coffee, but this cafe doesn't open until 12.00 noon. We returned an hour later. The sandwich menu looks interesting but we thought it rather pricey. We settled for an iced coffee and a mango/mint frosty. The latter was a very satisfying thirst quencher and worth a return visit for a second round or another variation on the mint frosty theme. A first visit isn't always the best time to rate a restaurant and we will probably return.Show less

Author: welshman279North Wales
Title: Excellent food and lovely staff
Review: Open slightly later than surrounding eateries ( hawker market excluded) we came upon the Book Sandwich Cafe whilst taking pictures in Armenian Street. Good food, nice surroundings and delicious drinks made for a pleasant stop.My wife's lobster sandwich was excellent quality and very tasty. We thought the price was also excellent, just right.Show less

Author: ong1311Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: great Western food in George town
Review: This is a nice restaurant in town.I wanted to try their rosemary chicken which was said to be quite good. But alas, when I was here, they changed the menu and rosemary chicken is no more available. I opted for the roast chicken which was OK but not exceptional.portion is quite generous. This is one of the better restaurant,western-style in George Town.Show less

Author: Antonia B
Title: Enormous heavy fatty sandwiches
Review: Very polite and helpful staff in a nice bieder café. The sandwiches are pricey and enormous. They are soaked with fat though, oily onion rings on top of heavy sauce on top of fat meat. I'm sure people used to American fast food like it. I'm in no way a dieter, but I simply couldn't eat mine. Show less

Author: Hannah RLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Lovely place and tasty salad
Review: I stopped here for lunch and to get out of the midday heat.Great choice of food and I ordered a chicken salad. Reasonably priced and it was a decent size (I was fed up of being charged a fortune for tiny salads in previous places).Staff were friendly too.I really liked the venue - great place to stop.Show less

Author: 452liaw
Title: Yummy food
Review: Went here for dinner around 7ish, restaurant was getting busier. I ordered pasta and it was delish! Would come here again.

Author: Nomistrebor
Title: Refreshing break with friends
Review: Very accommodating staff who made every effort to accommodate a largish group in quite a narrow restaurant/cafe. Just had teas and coffees but everyone enjoyed the ambiance and service.

Author: cheah99Penang Island, Malaysia
Title: Great western food in George Town
Review: This is one of the best western style cafe in Penang. The chef is quite imaginative and serves the food fresh. We have been here several times and the food is consistently good. Try the chicken rosemary, lobster burger & pasta. It's one place one can count on if it's a craving for some western style food.Show less

Author: 2trvelWashington DC
Title: Nice place for lunch
Review: This charming little restaurant is a good place for lunch or dinner. We ate there twice. The sliced pork salad was good (but overdressed - ask for the dressing on the side). The soft shell crab ‘burger’ was terrific (although we didn’t need the huge pile of fries - they subbed them out for more salad). We also had the pork chop one night with cheesy fries. The chop was a bit overcooked but the sauce was tasty and the ambience and service are both very good. No A/C so lots of fans which worked for us, but it’s a consideration.Show less

Author: Tim P
Title: Amazing atmosphere and lovely food
Review: Highly recommended as the decor and atmosphere lends itself to increasing your appetite. The food is fresh and tasty. Good value and great service. Definitely will visit again before we leave for UK.

Author: travelbug2859Penang Island, Malaysia
Title: Touristic quality....
Review: Passed this cafe a couple of times but did not have the chance to dine till lately.Deco and ambience certainly attracts diners or visitors for a stopover in the bustling heritage part of Penang. An array of selection of pastas, sandwiches and snacks to choose from.We had the burgers, portion is mediocre. After the first bite, I found the pork pattie was not well cooked and had to be sent back to re-cook. It took a while before it was served again with the portion of the first bite still intact??I would have thought that they will replace the bun or re-dress the burger.A bit of a disappointment and slightly pricy for burgers and sandwiches.Show less

Author: re1na
Title: Big portions but delicious
Review: This cafe gets crowded quickly during lunch hours and have a good array of sandwiches, pastas and dessert. Had the roast beef sandwich and lamb sandwich here and should have shared as portions were quite big.

Author: gphfok
Title: Great food
Review: The food was awesome. Would suggest the Lobster sandwich and the spicy pork ribs. Service was attentive and the quaint decoration and atmosphere make the place a lovely destination for meals and afternoon tea.

Author: Changee610
Title: Decent place to have dinner
Review: The food was great, and the service wad okay too. It was such a cool environment to hang out with friends. For sure will come again next time when hving a gathering with friends.

Author: Fleur V
Title: Delicious!
Review: We were tree days in Georgetown and ate twice in the book sandwich café (both lunch). The food is really tasty and fresh. The burgers/sandwiches are amazing!! And the cappuccino is great! Definitely recommend this place!

Author: AnnAnn428Penang Island, Malaysia
Title: Nice to know this place
Review: We went there on a Saturday afternoon around 2:00pm for lunch and it was full and people are keep coming, better to make your reservation if possible. We have ordered their signature soup and 3 mains. Soup was good but is a bit salty for us but the burger and sandwich were good with a big portion (for ladies). May be weekends are usually very busy for them and the chicken that we ordered for my daughter was uncooked end up have to return to the kitchen and they have replaced another portion for us.Show less

Author: Jean-Ann R
Title: A Great Find!
Review: Great location in the heart of the Old Heritage Town. A small welcoming restaurant that that we couldn't get enough of. The food was so amazing and the staff exceptional. A must when visiting Georgetown.

Author: 12MLee
Title: Good food and deco
Review: Awesome sandwiches. Nice ambience. Fine selection of sandwiches, made with delicately made breads with soft centres and crunchy crusts. Very packed though, even on weekdays.

Author: cheryloas
Title: Average dining experience
Review: The food portion was big and reservations had to be made in advance in order to secure seats for dining. Taste was average. Price was slightly high. It was slightly hot in the cafe. Overall, it was just average.

Author: caveinacave
Title: Amazing!
Review: The Book Sandwich Cafe has some of the best sandwiches I have ever tried. Anyone in Georgetown should not pass this place by without trying it!

Author: 841madelinehVienna, Austria
Title: Wonderful experience!
Review: I went for a quick dinner there and in the end stayed for 2 hours.I am vegetarian and although the menu does not provide veggie sandwiches the staff provided me with a special creation of a veggie meal. It was extremly tasty! I also really liked the warm and comfortable atmosphere of the cafe. Service was excellent, too! An absolut recommendation from my side! Show less

Author: Marie-Dominique J
Title: Very nice place!!!!
Review:
A very good surprise for us!
Eat, drink, service, staff, ALL IS PERFECT!
You need to know this restaurant.
Stéphane

Author: RandyO400
Title: Perfect fine dining restaurant and lounge
Review: I really enjoy our dinner with my friends  the foods are delicious  specially the  lobster sandwich and duck chop. Fantastic services and friendly staff.

Author: Jeremy K
Title: excellent
Review: A very nice place. Nice people. The soup... I forgot the name, very tasty, very good. The same about the other meals.

Author: val0123Coatbridge, United Kingdom
Title: Delicious Food
Review: The food here is soo good. Tried scallop starter, fishcakes and tomato soup and they were all really good. Main courses surf and turf, lobster sandwich and duck chop. My mouth is watering just thinking about it. very reasonably priced and good service. Very nice atmosphere and a bit quirky. I rarely give a five but this place deserves itShow less

Author: Mitchell P
Title: Beautifully decorated and delicious!
Review: Quaint wee cafe which is decorated superbly with books, paintings and nick nacks for Africa! Food was also very good, I would recommend the duck chop and cafe special seafood soup. Well priced too!! Yum yum yum!

Author: JoanneLeowMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Fantastic food and service!
Review: After reading so many good reviews of this place, we made sure its on our must-visit-list for our recent Penang trip. Everything on the menu sounds so good but it didn't took long for us to decide what to order. We had the duck chop and lobster sandwich and they were fantastic. Presentation of the food was spot-on and the lobster was juicy and succulent. The duck chop was superb! Every element on that plate was truly an enjoyment. We felt welcomed from the minute we stepped in. Service was impeccable and high praises to Amy, she's so friendly and attentive!I would've rated this place 5-star if they've had a better selection for beverages.Show less

Author: Elynne TBradford, United Kingdom
Title: Love their sandwich, excellent service too!
Review: Could never resist the aroma of the bread when it came to be served on my table. Recommend roasted duck sandwich which the mixture of the meat and vegetable came pretty well in taste with their sauce. Bread skin is crunchy but soft inside. Will definitely come again to taste on their lobster sandwich!Show less

Author: 921aoifeoCork, Ireland
Title: Really nice place for lunch
Review: Went here for light lunch while we were pottering around looking at street art, it's very close to Armenian street. I only ordered a portion of chips and a drink and my boyfriend had a sandwich. The chips came with nice bbq sauce and interestingly there was a poached egg on top which was yum! The sandwich was also very good. They had plenty options including burgers and pizza, we simply weren't hungry enough for these but saw loads of food passing and it looked amazing. Great atmosphere inside. Drinks were very expensive at 6.80 RM each for cans, which in other restaurants are sold for 2.50. Show less

Author: Joaney JSingapore, Singapore
Title: Went Back Twice in Two Days!
Review: I am very impressed by the quality of food served at this quaint little cafe tucked in-between unpretentious shop houses. We ordered the Book Signature Soup, Sambal Udang Sandwich and Duck Chop. The portions are generous and very filling. It was definitely value for the money you are paying. The soup which we felt was the star of the menu was DELICIOUS. There were a generous amount of seafood and it was creamy and so addictive! We loved the food and the atmosphere so much, we took time out and made another visit. We ordered the Signature Soup, Seafood Marinara and the Duck Sandwich. Do order the sandwiches while you're here! We felt that the sandwiches are generally better than the mains. The bread was crisp on the outside, soft and flavourful on the inside. There's just so much to love about the food!! The fries could be further improved as it was mostly tasteless. I found a tiny strand of hair in my food on my first visit but the food was clearly good enough that it did not bother me as much as it normally would have. They have a really clean washroom too! Loved the service and the attentiveness of the crew! Great job you guys! Show less

Author: Becky_entzi
Title: First rated food and service!
Review: The food, especially the lobster sandwich and duck chop were beyond scrumptious! And is value for money! The first rated service and also the atmosphere added charms into the cafe! Will definitely revisit!!

Author: MinQi0208
Title: Good food
Review: Tried their Lobster Sandwich and Duck Chop, both were well cooked and delicious. Duck chop is the highlight, very unique recipe, succulent meat paired with mediocre mashed potato. Wine is very well priced. Good for a good night out with special one/s.

Author: Richard P
Title: They serve great sandwiches /w great variety
Review: We had lobster sandwich and Samba udang sandwich on our last visit to this wonderful restaurant. The food was great, the staff were helpful and attentive! I will definitely visit this place again!

Author: kathy2392015
Title: First visit to The Book Sandwich Cafe
Review: Thumbs up for the place, service &food.Heard & read about it. Was strongly recommended. Thoroughly enjoyed our lunch here.Ordered The Real Burger . Was a steal!Definitely will return with another group of friends!

Author: Hanhanseng
Title: Nice environment, food and service!
Review: Have been here for few times and I really enjoy tasting different food they provide in the menu every time. Make sure u try their signature food - sandwich. However, every food I have tasted was nice too! Recommend for those who love sandwiches! Also, it's a romantic environment although I always come alone.Show less

Author: arco27
Title: Great Coffee
Review: as everywhere in Malaysia it is hard to find a good strong Italian type espresso, but at the book we got great coffee with nice food and friendly service, great place to relax

Author: Rachel HKathmandu, Nepal
Title: Great food, service and atmosphere!
Review: We loved everything about The Book cafe. We went two nights in a row because it was so great! The price for food is very reasonable based on it's quality and the service you receive by the very friendly, attentive staff. It has a romantic setting perfect for a date or time with friends.Show less

Author: 526NicolaH
Title: YUM - Not to be Missed
Review: We have visited this cafe three times over the last two months and loved the whole experience each time. The food is delicious and beautifully presented and the service is outstanding.

Author: L_Ann07Penang, Malaysia
Title: Sandwich and appetizer is good, get a good seat is difficult.
Review: We are not allow to sit on the other table (which is a table of four) as only two of us, I feel not comfortable as the seat is near the entrance and it is kind of cramp. After request, we get moved to a little bit wider seat, but we still left early. A cafe normally factor in with the cozy and enjoyable environment into meal price, and I don't think our spending is less than a table of four, so I do expect to have a good and comfortable seat for dining.
