The other seat at rear part is really hot, so beware of that. Food vice, I would recommend the sandwich, which is their signature, the scallop appetizer and the signature salmon soup. Especially the scallop, which is very juicy. The soup is special and serve as good starter. Spaghetti is just average as it similar to Chinese style of frying.Show less

Author: Yussef L
Title: Stylish, Delicious and friendly
Review: Loved the decoration. Paintings that remind of Penang street art. Very good service and smiling staff. The food was absolutely delicious!!!! Do not miss the lobster sandwich. The sauce was amazing.

Author: Brigitte2351Perth, Australia
Title: EXCELLENT RESTAURANT - DELICIOUS FOOD
Review: My husband and I were looking for a restaurant that had Western Food as we wanted an English style breakfast. We happened upon the Book Sandwich Cafe. The exterior looked very inviting so we went inside and were very impressed with the decor. We sat down and were immediately attended to. The breakfast (eggs benedict) was delicious. Subsequently we went there again twice more and were very pleasantly surprised with the food which is of a high quality, beautifully presented and very politely and professionally served. Thank you owners/chef and servers. Will be back.Show less

Author: kelvinkk
Title: a small but beautiful place
Review: after a long day around Beach Street in Penang, came across this lovely sport which decorate their cafe with books, painting and origami made using old books. You can witnessed their creativity insetting the place. The food is nice and affordable too

Author: Dave1001Bangkok, Thailand
Title: Enjoyable Place
Review: Lunch today with a friend and was enjoyale.Place was very clean and seating/table comfortable.Wait people very polite. Kitchen staff very SLOW but food very good and attractive when served,Had smoked tomato, was excellent but way over priced for the portion served.Friend had crab cake that I sampled, excellent but did have pieces of shell in tasting. Friend had lamb sandwich and said was great. I had roast beef sandwich. We both said meat on sandwiches were cut a bit too thick. We also shared a ham and grilled cheese that shouldn't missed as was wonderful.Both had the frost drinks.Friend is a water drinker and waitress kept his glass filled w/o asking.I will return and suggest to friends!Show less

Author: Alan T
Title: First visit
Review: For me , it is an honour to have a restaurant like this in Georgetown . The food , you can feel the passion of the chef, very enjoyable dining experience

Author: Coops6219
Title: Definitely worth a visit
Review: After wandering around the old part of Georgetown The Book cafe was a welcome haven from the heat. Great decor and brilliant food. Fantastic service from friendly staff. Value for money. We left feeling recharged.

Author: Steve G
Title: Super friendly staff and good food
Review: A great place, and the prices are fine. I tried the chicken burger and my partner tried the satay sandwich. Both we're very nice.

Author: 225barriel
Title: fusion food in a bistro setting
Review: this place is adorable! easy to find, and it stands out from its neighbors eight eh friendly facade and inviting couches. staff is congenial, WiFi is excellent, the sambal Udang sandwich is delish (and very inexpensive)... altogether, a great place to escape the midday heat!

Author: acburns123Hamilton, Bermuda
Title: Hidden Gem!!!!
Review: Wow! I cannot say enough good things about this place. Where to even start?! It's beautifully decorated from the outside in. I literally wanted to stay there and make it my own house. The bathroom was clean, the service was impeccable, they had an amazing easy listening play list and the food was spot on! Love love love! You must go! Show less

Author: Andrew Y
Title: Fantastic meal & superb service!
Review: I had a late lunch with a friend from SG at this place. The food surpassed my expectation with it's simple yet delicious dishes! The Signature soup was special although it was slightly pricey at RM20+. But save to say, it was worth it! I had a carbonara as well and I like it too.The service is excellent. The waitresses there were super attentive and extremely friendly. I don't normally leave a tip but this time I did. As for the environment, the place is neatly decorated and the kitchen is in an open space for customers who are curious to see how the chef prepares the food. Really nice concept! Overall, I've no complain or any negative things to say. I would definitely visit The Book Sandwich Cafe again and I would suggest others to try them out!Show less

Author: Philipp D
Title: Awesome
Review:
Never had such a good vegetarian burger/sandwich! came with good fries and a small salad.

Although its more expensive than other places around its really worth it.

Author: jolijdamPulau Penang, Malaysia
Title: excellent food and affordable
Review: we have enjoyed our dinner in this new restaurant. the place is very well decorated and give a cozy impression within the old wholesale shoplot. a lot of old elements makes it stylish.the menu is very blanced and has a good range to chose from.the salmon tartar was excellent in taste and flavour, all fresh ingredients. crispy fish sandwich was a real main course and my chicken chop was good for both taste and quantity.an excellent red wine completed the dinner.the prices are really affordable starter from RM 12,50 and up with main course froom RM 20.in the evening it is no problem to find a parking lot and we just parked opposite of the restaurant.Show less

Author: 5EX
Title: Book us to Serve You!
Review: A promising Café at the heart of George Town, co-owned by one of renowned Chef of Penang Malaysia. Chef  Woei Liang Yeoh Peh

Author: baldwincKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Genuine, Honest and Good Food
Review: First time here based on the reviews in trip advisor and we are impressed.Dragon (the friendly boss) never missed a beat with his service (alongside other family members who runs the place). Great nyonya food, great set meals to satisfy hungry tummies and very reasonable pricing. Will come back for more! ProTip: Book a table in advance especially if ur coming during weekend/holidays. Show less

Author: Adeline CPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Great Nyonya Dish with good price
Review: We have a food package provided by restaurant which can try all kind of famous nyonya dish in the restaurant with enough portion. All dishes was tasty and cook by special spice and charge with reasonable price. Service of restaurant is great and warm. Thumbs up for the dessert 'black pulut' which must try. Definitely will come again. Show less

Author: FlyingPinkPandaLos Angeles, California
Title: Nonya cuisine like what my grandma used to serve us.
Review: One of a few things that’s always on my to do list especially in Penang is to look for authentic Nonya cuisine. We called Ivy Nonya Cuisine to make a reservation where we spoke with a friendly and jovial Mr.Dragon. (yes its a person, actually his the owner). The restaurant is tucked away in between the terrace homes, so parking can be tricky if you have a large group. Highly recommend to make a reservation if you have a party of four or more because the restaurant is quite small and it gets busy during lunch or dinner hours.Mr.Dragon was super helpful in providing us suggestion what to order for 5 people. We ended ordered Curry Chicken Kapitan, Jeow Hoo Char, Curry Fish and Sambal Shrimp which was all super delicious. All the food were made in the kitchen including fresh Nonya kuih or snacks that were available for purchase.I would absolutely be back because I love the food and the homey feel like I was visiting a relative, and less of the typical restaurant settings.Show less

Author: Dvicary
Title: Lovely
Review: Recommend by a friend. Delicious home cooked food and attentive and informative service. A very enjoyable experience

Author: msmann65
Title: Very good home cooked Nonya food
Review: Very good home cooked Nonya cuisine. The service could be a bit faster but the food is worth the wait. People serving are extremely friendly and happy to help with the menu. All in all a wonderful place.

Author: PatrickngiapSingapore, Singapore
Title: Lunch at Ivy’s Nonya Cuisine
Review: During my recent trip to Penang my Penang relatives brought us to Ivy’s Nonya cuisine for lunch. I found the food rather light in taste and not salty. Curry Kapitan was nice but the Assam pedas fish was too watery. I found cooking standard and food quality rather mediocre and didn’t deserve the rave reviews that I read. It’s now halal. The saving grace for dining there was the excellent homemade Nonya kuih sold there, far better than any that I can find in SingaporeShow less

Author: Ee Chuan NSingapore, Singapore
Title: Fantastic meal for 10
Review: Our family of 10 were on cruise stopover in Penang. Ivy' Nonya was a perfect lunch place. Restaurant was in a quaint old house, where Dragon the owner was a wonderful host and gave us his recommended menu. We left it to him. Kids loved the Chicken Kapitan. Kueh Pie Tee with a topping of their balacan chilli was really good. Went for extras. Huge portion of assam snapper fish and chicken ngoh hiang was delicious. Going off with an extra order of hei bi hiam in a takeaway packet. Highly recommended. Show less

Author: Daddypig331
Title: Good nonya food
Review: Delicious food. Family friendly. Book early. There is limited seating. Try the set menu. Reasonably priced

Author: ilovetotravelfoodieEurope
Title: Great Nyonya food in Penang.
Review: After having read so many reviews about this restaurant, in Georgetown, I took a Grab car from my nearby hotel to this restaurant. For just 54 ringgit all-in (cash only, no credit cards!) I had a really delicious Nyonya set lunch for one person, with two glasses of hot chinese tea, as was recommended by the quite helpful owner Mr. Dragon. One of his assistants Mr. Manuel afterwards recommended to me a good Nyonya dessert. A delightful Penang foodie experience indeed for all food lovers and definitely worth trying out if one happens to be in Penang. During my lunch visit, on a Sunday afternoon, the restaurant was fully packed with locals, which for me was always a good sign of the authenticity as well as the quality of the food.Show less

Author: TravelingWithZen
Title: Nyonya delight
Review:
Excellent services
from my Penang Friend recommendation this is one of the very few that still keep the authenticity of traditional Nyonya cuisine, price was slightly expensive but is worth a try when you come to Penang.

Author: atykalimiharjaSurabaya, Indonesia
Title: Great food, but long waiting time
Review: Went here for family dinner. Did not have reservation before so we had to wait for 1 hour to get a table. We ordered set of 2 for 3 people since we are not big eater. Food was amazing, especially Fish with Gulai Assam. Price range is ok for food quality. The only downside is long queue time, so better get reservation before. Show less

Author: 587osmanaSingapore, Singapore
Title: Dinner at Ivy’s
Review: This is a must visit to see Dragon and his wife, Ivy in the kitchen. The husband and wife duo makes the place come alive. The food is fabulous- rendang; kapitan chicken; otak and prawns... couldn’t fault it. Only wish they served some kueh kueh. We ended up buying back their Hei Bee Hiam to put on bread at home ...service is impeccable and super friendly ...you want great food and homely feel, this is THE place.. Show less

Author: HkTraveller01
Title: Awesome!
Review:
Excellent value set dinner with good variety of fish, chicken and veg dishes. Best/hottest sambal ever!
Will be back for the a la carte menu soon.

Author: stephenye0Singapore, Singapore
Title: Nonya Food - Penang Style
Review: Ivy's home-cooked Penang nonya food is one of the best in Georgetown Penang. It is found in a charming home restaurant setting which also means it can seat less than 30 customers at any one time. Needs reservation.The owner chef usually prepares a set menu which is great value for money. The combination of seafood and meats in the set menu makes for a good sampling of local nonya food. The spices used are delicate and the meats are tender especially the beef rendang. I love the home brewed nutmeg drink which is refreshing and leaves a lingering aromatic taste in the mouth.Show less

Author: tescoqueen
Title: Tour groups
Review: As we arrived so did a huge tour group, pre booked. Owner was entirely preoccupied with them, rushed out order. Food average. We got our drinks after we finished our food. Not a local place. Wouldn’t recommend.

Author: Nai BShanghai, China
Title: Authentic Nyonya Cuisine
Review: This restaurant was recommended highly by my friends. We went for lunch and was happy to find parking space along the street.Since the restaurant was owner managed, the welcome greeting can be better. Once seated, the menu was presented and the male manager went through the daily recommendation. He suggested we took the set lunch and add another 2-3 dishes to cater to our group. He recommended the fish stomach with the Assam Sauce. With the drinks, he suggested the homemade Lemongrass with ginger tea which was nicely flavoured.The food was served promptly with a bowl of steamed rice. Most of the dishes were authentic and we agreed that the Assam Fish and Curry Chicken were the best.The sourish Assam sauce was just right with the rice. The coconut gerisik in the Chicken Curry added the special touch.Overall we enjoyed the lunch and the bill was reasonable as the portions were enough to share.We will definitely visit again in the near future.Show less

Author: Jeremas93Melbourne, Australia
Title: Appetizing, authentic and decently priced Peranakan food
Review: Peranakan culture is very prevalent and promoted in Penang that it can be a real struggle to find a delicious meal out of the huge amount of Peranakan restaurants and cafes here. Fortunately the positive reviews for Ivy’s Nyonya Cuisine were very well-deserved.My family and I followed the recommendation the owner to try the set, where the owner kindly explained and showed various photos of the dishes. I would strongly recommend potential visitors to try the Lor Bak which is a deep fried roll with meat and vegetables wrapped in a delicious bean curd skin as the flavour of the roll’s stuffings just bursted a good way in my mouth.The set’s dishes didn’t disappoint either! I really liked the Kapitan Chicken where the meat was flavorful with the curry spices and tender. Do consider spreading some of the curry onto your rice as that just dramatically enhances your rice’s taste. The Joo Hoo Char was very well-done too, where nicely cooked vegetables and shallow fried shrimps go very well in a lettuce cup that you can wrap yourself!The restaurant can be very crowded, as although we reached by 6.30pm, we had to wait about 15 mins before we could get a table as most of the tables were either occupied or reserved. If you wish to guarantee your table, do consider calling in on the phone for a reservation and arrive at the appointed time so you can get your table with less fuss. Despite this crowd, I strongly recommend this restaurant as the various dishes are tasty and the service from the staff is excellent!Show less

Author: 91penelopebAuckland Central, New Zealand
Title: Delicious dinner!
Review: We came here for dinner one night after reading the good reviews and it certainly did not disappoint! Very helpful and friendly service by the front of house staff member (I assume he is the owner) who took us through the menu options. We opted for the set menu and added on a beef rendang as my partner was keen to try it. We were blown away by the food - the set menu allows you to try lots of different dishes, all of which were so tasty. The portion is large too- we couldn’t finish it! Highly recommended for a great, reasonably priced dinner in Penang when you get sick of street food! Show less

Author: Nick ZMelbourne, Australia
Title: Brilliant local ecper
Review: This place was full of locals which is always a good sign. It’s nothing fancy but the food and service is exceptional. I strongly recommend the set menu which can be somewhat altered to suit.There’s no alcohol but the rest of the experience makes up for it.Delicious.Show less

Author: JCookCheltenhamBlackpool, United Kingdom
Title: Return visit
Review: Came here in February for valentines night and loved the food so decided to come back during this stay in Penang. We received a warm welcome from the owner and the set menu is such good value and amazing food. Really beautiful food and great service. Can’t wait to return. Show less

Author: MariaW3924Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: authentic nyonya
Review: Walk in without book as its was early and on a weekday. Menu was simple yet has daily set menu. We ordered the set as it covers most of the dishes we wanted to try or must try.We were to hungry and hence didn’t take photos of our meal. Its has the homely feely and its taste was really good. Nyonya Fish fillet which was the signature dish don’t look like picture perfect like those in insta story BUT the taste was really amazingShow less

Author: kasselanDublin, Ireland
Title: Delicious traditional food !
Review: For those who want to try Traditional Nyonya food in a cozy and family restaurant, you should visit this place. The gulai tumis fish and the inche kabin fried chicken were yummy ! Ask recommendations to the chef, he is very helpful and can show you pictures of the dishes. Thank you Auntie Ivy for the experience, I’ll be back :)Show less

Author: Daniel C
Title: Excellent food, couldn’t think of an equally excellent review title
Review: This is our fourth trip to Penang, and we have returned to Ivy’s every single day (as long as they are open for lunch), which speaks volume seeing how most visitors descend upon Penang to restaurant/hawker hop. My family always enjoyed ourselves at Ivy’s, eating in this small homely set up, served by the unassuming owner and his staff. It doesn’t hurt that the food is always excellent, and no one I’ve recommended ever disagree. Looking forward to our next meal already!Show less

Author: Hsien_TehSingapore, Singapore
Title: Not good
Review: I don’t know if they were having an “off” day but the food was a disaster when my friends and I dined there. The fish in the otah was mushy and tasted far from fresh. The beef rendang was tough and sinewy. The sambal of the sambal kang kong tasted chalky and the hee peow soup had a strong fishy taste. I am sorry to say but as a person of Peranakan heritage, I was totally disappointed. Show less

Author: Ph H
Title: Nyonya dishes, simply delicious
Review: awesome taste on the set nyonya dinner set for two with a soup, 5 dishes and a dessert. Restaurant is nice and cosy  with nyonya decorations.

Author: miloqkAdelaide, Australia
Title: Delicious!
Review: We found this restaurant by accident. We visited the Northam Beach Cafe for a sunset dinner but found the food there to be disappointing. We saw Ivy's on the map and decided to give it a go.We were so glad we found it! We ate beef rendang and chicken lohbak, plus a vegetable dish recommend by the owner. It absolutely delicious, and well worth the journey from George Town. It was pricier than average meals in Penang but definitely worth it. Be aware that it's cash only, so bring enough cash that you aren't counting your pennies like we were!Show less

Author: Leena SFukuoka, Japan
Title: Best restaurant meal in penang
Review: If you're a foreigner struggling to find all the delicious food people blog about then I suggest heading here and going straight for the set menu. We ordered this today and wished we were here longer to try more food.You get more value for money and are able to try a variety of foods. The owner was so kind he even slightly changed one item on the set course for us to suit our taste more.I tried similar food at a more expensive restaurant in Georgetown (fish curry and the local glutinous black rice pudding) and the food at Ivy's was ten times better.Cant recommend this place enough!Show less

Author: NoliniceOakville, Canada
Title: Great food for me and to the mosquitos
Review: It has been said here before and I am afraid I will say it again, but the fix price menu, has some small but sufficient portions of all you need to taste. Very friendly service by owner, more than willing to chat on great English, lots of local families inside. Sitting outside ok until the mosquitoes start feasting Show less

Author: duttonstLondon, U.K.
Title: Every dish was delicious
Review: We were a family group of 7, including elderly grandparents, and were lucky to be seated at a large round table in the restaurant. The owner advised what dishes were available on the set menu that day, and suggested some additional dishes we may wish to add for the table - we went with his recommendations, and were not disappointed. Every single choice was delicious, and all members of our party really enjoyed the food. Service was great too, and we'll definitely come back here again when we are next in Penang. Highly recommended.Show less

Author: hsmomtravels
Title: Fall in love with Nonya food
Review:
Food was delicious and amazing! Left us wanting more!
My kids who usually don't eat spicy food, tried all the dishes and are now in love with Nonya cuisine.
Service was a bit slow but worth the wait.

Author: JessWph
Title: Nyonya foodie
Review: Craving for Nyonya food n was not disappointed with Ivy's Cuisine. Unpretentious place serves delicious nyonya food especially the Asam fish, sweet potato leaves in santan, and black pulut dessert. Price is reasonable. Would come again and try other dishes.

Author: Liz EMelbourne, Australia
Title: A must
Review: We’re all in the food/ hospo industry, and Ivy’s was recommended to us by a colleague. It’s a very unprepossessing little cafe, and yet the owner is so passionate about his product that you immediately feel you’re in the right hands. Go with his choices, make sure the broth with fish maw, the sambal fish and the chicken kopitiam are involved, get whatever else he suggests, and sit back and be thrilled by this wonderful truly authentic Nonya experienceShow less

Author: Explorer44434162323
Title: Cook and served from their heart
Review: Value for money with great flavour on each dish. Food is fresh and their otak otak cum kapitan chicken is a must try. Boss is genuine friendly towards all his patrons..... "Services from his HEART"

Author: Kai_WahMalaysia
Title: Superb Peranakan Cuisine
Review: We read the good review at TripAdvisor and decided to give it a try on our last night in Penang. We were so glad that we made this choice after having a sumptuous dinner of an authentic Peranakan food. As recommended by the owner, we ordered the set menu for 3 persons and add on some Ala Carte items because there were five of us in a group. These include Nyonya chicken curry, grilled prawns, Nyonya curry fish with tamarind, salted vegetable soup with duck meat, turnip with lettuce wrap, etc. We added the Nyonya Platters that included chicken Ngor Hiong, special salted fish sambas, minced shrimp (Hay Bee Hiam) and Otah. I must say all the dishes were so good and we loved them all. More importantly the price was very reasonable as it cost us slightly less than RM180 for five of us. The owner was very friendly and serving was reasonably quick. Strongly recommended and booking is advisable to avoid disappointment as they are really very popular! Show less

Author: Jac25Jac
Title: Dinner Traditional Cuisine
Review: Food was excellent did not skim on ingredients so it was tasty and price was reasonable. It's on a busy (day/evening) one way street so difficult for handicapped.  Owner was very pleasant and offered us parking on his premises. Will definately visit again.

Author: 784brookecCraigieburn, Australia
Title: Loved it!
Review: This was our first foray into Nyonya cuisine. The set menu is predominantly seafood. My husband’s face fell as he does not eat seafood. I’m glad I didn’t do my research first as chicken and beef alternatives were offered as replacements, but I got to keep the delicious, though small prawns.He loved the beef redang (too spicy for the rest of us even though it’s considered very mild) the rest of the food was tasty, salty and tangy. The drinks menu was limited- no coke or sprite (shock horror, what will the child do??), a plus in my book. He had iced milo, I tried the nutmeg drink.The dessert of the day was coconut sticky rice. Again, husband, not a dessert eater loved it. Fabulous meal.Show less

Author: hkvisitor1997Hong Kong, China
Title: Famous Nyonya cuisine Restaurant
Review: This small family run local food restaurant been here many years, they do not serve pork, so it's more busy than others, we order the from the fix price menu, for two person is MR65, 3 person is MR95 and for 4 is MR120 etc, the dinner have chicken, shrimps, vegetables and soup, more than we can finish, they also serve Ala Carte menu as well,price from MR12 to 24 average, we enjoy the experience, the cooking style only popular here, they do not accept credit card, please bring cash.Show less

Author: Jenny MSingapore, null, Singapore
Title: Good food
Review: Had the set dinner for 2 people, and absolutely loved every bit of it. Hearty, tasty home cooked meals. The sambal hae bee was excellent, along with the other dishes as part of the set. Had a table at the verandah instead of inside the restaurant which I thought may be noisier. Will definitely return when we’re next in Penang!Show less

Author: Chow M
Title: Sumptuous Nyonya Meal
Review: Arrived earlier to avoid crowd. Family had a great time enjoying the food, the owner has done great job giving us recommendations. What we especially like is the black glutinous rice dessert.

Author: kmquek
Title: Nice Nonya food
Review: The food here is good. I especially like the freshly steamed otah and the chicken kapitan. The lor bak is also nice. The rest of the food was ok.

Author: Joshuatqy
Title: The quality
Review: The quality and service is very good offering authentic and one of a kind nyonya cuisine, which is very hard to still see or find in Penang whith a more affordable price such as this place. It has the best traditional nyonya cuisines. Especially the rendang which is my absolute favourite. High recommendations for this dish but if you can't take spice, it's ok they have other unspicy options like their bee hoon soup noodles, soysauce meat with rice and nasi lemak.Show less

Author: yennyng
Title: Yummy & Cosy Place
Review: Saw previous reviews and was hesitated to come in. But it turns out so good! My aunt was happy with the overall food quality. Things to order are their platters and perut ikan. Their desserts such as gandum & pulut hitam is great too! Definitely be back again!Show less

Author: greenham01San Jose, California
Title: Good nyonya food at typical nyonya (higher end) prices
Review: This eatery is located in one of the old houses, so not in a typical shoplot. Parking can be difficult as the street is narrow. Food is generally decent, especially for the uninitiated - given I have been around nyonya cooking on and off (my grandma & MIL), I found the dishes not as intense in flavor as I am used to. Perhaps the dishes are "muted" down to accommodate the uninitiated. Still, most of the dishes we tried(fish, curry chicken, pork, lobak) was passable, with exception of the black rice pudding (dessert) - that was certainly watered down and a disappointment.Overall, portions on the smaller side (as is typical of nyonya dishes), but prices on the higher end - as is also typical of nyonya dishes (given the varied spices and the amount of work needed to cook the dishes).Overall, not bad as an introduction to this cuisine, a bit tame for the hardcore.Show less

Author: 342pena
Title: delicious
Review:
we really enjoyed the food
everything was very tasty and the staffs are so nice and lovely 
the price also good for everyone

Author: JinnaT2Geylang, Singapore
Title: Lovely little place
Review: Saw good reviews of this place and went to try it out. Great beef rendang, ayam kapitang and quite a laid back little place. It's not cheap but not super expensive either, around Sgp 7 for smallest size meal, which is quite a good serving. We had 2 adults and 1 child and ate MYR 130 for around 5 dishes. Worth trying out if you want a low key Penang nyonya cuisine. My disclaimer is that I wanted to compare nyonya cuisine of Singapore and Melaka to Penang's, and my conclusion is that restaurant stuff are all kinda the same! It's the genuine home cooked ones that taste different Show less

Author: yeelaml2015Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Homecooked Peranakan food
Review: The restaurant is small and reservations should be made. Can be noisy when the place is full. Food is delicious and authentic. This is a family run restaurant and is closed on Mondays. The tamarind prawns, assam stingray (if available), jui hu char, otak otak, kapitan chicken, beef rending, lobak are all delicious.Show less

Author: Dalip CSingapore, Singapore
Title: Definitely coming back here.....
Review: Malacca is touted to have the best nonya restaurants in M'ysia, given its Nonya hub status. So...when it was suggested to try Ivy's, there was some hesitation from within the gang of 11; esp since we only had 9 precious meals in Penang, and werent ready to blow any of them (on some flim-flam meal). But... we decided to risk it, and dinner it was to be on the last night (tip #1 : reservation for groups a must). Its located in a terrace house, with alfresco (smaller tables) and indoor seating (larger table sizes) -- its cooler and comfortable indoors, given Penang's humid conditions. Dragon (Ivy's husband) is a charming host and walks you through the menu (tip #2 : go with his suggestions); he knows the dishes well and works out the best combinations between the sets and what to add-on. Then.. just sit back, relax, enjoy your conversation, whilst awaiting the meal. The fish head curry is a must-try, as are the prawn/leaf curry, the vegetable wrap dish, chicken capitan. For a good variety, you wont go wrong with the sampler platter -- mini portions of yummy dishes (petai belachan a huge winner!). Service is great. The dishes come out freshly cooked, with the serving staff gently placing all the required items perfectly in front of you (remember : this is not a top-end fine dining resto...but a mid-ranged family-run F+B); giving perfect delivery to the meal.As you come towards the end of your meal, 11-year old 'Magic' (Dragon + Ivy's son) comes to the table ever so gingerly, and makes the dessert suggestions (3 choices only.. and we had all of them shared between ourselves). The Pulot Itam is a stand-out winner, altho the other 2 sweets are good in their own right. Altho Dragon is busy looking after 6 indoor (and 5 outdoor) tables, shuttling between the kitchen, serving, making light conversation (he's an affable fellow), you never feel being unattended too. Young Magic is the youngest serving staff member, and adds a fresh dimension to the whole experience, as he (nervously, and cheekily i must add) attends to you, when the elder staff members arent able too. The food is yummy, and the 11 of us were unanimous is saying : "we're definitely coming back here on our next Penang trip." Show less

Author: little_miss_perfectEssex, United Kingdom
Title: Delicious traditional food
Review: When we arrived, we weren’t sure what to order but the owner was really helpful and talked us through the dishes and showed us pictures on an iPad. We decided on the kapitan chicken, beef rendang, a vegetable dish that you roll in lettuce, another chicken dish that I forgot the name of and a seafood soup. Everything was so tasty and piping hot- no wonder the reviews are so good. Thank you trip advisor- we would probably never visit the more traditional places without being able to read the reviews first!Show less

Author: ClarisloveslifeMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Good try
Review: Randomly surf around Nyonya restaurant online and decided to try out Ivy.It's a restaurant in a small house, occupying only 4 tables inside and 2-3 small tables outside. It took quite awhile for our dishes to be served, however when they are done, all dishes were served at once.The male boss (Ivy's husband), a humble and friendly guy always standby around, assisting customers and even explain to us about the dishes. Personal touch added points If one likes intense sour and spicy taste of Nyonya cuisine, then Ivy might not be the best restaurant. All our dishes tend to be on sweet note, even for some dishes which we anticipate to be spicy According to the boss, northern Nyonya taste more or less influenced by Thai while Melaka's Nyonya foods most likely skewed to Malay taste which attributes to the spiciness.We paid total RM80-85 for 2 pax. Overall, it was a pleasant dining experience :)Show less

Author: jmullenk
Title: Interesting and welcoming ... and so tasty too
Review: I agree with these recent reviews. The owner was so kind and helpful. We went for the set menu to have a chance to taste all the flavours. It was too much food for us but really enjoyed the experience.

Author: MrS108
Title: Hidden Treasure
Review: The food is amazing. Have to try Kapitan Chicken. Service is friendly and swift. Great place to bring the whole family.

Author: AdamsWednesdayLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Great authentic cuisine
Review: Great little place, with authentic Malaysian cuisine. The waiter/owner recommended some dishes to us as we were unsure as to what certain dishes were. His recommendation was spot on - the dishes were very tasty and came out in a timely manner. I can definitely recommend the beef rendang. Staff were friendly and welcoming. Show less

Author: DeftlyDPortsmouth, United Kingdom
Title: Amazing food in a cozy venue
Review: Another excellent TripAdvisor choice.There is not much I can add to the already excellent reviews.From the minute we walked in we were welcomed with open arms. The menu was explained with passion & we chose the beef rednang & the chicken cappitain & a portion of veggies in a sesame seed sauce. Wow, the food packed a punch, it was delicious & plentiful & our taste buds are still tingling with delight.We’ve been in Malaysia for 4 months & this is by far our favourite meal to date.Show less

Author: JoRCamb
Title: Really tasty food
Review: I really enjoyed everything we ate, the asam prawns were especially delicious. Price was good and I would definitely eat here again.

Author: CalebS628KL
Title: One of the best Nyonya
Review: This is probably the third or fourth Nyonya Restaurant I've visited in Penang. By far, this is the best. Personally I don't think Nyonya cuisine appeals to everyone therefore do not expect it to be the general western/pub food which most people would happily accept. But if you are a fan, definitely try this restaurant. It is a small-medium sized restaurant that can probably fit 2 large tables and 3/4 other medium to small tables. I managed to try the Perut Ikan, sambal belacan, lobak, fried chicken, otak-otak and they were all very delicious. Certain dishes can be a little bit spicy.Show less

Author: Destination673627
Title: Just awesome!
Review: Food was delicious every mouthful! A must visit. Service a slow but worth the wait. The achar and sambal goreng were so authentic. Every dish was exquisite!

Author: 23booker
Title: Fabulous
Review:
What a find!

Local “home style” food cooked from the heart.

Delicious flavours, beef rendang, soya chicken, lettuce wraps, sweet/sour salad, all were Amazing!!!

To top it off........the service was superb.

Thoroughly recommend you try this place.

Author: StarThrower89
Title: True Blue Nonya
Review: Really enjoyable after a few days of carbohydrate filled hawker fare. Originally from Melaka now living in Melbourne I can appreciate the differences and quality. Authenticity defines this place and if you ask me it’s dishes have a more sourish siamese influence! Enjoy!

Author: coachdadi
Title: Best Nyonya Peranakan
Review: Eat and Eat.. all are delicious ... from appetizer to dessert . You name it.. chicken curry, asam fish, prawn ..tasty

Author: rebeccamxChina
Title: Unique flavors, really nice
Review: First time brought there by friends and really liked there food. Only eight tables in all. Felt special when dining there. Curry chicken has a special flavour, really liked it. An assorted appetizer combines a great varied of food, chicken roll, shrimp paste, egg and dish, etc. Show less

Author: POH BF M
Title: Delicious Food & Excellent service
Review: Had a dinner here with a few friends and teacher. The food is delicious with interesting presentation. The service is good too. Will surely recommend friends to come here.

Author: mncpetherAuckland, New Zealand
Title: Staff member hung up the phone when booking!
Review: This restaurant has a good reputation and is clearly popular but our experience never progressed past the booking process when the very polite person on the front desk of the E & O Hotel phoned on our behalf to book a table. he was told the only seating available was on the 'terrace' and when i mentioned a big storm was coming he asked if there was any undercover seating - at which point the Ivy's staff member hung up on him. perhaps a case of 'hubris' as they become popular as a restaurant?Show less

Author: NickWhite_12
Title: Excellent service and beef rendang
Review: A small restaurant with probably only 5 tables. Excellent service and outstanding beef rendang at very good prices.

Author: tomkate
Title: Great service and good food
Review: Lovely little restaurant in a street full of restaurants.  Had read previous reviews here on Tripadvisor and decided to eat there.  Perfect prices.

Author: choobengg2017Singapore, Singapore
Title: Non-pork Peranakan choice in Penang
Review: I was pleasantly surprised by a non pork option here. After all if one mentions Nonya cuisine how can one not think of Babi pangang and Ngoh Hiang? So we made a trip there for our first lunch meal in Penang, being the first walk-in patrons at noon. I was recommended the set meal which comprises the star dishes from the a la carte menu such as kapitan curry and Assam fish. The owner's linguistic skills impressed me when he switched from English to Penang Hokkien to mandarin and later Malay as more intentional guests trundled into the small dining space meant for five tables. The dishes came fast and furious. The kapitan curry is like a chicken rendang and the Assam fish was nicely paired with the banana flowers. The hee peow soup was a little light compared to the heavier versions I'm used to. My choice of a standout was actually the Poh piah style banguang eaten with lettuce and a very piquant belacan. Dessert is included in the set meal with a choice of Pulot Hitam, green or red bean soup. All in it was a great value set meal for two at 95 ringgit. Show less

Author: ShawnO431
Title: Good Nyona Restaurant
Review: Nice dining place which they made Delicious Food & very Good in Servicing, A good restaurant to visit in Penang Island!!!

Author: 158kareldBrisbane, Australia
Title: Delicious
Review: We went there on a Saturday night. The restaurant was busy with big groups. We were very warmly welcomed and the menu was explained. We opted for the set menu to get a taste of everything, and we weren't disappointed! Everything was delicious and tasty with the Kapitan chicken being the winner along with the fish! Well worth it! Thank you! Show less

Author: Kyoko T
Title: Authentic Penang Style Nyonya Food
Review:
Enjoyed the Penang Peranakan food during my stay. 
Love the Penang style Otak-otak which like a creamy fish pudding. Must visit for Peranakan fans!

Author: Shalla
Title: Brilliant!
Review: Great food and great service. We were a bit clueless about Nyonya food and the owner really went out of the way to recommend the right dishes and the food was simply delicious! Especially the kapitan chicken...yummmmm

Author: F5271CFleemSingapore, Singapore
Title: Superb Authentic Nonya Cuisine- Must Try!!
Review: Hello, I wish to recommend Ivy's Nonya cuisine. The food has a home-cooked feel and prices are reasonable with generous portions. Highly recommend Assam Prawns, Kapitan Chicken and soft beef rendang. Owner was honest in his suggestion of set portions to order, which was enough for 4 adults and 2 kids. It's a must try for visit to Penang!!Show less

Author: FuiYeeSingapore, Singapore
Title: Delicious nyonya cuisine
Review: Get to know this restaurant from website, which is recommended by the locals. We reach the restaurant very late and luckily still manage to get into the restaurant. Ivy's Nyonya Cuisine is located at a pre-war convertedhouse at Jalan Chow Thye. Order set meals for 3 pax and Huan Choo Masak Lemak which recommended by the restaurant owner. Daughter likes to eat the assam fish so much. We did like this dishes which make us feel like home cooked food. Definitely will come back again.Show less

Author: sujatav2015Hong Kong
Title: Delicious!
Review: We ate dinner here and then came back again for lunch the next day to eat our favourites again and try out other dishes we were curious about.Our favourites:achat (pickled vegetables)joo hoo char (lettuce wraps with sambal and a finely chopped vegetables, assembled ourselves)marinated minced prawnsfish maw soupThe fresh juices were excellent and so were the desserts (we especially liked the black glutinous rice and the wheat gandum).Show less

Author: sengfattlMalaysia
Title: Typical home cook
Review: This is a cosy restaurant, operated by a couple, plus their little son with 2 workers. The nyonya cuisine is basic yet you can taste the homecook essence. The ambience making you feel like dining at your own home. The couple is honest is making business and always suggest appropriate. Nice nyonya with medium price range.Show less

Author: smoochiejoyceKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Peranakan food
Review: 4 of us ordered the set meal for 2 as we weren't too hungry. Wanted to try the otak but wasn't available. Kapitan chicken and the asam fish were good. But what was a pity was the prawns. Only 4 were served. The nyonya dumpling as starter was good. Restaurant is very clean but the service is a bit slow. Need to book this place in advance.Show less

Author: doublestufcoreo
Title: Great first meal in Malaysia!
Review: We chose this restaurant since it was very close to our accommodations and were very satisfied with the food and the excellent service. Very clear menu and good suggestions. The special is more than enough food for 2 people and we were very happy with the stingray and the kapitan curry chicken! Show less

Author: GSiva27Singapore, Singapore
Title: Excellent food and honest owners
Review: My family and I booked a table for 18, and it was waiting for us when we got there. Dragon (yes, that's his name) greeted us, sorted us out, and recommended the set meal and a few other dishes that the restaurant specialises in. We put our faith in him, and he did not let us down. It was, without a doubt, one of the best Peranakan meals that I've had in Singapore or Malaysia. And I've had a few. Everything tasted very good, and we could not decide which dish was our favourite. I am not going to list all of them, but I was especially keen on the otak, hae bee hiam and fish curry. But, as I said, other members of the family found something else that they liked. The desserts were good to - try the barley dish. I also highly recommend ordering the excellent sugee cake for starters, and waiting for the dishes to come out one by one. What made the trip even better was the fact that Dragon sent me a message later that day to say that they had accidentally overcharged us. We were coming back to collect a few sugee cakes that we had ordered, and we got the refund with that. But props for the honesty - we wouldn't have realised that we were overcharged and it reinforced the fact that this is not just a good restaurant but an establishment run by some honest to goodness folks. Show less

Author: FlyingbertKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good recommendation
Review: Recommended by a friend. 11 of us.We took the package for 6 and added few other dishes. All good. Ikan gulai tumi, chicken kapitan, ju hu char, a dish like "4 season" which has otak otak, acar ikan masin, sambal petai. Others - fish maw soup, asam prawn. Dessert was - red bean, black glutinous rice... all good except the prawn. Bill came to RM411. Will return. Show less

Author: takewee
Title: Nice Nyonya Restaurant
Review: Nice place in a quiet corner along a busy street. Friendly owner but this place accepts cash payment only. Try almost everything and Otak is really great !!

Author: Gregory C
Title: Wonderful experience
Review: My family and I received a very warm and sincere welcome. The ambience is lovely, and the place is cool and comfortable. All the food was great (including dessert) - if you are not sure, just ask them for their specials and you won't go wrong!Show less

Author: gheesoon
Title: Acceptable food but overrated in TripAdvisor
Review:
A friend of mine and I walked 2.3 km from our hotel here to try out this restaurant. 
We had the set for two with the fish dish cooked with snapper.

Author: SooKuan
Title: Fantastically awesome and yummy
Review: Super friendly Boss and great environment. We all love the foods which are truly freshly home cook right after the order. Do not miss the red bean desserts. Highly recommended.

Author: ScottLoarPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: One of the Very Best in Penang
Review: Penang is well known for its foods, Chinese, Malay, Indian and a mix of all three which creates a distinctive taste, and although many restaurants throughout the peninsula and Singapore style themselves as nonya cuisine few can really claim the title. Nonya cuisine is the unique flavour created from a mix of Chinese and Malay foods through past intermarriage between the two cultures, and it must be halal to be called nonya cuisine. This taste and halal is what Ivy's has; you'll see foreigners, Chinese and Malays eating in the small house which is the restaurant on Jalan Chow Thye, a small street which in recent years has become one good restaurant after another.The owner of Ivy's is not only helpful but sincerely wants to ensure you enjoy the meal and offers suggestions you would be wise to accept, such as the set menu which be sure to include the pineapple/skate fish, and the prawns. Understand that nonya food is spicy, but its defining characteristic is a blend of Chinese and Malay taste which is, well, nonya cuisine. This is one of the five restaurants I suggest to anyone visiting Penang who wants a taste of the foods that make Penang famous. Also, the spelling of "nyonya" or "nonya" has changed according to the fashion of the times, but real nonya cuisine is not common no matter which restaurant claims to be so. Ivy's Nyonya Cuisine is the real deal and not to be missed.Show less

Author: 森特 文
Title: Great food
Review:
Delicious Nyonya cuisine in town. 
Price are reasonable. Service are good and friendly.
Pork free.
Nice place to dine in town.

Author: Marilyn186338
Title: Fab food, fab staff
Review: The tv crew were filming at the restaurant but the owner gave us a table on the terrace and explained the menu. We had a wonderful meal and the staff were all extremely friendly and helpful.

Author: JulieLimSYSingapore, Singapore
Title: Lovely
Review: My husband and I chose the set menu. It came up to RM 72 for 2 persons without drinks. The set menu includes rice, assam pineapple fish (the fish is stingray but you can choose the pomfret for an extra charge), hee peow soup, a choice of one chicken dish (curry kapitan, peranakan fried chicken or soya sauce chicken), cuttlefish and turnip vegetable wrap, pan fried turmeric prawns and a choice of dessert (black glutinous rice, red bean soup or a traditional oat dessert). All the dishes were delicious. I especially loved the turmeric prawns. Very tasty. The curry kapitan was a little too spicy for me but it should be ok for those who are used to spicy food. We arrived at about 7.50pm and it was crowded. We sat outdoors at the verandah which we didn't mind at all. They close at 9pm and payment is by cash only. They don't open on Mondays. Would definitely recommend.Show less

Author: NoreenChan
Title: Delicious Penang Nyonya cuisine in a homey atmosphere
Review: We were recommended this restaurant by a Penang resident and Ivy's did not disappoint. We were a large group (11 diners) but got good advice to order the set meal for fewer people, and then order a few extra dishes for everyone to share. The quantity and variety was just right. Standout dishes were the inche kabin, kari kapitan and the perut ikan (better than my grandaunt's but don't tell her).Show less

Author: JeslineD
Title: Great Nyonya Cuisine
Review: Food taste really good and the service is tip top in a very cozy place. The owner is a very friendly and humble man. Nothing is a trouble for him and food was served really quickly.

Author: njwongSingapore, Singapore
Title: Hard to beat - this Penang Nyona food restaurant
Review: Our 3-generation family of 9 went on New Year's Eve 2016 to usher in 2017. Thanks to other food reviewers from Trip Advisor, it was the best Penang Nyonya food we have had in a long while.We were recommended a set menu for 5 pax consisting of lobak (deep-fried meat roll); hae bee hiam (spicy dried shrimp), ju hu char (spring roll filling with dried squid), otah otah (fish meat wrapped in banana leaf),and achar (pickled root vegetables). To supplement, the owner suggested adding Inche cabin fried chicken, kapitan curry, and assam fish (red snapper). Excellent choices. Dessert for 5 was included in the set menu.Fortunately, we made a reservation for 6 pm. By 7.30 pm there was a long queue of diners, some of whom had confirmed reservations. Strongly recommend you start dinner early and make reservations in advance.Service? No smiles, but the food was tasty...and the total cost of RM 360+ for 9 (including drinks) is hard to beat.Show less

Author: AlmyhappySingapore, Singapore
Title: Excellent Nyonya meal!
Review: Ordered the sampler set that comes with dessert! Simply delicious. We added the otah which was additional. It's a waste they do not serve pork. We heard because the premise is owned by a malay landlord so out of respect, they do not serve pork.The curry chicken is so fragrant! Totally awesome. The snapper is tasty too. The assam prawn can be eaten with the shell. Desserts are also yummy. Overall, it was a very delicious meal.Show less

Author: Marwan1985Serpong, Indonesia
Title: Nice authentic local food
Review: Came here at 2pm and the table is still full but we are seated quickly. The food is good and portion is generous. Price is really reasonable. 65 rm for 2 pax and additional 15 to upgrade the fish. Loved the lor bak, the inchi kabin chicken and one other menu that we eat by wrapping it with vegetables, forget the name. The assam fish is too sour to our liking but its the way how assam fish is cooked here so we just appreciate the taste. Nothing to fault here and worth a tryShow less

Author: Elexx_375
Title: Very very good peranakan food!
Review: Ordered the set of 2 plus some ala carte dishes for my family of 4. Loved ALL the dishes and would highly recommend the beef rendang and otah!

Author: brownliquidsugarsingapore!
Title: Best Peranakan Meal we ever had!
Review: Excellent recommendations by the owner. We had the set for 2. Changed the stingray to pomfret and the assam pedas is amazing! With fresh and clean tasting. The otah melts in our mouths and we are going to miss it because we can never get such standards in Singapore. We didn't have enough cash because they don't accept cards and the owner actually was nice enough to offer us an option to pay next trip which we politely declined and paid in sgd.Heart warming service and delicious home cooked food.Show less

Author: bedimagesSingapore, Singapore
Title: Modest in Looks, Deliciously Deceiving!
Review: We arrived at Ivy's not expecting much from the looks of the place. It looked rather small, with 3-4 tables outside. The boss young son ( around 12yrs old), opened the door and greeted us. "Hello Sir, how many people?" I was very amused at first, then it hit me. That aroma from the kitchen just struck me! I knew then, we were going to have a great dinner. Turned out to be true! Recommendation: Hit the set dinner to sample the many different dishes. I wont spoil the surprise. Just try it already, best to book in advance or go early. Dreaming of it already!Show less

Author: simonhF240YM
Title: Incredible food
Review: One of the best meals I've had in 2 months in Asia. The beef rendang was flavoursome and the beef cooked to perfection. The Assam prawns were amazing. Highly recommend both. Great service to go with it!

Author: Irene_G1206Penang Island, Malaysia
Title: Pork Free Nyonya Food
Review: The restaurant does not serve pork. Service was a bit slow, waited for sometimes and no one approach to give a menu or either ask for a drink. I had the set meal which was a taster of various dishes - gulai fish, joo hoo char vege dish, kapitan chicken, soup, followed by a sticky rice dessert. The taste is not bad but I do find a bit pricy. Show less

Author: alexisployaSingapore, Singapore
Title: Excellent
Review: I'm glad we went early for lunch. The later tables had to wait longer to be served. The set menu has a lot of favorites, worth a try. If you're an otah fan, must try their freshly steamed otah- tender & melts in your mouth. All the flavours were good, spot on except I didn't like the Kapitan curry - a tad too sweet. Truly, authentic peranakan cusine. Show less

Author: jaseet88Singapore, Singapore
Title: Nice Food in a Small family-run restaurant
Review: This place quite small. They used their living room as a restaurant, so can only hold about 5 tables inside & 3 tables on their balcony. Best to make a booking before going there. As the food tend to be cooked individually, expect a rather slow wait.Show less

Author: eilliabs
Title: Home cooked Malaysian Food
Review: Great atmosphere. A real taste of local food that is home cooked. We chose the set menu and had a great selection. The owner explained exactly what we were going to eat and you could vary the selection if there was something you didn't fancy. Just to make it more homily the son ( about 9 years old ) was doing his home work in the corner and the interaction between father and son added to our experience and was just lovely to see.The food was superb - would thoroughly recommend Ivy's Show less

Author: Solosky2013
Title: Authentic nyonya cuisine
Review: Delicious, value for money authentic nyonya cuisine. We followed the recommendation and ordered the set menu. The place is really small and can only seat a number of people. So do make reservations to avoid disappointment.

Author: Alan_Pratt23Newcastle upon Tyne, United Kingdom
Title: Ivy's Nyonya Cuisine
Review: I used to live in Malaysia, and on my frequent trips from JB up to Melaka on business always looked forward to Nyonya Cuisine. Ivy's is authentic Nyonya cuisine with a very good selection. Ivy's Husband, Dragon, is extremely helpful in suggesting different dishes.The food was very good, so much so that after my first visit I went back a few times.Show less

Author: jchongIpoh, Malaysia
Title: Yummy!
Review: This is one of the highly recommended nyonya restaurants in Penang. In general the food is good. We had the asam prawns, otak-otak, ju hu char, kapitan chicken, inche kabin and sambal he bee. Serving sizes are on the smaller side.The only downside is that it does not serve pork, so some of the traditional items like tau yu bak and loh bak are made with chicken instead (which I feel is a poor substitute).Make reservations if possible since the place gets busy.Show less

Author: seeseepgPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Surprise from a little kitchen hidden away on a small lane
Review: One of the biggest surprise this year.Better than Nyonya Breeze Desire @ Straits Quay, even better value.Must eat place of the year. Wonder why i had not been here earlier.Few tables, tho, & outdoor seating attracts mozzies..... be here early or be insect fodder.Definitely will bring frens & relatives to this great place.Show less

Author: Tonykohlc
Title: Nice local food
Review: The Nonya food was delicious and nice. The staffs were friendly and were able to recommend nice dishes. The price was also reasonable. The setting is nothing to shout about but pleasant and clean.

Author: dtjt1
Title: Lovely
Review:
Nice place with good food and ambience. Love the place and not too far from gurney drive making it easy for those staying ard the city.

Would recommend this place.

Author: yss97Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Pork-free Nyonya food
Review: The food is quite authentic apart from the fact that it was pork-free. We had the set meal which was a taster of various dishes - gulai (curry) sting-ray, joo hoo char (chopped veg dish), kapitan chicken (curry), Assam prawns, soup, followed by a sticky rice dessert. All pretty tasty. Service was quick & we didn't have to wait on a weekday night. Worth a try. Show less

Author: joykooSingapore, Singapore
Title: Average Food but good ambience
Review: I was introduced to this restaurant by my Penang relatives. We were recommended by the restaurant to rake their set meal. So trusting the staff, we took it plus added in perut ikan, achar, sambal hebee. I share the same comments by one of the reviewers. The food came very fast and we can tell that the food may be cooked the night before and heated up. Can tell that they are not freshly cooked.Show less

Author: Dennis146Penang Island, Malaysia
Title: Food was good and tasty but some concerns
Review: This is a nice cosy eating place with lots of competition in Jalan Chow Thye. We were a bit suprised how fast the dishes came and when I came to taste my chicken curry Nyonya Style I found out. The dish was just warm the curry sauce and the chicken which was chewy (should not be like that). If in the restaurant business they should know that re-heating food to low temperature creates a breeding ground for bacteria it Must reach a minimum temperature for a minimum time to prevent bacteria.The party enjoyed the meal but I would not return.Show less

Author: AzOthmanBern, Switzerland
Title: "Very delicious Nyonya Cuisine"
Review: We was there on a Tuesday night and it was full!!! Some customer had to wait to have a table! It is located somewhere behind Gleneagles Hospital.The service is very friendly and fast.The food was very delicious, especially chicken Kapitan curry and the prawn with tamarind was very nice and crunchy. We dined outside at the veranda since it was a nice evening and not to hot.I strongly recommend this place. If you have to wait to get a table its worth it.Show less

Author: 1971run
Title: Great Nyonya food!
Review: Ivy's Nyonya cuisine is a small restaurant in Penang, with home-cooked Nyonya food. The menu presents a good choice in meat, fish and vegetables. The food is delicious - I cannot stress this enough - freshly prepared and clean. On top of that you have a good selection of beverages, including fresh juices.The restaurant is walking distance from the Thai and Burmese Buddhist temples as well as other interesting places to visit.Recommended!Show less

Author: sophiasng
Title: Very good nyonya food !
Review: It was crowded when we reached. I went with my hubby parents and relatives. There were like 18 of us. They tried their best to help us settle down. I would rate the nyonya food 8.9/10. It has been a long time since I tasted gd nyonya food. Before this I only tried nyonya food from Singapore. Must try if you like nyonya food.Show less

Author: Happy258Western Australia, Australia
Title: Overrated Nyonya Home Cooking
Review: Only 2 car parking space at the premise . Roadside parking is few and tight . Small space with about 8 tables indoor and outdoor . Father and one helper even with the young son helping service prove to be slow . There are la Carte menu and set menu to choose Vegetable and meat ball soup- tasteless Perut ikan - too sour and lack of fish stomach . Curry kapitan - thick gravy and heavy .Joo hoo Cha with lettuce and sambal -not bad Assam Prawn-crispy and dry . Good taste. Curry fish - not fragrant enough Pricing - reasonable Tried and tick it off . Show less

Author: Vince YGeorge Town, Malaysia
Title: Expensive Nyonya Cruisine
Review: Food : Good (8/10)Price : Expensive (8/10)Kitchen Cleanliness : Average (5/10), very untidyToilet Cleanliness : Poor (4/10)No of Table : Limited Serving Time : Poor (need to wait at least 30 min for food to serve) (4/10)Display of Food : Good (7/10)Parking : Very Good (8/10), FreeWifi Connection : Average (7/10) and FreeCredit Card : No Credit Card facilityNote : Cashier Counter very untidy and disorganize.Show less

Author: SuaveelleIpoh
Title: Awesome place to visit! Food is fantastic
Review: We went there for dinner last night, luckily we reserved a table. Food was fantastic, delicious and very nice. Is like home cook Nyonya food. Service is a bit slow due to only the owner and his son attending to the customers,but the wait is worth it. The Otak Otak is very good,so was the Kapitan chic,sambal prawns,jiu hu char,lobak chic,Inchi Kabin,Assam prawns! Thumbs up. Recommended highly. Parking is an issue as it's located along a lane with other restaurants. Show less

Author: KelvinPg
Title: Authentic n Reasonable
Review: 5 dishes plus a dessert for 3 persons rm80. The assam prawns were really good. Jiu Hu Char was good. Simple environment but cosy enough. Friendly proprietor. Simply love tbe food n place. The black glutinous sweet dessert was tasty.

Author: Hock Boon TSingapore, Singapore
Title: Friendly boss and excellent food
Review: Ivy's Nynonya Cuisine is in a quaint rather residential-looking area. However, there are some businesses in the area. The restaurant is along a quiet lane about a 5 to 10 minute drive from Gurney Plaza. The food is fantastic. The must try is the Tau Eu Kay Bak. It's basically something wrapped with some vegetable leave. The interesting part is that you wrap it yourself. Please add some of the chilli. But be warned, it's on the hot side. But, it's exceptionally tasty and flavourful. The taste of the chilli brings fills your mouth and as it fills your mouth the taste of the vegetable leaves mellow it down to give a balanced taste. Another must try is the kapitan curry chicken. It was well done, flavourful and well done The taste of the chicken exudes wonderfully.We also trie the red snapper. the snapper was fresh and it was well cooked the nyonya style. Not like some other restaurants that just throw simply steam the Snapper, Ivy adds some special nonya style gravy that is exceptionally flavourful.The owner also speaks excellent English and is very friendly. The restaurant opens at 6pm for dinner and I suggest you go there early as it gets rather crowded. Seating capacity is rather limited. But please don't bother going too early like 5.30pm as the staff are busy in the kitchen and you'll be left outside (unless you manage to catch them to open the door for you). Otherwise you can go for lunch as well. Another tip is to drive to the area, or at least think of some way to get back to your hotel. Uber or something. It's a rather quiet street and might be hard to get a taxi. But the quietness and quaint area adds to atmosphere of the restaurant. This is a true blue authentic local restaurant - not like those commercial restaurants that lack the homely feel and taste.This is really home-cooked to perfection. Key word perfection. Service is perfect.Show less

Author: Jasmine WSingapore, Singapore
Title: Very good authentic Nyonya cuisine
Review: They were so kind to accept us even though we walked in 5 min before their closing time at 9pm. We ordered beef rendang, sambal kang kong (stir fried vegetables with sambal) and Assam prawns plus barley for drinks. Nothing was bad. Everything was good. Highly recommended for beef rendang - tender and tasty not over cooked beef! Assam prawns was surprisingly good but I thought it was the gravy type. It's a dry stir fried with Assam. Very flavorful. Sambal kangkong never disappoints. Barley tastes like my mom's! Very traditional homemade style Show less

Author: Rebecca MBanbury, United Kingdom
Title: Nice family very friendly , food good , can however eat more luxuriously for exactly the same price.
Review: We were recommended this by a couple staying at our hotel, beware....what someone else calls great food is not always your version of good food.We'd booked ahead and the taxi brought us to a normal looking house with parking at the front off the main road. Inside the decorations are sparce, a couple of tables on the porch and room for about 18 patrons within. We sat indoors. The owner brought menus, his son played inside the restaurant, the cooking is performed inside by foreign workers, clean and presentable. Western piped music eg Everley brothers, toilets at the back, everything kept very clean.The spring and meat rolls were delicious, fruit juices well blended, the portions were more than ample, it just seemed odd that everything was served all at once, ie the starters and the main so that the main wasn't as piping hot as preferred.The acar fish steaks were good with a great deal of ginger, a vinegary taste.The chicken Kapitan was good , we only got three assam prawns , should have been four, they were well grilled, the veg was a bit bland and the black rice and coconut milk adequate.The food was good don't get me wrong and the service very good, but for exactly the same price we ate in more luxurious surroundings and very delicious foods in another Nyonya restaurant the following evening.I don't wish to run this place down, it is nice food and I'm glad we went however we ate more lavishly the following night for the exact same price.Show less

Author: JuldiPerth, Australia
Title: Disappointed
Review: Went for dinner based on TA reviews and particularly for the rendang.Food was average. For a slow cooked dish, the Rendang tasted like it had undercooked spices.Show less

Author: MazzaJohno
Title: Hidden gem in the back lane
Review: Awesome delicious food yum yum! Even dessert! Only service bit lacking they r obviously understaffed. Must make reservations or else long wait for a table!

Author: annwongsy
Title: Confirm sedap
Review: Authentic nyonya cooking. fresh seafood especially the prawns. please give it a try. We visited during CNY 2015. Even with the holiday season the quality of the food was not compromised.

Author: dharmavilasanRawang, Malaysia
Title: Superb Customer Service
Review: This was my 5th visit last November...Great Customer Service, tried most of the dishes and all of them have their own signature.Limited space, operates within limited hours.. So be sure to book during public holidays. All of you who reading this review, be sure to visit this place if you happen to visit penang.Show less

Author: DawnBiglandHalifax, United Kingdom
Title: Lovely restaurant and excellent food
Review: I should have posted this review over 12 months ago and now I've just come across some notes and emails giving details of our visit in January 2015 but I can't go back that far on the month visited....understandably, so here goes:A wonderful family run restaurant. The owner was very welcoming and informative. We decided to go for the taster menu which at the time was, fish maw soup (Hoo Peow Thng), fish curry (Pomfret in Gulag Tunis Assam), assam prawns, traditional Nyoman mixed vegetables served with lettuce and chilli sambal (Joo Hoo Char), beer rending, and black rice pudding. Everything was absolutely delicious and the beef rendang was the best I've tasted to date. Definitely worth a visit and when we return to Penang in the future we'll be going back.Show less

Author: Lee O
Title: Good Intro to nyonya food
Review: Great food at a reasonable price. We had the tasting menu for 65 (for both of us) and added the 15 for the pickled fish... Well worth it, it was delicious. All the food was good and the service was great.

Author: ttvarkey
Title: Penang Nyonya Food
Review: A few variety of local food which we have never tried before though a Malaysian. Kapitan chicken is unique, Assam red snapper fish is delicious. Recommended

Author: hendomaniaLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Exceptional
Review: Small unpretentious restaurant in a quiet street. Turned up on spec to a busy establishment, however we were welcomed and asked to take seat on the outside terrace (inside was full of local Chinese). Plan B would have been the Japanese next door.It was already busy, but we were brought salted nuts whilst we waited. Shortly thereafter the owner brought the menus. We opted for the set menu, which was priced at RM 65 for two persons with option of paying an extra RM15 for a fish option.All I can say is that elements of the meal weren't like anything I'd ever eaten. Fortunately this was a good thing! if you eat nothing else,please try the fish in pickle, I can't stop thinking about it.In summary, great value and great cuisine.Show less

Author: Ngfongping
Title: Worthy to try!
Review:
Nice food with reasonable price!
The desserts are nice which not too sweet! Just nice and home tasty!
We have fish, Chicken, prawn, soup, popiah, desserts! All is Nice!!
Keep on maintain the standard and we'll back!

Author: Deci2014Townsville, Australia
Title: Beautiful food
Review: My wife and I had a splendid meal here. We went for the set menu with the addition of beef rendeng (as recommended my a fellow trip advisorite). All the food came out together which allowed us to try, taste and enjoy the many flavours which are within the nonya cuisine. The beef rendeng and the chicken kaptain were amazing, and I highly recommend.The host can speak fluent English, so if you need any suggestions and is more than capable to help you.I hope you all go here because it really was amazing.Show less

Author: rosiem333Melbourne, Australia
Title: Good food (albeit cold) odd service
Review: Authentic Malaysian/ nnonya cuisine. We had a few dishes on our waiters recommendation. The beef Penang was fantastically flavoured (best so far in Malaysia) and v tender but unfortunately served tepid. Chicken curry was very nice but also only luke warm. Veggie dishes were a mixed bag. We were the only people in the restaurant so hot food shouldn't have been such a challengeThe fresh juices were very nice and the restaurant decor itself pretty basic but fine. Free wi-fi was a bonusShow less

Author: Chong WSingapore, null, Singapore
Title: Very authentic home cooking style setting
Review: Went with a big group of 9. Our host, Dragon look a bit overhelmed with the full restaurant but dishes and drinks came out all in good order. Didn't have to wait long after all. Good variety of dishes - combining the set menu for 5 pax + a few ala carte dishes to complete the feast. Kapitan curry chicken, joo hu char and assam gulai fish are must try. Pulut hitam dessert is the light version and we have no problem squeezing it in despite after a full meal. Show less

Author: MissSaucyRichmond, United Kingdom
Title: Good casual spot for food with locals
Review: We stopped in here for a late lunch. The restaurant looks a little tired but we weren't there for the scenery.We opted for the set lunch for 65 MR. We got a lot of food and it was very tasty so definitely worth it if you want to try authentic local cuisine. Clearly also a place that locals still go to, rather than a number of highly rated spots on trip adviser which are basically catering to tourists / westerners even if offering local cuisine.The guy who owns it (we assume) was lovely and very helpful - it was our first day in Penang and we had no idea what to try. His recommendations were spot on.For someone who usually judges a restaurant by its looks, I was pleasantly surprised. Show less

Author: MMAH10Penang Island, Malaysia
Title: Tasty Nyonya Foods.
Review: Small simple place with few tables place. Car parking a bit of problem. More of a home cooks restaurant. More for good food tastes with good service and reasonable price. Most dishes tasty and nice. My favorite one is the sambal haby. Great deserts especially the black beans with coconut milk. Show less

Author: james_paul1
Title: Great food, great host
Review: We had a brilliant Nonya meal at Ivy's. If this is your first Nonya experience I'd highly recommend, as the host is great at explaining the dishes and recommending.

Author: DJANDYK17Skovde, Sweden
Title: Wonderful!!
Review: We actually booked a table, as it was recommended. The host is a really nice and charming person, who immediately came out to greet us. One could feel that he wants to make u feel welcome and that he wants to give you a good experience by giving u just good food. We took the menu for 2 persons for 65rm, where you can try a a few dishes in smaller portions. The kapitan chicken was a delight, the prawns indeed fried till perfection, the fish was not just our liking but still well cooked. All in all just a great evening with great food. And i have to say nyonya food is very interesting, a very unique style by combining different flavors in a very interesting and yummy way! This will stimulate your taste buds, for sure! Talking about the taste buds: the homemade sambal is pure fire, but try it in combination with the veggie dish in small dosis! It is really good, But be warned: this stuff is serious business! ;)I wish more places would focus on the food and hospitality like this one here, because that is the spirit what makes a restaurant just good! :) so, our compliments to the chef! Show less

Author: HpLianSingapore, Singapore
Title: Genuine Peranakan cuisine
Review: On our first day in Penang the six of us took a taxi to Ivy's for dinner. The locale is not too easy to find. It's owned by a husband & wife team. The wife Ivy is the chef. Was recommended to take a set for 4 persons followed by some a la carte dishes. We had Assam stingray,Kapitan chicken,fish maw soup,mixed vegetables,lor bak chicken roll and red beans/black glutinous rice with coconut milk for desert. The dinner was delicious and left us satiated. The bill was $250/- ringgit. About US$60/-. Show less

Author: TWGoh
Title: Good home cooked nyonya baba food- the best you can get
Review: A friend recommended this highly for nyonya baba food and yes it is as authentic as you can get for home cooked nyonya baba cuisine. To me this is the best in town.

Author: nellielimKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Genuine nyonya food
Review: Tucked away in a quiet enclave on Chow Thye Road, off Burma Road, this is one of the better Nyonya restaurants in Penang. We ordered kari kapitan chicken, otak-otak, assam prawns and ju joo char and was satisfied with the taste. They also have a set meal which is value for money. Best to get reservations as it can get really packed especially on weekends. A definite recommendation for genuine nyonya food.Show less

Author: Sim NSingapore, null, Singapore
Title: Very delicious peranakan food
Review: Was there with my 8+3 family members on Sunday. Luckily I made reservations as the place filled up very fast. Damn good peranakan food as we ordered tau eu bak and eggs, otak, kapitan chicken curry, curry fish, sambal hae bae petai etc. Whole family loved the kapitan chicken curry, probably the best in town. I will definitely come back for another family dinner. Giving rating of 4 stars as the service was so-so but food is definitely very good.Show less

Author: Angela20140210Hong Kong, China
Title: Authentic Nyonya Cuisine
Review: It is a family run cozy Nyonya restaurant offering authentic Nyonya cuisine. The curry and the Kapitan chicken are very yummy, a must try is the catch of the day which you can choose different Nyonya sauce to go with. The night we went were full house and the kitchen was so busy that they cannot accept additional order. It was a pity that we cannot try all dishes we want.Show less

Author: marinsulGeylang, Singapore
Title: A great place to eat in an off the beaten track
Review: Found this place on TA. Location is in a residential area, in a very quiet street. Food is amazingly good. The vegetable roll with rice noodle and mushroom and fried chicken were delicious. The curry fish, although it is fresh, wasn't our favorite. Didn't try any dessert because we're still full from breakfast but I have no doubt that the desserts taste excellent. Ivy's is a must go when you are in Penang.Show less

Author: Yarzar_Zaw_Min
Title: Best Nyonya Cuisine in Penang
Review: Ask for set lunch menu. 3 paxs set menu is more than enough for 4 paxs. And you may ask some recommend dish from the owner. Lobak is nice too.. 👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻

Author: baoshunSingapore, Singapore
Title: High expectation - Bad experience
Review: Made a reservation for 8pm dinner. Arrived at the restaurant and there were only hungry diners with no restaurant staff in sight. Waited for 5min and finally saw somebody. Informed of my reservation and only to be told that we had to wait outside until a table is available. Obviously, the earlier reservation was not recorded. We waited. After about 20minutes, still not one in sight to usher us to our seats. We gave up. Wanted to inform the restaurant but the guy was too busy taking orders from other diners. We figured, the wait is not worth it especially if the wait time for the food is expected to be more than 45min (based on TripAdvisor forum).Bad experience. We had high expectations. Just too bad. Left disappointed.Show less

Author: Cheryl O
Title: Very cozy and food is great!!!
Review: We have been there already two times and the food is great. Even though they were a bit shorthanded but the food is just like eating at home.

Author: mimosa_miniSingapore, Singapore
Title: Fantastic delicious Nyonya Cuisine
Review: Taste is authentic and yummy! After browsing through the reviews, I decided to bring my family there for some authentic nyonya dishes.. it was surprisingly good and yummy! All of us had a second serving of rice and all the food ordered tasted great and suitable for young children! We ordered the 4 pax set that costs about RM$120 and added more dishes as we have 7 adults and 2 young children. We added Joo Hoo Char, a fried turnip dish that goes so well with the lettuce leaves.and sambal belacan ... Nyonya Achar, Kapitan Curry Chicken, the tasty Lo Bak (chicken roll), steamed silver promfret In assam and Loh nui (braised hard boiled eggs), fried chicken.. everything tasted so good! it's a small restaurant with less than 15 tables so do make reservation before going.. you probably will have to wait about 30-45 mind for your food to be served but it's worth the wait! Show less

Author: danieloR2895ZGSingapore, Singapore
Title: We love Ivy's Nyonya Food
Review: We came here in 2013 and now again. The food is still as good. My wife, our two daughters and I had the menu for 3pax. A good selection and enough for all of us. Beside the food which is great we love this cozy restaurant with a very friendly host. Makes you feel like at home. Will for sure be back if we visit Penang again. Show less

Author: MissypenguinSingapore, Singapore
Title: Food Taste good but slow service
