Review: Went with my husband to try out the food as the reviews online were good. Food was pretty decent. However it was not really crowded but the service was pretty slow. Waited for a good one hour before the food and drinks were served. They looked like they were shorthanded so it could be a one off experience. We took their recommendation of a set meal which consists of dishes the following dishes, Fish Maw Soup, Mixed Vegetables, Sambal Prawn, Assam Fish and Ayam Curry and end off with a dessert which is burbur chacha. All were nice except for the prawn which was tasteless and you can tell it was not too fresh. So we hardly ate that. The Assam Fish and Ayam Curry were good. Other than that the rest of the dishes were mediocre. Paid around 100 ringgit for our meal which I feel that it is a bit pricey based on the level of service, food quality and also the ambience. Show less

Author: Nardev_RamanathanSingapore, Singapore
Title: Fantastic Nyonya cuisine in Georgetown
Review: I was also a member of the 'big party of 11' mentioned by Miss AudreyWang below and can definitely corroborate all the points made in her well written review, which also ,I daresay, represents the views of the other 9 of us in the travel group as well. I would only like to further add how personable and attentive the owner, Dragon, often coming around to ask us about the various dishes, yet not overdoing it to the point of interrupting our meal. Having a small and cosy environment, with a somewhat Peranakan feel adds to the dining experience as well. Some nice old country tracks from the 1940-50's were also playing in the background (e.g. Jim Reeves - Bimbo) which, while not quite Peranakan music, was a very refreshing change and definitely enhanced our dining experience. I will definitely recommend this excellent restaurant to friends and family who might plan to visit Georgetown and look forward to visiting it again if I ever end up in Penang myself.Show less

Author: laudtravelsSingapore, Singapore
Title: Cosy little restaurant serving food with lots of love!
Review: We were a big party of 11 and wanted to make reservations, however we couldn't get through the restaurant's line. Lucky for us, we came slightly late for lunch and waited about 15 minutes for the restaurant to clear before we got our table. The friendly boss, Mr Dragon, gave excellent recommendations to take a set menu and add on other ala carte items. He was patient in explaining the dishes to us and flexible in replacing items in the set menu to other items which we preferred. We tried almost every item on the menu, and the most commendable dishes are the Cabbage-wrapped kueh pie tee with their amazing chilli, Kapitan Curry Chicken, Soya Sauce Chicken, Petai with hae bee and Sambal Kangkong! Different dishes came with unique dips, all of them taste out of this world! Mr Dragon also gave us some complimentary nonya kuehs at the end of our lunch! I've tried many restaurants serving Peranakan cuisine, and Ivy's Cuisine definitely has topped my list! Every dish is full of flavour, love and sincerity.I would highly recommend Ivy's if you are looking to try Peranakan food in Georgetown. But be patient, the service here is quite slow and we took nearly two hours for our lunch. Every drink and dish was prepared fresh with great quality hence we are not complaining. We will definitely be back on our next trip to Penang and we hope to see and try more non-chicken dishes! See you soon, Ivy's Nyonya Cuisine. :)Show less

Author: zhouf2015
Title: Best ever
Review: Wanna venture Ivy Nonya along the way but realize is was super late. But I still give them a call hoping their last order is 9 instead. Thinking I will need to miss it after no answer. A moment later a return call. Rush down from where we was, owner say just come over and he recommend the perfect meal for usShow less

Author: Travelicious_KKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good, authentic Nyonya food
Review: Tasty food at very reasonable prices. It can be tricky to find this place if you're not familiar with the area, so best to Waze it. The proprietor was a very nice gentleman. If there's any feedback I have about this place is they should have more that just one vegetarian option. So, not the best place for vegetarians.Show less

Author: SueMeiTIpoh, Malaysia
Title: It's like eating at home
Review: We ate here on 2 occasions, tried their set lunch and dinner. Very tasty peranakan food. Both occasions did not disappoint. It felt like eating in my own home as every dish is lovingly cooked to perfection like my mother's cooking. Show less

Author: homarcus88
Title: Nice and unique food
Review: The food is nice and special. Especially the beef rendang . The prawn look normal but taste good. The belacan is the best. I will come back again.

Author: MarkAH1507Ipswich, United Kingdom
Title: Worth a visit
Review: We visited Ivy's whilst staying at Clove Hall which is a short walk away. We had tried to visit it last year whilst we were in Penang but went along on an evening when it was closed so this made us even keener to visit this time around.It is a small, homely restaurant with half a dozen tables inside and a few outside on a terrace. The owner was very helpful and enthusiastic and suggested a set meal for two (there were three of us) enabling us to choose a couple of dishes off the a la carte menu to accompany it. He also advised us to have the deep fried chicken off the set menu rather than the Kapitan curry when we chose the beef rendang as one of our additional dishes.The food is cooked by his wife and was excellent. I cannot recall what the dish was but it involved wrapping some noodles and mushrooms in a lettuce leaf with a fiery sauce - awesome. The assam prawns were delicious and the rendang was superb as was the deep fried chicken and our host's help with the menu rewarded us with a memorable meal. Very much worth a visit if you find yourselves in Georgetown.Show less

Author: C33kSingapore
Title: Excellent homely feel of Penang Nyonya food
Review: We ordered the set with red snapper and added lok bak, achar and lor neng. It was a satisfying meal. The dishes were well executed and the less lemak and more tangy version of penang nyonya food was a welcomed change to its Melaka counterpart. Fish was fresh! Love the assam prawns and the achar! The owners were v gracious. We were there just as they were about to close for lunch break but they served us anyway and was v hospitable. We'll definitely be back when we visit Penang again!Show less

Author: fool2013
Title: Home cooked
Review: One of the better Nyonya food we had. Food taste home cooked. Service was good. They have group set meal which is accommodating. Recommended!

Author: nightfurythedragon
Title: delicieux!
Review: one of the best nyonya cuisine i've tried in Penang. reminds me of my grandma's cooking. my favorite would be the curry kapitan chicken! would like it to be more spicy though. personal preference.

Author: JerylublyWest Drayton, United Kingdom
Title: I don't get all the rave reviews!
Review: I went to Ivy's last week but I also went to Mum's Place in KL and the two can't compare. Frankly, the Kapitan Chicken was very mild and not so strong in flavour, the 'morning glory' was over-cooked, and the sauce the prawns came in was too sweet. Granted, the price is not much at all. During my visit the restaurant was busy with visitors from Hong Kong and another large party. As others have noted, it isn't a huge restaurant and the décor is 'shabby chic' but I must say that the food is simply 'ok'. I wonder why this place has so many reviews compared with the aforementioned Mum's Place which is leagues better. Now, I have absolutely no affiliation with my preferred restaurant. It's just my honest opinion. As for the service, it was fine. No complaints here at all. Hmm. I think that if you haven't had good Nonya cooking then you will be well catered for here but there are other better restaurants around.Show less

Author: CTTAN26
Title: Good Nyonya Food
Review: Good food! You van eexperience the home cook tease in this restaurant. Service is good. And price are moderate. The only thing need to improve is environment.... oilly smell from kitchen can be feel when enter into the restaurant.

Author: Christine FPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Basic decor, excellent food
Review: Run by a very friendly young couple this little restaurant tucked in a rapidly developing area (for eateries) serves local Nyonya cuisine (the traditional blend of Chinese and Malay flavours) in a somewhat drab interior but makes up for it (and the poorly designed lighting) with its excellent food. Ivy is in the kitchen while her husband looks after their guests. Nyonya food is elaborate and is best eaten in a private home (where recipes are jealously guarded and passed on from generation to generation), prepared by a cook who has the time (and knowledge) to produce authentic dishes. This is "slow cooking" food. Ivy seems to have been initiated into the secrets of such traditional dishes as otak-otak, chicken curry kapitan, prawns assam, sambals, etc. As a result, dinner last night with four friends was a real treat and though we over ordered, we polished it all. The decor and lighting need improving though..the reason why I don't give it an "excellent" rating.The restaurant does not sell wine and charges a small amount for corkage.Show less

Author: Phua WSingapore, Singapore
Title: Great food!
Review: Tucked away in a small street is this quaint little eatery which serves quite authentic Peranakan food. The 3 of us tried the set meal for 2 which offers a choice of a 6 dishes and dessert. We chose - Ayam Kapitan, Joo Hoo Char, Assam Stingray (or change it to a Pomfret Fish or fish of the day for an additional M$15-20), Fried Prawns ,Nonya Duck Soup and a dessert. We added 2 side dishes and it was pretty good. Total bill for 3 including drinks is M$143 which is pretty reasonable.Great find !!Show less

Author: CestMoi33singapore
Title: Best meal in Georgetown
Review: It was a busy night at this restaurant and good thing that we asked the hotel to book us a table here for 5 of us. I saw a few patrons had to wait or come back at other time. Food was great and it was the best Peranakan meal that my family and I had in Georgetown. We ordered a set menu for 5 of us and all was great. The samba belachan was very spicy to some but I enjoyed it. If you want to try great authentic Peranakan food, you should come here. The service was great and owner was very attentive and friendly.Show less

Author: samtan71
Title: New experience of northern Peranakan cuisine
Review: Never knew there different dimensions of Peranakan cuisine until I tasted food from this restaurant. The favours are light and elegant. If I have to draw a comparison between Penang's Pernakan food witth those with Melaka and Singapore using my understanding about wine, I consider Penang's as Burgundy while Melaka's and Singapore's are Bordeaux. They are all tasty and I love them. Thoroughly enjoyed ourselves.Show less

Author: GillieRLondon, England
Title: Delicious food & authentic dining experience
Review: My husband & I visited this restaurant in Penang, whilst on holiday from UK, based on the Trip Advisor reviews. We were not disappointed. It is a small restaurant, located approx 10 min taxi ride (15 RM) from the E&O hotel, where we were staying. We opted for the set menu which includes many dishes (Fish curry, chicken, shrimp, soup). We were not very familiar with Nyonya cuisine and the manager helped to explain the menu items. The service was very attentive (despite the fact we arrived late & close to the restaurant closing time) and the food was really delicious. We thought it was excellent value for the quality & quantity provided. We were advised by the manager that all the food is cooled by Ivy herself. I would definitely recommend this restaurant to others as an example of a high quality, authentic Nyonya dining experience! Show less

Author: SueChooSingapore, Singapore
Title: Tasty home-cooked cuisine!
Review: My family of 5 have to walk in the sweltering heat to locate this restaurant. When we went in, the restaurant was totally empty, that got me worried cos' good food attracts crowd but this one is empty on Sunday lunch 1pm.But my worries were unfounded, we order the set for 3 (which comprise of 5 dish + 1 dessert) + 1 separate order for Beef Rendang. The quality of the food blew us away, we polished off everything!One dish that deserve special mention is the humble Ban Kuang Char (shredded turnip, carrot, mushroom & dried shrimp) served on lettuce together with their home-made sambal. The sambal gives an oomph to the dish but most importantly the dish in itself is so tasty & sweet! I can eat it by the mouthful :p The kind owner even offered us kueh-pie-ti to fill with. Again, the kueh-pie-ti was fresh & crispy, nice! Then there was the beef Rendang, so tender & succulent, oooh!We are totally contented, spent a total of MYR150 cos' we ordered 5 drinks in addition to the set menu & beef Rendang. See my photo of their menu for easy reference. :-)Show less

Author: Irene T
Title: Good food Great Host
Review: Food is good and very tasty. A little pricey for Malaysian standard but with exchange rate is acceptable. Dragon, our host is very attentive and the overall experience very good and our group enjoyed ourselves. Only regret that we didn't have tummies big enough to finish everything.Show less

Author: themenonSingapore
Title: A great find
Review: I brought my mum here for dinner while we were on a trip to Penang and we were delighted with the meal. We had the set meal for two, which gave us a wide assortment of choice nyonya dishes and almost too much food for a reasonable price. Everything tasted great, and the service was prompt, attentive and friendly. I'm very glad I found this place while researching before the trip, would definitely go back if I visit Penang again!Show less

Author: iansiow
Title: Pricey...
Review: Nyonya food. Food rating would be 7/10. Environment 5/10THE price is 3/10As they charge 2.5 X local price for the portion they provideShow less

Author: K0ayKHPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Pricy
Review: I brought guest from overseas together with colleagues. 7 of us in total. We ordered 2 sets of 4 pax set meals. Drinks were expensive, one nutmeg drinks costs RM6. One of the dishes which was supposed to be prawn was changed to otak-otak without prior notice. At the end of the meal, we were asked whether we wanted some mango fruits. We said ok. Then we were served about two mangoes. That cost RM30. In total the meal was about RM370.Show less

Author: Jacqueline_skPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Bad Impression
Review: 7 out of 10 dishes are not available in 'Today's special' list, even juices on the list is not available, reason given: 'Today is a little busy, can i just make you an apple juice?'No first come first served basis! I have no comment on the foods, but the service definitely ruined my night.Show less

Author: gnoredaSingapore, Singapore
Title: Not the best
Review: Had lunch with family of 4. Got bitten by mosquitoes 3mins after we sat down. Dinning area is their living room (small). The restaurant owner is very nice but we reckon quite a home cook taste. And honestly, not really impress by the taste.Show less

Author: Weng2608
Title: Delicious food!
Review: For the amount of food we had, 8 dishes & 1 dessert, it was value for money. The owner was very friendly and chatted with us on and off. Makes you feel like dining in someone's home instead of a restaurant.Would highly recommend this place to everyone visiting Penang and wants to try home-cooked authentic nyonya food. Thumbs-up!Show less

Author: John TPrague, Czech Republic
Title: Well looked after
Review: All of the guide books tell you how wonderful the street food is in George Town, but unless you are a local, or have acquired previous experience, it's not always easy to know what, or how, to order in an environment where neither the cuisine nor the language is familiar. (Our evening at the seafood food court on Lebuh Duke - VERY popular with the locals - was a case in point, we ended up eating a plate of chopped fish cakes, prawns, potatoes etc in a sweetish red sauce and not really enjoying the experience since we had no idea what to expect and very little opportunity to influence the food preparation}. This must account for much of the popularity of Ivy's Nyonya Cuisine, where the proprietor, who speaks fluent English, gives forthright advice and - to novices like ourselves - recommends the set menu and helps you to pick out the individual choices on it.... since the names generally mean very little to the uninitiated. As a result there was none of the "ordering anxiety" which can otherwise accompany meals in unfamiliar surroundings, and we felt well looked after from start to finish when our host ordered a taxi for us.It is difficult for us to judge the food itself without having much knowledge of local Chinese-Malay cuisine. It was all tasty, but nothing had us jumping up and down in excitement at a new discovery. To my mind the best and most surprising taste was the combination of spicy sambal with cooked vegetables and mushrooms which we were invited to wrap in the lettuce leaves provided! The fresh pineapple and ginger drink was also very good. Asian desserts are a bit of a no-go area for us (what is it with beans? we always find ourselves asking) but the sticky black rice in coconut milk was a pleasant end to the meal. It seems to be important to reserve in advance, since hopeful guests who walked in during our meal were mostly turned away. It is worth mentioning that the surroundings are simple and plain, and the bathroom facilities out at the back might not appeal to all (squat toilet). If your expectations are not over-sophisticated and you would welcome being gently guided through the meal, this could make a good evening out whilst in Georgetown. There is only a handful of tables, of which three are large round ones seating - I think - eight people, so it could b be a good place to go with a larger group. The price was more than reasonable.Show less

Author: travelholicj70Singapore, Singapore
Title: good food with good service!
Review: went on a sat afternoon and luckily we do not have to wait to be seated. it is a relatively small and cozy restaurant. went with 3 other friends hence we ordered the set which has a good range of dishes. all the dishes are so good we finished everything! the rice is also free flow. we feel very satisfied and happy at the end of the meal. the price might be on the high side for some but i feel that the good food makes up for it. the owner is very friendly and chatted with us. i will definitely go back if i visit penang again!Show less

Author: Jesse DMelbourne, Australia
Title: Stick to the street food
Review: This place (at the time of visit, Tripadvisor's 4th best local restaurant) was just around the corner from us, so we thought we'd check it out. Not sure what the other reviewers see.We ordered the beef rendang and the vegetables with prawns, along with drinks and sides. The rendang was relatively tasty, but at MYR 18 only contained three small chunks of beef. The vegetables with prawns were equally pricey, and to our dismay, quite tasteless. 6 of the smallest prawns you'll find on a dinner plate topped a bland plate of what is known in other parts of Malaysia as jungle greens.Service was okay, but in the end we were left with a large bill and a disappointing experience. This is a case of when Tripadvisor reviews let you down.Penang has amazing street food and food court dining at about a fifth the price of Ivy's. Fill up on that before you decide on a gamble at a place like this.Show less

Author: OllieSetLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Great food, verging on pricey
Review: Really friendly little place, they seemed to be full, but managed to squeeze us in. The food was excellent - we ordered the set menu - and considering how busy it was, it was fairly quick. The only thing stopping it being 5* is that after a couple of months in Asia, it is quite pricey (though maybe not by western standards).Show less

Author: LucifrostYork, United Kingdom
Title: Lovely taste of local cuisine
Review: If you're looking to try tasty local dishes served by lovely accommodating staff, Ivy's is a great restaurant to try.We arrived late for a lunch serving because we had just arrived but the manager didn't mind. We tried the set menu for two people with the restaurants signature juice blends. All was very tasty and at a good price.Show less

Author: BeachesAreBest123Columbia, Connecticut
Title: Delicious Nyonya food!
Review: I went to Ivy's in spite of hearing from proprietor of my hotel that there were better Nyonya restaurants, and we were glad we went! We went for lunch, and found the proprietor to be very helpful and friendly. He took his time to explain the dishes to us, and we had a pleasant conversation. We had assam prawns, curry kapitan, some kangkung belachan, and some honey lemon tea. Everything was delicious. We were given some desserts, pulao hitam, free of charge, and they were also utterly delicious. Next time in Penang, will be going back for dinner!Show less

Author: MiroSuBangkok, Thailand
Title: Good atmosphere, good Food
Review: This is a simple restaurant with typical Malaysian food - but cooked in an excellent manner. If you are not sure, what to choose, just trust the recommendation of the very attentive owner and you can't get wrong. We also enjoyed the fruit Cocktails, e.g. the Ananas with ginger and the apple with cellary. Summarized it is a place worth to be visited and we will definitely return.Show less

Author: Stephen WSydney, Australia
Title: Ivy's Nyona Cuisine
Review: I went with two friends to Ivy's on 28 November 2013. The host, Dragan, was charming and helpful, and advised us how to construct a set of courses, including an excellent beef rending. He arranged for a man to appear with a small range of wines, including French and Italian reds. I would definitely return.Show less

Author: Maureen3005Amsterdam-Netherlands
Title: Wonderful tasty Nyonya food
Review: We went to Ivy's because if the reviews on tripadvisor, the taxidriver didn't know where the restaurant was but luckely we found it.We were greeted bij our host at a nice small restaurant. After our host gave us advice about which fresh fruitjuice to choose he explained us the menu. We choose the pineapple ginger and apple sellery juice...both had nice flavour!We then had the grouper fish curry, sambal prawns, chicken kapitan in lemongras scented thick gravy...hmm succelent coconut beef rendang and vegetables which you had to wrap in saladleaves with a spoonfull of heavenly but spicy sambal (my favourite!!!)As a dessert we enjoyed black rice in coconut milk...my favourite dessert also known in Indonesia.The food was wonderful and we highly recommend Ivy's als because its nice to eat at a tradional style house in a nice quiet street opposite the 1926 Heritage Hotel at Jalan BurmahShow less

Author: seablue1985
Title: A very nice restaurant you wont regret.
Review: The boss is very friendly, the food is very tasty, the environment is very nic, too. In all, it is the restaurant you wont regret going to.

Author: beardedchimp
Title: Superb
Review: Food is delicious yet cheap. The set menu was 54rm for two and was a great mix of authentic flavours. Decent levels of chilli and the host was lovely. I would recommend it to anyone.

Author: GerardN
Title: Best Nyonya flavours I have tasted in many years.
Review:
This is a place for hardcore food lovers - best Nyonya flavours I have tasted in many years. 

Just follow the recommendations of the wonderful, welcoming staff.

Author: sambalkMelbourne, Australia
Title: Good "mom's cook" food
Review: Eberything just very good. Except the Assam prawn which is not the taste that I'm looking forward . However, it's still a good dish. Need to make early reservation to avoid disappointed. As this is very ordinary family business (which I think it is), they can't handle if too much walk in customers.Overall, very good food which bring "mom's taste". Good to dine inShow less

Author: misek24
Title: Best beef rendang ever
Review: We went to Ivy's based on the recommendation of our hotel hosts. Although the restaurant is pretty non-descript from the outside, the food is phenomenal. The host is very friendly and informative, and his wife's cooking is amazing. We're still raving about the beef rendang!

Author: Yong90Singapore
Title: Very tasty food and a very good host
Review: My family and I had dinner at this cosy restaurant on a Sunday evening 2 weeks ago. The host/ owner gave us ample time to select our food from the set menus and ala carte menus, without being pushy or impatient at all. He gave us time to browse through the menus first, before coming up to provide recommendations and suggestions which catered to our preferences. He was also kind enough to substitute a chicken dish from the set menu for the beef rendang after hearing that we wanted to try the beef. It was a very good dinner with very flavourful and authentic Nonya food. The host/ owner was also very friendly and chatty, and took efforts to engage us in conversations which enabled us to learn more about Penang in general. The dinner came up to a reasonable RM130 for a family of 4 :)Show less

Author: calvinkwcNew Haven, Connecticut
Title: Worth every penny
Review: The food is really good and local and the owner is very kind. I like especially how every dish is customizable, as in the owner would ask you how big the portion would you like and this prevents you from worrying one big dish might terminate your appetite. Truth is, your appetite here is just always high and good. Good food keeps you eating nonstop.Show less

Author: Connieeechan
Title: taste of home
Review: authentic Malaysian food, home setting, quiet and cozy, friendly owner, will definitely recommend to friends! must try the prawns and stir fried veggie!

Author: RichardDeeJR
Title: Authentic Malaysian Food
Review: I've been told that this cuisine hails from the state of Melacca, the origin of nyonya cooking. We arrived just in time for lunch and the place seems packed. Luckily there was still a vacant table. Thanks to the friedly staff who cleared our table in a second.The food here is definitely worth mentioning as they were excellent. The flavor and aroma that came out from our Asam Curry was out of this world! Will recommend to friends.Show less

Author: Yasmine BGeorge Town, Malaysia
Title: Nice enough but nothing special
Review: Based on the reviews I was expecting something special, but it is not - a bare room with a few tables, local food prepared adequately, but I have had much better in Penang. Quite a long wait for the food, options on the menu that weren't available, that sort of thing. Not somewhere I would go out of my way for.Show less

Author: dompogo
Title: Great food and service!
Review: The owner was very kind in letting me enter even though they had just closed up. I had the Tiger Shrimp set menu and the shrimp itself was good although a little overcooked but the sauce that it came in was absolutely phenomenal!

Author: Walterandyanli
Title: Very good restaurant
Review: You have to find this place, but once you are there enjoy the good food and service in this small and simple restaurant.

Author: DaveV775Ubud, Indonesia
Title: Disappointing
Review: We went there expecting some good nyonya cooking but were quite disappointed. The service was good but the food was very bland, not at all like other nyonya cuisine we've had. And a bit pricey -- 66 Ringgit for 2 without drinks -- not bad if it'd been good.Show less

Author: JakewooooPlentong, Malaysia
Title: Good quality and service
Review: We visited Ivy's a couple of days ago and ordered their set dinner for two (MYR55), as well as additional side dishes of sambal kangkong, five-spice chicken roll (ngoh hiang) and a sour plum with lime drink. The dishes were generally well-executed and there were no downers.1. Catch of the day (baby sting ray) prepared in Gulai TumisThe dish was prepared to an adequate standard and the fish was fresh and tender, but otherwise it was not particularly remarkable.2. Assam prawns.A very memorable dish, the prawns were marinated in an addictive sauce and could be chewed on, shells and all, to extract the sauce. 3. Nyonya Joo Hoo CharThis is akin to the turnip/jicama filling that we commonly see (for those who eat popiahs/spring rolls), served with lettuce to wrap the filling in to eat. It's decent, but once again, not particularly remarkable. 4. Nyonya style fried chickenA well-executed fried chicken, not too oily, served with a unique sourish, slightly peppery sauce (sour plums inside?). But not particularly memorable too.5. Green bean soup with gula melaka/coconut milkIt's creamy, sweet, with a nice thick consistency, but we generally can't go wrong with the combination ;)6. Sambal KangkongThis was a standout; the vegetable had a nice smokiness imparted into it (wok hei) that meant that the control of the heat during the cooking process was good. This dish is on par with that of premium restaurants.7. Chicken ngoh hiangI generally do not like five-spice rolls (personal preference), so I can't make an objective evaluation, but the rolls served were crisp and hot. 8. Sour plum-lime drinkThis was a very refreshing drink; it was not too sweet and was an excellent palate cleanser. Service was good with the proprietor checking on us every now and then to make sure everything was alright. He seems to be passionate about what he does, and we had a good dinner in general for the price we paid. We'd hoped to try a few more dishes (the otah, or fish paste, as well as the kerabu(salad)), but a lot of them were not available on the day that we went. I'd recommend this place for folks visiting Georgetown.Show less

Author: maryyeoHo Chi Minh City, Vietnam
Title: Best Peranakan Food in Penang... humble, homely.
Review: Homely feel, delicious authentic food, and SO unique!It feels like you stepped into a friend's peranakan-styled living room. This is the closest you get to walking into a home in Penang, and it feels like you know they cook delicious and authentic peranakan food with recipes passed down generations from their mums & grandmas.....!Every taste is so so unique. The Inche Kabin is fried chicken... but I've never tasted fried chicken so different, cripsy, and non-oily! The King Prawns won us over not just with its juicy tenderness, but it came in a generous portion of peranakan chilli paste that you can eat just that with rice and nothing else and it will still be heavenly. Even the juices are special with concoctions like ginger lemongrass and pineapple+something.Price for the sets:RM58 for 2RM76 for 3RM98 for 4 to 5Those staying at Northam All Suite, you're in luck! It's barely a 5min walk here using the shortcut from the carpark exit of the hotel. More chances to grab a slice of real Penang as you check out the different and rich architecture style of the houses there!Show less

Author: David KHobart, Australia
Title: For the homely and the hungry
Review: We had been travelling for over a month in Asia and had been eating in many restaurants. The foodhad been good in many places but we were now a little eager to get home and eat in a normal family way in a normal family place. Ivy's provided a taste not of our home but a Malaysian one. This an informal, charming and family place and the food is, as many others have said on Trip Advisor, inexpensive, beautifully prepared and, perhaps, the best example of traditional Nonya food in Penang and Malaysia. I had two Singaporean food critics with me and believe me when Singaporeans are bowled over by the food (they were ecstatic on this occasion) then something is very, very right.For the uninitiated in the variety of Nonya food I think the best way to go is to take advice from Dragon Tan, the owner, and take one of the set menus and, if you feel a little hungrier than most, (as most members of my Singporean family, and perhaps most Singaporeans, always do) add a couple of extra dishes. We took this approach and everyone was very happy and well satisfied with the result. Every, but every course was exceptional and there can be not greater praise than that.We had Fish(Garoupa) in Gulai Tumis Assam, 'Joo Hoo Char' (a nyonya mix vegetable served with fresh lettuce and sambal belacan), Kapitan Chicken and Chicken in Black Soya and Assam Prawns from the set menu supplemented with Sambal Hae Bee. This was followed by dessert Black Glutinous Rice serve with fresh coconut milk (a little sweet for my rough Australian palate but loved by the Singapean contingent). If you have a real passion for food as my family do, then I think this is the place for you David Kelly.Show less

Author: Chook K
Title: Ivy's Nyonya Cruisine
Review: Love coming back to this restaurant again and will recommend to friends visiting Penang. Great place to lunch or dine in terms of authentic food, pricing and ambience.

Author: N PLIVERPOOL
Title: Delicious food of a cuisine we were new to
Review: We were the only people in this restaurant on this quiet evening (although i've been told it can get very busy!) Our waiter (more like a host) was fantastic and the food was extremely interesting and delicious!! We had the set menu and as we don't eat meat they had no problem substituting the chicken for something else. Go for the set menu if, like us, you don't know anything about Nyonya food as it gives a great mixture (the host will also explain how to eat some of the more unusual food). Highlights were the Tamarind prawns and Fish mousse. This restaurant was the best meal we had in our trip around Malaysia.Show less

Author: Joeseph CSurabaya, Indonesia
Title: Longing for more....
Review: Used old Cao Cao trick to lure my mom and mother in law for 15 min walk to the place. It was absolutely worthed. It was a home actually and turned into small restaurant but don't be fooled by it's simple ordinary place. The food was excellent. We love the way they cook the stingray fish & tamarindprawn. The simple yet delicious Jo Hoo Cha vegetable dish.At the end all of us agreed if this place were next to our hotel , definitely we will have our daily 3 times meal at Ivy's Nyonya. The owner and the cook really had passion on food that's for sure.Show less

Author: DttfoodAdelaide, Australia
Title: Delicious home cooked food
Review: This restaurant serves excellent home cooked nyonya food. I came here with my husband and my sister & her family (2 young children) in early July. I would not hesitate to eat here again when I come back to Penang and it was definitely one of our food highlights during our trip to Penang.Recommended food: Beef rendang (note: quite spicy), fried chicken, otak otak and vegetables with sambal. Although, all the dishes that we ate were packed with flavour.Recommended drink: Sumboi, Pat Poh (herbal tea)Tips: As it is a small restaurant, I would advise to make a reservation beforehand. Also just note that the restaurant is closed on Mondays, and the traffic on Jalan Burma (the restaurant is located on Jalan Chow Thye which is off Jalan Burma), if you are driving/taking a taxi, can get quite jammed in the evenings.Show less

Author: suntickPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Home style authentic nyonya food!
Review: Very authentic and very reasonable price. Runs by a couple, very friendly and helpful. The food is good and the atmosphere is nice too.Show less

Author: shhhjaypi
Title: Great authentic food
Review: A bit out of the way but worth looking for! I brought my nyonya grandmother and it passed the muster. I do wish they served buah keras though. Other than that the food was wonderful and delicious. Show less

Author: Peter P
Title: Lives up to expectations
Review: A perfectly balanced, delicious set menu. We ordered the set menu for two, which included Nonya fish curry (grouper cooked with ladies fingers and tomatoes), Joo Hoo Char (salad), tender chicken in black soya and perfectly fried Assam Prawn. Plus Bee Koh Moi (traditional black rice with coconut). Complemented by fresh ginger and pineapple juice. We'll be back! We were so impressed we completed the TA review on their free WiFi!Show less

Author: DawnBluePenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Disappointed; shocked at prices
Review: Food was ok but only of 'economy rice' standard (cf. Ah Aik recently deceased); nothing special. Pales in comparison to other Nyonya restaurants like Mama's and Nyonya Breeze (both in Aboo Sitee Lane). Per dish price is very expensive for Penang for this standard of food. Our five dishes, not including drinks, totaled RM116.We didn't look at the set menus, perhaps these were more value for money.Show less

Author: dharmendraladCambridge, United Kingdom
Title: Hidden Gem!
Review: Excellent food and even better hospitality! We had the set 2 person dinner and it was a real joy to try such fabulous Nyonya cuisine especially the Chicken Kapitan and Tamarind Prawns. I was sceptical about whether I'd like the Green Bean Nyonya dessert being so different to western desserts but even that was a joy to eat. Dragon is a great host too - he explained a lot about Nyonya cuisine and its history. For anyone visiting Penang and wanting to try great home cooked Nyonya food this is a must!Show less

Author: ThaisoonJohor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: excellent food
Review: Food is excellent, price is fair. It is a small restaurant not so fancy decorated as many other restaurant near by. Simple, clean, small yet the Nyonya food is just the best I ever had in Malaysia. Before dinner my girlfriend and I actually quite took heavy high tea so we are not hungry at all. However, we have taken a lotz of food in this restaurant simply because it is just too delicious! Show less

Author: shaa007North Carolina
Title: Great Penang Nonya Cuisine
Review: A very nice little restaurant specializing in Nonya cuisine, a real must-try experience in the former Straits Settlements of old Malaya. Penang is definitely a center for this type of food, but sadly there are few good Nonya restaurants left. Ivy's was recommended to my wife, 2 daughters, and I by Jim, a Penangite, foodie, and the owner of Clove Hall. We were very happy with the food quality, service, and pricing. The food was very tasty and arrived in good time, although there were other occupied tables. Prices are reasonable for a sit-down restaurant. The owner, Dragon Tan, is a very pleasant, knowledgeable, and helpful gentleman. I liked his set menus for those who are not familiar with Nonya cuisine, although we ordered a la carte. He was very kind and gracious enough to serve us complimentary bubur kacang (red bean dessert soup). I especially enjoyed this dish, having grown up with it but haven't eaten it in a long time.We will definitely return to Ivy's on our next trip to Penang, and recommend it to all travelers who wish to experience a cuisine that is unique, historical, and extremely tasty.Show less

Author: lvmhungHanoi, Vietnam
Title: Best local restaurant in Penang !
Review: Very authentic Malaysian Chinese mixed cuisine. The flavors and spices were very unique, the menu set was well combined and kudos for the free extra bowl of dessert.I went with some friends and the owner were very friendly and explained to us about the cuisine, how did he prepare the food in very good English!Show less

Author: LAISHSHSingapore, Singapore
Title: Remarkable nyonya food, quite reasonable pricing
Review: Was on holiday with family in Penang and visited the restaurant for lunch after routine trip to buy tau sar piah from Him Heang. The restaurant was a few minutes walk from the bakery. Although there were 4 of us, we ordered a set meal for 3 as we wanted to leave room for other food. The set consists of BBQ prawns, traditional fish curry served with tomatoes and ladies' fingers, stewed chicken in soya sauce and traditional mixed vegetables served with lettuce. This was served with white rice and there was also dessert of green bean soup. We added order of otak otak and four cold milos. Prawns were each about the size of an adult's finger. Not big, but it was well cooked and so crispy that we did not need to spit out any shell. The serving of fish was quite big. The gravy was tasty, with just the right bland of sour and spiciness. This was great with the rice. The chicken stew was surprisingly good. The dark soy sauce was fragrant, flavourful, and had a fairly watery texture. Went very well with the rice too. Chicken was tender, well penetrated with the flavour of the soy sauce. The otak otak was spicy with a kick and had chunks of fish in it. The overall amount was just about right for my wife and I, and our two teenaged children. It left some room for us to enjoy a couple of smaller meals after that and before dinner. See other review on Ming Xiang Tai.Overall I feel that the food was well seasoned, well cooked and had a ver family feel. The restaurant is not big but was cosy with a homely and welcoming atmosphere. There were a couple of office girls, another couple as well as a family with children also eating there. Total cost was RM99. I would say that this is very reasonable in terms of Singapore dollar conversion. But to the locals, I think the cost is at least moderate. Nevertheless, the food was really good. On top of that, the boss was friendly and service was good. I would recommend this place for lunch and dinner when in Penang.Show less

Author: Paddington21
Title: Worst food throughout our penang trip
Review: Never gonna go this shop anymore. Worst service, slow and the food portion is small with high price.Show less

Author: vijay888Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Authentic nyonya cuisine
Review: One of the best nyonya food in town. Friendly owner. Price wise is ok. Taste jz like home cooked food. Will definitely come back for another round.Show less

Author: gzesingapore
Title: delicious end to a beautiful getaway
Review: hello mr tan!! rem us? we were at ivy's kitchen on sunday evening :) beautiful end to a 2d1n trip i was on, with my bffs! had the set dinner and seeing our indecisiveness, mr tan very kindly offered to split the portion of our chicken dish into 2, so we cld enjoy both the curry chicken and fried chicken :)assam fish and veg which was similar to popiah filling were tasty, but our favourite was the bbq prawns! :) ohhh!! the rendeng beef is a must try!! we wanted to order that in addition to our set meal but it was out of stock. however mr tan gave us a very small portion which was all that's left in the restaurant. spicy but ohhh so delicious.thanks again, mr tan! we look fwd to seeing u again during our next trip.Show less

Author: Eli GPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Try the sauteed Jicama!
Review: The staff is very helpful and will give crash course on the various dishes you order. The food is flavorful and fairly priced. Great place to try authentic Malaysian cuisine. They close between 3 p.m. and 6 p.m. so do not plan on a late lunch.Show less

Author: w pSingapore, Singapore
Title: Above average but not fanstastic
Review: So I went there after reading all the effusive reviews here and maybe I'm a picky eater but the food here is above average at best and not as fantastic as many have claimed. Or maybe these people have not tasted better food. One puzzling item is the Joo Hoo Char - which is the filling of the common street food Popiah. The way people are going on about this makes it seem like they have never eaten Popiah which is impossible in SEA. The standout is the chicken kapitan though. Still, worth a visit.As the long waiting time, we did not experience that as we went there on a weekday lunch right when they opened at 12noon, so we were pretty much the only ones there.Show less

Author: MelvinLinSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good food, but tons of patience required
Review: This place serves up great food. Even fussy eaters will probably find little to complain about in terms of the quality of food. We randomly picked about 7 dishes in the menu, and none of the dishes disappointed us. The drawback, however, was the long waiting time and being made to feel rather unwelcome during busy hours. This could be largely due to the fact that it looked very much like a two-person operation. A lady was cooking in the kitchen, and a gentleman did everything else, like serving food, taking orders, doing the bill, clearing tables etc. Considering this eatery can accommodate about 40 diners at a time, you know pretty much what you are in for. Seeing their high ranking on tripadvisor, we tried calling them the day before to try to reserve a table, but nobody picked up the phone. On our way to the airport, we drove past the vicinity and decided to try our luck, and there was a table available (the previous guests were leaving when we arrived, and we waited for about ten minutes for the table to be cleared). After waiting ten minutes for the table to be cleared, we were told to wait. We had to pick up the menu ourselves. It was then a 25-minute wait for our order to be taken, followed by another almost 40 minutes before our food was served (and he kept assuring us that the food would only take 15 minutes). In between, all we got were unapologetic, and even rather accusing repetitions of "you did not make a reservation, so I have to serve all the customers who made reservations first before I come to you". This was even after we had explained to the man that we were on our way to the airport to catch a flight; that we had made attempts the day before to make a reservation; and even though the customers who had made reservations (and who arrived after we had decided on what we wanted to order) took more than 15 minutes to decide on their orders. While in the restaurant, we also saw many customers being curtly turned away, and also a family who waited more than 20 minutes for a table to be cleared. For a very much family (or couple?) run establishment like this, we would not expect much in terms of service. However, the wait was definitely not for people like us who had time constraints. For other people who have the patience and the time to kill, the food might be worth the wait, as the quality was really pretty good. For us, by the time our food was served, we had only about 20 minutes left to finish it all up, and we were left wishing we had more time to really enjoy the food...Show less

Author: 68ADP
Title: Delicious and great value!
Review: A wonderful gem of a place that we found through Trip Advisor and it was well worth it! Simple, clean and uncluttered interior with a gracious and helpful host. The food was excellent, we really enjoy Nonya food and this certainly didn't disappoint. Wonderful flavours and textures and the best recommendation is that our 21 month old devoured the lot! Well worth a visit!Show less

Author: Guillermo JBarcelona, Spain
Title: very good little restaurant, perfect to experiment local food
Review: We went there yesterday, and although we arrived late for lunch and the place was already deserted (it was almost 3pm), the owner took us in, sat us and worked some more just for us. He helped us make our choice, pretty smart thing as it can be difficult to know what you wish for in a cuisine you don't know. We had a set menu for 2, was 50 to 60 MR (can't remember exactly). For this you get 4 different meals (we had a chicken curry, a fish curry, some vegetables and some prawns, plus of course the rice) to share plus a dessert. All meals very well made, with a special distinction for the chicken Kapitan curry, which blew our mind! A must try for Penang visitors!Show less

Author: james LJakarta, Indonesia
Title: Great host and very yummy
Review: First night in Georgetown and we wanted to try the well renowned local cuisine. Ivy's came highly recommended and we were equally delighted with the choice to dine there. Mr Tan certainly provides a warm welcome and personal approach. The restaurant was nicely laid out and pleasantly cool. We looked through various menu options and landed on the set menu for 2, plus delicious fresh juice drinks. The dishes were readily served, and each described in detail, including suggestions on how best to eat, and mix flavors. The sambal was spicy without being overbearing. Our meal was well rounded with a traditional sweet black rice pudding. Overall a lovely meal served by great hosts. Show less

Author: FulfillingdreamsBrisbane
Title: Real Nonya Cuisine
Review: What a gem of a place! It was recommended by a local and he was 'spot on'. We chose the set menu in order to try a variety of food. It is a small, clean simple restaurant with excellent service. Each of the dishes were fabulous and it was difficult to choose our favourite. Unfortunately it was our last night in Penang so will have to wait until our next trip to sample more of this delicious and economical Nonya food.Show less

Author: Ashley WDarwin, Australia
Title: the real deal.
Review: After having tasteless yukky nyonya food last night, we temped fate and tried Ivys. Expecting a fairly expensive place, we were welcomed into a clean and simple dining room by mr tan. Rather than pick through the menu, we opted for a set menu for two. About aud20 for two. 4 dishes. Assam prawns, fried chicken with sour sauce, stirfried pickled veg with a firey sambal, rise and a black rice pudding to finish. Great balance of flavours and textures. A thourouly enjoyable meal. Will be back to pick my way through the menuShow less

Author: joanner_11Sydney, Australia
Title: Excellent food and great service
Review: The owner of this restaurant take real pride in both the food and the service that he provides. We could tell straight away that the restaurant was both accommodating and professional in its approach to its customers and the food was fantastic. We would highly recommend this restaurant for someone that wants to check out Nonya cuisine while on a trip to Penang.Show less

Author: SimonR940
Title: friendly service, delicious food
Review: This quiet place has some excellent food in a friendly atmosphere.  Great flavours!  Excellent fresh juices.  All ingredients fresh.  Amazing spices.  The banquet menus are great.  No alcohol.

Author: Sue RSydney
Title: Great Nonya Food
Review: If you are looking for authentic Nonya food, this small family restaurant is worth seeking out. Located in a quiet street, just a short taxi ride from the centre of Georgetown, we found some of the best food we have eaten in Malaysia. Ivy's offers a number of menu suggestions that include seafood,poultry and vegetables that can be varied to suit individual tastes. Local ingredients are used in preparing dishes that are fresh tasting but with a complexity of flavours. Sambals are served as side dishes for those who like their food more spicy. Freshly made fruit juices deliciously complement the food. With a total bill of RM 78, Ivy's offers good value and friendly serviceShow less

Author: markfP6531LVMangawhai, New Zealand
Title: A memorable dining experience
Review: We visited Ivy's Nyonya Cuisine on a rainy night. The welcome made up for the atrocious weather and the cuisine topped the welcome. It was a superb meal. Mr Tan informed us at each step of the way what we were having - which was the set menu. The King Prawns were excellent, the Jiew Hu Char was delicious and the Chicken Kapitan was the best I have tasted. For dessert there was black glutinous rice, which was to die for. We washed it down with various delicious fruit juices. Although it doesn't appear on the menu, you can have wine and beer as well.I was staggered at how reasonably priced the whole meal was, with excellent service and a genuinely warm welcome thrown in. I only chose the place because of the Trip Advisor rating, and I would very warmly recommend others to try it out - you will not be disappointed.Show less

Author: TriciaT707Houston, Texas
Title: Mom and pop comfort food
Review: We were looking for authentic Nonya food and this little joint did not disappoint! It's located off of a Main Street In sort of residential neighborhood. If we weren't looking for it, it would've been easy to pass up, so make sure you keep ur eyes peeled. They have two prefix menus (2 entrees, one veggie, one dessert) bc the restaurant is literally run by a husband and wife. I think it's easier for them this way. But don't get me wrong, the prefix menus are not only pocketbook friendly (ours was 58 RM for 2pax) but give you a lot of variety. It's also nice for us newbies who are just starting to explore the Nonya cuisine and may not know what to order. The owner took our order and was very helpful in making suggestions based on our preferences. We had the king prawns, soya chicken, and they were nice enough to modify the vegetable on the prefix to ong choy in a sambal sauce. For dessert, we were served a glutinous black rice with sweet coconut milk. When we first sat down, a woman at the next table, who had apparently been there before, was making expressive noises about her food that reminded us of that scene in when Harry met Sally, lol. We asked what she was having. It was the beef rendang, so we ordered this in addition to the prefix. I get the feeling only people in the know know that there are select dishes that can be ordered not on the prefix, so we were just lucky enough to figure this out. If they have it, you should definitely order this in addition to your prefix.Everything we had was delicious. We are big on food and we were so happy with our little discovery. The meats were so tender...and the flavors you could tell had been developed through a long process of simmering to get them that savory. Even the simple ong choy was the best way I've had it! I'm Asian, so this veggie is my go to veggie at restaurants and this was my favorite preparation of it, hands down! Anyhow, we couldn't be more happy to recommend this place. Penang is known for its food and Ivy's is definitely playing its part in that. Oh yes...I'd also recommend their fresh fruit juices. We had the apple celery and pineapple ginger. Both nice and refreshing!Show less

Author: RayH961Taipei, Taiwan
Title: Very Good Quallity and Service
Review: Our first dinner in Penang. Very delicious and good service. We had the pleasure with a 2 pax Set Dinner @ RM58.00 comprise of the below:-1.Succulent King Prawns cook in traditional homemade chilli paste.2.'Joo Hoo Cha ' A Mix Vege served with fresh Lettuce and Sambal.3. Chicken Kapitan4.Black glutinous rice serve with fresh coconut milk (A nyonya dessert serve warm.)I would definitely recommend you to visit the place.Show less

Author: LSHemshallHong Kong
Title: Fantastic little restaurant with great service and food!
Review: We were recommended this simple little restaurant by Jo of Clove Hall and we were certainly not disappointed! Located in an old shop house near where we were staying it was just a short 10 minute stroll away. Very soon after we arrived we were greeted by Mr. Tan (Well known around Penang by his nickname - "Dragon Tan") the owner and waiter (Meanwhile his wife, Ivy was working her magic in the kitchen) and he presented to us two set menus as well as the standard a la carte menu. We opted for set menu option B for 5 people which included Stingray in "Gulai Tumis Assam" sauce, "Joo Hoon Cha" mixed vegetables with sambal chilli sauce and fresh lettuce, Chicken Kapitan, their famous Assam Prawns and a side order of their delicious King prawns cooked in homemade chilli paste. Dessert was a delicious warm black glutinous rice served with fresh coconut milk. The set menu cost 96 ringgit plus a further 50 ringgit for the side order - well worth the price for a delicious meal! While the family had their different opinions on the different dishes, I would say I personally most enjoyed the chicken kapitan - which were pieces of deep fried chicken with a lovely sauce - and their famed assam prawns, also fried and marinated in a tamarind paste beforehand. The king prawns were absolutely delicious too even if it meant getting our hands a little dirty peeling the shell off! Although I was too full by the time dessert arrived, the rest of the family thoroughly enjoyed it and by the end of the meal all the dessert bowls were wiped clean.On the service front - Tan was very nice and chatty and told us some facts about his and Ivy's lovely restaurant which I found interesting. He also helped us well when ordering the dishes and letting us know what was recommended.Another thing I liked is their passion for using fresh ingredients and how the dishes and sauces used were all handmade. While they try to close at around 9 every evening, Both Tan and his wife are up at 6 every morning to buy, and then produce the complex marinades and sauces that are used in all their dishes for the next 5 hours before lunch time. All in all - a very pleasant, mouth-watering and authentic experience not to be missed and now just thinking about the food at Ivy's makes me wish we were back in Penang again!Show less

Author: CKee EShah Alam, Selangor, Malaysia
Title: "Excellent Penang Nyonya Food"
Review: Highly recomended if you want to try authentic nyonya food in Penang. All the dishes were very delicious especially chicken kapitan, silver prompet fish in gulai tumis asam and otak otak. i finish all the yummy sauce too and not too spicy(just nice)!! The service was great too. The restaurant interior was simple. Perhaps just need slight decor improvement. Anyway, food is the priority and we were very satisfied. Will definitely back again in our next trip to Penang.Show less

Author: 682PaulPWamberal, Australia
Title: Great flavours
Review: Ate here last night, we had the set menu which we had king prawn , vegetable on lettuce and chicken kapitan, all was a bit step up from the other nonya food we had on Monday night. The vegetables on lettuce had a spices sambol which had the right amount of heat. Chicken was great, as one sauce the prawn was in.All in all a great meal, nice quiet location, and a friendly owner. Added advantage was a wine bar next door to shelter from the tropical down pour as we were leaving.Show less

Author: PudwickLiverpool, United Kingdom
Title: Good food and friendly service
Review: Hunted this place down on the recommendation of a friend.Front room style cafe, the owner was very helpful and we mixed up the menu slightly to match our party.All the food was fresh and tasty, kids got stuck in as well.The fruit juices exceptional especially after walking for nearly an hour in the Georgetown heat.Show less

Author: Al SMorgan Hill, California
Title: Small resturaunt, Big flavors
Review: The restaurant is one of those "out of the way" finds that's worth the effort. Don't let the outside fool you, the restaurant is down a side residential street that's in a house. If for not the Ivy's Kitchen sign out front you wouldn't find it. Once inside, the living area has been converted into a casual dining area with seating for may 30 people. The food presentation is not fancy yet the food was colorful and full of great smells. The quality and ingredients was outstanding, fresh, spicy, flavorful! There were three of us and we tried a variety of dishes at the waiters recommendations. All were excellent choices. Ivy's Kitchen will be a certain stop on each of my visits to Penang and I"m telling all my friends. Don't miss the experience.Show less

Author: WarwickHall101Sydney, Australia
Title: Recommended Night Out
Review: Is took a bit of finding by our taxi driver. In fact, make sure you take the address with you or you may end up at a different place altogether.The service was great. Felt like the front room of a friends house, particularly with our hosts young son helping out. The food takes a little while to come out but we were in no hurry.The deco isn't fancy. Just right for the style of place it is.This is not a place for food art. It is well prepared, tasty but simply served as you should expect.We were very glad we made the effort to find Ivy's Kitchen.Outstanding value for money.Show less

Author: Freddiontheroad
Title: Highly recommended!
Review: We followed the recommendations on Tripadvisor and were left totally happy with our dinner at Ivy's Nyonya Cuisine! We ordered one of the two menus offered that night.Here's the Menu:1.Chicken Kapitan,2.'Joo Hoon Cha 'A Mix Vege served with fresh Lettuce and Sambal. 3.Chilli Prawns4.'Gandum 'A nyonya dessert served warm.Price for 2 pax at RM58.00.Our host was very friendly and explained all the dishes in detail to us and how they are eaten traditionally. So this is a must for everybody visiting Penang! Take a cab (around 10 RYM from the old town) and tuck into this very tasty food... Hopefully we're able to come back one day...Cheers!Show less

Author: wagetKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: too simple
Review: went to visit with some friends, there is really nothing special about the place. it is like walking into a coffeeshop - decors are simple, food are served in plastic plates like anywhere else, food is nice but i think it can be found anywhere else, too. the only appeal is that the people are friendly. we did have to wait for the food, so, if you are hungry, better just go to a coffeeshop for food that comes out in a jiffy.Show less

Author: AhWahChaiKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Rare find - real taste of Penang Nyonya Food
Review: This place's Nyonya fare is closest to what my fussy and discerning Penang hokkien grandma would cook for us.Good picks:-1. Food - Chicken Kapitan, sambal prawns, asam fish, and lobar2. Drinks - nutmeg drink is the best.3. Prices are surprisingly affordable - 4 pax at RM 180, given the amt of food that we ordered.Real Nyonya uses spices skilfully to warm the throat and sooth the stomach. This is very different from the roadside pure spicy burning curry. Ask Dragon (owner) for suggestion to match your taste bud. Complete the dinner with a BYO wine, and u will totally hv a great time.Show less

Author: mehrtsgirlLaunceston Tasmania
Title: Lovely Nyonya food
Review: It was our mission this time in Penang to eat as much Nyonya food as possible - and we started off brilliantly with Ivy's! It was a pleasure to be served by someone (? the owner) who was so passionate about the food being served and so genuinely delighted when it was clearly enjoyed. We had our first try of pentai (stink bean) - an experience not to be missed! We also enjoyed Chicken Kapitan, Chilli Prawns and a perennial favourite - Spring Rolls Nyonya style. Yummy! Great place to eat truly delicious Nyonya food:)Show less

Author: Blung
Title: Simply delicious!
Review: Food too shiok!  Must try when you are in Penang. Owner is very friendly and was recommending us good food areas.  Easy parking when you go for dinner.

Author: Moongzr
Title: Highly Recommended!
Review: My mother is of Indonesian descent which makes me Indonesian Nyonya. I feel that makes me eligible to say I know my Nyonya food and what we had tonight was just excellent! And for the other "Babas" with me, it only brought back fond memories of what they had tasted at home! The only way we could fault them was that a few dishes had sold out earlier so we were not able to try them. They made up for this by recommending better replacements!Congratulations and keep it up! Thank you for the beautiful meal!ColinShow less

Author: Departure804130
Title: Excellent
Review: Foods great,authentic and reasonably priced. They may need to employ more staffs to cater for the crowd.

Author: sklee
Title: Fantastic Nyonya food
Review: Had my first nyonya food in this restaurant this month. Initially, I had my doubts but after eating several dishes, the food here is top notch amongst the other Nyonya restaurants that I have tried in Penang.

Author: PuiFernPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Nyonya food @ reasonable price
Review: The set lunch and dinner are really value for money and they come with drinks and dessert. Beef rendang, kapitan chicken, perut ikan are absolutely must-try's! This is a cozy and humble restaurant which is ran by the owners (husband & wife); absolutely excellent service. You will surely taste the traditional nyonya spices freshly made. Give it a try!Show less

Author: Lidija IMelbourne, Australia
Title: One of Penang's best kept secrets
Review: This place was recommended by our accommodation. We arrived early and were greeted warmly by one of the owners 'Dragon'. We chose the tasting menu and Dragon was good enough to substitute seafood selections for chicken for my partner. We had incredible chicken curry, grilled mackerel for me was crispy with mouth watering chilli paste that had just the right kick. The spinach was lovely - washed down with some icy cold beers. We had a complimentary dessert offered at the end of the meal. By the time we left the place was getting busy with locals and some tourists. This is well worth adding to your foodie tour of George Town. Great cheerful service, great local cuisine and a relaxed atmosphere.Show less

Author: ClayD665Sydney
Title: Nyonya Gem in Penang!
Review: This little place on a side street just off the main road Jalan Burma is worth seeking out. Penang is renowned for it's quality street food scene and that it most certainly has, but if you want to mix it up and fancy a homely restaurant rather than the hawker style eateries, then try this place. It's great Nyonya food in a comfortable dining room run by a very hospitable husband and wife team.We just went with Tan's recommendation of the set four dish meal for two. If I knew I was going to write this review at the time, I would have taken note of the dish names. Anyway, all were delicious. We loved our first taste of Nyonya food and you could tell they have passion for doing this.Very nice people and great food! Give it a go.......Show less

Author: Patrick255100Melbourne, Australia
Title: Mouth watering
Review: If you are visiting Penang as a ' foodie', then do not miss Ivy's Nyonya Cuisine. After spending 8 days in Penang enjoying a range of wonderfully varied and tasty food, we finally found an unrivaled beef randang. The food at Ivy's is cooked by Ivy herself, wife of 'Dragon' Tan, served in a modest kitchen style dining room furnished simply, but there was nothing ordinary about that beef rending, so soft it fell off the fork and melted in the mouth, beautifully set off by a side serve of crispy anchovies and peanuts, cucumber and a sliver of papadam, leaving us greedy for more!Show less

Author: Eagle899
Title: Tasty Food within a homely environment with very warm hospitality from the owners.
Review: Very nice food. Must try their wonderful Assam Prawns that are prepared in a unique way, and their Pineapple Ginger drink.

Author: Drysavy12
Title: Great flavour
Review:
Handmade noodles, unique flavoured noodles, generous portions, extremely affordable.

I know there are lots of places to pick in penang but give this place a chance. I'll be back.

Author: RobinandLexi
Title: So many noodle dishes to choose
Review: So many noodle dishes to choose from, with all the noodles made on site.  The owner will happily make all the dishes vegetarian or vegan on request.  Have eaten there twice and would eat there again.

Author: ZanoctaBangkok, Thailand
Title: The clams soup was amazing!
Review: We randomly picked a restaurant along Chulia street and found this by chance. Both I and my friend loved the clams soup and would definitely order this again next time! Also, the staffs were helpful. We asked for some info about transportation and they really tried hard to help us out. Thank you!Show less

Author: CecilieMu
Title: Beautiful handmade noodles
Review: Beautiful dishes with handmade noodles. I had Dry wantan & BBQ Pork noodles - delicious. The Tom Yam Yeap noodle soup was spicy with a hint of lime - wonderful. Highly recommend:)

Author: EnidL63
Title: Over rated and overpriced for mediocrity
Review: Over rated and overpriced for mediocrity. You can get larger portion and tastier noodles at the hawker centres. Avoid the black pepper noodle was unusual sweet.

Author: m16content
Title: Best Noodles on Chulia Street
Review: I love this place, the food is delicious and the price is fair. The people sre nice and the place is very clean.

Author: Alan S
Title: Average
Review: Nice fruit juice, dumpling soup had stock made from stock cube, noodle dish was OK.  Pricing for dumplings and noodles I felt were on the high side for the quality provided and an open street cafe.

Author: 455remyc
Title: Wonderful Chinese cuisine in George’s town.
Review: We had a wonderful lunch: local cuisine, large choice, nice people, good price and very good. Ask less spicy when you have kids.

Author: 707dangnHo Chi Minh City, Vietnam
Title:
Excellent!
Location is good,
Review: Excellent!Location is good, staff is extremely lovely, noodle is so nice and reasonable price! Highly recommended!!I would give credit for the lovely young girl with short hair there which serving very fast and supportive for all guests. The Lok Bah is nice to try!Show less

Author: itz_boris
Title: Great handmade noodles
Review: Beautifully handmade noodles. So authentic and delicious. You can taste the noodles are very different to others. I highly recommend anyone to try. Note: This place is not expensive at all. Fruit drinks are freshly made from real fruits. 100% super healthy.

Author: d-eilatanLlanfairpwllgwyngyll, United Kingdom
Title: Best cheap eat in town!
Review: We ate here multiples times during our stay in Penang. The restaurant is open for lunch and dinner which we found convenient compared to other places with limited opening hours. The food was tasty and the service was quick. Cannot fault the food for the price paid. Staff were friendly, they gave us a tourist map.Would recommend to anyone looking for authentic food without risking it at a street vendor.Show less

Author: Carol L
Title: Tasty and cheap!
Review: Really tasty food at such a cheap price.  We kept coming back for lunch! Very quick service and can accommodate vegetarian preferences in each dish. Also advised on spice levels. Can't find fault.

Author: muffinandcoffeeLondon, United Kingdom
Title: The best noodles ever!
Review: We have tried street noodles, which come at the same price. Believe me, this place is cheap, clean, big portions and street food price. The menu offers both amazing stir fried noodles, soups and also dishes with rice. We tried most of it, as we visited Penang on several trips. This place is definitely the best for noodles.Show less

Author: Mark672Napa
Title: Average food
Review: We ate here for lunch. My wife had a vegetarian noodle soup and I had the spicy pork noodle dish. The broth for the soup was very good, and was a generous portion. Mine was neither spicy, nor noteworthy. The sauce seemed to be primarily soy sauce, and the pork had little flavor. The service was good, and the price very cheap. Show less

Author: wendi aParis, France
Title: Interesting, tasty enough and inexpensive!
Review: This is a noodle joint as the name indicates. They do all kinds, like 8 different varieties. You don’t get to pick however as certain noodles are paired with certain dishes. Guess that keeps it easy in the kitchen. The food was average. I had vegetable noodle curry which was spicy enough for me. It was a bit gritty and had a rather heavy tumeric flavor. My husband had the spicy chili noodles with vegetables. He wouldn’t admit it but I think it about blew his head off! We each had a can of cold beer. We paid 30RM total.Show less

Author: David T
Title: Great food
Review: The food was delicious, the service was quick and polite, and the prices were reasonable.  I ate here 3 times during my stay in George Town, and I hope  that it’s still there when I return.

Author: angelineb98
Title: Nice Taste.
Review: We just stumbled upon this eating place. As there was a Trip advisor logo out front we wanted to try it. The noodles is quite unique. They made it to their own style thus making the menu non redundant as to what the usual Chinese cuisine I got used to. If you are around Chulia Street you can come and try it too.Show less

Author: BallardBeaverSeattle
Title: Excellent Food, Great Value
Review: I had the spicy dry noodles with clams and my companion had the noodles w/ black pepper sauce and chicken slices. We shared some fried wonton. All were excellent. As others have noted, when they say "spicy" they mean it. These dishes plus a coke and two glasses of pineapple juice cost RM 30.50 -- great value.Show less

Author: Beauc0up
Title: Love a place. Will go again
Review: I liked taste of noodle here.it’s home made noodle. Chilli sause is spicy so becareful if you cant eat too much spicy food. One recommendation is a fruit juice. Something simple but i found it’s taste really good.

Author: Roland127
Title: Great noodles
Review: Excellent noodles with great taste, and value for money. Very unique with a lot of roast meat. Big serving.

Author: rafaelaH455NQ
Title: Must come if in Georgetown 6/5
Review: Words cannot put into effect how good this place was. I first started with the spicy clams and noodles, I asked for extra spicy which the people next to me then went on warning me at how spicy it really is. I love spice so I wasn't worried. The noodles were okay spicy and tasty. I then got the Loh Bak (The sausage spring rolls essentially)it was fabulous. Everything was going great so I said to myself let me be gluttonous and order one more dish. I ordered the Tam Yam yeap noodle. OMG the flavor was to die for. Minty with a hint of line and tomato, o and the noodles tasted like they were made that day. If I could give 6 stars I would. I ordered 3 plates and paid 23 MR. Average price of the food is between 4-8.50MR. I only wish I knew about this place before hand.YOU MUST COME HERE IF YOU'RE IN GEORGETOWN!!Show less

Author: IamMrSlothMichigan
Title: How you say, what is amaze!
Review: For any mommies travelling through penang and want something OMG without an immediate trip to Brown Town, this is the spot. The noodles are great, but you might wonder, who's Randy, you will learn. Definitely veg head friendly. When I am out of the tree and down in penang you can find me here 4 out of 5 days. The staff are friendly and you can watch how to make traditional rice noodles, but remember to wipe down. Really, you do the math. Much love from penangShow less

Author: Chrisstockton2k19Stockton
Title: Really cheap and cheerful food
Review: Very cheap meals but extremely high quality. The taste is fantastic, I had the dry spicy noodles with chicken. Loads of chicken which I was surprised at and the taste was phenomenal. Be warned... spicy really does mean spicy! I'd order a vindaloo at an Indian restaurant and these are spicier than most vindaloos I've had! Highly recommend.Show less

Author: RandomGuy23
Title: Pretty good noodles
Review: Good noodles; I had the BBQ pork, my wife had chicken, but the restaurant itself doesn't inspire confidence. I remember feeling it was very basic, and we almost walked out before we ordered.

Author: Devon H
Title: Yeap noodles
Review: Quick and tastey food! Was Recommended this place by the local hostel and it was safe and cheap. Very worth trying ! Thanks from New Zealand.

Author: Swifty72Nelson, New Zealand
Title: Quick dinner
Review: Ate here tonight. Meals came really quick. We had spring rolls,dumpling sauce, noodle chicken curry and spicy chicken noodle. It was lovely BUT beware spicy means spicy! Nearly blew my partners head off BUT sure it's quite normal for locals ha.Would recommend as a great cheap meal with beers (only Carlsberg) for under $50. Show less

Author: itzmen
Title: Affordable Healthy Homemade Noodles
Review: Came here for lunch under friend's recommendation. The menu looked good and the prices suited our budget! All kinds of noodles choice, amazing flavours and welcoming atmosphere. We ordered-(Bamboo Charcoal) Yeap Noodle Soup with Seaweed-(Original) Yeap Noolde Soup-Dry Wan Tan BBQ Pork (Carrot) Yeap Noodle-Dried Spicy (Original) Yeap Noodle-I Highly Recommend!! Tom Yam (Peppermint) Yeap Noodle Squid SoupShow less

Author: garandedCardiff
Title: Quick night time dining
Review: Really fast service, excellent choice on the menu. The food we had was excellent, there is so much choice and the dishes are so cheap that if you don’t like something you can order something else. We were made to feel very welcome during our visit. Show less

Author: Gfan1990Copenhagen, Denmark
Title: Okay noodles
Review: We had read really great reviews of this place, and it perhaps didn’t live up to our expectations. The noodles were tasty but this is quite normal in Malaysia. They weren’t anything special, just okay. The nutmeg juice is really good.Maybe come here if you’re after a quick bite to eat. If it was located anywhere else, I would also maybe come back. But in Georgetown you are spoilt for choice!Show less

Author: KwT26
Title: Good
Review: Yea ! It’s a nice place to have your meal . Very good service and friendly staff here , and the good was so nice

Author: villa161
Title: Great food
Review: Small family run cafe with great food.  Quick service with a smile. Reviews were spot on . Prices were great.

Author: Vhalhen123
Title: Best noodles in town
Review: Visiting the shop in Chulia street,George town Penang, ordering pork rice and spicy noodles, delicious! Fast service. Great ambience, very chinese interior. Noodles start from 7 RM and jiuce 3 RM .. very reccomended :-)

Author: pitchayao
Title: Good taste
Review:
Recommended to eat
Many varies menus to choose
Not too expensive
Have many kind of noodle to choose 
Good!!!

Author: sandgrownun18
Title: Very tast food
Review: A basic Penang cafe serving the tastiest noodle dishes. I had curried chicken with noodles, my wife had noodles with minced pork and dark soya, all for £3! Highly recommended for a tasty snack.

Author: 258kerrynf
Title: Great noodles!
Review: Delicious noodles at a really good price! I had the pork mince noodles which were very good! Also sell beers for a good price.

Author: Tay J
Title: Delicious!
Review:
Loved this place! Simple yet so delicious! 
The noodles were fresh, not dripping in oil and the fresh juice was just what we needed to top off a great meal.

Author: DARREN9374
Title: Delicious..Aroi Jing Jing.
Review: I had go here for my lunch with my family .It is handmade noodle.All noodle made by vegetables.Very delicous and good for health

Author: MmeRobillard
Title: Not very good noodle
Review: We ate there for diner. We were very disappointed. The noodle did not taste good. The portion were so small. The sauce not good. We should of eat on the street where all the locals go. Next time..

Author: Alexander S
Title: Really nice noodles.
Review: Probably the best noodles I've tried in three years living in Asia. The place is small and very authentic looking.

Author: SimonestWindhoek, Namibia
Title: Simply amazing
Review: Amazingly tasty food and good service! The noodles are homemade and they really deserved a try! I went there with my boyfriend and we enjoyed how tasty it is! I tried the pork dried curry noodles and it is not spicy as I thought it. We simply loved the place! Show less

Author: deonnes5
Title: Nive noodles
Review: I love the noodles. It’s tasty and al dente. I had the curry noodles, the spiciness is just right for me. My friend cannot take spicy noodles. I tried it and the spice stays in the mouth.

Author: PernLoongT
