Title: Nice chewy noodles. Also had the Lor Bak and spring rolls as sides. Crispy and nice.
Review: It was raining and they sheltered my kids to the car after the meal. Really nice and unexpected gesture!!!

Author: maiswoods
Title: Pretty good but not great
Review: Went here based on reviews on here. Had the minced pork noodles and they were good noodles but nothing spectacular. The pork was nice but in general a slightly bland meal. Would recommend getting a couple dishes and maybe a side just to mix the flavours up. Beers are cheap for restaurants in penang. Show less

Author: ivons946
Title: Over rated
Review:
Me and my wife ordered a few plates of noodles, the taste is ok but I don't think it is very good. Many places noodles are competitive with this. 

It is quite little, definitely not big.

Author: Melody_1122Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Must eat!
Review: This is my must eat whenever I visit to Penang. Eventho the price is slightly higher than the hawkers but it is worth the money. Hand made noodles with different flavours and varieties of choices be it dry or soup. My personal favourite: Dry Curry Noodles! Show less

Author: Sydney HPrague, Czech Republic
Title: Homemade noodles, delicious
Review: My boyfriend and I ate here 3 times during our weekend stay in Georgetown. The noodles are so fresh and full of flavor, for the price you just can't beat it. The portions aren't huge, but they're big enough to fill you for a small lunch or big snack. I HIGHLY recommend the black pepper noodles with pork/chicken, it was both of our favorites. Also- trust the recommendations. Spicy means spicy, don't be naive. We both love spicy food and we could not even finish it. It's tasty, but it hurts!Show less

Author: lost-with-louiseManchester, United Kingdom
Title: Very cheap but VERY small portions
Review: My partner and I went here for an evening meal and it is very cheap. The portions were that small that we then had to go to Subway for a sandwich to feel satisfied. The noodles are very good though and are clearly homemade. We also ordered a side dish which I can't remember the name of but it was almost like pieces of crispy sausage. This had lots of hard lumps of fat in so we were unable to eat it. This place is ok for lunch but I wouldn't advise eating there in the evening as you will leave hungry, unless you order 2 meals per person.Show less

Author: TetaTea
Title: Very good homemade noodles
Review: Very good homemade noodles. The order came very fast and it’s not expensive. But be aware that if you order a spicy dish it will be very spicy, even if you are a spicy dish lover.

Author: alicebrickell
Title: Tasty
Review: Great noodles, full of flavour and really tasty. Friendly staff and excellent value. I would definitely recommend this place

Author: tomkate
Title: Perfect place for lunch
Review: Enjoyed this place for lunch and its delicious noodles.  It was great to get respite from the hot heat.  Will visit again.

Author: Freedom253951
Title: Awesome
Review: Portion sizes a bit small but very reasonable prices and great for an afternoon snack! If you're lucky you can find them making the noodles in the middle of the shop.

Author: Nicky S
Title: Highly recommend
Review: Not much to say, gorgeous food, quick service and really cheap. I had number 24 on the menu, green noodle soup with chicken and I think it was the best meal i've had in SE Asia. friend had the vegetarian noodle soup with tofu in and was equally as delicious. 10/10 recommend you go! Show less

Author: Fabian M
Title: Best clam soup I ever had
Review: One of my favorite places in George Town. Im in love with the clam soup really clean, fresh taste. I would give a clear recommandation for the place. Cheap and delicous.

Author: EricHTY
Title: Worth it!
Review: Easy to find as it is just nearby the Chulia Street famous hawker stalls. Recommended if you love to eat spicy food and you will be surprised with the cheap price but do not expect more about the portion.

Author: leet301
Title: Simple but fresh and good value
Review: This simple, but full of character, restaurant offers quick service, fresh and delicious meals and good value. Fried wontons are delicious. Even the waitstaff are colourful (no nonsense) characters, probably family, but hey it takes all kinds.  Give it a go, very central.

Author: Sophie SBerlin, Germany
Title: Nice Surprise, Very Good
Review: We came here for lunch expecting a basic cheap eat. We were pleasantly surprised. I had the vegetarian noodle soup with fresh vegetables - the only veggie item on the menu, but it was really very yummy. My partner had a very tasty chicken curry. Better than most Chinese in town, recommended!Show less

Author: swanstonanthonyPhuket, Thailand
Title: Don't walk by!
Review: This Chinese spot is very basic and you might also be put off by the picture menu. But go in. The rich variety of dishes are excellent and served up very, very quickly. The staff are friendly and helpful, in as much English as they speak. Best of all are the tiny prices. Most main course dishes are Ringett 7. The portions are not huge. So why not have two...Show less

Author: christopherhC7939IE
Title: Great food at great prices
Review: Stumbled on this place by accident, but had some awesome food at Yeap Noodles. They make their own noodles with different flavours accompanied by local, traditional sauces and soups. The Loh Bak was great too. And all for an extremely affordable price! Highly recommended.

Author: iamaguest
Title: 清爽的麵食 Tasty and reflashing noodles
Review:
麵本身吃的出來是手工的，口味清淡爽口，很適合大熱天吃上一碗，不過老實說，來自台灣的我們，這樣的味道，並沒辦法稱的上驚艷或特別。
The noodles are handmade with flash soup. It is pretty well with hot weather. But honestly, it is not so special for us whom from Taiwan...

Author: araiwat
Title: Delicious in Penang
Review: The local food and good prices are here , if you need to try some local food don't miss I love it, the low price but clean food and delicious, recommended food is yeap fired with calm !!! Must try!

Author: Merkulon
Title: Fast, tasty and well priced
Review:
Sat down, ordered and received food with 5 mins.

Prawn curry, rice and spring rolls. All piping Hot, nicely spiced and very flavoursome.

Charming ambience.

Would recommend.

Author: meltravelling255100
Title: Nothing special
Review: Got the spicy chicken noodles and my partner got the Tom Yum. I love spicy food, but both dishes were a bit too spicy even for me. Food was ok, but nothing to write home about.

Author: Steve SBrisbane, Australia
Title: Delicious Noodles
Review: Four of us dined at Yeap Noodles. A simple little restaurant situated in Chulia St. Georgetown. All the noodles are homemade. As it was quite warm in the restaurant, the owner quickly set up a couple of tables outside on the footpath. We chose both the homemade dumplings and wonton soups followed by a variety of tasty noodle dishes . It all comes to the table freshly made and so very hot, it is difficult to eat without waiting a little. As noted by other travellers, the meal sizes are not large, but still big enough for us and at absolute bargain pricing. Washed down with a beer, all up we averaged about 17 ringitts per head, just over $5 Aussie dollars per head.Great food, great value.Show less

Author: jbphillimore
Title: Great food and prices.
Review: Two great meals here and very low prices. Plenty of choice and good service. Two mains, spring rolls to share and two cans of fizzy drink came to about 27. Would recommend.

Author: herbal_healer
Title: Good noodles
Review: We went for some noodles and they were very good at a decent price. I wouldve prefered a larger portion but the value was good enough.

Author: hampus10
Title: Really good
Review: Went there for lunch, super good food. Everything is made from scratch with nice fresh ingredients. The portions was a bit small so I had two. If you're in Penang go and get some noodles here!

Author: SarvegetableVenice, Italy
Title: Cheap and cheerful - small eats at a good price
Review: Popped in for a small evening meal and ended up having 2 dishes, a wonton soup and a noodle dish. Both were tasty and quickly served up, piping hot and fresh. Nicely sized and well priced, a perfect way to enjoy the end of the day if you've had a large lunch. Was very busy with a quick turnover of locals and tourists. Definitely one to go back to again.Show less

Author: ginna618
Title: Nice local taste & healthy noodle
Review: Went back twice to have the noodle during our stay of 3D2N.  All are handmade.  Lots of choices.  Friendly business owner & fresh fruit juice available.

Author: robertrolph34
Title: Yummy
Review: Tasty and cheap....found this little jem as walking by. Pop in people ***** food. Lovely atmosphere and yes they make the noodles fresh.

Author: youvadee
Title: Best Noodles!
Review:
I really love the noodles. They give a good amount of veggies and everything is so tasty. I also like their herbal drink.
The food is really cheap and delicious!!!

Author: Trung L
Title: They have very good food here. will come back later
Review: they have very good food here. I tried Loh Bak and the supper long name noodle. will come back later

Author: WawaH44
Title: Delicious food with even greater service.
Review: The food is quite delicious, the staffs and owner of this restaurant are very friendly, prices are still considered as reasonable.

Author: Aom T
Title: Good local food at Love Lane, Georgetown
Review:
Here the noodle is made from owner. There are various kind of noodles. We have Chicken curry with original noodle and taste in tasty :)
If you visit and stay nearby Love Lane don't came across this local restaurant. Try it once!

Author: highlee
Title: Great food, great value
Review: Yeap noodles is a basic street restaurant were you can get great food for almost nothing. I would defintely come back!

Author: muzzyboyCanvey Island, United Kingdom
Title: What is the fuss
Review: Nice food cooked while you wait. It was hot and tasty but no more than many others in the area. Not a rush back to but if I was there I would go in again. The place is clean and service quick which was nice bShow less

Author: Beardboy1Vail, Colorado
Title: TomYUM
Review: Walked by this place just wandering around one afternoon and decided to try it. There are multiple flavored handmade noodles to choose from. I went for the prawn tom yam soup with mint noodles. This soup was fantastic! Savoury, citrusy broth with big prawns (slightly overcooked) and soft mint noodles, just enough chili for a little kick at the end. Mmmmm. My partner had curried prawn noodles with turmeric noodles, good but not amazing and small portion. Good value at 18rm for two mains and a juice. Show less

Author: Sophie M
Title: Recommended for value
Review: The food was really good and excellent value. I had a prawn noodle dish that was delicious. The staff are super helpful and gave us more information about the area (and also plastic bags to cover our heads when it was raining).

Author: MchylinsMelbourne, Australia
Title: Nice little noodle place
Review: We accidentally found this nice little noodle place and decided to give it a try. It is very small inside and we were the only two people. However, the food was very good, cheap, and service was quick! We had two noodle dishes, a side dish and two drinks for less than $30. Show less

Author: 930irinabFrauenfeld, Switzerland
Title: INCREDIBLE TASTY!
Review: This restaurant is simply amazing. The food is freshly prepared, hot and just delicious. Went there 4 times in 2 days, cause i just fell in love with the noodles. A friend of mine said, it was the best noodle soup she ever had in asia. GO THERE! Show less

Author: graemewest
Title: Quality, cheap and clean
Review:
House made noodles with multiple flavouring noodles makes for a diverse menu. Cheap beer helps make it a must go. Not ,
Many tables available but worth the wait if required.  Local drinks are fabulous as well

Author: Gok1Phuket, Thailand
Title: the best noodle I ever eat
Review: I always loved noodles but in asia I never found the taste I was looking for,ok I had some dishes that where close to be okay... but during my trip to Penang while I was exploring the town I saw the TripAdvisor banner front of the little restaurant, I thought to give it a try without any high expectations and I was really impressed with the food and service.I can easily say that it was my best noodle and Im gonna miss that taste for ever nowShow less

Author: little_moomoo
Title: Worth a visit
Review: Me and my family tried their handmade noodles. The noodles were springy and soft . The one I didn't like was the curry flavor noodle and Ma la flavor , they were really hot and spicy.

Author: hanhrollandCanton of Geneva, Switzerland
Title: Good food, good price, friendly restaurant owner!
Review: Very good choices of noodle, we were 3 and ordered more than 10 dishes. Do you know why? It was because the food was exceptionally good and cheap, I could even order something did not exist in the menu and the owner was happy to fix it for me! Show less

Author: Chuck BSteilacoom, Washington
Title: Fresh Vegetables!
Review: A high standard noodle house in a great central location with economical prices. Just a small place, nothing special in the decor and ambience. As a vegetable lover, #21 the vegetable noodle soup is a treat, a big bowl full of oodles of them. For me it is a perfect light evening meal. Unlike Thailand, Malaysian restaurants do not put a condiment array on the table, and I had to ask for hot sauce. Got a little dish and asked for a second one. Would have preferred a third, but didn't want to ask.Show less

Author: ztig65Tromso, Norway
Title: Little gem with great noodles
Review: Went there an evening, ordered fresh noodles and wontons. Service was fast and noodles was on my table after a short time. Wontons followed a couple of minutes later.Both were simply delicious. And it's a cheap place to eat. Wish I had time to go back there once more.Recommend this place.Show less

Author: makerass
Title: Cheap and delicious
Review: Noodles was cheap and delicious. Me and my friends have came here twice and the chef and their staffs were friendly and very inviting although they were busy

Author: 120xincSingapore, Singapore
Title: Tom yam soup rules!
Review: Very tasty, my mouth watered when we ordered the Tom yam soup with rice as side dish, the dumplings were very yummy as well as the spring rolls. For desert we had ice jelly. Me and my brother fought for the jelly, we ordered lots of food at the end we had to skip dinner!Highly recommended and great for tourists like usShow less

Author: livelifenjoyfood
Title: Great food, great service
Review: Food was great. I had the black bean chicken, would go back any day for round two. Great drinks as well.

Author: LauraLaw1028
Title: Noodles only!
Review: The noodle is awesome!! Very chewy, but is just the dumpling Bit disappointed, meat and the flour tortillas separated when i try to get it from soup :(

Author: Backpacking T
Title: Tasty and cheap.
Review: Good variety of dishes, service is decent, very reasonably priced. Definitely a place to go when you're in Penang. Highly recommended.

Author: Rockytj
Title: Amazing Noodles
Review: The place near is rangoon road, it's second branch, the 1st is near Chulia street. Amazing  food, special and healthy noodles, damn love the spicy yeap noodle and the 3 layer tea. :)

Author: Emma R
Title: Delicious
Review: Delicious, healthy tasting noodles for a very fair price. Great little place with tons of charm and plenty choices on the menu. Will be back for more!

Author: pami_me
Title: Cheap and tasteful
Review: For a good price (although it's easy to find cheap food in all over Georgetown), this delicious traditional noodle. Food came very quick too!

Author: CyberainSG
Title: Fantastic food
Review: Super delicious noodles, so tasty even a simple base soup noodle. Other local delights also good with fair price. The staffs are friendly too. Definitely willing to return.

Author: 420giub
Title: Kind staff and good food
Review: Just been today and i ve really appreciate the friendly staff ! Very good noodle dish with a tasty sweet and sour chicken. I ll go  for sure bacķ !!

Author: djpilot
Title: Noodle
Review:
I like the food ! I'm local penangtee.
I'm 1st time step in this Local food shop .. the homemade noodle is yummy and the hot & Spicy noodle taste was fantastic

Author: M R
Title: Oh maaaaan !
Review: Onenof the best noodles so far I had the chance to try inn this island. Homemade in fnt of your eyes, fresh, with variety of choices ! Try it ! Now ! Stop to read ! Go, and eat !

Author: nellielimKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Freshly made noodles
Review: This is a small coffee shop/cafe on Chulia Street. Selling freshly made noodles with different flavours all paired with their respective soups. Quite interesting taste and the noodles are tasty. Liked the spicy clam and tomyam noodles but disappointed that the sesame oil chicken was pretty plain and without any vegetables. Altogether an interesting lunch. Pricing reasonable and friendly service.Show less

Author: LWixwellington, nz
Title: great noodles!
Review: Fantastic noodles! went here twice in our week in penang island. every dish we ordered was delicious. my highlight was the spicy clam noodles, they're not lying they are spicy! but delicious and highly flavorsome. the chef makes all his own noodles and was very proud to show us them all in the fridge. would love to come back next time.Show less

Author: Max-zeene L
Title: Definitely go!!
Review: Hungry and tired we went into this place because the menu seemed good and it had ratings from TripAdvisor. It did not disappoint! Everything was really tasty and the owner was extremely friendly and proud of his business. Try the black pepper noodles, you won't be sorry! Show less

Author: Esther_MY
Title: it surprised me !
Review: been passed by this shop countless time, but finally step in for my very first time. The boss recommended me to try the Clams Yeap Noodle Soup.. and yeahh... thats really yummilicioussssssssss... love the soup !

Author: freetheworldPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: oodles of noodles!
Review: I came across this restaurant purely by accident and what an amazing find it was! If you like noodles then this is the place to be!Hand made noodles lovingly made on site by the owners...I definitely recommend this restaurant for the food and the friendly atmosphere.Show less

Author: Chattiee
Title: Best noodle ever !
Review: Went there today with friends and we ordered different noodles. Mine one is the Charcoal Milk soup Yeap noodle and it is simply amazing ! My first try on charcoal mee and milk soup as well but this is obviously a best combination in here ! My friends ordered Spicy noodles, mint noodles and also the original but all of them are simply AWESOME ! They are way too delicious. The environment there is clean and the taukes are so friendly and cute :) definitely will visit again and it may be one of my "always-visit list" too. Have a try ! :)Show less

Author: Captain_Sulu
Title: The most awesome noodle soup on this planet
Review: The soup was simply amazing ... I had the seaweed soup, herbal soup, and clear soup during various visits, and all were unique and delicious ... simply the best I've had in recent memory.  OK, the noodles were great too!

Author: ItsjamesnickJakarta, Indonesia
Title: Best noodles in town - spicy food lover, don't miss it
Review: You can't really differentiate good restaurant from the others in Penang, as they share same characteristics being not fancy, looks old, old (or even senile) cook/owner, and a little bit dusty. But this Yeap's Noodle is really something, I can say the best noodle house in town compared to others restaurant. Tried the spicy noodle with minced pork and meatballs, this is really a hawker style fried noodles with extravagant level of spiciness. If you a spicy food lover, don't miss this spicy noodles. I also ordered the non-spicy noodles for my daughter, the soup based is really delicious and tasty. Family are happy with the noodles.Show less

Author: kayesimon
Title: Must try Yeap Noodles on Chulia Street
Review: Ordered the bamboo charcoal noodle set. The milk soup base taste fantastic! For just 12.90 RM, you get a heaping serving of noodle soup, rose syrup drink with mustard seeds, and soybean pudding.

Author: wkplAuckland, New Zealand
Title: Home made noodles
Review: What a friendly little cafe who specializes different varieties of home made noodles. The Co owner, Isaac Yeap was helpful enough to show us the direction to the Penang Historical Museum as we were a bit lost in the direction. Try out this little eating place as I know you won't be disappointed. Show less

Author: Darshandev D
Title: The most delicious noodles
Review: The place is nice and Comfortable, great service, amazing food at a good price. The one and only yeap noodles in penang.

Author: Maky Z
Title: Delicious homemade noodles!
Review: I've been here twice and I'll be back again! So tasty, fresh, homemade noodles for really good price! If you are lucky you can see how are noodles made!

Author: Charlotteecc12Royal Tunbridge Wells, United Kingdom
Title: Incredible food
Review: We stumbled across this while exploring the streets. The friendly owner and nice looking menu encouraged us in and we were not disappointed. Friendly service and a good variety of food, we couldn't get enough of our meal. Very reasonable prices and fantastic flavours. Will definitely visit again. Show less

Author: anitah0
Title: Tasty and cheap
Review: Found the place by accident but it was a very lucky encounter. The noodles were good and cheap, we tried a spicy one with chicken and a peppermint noodle soup, i would recommend both to anyone. Real value for money.

Author: debsuk1967
Title: Great find
Review: We popped in here today for a quick snack.  We both had noodles, mine were the chilli ones and were nice and spicy. Also had the watermelon drink which was very refreshing.  Very reasonably priced.

Author: philip e
Title: Good honest food, great price
Review: Ate there twice during my three day trip, simple straight forward eating, hawker pricing.  Family works the restaurant, even the beer is half the price of the bars nearby.  Enjoyed the clam soup noodles, fresh clam broth.  Enjoyed everything we ate.

Author: Meegs9393Brighton, United Kingdom
Title: I wish I could give more than 5 stars!
Review: Dropped in for lunch today - my friend and I were craving noodles, and we found this place amazing! Incredibly tasty, fresh and filling, delicious watermelon juice and dirt cheap. 14RM for both of us to eat & have a drink - we're going back tonight for dinner!!!!!Show less

Author: FireLadRichland, Washington
Title: Drop by - Great eats
Review: Just walking down the street and though "Why Not - Looks clean and Good" . And yes it was! Ok, so what did we have? We had a rice dish and they are noted for their noodle dishes...our bad. Service was quick and the food was very good. I only have two thumbs and will give it two thumbs up! Thanks!Show less

Author: LuziV13
Title: Came here everyday
Review: We spent 4 days in Georgetown and we had lunch everyday at Yeap. It is so cheap and really tasteful, the portion is also really big. They also serve really cheap fruit juices. The people who work there are so nice and their service is super fast. Yeap is a good place to go to!Show less

Author: Talgat K
Title: Tasty and cheap
Review: Good family restraunt. Tasty food and beeg menu. You not wait more 10 minutes and you get your order. In walls beautyful pictures, and storyes about restraunt history.

Author: DiverDines
Title: So good
Review: Spent a week in Penang, and must have eaten here a half dozen times or more. Got a bit of entertainment watching the noodles get made by hand; and they were, of course, delicious. So was everything else we tried there, not to mention super affordable; great if you're on a budget and want a change from street hawkers. The beer was cheap too, always a good find in Malaysia.Show less

Author: AuscoachBrisbane, Australia
Title: Don't let looks deceive you - Great food!
Review: Initially the place looks awful, but as you stroll closer you see the cheap plastic seating is clean and the tables spotless.So taking a chance we dropped in for some noodles. I have to say I was pleasantly surprised service was prompt and friendly and the noodles were full of flavor and obviously they were using fresh ingredients. We went back a couple of times because service is prompt, food is good and the price was great.And its fun looking at all the kitchy photos on the wallShow less

Author: sjtorrieKuching
Title: Food this good shouldn't be this cheap!!
Review: Strolled in on a whim one lunch time looking for something cheap to keep us going for the afternoon and was frankly astounded!!! Its a simple enough place with pictures of all the meals stuck to the walls and just 2 staff. We ordered a couple of simple noodle dishes and they turned out to be the best dishes we had sampled inn Penang!!! Turns out all the noodles are made fresh in the restaurant (it looks and feels like a simple cafe), and there is a whole selection they make too. We went back two more times before leaving Penang, I'd heartily recommend a visit to anyone making their way to George Town!! Did I mention that most meals only cost 5-6rm? Madness!! I think you had to order a squid dish to take it to 6.50rm (£1.30!!!!!)Show less

Author: BrynNomadWinmalee, Australia
Title: Great noodles at local prices
Review: This place doesn't look like much from the outside but serves some of the best noodles you'll find in Malaysia. All the noodles are made in house and they offer a wide variety of noodles dishes, with most being priced under $MYR6. Definitely worth a visit.Show less

Author: colettevanojikAmsterdam, The Netherlands
Title: Best spicy clam noodles ever!
Review: This place is a gem. Ok, it won't get any interior decoration prizes, but the food! Wow! It's cheap too, like 5 RM for a dish.(about 1,20 euro/1,60$) I tried several dishes and they were all good, but the spicy clam noodles, they were simply delicious, one of the best things I ever ate! Seriously. For if you didn't get it yet: I highly recommend this restaurant!Show less

Author: phamdafied
Title: Great meal! Fantastic value!
Review: Yeap's is a fantastic family-run noodle house. The noodles were made fresh on site and tasted delicious. The staff are very friendly too. Overall a great meal and a fantastic value!

Author: ShaundaLCalgary, Canada
Title: Yum
Review: It was dinner time and we were getting hungry. We saw Yeap Noodles and decided to look at the menu. Looked okay so we went in. Best decision of the day. The spicy Taiwan sausage noodles are delicious, quite spicy but enjoyable. If it looks like a full house, they will pull out an extra table just for you. I would definitely return.Show less

Author: satusampo
Title: Perfect place for budget food.
Review: One of my favourite eateries when ever I visit Penang/Georgetown. Friendly staff, good food with very reasonable prices. Home made noodles, clams, great chinese sausage... Situated right in the middle of packpacker area. Plastic chairs and tabels - nooo problem.

Author: Steve BPeterborough, United Kingdom
Title: Great Food at Yeap Noodles
Review: Staying in Penang last week I stumbled across Yeap Noodles and ended up eating there 3 times. Amazing selection of freshly prepared dishes, and really good hygiene standards. The restaurant is not pretentious and plastic chairs and tables give a basic comfort, however Yeap Noodles let their Food do the talking. I recommend the spicy Taiwainese Sausage, The Pork Curry Noodles, Black Bean Chicken and rice, Dumpling Soup.A friendly welcome and good service from a lovely family fun business, anytime I return to Penang, I will be visiting.Show less

Author: AuscoachBrisbane, Australia
Title: Good food
Review: Great homemade noodles. Tried a number of local dishes and they were full of flavour and dirt cheapThe downside is the place is a typical hole in the wall cheap plastic tables and chairs etc.Not fine dining but good food at a great price Show less

Author: chalyshia
Title: Noodles galore
Review: A prefect noodle joint to mid-end your day. You can go there any time of the day, but I prefer going late afternoon, early evening. The noodles are great, try any type you like. All will suit your taste bud.

Author: Nel FCambodia
Title: Affordable quality local food in backpacker heaven
Review: Yeap Noodles make authentic Malaysian Chinese food low on MSG and fat, well-prepared, clean and flavorful, in a clean and cheery setting, and at normal prices, unlike the bulk of eateries in the radius of Chulia street that are either totally overpriced, cater to backpackers and have mediocre Malaysian and/or western food, or are just downright awful - and that given that GeorgeTown in general is not great for food to begin with. So: if you are Chulia street and want Chinese food - this is the place!Show less

Author: DzheinaSt. Petersburg, Russia
Title: The best TOMYAM we ever eat
Review: Oh, Yeap noodles :) Frankly, we are two young people form Russia, who have been travelling in Asia for more then 8 month already. We visited a lot of places, we eatten a lot of different colorful dishes, but Yeap Noods is the place, where all positive vibrations joined together: it's nice place and clean, it's tasty and cheap, and all the members of family, working here, are our friends now. About our memories in Georgtown and Yeap Noodles, please ream more in our blog: http://dzhedtravel.blogspot.com/2014/03/yeap-noodles.htmlShow less

Author: karinc4426Petaling Jaya, Wilayah Persekutuan, Malaysia
Title: Delicious food and lovely atmosphere
Review: I stayed at Campbell House and had breakfast almost every day at Il Bacaro. They always prepare a fruit platter for you first thing with watermelon, papaya, pineapple and mango, which I loved. You can then order an ala carte dish each from the menu alongside other things like yoghurt and granola - we tried the scrambled eggs with salmon, big breakfast, french toast and more - all generously portioned and tasty.For one of the nights, we had dinner and ordered the prawn saffron risotto, which was wonderfully creamy and flavourful, and the pizza as well, which was crispy and warm. Tiramisu was a good sweet ending!Service was brisk, attentive and friendly, and the team made birthdays very special for many people the night we were there. It seems to be popular among diners so booking early is recommended. There is public parking behind the hotel, or if you're lucky, streetside.Show less

Author: iisechewMalaysia
Title: Amazing Italian Food
Review: Il BacaroVisiting this restaurant with the best of COVID colleagues; we were caring for COVID patients in Kompleks Masyarakat Penyayang exactly a year ago. Many Penangnites swear that this is the best Italian cuisine restaurant in all of Penang. I just had to give this spot a try. I'll start with the pizza. It was delicious, perfectly baked; the cheese was generous in portion, and the condiments were rich. This was certainly a highlight.The pastas were prepared Al-Dente; the texture was ideal, not overcooked and too soft. I had the Penne Lamb Ragu; the spices overwhelmed my senses. The lamb complemented the penne perfectly. The Orriectte Pasta with salmon and pesto was delicious. I don't know how to describe the pastas better, besides it being impeccably prepared. I ended my meal with a mocktail. Gingery and gassy, it was clearly the work of a mixologist; it was most soothing to the tongue. The perfect way to end a perfect meal. I'm glad to have moments like these with my COVID colleagues. Our time in the COVID wards have forged us friendships that will last a lifetime.Show less

Author: QuincyGovin
Title: Well done grilled fish and roasted potatoes.
Review: Often restaurants get fish dishes so wrong - overcooked and over seasoned. Not this. My grilled seabass with roasted potatoes was done very well. Not perfect by any means but its very good indeed. My Caprese salad (the entree) was a little underwhelming. Difficult to get good tomatoes in these parts. Understandable.Desert was a Molten Chocolate Cake (fondant au chocolat en francais). It was divine. The ambience was really nice. Highly recommended. Show less

Author: henrysusanti
Title: Authentic Italian Food
Review: This time we tried grill fish, crab meat and vegetables salad, rigatoni with pulled beef sauce and gluten free lemony cake. Great lunch, fresh fish with herb was so good, fresh salad and delicious cake. Very recommended! Will be back for more.

Author: Diver99999
Title: Our favourite italian restaurant
Review: One of our favourite restaurants in Penang. Very nice italian food, steaks, weekly changingSpecial menu. Also the cocktails and desserts are delicious. Good value for money. Verygood serviceShow less

Author: knighte2017Bukit Mertajam, Malaysia
Title: Birthday dinner with my lady
Review: Having lovely birthday dinner with my girl, the manager was always concern about our satisfaction and very attentive, I’ve made a small request of giving surprise to my girl and boom, they sang birthday song while deliver the birthday dessert and they definitely nailed it!!!! If you looking for the food and environment, Il Bacaro will be your choice!!!Show less

Author: Dannyl220Portland, Oregon
Title: Great food, wine and company
Review: We had a great dinner last night with good food and wine. The manager was very attentive to our likes and assisted with food and wine recommendations. We will certainly be going backShow less

Author: NiyamajunPenang, Malaysia
Title: Sunday lunch with friends
Review: We had a great table with 7 people and still manage to socially distance. The friendly and professional staff advised us to go for the family sharing style food. We started with a 2 foot long meat eater pizza. Really good pizza very nice for sharing. The main we order were the lamb shoulder and the chicken. The lamb shoulder was incredible it comes with roast vegetables in gravy delicious. We will have it again for sure. The chicken comes out of the oven and on special request it was carved at the table great presentation it also comes with roast vegetables. The chicken is really good but bit overshadowed by the lamb. We will come back very soon!Show less

Author: ilovehomekong
Title: We were there for a family Sunday
Review: We were there for a family Sunday lunch! Very nice environment! And family friendly ☺️ we ordered a pizza, lamb shoulder and a whole chicken! You should really share the food the portion. Is big! The 2feet long pizza was more than enough to share with 7 people, the Lamb and chicken also! Plus dessert we had ☕️ affogato, tiramisu and budino - the salted caramel pudding ! we had a blast super good services and the price is super reasonable! It’s better than I expected :)(Too busy eating, didn’t really take pictures)Show less

Author: Estees234
Title: Chef and some staff
Review: Chef and some staff not wear mask in this covid period, waitress not introduce any signature dishes even you ask, she answer me they not have any signature dishes.Show less

Author: Charles TPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Ok Food, So-so Service but Upmarket Price!!
Review: My wife and I decided to try out lunch here, given all that raving reviews we see posted. We both, after all, do appreciate good and authentic Italian food as we have been on eating binges across Italy and pretty good ones in other Asia Pacific countries many times,.We ordered a pasta dish, their special mixed platter and a pizza with wine.Regrettably, the food turned out to be just so-so, frankly. And, the mixed platter was a mumbo-jumbo of little appetizers which could well be made up of ingredients, meat and seafood that are not at their best because they did not taste like they were very fresh and succulent.Service was not great either. We could see that both the boss and the waiter pay special attention to some customers and do not really bother with others. And, the Italian guy (boss, I presume) came across to me as somewhat "sombong". Perhaps we were unlucky with the food and the service encounter. But, when you pay high prices, expectations are understandably higher, especially since we were not eating at an osteria or trattoria but a proper restaurant. Perhaps we were unlucky with the food and the service encounter on our visit. But we won't be trying our luck again anytime soon.Show less

Author: DaudRayPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Authentic Italian cuisine with excellent service
Review: The ravioli was terrific. The waiter warned me that it would not be a large portion--in case I was especially hungry, but I told him I wanted something light, so it was perfect. My wife's gluten-free noodle dish was terrific as well. Excellent service from the maitre d' as well! This is the kind of service that you probably cannot ever hope to receive unless the same owners have run the place for several years--as is the case at Campbell House. Well done team!Show less

Author: FoodieMarkie
Title: Charming and great food
Review: Dinner was great, we enjoyed the food very much. It's definitely one of the best Italian restaurant in town. Ambience was nicely done and great service from their friendly staff. Definitely going back there again.

Author: CheryanLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: Not Italian
Review: Today we made the wrong choice again. We went for dinner to this restaurant when we got seated and got the menu we got very excited because we saw a lot of dishes we really like. First we ordered 2 Negroni what we got was very little and missed an ingredient. We ordered for appetizer Vitello Tonnato which is thinly sliced veal with a tuna sauce. The veal was nice but the tuna sauce was simply horrible if this is made by an Italian Chef shame on you. We both ordered pizza's and the pizza inferno had very little inferno it was suppose to be spicy which wasn't at all. The pizza gorgonzola was good of taste but very hard to cut. The tiramisu had a good consistency but the alcohol injection was the wrong alcohol for tiramisu. We will not return to this place there are other places to explore who provide hopefully more real Italian food.Show less

Author: ScottLoarPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Charming
Review: I must say this evening's dinner at Il Bacaro exceeded expectation, a rare Italian treat in Penang. You come, you will be charmed. The wine - house red wines by glass are Australian Shiraz and Italian Montepulciano my favorite  - is excellent, and for those wanting hearty fare there is steak, rack of lamb or fish for two. We had a rocket salad with black olives, cubes of water melon overlaid with shavings of pecorino then dressed with lemon vinegarette; the special of fregola pasta in seafood broth with clams, mussels and grilled king prawn and squid; and another special of tagliatelle with asparagus, shavings - not sprinklings - of Italian black truffle. These all were refined, delicate and tasty dishes. We finished the excellent dinner with an intense lemon sorbet for my wife and a coffee mousse with chocolate bits for myself. The service was immediate, friendly but unobtrusive and the servers well understood the menu. The interior is understated but well-designed, pleasant and the tables situated for private conversation.Il Bacaro is the perfect place for a romantic evening or business dinner yet I saw couples with children under ten years old but no noise, fuss or distraction; the layout of the restaurant serves all this well.Il Bacaro compares with the best Italian restaurants I've experienced in Sydney, Melbourne, Chicago, Portland, Shanghai and yes, even Bologna and Milan. The excellent quality and very reasonable pricing makes this a great value. Next time we will go for lunch. My regret? Il Bacaro has been open for eight years, I've passed by countless times always noticing the inviting exterior on Lebuh Campbell, but delayed my promise to explore; I  should have come much sooner. My wife, usually stingy with praise, encouraged me to write this review.Show less

Title: Great Food
Review: Excellent Italian Restaurant, good selection of food offering a variety of very tasty dishes and superb service.

Author: 100melvint
Title: The best Italian restaurant in Penang
Review: The best Italian restaurant I’ve tasted in Penang. Food perfectly cooked and well seasoned. Just the rib eye steak I ordered is abit too chewy/tough. But otherwise everything is on point, and desserts are superb Overall, Great food, great services ! Will definitely recommend !!Show less

Author: yisze6698
Title: Best Italian food I’ve tasted to date
Review: Really enjoyed the food here! The ravioli with truffle paste and also their pizza with beef salami, absolutely one of the best I’ve ever tasted, yumz!!! Tried the gnocchi and grilled sea bass which was not bad and was all for a reasonable price!

Author: henrysusantiTanjung Tokong, Malaysia
Title: Great Italian food and Service
Review: We had first time visit in this nice ambience resto. Italian music, unique speciality menu on board, even Roberto, the owner, patiently recommended us some food we need to try. Staff are friendly and helpful, quick serving, and .... great taste food! Very recommended to those Italian food lovers. Located in tourism area in Georgetown. Show less

Author: George CKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Great food in a well spaced out restaurant
Review: Our waiter, Luca, explained the entrees of the day, the specials in a professional and caring manner. The food was delicious and presentable. A great venue to go with your loved one and/or friendsShow less

Author: Patrick DLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Mixed results.
Review: We were lucky to get a place at this busy restaurant, but unfortunately that place was one of their outside tables. Which was offered to us and we decided to take based on the reviews. Would have been fine if it was in a secluded space, but the table is outside on the sidewalk. So you have every tourist and their families walking inches past your table, gawking at your meal, inuding a young child who coughed all over our table as he stared/walked past. Price of the restaurant does not mean the Hawker seating arrangement should apply. Starters were a bruschetta, gorgeously seasoned tomatoes, very tasty. Also stuffed peppers/aubergine/zucchini , again very tasty and a large portion, worthy of a main. Unfortunately the waiter came out with our mains whilst we were still eating our starters and due to the table size we had to remove our starters before they were finished. Waiter just smiled and said sorry instead of taking the mains back. Pasta crab pesto was boiling hot and burnt my tongue, dish was bland, and also a swimming pool of oil, so left half of it. Seafood linguini was good and balanced well. Show less

Author: SeanjotadhgMelbourne, Australia
Title: Best meal and staff in Penang
Review: We dined here tonight, we being myself , my wife and our 14 year old son. This restaurant was recommended to us by a local and having travelled extensively through Italy before, this was the real deal . The staff were helpful, friendly and obliging. We spoke to the great waiter from Genoa who has worked in Australia where we are from. A true gentleman with a touch of flair. We enjoyed the Gnocchi and and also a Pizza and they were superb. My wife and son requested for desert the Mount Etna cake and initial reports were that they were sold out due to a busy lunch trade. My wife and son were saddened by this news but never fear the wonderful chefs made some more up especially. What a wonderful gesture. The value of our meal was out of this world when it came to comparing the cost to similar and not so good in Melbourne which has a large Italian community. What a find and I know where we will be coming to dine should we find our way back to Penang. Bravo to all. CheersSeanShow less

Author: yinfan78Penang, Malaysia
Title: Only enter when quiet
Review: The food was OK, authentic Italian pizza and others dishes. However we were unlucky becoz big group sitting at the table next to us was so noisy. I can only remember I need to shout to my friend in order to let them listen to what I say.Show less

Author: Hans2Saint-Petersburg
Title: Overrated
Review: Better skip this one. There is lots of better food out there at much more reasonable price.Tried the fritto misto to start. Heaps of small deepfried unshelled shrimp and calamari rings plus a trio of extremely small fish. The calamari was ok but the rest was very difficult to eat. Had a couple of superb grilled giant prawns at the Red Garden another day at almost the same price... Then pasta of the day which was strozzapreti with (lots of) mushrooms and (very few) clams. Tasted ok but more clam shells than actual clams.Show less

Author: The_Andrew_MurdochBrisbane, Australia
Title: Fantastic meal
Review: We had a lovely meal at Il Bacaro. Excellent service and excellent food. I had the seafood tagliatelle, which was fantastic. Finished the meal with the tiramisu (well worth the calories).Show less

Author: valentinav58Dubai, United Arab Emirates
Title: We discovered the restaurant
Review: We discovered the restaurant by coincidence! The place is very cozy, it called our attention from the outside area. The chef is Italian Mario if I’m not wrong! Very friendly with us and he has very good suggestions. What can I say about the food? Is just perfect, real Italian. We got a pizza, bruschetta and linguini!! To finish our amazing night a tiramisu and a pistachio gelato with chocolate as the chef suggested. Everything was amazing!!! Special Thanks to the chef to take care of us and his amazing team. We had a really pleasant time. Show less

Author: Dexlovefood
Title: Wonderful pizza
Review: If you ever go there, order their pizza. It's really delicious. We ordered the turkey ham and mushroom pizza, lamb stew, makeral fish from their daily special menu, chocolate cake, tiramisu. Lamb strew was nice too. But I don't really like the makeral fish. Tiramisu was awesome with liquor. And we had some iced coffee which is nice as well. Great place for family lunch/dinner or a date night. Give it a try. Show less

Author: RossR908Thames, New Zealand
Title: Great as always
Review: Had dinner here last night and as on our previous visits we were extremely happy with the meals and the quality of all staff. Will be back on our next visit to Penang. Keep up the high standards Il Bacaro. Highly reccomend a meal here Show less

Author: claraghirardo
Title: Real Italian pizza
Review: I'm Italian and eating this pizza made me feel at home. I really recommend it, it's totally worth it!Show less

Author: Jonky1Chiang Mai, Thailand
Title: Beautiful decor / air con
Review: One of the nicest decors of the many restaurants in the area, air con. Nice menu with steak options, and wine by the glass. I had the pizza, and thought was excellent with a chewy soft crust, not crispy. The restaurant is run’d by an English gentleman, 9 years in business. Very very good, highly recommend! Show less

Author: TommyA376Edinburgh, United Kingdom
Title: Good but not great
Review: I really enjoyed my experience here but the missus. I said 5* and she said 3* so we compromised and went for 3*... anyway... Italian restaurant so lots of pizza, pasta and wine. My seafood pasta was actually very good with loads of squid, clams and prawns. I imagine it’s hard to get all the authentic ingredients for Italian food in Penang which you could tell from the carbonara she had. Nice wine and nice decor but we ended up paying a little more than I felt it was worth. Show less

Author: RossR908Thames, New Zealand
Title: Great food and service
Review: Had dinner here as it was just up the road from hotel Penaga. Brilliant range of foods to suit all tastes. Had mozzarella topped with anchovy for a starter very sublime. My main was a seafood platter[no breadcrumbs or deep frying] just an array of baby clams mussels and four types of fish all steamed to perfection and served with cauliflower and Broccoli florets. My wife had pasta with red snapper and a pesto sauce. Our only disappointment was the anise creme brulee that while nice tasting had unfortunately split. Otherwise highly reccomend. Show less

Author: xieminee
Title: Fantastic food and 5 stars service
Review: I came here for dinner with my boyfriend and ordered the mushroom pasta, turkey ham pizza and t-bone steak.Everything taste delicious! The pasta portion is huge with plenty of mushrooms. Turkey ham pizza is one of the best pizzas I've had. And, my boyfriend really loves his steak. It has this grilled flavour to it, it's so so good.What makes this place even better is their staffs' service. They're friendly, polite and made us feel at home. We're worried that the steak portion would be too much, one of your waiters overheard us and came to reassure us. They also constantly check in with us on the food. It's small things like this that makes this place wonderful.We'll definitely be back to try more items on the menu and recommend this place to our friends.Show less

Author: PebblesJetsonKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: One of the bext Italian restos in Malaysia
Review: Discovered this place by chance 5 years ago, and I've made it a point to come every time I'm in Penang. Food here is pretty authentic. They do Cicchetti which you can just come and have with your wine, but it makes a filling starter. I also like that I can customise my pizza with anchovies, capres and olives, which is hard to find.Show less

Author: angelcafra
Title: Gusto perfetto di piatto Italiano!!
Review: The only authentic Venetian dish you can find in Penang! Hurry up and try Octopus Carpaccio before they change their Special's List! ❤

Author: Louise L
Title: Great staff, good food and nice ambience
Review: Good wines, good food, lovely staff.   Would recommend eating here. Italian menu which, if you need a little taste of home if you're European.

Author: TheLodge103
Title: A Taste of Italy in Georgetown
Review: Thu 04 Apr 2019 - I had eaten here before on my own in 2018 and enjoyed the food so decided to return with my girl-friend. It did not disappoint. We stayed about 3 hours eating and chatting. The restaurant is part of a hotel called Campbell House and was fairly busy at 19.00 with around half of the maximum 50 covers. Very relaxed atmosphere and the staff were attentive when needed. We chose not to dine more formally (ie 3 courses) but instead went for the 'cicchetti' (chef's selection of 6 sharing dishes) and added in a 'specials board' prawn starter. Certainly ordered a little too much but washed it down with a couple of glasses of 'specials board' Italian red each. With a bottle of sparling water, the bill was 202.00RM. A little expensive for Georgetown but I personally felt the whole experience was very much worth it and will look forward to returning on my next trip.Show less

Author: ninabanina777Lisbon, Portugal
Title: Solid Italian food, expected more though...
Review: Fresh food, good food - we had salads and pastas. But it was slightly on the higher price that did not really reflect the food, for that price we expected more. Otherwise its ok:) Only one choice for white or red wine by the glass unfortunately as well, so no choice really, and its an Italian place - so this was a bit surprising.Show less

Author: NgKS9368George Town, Malaysia
Title: Dinner
Review: First time been there & I really loved their salmon fillet with vegetables, salmon is fresh & the soup soup is really delicious. For the pizza, I really love it & I rated as one of the best pizza in town. Oh ya, never forgot about excellent service given by Veer.Show less

Author: I494TQianpBandar Ser Begawan, Brunei Darussalam
Title: Consistently high quality food, service, ambience
Review: Il Bacaro is an oasis of calm and cool from the heat and hustle and bustle that is Penang. We have eaten here many times, and stayed at the hotel, and the quality of the food, service and ambience is always impeccable. I had already booked (in my head) the Insalata Caprese with creamy Burrata and anchovies (my favourite) before I boarded the flight to Malaysia! The hosts Nardiya and Roberto and all the staff are always attentive, warm and welcoming. We keep coming bacaro!Show less

Author: Jørgen G
Title: Heaven
Review: Had dinner here just before closing time. The food here is what I imagine they serve in heaven. And service was excellent.

Author: mpmilestogoMerida, Mexico
Title: Wonderful Pizza!
Review: I decided a change was needed so wandered down to order up a pizza. Have not had a pizza in Malaysia that I remember. This is a really nice restaurant! Beautiful artwork on the walls and a wonderful darker vibe makes eating very comfortable. Its nice to eat some different food that tastes so good and is served so well. Really enjoyed the cold beer and the dinner! Thanks!Show less

Author: Wright782Melaka, Malaysia
Title: Best italian food i have had in malaysia
Review: Tgey were really accomodating with our small children, aged 3 and 3 months. The food and service were superb. Big portions too. We had the 6 plate sharing platter and a pizza between us and it was plenty. If 6 stars were available i would rate it that.Show less

Author: PuiYengGeorge Town, Malaysia
Title: Best italian food that I’ve ever tasted till date!
Review: I haven’t much experience with Italian food. So the title may have been an overstatement. But we went for our Valentines dinner celebration and I do think that the pizza and the lamb shank that we ordered was top notch. The food was not cheap but I think it is worth every penny! The people working there are also very nice. I would definitely go back again in the future. Show less

Author: sarferjAustralia
Title: Bland Food - So disappointed!
Review: This place was so highly rated we were so excited to dine here.. unfortunately the food was extremely bland and tasteless. Perhaps we had such bad luck with what we ordered?We tried the mystery chefs selection appetisers - the calamari was basically just fried crust we couldn't even work out if there was actually squid inside. The rest was all very tasteless and to be frank quite boring. We ordered two of the pastas and even though we were so hungry, we couldn't even finish half our meals because they simply were just so tasteless. The mushroom pasta tasted like boiled mushrooms mixed with very bland spaghetti - honestly had no flavour whatsoever. We were really hoping to enjoy our meals but from entree to dessert - so disappointed.Show less

Author: ncraiderchicAsheville, North Carolina
Title: Something Diffrent in Penang - like taking a detour to DELICIOUS Italy!
Review: What a delightful and unexpected surprise. This restaurant is owned and operated by Italians whose high standards and excellence in delivery made me feel like I was on a side trip to Italy while visiting Georgetown. I tried the gnocchi (can't get the real thing where I live), burrata, Black Pizza (all recommended) plus breakfast too (eggs with salmon). A wonderful change of pace from more locally based foods - beautiful setting in a wonderful restored Colonial home/hotel too. Stay here - and eat here - THIS IS THE LIFE!Show less

Author: IvanR1381
Title: excellent pizza and service
Review: excellent pizzas and wonderful service. we had a really good lunch in a beautiful place. the restaurant is at the Campbell house, it's a beautiful building opened as an hotel and restaurant.

Author: JohnandSueEdwardsNottingham, United Kingdom
Title: Best meal of our tour
Review: We stayed at this hotel for five nights in total during our tour of South-East Asia. We loved the hotel and we loved the restaurant. When we travel abroad we like to concentrate on eating local food. Eating Italian food in Malaysia was not,therefore, part of our travel plans. On our first full day there, though, we were still tired from a very bad flight experience the day before. We therefore decided to have lunch in the restaurant. We had eaten one of their excellent breakfasts that morning so were only looking for a snack. We were both tempted, however, by the set meal for the day. This consisted of a starter of Sauteed Clams followed by a Braised Lamb main. These are both dishes that we love and the price was very good so we both plumped for it. The food quality, presentation and portion size were all excellent and this was the best meal that we enjoyed on the whole of our three week tour.We heartily recommend this restaurant. For the rest of our stay our philosophy of trying as much local food as possible won out, I am afraid. It was always a struggle to resist having lunch and dinner there, however, and I still wonder how much good food we missed out on!In common with the rest of the hotel staff, the people in the restaurant were always friendly,attentive and helpful. We did have five breakfasts in the restaurant and the high quaility of food and service were ever present.Even if, like us, you are dedicated to trying local cuisine wherever you travel, I strongly advise you to give this place a try. You will not be disappointed! Show less

Author: andrewLsh1987Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Cosy, quiet oasis
Review: Stumbled on this corner cafe/ restaurant at the corner of Cintra St. While looking for dimSum. Nice quiet breakfast. Good selection and well executed. On another occasion, on first day of chinese new year, we decided to have a late lunch here, arriving at 3.30pm. They were still offering the full lunch menu. Good salads pastas pizza and mains. Show less

Author: carlosT706GC
Title: bad
Review: expansive , taste not good, ambiance not so good, pizza too salty and hard . wine glasses basic and not so tasty . however welcoming staff. so, not the best italian at all in penang

Author: Stephen NJonzac, France
Title: Good Italian food reasonably priced
Review: Il Bacaro is the in-house restaurant of the Campbell House Hotel but is also available to non-residents.It has good range of Italian themed food in addition to the usual pizza and pasta, all at reasonable prices. Wine is available by the glass or the bottle should you so wish. The food is fresh and well cooked; portions are more than adequate.Staff are friendly and efficient and happy to advise as to what is on offer.I ate there twice and would not hesitate eating there again.Show less

Author: SzeT28
Title: Just Superb!
Review: We ordered homemade Salmon and Zucchini pizza, Gnocchi Gorgonzola e Noci and Spaghetti Carbonara. The moment i took the first bite of the pizza, i can literally feel the cheese melting in my mouth, the freshness of ingredients and everything we have ordered is just really good.The price is reasonable considering with quality food served, cozy ambiance and the professionalism of the waitress/waiters. I would definitely recommend this place.Show less

Author: 211selinan
Title: Great pasta
Review: What a cosy place right in the middle of Chinatown! My first and definitely not my last time there. Enjoyed the sauteed mushroom asa side,  and their pastas. The customer service was good, so was the ambience. A good place to hang out with friends.

Author: DoctorBakarKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Genuine Italian cuisine
Review: Having been patronising this eatery over the years, am extremely pleased with the genuine North Italian cuisine and the friendly service team. They use imported ingredients which probably explains the highish prices, but this is more than compensated by the quality of the food served, which has been consistent over the years. Show less

Author: DHGreenWoodbury, Minnesota
Title: Make a reservation
Review: Weekends need a reservation for dinner between 6:30 and 8:30. Opted to eat outside which was fine on an 83 degree night.enjoyed a glass of cab. Tim had a smoked salmon pizza which he enjoyed.I had a pasta special - beefy sauce was beefy but not saucy. Would have preferred more sauce. Pasta was very nice.Anise creme brûlée-ok/average250mR for dinner.Show less

Author: S. Y
Title: Awesome Place!
Review: Staff are courteous and knowledgeable. Food are above average with a wide variety of Italian cuisine. Will definitely come back again but this time we will remember to call to make reservation. Coz according to the waiters, they are fully booked everyday.

Author: ECV64Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: The best genuine italian restaurant in Penang,
Review: As an italian my expectation are normally low, knowing about the challenges to cook genuine italian food in south east asia. But I have been plesantly surprised by the variety of the menu and the quality of each dish I have tried.The pizza is huge and it's just like the one I eat back home in Milano, The home made gnocchi (potato dumplings) with blue cheese and walnuts were simply "mouthwateringly" delicious !!! Even the home made desserts are the typical example of the italian tradition in pastry making: we had the sampler with Tiramisu' with Marsala wine, panna cotta with rabarbaro coulis, chocolate souffle' with the hot heart of chocolate lava (Mount Etna) and...OMG !!! the chocolate salame !!!!! I want more !!!!!Show less

Author: TekTehKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good Italian Restaurant in Penang.
Review: This nice restaurant is located at the corner of Campbell and Chulia street. Decorations is nice in a classic style. Food is pretty good, we tried pasta, pizza, lamb and chicken. Good coffee too. locations is at a busy corner with limited parking space along the road, however, there are parking lots on the next road which is a short walk away. Nice cozy place to dine with family and friends.Show less

Author: Chan C
Title: Awesome western breakfast menus
Review: Serve awesome varieties italian cuisine. Breakfast menus are yummy. So good that we wish we could be eating there everyday.

Author: A_Sawan81Sydney, Australia
Title: friendly smile
Review: great customer service and friendly staff. Food in Malaysia is generally under average this is no exception hereShow less

Author: Bruno_OnkelinxBlanden, Belgium
Title: I like it...
Review: After all the food tours, tastings of all local dishes and flavours an evening for our son for some European dishes.Pasta was really good, I had the vongole, my lovely wife the pumpkin risotto and our son ravioli. All very well prepared, excellent and friendly service (but for the vongole I was missing some freshness, a bit too creamy). We ended with tiramisu, ok for me but I was not tasting marsala, limoncello with the bill was highly appreciated but not the real thing. Overall very good experience, good food and service.Show less

Author: stankim75Manhattan Beach, California
Title: Don’t go if you have allergies
Review: The food and service was acceptable but despite being informed about severe dairy allergy for my son the awareness seems to be absent. My son had a severe allergy response from his meal which we asked to be carefully prepared. I just want to ensure that other families with any child that has an allergic condition doesn’t encounter the same issue as my son. Show less

Author: jameshY2726QD
Title: Excellent!
Review: Outstanding Italian food.  I had the linguini pesto with shrimp and mussels and it was excellent.  Wife had tagliatelle and also enjoyed it. Service was also excellent!

Author: Brisbane963Brisbane, Australia
Title: Disappointed
Review: We arrived for lunch at Il Bacaro with high hopes of a delicious Italian meal. Sadly it just didn’t live up to our expectations. My husband had a pizza, which he said was nice, but nothing special. I chose something from the daily specials board, which while tasty didn’t justify the price. We finished with two doppio espresso which we couldn’t finish as they were too watery. We won’t be back as it was expensive for what we had. Show less

Author: AnnAnn428Penang Island, Malaysia
Title: Quiet atmosphere
Review: Restaurant is actually inside Campbell House in George Town, is a bit hard to find a carpark lot around there, may be we are not lucky enough. Not many tables but it gives you a quiet atmosphere, that's why we choose this place to celebrate our special occasion.Show less

Author: BomohMount Gambier, Australia
Title: Knowledgeable service
Review: Took my newly married niece and family for an upmarket meal. I was impressed by the wine knowledge of the waiter and his ability to answer all my questions about the wine and food. All dishes were very good and the wine excellent. I also praise the honesty of the staff for correcting an incorrect bill. Why not 5 stars? Being halal the anti pasta did not deliver on taste. I’d go there again. Show less

Author: klott1992
Title: Best pizza you’ll find in SE Asia
Review: Great place to come for a break from Asian food. The pizza is delicious and tastes authentically Italian. Cocktails are good too. Slightly expensive but worth the money as the atmosphere, service and food are all great. We came here two nights in a row as it was so good! Show less

Author: limhoon1984Penang Island, Malaysia
Title: Great service by Mr.Singh and awesome food
Review: I went to il bacaro this Wednesday afternoon for lunch with my wife and my daughter.. Food fresh and atmosphere very friendly! You will enjoy the cold beer and the smiling staff Singh who clearly like their work over looking the beautiful great place to spend a pleasant afternoon in IL bacaro..thanks Singh keep it up...Show less

Author: syiryaPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Friendly staff
Review: I went to il bacaro restaurants with my family and I order salamme pepperoni pizza and t bone stick and 1 bottle of wine .. and staff name is Singh was very good and took real good care of us. The environment of the restaurant was really cozy and was satisfied w the service.Show less

Author: Shannon CAlbany, Oregon
Title: Late Dinner A+
Review: We had great service at this gem of a restaurant. They fit us in late when the limited number of tables were nearly full. Fish of the day was a whole Red Snapper backer or grilled. The baked was delicious, my colleague had the grilled which looked equally stunning. I have been to Il Bacaro about 3 times and they have never disappointed Show less

Author: ferasn30
Title: Lovely place & fancy meal
Review:
We had good time there with my family, we enjoyed the food and feel comfortable in the place, staff is friendly & helpfull, chef also seems to care about his food & people reaction 
Will come again with more people

Author: agoh69Singapore, Singapore
Title: Great Italian food in town
Review: Best Italian food in town. Very authentic Italian cooking with great wines to chose from. The waiter is knowledgeable and all foods recommended were great except the mackerel fish was a little too big and the meat a bit overcooked . The homemade pasta with mushroom is out of the world, the sautéed clam was great but the fried prawn and grilled scallop is average. The wine was great. The ambience was great for dating or business. A bit warm after wine but requested to turn lower the aircon temperature. Very attentive waiters and a Lovely place to end your day! They offered free lemoncelo for us to try too!Show less

Author: j70nathanSingapore, Singapore
Title: lunch
Review: The ambience is fantastic, something out of an old godfather movie. Even the washrooms are well kept and has a classic Italian feel. It is definitely a place for a date, romantic dinner and even spending time with family. not a place for children of young age, teens are fine. I had the chefs special Safron Risotto With Lambroulade with red wine reduction. A bit of a disappointment as it was a tad salty and definitely light on the lamb. The Tiramisu was a disappointment as well, served in a cup and no alcohol. A they are a tad stingy on the wine per glass. I am rating it a 3 due the price does not justify the quality of the food and they charge for water. Overall it still worth checking out and I will come again and maybe try something else. Show less

Author: Lukim_58
Title: Great Italian - huge portions
Review:
Il Bacaro has a very friendly atmosphere.

The food was authenticate and the portions were huge (particularly the anti pasto which contained a large variety).

I definitely recommend Il Bacaro to anyone who wants real Italian food in Georgetown.

Author: FabioZ_1993
Title: very good pasta!
Review: the il bacaro is a very good restaurant with perfect italian pasta & pizza. staff was very friendly and professional, highly recommend! worth the price.

Author: RajaR957Bengaluru, India
Title: Very disappoini
Review: I was so looking forward to my dinner as this restaurant had a rating of 4.5. But my experience was very disappointing.As I was dining alone, I couldn’t order a bottle of wine and so asked for a house red - it wasn’t a Sangiovese; it was not even Italian!!I ordered Tomato Bruschetta - it was absolutely horrendous. The bread was not even properly baked. Bruschetta was devoid of any flavor. I couldn’t smell any olive oil or basil.I had chosen Linguine Pasta, with fresh shrimp, mussels and fresh pesto sauce. Pasta was cooked well. Shrimp was good & cooked well. Mussels seemed okay. Pesto is what should have given it the true Italian flavor and brought the dish together - visually as well as on my palate, I couldn’t detect pesto. So, this dish was also disappointing, though not as much as Bruschetta. There must have been something wrong with the Mussels as I was sick that night. I wonder how this restaurant has received such a high rating.Show less

Author: Rene84
Title: Excellent 👌
Review: Perfect place with very delicious cusine and nice atmosphere 😍 all what you would like to order take at least 5-7 min. The service here also very good, what surprised us in Penang ☝️

Author: teejayem
Title: Great Bruschetta
Review:
A wonderful Italian restaurant in the heart of the old district of Georgetown. Are there twice in a week and thoroughly enjoyed the food.
Highly recommend you give it a try.

Author: amelie_hildbrand
Title: Lovely Italian Food
Review: Very friendly staff and one of the best Pizzas I ever had. Pasta ist very nice as well, although the Italian flair is a bit missing.

Author: SoWeMeatAgainWells, United Kingdom
Title: Good food but pricey
Review: Made a reservation online and the team at Il Bacaro confirmed our details very quickly and catered for a vegan meal. Atmosphere was good and the service team were nice and attentive. The food was yummy, very much Western standards, and the pizza was huge! We all enjoyed our drinks too, both fruit juices and wine. The only con really were the prices- I found my meal even more expensive than what I would pay in the UK (however after weeks of rice and veg it was worth the splurge!). Also our side salads were brought out ages before our meal and just sat on the neighbouring table in the open air.Show less

Author: jmullenkInverness, United Kingdom
Title: Delicious food great service
Review: We stopped here needing a break from walking around. It was such a pleasant surprise! The pizza had lovely thin crust and the mozzarella salad was nice too. In the evening we would have gone for a larger meal. They all looked so go. I would highly recommend this place. Left feeling really refreshed. Show less

Author: lyehokePenang, Pulau Pinang, Malaysia
Title: Lovely place and crew
Review: This has been our favorite restaurant for Italian food since 2014, and our toddler's favorite as well once he learnt how to request for pizzas :) What keeps us coming back for more are the clean and cozy ambiance, hospitable team, and of course their exquisite food. The pizza's portion is really big and was enough to feed two adults and a toddler. We visited Il Bacaro again for dinner and as usual, our expectations were met. This is not a surprise given the welcome, gracious atmosphere and the uncommon competence of the kitchen. Thank you very much to our server, Mr Singh and the team for being very helpful today!Show less

Author: Beeteeyork
Title: A great find
Review:
We stumbled upon this Italian restaurant by accident and were thrilled with it. We ate first class Italian food including home made pasta to die for. Portion sizes were generous.
Service was very good. Wine selection varied and affordable.

Author: HaruKenchiruKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Ok but some improvements needed
Review: Visited the place and had my dinner. I have ordered the soup of the day as well as the chef special of the day : squid ink fettuccine. The soup somewhat tasted bland in the initial few sips but as I ate more of it, the taste somewhere came out and it was quite refreshing and rich. Quite a good dish to start with. Then I had my chef special of the day = the squid ink fettuccine. I had a high expectation on this dish considering this restaurant is quite recommended by others as well as its a chef special. However, to my disappointment, it fell off my expectations. The dish was just normal, and doesn't really taste exciting nor having any good textures to it. To be fair, the seafood scallop and prawns used were fresh. I think this dish can be made more savory and rich with added flavors and spices to it. It will be much better and enticing. My tiramisu dessert was ok and up to standard. Overall, it was an ok experience and visit for me; though I have had better similar dishes at other Italian restaurants.Show less

Author: 591gwendadNewcastle upon Tyne, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent dinner
Review: I trawler George town reviews to find a dinner location serving tuna for my husband. We found this restaurant and were lucky to get a table as it was so busy. The tomato buschetta was gorgeous and the tuna did not disappoint. Price for 3 courses / 3 wine / 2 beer was approx £80. Show less

Author: Hooksan13Saxonburg, Pennsylvania
Title: A Good Time
Review: We had bruschetta and fresh mozzarella pizza. Both were excellent. All fresh ingredients and carefully made. Show less

Author: NLinTKOPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Good for dinner on a regular day
Review: My wife and I visited Il Bacaro twice. Our first visit was on Valentine's Day 2018. We were told that we could not order a la carte, but only the special menu. After completing this we left the restaurant with very mixed feelings. From the individual dishes we could taste that there is a good cook in the kitchen. But the overall menu was strange, as the taste of the dishes did not fit well together, it somehow did not match at all. We also noticed that some dishes had very small portions, whereas others were much larger. Unbalanced. What also surprised us was that no bread and olive oil was being served (and was charged separately when we asked for it). And when dessert was served were we not asked whether we wanted to have any coffee or tea with it. Again: when we asked for this we were charged separately. This gave us the impression that the owner is very cheap and stingy. The overall cost exceeded RM400 but a free cup of coffee was not possible apparently.So we decided to give the restaurant a second chance, hoping that we were only unlucky on that Valentine's Day. Our second experience was rather different from the first one. We shared a starter which consists of six smaller dishes. This tasted very good and was rather large in volume. Each of us ordered a main dish (spring chicken, tuna) and these tasted both very well and, again, the volume was large. The cook likes to use herbs and spices as both dishes had a strong, but good, taste. This restaurant is not cheap though, as the cost for this dinner was approximately RM250.On both occasions was the restaurant fully booked, so making a reservation is necessary.Lesson learned: we will avoid this restaurant on special occasions when they only serve a special menu (e.g. Valentine's Day, Christmas). But will likely return on a regular day, when we can choose a la carte.Show less

Author: AnjaB2244Geneva, Switzerland
Title: It‘s okay
Review: The restaurant looks very nice and the staff is friendly. They have a nice menu with pizza, pasta, salads and special dishes. However the food was not that good. The pizza was way to cheesy and the salami didn‘t taste like salami at all. It was okay for Asia but not great.Show less

Author: eleonorat847Barcelona, Spain
Title: 100% recommendable
Review: I was born in Rome so when it comes to Italian food I am very "severe" in criticism. But I can only tell good things about Il Bacaro. Their pizza is fabulous, the staff is friendly and helpful, they have specials every week, they import from Italy all the fresh burrata, wines, pasta, olive oil etc...If you're in Penang and you feel tired of asian food a visit to Il Bacaro, you won't be disappointed.Show less

Author: bahamasblissexuma
Title: Excellent Italian food.
Review: Whether for breakfast,lunch or dinner all meals are well prepared, quickly presented and authentic in style. We stayed at the hotel for 4 days and enjoyed a number of meals and ate there at least once a dayShow less

Author: timu-sanTokyo, Japan
Title: Big on atmosphere
Review: We arrived at the restaurant in evening random mode insofar that we selected it on appearance not on the review ratings in TripAdvisor - we were in anniversary mode so were looking for somewhere with more intimacy than most of the highly rated cafes we’d read about. The food was good and not too expensive , the wine definitely mediocre and overpriced. It looks like the pizza is very good, we did not try, but wished we had! Show less

Author: TonyGoldCoast4225Sydney, Australia
Title: Very nice Dinner
Review: We found this gem of a restaurant and enjoyed both the lamb and steak offerings. The steak was cooked and presented beautifully although a tad chewy. Offset by a lovely glass of red.. The lamb was not quite up to my wife's exacting standards but all in all a well priced meal in lovely surroundings. The watermelon Martini was a standout. Show less

Author: colette4655Hervey Bay, Australia
Title: Cant believe we would be eating Italian in Penang!
Review: EXCELLENT service, cuisine and wines at this truly genuine Italian restaurant on George Town was a big surprise. Breakfast was delicious as were other meals at this relaxed venue.Show less

Author: HKB2011
Title: Great pizza with fabulous service
Review: If you are seeking a great Italian experience in Penang, then this is the place to go...  Food is fabulous and service is friendly and attentive.

Author: 851stephaneqChalong, Thailand
Title: Excellent authentic Italian restaurant
Review: I was craving for a pizza while on visa renewal trip to Penang. I tried the Il Bacaro and it was an excellent surprise. The bill was very reasonable despite a very nice atmosphere and interior design. The staff speaks perfect English and is very professional. The pizza was excellent and the wine tastyShow less

Author: SY12345Penang, Malaysia
Title: So real Italianan, even better
Review: We have visited several times already and everytime we say "wow". We are lucky that we could find your restaurant! We should try the T born steak soon! Grazie mille!!!?Show less

Author: S1827RFmanuelbPorto, Portugal
Title: Very very good
Review: Lá bruschetta was very good. And the black pizza was also very good. The environment was also very goodShow less

Author: MWBollomKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Small, fine dining Italian in a heritage hotel
Review: My wife and I had a rocket salad, pumpkin soup and spaghetti with clams. Every dish was subtly flavourful and well presented. The ambience is also elegant without pretension. Show less

Author: Geoff BMelbourne
Title: Quality pizza!
