Review: After many Asian meals on holiday, my partner and I sought out a change - we hankered for pizza and red wine and, luckily for us, Il Bacaro was just around the corner from our hotel and it came recommended.We weren't disappointed. The pizzas were superb, the ambience lovely and the service, courtesy of engaging Naz (a local with a BBC accent!), excellent. They were very accommodating - it was no trouble to change pizza ingredients or provide a pizza with two different halves.Highly recommended.All in all, a perfect evening meal for us.Show less

Author: GreeteKiTallinn, Estonia
Title: Great!
Review: Got a glimpse of this place a year ago. Brought me back this time! Continuesly good food (cheese platter and oven baked breads - yumm), good and attentive service, clean, friendly! Reasonably priced for everything it provides! Worth it! Show less

Author: I9454WTalessiamMilan, Italy
Title: Like at home
Review: Finally we ate a very good pizza! Travelling around the world sometimes you need to eat certain food...expecially if you come from italy! :-) we went to "il Bacaro" and we really enjoyed pizza! Also tiramisù was very good! We were surprised of the quality of ingredients, like italian one! The place is very elegant and quite. The staff is very friendly. Good rapport quality-price! Show less

Author: LeeAnn58Queensland, Australia
Title: Hearty Italian cuisine
Review: We had dinner at ll Bacaro whilst staying in Georgetown. The servings were generous and value for money. There was a good selection on the menu and we can recommend the pizza. We also had desert which was the Mt Etna molten larva cake and ice cream. Pure heaven for the chocoholic. The atmosphere in the restaurant was relaxed, mood music, decor contemporary, fine furnishing, artwork, photos, and bric a brac to capture the senses. A lovely place for dinner away from the hustle and bustle of downtown Georgetown. Show less

Author: Lauren0106
Title: Delicious!
Review:
The food and atmosphere are both outstanding. We both had the prawns to start, followed by steak and pizza. Everything cooked perfectly. 

Would highly recommend this restaurant!

Author: SY12345Penang, Malaysia
Title: As if in Italy
Review: We have visited few times already and became fan of this restaurant! First, the taste is better that some Italian restaurant in Italy! So far, everything we ordered were so delicious. I should visit more and try other menu!!! Show less

Author: Y1665HYfrancescapDerby, United Kingdom
Title: Amazing
Review: The best Italian I've ever had in east Asia! The food was phenomenal and the staff were lovely especially the young woman that served us. Would definitely recommend and I will be coming back next month when I am in Penang again. The portions are huge! Show less

Author: Turbayne94Bangkok, Thailand
Title: Giant Pizza!
Review: This is a really nice, quiet, 5 star restaurant. We had 2 starters which were giant portions and really filling. We also had 2 pizzas but they are really big and one can be shared between 2 people. Luckily we had our leftover pizza boxed up to take to the airport with us. Really nice staff that all speak fluent English, a nice menu and great service. One of the best restaurants we have been in Show less

Author: AmandaA4981
Title: Great Pizza!
Review: After living in Italy for 15 years this restaurant is the real deal! try it you won't be disappointed

Author: 774JamesMGlasgow, United Kingdom
Title: Well done
Review: I've passed Campbell House on previous visits to Penang but had never gone in until I stopped off for a beer at lunchtime. Liked the ambiance and after a glance at the menu, booked a table for dinner. Our meal was excellent. The prawn starter was generous, tasty and well prepared. Our pasta main courses were perfectly al dente and the garlic broccoli had just the right bite to it. The al Ragu sauce was one of the best I've tasted. To top it off, a delicious Orange Creme Brûlée and the most heavenly panna cotta served with rhubarb purée. The only slight annoyance was that I was half way through the pasta before my broccoli arrived. Also took the opportunity to view one of the rooms. It's now in my list for a stay on my next trip. Show less

Author: Tour810943Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Nice risotto ^ ^
Review: Always good service and food quality. This time we met with wonderful 4 cheese risotto make us feel very happy. We always dine here when we come to Penang and will from now on. Show less

Author: GGlen78Viborg, Denmark
Title: Good food - shame about the lack of pork
Review: We ordered pizza with salami and bucatini amitriciana. The salami used was beef and the bacon used in the pasta was duck. I was not impressed by the explanation- that it was difficult to obtain a license to serve non-halal food. I don'tbeleive that this is true. If you want to serve Italian- you need to be able to serve pork. It's like trying to seve Moroccan food without being able to seve lamb or mutton.Show less

Author: richo15cHong Kong Island, China
Title: Cracker find
Review: Walked around Georgetown spent days eating the local food( wonderful flavoursome and cheap)Turned corner into Lebuh Campbell and there is Il Bacaro .Great Italian diversity from Penang flavours and a small respite from the thunderstorms and humidity.recommend for its Genuine Italian feel . Speak with the waiters and you know they arent local and the good is fresh and clean Italian .WonderfulShow less

Author: Norma HKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Mediocre
Review: I had heard so much about this restaurant and after several visits to Penang finally had the time to dine there. It was mediocre, and wasn't the special Italian experience I was expecting. I wonder if the chef has changed because the reviews from several of my friends were quite positive? I hope others have a better experience than mine.Show less

Author: Christine FPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Third time lucky?
Review: Recently revisited with a friend, following two previous disappointing visits a couple of years ago, after being told this Italian restaurant had improved. The decor is the same, neutral and sober without any frills. The restaurant is in the ground floor of The Campbell House, in the heart of the Heritage quarter. Apart from the fixed menu, several day's specials are presented on a chalk board. We opted for pizzas which were excellent, came in very generous sizes and were baked in thin, crispy crusts. Service was adequate - in my previous visits it had been well below par - I would probably downgrade my rating to "good" if the option was offered; but "Average" would not be right. Our bill came to RM120, including lime juices and coffee. Show less

Author: rafharoldTangalle, Sri Lanka
Title: We missed the Italian touch of detail.
Review: It was our hotel who recommended Il Bacaro for a nice Italian diner in town.The cream colored building on the corner of Campbell Street with colonial blinds looks gorgeous from outside. When we entered the restaurant we were a bit disappointed. The interior consists of all kind of different items ( some very ugly ) and does not give an Italian ambiance - while Italy is so known for it's beautiful design interiors. The table setting was poor; cheap plastic woven table mats and paper napkins. With a nice white tablecloth and fabric napkins it would be more elegant. The public was a mix of locals, ex-pats and tourists and after a while is was full busy.There is a nice selection of wines and we choose a good Montepulciano Red wine.As starter we took the Bresaola; very tasteful dried beef slices served with rucola and Parmesan cheese.As main course my partner took beef and I took from the suggestion board the risotto with crab meat. The taste of the risotto was good, unfortunately the crab meat was hard to find !We finished our diner with a tiramisu for two.The bill of food + wine was not cheap, no problem, but we expected some more eye for Italian detail.With some changes it could be a 5 star experience ...Show less

Author: TheChilliPadiLondon, United Kingdom
Title: A good Italian restaurant
Review: Visited this restaurant after seeing and hearing the rave reviews from family members who have been here before. Food was good but nothing amazing. Would definitely recommend choosing from the specials menu that they bring around once you are seated. Reasonable-ish prices and casual atmosphere - however, some of the servers were standoffish and not particularly friendly. Nice to see the chef/owner walking around and interacting with the diners though. I would say this is worth a visit if you're craving some Italian food, as it is authentic. Show less

Author: Tuovi2013New Delhi, India
Title: Lovely dinner
Review: Great service and tasty food. Our starter plate for two was huge and delicious. My daily special ravioli was nice and my husband's lamb was well prepared. Restaurant was very cosy and service was very friendly. Show less

Author: carolaC8655QL
Title: Excellent Italian food and atmosphere
Review: After a day out sampling Chinese and Indian fare on the backstreets of Penang, this little gem of a restaurant was a revelation in the heart of Georgetown.  Delicious home cooked authentic Italian food and friendly, professional service.  Highly recommended.

Author: Evan GDubai, United Arab Emirates
Title: Fantastic breakfast
Review: We had breakfast there as part of our overnight stay in Campbell house. I was so impressed I thought I would write a review. I cannot comment on the price thought as it was included in the room rate. Assuming its mid-ranged I highly recommend it as the decor, finishings, ambience, location and most importantly the food are excellent. We started with coffee & the fruit platter, then croissants with various sides & I had the smoked salmon eggs benedict which were unreal. Generous with the fresh salmon, eggs cooked to perfection & the the sauce was well put together. On this basis I will try this place for dinner.Show less

Author: BoredaManchester
Title: Lovely Italian in Penang
Review: Enjoyed a very nice meal here on the first night in Penang - good food, not huge portions (which I like) and nice ambience. Would definitely recommend the bresaola starter and then the delicious duck ravioli. It was very busy here with a mix of locals and tourists.Show less

Author: Capta1n57
Title: Still as good
Review: Haven't been here for a while,but always good. Their specials menu is always fun,as they place a large blackboard on a chair at your table,displaying the days offerings. Always plenty to choose from. Good staff and plenty of customers for a Thursday night

Author: Photodude45Shenyang, China
Title: Great Italian
Review: We stopped in here for lunch and had a great time and food. We both ordered a pasta dish and we shared one of their salads. It was all so tasty and fresh. I had a glass of Chilean wine with mine which paired well with the pasta. For desert, my wife ordered the chocolate lava cake. She is still talking about this and it's been a week since we got back from our vacation. Wonderful Italian food in George Town!Show less

Author: LarryLAPGeneva, Switzerland
Title: Very mediocre Italianrestaurant at pretentious prices
Review: Very mediocre Italian restaurant at pretentious prices. Not worth it, unless you're unaware of what true nice Italian food is about and want a change from the local food.Show less

Author: k_in_seattleAustin, Texas
Title: It's truly good Italian food in Penang
Review: I went for lunch with friends and found the food very tasty and the atmosphere really inviting.I had the arugula salad with Gorgonzola cheese and Granny Smith apples followed by the daily special of angel hair pasta with fresh shrimp and olive oil and garlic. Very good indeed. My friend had this amazing crab and lemon risotto. Worth a visit--I'd like to go back again for dinner next time.Both the owner and the chef are Italian and it shows.Show less

Author: jetbailey
Title: Great
Review: We felt a bit guilty eating Italian food in Malaysia, but it was very good, and a nice change from the street options.  I had the black crust pizza, and am glad I did! The wait staff was helpful.

Author: GaoAnTian
Title: Superb Pizza
Review: One of the best pizzas I've had in years. Loved the black crust and roasted veggies. We loved our soup, salad, drinks and desserts.

Author: pauleraynerBrockenhurst, United Kingdom
Title: Nice ambience with good food
Review: We dined here one evening. The hosts (Nadia and Roberto) are a very friendly English and Italian couple. The food was good quality and arrived promptly. We had the Lamb Shank and fish of the day dishes. Both good quality and we also had a delicious bottle of well priced Italian Red wine (cannot remember the name). Will definitely be back!Show less

Author: marokins
Title: I don't take pleasure in giving bad reviews, but this place seems overrated :(
Review: My husband and I came here for late lunch and ordered from the chef's chalkboard specials ...so the expectation was that those items were the best on offer + made with fresh and/or in-season ingredients. We got the Baked Seabass as well as the Veal with Risotto, then a Tiramisu for dessert. They were all just ok, unfortunately. The veal was tender and flavorful but the risotto's texture was close to gummy, the tiramisu seemed like it had been sitting in that cup inside the fridge for days, the seabass was a generous portion but there was nothing 'wow' about the flavors. My two cents: if you're looking for a fine dining experience in Georgetown, you are so much better off at Indigo (at The Blue Mansion). The menu is slimmer but everything we tried was either very good or great, and the ambience is much better.Show less

Author: MalcolmA02Scotland, United Kingdom
Title: Very good food, but you'll not get fat on the portion size.
Review: We stopped by for the fixed price lunch. Both of us had the arancini, which were very good and an appropriate size for a starter. On to the main - we had the penne which was delicious but really could have been another 30% (my view) to 50% (husband's) bigger. At c.RM30++ it wasn't extortionate and I guess you could say they left us room for a dessert (not included in the price). I'd still recommend Il Bacaro and would return and perhaps ordering off the full menu would result in more sizeable portions.Show less

Author: pippyboomboom
Title: Great find
Review:
We enjoyed our breakfast twice at this well decorated and cosy restaurant.
Good food, service and price.
Would have liked to try for dinner, very welcoming.

Author: Apeelen
Title: Good food, unfriendly hostess
Review: We liked this place for its food. The pizza's are nice and they serve good quality coffee. The only unpleasant experience was the service the hostess provides. She was rude and seemed insincere.

Author: StewartRobertHong Kong, China
Title: Brilliant Venetian restaurant
Review: We were wondering where to eat on our last night in wonderful George Town when we walked past Il Bacaro. What a find! We had such a good evening, from the Venetian style Aperol spritz (wine wine rather than prosecco) through to tiramisu ice cream, we thoroughly enjoyed the entire meal. The staff were all super friendly, a must visit Show less

Author: Richard SMumbai, India
Title: Italian flair with style
Review: Wonderful evening. The restaurant is a wonderful experience of enthusiasm and traditional Italian cuisine. The attentive team from the front desk right through to the floor staff are amazing. Well done and highly recommended. This was our 2nd visit and there will be more. Highly recommended.Show less

Author: JennyS60
Title: Authentic Italian cooking...
Review: A good selection of authentic Italian food that is reasonably priced.  The staff are very attentive and there is a great selection on the drinks.

Author: Priyanka SSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good Italian fare, but a little pricey
Review: We had lunch here - hot bruschetta, porcini linguine and panacotta. The bread and pasta dishes were tasty and fresh, but the panacotta was a little too gelatinous and not too creamy. We also had lime based mocktails, both of which were very good. Overall it was a good dining experience, but was on the pricey side, one of the most expensive meals in Penang for us. Show less

Author: ErictheViking1805Kuching, Malaysia
Title: Excellent Italian Food
Review: I had been here before and wanted my family to enjoy the sumptuous food on offer. Although a bit pricey it is and will be in the future a restaurant I will go back to whenever I am in Penang for business. We thoroughly enjoyed all that was on offer especially the homemade Ravioli of Duck. The Gnocchi Tomato and Basil was also superb. I fact, it was all good. I love this place. Great hospitality from very friendly staff. Roberto and his wife are excellent hosts. They understand this business and what a guest stomach needs. A must visit if you like Italian food and next in Penang.Show less

Author: sussexrowmarkRye, United Kingdom
Title: a fine meal
Review: Nice dining room, nice staff, even nicer food. A shared dish to begin featured Italian burrata cheese, difficult to find even in London. The large pizza was one of the best I have ever eaten - a thin and tasty black crust, crushed aubergine, fresh tomato, pecorino cheese, rocket and a honey glaze. Not cheap at 48rg but well worth it. A very good selection of wines too. A little away from the main tourist drag and all the better for it.Show less

Author: MumtoScruffyYorkshire, United Kingdom
Title: Good Food
Review: We really love this place, it has a really classy feel to it and is like nowhere else in Georgetown. The food is always consistently good and there is a brilliant choice, something for everyone.Price is commiserate with quality and fair.Service is timely but I do wish that it was a little warmer from Roberto. We hate fuss but feel that he looks as though he is going into a serious business meeting rather than greeting us. None the less we will be back, this place is just too good to miss.Show less

Author: 619stanleysWinnipeg, Canada
Title: Excellent Italian Food in Penang
Review: We stayed at Campbell House for 4 nights. Had dinner at the restaurant twice as we really enjoyed the delicious pasta and seafood. We preferred to order from the chalk board menu instead of the regular menu and it was a good decision. Items on the chalk board are special cuisine recommended by the Italian chef. I had the fried trout and baked stuffed oysters and it was very delicious. The second time I ordered the seafood pasta, also very good. The 5 course set breakfast in the morning, included with the room, was very generous and delicious. Excellent service. For the high quality of food and nice service, the price is reasonable. I really enjoyed the meal and service. Thank you.Show less

Author: Su2122013Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Simple Italian in Penang
Review: Ambiance is good. Service is good. Love the frenzy lychee mint. Ordered antipasto, risotto, red tuna and lamb shank. Taste was okay except a dissatisfaction with lamb shank where it seemed like the meat was taken away leaving behind only two bites. Tiramisu and panacotta were so-so for me. Overall a good dining experience but no "wow" factor.Show less

Author: Coachsoren
Title: Something different near Chulia str.
Review:
I do fancy the Indian and Malay street kitchens around Chulia Street.
But when you are looking for something else , il Bacaro has it.
Nice Italian restaurant with good service and fair prices. High quality food
Only 100 meters away from Jims's place.

Author: Joshua L
Title: Most Racist Western Restaurant in Penang
Review: Table for two, expect for poor service if you're local asian.Went there last month, "the boss" didnt entertainment us but the rest of western. Foods was average and ambient just okay. Service is really bad. Better options out there defiantlyShow less

Author: JPSWashington_DCWashington, DC
Title: Delicious Authentic Italian Fare
Review: The restaurant has a very nice atmosphere and serves delicious and authentic Italian meals. We enjoyed a dinner of handmade pasta with Bolognese sauce and penne with a spicy sauce. Show less

Author: JamesSingapore2014Sydney, Australia
Title: Great find
Review: Il Bacaro is part of the Boutique hotel Campbell House. The menu has something for everyone and the service is very good. They have a huge specials menu too. Every dish that we ordered was very tasty and the food was fresh. Very good value for quality Italian food. The restaurant itself is not big but has a very nice atmosphere. We had the kids with us and they loved it especially the Mt Etna chocolate lava cake. The Bruschetta was one of the best I've had.Show less

Author: mrlabelman
Title: Wonderful gem of a restaurant
Review: Finding good Italian food in Asia isn't always easy but this little place in a heritage building is wonderful.  I enjoyed the baked linguini with seafood and it was really tasty.  We also enjoyed the six tapas appetizer and were not disappointed.  I'll be back

Author: DoctorBakarKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Magnifico!
Review: When you combine an Italian chef (from Veneto) with imported food ingredients and personally imported wines, very little can go wrong. The result is outstanding Italian cuisine. Combine that with outstanding service and pleasant ambience, this is a place to come back again to.. and we will! Show less

Author: berrykokUtrecht
Title: Proper Italian food although expensive
Review: We had diner at Il Bacaro on a Wednesday. Only 2 tables were occupied, but this didn't hold us back from going in. The restaurant looks nice with an Italian touch in the interior. My wife had chicken fillet with roast potatoes and salad which looked and tasted very well. I had a pizza with grilled vegetables. Since I have been in Italy for around 20 times, I know what proper Italian pizza is like. The pizzas at Il Bacaro are getting quite close to the real ones. Nice dough, only improvement would be the cheese. Tasteless and too much. Staff is friendly and attentive. Overall this is a nice option, although rather expensive for Malaysia. Show less

Author: Sue808Yokohama, Japan
Title: Delicious!
Review: I wanted pizza but got side tracked by everything else in the menu. First time we ordered a seafood pasta, broccoli truffle oil soup and salad. All of it was delicious. The ingredients used were very good. Sundries tomatoes were sweet and so were the cherry tomatoes - flavorful! We were too stuffed and decided to make a repeat visit for the pizza and dessert. During the second time we ordered the cicchetti and fried mozzarella. Portions were bigger than we imagined and still delicious. But we never made it to for the pizza and dessert. We will definitely be back to try the rest of the menu. Definitely a good change from the street food. Show less

Author: moonstarumieyBristol, United Kingdom
Title: BELLISIOMO.. Brava
Review: I was here with my friends to fulfil my craving for pasta and pizza. well this is the place to be if u are here in Penang! The pasta and the pizza were BELLISIOMO. we were super happy with the food and the service. Its a fine dining restaurant so don't expect cheap prices for the food. But for the quality and the taste of the food, its worth it to spend your money here. Brava..Show less

Author: Joseph H
Title: Very enjoyable
Review: What a lovely place this is! Excellent food, service, ambience. We had the rocket salad with Gorgonzola & buffalo mozzarella (unfortunately the rocket was a bit tuff/old) but we still ate it all and enjoyed it. We then had a really tasty pizza with spicy salami and olives. Apart from the rocket, I can't fault this place. We were made to feel very welcome from the start, great hosts/staff!Thanks for a lovely dinner, we'll be back for sure!Show less

Author: martvdkooi
Title: Top dining
Review: It's great to eat real Italian kitchen here in Penang! Great place to eat pizza or any other Italian dish. Freshly made, for breakfast even a pizza with egg and bacon.

Author: Jasonpianoharp
Title: Nice cozy place
Review:
Great place and great food! Authentic Italian pasta and tapas .
Great variety pizzas, pasta, tapas and some desserts. Friendly italian guy

Author: Lyndal_M
Title: All the food was tasty and presented well
Review: Tasty Italian food presented with a smile. If you have trouble choosing what to eat be guided by the well informed and friendly staff. Loved everything we tasted.

Author: billymars85Byron Bay, Australia
Title: Good italian food
Review: I've been eating at Il Bacaro with my father (we're both italians) to escape for the night from malaysian food. The menu as well as the owner and chef of the place are authentic italians. I ordered a rocket salad and a pizza, both delicious. My father had a pasta and also was pretty good (a bit overcooked for italian standards but that's normal overseas). The furniture and service were both good. Suggested as a good alternative to local cuisine if you feel like something else.Show less

Author: MumtoScruffyYorkshire, United Kingdom
Title: Enjoyable
Review: We had dinner here on two occasions during our recent 8 day stay in Georgetown. On the first visit we chose a pizza and thoroughly enjoyed it. On our second visit we had intended to have a meat based dish but we were seduced by the thought of another good pizza and succumbed. The food on neighbouring tables looked very well cooked and beautifully presented and I am sure that we will get around to trying some of these delights when we return to Penang.Service on both occasions was timely and professional but I did get the feeling that some of the pleasantness was put on and observed the Balinese waitress standing in the background on several occasions with a very sour face however as she reached the guests table she 'switched on' the smile. Indeed on our first visit she was incredibly friendly towards us but on our second visit only a few nights later, she was cool. I did wonder if the warmth of the smile is dependent on how big a tip you leave or maybe it was a bad day for her but hey, we expect a smily face and genuine warmth. The male waiter (I think from India) was lovely and the owner was just very business like. I think that on the service side we just didn't get that feel good factor which is a shame because this is a really good place.Show less

Author: lucy p
Title: Excellent food and Service
Review: Upon arrival the staff were very welcoming and we had excellent service throughout, while we read the menu we ordered a very good value and tasty bread basket and both of our pasta dishes were delicious.

Author: BHG2011Sydney, Australia
Title: Mistaken Identity
Review: Pizza makes my son happy. So we decided to have a family dinner at a fine Italian restaurant Il Bacaro. There is a restaurant in Melbourne of the same name so we thought it would be of the same if not a similar standard. Oops our mistake. We were among the first diners in the place yet it took more than one hour to get out food. One of the pasta was served in aluminium foil-that's a first and we were not impressed at all- I have dined in Rome, Florence and Venice and have never had such a presentation! The only thing that was truly nice was the cheesy garlic bread. Perhaps my standards should be lowered because this is an Asian country and italian would not be their speciality but the food and service was truly poor and if I'm not mistaken the chef was Italian. Here's the run down:Pizza base tough and oilyLamb shanks coldPrawns tasted frozenHouse Merlot tasted truly like sour grapesShow less

Author: GPORDOC
Title: Italian like no where else in Penang
Review: The place to eat Italian food in beautiful Penand setting reasonable priced If you have not been to this place then you have not wanted to experience Italian food George town recommended

Author: torinohardcore190XSingapore, Singapore
Title: Italian excellence in the street food island
Review: This is an authentic italian restaurant with fine dining restaurants standards. Everything is perfect, the welcome, the atmosphere, the service and quality of they offer. Unfortunately I never had the occasion to try their Mansion, cause most of the time is fully booked!Must try all the typical appetizers (= cicchetti from Venice) fully tasting and home made flavoured, the pasta and also the pizza has a good quality. Definitely one of the best italian restaurant in south east Asia.Show less

Author: AsianLiferSingapore, Singapore
Title: Mama mia, what flavor, what taste sensation!
Review: Back to Il Bacaro at Campbell House hotel after one year away. As far as I can tell, this restaurant is still without a doubt the most authentic Italian restaurant in Penang, and very likely all of Malaysia. I walk in, sit down and what I immediately hear is three or four staff chatting in, what else, Italian, right in front of the kitchen and just a few meters from my table. Honestly, there is absolutely nothing pretentious about this place: the sounds, smells and general ambience shout aloud that Il Bacaro is the real deal: 100% Italian! And the Italian food prepared by Italian chefs from, you guessed it, Italy, further speaks for itself. In fact, Il Bacaro is so obviously several notches above most restaurants in the region that dare label themselves as ‘Italian’ — you know the one’s that typically offer ‘European’ style pizza, lasagne, calamari and other uninspired, quickly made and usually mediocre dishes at inflated prices — that the difference is like night and day! Or more appropriately, delicious and barely edible. So, with delicious firmly planted in mind, I began my epicurean journey with the prawns Diavola appetizer. I was not disappointed. Just exquisite juicy prawns with cherry tomatoes swimming in a celery, garlic, parsley, chili and olive oil reduction and accompanied with crusty bread. This I ably washed down with an ice cold Italian Menabrea, brought with haste to my table by Farah on an especially hot day. I was half sated after my prawn orgy, and quicky proceeded to the Chef’s Special of linguine Bottarga with Sicilian mullet roe and clams in squid ink. Mama mia, what flavor, what taste sensation! Okay enough said on the main, I don’t want the chef to ask for a raise! Tiramisu and espresso for dessert. Do I really need to tell you about it? Suffice it to say, overall, confirmed yet again! Your time and money will be well spent at Il Bacaro, an affordable, true Italian gem in what to many remains an unexpected location. Bravisimo!Show less

Author: AAOOMMEE
Title: Afternoon tea until dinner
Review: We were looking for some place to sit and work. We passed this restaurant and tried. We've been there since 4:30PM to 8:30PM. We got mocktail 50% and we had salad, chicken and pizza. The food was awesome. Yummy! I recommend !

Author: Monika CVancouver, Canada
Title: A great place to be pampered
Review: Celebrated a birthday & anniversary in their Bistro... Fit for a queen ! Absolutely loved the canadian service -the italian owner and the awesome chef. My mouth is still lusting for the duck and chicken liver entree, what a great combo and it went well with the champagne! Thanks Roberto for a very memorable evening and hangover ! Loved it all.Show less

Author: jensbjorgensenSingapore, Singapore
Title: Fantastic Italian, very good service
Review: For those who grew up in western countries this is a welcome relief from the dirty streets. Aside from the Italian folks running and working in the place the staff is local but quite well trained. I had the salmon while my kids went for gnocchi and my wife ordered pan fried snapper which the kitchen graciously prepared in an alternative fashion as my wife doesn't like bacon. Salmon can be prepared quite boringly but this one was so nice balanced with savory flavors as well as just a bit of lemon, it was honestly one of the best salmon preparations I have ever had. The wine list is brief, we chose the Valpolicella Classico which has very enjoyable, fairly dry and earthy but still easy drinking. The Tomato Bruschetta was great, great bread with a more complicated and tasty topping than you'd expect. We were also treated to a glass of their house-made Limoncello which was quite interesting and tasty though sweeter than we prefer. Finally, Roberto came out to chat with us and ended up sitting down and giving us a very nice run-down of where we should eat and what to see. We enjoyed our meal so much we came back for a second one a few days later. Both were just great. The kids loved the gnocchi and their gnocchi and they eat a lot of it.Show less

Author: KieranM1042
Title: Promising restuarant spoiled by noisy children
Review: Started off very well ... Tomato Bruschetta was excellent, seabass very good, service very good Sadly we had to leave before dessert as the noise from a family with children was beyond tolerable ...unlucky I know ... but it if was my restuarant they would keep quiet or leave ! ... your market isn't young families I am sure I will probably try again ... but tonight was an ambience failure Show less

Author: Annemarie T
Title: Small serves, no extras
Review: Went there last night. Friendly and efficient staff. Overpriced for a very small serve. I had pasta with prawns and pesto. About ten or so very small prawns and not so tasty. No bread with meal. My husband had pasta and a beer and the total price would have been as much as we pay in Australia! Taste was OK, but better to wait till you are home.Show less

Author: Jeff PPerth, Australia
Title: Italian with Friendly Service
Review: Located in Campbell House, Il Bacaro has a large menu. Food was good quality and service excellent.I had the lamb cutlets, which were excellent, but if I could change one thing, it would be to add more vegetables with the cutlets as aubergine does not do it for an Aussie.However, the staff were friendly and well worth the visit as we chatted for ages and they made us fee welcome and at homeShow less

Author: AdriannaAye
Title: Delicious food.
Review:
I enjoyed my meal at this restaurant - simple, but really tasty!  Good wine selection as well.

Cocktail hour on the terrace - Lychee Martini is a must try!

Author: RickKRTKratie, Cambodia
Title: Only reviewing Il Bacaro...
Review: Walked through a very seedy area of George Town to find someplace to eat. Nothing but bars and street girls (or boys?) along the way. We were delighted to see what looked like a nice Italian below a hotel. We were presented with a chalk board menu that had lots of appetizing options in addition to the regular menu. We started with the rocket salad and my companion had the seafood salad. I was quite happy with the rocket but my companion said the seafood salad was flavorless. He asked for some chili sauce but Roberto, the owner, said they don't have in Italian restaurants. I had the slow roasted lamb shank for my main course. There was not much meat, maybe a scrawny lamb, but what there was was wonderful, with a mashed potato side. Nice ambiance overall. But the servers were quirky. They kept trying to push dessert on me before I had my main course. Bizarre. Anyway, I don't get good Italian food often and this was good. I enjoyed wishing another American couple Happy Thanksgiving in Penang for an extra special treat.Show less

Author: DWH33
Title: Very pleasant dining experience with tasty food and excellent service
Review: My partner and I enjoyed a very pleasant birthday dinner at Il Bacaro on her 61st Birthday. We liked the cozy, quiet environment and appreciated attentive yet not intrusive service. There's a nice selection of menu items plus a daily blackboard listing of specials.

Author: vishnu350Penang Island, Malaysia
Title: Soggy pizza, diluted coffee, rude chef.
Review: Used to come here often, however had a bad experience twice recently. The mushroom fettuccine and starters were ok. The ice cafe latte was watered down, and there was an ant in the sugar syrup bowl. The siciliana pizza was bad, the dough was soggy on the top. The cheese was like salty slice cheese, not mozzarella. We sent it back, but they just baked it an additional 10 mins and served it again, still soggy. No apology. We sent it back again, and the chef tried to rudely explain how to make pizza to us in a condescending manner because we were Asians. We paid and walked away. There are tons better places to eat in Penang.Show less

Author: samtantc73
Title: Great italian food not to be missed when u r in Penang
Review: Cozy place to dine with family members n friends. Great food with Italian taste.lots of wine selection n attentive waiters. Closed at 10.30pm

Author: neusallen
Title: Awesome food!
Review: Unluckily, I found this restaurant only on my last day in Penang, otherwise I'm pretty sure I would have eaten there a couple more times. The staff were super nice, fast service and big smile on their face and the food was fantastic. It didn't take long at all to get my food and I was very pleased with the nice taste. A truly Italian restaurant in South East Asia!My only regret is not having tried more of their menu, but I will be back next time I'm in town!Show less

Author: b0bbyhkHong Kong, China
Title: great food and value
Review: we just finished dinner and my brother (whose wife is italian an had recommended il bacaro). Had a pizza for appetizer and then an entree (a duck and a pasta dish) plus dessert and after dinner drink. the pizza was buffalo mozzarella and cherry tomatoes. plenty for an appetizer for two and delicious. i had fried duck breast with chicken liver mousse and spinach. also very good. my brother had house-made pasta that was also very good. our creme caramel dessert was a bit disappointing - while flavour good, the texture had air bubbles). Service was great, and total bill of Myr240 including wine was well worth it. when you are tired of the other great local food in george town, this is a great spot for change of pace and great value for global citizens.Show less

Author: buaya40The Hague, The Netherlands
Title: Il Bacaro, a place not soon to forget
Review: An inseparable part of hotel Campbell house is the restaurant "Il Bacaro", where chef Mario wields the sceptre in the kitchen. It resembles a typical Venetian tavern, where one enjoys a glass of wine and sharing “cicchetti” (small bites), but above all it serves traditional Italian dishes that are listed on a blackboard. We ordered the Chef’s “cicchetti” Selection, including a tomato bruschetta, deep fried calamari, meatballs, omelette with shrimps, sauted clams in garlic and herbs, grilled veggies, and croquettes, as a starter followed by the main course "Baked Seabass with asparagus" and "Lamb chops “Scottadito “ with aubergines in smoked melted cheese". It was a feast of recognition of particular tastes. To make it all complete, there is a terrific choice of Italian and Australian wines at affordable prices. The service was excellent and the staff was attentive and friendly.Show less

Author: spark41Copenhagen, Denmark
Title: Our favourite Italian restaurant in Georgetown
Review: Il Bacaro has traditional Italian dishes on it's menu and a blackboard with special dishes.There's a new chef too. Wines are affordable and there's a good choice. We shared the chacuterie plate at MYR 60 and it was more than enough for 2. The service was excellent as one expects from the restaurant owned by Campbell HouseShow less

Author: bearsense
Title: Good Italian Food
Review:
There were too many choices to make but the dishes I selected were satisfying.
The service staff were attentive and friendly.
Love the Octupus Carpaccio, Tiramisu and the Duck Bacon Fettuccine Carbonara which I ordered for takeaway.

Author: F8745ZUdavidm
Title: Best Italian Food
Review: I really enjoyed my meal here. In fact I came back the next night because there was too many tempting items on the menu that I needed a second chance to try more.

Author: KC64_Sydney
Title: Buonissimo!
Review: We loved this restaurant which is part of the beautiful Campbell House. Our daily breakfasts were delicious,  and we had a fabulous dinner as well. The food is fresh, authentic, and delicious!

Author: nadinel597Singapore, Singapore
Title: Return to Campbell House
Review: We stayed here about back in April 2014 with some family for a 30th.. We were back in Penang and decided to eat there again as the food was lovely from memory. Our meal was yummo again and would recommend to anyone... Was nice to finish off with an amaretto as a change! Good wine list too. Thumbs up. Show less

Author: Russell BCanterbury, United Kingdom
Title: Lovely breakfast
Review: We only had brunch here but the service was excellent and the food good. After wandering on foot through China Town it was nice to relax here. We were somewhat confused with our tourist map but the very helpful hotel receptionist gave us her map and directed us to where we were intending to go. The hotel reception area and dining room were spotless and should imagine the bedrooms are too. It was a haven of peace and tranquillity after wandering through the narrow alleys of the Chinese food market with all its smells, scooters and people.Show less

Author: WineloverMelbourneMelbourne, Australia
Title: A little bit of Italy in Panang
Review: Came here with a group and had the anti pasta to start. Around 10 different items and all were excellent. I had a chicken and mushroom dish which was well cooked and the mushrooms balanced the chicken very well. My dining companions all reported positive feedback on their meals. They do have Byo but you may also find it quite expensive. The panna cotta dessert was also excellent. All in all a good night and good food Show less

Author: Ryan MPhoenix, Arizona
Title: Excellent Pizza and Pasta
Review: The Pizza Margherita is consistently good as usual an I like the authenticity taste of the Pasta Alla Vongole (I was horrified a couple of times in other Penang Italian restaurant which adds flavor enhancer into this dish). This is cooked to Al dente with plenty of clams to sweeten the pasta. We were also given a very attentive service and impressed with the overall quality of the servings. High recommended.Show less

Author: BaronclogCanberra, Australia
Title: Pretentious
Review: We were really feeling like an italian style pizza, no that didn't happen. The pizza dough was under worked, without a full flour bloom and poorly developed gluten . We ordered a roast veg and smoked salmon pizza. It was not on the menu but our western maitre d assured us all ok. Yeah well we ended up with a roast zucchini and smoked salmon pizza which was on the menu. This pizza was definitely not kissed by the flame, the base was doughy and the topping barely cooked. The smoked salmon was however just brilliant. A nice drop of shiraz too, by the glass.Show less

Author: Sanspen
Title: Excellent Food & Service!
Review: Excellent breakfast, especially the eggs Benedict, and wonderful Italian dinners.  The pasta was very good - excellent service!

Author: SebastienC222London, England, United Kingdom
Title: Too good!
Review: So good, so italian, and so naughty!!! I had the prawns pesto spaghetti and it was delicious. Portion was big, there were a lot of prawns, and the pesto was yummy. My partner and I tried their delicious tapas, which is a nice way to taste a few specialities. If you are looking for a break from Malay, Chinese or Indian food, this is the place to go! Show less

Author: Yuki C
Title: Excellent service
Review: Friendly staff and boss~ Love the food and services provided by them. A very comfortable yet peaceful restaurant to relax your hassle and bustle lifestyle surrounded by delicious food.

Author: NomadicBoysLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent Italian food
Review: The food here is excellent! Everything we tried was delicious. We had the small plates as a starter which included meat balls, clams, calamari amongst other delicious prizes. We had the duck ravioli and 4 cheese gnocchi as a main - absolutely delicious. It is on par with some of the best Italian restaurants we've tried back home in London, if not better.The owners, Roberto and Nardya put their all into it and it really shows. The service is excellent.Our mistake - we stupidly chose to "share" a tiramisu dessert... Don't make the same mistake we did - ha ha ha.Show less

Author: ylfunSingapore, Singapore
Title: Nice ambience....fantastic starters....
Review: I had pretty high expectations when I went to Il Bacaro. I was told that the restaurant was really wonderful and the food excellent. The beginning of the evening it was exactly that. The hostess was really helpful with clarifications for one of the dishes listed on the chalkboard, even showing us the photo. The evening started out pretty good, as we all liked our drinks and appetisers even though it was quite some time before we were served. Then the waitress came to inform us that one of the orders (grilled fish with mashed pumpkin) needs our decision as they ran out of pumpkins. Then when the meals started coming after quite a long wait, the beef stew I ordered was too salty and the beef too tough (I managed to find a few pieces that are tender). The grilled fish was too dry and the tomato puree(replacement for pumpkin puree) and ratatouille didn't really go well with the fish. The Spaghetti Vongole was nice, but too dry. The Seafood Stew (which they strongly recommended) was cooked until there's hardly any sauce and the Spaghetti Carbonara needed additional parmesan cheese. I wished the staff had given an empty plate for the shells from the Vongole and Seafood Stew. Overall, I was disappointed with the experience. The waiters ignored my nephew's request for attention, only coming to our table when I waved. We had to ask for the parmesan cheese rather it being offered as there were pastas ordered.Show less

Author: epicwanderingsPortland, Oregon
Title: Delicious salads and pasta
Review: We've eaten at Il Bacari probably a dozen times over the past year and love their caprese salad plus many of their pastas, such as the penne with cream and smoked salmon. My husband ordered gnocchi the other night and the sauce was amazing, although we noticed the gnocchi were very soft and lacked texture.Il Bacaro has a wonderful, friendly staff who are attentive and want you to have the best meal possible. The interior is quaint and makes you feel like you are no longer in Penang but perhaps in Italy. Show less

Author: LizzyPickup
Title: A Quiet Oasis in the middle of Penang...Exceptional Food!!
Review: Gorgeous food! Really very good, a little nook of oasis in the heart of Penang. We will be back 100%

Author: jeff1955malaysia
Title: Italian Resto
Review: it is a nice comfortable place with inside and corridor sitting. the deco and ambiance is nice but the food is just average. Service is good and staff are attentive but they only need to improve on the quality of the food.

Author: FionaTayMelbourne, Australia
Title: Yummy
Review: Located on the corner of Campbell and Cintra street, nice air conditioned place, friendly staff and delicious food. You can get 6 small tapas for only 39RM! They make really good mojito's too :) Came here maybe 3 times, price is a bit dear but worth it. Show less

Author: GuliWherePenang, Pulau Pinang, Malaysia
Title: Scrumptious
Review: Not cheap but I just love the pizza. It's scrumptious and so addictive . They even have one with buffalo mozarella ! I believe bad reviews must come from customers who use Pizza Hut as a yardstick. That being said, mosquitoes are a problem in this dark dining room. Spray some on your legs before coming .Show less

Author: Augustine K
Title: Italian Crave.. Not satisfied unfortunately
Review: We ordered Pizza Napolitana as a starter and Spaghetti Vongole & Fettuccine Prawns & Zucchini.... 15minutes in every thing arrived !!! to add disappointment the pizza that arrived was a mushroom pizza... I have to say the ambience is very inviting... sadly the name does not live up to its reputation ... service was above average can improve with more product knowledge. Overall rating:-Food 4 /10 ( pasta was over cooked & pizza was soggy )Presentation 5.5 / 10 Attentiveness 6 / 10Drinks 7 / 10Would I come back again :- No ( no passion for the items served )" mediocre "Show less

Author: arco27Ocean Shores, Australia
Title: Italian surprise in world heritage George town
Review: by chance, while looking for good coffee we came across Il Bacaro. After sampling many delicious Penang restaurants we went several times to Il Bacaro for delicious breakfasts and lunches and highly recommend their delicious authentic Italian food, super friendly staff and pleasant atmosphere, 6 stars all the wayShow less

Author: minagsBangalore, Karnataka, India
Title: Exqusite Italian food...best ever!!
Review: Bacaro is a quaint little restaurant situated in the ground floor of Campbell house. The ambiance outside and inside captures the Italian experience in the true sense. The restaurant feels warm and cozy with courteous staffs. Coming to the food, well I can say, hands down that this place serves "THE BEST PIZZA I HAVE EVER HAD"!!! Our standard favorite is the ham and mushroom pizza which is to die for. It has loads of some exquisite quality Mozzarella and the pizza dough is most probably made in house giving the bread the most amazing flavor. Overall a must try. We also tried the Mozzarella fried in breadcrumbs which is served with a tomato based sauce..YUMMY!! The bruschetta varieties are amazing as well. We tried the"soup of the day" which was a spinach and potato soup that day which was delightful as well. Planning to try out the pasta on the next visit. Overall the food here is exquisite!! A must try!!Show less

Author: reins76
Title: Disappointing
Review:
Breakfast- inconsistent service and cooking
Dinner- very disappointing pizza, not like an Italian pizza, very American-cheesy with a bad base.  Very disappointing pasta dry stuck together pasta with dry ordinary sauce.  Expensive for poor quality food in a country/city full of cheap, delicious food

Author: Peter L
Title: Awesome hospitality
Review: The staff are extremely friendly. Literally making me feel like we are dining at our own home. Reasonable priced menu.

Author: Kushalneu
Title: Fantastic place to dine
Review: The food and hospitality was above expectation. Everything was great with friendly staffs. I enjoyed my time there

Author: Dennis R
Title: Food! Food!
Review: We stayed at Campbell House & had all our breakfasts here because there were plenty of choices.dropped in a couple of times during the afternoons & also for dinner because the food is good & the service is great.

Author: Dennis146Penang Island, Malaysia
Title: A Place to go for Authentic Italian Food
Review: This restaurant is off Jalan Penang in the heart of the Heritage part of Georgetown. They have some Al Fresco tables but most are inside with the comfort of air con. On offer is a wide choice of dishes, not just Italian but we went there to check out the Italian food. As a starter we had hot Bruschetta and it was absolutely fabulous from the bread base to the aromatic black olives marinated in house. The board showing the specials had Duck Bolognese so had to try this and it was a delightful change to the normal bolognese, Not heavy very good taste with the pasta cooked perfectly. We did not have a dessert as it was mainly based on ice cream but we understand there will be more Italian desserts in the near future. The house wine was from Australia which was a disappointment as I was expecting Italian, but it was drinkable and complemented the food. Finished off with a Grappa and Espresso, would have been nice to have a choice of Grappa. The restaurant does not give the staff a view of all the tables so they should be more mobile checking to see if any guests required service. I could see one or two getting frustrated about getting the waiters attention.Good atmosphere, friendly service, good food we will return, this was good value for money.Show less

Author: beachcomber_bambiMelbourne, Australia
Title: Authentic Italian
Review: I was dining on my own at night and felt very comfortable. Staff thoughtfully seated me at a side table from where I could watch the other tables and not feel conspicuous about being alone. The price was on the high side for Italian food, and more than I would normally pay for a casual meal, but the food and service were both excellent. I would return there for an occasion rather than everyday dining.Show less

Author: Dawdragon
Title: A pleasant breakfast
Review: Searching for breakfast I stopped by Il Bacaro and I was not disappointed. I left satisfied and ready for sightseeing. Staff were attentive and interested that their customers enjoyed their meals. Happy to go back.

Author: LISA OYangon (Rangoon), Myanmar
Title: An Enjoyable Dining Experience.
Review: We had lunch here and it was so good we went back for dinner! An Italian Restaurant with an Italian Chef was not a find we expected to have in Penang. The homemade gnocchi was delicious and the lamb shanks were mouth wateringly flavoursome and tender. With a discerning wine list to compliment, this is a wonderful location for an intimate dining experience. Show less

Author: mojay_9penang
Title: Great Italian good served fresh with a great price tag
Review: Visited here after meeting the owners one night and was very pleased with everything.the decor is spotless and very trendy,the owners and staff are all present and ready to serve which for malaysia is not standard.Ordered clams and gnocchi and it was devine.very fresh and authentic.Had 2 glasses of wine and lunch for 2 people and it cost $25 which I feel is really great value for quality food in asia.All in all will revisit to try other things on the menu.There is a hotel there too and all tastefully done up.very discreet and private which is a nice atmosphere to be in.Well done Roberto and Nadia on a fine establishment.Show less

Author: yvonKL
Title: Tres agreable
Review: We had here a lovely dinner pizza pasta 4 fromagi et a glass of a good red wine you ncan give a chance it is a good value

Author: Sue-ann R
Title: Below Expectation
Review: The name Campbell House and its Heritage status made me choose this restaurant one night recently. In all my worldly travels, Italian or French food had always been my preference and this time I thought I would not be far wrong to opt for Italian since it is reputed to be run by true blue Italians, not common on this island of Penang. The overall ambience was cosy but there it stops. The restaurant for a Saturday night was not crowded yet the service was slow. The house pour was overly priced for a low range wine. The most disappointing were the main courses. Both of our main course fell far below expectation.The Sirloin steak was definitely not fine dining standard. It came like a piece of rubbery beef. I had the snapper cooked in almonds and lemon.My face fell when I took a first bite. The fish was certainly not overly fresh and the cook must of tried to mask this by overpowering it with the white sauce.I didn't finish the dish. The only dish we ordered that night that passed muster was the pizza.It is a small restaurant but yet neither the manageress nor the owner cared to pause at table to enquire if everything was all right. They just walked past without a glance at the diners, Good rapport helps to ensure repeat clientele .I noticed that the restaurant won the Excellent Award by TripAdvisor for 2 years but somehow standards must have lapsed this year.Show less

Author: Richard SPhuket, Thailand
Title: Good honest eats and great service
Review: The one thing that pulled me into this place was the menu which promised good, honest, back to basics, quality meals made from quality ingredients. I certainly wasn't disappointed. The price bracket was a little higher than I would normally go for but as a place to take someone special or for an important occasion, fantastic. Show less

Author: IsselerhofSingapore, Singapore
Title: Solid Performance
Review: Went to dinner with friends:This is the in-house restaurant of one of the more well known boutique hotels in Penang: The Campbell House, so if trying to get a lift there, just let the driver know that's where you want to go.Very nice and pleasant atmosphere.Service friendly and prompt.Food fresh and well prepared and presented:We had pasta, fish and chicken all of which were well executed and tasty for a very reasonable price.I would recommend this place when in the area, it does not really fit a "very good" rating, but in absence of a "good" rating this is what it gets, it is too good for "average"Show less

Author: Kanan AAustralia
Title: Old World Comfort
Review: I would recommend this place as a good spot to retreat for a coffee or a juice while exploring Georgetown. We ordered an Americano (RM6.36), a fresh carrot and ginger juice (RM11.66), ice cream (RM12.72) and two scoops of Lemon Sorbet (RM12.72), all served in style with quality cutlery and crockery, although only with one small paper serviette. The decor is old world but very stylish. I found it a very nice place to sit, with excellent service that made us feel right at home. It was only our first visit, but we were asking ourselves why we hadn't come here earlier.I think it would be a good choice for a special occasion, as the dishes are not cheap.Show less

Author: Ouli_13Cerritos, California
Title: An Unexpcted Dining Experiance in Georgetown, Penang
Review: We were in Penang only because the buses from KL to Lingkawi were all full. Once again, the unplanned, the chance occurrence, turned out to be a trip highlight. We stumbled across Il Bacaro wandering around Georgetown after the day had cooled off a bit. Obviously, it was upscale compared to the other restaurants we were finding, plus, it served alcohol so we went for it. A great choice. The food was excellent, the service good and the soft Italian themed background music relaxing. It combined to make a pleasant environment for chatting, enjoying the wine and the dinner, relaxing, and then wrapping things up with a tasty cappuccino. Il Bacaro would be keeper anywhere.Show less

Author: madeleine E
Title: Great Italian Restaurant
Review: Located in the wonderful Campbell House Hotel in the middle of Georgetown this restaurant provides a great menu selection at very reasonable prices. Definitely worth a visit.

Author: AsianLiferSingapore, Singapore
Title: “Memorable Genuine Italian Dining Experience -- the Best in Town!”
Review: Over the last three years on each trip to Penang, my wife and I have returned to the Venetian-themed Il Bacaro restaurant at The Campbell House Hotel. Our last experience has strengthened our belief that for authentic Italian cuisine, Il Bacaro remains hands down the best choice in Penang. The adage ‘the people make the place’ is truly applicable to Il Bacaro in the form of the executive chef, Mario, who brings genuine Italian fare and flavor from kitchen to table. In fact many of the dishes on Il Bacaro’s menu are the same Mario’s mama made him at home in Italy. Not surprisingly we have yet to be disappointed with Mario’s cooking acumen, it's just too bad our Italian language skills are lacking so we can't express our satisfaction to him. Further on the topic of people making the place, Mario’s brother, Roberto, and his wife, Nardya, the hotel’s proprietors, double as wait staff. Whether greeted and seated by the owners, or by Emily, Cholo or Ronaldo, we have always felt welcome, engaged and at home; what's more, our orders have never been messed up! Our favorite mains are gnocchi Bolognese, gnocchi quattro formaggi, rocket salad with grilled vegetables and buffalo mozzarella, and the Australian beef tenderloin wrapped in pastry. For desert we recommend the zuppa Inglese (trifle), and although it goes without saying, the coffee is always good (okay I said it). Look for the chef’s specials, too. As if Il Bacaro needs another reason for a visit, there are wonderful framed photos and other local souvenirs for sale, including jewellery displayed in several curio cabinets. We were particularly struck by the Malaya and Straights Settlements coin cufflinks in beautiful polished wood boxes. Thank-you Campbell House Hotel for giving us yet another memorable food experience – most definitely we'll be coming back to Il Bacaro!Show less

Author: GlobalTraveller1985
Title: Angry bird
Review: angry unpleasant unwelcoming waitress/bar woman - luckily stumbled across the place while exploring the old town. I say luckily so i know where to avoid in future

Author: BricodustSouth West France
Title: Pretty good restaurant but
Review: We visited this restaurant with some local Penang friends on their recommendation.Not sure why it is called an Italian restaurant (Venetian specifically), yes, it serves pasta and pizza but the main menu contained very few true Italian meals, lamb shank, snapper special, steak with a taragon sauce, etc.?, where was the bacala mantecata (salt cod), Sarde en saor (marinated herrings), capaccio of beef, bigoli pasta etc. We did have the Cicchetti (chefs's selection of italian tapas) which were very good.The quality of the rest of the food that we did eat was very good- lamb shank, snapper special and the Involtini. Finishing off with Affogato (vanilla icecream with strong expresso poured over was great.Wine at approx 130-140 RM upwards was just above average price for a Penang restaurant.Total bill for 4 was 500 RM, so not bad.Good anmbiance and efficient, professional waiters.Would visit again for a very nice meal but not for their selection of Italian food.Show less

Author: mike dSeattle, Washington
Title: we had a better Pizza at Ecco
Review: I didn;t have a good time at this hotel and found the management rude so probably wasnt in the best mood to try their restauarant. Even in a good mood it would be no better than average and the place looked like it needed a paint. In terms of fire safety this place should not be operating in my opinion.Show less

Author: DivingSEABangkok, Thailand
Title: Went there two times (so far) but quality was not same...
Review: I would have given 5 stars after first visit last week - and this week we came back, and suddenly the quality and taste of the pizza bread was very different from last time. This worries me a bit, but this is with no doubt one of the best italian in Georgetown - basically because they try to cook the italian food in italian style.Atmosphere and staff is great, so could easily have been 5 stars - if I did not have this experience that the quality may depend on the day you visit.Prizes are above average (but not too much) so I would expect a consistent qualityShow less

Author: JLee23Friedrichshafen, Germany
Title: Enjoyable food
Review: We went there due to recommendation of a chef. We really enjoyed the Chiccetti, chef's selection of nine dishes. Three different types of croquets, snapper, bruschetta, pancake, grilled vegetables, clams, and prawns. Love the basil panna cotta with berry sauce and the mint soda drinks. I didn't know what panna cotta is and a guy, probably the owner showed us from the kitchen. Food and drinks are great. The staff service could certainly be improved - do not confuse the diners. We only understand the owner and not any of the two serving staff. Show less

Author: Bob HPoole, United Kingdom
Title: Atmospheric dining
Review: One can have too much of Malaysian food, and to find an Italian restaurant in Georgetown, a great welcome from the owners Roberto and Nardya, followed by a detailed description of the menu and specials, made for a very refreshing change.The food that followed, the service, and being joined by the owners, made this a special occasion. After much thought the following day, and a search for an alternative, we finished up booking a table that night for a return visit.This restaurant is special, the food, wine and service is excellent, you will enjoy your visit.Show less

Author: 788graemegPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Excellent meal, great atmosphere
Review: My wife and I went to this restaurant for to celebrate a birthday of a friend. There were about 20 in the group. We pre-ordered our meals. The entree, main course and dessert were just excellent. They were all served most efficiently by friendly staff. The atmosphere in the restaurant is cozy and welcoming despite being in the midst of bustling George Town,Quite the best meal I have had for some timeShow less

Author: SSPhoon
Title: Excellent Italian Food
Review: One of the few restaurant in Penang that serves authentic Italian Food. Food is excellent, portion is just nice and not too pricey. Parking is a problem though as it is smack right in the middle of Georgetown.

Author: shaunpunpunManchester, United Kingdom
Title: Amazing
Review: Staff were great, food was actually amazing and the price was also unbelievable for the quality and portion sizes. All the staff were very friendly and chatty, very attentive and makes the vibe very comfortable. Whole experience was excellent. One thing you must have is their famous 'chocolate mount Edna dessert' - literally the nicest desert I've ever had. Will eat here again in my visit to Penang!Show less

Author: Dr_Les_SgSingapore, Singapore
Title: Fantastic experience
Review: We have stayed with Antonio and Nardya at Campbell House- great place to stay, and now we have dined at Il BacaroIt's a great place to escape the frenetic pace of Penang and to luxuriate in a little continental relaxation.The Gnocchi are little pillows of cloud on a great sauce. The lamb shanks just melt in your mouth. The mount Etna chocolate dessert was superb.We really enjoyed our time in real Veneto cuisine in Penang Show less

Author: dkh117Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania
Title: Great food and service
Review: We stayed at the Campbell House and decided to have dinner here mostly because it had air conditioning and was not rice or noodles. Everything was excellent. Waiters were patient and answered all our questions about the where the meat and seafood was from and explained how the water was purified (big concern for us). There were a few meal descriptions that I was not familiar with and they explained that as well. The place was very nice and seemed like a special place to have dinner but the cost was very reasonable compared to US places. Wine was similarly priced to others we had in Malaysia. We ended up with two entrees off the special board - gnocchi and a beef served with mashed potatoes. The wine was also from the special board. We finished our meal with classic gelato and enjoyed every bite.Show less

Author: mikeprice43Kearns, Australia
Title: When in Penang, do as the Romans do.
Review: When in Rome do as the Romans do. We spent two weeks in Penang and for most of this time my wife and I pretty much stuck to this adage. For our last night we decided to treat ourselves to something a little more up market to what is generally available in Georgetown and we were not disappointed.I had the Rib-eye steak with Blue Vein cheese sauce and my wife had the Gnocchi Bolognese. Both were delicious and the service was impeccable.I can highly recommend the Il Bacaro Restaurant.Show less

Author: jamoca84George Town, Malaysia
Title: Italian food from an Italian chef
Review: When you go to an Italian restaurant that serves food by an Italian chef, you know you're in for a treat. The menu is pretty simplistic with mostly appetisers, pastas and pizzas. But it does have a selection of other mains such as poultry and seafood just in case you didn't feel like having pasta or pizza. But since it was our first time at the restaurant, we all felt like having pasta. I had never tried gnocchi before and I thought it would be good to try it for the first time. I chose to have it with a four cheese sauce - which was extremely creamy and rich. However I could not finish the whole plate because I was too full. But thumbs up nevertheless because it was really quite indulgent. We also tried the appetiser of tomato bruschetta which was really packed with flavour. The bread was toasted at just the right amount and was topped with balsamic vinegar and a generous amount of tomatoes that was mixed with garlic and herbs and olive oil. The other main that I would recommend that was at our table was in the special menu: Seafood Spaghetti. It's a tomato based pasta which had a generous amount of seafood and the sauce was a killer. Loved the tomato, olive oil and garlic mix of sauce. It gave the dish the punch of flavour it needed. The restaurant isn't very big but has a very nice cozy feeling to it. Perfect for catching up with friends and family. The restaurant is located at the Ground floor but there are 2 floors more which holds their Trip Advisor award winning hotel. The dishes are also not too pricey considering the portions of the meals as well. Overall a good restaurant that I would love to visit again soon.Show less

Author: AuscoachBrisbane, Australia
Title: Excellent meal
Review: Bruschetta is best I have had outside of Italy. Lamb shanks were to perfection. Steak with blue cheese sauce had great sauce and potatoes. Meat was well cooked but was a lower quality of meat. However considering how hard it is to get steak here perhaps understandable. Desert of chocolate chilli mud cake was a treat. The chef here is top quality, service great and the host genial and helpful. Great place to eatShow less

Author: Alex_e_SabrinaRivignano, Italy
Title: Highly recommended!
Review: Delicious food, typically Italian (original products!), authentic hospitality, kindness like a few!As frequent traveler for business reasons, I attend this place every time I am in Penang, I think it is one of the best Italian restaurants in the world.For the most demanding gourmets, chef Mario is always available for specialties on demand.Very good bar tender with his excellent drinks!Show less

Author: Marian SPenang
Title: Authentic High Quality Italian Fare
Review: This is by far my first dining choice in Georgetown.I've eaten here several times and it is a mainstay when friends from overseas visit.The menu is vast and changes frequently. We've had exquisite duck dishes, beef, fish and, of course, wonderful pastas. Vegetables are fresh and cooked perfectly.Wine list offers excellent choices at very fair prices.It surprises me that there are disappointing reviews of Il Bacaro. I live in Penang and, generally, have the habit of consulting with the chef and staff on what is freshest and best, before ordering.There are many constraints on getting top quality fresh foods here, so asking is probably a good idea.Show less

Author: Tzeni660Richmond, Australia
Title: Looked promising
Review: We visited this restaurant recently and it looked so promising. Lovely inside, attentive staff, lovely setting. I ordered a garden salad to start with, well what a poor garden it must have come from. The only piece of salad on the plate was lettuce. I thought it should have at least tomato and cucumber. Then we ordered pizzas each. Well they have got to be the most tasteless pizzas I have ever eaten. They were covered in what looked like a kilo of cheese which was revolting. What an absolute waste of an oasis in Georgetown which should be so much better. Would never recommend this place to anyone.Show less

Author: Steve J
Title: Very nice meal at a good price.
Review: Il Bacaro offers a very pleasant, quiet, cool and relaxed environment for meal - the polar opposite of the eating experience in most of Penang. We had a large green salad with grilled vegetables (eggplant and roasted red peppers) as a starter - beautifully presented and delicious. For mains, I had a pomfret fillet and my bride had a thick snapper fillet. Mine was grilled and sauced with a white wine lemon and caper reduction and served in a sea of lightly sautéed cherry tomatoes, over boiled and sautéed golden potatoes - yummy. My wife's snapper was sautéed and sauced in a tomato, parsley and garlic mix - also delicious. We had no drinks other than water. The bill was RM 118 (US$ 36), very reasonable for what we got and the quality of the dining experience. The service was very attentive. This meal was such a contrast with the hastily prepared, carelessly presented low quality food we found in several of the well known Penang restaurants and the famous hawker stalls. The latter were a real disappointment - highly touted worldwide, but frankly not worth a look.Show less

Author: Silvio2805Penang Island, Malaysia
Title: Dissapointing food - please don't think of it as typically Italian.
Review: This restaurant looks like an oasis of European excellence in Georgetown's China Town and the setting and service is excellent - unlike the food. We ate a Lamb Shank that looked and tasted like it had been prepared a long, long time before we saw it together with a Chicken Milanese with Spaghetti which turned out to be an OK Chicken Milanese with dried pasta twists and fake Parmesan cheese. The bread served was sliced supermarket white! The desert was a perfectly acceptable Panacotta. If your looking for a typically Italian restaurant where they use the freshest ingredients, cooked simply and always delicious Il Barco isn't it.Show less

Author: calin301eItaly
Title: Will come back again
Review: The spaghetti vongole was cooked al dente which was superb. Tried the cicchetti for 6 dishes and they were lovely. Friendly and attentive staffs. Pizza however was a little too salty to our liking. Overall it was a good experience and would definitely come back again.Show less

Author: Annlim88
Title: Will be back for more.
Review: Comfortable and Cozy. Friendly and Attentive staffs. Great place to dine and relax with family and friends. Tried the Tiramisu with a hot cup of Illy cappuccino. Two Thumbs up.

Author: LeuraYorkshire
Title: Good Italian restaurant
Review: Ate here three times, food was good and service. Had one slight disappointment on last night when we chose the recommended wine from the 'Specials' board, which was shown as 75 ringgits and seemed a good deal. However, when we came to pay they charged us 95 ringgits and when I queried it they brought out the Specials board showing the price at 95. They said it must have been smudged when I saw it but I'm certain they changed the price. Surely if a wine is on 'Special' it would be cheaper than the normal menu price? They said no, it was only to recommend it. I paid the bill but felt slightly cheated and annoyed that they seemed to suggest I was mistaken, when my wife and I both saw the price at 75, as that is why we ordered a bottle. A little honesty would not go amiss and if they had made a mistake they should have stood by the price shown.Show less

Author: emeraldgreenShanghai, China
Title: Comfort food
Review: Judging from the stream of customers coming in on a rainy Sunday nite, Il Bacaro must be doing something right!Hosts were very welcoming, promptly seating us and after taking our drinks order, were quick to introduce the nite' s specials. They also offered a variety of different sauces than the one on the menu when we said we are looking for a gnocchi dish. The 4 cheeses homemade gnocchi was lovely as was the fall-off-bone lamb shank. Overall I wud say Il Bacaro is a relaxed and comfortable ( quiet n air conditioned ) place for a good meal at reasonable price.Show less

Author: cikkcakkGlobal Village
Title: TURNED AWAY - UNABLE TO RATE
Review: Sunday, March 2nd, 2014 @ 9:00AM. We were taking a morning walk in Georgetown, looking for a decent place to spend our breakfast. There we were, on the corner of Campbell and Cintra Roads at the café/restaurant that apparently belongs to Campbell House. Upon entering a lady asked us whether we're walk-in or in-house guests. After finding out that we are not hotel guests, we were told that unfortunately they cannot serve us breakfast. They reasoned that there are not enough tables. We looked around, and saw that only three tables were occupied out of about ten. "It's okay, we can sit outside on the terrace." - we replied. Unfortunately they still refused to serve us, blaming the lack of tables. Basically we were politely told to go to hell... It's hard to comprehend that a food service business that is obviously open to the public turns away paying customers. Even if they were jam packed (which was NOT the case) they could have asked us to wait. It's also understandable that a restaurant of a hotel caters toward their guests first. However, they were more like empty than full. I never give the lowest rating, but it's impossible to rate a place that denies entry during their normal operating times. The owners and/or the management should make up their minds and decide if they want to serve in-house guests only, or have an "all are welcome" policy. Please do not discriminate by serving outsiders only when the hotel isn't fully booked.PS: Don't get me wrong, Campbell House is probably a good place if you are an "in-house guest". I just wanted to voice my opinion, since it's very shocking and degrading to be turned away without a good reason.Show less

Author: csChaiMalaysia
Title: Authentic Italian Food, Friendly Service, Cozy Place
Review: My family and I had a nice authentic Italian dinner at Il Bacaro Venetian Restaurant in Campbell House. It is located at the junction of Campbell Street and Cintra Street in the heart of Georgetown. It is run by two Italian brothers from Venice, Roberto and Mario.We had Cicchetti (RM45)for starters. It was very special with nine small dishes, giving us a taste of the different types of food. For the main course, we ordered Honey Roasted Lamb Shank (RM42) and Salmon with herbs and olive crest (RM36). The former was slow-cooked till the meat was soft and succulent. Good to the last bit. The latter was a sizeable grilled salmon, just nicely flavoured. Roberto recommended us his Homemade Gnoochi with Bolognese (RM30). He said this flour and potato 'dumplings' was from his mother's original recipe. This can be considered the carbohydrate dish to complement the two other dishes above.For dessert, we asked Roberto for his recommendation again and he suggested Tiramisu (RM17) described as layers of sponge fingers coffee with mas carpone. It was non-alcoholic and very rich in flavour. It was served in a small, short glass. We also had Vanilla Panna Cotta with Berry sauce (RM15), a traditional Italian dessert. This small piece of jelly was creamy-smooth and melt in the mouth.For drinks, we had Apple Blush (RM17), consisting of apple, lime, mint topped with Spirite, Mango Tango (RM17) which was mango,lemon topped with soda and Italian Soda (RM17), mint topped with soda and a scoop of vanilla ice cream.The place is clean and cozy. The service is friendly, even Mario, the chef takes time off from his kitchen to talk to the customers. There is an additional 10% service charge and 6% government tax to all the prices. It would be a very good place if you wish to have some authentic Italian food cooked by real Italians in Penang.Show less

Author: FTkelvinkhaw
Title: I'd lick my plate clean if there weren't that many people around!
Review: Great service from the staff. Excellent authentic food n drinks. Pleasant atmosphere. These guys are seriously worth my money. Can't wait for my next visit.

Author: KevinC183
Title: Kevin Coetzee
Review: This would be the third time I have been here and every occasion has been a pleasant experience. The food is good and friendly service is top notch. Well worth trying out.

Author: Carol L
Title: Excellent food
