Review: Everything there was cheap and good and we especially enjoyed the curry mee! It has some fried curry leaves in the soup and added extra flavor and texture. Better than the other hawker centers we've tried.

Author: leecK9330OU
Title: Family Dinner
Review: Visit to the food court because of nearby chew's jetty. Many choice, taste acceptable & price resonable too

Author: kinmuntam
Title: Variety of food
Review: Had dinner before leaving our Penang holiday. Between the three of us we had:Assam laksa: first bowl we had (could not make it to the the other places to try) but it was very well spiced, just sour and spicy enough and LOTS of mackerel in the soup. Well worth the money.Popiah (from the Assam laksa lady): OK but still prefers the Thean Chun, Ipoh version.Mamak Mee Goreng: acceptable only.Sizzling pork rice: large portion, with fried egg. Delicious according to my son.Will return for the variety and cheap prices, if we in town again.Show less

Author: MichaelW4494
Title: Good food
Review: Really enjoyed the experience. a lively food court. Very clean, high quality food and friendly workers. We sampled several dishes including Hor Fun, Sataypork and lovely Popiah. Best of all sizzling pork rice.

Author: Hildyblues
Title: A Variety of Penang Food
Review: This place has a whole lot of stalls selling all the Penang local food.  The food is good and cheap and all served up nicely but nothing is extraordinary that you can't get elsewhere in Penang.

Author: cutedinoMelbourne, Australia
Title: Food quite good and place is clean!
Review: You can tell a place has authentic local food when the locals eat there. The assam laksa was lovely as was the lor bak with sweet sauce and chilli sauce. Lots of other choices which we did not try, The place was surprisingly clean, even the toilets for a hawker centre! The floors did not have the sticky/oily feel which most hawker centres have. Good place to have a drink and food whilst walking around the area looking for the street arts and the clan jetties.Show less

Author: WSLEE74
Title: Disappointed !
Review: Brought my family to chew jetty around 7pm. Thought of taking dinner nearby before going into the jetty. CF was the nearest food court around. Ordered few dishes there and all the food was not up to the standard. Will not visit again

Author: liesenlucBrugge, Belgium
Title: Good food in a clean environment
Review: Normally we are a bit afraid to eat at stalls, but we arrived here, because the other restaurants nearby were closed. And we found it so great, that we returned every day. It is a big and busy place, and sometimes you must be happy to find a table free. Choose first your table and let someone of your company stay at the table. Then go to the stalls and have a look at all the specialities they offer. Make your choice and pay, when they bring the plate to your table. If you like another plate, just go walking around again. For drinks, they come to your table. It is cheap, funny, and good, so give it a try!Show less

Author: jelebean
Title: Foodies paradise
Review: Come here twice during our stay and had some great meals here. Due to such a huge variety of meals we had difficulty in choosing what to try, the place was pumping! They put on entertainment which was ' interesting'.

Author: 442joseph
Title: Great food
Review: If you want to try local food, You need to go and try the Hawker place. The price are cheap and the choice of food is great

Author: Emilyd506Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Huge selection of food!
Review: easy to find from most backpacker hotels in Georgetown, passing a number of the famous street art murals on the way from Love Lane. Great for sharing food with a group and the food is all cheap, arrives at your table quick. The live band was pretty awful but it adds to the fun! Arriving after 8pm means you might have to wait a few minutes for a tableShow less

Author: Hawanum HKajang, Malaysia
Title: Good food but noisy and crowded
Review: My family and I went there to eat as locals tell us the CF hawker center has halal food as many eating places in Penang cater mostly to non Muslim tourists. My children had Char Kway Teow which according to them, were OK. Each plate had three giant shrimp which were a bit overcooked. My husband and I ate the Squid with Kangkong and the roasted mussels. They were fresh and delicious. The cendol was also very good. Service was quick but customers might be overwhelmed by the rapid appearance of three or more food vendors asking for orders as soon as they sit down. A good idea would be to select what you want to eat before you sit at any of the benches. Local tourists would say the food is a tad too expensive but overseas tourists often say the food is cheap.Overall, the hawker center is a nice place to eat local food the way locals do it...under the open night sky. It would have been a nicer experience it wasn't so crowded and noisy.Show less

Author: editha05
Title: Great Food
Review: We had a great dinner at the CF Hawker. The food taste soooo good with the very reasonable price. I enjoyed the Kangkong Belachan, Ikan Panggang ( barbeque stingray) fish head curry, chicken satay and chicken barbeque. The fresh fruit juice is so tasty. The service is quick though the place is too busy, No wonder why people are coming to this place like there's no other place to dine.Show less

Author: 106mtmt
Title: Good and cheap food
Review: Had dinner there and ordered char kway tiao (stir-fried noodles) and wanton noodles. The char kway tiao (store to towards the main road - Weld quay) is good while you can skipped the wanton noodle (from the store somewhere in the middle near to the drink stall). Overall a local dinning experience different from the one at Gurney Drive. Show less

Author: DarreninHK
Title: Great food that locals eat
Review: Unless some of the more central foodcourts, this one is primarily used by locals. Great food, and great prices

Author: jaydee55Angeles City, Philippines
Title: Good food ,great price, basic environment
Review: Very authentic hawker center that tends to see a lot of local clientele with some tourists moved in. We ate there on a couple of occasions on the back of a recommendation from a local.There is a wide choice of vendors selling a wide array of dishes. Just find a table and then probably best that one person stays at the table at a time whilst the other goes to a few different stalls and selects some dishes and then swap over. Typical price for a dish would be something like 5 MYR with the fish being more but still very reasonable.Go here if you want good street food ........don't go here if you are looking for air conditioning or anything vaguely upmarket !Personally I really liked the food and the atmosphere and will be back again soon.Show less

Author: tieneit
Title: Cheap and Good
Review: One stop center for hawker food for both locals and tourist. Variety of food at a very low price. Chicken, BBQ pork and roast pork rice a must for my family for every visit.

Author: Jonathan N
Title: Fantastic choice and cheap as chips!
Review:
Choice of dozens of hawker stalls selling a large range of delicious food at very low prices.
Great buzz here and beer prices are some of the lowest in Penang!

Author: smook tSanur, Indonesia
Title: Simple and pleasant
Review: We are staying in Georgetown for a few weeks and this has been our fourth time down here. We did not know about this place but stumbled on it when we were walking around town. This place is simple but the food is great. We tried a few different vendors and especially the won ton soup is great. We also had the rice with sweet and sour and also the fried rice at another vendor. You can have a meal for a few $ and it is all very tastyShow less

Author: lupari2Phuket, Thailand
Title: hot, noisy but great food
Review: We liked CF food just across the road from the Chew jetty. We enjoyed being able to choose from many styles of Asian food. The quality was good, value was good and the food plentiful. Beer was available from the drinks vendor. The tables were kept clean and we were regarded with interest as there were never many white people there. We like to eat where the locals eat - the food is usually great.Show less

Author: AnjelryRobina, Australia
Title: Fantastic local hawker centre near the Clan Jetties
Review: We stumbled on this little gem on our way back from exploring the Clan Jetties in George Town. It is located on the corner of Lebuh Victoria and Ghaut Lebuh Armenia around the corner from the 'Love Me Like Your Favorite Cat' street art. It is a bustling hawker centre frequented mostly by locals. There is a range of stalls offering local fare such as char koay teow, wanton mee and rice dishes as well as Chinese, Japanese and fresh seafood. We ate at both of the seafood stalls (this place was so good we went twice in four days) directly opposite the big drinks stall, and they were both fantastic. You just choose the seafood you want and let them know how you want it, grilled, fried etc, and what sauce, curry, chilli, ginger shallott, whatever you want. The seafood place to the right, which has no English on their picture board did fantastic fried fish, and also pipi like things in a spicy curry sauce. The drinks stall has great cold beer, and also has bottled wine if you ask for it. We paid 45RM for a bottle of (chilled) Cabernet Merlot which was half the price of what we'd paid the previous night at Bali Hai on Gurney Drive. If you are staying in George Town this place should not be missed.Show less

Author: Kris_thenomad07
Title: Food was a pleasant surprise
Review: The interiors weren’t as cool as some of the other chic cafes around but the sandwich was super delicious. So visit this place for the food not the ambience.

Author: chrisdoe2328
Title: Unexpected haiya... 😢😢😭
Review: Have been wanting to visit the place and try out their fried chicken waffle ever since we first found it! So we travel all the way from our town/ hometown to Penang just to try this cafe's waffle on last 2 weekends ago.But when we reach there, we didn't expect that people with "casual contact" witht the dark yellowish sign are NOT allow to dine-in there (only my bro got this), we were really surprised to hear that as they did not even state or mention this info in any their page and other cafes would still allow us to visit and have a dine-in despite thatSince there's no way that imma dine alone there without my bro, we just left and went to another famous cafe there ya I was obviously feeling very guilty cuz i was the one who suggested this place to my bro so haiya lah hahaSo to be honest, it was quite a dissapointing experience ya, as we drove all the way there and spent 30 minutes trying to get a parking spot just to experience this? Not cool man To the person in charge, please do post any new informations up in any of your social page so that all of the interested customers would know when to come or when not to come ya, cuz we would love to visit again though (thank god that your barista and waiter weren't rude and were polite enough to explain everything and apologize to us, or else anyone could've been mad about this, thumbs up for them ya)Show less

Author: M-TravelDiaryKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Great Brunch Venue
Review: Had a pre-birthday brunch here & found that the food qualities were good. Sandwiches & their signature dishes worth to be try out.Coffee was nice as well.The service staffs also great as they will recommended what are their best to try items if you unable to make the choices. They also will let you know out of stock items by the moment sat down to avoid dissappointment.Thumbs Up!!Show less

Author: WesmineKang
Title: Fantastic Wednesday Breakfast
Review: Fantastic Breakfast to kickstart my Wednesday | Hearty | Scrumptious | Lovely | Attentive Staff | Top Notch Customer Service

Author: Michelle H
Title: Yummy waffles
Review: Arrived to Penang today after an early morning flight and enjoyed a delicious breakfast. The food, coffees and service were excellent. I adored the sweet fruity waffle dish with peach, would definitely recommend to a friend. Lovely spot for a tasty casual brunch.

Author: dramaqueen2016Singapore, Singapore
Title: Terrible service
Review: Awful service, staff who appeared not to understand English. Messed up my order of the Really Big Breakfast. They ran out of pork sausage and gave the option to substitute for either extra bacon or hash browns. I chose hash browns but when the dish arrived it was SANS ANY bacon at all. They served my boyfriend’s omelette 30 mins before mine and by the time we could eat together his meal was ice cold. Food tasted average. Additional side order of mushrooms and spinach was pathetic in portion size. Show less

Author: chAUHSalt Lake City, Utah
Title: Really delicious brunch, excellent service
Review: We had the avocado toast with poached eggs, and a hash w scrambled eggs and sausage and potatoes, all were super delicious. The waiter was young and new but extremely considerate and accurate. the Chai latte float was to die for, will go back just for that.Show less

Author: Girasol2014
Title: Overrated
Review:
The place is overrated on all aspects. The downstairs is quite nice, but the upstairs doesn’t have any charm. 
The avocado smash was below average and the portion quite small. Spicy scrambled eggs were nice.
Don’t recommend it.

Author: 100melvint
Title: Awful Customer Service (Worst ever!)
Review: We went to Urban Daybreak around 2pm on 3/11 to get lunch. When we went in, the staffs stopped us and told us that the restaurant was full so we have to wait, around 30 minutes. ( His attitude wasn’t very nice ). We are willing to wait as we understand that it’s weekend, it’s normal that restaurant get crowded. Therefore we ask them that if it’s okay to sit at the empty tables (Yes! We spotted 2 empty tables despite the staff told us that the restaurant is full, and there were no reserve sign put on top of the table also) near the entrance point while waiting as we have 2 kids under 6 years old and staff also busy walking at the hallway serving customers, we wouldn’t want to block their way. But what we got in return is silence treatment. The waiters just staring blankly at us, not offering any form of assistance. In the end, we were standing outside of the restaurant waiting for our turn. No, we didn’t get upset nor giving the waiters bad treatment, instead it was the opposite. While waiting, one of my family member wanted to use the washroom located at the end of the hallway inside the restaurant, and found out that there were actually plenty of empty seats inside. Afterwards, we questioned them (politely, not raising voice) about why they told us that it was full house with no empty seats available. This time the reply we got is, in their own words: “ We don’t have enough staff, so we cannot serve you.... “. No apologies were given and they replied in a rude manner. That’s the last straw! We decided to leave the place. If you have a pleasant experience dining at the restaurant, I’m happy for you. Maybe it’s just our bad luck having to encounter these staffs on our first visit at 3/11/19 Sunday 2pm (in case the owner read this comment, he/she can find the culprit and solve this issue so that it will not happen to anyone else). Haven’t try the food yet, will I ever return to that place again? Hell no! Show less

Author: char-lfx
Title: Fab brunch!
Review: Two of us visited here for brunch but the menu was so good we had to order three meals. Everything was delicious, including the coffee. Very tasty meal and would definitely recommend!

Author: jackiemT4721ACAmsterdam, The Netherlands
Title: Just a coffeebar with mediocre food
Review: Went here for coffee in Georgetown. When given the menu tried the french toast and bread. According to European standards its not worth the visit or the money (11 euro’s for bread and coffee). If you crave western/european breakfast, just visit a local bakery buy some (sweet) bread and coffee and you are set. Places like this will just let you down.Show less

Author: Yrisabelle
Title: Thank you Medo
Review: We had a lovely breakfast this morning at Urban Daybreak. Good food and delicious juices. A special mention to the staff and in particular to the manager Medo who was very welcoming and ensured we had a great time. Keep the good customer experience going!

Author: Aussielies
Title: Great breakfast and coffee!!
Review: Make sure to call in for reservation as this place is always busy. The food is very tasty and the coffee is great. Best place to get your eggs breakkie fix!

Author: Danny Y
Title: Breakfast
Review: Try the “Really Big Breakfast”, taste awesome and suit for 2 persons portion. Egg , bacon , mushroom , spinach , salad , special meat and etc . You will love it .

Author: 900te
Title: Nice atmosphere & wide range of choices
Review: The Urban Daybreak cafe offers great food in a modern setting. They offer a wide selection of vegetarian and non-vegetarian food so it was easy for our group to find something we liked. The food tasted good and I enjoyed my cappuccino!

Author: AOddsJ
Title: Best breakfast
Review: Good menu, great variety, very sweet and accommodating staff! We waited for quite some time for our food, but it was worth it and by far the best breakfast place in Georgetown

Author: berkwoodBangkok, Thailand
Title: Great Western Brunch
Review: We went on Saturday morning for brunch and were seated immediately. The staff was kind, and our food came out very quickly. Great for Western breakfast and clean eats! They have lots of specialty drinks and food for a sweet tooth as well. My avocado toast had a fantastic beet puree that paired really well with the feta cheese and cherry tomatoes.Show less

Author: 347faithbMilton Keynes, United Kingdom
Title: Epic food
Review: Our hotel was not far from here so we stumbled I'm on the first day and had breakfast.We were not disappointed!Fresh, well cooked and presented food, great coffee and sweet staff. Your food and drink will come at different times so don't get bent out if shape about it. It's a small kitchen but totally recommended and worth the wait. Needless to say we've had three breakfasts there as it seems hard to beat.Show less

Author: Nicole C
Title: Slow Service
Review: Food is quite good but the service is rather slow. However the place is overall pretty relaxing and nice for hangouts.

Author: Lau6724George Town, Malaysia
Title: One of my fav breakfast spot in Penang
Review: - Fried chicken waffle *if you are visiting for the first time, we are always returning for this- burger was not a bad choice- however need to improve on the big breakfast set’s scrambled egg.+ friendly staffs+ air conditioned , cozy+ cleanNote: please be early during the weekend to avoid disappointment else you would have to wait for quite some time ~ 45mins - 1 hourShow less

Author: hilall2016
Title: Amazing coffee
Review: The breakfast is really nice and fresh, loved the super bowl. You should try their ‘best drink ever’ for an amazing cup of coffee!

Author: jesstourist
Title: Cafe food
Review:
Fried Chicken waffle is delicious! Good service too 

It is near other good cafes like China House and near the heritage area too

Author: vob_86
Title: Large portions and fast food
Review:
Nice selection of food which tasted good. Slow service and a couple of items were delivered incorrectly. Coffee is poor and expensive. Would recommend if you are craving western food but you
will get much cheaper options at other places.

Author: twiggsandtravelsMississauga, Canada
Title: Tasty & fresh, but a bit too bougie for us
Review: We visited for Boxing Day brunch as I'd read that they had vegan options. Honestly, there's no much in the way of plant based choices, aside from avocado on toast and a goodness bowl with ugh, saying that, the goodness bowl was delicious but pretty expensive, for Penang. Our two breakfasts and two coffees cost the same as our 3 course Christmas Day meals...so maybe stick to a more traditional street food breakfast if you're watching the pennies. The cafe itself is lovely and comfortable and the staff were great. Urban Daybreak is a nice little spot but it just wasn't really for us. Show less

Author: LeonCheah
Title: Good coffee/food and nice environment.
Review: Ordered big breakfast and the chicken waffles, enjoyed it, will definitely come back again. Kind staff too!

Author: BrookeSCWoonona, Australia
Title: Authentic Australian cafe experience
Review: As Australians travelling in Malaysia we really started to miss our traditional breakfasts and good coffee. This place actually does really decent coffee and the waffle I had was absolutely delicious. Definitely a good option if you're out for a more western breakfast, despite the fact it is a bit pricier than the other local options.Show less

Author: VivienneK84
Title: Decent breakfast, fantastic service
Review: Food was decent, ambience was not too bad. Worth a trip!Do try out the fried chicken waffles! Please heed that I am also a fussy eater with alot of requests but their service staff (shoutout to medo!) accommodated to everything I asked for with a smile!1. There was a chai latte float option but it was cold and I asked for hot (got it hot yay)2. Asked for french toast option but to replace the toast with waffles - we had bacon, caramelized bananas and waffles!! Thank you medo!!! Uploaded the only photo I have here.We were also encouraged to change seats to somewhere more spacious and more privacy which I truly appreciated because it can get quite busy around 12ish! Show less

Author: BigYungMiawTawau, Malaysia
Title: Amazing breakfast
Review: We had brekfast here. Fried chicken waffle was really great. The fried chickens had a nice aroma and spice to the bite. Our plate of French toast contains peanuts, drizzled with honey, banana slices were. caramelized and the bacon was as great as bacons get. One of the best French toast in town. And I've tasted a lot of French toasts. The Indian chai latte was really good S well. 5 stars. Show less

Author: 162joelsHobart, Australia
Title: Great breakfast and venue
Review: The food and coffee was great but the service was a bit slow. Although it was busy we did not get our food at the same time (4 people). I don't think that is asking too much. No apologies for in adequate service. I would still return to give them another try to redeem themselves as the food was that good.Show less

Author: Relax825544
Title: Good Food & Service!
Review: This place serve good brekkie & brunch. Highly recommended with good service. Always full house. Portion is a good size.

Author: salsabellaMalaysia
Title: Will come back!
Review: This is a lovely place to have breakfast or brunch with very limited tables. The upstairs area is only open during weekends. We were there on a mid-weekday and still had to wait for a table. Staff were courteous and always smiling. The best part of this restaurant is the 2 resident cats. I truly appreciate establishments who rescue animals and all their staff have a role in looking after both cats. They were very well behaved and did not bother the diners at all. If you’re driving, it’ll be street parking or an open air car park about 2 blocks away along Gat Lebuh Aceh.The only downside to our visit was the long wait for our food which happens to be a gripe for many. We were there as a couple and unfortunately our food did not arrive at the same time. It was about 25 minutes before our Fried Chicken Waffle was served and I waited a full 10 minutes before digging in. By then, the waffle was soggy due to the baked beans on it. The Really Big Breakfast we ordered only came when I was about to finish the Fried Chicken Waffle. With that experience & if you’re like me who enjoy starting a meal at the same time as your partner or friends, we will probably order anything that has sauce on it to be placed on the side.Show less

Author: Jeremy T
Title: Nice cafe/restaurant to hang out
Review: Great coffee or juices as the choice of the day with great all day breakfast!!! Environment is cozy.

Author: joellk2015
Title: Best Bowl!!!
Review:
Great place for a good breakfast! 
Lounge music 
Good Coffee 
Good wifi
Prices are normal
Also with a nut allergy it is no problem too get a Bowl without nuts! :D

Author: mariavU4069PT
Title: Nice place to relax after sightseeing
Review: Very near to street art area, decent environment and courteous staff..a good place to enjoy a break in the hot afternoon.

Author: Vince YGeorge Town, Malaysia
Title: Unfortunately, missout our order
Review: Seating: not many tables.Avoid weekend.Environment : Normal setupCoffee: Try Honey Latte - not badUnfortunately misplace our order and end up had to wait for more than 45 min.Staff are friendly.Show less

Author: SheeradeanKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Expect only the best from this place !
Review: There is only one word to sum up the entire experience which is excellent.I like the thrill of looking for this place(almost every good cafe in Penang is well hidden)The welcoming was so inviting,the crew is extremely attentive and pay attention to details.The coffee is great and the chicken waffle is a bomb.Too much for small and solo eater but I don’t regret every cent of it.A wonderful place that will keep drawing me back for my next visit.Finally found a place that can be equally inviting like the mugshot that I’ve been going multiple time each visit for many years. Show less

Author: Elizabeth A
Title: Good place for lunch
Review: I had the waffles at it’s best and it was good! I would definitely have it again. We had a great time and the service was excellent.

Author: Edison N
Title: Cool place to eat
Review: I came here to have team lunch with my colleagues. I ordered bacon carbonara and coffee. The food taste is good but the environment is quite warm when you have more then 5 persons on the table.

Author: Jessica FDenver, Colorado
Title: So good we came twice in 3 days
Review: Super cute little cafe with fantastic food and coffee! We came twice in three days and had excellent meals both times. We got the egg scramble and avocado smash the first time, and chicken and waffle and grilled cheese the second time. Great service, great atmosphere and great food!Show less

Author: Fannyllx
Title: Soo good
Review:
I really recommand this place in penang! 
There is so much choices on the menu, I wanted to take everything!  Everything is fresh and healthy. 
The services is perfect, the waitress was so nice and I really liked the cutlery !

Author: TimothyP1210
Title: Morning Breakfast is awesome!
Review:
The morning breakfast is superb especially the big breakfast! Love it! 

Would recommend to come here for the breakfast.

Author: BentleyB14
Title: Dreamy morning oasis
Review: We stumbled across this cute little cafe, tucked away, while wandering the streets of Georgetown for our morning coffee-- the menu has a lot to offer and it's obvious that someone who makes cusine their art designed it—the 'best drink ever' listed under handcrafted coffee really does live up to expectations - super chill staff and a nice atmosphere to be in.Show less

Author: louis899Vancouver, Canada
Title: Good Place for brunch
Review: We ordered the Big Breakfast and fried chicken placed on top of egg sunny side up with red beans.Both dishes were good though the Big Breakfast was a little heavy.Lattee was a little sweet but cappuccino was good without sugar.Prices reasonable and service excellent for which the 10% service charge was well deserved.Car park however is limited by the one way street.Used Waze ( a local favorite app) to drive there.If you find a car parking lot just park and walk, it is minutes away.Place is within Unesco heritage site and right in the old part of Georgetown.It is walking distance from the cruise ship terminal, about 15 minutes slow walk through the old city.Show less

Author: MichelleABWBern, Switzerland
Title: Waited for hours!!!!!
Review: The menue looks delicious but you will wait hours just to even get the menue card. Then you wait hours that a waiter will come that you can order & than you wait again hours untill the food is coming. I won‘t come again here!!It was also a pitty that you can‘t eat Acai Bowl on weekends. But this was nowhere written on the menue. So when you choose Acai Bowl on weekends the waiter will say you that you have to choose something else.So when you‘re hungry don‘t go here - you will wait at least an hour untill the food is coming.But the food is good.Show less

Author: AnnAnn428Penang Island, Malaysia
Title: No chance to taste the food...
Review: It was a public holiday, and I expected the cafe to be full. This is totally understandable, but the waiting time was rather enraging. First, there was a 10 minute wait for a table--which was quite tight for my family and I (there was 3 of us). After placing our order, the drinks took approximately 30 minutes to arrive and the food never came. We asked the waitress for the time we placed our order, it was 47 minutes ago. So, we waited a total of 57 minutes. We decided to leave, and the cafe was nice enough to tell us the coffee was on the house. Show less

Author: 677joanl
Title: Breakfast
Review: The vibes from the cafe were relaxed and comfortable. We ordered The Really Big Breakfast and When Hash meets Egg. The wait was long. I was expecting a tastier homemade sausage. The combination of hash and egg was flavourful.

Author: Lew T
Title: Disappointed
Review: I was having lunch with mine few Frens. and I found that one of the staff was not very happy to serve us especially at the counter.

Author: Deaglan C
Title: Breakfast
Review: Had a really good breakfast would highly recommend, the variety of coffee on offer is excellent and the juices are so tasty.

Author: Ronaldinho EPhuket, Thailand
Title: Amazing guacamole toast for vegans
Review: There were no vegan food options on the menu, so I asked if I could have the guacamole toast without the egg and cheese. With extra guacamole and spinach.It was so good!Two slices of brown seeded artisan toast, covered in tasty guacamole, the sweetest roasted cherry tomatoes I've ever tasted, with spinach leaves on the top and the bread was resting on beetroot cider puree (I'm not usually a massive fan of beetroot). The toast was a delicious mix of soft and crunchy.We also had delicious fresh fruit drinks.After our meal the restaurants cat Jimmy, who is a rescued stray, ran through the restaurant. We are cat lovers so we called him over and he quickly came to say hello. He soon got confident and jumped onto my partners lap and then mine. The staff stopped him from coming into the restaurant the first time he tried, but the second time we were the only people in the restaurant, we had finished eating and we were clearly happy to receive Jimmys playful affection. So don't worry that your meal will be invaded if you're not into cats (you should be by the way!! What's wrong with you!!!)Show less

Author: IkerR436
Title: Great espresso
Review: Very good espresso. Well prepared and a very reasonable quality. Happy to discover this place next to my accommodation!

Author: Hannah T
Title: The best breakfast!
Review: So many great breakfast and juice choices it was hard to choose! Had full English that was amazing and huge portions!! Such good value for money. Would recommend and we wanted to come back but they were shut :( lovely friendly staff and WiFi!

Author: GeorgetownPenang
Title: Late Breakfast
Review:
Nice to have an alternate to our local fare 

Service was pleasant and the place is cosy

If you are not a big eater then one portion should be able to feed two pax 

Try the fresh mix juices they are nice

Coffee selection is...More

Author: tungmayw
Title: Prob not bad if you like curry and raw eggs
Review:
Heard good things about this place both from locals and reviews so we gave it a try.

When we were there, they ran out of the big breakfast. So we got omelette and baked eggs with extra bacon and sausage. Omelette was okay. Bacon was...More

Author: Sharronly19
Title: BEST all-day-breakfast in PENANG
Review: the only restaurant/cafe that i go to in penang. love all the food here, amazing all-day-breakfast and wide range of juices and coffee! friendly staffs & good music.

Author: sarri06
Title: Ahh-mazing breakfast
Review: My boyfriend and I had breakfast here before we headed out sightseeing for the day and it exceeded our expectations. I had the croissant with fresh fruit and yogurt which was delicious, and he was really pleased with his burger. The orange juice he ordered...More

Author: Mikaela3003
Title: Burgers & Jimmy
Review:
Had dinner at Urban Daybreak tonight, was absolutely outstanding!

The staff greeted us as we came in and were so friendly! They even introduced us to their cat Jimmy.

Our meal came out very quickly, was perfectly portioned and was amazing. Definitely recommend them!

Author: charlesdH758GO
Title: The Perfect Stop for Breakfast
Review: If you are in Penang 7.30 - 9.30 am and hungry, options are limited but thankfully this is the perfect place to eat. We had a delightful and memorable breakfast at good value. Western artisanal bread and cooking with Asian twists, great for vegetarians but...More

Author: Nigel_Ming
Title: Cozy & Yummy
Review:
Staff’s friendly and helpful with recommending menus, foods awesome with unique flavours, cinnamon spiced hot chocolate is to die for ;)
overall this place deserves a shot 👍🏻

Author: MetalTiger
Title: Sweet little Coffee House/Restaurant with great juices
Review: Coffee shops pop up and close down sometimes too fast to get to them in time but this one deserves to succeed. Great breakfasts and original fresh juice combinations. Interesting menu, attentive and friendly staff. Check their times because they tend to open different hours...More

Author: MarinaTrocin
Title: Nice eggs but the granola should be swipped off the meny
Review: We came today for breakfast. The scrambled eggs were really good and the portion generous. For desert we ordered a granola with: honey greek yoghurt, baked apples, maple candied walnuts. We got musli with 2 spoons of some kind of sweetened yoghurt with raisins and...More

Author: 28faridacLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Good Breakfast (££)
Review: Chilled ambiance, cute decor, friendly staff, great location in the heart of George Town. Food was very good we had the avocado smash and the Bircher Muesli with caramelised banana apples and nuts - good size portions also. To be improved: The coffee was not good... I had a flat white which was too big and too milky (milk tasted very sour) :-/ Show less

Author: koshpatPenang, Malaysia
Title: Lower your expectation
Review: Food was nothing to shout about, service was normal. Ordered the Big Breakfast but was served without sausages because the it was still in the oven. Sausages was only served after I have finished the breakfast. Just my thought, if the sausages are not ready, don't serve yet. Food is not worth the price.Show less

Author: Tuea B
Title: Simply Great.
Review: Not just an usual café food. served good nutritious all day menu. Short visit to Penang, and been there twice for breakfast and dinner. Highly recommend.

Author: susuyoGeorge Town, Malaysia
Title: Great, special, yummy
Review: We came here twice. The food is good and never regrets. A lot of choice and of course the fresh blended juice was one of my favorite. Nice cozy atmosphere, suitable for a Sunday morning stress free breakfast! Strongly recommended. Well, a lil bit pricey but worth trying and it’s so so so filling. The big breakfast is big enough to feed two of us!!! Show less

Author: Seren79England, United Kingdom
Title: Amazing breakfast
Review: We stumbled upon this place while looking for somewhere to eat breakfast in George Town and it really hit the spot. The decor is trendy and inviting, and the menu is seriously tempting. I had some of the best scrambled eggs that I've ever had which came complete with bacon, tomatoes and mozzarella. There are so many yummy looking things to choose from that a return visit is definitely required!Show less

Author: RobertxRobotPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Love it!
Review: Heard so much about it and decided to come here 1 fine morning. The place was already packed but luckily there is just 1 more table left for us. We made our order and food came shortly after. The presentation is good. But the best is the scrambled eggs which was really really delicious. The warm water which we had, the glasses had a weird smell. Show less

Author: patrickw473
Title: Yummy Breakfast
Review: I had a very good breakfast @urban daybreak. The staff was very, very nice and the sweet waffles were incredibly amazing. Tasty, high quality food for a reasonable price. Good choice. Good Coffee. Highly recommanded!

Author: Mah FPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Undisputed Quality breakfast
Review: Do not be taken down by its moderate pricing. Its portion and quality is certainly worth what you pay. Love the bacon jam and pls take note that the big breakfast is honestly big enough to serve 2 person.The only downside is that they have less than 10 tables in the place so do visit early to avoid waiting.Upsize your cafe and you will get that 5th star, urban daybreak!Well done!Show less

Author: rayram83
Title: Mwoah
Review: if you care about your wallet, dont come in here. It is presented fantastic on your plate, but it doesnt taste how it looks.

Author: ChristineMML
Title: Good brunch
Review: Omelette that I ordered was very tasty. Had a taste of my friend's aglio olio and would also highly recommend that dish!

Author: no_idea_at_all
Title: Tasty 😋
Review: Great coffee and food! Every single dish is delicious 😋 and one of the best coffees in town. Definitely recommend.

Author: JoostG3Amsterdam, The Netherlands
Title: Best breakfast
Review: Tried several breakfast places during our stay, this one stood out. Two main reasons with the food as the most obvious one (had the perfect omelette and the continental croissant, both great) but key as well is their staff; extremely friendly and always serving with a smile.Officially serves breakfast from 8am, yet, accommodating as the staff is, we got in around 7:45 and were already eating before 8am.Show less

Author: pacero599London, United Kingdom
Title: The Breakfast Cafe in Georgetown!!!!
Review: Probably one of the best breakfast cafes in Georgetown and yes it opens at 07:30, thank god!!I was there twice last week for breakfast and for the first time!! Having read all the reviews on Tripadvisor, I was very impressed by the quality and presentation of the breakfast, coffee and the cosy environment.What makes it so special is the friendly and smiling staff looking up and greeting you as you walk pass by the kitchen and when you leave too!!A rare find in this UNESCO heritage city!! Show less

Author: meechtPortsmouth, United Kingdom
Title: Exquisite western brunch!
Review: The brunch options were quite extensive, and very intricately made. Food tasted really good, the interior also has lots of character to it. Staff was very helpful - it was raining on the day we went and he helped shelter us to the Grab car we had ordered.Show less

Author: Kate J
Title: Delicious!
Review: We stopped in here on a whim looking for breakfast while staying at the nearby B Street Hotel (would also recommend!). We really enjoyed our big breakfasts and had a nice time soaking in the cafe's ambience while sipping our strong coffees.

Author: MUMCOOKS
Title: Surprisingly awesome
Review: Breakfast is a must for my whole family. Normally we go for local food such as koay teow soup, chee cheong fun and so in. We heard so much about this place and decided to give it a try. My whole family love the food. We will go back again in 2 weeks time. Show less

Author: ChungK44
Title: Empty stomach in, Bloated tummy out
Review: One of the best breakfast I ever had. Went there with bunch of friends all the way from KL and we are all very satisfied with the foods. Must try their Ann's Big One, Such A Good Waffle and Moho Cubano Sandwich. One of friend was on vegetarian week, but nothing on the menu seem to be vegetarian but do ask the staff/chef, they can definitely help out with something special out of the menu.Show less

Author: Hanna M
Title: No vegan options
Review: I tried to eat at this restaurant because trip advisor said there were vegan options. There was nothing that could be veganized except toast. I had to leave and go elsewhere.

Author: CarolineG1083London, United Kingdom
Title: Delicious food and friendly staff, quite expensive
Review: The menu here is very good - lots of unique options for breakfast. In the end I went for the bircher which is a great healthy option with lots of fresh fruit. The coffee was also delicious. The staff are very friendly and took our order quickly. It is more expensive than breakfast in lots of other places but I would definitely go again - it is worth it!Show less

Author: AaronKin
Title: Breakfast should be this good!
Review: Lovely atmosphere, friendly faces, and I must say could be the best breakfast I had in Malaysia so far. Parking is a little bit difficult, but it was worth the hunt! Heard they are opening a branch soon on Campbell Street. Can't wait!

Author: Deb-n-Andy-92Auckland
Title: A++
Review: I cannot fault this little George Town gem, I am very fussy with my coffee and they listened carefully and got it perfect! I went there two days in a row for breakfast and both were delicious! I will definitely be back next time I'm in Penang as not only was the good great but such lovely, happy staff as well. Show less

Author: 137annyl
Title: Expensive but Good Food.
Review: Food are a little over price, but it was good. Staff are friendly but not professional. She forgot our order. Hummus was really good.

Author: AshA417
Title: BEST BREAKFAST IN TOWN
Review: It is one cafe that serves the best breakfast in town. A small cafe with unique indoor decoration. Love their homemade pork sausage and salted peanut butter. Not forgetting the bacon jam. Everything serve on the table tasted heaven. Highly recommended to those who think a good breakfast is compulsory in life. Enjoy life.Show less

Author: pippyboomboom
Title: Great yummy breakfast
Review:
Very enjoyable food,  preparation and plating.
A must try.
One of the best in this location, friendly staff.

Author: TheYumL
Title: Urban Daybreak
Review: I only ordered their Bircher muesli here so can't comment too much on the menu. What I had was delicious with fresh fruit cut on the spot and added to the muesli. I did watch in the open kitchen however how carefully the chefs put all of the meals together. I'd love to come back and try the rest of the menu.Show less

Author: GLS76Penang Island, Malaysia
Title: Good Food but.......
Review: Came here after my sister couldn't stop raving about how nice the pancakes was. 4 of us visited this cafe just after Christmas. 2 ordered the Prospector Hotcakes and the other 2 Anne's Big One. We waited for 20 minutes for the first plate to arrive. The remainder food took 5-7 minutes after the next. The Anne's Big One is really tasty and good. Pancakes was above average. The only downside was the waiting.I'll try this place again to see maybe the long wait was a one off issue.Bottom line, good food, small cozy cafe.Show less

Author: cheryloas
Title: Interesting variety
Review: The environment was cozy. Had Morning on the Roll and orange juice during my first visit. The "Such a Good Waffle" was delicious, flavourful and lives up to its name. "Scramble Trouble" was a bit bland.

Author: Jayne_1950Brisbane, Australia
Title: Brunch
Review: We met at this venue for brunch. Our friend usually finds a different coffee pleasure for us each week. We meet every Monday. We arrived at Urban Daybreak in time for morning coffee followed by lunch. The staff were accommodating and made us feel welcomed. We love the coffee it's delicious as was the food. The ablution was clean but there was no paper to dry my hands. Because I have arthritis I found that the chairs were most uncomfortable but I was offered a cushion and that helped. One wonders why most cafes and restaurants have such uncomfortable chairs. I would recommend this cafe. However be warned the chairs are rock hard. I suppose the music is what most like these days but I think it's just a bit too loud for my liking. Would I go there again? Yes in a heartbeat. It was enjoyable. Thank you. Show less

Author: vijay888Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Below expectation
Review: Waited for an hour for my spaghetti and was told they missed out my order. Food was normal, coffee was normal. Food and drinks are priceyShow less

Author: scubachuck89
Title: Best breakfast in Penang!
Review: In a town that is famous for its local food, this western breakfast is hard to beat. Great value with the friendly service, nice new and cozy cafe atmosphere, delicious breakfast and homemade flare.

Author: eugeneltcPGGeorge Town, Malaysia
Title: Grilled Cheese 😍😍
Review: We decided to hop in for late lunch but the place is packed (they only have 7 tables though). As the (open) kitchen is by the entrance, you'll be greeted by the smells.We tried the grilled cheese and pulled chicken bagel which are great. Waiting time about 15-20 minutes. Can't tell about the drinks as we settled for warm water.Great place if you are walking around Georgetown as parking are scarce especially on work days or holiday. Take note that they are close on Tuesday and open until 3pm only.Show less

Author: 224ellens
Title: Best place for breakfast and lunch
Review:
We had breakfast twice a this place and we would really recommend to go here. We had the scrumble egg, poached egg, healthy bircher and toast w baconjam (which is delicious!!) and salted peanutbutter.
All dishes looked very nice and the taste was even better!!

Author: Eliska03Prague, Czech Republic
Title: Delicious breakfast
Review: Daybreak serves the best omelette! We have also enjoyed home made juices and warm waffles with ice cream. The places is located in one of the small streets of Georgetown, not that easy to find, so I would suggest to follow a map. Definitely a recommend for breakfast or even lunch - they close at 3pm.Show less

Author: wooster4
Title: Best breakfasts
Review: My family stayed in Georgetown for 5 days, trying out different cafes every morning for breakfast - Urban Daybreak was the best; we returned here on our final day to get one more hit. Wonderful coffee, amazing food which both adults and children loved.

Author: Y3580JLnickbNottingham, United Kingdom
Title: Great place to break your fast.
Review: I stumbled across Urban Daybreak one morning while walking the streets of Georgetown. I'd built up a pretty strong hunger and was craving a good sandwich. I settled for the Moho Cubano Sandwich and a long black coffee. They both exceeded my expectations. The menu is a good mix of healthy and not so healthy delicious brunch items. Good enough to tempt me back a few days later where I was equally satisfied with my food. There's a great atmosphere in this place and the staff are very welcoming and attentive. Show less

Author: MumbakesPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Orgasmically Delicious - highly recommended
Review: Found the best place for breakfast/brunch on the planet !! Their "Brioche French Toast" was super delicious and their handmade pork sausage was top notch too. Great quality food with perfect portion. Their coffee and fruit juices are just right for the city that loves to drink it !!Show less

Author: PaulineMah68Penang Island, Malaysia
Title: Healthy Breakfast
Review: An excellent place for breakfast and brunch. They have varieties of healthy choice of breakfast. My Favourite is "Such A Good Waffle". It comes with fried egg, arugula gammon ham, bbq baked beans, salted egg yoke hollandaise. It's so tasty. Great coffee too. It's a place that you shouldn't miss.Show less

Author: AnimeIsMyLife
Title: BEST FOOD EVER THAT YOU WILL CRY FOR IT!!!������
Review: This place serves the best meal! Their food doesn't contain MSG. Price is reasonable. Food serving value for money. Their meals always brighten up my day. Food lovers, coffee lover and other lovers, this is your ticket to the best meals of your life! The picture included is my favourite meal in Urban DayBreak.Show less

Author: MMAH10Penang Island, Malaysia
Title: Healthy Hearty Meal.
Review: Finally the place for great value breakfast in Georgetown, Penang. Great choices of breakfast & lunch menus. Pure fresh vegetable & fresh fruits juice sugar free. Nice cosy place with friendly service. Our favourites breakfast menu, "Morning on the Roll", "Brioche French Toast" & "Such a good Waffle". Others menu as interesting and great. Coffee a must for coffee lovers.Show less

Author: Sue A
Title: Lunch
Review: Great service, excellent  food. Newly opened, so eager to please. Would definitely eat here again. Good prices.

Author: mrandmrsbeetleCanberra, Australia
Title: Don't think about coming here - just do it!
Review: Food = deliciousService = exceptionalJen and Hong = AmazingWe went for dinner early on a Saturday night where it was a bit quieter and were lucky enough to get talking to the wonderful owners. We will 100% be back here with our family.The stall is a little tricky to find inside the Jetty Food Court but once you see the sign it will all make sense. We tried the ribs, pulled pork and brisket. The accompanying sides are just delicious too. Highly recommendedShow less

Author: trevorsashibharathan
Title: Very scrumptious pulled pork
Review:
Very scrumptious pulled pork and BBW chicken....good portion for 2....comes with a mini muffins as well.....satisfied overall
A must checkout stall in The Jetty Food court

Author: Timothy CSingapore, Singapore
Title: Awesome Texas BBQ
Review: Ordered delivery from Smokepapa for my mother’s birthday. Did not disappoint. In addition to the stellar customer service, I got quality food at an affordable price tag. Ordered the BBQ ribs and pulled pork sets and both were deliciously finger-lickin' good. It’s a double thumbs up from my family.Show less

Author: Rockie S
Title: Excellent BBQ
Review: It's not easy to find great pork BBQ in Malaysia so imagine my delight when we found this place online. Friendly owners and we enjoyed the dishes. We ordered Pulled Pork set and Pork Ribs set. The boss had informed us that people who like their meat less sweet will prefer the pulled pork and he was right. Everything was really tasty, even the mashed potato was out of this world. Portion was good and we'll definitely be back!Show less

Author: B1042UEjennifert
Title: Very delicious
Review: On our way back from sightseeing we came across the jetty foodcourt. Nice place with a lot of different booths to eat. We were very happy to be stopped at SmokePapa bbq. Friendly staff and very good food. Keep on going

Author: O6240UYmicheleb
Title: Don’t pass this gem up! Jen
Review: Don’t pass this gem up! Jen and her husband do an AMAZING smoked bbq pulled pork, ribs and chicken. All the dudes are delicious as well. We are from the USA and this is by far the best bbq I’ve had. The sweetest people ❤️❤️❤️❤️

Author: DnarayAberdeen, United Kingdom
Title: Easy to miss as different title above stand
Review: We walked past it twice! But glad we took the effort to keep looking and in the end while ordering asked and then he pointed out the small sign with this name. He was super friendly and explained everything and the food was delicious and a nice change during our 2 week trip. All the meat was excellent as was mash - only item I wasn't keen on was cornbread.Show less

Author: MeLiSsA4evaPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Delicious and juicy meat!
Review: The meat was extremely tender and juicy. The buttery flavour of the shredded pork meat with the bbq sauce were extremely delicious. Not to forget the mashed potato was superb. The shop owners was incredibly friendly and even spend time to explain the dish for us.Definitely worth going second round for this!!Show less

Author: jonathanv398Penang Island, Malaysia
Title: Texas style BBQ in Penang
Review: Moved to Penang from Texas 4 years ago and was very excited when this place opened. Food is really good with the ribs being our family favorite. I love the mashed potatoes and my daughter goes for the pulled pork. It’s the only Texas style BBQ in Penang!Show less

Author: 193sandymWestern Australia, Australia
Title: Christmas Dinner 🎅🎅
Review: Hubby and I went here for dinner tonight, even though it was Christmas, he was craving for American BBQ, we were not disappointed, it was absolutely delicious, we has 2 different sorts of set meals made up of, slow cooked BBQ Pulled Pork, Pork Ribs, mash Potato, Rice, Coleslaw, a type of Corn Bread and a couple of small dinner Rolls, along with a few Sauces, hubby also got a small plate of Beef Brisket, the meat was so tender, definitely recommend this watery Show less

Author: Mas0512Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
Title: Delicious BBQ in the heart of Penang
Review: We had 5 days to travel in Malaysia, including Kuala Lumpur and Penang and unexpectedly saw the Smokepapa BBQ in Jetty food court. First impression was that the owners were friendly and welcomed us when we considered at store. They advised us the signature of store, Smoked BBQ pork ribs and Grilled chicken as well as homemade sauce. We tried to order after days with curry and Malaysian food. The ribs were soft and tasty, the homemade sauces were different from others i had tried before. There were a little spicy and sweet. We felt happy and enjoyable with the quality and service over the reasonable price and obviously we would be back if we were back to Penang. Thanks Smokepapa BBQ for welcoming us and serving delicious food and great serviceShow less

Author: vietanhvuongHo Chi Minh City, Vietnam
Title: Best smoked BBQ pork and chicken in Penang!
Review: I was craving for something different than the usual Malaysian food. But i needed something cooked with more soul than the fast food joints or restaurants in the malls.Smokepapa didn’t disappoint. I had the Grilled BBQ Chicken as well as the bestselling Smoked BBQ Pork Ribs. Both were delectable and succulent and came with a delicious thickly cut corn bread. The bread’s texture was perfect.I loved their BBQ sauces. There was a sweet and a spicy variant. Both were a wonderful accompaniment to the ribs. Made in house and both well-seasoned.The waiters and owner were very attentive and warm. Eating there feels like eating at a friends’ home.I loved my first time here and i would be back. The prices were very reasonable for the quality and the amount you get. I recommend it to everyone.Thanks for a great meal, Smokepapa :DShow less

Author: ilseo714Nusa Lembongan, Indonesia
Title: Most AMAZING pork!! 🤩
Review: This shop at the Jeti food court is truly fantastic!! We had the pulled pork burger and it was huge and juicy! We also saw them preparing the rib meal and it smelled and looked sooooo good! The owners are super cool and friendly and gave us advice about the best places to visit in penang. They shared also a HUGE list of to do things in Vietnam as the lady is from Vietnam! If you are a meat lover please do yourself a favor Show less

Author: cuongdng
Title: Best food
Review:
The best food in George Town,Penang
Here you can enjoy real barbecue, come and will come back soon!!!

Author: Stay399004
Title: Yum yum yum!
Review:
We chose Smoke Papa BBQ as it was a welcome change to find some pork for lunch in Penang.

It was very tasty! We had the A Combo - ribs and pulled pork. All cooked from fresh every day. The home made sauces were fabulous.

Author: hailthygoddess
Title: Succulent BBQ
Review: Ordered a BBQ ribs and pulled pork combo for 2. Portion is generous. BBQ ribs is super tender and falls off the bone; the pulled pork is so soft and well marinated. If you love Kenny Rogers cornbread, they made it even better! Everything is homemade with TLC ❤️Show less

Author: baileshOttawa, Canada
Title: Delicious BBQ Pork and Sides
Review: Wow, stumbled in here for a quick bite and left so full after a delicious meal of pulled pork and ribs with sides of coleslaw, potatoes, rice and more. The flavour was unique and amazing. I asked about the spicy bbq sauce and learned it is made over many hours with slow roasted veggies. You could taste the freshness. Super nice family too.Show less

Author: Mr_rossduncanAdelaide, Australia
Title: Exellent food court experience
Review: The young team who run the Smokepapa BBQ stall at the Jetty Food Court in downtown George Town are doing an excellent job.Not just excellent service, but excellent food as well.Specializing in tasty and unique smoked goods it makes a lovely change from the normal food court fare.Generous portions, great quality and tasty food, there's nothing like it in Penang.Do yourself a favour and get down to The Jetty Food Court for a tasty treat next time you visit the island.Show less

Author: SajHong
Title: Best BBQ Ribs ever
Review: This humble stall gave me the best pork ribs dish experience ever. Even the side dish are amazing. Combine that with the superb and friendly customer service, this is the go to place for pork ribs and not forgetting their chicken BBQ and Pull Pork.

Author: jmr507
Title: Lovely food, lovely family!
Review: Great experience this evening with great food and good service.  This young family deserve to do well.  Thoroughly enjoyable!!

Author: Thomas A
Title: Best BBQ in Penang
Review:
Delicious BBQ Ribs, pulled pork and chicken. Everything just falls of the bones which is a great sign when eating BBQ. The sides such as butter rice, coleslaw and mashed potatoes are also really good. 
Don’t miss this spot if you’re coming to Georgetown.

Author: AntonG1281
Title: Awesome
Review: Awesome place which sells absolutely scrumptious pork ribs. Been there two times already and will go again the next time I visit Penang!

Author: DarrenG49Canton of Geneva, Switzerland
Title: Quality Restaurant Meal at Hawker Store Price
Review: Delicious, tasty smokey BBQ chicken, pork ribs and pulled pork. You can taste the smokiness and the sauces add more flavour. The owners are well trained 5 star restaurant chefs and have opened their own store in this hawker centre. Try the All 3 Meats Platter Combo. Highly recommended.Show less

Author: ndibotravels
Title: Delicious tender food with super friendly staff(owners)
Review: Great couple who are very nice even when we were asking directions to another restaurant. We ended up returning for dinner. Soft and tender ribs and chicken with the softest buttery mash and coleslaw.

Author: Wesley1109
Title: Impressive food with reasonable price.
Review: Must try their signature pork ribs, it tastes so so tender and juicy. Impressive found such a very good food in the street.

Author: reidchia
Title: Pulled Pork & BBQ Pork Ribs
Review: This is one of the tasty pork dish I have ever tried before. The pork is soft and juicy. Highly recommended to bring friends and family to try it.

Author: lightTCY
Title: The food here is very nice
Review: Good aroma very tender until it can scoop with a spoon 🤤 I will recommend any of my friends and family to come here to eat 👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻

Author: MisterL121
Title: Excellent hainanese style cuisine - freshly cooked
Review: Although it has a small menu, the food is of a very high quality Hainanese style and is freshly cooked. Hainanese Chicken chop was good. On specials there was 'beef rendang' and 'Mutton Rendang'. Both delicious. Their version of a 'Spring Roll' is awesome! Service was excellent - dishes served at same time - YES!!!!!!! Price - excellent value. Locals use this place alot. Repeated use of this restaurant it was that good.Show less

Author: Ginnie KPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Special Hainan Cuisine
Review: Served delicious Hainan food in a cozy and relaxing restaurant. Don’t miss out the following favourites : Picture 1. “Four Season” nicely presentedPicture 2. Big pie stuffing with chicken and vegetable. Picture 3. Baked cheese crab. We always like the food here and highly recommended to all food lovers.Show less

Author: allspice502016New Westminster, Canada
Title: A hidden gem for Hainanese cuisine
Review: The restaurant is located beside the historic Yeng Keng Boutique Hotel on Chulia Street. The decor is of the 1930s with posh, plush cosy banquette and normal table seating. This restaurant serves authentic Hainanese-style cuisine. Throughout my travels in Malaysia & Singapore I haven’t been able to find Char Hor Fun of this quality. A twist on the Hainanese chicken - flaky puff pastry on the outside enclosing steaming hot mushroom and chicken within. Quite unique and suitable for Western palates. A good range of dishes offered and pricing is reasonable.Show less

Author: Singapore0426Singapore, Singapore
Title: Our 2nd visit
Review: We ate here in January and enjoyed the food. That trip we ate the Ar Or (braised duck with yam), the Assam fish and beef rendang. All very enjoyable. This time we decided to order the chicken chops. My husband ate the grilled chicken chop with black pepper sauce. A very safe choice and very much to our expectation. I ordered the Hainanese chicken chop as there had been good reviews on it. Actually, I have never eaten a Hainanese chicken chop and did not know what to expect. It was a chicken chop dipped in batter and fried and drizzled with a in-house sauce. It was nice but I found the sauce abit bland. The potato wedges which came with it were very well fried n fragrant. For dessert we had the sago with gula Melaka. It came with a generous portion of sago and a small portion of coconut milk. We would have liked it to be less sago and more coconut milk. Nevertheless with the gula Melaka, it was nice. We also ordered the banana fritters which came with a generous portion of vanilla ice cream and chocolate sauce. The local bananas had a slight sourness to it - very well fried, very nice.Show less

Author: mervdunia
Title: Great food and days of old atmosphere
Review: It is hard to top the offerings of the street stalls at time, but Yeng Keng has some excellent local fare.

Author: Ted GMelbourne, Australia
Title: Nice Rendang and a little quirky
Review: We love Chulia Street and decided to visit Yeng Keng for an early dinner. The front door appeared to be locked even though I could see people inside. I ended up ringing the restaurant from the front door, looking at the waiter talking to me! Once inside the special of the day was very good, Beef Rendang. The service was a little slow and uncoordinated bit overall a very pleasant and good value meal. Show less

Author: adandangBrisbane, Australia
Title: Fantastic food
Review: We called in here looking for traditional Malay food. Apparently Malaysian food is better for breakfast or lunch and as this place advertise as serving traditional Hianese food we thought it would be near enough what we were looking for. We asked the waiter to bring us a selection of recommended dishes and we were treated to a feast of fabulousness. This was one of the best meals we’ve had in Georgetown so far. Service and price were superb to. Show less

Author: SeokdoespilatesSGPSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good Hainanese/local food with a charming old-world ambience
Review: This was probably my favourite dining experience in Penang. Reservations are suggested as it got packed at dinner. I was blown away by the charming ambiance of the place, with its high ceilings, antique looking accessories and a French-brasserie meets Paranakan heritage setting. I wanted to dress up to eat here, though it probably isn't necessary!My family of 2 adults, 1 teen and 1 child came for the Hainanese chicken chop and it did not disappoint. The Duck with Yam had a thick creamy yammy gravy (delish!) though the duck was on the tough side. Jiu Hu Char was so tasty as was the Hailam Mee. My son declared the Nutmeg Cooler the best drink ever. The only thing that surprisingly did not live up to the cooking was the rice they serve, which was hard and not of the best quality. Regrettably we had no more room to try the other dishes, but this Cafe is on my must-eat list for my next trip. HIGHLY RECOMMENDED.Show less

Author: pedrosz1
Title: Nice place
Review:
The service is very good.
The food is very good I liked the wraps, the wrap lettuce and rhe prawns noodle.
The prices were ver good.

Author: Evelyn K
Title: 5** Customer Service
Review: Handle customer service feedback well, they do listen and improve.  This is what 5** customer rating means to me fast in responding and able to receive feedback for improvement.  Food is nice and also the quality.

Author: Joey L
Title: Lunch on specialty food
Review: Disappointed with service upon arrival. Refused me for pax of two where bar and back has a big table. Anyhow a Chinese staff came assisted us and we sat for meal. Chicken rice is a total failure. Chicken Chop was okay. Coffee is excellent.

Author: wonghuaying
Title: A bit over-rated
Review: A footage on FB initiates our interest to try out the food at Yeng Keng Cafe. Reservation was made effortlessly. Parking was a disappointment due to limitations. The restaurant was too busy as there was a group of people having dinner prior to a wedding. We can see that the staffs were too busy serving this group and number of staffs is greatly a scarce. Food was just alright and a bit below our expectations. Chicken pie was not that great though early reservation is required. The chicken was obviously overcooked and doesn't taste that great and it's a big disappointment with the price you charge. The rest of our orders are fine except for the nutmeg drink is a disaster. I was expecting nutmeg juice when I was ascertain that it will be juice. But turned out to be nutmeg syrup. My friend was joking that the food down the street taste much better and cheaper.....Show less

Author: ooi h
Title: Good place
Review: Great place to enjoy meal with friends.. classic ancient enviroment. Food is good. Must try the "hainan chicken rice"...the dessert "alaska bom" is fun to eat too..

Author: pupixie
Title: Back To Old Time Dinning
Review: Antique... Nyonya style! A cafe that full of historical smell. I love the beverage corner, it is antique yet looks modern. It was definitely a good place to go with friends or alone to enjoy own sweet time. Menu is simple Asian and Nyonya food but enough to make you drooling, especially the Hainanese Chicken Chop.Show less

Author: VivianW516
Title: Hainan Chicken Rice
Review: the chicken rice is nice and the chilli is superb. If u r fan of mushroom, mushroom soup is a must try item....

Author: AzurianWorthing, United Kingdom
Title: Chicken Rendang!!
Review: We're suckers for this dish. We make it at home and if it's on the menu we've got to have it! It was an all round enjoyable experience here. The cafe itself has comfortable seating , and the walls are adorned with pictures of old Penang. The service was pretty good, and with a portion of banana fritters and a couple of coffees the bill was around 100RM. Credit cards are accepted.Show less

Author: NLinTKOPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Good chicken-rice for lunch
Review: My wife and I visited this Cafe to try out their "signature chicken rice" and the recommended spring roll. We were not disappointed: it was very tasty. However, I think that the chicken rice would not have been sufficient for me. Adding the spring roll avoided me getting hungry soon after.The interior, although rather new, look a bit European retro-style to me. The menu is rather extensive, offering a wide variety of dishes.I enjoyed it and think that I will return in the future.Show less

Author: redzuanadam
Title: Good cup of Hainan Coffee
Review: It was a great morning to start with a good cup of Hainan Coffee at Yeng Keng Cafe. Good and quiet morning for a good start of the day.

Author: Jacelyn L
Title: Totally worth the visit and the calories
Review: Delicious food in a charming quaint cafe! The food is really tasty. Reasonable price, good customer service from the cheerful staff, classy furnitures and good ambience. It really brings back the 1930s cafe experience. My spouse and I ate the curry chicken, hainanese chicken chop, chicken pie and sago gula melaka. Thanks for the pleasant experience, please keep up the good work! Show less

Author: Cheeps21Singapore, Singapore
Title: Sumptuous meal, great service & cosy ambience
Review: We had the marcaroni pie, fish and chips and green mango salad and we can taste the quality in the ingredient used. A great oasis in the midst of the Georgetown.We went on a weekday evening and only 2 of the 10 tables were occupied. Show less

Author: Strider3000Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: A Pleasant Surprise @ Yeng Keng Cafe
Review: We ran into this Hainanese Nyonya Cafe in a hurry, just because it was the first we saw in rain, not knowing a thing about this cafe. Only found out their dishes are superb, ambience is nice with live music, staff are friendly. The owner and chef even sit and chit chat with a retuning couple. A very pleasant dinner that we enjoyed very much. Love the Kerabu Mango (mango salad), a sour and spicy appetiser that really appetising with fresh mango. Spring roll is crunchy. We ate Ar Or (Hainanese-style braised duck with yam) and Gulai Tumis Ngo Wa Hoo (Threadfin cooked in tamarind flavoured curry), and impressed, impressed!! Yummy yummy!! The food price is reasonable for the quality food they serve, and the nice ambience guest enjoy. Average bill is approx. RM28/ pax, worth every cent we pay They also have a unique nyonya-styled hotel (TripAdvisor winner of travellers' choice) that either sold out or left only one room when I casually check availability for the next 3 months. Book early if you want to have a different experience of hotel stay. Note: the live music is on Fridays and Saturdays. Show less

Author: safwangimmy
Title: Affordable cuisine
Review: Situated along Chulia Street...despite of being the expensive hotel...walk towards to the left and enter.It is a must to order from the mpuenu..where delicious Indian Fried Nolodles...Springrolls..Curried dishes...to wet your hungry stomachs..to your satisfaction.After dinner...walk around where bars or pubs..watering holes drinking beers with friends...maybe later for hawker stalls for supper...or takeaways.Show less

Author: Chris HLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Comfortable period setting
Review: I chose to eat at the Yeng Keng restaurant hotel 3 times during my stay across the road at Chulia Mansion. I was eager for Chinese food and a comfortable setting.I was immediately drawn to the early 20th century feel of the place and was then impressed when the head chef came out to speak to each table. He seemed a wonderfully wise old Chinese man with stories behind his smiling eyes.The menu had options without being a bible of epic choice. There is Asian food and also European fare to cover culinary desires. You could also spend big or moderate, depending on how greedy or luxurious you felt. I spent 50 Ringgit (June 2017 = 11.66USD, £9.17, 15.40AUD, €10.42) and got:Chinese pot of teaHoney Passion fruit drinkHainese chicken rice mealBanana frittersVery satisfied!I was not hassled by waiting staff and left alone on WiFi to check on digital requirements and then read my book (a real one!), sat on lovely crimson red soft booth like seats.For when it is not raining, there is a lovely courtyard out front with running water features and seating for meals or drinks.One evening, they stayed open for me to serve me after I had asked if I could come back after a massage down the road. This was beyond expectation, although I was surprised that they were closing at 9pm on a Thursday evening. On that night, I had a pretty good chicken and chips meal, to balance all the Asian food I had been eating.Show less

Author: MarkS960Singapore, Singapore
Title: Yeng Keng Restaurant
Review: It is lovely restaurant in a wonderful surrounding. The food is great serving western and dishes. The food is prepared by a local Hainanese chef. During our visit ordered a typical English dinner with chicken pie and dinner served carrot, potatoes, cauliflowers etc. The spring roll was excellent.Show less

Author: BaronclogCanberra, Australia
Title: Any time of day
Review: Breakfast, lunch and dinner, all good. Malaysia really is a foodie destination and this spot ticks all the boxes. Really interesting choices at breakfast and snacks and meals all day long. Just one of the many great eateries in Chulia Street. Not Street level food and not top shelf just a very happy medium at the Yeng Keng cafe.Show less

Author: marbelous2017Singapore, Singapore
Title: Delicious food in a very photogenic and comfortable setting
Review: The hainanese chicken chop, which was recommended to me by the waiter was absolutely delicious. The chicken was thick and crispy and the gravy drizzled on top of it was clear but full of flavour. It's amazing how something so simple can be so delicious at the same time. I've had similar ones back in Singapore but this is one dish that I will order again.Show less

Author: K7613VAgloriab
Title: Great value - great dinner
Review: Went there for dinner because it looked nice from outside and was happy to find reasonably priced menu. We ordered the duck dish along with some vegetables and they were delicious and generous in size.Small restaurant where the front of house and kitchen staff have time to give you good service and food. One of the nicest meals we had in Panang.Show less

Author: Yvonne M
Title: Excellent food
Review: This popular cafe and restaurant has a lovely atmosphere, whether just for a drink or a full meal.  We particularly recommend the chicken fried rice, the house Nonya speciality of poached chicken in broth served with fried rice and various sauces.  Breakfasts also very good.

Author: Susangermany
Title: Beautiful place....
Review:
the service is friendly and fast!
Spring Rolls are very tasty! Mango Salad is a must!! Fish Curry Nyonya style.
Prawn Fritters are delicious!
After dinner you can make a walk trough the Chulia Street and have a drink in one of the bars!

Author: SusanGerry
Title: Our breakfast is always a very pleasant experience and always great service
Review: The fresh cooked omelette is recommended and a great range of local dishes to try. Fresh fruit to finish off with coffee, great.

Author: piotrekj81Luang Prabang, Laos
Title: Delicious lunch. Top-notch service !
Review: We tried local menu in this restaurant. I'm vegetarian so i could enjoy veggies in gravy sauce and pecambur salad. My partner tried theirs special chicken. At the end we ate local dessert - pearls with coconut cream and palm sugar. Everything was fresh and delicious. Top-notch service and great old style design of this place just calling you to go back there. We had lunch with Mr Poh -manager- who was very talkative person and told us many stories about the Island itself and heritage hotel which is jusy next to restaurant. Highly recommend during yoir stay in Georgetown.Show less

Author: JohnYa5Arcata. CA.
Title: A great place to eat in Georgetown.
Review: They know a lot about flavors and making food taste good. I had their club sandwich. It was excellent. I came back and had a chicken salad. It was also better than what I was getting used to traveling. My wife had a chicken and rice dish she enjoyed.Show less

Author: gryphonmonsterSingapore, Singapore
Title: A nice walk from the cruise port
Review: I was hosting a party of about 7 family members as we arrived at penang as part of our cruise itinerary. I did not want to bring to anywhere i havent tried before, therefore decided that yeng keng was the best option given that it is about 20 minutes walk from the terminal. The walk I have to say wasn't the best and I would not suggest for people with strollers or elderly, as the walkways require a bit of meandering. We ordered quite a number of dishes which included hainanese chicken chop, mixed vegetable, char hor fun, stir fried beef, spring rolls, some turnip dish which all turned out to be pretty tasty. The staff were also quite friendly and easy to hold a conversation with. I couldn't get a uber or grab car from that location and had to book through the hotel for 15Rm back to the terminal. If you're on a cruise and looking for nice comfortable place in penang for dinner, yeng keng maybe a good choice.Show less

Author: 774stevedHendersonville, North Carolina
Title: Ok
Review: We decided to try an indoor air conditioned restaurant at the "sister" hotel of the one we were staying at. The restaurant is known for its Hainanese cuisine and also serves local and Western dishes. First, the AC does work, the restaurant was comfortable and the service was prompt. The Hainan noodles were fine as were the Asam prawns. The vegetable dish with shredded turnip and dried salted cuttlefish was bland and disappointing. We did enjoy a good sized Caesar Salad which we split. No big complaints, but with all the great food choices in Penang, this restaurant would not be on our must visit again list. Show less

Author: aladdin_mp
Title: Gracious and Relaxing: Penang and Western Food: all tasty
Review: Reasonable prices. Large breakfast with many many choices and beverages; spacious table arrangements to allow conversation and enjoyment without rushing. Staff very courteous.

Author: JoAuntySingapore, Singapore
Title: Chanced upon an interesting boutique hotel and cafe
Review: Extensive menu including local and western food. Good for kids as restaurant is clean and air conditioned. Nice ambience, quiet, and we were the only family there. However, many dishes required advanced ordering, 24 hours, eg the Hainan Chicken Rice. Some dishes were really good eg spring roll. Had a nice tour of the boutique hotel next to it, too. May come back to stay here.Show less

Author: epicwanderingsPortland, Oregon
Title: Friendly staff, nice interior
Review: My mother and I had lunch at Yeng Keng last week, after looking around for a place to eat near our hotel. I ordered grilled fish but was brought the fried fish instead. I didn't send it back and it tasted OK but wasn't a memorable meal. The batter was very eggy but the potatoes served in the side were a nice accompaniment. We also got stuffed crab which was the highlight of the meal. The interior is beautiful ( a cross between an upscale diner and Raffles) and the staff were friendly.Show less

Author: Adrian_on_TAPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Delightful 8-course Hainanese feast
Review: We started off the birthday celebration dinner with the Fook Lok Shou platter. The generous portions of kerabu jellyfish, kung po prawns, egg fu yong and smoked duck were just delightful. This was followed by a light and delicate pumpkin soup with fried mantou on the side. Unlike the conventional thick and creamy version, this soup was such a refreshing treat. Next was the wintermelon with dried oysters and mushrooms, encircled with garden green broccoli. This dish was visually beautiful and had wonderful flavours that made my taste buds dance with joy. The Hainanese chicken was served next with pickled ginger. The meat was soft and tender. Such a simple yet elegant dish prepared with such skill. The 70-year plus chef made an appearance and we were only too happy to congratulate and thank him for preparing this fantastic dinner.Jiu hu char with pie tee cups had distinct Hainanese flavours.
