Author: JanaK123Penang Island, Malaysia
Title: Great Burgers
Review: Our family went here and really enjoyed the gourmet burgers. We arrived a few minutes before 6pm and the kitchen didn't open until 6 so we did not get our food until after 6:30. The food was really good though, and we enjoyed the atmosphere. Also, it was nice that there was lots of seating as many of the little cafes are limited in that area.Show less

Author: heyitsemilyKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Food not bad
Review: The coffee is a bit small in size, the desserts & food itself s pretty decent and delicious. However the environment & the seating itself is very uncomfortable, maybe they are trying to have a layback vintage style but it seems more like low on budget and abandon house style, as if they are lazy to furnish a little bit and use nicer tables and stools. Show less

Author: khaosk9Penang Island, Malaysia
Title: Great Burger, forget the rest.
Review: Atmosphere - Open space with tree indoors, the main attractive point of this place, giving people a nostalgia feelings, furnitures are made of steel and woods, felt like eating in 70's buildings. The area can be quite hot at sunny days as they use open space design, which means air-cons isn't very effective at cooling down the place. Staff - Friendly and prepare to help. Service is good, all waiter and waitress gets to the customers as soon as we raised our hand. However, meal preparing is taking quite some time. Food - Must try their gourmet burgers, I ordered the Peanut Butter Burger and its absolutely delicious. However, you should only get their burgers and other entrees. The ala-carte snacks is quite disastrous. I ordered a snack of fries and it is bitter and soggy, not crispy at all. Beverage even worse, overpriced and poorly made. Earl Grey tea is served before the teabag completely infuses the water. Ice chocolate feels like a mouthful of mud without flavor. They served it with the cocoa powder doesn't even dissolve yet, and maybe they forget the sugar. Overall, its recommended to come here, chill and rest while take some photos and try out their burgers but definitely avoid the snacks and drinks. Show less

Author: OlliechinSingapore, Singapore
Title: Great place to chill
Review: We were the first customers at this industrial themed cafe. The flat-white and latte was good. We sat and read books for hours, surfed the net w strong wifi without being disturbed, it was a great place to just chill and unwind! Didnt try their mains but seems like a pretty healthy selection they have there. Show less

Author: dreamofmarthaPerth, Australia
Title: Awesome Burger, Awesome Coffee
Review: My partner and I are coffee lover, we always look for good place to enjoy fine coffee in every trip that we did. In Penang, Awesome Canteen at Sekeping Victoria is enough to make us satisfy with their V60 Colombian coffee that we ordered. However, the best moment that we couldn't forget from this place is when we tried their traditional burger. It was so delicious! Must visit!The interior also really cool.Show less

Author: PoppyPotatoeSingapore, Singapore
Title: Super pretty dining place
Review: This is such a pretty cafe! With trees and nice furniture. I also found some cute postcards by their door. It's a bit hidden - I just chanced upon it on Google map when I was thinking of heading to Chinahouse!They have a paleo diet menu, which I thought was interesting and I had the 200g chicken patty. Really good and I couldn't even finish it - had to give some to a friend!Drinks are good but I thought a bit pricey.Show less

Author: araiwatBerlin, Germany
Title: Must visit
Review: If you looking for bunch and coffee shop don't miss any reason good place for relaxing and enjoy eating with your friends or by yourself, Awesome canteen of of the choice in Penang cafe, Decorated with mordern style and cozy, the price of food costly a bit but it valuable for your money to pay them! GOOD PLACE!!! Show less

Author: helenfann1Penang Island, Malaysia
Title: Wonderful menu
Review: A really rustic and unusual place to eat. This place is great is your health conscious and like to feel good about what your eating. One of the best burgers out there! An open kitchen so you can see the cleanliness and watch it all being prepared.Show less

Author: fflipped
Title: Decent food but slow service
Review:
Food was decent and coffee was quite good. Interesting industrial themed interior deco with trees growing inside the building amongst the tables too. 

But the salad I ordered took half an hour to prepare during none peak hours (4pm) and when it was not crowded.

Author: David MLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Hackney in Georgetown in a good way
Review: My partner and I enjoyed a really excellent cappuccino and black tonic in awesome canteen. Awesome indeed. Achingly cool interior, all concrete and slurried brickwork (and trees) with what looked like bedrooms above. Watched 5 artists curating a show for the evening (how many artists does it take to hang a painting?!) excellent service and friendly bearded staff. Going back for paleolithic dinner tomorrow..! Show less

Author: PaulO3291
Title: Food huge huge disappointment
Review: After seeing great reviews for this place I was excited to go visit and see for myself being a paleoist!!...the premises and interior is very unique spacious and very ambient very comfortable for lounging and relaxing...however when I ordered a very hot coffee emphasis on "hot" it came to me warm and typically rushed and that was just the start...I ordered the rosemary paleo chicken for my lunch...having just reviewed the book cafe with their spectacular meal last week..I thought I was on par with my order!!...I couldn't have been more disappointed two disgusting greasy fatty chicken chops!!..yes cheap nasty chicken chops!! came out on a plate with drenched vinegar salad one small portobello mushroom cut in slices!!!..no even a hint of rosemary it was truly terrible a complete ripoff...the staff were pleasant so I did not want to make fuss as I would have gone off and made a unnecessary scene... I just payed and left and it was more expensive than...the book cafe...bottom line great unique building and interior design perhaps a sociable place for chat and coffee..but no experience in the kitchen and needs serious experience on paleo cooking before advertising it and serving a cheap hawker stand chicken chop...insulted!!..and will never participate again..I still feel cheated!!..Show less

Author: LovelySR
Title: Gathering
Review: The cafe serves healthy meals but they are very expensive. Drinks are not worth it for the size served. Ordered the Paleo fish. Tasted quite nice just the sauce is not enough.

Author: iammichhhKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: They Have Gluten Free Option!
Review: My family and I visited this place a few days ago. It was a memorable experience. I really love the ambiance and the layout of this café. Besides that, the staffs were really helpful and friendly. One of the most exciting moments was when I found out that they offer gluten free food items. I am allergic to gluten and I have yet to find cafés with gluten free options. Therefore, I want to give this café a huge shoutout! They also have a small booth in front of the café which sells postcards. I am a big fan of postcards, so it was really great to be able to go to a café and also purchase something that I really like. 2 in 1! How awesome is that? No wonder they are named <Awesome Canteen>. Come and see it for yourself!Show less

Author: PieGuts101Perth, Australia
Title: Great Lunch
Review: We had a great Lunch today with great service. I had a cold coffee with tonic . It blew my mind. I also had the chefs salad , which turned out nothing like I thought. But was still very tasty . The wife had a peanut butter chicken burger and the kids a beef burger, we had a serve of sweet potato chips and the kids had chilled berry tea. Funky fit out. We loved itShow less

Author: SpyGirlTravellerSingapore, Singapore
Title: Paleo Food!! Rustic, high ceilings
Review: Wow! Amid all that hawker fare in Penang, I never expected to find Paleo food, that was great-tasting in generous portions! I had a freshly-squeezed orange juice, with a generous garden salad (small size was nearly a meal for me!) and a minced beef with eggplant main, all for RM 30! That's less than USD 7! Nice atmosphere! I've got to try their espresso soon too.Show less

Author: megac2014Jakarta, Indonesia
Title: nice ambience to hang out
Review: I definitely love this place though it feels like entering an unfinished building, but the concept is excellent ! You won't believe what you see once you step in to the room, since the front door is quite small, but the place is quite big inside. The meal is quite good, the coffee is great and you can hang out with almost everyone, you name it. Family, friends, spouse, or even going solo! Must try!Show less

Author: koshpatPenang, Malaysia
Title: Good to try once
Review: Penang has so many restaurants you'd probably not visit the same place twice. A cozy place to dine and have fun with friends. Welcoming service crew, okay food and a good place to hang out if you only want some cakes and drinks or even a proper dinner.Parking could be the main problem because this is a heritage area.. all the best :DShow less

Author: michavanlin
Title: Xmas
Review: Chicken patty with advocado salsa is awesome. Too much sause on chicken burger. Overall ok experience.

Author: goldenspoon
Title: Very good coffee and service
Review: I came over from China House, and what a difference! It is more hipster, the coffee is better, it is less crowded (certainly deserving of more attention) and a nicer place to chill with your mates!

Author: hcfoo
Title: Paleo delights, aromatic coffee, rustic interior
Review: We came here several times for its coffee but have never tried their food before. Paleo meals are rarely found on the menus in Malaysia. We ordered Paleo beef burger (with salad, pumpkins and guacamole dip) and rosemary chicken and it didn't disappoint. However list...More

Author: AshieddieIbrahim
Title: I love the ambience
Review: And old shop houses converted into a chic restaurant. I like how it was deco and the food was good to me. I had paleo butterfish and it taste just great

Author: Rosie R
Title: Chillin' in a paleo paradise
Review:
Stumbled across this delightful little cafe/restaurant when we were doing a street art tour in Georgetown. We popped in for a piece of cake and a coffee, and we were delighted to be able to try some new things we'd never had before!

We had...More

Author: Declanj51
Title: 1st visit & I will be back.......
Review: Yes it was my very 1st visit to this place & I will need to come back to try some of the other yummy things on the menu........was a group of 9 so plenty of food ordered........had the 200 chicken, its a chicken patty with...More

Author: hate1tenshai
Title: hipster
Review: if you are travel with friends or girlfriend/boyfriend this is your place to hang out but do not expect to have a strong connection wifi here,very suck only the wifi overall this is a nice place to hang out

Author: tracyalways
Title: Good place for idling n relax
Review:
A good choice if u've already sated with the local street food here.
The handcrafted filter coffee is real n paleo beef burger is also wonderful～

Author: Solosky2013
Title: Love it!
Review: Great atmosphere. I love the Japanese cold brew coffee and the mushroom Swiss cheese beef burger! Delicious!

Author: citylovers2015
Title: Unexpected !!
Review:
We have just finished an excellent meal at Awesome Canteen.
The exterior looks very small but opens into a well designed industrial feeling space. 
The food was an interesting option to the traditional George Town fare.
We will be back before we leave .

Author: Fangqi_A
Title: Great place to chill and relax
Review: Had mocha and cappucino both with lovely latte art. Loved the unique deco of spacious café and the friendly service.  A great place to relax and just chill with friends after exploring Georgetown.

Author: awanderingeyeMalaysia
Title: Picturesque and Paleo - what more could you ask for
Review: It's unique to find a restaurant which serves a Paleo menu, though they also have non-paleo choices. Kudos for this healthy offering! Ordered the chicken paleo burger (sans the carbs), big breakfast, chicken burger and a rosemary grilled chicken. All tasty and good. The cafe is located in the same building as Sekeping Victoria and the interiors are minimal, rustic and true to its roots. Natural light is abundant through the original skylight of the house, with naturally seasoned walls and floors. Great for photography.Show less

Author: Audrey Adella USabah, Malaysia
Title: An Oasis
Review: I wandered into Awesome Canteen one very hot afternoon to get an iced drink. I liked the decor and the bare industrial style, and how spacious the space is. I loved how the entrance is covered andovergrown with green plants!Unfortunately they ran out of the drink I wanted so I settled for some iced tea. I would come here again next time to try out the food.Service staff was very friendly, polite and efficient. Thumbs up!Show less

Author: JimC619Spencers Wood, United Kingdom
Title: Not so awesome restaurant
Review: My girlfriend had read rated reviews for the decor and food at this restaurant and our first night in Penang on our trip through Malaysia. on the outside it was almost impossible to get in with cars and bikes squeezed together making access ponderous. We were given a choice of tables and menus. That's where I thought it went downhill. no explanation of this paleo concept and left us. 10 to 15 mins no one came back. we had to find someone to order food and drink. I wasn't impressed as we were starving. Given there were 3 tables of diners service was shocking. we ordered the paleo chicken and normal beefburger. A small menu but it encompassed the food groups on both paleo and non paleo. we didn't wait too long give me so few diners in. but not even napkins are offered unless you ask. A bit shoddy really since the cutlery is on the tables in a small bucket room reinforce the urban nature. Food was fine you have to go grab your own condiments. Part of this hip thing? We finished our food and no one around service side. I was pretty disappointed at such a lack of service as no one came to clear up or ask whether we wanted anything else. we walked back to the cashier...apathy isn't the word as they looked so disinterested in serving as they looked at their phones. It has a concept just poorly executed. I wouldn't go back there if it was like that again in a hurry.Show less

Author: PostcardsFromPD
Title: Awesome - Outdoor indoor feel with great menu
Review: Kitcsh and quirkly instacafe stay place. Paleo menu options. A small vegetarian selection. Very tasty veggie burger. Good coffee. Setting is beautiful. Service was good.

Author: KLMel
Title: Great decor, atmosphere, great drinks, great air con :)
Review: What an oasis in the middle of Georgetown! A welcome cool break and cold drink during our exploration of the area. Loved the iced chocolate and... just sitting enjoying the sleek architecture and friendly service.

Author: brommie-diverPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Paleo diet followers rejoice!
Review: Previous reviewers mentioned about Sekeping Victoria's stripped-down retro, ultra minimalist decor–a unique concept by the architect, Ng Sek San. I like its ambience-good crowd, good vibrant energy.But what I love most about Awesome Canteen is its Paleo Burger. Its beef patty is thick, juicy and so tasty. Absence of bread is virtually unnoticeable; you'd probably be busy munching on its salad and sweet potatoes. Yummm! The menu is quite extensive and seems to cater for Paleo diet followers–perhaps the first restaurant in Penang?Show less

Author: HildaYeh
Title: Awesome place to chill out
Review: Friendly staff around provide nice service.  The food over there was worth it's value.  Jut go and grab one avocado& banana smoothie!

Author: niikiiiicnn
Title: What a place
Review: We were there in a big group, around 25 of us.We made reservation a day before and everything was nicely set up for us (was happy to know that).The food was better than we thought, well not the pasta.. Which is slightly sweet... Like weird sweet.Anyway, the rest of us ordered chicken, butterfish, salmon with rice, salad... And we absolutely loved it The must try is their coffee and ice chocolate ! Yumyum ~~The staff were nice, a lot of them working, pretty cool decorations It is just a nice chill placeShow less

Author: William W
Title: Rustic ecstatic, cold service, dry food and coffee
Review: A magnificent piece of rustic architecture. One would experience and enjoy it's culture through what remains; of bare walls and original structural timber rafters. The setting and ambience whispers tranquility, urging one to just relax and leave the stressful world behind. One thing I especially love about the architecture is the way they integrated a modern sense and nature (some trees from holes on the cement flooring) into an old piece of space. However, coffee seems to have been made from what can only be perceived as over roasted or burnt beans. Presentation of cakes and the combination of ingredients are very interesting, but very, very dry. Staff are cold and one you may want to avoid as much as possible to enjoy your surrounding and the ecstatics of the cafe. Overall; 3.6/5Show less

Author: verbijsterdMaastricht, The Netherlands
Title: Good coffee
Review: We only stopped over for coffee. Glad we did! Good selection of beans for a proper brew and tasty cappuccino. The barista did not have enough beans for a full brew, so instead offered to prepare two separate smaller cups. Also try their refreshing drink, the name of which I forgot (Jon something?).Show less

Author: Joke L
Title: Great place to chilled out all day
Review: Nice cafe with loft design. You can stay here and enjoy your food and drink all day. Let try this mocktails "special slush". If you are the mango lovers, it's worth to try.

Author: beccq2014
Title: Just awesome
Review: Awesome staff, awesome decor, awesome location and most importantly awesome coffee. Try the cold brew coffee made with honey!

Author: Jeidosharky
Title: Awesome
Review: It's just what it has been named! Awesome coffee, awesome ambient, awesome cake, awesome seats. What's not awesome about this cafe I can't think any for now.

Author: hkaidolaven
Title: The new special in its own way - My new favorite in town: Cozy, Quiet, Relax
Review: Great coffees. Nice food. Try the recommended one in the menu. The interior is special with a hints of natural wind-down ambiance.

Author: Davidlye70Singapore, Singapore
Title: Quaint rustic cafe in old Georgetown
Review: Set within an old house, Awesome Canteen has a few bedrooms for bed and breakfast.It is mainly a cafe for lunch and dinner, closed on Tuesday.Its main attraction is its setting which is aged. However it can do with better air conditioning which can reduce flies. The service staff is young and keen but can be more proactive. Their reticence may relate to language.Food portion is on small side but flavours are above average to good. Fish fillet burger is nothing to write home about. Awesome chicken is big in serving. The Japanese curry rice with chicken patty and sunny side up is tasty but dainty in serving.Coffee is excellent. Key lime tart good.Show less

Author: JoelchuPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: A cool place to chill from the hustle and bustle of Georgetown
Review: Walking in the heat, sweat dropping profusely, this is a place to stop if your near the murals of armenian street. Protected from the heat the decor mimics of an old warehouse laden with furniture made out of steel cages. The owners kept it cool with greenery around making the place green and cool . Stopping it at that the food is awesome . I would say it would be one of the better places that I have dined at so far where you could just chill in shorts . Don't just take my word for it check it out Show less

Author: lihshyy
Title: Awesome!
Review:
Awesome coffee with awesome environment. Friendly barista.
Surprisingly they do have 2 multi beds dorm for rent, recommend for travellers (4-6persons). Strategic location to all street art and food.

Author: RoyF31Newark-on-Trent, United Kingdom
Title: Delicious Food
Review: The word "awesome" I always consider is grossly overused by Americans to perhaps that is the focus of the marketing.We came across this canteen by accident looking for somewhere else and it is a strange building with trees growing in the middle of it and a eclectic mix of furniture in a building like a wharehouse.However, the food was unusual in the combination of vegetables and was delicious, freshly prepared and very tasty. One of the delights of George Town is coming across places like this. It is worth a visit and the service was good.Show less

Author: cheryloas
Title: Average coffee
Review: Average coffee and quite few choices of coffee. Environment was good though. Parking is quite limited.

Author: Hyoga83Bordeaux, France
Title: Cool place
Review: Loved the history and ambiance of George Town, but sometimes its good to change the déco. This place is great for taking a drink in a modern, industrial building. The look is rugged, with concrete and cement finishings, high ceilings and even trees!For 12 rm I tried my first cascara tea; real tasty and interesting, with a plum aftertaste. Another 12 rm for a not overly sweet chocolate cake with Guiness. Delicious. 8 rm for a nutmeg/lemon ice tea...Food seemed to expensive for backpackers like us but sounded goodShow less

Author: J_Tan_KLKuala Lumpur
Title: All style no substance
Review: Impressed by the photos of this place, I ventured on my own for a dining experience. Restaurant was not even half full. Ordered a simple pasta and a minty drink. Food came 45 minutes later and it wasnt even good. I do really wonder whats so awesome about this place. Much better f&b establishments around the area. I would suggest not to waste ur time on this one.Show less

Author: 781jacekpSingapore, Singapore
Title: Great desserts!
Review: Had one dinner there - burger. Cannot complain, very decent taste and size.However the key in Awesome Canteen is dessert - during 3 days stay had dessert there 3 times. Could not resist not going back and each day they have different special on the menu. Plus interior design is just great and hip.Show less

Author: tinesimanjuntakBandung, Indonesia
Title: Totally Awesome
Review: I was looking for any recommended coffee shop in PG and accidentally found Awesome Canteen. I really love the way they reused an old rusty building to be a nice and cozy coffee shop. I love my Rwanda pour-over. The waiter asked me to try the lime pie and it was totally delicious. Barista was also nice and friendly. It's a must to visit this place if you visit Georgetown.Show less

Author: LAFoong
Title: Cool ambiance and pretty good food!
Review: The Japanese curry with chicken patty was tasty although portions are pretty small. Most interesting is the experience of being in such a rustic environment of up-cycled furniture and feeling a bit closer to nature.

Author: LilyanaAzizPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Yup. Always good.
Review: Am not sure if you know of this little place called Awesome Canteen. On Victoria Street, George Town, Penang Island, Malaysia. Industrially, eccentrically, environmentally friendly . With a kick *ss healthy menu, do you know the Paleo diet? It encourages food naturally cooked using all the most naturally happy ingredients that your little vulnerable body will need to keep it healthy and jolly. Staff are kind. And helpful . And all smiles . Be kind in return. Try the grilled chunky butterfish. With a side of greens and grilled sweet tapioca, or sweet potato, not sure which... But it's all good. My partner had the blue cheese grilled burger, nicely proportioned. Tasty. Maybe he should have asked for medium. Dessert . Yumm. Get a slice of Key Lime Cake. Take a look around, scrappy wilting walls, all adds to the mystery of Unesco Heritage George Town. The trees, it's a statement. Don't forget, we need green. Either to devour and/or to survive. Be Eco . Their coffee kicks *ss too, FYI. Show less

Author: B W
Title: Cool in both senses of the word 😎
Review: Stopped here on a boiling hot day. V hipster and a bit exxy but the drinks are off the hook. Cool cucumber (13 ringgit) is THE MOST REFRESHING DRINK OF ALL TIME.  All time. If you're near Armenian st give it a crack.

Author: walkingchimney
Title: Beautiful people at awesome!
Review:
Great for Paleo!
Good atmosphere
Not cheap but reasonable!
Refreshing n fresh
Spacious and not noisy
Free wifi
Friendly and clean

Author: horhoruwm
Title: Pretty cool place
Review: Very cool and hip place to hang out and have meals with friends. Food is quite decent - we had burger, spaghetti, nasi goreng, sweet potato fries and Japanese curry rice. Coffee is very good as well.

Author: TmenziesJakarta, Indonesia
Title: Don't Walk Past!
Review: This is a great concept with a wonderful take on an 'industrial' architecture. The front is a little plain and hard to spot in the day time - so don't miss it by mistake!There is a small coffee/cake shop as you enter, and then the main event - a completely empty space created by gutting two shophouses. Housed in this 'warehouse' is a semi open kitchen, very spacious seating, and trees!The menu is short, but includes a number of interesting options - including paleo... We went for the 'awesome salmon' and the (non paleo) blue cheese burger, both of which were cooked perfectly and very tasty.Definitely one to visit, even if just to experience the space...Show less

Author: Eileen LMetro Manila, Philippines
Title: Charming and inspiring
Review: The trend towards green architecture has spawned a lot of hype but this 'chain' of projects by the same landscape architect behind Sekeping Melayu and the even more inspiring ones in the forest like the one at Ipoh really get your mind ticking. Really intelligent use of materials and space. There is hope for humanity yet 8-)Show less

Author: Wally SGalle, Sri Lanka
Title: Architectural simplicity, dining unimpressive.
Review: In an inspiring space, service is slow and unimpressive.Offering a Paleo option in several forms makes a great change from what everyone else is doing. It's just not done in such a way that you walk out a raving fan. Mains RM19-45, meat meals over RM40. Show less

Author: Melvin_GuoSingapore, Singapore
Title: An unique place worth exploring for food
Review: You'll be greeted by friendly staff and an unique environment which taps on the building's appearance of rusticity. The menu does not offer a lot of food choices however the portion for each serving is quite big. However the side dishes portion is rather small, especially french fries which my friends and I almost forgot that we had munched on any.They also offer b&b accomodation for travellers.Show less

Author: hxhxhx
Title: Nice cafe to chill
Review: mushroom burger is nice here, the cafe is very spacious with a rustic charm. There is a good selection of cakes with unique flavors.

Author: m888gggSydney, Australia
Title: Unforgettable Peanut Butter Burgers
Review: A year ago, I visited Penang and my friends bought me a take away peanut butter burger, it was so delicious when I visited Penang again this year, I had a craving for the taste again, and the taste was every bit as good as I remembered. This time, 11 of us had that ‘burger moment’ at the canteen together. Chicken and vegetarian versions available, and just as delicious.Show less

Author: MaureenO608
Title: Someone recommended this
Review: Someone recommended this place, I had a few hours to kill in the island, look on tripadvisor and the opening hours and it was stated 10am on a Saturday morning. 7 of us arrived at 1037am after a long walk with 4 children, we were told they open at 11am. I asked if we could sit down and wait for 30 mins inside since tripadvisor lead us there with the faulty opening time and the children were tired from walking. A lady at the door reluctantly agreed, 15 mins later a guy in glasses arrived, walked straight to out table trying to wipe it rudely, I felt I been asked to go.I asked him do you want us to leave? He said is up to you go if you want to because you forced yourself in! I explain that the tripadvisor bit he said well they can published what they like is not within our control they open at 11am.With an attitude larger than life, he chased four 7 years old children out along with 3 adult and showcase to the young children there’s no compassion and courtesy in this world. I think this is ‘preposterous. My 7 years old walked out and asked and I think she send the ship back to shore ‘ are Penang people all this rude!’ Show less

Author: SarahChermaine03Singapore, Singapore
Title: Spacious comfortable place to chill
Review: Only ordered the coffee - Iced Long black & Black tonic. I love the black tonic - it tastes like soda more than coffee & it’s refreshing!!! I could finish it in a glup! The service were a little tad slow but because there was a big group. Staff are friendly & patient. I love the ambience - despite the crowd, I love the privacy of my space. My husband & I had thoroughly enjoyed our quiet time there! Will be back to try the foodShow less

Author: lorraine164
Title: Lunch
Review: A nice hidden cafe for lunch. Food was good but slow. Clean and good food choices. Staff were friendly.

Author: joyceroxanne
Title: Best Burger in Georgetown
Review: Amazing vibes, great food and coffee. I liked how they have a Paleo Menu. We were thrilled with the cafe’s interior - the space is filled with repurposed industrial made chairs, canteen style metal table and chairs. We enjoyed the dining experience so much that we came back again for coffee, nutmeg lemon drink, and other bites. Show less

Author: klotikyRa
Title: Oooh—some vintage!
Review: it was good, loved the tiramisu but didnt like my mocha. not a fan of cocoa powder in a mocha. So far i enjoyed the vintagey bldg that turns into an oooh—some canteen☺️😎

Author: lanlan987
Title: Nice place to hang out for afternoon coffee
Review: The latte is kind of special and is a good try if you want to have something special. The environment is relax and a good place to have chat and gathering.

Author: NgKS9368
Title: Dinner
Review: First time been there & love the simple set up. They also maintained trees inside the building. You feel relaxed when you sitting inside the cafe while enjoying the food.

Author: James M
Title: Best burger in Penang
Review: I've tried alot: Rik's, spades, burger society, flip, Johnny rockets, viva, Tom's, junk, a host of stalls... Awesome is in front.The patty here is exceptional. Soft, flavourful, well seasoned and well cooked. The bun is soft and fresh. Accessories are fresh and well balanced. Great burger. My favourite in Penang at the time of writing.The place itself is a bit weird, indoors, trees growing indoors, very concrete vibe. Might not suit a local family, but for out of towners it's a great choice. Show less

Author: Raa-S-25
Title: Sophisticated atmosphere
Review:
There are many choices of cheesecake, and I ordered rum raisin cheesecake and mint ice tea. Total MYR 21.
The cheesecake was neither rich or creamy, it was so-so, but inside decoration and atmosphere were really good!

Author: dominicf330Penang Island, Malaysia
Title: Worst beef patty
Review: The so called ‘grass-fed’ beef is no different from the ones in MC D in terms of taste and quality, and I have never in my life have to spit out burger patty because there’s just so much (at least 70%) of rubber texture ligament. The portion has been reduced, not to mention some key ingredients taken out from the dish itself , no guacamole salsa on the dish and didn’t bother to address or add in alternatives until it was pointed out by customer. For a cafe that promotes healthy choices and diet but serves such poor quality and contradicting food is utterly disappointing . Show less

Author: kostam2015
Title: Can be better ... Service + Kitchen Low profile
Review:
Unfortunately for us/them,

Service was extremely slow .. where not fully booked (2-3 occupied tables). 

Food is average according the image the restaurant tries to display. Portions are not the same when served. 

Infrastructure is ok, but cold .. 

They can do better !

Author: mikeybbakerLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Great hipster cafe
Review: Whilst walking around Penang I came across this cool cafe or should I say awsome cafe , I stopped here for breakfast and I had a delicious cup of coffee followed by a chicken salad which was really tasty and a great portion too . If your around this area go have something to drink or eat , the decor is really cool inside too and I believe you can also stay the night as they have like 1-2 rooms from what I saw . Show less

Author: ChangBoris
Title: Very happening...Must visit.
Review: Very lively place to be. Cakes, food, drinks and live band. Super perfect all day and night long... Very creative way to convert all this old shop lots. Must visit.

Author: Meall MBangkok, Thailand
Title: Amazing cold brew coffee!
Review: After I test it, I forgot every cold brew coffee that I ate in my life!!It's really nice, I love smell and taste. We can rest and cool down from weather that so hot outside. We also order a Red Wine Chocolate Cake, that matching with cold brew coffee it's good but not so Wow!Show less

Author: Miike2000Brisbane, Australia
Title: How funky and authentic
Review: We stumbled over the place after having lunch at Chew Jetty , what a neat place for a coffee. It has high ceilings and trees growing inside. It's an old warehouse made into a coffee shop in front and restaurant in back. It's very recycled, the type of place which makes you feel good because of its appearance.Show less

Author: gilasss
Title: Interesting find!
Review: Surprise find at Lebuh Victoria street. It has the dilapidated industrial look with a different feel from what one expects from the crop of chic cafes sprouting up all over Penang. I loved the way the deliberately abandoned industrial chic is juxtaposed with nature... there are trees growing in the courtyard. The friendly staff reccomended a good choices of paelio organic menu and a sufficiently interesting drinks lost to chill from the scorching sun. Nice enough bar food and drinks. A good place for a lazy afternoon.Show less

Author: Shelley M
Title: Smallest iced Latte
Review: I would not order an Iced Latte from there again. I received the smallest iced drink I have ever had in any cafe. I drunk it in about two sips. For £2 this is a huge disappointment and very over priced.

Author: safitrirahayuGeorge Town, Malaysia
Title: Healthy food , healthy restaurant
Review: Very good restaurant , all menu are using organic ingredients , so very good to our healthy .. the taste its sooo delicious .. although the price is little bit high , but it’s ok , that’s whort it !! I will be back again ..Show less

Author: Mchan71Singapore, Singapore
Title: Food poisoning from an "awesome" place
Review: We chanced upon raving reviews about this place and hence on the last day of my trip. Me and 2 of my friends made a trip there to Awesome Canteen. The place was indeed unique. Nice big cafe with rustic looking furnitures. It was quite warm there and we have to request to switch on the fan.I ordered the Mushroom Aglio Olio and a iced latte for lunch. We also order sweet potato fries to share and each of us had our own drink. Sad to say that the food was average and they could use more salt as it was quite bland. The kitchen is visible and crews are snacking in the kitchen. Not a good sight in front of guest I think..Unfortunately, I had severe food poisoning in the night and we are certain that it's from the Mushroom Aglio Olio I shared with my 1 other friend as she also suffered from food poisoning. She left after the meal as she had an earlier flight to catch. Sadly, the experience is not so awesome after all :(Show less

Author: PreveenaBalakrishnan
Title: A sekeping(piece) of happiness!
Review: Loved the settings.. creative! their food was good.I love their avocado with cream sour paste!  The staffs are friendly too... Their concept is quite unique as well

Author: Eric L
Title: Truly an awesome place
Review: The place has industrial interior design, which I appreciate very much. The staff was friendly and helpful, offered meals simple and tasty, inspired by local cuisine.

Author: aroundthenextcorner4
Title: Awesome Cakes!
Review: This was the go to place for cake and tea for my husband and I during our two months in Penang. The old warehouse created a comfortable environment for quiet afternoon conversations. The staff were very nice and the home-made cakes were terrific.

Author: Joyce C
Title: Rude waitress
Review: They have one of the worst waitress there. Not only she show that she is annoyed but also super sarcastic in the way she talk. So bad.. worse waitress experience ever..

Author: 401christophhErfurt, Germany
Title: Stylish cafe/restaurant
Review: For everybody that likes industrial design, this would be the place to go to in Georgetown. The coffee is great as is the food. And their food definitely has got a twist. Bowls with mackerel, vegetables and tasty dressing, salads are amazing as well. The staff was very attentive and friendly! We loved it and do highly recommend!Show less

Author: Jacelyn L
Title: Awesome industrial chic cafe
Review: Surprise find when we turned the corner and ended up at Lebuh Victoria street. It has the industrial zen look with a different feel. The friendly staff reccomended us good choices of coolers to chill from the scorching sun. Nice coolers and orange cake. Reasonable price and good place for a long chat.Show less

Author: HKB2011
Title: Awesome find and fabulous smoothies
Review: Great find and perfect smoothie stop after wandering around the jetties... great place to hang out and cool done...

Author: pingpingjoKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Awesome Ambiance & Awesome Food
Review: It's an awesome chill and eat place attached to Sekeping Victoria - which is already pretty cool. Airy, spacious and feel-good-and-healthy food. The menu offers paleo-diet options which simply put, unprocessed food. I had a Paleo Chicken Burger which tasted as good as it looked.Tips/Notes :Awesome Canteen offers desserts too, and they looked great however old habits die hard so I went over to China House for my usual sweet fix :) Show less

Author: hadimukhriz
Title: First Cafe visit in Penang
Review: The place have amazing ambience with an industrial look. Awesome place to hangout after a heavy meal.

Author: JimmyC3092
Title: High Tea
Review: Nice and Relax place for gathering . Artistic and awesome.  Delicious lemon cake. Just feel bit hot in afternoon.

Author: LiJuanW4
Title: This review is for Pasta Lovers!
Review: Really love their cream pasta here! Would recommend their carbonara with turkey bacon to all cream pasta lovers! The thick cream, Mmm~ I'll be back here for this pasta if I were to come back again! Their Nutmeg drink has a refreshing 'tangerine' taste! :)

Author: JanaK123Penang Island, Malaysia
Title: Great Burgers
Review: Our family went here and really enjoyed the gourmet burgers. We arrived a few minutes before 6pm and the kitchen didn't open until 6 so we did not get our food until after 6:30. The food was really good though, and we enjoyed the atmosphere. Also, it was nice that there was lots of seating as many of the little cafes are limited in that area.Show less

Author: heyitsemilyKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Food not bad
Review: The coffee is a bit small in size, the desserts & food itself s pretty decent and delicious. However the environment & the seating itself is very uncomfortable, maybe they are trying to have a layback vintage style but it seems more like low on budget and abandon house style, as if they are lazy to furnish a little bit and use nicer tables and stools. Show less

Author: khaosk9Penang Island, Malaysia
Title: Great Burger, forget the rest.
Review: Atmosphere - Open space with tree indoors, the main attractive point of this place, giving people a nostalgia feelings, furnitures are made of steel and woods, felt like eating in 70's buildings. The area can be quite hot at sunny days as they use open space design, which means air-cons isn't very effective at cooling down the place. Staff - Friendly and prepare to help. Service is good, all waiter and waitress gets to the customers as soon as we raised our hand. However, meal preparing is taking quite some time. Food - Must try their gourmet burgers, I ordered the Peanut Butter Burger and its absolutely delicious. However, you should only get their burgers and other entrees. The ala-carte snacks is quite disastrous. I ordered a snack of fries and it is bitter and soggy, not crispy at all. Beverage even worse, overpriced and poorly made. Earl Grey tea is served before the teabag completely infuses the water. Ice chocolate feels like a mouthful of mud without flavor. They served it with the cocoa powder doesn't even dissolve yet, and maybe they forget the sugar. Overall, its recommended to come here, chill and rest while take some photos and try out their burgers but definitely avoid the snacks and drinks. Show less

Author: OlliechinSingapore, Singapore
Title: Great place to chill
Review: We were the first customers at this industrial themed cafe. The flat-white and latte was good. We sat and read books for hours, surfed the net w strong wifi without being disturbed, it was a great place to just chill and unwind! Didnt try their mains but seems like a pretty healthy selection they have there. Show less

Author: dreamofmarthaPerth, Australia
Title: Awesome Burger, Awesome Coffee
Review: My partner and I are coffee lover, we always look for good place to enjoy fine coffee in every trip that we did. In Penang, Awesome Canteen at Sekeping Victoria is enough to make us satisfy with their V60 Colombian coffee that we ordered. However, the best moment that we couldn't forget from this place is when we tried their traditional burger. It was so delicious! Must visit!The interior also really cool.Show less

Author: PoppyPotatoeSingapore, Singapore
Title: Super pretty dining place
Review: This is such a pretty cafe! With trees and nice furniture. I also found some cute postcards by their door. It's a bit hidden - I just chanced upon it on Google map when I was thinking of heading to Chinahouse!They have a paleo diet menu, which I thought was interesting and I had the 200g chicken patty. Really good and I couldn't even finish it - had to give some to a friend!Drinks are good but I thought a bit pricey.Show less

Author: araiwatBerlin, Germany
Title: Must visit
Review: If you looking for bunch and coffee shop don't miss any reason good place for relaxing and enjoy eating with your friends or by yourself, Awesome canteen of of the choice in Penang cafe, Decorated with mordern style and cozy, the price of food costly a bit but it valuable for your money to pay them! GOOD PLACE!!! Show less

Author: helenfann1Penang Island, Malaysia
Title: Wonderful menu
Review: A really rustic and unusual place to eat. This place is great is your health conscious and like to feel good about what your eating. One of the best burgers out there! An open kitchen so you can see the cleanliness and watch it all being prepared.Show less

Author: fflipped
Title: Decent food but slow service
Review:
Food was decent and coffee was quite good. Interesting industrial themed interior deco with trees growing inside the building amongst the tables too. 

But the salad I ordered took half an hour to prepare during none peak hours (4pm) and when it was not crowded.

Author: David MLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Hackney in Georgetown in a good way
Review: My partner and I enjoyed a really excellent cappuccino and black tonic in awesome canteen. Awesome indeed. Achingly cool interior, all concrete and slurried brickwork (and trees) with what looked like bedrooms above. Watched 5 artists curating a show for the evening (how many artists does it take to hang a painting?!) excellent service and friendly bearded staff. Going back for paleolithic dinner tomorrow..! Show less

Author: PaulO3291
Title: Food huge huge disappointment
Review: After seeing great reviews for this place I was excited to go visit and see for myself being a paleoist!!...the premises and interior is very unique spacious and very ambient very comfortable for lounging and relaxing...however when I ordered a very hot coffee emphasis on "hot" it came to me warm and typically rushed and that was just the start...I ordered the rosemary paleo chicken for my lunch...having just reviewed the book cafe with their spectacular meal last week..I thought I was on par with my order!!...I couldn't have been more disappointed two disgusting greasy fatty chicken chops!!..yes cheap nasty chicken chops!! came out on a plate with drenched vinegar salad one small portobello mushroom cut in slices!!!..no even a hint of rosemary it was truly terrible a complete ripoff...the staff were pleasant so I did not want to make fuss as I would have gone off and made a unnecessary scene... I just payed and left and it was more expensive than...the book cafe...bottom line great unique building and interior design perhaps a sociable place for chat and coffee..but no experience in the kitchen and needs serious experience on paleo cooking before advertising it and serving a cheap hawker stand chicken chop...insulted!!..and will never participate again..I still feel cheated!!..Show less

Author: LovelySR
Title: Gathering
Review: The cafe serves healthy meals but they are very expensive. Drinks are not worth it for the size served. Ordered the Paleo fish. Tasted quite nice just the sauce is not enough.

Author: iammichhhKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: They Have Gluten Free Option!
Review: My family and I visited this place a few days ago. It was a memorable experience. I really love the ambiance and the layout of this café. Besides that, the staffs were really helpful and friendly. One of the most exciting moments was when I found out that they offer gluten free food items. I am allergic to gluten and I have yet to find cafés with gluten free options. Therefore, I want to give this café a huge shoutout! They also have a small booth in front of the café which sells postcards. I am a big fan of postcards, so it was really great to be able to go to a café and also purchase something that I really like. 2 in 1! How awesome is that? No wonder they are named <Awesome Canteen>. Come and see it for yourself!Show less

Author: PieGuts101Perth, Australia
Title: Great Lunch
Review: We had a great Lunch today with great service. I had a cold coffee with tonic . It blew my mind. I also had the chefs salad , which turned out nothing like I thought. But was still very tasty . The wife had a peanut butter chicken burger and the kids a beef burger, we had a serve of sweet potato chips and the kids had chilled berry tea. Funky fit out. We loved itShow less

Author: SpyGirlTravellerSingapore, Singapore
Title: Paleo Food!! Rustic, high ceilings
Review: Wow! Amid all that hawker fare in Penang, I never expected to find Paleo food, that was great-tasting in generous portions! I had a freshly-squeezed orange juice, with a generous garden salad (small size was nearly a meal for me!) and a minced beef with eggplant main, all for RM 30! That's less than USD 7! Nice atmosphere! I've got to try their espresso soon too.Show less

Author: megac2014Jakarta, Indonesia
Title: nice ambience to hang out
Review: I definitely love this place though it feels like entering an unfinished building, but the concept is excellent ! You won't believe what you see once you step in to the room, since the front door is quite small, but the place is quite big inside. The meal is quite good, the coffee is great and you can hang out with almost everyone, you name it. Family, friends, spouse, or even going solo! Must try!Show less

Author: koshpatPenang, Malaysia
Title: Good to try once
Review: Penang has so many restaurants you'd probably not visit the same place twice. A cozy place to dine and have fun with friends. Welcoming service crew, okay food and a good place to hang out if you only want some cakes and drinks or even a proper dinner.Parking could be the main problem because this is a heritage area.. all the best :DShow less

Author: michavanlin
Title: Xmas
Review: Chicken patty with advocado salsa is awesome. Too much sause on chicken burger. Overall ok experience.

Author: goldenspoon
Title: Very good coffee and service
Review: I came over from China House, and what a difference! It is more hipster, the coffee is better, it is less crowded (certainly deserving of more attention) and a nicer place to chill with your mates!

Author: hcfoo
Title: Paleo delights, aromatic coffee, rustic interior
Review: We came here several times for its coffee but have never tried their food before. Paleo meals are rarely found on the menus in Malaysia. We ordered Paleo beef burger (with salad, pumpkins and guacamole dip) and rosemary chicken and it didn't disappoint. However list...More

Author: AshieddieIbrahim
Title: I love the ambience
Review: And old shop houses converted into a chic restaurant. I like how it was deco and the food was good to me. I had paleo butterfish and it taste just great

Author: Rosie R
Title: Chillin' in a paleo paradise
Review:
Stumbled across this delightful little cafe/restaurant when we were doing a street art tour in Georgetown. We popped in for a piece of cake and a coffee, and we were delighted to be able to try some new things we'd never had before!

We had...More

Author: Declanj51
Title: 1st visit & I will be back.......
Review: Yes it was my very 1st visit to this place & I will need to come back to try some of the other yummy things on the menu........was a group of 9 so plenty of food ordered........had the 200 chicken, its a chicken patty with...More

Author: hate1tenshai
Title: hipster
Review: if you are travel with friends or girlfriend/boyfriend this is your place to hang out but do not expect to have a strong connection wifi here,very suck only the wifi overall this is a nice place to hang out

Author: tracyalways
Title: Good place for idling n relax
Review:
A good choice if u've already sated with the local street food here.
The handcrafted filter coffee is real n paleo beef burger is also wonderful～

Author: Solosky2013
Title: Love it!
Review: Great atmosphere. I love the Japanese cold brew coffee and the mushroom Swiss cheese beef burger! Delicious!

Author: citylovers2015
Title: Unexpected !!
Review:
We have just finished an excellent meal at Awesome Canteen.
The exterior looks very small but opens into a well designed industrial feeling space. 
The food was an interesting option to the traditional George Town fare.
We will be back before we leave .

Author: Fangqi_A
Title: Great place to chill and relax
Review: Had mocha and cappucino both with lovely latte art. Loved the unique deco of spacious café and the friendly service.  A great place to relax and just chill with friends after exploring Georgetown.

Author: awanderingeyeMalaysia
Title: Picturesque and Paleo - what more could you ask for
Review: It's unique to find a restaurant which serves a Paleo menu, though they also have non-paleo choices. Kudos for this healthy offering! Ordered the chicken paleo burger (sans the carbs), big breakfast, chicken burger and a rosemary grilled chicken. All tasty and good. The cafe is located in the same building as Sekeping Victoria and the interiors are minimal, rustic and true to its roots. Natural light is abundant through the original skylight of the house, with naturally seasoned walls and floors. Great for photography.Show less

Author: Audrey Adella USabah, Malaysia
Title: An Oasis
Review: I wandered into Awesome Canteen one very hot afternoon to get an iced drink. I liked the decor and the bare industrial style, and how spacious the space is. I loved how the entrance is covered andovergrown with green plants!Unfortunately they ran out of the drink I wanted so I settled for some iced tea. I would come here again next time to try out the food.Service staff was very friendly, polite and efficient. Thumbs up!Show less

Author: JimC619Spencers Wood, United Kingdom
Title: Not so awesome restaurant
Review: My girlfriend had read rated reviews for the decor and food at this restaurant and our first night in Penang on our trip through Malaysia. on the outside it was almost impossible to get in with cars and bikes squeezed together making access ponderous. We were given a choice of tables and menus. That's where I thought it went downhill. no explanation of this paleo concept and left us. 10 to 15 mins no one came back. we had to find someone to order food and drink. I wasn't impressed as we were starving. Given there were 3 tables of diners service was shocking. we ordered the paleo chicken and normal beefburger. A small menu but it encompassed the food groups on both paleo and non paleo. we didn't wait too long give me so few diners in. but not even napkins are offered unless you ask. A bit shoddy really since the cutlery is on the tables in a small bucket room reinforce the urban nature. Food was fine you have to go grab your own condiments. Part of this hip thing? We finished our food and no one around service side. I was pretty disappointed at such a lack of service as no one came to clear up or ask whether we wanted anything else. we walked back to the cashier...apathy isn't the word as they looked so disinterested in serving as they looked at their phones. It has a concept just poorly executed. I wouldn't go back there if it was like that again in a hurry.Show less

Author: PostcardsFromPD
Title: Awesome - Outdoor indoor feel with great menu
Review: Kitcsh and quirkly instacafe stay place. Paleo menu options. A small vegetarian selection. Very tasty veggie burger. Good coffee. Setting is beautiful. Service was good.

Author: KLMel
Title: Great decor, atmosphere, great drinks, great air con :)
Review: What an oasis in the middle of Georgetown! A welcome cool break and cold drink during our exploration of the area. Loved the iced chocolate and... just sitting enjoying the sleek architecture and friendly service.

Author: brommie-diverPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Paleo diet followers rejoice!
Review: Previous reviewers mentioned about Sekeping Victoria's stripped-down retro, ultra minimalist decor–a unique concept by the architect, Ng Sek San. I like its ambience-good crowd, good vibrant energy.But what I love most about Awesome Canteen is its Paleo Burger. Its beef patty is thick, juicy and so tasty. Absence of bread is virtually unnoticeable; you'd probably be busy munching on its salad and sweet potatoes. Yummm! The menu is quite extensive and seems to cater for Paleo diet followers–perhaps the first restaurant in Penang?Show less

Author: HildaYeh
Title: Awesome place to chill out
Review: Friendly staff around provide nice service.  The food over there was worth it's value.  Jut go and grab one avocado& banana smoothie!

Author: niikiiiicnn
Title: What a place
Review: We were there in a big group, around 25 of us.We made reservation a day before and everything was nicely set up for us (was happy to know that).The food was better than we thought, well not the pasta.. Which is slightly sweet... Like weird sweet.Anyway, the rest of us ordered chicken, butterfish, salmon with rice, salad... And we absolutely loved it The must try is their coffee and ice chocolate ! Yumyum ~~The staff were nice, a lot of them working, pretty cool decorations It is just a nice chill placeShow less

Author: William W
Title: Rustic ecstatic, cold service, dry food and coffee
Review: A magnificent piece of rustic architecture. One would experience and enjoy it's culture through what remains; of bare walls and original structural timber rafters. The setting and ambience whispers tranquility, urging one to just relax and leave the stressful world behind. One thing I especially love about the architecture is the way they integrated a modern sense and nature (some trees from holes on the cement flooring) into an old piece of space. However, coffee seems to have been made from what can only be perceived as over roasted or burnt beans. Presentation of cakes and the combination of ingredients are very interesting, but very, very dry. Staff are cold and one you may want to avoid as much as possible to enjoy your surrounding and the ecstatics of the cafe. Overall; 3.6/5Show less

Author: verbijsterdMaastricht, The Netherlands
Title: Good coffee
Review: We only stopped over for coffee. Glad we did! Good selection of beans for a proper brew and tasty cappuccino. The barista did not have enough beans for a full brew, so instead offered to prepare two separate smaller cups. Also try their refreshing drink, the name of which I forgot (Jon something?).Show less

Author: Joke L
Title: Great place to chilled out all day
Review: Nice cafe with loft design. You can stay here and enjoy your food and drink all day. Let try this mocktails "special slush". If you are the mango lovers, it's worth to try.

Author: beccq2014
Title: Just awesome
Review: Awesome staff, awesome decor, awesome location and most importantly awesome coffee. Try the cold brew coffee made with honey!

Author: Jeidosharky
Title: Awesome
Review: It's just what it has been named! Awesome coffee, awesome ambient, awesome cake, awesome seats. What's not awesome about this cafe I can't think any for now.

Author: hkaidolaven
Title: The new special in its own way - My new favorite in town: Cozy, Quiet, Relax
Review: Great coffees. Nice food. Try the recommended one in the menu. The interior is special with a hints of natural wind-down ambiance.

Author: Davidlye70Singapore, Singapore
Title: Quaint rustic cafe in old Georgetown
Review: Set within an old house, Awesome Canteen has a few bedrooms for bed and breakfast.It is mainly a cafe for lunch and dinner, closed on Tuesday.Its main attraction is its setting which is aged. However it can do with better air conditioning which can reduce flies. The service staff is young and keen but can be more proactive. Their reticence may relate to language.Food portion is on small side but flavours are above average to good. Fish fillet burger is nothing to write home about. Awesome chicken is big in serving. The Japanese curry rice with chicken patty and sunny side up is tasty but dainty in serving.Coffee is excellent. Key lime tart good.Show less

Author: JoelchuPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: A cool place to chill from the hustle and bustle of Georgetown
Review: Walking in the heat, sweat dropping profusely, this is a place to stop if your near the murals of armenian street. Protected from the heat the decor mimics of an old warehouse laden with furniture made out of steel cages. The owners kept it cool with greenery around making the place green and cool . Stopping it at that the food is awesome . I would say it would be one of the better places that I have dined at so far where you could just chill in shorts . Don't just take my word for it check it out Show less

Author: lihshyy
Title: Awesome!
Review:
Awesome coffee with awesome environment. Friendly barista.
Surprisingly they do have 2 multi beds dorm for rent, recommend for travellers (4-6persons). Strategic location to all street art and food.

Author: RoyF31Newark-on-Trent, United Kingdom
Title: Delicious Food
Review: The word "awesome" I always consider is grossly overused by Americans to perhaps that is the focus of the marketing.We came across this canteen by accident looking for somewhere else and it is a strange building with trees growing in the middle of it and a eclectic mix of furniture in a building like a wharehouse.However, the food was unusual in the combination of vegetables and was delicious, freshly prepared and very tasty. One of the delights of George Town is coming across places like this. It is worth a visit and the service was good.Show less

Author: cheryloas
Title: Average coffee
Review: Average coffee and quite few choices of coffee. Environment was good though. Parking is quite limited.

Author: Hyoga83Bordeaux, France
Title: Cool place
Review: Loved the history and ambiance of George Town, but sometimes its good to change the déco. This place is great for taking a drink in a modern, industrial building. The look is rugged, with concrete and cement finishings, high ceilings and even trees!For 12 rm I tried my first cascara tea; real tasty and interesting, with a plum aftertaste. Another 12 rm for a not overly sweet chocolate cake with Guiness. Delicious. 8 rm for a nutmeg/lemon ice tea...Food seemed to expensive for backpackers like us but sounded goodShow less

Author: J_Tan_KLKuala Lumpur
Title: All style no substance
Review: Impressed by the photos of this place, I ventured on my own for a dining experience. Restaurant was not even half full. Ordered a simple pasta and a minty drink. Food came 45 minutes later and it wasnt even good. I do really wonder whats so awesome about this place. Much better f&b establishments around the area. I would suggest not to waste ur time on this one.Show less

Author: 781jacekpSingapore, Singapore
Title: Great desserts!
Review: Had one dinner there - burger. Cannot complain, very decent taste and size.However the key in Awesome Canteen is dessert - during 3 days stay had dessert there 3 times. Could not resist not going back and each day they have different special on the menu. Plus interior design is just great and hip.Show less

Author: tinesimanjuntakBandung, Indonesia
Title: Totally Awesome
Review: I was looking for any recommended coffee shop in PG and accidentally found Awesome Canteen. I really love the way they reused an old rusty building to be a nice and cozy coffee shop. I love my Rwanda pour-over. The waiter asked me to try the lime pie and it was totally delicious. Barista was also nice and friendly. It's a must to visit this place if you visit Georgetown.Show less

Author: LAFoong
Title: Cool ambiance and pretty good food!
Review: The Japanese curry with chicken patty was tasty although portions are pretty small. Most interesting is the experience of being in such a rustic environment of up-cycled furniture and feeling a bit closer to nature.

Author: LilyanaAzizPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Yup. Always good.
Review: Am not sure if you know of this little place called Awesome Canteen. On Victoria Street, George Town, Penang Island, Malaysia. Industrially, eccentrically, environmentally friendly . With a kick *ss healthy menu, do you know the Paleo diet? It encourages food naturally cooked using all the most naturally happy ingredients that your little vulnerable body will need to keep it healthy and jolly. Staff are kind. And helpful . And all smiles . Be kind in return. Try the grilled chunky butterfish. With a side of greens and grilled sweet tapioca, or sweet potato, not sure which... But it's all good. My partner had the blue cheese grilled burger, nicely proportioned. Tasty. Maybe he should have asked for medium. Dessert . Yumm. Get a slice of Key Lime Cake. Take a look around, scrappy wilting walls, all adds to the mystery of Unesco Heritage George Town. The trees, it's a statement. Don't forget, we need green. Either to devour and/or to survive. Be Eco . Their coffee kicks *ss too, FYI. Show less

Author: B W
Title: Cool in both senses of the word 😎
Review: Stopped here on a boiling hot day. V hipster and a bit exxy but the drinks are off the hook. Cool cucumber (13 ringgit) is THE MOST REFRESHING DRINK OF ALL TIME.  All time. If you're near Armenian st give it a crack.

Author: walkingchimney
Title: Beautiful people at awesome!
Review:
Great for Paleo!
Good atmosphere
Not cheap but reasonable!
Refreshing n fresh
Spacious and not noisy
Free wifi
Friendly and clean

Author: horhoruwm
Title: Pretty cool place
Review: Very cool and hip place to hang out and have meals with friends. Food is quite decent - we had burger, spaghetti, nasi goreng, sweet potato fries and Japanese curry rice. Coffee is very good as well.

Author: TmenziesJakarta, Indonesia
Title: Don't Walk Past!
Review: This is a great concept with a wonderful take on an 'industrial' architecture. The front is a little plain and hard to spot in the day time - so don't miss it by mistake!There is a small coffee/cake shop as you enter, and then the main event - a completely empty space created by gutting two shophouses. Housed in this 'warehouse' is a semi open kitchen, very spacious seating, and trees!The menu is short, but includes a number of interesting options - including paleo... We went for the 'awesome salmon' and the (non paleo) blue cheese burger, both of which were cooked perfectly and very tasty.Definitely one to visit, even if just to experience the space...Show less

Author: Eileen LMetro Manila, Philippines
Title: Charming and inspiring
Review: The trend towards green architecture has spawned a lot of hype but this 'chain' of projects by the same landscape architect behind Sekeping Melayu and the even more inspiring ones in the forest like the one at Ipoh really get your mind ticking. Really intelligent use of materials and space. There is hope for humanity yet 8-)Show less

Author: Wally SGalle, Sri Lanka
Title: Architectural simplicity, dining unimpressive.
Review: In an inspiring space, service is slow and unimpressive.Offering a Paleo option in several forms makes a great change from what everyone else is doing. It's just not done in such a way that you walk out a raving fan. Mains RM19-45, meat meals over RM40. Show less

Author: Melvin_GuoSingapore, Singapore
Title: An unique place worth exploring for food
Review: You'll be greeted by friendly staff and an unique environment which taps on the building's appearance of rusticity. The menu does not offer a lot of food choices however the portion for each serving is quite big. However the side dishes portion is rather small, especially french fries which my friends and I almost forgot that we had munched on any.They also offer b&b accomodation for travellers.Show less
